      calc l1 * linftyNorm z = l1Norm (x - y) * linftyNorm z := by rw [hl1eq]
        _ = ∑ i, |(x - y) i| * linftyNorm z := by simp only [l1Norm, Finset.sum_mul]
        _ = ∑ i, (x - y) i * z i := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => (main i).symm)
        _ = dotp (x - y) z := rfl
    exact le_of_eq heq

end NormFacts

section Compose
variable {n : ℕ}

lemma norm_pack {N : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ} (hN : N = l1Norm ∨ N = l2Norm ∨ N = linftyNorm) :
    (∀ a b, N (a + b) ≤ N a + N b) ∧
      (∀ (c : ℝ) (a : Fin n → ℝ), 0 ≤ c → N (c • a) = c * N a) ∧ N 0 = 0 := by
  rcases hN with h | h | h <;> subst h
  · exact ⟨l1_tri, l1_hom, l1_zero⟩
  · exact ⟨l2_tri, l2_hom, l2_zero⟩
  · exact ⟨linfty_tri, linfty_hom, linfty_zero⟩

lemma prox_facts {N : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ} {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    (htri : ∀ a b, N (a + b) ≤ N a + N b)
    (hhom : ∀ (c : ℝ) (a : Fin n → ℝ), 0 ≤ c → N (c • a) = c * N a)
    (hN0 : N 0 = 0) {x y : Fin n → ℝ} (h : IsProxNorm N lam x y) :
    (∀ v, dotp (x - y) v ≤ lam * N v) ∧ dotp (x - y) y = lam * N y := by
  have hconv := conv_of_tri_hom htri hhom
  have hVI := prox_VI N lam hlam x y hconv h
  have hd := prox_dual hlam htri hVI
  exact ⟨hd, prox_align hN0 hVI hd⟩

lemma dotp_split (x y z u : Fin n → ℝ) :
    dotp (x - z) u = dotp (x - y) u + dotp (y - z) u := by
  simp only [dotp, Pi.sub_apply, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring

lemma prox_compose {N : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ} {l1 l2 : ℝ} (hl1 : 0 ≤ l1) (hl2 : 0 ≤ l2)
    (htri : ∀ a b, N (a + b) ≤ N a + N b)
    (hhom : ∀ (c : ℝ) (a : Fin n → ℝ), 0 ≤ c → N (c • a) = c * N a)
    (hN0 : N 0 = 0) {x y z : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hy : IsProxNorm N l1 x y) (hz : IsProxNorm N l2 y z)
    (hstar : l1 * N z ≤ dotp (x - y) z) : IsProxNorm N (l1 + l2) x z := by
  obtain ⟨hd1, ha1⟩ := prox_facts hl1 htri hhom hN0 hy
  obtain ⟨hd2, ha2⟩ := prox_facts hl2 htri hhom hN0 hz
  apply prox_suff
  · intro u
    rw [dotp_split x y z u]
    have hr : (l1 + l2) * N u = l1 * N u + l2 * N u := by ring
    rw [hr]
    linarith [hd1 u, hd2 u]
  · rw [dotp_split x y z z, ha2]
    have hxy : dotp (x - y) z = l1 * N z := le_antisymm (hd1 z) hstar
    rw [hxy]; ring

lemma star_all {N : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ} (hN : N = l1Norm ∨ N = l2Norm ∨ N = linftyNorm)
    {l1 l2 : ℝ} (hl1 : 0 ≤ l1) (hl2 : 0 ≤ l2) {x y z : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hd1 : ∀ v, dotp (x - y) v ≤ l1 * N v) (ha1 : dotp (x - y) y = l1 * N y)
    (hd2 : ∀ v, dotp (y - z) v ≤ l2 * N v) (ha2 : dotp (y - z) z = l2 * N z)
    (hmono : N z ≤ N y) : l1 * N z ≤ dotp (x - y) z := by
  rcases hN with h | h | h <;> subst h
  · exact star_l1 hl1 hl2 hd1 ha1 hd2 ha2
  · exact star_l2 hl1 hl2 hd1 ha1 hd2 ha2
  · exact star_linfty hl1 hl2 hd1 ha1 hd2 ha2 hmono

end Compose

theorem proposition11
    {n : ℕ} (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (w0 wstar : Fin n → ℝ) (w : ℕ → Fin n → ℝ)
    (lam : ℕ → ℝ) (hlam : ∀ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, 0 ≤ lam t)
    (hw0 : w 0 = w0)
    (N : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hN : N = l1Norm ∨ N = l2Norm ∨ N = linftyNorm)
    (hseq : ∀ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, IsProxNorm N (lam t) (w (t - 1)) (w t))
    (hbatch : IsProxNorm N (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, lam t) w0 wstar) :
    w T = wstar := by
  obtain ⟨htri, hhom, hN0⟩ := norm_pack hN
  have hconv := conv_of_tri_hom htri hhom
  have hmid := mid_of_conv hconv
  have hlamsum : ∀ t, t ≤ T → 0 ≤ ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 t, lam s := by
    intro t ht
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro s hs
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hs
    exact hlam s (by rw [Finset.mem_Icc]; omega)
  have key : ∀ t, 1 ≤ t → t ≤ T → IsProxNorm N (∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 t, lam s) w0 (w t) := by
    intro t h1
    induction t, h1 using Nat.le_induction with
    | base =>
        intro _
        have h := hseq 1 (by rw [Finset.mem_Icc]; omega)
        simp only [Finset.Icc_self, Finset.sum_singleton]
        rw [show (1:ℕ) - 1 = 0 from rfl, hw0] at h
        exact h
    | succ m hm ih =>
        intro hmT
        have ihm := ih (by omega)
        have hstep := hseq (m+1) (by rw [Finset.mem_Icc]; omega)
        rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hstep
        have hl1 : 0 ≤ ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 m, lam s := hlamsum m (by omega)
        have hl2 : 0 ≤ lam (m+1) := hlam (m+1) (by rw [Finset.mem_Icc]; omega)
        obtain ⟨hd1, ha1⟩ := prox_facts hl1 htri hhom hN0 ihm
        obtain ⟨hd2, ha2⟩ := prox_facts hl2 htri hhom hN0 hstep
        have hmono : N (w (m+1)) ≤ N (w m) := prox_norm_le hl2 hstep
        have hstar := star_all hN hl1 hl2 hd1 ha1 hd2 ha2 hmono
        have hres := prox_compose hl1 hl2 htri hhom hN0 ihm hstep hstar
        rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega)]
        exact hres
  have hfin := key T hT le_rfl
  exact prox_unique (hlamsum T le_rfl) hmid hfin hbatch


end ResearchLevel

targets.label: Lemma 5
targets.statement:
Lemma 5 (Weighted-Regret Bound for EXP3). Let $\{\eta_{t}\}$ be a non-increasing step-size sequence such that $\eta_{t}\leq\frac 12e^{-2}$ for all t. Let $\left\{l_{t}^{\left(i\right)}\right\}$ be a cost sequence such that $l_{t}^{(i)}\in [0,1]$ for every $t,i.$ Let $\{d_{t}\}$ be a delay sequence such that the cost from round t is received at round $t + d_{t}$ . Define the set $\mathcal{M}^{\ast}$ of all samples that are not received before round T or that were delayed by $\begin{array}{r}{d_{t}\geq \frac{1}{e^{2}\eta_{t}}- 1}\end{array}$ . Then using EXP3 (Algorithm 3) guarantees:

1. With an oblivious adversary and $\gamma_{t}= 0$ for all t:

$$
\mathbb{E}\left\{\sum_{t=1}^{T}\eta_{t}l_{t}^{(a_{t})}-\operatorname*{min}_{i}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\eta_{t}l_{t}^{(i)}\right\}\leq\log K+\frac{e^{2}}{2}K\sum_{t=1}^{T}\eta_{t}^{2}+4\sum_{t\notin\mathcal{M}^{*}}\eta_{t}^{2}d_{t}+\sum_{t\in\mathcal{M}^{*}}\eta_{t}.\tag{42}
$$

2. With an adaptive adversary and $\gamma_{t}= \eta_{t}$ for all t:

$$
\mathbb{E}\left\{\sum_{t=1}^{T}\eta_{t}l_{t}^{(a_{t})}-\operatorname*{min}_{i}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\eta_{t}l_{t}^{(i)}\right\}\leq 2+2\log K+(1+\frac{e^{2}}{2})K\sum_{t=1}^{T}\eta_{t}^{2}+4 e^{2}K\sum_{t\notin\mathcal{M}^{*}}\eta_{t}^{2}d_{t}+\sum_{t\in\mathcal{M}^{*}}\eta_{t}.\tag{43}
$$

targets.label: Theorem 6
targets.statement:
Theorem 6. Let $\left\{l_{t}^{\left(i\right)}\right\}$ be a cost sequence such that $l_{t}^{(i)}\in [0,1]$ for every $t,i$ Let $\{d_{t}\}$ be a delay sequence such that the cost from round t is received at round $t + d_{t}$ . Define the set $\mathcal{M}=$ $\{t|t+d_{t}>T,t\in [1,T]\}$ of all samples that are not received before round T. Let us choose the fixed step-size $\begin{array}{r}{\eta = \frac{e^{- 2}}{2}\sqrt{\frac{\log K}{K T + \sum_{t \notin \mathcal{M}}d_{t}}}}\end{array}$ . Then the expected regret of EXP3 (Algorithm 3 with $\gamma_{t}= 0$ for all t) against an oblivious adversary satisfies

$$
\mathbb{E}\left\{R\left(T\right)\right\}=\mathbb{E}\left\{\sum_{t=1}^{T}\langle l_{t},p_{t}\rangle-\operatorname*{min}_{i}\sum_{t=1}^{T}l_{t}^{\left(i\right)}\right\}=O\left(\sqrt{\log K\left(K T+\sum_{t\notin\mathcal{M}}d_{t}\right)}+\left|\mathcal{M}\right|\right).\tag{46}
$$

targets.label: Lemma 6
targets.statement:
Lemma 6. EXP3 (Algorithm 3 with $\gamma_{t}= \eta_{t}$ for all t, against an adaptive adversary) with a non-increasing and positive step-size sequence $\{\eta_{t}\}$ such that $\eta_{t}\leq\frac 12e^{-2}$ for all t has no weighted-regret with respect to the sequence of delays $\{d_{t}\}$ and $\{\eta_{t}\}$ as the weight sequence, if the following two conditions hold:

1. $\textstyle \sum_{t = 1}^{\infty}\eta_{t}= \infty .$

2. $\operatorname*{lim}_{t\to\infty}\eta_{t}d_{t}<\infty$ and $\textstyle \sum_{t = 1}^{\infty}\eta_{t}^{2}d_{t}< \infty$

nl_proof:
### Proof of Lemma 5

## 13. Proof of Lemma 6: Weighted-Regret of EXP3 with Delays

Recall that $\mathcal{M}^{\ast}$ is the set of missing or discarded samples. Let $s_{-}, s_{+}$ as the step a moment before and a moment after the algorithm uses the feedback from round s, which updates the mixed action from $\pmb{p}_{s_{-}}$ to $\pmb{p}_{s_{+}}$ . Both $s_{-}$ and $s_{+}$ are algorithm update steps that take place in round t of the game if $s \in S_{t}$ Let $s_{T}$ be the last feedback to be updated.

We begin by the standard EXP3 analysis for arbitrary $\tilde{l}_{s}$ (Lattimore and Szepesvári, 2020), but with careful consideration to both the interleaved arrivals and the weight $\eta_{s}$ Recall that $\begin{array}{r}{\tilde{L}_{t}^{(i)}=\sum_{t\notin\mathcal{M}^{*}}\eta_{t}\frac{l_{t}^{(i)}1_{\{a_{t}=i\}}}{p_{t}^{(i)}+\gamma_{t}}}\end{array}$ , as defined in Algorithm 3. Define $\begin{array}{r}{\Phi\left(t\right)= -\log\left(\sum_{i=1}^{K}e^{-\tilde{L}_{t}^{(i)}}\right)}\end{array}$ and $\begin{array}{r}{\tilde{l}_{t}=\left(0,...,\frac{l_{t}^{(a_{t})}}{p_{t}^{(a_{t})}+\gamma_{t}},...,0\right)}\end{array}$ . Then

$$
\begin{array}{rl}
\Phi\left(s_{+}\right)-\Phi\left(s_{-}\right) & =-\log\left(\frac{\sum_{i=1}^{K}e^{-\tilde{L}_{s_{-}}^{(i)}}e^{-\eta_{s}\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}}}{\sum_{j=1}^{K}e^{-\tilde{L}_{s_{-}}^{(j)}}}\right)=-\log\left(\sum_{i=1}^{K}p_{s_{-}}^{(i)}e^{-\eta_{s}\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}}\right)\\
 & \underset{(a)}{\ge}-\log\left(\sum_{i=1}^{K}p_{s_{-}}^{(i)}\left(1-\eta_{s}\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}+\frac{1}{2}\eta_{s}^{2}\left(\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}\right)^{2}\right)\right)\\
 & =-\log\left(1-\sum_{i=1}^{K}p_{s_{-}}^{(i)}\left(\eta_{s}\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}-\frac{1}{2}\eta_{s}^{2}\left(\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}\right)^{2}\right)\right)\\
 & \underset{(b)}{\ge}\eta_{s}\sum_{i=1}^{K}p_{s_{-}}^{(i)}\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}-\frac{\eta_{s}^{2}}{2}\sum_{i=1}^{K}p_{s_{-}}^{(i)}\left(\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}\right)^{2}
\end{array}\tag{83}
$$

where (a) is $e^{- x}\leq 1 - x +{\textstyle{\frac{1}{2}}}x^{2}$ and (b) is $\log{(1-x)}\leq-x$ Hence, iterating (83) over s yields

$$
\Phi\left(s_{T}^{+}\right)-\Phi\left(1\right)=\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\left(\Phi\left(s_{+}\right)-\Phi\left(s_{-}\right)\right)\geq\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\eta_{s}\sum_{i=1}^{K}p_{s_{-}}^{(i)}\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}-\frac{1}{2}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\eta_{s}^{2}\sum_{i=1}^{K}p_{s_{-}}^{(i)}\left(\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}\right)^{2}.\tag{84}
$$

Next we upper bound $\Phi\left(s_{T}^{+}\right)-\Phi\left(1\right)$ . We have for $i^{*}\triangleq\arg\operatorname*{min}_{i}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\eta_{t}l_{t}^{(i)}$ that

$$
\Phi\left(s_{T}^{+}\right)-\Phi\left(1\right)= -\log\left(\sum_{j=1}^{K}e^{-\tilde{L}_{s_{T}^{+}}^{(j)}}\right)+\log K\underset{(a)}{\leq}\tilde{L}_{s_{T}^{+}}^{(i^{*})}+\log K=\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in S_{t}}\eta_{s}\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i^{*})}+\log K\tag{85}
$$

where (a) omits positive terms from $\Sigma_{j=1}^{K}e^{-\tilde{L}_{s_{T}^{+}}^{(j)}}$ . We conclude from (84) and (85) that

$$
\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in S_{t}}\eta_{s}\sum_{i=1}^{K}p_{s_{-}}^{(i)}\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}-\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in S_{t}}\eta_{s}\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i^{*})}\leq\log K+\frac{1}{2}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in S_{t}}\eta_{s}^{2}\sum_{i=1}^{K}p_{s_{-}}^{(i)}\left(\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}\right)^{2}.\tag{86}
$$

Now observe that

$$
\begin{array}{rl}
\sum_{i=1}^{K}p_{s_{-}}^{(i)}\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)} & =\sum_{i=1}^{K}p_{s_{-}}^{(i)}\frac{l_{s}^{(i)}1_{\{a_{s}=i\}}}{p_{s}^{(i)}+\gamma_{s}}=\sum_{i=1}^{K}\left(p_{s}^{(i)}+\gamma_{s}\right)\frac{l_{s}^{(i)}1_{\{a_{s}=i\}}}{p_{s}^{(i)}+\gamma_{s}}-\sum_{i=1}^{K}\left(p_{s}^{(i)}+\gamma_{s}-p_{s_{-}}^{(i)}\right)\frac{l_{s}^{(i)}1_{\{a_{s}=i\}}}{p_{s}^{(i)}+\gamma_{s}}\\
 & =l_{s}^{(a_{s})}-\gamma_{s}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}+\sum_{i=1}^{K}\left(p_{s_{-}}^{(i)}-p_{s}^{(i)}\right)\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}.
\end{array}\tag{87}
$$

Using $\frac{p_{s_{-}}^{(i)}}{p_{s}^{(i)}}\leq e^{2}$ from Lemma 9, we obtain

$$
\sum_{i=1}^{K}p_{s_{-}}^{(i)}\left(\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}\right)^{2}=\sum_{i=1}^{K}p_{s_{-}}^{(i)}\left(\frac{l_{s}^{(i)}1_{\left\{a_{s}=i\right\}}}{p_{s}^{(i)}+\gamma_{s}}\right)^{2}\leq e^{2}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\frac{p_{s}^{(i)}}{p_{s}^{(i)}+\gamma_{s}}\frac{l_{s}^{(i)}1_{\left\{a_{s}=i\right\}}}{p_{s}^{(i)}+\gamma_{s}}\leq e^{2}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}.\tag{88}
$$

Taking the weighted sum of (87) over $t \notin{\mathcal{M}}^{*}$ and subtracting $\begin{array}{r}{\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\eta_{s}\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i^{*})}}\end{array}$ from both sides:

$$
\begin{array}{rl}
 & \sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\eta_{s}l_{s}^{(a_{s})}-\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\gamma_{s}\eta_{s}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}+\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\eta_{s}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\left(p_{s_{-}}^{(i)}-p_{s}^{(i)}\right)\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}-\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\eta_{s}\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i^{*})}\\
 & =\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\eta_{s}\sum_{i=1}^{K}p_{s_{-}}^{(i)}\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}-\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\eta_{s}\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i^{*})}\\
 & \underset{(a)}{\le}\log K+\frac{1}{2}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\eta_{s}^{2}\sum_{i=1}^{K}p_{s_{-}}^{(i)}\left(\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}\right)^{2}\\
 & \underset{(b)}{\le}\log K+\frac{1}{2}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}e^{2}\eta_{s}^{2}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}
\end{array}\tag{89}
$$

where (a) uses (86) and (b) uses (88). Rearranging (89) and subtracting $\begin{array}{r}{\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\eta_{s}l_{s}^{(i^{*})}}\end{array}$ from both sides gives

$$
\begin{array}{l}
\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\eta_{s}\left(l_{s}^{(a_{s})}-l_{s}^{(i^{*})}\right)\leq\\
\underbrace{\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\eta_{s}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\left(p_{s}^{(i)}-p_{s_{-}}^{(i)}\right)\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}}_{A}+\log K+\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\eta_{s}\left(\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i^{*})}-l_{s}^{(i^{*})}\right)+\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\left(\gamma_{s}\eta_{s}+\frac{e^{2}}{2}\eta_{s}^{2}\right)\sum_{i=1}^{K}\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}.
\end{array}\tag{90}
$$

## 13.1 Adaptive Adversary with $\gamma_{t}= \eta_{t}$

## 13.1.1 Taking the Expectation

Define $\begin{array}{r}{W_{1}^{(i)}=\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in{\cal S}_{t}}\eta_{s}\left(\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}-l_{s}^{(i)}\right)-\log K}\end{array}$ . From Lemma 11 with $\delta \leftarrow \frac{\delta}{K}$ and $\alpha_{s}^{(i)}=\eta_{s}$ and $\alpha_{s}^{(j)}=0$ for all $j \neq i$ we get by using the union bound that

$$
\mathbb{P}\left(\operatorname*{max}_{i}W_{1}^{(i)}\geq\log\frac{1}{\delta}\right)\leq K\mathbb{P}\left(\sum_{{t=1}}^{T}\sum_{s\in S_{t}}\eta_{s}\left(\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}-l_{s}^{(i)}\right)\geq\log\frac{K}{\delta}\right)\leq\delta\tag{91}
$$

so by substituting $\begin{array}{r}{x = \log{\frac{1}{\delta}}}\end{array}$ so $\begin{array}{r}{d x = - \frac{d \delta}{\delta}}\end{array}$

$$
\mathbb E\left\{\operatorname*{max}_{i}W_{1}^{(i)}\right\}\leq\int_{0}^{\infty}\mathbb P\left(\operatorname*{max}_{i}W_{1}^{(i)}\geq x\right)d x=\int_{0}^{1}\frac 1\delta\mathbb P\left(\operatorname*{max}_{i}W_{1}^{(i)}\geq\log\frac 1\delta\right)d\delta\leq 1 .\tag{92}
$$

Define $\begin{array}{r}{W_{2}=\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in{{\mathcal{S}}}_{t}}\left(\gamma_{s}\eta_{s}+\frac{e^{2}}{2}\eta_{s}^{2}\right)\sum_{i=1}^{K}\left(\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}-l_{s}^{(i)}\right)}\end{array}$ . From Lemma 11 with $\alpha_{s}^{(i)}=\gamma_{s}\eta_{s}+$ $\begin{array}{r}{\frac{e^{2}}{2}\eta_{s}^{2}\leq 2 \eta_{s}}\end{array}$ for all i we get $\mathbb{P}\left(W_{2}\geq\log\frac{1}{\delta}\right)\leq\delta$ ,so using (92) on $W_{2}$ we obtain $\mathbb{E}\left\{W_{2}\right\}\le 1 .$

From $\mathbb{E}\left\{\operatorname*{max}_{i}W_{1}^{(i)}\right\}\le 1$ and $\mathbb{E}\left\{W_{2}\right\}\le 1$ we conclude that

$$
\begin{array}{r l r}{{\mathbb{E}\{\operatorname*{max}_{i}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\eta_{s}(\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}-l_{s}^{(i)})+\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}(\gamma_{s}\eta_{s}+\frac{e^{2}}{2}\eta_{s}^{2})\sum_{i=1}^{K}\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}\}\leq}}\\ &{}&{\log K+2+\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}(\gamma_{s}\eta_{s}+\frac{e^{2}}{2}\eta_{s}^{2})\sum_{i=1}^{K}l_{s}^{(i)}\leq\log K+2+K\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}(\gamma_{s}\eta_{s}+\frac{e^{2}}{2}\eta_{s}^{2}).}\end{array}\tag{93}
$$

## 13.1.2 The Effect of Delays

Next we bound the A term in (90), which quantifies the effect of the delays. Let $s \in S_{t}$ , and let q be a round for which the feedback is used after or at round s, but before the feedback from round s is used. Define $\begin{array}{r}{h_{i}\left(\tilde{L}_{q_{-}}\right)\triangleq p_{q_{-}}^{(i)}=\frac{e^{-\tilde{L}_{q_{-}}^{(i)}}}{\sum_{j=1}^{K}e^{-\tilde{L}_{q_{-}}^{(j)}}},\text{ so } p_{q_{+}}^{(i)}=h_{i}\left(\tilde{\pmb{L}}_{q_{-}}+\eta_{q}\tilde{\pmb{l}}_{q}\right)}\end{array}$ . Using Lemma 10 with $\pmb{x}= \tilde{\pmb{L}}_{q_{-}}$ and $\Delta = \eta_{q}\tilde{l}_{q}$ (so $\pmb{h}(\pmb{x})=\pmb{p}_{q_{-}})$ yields

$$
\begin{array}{rl}
\left\Vert \pmb{p}_{q_{-}}-\pmb{p}_{q_{+}}\right\Vert _{1} & \le2\eta_{q}\sum_{i=1}^{K}p_{q_{-}}^{(i)}\tilde{l}_{q}^{(i)}=2\eta_{q}\sum_{i=1}^{K}p_{q_{-}}^{(i)}\frac{l_{q}^{(i)}1_{\{a_{q}=i\}}}{p_{q}^{(i)}+\gamma_{q}}\\
 & \underset{(a)}{\le}2e^{2}\eta_{q}\sum_{i=1}^{K}p_{q}^{(i)}\frac{l_{q}^{(i)}1_{\{a_{q}=i\}}}{p_{q}^{(i)}+\gamma_{q}}\le2e^{2}\eta_{q}\sum_{i=1}^{K}l_{q}^{(i)}1_{\{a_{q}=i\}}=2e^{2}\eta_{q}l_{q}^{(a_{q})}\le2e^{2}\eta_{q}
\end{array}\tag{94}
$$

where (a) uses $\frac{p_{q_{-}}^{(i)}}{p_{q}^{(i)}}\leq e^{2}$ from Lemma 9. Hence

$$
\left\langle \tilde{\pmb{l}}_{s},\pmb{p}_{q_{-}}-\pmb{p}_{q_{+}}\right\rangle =\sum_{i=1}^{K}\left(p_{q_{-}}^{(i)}-p_{q_{+}}^{(i)}\right)\frac{l_{s}^{(i)}1_{\{a_{s}=i\}}}{p_{s}^{(i)}+\gamma_{s}}\underset{(a)}{\le}2e^{2}\eta_{q}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\frac{l_{s}^{(i)}1_{\{a_{s}=i\}}}{p_{s}^{(i)}+\gamma_{s}}\le2e^{2}\eta_{q}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\frac{1_{\{a_{s}=i\}}}{p_{s}^{(i)}+\gamma_{s}}\tag{95}
$$

where (a) follows since $p_{q_{-}}^{(i)}-p_{q_{+}}^{(i)}\leq\left|p_{q_{-}}^{(i)}-p_{q_{+}}^{(i)}\right|\leq\left\|p_{q_{-}}-p_{q_{+}}\right\|_{1}\leq 2e^{2}\eta_{q}$ . Using (95) we can write

$$
\mathbb{E}\left\{ \left\langle \tilde{\pmb{l}}_{s},\pmb{p}_{q_{-}}-\pmb{p}_{q_{+}}\right\rangle \mid\mathcal{F}_{s}\right\} \le2e^{2}\eta_{q}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\mathbb{E}\left\{ \frac{1_{\{a_{s}=i\}}}{p_{s}^{(i)}+\gamma_{s}}\mid\mathcal{F}_{s}\right\} \underset{(a)}{=}2e^{2}\eta_{q}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\frac{p_{s}^{(i)}}{p_{s}^{(i)}+\gamma_{s}}\le2e^{2}\eta_{q}K\tag{96}
$$

where (a) uses that $p_{s}^{(i)}$ is $\mathcal{F}_{s}$ -measurable and that $a_{s}= i$ with probability $p_{s}^{(i)}$ . Hence the A term in (90) can be bounded as

$$
\begin{array}{rl}
 & \mathbb{E}\left\{ \sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\eta_{s}\left\langle \tilde{\pmb{l}}_{s},\pmb{p}_{s}-\pmb{p}_{s_{-}}\right\rangle \right\} \\
 & =\mathbb{E}\left\{ \sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\eta_{s}\left(\left\langle \tilde{\pmb{l}}_{s},\pmb{p}_{t}-\pmb{p}_{s_{-}}\right\rangle +\sum_{r=s}^{t-1}\left\langle \tilde{\pmb{l}}_{s},\pmb{p}_{r}-\pmb{p}_{r+1}\right\rangle \right)\right\} \\
 & =\mathbb{E}\left\{ \sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\eta_{s}\left(\sum_{q\in\mathcal{S}_{t},q<s}\left\langle \tilde{\pmb{l}}_{s},\pmb{p}_{q_{-}}-\pmb{p}_{q_{+}}\right\rangle +\sum_{r=s}^{t-1}\sum_{q\in\mathcal{S}_{r}}\left\langle \tilde{\pmb{l}}_{s},\pmb{p}_{q_{-}}-\pmb{p}_{q_{+}}\right\rangle \right)\right\} \\
 & =\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\eta_{s}\left(\sum_{q\in\mathcal{S}_{t},q<s}\mathbb{E}\left\{ \left\langle \tilde{\pmb{l}}_{s},\pmb{p}_{q_{-}}-\pmb{p}_{q_{+}}\right\rangle \right\} +\sum_{r=s}^{t-1}\sum_{q\in\mathcal{S}_{r}}\mathbb{E}\left\{ \left\langle \tilde{\pmb{l}}_{s},\pmb{p}_{q_{-}}-\pmb{p}_{q_{+}}\right\rangle \right\} \right)\\
 & \underset{(a)}{\le}2e^{2}K\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\eta_{s}\left(\sum_{q\in\mathcal{S}_{t},q<s}\eta_{q}+\sum_{r=s}^{t-1}\sum_{q\in\mathcal{S}_{r}}\eta_{q}\right)\underset{(b)}{\le}4e^{2}K\sum_{t\notin\mathcal{M}^{*}}\eta_{t}^{2}d_{t}
\end{array}\tag{97}
$$

where (a) uses (96) with the tower rule, and (b) uses Lemma 8.

## 13.1.3 Concluding the Proof

We conclude that for $i^{*}\triangleq\arg\operatorname*{min}_{i}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\eta_{t}l_{t}^{(i)}$ :

$$
\begin{array}{rl}
\mathbb{E}\left\{ \sum_{t=1}^{T}\eta_{t}\left(l_{t}^{(a_{t})}-l_{t}^{(i^{*})}\right)\right\}  & \underset{(a)}{\le}\mathbb{E}\left\{ \sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\eta_{s}\left(l_{s}^{(a_{s})}-l_{s}^{(i^{*})}\right)\right\} +\sum_{t\in\mathcal{M}^{*}}\eta_{t}\\
 & \underset{(b)}{\le}\mathbb{E}\left\{ \sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\eta_{s}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\left(p_{s}^{(i)}-p_{s_{-}}^{(i)}\right)\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}\right\} +\log K\\
 & +\mathbb{E}\left\{ \sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\left(\eta_{s}\left(\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i^{*})}-l_{s}^{(i^{*})}\right)+\left(\gamma_{s}\eta_{s}+\frac{e^{2}}{2}\eta_{s}^{2}\right)\sum_{i=1}^{K}\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}\right)\right\} +\sum_{t\in\mathcal{M}^{*}}\eta_{t}\\
 & \underset{(c)}{\le}4e^{2}K\sum_{t\notin\mathcal{M}^{*}}\eta_{t}^{2}d_{t}+2+\left(1+\frac{e^{2}}{2}\right)K\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\eta_{s}^{2}+2\log K+\sum_{t\in\mathcal{M}^{*}}\eta_{t}
\end{array}\tag{98}
$$

where (a) uses that $0\leq l_{t}^{(i)}\leq 1$ for every i and t, (b) is (90) and (c) is (93) and (97) for $\gamma_{s}= \eta_{s}$

## 13.2 Oblivious Adversary with $\gamma_{t}= 0$

## 13.2.1 Taking the Expectation

With an oblivious adversary $\begin{array}{r}{\mathbb{E}\left\{\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}\right\}=l_{s}^{(i)}\mathbb{E}\left\{\frac{1_{\{a_{s}=i\}}}{p_{s}^{(i)}}\right\}=l_{s}^{(i)}}\end{array}$ for each s and $i,$ since $l_{s}^{(i)}$ is not random. Then for any $i,$ in particular $\begin{array}{r}{i^{*}\triangleq\arg\operatorname*{min}_{i}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\eta_{t}l_{t}^{(i)}}\end{array}$ , we have

$$
\mathbb{E}\left\{\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\eta_{s}\left(\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i^{*})}-l_{s}^{(i^{*})}\right)+\frac{e^{2}}{2}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\eta_{s}^{2}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}\right\}=\frac{e^{2}}{2}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\eta_{s}^{2}\sum_{i=1}^{K}l_{s}^{(i)}\le\frac{e^{2}}{2}K\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\eta_{s}^{2}.\tag{99}
$$

## 13.2.2 The Effect of Delays

Let $s \in S_{t}$ , and let $q$ be a round for which the feedback is used after or at round $s,$ but before the feedback from round s is used. Using Lemma 10 with $\pmb{x}= \tilde{\pmb{L}}_{q_{-}}$ and $\Delta = \eta_{q}\tilde{\pmb{l}}_{q}$ , so $\pmb{h}\left(\pmb{x}\right)=\pmb{p}_{q_{-}}$ yields

$$
\begin{array}{rl}
\mathbb{E}\left\{ \left\Vert \pmb{p}_{q_{-}}-\pmb{p}_{q_{+}}\right\Vert _{1}\mid\mathcal{F}_{q_{-}}\right\}  & \leq2\eta_{q}\mathbb{E}\left\{ \sum_{i=1}^{K}p_{q_{-}}^{(i)}\tilde{l}_{q}^{(i)}\mid\mathcal{F}_{q_{-}}\right\} \\
 & \underset{(a)}{=}2\eta_{q}\sum_{i=1}^{K}p_{q_{-}}^{(i)}\mathbb{E}\left\{ \tilde{l}_{q}^{(i)}\mid\mathcal{F}_{q_{-}}\right\} \underset{(b)}{=}2\eta_{q}\sum_{i=1}^{K}p_{q_{-}}^{(i)}l_{q}^{(i)}\leq2\eta_{q}\sum_{i=1}^{K}p_{q_{-}}^{(i)}=2\eta_{q}
\end{array}\tag{100}
$$

where $\mathrm{(a)}$ uses that $p_{q_{-}}^{(i)}$ is $\mathcal{F}_{q_{-}}$ -measurable and (b) uses that $p_{q}^{(i)}$ is $\mathcal{F}_{q_{-}}$ -measurable (since $q < q_{-})$ and that $\tilde{l}_{q}^{(i)}$ is $\frac{l_{q}^{(i)}}{p_{q}^{(i)}}$ with probability $p_{q}^{(i)}$ and zero otherwise. Note that $a_{q}$ given $\mathcal{F}_{q}$ is independent of $\mathcal{F}_{q_{-}}$ since by definition the feedback from $a_{q}$ was not received until round $q_{-}$ . This is unique to the oblivious adversary case when $\boldsymbol{l}_{r}$ for $r > s$ is not a random variable that depends on $a_{q}$ , which the adversary observes already at the end of round $q .$ Then for every $q \in S_{r}$ for $r < t$ or $q \in \mathcal{S}_{t}$ such that $q < s$ we have

$$
\begin{array}{rl}
\mathbb{E}\left\{ \left\langle \tilde{\pmb{l}}_{s},\pmb{p}_{q_{-}}-\pmb{p}_{q_{+}}\right\rangle \right\}  & =\mathbb{E}\left\{ \mathbb{E}\left\{ \sum_{i=1}^{K}\left(p_{q_{-}}^{(i)}-p_{q_{+}}^{(i)}\right)\frac{l_{s}^{(i)}1_{\{a_{s}=i\}}}{p_{s}^{(i)}}\mid\mathcal{F}_{s_{-}}\right\} \right\} \\
 & =\mathbb{E}\left\{ \sum_{i=1}^{K}\left(p_{q_{-}}^{(i)}-p_{q_{+}}^{(i)}\right)\mathbb{E}\left\{ \frac{l_{s}^{(i)}1_{\{a_{s}=i\}}}{p_{s}^{(i)}}\mid\mathcal{F}_{s_{-}}\right\} \right\} \\
 & =\mathbb{E}\left\{ \sum_{i=1}^{K}\left(p_{q_{-}}^{(i)}-p_{q_{+}}^{(i)}\right)l_{s}^{(i)}\right\} \\
 & =\mathbb{E}\left\{ \left\langle \pmb{l}_{s},\pmb{p}_{q_{-}}-\pmb{p}_{q_{+}}\right\rangle \right\} \underset{(a)}{\le}\mathbb{E}\left\{ \left\Vert \pmb{l}_{s}\right\Vert _{\infty}\left\Vert \pmb{p}_{q_{-}}-\pmb{p}_{q_{+}}\right\Vert _{1}\right\} \\
 & \underset{(b)}{\le}\mathbb{E}\left\{ \left\Vert \pmb{p}_{q_{-}}-\pmb{p}_{q_{+}}\right\Vert _{1}\right\} \underset{(c)}{\le}2\eta_{q}
\end{array}\tag{101}
$$

where (a) is Hölder's inequality, (b) uses $0\leq l_{t}^{(i)}\leq 1$ and (c) uses (100) and the tower rule. Therefore

$$
\begin{array}{rl}
 & \mathbb{E}\left\{ \sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\eta_{s}\left\langle \tilde{\pmb{l}}_{s},\pmb{p}_{s}-\pmb{p}_{s_{-}}\right\rangle \right\} \\
 & =\mathbb{E}\left\{ \sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\eta_{s}\left(\left\langle \tilde{\pmb{l}}_{s},\pmb{p}_{t}-\pmb{p}_{s_{-}}\right\rangle +\sum_{r=s}^{t-1}\left\langle \tilde{\pmb{l}}_{s},\pmb{p}_{r}-\pmb{p}_{r+1}\right\rangle \right)\right\} \\
 & =\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\eta_{s}\left(\sum_{q\in\mathcal{S}_{t},q<s}\mathbb{E}\left\{ \left\langle \tilde{\pmb{l}}_{s},\pmb{p}_{q_{-}}-\pmb{p}_{q_{+}}\right\rangle \right\} +\sum_{r=s}^{t-1}\sum_{q\in\mathcal{S}_{r}}\mathbb{E}\left\{ \left\langle \tilde{\pmb{l}}_{s},\pmb{p}_{q_{-}}-\pmb{p}_{q_{+}}\right\rangle \right\} \right)\\
 & \underset{(a)}{\le}2\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\eta_{s}\left(\sum_{q\in\mathcal{S}_{t},q<s}\eta_{q}+\sum_{r=s}^{t-1}\sum_{q\in\mathcal{S}_{r}}\eta_{q}\right)\underset{(b)}{\le}4\sum_{t\notin\mathcal{M}^{*}}\eta_{t}^{2}d_{t}
\end{array}\tag{102}
$$

where (a) follows from (101) and (b) follows from Lemma 8.

## 13.2.3 Concluding the Proof

We conclude that for $i^{*}\triangleq\arg\operatorname*{min}_{i}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\eta_{t}l_{t}^{(i)}$ :

$$
\begin{array}{l}
\mathbb{E}\left\{ \sum_{t=1}^{T}\eta_{t}l_{t}^{(a_{t})}-\sum_{t=1}^{T}\eta_{t}l_{t}^{(i^{*})}\right\} \underset{(a)}{\le}\\
\mathbb{E}\left\{ \sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\eta_{s}\left(l_{s}^{(a_{s})}-l_{s}^{(i^{*})}\right)\right\} +\sum_{t\in\mathcal{M}^{*}}\eta_{t}\underset{(b)}{\le}\log K+\frac{e^{2}}{2}K\sum_{t=1}^{T}\eta_{t}^{2}+4\sum_{t\notin\mathcal{M}^{*}}\eta_{t}^{2}d_{t}+\sum_{t\in\mathcal{M}^{*}}\eta_{t}
\end{array}\tag{103}
$$

where (a) uses that $0\leq l_{t}^{(i)}\leq 1$ for every i and t, and (b) uses (90), (99) and (102).

Proof Up to the weights $\eta_{q}$ , the quantity inside the parentheses in (66):

$$
Q_{s,t}\triangleq\sum_{r=s}^{t-1}\sum_{q\in S_{r}}\eta_{q}+\sum_{q\in S_{t},q<s}\eta_{q}\tag{67}
$$

counts of the number of feedback samples received and used between round s and round t such that $s \in S_{t}$ , before the feedback from round s was used. To prove (66), we want to upper bound $\textstyle\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in{\mathcal{S}}_{t}}\eta_{s}Q_{s,t}$ for all possible delay sequences $\{d_{t}\}$ . A sample can be received and used between round s and round t if it belongs to one of two types:

1. The first type is a feedback sample from $q \geq s$ that is received and used before the feedback from round s is used. There are a maximum of $d_{s}$ feedback samples of this type. We denote the contribution of these samples to $Q_{s,t}$ by $Q_{s,t}^{1}.$ Each feedback sample can contribute $\eta_{q}\leq \eta_{s}$ with $q \geq s$ (since $\eta_{t}$ is non-increasing) to $Q_{s,t}^{1}$ for $s \in S_{t}$ . We over count them by giving each $Q_{s,t}^{1}$ term all of its $d_{s}$ possible samples of this type. Summing over all t:

$$
\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in S_{t}}\eta_{s}Q_{s,t}^{1}\leq\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in S_{t}}\eta_{s}^{2}d_{s}=\sum_{t\notin\mathcal{M}^{*}}\eta_{s}^{2}d_{s}.\tag{68}
$$

2. The second type is a feedback sample from $q < s$ that is received and used before s is used. We denote the contribution of these samples to $Q_{s,t}$ by $Q_{s,t}^{2}.$ The samples from round q can contribute to a maximum of $d_{q}$ different $Q_{s,t}^{2}$ terms, all with $s \geq q .$ This follows simply because the feedback sample of $q$ is not received before $q + d_{q}$ . Let $\Gamma_{q}$ be the set of rounds s such that the samples from round $q$ contribute to $Q_{s,t}^{2}$ Then

$$
\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}_{t}}\eta_{s}Q_{s,t}^{2}\underset{(a)}{=}\sum_{q\notin\mathcal{M}^{*}}\sum_{s\in\Gamma_{q}}\eta_{s}\eta_{q}\underset{(b)}{\le}\sum_{q\notin\mathcal{M}^{*}}\eta_{q}^{2}\left|\Gamma_{q}\right|\leq\sum_{q\notin\mathcal{M}^{*}}\eta_{q}^{2}d_{q}\tag{69}
$$

where $\mathrm{(a)}$ follows since only rounds $q$ that their feedback is received and used sometime before round T are counted in $Q_{s,t}^{2}$ for some $s,t.$ Inequality (b) uses $\eta_{s}\leq \eta_{q}$ since $\eta_{t}$ is non-increasing and $s \geq q$ for all $s \in \Gamma_{q}.$

Summing the contribution to (67) from these two possible types of samples, we have $Q_{s,t}=Q_{s,t}^{1}+Q_{s,t}^{2}$ so by summing (68) and (69) we obtain (66).

Proof The proof follows by induction on the feedback arrival index. Let s be the first feedback to arrive. Before that, at $s_{-}$ ,we have $\begin{array}{r}{p_{s_{-}}^{(i)}=\frac{1}{K}}\end{array}$ and $\begin{array}{r}{\frac{p_{s_{-}}^{(i)}}{p_{s}^{(i)}}=1}\end{array}$ for all i. Then, the first update satisfies

$$
\frac{p_{s_{-}}^{(i)}}{p_{s_{+}}^{(i)}}=\frac{\frac{1}{K}}{\frac{\frac{1}{K}e^{-\eta_{s}\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}}}{\sum_{j=1}^{K}\frac{1}{K}e^{-\eta_{s}\tilde{l}_{s}^{(j)}}}}\geq1-\frac{1}{K}+\frac{1}{K}e^{-\eta_{s}\frac{l_{s}^{(a_{s})}}{\frac{1}{K}+\gamma_{s}}}\geq1+\frac{1}{K}\left(e^{-\eta_{s}Kl_{s}^{(a_{s})}}-1\right)\geq1-\eta_{s}l_{s}^{(a_{s})}\geq1-e^{2}\eta_{s}.\tag{104}
$$

Now let s be any arbitrary round for which the feedback arrives at time t. According to the inductive hypothesis, we have $\begin{array}{r}{\frac{p_{q_{+}}^{(i)}}{p_{q_{-}}^{(i)}}\leq\frac{1}{1-e^{2}\eta_{q}}}\end{array}$ for all $q \in \{r \in S_{t}, r < s \}\cup \left\{\bigcup_{r = s}^{t - 1}S_{r}\right\}$ . Define $s_{0}$ as the minimal $q < s$ such that $s \leq q + d_{q}\leq t$ and $q \notin{\mathcal{D}}$ (if it exists). Then for all $i=1,...,K$

$$
\begin{array}{rl}
\frac{p_{s_{-}}^{(i)}}{p_{s}^{(i)}}=\prod_{r=s}^{t-1}\prod_{q\in\mathcal{S}_{r}}\prod_{q\in\mathcal{S}_{t},q<s}\frac{p_{q_{+}}^{(i)}}{p_{q_{-}}^{(i)}} & \underset{(a)}{\le}\prod_{r=s}^{t-1}\prod_{q\in\mathcal{S}_{r}}\prod_{q\in\mathcal{S}_{t},q<s}\left(1+\frac{e^{2}\eta_{q}}{1-e^{2}\eta_{q}}\right)\\
 & \underset{(b)}{\le}\left(1+\frac{1}{e^{-2}\eta_{s_{0}}^{-1}-1}\right)^{d_{s_{0}}}\left(1+\frac{1}{e^{-2}\eta_{s}^{-1}-1}\right)^{d_{s}}\underset{(c)}{\le}e^{2}
\end{array}\tag{105}
$$

where $\mathrm{(a)}$ uses the inductive hypothesis and (c) uses that by definition $d_{s_{0}}\leq e^{- 2}\eta_{s_{0}}^{- 1}- 1$ and $d_{s}\leq e^{- 2}\eta_{s}^{- 1}- 1$ . If $s_{0}$ does not exist then the first factor is one $(\mathrm{i.e.,~}d_{s_{0}}=0)$ . Inequality (b) uses that the product runs over all rounds $q \notin{\mathcal{D}}$ for which the feedback is received between s and $s_{-}.$ Feedback from $q \in \mathcal{D}$ is discarded and has no effect on $\frac{p_{s_{-}}^{(i)}}{p_{s}^{(i)}}$ . The received feedback includes no more than $d_{s_{0}}$ samples of rounds before s. This follows since there are at most $d_{s_{0}}$ rounds between $s_{0}$ and s (since $s \leq s_{0}+ d_{s_{0}}$ by definition), and each of them contributes at most one feedback that is received between s and $s_{-}$ We have $\eta_{q}\leq \eta_{s_{0}}$ for each such round $q,$ since $\eta_{t}$ is non-increasing. It also includes no more than $d_{s}$ feedback samples of rounds after s, since all these feedback samples are received before $s_{-}$ , which occurs during round $t = s + d_{s}$ . We have $\eta_{r}\leq \eta_{s}$ for each such round r. We conclude that the update at $s_{-},$ occurring at time t using the feedback for $\textstyle{a_{s},}$ satisfies:

$$
\begin{array}{rl}
\frac{p_{s_{-}}^{(i)}}{p_{s_{+}}^{(i)}}=\frac{\frac{e^{-\tilde{L}_{s_{-}}^{(i)}}}{\sum_{j=1}^{K}e^{-\tilde{L}_{s_{-}}^{(j)}}}}{\frac{e^{-\tilde{L}_{s_{+}}^{(i)}}}{\sum_{j=1}^{K}e^{-\tilde{L}_{s_{+}}^{(j)}}}} & =\frac{\frac{e^{-\tilde{L}_{s_{-}}^{(i)}}}{\sum_{j=1}^{K}e^{-\tilde{L}_{s_{-}}^{(j)}}}}{\frac{e^{-\tilde{L}_{s_{-}}^{(i)}}e^{-\eta_{s}\tilde{l}_{s}^{(i)}}}{\sum_{j=1}^{K}e^{-\tilde{L}_{s_{-}}^{(j)}}e^{-\eta_{s}\tilde{l}_{s}^{(j)}}}}\geq\frac{\sum_{j=1}^{K}e^{-\tilde{L}_{s_{-}}^{(j)}}e^{-\eta_{s}\tilde{l}_{s}^{(j)}}}{\sum_{j=1}^{K}e^{-\tilde{L}_{s_{-}}^{(j)}}}\geq\frac{\sum_{j=1}^{K}e^{-\tilde{L}_{s_{-}}^{(j)}}\left(1-\eta_{s}\tilde{l}_{s}^{(j)}\right)}{\sum_{j=1}^{K}e^{-\tilde{L}_{s_{-}}^{(j)}}}\\
 & =1-\eta_{s}\sum_{j=1}^{K}p_{s_{-}}^{(j)}\tilde{l}_{s}^{(j)}=1-\eta_{s}p_{s_{-}}^{(a_{s})}\frac{l_{s}^{(a_{s})}}{p_{s}^{(a_{s})}+\gamma_{s}}\geq1-\eta_{s}\frac{p_{s_{-}}^{(a_{s})}}{p_{s}^{(a_{s})}}\underset{(a)}{\geq}1-e^{2}\eta_{s}
\end{array}\tag{106}
$$

where (a) follows from (105). Hence $\begin{array}{r}{\frac{p_{s_{+}}^{(i)}}{p_{s_{-}}^{(i)}}\leq\frac{1}{1-e^{2}\eta_{s}}}\end{array}$ and the proof is complete.

Proof For all $\pmb{x}\in \mathbb{R}^{K}$ and $\Delta \in \mathbb{R}_{+}^{K}$

$$
h_{i}\left(\pmb{x}+\Delta\right)-h_{i}\left(\pmb{x}\right)=\frac{e^{-x_{i}-\Delta_{i}}}{\sum_{j=1}^{K}e^{-x_{j}-\Delta_{j}}}-\frac{e^{-x_{i}}}{\sum_{j=1}^{K}e^{-x_{j}}}\underset{(a)}{\geq}\left(e^{-\Delta_{i}}-1\right)h_{i}\left(\pmb{x}\right)\underset{(b)}{\geq}-\Delta_{i}h_{i}\left(\pmb{x}\right)\tag{108}
$$

where (a) follows since $\begin{array}{r}{\sum_{j = 1}^{K}e^{- x_{j}- \Delta_{j}}\le \sum_{j = 1}^{K}e^{- x_{j}}}\end{array}$ and (b) since $1 - x \leq e^{- x}$ for all $x \geq 0$ .We also have for all $\pmb{x}\in \mathbb{R}^{K}$ and $\Delta \in \mathbb{R}_{+}^{K}$ that

$$
\begin{array}{l}
h_{i}\left(\pmb{x}+\Delta\right)-h_{i}\left(\pmb{x}\right)=\frac{e^{-x_{i}-\Delta_{i}}}{\sum_{j=1}^{K}e^{-x_{j}-\Delta_{j}}}-\frac{e^{-x_{i}}}{\sum_{j=1}^{K}e^{-x_{j}}}\underset{(a)}{\le}\frac{e^{-x_{i}-\Delta_{i}}}{\sum_{j=1}^{K}e^{-x_{j}-\Delta_{j}}}-\frac{e^{-x_{i}-\Delta_{i}}}{\sum_{j=1}^{K}e^{-x_{j}}}=\\
h_{i}\left(\pmb{x}+\Delta\right)\left(1-\frac{\sum_{j=1}^{K}e^{-x_{j}-\Delta_{j}}}{\sum_{l=1}^{K}e^{-x_{l}}}\right)=h_{i}\left(\pmb{x}+\Delta\right)\frac{\sum_{j=1}^{K}e^{-x_{j}}\left(1-e^{-\Delta_{j}}\right)}{\sum_{l=1}^{K}e^{-x_{l}}}\underset{(b)}{\le}h_{i}\left(\pmb{x}+\Delta\right)\frac{\sum_{j=1}^{K}\Delta_{j}e^{-x_{j}}}{\sum_{l=1}^{K}e^{-x_{l}}}
\end{array}\tag{109}
$$

where (a) uses $e^{- x_{j}}\geq e^{- x_{j}- \Delta_{j}}$ and (b) uses $1 - x \leq e^{- x}$ for all $x \geq 0$ Combining (108) and (109):

$$
\begin{array}{l}
\left\Vert h\left(\pmb{x}\right)-h\left(\pmb{x}+\Delta\right)\right\Vert _{1}=\sum_{i=1}^{K}\left|h_{i}\left(\pmb{x}\right)-h_{i}\left(\pmb{x}+\Delta\right)\right|\underset{(a)}{\le}\sum_{i=1}^{K}h_{i}\left(\pmb{x}+\Delta\right)\left(\sum_{j=1}^{K}\frac{\Delta_{j}e^{-x_{j}}}{\sum_{l=1}^{K}e^{-x_{l}}}\right)\\
+\sum_{i=1}^{K}\Delta_{i}h_{i}\left(\pmb{x}\right)=\left(\sum_{j=1}^{K}\left(\Delta_{j}\frac{e^{-x_{j}}}{\sum_{l=1}^{K}e^{-x_{l}}}\right)\right)\sum_{i=1}^{K}h_{i}\left(\pmb{x}+\Delta\right)+\left\langle h\left(\pmb{x}\right),\Delta\right\rangle \underset{(b)}{=}2\left\langle h\left(\pmb{x}\right),\Delta\right\rangle 
\end{array}\tag{110}
$$

where (a) uses $\begin{array}{r}{\left|h_{i}\left(\pmb{x}+\Delta\right)-h_{i}\left(\pmb{x}\right)\right|\le\operatorname*{max}\bigg\{\Delta_{i}h_{i}\left(\pmb{x}\right),h_{i}\left(\pmb{x}+\Delta\right)\frac{\sum_{j=1}^{K}\Delta_{j}e^{-x_{j}}}{\sum_{l=1}^{K}e^{-x_{l}}}\bigg\}}\end{array}$ for all i, due to (108) and (109). Equality (b) uses that $\begin{array}{r}{\sum_{i=1}^{K}h_{i}\left(\pmb{x}+\Delta\right)=1}\end{array}$ by definition.

Proof Define the filtration $\mathcal{G}_{t}=\sigma\left(\{a_{\tau}|\tau<t\}\right)$ and note that $\pmb{l}_{t}$ is $\mathcal{G}_{t}$ -measurable. We have

$$
\tilde{l}_{t}^{(i)}=\frac{l_{t}^{(i)}1_{\{a_{t}=i\}}}{p_{t}^{(i)}+\gamma_{t}}\leq\frac{l_{t}^{(i)}1_{\{a_{t}=i\}}}{p_{t}^{(i)}+\gamma_{t}l_{t}^{(i)}1_{\{a_{t}=i\}}}=\frac{1}{2\gamma_{t}}\frac{2\gamma_{t}\frac{l_{t}^{(i)}}{p_{t}^{(i)}}1_{\{a_{t}=i\}}}{1+\gamma_{t}\frac{l_{t}^{(i)}}{p_{t}^{(i)}}1_{\{a_{t}=i\}}}\underset{(a)}{\leq}\frac{1}{2\gamma_{t}}\log\left(1+2\gamma_{t}\frac{l_{t}^{(i)}}{p_{t}^{(i)}}1_{\{a_{t}=i\}}\right)\tag{112}
$$

where (a) uses ${\frac{x}{1+{\frac{x}{2}}}}\leq\log\left(1+x\right)$ which holds for $x \geq 0$ .Then

$$
\begin{array}{rl}
\mathbb{E}\left\{ e^{\sum_{i=1}^{K}\alpha_{t}^{(i)}\tilde{l}_{t}^{(i)}}\mid\mathcal{G}_{t}\right\}  & \leq\mathbb{E}\left\{ e^{\sum_{i=1}^{K}\frac{\alpha_{t}^{(i)}}{2\gamma_{t}}\log\left(1+2\gamma_{t}\frac{l_{t}^{(i)}}{p_{t}^{(i)}}1_{\{a_{t}=i\}}\right)}\mid\mathcal{G}_{t}\right\} \\
 & \underset{(a)}{\le}\mathbb{E}\left\{ e^{\sum_{i=1}^{K}\log\left(1+\alpha_{t}^{(i)}\frac{l_{t}^{(i)}}{p_{t}^{(i)}}1_{\{a_{t}=i\}}\right)}\mid\mathcal{G}_{t}\right\} =\mathbb{E}\left\{ \prod_{i=1}^{K}\left(1+\alpha_{t}^{(i)}\frac{l_{t}^{(i)}}{p_{t}^{(i)}}1_{\{a_{t}=i\}}\right)\mid\mathcal{G}_{t}\right\} \\
 & \underset{(b)}{=}\mathbb{E}\left\{ 1+\sum_{i=1}^{K}\alpha_{t}^{(i)}\frac{l_{t}^{(i)}}{p_{t}^{(i)}}1_{\{a_{t}=i\}}\mid\mathcal{G}_{t}\right\} \underset{(c)}{=}1+\sum_{i=1}^{K}\alpha_{t}^{(i)}l_{t}^{(i)}\le e^{\sum_{i=1}^{K}\alpha_{t}^{(i)}l_{t}^{(i)}}
\end{array}\tag{113}
$$

where (a) uses $x\log(1+y)\leq\log{(1+xy)}$ which holds for $y > - 1$ and $0 \leq x \leq 1$ , since $\alpha_{t}^{(i)}\leq 2\gamma_{t}$ Inequality (b) uses that $1_{\{a_{t}= i \}}1_{\{a_{t}= j \}}= 0$ for all $i \neq j$ ,and (c) uses that $p_{t}^{(i)}$ and $l_{t}^{(i)}$ are $\mathcal{G}_{t}$ -measurable and that given $\mathcal{G}_{t}, a_{t}= i$ with probability $p_{t}^{(i)}$

Since $l_{t}^{(i)}$ is $\mathcal{G}_{t}$ -measurable then (113) yields $\mathbb{E}\left\{e^{\sum_{i=1}^{K}\alpha_{t}^{(i)}\left(\tilde{l}_{t}^{(i)}-l_{t}^{(i)}\right)}|\mathcal{G}_{t}\right\}\leq 1$ for all i. Let $S =$ $\textstyle \sum_{t = 1}^{T}| S_{t}|$ . Let $\tau_{l}$ be l-th round for which the feedback is not missing or discarded, so $\tau_{1}\leq \tau_{2}\leq$ $\dots \le \tau_{S}$ . Then

$$
\begin{array}{r l}&{\mathbb{E}\left\{e^{\sum_{l=1}^{S}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\alpha_{\tau_{l}}^{(i)}\left(\tilde{l}_{\tau_{l}}^{(i)}-l_{\tau_{l}}^{(i)}\right)}\right\}=\mathbb{E}\left\{\mathbb{E}\left\{e^{\sum_{l=1}^{S}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\alpha_{\tau_{l}}^{(i)}\left(\tilde{l}_{\tau_{l}}^{(i)}-l_{\tau_{l}}^{(i)}\right)}|\mathcal{G}_{\tau_{S}}\right\}\right\}\underset{(a)}{=}}\\ &{\quad\mathbb{E}\left\{e^{\sum_{l=1}^{S-1}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\alpha_{\tau_{l}}^{(i)}\left(\tilde{l}_{\tau_{l}}^{(i)}-l_{\tau_{l}}^{(i)}\right)}\mathbb{E}\left\{e^{\sum_{i=1}^{K}\alpha_{\tau_{S}}^{(i)}\left(\tilde{l}_{\tau_{S}}^{(i)}-l_{\tau_{S}}^{(i)}\right)}|\mathcal{G}_{\tau_{S}}\right\}\right\}\leq\mathbb{E}\left\{e^{\sum_{l=1}^{S-1}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\alpha_{\tau_{l}}^{(i)}\left(\tilde{l}_{\tau_{l}}^{(i)}-l_{\tau_{l}}^{(i)}\right)}\right\}}\end{array}\tag{114}
$$

where (a) uses that $a_{\tau_{1}},l_{\tau_{1}},{p_{\tau_{1}}},\dotsc,a_{\tau_{S-1}},l_{\tau_{S-1}},{p_{\tau_{S-1}}}$ are $\mathcal{G}_{\tau_{S}}$ -measurable.

Iterating over (114) yields $\mathbb{E}\left\{e^{\sum_{t\notin\mathcal{M}^{\ast}}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\alpha_{t}^{(i)}\left(\tilde{l}_{t}^{(i)}-l_{t}^{(i)}\right)}\right\}\leq 1$ , so by Markov's inequality

$$
\begin{array}{ r }{\mathbb{P}\left(\displaystyle\sum_{t\notin\mathcal{M}^{*}}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\alpha_{t}^{(i)}\left(\tilde{l}_{t}^{(i)}-l_{t}^{(i)}\right)>\log\frac{1}{\delta}\right)=\mathbb{P}\left(e^{\sum_{t\notin\mathcal{M}^{*}}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\alpha_{t}^{(i)}\left(\tilde{l}_{t}^{(i)}-l_{t}^{(i)}\right)}>\frac{1}{\delta}\right)}\\ {\leq\delta\mathbb{E}\left\{e^{\sum_{t\notin\mathcal{M}^{*}}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\alpha_{t}^{(i)}\left(\tilde{l}_{t}^{(i)}-l_{t}^{(i)}\right)}\right\}\leq\delta .}\end{array}\tag{115}
$$

### Proof of Theorem 6

Proof We choose $\eta_{t}= \eta$ in (42) of Lemma 5 and define $\mathcal{D}= \left\{t | d_{t}\geq \frac{1}{e^{2}\eta}- 1 \text{ and } t + d_{t}\leq T \right\}$ so $\mathcal{M}^{\ast}= \mathcal{M}\cup \mathcal{D}$ in the statement of Lemma 5. Now divide both sides by η:

$$
\mathbb{E}\left\{\sum_{t=1}^{T}l_{t}^{(a_{t})}-\operatorname*{min}_{i}\sum_{t=1}^{T}l_{t}^{(i)}\right\}\leq\frac{\log K}{\eta}+\frac{e^{2}}{2}\eta K T+4\eta\sum_{t\notin\mathcal{M}^{*}}d_{t}+\left|\mathcal{M}\right| +\left|\mathcal{D}\right|.\tag{47}
$$

Then, choosing $\begin{array}{r}{\eta = \frac{e^{- 2}}{2}\sqrt{\frac{\log K}{K T + \sum_{t \notin \mathcal{M}}d_{t}}}}\end{array}$ yields (46). Note that for this choice $\begin{array}{r}{|\mathcal{D}|\leq\frac{\sum_{t\notin\mathcal{M}}d_{t}}{e^{-2}\eta^{-1}-1}\leq\sqrt{\left(\sum_{t\notin\mathcal{M}}d_{t}\right)\log K}}\end{array}$ , since $\begin{array}{r}{\sum_{t\not\in\mathcal{M}}d_{t}\geq\left(\frac{1}{e^{2}\eta}-1\right)|\mathcal{D}|}\end{array}$ (discarded samples in D are not missing).

### Proof of Lemma 6

Proof Define the set of missing samples $\mathcal{M}= \{t | t + d_{t}> T \}$ and the set of discarded samples ${\mathcal{D}}_{T}= \left\{t | d_{t}\eta_{t}> e^{- 2}- \eta_{t}\right\}$ . Define $t^{*}\left(T\right)=\operatorname*{min}_{t\in\mathcal{M}}t$ , and note that $t^{*}(T)\to\infty$ as $T \to \infty$ since $t + d_{t}\geq t$ ,and $f\left(t\right)=t$ is increasing. Since $\eta_{t}$ is non-increasing then

$$
\sum_{t\in\mathcal{M}}\eta_{t}\le\left|\mathcal{M}\right|\eta_{t^{\ast}\left(T\right)}\le\left(T-t^{\ast}\left(T\right)+1\right)\eta_{t^{\ast}\left(T\right)}\le d_{t^{\ast}\left(T\right)}\eta_{t^{\ast}\left(T\right)}.\tag{51}
$$

Given $\textstyle \sum_{t = 1}^{\infty}\eta_{t}^{2}d_{t}~ < ~ \infty$ and $\textstyle \sum_{t = 1}^{\infty}\eta_{t}\ = \ \infty$ we must have $\operatorname*{lim}_{t\to\infty}\eta_{t}d_{t}=0$ if this limit exists, so $\operatorname*{lim}_{T\to\infty}|\mathcal{D}_{T}| <\infty$ . Therefore for the optimal arm $i^{*}$

$$
\operatorname*{lim}_{T\to\infty}\frac{\mathbb{E}\left\{\sum_{t=1}^{T}\eta_{t}\left(l_{t}^{(a_{t})}-l_{t}^{(i^{*})}\right)\right\}}{\sum_{t=1}^{T}\eta_{t}}\underset{(a)}{\le}\operatorname*{lim}_{T\to\infty}\frac{\eta_{1}\left|\mathcal{D}_{T}\right| +d_{t^{*}(T)}\eta_{t^{*}(T)}+4\log K+5 K\sum_{t=1}^{T}\eta_{t}^{2}\left(1+6 d_{t}\right)}{\sum_{t=1}^{T}\eta_{t}}\underset{(b)}{=}0\tag{52}
$$

where (a) is Lemma 5 and (51), and (b) uses $d_{t}\eta_{t}\to 0$ as $\begin{array}{r}{t\to\infty,\sum_{t=1}^{\infty}\eta_{t}=\infty}\end{array}$ and $\textstyle \sum_{t = 1}^{\infty}d_{t}\eta_{t}^{2}< \infty .$

context.name: Setup: problem formulation, adversaries, delays, missing samples (Section 2)
context.statement:
Consider a player that in each round t from 1 to $T$ picks an action $\pmb{a}_{t}\in \mathcal{K}$ from a set $\mathcal{K}$ . The cost at round t from playing $\pmb{a}_{t}$ is $l_{t}\left(\boldsymbol{a}_{t}\right)\in\left[0,1\right]$ . We consider two types of adversaries:

1. Oblivious Adversary: chooses the cost functions $l_{1},...,l_{T}$ before the game starts.

2. Adaptive Adversary: chooses the cost function $l_{t}$ after observing $\{a_{1}, \ldots a_{t - 1}\}$ , for each t.

With full information and no delays, the player gets to know the function $l_{t}$ immediately after playing $\pmb{a}_{t}$ . In the bandit delayed feedback scenario, the player only gets to know the value of ${l}_{t}\left(\pmb{a}_{t}\right)$ at the beginning of round $t + d_{t}$ . (i.e., after a delay of $d_{t}\geq 1$ rounds). The adversary (oblivious or adaptive) chooses the delay sequence $\{d_{t}\}$ before the game starts.

We assume that the cost feedback includes the timestamp of the action that incurred this cost. This is indeed the case in many applications, such as when robots take physical actions, a recommendation is made to a customer or a treatment is given to a patient. If the delays are bounded by d, Cesa-Bianchi et al. (2018) have shown that EXP3 can still be implemented even with no timestamps, with expected regret $O(\sqrt{dTK\log K})$ instead of $O\left({\sqrt{\left(d+K\right)T\log K}}\right)$ . For our unbounded delays case, it is not clear if FKM or EXP3 can be implemented without timestamps.

The set of costs (feedback samples) received and used at round t is denoted $\mathcal{S}_{t}$ , so $s \in \mathcal{S}_{t}$ means that the cost of $\pmb{a}_{s}$ from round s is received and used at round t. Since the game lasts for $T$ rounds, all costs for which $t + d_{t}> T$ are never received. Of course, the value of $d_{t}$ does not matter as long as $t + d_{t}> T$ , and these are just samples that the adversary chose to prevent the player from receiving. We name these costs the missing samples and denote their set by $\mathcal{M}$ .

While the rounds of the game are indexed by t, it will be useful to our analysis to index a finer time scale that counts the steps of the algorithm for every such t. We define $s_{-}, s_{+}$ as the steps a moment before and after the algorithm uses the feedback from round s, respectively. These steps are taking place in round t if $s \in S_{t}$

context.name: Setup: multi-armed bandit special case (Section 2)
context.statement:
We analyze two widely applied algorithms for the two central special cases of the scenario above:

2. Multi-Armed Bandit - $\mathcal{K}=\{1,...,K\},\ l_{t}:\{1,...,K\}\to [0,1].$ With no delays, the EXP3 algorithm (Auer et al., 2002) achieves an expected regret of $O \left({\sqrt{T K \log K}}\right)$ for this problem.

context.name: Definition 1 (expected regret, eq. 1)
context.statement:
The player wants to have a learning algorithm that uses past observations to make good decisions over time. The performance of the player's algorithm is measured using the regret. The expected regret is the total expected cost over a horizon of $T$ rounds, compared to the total expected cost that results from playing the best fixed action in hindsight in all rounds:

Definition 1. Let $\begin{array}{r}{\pmb{a}^{*}=\underset{\pmb{a}\in\mathcal{K}}{\arg\operatorname*{min}}\sum_{t=1}^{T}l_{t}\left(\pmb{a}\right)}\end{array}$ . The expected regret is defined as

$$
\mathbb{E}\left\{R\left(T\right)\right\}\triangleq\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left\{l_{t}\left(\pmb{a}_{t}\right)-l_{t}\left(\pmb{a}^{*}\right)\right\}\tag{1}
$$

where $\mathbb{E}$ is the expectation over the (possibly) random actions $\pmb{a}_{1},\ldots,\pmb{a}_{T}$ of the player.

context.name: Definition 2 (no weighted-regret, eq. 2) and remarks
context.statement:
Our key observation is that with delayed feedback, it is not the regret that matters for the game dynamics but rather what we call the weighted-regret. The weighted-regret weighs the costs in different rounds according to a given non-increasing sequence $\eta_{t}$ so it coincides with the regret when $\eta_{t}=\eta,\forall t$ . We define "no weighted-regret" to replace the traditional no-regret property:

Definition 2. Let $\{l_{t}:\mathcal{K}\to [0,1]\}_{t}$ be a sequence of cost functions, chosen by an adaptive adversary. Let $\pmb{a}^{*}=\arg\operatorname*{min}_{\pmb{a}\in\mathcal{K}}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\eta_{t}l_{t}\left(\pmb{a}\right)$ . Let $\{d_{t}\}$ be a delay sequence such that the cost from round t is received at round $t + d_{t}$ . We say that an algorithm that produces the random sequence of (single-agent) actions $\left\{\pmb{a}_{t}\right\}$ has no weighted-regret with respect to $\{d_{t}\}$ and the non-increasing weight

sequence $\{\eta_{t}\}$ if

$$
\operatorname*{lim}_{T\to\infty}\mathbb{E}\left\{\frac{\sum_{t=1}^{T}\eta_{t}\left(l_{t}\left(\pmb{a}_{t}\right)-l_{t}\left(\pmb{a}^{*}\right)\right)}{\sum_{t=1}^{T}\eta_{t}}\right\}=0\tag{2}
$$

where the expectation is with respect to the random $\left\{\pmb{a}_{t}\right\}$ generated by the algorithm.

Having no weighted-regret is only non-trivial when $\textstyle \sum_{t = 1}^{\infty}\eta_{t}\ = \infty$ When $\textstyle\sum_{t=1}^{\infty}\eta_{t}<\infty,$ the feedback from the last $\textstyle{\frac{T}{2}}$ rounds can be discarded without affecting (2). When $\textstyle \sum_{t = 1}^{\infty}\eta_{t}= \infty$ ,there is no round t after which we can discard all feedback and still maintain (2).

We define no weighted-regret with respect to an adaptive adversary since, in a non-cooperative game with cost functions $\{u_{n}\}$ , the "adversarial" cost function of player n is $l_{t}({\bf{a}}_{n})=u_{n}({\bf{a}}_{n},{\bf{a}}_{-n,t})$ so it is determined by the actions of the other players. In turn, the actions of the other players depend on the past actions of player n. Hence, the cost function of player n depends on her past actions, as with an adaptive adversary. In general, the equilibrium does not consist of absolute strategies such as "min-max" in zero-sum games. Hence, regret guarantees against an adaptive adversary allow proving convergence to the set of CCE for general non-cooperative games.

When taking the limit $T\to\infty,$ it is important to emphasize that we do not change the infinite sequence of delays $\{d_{t}\}$ , but only reveal more elements in this sequence. In other words, we are looking at the same game but over a longer time horizon. Therefore, while $\begin{array}{r}{d_{t}= \frac{T}{2}}\end{array}$ makes sense for a constant $T,$ it is misleading when taking $T \to \infty$ since it represents a delay that occurred at time t but changes with the limit, so the limit is no longer of the "same game".

context.name: Setup: EXP3 with delays, mixed actions and the filtration F_t (eq. 41, Section 6)
context.statement:
Consider a player that at each round t picks one out of K arms. Let $a_{t}$ be the arm the player chooses at round t. The cost at round t of playing arm i is $l_{t}^{(i)}\in [0,1]$ , and let $l_{t}=\left(l_{t}^{(1)},...,l_{t}^{(K)}\right)$ be the cost vector. At round t, the EXP3 algorithm, detailed in Algorithm 3, chooses an arm at random using a distribution that depends on the history of the game. The variant when $\gamma_{t}\neq 0$ , as we use against an adaptive adversary, is known as EXP3-IX (see Neu (2015)). We denote the vector of probabilities of the player for choosing arms at round t by $\pmb{p}_{t}\in \Delta^{K}$ , where $\Delta^{K}$ denotes the K-simplex. This is also known as the mixed action of the player. We also define the following filtration

$$
\mathcal{F}_{t}=\sigma\left(\left\{a_{s}\vert s+d_{s}\le t\right\}\cup\left\{l_{s}\vert s\le t\right\}\right)\tag{41}
$$

which is generated from all the actions for which the feedback was received up to round t and all cost functions up to round t. Note that the mixed action $\pmb{p}_{t}$ is a $\mathcal{F}_{t}$ -measurable random variable since $\mathcal{F}_{t}$ includes everything that could affect the algorithm up to round t. With a slight abuse of notation, we use $\mathcal{F}_{s_{-}}$ to denote the filtration induced from all actions for which the feedback has been received and used up to step $s_{-}$ and all the cost functions up to round t.

context.name: Algorithm 3 (EXP3 with delays, eqs. 44-45)
context.statement:
Algorithm 3 EXP3 with delays   
Initialization: Let $\{\eta_{t}\}$ and $\{\gamma_{t}\}$ be non-negative non-increasing sequences such that $\eta_{1}\leq \frac{e^{- 2}}{2}$ and   
set $\tilde{L}_{1}^{(i)}=0$ and $\begin{array}{r}{p_{1}^{(i)}=\frac{1}{K}}\end{array}$ for $i=1,...,K.$   
For $t=1,...,T$ do   
1. Choose an arm $a_{t}$ at random according to the distribution $\pmb{p}_{t}$ .   
2. Collect in $S_{t}$ all the rounds s for which $l_{s}^{(a_{s})}$ arrived at round t after a delay of $\begin{array}{r}{d_{s}\le \frac{1}{e^{2}\eta_{s}}- 1}\end{array}$   
3. Set $\tilde{L}_{t}^{(i)}=\tilde{L}_{t-1}^{(i)}$ for all i. Update the weights of arm $a_{s}$ for all $s \in S_{t}$ using   
$\tilde{L}_{t}^{(a_{s})}=\tilde{L}_{t}^{(a_{s})}+\eta_{s}\frac{l_{s}^{(a_{s})}}{p_{s}^{(a_{s})}+\gamma_{s}}.$ (44)   
4. Update the mixed action for $i=1,\ldots,K$ using   
$p_{t+1}^{(i)}=\frac{e^{-\tilde{L}_{t}^{(i)}}}{\sum_{j=1}^{K}e^{-\tilde{L}_{t}^{(j)}}}.$ (45)   
End

context.name: Section 6.2 introduction (conditions for no weighted-regret)
context.statement: In this subsection, we provide conditions for EXP3 to have no weighted-regret with respect to the delay sequence and its step-size sequence as the weight sequence of Section 3. As discussed in Section 3, $\textstyle \sum_{t = 1}^{\infty}\eta_{t}= \infty$ , is necessary for the no weighted-regret property to be non-trivial. All other conditions of Lemma 6 are as tight as the bound of Lemma 5.

context.name: Lemma 8 (effect of delays, eq. 66)
context.statement:
Lemma 8. Let $\{\eta_{t}\}$ be a non-increasing step-size sequence. Let $\{d_{t}\}$ be a delay such that the cost from round t is received at round $t + d_{t}$ . Let $S_{t}$ be the set of feedback samples received and used at round t. Define the set $\mathcal{M}^{\ast}$ of all samples that are not received and used before round T. Then

$$

  weightedExpReg μ T K hK (fun _ => 1) (fun t _ i => l0 t i) a

noncomputable def NoWeightedRegret {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    (K : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (l : ℕ → Ω → Fin K → ℝ) (a : ℕ → Ω → Fin K) : Prop :=
  limsup (fun T : ℕ => weightedExpReg μ T K hK η l a / ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t)
    atTop ≤ 0

structure Exp3Delayed {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) (K : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K)
    (l : ℕ → Ω → Fin K → ℝ) (d : ℕ → ℕ) (η γ : ℕ → ℝ) where
  𝓕 : ℕ → MeasurableSpace Ω
  𝓕_le : ∀ t, 𝓕 t ≤ ‹MeasurableSpace Ω›
  𝓕_mono : Monotone 𝓕
  a : ℕ → Ω → Fin K
  p : ℕ → Ω → Fin K → ℝ
  Lhat : ℕ → Ω → Fin K → ℝ
  measurable_a : ∀ t, Measurable (a t)
  𝓕_eq : ∀ t, 𝓕 t =
    (⨆ s, ⨆ (_ : 1 ≤ s ∧ s + d s ≤ t), MeasurableSpace.comap (a s) inferInstance)
      ⊔ (⨆ s, ⨆ (_ : 1 ≤ s ∧ s ≤ t), MeasurableSpace.comap (l s) inferInstance)
  measurable_p : ∀ t i, @Measurable Ω ℝ (𝓕 t) _ (fun ω => p t ω i)
  p_isProb : ∀ t ω, (∀ i, 0 ≤ p t ω i) ∧ ∑ i, p t ω i = 1
  p_init : ∀ ω i, p 1 ω i = 1 / (K : ℝ)
  a_law : ∀ t i,
      (μ[(fun ω => if a t ω = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0) | 𝓕 t]) =ᵐ[μ] (fun ω => p t ω i)
  Lhat_init : ∀ ω i, Lhat 0 ω i = 0
  Lhat_step : ∀ t ω i, 1 ≤ t →
      Lhat t ω i = Lhat (t - 1) ω i +
        ∑ s ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 t).filter
          (fun s => s + d s = t ∧ (d s : ℝ) ≤ 1 / (Real.exp 2 * η s) - 1 ∧ a s ω = i),
          η s * l s ω i / (p s ω i + γ s)
  p_update : ∀ t ω i,
      p (t + 1) ω i = Real.exp (- Lhat t ω i) / ∑ j, Real.exp (- Lhat t ω j)

-- ############ MACHINERY ############


noncomputable def sfm {K : ℕ} (x : Fin K → ℝ) (i : Fin K) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (- x i) / ∑ j, Real.exp (- x j)

lemma sfm_denom_pos {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K) (x : Fin K → ℝ) :
    0 < ∑ j, Real.exp (- x j) := by
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin K) := ⟨⟨0, hK⟩⟩
  exact Finset.sum_pos (fun j _ => Real.exp_pos _) Finset.univ_nonempty

lemma sfm_pos {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K) (x : Fin K → ℝ) (i : Fin K) : 0 < sfm x i :=
  div_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (sfm_denom_pos hK x)

lemma sfm_sum {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K) (x : Fin K → ℝ) : ∑ i, sfm x i = 1 := by
  unfold sfm
  rw [← Finset.sum_div, div_self (ne_of_gt (sfm_denom_pos hK x))]

-- Lemma 10
lemma sfm_l1 {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K) (x D : Fin K → ℝ) (hD : ∀ i, 0 ≤ D i) :
    ∑ i, |sfm x i - sfm (fun j => x j + D j) i| ≤ 2 * ∑ i, sfm x i * D i := by
  set Z := ∑ j, Real.exp (- x j) with hZ
  set Z' := ∑ j, Real.exp (- (x j + D j)) with hZ'
  have hZpos : 0 < Z := sfm_denom_pos hK x
  have hZ'pos : 0 < Z' := sfm_denom_pos hK (fun j => x j + D j)
  have hZle : Z' ≤ Z := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro j _
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.2 (by linarith [hD j])
  set S := ∑ j, sfm x j * D j with hS
  have hSnn : 0 ≤ S := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (sfm_pos hK x j)) (hD j))
  have hA : ∀ i, sfm x i - sfm (fun j => x j + D j) i ≤ D i * sfm x i := by
    intro i
    have h1 : sfm x i * Real.exp (-(D i)) ≤ sfm (fun j => x j + D j) i := by
      show Real.exp (-x i) / Z * Real.exp (-(D i)) ≤ Real.exp (-(x i + D i)) / Z'
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_div_iff₀ hZpos hZ'pos]
      have h : Real.exp (-x i) * Real.exp (-(D i)) = Real.exp (-(x i + D i)) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
      rw [h]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hZle (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _))
    have h2 : 1 - D i ≤ Real.exp (-(D i)) := by
      have := Real.add_one_le_exp (-(D i)); linarith
    nlinarith [sfm_pos hK x i]
  have hSform : S = (∑ j, Real.exp (-x j) * D j) / Z := by
    rw [hS, Finset.sum_div]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by show sfm x j * D j = _; unfold sfm; ring)
  have hZZ' : Z - Z' ≤ ∑ j, Real.exp (-x j) * D j := by
    rw [hZ, hZ', ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro j _
    have h : Real.exp (-(x j + D j)) = Real.exp (-x j) * Real.exp (-(D j)) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
    rw [h]
    have h2 : 1 - D j ≤ Real.exp (-(D j)) := by
      have := Real.add_one_le_exp (-(D j)); linarith
    nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (-x j)]
  have hB : ∀ i, sfm (fun j => x j + D j) i - sfm x i ≤ sfm (fun j => x j + D j) i * S := by
    intro i
    have h1 : sfm (fun j => x j + D j) i - sfm x i
        ≤ sfm (fun j => x j + D j) i * ((Z - Z')/Z) := by
      show Real.exp (-(x i + D i)) / Z' - Real.exp (-x i) / Z
          ≤ Real.exp (-(x i + D i)) / Z' * ((Z - Z')/Z)
      have hle : Real.exp (-(x i + D i)) ≤ Real.exp (-x i) := by
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.2; linarith [hD i]
      have heq : Real.exp (-(x i + D i)) / Z' * ((Z - Z')/Z)
           = Real.exp (-(x i + D i))/Z' - Real.exp (-(x i+D i))/Z := by
        field_simp
      rw [heq]
      have : Real.exp (-(x i + D i))/Z ≤ Real.exp (-x i)/Z := by gcongr
      linarith
    refine h1.trans ?_
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (le_of_lt (sfm_pos hK _ i))
    rw [hSform]
    gcongr
  calc ∑ i, |sfm x i - sfm (fun j => x j + D j) i|
      ≤ ∑ i, (D i * sfm x i + sfm (fun j => x j + D j) i * S) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        rw [abs_le]
        constructor
        · have := hB i
          have h1 : 0 ≤ D i * sfm x i := mul_nonneg (hD i) (le_of_lt (sfm_pos hK x i))
          linarith
        · have := hA i
          have h2 : 0 ≤ sfm (fun j => x j + D j) i * S :=
            mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (sfm_pos hK _ i)) hSnn
          linarith
    _ = 2 * S := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, sfm_sum hK]
        have : ∑ i, D i * sfm x i = S := by
          rw [hS]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => mul_comm _ _)
        rw [this]; ring

/-- A nonnegative loss update can decrease coordinate `i` by at most its old
probability times the increment of that coordinate. -/
private lemma sfm_drop_le {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K) (x D : Fin K → ℝ)
    (hD : ∀ i, 0 ≤ D i) (i : Fin K) :
    max (sfm x i - sfm (fun j => x j + D j) i) 0 ≤ sfm x i * D i := by
  set Z := ∑ j, Real.exp (-x j) with hZ
  set Z' := ∑ j, Real.exp (-(x j + D j)) with hZ'
  have hZpos : 0 < Z := sfm_denom_pos hK x
  have hZ'pos : 0 < Z' := sfm_denom_pos hK (fun j => x j + D j)
  have hZle : Z' ≤ Z := by
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => Real.exp_le_exp.2 ?_)
    linarith [hD j]
  have hmul : sfm x i * Real.exp (-(D i)) ≤ sfm (fun j => x j + D j) i := by
    show Real.exp (-x i) / Z * Real.exp (-(D i)) ≤ Real.exp (-(x i + D i)) / Z'
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_div_iff₀ hZpos hZ'pos]
    have he : Real.exp (-x i) * Real.exp (-(D i)) = Real.exp (-(x i + D i)) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      ring_nf
    rw [he]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hZle (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _))
  have hexp : 1 - D i ≤ Real.exp (-(D i)) := by
    have := Real.add_one_le_exp (-(D i))
    linarith
  have hdiff : sfm x i - sfm (fun j => x j + D j) i ≤ sfm x i * D i := by
    nlinarith [sfm_pos hK x i]
  exact max_le hdiff (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (sfm_pos hK x i)) (hD i))

lemma exp_neg_quad (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) : Real.exp (-u) ≤ 1 - u + u^2/2 := by
  have h1 : (1:ℝ) + u + u^2/2 ≤ Real.exp u := Real.quadratic_le_exp_of_nonneg hu
  have h2 : (0:ℝ) < 1 + u + u^2/2 := by nlinarith
  have h3 : Real.exp (-u) = 1 / Real.exp u := by rw [Real.exp_neg]; ring
  rw [h3]
  refine (one_div_le_one_div_of_le h2 h1).trans ?_
  rw [div_le_iff₀ h2]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg u, sq_nonneg (u^2)]

noncomputable def pot {K : ℕ} (x : Fin K → ℝ) : ℝ := - Real.log (∑ j, Real.exp (- x j))

lemma pot_le {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K) (x : Fin K → ℝ) (i : Fin K) : pot x ≤ x i := by
  unfold pot
  have h1 : Real.exp (- x i) ≤ ∑ j, Real.exp (- x j) :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => Real.exp (- x j)) (fun j _ => le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _))
      (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) h1
  rw [Real.log_exp] at this
  linarith

lemma pot_zero {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K) : pot (fun _ : Fin K => (0:ℝ)) = - Real.log K := by
  unfold pot
  simp

lemma pot_step {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K) (x D : Fin K → ℝ) (hD : ∀ i, 0 ≤ D i) :
    (∑ i, sfm x i * D i) - (1/2) * ∑ i, sfm x i * (D i)^2
      ≤ pot (fun j => x j + D j) - pot x := by
  set Z := ∑ j, Real.exp (- x j) with hZ
  set Z' := ∑ j, Real.exp (- (x j + D j)) with hZ'
  have hZpos : 0 < Z := sfm_denom_pos hK x
  have hZ'pos : 0 < Z' := sfm_denom_pos hK (fun j => x j + D j)
  set W := Z' / Z with hW
  have hWpos : 0 < W := div_pos hZ'pos hZpos
  have hpotdiff : pot (fun j => x j + D j) - pot x = - Real.log W := by
    unfold pot
    rw [hW, Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hZ'pos) (ne_of_gt hZpos)]
    ring
  have hlog : 1 - W ≤ - Real.log W := by
    have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hWpos; linarith
  have hWeq : W = ∑ j, sfm x j * Real.exp (- D j) := by
    rw [hW, hZ']
    rw [Finset.sum_div]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    unfold sfm
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, ← Real.exp_add]
    ring_nf
    rw [hZ]
  have key : (∑ i, sfm x i * D i) - (1/2) * ∑ i, sfm x i * (D i)^2 ≤ 1 - W := by
    rw [hWeq]
    have h1 : ∑ j, sfm x j * Real.exp (- D j)
        ≤ ∑ j, sfm x j * (1 - D j + (D j)^2/2) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro j _
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (exp_neg_quad (D j) (hD j)) (le_of_lt (sfm_pos hK x j))
    have h2 : ∑ j, sfm x j * (1 - D j + (D j)^2/2)
        = 1 - ((∑ i, sfm x i * D i) - (1/2) * ∑ i, sfm x i * (D i)^2) := by
      have : ∀ j, sfm x j * (1 - D j + (D j)^2/2)
          = sfm x j - sfm x j * D j + (1/2) * (sfm x j * (D j)^2) := by intro j; ring
      simp_rw [this]
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, sfm_sum hK, ← Finset.mul_sum]
      ring
    linarith
  linarith

lemma cond_pull {Ω : Type*} {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] (hm : m ≤ mΩ)
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {f g h : Ω → ℝ} (hf : Measurable[m] f) (hf0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ f ω)
    (hg : Measurable[mΩ] g) (hg0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ g ω) (hgb : ∀ ω, g ω ≤ 1)
    (hh : Measurable[m] h) (hh0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ h ω)
    (hcond : μ[g|m] =ᵐ[μ] h)
    (hfh : Integrable (fun ω => f ω * h ω) μ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => f ω * g ω) μ ∧ ∫ ω, f ω * g ω ∂μ = ∫ ω, f ω * h ω ∂μ := by
  haveI : SigmaFinite (μ.trim hm) := by infer_instance
  set fn : ℕ → Ω → ℝ := fun n ω => min (f ω) (n : ℝ) with hfn
  have hfnm : ∀ n, Measurable[m] (fn n) := fun n => hf.min measurable_const
  have hfnM : ∀ n, Measurable[mΩ] (fn n) := fun n => (hfnm n).mono hm le_rfl
  have hfM : Measurable[mΩ] f := hf.mono hm le_rfl
  have hhM : Measurable[mΩ] h := hh.mono hm le_rfl
  have hfn0 : ∀ n ω, 0 ≤ fn n ω := fun n ω => le_min (hf0 ω) (Nat.cast_nonneg n)
  have hfnle : ∀ n ω, fn n ω ≤ f ω := fun n ω => min_le_left _ _
  have hgint : Integrable g μ := by
    refine (integrable_const (1:ℝ)).mono' hg.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_)
    intro ω; rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hg0 ω)]; exact hgb ω
  -- step: for each n, the integrals agree
  have key : ∀ n, ∫ ω, fn n ω * g ω ∂μ = ∫ ω, fn n ω * h ω ∂μ := by
    intro n
    have hb : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ‖fn n ω‖ ≤ (n:ℝ) := by
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hfn0 n ω)]
      exact min_le_right _ _
    have h1 : μ[(fn n) * g|m] =ᵐ[μ] (fn n) * (μ[g|m]) :=
      condExp_stronglyMeasurable_mul_of_bound (μ := μ) hm (hfnm n).stronglyMeasurable hgint (n:ℝ) hb
    have h2 : μ[(fn n) * g|m] =ᵐ[μ] fun ω => fn n ω * h ω := by
      filter_upwards [h1, hcond] with ω hω1 hω2
      simp only [Pi.mul_apply] at hω1 ⊢
      rw [hω1, hω2]
    calc ∫ ω, fn n ω * g ω ∂μ = ∫ ω, (μ[(fn n) * g|m]) ω ∂μ := (integral_condExp hm).symm
      _ = ∫ ω, fn n ω * h ω ∂μ := integral_congr_ae h2
  -- integrability of fn n * h
  have hfnh_int : ∀ n, Integrable (fun ω => fn n ω * h ω) μ := by
    intro n
    refine hfh.mono' ((hfnM n).mul hhM).aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_)
    intro ω
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hfn0 n ω) (hh0 ω))]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hfnle n ω) (hh0 ω)
  have hfnh_le : ∀ n, ∫ ω, fn n ω * h ω ∂μ ≤ ∫ ω, f ω * h ω ∂μ := by
    intro n
    refine integral_mono (hfnh_int n) hfh ?_
    intro ω
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hfnle n ω) (hh0 ω)
  -- integrability of fn n * g
  have hfng_int : ∀ n, Integrable (fun ω => fn n ω * g ω) μ := by
    intro n
    refine (hgint.const_mul (n:ℝ)).mono' ((hfnM n).mul hg).aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_)
    intro ω
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hfn0 n ω) (hg0 ω))]
    have : fn n ω ≤ (n:ℝ) := min_le_right _ _
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right this (hg0 ω)
  -- lintegral bound
  have hlint : ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (f ω * g ω) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ ω, f ω * h ω ∂μ) := by
    have hmono : Monotone (fun n : ℕ => fun ω => ENNReal.ofReal (fn n ω * g ω)) := by
      intro a b hab ω
      simp only
      apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (hg0 ω)
      exact min_le_min_left _ (by exact_mod_cast Nat.cast_le.2 hab)
    have hmeas : ∀ n : ℕ, Measurable (fun ω => ENNReal.ofReal (fn n ω * g ω)) :=
      fun n => ((hfnM n).mul hg).ennreal_ofReal
    have hsup : (fun ω => ⨆ n : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal (fn n ω * g ω))
        = fun ω => ENNReal.ofReal (f ω * g ω) := by
      funext ω
      apply le_antisymm
      · exact iSup_le (fun n => ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hfnle n ω) (hg0 ω)))
      · obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_ge (f ω)
        refine le_iSup_of_le n ?_
        have : fn n ω = f ω := min_eq_left hn
        rw [this]
    rw [← hsup, lintegral_iSup hmeas hmono]
    refine iSup_le (fun n => ?_)
    rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (hfng_int n)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => mul_nonneg (hfn0 n ω) (hg0 ω)))]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ((key n) ▸ hfnh_le n)
  have hfg_int : Integrable (fun ω => f ω * g ω) μ := by
    refine ⟨(hfM.mul hg).aestronglyMeasurable, ?_⟩
    rw [hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal (Filter.Eventually.of_forall
      (fun ω => mul_nonneg (hf0 ω) (hg0 ω)))]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt hlint ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
  refine ⟨hfg_int, ?_⟩
  have lim1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∫ ω, fn n ω * g ω ∂μ) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (∫ ω, f ω * g ω ∂μ)) := by
    refine tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (fun ω => f ω * g ω)
      (fun n => ((hfnM n).mul hg).aestronglyMeasurable) hfg_int ?_ ?_
    · intro n
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hfn0 n ω) (hg0 ω))]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hfnle n ω) (hg0 ω)
    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => ?_)
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_ge (f ω)
      apply Filter.Tendsto.congr' _ tendsto_const_nhds
      filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop N] with n hn
      have : fn n ω = f ω := min_eq_left (hN.trans (by exact_mod_cast Nat.cast_le.2 hn))
      rw [this]
  have lim2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∫ ω, fn n ω * h ω ∂μ) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (∫ ω, f ω * h ω ∂μ)) := by
    refine tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (fun ω => f ω * h ω)
      (fun n => ((hfnM n).mul hhM).aestronglyMeasurable) hfh ?_ ?_
    · intro n
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hfn0 n ω) (hh0 ω))]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hfnle n ω) (hh0 ω)
    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => ?_)
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_ge (f ω)
      apply Filter.Tendsto.congr' _ tendsto_const_nhds
      filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop N] with n hn
      have : fn n ω = f ω := min_eq_left (hN.trans (by exact_mod_cast Nat.cast_le.2 hn))
      rw [this]
  have : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∫ ω, fn n ω * g ω ∂μ) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (∫ ω, f ω * h ω ∂μ)) := by
    simpa only [key] using lim2
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique lim1 this

section Keys

def kkey (T : ℕ) (d : ℕ → ℕ) (q : ℕ) : ℕ := (q + d q) * (T+1) + q

lemma nat_lex_lt {T x y a b : ℕ} (ha : a < T+1) (hb : b < T+1) :
    x*(T+1)+a < y*(T+1)+b ↔ (x < y ∨ (x = y ∧ a < b)) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases lt_trichotomy x y with hxy | hxy | hxy
    · exact Or.inl hxy
    · subst hxy; right; exact ⟨rfl, by omega⟩
    · exfalso
      have : y*(T+1) + (T+1) ≤ x*(T+1) := by
        have : (y+1)*(T+1) ≤ x*(T+1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hxy
        simpa [add_mul] using this
      omega
  · rintro (hxy | ⟨rfl, hab⟩)
    · have : (x+1)*(T+1) ≤ y*(T+1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hxy
      rw [add_mul, one_mul] at this
      omega
    · omega

lemma kkey_lt_iff {T : ℕ} {d : ℕ → ℕ} {q q' : ℕ} (hq : q ≤ T) (hq' : q' ≤ T) :
    kkey T d q < kkey T d q' ↔
      ((q + d q < q' + d q') ∨ (q + d q = q' + d q' ∧ q < q')) := by
  unfold kkey
  exact nat_lex_lt (by omega) (by omega)

lemma kkey_inj {T : ℕ} {d : ℕ → ℕ} {q q' : ℕ} (hq : q ≤ T) (hq' : q' ≤ T)
    (h : kkey T d q = kkey T d q') : q = q' := by
  by_contra hne
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hlt
  · have := (kkey_lt_iff (T := T) (d := d) hq hq').2 (by
      rcases lt_trichotomy (q + d q) (q' + d q') with h1|h1|h1
      · exact Or.inl h1
      · exact Or.inr ⟨h1, hlt⟩
      · exfalso
        have := (kkey_lt_iff (T := T) (d := d) hq' hq).2 (Or.inl h1)
        omega)
    omega
  · have := (kkey_lt_iff (T := T) (d := d) hq' hq).2 (by
      rcases lt_trichotomy (q' + d q') (q + d q) with h1|h1|h1
      · exact Or.inl h1
      · exact Or.inr ⟨h1, hlt⟩
      · exfalso
        have := (kkey_lt_iff (T := T) (d := d) hq hq').2 (Or.inl h1)
        omega)
    omega

lemma kkey_lt_time {T : ℕ} {d : ℕ → ℕ} {q t : ℕ} (hq : q ≤ T) :
    kkey T d q < (t+1)*(T+1) ↔ q + d q ≤ t := by
  unfold kkey
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    have : (t+1)*(T+1) ≤ (q + d q)*(T+1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hc
    omega
  · intro h
    have : (q+d q)*(T+1) ≤ t*(T+1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h
    have h2 : (t+1)*(T+1) = t*(T+1) + (T+1) := by ring
    omega

end Keys


structure AlgData (Ω : Type*) (K : ℕ) where
  T : ℕ
  d : ℕ → ℕ
  η : ℕ → ℝ
  γ : ℕ → ℝ
  a : ℕ → Ω → Fin K
  l : ℕ → Ω → Fin K → ℝ
  p : ℕ → Ω → Fin K → ℝ

noncomputable def bset {Ω : Type*} {K : ℕ} (A : AlgData Ω K) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Finset.Icc 1 A.T).filter
    (fun q => q + A.d q ≤ A.T ∧ (A.d q : ℝ) ≤ 1/(Real.exp 2 * A.η q) - 1)

noncomputable def ltil {Ω : Type*} {K : ℕ} (A : AlgData Ω K) (q : ℕ) (ω : Ω) (i : Fin K) : ℝ :=
  A.l q ω i * (if A.a q ω = i then (1:ℝ) else 0) / (A.p q ω i + A.γ q)

noncomputable def GG {Ω : Type*} {K : ℕ} (A : AlgData Ω K) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) (i : Fin K) : ℝ :=
  ∑ q ∈ (bset A).filter (fun q => kkey A.T A.d q < n), A.η q * ltil A q ω i

lemma mem_bset {Ω : Type*} {K : ℕ} {A : AlgData Ω K} {q : ℕ} :
    q ∈ bset A ↔ (1 ≤ q ∧ q ≤ A.T) ∧ (q + A.d q ≤ A.T ∧
      (A.d q : ℝ) ≤ 1/(Real.exp 2 * A.η q) - 1) := by
  unfold bset
  simp [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc, and_assoc]

lemma bset_le_T {Ω : Type*} {K : ℕ} {A : AlgData Ω K} {q : ℕ} (h : q ∈ bset A) : q ≤ A.T :=
  (mem_bset.1 h).1.2

lemma filter_split {Ω : Type*} {K : ℕ} (A : AlgData Ω K) (n : ℕ) :
    (bset A).filter (fun q => kkey A.T A.d q < n+1)
      = (bset A).filter (fun q => kkey A.T A.d q < n)
        ∪ (bset A).filter (fun q => kkey A.T A.d q = n) := by
  rw [← Finset.filter_or]
  apply Finset.filter_congr
  intro x _
  simp [Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq]

lemma GG_succ_mem {Ω : Type*} {K : ℕ} (A : AlgData Ω K) (n q : ℕ) (hq : q ∈ bset A)
    (hkq : kkey A.T A.d q = n) (ω : Ω) (i : Fin K) :
    GG A (n+1) ω i = GG A n ω i + A.η q * ltil A q ω i := by
  unfold GG
  rw [filter_split A n]
  rw [Finset.sum_union (by
    simp only [Finset.disjoint_left, Finset.mem_filter]
    rintro x ⟨-, h1⟩ ⟨-, h2⟩; omega)]
  congr 1
  have : (bset A).filter (fun x => kkey A.T A.d x = n) = {q} := by
    apply Finset.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.2
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hq, hkq⟩, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hx
    exact kkey_inj (bset_le_T hx.1) (bset_le_T hq) (by rw [hx.2, hkq])
  rw [this, Finset.sum_singleton]

lemma GG_succ_not {Ω : Type*} {K : ℕ} (A : AlgData Ω K) (n : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ q ∈ bset A, kkey A.T A.d q ≠ n) (ω : Ω) (i : Fin K) :
    GG A (n+1) ω i = GG A n ω i := by
  unfold GG
  rw [filter_split A n]
  rw [Finset.sum_union (by
    simp only [Finset.disjoint_left, Finset.mem_filter]
    rintro x ⟨-, h1⟩ ⟨-, h2⟩; omega)]
  have : (bset A).filter (fun x => kkey A.T A.d x = n) = ∅ := by
    apply Finset.filter_false_of_mem
    intro x hx; exact h x hx
  rw [this, Finset.sum_empty, add_zero]

lemma kkey_lt_N {Ω : Type*} {K : ℕ} {A : AlgData Ω K} {q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ bset A) :
    kkey A.T A.d q < (A.T+1)*(A.T+1) := by
  rw [mem_bset] at hq
  have h1 : q + A.d q ≤ A.T := hq.2.1
  have h2 : q ≤ A.T := hq.1.2
  unfold kkey
  have : (q + A.d q)*(A.T+1) ≤ A.T*(A.T+1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h1
  have h3 : (A.T+1)*(A.T+1) = A.T*(A.T+1) + (A.T+1) := by ring
  omega

/-- Sum over `n < N` of a function that vanishes off the image of `kkey` equals the sum over
`bset`. -/
lemma sum_range_eq_sum_bset {Ω : Type*} {K : ℕ} (A : AlgData Ω K) (F : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ n, (∀ q ∈ bset A, kkey A.T A.d q ≠ n) → F n = 0) :
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.range ((A.T+1)*(A.T+1)), F n = ∑ q ∈ bset A, F (kkey A.T A.d q) := by
  rw [← Finset.sum_image (f := F) (g := kkey A.T A.d)
      (by intro x hx y hy h; exact kkey_inj (bset_le_T hx) (bset_le_T hy) h)]
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_subset
  · intro x hx
    rw [Finset.mem_image] at hx
    obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact Finset.mem_range.2 (kkey_lt_N hq)
  · intro x _ hx
    apply hF
    intro q hq hcon
    exact hx (Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨q, hq, hcon⟩)

noncomputable def PP {Ω : Type*} {K : ℕ} (A : AlgData Ω K) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) (i : Fin K) : ℝ :=
  sfm (GG A n ω) i

structure AlgOK {Ω : Type*} {K : ℕ} (A : AlgData Ω K) : Prop where
  hK : 0 < K
  hd : ∀ t, 1 ≤ t → 1 ≤ A.d t
  hηpos : ∀ t, 0 < A.η t
  hηdec : ∀ t, A.η (t+1) ≤ A.η t
  hηb : ∀ t, A.η t ≤ (1/2) * Real.exp (-2)
  hl0 : ∀ t ω i, 0 ≤ A.l t ω i
  hl1 : ∀ t ω i, A.l t ω i ≤ 1
  hγ : ∀ t, 0 ≤ A.γ t
  hp : ∀ t ω i, 1 ≤ t → t ≤ A.T + 1 → A.p t ω i = sfm (GG A (t * (A.T+1)) ω) i

namespace AlgOK
variable {Ω : Type*} {K : ℕ} {A : AlgData Ω K}

lemma eta_anti (hA : AlgOK A) : ∀ {s t : ℕ}, s ≤ t → A.η t ≤ A.η s := by
  intro s t h
  exact antitone_nat_of_succ_le (fun n => hA.hηdec n) h

lemma p_pos (hA : AlgOK A) {t : ℕ} (h1 : 1 ≤ t) (h2 : t ≤ A.T + 1) (ω : Ω) (i : Fin K) :
    0 < A.p t ω i := by
  rw [hA.hp t ω i h1 h2]; exact sfm_pos hA.hK _ _

lemma p_pos_bset (hA : AlgOK A) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ bset A) (ω : Ω) (i : Fin K) :
    0 < A.p q ω i := by
  rw [mem_bset] at hq
  exact hA.p_pos hq.1.1 (by omega) ω i

lemma pg_pos (hA : AlgOK A) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ bset A) (ω : Ω) (i : Fin K) :
    0 < A.p q ω i + A.γ q :=
  add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (hA.p_pos_bset hq ω i) (hA.hγ q)

lemma ltil_nonneg (hA : AlgOK A) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ bset A) (ω : Ω) (i : Fin K) :
    0 ≤ ltil A q ω i := by
  unfold ltil
  apply div_nonneg _ (le_of_lt (hA.pg_pos hq ω i))
  exact mul_nonneg (hA.hl0 _ _ _) (by positivity)

lemma sum_ltil (hA : AlgOK A) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ bset A) (ω : Ω) :
    ∑ i, ltil A q ω i = A.l q ω (A.a q ω) / (A.p q ω (A.a q ω) + A.γ q) := by
  unfold ltil
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (A.a q ω)]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hb
    simp [Ne.symm hb]
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h

lemma sum_p_ltil (hA : AlgOK A) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ bset A) (ω : Ω) :
    ∑ i, A.p q ω i * ltil A q ω i
      = A.l q ω (A.a q ω) - A.γ q * ∑ i, ltil A q ω i := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, A.p q ω i * ltil A q ω i
      = A.p q ω (A.a q ω) * ltil A q ω (A.a q ω) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (A.a q ω)]
    · intro b _ hb
      unfold ltil
      simp [Ne.symm hb]
    · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h
  rw [h1, hA.sum_ltil hq ω]
  have hpg := hA.pg_pos hq ω (A.a q ω)
  have hlt : ltil A q ω (A.a q ω) = A.l q ω (A.a q ω) / (A.p q ω (A.a q ω) + A.γ q) := by
    unfold ltil; simp
  rw [hlt]
  field_simp
  ring

lemma GG_mono (hA : AlgOK A) {n n' : ℕ} (h : n ≤ n') (ω : Ω) (i : Fin K) :
    GG A n ω i ≤ GG A n' ω i := by
  unfold GG
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
  · intro x hx
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hx ⊢
    exact ⟨hx.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hx.2 h⟩
  · intro x hx _
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hx
    exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hA.hηpos x)) (hA.ltil_nonneg hx.1 ω i)

lemma GG_zero (A : AlgData Ω K) (ω : Ω) (i : Fin K) : GG A 0 ω i = 0 := by
  unfold GG
  rw [Finset.filter_false_of_mem (fun x _ => by omega), Finset.sum_empty]

lemma GG_full (A : AlgData Ω K) (ω : Ω) (i : Fin K) :
    GG A ((A.T+1)*(A.T+1)) ω i = ∑ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * ltil A q ω i := by
  unfold GG
  congr 1
  apply Finset.filter_true_of_mem
  intro x hx
  exact kkey_lt_N hx

end AlgOK

namespace AlgOK
variable {Ω : Type*} {K : ℕ} {A : AlgData Ω K}

lemma p_ltil_sq_le (hA : AlgOK A) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ bset A) (ω : Ω) (i : Fin K) :
    A.p q ω i * (ltil A q ω i)^2 ≤ ltil A q ω i := by
  set u := ltil A q ω i with hu
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ u := hA.ltil_nonneg hq ω i
  have hpg := hA.pg_pos hq ω i
  have hp0 : 0 ≤ A.p q ω i := le_of_lt (hA.p_pos_bset hq ω i)
  have hlx : A.l q ω i * (if A.a q ω = i then (1:ℝ) else 0) ≤ 1 := by
    by_cases h : A.a q ω = i
    · rw [if_pos h, mul_one]; exact hA.hl1 _ _ _
    · rw [if_neg h]; simp
  have hlx0 : 0 ≤ A.l q ω i * (if A.a q ω = i then (1:ℝ) else 0) :=
    mul_nonneg (hA.hl0 _ _ _) (by positivity)
  have hpu : A.p q ω i * u ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hu]
    unfold ltil
    rw [mul_div_assoc'] at *
    rw [div_le_one hpg]
    nlinarith [hA.hγ q]
  nlinarith

lemma quad_bound (hA : AlgOK A) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ bset A) (ω : Ω) (n : ℕ)
    (hr : ∀ i, PP A n ω i ≤ Real.exp 2 * A.p q ω i) :
    ∑ i, PP A n ω i * (ltil A q ω i)^2 ≤ Real.exp 2 * ∑ i, ltil A q ω i := by
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  have h1 : PP A n ω i * (ltil A q ω i)^2
      ≤ (Real.exp 2 * A.p q ω i) * (ltil A q ω i)^2 :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hr i) (sq_nonneg _)
  have h2 : (Real.exp 2 * A.p q ω i) * (ltil A q ω i)^2
      ≤ Real.exp 2 * ltil A q ω i := by
    rw [mul_assoc]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hA.p_ltil_sq_le hq ω i) (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos 2))
  linarith

lemma core_pathwise (hA : AlgOK A) (ω : Ω) (istar : Fin K)
    (hratio : ∀ q ∈ bset A, ∀ i, PP A (kkey A.T A.d q) ω i ≤ Real.exp 2 * A.p q ω i) :
    ∑ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * A.l q ω (A.a q ω)
      ≤ Real.log K + ∑ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * ltil A q ω istar
        + ∑ q ∈ bset A, (A.γ q * A.η q + (Real.exp 2/2) * (A.η q)^2) * ∑ i, ltil A q ω i
        + ∑ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * ∑ i, (A.p q ω i - PP A (kkey A.T A.d q) ω i)
            * ltil A q ω i := by
  set N := (A.T+1)*(A.T+1) with hN
  set F : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => (∑ i, PP A n ω i * (GG A (n+1) ω i - GG A n ω i))
       - (1/2) * ∑ i, PP A n ω i * (GG A (n+1) ω i - GG A n ω i)^2 with hF
  have hstep : ∀ n, F n ≤ pot (GG A (n+1) ω) - pot (GG A n ω) := by
    intro n
    have hD : ∀ i, 0 ≤ GG A (n+1) ω i - GG A n ω i := by
      intro i; have := hA.GG_mono (Nat.le_succ n) ω i; linarith
    have := pot_step hA.hK (GG A n ω) (fun i => GG A (n+1) ω i - GG A n ω i) hD
    have heq : (fun j => GG A n ω j + (GG A (n+1) ω j - GG A n ω j)) = GG A (n+1) ω := by
      funext j; ring
    rw [heq] at this
    exact this
  have hsumF : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, F n ≤ pot (GG A N ω) - pot (GG A 0 ω) := by
    calc ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, F n
        ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (pot (GG A (n+1) ω) - pot (GG A n ω)) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun n _ => hstep n)
      _ = pot (GG A N ω) - pot (GG A 0 ω) :=
