          Finset.sum_range_sub (fun n => pot (GG A n ω)) N
  have hFzero : ∀ n, (∀ q ∈ bset A, kkey A.T A.d q ≠ n) → F n = 0 := by
    intro n h
    have := GG_succ_not A n h ω
    simp only [hF]
    have h2 : ∀ i, GG A (n+1) ω i - GG A n ω i = 0 := by
      intro i; rw [this i]; ring
    simp [h2]
  have hFkey : ∀ q ∈ bset A, F (kkey A.T A.d q)
      = A.η q * (∑ i, PP A (kkey A.T A.d q) ω i * ltil A q ω i)
        - (1/2) * (A.η q)^2 * (∑ i, PP A (kkey A.T A.d q) ω i * (ltil A q ω i)^2) := by
    intro q hq
    have hg : ∀ i, GG A (kkey A.T A.d q + 1) ω i - GG A (kkey A.T A.d q) ω i
        = A.η q * ltil A q ω i := by
      intro i
      rw [GG_succ_mem A (kkey A.T A.d q) q hq rfl ω i]; ring
    have e1 : ∑ i, PP A (kkey A.T A.d q) ω i
          * (GG A (kkey A.T A.d q + 1) ω i - GG A (kkey A.T A.d q) ω i)
        = A.η q * ∑ i, PP A (kkey A.T A.d q) ω i * ltil A q ω i := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by rw [hg i]; ring)
    have e2 : ∑ i, PP A (kkey A.T A.d q) ω i
          * (GG A (kkey A.T A.d q + 1) ω i - GG A (kkey A.T A.d q) ω i)^2
        = (A.η q)^2 * ∑ i, PP A (kkey A.T A.d q) ω i * (ltil A q ω i)^2 := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by rw [hg i]; ring)
    simp only [hF]
    rw [e1, e2]
    ring
  have hpot0 : pot (GG A 0 ω) = - Real.log K := by
    have : GG A 0 ω = fun _ : Fin K => (0:ℝ) := by funext i; exact AlgOK.GG_zero A ω i
    rw [this, pot_zero hA.hK]
  have hpotN : pot (GG A N ω) ≤ ∑ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * ltil A q ω istar := by
    have := pot_le hA.hK (GG A N ω) istar
    rw [AlgOK.GG_full A ω istar] at this
    exact this
  have h5 : ∑ q ∈ bset A, (A.η q * (∑ i, PP A (kkey A.T A.d q) ω i * ltil A q ω i)
        - (1/2) * (A.η q)^2 * (∑ i, PP A (kkey A.T A.d q) ω i * (ltil A q ω i)^2))
      ≤ Real.log K + ∑ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * ltil A q ω istar := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_congr rfl hFkey, ← sum_range_eq_sum_bset A F hFzero]
    rw [hpot0] at hsumF
    linarith
  have h6 : ∀ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * A.l q ω (A.a q ω)
      ≤ (A.η q * (∑ i, PP A (kkey A.T A.d q) ω i * ltil A q ω i)
        - (1/2) * (A.η q)^2 * (∑ i, PP A (kkey A.T A.d q) ω i * (ltil A q ω i)^2))
        + (A.γ q * A.η q + (Real.exp 2/2) * (A.η q)^2) * (∑ i, ltil A q ω i)
        + A.η q * ∑ i, (A.p q ω i - PP A (kkey A.T A.d q) ω i) * ltil A q ω i := by
    intro q hq
    have hsplit : ∑ i, A.p q ω i * ltil A q ω i
        = (∑ i, PP A (kkey A.T A.d q) ω i * ltil A q ω i)
          + ∑ i, (A.p q ω i - PP A (kkey A.T A.d q) ω i) * ltil A q ω i := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
    have hL := hA.sum_p_ltil hq ω
    have hqb := hA.quad_bound hq ω (kkey A.T A.d q) (hratio q hq)
    have hc0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i, ltil A q ω i :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hA.ltil_nonneg hq ω i)
    have hη0 : 0 ≤ A.η q := le_of_lt (hA.hηpos q)
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (A.η q)]
  calc ∑ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * A.l q ω (A.a q ω)
      ≤ ∑ q ∈ bset A, ((A.η q * (∑ i, PP A (kkey A.T A.d q) ω i * ltil A q ω i)
        - (1/2) * (A.η q)^2 * (∑ i, PP A (kkey A.T A.d q) ω i * (ltil A q ω i)^2))
        + (A.γ q * A.η q + (Real.exp 2/2) * (A.η q)^2) * (∑ i, ltil A q ω i)
        + A.η q * ∑ i, (A.p q ω i - PP A (kkey A.T A.d q) ω i) * ltil A q ω i) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum h6
    _ = (∑ q ∈ bset A, (A.η q * (∑ i, PP A (kkey A.T A.d q) ω i * ltil A q ω i)
        - (1/2) * (A.η q)^2 * (∑ i, PP A (kkey A.T A.d q) ω i * (ltil A q ω i)^2)))
        + (∑ q ∈ bset A, (A.γ q * A.η q + (Real.exp 2/2) * (A.η q)^2) * (∑ i, ltil A q ω i))
        + (∑ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * ∑ i, (A.p q ω i - PP A (kkey A.T A.d q) ω i)
            * ltil A q ω i) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    _ ≤ _ := by linarith

end AlgOK

lemma sfm_step_ratio {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K) (x D : Fin K → ℝ) (hD : ∀ i, 0 ≤ D i)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : c < 1) (hS : ∑ j, sfm x j * D j ≤ c) (i : Fin K) :
    sfm (fun j => x j + D j) i ≤ (1 - c)⁻¹ * sfm x i := by
  set Z := ∑ j, Real.exp (- x j) with hZ
  set Z' := ∑ j, Real.exp (- (x j + D j)) with hZ'
  have hZpos : 0 < Z := sfm_denom_pos hK x
  have hZ'pos : 0 < Z' := sfm_denom_pos hK (fun j => x j + D j)
  have hc1 : 0 < 1 - c := by linarith
  have hSform : ∑ j, sfm x j * D j = (∑ j, Real.exp (-x j) * D j) / Z := by
    rw [Finset.sum_div]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by show sfm x j * D j = _; unfold sfm; ring)
  have hlow : Z * (1 - c) ≤ Z' := by
    have h1 : Z - (∑ j, Real.exp (-x j) * D j) ≤ Z' := by
      rw [hZ, hZ', ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro j _
      have h : Real.exp (-(x j + D j)) = Real.exp (-x j) * Real.exp (-(D j)) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
      rw [h]
      have h2 : 1 - D j ≤ Real.exp (-(D j)) := by
        have := Real.add_one_le_exp (-(D j)); linarith
      nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (-x j)]
    have h3 : (∑ j, Real.exp (-x j) * D j) ≤ Z * c := by
      rw [hSform] at hS
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hZpos] at hS
      linarith
    nlinarith
  have hZc : 0 < Z * (1 - c) := mul_pos hZpos hc1
  have hnum : Real.exp (-(x i + D i)) ≤ Real.exp (- x i) := by
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.2; linarith [hD i]
  show Real.exp (-(x i + D i)) / Z' ≤ (1-c)⁻¹ * (Real.exp (-x i) / Z)
  have : (1-c)⁻¹ * (Real.exp (-x i) / Z) = Real.exp (-x i) / (Z * (1-c)) := by
    field_simp
  rw [this]
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hZ'pos hZc]
  nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (-(x i + D i)), Real.exp_pos (-x i)]

lemma pow_inv_le_exp1 {η : ℝ} {D c : ℕ} (hηp : 0 < η) (hD : 1 ≤ D)
    (h : (D:ℝ) ≤ 1/(Real.exp 2 * η) - 1) (hc : c ≤ D) :
    ((1 - Real.exp 2 * η)⁻¹)^c ≤ Real.exp 1 := by
  have hD1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (D:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hD
  have hDp : (0:ℝ) < (D:ℝ) := by linarith
  have he2 : 0 < Real.exp 2 * η := mul_pos (Real.exp_pos 2) hηp
  have h1 : Real.exp 2 * η ≤ 1/((D:ℝ)+1) := by
    have h' : (D:ℝ) + 1 ≤ 1/(Real.exp 2 * η) := by linarith
    rw [le_div_iff₀ he2] at h'
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < (D:ℝ)+1)]
    linarith
  have hfrac : (1:ℝ)/((D:ℝ)+1) ≤ 1/2 := by
    apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) (by linarith)
  have h2 : 0 < 1 - Real.exp 2 * η := by linarith
  have h3 : (D:ℝ)/((D:ℝ)+1) ≤ 1 - Real.exp 2 * η := by
    have hh : (D:ℝ)/((D:ℝ)+1) = 1 - 1/((D:ℝ)+1) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    linarith [hh]
  have h4 : (1 - Real.exp 2 * η)⁻¹ ≤ ((D:ℝ)+1)/(D:ℝ) := by
    have hpos : (0:ℝ) < (D:ℝ)/((D:ℝ)+1) := by positivity
    have := one_div_le_one_div_of_le hpos h3
    rw [one_div, one_div, inv_div] at this
    exact this
  have h5 : ((D:ℝ)+1)/(D:ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (1/(D:ℝ)) := by
    have hh : ((D:ℝ)+1)/(D:ℝ) = 1/(D:ℝ) + 1 := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [hh]
    exact Real.add_one_le_exp _
  have h6 : (1 - Real.exp 2 * η)⁻¹ ≤ Real.exp (1/(D:ℝ)) := le_trans h4 h5
  calc ((1 - Real.exp 2 * η)⁻¹)^c ≤ (Real.exp (1/(D:ℝ)))^c := by
        gcongr
    _ = Real.exp ((c:ℝ) * (1/(D:ℝ))) := (Real.exp_nat_mul _ _).symm
    _ ≤ Real.exp 1 := by
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
        rw [mul_one_div, div_le_one hDp]
        exact_mod_cast hc

noncomputable def Fprod {Ω : Type*} {K : ℕ} (A : AlgData Ω K) (m₁ m₂ : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∏ r ∈ (bset A).filter (fun r => m₁ ≤ kkey A.T A.d r ∧ kkey A.T A.d r < m₂),
    (1 - Real.exp 2 * A.η r)⁻¹

namespace AlgOK
variable {Ω : Type*} {K : ℕ} {A : AlgData Ω K}

lemma e2eta_le_half (hA : AlgOK A) (t : ℕ) : Real.exp 2 * A.η t ≤ 1/2 := by
  have h := hA.hηb t
  have h2 : Real.exp 2 * ((1/2) * Real.exp (-2)) = 1/2 := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, mul_comm (Real.exp 2), mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
    norm_num
  calc Real.exp 2 * A.η t ≤ Real.exp 2 * ((1/2) * Real.exp (-2)) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos 2))
    _ = 1/2 := h2

lemma one_sub_pos (hA : AlgOK A) (t : ℕ) : 0 < 1 - Real.exp 2 * A.η t := by
  have := hA.e2eta_le_half t; linarith

lemma inv_one_sub_nonneg (hA : AlgOK A) (t : ℕ) : 0 ≤ (1 - Real.exp 2 * A.η t)⁻¹ :=
  le_of_lt (inv_pos.2 (hA.one_sub_pos t))

lemma Fprod_self (A : AlgData Ω K) (m : ℕ) : Fprod A m m = 1 := by
  unfold Fprod
  rw [Finset.filter_false_of_mem (fun x _ => by omega), Finset.prod_empty]

lemma Fprod_nonneg (hA : AlgOK A) (m₁ m₂ : ℕ) : 0 ≤ Fprod A m₁ m₂ :=
  Finset.prod_nonneg (fun r _ => hA.inv_one_sub_nonneg r)

lemma Fprod_succ_mem (A : AlgData Ω K) {m₁ m₂ : ℕ} (hm : m₁ ≤ m₂) {r : ℕ}
    (hr : r ∈ bset A) (hkr : kkey A.T A.d r = m₂) :
    Fprod A m₁ (m₂+1) = Fprod A m₁ m₂ * (1 - Real.exp 2 * A.η r)⁻¹ := by
  unfold Fprod
  have hsplit : (bset A).filter (fun x => m₁ ≤ kkey A.T A.d x ∧ kkey A.T A.d x < m₂+1)
      = (bset A).filter (fun x => m₁ ≤ kkey A.T A.d x ∧ kkey A.T A.d x < m₂)
        ∪ (bset A).filter (fun x => kkey A.T A.d x = m₂) := by
    rw [← Finset.filter_or]
    apply Finset.filter_congr
    intro x _
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨ha, hb⟩
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (kkey A.T A.d x) m₂ with h | h
      · exact Or.inl ⟨ha, h⟩
      · exact Or.inr (by omega)
    · rintro (⟨ha, hb⟩ | h)
      · exact ⟨ha, by omega⟩
      · exact ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
  rw [hsplit, Finset.prod_union (by
    simp only [Finset.disjoint_left, Finset.mem_filter]
    rintro x ⟨-, -, h1⟩ ⟨-, h2⟩; omega)]
  congr 1
  have : (bset A).filter (fun x => kkey A.T A.d x = m₂) = {r} := by
    apply Finset.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.2
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hr, hkr⟩, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hx
    exact kkey_inj (bset_le_T hx.1) (bset_le_T hr) (by rw [hx.2, hkr])
  rw [this, Finset.prod_singleton]

lemma Fprod_succ_not (A : AlgData Ω K) {m₁ m₂ : ℕ} (hm : m₁ ≤ m₂)
    (h : ∀ r ∈ bset A, kkey A.T A.d r ≠ m₂) :
    Fprod A m₁ (m₂+1) = Fprod A m₁ m₂ := by
  unfold Fprod
  apply Finset.prod_congr _ (fun _ _ => rfl)
  apply Finset.filter_congr
  intro x hx
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ha, hb⟩
    refine ⟨ha, ?_⟩
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (kkey A.T A.d x) m₂ with h1 | h1
    · exact h1
    · exact absurd (by omega : kkey A.T A.d x = m₂) (h x hx)
  · rintro ⟨ha, hb⟩; exact ⟨ha, by omega⟩

lemma PP_eq_of_GG_eq (A : AlgData Ω K) {n n' : ℕ} (ω : Ω)
    (h : ∀ i, GG A n ω i = GG A n' ω i) (i : Fin K) : PP A n ω i = PP A n' ω i := by
  unfold PP
  congr 1
  funext j
  exact h j

lemma prod_ratio (hA : AlgOK A) (ω : Ω) (m₁ n₀ : ℕ)
    (H : ∀ m, m < n₀ → ∀ r ∈ bset A, kkey A.T A.d r = m → ∀ i,
        PP A (m+1) ω i ≤ (1 - Real.exp 2 * A.η r)⁻¹ * PP A m ω i) :
    ∀ m₂, m₁ ≤ m₂ → m₂ ≤ n₀ → ∀ i, PP A m₂ ω i ≤ (Fprod A m₁ m₂) * PP A m₁ ω i := by
  intro m₂
  induction m₂ with
  | zero =>
      intro h1 h2 i
      have : m₁ = 0 := by omega
      subst this
      rw [AlgOK.Fprod_self A, one_mul]
  | succ n ih =>
      intro h1 h2 i
      rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le h1 with heq | hlt
      · rw [← heq, AlgOK.Fprod_self A, one_mul]
      · have hmn : m₁ ≤ n := by omega
        have hstep := ih hmn (by omega) i
        by_cases hex : ∃ r ∈ bset A, kkey A.T A.d r = n
        · obtain ⟨r, hr, hkr⟩ := hex
          have h3 := H n (by omega) r hr hkr i
          rw [AlgOK.Fprod_succ_mem A hmn hr hkr]
          have hc : 0 ≤ (1 - Real.exp 2 * A.η r)⁻¹ := hA.inv_one_sub_nonneg r
          calc PP A (n+1) ω i ≤ (1 - Real.exp 2 * A.η r)⁻¹ * PP A n ω i := h3
            _ ≤ (1 - Real.exp 2 * A.η r)⁻¹ * ((Fprod A m₁ n) * PP A m₁ ω i) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hstep hc
            _ = Fprod A m₁ n * (1 - Real.exp 2 * A.η r)⁻¹ * PP A m₁ ω i := by ring
        · push_neg at hex
          rw [AlgOK.Fprod_succ_not A hmn hex]
          have : PP A (n+1) ω i = PP A n ω i :=
            AlgOK.PP_eq_of_GG_eq A ω (fun j => GG_succ_not A n hex ω j) i
          rw [this]
          exact hstep

end AlgOK

lemma prod_le_pow_card_nonneg {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℝ) (n : ℝ)
    (h0 : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ f x) (h : ∀ x ∈ s, f x ≤ n) : ∏ x ∈ s, f x ≤ n ^ s.card := by
  calc ∏ x ∈ s, f x ≤ ∏ _x ∈ s, n := Finset.prod_le_prod h0 h
    _ = n ^ s.card := Finset.prod_const n

namespace AlgOK
variable {Ω : Type*} {K : ℕ} {A : AlgData Ω K}

lemma inv_mono (hA : AlgOK A) {r s : ℕ} (h : A.η r ≤ A.η s) :
    (1 - Real.exp 2 * A.η r)⁻¹ ≤ (1 - Real.exp 2 * A.η s)⁻¹ := by
  have h1 := hA.one_sub_pos r
  have h2 := hA.one_sub_pos s
  have hmul : Real.exp 2 * A.η r ≤ Real.exp 2 * A.η s :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos 2))
  have h3 : 1 - Real.exp 2 * A.η s ≤ 1 - Real.exp 2 * A.η r := by linarith
  have h4 := one_div_le_one_div_of_le h2 h3
  rwa [one_div, one_div] at h4

lemma Fprod_bound (hA : AlgOK A) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ bset A) :
    Fprod A (q*(A.T+1)) (kkey A.T A.d q) ≤ Real.exp 2 := by
  classical
  set R := (bset A).filter
    (fun r => q*(A.T+1) ≤ kkey A.T A.d r ∧ kkey A.T A.d r < kkey A.T A.d q) with hR
  have hqT : q ≤ A.T := bset_le_T hq
  have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := (mem_bset.1 hq).1.1
  have hd_q : 1 ≤ A.d q := hA.hd q hq1
  have hbq : (A.d q : ℝ) ≤ 1/(Real.exp 2 * A.η q) - 1 := (mem_bset.1 hq).2.2
  have hsplit : Fprod A (q*(A.T+1)) (kkey A.T A.d q)
      = (∏ r ∈ R.filter (fun r => q ≤ r), (1 - Real.exp 2 * A.η r)⁻¹)
        * (∏ r ∈ R.filter (fun r => ¬ q ≤ r), (1 - Real.exp 2 * A.η r)⁻¹) := by
    unfold Fprod
    rw [← hR]
    exact (Finset.prod_filter_mul_prod_filter_not R _ _).symm
  -- part 1
  have hsub1 : R.filter (fun r => q ≤ r) ⊆ Finset.Ioo q (q + A.d q) := by
    intro r hr
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, hR, Finset.mem_filter] at hr
    obtain ⟨⟨hrb, hlo, hhi⟩, hqr⟩ := hr
    have hrT := bset_le_T hrb
    have hne : r ≠ q := by rintro rfl; omega
    have hqlt : q < r := lt_of_le_of_ne hqr (Ne.symm hne)
    rcases (kkey_lt_iff (T := A.T) (d := A.d) hrT hqT).1 hhi with h | ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · exact Finset.mem_Ioo.2 ⟨hqlt, by omega⟩
    · omega
  have hcard1 : (R.filter (fun r => q ≤ r)).card ≤ A.d q := by
    have h := Finset.card_le_card hsub1
    rw [Nat.card_Ioo] at h
    omega
  have hprod1 : (∏ r ∈ R.filter (fun r => q ≤ r), (1 - Real.exp 2 * A.η r)⁻¹)
      ≤ Real.exp 1 := by
    have hb : ∀ r ∈ R.filter (fun r => q ≤ r),
        (1 - Real.exp 2 * A.η r)⁻¹ ≤ (1 - Real.exp 2 * A.η q)⁻¹ := by
      intro r hr
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hr
      exact hA.inv_mono (hA.eta_anti hr.2)
    calc (∏ r ∈ R.filter (fun r => q ≤ r), (1 - Real.exp 2 * A.η r)⁻¹)
        ≤ ((1 - Real.exp 2 * A.η q)⁻¹)^((R.filter (fun r => q ≤ r)).card) :=
          prod_le_pow_card_nonneg _ _ _ (fun r _ => hA.inv_one_sub_nonneg r) hb
      _ ≤ Real.exp 1 := pow_inv_le_exp1 (hA.hηpos q) hd_q hbq hcard1
  -- part 2
  have hprod2 : (∏ r ∈ R.filter (fun r => ¬ q ≤ r), (1 - Real.exp 2 * A.η r)⁻¹)
      ≤ Real.exp 1 := by
    by_cases hemp : (R.filter (fun r => ¬ q ≤ r)).Nonempty
    · set r₀ := (R.filter (fun r => ¬ q ≤ r)).min' hemp with hr0
      have hr0mem : r₀ ∈ R.filter (fun r => ¬ q ≤ r) := Finset.min'_mem _ hemp
      rw [Finset.mem_filter, hR, Finset.mem_filter] at hr0mem
      obtain ⟨⟨hr0b, hr0lo, hr0hi⟩, hr0q⟩ := hr0mem
      have hr0T := bset_le_T hr0b
      have hr01 : 1 ≤ r₀ := (mem_bset.1 hr0b).1.1
      have hd_r0 : 1 ≤ A.d r₀ := hA.hd r₀ hr01
      have hbr0 : (A.d r₀ : ℝ) ≤ 1/(Real.exp 2 * A.η r₀) - 1 := (mem_bset.1 hr0b).2.2
      have hqle : q ≤ r₀ + A.d r₀ := by
        by_contra hc
        push_neg at hc
        have hkt := (kkey_lt_time (T := A.T) (d := A.d) (q := r₀) (t := q-1) hr0T).2 (by omega)
        have hqq : (q-1)+1 = q := by omega
        rw [hqq] at hkt
        omega
      have hsub2 : R.filter (fun r => ¬ q ≤ r) ⊆ Finset.Ico r₀ q := by
        intro r hr
        have hmin : r₀ ≤ r := Finset.min'_le _ _ hr
        rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hr
        exact Finset.mem_Ico.2 ⟨hmin, by omega⟩
      have hcard2 : (R.filter (fun r => ¬ q ≤ r)).card ≤ A.d r₀ := by
        have h := Finset.card_le_card hsub2
        rw [Nat.card_Ico] at h
        omega
      have hb : ∀ r ∈ R.filter (fun r => ¬ q ≤ r),
          (1 - Real.exp 2 * A.η r)⁻¹ ≤ (1 - Real.exp 2 * A.η r₀)⁻¹ := by
        intro r hr
        exact hA.inv_mono (hA.eta_anti (Finset.min'_le _ _ hr))
      calc (∏ r ∈ R.filter (fun r => ¬ q ≤ r), (1 - Real.exp 2 * A.η r)⁻¹)
          ≤ ((1 - Real.exp 2 * A.η r₀)⁻¹)^((R.filter (fun r => ¬ q ≤ r)).card) :=
            prod_le_pow_card_nonneg _ _ _ (fun r _ => hA.inv_one_sub_nonneg r) hb
        _ ≤ Real.exp 1 := pow_inv_le_exp1 (hA.hηpos r₀) hd_r0 hbr0 hcard2
    · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hemp
      rw [hemp, Finset.prod_empty]
      have := Real.add_one_le_exp (0:ℝ)
      simp at this
      linarith [Real.one_le_exp (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1)]
  have hnn1 : 0 ≤ (∏ r ∈ R.filter (fun r => q ≤ r), (1 - Real.exp 2 * A.η r)⁻¹) :=
    Finset.prod_nonneg (fun r _ => hA.inv_one_sub_nonneg r)
  have hnn2 : 0 ≤ (∏ r ∈ R.filter (fun r => ¬ q ≤ r), (1 - Real.exp 2 * A.η r)⁻¹) :=
    Finset.prod_nonneg (fun r _ => hA.inv_one_sub_nonneg r)
  rw [hsplit]
  calc (∏ r ∈ R.filter (fun r => q ≤ r), (1 - Real.exp 2 * A.η r)⁻¹)
        * (∏ r ∈ R.filter (fun r => ¬ q ≤ r), (1 - Real.exp 2 * A.η r)⁻¹)
      ≤ Real.exp 1 * Real.exp 1 := by
        apply mul_le_mul hprod1 hprod2 hnn2 (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos 1))
    _ = Real.exp 2 := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; norm_num

private lemma prod_mono_subset_of_one_le {s t : Finset ℕ} {f : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hst : s ⊆ t) (hf : ∀ i ∈ t, 1 ≤ f i) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, f i) ≤ ∏ i ∈ t, f i := by
  classical
  induction t using Finset.induction_on generalizing s with
  | empty =>
      have : s = ∅ := Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem.2 (fun i hi => by
        exact (Finset.not_mem_empty i) (hst hi))
      simp [this]
  | @insert a t ha ih =>
      by_cases has : a ∈ s
      · have hsub : s.erase a ⊆ t := by
          intro i hi
          have his : i ∈ s := Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hi
          have hit := hst his
          rw [Finset.mem_insert] at hit
          exact hit.resolve_left (fun hia => (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hi) hia)
        have hfa0 : 0 ≤ f a := le_trans (by norm_num) (hf a (Finset.mem_insert_self a t))
        rw [← Finset.insert_erase has, Finset.prod_insert (Finset.not_mem_erase a s),
          Finset.prod_insert ha]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (ih hsub (fun i hi => hf i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))) hfa0
      · have hsub : s ⊆ t := by
          intro i hi
          have hit := hst hi
          rw [Finset.mem_insert] at hit
          exact hit.resolve_left (fun hia => has (hia ▸ hi))
        have hprod0 : 0 ≤ ∏ i ∈ t, f i := Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i hi =>
          le_trans (by norm_num) (hf i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)))
        rw [Finset.prod_insert ha]
        calc
          (∏ i ∈ s, f i) ≤ ∏ i ∈ t, f i :=
            ih hsub (fun i hi => hf i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))
          _ ≤ f a * ∏ i ∈ t, f i := by
            have hfa := hf a (Finset.mem_insert_self a t)
            nlinarith

private lemma Fprod_partial_bound (hA : AlgOK A) {q n : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ bset A)
    (hn0 : q * (A.T + 1) ≤ n) (hn1 : n ≤ kkey A.T A.d q) :
    Fprod A (q * (A.T + 1)) n ≤ Real.exp 2 := by
  have hsub : (bset A).filter
        (fun r => q * (A.T + 1) ≤ kkey A.T A.d r ∧ kkey A.T A.d r < n)
      ⊆ (bset A).filter
        (fun r => q * (A.T + 1) ≤ kkey A.T A.d r ∧
          kkey A.T A.d r < kkey A.T A.d q) := by
    intro r hr
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hr ⊢
    exact ⟨hr.1, hr.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hr.2.2 hn1⟩
  have hprod : Fprod A (q * (A.T + 1)) n
      ≤ Fprod A (q * (A.T + 1)) (kkey A.T A.d q) := by
    unfold Fprod
    apply prod_mono_subset_of_one_le hsub
    intro r hr
    exact (one_le_inv₀ (hA.one_sub_pos r)).2 (by
      have hp : 0 < Real.exp 2 * A.η r := mul_pos (Real.exp_pos 2) (hA.hηpos r)
      linarith)
  exact hprod.trans (hA.Fprod_bound hq)

end AlgOK

namespace AlgOK
variable {Ω : Type*} {K : ℕ} {A : AlgData Ω K}

lemma ratio_star (hA : AlgOK A) (ω : Ω) (n : ℕ)
    (H : ∀ m, m < n → ∀ r ∈ bset A, kkey A.T A.d r = m → ∀ i,
        PP A (m+1) ω i ≤ (1 - Real.exp 2 * A.η r)⁻¹ * PP A m ω i)
    {r : ℕ} (hr : r ∈ bset A) (hkr : kkey A.T A.d r = n) (i : Fin K) :
    PP A n ω i ≤ Real.exp 2 * A.p r ω i := by
  have hrT := bset_le_T hr
  have hr1 : 1 ≤ r := (mem_bset.1 hr).1.1
  have hple : r*(A.T+1) ≤ n := by
    rw [← hkr]
    show r*(A.T+1) ≤ (r + A.d r)*(A.T+1) + r
    exact le_trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right (A.T+1) (Nat.le_add_right r (A.d r)))
      (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  have h1 := hA.prod_ratio ω (r*(A.T+1)) n H n hple le_rfl i
  have h2 : Fprod A (r*(A.T+1)) n ≤ Real.exp 2 := by rw [← hkr]; exact hA.Fprod_bound hr
  have h3 : A.p r ω i = PP A (r*(A.T+1)) ω i := by
    rw [hA.hp r ω i hr1 (by omega)]; rfl
  have h4 : 0 ≤ PP A (r*(A.T+1)) ω i := le_of_lt (sfm_pos hA.hK _ _)
  calc PP A n ω i ≤ Fprod A (r*(A.T+1)) n * PP A (r*(A.T+1)) ω i := h1
    _ ≤ Real.exp 2 * PP A (r*(A.T+1)) ω i := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 h4
    _ = Real.exp 2 * A.p r ω i := by rw [h3]

lemma sum_PP_ltil_le (hA : AlgOK A) (ω : Ω) (n : ℕ) {r : ℕ} (hr : r ∈ bset A)
    (hstar : ∀ j, PP A n ω j ≤ Real.exp 2 * A.p r ω j) :
    ∑ j, PP A n ω j * ltil A r ω j ≤ Real.exp 2 := by
  have h1 : ∑ j, PP A n ω j * ltil A r ω j
      ≤ ∑ j, (Real.exp 2 * A.p r ω j) * ltil A r ω j := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro j _
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hstar j) (hA.ltil_nonneg hr ω j)
  have h2 : ∑ j, (Real.exp 2 * A.p r ω j) * ltil A r ω j
      = Real.exp 2 * ∑ j, A.p r ω j * ltil A r ω j := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by ring)
  rw [h2, hA.sum_p_ltil hr ω] at h1
  have h3 : 0 ≤ A.γ r * ∑ i, ltil A r ω i :=
    mul_nonneg (hA.hγ r) (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hA.ltil_nonneg hr ω i))
  have h4 : A.l r ω (A.a r ω) ≤ 1 := hA.hl1 _ _ _
  nlinarith [Real.exp_pos 2]

lemma ratio_step (hA : AlgOK A) (ω : Ω) (n : ℕ) {r : ℕ} (hr : r ∈ bset A)
    (hkr : kkey A.T A.d r = n)
    (hstar : ∀ j, PP A n ω j ≤ Real.exp 2 * A.p r ω j) (i : Fin K) :
    PP A (n+1) ω i ≤ (1 - Real.exp 2 * A.η r)⁻¹ * PP A n ω i := by
  have hη0 : 0 ≤ A.η r := le_of_lt (hA.hηpos r)
  have hD : ∀ j, 0 ≤ A.η r * ltil A r ω j := fun j =>
    mul_nonneg hη0 (hA.ltil_nonneg hr ω j)
  have hc : Real.exp 2 * A.η r < 1 := by have := hA.one_sub_pos r; linarith
  have hS : ∑ j, sfm (GG A n ω) j * (A.η r * ltil A r ω j) ≤ Real.exp 2 * A.η r := by
    have he : ∑ j, sfm (GG A n ω) j * (A.η r * ltil A r ω j)
        = A.η r * ∑ j, PP A n ω j * ltil A r ω j := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by unfold PP; ring)
    rw [he]
    have := hA.sum_PP_ltil_le ω n hr hstar
    nlinarith
  have hgg : GG A (n+1) ω = fun j => GG A n ω j + A.η r * ltil A r ω j := by
    funext j
    exact GG_succ_mem A n r hr hkr ω j
  have := sfm_step_ratio hA.hK (GG A n ω) (fun j => A.η r * ltil A r ω j) hD
    (Real.exp 2 * A.η r) hc hS i
  unfold PP
  rw [hgg]
  exact this

lemma ratio_main (hA : AlgOK A) (ω : Ω) : ∀ n, ∀ r ∈ bset A, kkey A.T A.d r = n → ∀ i,
    PP A (n+1) ω i ≤ (1 - Real.exp 2 * A.η r)⁻¹ * PP A n ω i := by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n IH =>
    intro r hr hkr i
    exact hA.ratio_step ω n hr hkr (hA.ratio_star ω n (fun m hm => IH m hm) hr hkr) i

lemma key_ratio (hA : AlgOK A) (ω : Ω) : ∀ q ∈ bset A, ∀ i,
    PP A (kkey A.T A.d q) ω i ≤ Real.exp 2 * A.p q ω i := by
  intro q hq i
  exact hA.ratio_star ω (kkey A.T A.d q) (fun m _ => hA.ratio_main ω m) hq rfl i

private lemma PP_partial_le (hA : AlgOK A) (ω : Ω) {q n : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ bset A)
    (hn0 : q * (A.T + 1) ≤ n) (hn1 : n ≤ kkey A.T A.d q) (i : Fin K) :
    PP A n ω i ≤ Fprod A (q * (A.T + 1)) n * A.p q ω i := by
  have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := (mem_bset.1 hq).1.1
  have hqT : q ≤ A.T := bset_le_T hq
  have hpq : A.p q ω i = PP A (q * (A.T + 1)) ω i := by
    rw [hA.hp q ω i hq1 (by omega)]
    rfl
  have h := hA.prod_ratio ω (q * (A.T + 1)) n
    (fun m _ => hA.ratio_main ω m) n hn0 le_rfl i
  rwa [← hpq] at h

private lemma PP_partial_exp_le (hA : AlgOK A) (ω : Ω) {q n : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ bset A)
    (hn0 : q * (A.T + 1) ≤ n) (hn1 : n ≤ kkey A.T A.d q) (i : Fin K) :
    PP A n ω i ≤ Real.exp 2 * A.p q ω i := by
  have h := PP_partial_le hA ω hq hn0 hn1 i
  have hf := Fprod_partial_bound hA hq hn0 hn1
  exact h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hf (le_of_lt (hA.p_pos_bset hq ω i)))

end AlgOK

noncomputable def Rset {Ω : Type*} {K : ℕ} (A : AlgData Ω K) (q : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (bset A).filter (fun r => q*(A.T+1) ≤ kkey A.T A.d r ∧ kkey A.T A.d r < kkey A.T A.d q)

namespace AlgOK
variable {Ω : Type*} {K : ℕ} {A : AlgData Ω K}

lemma mem_Rset {q r : ℕ} : r ∈ Rset A q ↔
    r ∈ bset A ∧ (q*(A.T+1) ≤ kkey A.T A.d r ∧ kkey A.T A.d r < kkey A.T A.d q) := by
  unfold Rset; simp [Finset.mem_filter]

lemma Rset_ge (hA : AlgOK A) {q r : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ bset A) (hr : r ∈ Rset A q) (h : q ≤ r) :
    q < r ∧ r < q + A.d q := by
  rw [mem_Rset] at hr
  obtain ⟨hrb, hlo, hhi⟩ := hr
  have hrT := bset_le_T hrb
  have hqT := bset_le_T hq
  have hne : r ≠ q := by rintro rfl; omega
  have hqlt : q < r := lt_of_le_of_ne h (Ne.symm hne)
  rcases (kkey_lt_iff (T := A.T) (d := A.d) hrT hqT).1 hhi with h1 | ⟨h1, h2⟩
  · exact ⟨hqlt, by omega⟩
  · omega

lemma Rset_lt (hA : AlgOK A) {q r : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ bset A) (hr : r ∈ Rset A q) (h : r < q) :
    q ≤ r + A.d r := by
  rw [mem_Rset] at hr
  obtain ⟨hrb, hlo, hhi⟩ := hr
  have hrT := bset_le_T hrb
  have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := (mem_bset.1 hq).1.1
  by_contra hc
  push_neg at hc
  have hkt := (kkey_lt_time (T := A.T) (d := A.d) (q := r) (t := q-1) hrT).2 (by omega)
  have hqq : (q-1)+1 = q := by omega
  rw [hqq] at hkt
  omega

lemma eta_sq_nonneg (hA : AlgOK A) (q : ℕ) : 0 ≤ (A.η q)^2 := sq_nonneg _

lemma bound_ge (hA : AlgOK A) :
    ∑ q ∈ bset A, ∑ r ∈ (Rset A q).filter (fun r => q ≤ r), A.η q * A.η r
      ≤ ∑ q ∈ bset A, (A.d q : ℝ) * (A.η q)^2 := by
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro q hq
  have hsub : (Rset A q).filter (fun r => q ≤ r) ⊆ Finset.Ioo q (q + A.d q) := by
    intro r hr
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hr
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hA.Rset_ge hq hr.1 hr.2
    exact Finset.mem_Ioo.2 ⟨h1, h2⟩
  have hcard : ((Rset A q).filter (fun r => q ≤ r)).card ≤ A.d q := by
    have h := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    rw [Nat.card_Ioo] at h
    omega
  have hterm : ∀ r ∈ (Rset A q).filter (fun r => q ≤ r), A.η q * A.η r ≤ (A.η q)^2 := by
    intro r hr
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hr
    have := hA.eta_anti hr.2
    nlinarith [hA.hηpos q]
  calc ∑ r ∈ (Rset A q).filter (fun r => q ≤ r), A.η q * A.η r
      ≤ (((Rset A q).filter (fun r => q ≤ r)).card : ℝ) * (A.η q)^2 := by
        have := Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul _ _ _ hterm
        simpa [nsmul_eq_mul] using this
    _ ≤ (A.d q : ℝ) * (A.η q)^2 := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (sq_nonneg _)
        exact_mod_cast hcard

lemma bound_lt (hA : AlgOK A) :
    ∑ q ∈ bset A, ∑ r ∈ (Rset A q).filter (fun r => ¬ q ≤ r), A.η q * A.η r
      ≤ ∑ r ∈ bset A, (A.d r : ℝ) * (A.η r)^2 := by
  have hrw : ∀ q ∈ bset A, ∑ r ∈ (Rset A q).filter (fun r => ¬ q ≤ r), A.η q * A.η r
      = ∑ r ∈ bset A, (if ((q*(A.T+1) ≤ kkey A.T A.d r ∧ kkey A.T A.d r < kkey A.T A.d q)
          ∧ ¬ q ≤ r) then A.η q * A.η r else 0) := by
    intro q _
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
    congr 1
    unfold Rset
    rw [Finset.filter_filter]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hrw, Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro r hr
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  have hsub : (bset A).filter (fun q => (q*(A.T+1) ≤ kkey A.T A.d r
      ∧ kkey A.T A.d r < kkey A.T A.d q) ∧ ¬ q ≤ r) ⊆ Finset.Ioc r (r + A.d r) := by
    intro q hq
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hq
    obtain ⟨hqb, hcond, hnq⟩ := hq
    have hrmem : r ∈ Rset A q := mem_Rset.2 ⟨hr, hcond⟩
    have := hA.Rset_lt hqb hrmem (by omega)
    exact Finset.mem_Ioc.2 ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
  have hcard : ((bset A).filter (fun q => (q*(A.T+1) ≤ kkey A.T A.d r
      ∧ kkey A.T A.d r < kkey A.T A.d q) ∧ ¬ q ≤ r)).card ≤ A.d r := by
    have h := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    rw [Nat.card_Ioc] at h
    omega
  have hterm : ∀ q ∈ (bset A).filter (fun q => (q*(A.T+1) ≤ kkey A.T A.d r
      ∧ kkey A.T A.d r < kkey A.T A.d q) ∧ ¬ q ≤ r), A.η q * A.η r ≤ (A.η r)^2 := by
    intro q hq
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hq
    have hqr : r ≤ q := by omega
    have := hA.eta_anti hqr
    nlinarith [hA.hηpos r]
  calc ∑ q ∈ (bset A).filter (fun q => (q*(A.T+1) ≤ kkey A.T A.d r
        ∧ kkey A.T A.d r < kkey A.T A.d q) ∧ ¬ q ≤ r), A.η q * A.η r
      ≤ (((bset A).filter (fun q => (q*(A.T+1) ≤ kkey A.T A.d r
        ∧ kkey A.T A.d r < kkey A.T A.d q) ∧ ¬ q ≤ r)).card : ℝ) * (A.η r)^2 := by
        have := Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul _ _ _ hterm
        simpa [nsmul_eq_mul] using this
    _ ≤ (A.d r : ℝ) * (A.η r)^2 := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (sq_nonneg _)
        exact_mod_cast hcard

lemma eta_pair_bound (hA : AlgOK A) :
    ∑ q ∈ bset A, ∑ r ∈ Rset A q, A.η q * A.η r
      ≤ 2 * ∑ q ∈ bset A, (A.η q)^2 * (A.d q : ℝ) := by
  have hsplit : ∀ q ∈ bset A, ∑ r ∈ Rset A q, A.η q * A.η r
      = (∑ r ∈ (Rset A q).filter (fun r => q ≤ r), A.η q * A.η r)
        + (∑ r ∈ (Rset A q).filter (fun r => ¬ q ≤ r), A.η q * A.η r) := by
    intro q _
    exact (Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (Rset A q) _ _).symm
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hsplit, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  have h1 := hA.bound_ge
  have h2 := hA.bound_lt
  have h3 : ∑ q ∈ bset A, (A.d q : ℝ) * (A.η q)^2 = ∑ q ∈ bset A, (A.η q)^2 * (A.d q : ℝ) :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun q _ => mul_comm _ _)
  rw [h3] at h1 h2
  linarith

end AlgOK

private noncomputable def laterHi {Ω : Type*} {K : ℕ} (A : AlgData Ω K) (s : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Rset A s).filter (fun u => s ≤ u)

private noncomputable def laterLo {Ω : Type*} {K : ℕ} (A : AlgData Ω K) (s : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (bset A).filter (fun u => s ∈ Rset A u ∧ s < u)

/-- Every unordered pair of overlapping feedback intervals occurs in exactly one arrival order.
Charging it to its earlier round removes the factor two in `eta_pair_bound`. -/
private lemma eta_pair_bound_one {Ω : Type*} {K : ℕ} {A : AlgData Ω K}
    (hA : AlgOK A) :
    ∑ q ∈ bset A, ∑ r ∈ Rset A q, A.η q * A.η r
      ≤ ∑ s ∈ bset A, (A.η s)^2 * (A.d s : ℝ) := by
  classical
  have hsplit : ∀ q ∈ bset A, ∑ r ∈ Rset A q, A.η q * A.η r
      = (∑ r ∈ laterHi A q, A.η q * A.η r)
        + (∑ r ∈ (Rset A q).filter (fun r => ¬ q ≤ r), A.η q * A.η r) := by
    intro q _
    exact (Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (Rset A q) _ _).symm
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hsplit, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  have hlt_reindex :
      (∑ q ∈ bset A, ∑ r ∈ (Rset A q).filter (fun r => ¬ q ≤ r), A.η q * A.η r)
        = ∑ s ∈ bset A, ∑ u ∈ laterLo A s, A.η s * A.η u := by
    have hrw : ∀ q ∈ bset A,
        (∑ r ∈ (Rset A q).filter (fun r => ¬ q ≤ r), A.η q * A.η r)
          = ∑ r ∈ bset A,
              if r ∈ Rset A q ∧ r < q then A.η q * A.η r else 0 := by
      intro q _
      rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
      apply Finset.sum_congr
      · ext r
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨hrR, hnqr⟩
          exact ⟨(AlgOK.mem_Rset.1 hrR).1, hrR, Nat.lt_of_not_ge hnqr⟩
        · rintro ⟨_, hrR, hrq⟩
          exact ⟨hrR, by omega⟩
      · intro r hr
        rfl
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hrw, Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro s hs
    unfold laterLo
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro u hu
    exact mul_comm _ _
  rw [hlt_reindex, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun s hs => ?_)
  have hdisj : Disjoint (laterHi A s) (laterLo A s) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro u huhi hulo
    rw [laterHi, Finset.mem_filter] at huhi
    rw [laterLo, Finset.mem_filter] at hulo
    have hku : kkey A.T A.d u < kkey A.T A.d s := (AlgOK.mem_Rset.1 huhi.1).2.2
    have hks : kkey A.T A.d s < kkey A.T A.d u := (AlgOK.mem_Rset.1 hulo.2.1).2.2
    omega
  have hsub : laterHi A s ∪ laterLo A s ⊆ Finset.Ioc s (s + A.d s) := by
    intro u hu
    rw [Finset.mem_union] at hu
    rcases hu with hu | hu
    · rw [laterHi, Finset.mem_filter] at hu
      obtain ⟨hsu, huend⟩ := hA.Rset_ge hs hu.1 hu.2
      exact Finset.mem_Ioc.2 ⟨hsu, by omega⟩
    · rw [laterLo, Finset.mem_filter] at hu
      have huend := hA.Rset_lt hu.1 hu.2.1 hu.2.2
      exact Finset.mem_Ioc.2 ⟨hu.2.2, huend⟩
  have hcard : (laterHi A s ∪ laterLo A s).card ≤ A.d s := by
    have hc := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    rw [Nat.card_Ioc] at hc
    simpa using hc
  have hterm : ∀ u ∈ laterHi A s ∪ laterLo A s,
      A.η s * A.η u ≤ (A.η s)^2 := by
    intro u hu
    have hsu : s ≤ u := (Finset.mem_Ioc.1 (hsub hu)).1.le
    have heta := hA.eta_anti hsu
    nlinarith [hA.hηpos s]
  rw [← Finset.sum_union hdisj]
  calc
    ∑ u ∈ laterHi A s ∪ laterLo A s, A.η s * A.η u
        ≤ (((laterHi A s ∪ laterLo A s).card : ℕ) : ℝ) * (A.η s)^2 := by
          have h := Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul _ _ _ hterm
          simpa [nsmul_eq_mul] using h
    _ ≤ (A.d s : ℝ) * (A.η s)^2 := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hcard) (sq_nonneg _)
    _ = (A.η s)^2 * (A.d s : ℝ) := mul_comm _ _

lemma sum_Ico_telescope (f : ℕ → ℝ) {m₁ m₂ : ℕ} (h : m₁ ≤ m₂) :
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico m₁ m₂, (f n - f (n+1)) = f m₁ - f m₂ := by
  induction m₂, h using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => simp
  | succ n hn ih => rw [Finset.sum_Ico_succ_top hn, ih]; ring

lemma sum_Ico_eq_sum_bset {Ω : Type*} {K : ℕ} (A : AlgData Ω K) (F : ℕ → ℝ) (m₁ m₂ : ℕ)
    (hF : ∀ n, (∀ q ∈ bset A, kkey A.T A.d q ≠ n) → F n = 0) :
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico m₁ m₂, F n
      = ∑ r ∈ (bset A).filter (fun r => m₁ ≤ kkey A.T A.d r ∧ kkey A.T A.d r < m₂),
          F (kkey A.T A.d r) := by
  rw [← Finset.sum_image (f := F) (g := kkey A.T A.d)
      (by
        intro x hx y hy hxy
        simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_filter] at hx hy
        exact kkey_inj (bset_le_T hx.1) (bset_le_T hy.1) hxy)]
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_subset
  · intro x hx
    rw [Finset.mem_image] at hx
    obtain ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hr
    exact Finset.mem_Ico.2 ⟨hr.2.1, hr.2.2⟩
  · intro x hxIco hx
    apply hF
    intro q hq hcon
    have hIco := Finset.mem_Ico.1 hxIco
    refine hx (Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨q, ?_, hcon⟩)
    rw [Finset.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨hq, by omega, by omega⟩

noncomputable def dpos {Ω : Type*} {K : ℕ} (A : AlgData Ω K) (r : ℕ) (ω : Ω) (i : Fin K) : ℝ :=
  max (PP A (kkey A.T A.d r) ω i - PP A (kkey A.T A.d r + 1) ω i) 0

namespace AlgOK
variable {Ω : Type*} {K : ℕ} {A : AlgData Ω K}

lemma dpos_nonneg (A : AlgData Ω K) (r : ℕ) (ω : Ω) (i : Fin K) : 0 ≤ dpos A r ω i :=
  le_max_right _ _

private lemma dpos_le_update (hA : AlgOK A) {r : ℕ} (hr : r ∈ bset A)
    (ω : Ω) (i : Fin K) :
    dpos A r ω i ≤ PP A (kkey A.T A.d r) ω i * (A.η r * ltil A r ω i) := by
  have hD : ∀ j, 0 ≤ A.η r * ltil A r ω j := fun j =>
    mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hA.hηpos r)) (hA.ltil_nonneg hr ω j)
  have hgg : GG A (kkey A.T A.d r + 1) ω
      = fun j => GG A (kkey A.T A.d r) ω j + A.η r * ltil A r ω j := by
    funext j
    exact GG_succ_mem A (kkey A.T A.d r) r hr rfl ω j
  unfold dpos PP
  rw [hgg]
  exact sfm_drop_le hA.hK _ _ hD i

private lemma dpos_le_indicator (hA : AlgOK A) {r : ℕ} (hr : r ∈ bset A)
    (ω : Ω) (i : Fin K) :
    dpos A r ω i ≤ Real.exp 2 * A.η r *
      (if A.a r ω = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
  have h0 : 0 ≤ A.η r * ltil A r ω i :=
    mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hA.hηpos r)) (hA.ltil_nonneg hr ω i)
  have h1 := dpos_le_update hA hr ω i
  have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hA.key_ratio ω r hr i) h0
  refine h1.trans (h2.trans ?_)
  by_cases hi : A.a r ω = i
  · rw [if_pos hi]
    have hpg := hA.pg_pos hr ω i
    have hrat : A.p r ω i * A.l r ω i / (A.p r ω i + A.γ r) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [div_le_one hpg]
      nlinarith [hA.hl1 r ω i, hA.p_pos_bset hr ω i, hA.hγ r]
    unfold ltil
    rw [if_pos hi]
    have hc : 0 ≤ Real.exp 2 * A.η r :=
      mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos 2)) (le_of_lt (hA.hηpos r))
    calc
      (Real.exp 2 * A.p r ω i) *
          (A.η r * (A.l r ω i * 1 / (A.p r ω i + A.γ r)))
          = (Real.exp 2 * A.η r) *
              (A.p r ω i * A.l r ω i / (A.p r ω i + A.γ r)) := by ring
      _ ≤ (Real.exp 2 * A.η r) * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrat hc
      _ = Real.exp 2 * A.η r * 1 := by ring
  · unfold ltil
    rw [if_neg hi]
    norm_num

lemma delay_decomp (hA : AlgOK A) (ω : Ω) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ bset A) (i : Fin K) :
    A.p q ω i - PP A (kkey A.T A.d q) ω i
      = ∑ r ∈ Rset A q, (PP A (kkey A.T A.d r) ω i - PP A (kkey A.T A.d r + 1) ω i) := by
  have hqT := bset_le_T hq
  have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := (mem_bset.1 hq).1.1
  have hple : q*(A.T+1) ≤ kkey A.T A.d q := by
    show q*(A.T+1) ≤ (q + A.d q)*(A.T+1) + q
    exact le_trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right (A.T+1) (Nat.le_add_right q (A.d q)))
      (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  have hpq : A.p q ω i = PP A (q*(A.T+1)) ω i := by
    rw [hA.hp q ω i hq1 (by omega)]; rfl
  rw [hpq, ← sum_Ico_telescope (fun n => PP A n ω i) hple]
  rw [sum_Ico_eq_sum_bset A (fun n => PP A n ω i - PP A (n+1) ω i) _ _ ?_]
  · rfl
  · intro n hn
    have hgg := GG_succ_not A n hn ω
    show PP A n ω i - PP A (n+1) ω i = 0
    rw [AlgOK.PP_eq_of_GG_eq A ω (fun j => (hgg j).symm) i]
    ring

lemma dpos_sum_le (hA : AlgOK A) (ω : Ω) {r : ℕ} (hr : r ∈ bset A) :
    ∑ i, dpos A r ω i ≤ 2 * A.η r * ∑ i, PP A (kkey A.T A.d r) ω i * ltil A r ω i := by
  have hD : ∀ j, 0 ≤ A.η r * ltil A r ω j := fun j =>
    mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hA.hηpos r)) (hA.ltil_nonneg hr ω j)
  have hgg : GG A (kkey A.T A.d r + 1) ω
      = fun j => GG A (kkey A.T A.d r) ω j + A.η r * ltil A r ω j := by
    funext j
    exact GG_succ_mem A (kkey A.T A.d r) r hr rfl ω j
  have h1 := sfm_l1 hA.hK (GG A (kkey A.T A.d r) ω) (fun j => A.η r * ltil A r ω j) hD
  have h2 : ∑ i, |PP A (kkey A.T A.d r) ω i - PP A (kkey A.T A.d r + 1) ω i|
      ≤ 2 * ∑ i, PP A (kkey A.T A.d r) ω i * (A.η r * ltil A r ω i) := by
    have heq : ∀ i, PP A (kkey A.T A.d r + 1) ω i
        = sfm (fun j => GG A (kkey A.T A.d r) ω j + A.η r * ltil A r ω j) i := by
      intro i; unfold PP; rw [hgg]
    calc ∑ i, |PP A (kkey A.T A.d r) ω i - PP A (kkey A.T A.d r + 1) ω i|
        = ∑ i, |sfm (GG A (kkey A.T A.d r) ω) i
            - sfm (fun j => GG A (kkey A.T A.d r) ω j + A.η r * ltil A r ω j) i| := by
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by rw [heq i]; rfl)
      _ ≤ 2 * ∑ i, sfm (GG A (kkey A.T A.d r) ω) i * (A.η r * ltil A r ω i) := h1
      _ = 2 * ∑ i, PP A (kkey A.T A.d r) ω i * (A.η r * ltil A r ω i) := rfl
  have h3 : ∑ i, dpos A r ω i
      ≤ ∑ i, |PP A (kkey A.T A.d r) ω i - PP A (kkey A.T A.d r + 1) ω i| := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    unfold dpos
    exact max_le (le_abs_self _) (abs_nonneg _)
  have hin : ∑ i, PP A (kkey A.T A.d r) ω i * (A.η r * ltil A r ω i)
      = A.η r * ∑ i, PP A (kkey A.T A.d r) ω i * ltil A r ω i := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
  rw [hin] at h2
  linarith

lemma core_final (hA : AlgOK A) (ω : Ω) (istar : Fin K) :
    ∑ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * A.l q ω (A.a q ω)
      ≤ Real.log K + ∑ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * ltil A q ω istar
        + ∑ q ∈ bset A, (A.γ q * A.η q + (Real.exp 2/2) * (A.η q)^2) * ∑ i, ltil A q ω i
        + ∑ q ∈ bset A, ∑ r ∈ Rset A q, A.η q * ∑ i, dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i := by
  have hcore := hA.core_pathwise ω istar (fun q hq i => hA.key_ratio ω q hq i)
  refine le_trans hcore ?_
  have hle : ∀ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * ∑ i, (A.p q ω i - PP A (kkey A.T A.d q) ω i) * ltil A q ω i
      ≤ ∑ r ∈ Rset A q, A.η q * ∑ i, dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i := by
    intro q hq
    have hdec : ∀ i, (A.p q ω i - PP A (kkey A.T A.d q) ω i) * ltil A q ω i
        ≤ ∑ r ∈ Rset A q, dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i := by
      intro i
      rw [hA.delay_decomp ω hq i, Finset.sum_mul]
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro r _
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) (hA.ltil_nonneg hq ω i)
    have h2 : ∑ i, (A.p q ω i - PP A (kkey A.T A.d q) ω i) * ltil A q ω i
        ≤ ∑ i, ∑ r ∈ Rset A q, dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hdec i)
    have h3 : ∑ i, ∑ r ∈ Rset A q, dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i
        = ∑ r ∈ Rset A q, ∑ i, dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i := Finset.sum_comm
    have h4 : A.η q * ∑ i, (A.p q ω i - PP A (kkey A.T A.d q) ω i) * ltil A q ω i
        ≤ A.η q * ∑ r ∈ Rset A q, ∑ i, dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i := by
      rw [← h3]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (le_of_lt (hA.hηpos q))
    rw [Finset.mul_sum (s := Rset A q)] at h4
    exact h4
  have := Finset.sum_le_sum hle
  linarith

end AlgOK

namespace AlgOK
variable {Ω : Type*} {K : ℕ} {A : AlgData Ω K}

lemma ltil_meas (A : AlgData Ω K) (m : MeasurableSpace Ω) {q : ℕ}
    (ha : Measurable[m] (A.a q)) (hp : ∀ i, Measurable[m] (fun ω => A.p q ω i))
    (hl : ∀ i, Measurable[m] (fun ω => A.l q ω i)) (i : Fin K) :
    Measurable[m] (fun ω => ltil A q ω i) := by
  unfold ltil
  have hset : MeasurableSet[m] {ω | A.a q ω = i} := ha (measurableSet_singleton i)
  exact ((hl i).mul (Measurable.ite hset measurable_const measurable_const)).div
    ((hp i).add measurable_const)

lemma GG_meas (A : AlgData Ω K) (m : MeasurableSpace Ω) (n : ℕ)
    (ha : ∀ q ∈ bset A, kkey A.T A.d q < n → Measurable[m] (A.a q))
    (hp : ∀ q ∈ bset A, kkey A.T A.d q < n → ∀ i, Measurable[m] (fun ω => A.p q ω i))
    (hl : ∀ q i, Measurable[m] (fun ω => A.l q ω i)) (i : Fin K) :
    Measurable[m] (fun ω => GG A n ω i) := by
  unfold GG
  apply Finset.measurable_sum
  intro q hq
  rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hq
  exact ((ltil_meas A m (ha q hq.1 hq.2) (hp q hq.1 hq.2) (fun i => hl q i) i)).const_mul _

lemma PP_meas (A : AlgData Ω K) (m : MeasurableSpace Ω) (n : ℕ)
    (ha : ∀ q ∈ bset A, kkey A.T A.d q < n → Measurable[m] (A.a q))
    (hp : ∀ q ∈ bset A, kkey A.T A.d q < n → ∀ i, Measurable[m] (fun ω => A.p q ω i))
    (hl : ∀ q i, Measurable[m] (fun ω => A.l q ω i)) (i : Fin K) :
    Measurable[m] (fun ω => PP A n ω i) := by
  unfold PP sfm
  exact ((GG_meas A m n ha hp hl i).neg.exp).div
    (Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun j _ => (GG_meas A m n ha hp hl j).neg.exp))

lemma dpos_meas (A : AlgData Ω K) (m : MeasurableSpace Ω) (r : ℕ)
    (ha : ∀ q ∈ bset A, kkey A.T A.d q < kkey A.T A.d r + 1 → Measurable[m] (A.a q))
    (hp : ∀ q ∈ bset A, kkey A.T A.d q < kkey A.T A.d r + 1 → ∀ i,
      Measurable[m] (fun ω => A.p q ω i))
    (hl : ∀ q i, Measurable[m] (fun ω => A.l q ω i)) (i : Fin K) :
    Measurable[m] (fun ω => dpos A r ω i) := by
  unfold dpos
  refine Measurable.max (Measurable.sub ?_ ?_) measurable_const
  · exact PP_meas A m _ (fun q hq h => ha q hq (by omega)) (fun q hq h => hp q hq (by omega)) hl i
  · exact PP_meas A m _ ha hp hl i

lemma PP_nonneg (hA : AlgOK A) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) (i : Fin K) : 0 ≤ PP A n ω i :=
  le_of_lt (sfm_pos hA.hK _ _)

lemma PP_le_one (hA : AlgOK A) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) (i : Fin K) : PP A n ω i ≤ 1 := by
  have h1 : ∑ j, PP A n ω j = 1 := sfm_sum hA.hK _
  have h2 : PP A n ω i ≤ ∑ j, PP A n ω j :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hA.PP_nonneg n ω j) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  linarith

lemma dpos_le_one (hA : AlgOK A) (r : ℕ) (ω : Ω) (i : Fin K) : dpos A r ω i ≤ 1 := by
  unfold dpos
  apply max_le
  · have := hA.PP_le_one (kkey A.T A.d r) ω i
    have := hA.PP_nonneg (kkey A.T A.d r + 1) ω i
    linarith
  · norm_num

end AlgOK

section Build

variable {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {K : ℕ} {hK : 0 < K}
  {l : ℕ → Ω → Fin K → ℝ} {d : ℕ → ℕ} {η γ : ℕ → ℝ}

/-- The `AlgData` recording a run of `Exp3Delayed` up to horizon `T`. -/
noncomputable def toAlg (T : ℕ) (d : ℕ → ℕ) (η γ : ℕ → ℝ) (l : ℕ → Ω → Fin K → ℝ)
    (E : Exp3Delayed μ K hK l d η γ) : AlgData Ω K :=
  { T := T, d := d, η := η, γ := γ, a := E.a, l := l, p := E.p }

@[simp] lemma toAlg_T (T : ℕ) (E : Exp3Delayed μ K hK l d η γ) :
    (toAlg T d η γ l E).T = T := rfl
@[simp] lemma toAlg_d (T : ℕ) (E : Exp3Delayed μ K hK l d η γ) :
    (toAlg T d η γ l E).d = d := rfl
@[simp] lemma toAlg_eta (T : ℕ) (E : Exp3Delayed μ K hK l d η γ) :
    (toAlg T d η γ l E).η = η := rfl
@[simp] lemma toAlg_gamma (T : ℕ) (E : Exp3Delayed μ K hK l d η γ) :
    (toAlg T d η γ l E).γ = γ := rfl
@[simp] lemma toAlg_a (T : ℕ) (E : Exp3Delayed μ K hK l d η γ) :
    (toAlg T d η γ l E).a = E.a := rfl
@[simp] lemma toAlg_l (T : ℕ) (E : Exp3Delayed μ K hK l d η γ) :
    (toAlg T d η γ l E).l = l := rfl
@[simp] lemma toAlg_p (T : ℕ) (E : Exp3Delayed μ K hK l d η γ) :
    (toAlg T d η γ l E).p = E.p := rfl

/-- The set of rounds whose feedback has arrived by time `m`. -/
noncomputable def arrived (T : ℕ) (d : ℕ → ℕ) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Finset.Icc 1 T).filter (fun q => q + d q ≤ m ∧ (d q : ℝ) ≤ 1/(Real.exp 2 * η q) - 1)

lemma bset_filter_eq_arrived (T : ℕ) (E : Exp3Delayed μ K hK l d η γ) {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ T) :
    (bset (toAlg T d η γ l E)).filter (fun q => kkey T d q < (m+1)*(T+1))
      = arrived T d η m := by
  ext q
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, mem_bset, arrived, toAlg_T, toAlg_d, toAlg_eta]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3, h4⟩, h5⟩
    exact ⟨Finset.mem_Icc.2 ⟨h1, h2⟩, (kkey_lt_time (T := T) (d := d) h2).1 h5, h4⟩
  · rintro ⟨hq, h1, h2⟩
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hq
    refine ⟨⟨⟨hq.1, hq.2⟩, by omega, h2⟩, ?_⟩
    exact (kkey_lt_time (T := T) (d := d) hq.2).2 h1

lemma Lhat_eq_sum (T : ℕ) (E : Exp3Delayed μ K hK l d η γ) (hd : ∀ t, 1 ≤ t → 1 ≤ d t)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ T) (ω : Ω) (i : Fin K) :
    E.Lhat m ω i = ∑ q ∈ arrived T d η m, η q * ltil (toAlg T d η γ l E) q ω i := by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
      rw [E.Lhat_init]
      have : arrived T d η 0 = ∅ := by
        apply Finset.filter_false_of_mem
        intro x hx
        rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hx
        rintro ⟨h1, -⟩
        have := hd x hx.1
        omega
      rw [this, Finset.sum_empty]
  | succ n ih =>
      have hn : n ≤ T := by omega
      rw [E.Lhat_step (n+1) ω i (by omega)]
      simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
      rw [ih hn]
      have hsplit : arrived T d η (n+1)
          = arrived T d η n ∪ (Finset.Icc 1 T).filter
              (fun q => q + d q = n+1 ∧ (d q : ℝ) ≤ 1/(Real.exp 2 * η q) - 1) := by
        rw [arrived, arrived, ← Finset.filter_or]
        apply Finset.filter_congr
        intro x _
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
          rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (x + d x) (n+1) with h | h
          · exact Or.inl ⟨by omega, h2⟩
          · exact Or.inr ⟨by omega, h2⟩
        · rintro (⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩) <;> exact ⟨by omega, h2⟩
      rw [hsplit, Finset.sum_union (by
        simp only [Finset.disjoint_left, Finset.mem_filter, arrived]
        rintro x ⟨-, hx1, -⟩ ⟨-, hx2, -⟩; omega)]
      congr 1
      -- now match the second sum with the Lhat_step sum
      have hkey : ∀ q, η q * ltil (toAlg T d η γ l E) q ω i
          = if E.a q ω = i then η q * l q ω i / (E.p q ω i + γ q) else 0 := by
        intro q
        unfold ltil
        simp only [toAlg_a, toAlg_l, toAlg_p, toAlg_gamma]
        by_cases h : E.a q ω = i
        · simp [h, mul_div_assoc]
        · simp [h]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun q _ => hkey q), ← Finset.sum_filter]
      apply Finset.sum_congr _ (fun _ _ => rfl)
      ext q
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]
      constructor
      · intro h
        obtain ⟨hIcc, he, hbd, hai⟩ := h
        exact ⟨⟨⟨hIcc.1, by omega⟩, he, hbd⟩, hai⟩
      · intro h
        obtain ⟨⟨hIcc, he, hbd⟩, hai⟩ := h
        exact ⟨⟨hIcc.1, by omega⟩, he, hbd, hai⟩

end Build

section Build2

variable {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {K : ℕ} {hK : 0 < K}
  {l : ℕ → Ω → Fin K → ℝ} {d : ℕ → ℕ} {η γ : ℕ → ℝ}

lemma GG_eq_arrived (T : ℕ) (E : Exp3Delayed μ K hK l d η γ) {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ T)
    (ω : Ω) (i : Fin K) :
    GG (toAlg T d η γ l E) ((m+1)*(T+1)) ω i
      = ∑ q ∈ arrived T d η m, η q * ltil (toAlg T d η γ l E) q ω i := by
  unfold GG
  simp only [toAlg_T, toAlg_d, toAlg_eta]
  rw [bset_filter_eq_arrived T E hm]

lemma toAlg_hp (T : ℕ) (E : Exp3Delayed μ K hK l d η γ) (hd : ∀ t, 1 ≤ t → 1 ≤ d t)
    (t : ℕ) (ω : Ω) (i : Fin K) (h1 : 1 ≤ t) (h2 : t ≤ T + 1) :
    E.p t ω i = sfm (GG (toAlg T d η γ l E) (t * (T+1)) ω) i := by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, t = m + 1 := ⟨t - 1, by omega⟩
  have hm : m ≤ T := by omega
  have hL : ∀ j, E.Lhat m ω j = GG (toAlg T d η γ l E) ((m+1)*(T+1)) ω j := by
    intro j
    rw [GG_eq_arrived T E hm ω j]
    exact Lhat_eq_sum T E hd m hm ω j
  rw [E.p_update m ω i]
  unfold sfm
  rw [hL i]
  congr 1
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by rw [hL j])

lemma toAlg_ok (T : ℕ) (E : Exp3Delayed μ K hK l d η γ)
    (hd : ∀ t, 1 ≤ t → 1 ≤ d t)
    (hηpos : ∀ t, 0 < η t) (hηdec : ∀ t, η (t+1) ≤ η t)
    (hηb : ∀ t, η t ≤ (1/2) * Real.exp (-2))
    (hl0 : ∀ t ω i, 0 ≤ l t ω i) (hl1 : ∀ t ω i, l t ω i ≤ 1)
    (hγ : ∀ t, 0 ≤ γ t) :
    AlgOK (toAlg T d η γ l E) where
  hK := hK
  hd := hd
  hηpos := hηpos
  hηdec := hηdec
  hηb := hηb
  hl0 := hl0
  hl1 := hl1
  hγ := hγ
  hp := fun t ω i h1 h2 => toAlg_hp T E hd t ω i h1 h2

end Build2

section Meas

variable {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {K : ℕ} {A : AlgData Ω K}

/-- The σ-algebra generated by the actions of all *used* rounds with key `< n`. -/
noncomputable def Mact (A : AlgData Ω K) (n : ℕ) : MeasurableSpace Ω :=
  ⨆ u, ⨆ (_ : u ∈ bset A ∧ kkey A.T A.d u < n), MeasurableSpace.comap (A.a u) inferInstance

lemma comap_le_Mact {u n : ℕ} (hu : u ∈ bset A) (hk : kkey A.T A.d u < n) :
    MeasurableSpace.comap (A.a u) inferInstance ≤ Mact A n := by
  unfold Mact
  exact le_iSup_of_le u (le_iSup_of_le ⟨hu, hk⟩ le_rfl)

lemma a_meas_Mact {u n : ℕ} (hu : u ∈ bset A) (hk : kkey A.T A.d u < n) :
    Measurable[Mact A n] (A.a u) :=
  measurable_iff_comap_le.2 (comap_le_Mact hu hk)

lemma Mact_mono (A : AlgData Ω K) {n n' : ℕ} (h : n ≤ n') : Mact A n ≤ Mact A n' := by
  unfold Mact
  refine iSup_le (fun u => iSup_le (fun hu => ?_))
  exact comap_le_Mact hu.1 (lt_of_lt_of_le hu.2 h)

lemma Mact_le (A : AlgData Ω K) (n : ℕ) (ha : ∀ u, Measurable (A.a u)) :
    Mact A n ≤ mΩ := by
  unfold Mact
  refine iSup_le (fun u => iSup_le (fun _ => ?_))
  exact (measurable_iff_comap_le.1 (ha u))

lemma GG_meas_Mact (hA : AlgOK A) (hlc : ∀ q i, ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ ω, A.l q ω i = c) :
    ∀ n, ∀ i, Measurable[Mact A n] (fun ω => GG A n ω i) := by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n IH =>
    intro i
    refine AlgOK.GG_meas A (Mact A n) n (fun q hq hk => a_meas_Mact hq hk) ?_ ?_ i
    · intro q hq hk j
      have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := (mem_bset.1 hq).1.1
      have hqT : q ≤ A.T := bset_le_T hq
      have hlt : q * (A.T+1) < n := by
        refine lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ hk
        show q * (A.T+1) ≤ (q + A.d q)*(A.T+1) + q
        exact le_trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right (A.T+1) (Nat.le_add_right q (A.d q)))
          (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
      have hmono : Mact A (q*(A.T+1)) ≤ Mact A n := Mact_mono A (le_of_lt hlt)
      have hIH : ∀ j', Measurable[Mact A n] (fun ω => GG A (q*(A.T+1)) ω j') := by
        intro j'
        exact (IH _ hlt j').mono hmono le_rfl
      have hpe : (fun ω => A.p q ω j) = fun ω => sfm (GG A (q*(A.T+1)) ω) j := by
        funext ω; exact hA.hp q ω j hq1 (by omega)
      rw [hpe]
      unfold sfm
      exact ((hIH j).neg.exp).div (Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun j' _ => (hIH j').neg.exp))
    · intro q j
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hlc q j
      have : (fun ω => A.l q ω j) = fun _ => c := funext hc
      rw [this]
      exact measurable_const

lemma PP_meas_Mact (hA : AlgOK A) (hlc : ∀ q i, ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ ω, A.l q ω i = c)
    (n : ℕ) (i : Fin K) : Measurable[Mact A n] (fun ω => PP A n ω i) := by
  unfold PP sfm
  exact ((GG_meas_Mact hA hlc n i).neg.exp).div
    (Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun j _ => (GG_meas_Mact hA hlc n j).neg.exp))

lemma dpos_meas_Mact (hA : AlgOK A) (hlc : ∀ q i, ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ ω, A.l q ω i = c)
    (r : ℕ) (i : Fin K) : Measurable[Mact A (kkey A.T A.d r + 1)] (fun ω => dpos A r ω i) := by
  unfold dpos
  refine Measurable.max (Measurable.sub ?_ ?_) measurable_const
  · exact (PP_meas_Mact hA hlc (kkey A.T A.d r) i).mono
      (Mact_mono A (by omega)) le_rfl
  · exact PP_meas_Mact hA hlc (kkey A.T A.d r + 1) i

lemma p_meas_Mact (hA : AlgOK A) (hlc : ∀ q i, ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ ω, A.l q ω i = c)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ bset A) (i : Fin K) :
    Measurable[Mact A (kkey A.T A.d q)] (fun ω => A.p q ω i) := by
  have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := (mem_bset.1 hq).1.1
  have hqT : q ≤ A.T := bset_le_T hq
  have hle : q * (A.T+1) ≤ kkey A.T A.d q := by
    show q * (A.T+1) ≤ (q + A.d q)*(A.T+1) + q
    exact le_trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right (A.T+1) (Nat.le_add_right q (A.d q)))
      (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  have hpe : (fun ω => A.p q ω i) = fun ω => sfm (GG A (q*(A.T+1)) ω) i := by
    funext ω; exact hA.hp q ω i hq1 (by omega)
  rw [hpe]
  unfold sfm
  have hIH : ∀ j', Measurable[Mact A (kkey A.T A.d q)] (fun ω => GG A (q*(A.T+1)) ω j') :=
    fun j' => (GG_meas_Mact hA hlc _ j').mono (Mact_mono A hle) le_rfl
  exact ((hIH i).neg.exp).div (Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun j' _ => (hIH j').neg.exp))

end Meas

section Expect

variable {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {K : ℕ} {A : AlgData Ω K}

/-- Unbiasedness of the importance-weighted loss estimator, against a weight `F` that is
measurable for a σ-algebra `m` for which the action still has conditional law `p`. -/
lemma expect_ltil (hA : AlgOK A) (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hγ0 : ∀ t, A.γ t = 0)
    (m : MeasurableSpace Ω) (hm : m ≤ mΩ)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ bset A) (i : Fin K)
    (hpm : Measurable[m] (fun ω => A.p q ω i))
    (hai : @Measurable Ω (Fin K) mΩ _ (A.a q))
    (hcond : (μ[(fun ω => if A.a q ω = i then (1:ℝ) else 0) | m]) =ᵐ[μ] (fun ω => A.p q ω i))
    (F : Ω → ℝ) (hF : Measurable[m] F) (hF0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ F ω) (hFb : ∀ ω, F ω ≤ 1)
    (hlm : Measurable[m] (fun ω => A.l q ω i)) :
    Integrable (fun ω => F ω * ltil A q ω i) μ ∧
      ∫ ω, F ω * ltil A q ω i ∂μ = ∫ ω, F ω * A.l q ω i ∂μ := by
  set f : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => F ω * A.l q ω i / A.p q ω i with hfdef
  set g : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => if A.a q ω = i then (1:ℝ) else 0 with hgdef
  set h : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => A.p q ω i with hhdef
  have hppos : ∀ ω, 0 < A.p q ω i := fun ω => hA.p_pos_bset hq ω i
  have hfg : (fun ω => f ω * g ω) = fun ω => F ω * ltil A q ω i := by
    funext ω
    simp only [hfdef, hgdef, ltil, hγ0, add_zero]
    ring
  have hfh : (fun ω => f ω * h ω) = fun ω => F ω * A.l q ω i := by
    funext ω
    simp only [hfdef, hhdef]
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, mul_div_assoc, div_self (ne_of_gt (hppos ω)), mul_one]
  have hFl0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ F ω * A.l q ω i := fun ω => mul_nonneg (hF0 ω) (hA.hl0 _ _ _)
  have hFl1 : ∀ ω, F ω * A.l q ω i ≤ 1 := by
    intro ω
    have := hA.hl1 q ω i
    have := hA.hl0 q ω i
    nlinarith [hF0 ω, hFb ω]
  have hFlmeas : Measurable[mΩ] (fun ω => F ω * A.l q ω i) :=
    (hF.mono hm le_rfl).mul (hlm.mono hm le_rfl)
  have hFlint : Integrable (fun ω => F ω * A.l q ω i) μ := by
    refine (integrable_const (1:ℝ)).mono' hFlmeas.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => ?_))
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hFl0 ω)]
    exact hFl1 ω
  have hres := @cond_pull Ω m mΩ hm μ _ f g h
    ((hF.mul hlm).div hpm)
    (fun ω => div_nonneg (hFl0 ω) (le_of_lt (hppos ω)))
    (by
      have hs : MeasurableSet[mΩ] {ω | A.a q ω = i} := hai (measurableSet_singleton i)
      exact @Measurable.ite Ω ℝ _ _ mΩ _ _ _ hs measurable_const measurable_const)
    (fun ω => by simp only [hgdef]; split <;> norm_num)
    (fun ω => by simp only [hgdef]; split <;> norm_num)
    hpm (fun ω => le_of_lt (hppos ω)) hcond (by rw [hfh]; exact hFlint)
  rw [hfg, hfh] at hres
  exact hres

end Expect

section Master

lemma master_bound {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {K : ℕ} (A : AlgData Ω K) (hA : AlgOK A)
    (L0 : ℕ → Fin K → ℝ) (hlc : ∀ q ω i, A.l q ω i = L0 q i)
    (hγ0 : ∀ t, A.γ t = 0)
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (m : ℕ → MeasurableSpace Ω)
    (hmle : ∀ q, m q ≤ mΩ)
    (hMm : ∀ q ∈ bset A, Mact A (kkey A.T A.d q) ≤ m q)
    (ha : ∀ q, @Measurable Ω (Fin K) mΩ _ (A.a q))
    (hcond : ∀ q ∈ bset A, ∀ i,
       (μ[(fun ω => if A.a q ω = i then (1:ℝ) else 0) | m q]) =ᵐ[μ] (fun ω => A.p q ω i))
    (istar : Fin K) :
    ∫ ω, (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 A.T, A.η t * L0 t (A.a t ω)) ∂μ
      ≤ (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 A.T, A.η t * L0 t istar)
        + Real.log K + (Real.exp 2/2) * K * (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 A.T, (A.η t)^2)
        + 4 * (∑ q ∈ bset A, (A.η q)^2 * (A.d q : ℝ))
        + (∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 A.T) \ bset A, A.η t) := by
  classical
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin K) := ⟨⟨0, hA.hK⟩⟩
  haveI hne : Nonempty Ω := by
    by_contra hcon
    rw [not_nonempty_iff] at hcon
    have h0 : (μ Set.univ) = 0 := by
      rw [Set.univ_eq_empty_iff.2 hcon, measure_empty]
    rw [measure_univ] at h0
    exact one_ne_zero h0
  have hlc' : ∀ q (i : Fin K), ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ ω, A.l q ω i = c :=
    fun q i => ⟨L0 q i, fun ω => hlc q ω i⟩
  have hL00 : ∀ q i, 0 ≤ L0 q i := by
    intro q i; rw [← hlc q (Classical.arbitrary Ω) i]; exact hA.hl0 _ _ _
  have hL01 : ∀ q i, L0 q i ≤ 1 := by
    intro q i; rw [← hlc q (Classical.arbitrary Ω) i]; exact hA.hl1 _ _ _
  have hlfun : ∀ q (i : Fin K), (fun ω => A.l q ω i) = fun _ => L0 q i :=
    fun q i => funext (fun ω => hlc q ω i)
  -- integrability of bounded nonnegative measurable functions
  have hFintC : ∀ (F : Ω → ℝ) (C : ℝ), Measurable[mΩ] F → (∀ ω, 0 ≤ F ω) → (∀ ω, F ω ≤ C) →
      Integrable F μ := by
    intro F C hF hF0 hFb
    refine (integrable_const C).mono' hF.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => ?_))
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hF0 ω)]; exact hFb ω
  -- Step 1 : unbiasedness of the estimator against a weight
  have hltil : ∀ q ∈ bset A, ∀ (i : Fin K) (F : Ω → ℝ), Measurable[m q] F →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ F ω) → (∀ ω, F ω ≤ 1) →
      Integrable (fun ω => F ω * ltil A q ω i) μ ∧
        ∫ ω, F ω * ltil A q ω i ∂μ = ∫ ω, F ω * A.l q ω i ∂μ := by
    intro q hq i F hF hF0 hFb
    refine expect_ltil hA μ hγ0 (m q) (hmle q) hq i
      ((p_meas_Mact hA hlc' hq i).mono (hMm q hq) le_rfl) (ha q) (hcond q hq i) F hF hF0 hFb ?_
    rw [hlfun q i]; exact measurable_const
  have hltilF_le : ∀ q ∈ bset A, ∀ (i : Fin K) (F : Ω → ℝ), Measurable[m q] F →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ F ω) → (∀ ω, F ω ≤ 1) →
      ∫ ω, F ω * ltil A q ω i ∂μ ≤ ∫ ω, F ω ∂μ := by
    intro q hq i F hF hF0 hFb
    rw [(hltil q hq i F hF hF0 hFb).2]
    have hFM : Measurable[mΩ] F := hF.mono (hmle q) le_rfl
    have h1 : Integrable F μ := hFintC F 1 hFM hF0 hFb
    have h2 : Integrable (fun ω => F ω * A.l q ω i) μ := by
      refine hFintC _ 1 (hFM.mul (by rw [hlfun q i]; exact measurable_const)) ?_ ?_
      · exact fun ω => mul_nonneg (hF0 ω) (hA.hl0 _ _ _)
      · intro ω; nlinarith [hA.hl0 q ω i, hA.hl1 q ω i, hF0 ω, hFb ω]
    refine integral_mono h2 h1 (fun ω => ?_)
    nlinarith [hA.hl1 q ω i, hF0 ω, hA.hl0 q ω i]
  have hltil1 : ∀ q ∈ bset A, ∀ i : Fin K,
      Integrable (fun ω => ltil A q ω i) μ ∧ ∫ ω, ltil A q ω i ∂μ = L0 q i := by
    intro q hq i
    have h := hltil q hq i (fun _ => 1) measurable_const (fun _ => zero_le_one) (fun _ => le_rfl)
    refine ⟨by simpa using h.1, ?_⟩
    have h2 := h.2
    simp only [one_mul] at h2
    rw [h2, hlfun q i]
    simp
  have hsumltil : ∀ q ∈ bset A,
      Integrable (fun ω => ∑ i, ltil A q ω i) μ ∧
        ∫ ω, (∑ i, ltil A q ω i) ∂μ = ∑ i, L0 q i := by
    intro q hq
    refine ⟨integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => (hltil1 q hq i).1), ?_⟩
    rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => (hltil1 q hq i).1)]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => (hltil1 q hq i).2)
  -- Step 2 : the delayed-drift terms
  have hPPm : ∀ r ∈ bset A, ∀ i, Measurable[m r] (fun ω => PP A (kkey A.T A.d r) ω i) :=
    fun r hr i => (PP_meas_Mact hA hlc' _ i).mono (hMm r hr) le_rfl
  have hPPltil : ∀ r ∈ bset A,
      ∫ ω, (∑ i, PP A (kkey A.T A.d r) ω i * ltil A r ω i) ∂μ ≤ 1 := by
    intro r hr
    have hint : ∀ i, Integrable (fun ω => PP A (kkey A.T A.d r) ω i * ltil A r ω i) μ :=
      fun i => (hltil r hr i _ (hPPm r hr i) (fun ω => hA.PP_nonneg _ ω i)
        (fun ω => hA.PP_le_one _ ω i)).1
    rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => hint i)]
    have hb : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin K)),
        ∫ ω, PP A (kkey A.T A.d r) ω i * ltil A r ω i ∂μ
          ≤ ∫ ω, PP A (kkey A.T A.d r) ω i ∂μ :=
      fun i _ => hltilF_le r hr i _ (hPPm r hr i) (fun ω => hA.PP_nonneg _ ω i)
        (fun ω => hA.PP_le_one _ ω i)
    refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum hb) ?_
    have hPPint : ∀ i, Integrable (fun ω => PP A (kkey A.T A.d r) ω i) μ :=
      fun i => hFintC _ 1 ((hPPm r hr i).mono (hmle r) le_rfl)
        (fun ω => hA.PP_nonneg _ ω i) (fun ω => hA.PP_le_one _ ω i)
    rw [← integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => hPPint i)]
    have he : (fun ω => ∑ i, PP A (kkey A.T A.d r) ω i) = fun _ => (1:ℝ) :=
      funext (fun ω => sfm_sum hA.hK _)
    rw [he]
    simp
  have hdpos_int : ∀ r i, Integrable (fun ω => dpos A r ω i) μ :=
    fun r i => hFintC _ 1 ((dpos_meas_Mact hA hlc' r i).mono (Mact_le A _ ha) le_rfl)
      (fun ω => AlgOK.dpos_nonneg A r ω i) (fun ω => hA.dpos_le_one r ω i)
  have hdpos_bound : ∀ r ∈ bset A, ∫ ω, (∑ i, dpos A r ω i) ∂μ ≤ 2 * A.η r := by
    intro r hr
    have hpath : ∀ ω, ∑ i, dpos A r ω i
        ≤ 2 * A.η r * ∑ i, PP A (kkey A.T A.d r) ω i * ltil A r ω i :=
      fun ω => hA.dpos_sum_le ω hr
    have hint2 : Integrable
        (fun ω => 2 * A.η r * ∑ i, PP A (kkey A.T A.d r) ω i * ltil A r ω i) μ := by
      refine Integrable.const_mul ?_ _
      exact integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => (hltil r hr i _ (hPPm r hr i)
        (fun ω => hA.PP_nonneg _ ω i) (fun ω => hA.PP_le_one _ ω i)).1)
    have h1 := integral_mono (integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) =>
      hdpos_int r i)) hint2 hpath
    rw [integral_const_mul] at h1
    have h2 := hPPltil r hr
    have h3 : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * A.η r := by linarith [hA.hηpos r]
    nlinarith
  have hdposltil_meas : ∀ q ∈ bset A, ∀ r ∈ Rset A q, ∀ i,
      Measurable[m q] (fun ω => dpos A r ω i) := by
    intro q hq r hr i
    have hk : kkey A.T A.d r + 1 ≤ kkey A.T A.d q := (AlgOK.mem_Rset.1 hr).2.2
    exact (dpos_meas_Mact hA hlc' r i).mono
      (le_trans (Mact_mono A hk) (hMm q hq)) le_rfl
  have hdposltil_bd : ∀ q ∈ bset A, ∀ r ∈ Rset A q,
      Integrable (fun ω => ∑ i, dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i) μ ∧
      ∫ ω, (∑ i, dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i) ∂μ ≤ 2 * A.η r := by
    intro q hq r hr
    have hint : ∀ i, Integrable (fun ω => dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i) μ :=
      fun i => (hltil q hq i _ (hdposltil_meas q hq r hr i)
        (fun ω => AlgOK.dpos_nonneg A r ω i) (fun ω => hA.dpos_le_one r ω i)).1
    refine ⟨integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => hint i), ?_⟩
    rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => hint i)]
    have hb : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin K)),
        ∫ ω, dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i ∂μ ≤ ∫ ω, dpos A r ω i ∂μ :=
      fun i _ => hltilF_le q hq i _ (hdposltil_meas q hq r hr i)
        (fun ω => AlgOK.dpos_nonneg A r ω i) (fun ω => hA.dpos_le_one r ω i)
    refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum hb) ?_
    rw [← integral_finset_sum _ (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) => hdpos_int r i)]
    exact hdpos_bound r ((AlgOK.mem_Rset.1 hr).1)
  -- Step 3 : pathwise bound
  have hbsub : bset A ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 A.T := Finset.filter_subset _ _
  have hpath : ∀ ω, (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 A.T, A.η t * L0 t (A.a t ω))
      ≤ (Real.log K + ∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 A.T) \ bset A, A.η t)
        + (∑ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * ltil A q ω istar)
        + (∑ q ∈ bset A, (A.γ q * A.η q + (Real.exp 2/2) * (A.η q)^2) * ∑ i, ltil A q ω i)
        + (∑ q ∈ bset A, ∑ r ∈ Rset A q, A.η q * ∑ i, dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i) := by
    intro ω
    have hcore := hA.core_final ω istar
    have hsplit : ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 A.T, A.η t * L0 t (A.a t ω)
        = (∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 A.T) \ bset A, A.η t * L0 t (A.a t ω))
          + ∑ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * L0 q (A.a q ω) :=
      (Finset.sum_sdiff hbsub).symm
    have hb1 : (∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 A.T) \ bset A, A.η t * L0 t (A.a t ω))
        ≤ ∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 A.T) \ bset A, A.η t := by
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun t _ => ?_)
      nlinarith [hA.hηpos t, hL01 t (A.a t ω), hL00 t (A.a t ω)]
    have hb2 : ∑ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * L0 q (A.a q ω)
        = ∑ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * A.l q ω (A.a q ω) :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun q _ => by rw [hlc q ω (A.a q ω)])
    rw [hsplit, hb2]
    linarith
  -- Step 4 : integrability and integration
  have hS1int : Integrable (fun ω => ∑ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * ltil A q ω istar) μ :=
    integrable_finset_sum _ (fun q hq => ((hltil1 q hq istar).1).const_mul _)
  have hS1val : ∫ ω, (∑ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * ltil A q ω istar) ∂μ
      = ∑ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * L0 q istar := by
    rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun q hq => ((hltil1 q hq istar).1).const_mul _)]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun q hq => ?_)
    rw [integral_const_mul, (hltil1 q hq istar).2]
  have hS2int : Integrable (fun ω => ∑ q ∈ bset A,
      (A.γ q * A.η q + (Real.exp 2/2) * (A.η q)^2) * ∑ i, ltil A q ω i) μ :=
    integrable_finset_sum _ (fun q hq => ((hsumltil q hq).1).const_mul _)
  have hS2val : ∫ ω, (∑ q ∈ bset A,
      (A.γ q * A.η q + (Real.exp 2/2) * (A.η q)^2) * ∑ i, ltil A q ω i) ∂μ
      = ∑ q ∈ bset A, (A.γ q * A.η q + (Real.exp 2/2) * (A.η q)^2) * (∑ i, L0 q i) := by
    rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun q hq => ((hsumltil q hq).1).const_mul _)]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun q hq => ?_)
    rw [integral_const_mul, (hsumltil q hq).2]
  have hS3int : Integrable (fun ω => ∑ q ∈ bset A, ∑ r ∈ Rset A q,
      A.η q * ∑ i, dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i) μ :=
    integrable_finset_sum _ (fun q hq => integrable_finset_sum _
      (fun r hr => ((hdposltil_bd q hq r hr).1).const_mul _))
  have hS3val : ∫ ω, (∑ q ∈ bset A, ∑ r ∈ Rset A q,
      A.η q * ∑ i, dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i) ∂μ
      ≤ ∑ q ∈ bset A, ∑ r ∈ Rset A q, A.η q * (2 * A.η r) := by
    rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun q hq => integrable_finset_sum _
      (fun r hr => ((hdposltil_bd q hq r hr).1).const_mul _))]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun q hq => ?_)
    rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun r hr => ((hdposltil_bd q hq r hr).1).const_mul _)]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun r hr => ?_)
    rw [integral_const_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hdposltil_bd q hq r hr).2 (le_of_lt (hA.hηpos q))
  have hLHSint : Integrable (fun ω => ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 A.T, A.η t * L0 t (A.a t ω)) μ := by
    refine hFintC _ (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 A.T, A.η t) ?_ ?_ ?_
    · refine Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun t _ => ?_)
      exact (Measurable.comp (measurable_of_countable (L0 t)) (ha t)).const_mul _
    · exact fun ω => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun t _ =>
        mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hA.hηpos t)) (hL00 t _))
    · intro ω
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun t _ => ?_)
      nlinarith [hA.hηpos t, hL01 t (A.a t ω)]
  have hI0 : Integrable (fun _ω : Ω => (Real.log K + ∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 A.T) \ bset A, A.η t)) μ := integrable_const _
  have hI1 : Integrable (fun ω => (Real.log K + ∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 A.T) \ bset A, A.η t) + (∑ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * ltil A q ω istar)) μ := hI0.add hS1int
  have hI2 : Integrable (fun ω => (Real.log K + ∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 A.T) \ bset A, A.η t) + (∑ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * ltil A q ω istar) + (∑ q ∈ bset A, (A.γ q * A.η q + (Real.exp 2/2) * (A.η q)^2) * ∑ i, ltil A q ω i)) μ := hI1.add hS2int
  have hRHSint : Integrable (fun ω => (Real.log K + ∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 A.T) \ bset A, A.η t) + (∑ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * ltil A q ω istar) + (∑ q ∈ bset A, (A.γ q * A.η q + (Real.exp 2/2) * (A.η q)^2) * ∑ i, ltil A q ω i) + (∑ q ∈ bset A, ∑ r ∈ Rset A q, A.η q * ∑ i, dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i)) μ := hI2.add hS3int
  have hmain := integral_mono hLHSint hRHSint hpath
  have e1 : ∫ ω, ((Real.log K + ∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 A.T) \ bset A, A.η t) + (∑ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * ltil A q ω istar) + (∑ q ∈ bset A, (A.γ q * A.η q + (Real.exp 2/2) * (A.η q)^2) * ∑ i, ltil A q ω i) + (∑ q ∈ bset A, ∑ r ∈ Rset A q, A.η q * ∑ i, dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i)) ∂μ
      = (∫ ω, ((Real.log K + ∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 A.T) \ bset A, A.η t) + (∑ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * ltil A q ω istar) + (∑ q ∈ bset A, (A.γ q * A.η q + (Real.exp 2/2) * (A.η q)^2) * ∑ i, ltil A q ω i)) ∂μ) + (∫ ω, (∑ q ∈ bset A, ∑ r ∈ Rset A q, A.η q * ∑ i, dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i) ∂μ) := integral_add hI2 hS3int
  have e2 : ∫ ω, ((Real.log K + ∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 A.T) \ bset A, A.η t) + (∑ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * ltil A q ω istar) + (∑ q ∈ bset A, (A.γ q * A.η q + (Real.exp 2/2) * (A.η q)^2) * ∑ i, ltil A q ω i)) ∂μ
      = (∫ ω, ((Real.log K + ∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 A.T) \ bset A, A.η t) + (∑ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * ltil A q ω istar)) ∂μ) + (∫ ω, (∑ q ∈ bset A, (A.γ q * A.η q + (Real.exp 2/2) * (A.η q)^2) * ∑ i, ltil A q ω i) ∂μ) := integral_add hI1 hS2int
  have e3 : ∫ ω, ((Real.log K + ∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 A.T) \ bset A, A.η t) + (∑ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * ltil A q ω istar)) ∂μ
      = (∫ _ω : Ω, ((Real.log K + ∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 A.T) \ bset A, A.η t)) ∂μ) + (∫ ω, (∑ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * ltil A q ω istar) ∂μ) := integral_add hI0 hS1int
  have e4 : ∫ _ω : Ω, ((Real.log K + ∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 A.T) \ bset A, A.η t)) ∂μ = (Real.log K + ∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 A.T) \ bset A, A.η t) := by simp
  rw [e1, e2, e3, e4, hS1val, hS2val] at hmain
  -- Step 5 : final arithmetic
  have hA1 : ∑ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * L0 q istar
      ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 A.T, A.η t * L0 t istar :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hbsub
      (fun t _ _ => mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hA.hηpos t)) (hL00 t istar))
  have hB1 : ∑ q ∈ bset A, (A.γ q * A.η q + (Real.exp 2/2) * (A.η q)^2) * (∑ i, L0 q i)
      ≤ (Real.exp 2/2) * K * (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 A.T, (A.η t)^2) := by
    have hstep : ∀ q ∈ bset A, (A.γ q * A.η q + (Real.exp 2/2) * (A.η q)^2) * (∑ i, L0 q i)
        ≤ (Real.exp 2/2) * K * (A.η q)^2 := by
      intro q _
      rw [hγ0 q]
      have hsum : ∑ i, L0 q i ≤ (K:ℝ) := by
        calc ∑ i, L0 q i ≤ ∑ _i : Fin K, (1:ℝ) := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hL01 q i)
          _ = K := by simp
      have h0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (Real.exp 2/2) * (A.η q)^2 := by positivity
      nlinarith [Finset.sum_nonneg (fun (i : Fin K) (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) => hL00 q i)]
    calc ∑ q ∈ bset A, (A.γ q * A.η q + (Real.exp 2/2) * (A.η q)^2) * (∑ i, L0 q i)
        ≤ ∑ q ∈ bset A, (Real.exp 2/2) * K * (A.η q)^2 := Finset.sum_le_sum hstep
      _ ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 A.T, (Real.exp 2/2) * K * (A.η t)^2 :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hbsub (fun t _ _ => by positivity)
      _ = (Real.exp 2/2) * K * (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 A.T, (A.η t)^2) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  have hC1 : ∑ q ∈ bset A, ∑ r ∈ Rset A q, A.η q * (2 * A.η r)
      ≤ 4 * (∑ q ∈ bset A, (A.η q)^2 * (A.d q : ℝ)) := by
    have he : ∑ q ∈ bset A, ∑ r ∈ Rset A q, A.η q * (2 * A.η r)
        = 2 * ∑ q ∈ bset A, ∑ r ∈ Rset A q, A.η q * A.η r := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun q _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun r _ => by ring)
    rw [he]
    have h2 := hA.eta_pair_bound
    linarith
  linarith [hS3val]

end Master

section SetArith

lemma exp_two_ge_four : (4:ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 2 := by
  have h : (2:ℝ) < Real.exp 1 := by
    have := Real.exp_one_gt_d9
    linarith
  have he : Real.exp 2 = Real.exp 1 * Real.exp 1 := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]; norm_num
  nlinarith [Real.exp_pos 1]

/-- Rounds actually used by the algorithm up to horizon `T`. -/
noncomputable def Bset (T : ℕ) (d : ℕ → ℕ) (η : ℕ → ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Finset.Icc 1 T).filter (fun q => q + d q ≤ T ∧ (d q : ℝ) ≤ 1/(Real.exp 2 * η q) - 1)

lemma mem_Bset {T : ℕ} {d : ℕ → ℕ} {η : ℕ → ℝ} {q : ℕ} :
    q ∈ Bset T d η ↔ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T ∧ (q + d q ≤ T ∧ (d q : ℝ) ≤ 1/(Real.exp 2 * η q) - 1) := by
  unfold Bset; simp [Finset.mem_filter]

lemma mem_MStar {T : ℕ} {d : ℕ → ℕ} {η : ℕ → ℝ} {t : ℕ} :
    t ∈ MStar T d η ↔ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T ∧ (T < t + d t ∨ (d t : ℝ) ≥ 1/(Real.exp 2 * η t) - 1) := by
  unfold MStar; simp [Finset.mem_filter]

lemma set_arith (T : ℕ) (d : ℕ → ℕ) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (hηpos : ∀ t, 0 < η t) :
    4 * (∑ q ∈ Bset T d η, (η q)^2 * (d q : ℝ))
      + (∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ Bset T d η, η t)
      ≤ 4 * (∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ MStar T d η, (η t)^2 * (d t : ℝ))
        + ∑ t ∈ MStar T d η, η t := by
  classical
  have hBsub : Bset T d η ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 T := Finset.filter_subset _ _
  have hcompl : (Bset T d η).filter (fun q => q ∉ MStar T d η)
      = (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ MStar T d η := by
    ext q
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_sdiff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hqB, hnm⟩
      exact ⟨hBsub hqB, hnm⟩
    · rintro ⟨hIcc, hnm⟩
      refine ⟨mem_Bset.2 ⟨hIcc, ?_, ?_⟩, hnm⟩
      · by_contra hc
        exact hnm (mem_MStar.2 ⟨hIcc, Or.inl (by omega)⟩)
      · by_contra hc
        push_neg at hc
        exact hnm (mem_MStar.2 ⟨hIcc, Or.inr (le_of_lt hc)⟩)
  have hsplit : ∑ q ∈ Bset T d η, (η q)^2 * (d q : ℝ)
      = (∑ q ∈ (Bset T d η).filter (fun q => q ∈ MStar T d η), (η q)^2 * (d q : ℝ))
        + ∑ q ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ MStar T d η, (η q)^2 * (d q : ℝ) := by
    rw [← hcompl]
    exact (Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (Bset T d η)
      (fun q => q ∈ MStar T d η) _).symm
  have hkey : ∀ q ∈ Bset T d η, 4 * ((η q)^2 * (d q : ℝ)) ≤ η q := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨-, -, hdq⟩ := mem_Bset.1 hq
    have hp := hηpos q
    have he2 : (0:ℝ) < Real.exp 2 * η q := mul_pos (Real.exp_pos 2) hp
    have h1 : (η q)^2 * (d q : ℝ) ≤ (η q)^2 * (1/(Real.exp 2 * η q) - 1) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdq (sq_nonneg _)
    have h2 : (η q)^2 * (1/(Real.exp 2 * η q) - 1) = η q / Real.exp 2 - (η q)^2 := by
      field_simp
    have h4 := exp_two_ge_four
    have h3 : 4 * (η q / Real.exp 2) ≤ η q := by
      rw [← mul_div_assoc, div_le_iff₀ (Real.exp_pos 2)]
      nlinarith
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (η q)]
  have hbd1 : 4 * (∑ q ∈ (Bset T d η).filter (fun q => q ∈ MStar T d η), (η q)^2 * (d q : ℝ))
      ≤ ∑ q ∈ (Bset T d η).filter (fun q => q ∈ MStar T d η), η q := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun q hq => hkey q (Finset.mem_filter.1 hq).1)
  have hUdisj : Disjoint ((Finset.Icc 1 T) \ Bset T d η)
      ((Bset T d η).filter (fun q => q ∈ MStar T d η)) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro x hx hx2
    rw [Finset.mem_sdiff] at hx
    exact hx.2 (Finset.mem_filter.1 hx2).1
  have hUsub : ((Finset.Icc 1 T) \ Bset T d η)
      ∪ ((Bset T d η).filter (fun q => q ∈ MStar T d η)) ⊆ MStar T d η := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Finset.mem_union] at hx
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · rw [Finset.mem_sdiff] at hx
      obtain ⟨hIcc, hnb⟩ := hx
      rw [mem_Bset] at hnb
      push_neg at hnb
      rw [mem_MStar]
      refine ⟨hIcc, ?_⟩
      by_cases hle : T < x + d x
      · exact Or.inl hle
      · exact Or.inr (le_of_lt (hnb hIcc (by omega)))
    · exact (Finset.mem_filter.1 hx).2
  have hbd2 : (∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ Bset T d η, η t)
      + (∑ q ∈ (Bset T d η).filter (fun q => q ∈ MStar T d η), η q)
      ≤ ∑ t ∈ MStar T d η, η t := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_union hUdisj]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hUsub (fun t _ _ => le_of_lt (hηpos t))
  rw [hsplit, mul_add]
  linarith

private lemma set_arith_adaptive (T K : ℕ) (d : ℕ → ℕ) (η : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hK : 0 < K) (hηpos : ∀ t, 0 < η t) :
    Real.exp 2 * (∑ q ∈ Bset T d η, (η q)^2 * (d q : ℝ))
      + (∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ Bset T d η, η t)
      ≤ 4 * Real.exp 2 * (K : ℝ) *
          (∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ MStar T d η, (η t)^2 * (d t : ℝ))
        + ∑ t ∈ MStar T d η, η t := by
  classical
  have hBsub : Bset T d η ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 T := Finset.filter_subset _ _
  have hcompl : (Bset T d η).filter (fun q => q ∉ MStar T d η)
      = (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ MStar T d η := by
    ext q
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_sdiff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hqB, hnm⟩
      exact ⟨hBsub hqB, hnm⟩
    · rintro ⟨hIcc, hnm⟩
      refine ⟨mem_Bset.2 ⟨hIcc, ?_, ?_⟩, hnm⟩
      · by_contra hc
        exact hnm (mem_MStar.2 ⟨hIcc, Or.inl (by omega)⟩)
      · by_contra hc
        push_neg at hc
        exact hnm (mem_MStar.2 ⟨hIcc, Or.inr (le_of_lt hc)⟩)
  have hsplit : ∑ q ∈ Bset T d η, (η q)^2 * (d q : ℝ)
      = (∑ q ∈ (Bset T d η).filter (fun q => q ∈ MStar T d η),
          (η q)^2 * (d q : ℝ))
        + ∑ q ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ MStar T d η, (η q)^2 * (d q : ℝ) := by
    rw [← hcompl]
    exact (Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (Bset T d η)
      (fun q => q ∈ MStar T d η) _).symm
  have hkey : ∀ q ∈ Bset T d η,
      Real.exp 2 * ((η q)^2 * (d q : ℝ)) ≤ η q := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨-, -, hdq⟩ := mem_Bset.1 hq
    have hp := hηpos q
    have he2 : (0 : ℝ) < Real.exp 2 := Real.exp_pos 2
    have heη : (0 : ℝ) < Real.exp 2 * η q := mul_pos he2 hp
    have h1 : (η q)^2 * (d q : ℝ)
        ≤ (η q)^2 * (1 / (Real.exp 2 * η q) - 1) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdq (sq_nonneg _)
    have h2 : (η q)^2 * (1 / (Real.exp 2 * η q) - 1)
        = η q / Real.exp 2 - (η q)^2 := by
      field_simp
    calc
      Real.exp 2 * ((η q)^2 * (d q : ℝ))
          ≤ Real.exp 2 * ((η q)^2 * (1 / (Real.exp 2 * η q) - 1)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 he2.le
      _ = η q - Real.exp 2 * (η q)^2 := by
        rw [h2]
        field_simp
      _ ≤ η q := by
        have hn : 0 ≤ Real.exp 2 * (η q)^2 :=
          mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos 2).le (sq_nonneg _)
        linarith
  have hbd1 : Real.exp 2 *
        (∑ q ∈ (Bset T d η).filter (fun q => q ∈ MStar T d η),
          (η q)^2 * (d q : ℝ))
      ≤ ∑ q ∈ (Bset T d η).filter (fun q => q ∈ MStar T d η), η q := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun q hq => hkey q (Finset.mem_filter.1 hq).1)
  have hUdisj : Disjoint ((Finset.Icc 1 T) \ Bset T d η)
      ((Bset T d η).filter (fun q => q ∈ MStar T d η)) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro x hx hx2
    rw [Finset.mem_sdiff] at hx
    exact hx.2 (Finset.mem_filter.1 hx2).1
  have hUsub : ((Finset.Icc 1 T) \ Bset T d η)
      ∪ ((Bset T d η).filter (fun q => q ∈ MStar T d η)) ⊆ MStar T d η := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Finset.mem_union] at hx
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · rw [Finset.mem_sdiff] at hx
      obtain ⟨hIcc, hnb⟩ := hx
      rw [mem_Bset] at hnb
      push_neg at hnb
      rw [mem_MStar]
      refine ⟨hIcc, ?_⟩
      by_cases hle : T < x + d x
      · exact Or.inl hle
      · exact Or.inr (le_of_lt (hnb hIcc (by omega)))
    · exact (Finset.mem_filter.1 hx).2
  have hbd2 : (∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ Bset T d η, η t)
      + (∑ q ∈ (Bset T d η).filter (fun q => q ∈ MStar T d η), η q)
      ≤ ∑ t ∈ MStar T d η, η t := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_union hUdisj]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hUsub
      (fun t _ _ => (hηpos t).le)
  have hgood0 : 0 ≤ ∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ MStar T d η,
      (η t)^2 * (d t : ℝ) := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun t _ => by positivity)
  have hK1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (K : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hK
  have hgood : Real.exp 2 *
        (∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ MStar T d η, (η t)^2 * (d t : ℝ))
      ≤ 4 * Real.exp 2 * (K : ℝ) *
        (∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ MStar T d η, (η t)^2 * (d t : ℝ)) := by
    have hcoef : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 4 * (K : ℝ) := by nlinarith
    have hnon : 0 ≤ Real.exp 2 *
        (∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ MStar T d η, (η t)^2 * (d t : ℝ)) :=
      mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos 2).le hgood0
    calc
      Real.exp 2 *
          (∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ MStar T d η, (η t)^2 * (d t : ℝ))
          = 1 * (Real.exp 2 *
              (∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ MStar T d η,
                (η t)^2 * (d t : ℝ))) := by ring
      _ ≤ (4 * (K : ℝ)) * (Real.exp 2 *
              (∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ MStar T d η,
                (η t)^2 * (d t : ℝ))) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoef hnon
      _ = 4 * Real.exp 2 * (K : ℝ) *
              (∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ MStar T d η,
                (η t)^2 * (d t : ℝ)) := by ring
  rw [hsplit, mul_add]
  linarith

end SetArith
