theorem lemma5_oblivious {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (K T : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K) (hT : 0 < T)
    (η : ℕ → ℝ) (l0 : ℕ → Fin K → ℝ) (d : ℕ → ℕ) (hd : ∀ t ≥ 1, 1 ≤ d t)
    (hη_pos : ∀ t, 0 < η t) (hη_dec : ∀ t, η (t + 1) ≤ η t)
    (hη_bound : ∀ t, η t ≤ (1 / 2) * Real.exp (-2))
    (hl : ∀ t i, l0 t i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (E : Exp3Delayed μ K hK (fun t _ i => l0 t i) d η (fun _ => 0))

    
    
    
    
    
    
    (a_fresh : ∀ t t' i, t ≤ t' → t' < t + d t →
      (μ[(fun ω => if E.a t ω = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0) |
          E.𝓕 t' ⊔ ⨆ s ∈ {s : ℕ | s + d s < t + d t ∨ (s + d s = t + d t ∧ s < t)},
            MeasurableSpace.comap (E.a s) inferInstance]) =ᵐ[μ] (fun ω => E.p t ω i)) :
    weightedExpReg μ T K hK η (fun t _ i => l0 t i) E.a ≤
      Real.log K + (Real.exp 2 / 2) * K * (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, (η t) ^ 2)
        + 4 * (∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ MStar T d η, (η t) ^ 2 * (d t : ℝ))
        + (∑ t ∈ MStar T d η, η t) := by
  classical
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin K) := ⟨⟨0, hK⟩⟩
  have hA : AlgOK (toAlg T d η (fun _ => 0) (fun t _ i => l0 t i) E) :=
    toAlg_ok T E hd hη_pos hη_dec hη_bound
      (fun t ω i => (hl t i).1) (fun t ω i => (hl t i).2) (fun _ => le_rfl)
  have hmle : ∀ q : ℕ, (E.𝓕 q ⊔ ⨆ s ∈ {s : ℕ | s + d s < q + d q ∨ (s + d s = q + d q ∧ s < q)},
      MeasurableSpace.comap (E.a s) inferInstance) ≤ (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace Ω) := by
    intro q
    refine sup_le (E.𝓕_le q) (iSup_le (fun s => iSup_le (fun _ => ?_)))
    exact measurable_iff_comap_le.1 (E.measurable_a s)
  have hMm : ∀ q ∈ bset (toAlg T d η (fun _ => 0) (fun t _ i => l0 t i) E),
      Mact (toAlg T d η (fun _ => 0) (fun t _ i => l0 t i) E)
          (kkey (toAlg T d η (fun _ => 0) (fun t _ i => l0 t i) E).T
            (toAlg T d η (fun _ => 0) (fun t _ i => l0 t i) E).d q)
        ≤ (E.𝓕 q ⊔ ⨆ s ∈ {s : ℕ | s + d s < q + d q ∨ (s + d s = q + d q ∧ s < q)},
            MeasurableSpace.comap (E.a s) inferInstance) := by
    intro q hq
    refine iSup_le (fun u => iSup_le (fun hu => ?_))
    obtain ⟨hub, huk⟩ := hu
    have huT : u ≤ T := bset_le_T hub
    have hqT : q ≤ T := bset_le_T hq
    have hcase : (u + d u < q + d q) ∨ (u + d u = q + d q ∧ u < q) :=
      (kkey_lt_iff (T := T) (d := d) huT hqT).1 huk
    exact le_sup_of_le_right (le_iSup_of_le u (le_iSup_of_le hcase le_rfl))
  have hcond : ∀ q ∈ bset (toAlg T d η (fun _ => 0) (fun t _ i => l0 t i) E), ∀ i,
      (μ[(fun ω => if E.a q ω = i then (1:ℝ) else 0) |
        (E.𝓕 q ⊔ ⨆ s ∈ {s : ℕ | s + d s < q + d q ∨ (s + d s = q + d q ∧ s < q)},
          MeasurableSpace.comap (E.a s) inferInstance)]) =ᵐ[μ] (fun ω => E.p q ω i) := by
    intro q hq i
    have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := (mem_bset.1 hq).1.1
    have hdq : 1 ≤ d q := hd q hq1
    exact a_fresh q q i le_rfl (by omega)
  obtain ⟨istar, -, hstar⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_inf' (Finset.univ_nonempty (α := Fin K))
      (fun i => ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t * l0 t i)
  have hmb := master_bound (toAlg T d η (fun _ => 0) (fun t _ i => l0 t i) E) hA l0
      (fun q ω i => rfl) (fun t => rfl) μ
      (fun q => E.𝓕 q ⊔ ⨆ s ∈ {s : ℕ | s + d s < q + d q ∨ (s + d s = q + d q ∧ s < q)},
        MeasurableSpace.comap (E.a s) inferInstance)
      hmle hMm E.measurable_a hcond istar
  simp only [toAlg_T, toAlg_eta, toAlg_a, toAlg_d, bset_toAlg] at hmb
  -- integrability of the realized loss
  have hLHSint : Integrable (fun ω => ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t * l0 t (E.a t ω)) μ := by
    refine (integrable_const (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t)).mono' ?_ ?_
    · refine (Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun t _ =>
        (Measurable.comp (measurable_of_countable (l0 t)) (E.measurable_a t)).const_mul _)).aestronglyMeasurable
    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg
        (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun t _ => mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hη_pos t)) (hl t _).1))]
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun t _ => ?_)
      nlinarith [hη_pos t, (hl t (E.a t ω)).2, (hl t (E.a t ω)).1]
  have hCeq : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin K)).inf' Finset.univ_nonempty
      (fun i => ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t * l0 t i)
      = ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t * l0 t istar := hstar
  have esub : ∫ ω, ((∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t * l0 t (E.a t ω))
        - (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t * l0 t istar)) ∂μ
      = (∫ ω, (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t * l0 t (E.a t ω)) ∂μ)
        - (∫ _ω : Ω, (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t * l0 t istar) ∂μ) :=
    integral_sub hLHSint (integrable_const _)
  have econst : (∫ _ω : Ω, (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t * l0 t istar) ∂μ)
      = ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t * l0 t istar := by simp
  have hval : weightedExpReg μ T K hK η (fun t _ i => l0 t i) E.a
      = (∫ ω, (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t * l0 t (E.a t ω)) ∂μ)
        - (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t * l0 t istar) := by
    show (∫ ω, ((∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t * l0 t (E.a t ω))
      - (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin K)).inf' Finset.univ_nonempty
        (fun i => ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t * l0 t i)) ∂μ) = _
    rw [hCeq, esub, econst]
  rw [hval]
  have hsa := set_arith T d η hη_pos
  linarith

lemma inf'_const_mul {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (H : s.Nonempty) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (f : ι → ℝ) : s.inf' H (fun i => c * f i) = c * s.inf' H f := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · obtain ⟨j, hj, hje⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_inf' H f
    rw [hje]
    exact Finset.inf'_le (fun i => c * f i) hj
  · exact Finset.le_inf' H _ (fun i hi => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Finset.inf'_le f hi) hc)

lemma weightedExpReg_const {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) (T K : ℕ)
    (hK : 0 < K) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (l0 : ℕ → Fin K → ℝ) (a : ℕ → Ω → Fin K) :
    weightedExpReg μ T K hK (fun _ => c) (fun t _ i => l0 t i) a
      = c * expReg μ T K hK l0 a := by
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin K) := ⟨⟨0, hK⟩⟩
  show (∫ ω, ((∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, c * l0 t (a t ω))
      - (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin K)).inf' Finset.univ_nonempty
          (fun i => ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, c * l0 t i)) ∂μ)
    = c * ∫ ω, ((∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, (1:ℝ) * l0 t (a t ω))
      - (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin K)).inf' Finset.univ_nonempty
          (fun i => ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, (1:ℝ) * l0 t i)) ∂μ
  rw [← integral_const_mul]
  refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => ?_))
  dsimp only
  have h1 : ∀ i : Fin K, (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, c * l0 t i)
      = c * ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, (1:ℝ) * l0 t i := by
    intro i
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun t _ => by ring)
  have h2 : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin K)).inf' Finset.univ_nonempty
      (fun i => ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, c * l0 t i)
      = c * (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin K)).inf' Finset.univ_nonempty
          (fun i => ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, (1:ℝ) * l0 t i) := by
    have hf : (fun i => ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, c * l0 t i)
        = (fun i => c * ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, (1:ℝ) * l0 t i) := funext h1
    rw [hf, inf'_const_mul _ _ c hc]
  have h3 : (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, c * l0 t (a t ω))
      = c * ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, (1:ℝ) * l0 t (a t ω) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun t _ => by ring)
  rw [h2, h3]
  ring

section AdaptiveScalar

/-- `z/(1+z) ≤ log (1+z)` for `z ≥ 0`. -/
lemma log_one_add_ge' (z : ℝ) (hz : 0 ≤ z) : z / (1 + z) ≤ Real.log (1 + z) := by
  have h1 : (0:ℝ) < 1 + z := by linarith
  have h2 : Real.log (1/(1+z)) ≤ 1/(1+z) - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by positivity)
  rw [Real.log_div one_ne_zero (ne_of_gt h1), Real.log_one] at h2
  have h3 : (1:ℝ)/(1+z) - 1 = -(z/(1+z)) := by field_simp; ring
  rw [h3] at h2
  linarith

/-- `x * log (1+y) ≤ log (1 + x*y)` for `x ∈ [0,1]`, `y ≥ 0`. -/
lemma mul_log_one_add_le (x y : ℝ) (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    x * Real.log (1 + y) ≤ Real.log (1 + x * y) := by
  have hcc := (strictConcaveOn_log_Ioi).concaveOn
  have h1 : (1 + y) ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) := by simp only [Set.mem_Ioi]; linarith
  have h2 : (1:ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) := by simp
  have hres := hcc.2 h1 h2 hx0 (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - x) (by ring)
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, Real.log_one, mul_zero, add_zero, mul_one] at hres
  have heq : x * (1+y) + (1-x) = 1 + x*y := by ring
  rw [heq] at hres
  exact hres

/-- The key scalar inequality behind Neu's implicit-exploration bound. -/
lemma exp_ltil_scalar {a g l p : ℝ} (hg : 0 < g) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hag : a ≤ g)
    (hl0 : 0 ≤ l) (hl1 : l ≤ 1) (hp : 0 < p) :
    Real.exp (a * l / (p + g)) ≤ 1 + a * l / p := by
  have hpgl : 0 < p + g * l := by nlinarith
  have hx0 : 0 ≤ a / g := by positivity
  have hx1 : a / g ≤ 1 := by rw [div_le_one hg]; exact hag
  have hz0 : 0 ≤ g * l / p := by positivity
  have h1z : (0:ℝ) < 1 + g * l / p := by linarith
  have hxz : (a/g) * (g*l/p) = a * l / p := by field_simp
  have hzz : (a/g) * ((g*l/p) / (1 + g*l/p)) = a * l / (p + g * l) := by
    rw [eq_div_iff (ne_of_gt hpgl)]
    field_simp
  have step1 : a * l / (p + g) ≤ (a/g) * ((g*l/p) / (1 + g*l/p)) := by
    rw [hzz]
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) hpgl
    nlinarith
  have step2 : (a/g) * ((g*l/p) / (1 + g*l/p)) ≤ (a/g) * Real.log (1 + g*l/p) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (log_one_add_ge' _ hz0) hx0
  have step3 : (a/g) * Real.log (1 + g*l/p) ≤ Real.log (1 + a*l/p) := by
    have h := mul_log_one_add_le (a/g) (g*l/p) hx0 hx1 hz0
    rwa [hxz] at h
  have hfin : a * l / (p+g) ≤ Real.log (1 + a*l/p) := by linarith
  have hpos : (0:ℝ) < 1 + a*l/p := by positivity
  calc Real.exp (a * l / (p+g)) ≤ Real.exp (Real.log (1 + a*l/p)) := Real.exp_le_exp.2 hfin
    _ = 1 + a*l/p := Real.exp_log hpos

end AdaptiveScalar

section AdaptiveMeas

variable {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {K : ℕ} {A : AlgData Ω K}

/-- The plain (exploration-free) importance-weighted estimator. -/
noncomputable def lhat (A : AlgData Ω K) (q : ℕ) (ω : Ω) (i : Fin K) : ℝ :=
  A.l q ω i * (if A.a q ω = i then (1:ℝ) else 0) / A.p q ω i

lemma sum_alpha_ltil (A : AlgData Ω K) (α : Fin K → ℝ) (q : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    ∑ i, α i * ltil A q ω i
      = α (A.a q ω) * A.l q ω (A.a q ω) / (A.p q ω (A.a q ω) + A.γ q) := by
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (A.a q ω)]
  · unfold ltil; rw [if_pos rfl]; ring
  · intro b _ hb; unfold ltil; rw [if_neg (Ne.symm hb)]; ring
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h

lemma sum_alpha_lhat (A : AlgData Ω K) (α : Fin K → ℝ) (q : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    ∑ i, α i * lhat A q ω i
      = α (A.a q ω) * A.l q ω (A.a q ω) / A.p q ω (A.a q ω) := by
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (A.a q ω)]
  · unfold lhat; rw [if_pos rfl]; ring
  · intro b _ hb; unfold lhat; rw [if_neg (Ne.symm hb)]; ring
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h

lemma lhat_nonneg (hA : AlgOK A) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ bset A) (ω : Ω) (i : Fin K) :
    0 ≤ lhat A q ω i := by
  unfold lhat
  refine div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hA.hl0 _ _ _) (by positivity)) ?_
  exact le_of_lt (hA.p_pos_bset hq ω i)

/-- Pathwise exponential bound: the heart of Neu's implicit-exploration argument. -/
lemma exp_sum_alpha_ltil_le (hA : AlgOK A) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ bset A) (ω : Ω)
    (α : Fin K → ℝ) (hα0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ α i) (hαγ : ∀ i, α i ≤ A.γ q) (hγ : 0 < A.γ q) :
    Real.exp (∑ i, α i * ltil A q ω i) ≤ 1 + ∑ i, α i * lhat A q ω i := by
  rw [sum_alpha_ltil, sum_alpha_lhat]
  exact exp_ltil_scalar hγ (hα0 _) (hαγ _) (hA.hl0 _ _ _) (hA.hl1 _ _ _)
    (hA.p_pos_bset hq ω _)

/-- `p t` is measurable with respect to an "action filtration". -/
lemma p_meas_filt (hA : AlgOK A) (G : ℕ → MeasurableSpace Ω) (hGmono : Monotone G)
    (hGa : ∀ u t : ℕ, 1 ≤ u → u < t → MeasurableSpace.comap (A.a u) inferInstance ≤ G t)
    (hGl : ∀ q i, Measurable[G q] (fun ω => A.l q ω i)) :
    ∀ t : ℕ, 1 ≤ t → t ≤ A.T + 1 → ∀ i, Measurable[G t] (fun ω => A.p t ω i) := by
  intro t
  induction t using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ t IH =>
    intro ht1 ht2 i
    have hGG : ∀ j, Measurable[G t] (fun ω => GG A (t*(A.T+1)) ω j) := by
      intro j
      unfold GG
      refine Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun q hq => ?_)
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hq
      obtain ⟨hqb, hqk⟩ := hq
      have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := (mem_bset.1 hqb).1.1
      have hqT : q ≤ A.T := bset_le_T hqb
      have hqlt : q < t := by
        by_contra hc
        push_neg at hc
        have h1 : t * (A.T+1) ≤ q * (A.T+1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hc
        have h2 : q * (A.T+1) ≤ (q + A.d q)*(A.T+1) :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
        have h3 : (q + A.d q)*(A.T+1) ≤ kkey A.T A.d q := by
          show (q + A.d q)*(A.T+1) ≤ (q + A.d q)*(A.T+1) + q
          omega
        exact absurd hqk (not_lt.2 (h1.trans (h2.trans h3)))
      refine Measurable.const_mul ?_ _
      exact AlgOK.ltil_meas A (G t) (measurable_iff_comap_le.2 (hGa q t hq1 hqlt))
        (fun j' => (IH q hqlt hq1 (by omega) j').mono (hGmono (le_of_lt hqlt)) le_rfl)
        (fun j' => (hGl q j').mono (hGmono (le_of_lt hqlt)) le_rfl) j
    have hpe : (fun ω => A.p t ω i) = fun ω => sfm (GG A (t*(A.T+1)) ω) i :=
      funext (fun ω => hA.hp t ω i ht1 ht2)
    rw [hpe]
    unfold sfm
    exact ((hGG i).neg.exp).div (Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun j _ => (hGG j).neg.exp))

lemma ltil_meas_filt (hA : AlgOK A) (G : ℕ → MeasurableSpace Ω) (hGmono : Monotone G)
    (hGa : ∀ u t : ℕ, 1 ≤ u → u < t → MeasurableSpace.comap (A.a u) inferInstance ≤ G t)
    (hGl : ∀ q i, Measurable[G q] (fun ω => A.l q ω i))
    {q n : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ bset A) (hqn : q < n) (i : Fin K) :
    Measurable[G n] (fun ω => ltil A q ω i) := by
  have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := (mem_bset.1 hq).1.1
  have hqT : q ≤ A.T := bset_le_T hq
  exact AlgOK.ltil_meas A (G n) (measurable_iff_comap_le.2 (hGa q n hq1 hqn))
    (fun j => (p_meas_filt hA G hGmono hGa hGl q hq1 (by omega) j).mono
      (hGmono (le_of_lt hqn)) le_rfl)
    (fun j => (hGl q j).mono (hGmono (le_of_lt hqn)) le_rfl) i

lemma ltil_le_inv_gamma (hA : AlgOK A) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ bset A) (hγ : 0 < A.γ q)
    (ω : Ω) (i : Fin K) : ltil A q ω i ≤ 1 / A.γ q := by
  unfold ltil
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (hA.pg_pos hq ω i) hγ]
  have h1 : A.l q ω i * (if A.a q ω = i then (1:ℝ) else 0) ≤ 1 := by
    by_cases h : A.a q ω = i
    · rw [if_pos h, mul_one]; exact hA.hl1 _ _ _
    · rw [if_neg h]; simp
  have h2 : 0 ≤ A.p q ω i := le_of_lt (hA.p_pos_bset hq ω i)
  nlinarith

end AdaptiveMeas
section AdaptiveMGF

variable {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {K : ℕ} {A : AlgData Ω K}

/-- Partial exponent: the sum of the centred estimator increments over the rounds
`q ∈ bset A` with `q < n`. -/
noncomputable def Phi (A : AlgData Ω K) (α : ℕ → Fin K → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : ℝ :=
  ∑ q ∈ (bset A).filter (fun q => q < n), ∑ i, α q i * (ltil A q ω i - A.l q ω i)

lemma Phi_meas (hA : AlgOK A) (G : ℕ → MeasurableSpace Ω) (hGmono : Monotone G)
    (hGa : ∀ u t : ℕ, 1 ≤ u → u < t → MeasurableSpace.comap (A.a u) inferInstance ≤ G t)
    (hGl : ∀ q i, Measurable[G q] (fun ω => A.l q ω i))
    (α : ℕ → Fin K → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : Measurable[G n] (Phi A α n) := by
  unfold Phi
  refine Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun q hq => ?_)
  rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hq
  refine Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun i _ => ?_)
  refine Measurable.const_mul (Measurable.sub ?_ ?_) _
  · exact ltil_meas_filt hA G hGmono hGa hGl hq.1 hq.2 i
  · exact (hGl q i).mono (hGmono (le_of_lt hq.2)) le_rfl

lemma Phi_le (hA : AlgOK A) (hγpos : ∀ q, 0 < A.γ q) (α : ℕ → Fin K → ℝ)
    (hα0 : ∀ q i, 0 ≤ α q i) (hαγ : ∀ q i, α q i ≤ A.γ q) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    Phi A α n ω ≤ ((bset A).card : ℝ) * (K : ℝ) := by
  unfold Phi
  have hterm : ∀ q ∈ (bset A).filter (fun q => q < n),
      ∑ i, α q i * (ltil A q ω i - A.l q ω i) ≤ (K : ℝ) := by
    intro q hq
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hq
    have hqb := hq.1
    have hg := hγpos q
    have hinv : A.γ q * (1 / A.γ q) = 1 := by field_simp
    have hstep : ∀ i : Fin K, α q i * (ltil A q ω i - A.l q ω i) ≤ 1 := by
      intro i
      have h1 : 0 ≤ ltil A q ω i := hA.ltil_nonneg hqb ω i
      have h2 : ltil A q ω i ≤ 1 / A.γ q := ltil_le_inv_gamma hA hqb hg ω i
      have h3 : 0 ≤ A.l q ω i := hA.hl0 _ _ _
      nlinarith [hα0 q i, hαγ q i]
    calc ∑ i, α q i * (ltil A q ω i - A.l q ω i) ≤ ∑ _i : Fin K, (1:ℝ) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hstep i)
      _ = (K : ℝ) := by simp
  calc ∑ q ∈ (bset A).filter (fun q => q < n), ∑ i, α q i * (ltil A q ω i - A.l q ω i)
      ≤ ∑ _q ∈ (bset A).filter (fun q => q < n), (K:ℝ) := Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
    _ = (((bset A).filter (fun q => q < n)).card : ℝ) * (K:ℝ) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    _ ≤ ((bset A).card : ℝ) * (K:ℝ) := by
        have : (((bset A).filter (fun q => q < n)).card : ℝ) ≤ ((bset A).card : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast Finset.card_filter_le _ _
        have hK0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (K:ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right this hK0

/-- The exponential supermartingale bound (Neu's lemma), in integral form. -/
lemma mgf_le_one (hA : AlgOK A) (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (G : ℕ → MeasurableSpace Ω) (hGle : ∀ t, G t ≤ mΩ) (hGmono : Monotone G)
    (hGa : ∀ u t : ℕ, 1 ≤ u → u < t → MeasurableSpace.comap (A.a u) inferInstance ≤ G t)
    (hGl : ∀ q i, Measurable[G q] (fun ω => A.l q ω i))
    (ha : ∀ q, Measurable (A.a q))
    (hcond : ∀ q ∈ bset A, ∀ i,
       (μ[(fun ω => if A.a q ω = i then (1:ℝ) else 0) | G q]) =ᵐ[μ] (fun ω => A.p q ω i))
    (hγpos : ∀ q, 0 < A.γ q)
    (α : ℕ → Fin K → ℝ) (hα0 : ∀ q i, 0 ≤ α q i) (hαγ : ∀ q i, α q i ≤ A.γ q) :
    ∀ n, ∫ ω, Real.exp (Phi A α n ω) ∂μ ≤ 1 := by
  classical
  set UB : ℝ := ((bset A).card : ℝ) * (K : ℝ) with hUB
  have hPhiM : ∀ m, Measurable (Phi A α m) := fun m =>
    (Phi_meas hA G hGmono hGa hGl α m).mono (hGle m) le_rfl
  have hPhiB : ∀ m ω, Phi A α m ω ≤ UB := fun m ω => Phi_le hA hγpos α hα0 hαγ m ω
  have hexpint : ∀ m, Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (Phi A α m ω)) μ := by
    intro m
    refine (integrable_const (Real.exp UB)).mono' (hPhiM m).exp.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => ?_))
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _))]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.2 (hPhiB m ω)
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      have h0 : ∀ ω, Real.exp (Phi A α 0 ω) = 1 := by
        intro ω
        unfold Phi
        rw [Finset.filter_false_of_mem (fun x _ => by omega), Finset.sum_empty, Real.exp_zero]
      simp only [h0]
      simp
  | succ n ih =>
      by_cases hn : n ∈ bset A
      · -- the substantial step
        have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := (mem_bset.1 hn).1.1
        have hnT : n ≤ A.T := bset_le_T hn
        have hnotmem : n ∉ (bset A).filter (fun q => q < n) := by simp
        have hsplit : (bset A).filter (fun q => q < n+1)
            = insert n ((bset A).filter (fun q => q < n)) := by
          ext x
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_insert]
          constructor
          · rintro ⟨hx, hlt⟩
            rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.1 hlt with h | h
            · exact Or.inr ⟨hx, h⟩
            · exact Or.inl h
          · rintro (rfl | ⟨hx, hlt⟩)
            · exact ⟨hn, Nat.lt_succ_self _⟩
            · exact ⟨hx, by omega⟩
        have hPhirec : ∀ ω, Phi A α (n+1) ω
            = Phi A α n ω + ∑ i, α n i * (ltil A n ω i - A.l n ω i) := by
          intro ω
          unfold Phi
          rw [hsplit, Finset.sum_insert hnotmem]
          ring
        -- the G n-measurable prefactor
        set Lsum : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => ∑ i, α n i * A.l n ω i with hLsum
        set F : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => Real.exp (Phi A α n ω) * Real.exp (- Lsum ω) with hFdef
        have hL0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ Lsum ω := fun ω =>
          Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hα0 n i) (hA.hl0 _ _ _))
        have hLmeasG : Measurable[G n] Lsum :=
          Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun i _ => (hGl n i).const_mul _)
        have hFmeasG : Measurable[G n] F :=
          ((Phi_meas hA G hGmono hGa hGl α n).exp).mul (hLmeasG.neg.exp)
        have hFmeas : Measurable F := hFmeasG.mono (hGle n) le_rfl
        have hF0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ F ω := fun ω => by
          simp only [hFdef]; positivity
        have hFb : ∀ ω, F ω ≤ Real.exp UB := by
          intro ω
          have h1 : Real.exp (Phi A α n ω) ≤ Real.exp UB := Real.exp_le_exp.2 (hPhiB n ω)
          have h2 : Real.exp (- Lsum ω) ≤ 1 := by
            rw [Real.exp_le_one_iff]; linarith [hL0 ω]
          have h3 : (0:ℝ) < Real.exp (- Lsum ω) := Real.exp_pos _
          calc F ω = Real.exp (Phi A α n ω) * Real.exp (- Lsum ω) := rfl
            _ ≤ Real.exp UB * Real.exp (- Lsum ω) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (le_of_lt h3)
            _ ≤ Real.exp UB * 1 := by
                exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _))
            _ = Real.exp UB := by ring
        have hFint : Integrable F μ := by
          refine (integrable_const (Real.exp UB)).mono' hFmeas.aestronglyMeasurable
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => ?_))
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hF0 ω)]
          exact hFb ω
        -- p is measurable for G n
        have hpn : ∀ i, Measurable[G n] (fun ω => A.p n ω i) :=
          fun i => p_meas_filt hA G hGmono hGa hGl n hn1 (by omega) i
        have hppos : ∀ ω i, 0 < A.p n ω i := fun ω i => hA.p_pos_bset hn ω i
        have hg0 : ∀ (i : Fin K) (ω : Ω), (0:ℝ) ≤ (if A.a n ω = i then (1:ℝ) else 0) := by
          intro i ω; split <;> norm_num
        have hgb : ∀ (i : Fin K) (ω : Ω), (if A.a n ω = i then (1:ℝ) else 0) ≤ 1 := by
          intro i ω; split <;> norm_num
        have hFl0 : ∀ (i : Fin K) (ω : Ω), 0 ≤ F ω * A.l n ω i :=
          fun i ω => mul_nonneg (hF0 ω) (hA.hl0 _ _ _)
        have hFlint : ∀ i : Fin K, Integrable (fun ω => F ω * A.l n ω i) μ := by
          intro i
          refine (integrable_const (Real.exp UB)).mono'
            (hFmeas.mul ((hGl n i).mono (hGle n) le_rfl)).aestronglyMeasurable
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => ?_))
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hFl0 i ω)]
          nlinarith [hFb ω, hF0 ω, hA.hl0 n ω i, hA.hl1 n ω i, Real.exp_pos UB]
        -- unbiasedness for each arm
        have hunb : ∀ i : Fin K,
            Integrable (fun ω => F ω * lhat A n ω i) μ ∧
            ∫ ω, F ω * lhat A n ω i ∂μ = ∫ ω, F ω * A.l n ω i ∂μ := by
          intro i
          have hfg : (fun ω => (F ω * A.l n ω i / A.p n ω i)
              * (if A.a n ω = i then (1:ℝ) else 0)) = fun ω => F ω * lhat A n ω i := by
            funext ω
            simp only [lhat]
            field_simp
          have hfh : (fun ω => (F ω * A.l n ω i / A.p n ω i) * A.p n ω i)
              = fun ω => F ω * A.l n ω i := by
            funext ω
            rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt (hppos ω i))]
          have hres := @cond_pull Ω (G n) mΩ (hGle n) μ _
            (fun ω => F ω * A.l n ω i / A.p n ω i)
            (fun ω => if A.a n ω = i then (1:ℝ) else 0)
            (fun ω => A.p n ω i)
            ((hFmeasG.mul (hGl n i)).div (hpn i))
            (fun ω => div_nonneg (hFl0 i ω) (le_of_lt (hppos ω i)))
            (by
              have hs : MeasurableSet[mΩ] {ω | A.a n ω = i} := ha n (measurableSet_singleton i)
              exact @Measurable.ite Ω ℝ _ _ mΩ _ _ _ hs measurable_const measurable_const)
            (hg0 i) (hgb i)
            (hpn i) (fun ω => le_of_lt (hppos ω i)) (hcond n hn i)
            (by rw [hfh]; exact hFlint i)
          rw [hfg, hfh] at hres
          exact hres
        -- pathwise bound
        have hpath : ∀ ω, Real.exp (Phi A α (n+1) ω)
            ≤ F ω + ∑ i, α n i * (F ω * lhat A n ω i) := by
          intro ω
          have hsum : ∑ i, α n i * (ltil A n ω i - A.l n ω i)
              = (∑ i, α n i * ltil A n ω i) - Lsum ω := by
            simp only [hLsum]
            rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
            exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
          have he : Real.exp (Phi A α (n+1) ω)
              = F ω * Real.exp (∑ i, α n i * ltil A n ω i) := by
            rw [hPhirec ω, hsum, hFdef]
            simp only
            rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]
            congr 1
            ring
          have hb := exp_sum_alpha_ltil_le hA hn ω (α n) (fun i => hα0 n i)
            (fun i => hαγ n i) (hγpos n)
          have h1 : F ω * Real.exp (∑ i, α n i * ltil A n ω i)
              ≤ F ω * (1 + ∑ i, α n i * lhat A n ω i) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (hF0 ω)
          have h2 : F ω * (1 + ∑ i, α n i * lhat A n ω i)
              = F ω + ∑ i, α n i * (F ω * lhat A n ω i) := by
            rw [mul_add, mul_one, Finset.mul_sum]
            congr 1
            exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
          rw [he]
          linarith
        -- integrate
        have hsumint : Integrable (fun ω => ∑ i, α n i * (F ω * lhat A n ω i)) μ :=
          integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => ((hunb i).1).const_mul _)
        have hRHSint : Integrable (fun ω => F ω + ∑ i, α n i * (F ω * lhat A n ω i)) μ :=
          hFint.add hsumint
        have hmain := integral_mono (hexpint (n+1)) hRHSint hpath
        have hval : ∫ ω, (F ω + ∑ i, α n i * (F ω * lhat A n ω i)) ∂μ
            = (∫ ω, F ω ∂μ) + ∑ i, α n i * ∫ ω, F ω * A.l n ω i ∂μ := by
          rw [integral_add hFint hsumint]
          congr 1
          rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => ((hunb i).1).const_mul _)]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by rw [integral_const_mul, (hunb i).2])
        have e1 : (fun ω => F ω * (1 + Lsum ω))
            = fun ω => F ω + ∑ i, α n i * (F ω * A.l n ω i) := by
          funext ω
          simp only [hLsum]
          rw [mul_add, mul_one, Finset.mul_sum]
          congr 1
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
        have hsumint2 : Integrable (fun ω => ∑ i, α n i * (F ω * A.l n ω i)) μ :=
          integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => ((hFlint i)).const_mul _)
        have hFLint : Integrable (fun ω => F ω * (1 + Lsum ω)) μ := by
          rw [e1]; exact hFint.add hsumint2
        have hval2 : (∫ ω, F ω ∂μ) + ∑ i, α n i * ∫ ω, F ω * A.l n ω i ∂μ
            = ∫ ω, (F ω * (1 + Lsum ω)) ∂μ := by
          rw [e1, integral_add hFint hsumint2]
          congr 1
          rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => ((hFlint i)).const_mul _)]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by rw [integral_const_mul])
        have hfinpt : ∀ ω, F ω * (1 + Lsum ω) ≤ Real.exp (Phi A α n ω) := by
          intro ω
          have h1 : 1 + Lsum ω ≤ Real.exp (Lsum ω) := by
            linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (Lsum ω)]
          have h2 : F ω * (1 + Lsum ω) ≤ F ω * Real.exp (Lsum ω) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (hF0 ω)
          have h3 : F ω * Real.exp (Lsum ω) = Real.exp (Phi A α n ω) := by
            simp only [hFdef]
            rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
            simp
          linarith
        have hfin := integral_mono hFLint (hexpint n) hfinpt
        linarith
      · -- vacuous step
        have hfe : (bset A).filter (fun q => q < n+1) = (bset A).filter (fun q => q < n) := by
          apply Finset.filter_congr
          intro x hx
          constructor
          · intro h
            rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.1 h with h' | h'
            · exact h'
            · exact absurd (h' ▸ hx) hn
          · intro h; omega
        have : ∀ ω, Phi A α (n+1) ω = Phi A α n ω := by
          intro ω; unfold Phi; rw [hfe]
        simp only [this]
        exact ih

end AdaptiveMGF
section AdaptiveExpect

variable {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {K : ℕ} {A : AlgData Ω K}

/-- Bundled hypotheses: `G` is the filtration generated by the past actions, the losses are
predictable for it, and the action at round `q` has conditional law `p q` given `G q`. -/
structure ActFilt (A : AlgData Ω K) (μ : Measure Ω) (G : ℕ → MeasurableSpace Ω) : Prop where
  le : ∀ t, G t ≤ mΩ
  mono' : Monotone G
  act : ∀ u t : ℕ, 1 ≤ u → u < t → MeasurableSpace.comap (A.a u) inferInstance ≤ G t
  loss : ∀ q i, Measurable[G q] (fun ω => A.l q ω i)
  meas_a : ∀ q, Measurable (A.a q)
  cond : ∀ q i,
    (μ[(fun ω => if A.a q ω = i then (1:ℝ) else 0) | G q]) =ᵐ[μ] (fun ω => A.p q ω i)

variable {μ : Measure Ω} {G : ℕ → MeasurableSpace Ω}

lemma ltil_meas_top (hA : AlgOK A) (hF : ActFilt A μ G) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ bset A) (i : Fin K) :
    Measurable (fun ω => ltil A q ω i) :=
  (ltil_meas_filt hA G hF.mono' hF.act hF.loss hq (Nat.lt_succ_self q) i).mono
    (hF.le (q+1)) le_rfl

lemma l_meas_top (hF : ActFilt A μ G) (q : ℕ) (i : Fin K) :
    Measurable (fun ω => A.l q ω i) := (hF.loss q i).mono (hF.le q) le_rfl

lemma l_int (hA : AlgOK A) (hF : ActFilt A μ G) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (q : ℕ) (i : Fin K) :
    Integrable (fun ω => A.l q ω i) μ := by
  refine (integrable_const (1:ℝ)).mono' (l_meas_top hF q i).aestronglyMeasurable
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => ?_))
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hA.hl0 _ _ _)]
  exact hA.hl1 _ _ _

lemma l_int_le (hA : AlgOK A) (hF : ActFilt A μ G) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (q : ℕ) (i : Fin K) :
    ∫ ω, A.l q ω i ∂μ ≤ 1 := by
  have h := integral_mono (l_int hA hF q i) (integrable_const (1:ℝ))
    (fun ω => hA.hl1 q ω i)
  simpa using h

/-- The estimator is unbiased-from-above: its integral is at most that of the true loss. -/
lemma int_ltil_le (hA : AlgOK A) (hF : ActFilt A μ G) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hγpos : ∀ q, 0 < A.γ q) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ bset A) (i : Fin K) :
    Integrable (fun ω => ltil A q ω i) μ ∧ ∫ ω, ltil A q ω i ∂μ ≤ ∫ ω, A.l q ω i ∂μ := by
  have hppos : ∀ ω, 0 < A.p q ω i := fun ω => hA.p_pos_bset hq ω i
  have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := (mem_bset.1 hq).1.1
  have hqT : q ≤ A.T := bset_le_T hq
  have hpq : Measurable[G q] (fun ω => A.p q ω i) :=
    p_meas_filt hA G hF.mono' hF.act hF.loss q hq1 (by omega) i
  have hg0 : ∀ ω, (0:ℝ) ≤ (if A.a q ω = i then (1:ℝ) else 0) := by intro ω; split <;> norm_num
  have hgb : ∀ ω, (if A.a q ω = i then (1:ℝ) else 0) ≤ 1 := by intro ω; split <;> norm_num
  have hfg : (fun ω => (A.l q ω i / A.p q ω i) * (if A.a q ω = i then (1:ℝ) else 0))
      = fun ω => lhat A q ω i := by
    funext ω; simp only [lhat]; field_simp
  have hfh : (fun ω => (A.l q ω i / A.p q ω i) * A.p q ω i) = fun ω => A.l q ω i := by
    funext ω; rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt (hppos ω))]
  have hres := @cond_pull Ω (G q) mΩ (hF.le q) μ _
    (fun ω => A.l q ω i / A.p q ω i)
    (fun ω => if A.a q ω = i then (1:ℝ) else 0)
    (fun ω => A.p q ω i)
    ((hF.loss q i).div hpq)
    (fun ω => div_nonneg (hA.hl0 _ _ _) (le_of_lt (hppos ω)))
    (by
      have hs : MeasurableSet[mΩ] {ω | A.a q ω = i} := hF.meas_a q (measurableSet_singleton i)
      exact @Measurable.ite Ω ℝ _ _ mΩ _ _ _ hs measurable_const measurable_const)
    hg0 hgb hpq (fun ω => le_of_lt (hppos ω)) (hF.cond q i)
    (by rw [hfh]; exact l_int hA hF q i)
  rw [hfg, hfh] at hres
  have hltilint : Integrable (fun ω => ltil A q ω i) μ := by
    refine (integrable_const (1 / A.γ q)).mono'
      (ltil_meas_top hA hF hq i).aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => ?_))
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hA.ltil_nonneg hq ω i)]
    exact ltil_le_inv_gamma hA hq (hγpos q) ω i
  refine ⟨hltilint, ?_⟩
  have hle : ∀ ω, ltil A q ω i ≤ lhat A q ω i := by
    intro ω
    unfold ltil lhat
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left _ (hppos ω) _
    · exact mul_nonneg (hA.hl0 _ _ _) (hg0 ω)
    · linarith [hA.hγ q]
  calc ∫ ω, ltil A q ω i ∂μ ≤ ∫ ω, lhat A q ω i ∂μ :=
        integral_mono hltilint hres.1 hle
    _ = ∫ ω, A.l q ω i ∂μ := hres.2

lemma int_sum_ltil_le (hA : AlgOK A) (hF : ActFilt A μ G) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hγpos : ∀ q, 0 < A.γ q) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ bset A) :
    Integrable (fun ω => ∑ i, ltil A q ω i) μ ∧
      ∫ ω, (∑ i, ltil A q ω i) ∂μ ≤ (K : ℝ) := by
  refine ⟨integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => (int_ltil_le hA hF hγpos hq i).1), ?_⟩
  rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => (int_ltil_le hA hF hγpos hq i).1)]
  calc ∑ i, ∫ ω, ltil A q ω i ∂μ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin K, (1:ℝ) := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => ?_)
        exact le_trans (int_ltil_le hA hF hγpos hq i).2 (l_int_le hA hF q i)
    _ = (K:ℝ) := by simp

/-- The total-variation of one softmax update is at most `2 e² η`. -/
lemma dpos_le_eta (hA : AlgOK A) {r : ℕ} (hr : r ∈ bset A) (ω : Ω) (i : Fin K) :
    dpos A r ω i ≤ 2 * Real.exp 2 * A.η r := by
  have h1 : ∑ j, dpos A r ω j ≤ 2 * A.η r * ∑ j, PP A (kkey A.T A.d r) ω j * ltil A r ω j :=
    hA.dpos_sum_le ω hr
  have h2 : ∑ j, PP A (kkey A.T A.d r) ω j * ltil A r ω j ≤ Real.exp 2 :=
    hA.sum_PP_ltil_le ω _ hr (fun j => hA.key_ratio ω r hr j)
  have h3 : dpos A r ω i ≤ ∑ j, dpos A r ω j :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => AlgOK.dpos_nonneg A r ω j) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have h4 : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * A.η r := by linarith [hA.hηpos r]
  nlinarith

end AdaptiveExpect
section AdaptiveMaster

variable {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {K : ℕ} {A : AlgData Ω K}
variable {μ : Measure Ω} {G : ℕ → MeasurableSpace Ω}

/-- The centred estimator sum for a fixed arm. -/
noncomputable def Xj (A : AlgData Ω K) (j : Fin K) (ω : Ω) : ℝ :=
  ∑ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * (ltil A q ω j - A.l q ω j)

/-- Log-sum-exp majorant of `max_j Xj`. -/
noncomputable def Vfun (A : AlgData Ω K) (ω : Ω) : ℝ :=
  Real.log (∑ j, Real.exp (Xj A j ω))

lemma Phi_eq_Xj (A : AlgData Ω K) (j : Fin K) (ω : Ω) :
    Phi A (fun q i => if i = j then A.η q else 0) (A.T+1) ω = Xj A j ω := by
  unfold Phi Xj
  have hfe : (bset A).filter (fun q => q < A.T + 1) = bset A := by
    apply Finset.filter_true_of_mem
    intro x hx
    have := bset_le_T hx
    omega
  rw [hfe]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun q _ => ?_)
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hb; simp [hb]
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h

lemma Phi_ge (hA : AlgOK A) (α : ℕ → Fin K → ℝ)
    (hα0 : ∀ q i, 0 ≤ α q i) (hα1 : ∀ q i, α q i ≤ 1) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    -(((bset A).card : ℝ) * (K : ℝ)) ≤ Phi A α n ω := by
  unfold Phi
  have hterm : ∀ q ∈ (bset A).filter (fun q => q < n),
      -(K:ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, α q i * (ltil A q ω i - A.l q ω i) := by
    intro q hq
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hq
    have hstep : ∀ i : Fin K, (-1:ℝ) ≤ α q i * (ltil A q ω i - A.l q ω i) := by
      intro i
      have h1 : 0 ≤ ltil A q ω i := hA.ltil_nonneg hq.1 ω i
      have h2 : A.l q ω i ≤ 1 := hA.hl1 _ _ _
      nlinarith [hα0 q i, hα1 q i]
    calc (-(K:ℝ)) = ∑ _i : Fin K, (-1:ℝ) := by simp
      _ ≤ ∑ i, α q i * (ltil A q ω i - A.l q ω i) := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hstep i)
  calc -(((bset A).card : ℝ) * (K:ℝ))
      ≤ -((((bset A).filter (fun q => q < n)).card : ℝ) * (K:ℝ)) := by
        have h1 : (((bset A).filter (fun q => q < n)).card : ℝ) ≤ ((bset A).card : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast Finset.card_filter_le _ _
        have hK0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (K:ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
        nlinarith
    _ = ∑ _q ∈ (bset A).filter (fun q => q < n), (-(K:ℝ)) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]; ring
    _ ≤ ∑ q ∈ (bset A).filter (fun q => q < n), ∑ i, α q i * (ltil A q ω i - A.l q ω i) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum hterm

lemma p_meas_top (hA : AlgOK A) (hF : ActFilt A μ G) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ bset A) (i : Fin K) :
    Measurable (fun ω => A.p q ω i) := by
  have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := (mem_bset.1 hq).1.1
  have hqT : q ≤ A.T := bset_le_T hq
  exact (p_meas_filt hA G hF.mono' hF.act hF.loss q hq1 (by omega) i).mono (hF.le q) le_rfl

lemma dpos_meas_top (hA : AlgOK A) (hF : ActFilt A μ G) (r : ℕ) (i : Fin K) :
    Measurable (fun ω => dpos A r ω i) :=
  AlgOK.dpos_meas A mΩ r (fun q _ _ => hF.meas_a q)
    (fun q hq _ i' => p_meas_top hA hF hq i') (fun q i' => l_meas_top hF q i') i

lemma l_at_a_meas (hF : ActFilt A μ G) (t : ℕ) : Measurable (fun ω => A.l t ω (A.a t ω)) := by
  have he : (fun ω => A.l t ω (A.a t ω))
      = fun ω => ∑ i, (if A.a t ω = i then A.l t ω i else 0) := by
    funext ω
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (A.a t ω)]
    · rw [if_pos rfl]
    · intro b _ hb; rw [if_neg (Ne.symm hb)]
    · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h
  rw [he]
  refine Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun i _ => ?_)
  exact Measurable.ite (hF.meas_a t (measurableSet_singleton i)) (l_meas_top hF t i)
    measurable_const

end AdaptiveMaster
section AdaptiveMaster2

variable {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {K : ℕ} {A : AlgData Ω K}
variable {μ : Measure Ω} {G : ℕ → MeasurableSpace Ω}

lemma Xj_meas (hA : AlgOK A) (hF : ActFilt A μ G) (j : Fin K) : Measurable (Xj A j) := by
  unfold Xj
  refine Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun q hq => ?_)
  exact ((ltil_meas_top hA hF hq j).sub (l_meas_top hF q j)).const_mul _

lemma eta_le_one (hA : AlgOK A) (q : ℕ) : A.η q ≤ 1 := by
  have h1 : Real.exp (-2) ≤ 1 := by rw [Real.exp_le_one_iff]; norm_num
  have := hA.hηb q
  linarith

lemma Xj_le (hA : AlgOK A) (hγη : ∀ t, A.γ t = A.η t) (j : Fin K) (ω : Ω) :
    Xj A j ω ≤ ((bset A).card : ℝ) * (K:ℝ) := by
  rw [← Phi_eq_Xj A j ω]
  exact Phi_le hA (fun q => by rw [hγη q]; exact hA.hηpos q) _
    (fun q i => by by_cases h : i = j <;> simp [h, (hA.hηpos q).le])
    (fun q i => by rw [hγη q]; by_cases h : i = j <;> simp [h, (hA.hηpos q).le])
    _ _

lemma Xj_ge (hA : AlgOK A) (j : Fin K) (ω : Ω) :
    -(((bset A).card : ℝ) * (K:ℝ)) ≤ Xj A j ω := by
  rw [← Phi_eq_Xj A j ω]
  exact Phi_ge hA _
    (fun q i => by by_cases h : i = j <;> simp [h, (hA.hηpos q).le])
    (fun q i => by by_cases h : i = j <;> simp [h, eta_le_one hA q]) _ _

/-- The log-sum-exp majorant has integral at most `log K`. -/
lemma int_Vfun_le (hA : AlgOK A) (hF : ActFilt A μ G) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hγη : ∀ t, A.γ t = A.η t) :
    Integrable (Vfun A) μ ∧ ∫ ω, Vfun A ω ∂μ ≤ Real.log (K:ℝ) := by
  classical
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin K) := ⟨⟨0, hA.hK⟩⟩
  set UB : ℝ := ((bset A).card : ℝ) * (K:ℝ) with hUB
  have hK0 : (0:ℝ) < (K:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hA.hK
  -- mgf bound for each arm
  have hmgf : ∀ j : Fin K, ∫ ω, Real.exp (Xj A j ω) ∂μ ≤ 1 := by
    intro j
    have h := mgf_le_one hA μ G hF.le hF.mono' hF.act hF.loss hF.meas_a
      (fun q _ i => hF.cond q i) (fun q => by rw [hγη q]; exact hA.hηpos q)
      (fun q i => if i = j then A.η q else 0)
      (fun q i => by by_cases h : i = j <;> simp [h, (hA.hηpos q).le])
      (fun q i => by rw [hγη q]; by_cases h : i = j <;> simp [h, (hA.hηpos q).le])
      (A.T+1)
    simp only [Phi_eq_Xj] at h
    exact h
  -- boundedness / integrability of the exponentials
  have hexpint : ∀ j : Fin K, Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (Xj A j ω)) μ := by
    intro j
    refine (integrable_const (Real.exp UB)).mono' (Xj_meas hA hF j).exp.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => ?_))
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _))]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.2 (Xj_le hA hγη j ω)
  set S : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => ∑ j, Real.exp (Xj A j ω) with hS
  have hSint : Integrable S μ := integrable_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => hexpint j)
  have hSpos : ∀ ω, 0 < S ω := by
    intro ω
    refine Finset.sum_pos (fun j _ => Real.exp_pos _) ?_
    exact Finset.univ_nonempty
  have hSlow : ∀ ω, (K:ℝ) * Real.exp (-UB) ≤ S ω := by
    intro ω
    have : ∀ j : Fin K, Real.exp (-UB) ≤ Real.exp (Xj A j ω) :=
      fun j => Real.exp_le_exp.2 (by have := Xj_ge hA j ω; linarith)
    calc (K:ℝ) * Real.exp (-UB) = ∑ _j : Fin K, Real.exp (-UB) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]; simp
      _ ≤ S ω := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => this j)
  have hShigh : ∀ ω, S ω ≤ (K:ℝ) * Real.exp UB := by
    intro ω
    calc S ω ≤ ∑ _j : Fin K, Real.exp UB :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => Real.exp_le_exp.2 (Xj_le hA hγη j ω))
      _ = (K:ℝ) * Real.exp UB := by rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]; simp
  have hSmeas : Measurable S :=
    Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun j _ => (Xj_meas hA hF j).exp)
  -- V is measurable and bounded
  have hVmeas : Measurable (Vfun A) := Real.measurable_log.comp hSmeas
  have hVlow : ∀ ω, Real.log ((K:ℝ) * Real.exp (-UB)) ≤ Vfun A ω := by
    intro ω
    exact Real.log_le_log (by positivity) (hSlow ω)
  have hVhigh : ∀ ω, Vfun A ω ≤ Real.log ((K:ℝ) * Real.exp UB) := by
    intro ω
    exact Real.log_le_log (hSpos ω) (hShigh ω)
  have hVint : Integrable (Vfun A) μ := by
    set C : ℝ := |Real.log ((K:ℝ) * Real.exp (-UB))| + |Real.log ((K:ℝ) * Real.exp UB)| with hC
    refine (integrable_const C).mono' hVmeas.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => ?_))
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]
    constructor
    · have := hVlow ω
      have h2 := abs_nonneg (Real.log ((K:ℝ) * Real.exp UB))
      have h3 := neg_abs_le (Real.log ((K:ℝ) * Real.exp (-UB)))
      rw [hC]; linarith
    · have := hVhigh ω
      have h2 := abs_nonneg (Real.log ((K:ℝ) * Real.exp (-UB)))
      have h3 := le_abs_self (Real.log ((K:ℝ) * Real.exp UB))
      rw [hC]; linarith
  refine ⟨hVint, ?_⟩
  -- the shift trick
  have hkey : ∀ ω, Vfun A ω - Real.log (K:ℝ) ≤ S ω / (K:ℝ) - 1 := by
    intro ω
    have hVS : Vfun A ω = Real.log (S ω) := rfl
    have he : Real.exp (Vfun A ω - Real.log (K:ℝ)) = S ω / (K:ℝ) := by
      rw [hVS, Real.exp_sub, Real.exp_log (hSpos ω), Real.exp_log hK0]
    have := Real.add_one_le_exp (Vfun A ω - Real.log (K:ℝ))
    rw [he] at this
    linarith
  have h1 : Integrable (fun ω => Vfun A ω - Real.log (K:ℝ)) μ := hVint.sub (integrable_const _)
  have h2 : Integrable (fun ω => S ω / (K:ℝ) - 1) μ :=
    (hSint.div_const _).sub (integrable_const _)
  have h3 := integral_mono h1 h2 hkey
  have e1 : ∫ ω, (Vfun A ω - Real.log (K:ℝ)) ∂μ = (∫ ω, Vfun A ω ∂μ) - Real.log (K:ℝ) := by
    rw [integral_sub hVint (integrable_const _)]
    simp
  have e2 : ∫ ω, (S ω / (K:ℝ) - 1) ∂μ = (∫ ω, S ω ∂μ)/(K:ℝ) - 1 := by
    rw [integral_sub (hSint.div_const _) (integrable_const _), integral_div]
    simp
  rw [e1, e2] at h3
  have h4 : ∫ ω, S ω ∂μ ≤ (K:ℝ) := by
    rw [hS, integral_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => hexpint j)]
    calc ∑ j, ∫ ω, Real.exp (Xj A j ω) ∂μ ≤ ∑ _j : Fin K, (1:ℝ) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => hmgf j)
      _ = (K:ℝ) := by simp
  have h5 : (∫ ω, S ω ∂μ) / (K:ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [div_le_one hK0]; exact h4
  linarith

end AdaptiveMaster2
section AdaptiveMaster3

variable {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {K : ℕ} {A : AlgData Ω K}
variable {μ : Measure Ω} {G : ℕ → MeasurableSpace Ω}

private lemma pull_action_indicator (hA : AlgOK A) (hF : ActFilt A μ G)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {t : ℕ} (ht : t ∈ bset A) (i : Fin K)
    (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : Measurable[G t] f) (hf0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ f ω)
    (hfp : Integrable (fun ω => f ω * A.p t ω i) μ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => f ω * (if A.a t ω = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) μ ∧
      ∫ ω, f ω * (if A.a t ω = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ∂μ
        = ∫ ω, f ω * A.p t ω i ∂μ := by
  have ht1 : 1 ≤ t := (mem_bset.1 ht).1.1
  have htT : t ≤ A.T := bset_le_T ht
  have hp : Measurable[G t] (fun ω => A.p t ω i) :=
    p_meas_filt hA G hF.mono' hF.act hF.loss t ht1 (by omega) i
  exact @cond_pull Ω (G t) mΩ (hF.le t) μ _ f
    (fun ω => if A.a t ω = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
    (fun ω => A.p t ω i) hf hf0
    (Measurable.ite (hF.meas_a t (measurableSet_singleton i)) measurable_const measurable_const)
    (fun ω => by by_cases h : A.a t ω = i <;> simp [h])
    (fun ω => by by_cases h : A.a t ω = i <;> simp [h])
    hp (fun ω => le_of_lt (hA.p_pos_bset ht ω i)) (hF.cond t i) hfp

lemma sum_ltil_meas (hA : AlgOK A) (hF : ActFilt A μ G) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ bset A) :
    Measurable (fun ω => ∑ i, ltil A q ω i) :=
  Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun i _ => ltil_meas_top hA hF hq i)

/-- Expected value of the delay-drift inner product for one pair `(q,r)`. -/
lemma int_dpos_ltil_le (hA : AlgOK A) (hF : ActFilt A μ G) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hγpos : ∀ q, 0 < A.γ q) {q r : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ bset A) (hr : r ∈ bset A) :
    Integrable (fun ω => ∑ i, dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i) μ ∧
      ∫ ω, (∑ i, dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i) ∂μ ≤ 2 * Real.exp 2 * A.η r * (K:ℝ) := by
  have hsum := int_sum_ltil_le hA hF hγpos hq
  have hmeas : Measurable (fun ω => ∑ i, dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i) :=
    Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun i _ =>
      (dpos_meas_top hA hF r i).mul (ltil_meas_top hA hF hq i))
  have hnn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ ∑ i, dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i := fun ω =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ =>
      mul_nonneg (AlgOK.dpos_nonneg A r ω i) (hA.ltil_nonneg hq ω i))
  have hle : ∀ ω, ∑ i, dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i
      ≤ (2 * Real.exp 2 * A.η r) * ∑ i, ltil A q ω i := by
    intro ω
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => ?_)
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (dpos_le_eta hA hr ω i) (hA.ltil_nonneg hq ω i)
  have hc0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.exp 2 * A.η r := by
    have := hA.hηpos r; have := Real.exp_pos 2; positivity
  have hint : Integrable (fun ω => ∑ i, dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i) μ := by
    refine (hsum.1.const_mul (2 * Real.exp 2 * A.η r)).mono' hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => ?_))
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hnn ω)]
    exact hle ω
  refine ⟨hint, ?_⟩
  calc ∫ ω, (∑ i, dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i) ∂μ
      ≤ ∫ ω, ((2 * Real.exp 2 * A.η r) * ∑ i, ltil A q ω i) ∂μ :=
        integral_mono hint (hsum.1.const_mul _) hle
    _ = (2 * Real.exp 2 * A.η r) * ∫ ω, (∑ i, ltil A q ω i) ∂μ := integral_const_mul _ _
    _ ≤ (2 * Real.exp 2 * A.η r) * (K:ℝ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum.2 hc0

private lemma int_dpos_ltil_of_r_lt_q (hA : AlgOK A) (hF : ActFilt A μ G)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hγpos : ∀ q, 0 < A.γ q)
    {q r : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ bset A) (hr : r ∈ bset A) (hrq : r < q) :
    ∫ ω, (∑ i, dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i) ∂μ ≤ Real.exp 2 * A.η r := by
  classical
  set c : ℝ := Real.exp 2 * A.η r with hc
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := by
    simp only [c]
    exact mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos 2).le (hA.hηpos r).le
  have hr1 : 1 ≤ r := (mem_bset.1 hr).1.1
  have haq : Measurable[G q] (A.a r) :=
    Measurable.of_comap_le (hF.act r q hr1 hrq)
  have hpq : ∀ i, Measurable[G q] (fun ω => A.p q ω i) := by
    intro i
    have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := (mem_bset.1 hq).1.1
    have hqT : q ≤ A.T := bset_le_T hq
    exact p_meas_filt hA G hF.mono' hF.act hF.loss q hq1 (by omega) i
  let f : Fin K → Ω → ℝ := fun i ω =>
    c * (if A.a r ω = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * A.l q ω i /
      (A.p q ω i + A.γ q)
  have hfmeas : ∀ i, Measurable[G q] (f i) := by
    intro i
    have hI : Measurable[G q] (fun ω => if A.a r ω = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0) :=
      Measurable.ite (haq (measurableSet_singleton i)) measurable_const measurable_const
    exact ((measurable_const.mul hI).mul (hF.loss q i)).div ((hpq i).add measurable_const)
  have hf0 : ∀ i ω, 0 ≤ f i ω := by
    intro i ω
    unfold f
    exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hc0 (by positivity)) (hA.hl0 q ω i))
      (le_of_lt (hA.pg_pos hq ω i))
  have hfp_le : ∀ i ω, f i ω * A.p q ω i
      ≤ c * (if A.a r ω = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
    intro i ω
    by_cases hi : A.a r ω = i
    · rw [if_pos hi]
      have hrat : A.l q ω i * A.p q ω i / (A.p q ω i + A.γ q) ≤ 1 := by
        rw [div_le_one (hA.pg_pos hq ω i)]
        nlinarith [hA.hl1 q ω i, hA.p_pos_bset hq ω i, hA.hγ q]
      unfold f
      rw [if_pos hi]
      calc
        (c * 1 * A.l q ω i / (A.p q ω i + A.γ q)) * A.p q ω i
            = c * (A.l q ω i * A.p q ω i / (A.p q ω i + A.γ q)) := by ring
        _ ≤ c * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrat hc0
    · unfold f
      rw [if_neg hi]
      norm_num
  have hfp0 : ∀ i ω, 0 ≤ f i ω * A.p q ω i := fun i ω =>
    mul_nonneg (hf0 i ω) (le_of_lt (hA.p_pos_bset hq ω i))
  have hfpint : ∀ i, Integrable (fun ω => f i ω * A.p q ω i) μ := by
    intro i
    refine (integrable_const c).mono'
      (((hfmeas i).mul (hpq i)).mono (hF.le q) le_rfl).aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => ?_))
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hfp0 i ω)]
    have hI : (if A.a r ω = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ 1 := by
      by_cases h : A.a r ω = i <;> simp [h]
    exact (hfp_le i ω).trans (by
      simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hI hc0)
  have hpull : ∀ i,
      Integrable (fun ω => f i ω * (if A.a q ω = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) μ ∧
      ∫ ω, f i ω * (if A.a q ω = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ∂μ
        = ∫ ω, f i ω * A.p q ω i ∂μ := by
    intro i
    exact pull_action_indicator hA hF hq i (f i) (hfmeas i) (hf0 i) (hfpint i)
  have hpoint : ∀ ω,
      (∑ i, dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i)
        ≤ ∑ i, f i ω * (if A.a q ω = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
    intro ω
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => ?_)
    calc
      dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i
          ≤ (c * (if A.a r ω = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) * ltil A q ω i :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
              (by simpa [c] using AlgOK.dpos_le_indicator hA hr ω i)
              (hA.ltil_nonneg hq ω i)
      _ = f i ω * (if A.a q ω = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
            unfold f ltil
            ring
  have hleft := (int_dpos_ltil_le hA hF hγpos hq hr).1
  have huint : Integrable
      (fun ω => ∑ i, f i ω * (if A.a q ω = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) μ :=
    integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => (hpull i).1)
  have hmain := integral_mono hleft huint hpoint
  have hur :
      ∫ ω, (∑ i, f i ω * (if A.a q ω = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) ∂μ
        = ∫ ω, (∑ i, f i ω * A.p q ω i) ∂μ := by
    rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => (hpull i).1),
      integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => hfpint i)]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => (hpull i).2)
  have hrhsint : Integrable (fun ω => ∑ i, f i ω * A.p q ω i) μ :=
    integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => hfpint i)
  have hrhsle : ∀ ω, (∑ i, f i ω * A.p q ω i) ≤ c := by
    intro ω
    calc
      (∑ i, f i ω * A.p q ω i)
          ≤ ∑ i, c * (if A.a r ω = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hfp_le i ω)
      _ = c := by
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (A.a r ω)]
        · simp
        · intro i _ hi
          rw [if_neg (Ne.symm hi)]
          ring
        · intro h
          exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h
  have hrhs := integral_mono hrhsint (integrable_const c) hrhsle
  rw [hur] at hmain
  simpa [c] using hmain.trans (by simpa using hrhs)

private lemma int_dpos_ltil_of_q_lt_r (hA : AlgOK A) (hF : ActFilt A μ G)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hγpos : ∀ q, 0 < A.γ q)
    {q r : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ bset A) (hqr : r ∈ Rset A q) (hqrlt : q < r) :
    ∫ ω, (∑ i, dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i) ∂μ ≤ Real.exp 2 * A.η r := by
  classical
  have hr : r ∈ bset A := (AlgOK.mem_Rset.1 hqr).1
  have hkey0 : q * (A.T + 1) ≤ kkey A.T A.d r := (AlgOK.mem_Rset.1 hqr).2.1
  have hkey1 : kkey A.T A.d r ≤ kkey A.T A.d q :=
    le_of_lt (AlgOK.mem_Rset.1 hqr).2.2
  set C : ℝ := Fprod A (q * (A.T + 1)) (kkey A.T A.d r) with hC
  set c : ℝ := C * A.η r with hc
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := by simp only [C]; exact hA.Fprod_nonneg _ _
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := mul_nonneg hC0 (le_of_lt (hA.hηpos r))
  have hCle : C ≤ Real.exp 2 := by
    simp only [C]
    exact AlgOK.Fprod_partial_bound hA hq hkey0 hkey1
  have hpq : ∀ i, Measurable[G r] (fun ω => A.p q ω i) := by
    intro i
    have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := (mem_bset.1 hq).1.1
    have hqT : q ≤ A.T := bset_le_T hq
    exact (p_meas_filt hA G hF.mono' hF.act hF.loss q hq1 (by omega) i).mono
      (hF.mono' (le_of_lt hqrlt)) le_rfl
  have hpr : ∀ i, Measurable[G r] (fun ω => A.p r ω i) := by
    intro i
    have hr1 : 1 ≤ r := (mem_bset.1 hr).1.1
    have hrT : r ≤ A.T := bset_le_T hr
    exact p_meas_filt hA G hF.mono' hF.act hF.loss r hr1 (by omega) i
  have hlq : ∀ i, Measurable[G r] (fun ω => ltil A q ω i) := fun i =>
    ltil_meas_filt hA G hF.mono' hF.act hF.loss hq hqrlt i
  let f : Fin K → Ω → ℝ := fun i ω =>
    c * A.p q ω i * ltil A q ω i * A.l r ω i /
      (A.p r ω i + A.γ r)
  have hfmeas : ∀ i, Measurable[G r] (f i) := by
    intro i
    exact ((((measurable_const.mul (hpq i)).mul (hlq i)).mul (hF.loss r i)).div
      ((hpr i).add measurable_const))
  have hf0 : ∀ i ω, 0 ≤ f i ω := by
    intro i ω
    unfold f
    exact div_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hc0 (le_of_lt (hA.p_pos_bset hq ω i)))
        (hA.ltil_nonneg hq ω i)) (hA.hl0 r ω i))
      (le_of_lt (hA.pg_pos hr ω i))
  have hsumq : ∀ ω, ∑ i, A.p q ω i * ltil A q ω i ≤ 1 := by
    intro ω
    have he := hA.sum_p_ltil hq ω
    have hnon : 0 ≤ A.γ q * ∑ i, ltil A q ω i :=
      mul_nonneg (hA.hγ q) (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hA.ltil_nonneg hq ω i))
    linarith [hA.hl1 q ω (A.a q ω)]
  have hfp_base : ∀ i ω,
      f i ω * A.p r ω i ≤ c * (A.p q ω i * ltil A q ω i) := by
    intro i ω
    have hrat : A.l r ω i * A.p r ω i / (A.p r ω i + A.γ r) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [div_le_one (hA.pg_pos hr ω i)]
      nlinarith [hA.hl1 r ω i, hA.p_pos_bset hr ω i, hA.hγ r]
    have hcoef : 0 ≤ c * (A.p q ω i * ltil A q ω i) :=
      mul_nonneg hc0 (mul_nonneg (hA.p_pos_bset hq ω i).le
        (hA.ltil_nonneg hq ω i))
    unfold f
    calc
      (c * A.p q ω i * ltil A q ω i * A.l r ω i /
          (A.p r ω i + A.γ r)) * A.p r ω i
          = (c * (A.p q ω i * ltil A q ω i)) *
              (A.l r ω i * A.p r ω i / (A.p r ω i + A.γ r)) := by ring
      _ ≤ (c * (A.p q ω i * ltil A q ω i)) * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrat hcoef
      _ = c * (A.p q ω i * ltil A q ω i) := by ring
  have hfp0 : ∀ i ω, 0 ≤ f i ω * A.p r ω i := fun i ω =>
    mul_nonneg (hf0 i ω) (le_of_lt (hA.p_pos_bset hr ω i))
  have hfp_le_c : ∀ i ω, f i ω * A.p r ω i ≤ c := by
    intro i ω
    have hone : A.p q ω i * ltil A q ω i ≤ 1 := by
      refine le_trans (Finset.single_le_sum
        (fun j _ => mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hA.p_pos_bset hq ω j))
          (hA.ltil_nonneg hq ω j)) (Finset.mem_univ i)) (hsumq ω)
    exact (hfp_base i ω).trans (by simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hone hc0)
  have hfpint : ∀ i, Integrable (fun ω => f i ω * A.p r ω i) μ := by
    intro i
    refine (integrable_const c).mono'
      (((hfmeas i).mul (hpr i)).mono (hF.le r) le_rfl).aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => ?_))
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hfp0 i ω)]
    exact hfp_le_c i ω
  have hpull : ∀ i,
      Integrable (fun ω => f i ω * (if A.a r ω = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) μ ∧
      ∫ ω, f i ω * (if A.a r ω = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ∂μ
        = ∫ ω, f i ω * A.p r ω i ∂μ := by
    intro i
    exact pull_action_indicator hA hF hr i (f i) (hfmeas i) (hf0 i) (hfpint i)
  have hpoint : ∀ ω,
      (∑ i, dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i)
        ≤ ∑ i, f i ω * (if A.a r ω = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
    intro ω
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => ?_)
    have hinc : 0 ≤ A.η r * ltil A r ω i :=
      mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hA.hηpos r)) (hA.ltil_nonneg hr ω i)
    have hpbound := AlgOK.PP_partial_le hA ω hq hkey0 hkey1 i
    calc
      dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i
          ≤ (PP A (kkey A.T A.d r) ω i * (A.η r * ltil A r ω i)) *
              ltil A q ω i := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
                (AlgOK.dpos_le_update hA hr ω i) (hA.ltil_nonneg hq ω i)
      _ ≤ ((C * A.p q ω i) * (A.η r * ltil A r ω i)) * ltil A q ω i := by
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by simpa [C] using hpbound) hinc)
              (hA.ltil_nonneg hq ω i)
      _ = f i ω * (if A.a r ω = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
            unfold f ltil
            simp only [c, C]
            ring
  have hleft := (int_dpos_ltil_le hA hF hγpos hq hr).1
  have huint : Integrable
      (fun ω => ∑ i, f i ω * (if A.a r ω = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) μ :=
    integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => (hpull i).1)
  have hmain := integral_mono hleft huint hpoint
  have hur :
      ∫ ω, (∑ i, f i ω * (if A.a r ω = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) ∂μ
        = ∫ ω, (∑ i, f i ω * A.p r ω i) ∂μ := by
    rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => (hpull i).1),
      integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => hfpint i)]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => (hpull i).2)
  have hrhsint : Integrable (fun ω => ∑ i, f i ω * A.p r ω i) μ :=
    integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => hfpint i)
  have hrhsle : ∀ ω, (∑ i, f i ω * A.p r ω i) ≤ c := by
    intro ω
    calc
      (∑ i, f i ω * A.p r ω i)
          ≤ ∑ i, c * (A.p q ω i * ltil A q ω i) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hfp_base i ω)
      _ = c * ∑ i, A.p q ω i * ltil A q ω i := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ ≤ c * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hsumq ω) hc0
      _ = c := by ring
  have hrhs := integral_mono hrhsint (integrable_const c) hrhsle
  rw [hur] at hmain
  have hc_le : c ≤ Real.exp 2 * A.η r := by
    simp only [c]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCle (le_of_lt (hA.hηpos r))
  have hrhs' : ∫ ω, (∑ i, f i ω * A.p r ω i) ∂μ ≤ c := by
    simpa using hrhs
  exact hmain.trans (hrhs'.trans hc_le)

private lemma int_dpos_ltil_le_sharp (hA : AlgOK A) (hF : ActFilt A μ G)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hγpos : ∀ q, 0 < A.γ q)
    {q r : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ bset A) (hqr : r ∈ Rset A q) :
    Integrable (fun ω => ∑ i, dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i) μ ∧
      ∫ ω, (∑ i, dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i) ∂μ
        ≤ Real.exp 2 * A.η r := by
  have hr : r ∈ bset A := (AlgOK.mem_Rset.1 hqr).1
  refine ⟨(int_dpos_ltil_le hA hF hγpos hq hr).1, ?_⟩
  have hne : q ≠ r := by
    intro h
    subst r
    exact (Nat.lt_irrefl (kkey A.T A.d q)) (AlgOK.mem_Rset.1 hqr).2.2
  by_cases hlt : q < r
  · exact int_dpos_ltil_of_q_lt_r hA hF hγpos hq hqr hlt
  · have hrq : r < q := by omega
    exact int_dpos_ltil_of_r_lt_q hA hF hγpos hq hr hrq

end AdaptiveMaster3
section AdaptiveMaster4

variable {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {K : ℕ} {A : AlgData Ω K}
variable {μ : Measure Ω} {G : ℕ → MeasurableSpace Ω}

noncomputable def S2fun (A : AlgData Ω K) (ω : Ω) : ℝ :=
  ∑ q ∈ bset A, (A.γ q * A.η q + (Real.exp 2/2) * (A.η q)^2) * ∑ i, ltil A q ω i

noncomputable def S3fun (A : AlgData Ω K) (ω : Ω) : ℝ :=
  ∑ q ∈ bset A, ∑ r ∈ Rset A q, A.η q * ∑ i, dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i

lemma S2_int_le (hA : AlgOK A) (hF : ActFilt A μ G) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hγpos : ∀ q, 0 < A.γ q) :
    Integrable (S2fun A) μ ∧ ∫ ω, S2fun A ω ∂μ
      ≤ ∑ q ∈ bset A, (A.γ q * A.η q + (Real.exp 2/2) * (A.η q)^2) * (K:ℝ) := by
  have hc0 : ∀ q, (0:ℝ) ≤ A.γ q * A.η q + (Real.exp 2/2) * (A.η q)^2 := by
    intro q
    have h1 := hA.hγ q
    have h2 := (hA.hηpos q).le
    have h3 : (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 2 / 2 := by positivity
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (A.η q)]
  have hint : Integrable (S2fun A) μ :=
    integrable_finset_sum _ (fun q hq => ((int_sum_ltil_le hA hF hγpos hq).1).const_mul _)
  refine ⟨hint, ?_⟩
  simp only [S2fun]
  rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun q hq => ((int_sum_ltil_le hA hF hγpos hq).1).const_mul _)]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun q hq => ?_)
  rw [integral_const_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (int_sum_ltil_le hA hF hγpos hq).2 (hc0 q)

lemma S3_int_le (hA : AlgOK A) (hF : ActFilt A μ G) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hγpos : ∀ q, 0 < A.γ q) :
    Integrable (S3fun A) μ ∧ ∫ ω, S3fun A ω ∂μ
      ≤ ∑ q ∈ bset A, ∑ r ∈ Rset A q, A.η q * (2 * Real.exp 2 * A.η r * (K:ℝ)) := by
  have hint : Integrable (S3fun A) μ :=
    integrable_finset_sum _ (fun q hq => integrable_finset_sum _ (fun r hr =>
      ((int_dpos_ltil_le hA hF hγpos hq (AlgOK.mem_Rset.1 hr).1).1).const_mul _))
  refine ⟨hint, ?_⟩
  simp only [S3fun]
  rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun q hq => integrable_finset_sum _ (fun r hr =>
      ((int_dpos_ltil_le hA hF hγpos hq (AlgOK.mem_Rset.1 hr).1).1).const_mul _))]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun q hq => ?_)
  rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun r hr =>
      ((int_dpos_ltil_le hA hF hγpos hq (AlgOK.mem_Rset.1 hr).1).1).const_mul _)]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun r hr => ?_)
  rw [integral_const_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (int_dpos_ltil_le hA hF hγpos hq (AlgOK.mem_Rset.1 hr).1).2 (hA.hηpos q).le

private lemma S3_int_le_sharp (hA : AlgOK A) (hF : ActFilt A μ G)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hγpos : ∀ q, 0 < A.γ q) :
    Integrable (S3fun A) μ ∧ ∫ ω, S3fun A ω ∂μ
      ≤ Real.exp 2 * (∑ q ∈ bset A, (A.η q)^2 * (A.d q : ℝ)) := by
  have hint : Integrable (S3fun A) μ :=
    integrable_finset_sum _ (fun q hq => integrable_finset_sum _ (fun r hr =>
      ((int_dpos_ltil_le_sharp hA hF hγpos hq hr).1).const_mul _))
  refine ⟨hint, ?_⟩
  have hraw : ∫ ω, S3fun A ω ∂μ
      ≤ ∑ q ∈ bset A, ∑ r ∈ Rset A q,
          A.η q * (Real.exp 2 * A.η r) := by
    simp only [S3fun]
    rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun q hq => integrable_finset_sum _ (fun r hr =>
      ((int_dpos_ltil_le_sharp hA hF hγpos hq hr).1).const_mul _))]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun q hq => ?_)
    rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun r hr =>
      ((int_dpos_ltil_le_sharp hA hF hγpos hq hr).1).const_mul _)]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun r hr => ?_)
    rw [integral_const_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (int_dpos_ltil_le_sharp hA hF hγpos hq hr).2 (hA.hηpos q).le
  calc
    ∫ ω, S3fun A ω ∂μ
        ≤ ∑ q ∈ bset A, ∑ r ∈ Rset A q,
            A.η q * (Real.exp 2 * A.η r) := hraw
    _ = Real.exp 2 *
          (∑ q ∈ bset A, ∑ r ∈ Rset A q, A.η q * A.η r) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun q _ => ?_)
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun r _ => by ring)
    _ ≤ Real.exp 2 * (∑ q ∈ bset A, (A.η q)^2 * (A.d q : ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (eta_pair_bound_one hA) (Real.exp_pos 2).le

/-- The adaptive-adversary master bound. -/
lemma master_bound_adaptive (hA : AlgOK A) (hF : ActFilt A μ G) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hγη : ∀ t, A.γ t = A.η t) (hne : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin K)).Nonempty) :
    ∫ ω, ((∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 A.T, A.η t * A.l t ω (A.a t ω))
        - (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin K)).inf' hne
            (fun i => ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 A.T, A.η t * A.l t ω i)) ∂μ
      ≤ 2 * Real.log (K:ℝ)
        + (1 + Real.exp 2/2) * (K:ℝ) * (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 A.T, (A.η t)^2)
        + Real.exp 2 * (∑ q ∈ bset A, (A.η q)^2 * (A.d q : ℝ))
        + (∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 A.T) \ bset A, A.η t) := by
  classical
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin K) := ⟨⟨0, hA.hK⟩⟩
  have hγpos : ∀ q, 0 < A.γ q := fun q => by rw [hγη q]; exact hA.hηpos q
  have hK1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (K:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hA.hK
  have hK0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (K:ℝ) := by linarith
  have hlogK : 0 ≤ Real.log (K:ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg hK1
  have hbsub : bset A ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 A.T := Finset.filter_subset _ _
  have hCnn : 0 ≤ ∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 A.T) \ bset A, A.η t :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun t _ => (hA.hηpos t).le)
  have hsq : 0 ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 A.T, (A.η t)^2 :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun t _ => sq_nonneg _)
  have hdd : 0 ≤ ∑ q ∈ bset A, (A.η q)^2 * (A.d q : ℝ) :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun q _ => by positivity)
  have he2 : (0:ℝ) < Real.exp 2 := Real.exp_pos 2
  by_cases hYint : Integrable (fun ω => (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 A.T, A.η t * A.l t ω (A.a t ω))
        - (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin K)).inf' hne
            (fun i => ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 A.T, A.η t * A.l t ω i)) μ
  · -- the substantive case
    obtain ⟨hVint, hVle⟩ := int_Vfun_le hA hF hγη
    obtain ⟨hS2int, hS2le⟩ := S2_int_le hA hF hγpos
    obtain ⟨hS3int, hS3le⟩ := S3_int_le_sharp hA hF hγpos
    have hVS2int : Integrable (fun ω => Vfun A ω + S2fun A ω) μ := hVint.add hS2int
    have hZint : Integrable (fun ω => Vfun A ω + S2fun A ω + S3fun A ω) μ :=
      hVS2int.add hS3int
    have hRint : Integrable (fun ω => (Real.log (K:ℝ)
        + ∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 A.T) \ bset A, A.η t) + (Vfun A ω + S2fun A ω + S3fun A ω)) μ :=
      (integrable_const _).add hZint
    have hpath : ∀ ω, ((∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 A.T, A.η t * A.l t ω (A.a t ω))
        - (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin K)).inf' hne
            (fun i => ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 A.T, A.η t * A.l t ω i))
        ≤ (Real.log (K:ℝ) + ∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 A.T) \ bset A, A.η t)
            + (Vfun A ω + S2fun A ω + S3fun A ω) := by
      intro ω
      obtain ⟨j0, -, hj0⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_inf' hne
        (fun i => ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 A.T, A.η t * A.l t ω i)
      have hcore := hA.core_final ω j0
      have e2 : S2fun A ω
          = ∑ q ∈ bset A, (A.γ q * A.η q + (Real.exp 2/2) * (A.η q)^2) * ∑ i, ltil A q ω i := rfl
      have e3 : S3fun A ω
          = ∑ q ∈ bset A, ∑ r ∈ Rset A q, A.η q * ∑ i, dpos A r ω i * ltil A q ω i := rfl
      rw [← e2, ← e3] at hcore
      have hs1 : ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 A.T, A.η t * A.l t ω (A.a t ω)
          = (∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 A.T) \ bset A, A.η t * A.l t ω (A.a t ω))
            + ∑ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * A.l q ω (A.a q ω) := (Finset.sum_sdiff hbsub).symm
      have hs2 : ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 A.T, A.η t * A.l t ω j0
          = (∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 A.T) \ bset A, A.η t * A.l t ω j0)
            + ∑ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * A.l q ω j0 := (Finset.sum_sdiff hbsub).symm
      have hb1 : (∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 A.T) \ bset A, A.η t * A.l t ω (A.a t ω))
               - (∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 A.T) \ bset A, A.η t * A.l t ω j0)
             ≤ ∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 A.T) \ bset A, A.η t := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun t _ => ?_)
        nlinarith [(hA.hηpos t).le, hA.hl1 t ω (A.a t ω), hA.hl0 t ω j0]
      have hXeq : (∑ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * ltil A q ω j0)
          - (∑ q ∈ bset A, A.η q * A.l q ω j0) = Xj A j0 ω := by
        rw [Xj, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun q _ => by ring)
      have hVge : Xj A j0 ω ≤ Vfun A ω := by
        have h1 : Real.exp (Xj A j0 ω) ≤ ∑ j, Real.exp (Xj A j ω) :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => Real.exp (Xj A j ω))
            (fun j _ => (Real.exp_pos _).le) (Finset.mem_univ j0)
        have h2 : (0:ℝ) < Real.exp (Xj A j0 ω) := Real.exp_pos _
        calc Xj A j0 ω = Real.log (Real.exp (Xj A j0 ω)) := (Real.log_exp _).symm
          _ ≤ Real.log (∑ j, Real.exp (Xj A j ω)) := Real.log_le_log h2 h1
      rw [hj0, hs1, hs2]
      linarith
    have hmain := integral_mono hYint hRint hpath
    have hval1 : ∫ ω, (Vfun A ω + S2fun A ω + S3fun A ω) ∂μ
        = (∫ ω, Vfun A ω ∂μ) + (∫ ω, S2fun A ω ∂μ) + (∫ ω, S3fun A ω ∂μ) := by
      rw [integral_add hVS2int hS3int, integral_add hVint hS2int]
    have hval : ∫ ω, ((Real.log (K:ℝ) + ∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 A.T) \ bset A, A.η t)
        + (Vfun A ω + S2fun A ω + S3fun A ω)) ∂μ
        = (Real.log (K:ℝ) + ∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 A.T) \ bset A, A.η t)
          + ((∫ ω, Vfun A ω ∂μ) + (∫ ω, S2fun A ω ∂μ) + (∫ ω, S3fun A ω ∂μ)) := by
      rw [integral_add (integrable_const _) hZint, hval1]
      simp
    rw [hval] at hmain
    -- arithmetic for the S2 term
    have hS2arith : ∑ q ∈ bset A, (A.γ q * A.η q + (Real.exp 2/2) * (A.η q)^2) * (K:ℝ)
        ≤ (1 + Real.exp 2/2) * (K:ℝ) * (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 A.T, (A.η t)^2) := by
      have hstep : ∀ q ∈ bset A, (A.γ q * A.η q + (Real.exp 2/2) * (A.η q)^2) * (K:ℝ)
          = (1 + Real.exp 2/2) * (K:ℝ) * (A.η q)^2 := by
        intro q _
        rw [hγη q]; ring
      calc ∑ q ∈ bset A, (A.γ q * A.η q + (Real.exp 2/2) * (A.η q)^2) * (K:ℝ)
          = ∑ q ∈ bset A, (1 + Real.exp 2/2) * (K:ℝ) * (A.η q)^2 :=
            Finset.sum_congr rfl hstep
        _ ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 A.T, (1 + Real.exp 2/2) * (K:ℝ) * (A.η t)^2 :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hbsub (fun t _ _ => by positivity)
        _ = (1 + Real.exp 2/2) * (K:ℝ) * (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 A.T, (A.η t)^2) := by
            rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    linarith
  · rw [integral_undef hYint]
    have h1 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (1 + Real.exp 2/2) * (K:ℝ) * (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 A.T, (A.η t)^2) := by
      have : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 + Real.exp 2/2 := by linarith
      positivity
    have h2 : (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 2 * (∑ q ∈ bset A, (A.η q)^2 * (A.d q : ℝ)) := by
      positivity
    linarith

end AdaptiveMaster4
section Shift

variable {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {K : ℕ} {hK : 0 < K}
  {l : ℕ → Ω → Fin K → ℝ} {d : ℕ → ℕ} {η γ : ℕ → ℝ}

/-- Reindex a real sequence so that index `0` copies index `1`. -/
noncomputable def shR (η : ℕ → ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ := fun t => η (max t 1)
/-- Reindex a natural sequence so that index `0` copies index `1`. -/
def shN (d : ℕ → ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ := fun t => d (max t 1)
/-- Reindex a loss sequence so that index `0` copies index `1`. -/
noncomputable def shL {Ω : Type*} {K : ℕ} (l : ℕ → Ω → Fin K → ℝ) : ℕ → Ω → Fin K → ℝ :=
  fun t => l (max t 1)

lemma shR_eq (η : ℕ → ℝ) {t : ℕ} (ht : 1 ≤ t) : shR η t = η t := by
  simp [shR, max_eq_left ht]
lemma shN_eq (d : ℕ → ℕ) {t : ℕ} (ht : 1 ≤ t) : shN d t = d t := by
  simp [shN, max_eq_left ht]
lemma shL_eq {Ω : Type*} {K : ℕ} (l : ℕ → Ω → Fin K → ℝ) {t : ℕ} (ht : 1 ≤ t) :
    shL l t = l t := by
  simp [shL, max_eq_left ht]

/-- The same run of the algorithm, recorded with reindexed parameter sequences. -/
noncomputable def shiftExp3 (E : Exp3Delayed μ K hK l d η γ) :
    Exp3Delayed μ K hK (shL l) (shN d) (shR η) (shR γ) where
  𝓕 := E.𝓕
  𝓕_le := E.𝓕_le
  𝓕_mono := E.𝓕_mono
  a := E.a
  p := E.p
  Lhat := E.Lhat
  measurable_a := E.measurable_a
  𝓕_eq := by
    intro t
    rw [E.𝓕_eq t]
    congr 1
    · refine iSup_congr (fun s => ?_)
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos s with rfl | hs
      · simp
      · rw [shN_eq d hs]
    · refine iSup_congr (fun s => ?_)
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos s with rfl | hs
      · simp
      · rw [shL_eq l hs]
  measurable_p := E.measurable_p
  p_isProb := E.p_isProb
  p_init := E.p_init
  a_law := E.a_law
  Lhat_init := E.Lhat_init
  Lhat_step := by
    intro t ω i ht
    rw [E.Lhat_step t ω i ht]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr ?_ ?_
    · refine Finset.filter_congr (fun s hs => ?_)
      rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hs
      rw [shN_eq d hs.1, shR_eq η hs.1]
    · intro s hs
      rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc] at hs
      rw [shR_eq η hs.1.1, shL_eq l hs.1.1, shR_eq γ hs.1.1]
  p_update := E.p_update

@[simp] lemma shiftExp3_a (E : Exp3Delayed μ K hK l d η γ) : (shiftExp3 E).a = E.a := rfl

end Shift
section AdaptiveConcrete

lemma shR_pos (η : ℕ → ℝ) (h : ∀ t ≥ 1, 0 < η t) : ∀ t, 0 < shR η t :=
  fun t => h (max t 1) (le_max_right t 1)

lemma shR_bd (η : ℕ → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (h : ∀ t ≥ 1, η t ≤ c) : ∀ t, shR η t ≤ c :=
  fun t => h (max t 1) (le_max_right t 1)

lemma shR_dec (η : ℕ → ℝ) (h : ∀ t ≥ 1, η (t+1) ≤ η t) : ∀ t, shR η (t+1) ≤ shR η t := by
  intro t
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos t with rfl | ht
  · simp [shR]
  · rw [shR_eq η (by omega : 1 ≤ t+1), shR_eq η ht]
    exact h t ht

lemma shN_ge (d : ℕ → ℕ) (h : ∀ t ≥ 1, 1 ≤ d t) : ∀ t, 1 ≤ t → 1 ≤ shN d t := by
  intro t ht; rw [shN_eq d ht]; exact h t ht

lemma shL_mem {Ω : Type*} {K : ℕ} (l : ℕ → Ω → Fin K → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ t ≥ 1, ∀ ω i, l t ω i ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) :
    ∀ t ω i, shL l t ω i ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 :=
  fun t ω i => h (max t 1) (le_max_right t 1) ω i

/-- The regret bound for the adaptive adversary, at a fixed horizon `T`. -/
lemma adaptive_regret_bound {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (K T : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K)
    (η : ℕ → ℝ) (l : ℕ → Ω → Fin K → ℝ) (d : ℕ → ℕ) (hd : ∀ t ≥ 1, 1 ≤ d t)
    (hη_pos : ∀ t ≥ 1, 0 < η t) (hη_dec : ∀ t ≥ 1, η (t + 1) ≤ η t)
    (hη_bound : ∀ t ≥ 1, η t ≤ (1 / 2) * Real.exp (-2))
    (hl : ∀ t ≥ 1, ∀ ω i, l t ω i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (E : Exp3Delayed μ K hK l d η η)
    (hl_adapted : ∀ t i, @Measurable Ω ℝ
      (⨆ τ ∈ Finset.Ico 1 t, MeasurableSpace.comap (E.a τ) inferInstance) _
      (fun ω => l t ω i))
    (a_law_adaptive : ∀ t i,
      (μ[(fun ω => if E.a t ω = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0) |
          ⨆ τ ∈ Finset.Ico 1 t, MeasurableSpace.comap (E.a τ) inferInstance]) =ᵐ[μ]
        (fun ω => E.p t ω i)) :
    weightedExpReg μ T K hK η l E.a ≤
      2 * Real.log (K:ℝ)
        + (1 + Real.exp 2 / 2) * (K:ℝ) * (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, (η t) ^ 2)
        + Real.exp 2 * (∑ q ∈ Bset T d η, (η q) ^ 2 * (d q : ℝ))
        + (∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ Bset T d η, η t) := by
  classical
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin K) := ⟨⟨0, hK⟩⟩
  set E' := shiftExp3 E with hE'
  set A : AlgData Ω K := toAlg T (shN d) (shR η) (shR η) (shL l) E' with hAdef
  have hA : AlgOK A := toAlg_ok T E' (shN_ge d hd) (shR_pos η hη_pos) (shR_dec η hη_dec)
    (shR_bd η _ hη_bound) (fun t ω i => (shL_mem l hl t ω i).1)
    (fun t ω i => (shL_mem l hl t ω i).2) (fun t => le_of_lt (shR_pos η hη_pos t))
  set G : ℕ → MeasurableSpace Ω :=
    fun t => ⨆ τ ∈ Finset.Ico 1 t, MeasurableSpace.comap (E.a τ) inferInstance with hGdef
  have hGmono : Monotone G := by
    intro s t hst
    refine iSup_le (fun τ => iSup_le (fun hτ => ?_))
    rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hτ
    exact le_iSup_of_le τ (le_iSup_of_le (Finset.mem_Ico.2 ⟨hτ.1, by omega⟩) le_rfl)
  have hGle : ∀ t, G t ≤ mΩ := by
    intro t
    refine iSup_le (fun τ => iSup_le (fun _ => ?_))
    exact measurable_iff_comap_le.1 (E.measurable_a τ)
  have hG10 : G 1 ≤ G 0 := by
    refine iSup_le (fun τ => iSup_le (fun hτ => ?_))
    simp at hτ
  have hGmax : ∀ q, G (max q 1) ≤ G q := by
    intro q
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos q with rfl | hq
    · simpa using hG10
    · rw [max_eq_left hq]
  have hF : ActFilt A μ G := by
    refine ⟨hGle, hGmono, ?_, ?_, E.measurable_a, ?_⟩
    · intro u t hu hut
      exact le_iSup_of_le u (le_iSup_of_le (Finset.mem_Ico.2 ⟨hu, hut⟩) le_rfl)
    · intro q i
      exact (hl_adapted (max q 1) i).mono (hGmax q) le_rfl
    · intro q i
      exact a_law_adaptive q i
  have hmb := master_bound_adaptive hA hF (fun t => rfl) (Finset.univ_nonempty)
  -- identify the pieces
  have hbs : bset A = Bset T d η := by
    show Bset T (shN d) (shR η) = Bset T d η
    apply Finset.filter_congr
    intro q hq
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hq
    rw [shN_eq d hq.1, shR_eq η hq.1]
  have hsq : ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, (A.η t)^2 = ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, (η t)^2 := by
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun t ht => ?_)
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at ht
    show (shR η t)^2 = (η t)^2
    rw [shR_eq η ht.1]
  have hdd : ∑ q ∈ bset A, (A.η q)^2 * (A.d q : ℝ)
      = ∑ q ∈ Bset T d η, (η q)^2 * (d q : ℝ) := by
    rw [hbs]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun q hq => ?_)
    have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 (mem_Bset.1 hq).1).1
    show (shR η q)^2 * ((shN d q : ℕ) : ℝ) = _
    rw [shR_eq η hq1, shN_eq d hq1]
  have hsd : ∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ bset A, A.η t
      = ∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ Bset T d η, η t := by
    rw [hbs]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun t ht => ?_)
    have ht1 : 1 ≤ t := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 (Finset.mem_sdiff.1 ht).1).1
    show shR η t = η t
    rw [shR_eq η ht1]
  have hwe : weightedExpReg μ T K hK η l E.a
      = ∫ ω, ((∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, A.η t * A.l t ω (A.a t ω))
        - (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin K)).inf' Finset.univ_nonempty
            (fun i => ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, A.η t * A.l t ω i)) ∂μ := by
    unfold weightedExpReg
    refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => ?_))
    dsimp only
    have e1 : (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, A.η t * A.l t ω (A.a t ω))
        = ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t * l t ω (E.a t ω) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun t ht => ?_)
      rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at ht
      show shR η t * shL l t ω (E.a t ω) = _
      rw [shR_eq η ht.1, shL_eq l ht.1]
    have e2 : (fun i => ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, A.η t * A.l t ω i)
        = (fun i => ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t * l t ω i) := by
      funext i
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun t ht => ?_)
      rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at ht
      show shR η t * shL l t ω i = _
      rw [shR_eq η ht.1, shL_eq l ht.1]
    rw [e1, e2]
  have hAT : A.T = T := rfl
  rw [hAT] at hmb
  rw [hwe]
  rw [hsq, hdd, hsd] at hmb
  exact hmb

end AdaptiveConcrete

private lemma weightedExpReg_one_arm {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) (T : ℕ) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (l : ℕ → Ω → Fin 1 → ℝ)
    (a : ℕ → Ω → Fin 1) :
    weightedExpReg μ T 1 (by omega) η l a = 0 := by
  unfold weightedExpReg
  have ha (t : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : a t ω = (0 : Fin 1) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  simp_rw [ha]
  simp

theorem lemma5_adaptive {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (K T : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K) (hT : 0 < T)
    (η : ℕ → ℝ) (l : ℕ → Ω → Fin K → ℝ) (d : ℕ → ℕ) (hd : ∀ t ≥ 1, 1 ≤ d t)
    (hη_pos : ∀ t, 0 < η t) (hη_dec : ∀ t, η (t + 1) ≤ η t)
    (hη_bound : ∀ t, η t ≤ (1 / 2) * Real.exp (-2))
    (hl : ∀ t ω i, l t ω i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (E : Exp3Delayed μ K hK l d η η)
    (hl_adapted : ∀ t i, @Measurable Ω ℝ
      (⨆ τ ∈ Finset.Ico 1 t, MeasurableSpace.comap (E.a τ) inferInstance) _
      (fun ω => l t ω i))

    (a_law_adaptive : ∀ t i,
      (μ[(fun ω => if E.a t ω = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0) |
          ⨆ τ ∈ Finset.Ico 1 t, MeasurableSpace.comap (E.a τ) inferInstance]) =ᵐ[μ]
        (fun ω => E.p t ω i)) :
    weightedExpReg μ T K hK η l E.a ≤
      2 + 2 * Real.log K
        + (1 + Real.exp 2 / 2) * K * (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, (η t) ^ 2)
        + 4 * Real.exp 2 * K * (∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ MStar T d η, (η t) ^ 2 * (d t : ℝ))
        + (∑ t ∈ MStar T d η, η t) := by
  have hb := adaptive_regret_bound μ K T hK η l d hd
    (fun t _ => hη_pos t) (fun t _ => hη_dec t) (fun t _ => hη_bound t)
    (fun t _ ω i => hl t ω i) E hl_adapted a_law_adaptive
  have hs := set_arith_adaptive T K d η hK hη_pos
  linarith

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
theorem theorem6_regretBound :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
        (K T : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K) (hT : 0 < T) (l0 : ℕ → Fin K → ℝ) (d : ℕ → ℕ)
        (hd : ∀ t ≥ 1, 1 ≤ d t)
        (hl : ∀ t i, l0 t i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (η : ℕ → ℝ)
        (hη_pos : ∀ t ≥ 1, 0 < η t)
        (hη : η = fun _ =>
          (Real.exp (-2) / 2) *
            Real.sqrt (Real.log K /
              ((K : ℝ) * T + ∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ missedRounds T d, (d t : ℝ))))
        (E : Exp3Delayed μ K hK (fun t _ i => l0 t i) d η (fun _ => 0))
        (a_fresh : ∀ t t' i, t ≤ t' → t' < t + d t →
          (μ[(fun ω => if E.a t ω = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0) |
              E.𝓕 t' ⊔ ⨆ s ∈ {s : ℕ | s + d s < t + d t ∨ (s + d s = t + d t ∧ s < t)},
                MeasurableSpace.comap (E.a s) inferInstance]) =ᵐ[μ] (fun ω => E.p t ω i)),
        expReg μ T K hK l0 E.a ≤
          C * (Real.sqrt (Real.log K *
                ((K : ℝ) * T + ∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ missedRounds T d, (d t : ℝ)))
              + (missedRounds T d).card) := by
  classical
  refine ⟨2 * Real.exp 2 + 2, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro Ω _ μ _ K T hK hT l0 d hd hl η hη_pos hη E a_fresh
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin K) := ⟨⟨0, hK⟩⟩
  set D : ℝ := ∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ missedRounds T d, (d t : ℝ) with hDdef
  set L : ℝ := Real.log K with hLdef
  set W : ℝ := (K:ℝ) * (T:ℝ) + D with hWdef
  set s : ℝ := Real.sqrt (L / W) with hsdef
  set c : ℝ := (Real.exp (-2) / 2) * s with hcdef
  set R : ℝ := Real.sqrt (L * W) with hRdef
  clear_value R c s W L D
  have hee : Real.exp 2 * Real.exp (-2) = 1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; norm_num
  have hcpos : 0 < c := by
    have h := hη_pos 1 le_rfl
    rw [hη] at h
    exact h
  have he2n : (0:ℝ) < Real.exp (-2)/2 := by positivity
  have hcpos' : 0 < (Real.exp (-2)/2) * s := by rw [← hcdef]; exact hcpos
  have hs0 : 0 < s := by nlinarith [hcpos', he2n]
  have hD0 : 0 ≤ D := by
    rw [hDdef]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun t _ => by positivity)
  have hK1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (K:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hK
  have hT1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (T:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hT
  have hKT : (1:ℝ) ≤ (K:ℝ)*(T:ℝ) := by nlinarith
  have hW0 : 0 < W := by rw [hWdef]; linarith
  have hLWpos : 0 < L / W := Real.sqrt_pos.1 (by rw [← hsdef]; exact hs0)
  have hL0 : 0 < L := by
    have h := mul_pos hLWpos hW0
    rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hW0)] at h
  have hLleW : L ≤ W := by
    have h1 : L ≤ (K:ℝ) - 1 := by
      rw [hLdef]; exact Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by linarith)
    rw [hWdef]; nlinarith
  have hs1 : s ≤ 1 := by
    have h : L/W ≤ 1 := by rw [div_le_one hW0]; exact hLleW
    calc s = Real.sqrt (L/W) := hsdef
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt 1 := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h
      _ = 1 := Real.sqrt_one
  have hs2 : s^2 = L/W := by rw [hsdef]; exact Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt hLWpos)
  have hsW : s * W = R := by
    have hsq : L * W = (s*W)^2 := by rw [mul_pow, hs2]; field_simp
    rw [hRdef, hsq, Real.sqrt_sq (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hs0) (le_of_lt hW0))]
  have hR0 : 0 < R := by rw [← hsW]; exact mul_pos hs0 hW0
  have hLsR : L = s * R := by
    rw [← hsW, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_two, hs2]
    field_simp
  have hDW : D ≤ W := by rw [hWdef]; linarith
  -- apply the oblivious regret bound
  have hbnd : ∀ t : ℕ, c ≤ (1/2) * Real.exp (-2) := by
    intro t; rw [hcdef]; nlinarith [hs1, he2n, hs0]
  have hηc : ∀ t, η t = c := fun t => by rw [hη]
  have h5 := lemma5_oblivious μ K T hK hT η l0 d hd (fun t => by rw [hηc t]; exact hcpos)
      (fun t => by rw [hηc t, hηc (t+1)]) (fun t => by rw [hηc t]; exact hbnd t) hl E a_fresh
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : ℕ → Ω → Fin K, E.a = a := ⟨E.a, rfl⟩
  rw [ha] at h5 ⊢
  rw [hη] at h5
  dsimp only at h5
  rw [weightedExpReg_const μ T K hK c (le_of_lt hcpos) l0 a] at h5
