  -- simplify the three sums
  have hcardIcc : (Finset.Icc 1 T).card = T := by rw [Nat.card_Icc]; omega
  have hsum1 : (∑ _t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, c^2) = (T:ℝ) * c^2 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_const, hcardIcc, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hsum2 : (∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ MStar T d (fun _ => c), c^2 * (d t : ℝ))
      = c^2 * ∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ MStar T d (fun _ => c), (d t : ℝ) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  have hsum3 : (∑ _t ∈ MStar T d (fun _ => c), c)
      = ((MStar T d (fun _ => c)).card : ℝ) * c := by
    rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [hsum1, hsum2, hsum3, ← hLdef] at h5
  set D' : ℝ := ∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ MStar T d (fun _ => c), (d t : ℝ) with hD'def
  -- D' ≤ D
  have hmissedsub : missedRounds T d ⊆ MStar T d (fun _ => c) := by
    intro t ht
    rw [missedRounds, Finset.mem_filter] at ht
    exact mem_MStar.2 ⟨ht.1, Or.inl ht.2⟩
  have hsdiffsub : (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ MStar T d (fun _ => c)
      ⊆ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ missedRounds T d :=
    Finset.sdiff_subset_sdiff (Finset.Subset.refl _) hmissedsub
  have hD'le : D' ≤ D := by
    rw [hD'def, hDdef]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsdiffsub (fun t _ _ => by positivity)
  -- cardinality of MStar
  have hNcard : ((MStar T d (fun _ => c)).card : ℝ)
      ≤ ((missedRounds T d).card : ℝ) + R := by
    set N := (Finset.Icc 1 T).filter (fun t => ¬ (T < t + d t)
        ∧ ((d t : ℝ) ≥ 1/(Real.exp 2 * c) - 1)) with hNdef
    have hsub : MStar T d (fun _ => c) ⊆ missedRounds T d ∪ N := by
      intro t ht
      rw [mem_MStar] at ht
      obtain ⟨hIcc, hor⟩ := ht
      by_cases hc2 : T < t + d t
      · exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (by rw [missedRounds, Finset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨hIcc, hc2⟩)
      · refine Finset.mem_union_right _ ?_
        rw [hNdef, Finset.mem_filter]
        refine ⟨hIcc, hc2, ?_⟩
        rcases hor with h | h
        · exact absurd h hc2
        · exact h
    have hcard : (MStar T d (fun _ => c)).card ≤ (missedRounds T d).card + N.card :=
      le_trans (Finset.card_le_card hsub) (Finset.card_union_le _ _)
    have hNsub : N ⊆ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ missedRounds T d := by
      intro t ht
      rw [hNdef, Finset.mem_filter] at ht
      rw [Finset.mem_sdiff]
      refine ⟨ht.1, ?_⟩
      rw [missedRounds, Finset.mem_filter]
      rintro ⟨-, h⟩
      exact ht.2.1 h
    have hdlow : ∀ t ∈ N, 1/s ≤ (d t : ℝ) := by
      intro t ht
      rw [hNdef, Finset.mem_filter] at ht
      have h := ht.2.2
      have he : Real.exp 2 * c = s/2 := by
        rw [hcdef]; linear_combination (s/2) * hee
      rw [he] at h
      have hh : (1:ℝ)/(s/2) = 2/s := by field_simp
      rw [hh] at h
      have hinv : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1/s := by rw [le_div_iff₀ hs0]; linarith
      have h2s : (2:ℝ)/s = 1/s + 1/s := by ring
      linarith
    have hNcard1 : (N.card : ℝ) * (1/s) ≤ ∑ t ∈ N, (d t : ℝ) := by
      have h := Finset.card_nsmul_le_sum N (fun t => (d t : ℝ)) (1/s) hdlow
      simpa [nsmul_eq_mul] using h
    have hNsum : (∑ t ∈ N, (d t : ℝ)) ≤ D := by
      rw [hDdef]
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hNsub (fun t _ _ => by positivity)
    have hNle : (N.card : ℝ) ≤ D * s := by
      have h1 : (N.card:ℝ) * (1/s) ≤ D := le_trans hNcard1 hNsum
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (le_of_lt hs0)
      rw [mul_assoc, one_div, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hs0), mul_one] at h2
      exact h2
    have hDsR : D * s ≤ R := by
      calc D * s ≤ W * s := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hDW (le_of_lt hs0)
        _ = s * W := mul_comm _ _
        _ = R := hsW
    have hcast := (Nat.cast_le (α := ℝ)).2 hcard
    push_cast at hcast
    linarith
  -- termwise bounds
  have hi : L = c * (2 * Real.exp 2 * R) := by
    rw [hcdef, hLsR]
    linear_combination (-(s*R)) * hee
  have hii : (Real.exp 2/2) * (K:ℝ) * ((T:ℝ) * c^2) ≤ c * ((1/4) * R) := by
    have hKTW : (K:ℝ)*(T:ℝ) ≤ W := by rw [hWdef]; linarith
    have h1 : (K:ℝ)*(T:ℝ)*s ≤ R := by
      calc (K:ℝ)*(T:ℝ)*s ≤ W*s := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hKTW (le_of_lt hs0)
        _ = s*W := mul_comm _ _
        _ = R := hsW
    have heq : (Real.exp 2/2) * (K:ℝ) * ((T:ℝ) * c^2)
        = c * ((1/4) * ((K:ℝ)*(T:ℝ)*s)) := by
      rw [hcdef]
      linear_combination ((K:ℝ)*(T:ℝ)*s^2/8*Real.exp (-2)) * hee
    rw [heq]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (le_of_lt hcpos)
  have hiii : 4 * (c^2 * D') ≤ c * (2 * Real.exp (-2) * R) := by
    have hsD' : s * D' ≤ R := by
      have h1 : D' ≤ W := le_trans hD'le hDW
      calc s*D' ≤ s*W := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (le_of_lt hs0)
        _ = R := hsW
    have heq : 4 * (c^2 * D') = c * (2 * Real.exp (-2) * (s * D')) := by
      rw [hcdef]; ring
    rw [heq]
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (le_of_lt hcpos)
    have hpos : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-2) := by positivity
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsD' hpos
  have hiv : ((MStar T d (fun _ => c)).card : ℝ) * c
      ≤ c * (((missedRounds T d).card : ℝ) + R) := by
    rw [mul_comm]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hNcard (le_of_lt hcpos)
  -- final numeric combination
  have hXY : 2 * Real.exp 2 * R + (1/4) * R + 2 * Real.exp (-2) * R
        + (((missedRounds T d).card : ℝ) + R)
      ≤ (2 * Real.exp 2 + 2) * (R + ((missedRounds T d).card : ℝ)) := by
    have hen := exp_neg_two_le
    have hR0' : (0:ℝ) ≤ R := le_of_lt hR0
    have hcm : (0:ℝ) ≤ ((missedRounds T d).card : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    have he2p : (0:ℝ) < Real.exp 2 := Real.exp_pos 2
    have h1 : 2 * Real.exp (-2) * R ≤ (1/2) * R :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hR0'
    have h2 : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.exp 2 * ((missedRounds T d).card : ℝ) :=
      mul_nonneg (by linarith) hcm
    linarith
  have hfinal : c * (2 * Real.exp 2 * R) + c * ((1/4) * R)
        + c * (2 * Real.exp (-2) * R) + c * (((missedRounds T d).card : ℝ) + R)
      ≤ c * ((2 * Real.exp 2 + 2) * (R + ((missedRounds T d).card : ℝ))) := by
    calc c * (2 * Real.exp 2 * R) + c * ((1/4) * R)
          + c * (2 * Real.exp (-2) * R) + c * (((missedRounds T d).card : ℝ) + R)
        = c * (2 * Real.exp 2 * R + (1/4) * R + 2 * Real.exp (-2) * R
            + (((missedRounds T d).card : ℝ) + R)) := by ring
      _ ≤ c * ((2 * Real.exp 2 + 2) * (R + ((missedRounds T d).card : ℝ))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hXY (le_of_lt hcpos)
  have hcomb : c * expReg μ T K hK l0 a
      ≤ c * ((2 * Real.exp 2 + 2) * (R + ((missedRounds T d).card : ℝ))) := by
    linarith
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hcomb hcpos

private lemma weightedExpReg_congr_of_pos
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    (T K : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K) (η η' : ℕ → ℝ)
    (l l' : ℕ → Ω → Fin K → ℝ) (a : ℕ → Ω → Fin K)
    (hη : ∀ t, 1 ≤ t → η t = η' t)
    (hl : ∀ t, 1 ≤ t → l t = l' t) :
    weightedExpReg μ T K hK η l a = weightedExpReg μ T K hK η' l' a := by
  letI : Nonempty (Fin K) := ⟨⟨0, hK⟩⟩
  unfold weightedExpReg
  congr 1
  funext ω
  congr 1
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro t ht
    have ht1 : 1 ≤ t := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp ht).1
    rw [hη t ht1, hl t ht1]
  · apply Finset.inf'_congr Finset.univ_nonempty rfl
    intro i hi
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro t ht
    have ht1 : 1 ≤ t := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp ht).1
    rw [hη t ht1, hl t ht1]

private lemma MStar_congr_of_pos (T : ℕ) (d : ℕ → ℕ) (η η' : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hη : ∀ t, 1 ≤ t → η t = η' t) : MStar T d η = MStar T d η' := by
  ext t
  simp only [MStar, Finset.mem_filter]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ht, hcond⟩
    exact ⟨ht, by simpa [hη t (Finset.mem_Icc.mp ht).1] using hcond⟩
  · rintro ⟨ht, hcond⟩
    exact ⟨ht, by simpa [hη t (Finset.mem_Icc.mp ht).1] using hcond⟩

private lemma missed_sum_bound
    (η : ℕ → ℝ) (d : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hηpos : ∀ t, 0 < η t) (hηanti : Antitone η)
    (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hq : ∀ t, η t * (d t : ℝ) ≤ B)
    (n T : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hT : n ≤ T) :
    (∑ t ∈ missedRounds T d, η t) ≤
      2 * (n : ℝ) * B + (1 / ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
        (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t) := by
  let u : ℕ := T / n
  let c : ℕ := T - u
  let A : Finset ℕ := (missedRounds T d).filter (fun t => t ≤ c)
  let Z : Finset ℕ := (missedRounds T d).filter (fun t => ¬t ≤ c)
  have hn0 : 0 < n := by omega
  have hu0 : 0 < u := by
    dsimp [u]
    exact Nat.div_pos hT hn0
  have huT : u ≤ T := by
    dsimp [u]
    exact Nat.div_le_self _ _
  have hcu : c + u = T := by
    dsimp [c]
    exact Nat.sub_add_cancel huT
  have hsplit :
      (∑ t ∈ A, η t) + (∑ t ∈ Z, η t) = ∑ t ∈ missedRounds T d, η t := by
    simpa [A, Z] using
      (Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (missedRounds T d) (fun t => t ≤ c) η)
  have hA_point : ∀ t ∈ A, η t ≤ B / (u : ℝ) := by
    intro t ht
    have ht' := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ht)
    have htM := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ht'.1)
    have hutu : u ≤ T - t := by omega
    have hud : u < d t := by omega
    have hudR : (u : ℝ) ≤ d t := by exact_mod_cast hud.le
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by exact_mod_cast hu0)]
    calc
      η t * (u : ℝ) ≤ η t * (d t : ℝ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hudR (hηpos t).le
      _ ≤ B := hq t
  have hcardA : (A.card : ℝ) ≤ T := by
    have hAsub : A ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 T := by
      intro t ht
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp ht).1).1
    have hcA := Finset.card_le_card hAsub
    rw [Nat.card_Icc] at hcA
    norm_num at hcA
    exact_mod_cast hcA
  have hT_two_nu : (T : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (n : ℝ) * (u : ℝ) := by
    have hmod : T % n < n := Nat.mod_lt _ hn0
    have hnu : n ≤ n * u := by
      have : 1 ≤ u := hu0
      nlinarith
    have hnat : T ≤ 2 * n * u := by
      calc
        T = n * u + T % n := by
          dsimp [u]
          exact (Nat.div_add_mod T n).symm
        _ ≤ n * u + n := by omega
        _ ≤ n * u + n * u := by omega
        _ = 2 * n * u := by ring
    exact_mod_cast hnat
  have hA_sum : (∑ t ∈ A, η t) ≤ 2 * (n : ℝ) * B := by
    calc
      (∑ t ∈ A, η t) ≤ (A.card : ℝ) * (B / (u : ℝ)) := by
        simpa only [nsmul_eq_mul] using Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul A η (B / (u : ℝ)) hA_point
      _ ≤ (T : ℝ) * (B / (u : ℝ)) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcardA (div_nonneg hB (by positivity))
      _ ≤ 2 * (n : ℝ) * B := by
        have huR : 0 < (u : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hu0
        rw [← mul_div_assoc]
        rw [div_le_iff₀ huR]
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hT_two_nu hB]
  have hZsub : Z ⊆ Finset.Icc (c + 1) T := by
    intro t ht
    have ht' := Finset.mem_filter.mp ht
    have htM := Finset.mem_filter.mp ht'.1
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
    exact ⟨Nat.lt_iff_add_one_le.mp (lt_of_not_ge ht'.2), (Finset.mem_Icc.mp htM.1).2⟩
  have hcardZ : (Z.card : ℝ) ≤ u := by
    have hz := Finset.card_le_card hZsub
    rw [Nat.card_Icc] at hz
    have hcard : T + 1 - (c + 1) = u := by omega
    rw [hcard] at hz
    exact_mod_cast hz
  have hZ_point : ∀ t ∈ Z, η t ≤ η (c + 1) := by
    intro t ht
    exact hηanti (Finset.mem_Icc.mp (hZsub ht)).1
  have hZ_sum : (∑ t ∈ Z, η t) ≤ (u : ℝ) * η (c + 1) := by
    calc
      (∑ t ∈ Z, η t) ≤ (Z.card : ℝ) * η (c + 1) := by
        simpa only [nsmul_eq_mul] using
          Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul Z η (η (c + 1)) hZ_point
      _ ≤ (u : ℝ) * η (c + 1) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcardZ (hηpos (c + 1)).le
  have hc1T : c + 1 ≤ T := by omega
  have hprefix_sub : Finset.Icc 1 (c + 1) ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 T := by
    intro t ht
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at ht ⊢
    omega
  have hS_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t := by
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun t ht => (hηpos t).le
  have hprefix : ((c + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * η (c + 1) ≤
      ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t := by
    have hlow : ((c + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * η (c + 1) ≤
        ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (c + 1), η t := by
      calc
        ((c + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * η (c + 1) =
            ∑ _t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (c + 1), η (c + 1) := by
              simp [Nat.card_Icc]
        _ ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (c + 1), η t := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro t ht
          exact hηanti (Finset.mem_Icc.mp ht).2
    exact hlow.trans
      (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hprefix_sub (fun t ht hnot => (hηpos t).le))
  have hnsub0 : 0 < ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show 0 < n - 1 by omega)
  have hnu_c : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (u : ℝ) ≤ (c + 1 : ℕ) := by
    have hmul : (n - 1) * u ≤ c + 1 := by
      have hbase : n * u ≤ T := by
        dsimp [u]
        simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using Nat.div_mul_le_self T n
      calc
        (n - 1) * u = n * u - u := by
          rw [Nat.sub_mul]
          simp
        _ ≤ T - u := Nat.sub_le_sub_right hbase u
        _ ≤ c + 1 := by simp [c]
    exact_mod_cast hmul
  have hZ_ratio : (u : ℝ) * η (c + 1) ≤
      (1 / ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t) := by
    calc
      (u : ℝ) * η (c + 1) ≤
          (1 / ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * (((c + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * η (c + 1)) := by
            rw [one_div, inv_mul_eq_div]
            rw [le_div_iff₀ hnsub0]
            nlinarith [hnu_c, (hηpos (c + 1)).le]
      _ ≤ (1 / ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprefix (by positivity)
  rw [← hsplit]
  exact add_le_add hA_sum (hZ_sum.trans hZ_ratio)

private lemma missed_ratio_tendsto_zero
    (η : ℕ → ℝ) (d : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hηpos : ∀ t, 0 < η t) (hηanti : Antitone η)
    (hS : Tendsto (fun T : ℕ => ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t) atTop atTop)
    {L : ℝ} (hq : Tendsto (fun t : ℕ => η t * (d t : ℝ)) atTop (nhds L)) :
    Tendsto (fun T : ℕ =>
      (∑ t ∈ missedRounds T d, η t) / (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
  let q : ℕ → ℝ := fun t => η t * (d t : ℝ)
  have hq' : Tendsto q atTop (nhds L) := hq
  obtain ⟨B, hBrange⟩ :=
    (Metric.isBounded_range_of_tendsto q hq').subset_closedBall (0 : ℝ)
  have hq_abs : ∀ t, |q t| ≤ B := by
    intro t
    have ht := hBrange (Set.mem_range_self t)
    simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] using ht
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := (abs_nonneg (q 0)).trans (hq_abs 0)
  have hq_le : ∀ t, η t * (d t : ℝ) ≤ B := by
    intro t
    exact (le_abs_self (q t)).trans (hq_abs t)
  rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_nat_one_div_lt (show 0 < ε / 4 by positivity)
  let n : ℕ := k + 2
  have hn : 2 ≤ n := by simp [n]
  have hn0 : 0 < n := by omega
  have hcoeff : 1 / (((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) < ε / 4 := by
    simpa [n] using hk
  have hevS : ∀ᶠ T : ℕ in atTop,
      4 * (n : ℝ) * B / ε < ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t :=
    hS.eventually_gt_atTop _
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hevS
  refine ⟨max N n, ?_⟩
  intro T hTmax
  have hST := hN T ((le_max_left N n).trans hTmax)
  have hT : n ≤ T := (le_max_right N n).trans hTmax
  let ST : ℝ := ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t
  let MT : ℝ := ∑ t ∈ missedRounds T d, η t
  have hthreshold_nonneg : 0 ≤ 4 * (n : ℝ) * B / ε := by positivity
  have hSTpos : 0 < ST := hthreshold_nonneg.trans_lt hST
  have hMTnonneg : 0 ≤ MT := by
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun t ht => (hηpos t).le
  have hbound : MT ≤
      2 * (n : ℝ) * B + (1 / (((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) * ST := by
    exact missed_sum_bound η d hηpos hηanti B hB hq_le n T hn hT
  have hratio : MT / ST ≤
      (2 * (n : ℝ) * B) / ST + 1 / (((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      MT / ST ≤
          (2 * (n : ℝ) * B + (1 / (((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) * ST) / ST := by
            exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hbound hSTpos.le
      _ = (2 * (n : ℝ) * B) / ST + 1 / (((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
        field_simp
  have hfirst : (2 * (n : ℝ) * B) / ST < ε / 2 := by
    have hcross : 4 * (n : ℝ) * B < ST * ε := by
      exact (div_lt_iff₀ hε).mp hST
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hSTpos]
    nlinarith
  rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg hMTnonneg hSTpos.le)]
  exact hratio.trans_lt (by nlinarith)

private noncomputable def Exp3Delayed.ratesCongr
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {K : ℕ} {hK : 0 < K}
    {l : ℕ → Ω → Fin K → ℝ} {d : ℕ → ℕ} {η γ η' γ' : ℕ → ℝ}
    (E : Exp3Delayed μ K hK l d η γ)
    (hη : ∀ s, 1 ≤ s → η' s = η s) (hγ : ∀ s, 1 ≤ s → γ' s = γ s) :
    Exp3Delayed μ K hK l d η' γ' where
  𝓕 := E.𝓕
  𝓕_le := E.𝓕_le
  𝓕_mono := E.𝓕_mono
  a := E.a
  p := E.p
  Lhat := E.Lhat
  measurable_a := E.measurable_a
  𝓕_eq := E.𝓕_eq
  measurable_p := E.measurable_p
  p_isProb := E.p_isProb
  p_init := E.p_init
  a_law := E.a_law
  Lhat_init := E.Lhat_init
  Lhat_step := by
    intro t ω i ht
    rw [E.Lhat_step t ω i ht]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr
    · ext s
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hs, harr, hbound, ha⟩
        have hs1 : 1 ≤ s := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hs).1
        exact ⟨hs, harr, by simpa [hη s hs1] using hbound, ha⟩
      · rintro ⟨hs, harr, hbound, ha⟩
        have hs1 : 1 ≤ s := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hs).1
        exact ⟨hs, harr, by simpa [hη s hs1] using hbound, ha⟩
    · intro s hs
      have hs1 : 1 ≤ s := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hs).1).1
      rw [hη s hs1, hγ s hs1]
  p_update := E.p_update

private noncomputable def Exp3Delayed.lossCongr
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {K : ℕ} {hK : 0 < K}
    {l l' : ℕ → Ω → Fin K → ℝ} {d : ℕ → ℕ} {η γ : ℕ → ℝ}
    (E : Exp3Delayed μ K hK l d η γ)
    (hl : ∀ s, 1 ≤ s → l' s = l s) : Exp3Delayed μ K hK l' d η γ where
  𝓕 := E.𝓕
  𝓕_le := E.𝓕_le
  𝓕_mono := E.𝓕_mono
  a := E.a
  p := E.p
  Lhat := E.Lhat
  measurable_a := E.measurable_a
  𝓕_eq := by
    intro t
    rw [E.𝓕_eq]
    congr 1
    apply iSup_congr
    intro s
    apply iSup_congr_Prop Iff.rfl
    intro hs
    rw [hl s hs.1]
  measurable_p := E.measurable_p
  p_isProb := E.p_isProb
  p_init := E.p_init
  a_law := E.a_law
  Lhat_init := E.Lhat_init
  Lhat_step := by
    intro t ω i ht
    rw [E.Lhat_step t ω i ht]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro s hs
    have hs1 : 1 ≤ s := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hs).1).1
    rw [hl s hs1]
  p_update := E.p_update

theorem lemma6_noWeightedRegret {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (K : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K)
    (η : ℕ → ℝ) (l : ℕ → Ω → Fin K → ℝ) (d : ℕ → ℕ) (hd : ∀ t ≥ 1, 1 ≤ d t)
    (hη_pos : ∀ t ≥ 1, 0 < η t) (hη_dec : ∀ t ≥ 1, η (t + 1) ≤ η t)
    (hη_bound : ∀ t ≥ 1, η t ≤ (1 / 2) * Real.exp (-2))
    (hl : ∀ t ≥ 1, ∀ ω i, l t ω i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (E : Exp3Delayed μ K hK l d η η)
    (hl_adapted : ∀ t i, @Measurable Ω ℝ
      (⨆ τ ∈ Finset.Ico 1 t, MeasurableSpace.comap (E.a τ) inferInstance) _
      (fun ω => l t ω i))
    (a_law_adaptive : ∀ t i,
      (μ[(fun ω => if E.a t ω = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0) |
          ⨆ τ ∈ Finset.Ico 1 t, MeasurableSpace.comap (E.a τ) inferInstance]) =ᵐ[μ]
        (fun ω => E.p t ω i))
    (h1 : Tendsto (fun T : ℕ => ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t) atTop atTop)
    (h2 : ∃ L : ℝ, Tendsto (fun t : ℕ => η t * (d t : ℝ)) atTop (nhds L))
    (h3 : Summable (fun t : ℕ => (η t) ^ 2 * (d t : ℝ))) :
    NoWeightedRegret μ K hK η l E.a := by
  let η' : ℕ → ℝ := fun t => if t = 0 then η 1 else η t
  let l' : ℕ → Ω → Fin K → ℝ := fun t => if t = 0 then fun _ _ => 0 else l t
  have hηeq : ∀ t, 1 ≤ t → η' t = η t := by
    intro t ht
    simp [η', Nat.ne_of_gt ht]
  have hleq : ∀ t, 1 ≤ t → l' t = l t := by
    intro t ht
    simp [l', Nat.ne_of_gt ht]
  let Eη : Exp3Delayed μ K hK l d η' η' :=
    E.ratesCongr (fun t ht => hηeq t ht) (fun t ht => hηeq t ht)
  let E' : Exp3Delayed μ K hK l' d η' η' := Eη.lossCongr hleq
  have hη'_pos : ∀ t, 0 < η' t := by
    intro t
    by_cases ht : t = 0
    · subst t
      simpa [η'] using hη_pos 1 (by omega)
    · simpa [η', ht] using hη_pos t (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr ht)
  have hη'_dec : ∀ t, η' (t + 1) ≤ η' t := by
    intro t
    by_cases ht : t = 0
    · subst t
      simp [η']
    · simpa [η', ht] using hη_dec t (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr ht)
  have hη'_bound : ∀ t, η' t ≤ (1 / 2) * Real.exp (-2) := by
    intro t
    by_cases ht : t = 0
    · subst t
      simpa [η'] using hη_bound 1 (by omega)
    · simpa [η', ht] using hη_bound t (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr ht)
  have hl' : ∀ t ω i, l' t ω i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    intro t ω i
    by_cases ht : t = 0
    · subst t
      simp [l']
    · simpa [l', ht] using hl t (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr ht) ω i
  have hl'_adapted : ∀ t i, @Measurable Ω ℝ
      (⨆ τ ∈ Finset.Ico 1 t, MeasurableSpace.comap (E'.a τ) inferInstance) _
      (fun ω => l' t ω i) := by
    intro t i
    by_cases ht : t = 0
    · subst t
      simp only [l', if_pos]
      exact measurable_const
    · simpa only [l', if_neg ht, E', Eη, Exp3Delayed.lossCongr,
        Exp3Delayed.ratesCongr] using hl_adapted t i
  have ha'_law : ∀ t i,
      (μ[(fun ω => if E'.a t ω = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0) |
          ⨆ τ ∈ Finset.Ico 1 t, MeasurableSpace.comap (E'.a τ) inferInstance]) =ᵐ[μ]
        (fun ω => E'.p t ω i) := by
    simpa only [E', Eη, Exp3Delayed.lossCongr, Exp3Delayed.ratesCongr] using
      a_law_adaptive
  have finite_bound : ∀ T : ℕ, 0 < T →
      weightedExpReg μ T K hK η l E.a ≤
        2 + 2 * Real.log K
          + (1 + Real.exp 2 / 2) * K * (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, (η t) ^ 2)
          + 4 * Real.exp 2 * K *
            (∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ MStar T d η, (η t) ^ 2 * (d t : ℝ))
          + (∑ t ∈ MStar T d η, η t) := by
    intro T hT
    have HB := lemma5_adaptive μ K T hK hT η' l' d hd hη'_pos hη'_dec
      hη'_bound hl' E' hl'_adapted ha'_law
    have hw := weightedExpReg_congr_of_pos μ T K hK η η' l l' E.a
      (fun t ht => (hηeq t ht).symm) (fun t ht => (hleq t ht).symm)
    change weightedExpReg μ T K hK η' l' E.a ≤ _ at HB
    rw [← hw] at HB
    have hM : MStar T d η' = MStar T d η :=
      MStar_congr_of_pos T d η' η hηeq
    rw [hM] at HB
    have hsquare : (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, (η' t) ^ 2) =
        ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, (η t) ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro t ht
      rw [hηeq t (Finset.mem_Icc.mp ht).1]
    have hdelay :
        (∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ MStar T d η, (η' t) ^ 2 * (d t : ℝ)) =
          ∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ MStar T d η, (η t) ^ 2 * (d t : ℝ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro t ht
      rw [hηeq t (Finset.mem_Icc.mp (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp ht).1).1]
    have hbad : (∑ t ∈ MStar T d η, η' t) = ∑ t ∈ MStar T d η, η t := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro t ht
      rw [hηeq t (Finset.mem_Icc.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp ht).1).1]
    simpa only [hsquare, hdelay, hbad, E', Eη, Exp3Delayed.lossCongr,
      Exp3Delayed.ratesCongr] using HB
  have hsum_eq : ∀ T : ℕ,
      (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η' t) = ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t := by
    intro T
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro t ht
    rw [hηeq t (Finset.mem_Icc.mp ht).1]
  have hmiss_sum_eq : ∀ T : ℕ,
      (∑ t ∈ missedRounds T d, η' t) = ∑ t ∈ missedRounds T d, η t := by
    intro T
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro t ht
    rw [hηeq t (Finset.mem_Icc.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp ht).1).1]
  have h1' : Tendsto (fun T : ℕ => ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η' t) atTop atTop := by
    exact Filter.Tendsto.congr' (Eventually.of_forall fun T => (hsum_eq T).symm) h1
  obtain ⟨L, hq⟩ := h2
  have hq' : Tendsto (fun t : ℕ => η' t * (d t : ℝ)) atTop (nhds L) := by
    apply Filter.Tendsto.congr' _ hq
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 1] with t ht
    rw [hηeq t ht]
  have hη'_anti : Antitone η' := antitone_nat_of_succ_le hη'_dec
  have hmiss' := missed_ratio_tendsto_zero η' d hη'_pos hη'_anti h1' hq'
  have hmiss : Tendsto (fun T : ℕ =>
      (∑ t ∈ missedRounds T d, η t) / (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    apply Filter.Tendsto.congr' _ hmiss'
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun T => by
      change (∑ t ∈ missedRounds T d, η' t) / (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η' t) = _
      rw [hmiss_sum_eq T, hsum_eq T]
  have h3shift : Summable (fun n : ℕ =>
      (η (n + 1)) ^ 2 * (d (n + 1) : ℝ)) :=
    (summable_nat_add_iff 1).2 h3
  have heta_sq_shift : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (η (n + 1)) ^ 2) := by
    apply h3shift.of_nonneg_of_le
    · intro n
      positivity
    · intro n
      have hdR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ d (n + 1) := by
        exact_mod_cast hd (n + 1) (by omega)
      calc
        (η (n + 1)) ^ 2 = (η (n + 1)) ^ 2 * 1 := by ring
        _ ≤ (η (n + 1)) ^ 2 * (d (n + 1) : ℝ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdR (sq_nonneg _)
  have heta_sq : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (η n) ^ 2) :=
    (summable_nat_add_iff 1).1 heta_sq_shift
  let b : ℕ → ℝ := fun t => Real.exp 2 * ((η t) ^ 2 * (d t : ℝ) + (η t) ^ 2)
  have hb_nonneg : ∀ t, 0 ≤ b t := by
    intro t
    dsimp [b]
    positivity
  have hb_sum : Summable b := by
    dsimp [b]
    exact (h3.add heta_sq).mul_left (Real.exp 2)
  let Hset : ℕ → Finset ℕ := fun T => (Finset.Icc 1 T).filter
    (fun t => (d t : ℝ) ≥ 1 / (Real.exp 2 * η t) - 1)
  have hthreshold_point : ∀ T t, t ∈ Hset T → η t ≤ b t := by
    intro T t ht
    have ht' := Finset.mem_filter.mp ht
    have ht1 : 1 ≤ t := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp ht'.1).1
    have hthreshold :
        (1 : ℝ) / (Real.exp 2 * η t) ≤ (d t : ℝ) + 1 := by
      linarith
    have hx : 0 < Real.exp 2 * η t := mul_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (hη_pos t ht1)
    have hone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (Real.exp 2 * η t) * ((d t : ℝ) + 1) := by
      calc
        (1 : ℝ) = (Real.exp 2 * η t) * (1 / (Real.exp 2 * η t)) := by
          exact (mul_div_cancel₀ 1 hx.ne').symm
        _ ≤ (Real.exp 2 * η t) * ((d t : ℝ) + 1) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hthreshold hx.le
    calc
      η t = η t * 1 := by ring
      _ ≤ η t * ((Real.exp 2 * η t) * ((d t : ℝ) + 1)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hone (hη_pos t ht1).le
      _ = b t := by
        dsimp [b]
        ring
  have hH_sum : ∀ T : ℕ, (∑ t ∈ Hset T, η t) ≤ ∑' t : ℕ, b t := by
    intro T
    calc
      (∑ t ∈ Hset T, η t) ≤ ∑ t ∈ Hset T, b t := by
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun t ht => hthreshold_point T t ht
      _ ≤ ∑' t : ℕ, b t := hb_sum.sum_le_tsum (Hset T) (fun t ht => hb_nonneg t)
  have hM_sub : ∀ T : ℕ, MStar T d η ⊆ missedRounds T d ∪ Hset T := by
    intro T t ht
    have ht' := Finset.mem_filter.mp ht
    rcases ht'.2 with harr | hthreshold
    · apply Finset.mem_union_left
      rw [missedRounds, Finset.mem_filter]
      exact ⟨ht'.1, harr⟩
    · apply Finset.mem_union_right
      dsimp [Hset]
      rw [Finset.mem_filter]
      exact ⟨ht'.1, hthreshold⟩
  have hM_sum : ∀ T : ℕ,
      (∑ t ∈ MStar T d η, η t) ≤
        (∑ t ∈ missedRounds T d, η t) + ∑' t : ℕ, b t := by
    intro T
    have hunion :
        (∑ t ∈ missedRounds T d ∪ Hset T, η t) ≤
          (∑ t ∈ missedRounds T d, η t) + (∑ t ∈ Hset T, η t) := by
      have hi := Finset.sum_union_inter (s₁ := missedRounds T d) (s₂ := Hset T)
        (f := η)
      have hinter : 0 ≤ ∑ t ∈ missedRounds T d ∩ Hset T, η t := by
        exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun t ht =>
          (hη_pos t (Finset.mem_Icc.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp
            (Finset.mem_inter.mp ht).1).1).1).le
      linarith
    calc
      (∑ t ∈ MStar T d η, η t) ≤
          ∑ t ∈ missedRounds T d ∪ Hset T, η t := by
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (hM_sub T)
          (fun t ht hnot => by
            rcases Finset.mem_union.mp ht with ht | ht
            · exact (hη_pos t (Finset.mem_Icc.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp ht).1).1).le
            · exact (hη_pos t (Finset.mem_Icc.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp ht).1).1).le)
      _ ≤ (∑ t ∈ missedRounds T d, η t) + (∑ t ∈ Hset T, η t) := hunion
      _ ≤ (∑ t ∈ missedRounds T d, η t) + ∑' t : ℕ, b t :=
        add_le_add_right (hH_sum T) _
  have hS_nonneg : ∀ T : ℕ, 0 ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t := by
    intro T
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun t ht => (hη_pos t (Finset.mem_Icc.mp ht).1).le
  have hMratio_le : ∀ T : ℕ,
      (∑ t ∈ MStar T d η, η t) / (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t) ≤
        (∑ t ∈ missedRounds T d, η t) / (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t) +
          (∑' t : ℕ, b t) / (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t) := by
    intro T
    calc
      (∑ t ∈ MStar T d η, η t) / (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t) ≤
          ((∑ t ∈ missedRounds T d, η t) + ∑' t : ℕ, b t) /
            (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hM_sum T) (hS_nonneg T)
      _ = (∑ t ∈ missedRounds T d, η t) / (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t) +
          (∑' t : ℕ, b t) / (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t) := by rw [add_div]
  have hupper : Tendsto (fun T : ℕ =>
      (∑ t ∈ missedRounds T d, η t) / (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t) +
        (∑' t : ℕ, b t) / (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa using hmiss.add (h1.const_div_atTop (∑' t : ℕ, b t))
  have hMratio : Tendsto (fun T : ℕ =>
      (∑ t ∈ MStar T d η, η t) / (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    apply squeeze_zero
    · intro T
      exact div_nonneg
        (Finset.sum_nonneg fun t ht =>
          (hη_pos t (Finset.mem_Icc.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp ht).1).1).le)
        (hS_nonneg T)
    · exact hMratio_le
    · exact hupper
  have hlog_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.log (K : ℝ) := by
    apply Real.log_nonneg
    exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ K by omega)
  have heta_part : ∀ T : ℕ,
      (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, (η t) ^ 2) ≤ ∑' t : ℕ, (η t) ^ 2 := by
    intro T
    exact heta_sq.sum_le_tsum (Finset.Icc 1 T) (fun t ht => sq_nonneg _)
  have hr_part : ∀ T : ℕ,
      (∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T) \ MStar T d η, (η t) ^ 2 * (d t : ℝ)) ≤
        ∑' t : ℕ, (η t) ^ 2 * (d t : ℝ) := by
    intro T
    exact h3.sum_le_tsum ((Finset.Icc 1 T) \ MStar T d η)
      (fun t ht => by positivity)
  let C0 : ℝ :=
    2 + 2 * Real.log K
      + (1 + Real.exp 2 / 2) * K * (∑' t : ℕ, (η t) ^ 2)
      + 4 * Real.exp 2 * K * (∑' t : ℕ, (η t) ^ 2 * (d t : ℝ))
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ C0 := by
    dsimp [C0]
    have hsquare_tsum : 0 ≤ ∑' t : ℕ, (η t) ^ 2 := tsum_nonneg fun t => sq_nonneg _
    have hr_tsum : 0 ≤ ∑' t : ℕ, (η t) ^ 2 * (d t : ℝ) :=
      tsum_nonneg fun t => by positivity
    positivity
  have hR_bound : ∀ T : ℕ,
      weightedExpReg μ T K hK η l E.a ≤ C0 + ∑ t ∈ MStar T d η, η t := by
    intro T
    rcases T with _ | T
    · simp [weightedExpReg, MStar, C0]
      exact hC0
    · calc
        weightedExpReg μ (T + 1) K hK η l E.a ≤
            2 + 2 * Real.log K
              + (1 + Real.exp 2 / 2) * K *
                (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (T + 1), (η t) ^ 2)
              + 4 * Real.exp 2 * K *
                (∑ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 (T + 1)) \ MStar (T + 1) d η,
                  (η t) ^ 2 * (d t : ℝ))
              + (∑ t ∈ MStar (T + 1) d η, η t) :=
          finite_bound (T + 1) (by omega)
        _ ≤ C0 + ∑ t ∈ MStar (T + 1) d η, η t := by
          dsimp [C0]
          gcongr
          · exact heta_part (T + 1)
          · exact hr_part (T + 1)
  have hRratio_le : ∀ T : ℕ,
      weightedExpReg μ T K hK η l E.a / (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t) ≤
        C0 / (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t) +
          (∑ t ∈ MStar T d η, η t) / (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t) := by
    intro T
    calc
      weightedExpReg μ T K hK η l E.a / (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t) ≤
          (C0 + ∑ t ∈ MStar T d η, η t) / (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hR_bound T) (hS_nonneg T)
      _ = C0 / (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t) +
          (∑ t ∈ MStar T d η, η t) / (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t) := by
        rw [add_div]
  have hRupper : Tendsto (fun T : ℕ =>
      C0 / (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t) +
        (∑ t ∈ MStar T d η, η t) / (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa using (h1.const_div_atTop C0).add hMratio
  have hR_lower : ∀ T : ℕ,
      -(∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t) ≤ weightedExpReg μ T K hK η l E.a := by
    intro T
    letI : Nonempty (Fin K) := ⟨⟨0, hK⟩⟩
    let ST : ℝ := ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t
    let F : Ω → ℝ := fun ω =>
      (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t * l t ω (E.a t ω)) -
        (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin K)).inf' Finset.univ_nonempty
          (fun i => ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t * l t ω i)
    change -ST ≤ ∫ ω, F ω ∂μ
    have hpoint : ∀ ω, -ST ≤ F ω := by
      intro ω
      have hactual : 0 ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t * l t ω (E.a t ω) := by
        apply Finset.sum_nonneg
        intro t ht
        exact mul_nonneg (hη_pos t (Finset.mem_Icc.mp ht).1).le
          (hl t (Finset.mem_Icc.mp ht).1 ω (E.a t ω)).1
      let i0 : Fin K := ⟨0, hK⟩
      have hcomp :
          (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin K)).inf' Finset.univ_nonempty
              (fun i => ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t * l t ω i) ≤ ST := by
        calc
          (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin K)).inf' Finset.univ_nonempty
              (fun i => ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t * l t ω i) ≤
              ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t * l t ω i0 :=
            Finset.inf'_le _ (Finset.mem_univ i0)
          _ ≤ ST := by
            dsimp [ST]
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum
            intro t ht
            simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
              (hl t (Finset.mem_Icc.mp ht).1 ω i0).2
              (hη_pos t (Finset.mem_Icc.mp ht).1).le
      dsimp [F]
      linarith
    by_cases hF : Integrable F μ
    · have hconst : Integrable (fun _ : Ω => -ST) μ := integrable_const _
      calc
        -ST = ∫ _ : Ω, -ST ∂μ := by simp
        _ ≤ ∫ ω, F ω ∂μ := integral_mono hconst hF hpoint
    · rw [integral_undef hF]
      exact neg_nonpos.mpr (hS_nonneg T)
  have hratio_lower : ∀ T : ℕ, (-1 : ℝ) ≤
      weightedExpReg μ T K hK η l E.a / (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t) := by
    intro T
    rcases T with _ | T
    · simp [weightedExpReg]
    · have hSTpos : 0 < ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (T + 1), η t := by
        apply Finset.sum_pos
        · intro t ht
          exact hη_pos t (Finset.mem_Icc.mp ht).1
        · exact ⟨1, by simp⟩
      calc
        (-1 : ℝ) = (-(∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (T + 1), η t)) /
            (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (T + 1), η t) := by field_simp
        _ ≤ weightedExpReg μ (T + 1) K hK η l E.a /
            (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (T + 1), η t) :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hR_lower (T + 1)) hSTpos.le
  have hRcobounded : IsCoboundedUnder (fun x₁ x₂ : ℝ => x₁ ≤ x₂) atTop
      (fun T : ℕ => weightedExpReg μ T K hK η l E.a /
        ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t) :=
    isCoboundedUnder_le_of_le atTop hratio_lower
  unfold NoWeightedRegret
  calc
    limsup (fun T : ℕ =>
        weightedExpReg μ T K hK η l E.a / ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t) atTop ≤
        limsup (fun T : ℕ =>
          C0 / (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t) +
            (∑ t ∈ MStar T d η, η t) / (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t)) atTop :=
      Filter.limsup_le_limsup (Eventually.of_forall hRratio_le) hRcobounded
        hRupper.isBoundedUnder_le
    _ = 0 := hRupper.limsup_eq

end ResearchLevel

targets.label: Theorem 3
targets.statement:
Theorem 3 (Regret bound for dual-stabilized OMD) Assume we have $\eta_{t}\geq \eta_{t + 1}>$ 0 for each $t > 1$ . Define $\gamma_{t}=\eta_{t+1}/\eta_{t}\in(0,1]$ for all $t \geq 1$ . Let $\{f_{t}\}_{t \ge 1}$ be a sequence of convex functions with $f_{t}\colon \mathcal{X}\to \mathbb{R}$ for each $t \geq 1$ . Let $\{x_{t}\}_{t \ge 1}$ and $\{\hat{w}_{t}\}_{t \ge 2}$ be as in Algorithm 2. Then, for all $T > 0$ and $z \in \mathcal{X}$ ,

$$
\mathrm{Regret}(T,z)\ \leq\ \sum_{t=1}^{T}\frac{D_{\Phi}\bigl({}_{x_{t+1}}^{x_{t}};w_{t+1}\bigr)}{\eta_{t}}+\frac{D_{\Phi}\bigl(z,x_{1}\bigr)}{\eta_{T+1}}.\tag{8}
$$

for all $z \in \mathcal{X}$ , the map $x\mapsto D_{\Phi}(z,x)$ is convex on $\mathcal{X}.$

(15)

Then for any sequence of convex functions $\{f_{t}\}_{t \ge 1}$ with each $f_{t}: \mathcal{X}\to \mathbb{R}$ ,

$$
\mathrm{Regret}(T,z)\ \leq\ \sum_{t=1}^{T}\frac{D_{\Phi}\big({}_{y_{t+1}}^{x_{t}};w_{t+1}\big)}{\eta_{t}}+\frac{D_{\Phi}\big(z,x_{1}\big)}{\eta_{T+1}}\quad\forall T>0 .\tag{16}

targets.label: Theorem 8
targets.statement:
Theorem 8 (Regret bound for dual averaging) Assume we have $\eta_{t}\geq \eta_{t + 1}> 0$ for each $t \geq 1$ . Let $\{x_{t}\}_{t \ge 1}$ be the sequence of iterates generated by Algorithm 4. Then for any sequence of convex functions $\{f_{t}\}_{t \ge 1}$ with each $f_{t}: \mathcal{X}\to \mathbb{R}$ ,

$$
\mathrm{Regret}(T,z)~\le~\sum_{t=1}^{T}\frac{D_{\Phi}\bigl({{}_{x_{t+1}}^{x_{t}};\nabla\Phi^{*}(\hat{x}_{t}-\eta_{t}\hat{g}_{t})\bigr)}}{\eta_{t}}+\frac{D_{\Phi}\bigl(z,x_{1}\bigr)}{\eta_{T+1}}~\forall T>0 .\tag{20}
$$

nl_proof:
### Proof of Theorem 3

Proof [of Theorem 3]

Let $z \in \mathcal{X}$ . The first step is the same as in the standard OMD proof.

$$
\begin{array}{r l l}
f_{t}(x_{t})-f_{t}(z)&\leq\ \langle\hat{g}_{t},x_{t}-z\rangle&\text{(subgradient ineq.)}\\
&=\ \frac{1}{\eta_{t}}\langle\hat{x}_{t}-\hat{w}_{t+1},x_{t}-z\rangle&\text{(by (5))}\\
&=\ \frac{1}{\eta_{t}}\big(D_{\Phi}(x_{t},w_{t+1})-D_{\Phi}(z,w_{t+1})+D_{\Phi}(z,x_{t})\big)&\text{(by Prop. 38).}
\end{array}\tag{9}
$$

The next step exhibits the main point of stabilization. Without stabilization, we would have $x_{t+1}=\Pi_{\mathcal{X}}^{\Phi}(w_{t+1})$ and $D_{\Phi}(z,w_{t+1})\geq D_{\Phi}(z,x_{t+1})+D_{\Phi}(x_{t+1},w_{t+1})$ by Proposition 40, so (9) would lead to a telescoping sum involving $D_{\Phi}(z,\cdot)$ if the learning rate were fixed. With a dynamic learning rate the analysis is trickier: we need a claim that leads to telescoping terms by relating $D_{\Phi}(z,w_{t+1})$ to $D_{\Phi}\big(z,x_{t+1}\big)$

Claim 4 Assume that $\gamma_{t}=\eta_{t+1}/\eta_{t}\in(0,1]$ . Then

$$
(9)~\le~\frac{D_{\Phi}\big({}_{x_{t+1}}^{x_{t}};w_{t+1}\big)}{\eta_{t}}+\underbrace{\Big(\frac{1}{\eta_{t+1}}-\frac{1}{\eta_{t}}\Big)}_{telescopes}D_{\Phi}(z,x_{1})+\underbrace{\frac{D_{\Phi}(z,x_{t})}{\eta_{t}}-\frac{D_{\Phi}(z,x_{t+1})}{\eta_{t+1}}}_{telescopes}.
$$

Proof First we derive the inequality

$$
\begin{array}{r l l}
&\gamma_{t}\big(D_{\Phi}(z,w_{t+1})-D_{\Phi}(x_{t+1},w_{t+1})\big)\ +\ (1-\gamma_{t})D_{\Phi}(z,x_{1})&\\
\ge&\gamma_{t}D_{\Phi}({}_{x_{t+1}}^{z};w_{t+1})\ +\ (1-\gamma_{t})D_{\Phi}({}_{x_{t+1}}^{z};x_{1})&\text{(since } D_{\Phi}(x_{t+1},x_{1})\ge 0 \text{ and }\gamma_{t}\le 1)\\
=&D_{\Phi}({}_{x_{t+1}}^{z};y_{t+1})&\text{(by Proposition 39 and (6))}\\
\ge&D_{\Phi}(z,x_{t+1})&\text{(by Proposition 40 and (7)).}
\end{array}
$$

Rearranging and using $\gamma_{t}> 0$ yields

$$
D_{\Phi}(z,w_{t+1})\ \geq\ D_{\Phi}(x_{t+1},w_{t+1})-\Big(\frac{1}{\gamma_{t}}-1\Big)D_{\Phi}(z,x_{1})+\frac{1}{\gamma_{t}}D_{\Phi}(z,x_{t+1}).\tag{10}
$$

Plugging this into (9) yields

$$
\begin{array}{r l r}{{(9)\ =\ \frac{1}{\eta_{t}}\Big(D_{\Phi}\big(x_{t},w_{t+1}\big)-D_{\Phi}\big(z,w_{t+1}\big)+D_{\Phi}\big(z,x_{t}\big)\Big)}}\\ &{}&\\ &{}&{\leq\ \frac{1}{\eta_{t}}\Bigg(D_{\Phi}\big(x_{t},w_{t+1}\big)-D_{\Phi}\big(x_{t+1},w_{t+1}\big)\ +}\\ &{}&\\ &{}&{\Big(\frac{1}{\gamma_{t}}-1\Big)D_{\Phi}\big(z,x_{1}\big)-\frac{1}{\gamma_{t}}D_{\Phi}\big(z,x_{t+1}\big)+D_{\Phi}\big(z,x_{t}\big)\Bigg).}\end{array}\tag{by (10)}
$$

The claim follows by the definition of $\gamma_{t}$

The final step is very similar to the standard OMD proof. Summing (9) over t and using Claim 4 leads to the desired telescoping sum.

$$
\begin{array}{r l}&{\displaystyle\sum_{t=1}^{T}\left(f_{t}(x_{t})-f_{t}(z)\right)}\\ {\le}&{\displaystyle\sum_{t=1}^{T}\left(\frac{D_{\Phi}\big({}_{x_{t+1}}^{x_{t}};w_{t+1}\big)}{\eta_{t}}+\Big(\frac{1}{\eta_{t+1}}-\frac{1}{\eta_{t}}\Big)D_{\Phi}(z,x_{1})+\frac{D_{\Phi}(z,x_{t})}{\eta_{t}}-\frac{D_{\Phi}(z,x_{t+1})}{\eta_{t+1}}\right)}\\ {\le}&{\displaystyle\sum_{t=1}^{T}\frac{D_{\Phi}\big({}_{x_{t+1}}^{x_{t}};w_{t+1}\big)}{\eta_{t}}+\Bigg(\frac{1}{\eta_{1}}+\sum_{t=1}^{T}\left(\frac{1}{\eta_{t+1}}-\frac{1}{\eta_{t}}\right)\Bigg)D_{\Phi}(z,x_{1})}\\ {=}&{\displaystyle\sum_{t=1}^{T}\frac{D_{\Phi}\big({}_{x_{t+1}}^{x_{t}};w_{t+1}\big)}{\eta_{t}}+\frac{D_{\Phi}(z,x_{1})}{\eta_{T+1}}.}\end{array}
$$

### Proof of Theorem 5

Let $z \in \mathcal{X}$ . The first step is identical to the proof of Theorem 3 since the update rule in (11) is exactly the same as (5). Therefore, we have that (9) holds, that is,

$$
f_{t}(x_{t})-f_{t}(z)\ \leq\ \frac{1}{\eta_{t}}\big(D_{\Phi}(x_{t},w_{t+1})-D_{\Phi}(z,w_{t+1})+D_{\Phi}(z,x_{t})\big).
$$

Now instead of Claim 4 we use the next claim, which is similar to Claim 4 but replaces $D_{\Phi}({}_{x_{t + 1}}^{x_{t}}; w_{t + 1})$ with $D_{\Phi}({}_{y_{t + 1}}^{x_{t}}; w_{t + 1})$.

Claim 6 Assume that $\gamma_{t}=\eta_{t+1}/\eta_{t}\in(0,1]$ . Then

$$
(9)~\le~\frac{D_{\Phi}\big({}_{y_{t+1}}^{x_{t}};w_{t+1}\big)}{\eta_{t}}+\underbrace{\Big(\frac{1}{\eta_{t+1}}-\frac{1}{\eta_{t}}\Big)}_{telescopes}D_{\Phi}(z,x_{1})+\underbrace{\frac{D_{\Phi}(z,x_{t})}{\eta_{t}}-\frac{D_{\Phi}(z,x_{t+1})}{\eta_{t+1}}}_{telescopes}.
$$

Proof First, we derive the inequality

$$
\begin{array}{r l r}&{\gamma_{t}\big(D_{\Phi}(z,w_{t+1})-D_{\Phi}(y_{t+1},w_{t+1})\big)+(1-\gamma_{t})D_{\Phi}(z,x_{1})}\\ {=}&{\gamma_{t}D_{\Phi}({}_{y_{t+1}}^{z};w_{t+1})+(1-\gamma_{t})D_{\Phi}(z,x_{1})}\\ {\geq}&{\gamma_{t}D_{\Phi}(z,y_{t+1})+(1-\gamma_{t})D_{\Phi}(z,x_{1})}&{\mathrm{~(by~Prop.~40~and~(13))}}\\ {\geq}&{D_{\Phi}(z,x_{t+1})}&{\mathrm{~(by~(14)~and~(15)).}}\end{array}
$$

Rearranging and using $\gamma_{t}> 0$ yields

$$
D_{\Phi}(z,w_{t+1})\ \ge\ D_{\Phi}\big(y_{t+1},w_{t+1}\big)-\Big(\frac{1}{\gamma_{t}}-1\Big)D_{\Phi}\big(z,x_{1}\big)+\frac{1}{\gamma_{t}}D_{\Phi}\big(z,x_{t+1}\big).\tag{17}
$$

Plugging this into (9) yields

$$
\begin{array}{r l r}{{(9)\ =\ \frac{1}{\eta_{t}}\Big(D_{\Phi}\big(x_{t},w_{t+1}\big)-D_{\Phi}\big(z,w_{t+1}\big)+D_{\Phi}\big(z,x_{t}\big)\Big)}}\\ &{}&{\quad\leq\ \frac{1}{\eta_{t}}\Bigg(D_{\Phi}\big(x_{t},w_{t+1}\big)-D_{\Phi}\big(y_{t+1},w_{t+1}\big)\ +\ }\\ &{}&{\qquad\Big(\frac{1}{\gamma_{t}}-1\Big)D_{\Phi}\big(z,x_{1}\big)-\frac{1}{\gamma_{t}}D_{\Phi}\big(z,x_{t+1}\big)+D_{\Phi}\big(z,x_{t}\big)\Bigg).}\end{array}\tag{by (17)}
$$

The claim follows by the definition of $\gamma_{t}$ .

The final step is very similar to the proof of Theorem 3. The only differences are that we are using Claim 6 instead of Claim 4 and that we replace $D_{\Phi}({}_{x_{t + 1}}^{x_{t}}; w_{t + 1})$ with $D_{\Phi}({}_{y_{t + 1}}^{x_{t}}; w_{t + 1})$ . Formally, summing (9) over t and using Claim 6 leads to the desired telescoping sum, that is,

$$
\begin{array}{r l}&{\sum_{t=1}^{T}\left(f_{t}(x_{t})-f_{t}(z)\right)}\\ {\leq}&{\sum_{t=1}^{T}\left(\frac{D_{\Phi}\big({}_{y_{t+1}}^{x_{t}};w_{t+1}\big)}{\eta_{t}}+\Big(\frac{1}{\eta_{t+1}}-\frac{1}{\eta_{t}}\Big)D_{\Phi}(z,x_{1})+\frac{D_{\Phi}(z,x_{t})}{\eta_{t}}-\frac{D_{\Phi}\big(z,x_{t+1}\big)}{\eta_{t+1}}\right)}\\ {\leq}&{\sum_{t=1}^{T}\frac{D_{\Phi}\big({}_{y_{t+1}}^{x_{t}};w_{t+1}\big)}{\eta_{t}}+\Bigg(\frac{1}{\eta_{1}}+\sum_{t=1}^{T}\left(\frac{1}{\eta_{t+1}}-\frac{1}{\eta_{t}}\right)\Bigg)D_{\Phi}(z,x_{1})}\\ {=}&{\sum_{t=1}^{T}\frac{D_{\Phi}\big({}_{y_{t+1}}^{x_{t}};w_{t+1}\big)}{\eta_{t}}+\frac{D_{\Phi}(z,x_{1})}{\eta_{T+1}}.}\end{array}
$$

### Proof of Theorem 8

Proof [of Theorem 8]

Let $z \in \mathcal{X}$ . The first step is very similar to the proof of Theorem 3.

$$
\begin{array}{r l l}
f_{t}(x_{t})-f_{t}(z)&\leq\ \langle\hat{g}_{t},x_{t}-z\rangle&\text{(subgradient ineq.)}\\
&=\ \frac{1}{\eta_{t}}\langle\hat{y}_{t}-\hat{w}_{t+1},x_{t}-z\rangle&\text{(by (18))}\\
&=\ \frac{1}{\eta_{t}}\Big(D_{\Phi}(x_{t},w_{t+1})-D_{\Phi}(z,w_{t+1})+D_{\Phi}\big({}_{x_{t}}^{z};y_{t}\big)\Big),
\end{array}\tag{21}
$$

where in the last equation we have used Proposition 37 instead of Proposition 38.

As in the proof of Theorem 3, the next step is to relate $D_{\Phi}(z,w_{t+1})$ to $D_{\Phi}({}_{x_{t + 1}}^{z}; y_{t + 1})$ so that (21) can be bounded using a telescoping sum. The following claim is similar to Claim 4.

Claim 9 Assume that $\gamma_{t}=\eta_{t+1}/\eta_{t}\in(0,1]$ . Then

$$
(21)~\le~\frac{D_{\Phi}\big({}_{x_{t+1}}^{x_{t}};w_{t+1}\big)}{\eta_{t}}+\underbrace{\left(\frac{1}{\eta_{t+1}}-\frac{1}{\eta_{t}}\right)}_{telescopes}D_{\Phi}(z,x_{1})+\underbrace{\frac{D_{\Phi}\big({}_{x_{t}}^{z};y_{t}\big)}{\eta_{t}}-\frac{D_{\Phi}\big({}_{x_{t+1}}^{z};y_{t+1}\big)}{\eta_{t+1}}}_{telescopes}.
$$

Proof The first two steps are identical to the proof of Claim 4.

$$
\begin{array}{r l}&{\gamma_{t}\big(D_{\Phi}(z,w_{t+1})-D_{\Phi}(x_{t+1},w_{t+1})\big)\ : +\ :(1-\gamma_{t})D_{\Phi}(z,x_{1})}\\ {\ge}&{\gamma_{t}D_{\Phi}\big({}_{x_{t+1}}^{z};w_{t+1}\big)\ : +\ :(1-\gamma_{t})D_{\Phi}\big({}_{x_{t+1}}^{z};x_{1}\big)\qquad\mathrm{(since~}D_{\Phi}(x_{t+1},x_{1})\ge 0\mathrm{~and~}\gamma_{t}\le 1\big)}\\ {=}&{D_{\Phi}\big({}_{x_{t+1}}^{z};y_{t+1}\big)\qquad\quad\mathrm{(by~Proposition~39~and~(19)).}}\end{array}
$$

Rearranging and using $\gamma_{t}> 0$ yields

$$
D_{\Phi}(z,w_{t+1})\ \ge\ D_{\Phi}(x_{t+1},w_{t+1})\ -\ \Big(\frac{1}{\gamma_{t}}-1\Big)D_{\Phi}(z,x_{1})\ +\ \frac{D_{\Phi}\big({}_{x_{t+1}}^{z};y_{t+1}\big)}{\gamma_{t}}.\tag{22}
$$

Plugging this into (21) yields

$$
\begin{array}{r c l}{(21)}&{=}&{\displaystyle\frac{1}{\eta_{t}}\Big(D_{\Phi}\big(x_{t},w_{t+1}\big)-D_{\Phi}\big(z,w_{t+1}\big)+D_{\Phi}\big({}_{x_{t}}^{z};y_{t}\big)\Big)}\\ &{\leq}&{\displaystyle\frac{1}{\eta_{t}}\Bigg(D_{\Phi}\big(x_{t},w_{t+1}\big)-D_{\Phi}\big(x_{t+1},w_{t+1}\big)+}\\ &&{\displaystyle\qquad\Big(\frac{1}{\gamma_{t}}-1\Big)D_{\Phi}\big(z,x_{1}\big)-\frac{D_{\Phi}\big({}_{x_{t+1}}^{z};y_{t+1}\big)}{\gamma_{t}}+D_{\Phi}\big({}_{x_{t}}^{z};y_{t}\big)\Bigg),}\end{array}\tag{by (22).}
$$

The claim follows by the definition of $\gamma_{t}$

Again the final step is very similar to the proof of Theorem 3. Summing (21) over t and using Claim 9 leads to the desired telescoping sum.

$$
\begin{array}{r l}&{\displaystyle\sum_{t=1}^{T}\left(f_{t}(x_{t})-f_{t}(z)\right)}\\ {\le}&{\displaystyle\sum_{t=1}^{T}\left(\frac{D_{\Phi}\big({}_{x_{t+1}}^{x_{t}};w_{t+1}\big)}{\eta_{t}}+\Big(\frac{1}{\eta_{t+1}}-\frac{1}{\eta_{t}}\Big)D_{\Phi}(z,x_{1})+\frac{D_{\Phi}\big({}_{x_{t}}^{z};y_{t}\big)}{\eta_{t}}-\frac{D_{\Phi}\big({}_{x_{t+1}}^{z};y_{t+1}\big)}{\eta_{t+1}}\right)}\\ {\le}&{\displaystyle\sum_{t=1}^{T}\frac{D_{\Phi}\big({}_{x_{t+1}}^{x_{t}};w_{t+1}\big)}{\eta_{t}}+\left(\frac{1}{\eta_{1}}+\displaystyle\sum_{t=1}^{T}\left(\frac{1}{\eta_{t+1}}-\frac{1}{\eta_{t}}\right)\right)D_{\Phi}(z,x_{1})}\\ {=}&{\displaystyle\sum_{t=1}^{T}\frac{D_{\Phi}\big({}_{x_{t+1}}^{x_{t}};w_{t+1}\big)}{\eta_{t}}+\frac{D_{\Phi}(z,x_{1})}{\eta_{T+1}},}\end{array}
$$

where for the second inequality we have also used that $D_{\Phi}({}_{x_{1}}^{z};y_{1})=D_{\Phi}(z,x_{1})$ since $x_{1}= y_{1}$ . Thus, the above shows that

$$
\mathrm{Regret}(T,z)\ \leq\ \sum_{t=1}^{T}\frac{D_{\Phi}\big({}_{x_{t+1}}^{x_{t}};w_{t+1}\big)}{\eta_{t}}+\frac{D_{\Phi}\big(z,x_{1}\big)}{\eta_{T+1}}\quad\forall T>0 .\tag{23}
$$

Notice that (23) is syntactically identical to (8); the only difference is the definition of $w_{t + 1}$ in these two settings. However, in this section the definition of $x_{t}$ has not yet been used! Doing so will provide an upper bound on (23), which is the conclusion of this theorem. To control $D_{\Phi}({}_{x_{t + 1}}^{x_{t}}; w_{t + 1})$ , we will apply Proposition 41 as follows. Taking $p = y_{t}$ , $\pi=x_{t}=\Pi_{\mathcal{X}}^{\Phi}(y_{t}),v=x_{t+1}$ and $\hat{q}= \eta_{t}g_{t}$ , we obtain

$$
\begin{array}{r l}{D_{\Phi}({}_{x_{t+1}}^{x_{t}};w_{t+1})=}&{-D_{\Phi}({}_{\pi}^{v};\nabla\Phi^{*}(\hat{p}-\hat{q}))\qquad\mathrm{(since~}\hat{w}_{t+1}=\hat{y}_{t}-\eta_{t}\hat{g}_{t}=\hat{p}-\hat{q})}\\ {\le}&{-D_{\Phi}({}_{\pi}^{v};\nabla\Phi^{*}(\hat{\pi}-\hat{q}))\qquad\mathrm{(by~Proposition~41)}}\\ {=}&{D_{\Phi}({}_{x_{t+1}}^{x_{t}};\nabla\Phi^{*}(\hat{x}_{t}-\eta_{t}\hat{g}_{t})).}\end{array}
$$

Plugging this into (23) completes the proof.

context.name: Setup: online convex optimization and regret (Section 3)
context.statement:
We consider the online convex optimization problem with unknown time horizon. For each time step $t\in\{1,2,\ldots\}$ the algorithm proposes a point $x_{t}$ from a closed convex set ${\mathcal{X}}\subseteq \mathbb{R}^{n}$ and an adversary simultaneously picks a convex cost function $f_{t}$ which the algorithm has access to via a first-order oracle, that is, for any $x \in \mathcal{X}$ the algorithm can compute $f_{t}(x)$ and a subgradient $\hat{g}\in\partial f_{t}(x): =\{\hat{g}\in\mathbb{R}^{n}\mid f_{t}(z)\geq f_{t}(x)+\langle\hat{g},z-x\rangle\forall z\in\mathcal{X}\}$ . We will assume1 that all cost functions $f_{t}$ in this text are subdifferentiable on $\mathcal{X}$ , that is, meaning that the subdifferential $\partial f_{t}(x)$ is non-empty for all $x \in \mathcal{X}$

The cost of the iteration at time t is defined as $f_{t}(x_{t})$ . In this setting the goal is to produce a sequence of proposals $\{x_{t}\}_{t \ge 1}$ that minimizes the regret against an unknown comparison point $z \in \mathcal{X}$ that has accrued up until time $T$:

$$
\mathrm{Regret}(T,z): =\ \sum_{t=1}^{T}f_{t}(x_{t})-\sum_{t=1}^{T}f_{t}(z).
$$

context.name: Standing assumptions on the mirror map Φ and hat notation (1) (Section 3)
context.statement:
Both dual averaging and online mirror descent are parameterized by a special convex function $\Phi,$ often referred as a regularizer or a mirror map (for D and X), which among other properties needs$^{2}$ to be of Legendre type (Rockafellar, 1970, Chapter 26). Formally, throughout the paper we assume that the function $\Phi\colon \bar{\mathcal{D}}\to \mathbb{R}$ is a closed convex function whose conjugate is differentiable on $\mathbb{R}^{n}$ and such that $\bar{\mathcal{D}}$ satisfies $\mathcal{X}\subseteq \bar{\mathcal{D}}$ and $\mathrm{int}\,\bar{\mathcal{D}}\cap \mathrm{ri}\,\mathcal{X}\neq \varnothing$ (where $\mathrm{ri}\,\mathcal{X}$ denotes the relative interior of $\mathcal{X}$). Moreover, we also suppose that $\Phi$ is of Legendre type, which means that $\Phi$ is strictly convex on its domain$^{3}$ and essentially smooth, that is, for $\mathcal{D}: =\mathrm{int}\bar{\mathcal{D}}$ we have

$\mathcal{D}$ is nonempty,

$\Phi$ is differentiable on $\mathcal{D}$, and

$\lim_{x\to\partial\mathcal{D}}\|\nabla\Phi(x)\|= +\infty$ , where ∂D is the boundary of $\mathcal{D},\mathrm{i.e.,}\partial\mathcal{D}: =\mathrm{cl}\mathcal{D}\backslash\mathcal{D}$

The gradient of the mirror map $\nabla \Phi :{\mathcal{D}}\to \mathbb{R}^{n}$ and the gradient of its conjugate $\nabla \Phi^{*}: \mathbb{R}^{n}\to \mathcal{D}$ are mutually inverse bijections between the primal space $\mathcal{D}$ and the dual space $\mathbb{R}^{n}$ . We will adopt the following notational convention. Any vector in the primal space will be written without a hat, such as $x \in \mathcal{D}$ . The same letter with a hat, namely $\hat{x}$, will denote the corresponding dual vector:

$$
{\hat{x}}: =\nabla\Phi(x)\qquad{\mathrm{and}}\qquad x: =\nabla\Phi^{*}({\hat{x}})\qquad{\mathrm{f o r~a l l~l e t t e r s~}}x .\tag{1}
$$

context.name: Essential smoothness and well-posedness of the Bregman projection (Section 3)
context.statement: Essential smoothness ensures not only that $\Phi$ is differentiable on the interior of its domain, but also that the slope of $\Phi$ increases arbitrarily fast near the boundary of its domain. The latter guarantees, at least intuitively, that the function is increasing near and in the direction of the boundary of its domain. This property is fundamental for mirror descent to be well-defined (although not essential for dual averaging) since it ensures that the Bregman projection onto $\mathcal{X}$ is attained by a point on $\mathcal{D}$ where Φ is differentiable (we give more details on this on Section 7), and uniqueness is a consequence of the strict convexity of Φ. Some mirror maps we shall look at are classical cases of the OCO literature such as the negative entropy $x \in \mathbb{R}_{+}^{n}\mapsto \sum_{i = 1}^{n} x_{i}\ln x_{i}$ and the squared 2-norm ${\frac{1}{2}}\|\cdot\|_{2}^{2}$ , and details on the reasons they are mirror maps can be found in the works of Shalev-Shwartz (2012); Bubeck (2011) and Bubeck (2015) (in particular, Bubeck, 2011, Section 5.2 discusses the properties of functions of Legendre type and why requiring the conjugate of the mirror map to be differentiable on the whole space is not necessary for mirror descent to be well-defined if one restricts the gradient steps in the dual space in some way).

context.name: Definition: Bregman divergence (2), difference notation (3) and Bregman projection
context.statement:
Given a mirror map $\Phi,$ the Bregman divergence with respect to $\Phi$ is defined as

$$
D_{\Phi}(x,y)\ : =\ \Phi(x)-\Phi(y)-\langle\nabla\Phi(y),x-y\rangle,\qquad\forall x\in\bar{\mathcal{D}},\forall y\in\mathcal{D}.\tag{2}
$$

Throughout this paper it will be convenient to use the notation

$$
D_{\Phi}({}_{b}^{a};c): =D_{\Phi}(a,c)-D_{\Phi}(b,c)=\Phi(a)-\Phi(b)-\langle\nabla\Phi(c),a-b\rangle .\tag{3}
$$

In the important special case where $\begin{array}{r}{\Phi(x)=\frac{1}{2}\|x\|_{2}^{2}}\end{array}$ , the Bregman divergence relates to the Euclidean distance, i.e., $\begin{array}{r}{D_{\Phi}(x,y)=\frac 12\|x-y\|_{2}^{2}}\end{array}$ When $\begin{array}{r}{\Phi(x)=\sum_{i=1}^{n}x_{i}\log x_{i}}\end{array}$ , the Bregman divergence becomes the generalized Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence. The projection operator induced by the Bregman divergence is $\Pi_{\mathcal{X}}^{\Phi}$ given by $\{\Pi_{\mathcal{X}}^{\Phi}\}(y): =\arg\min\{D_{\Phi}(x,y)\mid x\in\mathcal{X}\}$ for any $y \in \mathcal{X}\cap \mathcal{D}$

context.name: Algorithm 1: generic OMD / DA template
context.statement:
A general template for optimization in the mirror descent framework is shown in Algorithm 1. The two classical algorithms, online mirror descent and dual averaging, are incarnations of this, differing only in how the dual variable $\hat{y}_{t}$ is updated.

In this work, for a given initial point $x_{1}\in{\mathcal{X}}$ of the player, we are interested in the case when $\begin{array}{r}{\operatorname*{sup}_{z\in\mathcal{X}}D_{\Phi}(z,x_{1})}\end{array}$ is bounded, which still allows $\sup_{z,x\in{\mathcal{X}}}D_{\Phi}(z,x)$ to be unbounded. In fact, in the Euclidean setting $\begin{array}{r}{(\mathrm{i . e .,}\Phi=\frac{1}{2}\|\cdot\|_{2}^{2}),\operatorname*{sup}_{z\in\mathcal{X}}D_{\Phi}(z,x_{1})}\end{array}$ is bounded if and only if the diameter of X given by $\sup_{x,y\in\mathcal{X}}\frac{1}{2}\Vert x-y\Vert_{2}^{2}$ is also bounded. However, for a general mirror map $\Phi$, assuming $\begin{array}{r}{\operatorname*{sup}_{z\in\mathcal{X}}D_{\Phi}(z,x_{1})}\end{array}$ is bounded is strictly weaker than assuming $\scriptstyle\operatorname*{sup}_{x,y\in{\mathcal{X}}}D_{\Phi}(x,y)$ is bounded. This is the case for the well-known experts' problem, where Φ is the negative entropy, $D_{\Phi}$ is the KL-divergence, X is the unit simplex $\Delta_{n}: =\{p\in [0,1]^{n}:\textstyle\sum_{i=1}^{n}p_{i}=1\}$ , and $\begin{array}{r}{x_{1}: = \frac{1}{n}\vec{1},}\end{array}$ where $\vec{1}$ is the vector in $\mathbb{R}^{n}$ with entries all set to 1. In this case, we have $\sup_{z\in\mathcal{X}}D_{\Phi}(z,x_{1})\leq\ln n$ while $\begin{array}{r}{\operatorname*{sup}_{z,x\in\mathcal{X}}D_{\Phi}(z,x)= +\infty}\end{array}$ .

To conclude, throughout the paper we shall try to stick to the following naming convention: greek letters will denote scalars, lower-case roman letters will denote vectors, $\mathrm{e.g.},x,y$ ,and capital calligraphic letters shall denote sets, $\mathrm{e . g .}, \mathcal{X}, \mathcal{Y}$ . Any deviations from this convention (or the hat notation as in (1)) are intended to follow other conventions in the literature.

Algorithm 1 Pseudocode for both online mirror descent and dual averaging with adaptive   
learning rate given by $\eta_{t}$ on iteration t. These methods differ only in how the iterate $\hat{y}_{t + 1}$ is   
updated.   
Input: $x_{1}\in \mathcal{X}\cap \mathcal{D}, \eta : \mathbb{N}\to \mathbb{R}_{> 0}$   
for $t=1,2,\dots$ do   
Incur cost $f_{t}(x_{t})$ and receive $\hat{g}_{t}\in\partial f_{t}(x_{t})$   
$\hat{x}_{t}=\nabla\Phi(x_{t})$   
[OMD update] $\hat{y}_{t + 1}= \hat{x}_{t}- \eta_{t}\hat{g}_{t}$   
[DA update] $\begin{array}{r}{\hat{y}_{t + 1}= \hat{x}_{1}- \eta_{t}\sum_{i \leq t}\hat{g}_{i}}\end{array}$   
$\boldsymbol{y}_{t+1}=\nabla\Phi^{*}(\hat{\boldsymbol{y}}_{t+1})$   
$x_{t+1}=\Pi_{\mathcal{X}}^{\Phi}(y_{t+1})$   
end for

context.name: Algorithm 2: dual-stabilized OMD, eqs. (5)-(7)
context.statement:
Algorithm 2 Dual-stabilized OMD (DS-OMD). The parameters $\gamma_{t}$ control the amount of   
stabilization.   
Input: $x_{1}\in\mathcal{X}\cap\mathcal{D},\eta:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{R}_{+},\ \gamma:\mathbb{N}\to(0,1]$   
for $t=1,2,\dots$ do   
Incur cost $f_{t}(x_{t})$ and receive $\hat{g}_{t}\in\partial f_{t}(x_{t})$   
$\hat{x}_{t}=\nabla\Phi(x_{t})$ map primal iterate to dual space   
$\hat{w}_{t + 1}= \hat{x}_{t}- \eta_{t}\hat{g}_{t}$ gradient step in dual space (5)   
$\hat{y}_{t+1}=\gamma_{t}\hat{w}_{t+1}+(1-\gamma_{t})\hat{x}_{1}$ stabilization in dual space (6)   
$\boldsymbol{y}_{t+1}=\nabla\Phi^{*}(\hat{\boldsymbol{y}}_{t+1})$ map dual iterate to primal space   
$x_{t+1}=\Pi_{\mathcal{X}}^{\Phi}(y_{t+1})$ project onto feasible region (7)   
end for

context.name: Proposition 38 (generalized triangle inequality)
context.statement:
An immediate consequence is the "generalized triangle inequality for Bregman divergence", such as in Bubeck (2015, Eq. (4.1)) or in Beck and Teboulle (2003, Lemma 4.1).

Proposition 38 For all $a,b,d\in{\mathcal{D}}$

$$
D_{\Phi}(a,d)-D_{\Phi}(b,d)+D_{\Phi}(b,a)\ =\ \langle\hat{a}-\hat{d},a-b\rangle
$$

context.name: Proposition 39
context.statement:
Proposition 39 Let $a,b,c,u,v\in\mathbb{R}^{n}$ satisfy $\gamma\hat{a}+(1-\gamma)\hat{b}=\hat{c}$ for some $\gamma \in \mathbb{R}$ . Then

$$
\gamma D_{\Phi}({}_{v}^{u};a)\ : +\ :(1-\gamma)D_{\Phi}({}_{v}^{u};b)\ : =\ :D_{\Phi}({}_{v}^{u};c).
$$

context.name: Proposition 40 (Pythagorean theorem for Bregman divergence)
context.statement:
The following proposition is the "Pythagorean theorem for Bregman divergence". Recall that $\Pi_{\mathcal{X}}^{\Phi}(y)=\arg\operatorname*{min}_{u\in\mathcal{X}}D_{\Phi}(u,y)$ . A proof may be found in Bubeck (2015, Lemma 4.1).

Proposition 40 Let $\mathcal{X}\subset \mathbb{R}^{n}$ be a convex set. Let $p \in \mathbb{R}^{n}$ and $\pi=\Pi_{\mathcal{X}}^{\Phi}(p)$ . Then

$$
D_{\Phi}({}_{\pi}^{z};p)\geq D_{\Phi}({}_{\pi}^{z};\pi)=D_{\Phi}(z,\pi)\forall z\in\mathcal{X}.
$$

context.name: Algorithm 3: primal-stabilized OMD, eqs. (11)-(14)
context.statement:
Algorithm 3 Online mirror descent with primal stabilization.   
Input: $x_{1}\in \mathcal{X}\cap \mathcal{D}, \eta : \mathbb{N}\to \mathbb{R}, \gamma : \mathbb{N}\to \mathbb{R}.$   
for $t=1,2,\dots$ do   
Incur cost $f_{t}(x_{t})$ and receive $\hat{\boldsymbol g}_{t}\in\partial f_{t}(\boldsymbol x_{t})$   
$\hat{x}_{t}=\nabla\Phi(x_{t})$ map primal iterate to dual space   
$\hat{w}_{t + 1}= \hat{x}_{t}- \eta_{t}\hat{g}_{t}$ gradient step in dual space (11)   
$\boldsymbol{w}_{t+1}=\nabla\Phi^{*}(\hat{\boldsymbol{w}}_{t+1})$ map dual iterate to primal space (12)   
$y_{t+1}=\Pi_{\mathcal{X}}^{\Phi}(w_{t+1})$ project onto feasible region (13)   
$x_{t+1}=\gamma_{t}y_{t+1}+(1-\gamma_{t})x_{1}$ stabilization in primal space (14)   
end for

context.name: Setup: lazy gradient step (18), stabilization (19) and Claim 7 (Section 5.3)
context.statement:
In this section, we show that Nesterov's dual averaging algorithm can be obtained from a small modification to dual-stabilized online mirror descent. Furthermore, our proof of Theorem 3 can be adapted to analyze DA.

The main difference between DS-OMD and dual averaging is in the gradient step, as we now explain. In iteration t of DS-OMD, the gradient step in (5) is taken from $\hat{x}_{t}$ ,the dual counterpart of the iterate $x_{t}\colon$

$$
\mathrm{D S - O M D \ g r a d i e n t \ s t e p}: \quad \hat{w}_{t + 1}= \hat{x}_{t}- \eta_{t}\hat{g}_{t}.
$$

Suppose that the algorithm is modified so that the gradient step is taken from $\hat{y}_{t}$ , the dual point from iteration t before projection onto the feasible region. (Here $\hat{y}_{1}$ is defined to be $\hat{x}_{1}$.) The resulting gradient step is:

$$
\mathrm{L a z y ~ g r a d i e n t ~ s t e p}\colon \hat{w}_{t + 1}= \hat{y}_{t}- \eta_{t}\hat{g}_{t}.\tag{18}
$$

As before, we set

$$
\hat{y}_{t+1}~=~\gamma_{t}\hat{w}_{t+1}+(1-\gamma_{t})\hat{x}_{1}\tag{19}
$$

where $\gamma_{t}= \eta_{t + 1}/ \eta_{t}$ . Then a simple inductive proof yields the following claim.

Claim 7 $\hat{w}_{t}= \hat{x}_{1}- \eta_{t - 1}\sum_{i < t}\hat{g}_{i}$ and $\hat{y}_{t}= \hat{x}_{1}- \eta_{t}\sum_{i < t}\hat{g}_{i}$ for all $t > 1$.

Thus, the algorithm with the lazy gradient step can be written as in Algorithm 4. This is equivalent to Algorithm 1 with the DA update, except that $\eta_{t}$ in Algorithm 1 corresponds to $\eta_{t + 1}$ in Algorithm 4. In the next theorem we analyze DA with similar techniques to the ones used in Theorems 3 and 5.

context.name: Algorithm 4: dual averaging with re-indexed learning rate
context.statement:
Algorithm 4 Dual averaging with learning rate re-indexed as $\eta_{2}, \eta_{3}, \ldots$   
Input: $x_{1}\in\mathcal{X}\cap\mathcal{D},~\eta:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{R}_{+},~\gamma:\mathbb{N}\to(0,1]$   
$\hat{y}_{1}=\nabla\Phi(x_{1})$   
for $t=1,2,\dots$ do   
Incur cost $f_{t}(x_{t})$ and receive $\hat{g}_{t}\in\partial f_{t}(x_{t})$   
$\begin{array}{r}{\hat{y}_{t + 1}= \hat{x}_{1}- \eta_{t + 1}\sum_{i \leq t}\hat{g}_{i}}\end{array}$ dual averaging update   
$\boldsymbol{y}_{t+1}=\nabla\Phi^{*}(\hat{\boldsymbol{y}}_{t+1})$ map dual iterate to primal space   
$x_{t+1}=\Pi_{\mathcal{X}}^{\Phi}(y_{t+1})$ project onto feasible region   
end for

context.name: Proposition 36 (linearity of D_Φ(^a_b; p) in p̂)
context.statement:
Recall that in (3) we defined the notation

$$
D_{\Phi}({}_{b}^{a};c): =D_{\Phi}(a,c)-D_{\Phi}(b,c)=\Phi(a)-\Phi(b)-\langle\nabla\Phi(c),a-b\rangle .
$$

This has several useful properties, which we now discuss.

Proposition 36 $D_{\Phi}({}_{b}^{a}; p)$ is linear in $\hat{p}$. In particular,

$$
D_{\Phi}\big({}_{b}^{a};\nabla\Phi^{*}(\widehat{p}-\widehat{q})\big)\ =\ D_{\Phi}\big({}_{b}^{a};p\big)+\big\langle\widehat{q},a-b\big\rangle\qquad\forall\widehat{q}\in\mathbb{R}^{n}.
$$

context.name: Proposition 37
context.statement:
Proposition 37 For all $a,b,c,d\in\mathcal{D}$

$$
D_{\Phi}\big({}_{b}^{a};d\big)-D_{\Phi}\big({}_{b}^{a};c\big)=\langle\hat{c}-\hat{d},a-b\rangle=D_{\Phi}\big({}_{b}^{a};d\big)+D_{\Phi}\big({}_{a}^{b};c\big).
$$

context.name: Proposition 41
context.statement:
A generalization of the previous proposition can be obtained by using linearity.

Proposition 41 Let $\mathcal{X}\subset \mathbb{R}^{n}$ be a convex set. Let $p \in \mathbb{R}^{n}$ and $\pi=\Pi_{\mathcal{X}}^{\Phi}(p)$ . Then

$$
D_{\Phi}\big({}_{\pi}^{v};\nabla\Phi^{*}({\widehat{p}}-{\widehat{q}})\big)\ \geq\ D_{\Phi}\big({}_{\pi}^{v};\nabla\Phi^{*}({\widehat{\pi}}-{\widehat{q}})\big)\qquad\forall v\in\mathcal{X},{\widehat{q}}\in\mathbb{R}^{n}.
$$

context.name: Lemma 34 (basic properties of the mirror map and Bregman divergence)
context.statement:
The following lemma collects basic facts regarding the a mirror map Φ (or simply a function of Legendre type) and the Bregman divergence it induces. See Cesa-Bianchi and Lugosi (2006, Lemma 11.5 and Proposition 11.1).

Lemma 34 The mirror map $\Phi$ and the Bregman divergence it induces satisfy the following properties:

$D_{\Phi}(x,y)$ is convex in x.

$\nabla\Phi(\nabla\Phi^{*}(z))=z$ and $\nabla^{*}\Phi(\nabla\Phi(x))=x$ for all x and z.

$D_{\Phi}(x,y)=D_{\Phi^{*}}\bigl(\nabla\Phi(y),\nabla\Phi(x)\bigr)$ for all x and $y$

import Mathlib

open scoped RealInnerProductSpace BigOperators

namespace ResearchLevel

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]

noncomputable def bregman (Φ : E → ℝ) (gΦ : E → E) (x y : E) : ℝ :=
  Φ x - Φ y - (@inner ℝ E _ (gΦ y) (x - y))

noncomputable def regret (f : ℕ → E → ℝ) (x : ℕ → E) (z : E) (T : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, (f t (x t) - f t z)

structure PaperNorm (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] where
  nrm : E → ℝ
  nonneg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ nrm x
  eq_zero_iff : ∀ x, nrm x = 0 ↔ x = 0
  smul : ∀ (c : ℝ) (x : E), nrm (c • x) = |c| * nrm x
  triangle : ∀ x y, nrm (x + y) ≤ nrm x + nrm y

noncomputable def dualNorm (N : PaperNorm E) (z : E) : ℝ :=
  sSup {v : ℝ | ∃ x : E, N.nrm x ≤ 1 ∧ v = (@inner ℝ E _ z x)}

private lemma tele_sum (G : ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ) :
    ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, (G t - G (t+1)) = G 1 - G (T+1) := by
  induction T with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega : 1 ≤ n + 1), ih]; ring

private lemma sum_bound {a c : ℕ → ℝ} {G : ℕ → ℝ} {K : ℝ} {T : ℕ}
    (hstep : ∀ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, a t ≤ c t + (G t - G (t+1)))
    (hG1 : G 1 = 0) (hGT : -G (T+1) ≤ K) :
    ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, a t ≤ (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, c t) + K := by
  have h1 := Finset.sum_le_sum hstep
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, tele_sum, hG1] at h1
  linarith

noncomputable def dgap (Φ : E → ℝ) (a b d : E) : ℝ :=
  Φ a - Φ b - (@inner ℝ E _ d (a - b))

private lemma dgap_breg (Φ : E → ℝ) (gΦ : E → E) (a b c : E) :
    dgap Φ a b (gΦ c) = bregman Φ gΦ a c - bregman Φ gΦ b c := by
  simp only [dgap, bregman, inner_sub_right]; ring

private lemma dgap_self (Φ : E → ℝ) (gΦ : E → E) (a b : E) :
    dgap Φ a b (gΦ b) = bregman Φ gΦ a b := by
  simp only [dgap, bregman]

private lemma dgap_add (Φ : E → ℝ) (a b c d : E) :
    dgap Φ a b d + dgap Φ b c d = dgap Φ a c d := by
  simp only [dgap, inner_sub_right]; ring

private lemma dgap_mix (Φ : E → ℝ) (γ : ℝ) (a b d₁ d₂ : E) :
    γ * dgap Φ a b d₁ + (1 - γ) * dgap Φ a b d₂ = dgap Φ a b (γ • d₁ + (1 - γ) • d₂) := by
  simp only [dgap, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left]; ring

private lemma breg_step (Φ : E → ℝ) (gΦ : E → E) (xt z wv gt : E) (e : ℝ)
    (h : gΦ wv = gΦ xt - e • gt) :
    e * (@inner ℝ E _ gt (xt - z)) =
      bregman Φ gΦ xt wv - bregman Φ gΦ z wv + bregman Φ gΦ z xt := by
  simp only [bregman, h, inner_sub_left, inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_left]
  ring

private lemma breg_mix (Φ : E → ℝ) (gΦ : E → E) (γ : ℝ) (a b p q v : E)
    (h : gΦ v = γ • gΦ p + (1 - γ) • gΦ q) :
    γ * (bregman Φ gΦ a p - bregman Φ gΦ b p)
        + (1 - γ) * (bregman Φ gΦ a q - bregman Φ gΦ b q)
      = bregman Φ gΦ a v - bregman Φ gΦ b v := by
  simp only [bregman, h, inner_add_left, inner_sub_left, inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_left]
  ring

private lemma breg_nonneg (Φ : E → ℝ) (gΦ : E → E) (D X : Set E)
    (hΦsub : ∀ a ∈ D, ∀ b ∈ X, Φ b ≥ Φ a + (@inner ℝ E _ (gΦ a) (b - a)))
    {a b : E} (ha : a ∈ D) (hb : b ∈ X) : 0 ≤ bregman Φ gΦ b a := by
  have := hΦsub a ha b hb
  simp only [bregman]; linarith

    have hnnT : 0 ≤ bregman Φ gΦ z (x (T+1)) := breg_nonneg Φ gΦ D X hΦsub hxTD hz
    have h0 : 0 ≤ bregman Φ gΦ z (x (T+1)) / η (T+1) := div_nonneg hnnT (le_of_lt hbT)
    have e : -((bregman Φ gΦ z (x (T+1)) - bregman Φ gΦ z (x 1)) / η (T+1))
        = bregman Φ gΦ z (x 1) / η (T+1) - bregman Φ gΦ z (x (T+1)) / η (T+1) := by ring
    rw [e]; linarith

private lemma dgap_step (Φ : E → ℝ) (a b c : E) (yh gt : E) (e : ℝ) :
    e * (@inner ℝ E _ gt (b - a)) =
      dgap Φ a b yh - dgap Φ a c (yh - e • gt) - dgap Φ c b (yh - e • gt) := by
  simp only [dgap, inner_sub_left, inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_left]
  ring

theorem theorem8

    (hinv : ∀ v : E, gΦ (gΦs v) = v)
    (hinvD : ∀ a ∈ D, gΦs (gΦ a) = a)

    (hy1 : y 1 = x 1)

    (hyupdate : ∀ t, 1 ≤ t →

    (hxupdate : ∀ t, 1 ≤ t → x (t + 1) = proj (y (t + 1)))

    (hpyth : ∀ z ∈ X, ∀ v ∈ D,

    (T : ℕ) (hT : 1 ≤ T) (z : E) (hz : z ∈ X) :

    (G := fun t => (dgap Φ z (x t) (gΦ (y t)) - bregman Φ gΦ z (x 1)) / η t) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro t ht
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at ht

    have ha : 0 < η (s+1) := hηpos (s+1) (by omega)

    have ha' : η (s+1) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ha

      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos s with hs | hs

        linarith
    have hBd : dgap Φ (x (s+1+1)) (x (s+1)) (gΦ (gΦs (gΦ (x (s+1)) - η (s+1) • g (s+1))))
        ≤ dgap Φ (x (s+1+1)) (x (s+1)) (gΦ (y (s+1)) - η (s+1) • g (s+1)) := by
      have e2 : dgap Φ (x (s+1+1)) (x (s+1)) (gΦ (y (s+1)) - η (s+1) • g (s+1))

        simp only [dgap, hgw', inner_sub_left]; ring

    have hSsucc : (∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (s+1), g i) = (∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 s, g i) + g (s+1) :=
      Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega) _
    have hmixd : (η (s+1+1) / η (s+1)) • (gΦ (y (s+1)) - η (s+1) • g (s+1))

      rw [hyhat s, hyhat (s+1), hSsucc]
      match_scalars <;> (field_simp; try ring)
    have hnn : 0 ≤ bregman Φ gΦ (x (s+1+1)) (x 1) := breg_nonneg Φ gΦ D X hΦsub hx1D hxX
    have hdb := dgap_breg Φ gΦ z (x (s+1+1)) (x 1)

        (gΦ (y (s+1)) - η (s+1) • g (s+1)) (gΦ (x 1))
      rw [hmixd] at hmx
      have hpp : 0 ≤ (1 - η (s+1+1) / η (s+1)) * bregman Φ gΦ (x (s+1+1)) (x 1) :=
        mul_nonneg (by linarith) hnn
      nlinarith [hmx, hdb, hpp]
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hClaim (le_of_lt (inv_pos.mpr hbp))
    have he : ((η (s+1+1) / η (s+1))
            * dgap Φ z (x (s+1+1)) (gΦ (y (s+1)) - η (s+1) • g (s+1))
          + (1 - η (s+1+1) / η (s+1)) * bregman Φ gΦ z (x 1)) * (η (s+1+1))⁻¹
        = dgap Φ z (x (s+1+1)) (gΦ (y (s+1)) - η (s+1) • g (s+1)) * (η (s+1))⁻¹
          + bregman Φ gΦ z (x 1) * (η (s+1+1))⁻¹
          - bregman Φ gΦ z (x 1) * (η (s+1))⁻¹ := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [he] at hm
    have h3 := dgap_step Φ z (x (s+1)) (x (s+1+1)) (gΦ (y (s+1))) (g (s+1)) (η (s+1))
    have hs2 := hsub (s+1) (by omega) z hz
    have hI : (@inner ℝ E _ (g (s+1)) (x (s+1) - z))
        = (dgap Φ z (x (s+1)) (gΦ (y (s+1)))
            - dgap Φ z (x (s+1+1)) (gΦ (y (s+1)) - η (s+1) • g (s+1))
            - dgap Φ (x (s+1+1)) (x (s+1)) (gΦ (y (s+1)) - η (s+1) • g (s+1))) * (η (s+1))⁻¹ := by
      rw [← h3]; field_simp
    rw [hI] at hs2
    have hCd := dgap_breg Φ gΦ (x (s+1+1)) (x (s+1)) (gΦs (gΦ (x (s+1)) - η (s+1) • g (s+1)))
    have hBdmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hBd (le_of_lt (inv_pos.mpr ha))
    dsimp only
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
    rw [hCd] at hBdmul
    linarith [hs2, hm, hBdmul]
  · dsimp only
    rw [hy1, dgap_self]
    simp
  · dsimp only
    have hbT : 0 < η (T+1) := hηpos (T+1) (by omega)
    have hyTD : y (T+1) ∈ D := by rw [hyupdate T hT]; exact hgΦsD _
    have hxTD : x (T+1) ∈ D := by rw [hxupdate T hT]; exact hprojD _
    have hp := hpyth z hz (y (T+1)) hyTD

    have h0 : 0 ≤ dgap Φ z (x (T+1)) (gΦ (y (T+1))) / η (T+1) :=

    have e : -((dgap Φ z (x (T+1)) (gΦ (y (T+1))) - bregman Φ gΦ z (x 1)) / η (T+1))
        = bregman Φ gΦ z (x 1) / η (T+1) - dgap Φ z (x (T+1)) (gΦ (y (T+1))) / η (T+1) := by ring
