  have hpiece2 : ∀ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
      ∑ y : Bool, Real.sqrt (droW D r b (j, y) * droW D r (droFlip i b) (j, y)) = 1/(D:ℝ) := by
    intro j hj
    have hjne : j ≠ i := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1
    have : ∀ y : Bool, Real.sqrt (droW D r b (j, y) * droW D r (droFlip i b) (j, y)) = droW D r b (j,y) := by
      intro y
      have h2 : droW D r (droFlip i b) (j,y) = droW D r b (j,y) := by simp only [droW]; rw [droFlip_ne hjne]
      rw [h2]
      exact Real.sqrt_mul_self (le_of_lt (droW_pos hD hr hr0 b (j,y)))
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun y _ => this y)]
    simp only [droW, ← Finset.mul_sum, dro_sum_bool_if (b j)]
    ring
  rw [hpiece1, Finset.sum_congr rfl hpiece2]
  rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  have hcast : ((D - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (D:ℝ) - 1 := by
    have : (1:ℕ) ≤ D := hD
    push_cast [Nat.cast_sub this]
    ring
  simp only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, hcast]
  field_simp
  try ring

theorem droW_chi_sum {D : ℕ} {r : ℝ} (hD : 0 < D) (hr : r < 1) (hr0 : -1 < r)
    (b : Fin D → Bool) (i : Fin D) :
    ∑ v : Fin D × Bool, (droW D r (droFlip i b) v)^2/(droW D r b v)
      = (((D:ℝ)-1) + (1+3*r^2)/(1-r^2))/(D:ℝ) := by
  have hDpos : (0:ℝ) < D := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hD
  have hDne : (D:ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hDpos
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, ← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  have hpiece1 : ∑ y : Bool, (droW D r (droFlip i b) (i, y))^2/(droW D r b (i, y))
      = (1+3*r^2)/((1-r^2)*(D:ℝ)) := by
    have hval : ∀ y : Bool, (droW D r (droFlip i b) (i, y))^2/(droW D r b (i, y))
        = (1/(D:ℝ)) * ((if y = !(b i) then (1+r)/2 else (1-r)/2)^2
            / (if y = b i then (1+r)/2 else (1-r)/2)) := by
      intro y
      simp only [droW, droFlip, eq_self_iff_true, if_true]
      have hy : (0:ℝ) < (if y = b i then (1+r)/2 else (1-r)/2) := by
        by_cases h : y = b i <;> simp [h] <;> linarith
      field_simp
      try ring
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun y _ => hval y), ← Finset.mul_sum,
      dro_bool_chi (b i) ((1+r)/2) ((1-r)/2)]
    have h1 : (0:ℝ) < 1 + r := by linarith
    have h2 : (0:ℝ) < 1 - r := by linarith
    have h3 : (1:ℝ) - r^2 ≠ 0 := by nlinarith
    field_simp
    ring
  have hpiece2 : ∀ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
      ∑ y : Bool, (droW D r (droFlip i b) (j, y))^2/(droW D r b (j, y)) = 1/(D:ℝ) := by
    intro j hj
    have hjne : j ≠ i := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1
    have : ∀ y : Bool, (droW D r (droFlip i b) (j, y))^2/(droW D r b (j, y)) = droW D r b (j,y) := by
      intro y
      have h2 : droW D r (droFlip i b) (j,y) = droW D r b (j,y) := by simp only [droW]; rw [droFlip_ne hjne]
      rw [h2, sq, mul_div_assoc, div_self (ne_of_gt (droW_pos hD hr hr0 b (j,y))), mul_one]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun y _ => this y)]
    simp only [droW, ← Finset.mul_sum, dro_sum_bool_if (b j)]
    ring
  rw [hpiece1, Finset.sum_congr rfl hpiece2]
  rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  have hcast : ((D - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (D:ℝ) - 1 := by
    have h1 : (1:ℕ) ≤ D := hD
    push_cast [Nat.cast_sub h1]
    ring
  have hr2 : (0:ℝ) < 1 - r^2 := by nlinarith
  simp only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, hcast]
  field_simp
  try ring

/-! #### The hard family of distributions -/

/-- Embedding of the finite index set into the sample space. -/
def droG {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {D : ℕ} (c : Fin D → 𝒳) :
    Fin D × Bool → 𝒳 × Bool := fun v => (c v.1, v.2)

theorem droG_meas {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {D : ℕ} (c : Fin D → 𝒳) :
    Measurable (droG c) := by
  unfold droG
  measurability

/-- The finite measure on the index set. -/
noncomputable def droQ (D : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (b : Fin D → Bool) : Measure (Fin D × Bool) :=
  droMeas (fun v => ENNReal.ofReal (droW D r b v))

/-- The hard distribution associated with a labelling `b`. -/
noncomputable def droP {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {D : ℕ} (c : Fin D → 𝒳) (r : ℝ)
    (b : Fin D → Bool) : Measure (𝒳 × Bool) :=
  Measure.map (droG c) (droQ D r b)

theorem droQ_prob {D : ℕ} {r : ℝ} (hD : 0 < D) (hr : r < 1) (hr0 : -1 < r) (b : Fin D → Bool) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (droQ D r b) := by
  apply droMeas_prob
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun v _ => le_of_lt (droW_pos hD hr hr0 b v))]
  rw [droW_sum hD b]
  simp

theorem droP_prob {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {D : ℕ} {r : ℝ} (hD : 0 < D) (hr : r < 1)
    (hr0 : -1 < r) (c : Fin D → 𝒳) (b : Fin D → Bool) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (droP c r b) := by
  haveI := droQ_prob hD hr hr0 b
  exact Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (droG_meas c).aemeasurable

theorem dro_bool_err (β γ : Bool) (A B : ℝ) :
    (∑ y : Bool, if γ ≠ y then (if y = β then A else B) else 0) = (if γ ≠ β then A else B) := by
  cases β <;> cases γ <;> simp

theorem dro_sum_ite_card {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (P : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (A B : ℝ) :
    (∑ i, if P i then A else B)
      = ((Finset.univ.filter P).card : ℝ) * (A - B) + (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * B := by
  have h1 : ∀ i : ι, (if P i then A else B) = B + (if P i then (A - B) else 0) := by
    intro i; by_cases h : P i <;> simp [h]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => h1 i), Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_filter,
    Finset.sum_const, Finset.sum_const]
  simp [Finset.card_univ]
  ring

theorem droP_err {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {D : ℕ} {r : ℝ} (hD : 0 < D) (hr : r < 1)
    (hr0 : -1 < r) (c : Fin D → 𝒳) (b : Fin D → Bool) (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) :
    ((droP c r b) {z : 𝒳 × Bool | h.f z.1 ≠ z.2}).toReal
      = (1-r)/2 + r * ((Finset.univ.filter (fun i => h.f (c i) ≠ b i)).card : ℝ)/(D:ℝ) := by
  classical
  have hDpos : (0:ℝ) < D := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hD
  have hpre : (droG c) ⁻¹' {z : 𝒳 × Bool | h.f z.1 ≠ z.2}
      = {v : Fin D × Bool | h.f (c v.1) ≠ v.2} := by
    ext v; simp [droG]
  rw [droP, Measure.map_apply (droG_meas c) (meas_ne_set h), hpre, droQ,
    droMeas_apply _ {v : Fin D × Bool | h.f (c v.1) ≠ v.2}]
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun v _ => le_of_lt (droW_pos hD hr hr0 b v)),
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun v _ => le_of_lt (droW_pos hD hr hr0 b v)))]
  rw [Finset.sum_filter, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  have hin : ∀ i : Fin D, (∑ y : Bool, if (i, y) ∈ {v : Fin D × Bool | h.f (c v.1) ≠ v.2}
        then droW D r b (i, y) else 0)
      = (1/(D:ℝ)) * (if h.f (c i) ≠ b i then (1+r)/2 else (1-r)/2) := by
    intro i
    have hstep : ∀ y : Bool, (if (i, y) ∈ {v : Fin D × Bool | h.f (c v.1) ≠ v.2}
          then droW D r b (i, y) else 0)
        = (1/(D:ℝ)) * (if h.f (c i) ≠ y then (if y = b i then (1+r)/2 else (1-r)/2) else 0) := by
      intro y
      by_cases hy : h.f (c i) ≠ y
      · simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, hy, if_pos, droW]
        simp [hy]
      · simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, hy, if_neg, droW]
        simp [hy]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun y _ => hstep y), ← Finset.mul_sum,
      dro_bool_err (b i) (h.f (c i)) ((1+r)/2) ((1-r)/2)]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hin i), ← Finset.mul_sum,
    dro_sum_ite_card (fun i => h.f (c i) ≠ b i) ((1+r)/2) ((1-r)/2)]
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin]
  field_simp
  ring

/-- The number of points on which a predictor disagrees with the labelling `b`. -/
noncomputable def droN {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {D : ℕ} (c : Fin D → 𝒳)
    (b : Fin D → Bool) (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) : ℕ := by
  classical
  exact (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => h.f (c i) ≠ b i)).card

theorem droN_le {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {D : ℕ} (c : Fin D → 𝒳)
    (b : Fin D → Bool) (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) : droN c b h ≤ D := by
  classical
  simpa [droN] using (Finset.card_filter_le (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin D))
    (fun i => h.f (c i) ≠ b i)).trans_eq (by simp)

theorem droP_risk {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {D : ℕ} {r ρ : ℝ} (hD : 0 < D) (hr : r < 1)
    (hr0 : 0 < r) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ8 : ρ ≤ 8) (hcomp : (1+r)*(1+2*ρ) ≤ 2)
    (c : Fin D → 𝒳) (b : Fin D → Bool) (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) :
    robustRisk h (droP c r b) ρ = psi ρ ((1-r)/2 + r * (droN c b h : ℝ)/(D:ℝ)) := by
  classical
  have hDpos : (0:ℝ) < D := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hD
  haveI := droP_prob hD hr (by linarith) c b
  have hNle : ((droN c b h : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (D:ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.cast_le.mpr (droN_le c b h)
  have hNnn : (0:ℝ) ≤ ((droN c b h : ℕ) : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hrN : (0:ℝ) ≤ r * (droN c b h : ℝ)/(D:ℝ) := by positivity
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ (1-r)/2 + r * (droN c b h : ℝ)/(D:ℝ) := by linarith
  have hle : (1-r)/2 + r * (droN c b h : ℝ)/(D:ℝ) ≤ (1+r)/2 := by
    have : r * (droN c b h : ℝ)/(D:ℝ) ≤ r := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hDpos]
      nlinarith
    linarith
  have ha1 : ((1-r)/2 + r * (droN c b h : ℝ)/(D:ℝ)) * (1+2*ρ) ≤ 1 := by
    nlinarith [hle, hρ]
  refine robustRisk_eq h (droP c r b) hρ hρ8 ?_ ha0 ha1
  rw [droP_err hD hr (by linarith) c b h]
  simp [droN]

/-- Lower bound on the excess robust risk in terms of the number of mistakes. -/
theorem droP_excess {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {D : ℕ} {r ρ : ℝ} (hD : 0 < D) (hr : r < 1)
    (hr0 : 0 < r) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ8 : ρ ≤ 8) (hcomp : (1+r)*(1+2*ρ) ≤ 2)
    (c : Fin D → 𝒳) (b : Fin D → Bool) (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) :
    psi ρ ((1-r)/2) + r * (droN c b h : ℝ)/(D:ℝ) ≤ robustRisk h (droP c r b) ρ := by
  classical
  have hDpos : (0:ℝ) < D := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hD
  have hNle : ((droN c b h : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (D:ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.cast_le.mpr (droN_le c b h)
  have hNnn : (0:ℝ) ≤ ((droN c b h : ℕ) : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hstep : r * (droN c b h : ℝ)/(D:ℝ) ≤ r := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hDpos]; nlinarith
  rw [droP_risk hD hr hr0 hρ hρ8 hcomp c b h]
  have := psi_mono (ρ := ρ) (a₀ := (1-r)/2) (a := (1-r)/2 + r * (droN c b h : ℝ)/(D:ℝ))
    (le_of_lt hρ) (by linarith) (by nlinarith [(by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ r * (droN c b h : ℝ)/(D:ℝ))])
    (by linarith)
  linarith

theorem droP_inf_le {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool} {D : ℕ}
    {r ρ : ℝ} (hD : 0 < D) (hr : r < 1) (hr0 : 0 < r) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ8 : ρ ≤ 8)
    (hcomp : (1+r)*(1+2*ρ) ≤ 2) (c : Fin D → 𝒳) (b : Fin D → Bool)
    (hb : ∃ h ∈ H, ∀ i, h.f (c i) = b i) :
    (⨅ h : ↥H, robustRisk (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (droP c r b) ρ) ≤ psi ρ ((1-r)/2) := by
  classical
  have hDpos : (0:ℝ) < D := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hD
  obtain ⟨h0, hh0, hh0f⟩ := hb
  have hrisk : ∀ h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool, robustRisk h (droP c r b) ρ
      = psi ρ ((1-r)/2 + r * (droN c b h : ℝ)/(D:ℝ)) :=
    fun h => droP_risk hD hr hr0 hρ hρ8 hcomp c b h
  have hbdd : BddBelow (Set.range fun h : ↥H =>
      robustRisk (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (droP c r b) ρ) := by
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨h, rfl⟩
    simp only []
    rw [hrisk]
    refine psi_nonneg ?_
    have : (0:ℝ) ≤ r * (droN c b (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) : ℝ)/(D:ℝ) := by positivity
    linarith
  have hci := ciInf_le hbdd (⟨h0, hh0⟩ : ↥H)
  refine le_trans hci (le_of_eq ?_)
  rw [hrisk]
  have hN0 : droN c b h0 = 0 := by
    simp only [droN, Finset.card_eq_zero, Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff]
    intro i _
    simp [hh0f i]
  rw [hN0]
  norm_num

theorem droP_bad {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool} {D : ℕ}
    {r ρ ε : ℝ} (hD : 0 < D) (hr : r < 1) (hr0 : 0 < r) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ8 : ρ ≤ 8)
    (hcomp : (1+r)*(1+2*ρ) ≤ 2) (c : Fin D → 𝒳) (b : Fin D → Bool)
    (hb : ∃ h ∈ H, ∀ i, h.f (c i) = b i) (g : Predictor 𝒳 Bool)
    (hlt : ε < r * (droN c b g : ℝ)/(D:ℝ)) :
    (⨅ h : ↥H, robustRisk (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (droP c r b) ρ) + ε
      < robustRisk g (droP c r b) ρ := by
  have h1 := droP_inf_le hD hr hr0 hρ hρ8 hcomp c b hb
  have h2 := droP_excess hD hr hr0 hρ hρ8 hcomp c b g
  linarith

theorem dro_transfer {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {D m : ℕ} {r δ : ℝ} (hD : 0 < D)
    (hr : r < 1) (hr0 : -1 < r) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (c : Fin D → 𝒳) (b : Fin D → Bool)
    (E : Set (Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool))
    (hPAC : (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => droP c r b) E ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ)
    (T : Finset (Fin m → Fin D × Bool))
    (hT : ∀ S ∈ T, (fun k => droG c (S k)) ∈ E) :
    ∑ S ∈ T, ∏ k, droW D r b (S k) ≤ δ := by
  haveI := droQ_prob hD hr hr0 b
  have key := dro_discrete_lb (droQ D r b) (droG c) (droG_meas c) m E T hT
  rw [← droP] at key
  have h2 : ∑ S ∈ T, ∏ k, (droQ D r b) {S k} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ := le_trans key hPAC
  have h3 : ∀ S : Fin m → Fin D × Bool,
      (∏ k, (droQ D r b) {S k}) = ENNReal.ofReal (∏ k, droW D r b (S k)) := by
    intro S
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_prod_of_nonneg (fun k _ => le_of_lt (droW_pos hD hr hr0 b (S k)))]
    exact Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun k _ => by rw [droQ, droMeas_singleton])
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun S _ => h3 S),
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg
      (fun S _ => Finset.prod_nonneg (fun k _ => le_of_lt (droW_pos hD hr hr0 b (S k))))] at h2
  exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff hδ).mp h2

/-- From the PAC guarantee at sample size `m`, the probability (computed in the finite model)
that the algorithm makes more than `εD/r` mistakes on the `D` shattered points is at most `δ`. -/
theorem dro_master {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool} {D m : ℕ}
    {r ρ ε δ : ℝ} (hD : 0 < D) (hr : r < 1) (hr0 : 0 < r) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ8 : ρ ≤ 8)
    (hcomp : (1+r)*(1+2*ρ) ≤ 2) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (c : Fin D → 𝒳)
    (hshat : ∀ b : Fin D → Bool, ∃ h ∈ H, ∀ i, h.f (c i) = b i)
    (A : (Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool) → Predictor 𝒳 Bool)
    (hA : ∀ (P : Measure (𝒳 × Bool)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P],
        (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P)
          {S : Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool |
            (⨅ h : ↥H, robustRisk (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) P ρ) + ε < robustRisk (A S) P ρ}
          ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ) (b : Fin D → Bool) :
    ∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun S : Fin m → Fin D × Bool =>
        ε < r * (droN c b (A (fun k => droG c (S k))) : ℝ)/(D:ℝ)),
      ∏ k, droW D r b (S k) ≤ δ := by
  classical
  haveI := droP_prob hD hr (by linarith) c b
  refine dro_transfer hD hr (by linarith) hδ c b _ (hA (droP c r b)) _ ?_
  intro S hS
  have hlt : ε < r * (droN c b (A (fun k => droG c (S k))) : ℝ)/(D:ℝ) :=
    (Finset.mem_filter.mp hS).2
  exact droP_bad hD hr hr0 hρ hρ8 hcomp c b (hshat b) _ hlt

theorem dro_pair_split {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (F₁ F₂ : Ω → ℝ) (P : Ω → Prop)
    [DecidablePred P] :
    ∑ S, min (F₁ S) (F₂ S)
      ≤ (∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.filter P, F₁ S)
        + ∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun S => ¬ P S), F₂ S := by
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not Finset.univ P (fun S => min (F₁ S) (F₂ S))]
  gcongr with S hS S hS
  · exact min_le_left _ _
  · exact min_le_right _ _

theorem droN_fin_one {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (c : Fin 1 → 𝒳) (b : Fin 1 → Bool)
    (g : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) :
    ((droN c b g : ℕ) : ℝ) = if g.f (c 0) ≠ b 0 then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  simp only [droN]
  rw [show (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1)) = {0} from rfl, Finset.filter_singleton]
  by_cases hh : g.f (c 0) ≠ b 0 <;> simp [hh]

theorem droFlip_fin_one (b : Fin 1 → Bool) (j : Fin 1) : droFlip 0 b j = !(b j) := by
  simp [droFlip, Subsingleton.elim j 0]

/-- **Part 1 of the lower bound**: two-point argument. -/
theorem dro_part1 {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool} {m : ℕ}
    {r ρ ε δ : ℝ} (hr : r < 1) (hr0 : 0 < r) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ8 : ρ ≤ 8)
    (hcomp : (1+r)*(1+2*ρ) ≤ 2) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεr : ε < r) (x : 𝒳)
    (hshat : ∀ y : Bool, ∃ h ∈ H, h.f x = y)
    (hPAC : AgnosticPACAtSize H ρ ε δ m) :
    (1/4) * (1-r^2)^m ≤ δ := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := hPAC
  set c : Fin 1 → 𝒳 := fun _ => x with hc
  have hc0 : c 0 = x := rfl
  set bt : Fin 1 → Bool := fun _ => true with hbt
  set bf : Fin 1 → Bool := fun _ => false with hbf
  have hshat' : ∀ b : Fin 1 → Bool, ∃ h ∈ H, ∀ i, h.f (c i) = b i := by
    intro b
    obtain ⟨h, hh, hf⟩ := hshat (b 0)
    exact ⟨h, hh, fun i => by rw [Subsingleton.elim i 0]; exact hf⟩
  have h1 := dro_master (D := 1) (by norm_num) hr hr0 hρ hρ8 hcomp hδ c hshat' A hA bt
  have h2 := dro_master (D := 1) (by norm_num) hr hr0 hρ hρ8 hcomp hδ c hshat' A hA bf
  have hfilt : ∀ (b : Fin 1 → Bool) (S : Fin m → Fin 1 × Bool),
      (ε < r * (droN c b (A (fun k => droG c (S k))) : ℝ)/((1:ℕ):ℝ))
        ↔ ((A (fun k => droG c (S k))).f x ≠ b 0) := by
    intro b S
    rw [droN_fin_one, hc0]
    by_cases hh : (A (fun k => droG c (S k))).f x ≠ b 0
    · rw [if_pos hh]
      constructor
      · intro _; exact hh
      · intro _; push_cast; rw [mul_one, div_one]; exact hεr
    · rw [if_neg hh]
      constructor
      · intro hcon; exfalso; rw [mul_zero, zero_div] at hcon; linarith
      · intro hcon; exact absurd hcon hh
  rw [Finset.filter_congr (fun S _ => by rw [hfilt bt S])] at h1
  rw [Finset.filter_congr (fun S _ => by rw [hfilt bf S])] at h2
  have hsplit := dro_pair_split (Ω := Fin m → Fin 1 × Bool)
    (fun S => ∏ k, droW 1 r bt (S k)) (fun S => ∏ k, droW 1 r bf (S k))
    (fun S => (A (fun k => droG c (S k))).f x ≠ bt 0)
  have hcongr : (Finset.univ.filter
        (fun S : Fin m → Fin 1 × Bool => ¬ ((A (fun k => droG c (S k))).f x ≠ bt 0)))
      = Finset.univ.filter
        (fun S : Fin m → Fin 1 × Bool => (A (fun k => droG c (S k))).f x ≠ bf 0) := by
    apply Finset.filter_congr
    intro S _
    show ¬ ((A (fun k => droG c (S k))).f x ≠ true) ↔ ((A (fun k => droG c (S k))).f x ≠ false)
    cases hv : (A (fun k => droG c (S k))).f x <;> simp
  rw [hcongr] at hsplit
  have hsum : ∑ S : Fin m → Fin 1 × Bool,
      min (∏ k, droW 1 r bt (S k)) (∏ k, droW 1 r bf (S k)) ≤ 2 * δ := by
    refine le_trans hsplit ?_
    linarith
  have hfl : droFlip 0 bt = bf := by
    funext j; rw [droFlip_fin_one]; simp [hbt, hbf]
  have hsq := droW_sqrt_sum (D := 1) (r := r) (by norm_num) hr (by linarith) bt 0
  rw [hfl] at hsq
  norm_num at hsq
  have hpm := dro_prodmin_1 m (droW 1 r bt) (droW 1 r bf)
    (fun w => le_of_lt (droW_pos (by norm_num) hr (by linarith) bt w))
    (fun w => le_of_lt (droW_pos (by norm_num) hr (by linarith) bf w))
    (droW_sum (by norm_num) bt) (droW_sum (by norm_num) bf)
  rw [hsq] at hpm
  have hpow : ((Real.sqrt (1-r^2))^m)^2 = (1-r^2)^m := by
    rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm, pow_mul, Real.sq_sqrt (by nlinarith)]
  rw [hpow] at hpm
  linarith

theorem dro_pairing {D : ℕ} (Q : (Fin D → Bool) → ℝ) (i : Fin D) (μ2 : ℝ)
    (hpair : ∀ b, μ2 ≤ Q b + Q (droFlip i b)) :
    (2:ℝ)^D * μ2 ≤ 2 * ∑ b : Fin D → Bool, Q b := by
  classical
  have hbij : ∑ b : Fin D → Bool, Q (droFlip i b) = ∑ b : Fin D → Bool, Q b := by
    refine Fintype.sum_equiv ((droFlip_inv i).toPerm) _ _ (fun b => ?_)
    rfl
  have hsum : ∑ b : Fin D → Bool, (Q b + Q (droFlip i b)) = 2 * ∑ b : Fin D → Bool, Q b := by
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, hbij]; ring
  have hlb : ∑ b : Fin D → Bool, μ2 ≤ ∑ b : Fin D → Bool, (Q b + Q (droFlip i b)) :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b _ => hpair b)
  rw [Finset.sum_const, hsum] at hlb
  simpa [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fun] using hlb

theorem droFlip_self {D : ℕ} (i : Fin D) (b : Fin D → Bool) : droFlip i b i = !(b i) := by
  simp [droFlip]

theorem dro_index_bound {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {D m : ℕ} {r : ℝ} (hD : 0 < D)
    (hr : r < 1) (hr0 : 0 < r) (G : (Fin m → Fin D × Bool) → Predictor 𝒳 Bool)
    (c : Fin D → 𝒳) (i : Fin D) :
    (2:ℝ)^D * (1 - (1/2) * Real.sqrt (((((D:ℝ)-1) + (1+3*r^2)/(1-r^2))/(D:ℝ))^m - 1))
      ≤ 2 * ∑ b : Fin D → Bool,
          ∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun S => (G S).f (c i) ≠ b i), ∏ k, droW D r b (S k) := by
  classical
  refine dro_pairing _ i _ (fun b => ?_)
  have hsplit := dro_pair_split (Ω := Fin m → Fin D × Bool)
    (fun S => ∏ k, droW D r b (S k)) (fun S => ∏ k, droW D r (droFlip i b) (S k))
    (fun S => (G S).f (c i) ≠ b i)
  have hcongr : (Finset.univ.filter
        (fun S : Fin m → Fin D × Bool => ¬ ((G S).f (c i) ≠ b i)))
      = Finset.univ.filter
        (fun S : Fin m → Fin D × Bool => (G S).f (c i) ≠ (droFlip i b) i) := by
    apply Finset.filter_congr
    intro S _
    rw [droFlip_self]
    cases hv : (G S).f (c i) <;> cases hb : b i <;> simp
  rw [hcongr] at hsplit
  have hpm := dro_prodmin_2 m (droW D r b) (droW D r (droFlip i b))
    (fun w => droW_pos hD hr (by linarith) b w)
    (fun w => le_of_lt (droW_pos hD hr (by linarith) (droFlip i b) w))
    (droW_sum hD b) (droW_sum hD (droFlip i b))
  rw [droW_chi_sum hD hr (by linarith) b i] at hpm
  linarith

theorem droN_eq_sum {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {D : ℕ} (c : Fin D → 𝒳)
    (b : Fin D → Bool) (g : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) :
    ((droN c b g : ℕ) : ℝ) = ∑ i, (if g.f (c i) ≠ b i then (1:ℝ) else 0) := by
  classical
  simp only [droN, Finset.card_filter]
  push_cast
  simp

theorem dro_sumN {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {D m : ℕ} {r : ℝ} (c : Fin D → 𝒳)
    (b : Fin D → Bool) (G : (Fin m → Fin D × Bool) → Predictor 𝒳 Bool) :
    ∑ i, (∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun S => (G S).f (c i) ≠ b i), ∏ k, droW D r b (S k))
      = ∑ S : Fin m → Fin D × Bool, (∏ k, droW D r b (S k)) * (droN c b (G S) : ℝ) := by
  classical
  have h1 : ∀ S : Fin m → Fin D × Bool, (∏ k, droW D r b (S k)) * (droN c b (G S) : ℝ)
      = ∑ i, (if (G S).f (c i) ≠ b i then (∏ k, droW D r b (S k)) else 0) := by
    intro S
    rw [droN_eq_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    by_cases hh : (G S).f (c i) ≠ b i <;> simp [hh]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun S _ => h1 S), Finset.sum_comm]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_filter _ _)

end Helpers

section Helpers2

open scoped ENNReal
open Finset

/-- Expected number of mistakes on the shattered set, under the PAC guarantee. -/
theorem dro_expected_mistakes {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool}
    {D m : ℕ} {r ρ ε δ : ℝ} (hD : 0 < D) (hr : r < 1) (hr0 : 0 < r) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ8 : ρ ≤ 8)
    (hcomp : (1+r)*(1+2*ρ) ≤ 2) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (c : Fin D → 𝒳)
    (hshat : ∀ b : Fin D → Bool, ∃ h ∈ H, ∀ i, h.f (c i) = b i)
    (A : (Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool) → Predictor 𝒳 Bool)
    (hA : ∀ (P : Measure (𝒳 × Bool)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P],
        (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P)
          {S : Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool |
            (⨅ h : ↥H, robustRisk (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) P ρ) + ε < robustRisk (A S) P ρ}
          ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ) (b : Fin D → Bool) :
    ∑ S : Fin m → Fin D × Bool, (∏ k, droW D r b (S k))
        * (droN c b (A (fun k => droG c (S k))) : ℝ)
      ≤ (D:ℝ)*(ε/r) + (D:ℝ)*δ := by
  classical
  have hDpos : (0:ℝ) < D := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hD
  have hwnn : ∀ S : Fin m → Fin D × Bool, 0 ≤ ∏ k, droW D r b (S k) :=
    fun S => Finset.prod_nonneg (fun k _ => le_of_lt (droW_pos hD hr (by linarith) b (S k)))
  have hwsum : ∑ S : Fin m → Fin D × Bool, (∏ k, droW D r b (S k)) = 1 := by
    rw [dro_sum_prod_pow, droW_sum hD, one_pow]
  have hmaster := dro_master hD hr hr0 hρ hρ8 hcomp hδ c hshat A hA b
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not Finset.univ
      (fun S : Fin m → Fin D × Bool =>
        ε < r * (droN c b (A (fun k => droG c (S k))) : ℝ)/(D:ℝ))]
  have h1 : ∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.filter
      (fun S : Fin m → Fin D × Bool =>
        ε < r * (droN c b (A (fun k => droG c (S k))) : ℝ)/(D:ℝ)),
      (∏ k, droW D r b (S k)) * (droN c b (A (fun k => droG c (S k))) : ℝ) ≤ (D:ℝ)*δ := by
    have hstep : ∀ S ∈ Finset.univ.filter
        (fun S : Fin m → Fin D × Bool =>
          ε < r * (droN c b (A (fun k => droG c (S k))) : ℝ)/(D:ℝ)),
        (∏ k, droW D r b (S k)) * (droN c b (A (fun k => droG c (S k))) : ℝ)
          ≤ (∏ k, droW D r b (S k)) * (D:ℝ) := by
      intro S _
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (hwnn S)
      exact_mod_cast Nat.cast_le.mpr (droN_le c b _)
    refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum hstep) ?_
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
    calc (∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.filter
            (fun S : Fin m → Fin D × Bool =>
              ε < r * (droN c b (A (fun k => droG c (S k))) : ℝ)/(D:ℝ)),
            ∏ k, droW D r b (S k)) * (D:ℝ)
        ≤ δ * (D:ℝ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmaster (le_of_lt hDpos)
      _ = (D:ℝ)*δ := by ring
  have h2 : ∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.filter
      (fun S : Fin m → Fin D × Bool =>
        ¬ (ε < r * (droN c b (A (fun k => droG c (S k))) : ℝ)/(D:ℝ))),
      (∏ k, droW D r b (S k)) * (droN c b (A (fun k => droG c (S k))) : ℝ)
        ≤ (D:ℝ)*(ε/r) := by
    have hstep : ∀ S ∈ Finset.univ.filter
        (fun S : Fin m → Fin D × Bool =>
          ¬ (ε < r * (droN c b (A (fun k => droG c (S k))) : ℝ)/(D:ℝ))),
        (∏ k, droW D r b (S k)) * (droN c b (A (fun k => droG c (S k))) : ℝ)
          ≤ (∏ k, droW D r b (S k)) * ((D:ℝ)*(ε/r)) := by
      intro S hS
      have hcon := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hS).2
      push_neg at hcon
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (hwnn S)
      have h3 : r * (droN c b (A (fun k => droG c (S k))) : ℝ) ≤ ε * (D:ℝ) :=
        (div_le_iff₀ hDpos).mp hcon
      rw [show (D:ℝ)*(ε/r) = ε*(D:ℝ)/r by ring, le_div_iff₀ hr0]
      nlinarith [h3]
    refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum hstep) ?_
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
    have hle1 : (∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.filter
        (fun S : Fin m → Fin D × Bool =>
          ¬ (ε < r * (droN c b (A (fun k => droG c (S k))) : ℝ)/(D:ℝ))),
        ∏ k, droW D r b (S k)) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [← hwsum]
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
        (fun S _ _ => hwnn S)
    have hnn : (0:ℝ) ≤ (D:ℝ)*(ε/r) := by positivity
    have hX0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.filter
        (fun S : Fin m → Fin D × Bool =>
          ¬ (ε < r * (droN c b (A (fun k => droG c (S k))) : ℝ)/(D:ℝ))),
        ∏ k, droW D r b (S k)) := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun S _ => hwnn S)
    nlinarith [hle1, hnn, hX0]
  linarith

/-- **Part 2 of the lower bound**: the `d`-dependent term, via Assouad-type pairing. -/
theorem dro_part2 {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool}
    {D m : ℕ} {r ρ ε δ : ℝ} (hD : 0 < D) (hr : r < 1) (hr0 : 0 < r) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ8 : ρ ≤ 8)
    (hcomp : (1+r)*(1+2*ρ) ≤ 2) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (c : Fin D → 𝒳)
    (hshat : ∀ b : Fin D → Bool, ∃ h ∈ H, ∀ i, h.f (c i) = b i)
    (hPAC : AgnosticPACAtSize H ρ ε δ m) :
    (1:ℝ) - (1/2) * Real.sqrt (((((D:ℝ)-1) + (1+3*r^2)/(1-r^2))/(D:ℝ))^m - 1)
      ≤ 2*(ε/r + δ) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := hPAC
  have hDpos : (0:ℝ) < D := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hD
  set K : ℝ := (1:ℝ) - (1/2) * Real.sqrt (((((D:ℝ)-1) + (1+3*r^2)/(1-r^2))/(D:ℝ))^m - 1)
    with hKdef
  have hidx : ∀ i : Fin D, (2:ℝ)^D * K ≤ 2 * ∑ b : Fin D → Bool,
      ∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.filter
        (fun S : Fin m → Fin D × Bool => (A (fun k => droG c (S k))).f (c i) ≠ b i),
        ∏ k, droW D r b (S k) :=
    fun i => dro_index_bound hD hr hr0 (fun S => A (fun k => droG c (S k))) c i
  have hsum1 := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i (_ : i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin D))) => hidx i)
  rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul] at hsum1
  have hswap : ∑ i : Fin D, (2 * ∑ b : Fin D → Bool,
      ∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.filter
        (fun S : Fin m → Fin D × Bool => (A (fun k => droG c (S k))).f (c i) ≠ b i),
        ∏ k, droW D r b (S k))
      = 2 * ∑ b : Fin D → Bool, ∑ S : Fin m → Fin D × Bool,
          (∏ k, droW D r b (S k)) * (droN c b (A (fun k => droG c (S k))) : ℝ) := by
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_comm]
    congr 1
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl
      (fun b _ => dro_sumN c b (fun S => A (fun k => droG c (S k))))
  rw [hswap] at hsum1
  have hbnd : ∑ b : Fin D → Bool, ∑ S : Fin m → Fin D × Bool,
      (∏ k, droW D r b (S k)) * (droN c b (A (fun k => droG c (S k))) : ℝ)
      ≤ (2:ℝ)^D * ((D:ℝ)*(ε/r) + (D:ℝ)*δ) := by
    have hstep := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b (_ : b ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin D → Bool))) =>
      dro_expected_mistakes hD hr hr0 hρ hρ8 hcomp hδ hε c hshat A hA b)
    refine le_trans hstep (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
    congr 1
    simp [Fintype.card_fun]
  have hfin : (D:ℝ) * ((2:ℝ)^D * K) ≤ 2 * ((2:ℝ)^D * ((D:ℝ)*(ε/r) + (D:ℝ)*δ)) := by
    refine le_trans hsum1 ?_
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbnd (by norm_num)
  have hp : (0:ℝ) < (D:ℝ) * (2:ℝ)^D := by positivity
  rw [hKdef] at *
  nlinarith [hfin, hp, hDpos]

section Helpers3

open scoped ENNReal
open Finset

theorem dro_sqrt2_sq : (Real.sqrt 2)^2 = 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)

theorem dro_sqrt2_pos : (0:ℝ) < Real.sqrt 2 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num)

theorem dro_sqrt2_lt : Real.sqrt 2 < 1.4143 := by
  nlinarith [dro_sqrt2_sq, dro_sqrt2_pos]

theorem dro_sqrt2_gt : (1.414:ℝ) < Real.sqrt 2 := by
  nlinarith [dro_sqrt2_sq, dro_sqrt2_pos]

/-- The `d/ε²` lower bound. -/
theorem dro_lb_d {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool}
    {D m : ℕ} {ρ ε δ : ℝ} (hD : 0 < D) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ' : ρ < (3 - 2*Real.sqrt 2)/2)
    (hε0 : 0 < ε) (hε : ε < 1/(8*Real.sqrt 2)) (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ : δ < 1/8)
    (c : Fin D → 𝒳)
    (hshat : ∀ b : Fin D → Bool, ∃ h ∈ H, ∀ i, h.f (c i) = b i)
    (hPAC : AgnosticPACAtSize H ρ ε δ m) :
    (D:ℝ) ≤ 1024 * m * ε^2 := by
  have hs2 := dro_sqrt2_sq
  have hs0 := dro_sqrt2_pos
  have hslt := dro_sqrt2_lt
  have hsgt := dro_sqrt2_gt
  have hDpos : (0:ℝ) < D := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hD
  have hrw : (1:ℝ)/(8*Real.sqrt 2) = Real.sqrt 2/16 := by
    rw [div_eq_div_iff (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
    nlinarith [hs2]
  rw [hrw] at hε
  have hεb : 8*ε < Real.sqrt 2 / 2 := by linarith
  have hε2 : ε^2 < 1/128 := by nlinarith [hεb, hε0, hs2]
  set r : ℝ := 8*ε with hrdef
  have hr0 : 0 < r := by simp [hrdef]; linarith
  have hr : r < 1 := by rw [hrdef]; linarith
  have hrsq : r^2 = 64*ε^2 := by rw [hrdef]; ring
  have hr2 : r^2 < 1/2 := by rw [hrsq]; linarith
  have hρ8 : ρ ≤ 8 := by linarith
  have hcomp : (1+r)*(1+2*ρ) ≤ 2 := by
    have h1 : 1 + 2*ρ < 4 - 2*Real.sqrt 2 := by linarith
    have h2 : 1 + r < 1 + Real.sqrt 2/2 := by linarith
    have h3 : (0:ℝ) < 1 + 2*ρ := by linarith
    have h4 : (0:ℝ) < 1 + Real.sqrt 2/2 := by linarith
    nlinarith [h1, h2, h3, h4, hs2]
  have hkey := dro_part2 hD hr hr0 hρ hρ8 hcomp (le_of_lt hδ0) (le_of_lt hε0) c hshat hPAC
  have hεr : ε / r = 1/8 := by rw [hrdef]; field_simp
  rw [hεr] at hkey
  -- Hence the square root exceeds 1
  have hsq1 : (1:ℝ) < Real.sqrt (((((D:ℝ)-1) + (1+3*r^2)/(1-r^2))/(D:ℝ))^m - 1) := by
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    linarith
  have hbig : (2:ℝ) < ((((D:ℝ)-1) + (1+3*r^2)/(1-r^2))/(D:ℝ))^m := by
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have : Real.sqrt (((((D:ℝ)-1) + (1+3*r^2)/(1-r^2))/(D:ℝ))^m - 1) ≤ Real.sqrt 1 :=
      Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
    rw [Real.sqrt_one] at this
    linarith
  -- Compare the base with 1 + 512 ε² / D
  have hone : (0:ℝ) < 1 - r^2 := by linarith
  have hbase_nn : (0:ℝ) ≤ ((((D:ℝ)-1) + (1+3*r^2)/(1-r^2))/(D:ℝ)) := by
    have hD1 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (D:ℝ) - 1 := by
      have : (1:ℕ) ≤ D := hD
      have := Nat.one_le_cast (α := ℝ) |>.mpr this
      linarith
    have : (0:ℝ) ≤ (1+3*r^2)/(1-r^2) := by positivity
    positivity
  have hbase_le : ((((D:ℝ)-1) + (1+3*r^2)/(1-r^2))/(D:ℝ)) ≤ 1 + 512*ε^2/(D:ℝ) := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hDpos]
    have hfrac : (1+3*r^2)/(1-r^2) ≤ 1 + 512*ε^2 := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hone, hrsq]
      nlinarith [hε2, hε0, sq_nonneg ε]
    have : (1 + 512*ε^2/(D:ℝ)) * (D:ℝ) = (D:ℝ) + 512*ε^2 := by field_simp
    rw [this]
    linarith
  have hpow : ((((D:ℝ)-1) + (1+3*r^2)/(1-r^2))/(D:ℝ))^m ≤ (1 + 512*ε^2/(D:ℝ))^m :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ hbase_nn hbase_le m
  have hgt2 : (2:ℝ) < (1 + 512*ε^2/(D:ℝ))^m := lt_of_lt_of_le hbig hpow
  have hxpos : (0:ℝ) < 512*ε^2/(D:ℝ) := by positivity
  have hlog : Real.log 2 ≤ (m:ℝ) * Real.log (1 + 512*ε^2/(D:ℝ)) := by
    have h1 : Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log ((1 + 512*ε^2/(D:ℝ))^m) :=
      Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) (le_of_lt hgt2)
    rwa [Real.log_pow] at h1
  have hlog2 : Real.log (1 + 512*ε^2/(D:ℝ)) ≤ 512*ε^2/(D:ℝ) := by
    have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (show (0:ℝ) < 1 + 512*ε^2/(D:ℝ) by linarith)
    linarith
  have hmnn : (0:ℝ) ≤ (m:ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg m
  have hfinal : (1:ℝ)/2 < (m:ℝ) * (512*ε^2/(D:ℝ)) := by
    have hl2 := Real.log_two_gt_d9
    have h5 : (m:ℝ) * Real.log (1 + 512*ε^2/(D:ℝ)) ≤ (m:ℝ) * (512*ε^2/(D:ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog2 hmnn
    linarith
  rw [mul_div_assoc'] at hfinal
  rw [lt_div_iff₀ hDpos] at hfinal
  linarith

theorem dro_delta_num {m : ℕ} {ε δ : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 < ε) (hε2 : ε^2 < 1/128)
    (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ : δ < 1/8) (hp1 : (1/4) * (1-(8*ε)^2)^m ≤ δ) :
    Real.log (1/δ) ≤ 384 * m * ε^2 := by
  set y : ℝ := 64*ε^2 with hydef
  have hy0 : 0 < y := by rw [hydef]; positivity
  have hy2 : y < 1/2 := by rw [hydef]; linarith
  have hpowle : (1-y)^m ≤ 4*δ := by
    have h0 : (8*ε)^2 = y := by rw [hydef]; ring
    rw [h0] at hp1
    linarith
  have hexpb : Real.exp (-(2*y)) ≤ 1 - y := by
    have h1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (1-y)*(1+2*y) := by nlinarith
    have h2 : (1+2*y) ≤ Real.exp (2*y) := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (2*y)]
    have h4 : Real.exp (-(2*y)) * Real.exp (2*y) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
    have h5 : (1-y)*(1+2*y) ≤ (1-y)*Real.exp (2*y) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (by linarith)
    have h6 : Real.exp (-(2*y)) * Real.exp (2*y) ≤ (1-y)*Real.exp (2*y) := by
      rw [h4]; linarith
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right h6 (Real.exp_pos (2*y))
  have hexppow : Real.exp (-(2*y)*(m:ℝ)) ≤ 4*δ := by
    have h6 : (Real.exp (-(2*y)))^m ≤ (1-y)^m :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _)) hexpb m
    have h7 : (Real.exp (-(2*y)))^m = Real.exp (-(2*y)*(m:ℝ)) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]; ring_nf
    rw [h7] at h6
    linarith
  have hlogle : -(2*y)*(m:ℝ) ≤ Real.log (4*δ) := by
    have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos (-(2*y)*(m:ℝ))) hexppow
    rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
  have hsplit : Real.log (4*δ) = Real.log 4 + Real.log δ :=
    Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (ne_of_gt hδ0)
  have hinv : Real.log (1/δ) = -Real.log δ := by
    rw [one_div, Real.log_inv]
  have hlog4 : Real.log 4 = 2 * Real.log 2 := by
    rw [show (4:ℝ) = 2^2 by norm_num, Real.log_pow]; norm_num
  have hlog8 : Real.log 8 = 3 * Real.log 2 := by
    rw [show (8:ℝ) = 2^3 by norm_num, Real.log_pow]; norm_num
  have h8lt : Real.log 8 < Real.log (1/δ) := by
    refine Real.log_lt_log (by norm_num) ?_
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ hδ0]; linarith
  rw [hlog8] at h8lt
  have hgoal : Real.log (1/δ) ≤ Real.log 4 + 2*y*(m:ℝ) := by
    rw [hsplit] at hlogle
    rw [hinv]
    linarith
  rw [hlog4, hydef] at hgoal
  linarith

/-- The `log(1/δ)/ε²` lower bound. -/
theorem dro_lb_delta {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool}
    {m : ℕ} {ρ ε δ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ' : ρ < (3 - 2*Real.sqrt 2)/2)
    (hε0 : 0 < ε) (hε : ε < 1/(8*Real.sqrt 2)) (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ : δ < 1/8)
    (x : 𝒳) (hshat : ∀ y : Bool, ∃ h ∈ H, h.f x = y)
    (hPAC : AgnosticPACAtSize H ρ ε δ m) :
    Real.log (1/δ) ≤ 384 * m * ε^2 := by
  have hs2 := dro_sqrt2_sq
  have hs0 := dro_sqrt2_pos
  have hslt := dro_sqrt2_lt
  have hsgt := dro_sqrt2_gt
  have hrw : (1:ℝ)/(8*Real.sqrt 2) = Real.sqrt 2/16 := by
    rw [div_eq_div_iff (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
    nlinarith [hs2]
  rw [hrw] at hε
  have hεb : 8*ε < Real.sqrt 2 / 2 := by linarith
  have hε2 : ε^2 < 1/128 := by nlinarith [hεb, hε0, hs2]
  have hr0 : (0:ℝ) < 8*ε := by linarith
  have hr : (8*ε) < 1 := by linarith
  have hρ8 : ρ ≤ 8 := by linarith
  have hcomp : (1+8*ε)*(1+2*ρ) ≤ 2 := by
    have h1 : 1 + 2*ρ < 4 - 2*Real.sqrt 2 := by linarith
    have h2 : 1 + 8*ε < 1 + Real.sqrt 2/2 := by linarith
    have h3 : (0:ℝ) < 1 + 2*ρ := by linarith
    have h4 : (0:ℝ) < 1 + Real.sqrt 2/2 := by linarith
    nlinarith [h1, h2, h3, h4, hs2]
  have hεr : ε < 8*ε := by linarith
  have hp1 := dro_part1 hr hr0 hρ hρ8 hcomp (le_of_lt hδ0) hε0 hεr x hshat hPAC
  exact dro_delta_num hε0 hε2 hδ0 hδ hp1

end Helpers3
section Helpers4

open scoped ENNReal

/-- If the VC dimension equals `d > 0`, some set of exactly `d` points is shattered. -/
theorem vc_shattered {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool)
    {d : ℕ} (hvc : VCDim H = (d:ℕ∞)) (hd : 0 < d) :
    ∃ c : Fin d → 𝒳, ∀ b : Fin d → Bool, ∃ h ∈ H, ∀ i, h.f (c i) = b i := by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ S : Finset 𝒳, Shatters H S ∧ S.card = d := by
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have hle : VCDim H ≤ ((d-1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
      refine iSup_le (fun S => iSup_le (fun hS => ?_))
      have hcard_le : (S.card : ℕ∞) ≤ (d : ℕ∞) := by
        rw [← hvc]
        exact le_iSup₂ (f := fun (S : Finset 𝒳) (_ : Shatters H S) => (S.card : ℕ∞)) S hS
      have h1 : S.card ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hcard_le
      have hne : S.card ≠ d := hcon S hS
      have h2 : S.card ≤ d - 1 := by omega
      exact_mod_cast Nat.cast_le.mpr h2
    rw [hvc] at hle
    have : d ≤ d - 1 := by exact_mod_cast hle
    omega
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hcard⟩ := hex
  let e : ↥S ≃ Fin d := S.equivFinOfCardEq hcard
  refine ⟨fun i => ((e.symm i : ↥S) : 𝒳), fun b => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨h, hh, hf⟩ := hS (fun x => b (e x))
  refine ⟨h, hh, fun i => ?_⟩
  have := hf (e.symm i)
  simpa using this

/-- Turning a bound valid for every admissible sample size into a bound on `n`. -/
theorem sample_complexity_lb {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool)
    (ρ ε δ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (L : ℝ)
    (hle : agnosticSampleComplexity H ρ ε δ ≤ (n : ℕ∞))
    (hbound : ∀ m : ℕ, AgnosticPACAtSize H ρ ε δ m → L ≤ (m:ℝ)) : L ≤ (n:ℝ) := by
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  have hlb : ((n+1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ agnosticSampleComplexity H ρ ε δ := by
    refine le_sInf ?_
    rintro x ⟨m, rfl, hm⟩
    have hLm := hbound m hm
    have hnm : n < m := by
      have : (n:ℝ) < (m:ℝ) := lt_of_lt_of_le hcon hLm
      exact_mod_cast this
    exact_mod_cast Nat.cast_le.mpr (by omega : n+1 ≤ m)
  have h2 : ((n+1:ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ (n : ℕ∞) := le_trans hlb hle
  have h3 : n+1 ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast h2
  omega

end Helpers4

/-! ### Reduction of the upper bounds to ordinary finite-VC learning

The robust-risk arguments below are independent of the statistical learning theorem.
They isolate the sole remaining issue as an ordinary finite-VC PAC theorem with the
same outer-measure convention as `Measure` uses on arbitrary sets.
-/

namespace Upper

noncomputable def ordinaryError {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳]
    (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (P : Measure (𝒳 × Bool)) : ℝ :=
  (P {z : 𝒳 × Bool | h.f z.1 ≠ z.2}).toReal

lemma error_correct_sum_one {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳]
    (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (P : Measure (𝒳 × Bool)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P] :
    ordinaryError h P + (P {z : 𝒳 × Bool | h.f z.1 = z.2}).toReal = 1 := by
  have hsum := measure_add_measure_compl (μ := P) (meas_ne_set h)
  have hc : {z : 𝒳 × Bool | h.f z.1 = z.2} =
      {z : 𝒳 × Bool | h.f z.1 ≠ z.2}ᶜ := by
    ext z
    simp
  rw [hc]
  have h1 : P {z : 𝒳 × Bool | h.f z.1 ≠ z.2} ≠ ⊤ := measure_ne_top _ _
  have h2 : P ({z : 𝒳 × Bool | h.f z.1 ≠ z.2}ᶜ) ≠ ⊤ := measure_ne_top _ _
  have h3 := congrArg ENNReal.toReal hsum
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_add h1 h2] at h3
  simpa [ordinaryError] using h3

lemma c2_ge_one (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) : 1 ≤ c2 ρ := by
  rw [c2]
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + 2 * ρ)
  have hn := Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 + 2 * ρ)
  nlinarith

lemma c2_gt_one (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) : 1 < c2 ρ := by
  exact one_lt_c2 hρ

lemma zero_mem_etaDomain (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) : 0 ∈ etaDomain ρ := by
  by_cases hρ0 : ρ = 0
  · simp [etaDomain, hρ0]
  · have hp : 0 < ρ := lt_of_le_of_ne hρ (Ne.symm hρ0)
    have hc : 0 < c2 ρ - 1 := sub_pos.mpr (c2_gt_one ρ hp)
    simp only [etaDomain, if_neg hρ0, Set.mem_Icc]
    constructor
    · have : 0 ≤ 1 / (c2 ρ - 1) := one_div_nonneg.mpr hc.le
      linarith
    · norm_num

lemma eta_le_one (ρ : ℝ) (η : etaDomain ρ) : (η : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
  by_cases hρ0 : ρ = 0
  · simpa [etaDomain, hρ0] using η.property
  · exact (by simpa [etaDomain, hρ0] using η.property :
        -(1 / (c2 ρ - 1)) ≤ (η : ℝ) ∧ (η : ℝ) ≤ 1).2

lemma eta_lower {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (η : etaDomain ρ) :
    -(1 / (c2 ρ - 1)) ≤ (η : ℝ) := by
  exact (by simpa [etaDomain, ne_of_gt hρ] using η.property :
    -(1 / (c2 ρ - 1)) ≤ (η : ℝ) ∧ (η : ℝ) ≤ 1).1

lemma scalar_rms_add_eta_ge (p q η c : ℝ)
    (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hpq : p + q = 1) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (hη : η ≤ 1) :
    p ≤ c * Real.sqrt
          (p * (max (1 - η) 0) ^ 2 + q * (max (0 - η) 0) ^ 2) + η := by
  have hp1 : p ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hsqrt_nonneg :
      0 ≤ Real.sqrt (p * (max (1 - η) 0) ^ 2 + q * (max (0 - η) 0) ^ 2) :=
    Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hc_mul :
      Real.sqrt (p * (max (1 - η) 0) ^ 2 + q * (max (0 - η) 0) ^ 2) ≤
        c * Real.sqrt (p * (max (1 - η) 0) ^ 2 + q * (max (0 - η) 0) ^ 2) := by
    nlinarith
  suffices p ≤ Real.sqrt
        (p * (max (1 - η) 0) ^ 2 + q * (max (0 - η) 0) ^ 2) + η by
    linarith
  by_cases hη0 : 0 ≤ η
  · rw [max_eq_left (sub_nonneg.mpr hη), max_eq_right (by linarith)]
    by_cases hpη : p ≤ η
    · linarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (p * (1 - η) ^ 2 + q * 0 ^ 2)]
    · have hηp : η ≤ p := le_of_not_ge hpη
      have hηsq : η ^ 2 ≤ p := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (p - η)]
      have hsquare : (p - η) ^ 2 ≤ p * (1 - η) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hp1) (sub_nonneg.mpr hηsq)]
      have hsqrt : p - η ≤ Real.sqrt (p * (1 - η) ^ 2 + q * 0 ^ 2) := by
        rw [Real.le_sqrt (by linarith) (by positivity)]
        simpa using hsquare
      linarith
  · have hηneg : η < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hη0
    rw [max_eq_left (by linarith), max_eq_left (by linarith)]
    have hsquare : (p - η) ^ 2 ≤ p * (1 - η) ^ 2 + q * (0 - η) ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hp (by linarith : 0 ≤ 1 - p)]
    have hsqrt : p - η ≤ Real.sqrt (p * (1 - η) ^ 2 + q * (0 - η) ^ 2) := by
      rw [Real.le_sqrt (by linarith) (by positivity)]
      exact hsquare
    linarith

lemma robustRisk_ge_error {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳]
    (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (P : Measure (𝒳 × Bool)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) : ordinaryError h P ≤ robustRisk h P ρ := by
  let p : ℝ := ordinaryError h P
  let q : ℝ := (P {z : 𝒳 × Bool | h.f z.1 = z.2}).toReal
  have hp : 0 ≤ p := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  have hq : 0 ≤ q := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  have hpq : p + q = 1 := error_correct_sum_one h P
  let η0 : etaDomain ρ := ⟨0, zero_mem_etaDomain ρ hρ⟩
  letI : Nonempty (etaDomain ρ) := ⟨η0⟩
  rw [robustRisk]
  apply le_ciInf
  intro η
  exact scalar_rms_add_eta_ge p q (η : ℝ) (c2 ρ) hp hq hpq
    (c2_ge_one ρ hρ) (eta_le_one ρ η)

noncomputable def scalarRobustRisk (ρ p : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ⨅ η : etaDomain ρ,
    c2 ρ * Real.sqrt
        (p * (max (1 - (η : ℝ)) 0) ^ 2
          + (1 - p) * (max (0 - (η : ℝ)) 0) ^ 2) + (η : ℝ)

lemma robustRisk_eq_scalar {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳]
    (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (P : Measure (𝒳 × Bool)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (ρ : ℝ) : robustRisk h P ρ = scalarRobustRisk ρ (ordinaryError h P) := by
  have hsum := error_correct_sum_one h P
  have hcorrect :
      (P {z : 𝒳 × Bool | h.f z.1 = z.2}).toReal = 1 - ordinaryError h P := by
    linarith
  unfold robustRisk scalarRobustRisk ordinaryError
  congr 1
  funext η
  rw [hcorrect]
  simp [ordinaryError]

lemma scalarObjective_bddBelow {ρ p : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    BddBelow (Set.range fun η : etaDomain ρ =>
      c2 ρ * Real.sqrt
          (p * (max (1 - (η : ℝ)) 0) ^ 2
            + (1 - p) * (max (0 - (η : ℝ)) 0) ^ 2) + (η : ℝ)) := by
  refine ⟨-(1 / (c2 ρ - 1)), ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨η, rfl⟩
  have hs : 0 ≤ c2 ρ * Real.sqrt
      (p * (max (1 - (η : ℝ)) 0) ^ 2 +
        (1 - p) * (max (0 - (η : ℝ)) 0) ^ 2) := by
    exact mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  linarith [eta_lower hρ η]

lemma scalarRobustRisk_le_objective {ρ p : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (η : etaDomain ρ) :
    scalarRobustRisk ρ p ≤
      c2 ρ * Real.sqrt
          (p * (max (1 - (η : ℝ)) 0) ^ 2
            + (1 - p) * (max (0 - (η : ℝ)) 0) ^ 2) + (η : ℝ) := by
  exact ciInf_le (scalarObjective_bddBelow hρ) η

lemma le_scalarRobustRisk {ρ p a : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (ha : ∀ η : etaDomain ρ,
      a ≤ c2 ρ * Real.sqrt
          (p * (max (1 - (η : ℝ)) 0) ^ 2
            + (1 - p) * (max (0 - (η : ℝ)) 0) ^ 2) + (η : ℝ)) :
    a ≤ scalarRobustRisk ρ p := by
  let η0 : etaDomain ρ := ⟨0, zero_mem_etaDomain ρ hρ.le⟩
  letI : Nonempty (etaDomain ρ) := ⟨η0⟩
  exact le_ciInf ha

noncomputable def robustLip (ρ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  c2 ρ * (1 + 1 / (c2 ρ - 1))

lemma robustLip_pos {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) : 0 < robustLip ρ := by
  have hc : 1 < c2 ρ := c2_gt_one ρ hρ
  have hc0 : 0 < c2 ρ := lt_trans zero_lt_one hc
  have hden : 0 < c2 ρ - 1 := sub_pos.mpr hc
  have hinv : 0 < 1 / (c2 ρ - 1) := one_div_pos.mpr hden
  unfold robustLip
  exact mul_pos hc0 (by linarith)

lemma one_lt_robustLip {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) : 1 < robustLip ρ := by
  have hc : 1 < c2 ρ := c2_gt_one ρ hρ
  have hden : 0 < c2 ρ - 1 := sub_pos.mpr hc
  have hinv : 0 < 1 / (c2 ρ - 1) := one_div_pos.mpr hden
  have hb : 1 < 1 + 1 / (c2 ρ - 1) := by linarith
  have hmul : 1 * (1 + 1 / (c2 ρ - 1)) <
      c2 ρ * (1 + 1 / (c2 ρ - 1)) :=
    mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hc (by linarith)
  unfold robustLip
  linarith

lemma sqrt_add_le' (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    Real.sqrt (x + y) ≤ Real.sqrt x + Real.sqrt y := by
  rw [Real.sqrt_le_iff]
  refine ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
  have h1 : Real.sqrt x ^ 2 = x := Real.sq_sqrt hx
  have h2 : Real.sqrt y ^ 2 = y := Real.sq_sqrt hy
  have h3 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt x * Real.sqrt y := by positivity
  nlinarith

lemma objective_mono_lip {ρ p q : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hpq : p ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1) (η : etaDomain ρ) :
    c2 ρ * Real.sqrt
          (q * (max (1 - (η : ℝ)) 0) ^ 2
            + (1 - q) * (max (0 - (η : ℝ)) 0) ^ 2) + (η : ℝ)
      ≤
    c2 ρ * Real.sqrt
          (p * (max (1 - (η : ℝ)) 0) ^ 2
            + (1 - p) * (max (0 - (η : ℝ)) 0) ^ 2) + (η : ℝ)
      + robustLip ρ * Real.sqrt (q - p) := by
  have hc : 0 ≤ c2 ρ := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hc1 : 1 < c2 ρ := c2_gt_one ρ hρ
  have hL0 : 0 ≤ 1 / (c2 ρ - 1) := one_div_nonneg.mpr (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨hηlo, hηhi⟩ := (by
    simpa [etaDomain, ne_of_gt hρ] using η.property :
      -(1 / (c2 ρ - 1)) ≤ (η : ℝ) ∧ (η : ℝ) ≤ 1)
  set A : ℝ := (max (1 - (η : ℝ)) 0) ^ 2 with hA
  set B : ℝ := (max (0 - (η : ℝ)) 0) ^ 2 with hB
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := sq_nonneg _
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := sq_nonneg _
  have hBA : B ≤ A := by
    rcases le_or_gt 0 (η : ℝ) with hη0 | hη0
    · have hBz : max (0 - (η : ℝ)) 0 = 0 := max_eq_right (by linarith)
      rw [hA, hB, hBz]
      simpa using sq_nonneg (max (1 - (η : ℝ)) 0)
    · have hBv : max (0 - (η : ℝ)) 0 = -(η : ℝ) := by
        rw [zero_sub, max_eq_left (by linarith)]
      have hAv : max (1 - (η : ℝ)) 0 = 1 - (η : ℝ) :=
        max_eq_left (by linarith)
      rw [hA, hB, hAv, hBv]
      nlinarith
  have hmaxA : max (1 - (η : ℝ)) 0 ≤ 1 + 1 / (c2 ρ - 1) := by
    rcases max_cases (1 - (η : ℝ)) 0 with ⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨h, _⟩ <;> rw [h] <;> linarith
  have hmaxA0 : 0 ≤ max (1 - (η : ℝ)) 0 := le_max_right _ _
  have hA_bound : A ≤ (1 + 1 / (c2 ρ - 1)) ^ 2 := by
    rw [hA]
    nlinarith
  set X : ℝ := p * A + (1 - p) * B with hX
  set Y : ℝ := q * A + (1 - q) * B with hY
  have hX0 : 0 ≤ X := by
    rw [hX]
    exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hp0 hA0) (mul_nonneg (by linarith) hB0)
  have hdiff0 : 0 ≤ (q - p) * (A - B) :=
    mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hpq) (sub_nonneg.mpr hBA)
  have hYX : Y = X + (q - p) * (A - B) := by
    rw [hX, hY]
    ring
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt Y ≤ Real.sqrt X + Real.sqrt ((q - p) * (A - B)) := by
    rw [hYX]
    exact sqrt_add_le' _ _ hX0 hdiff0
  have hdiff_bound : (q - p) * (A - B) ≤
      (1 + 1 / (c2 ρ - 1)) ^ 2 * (q - p) := by
    have hqp0 : 0 ≤ q - p := sub_nonneg.mpr hpq
    nlinarith
  have hsqrt_bound : Real.sqrt ((q - p) * (A - B)) ≤
      (1 + 1 / (c2 ρ - 1)) * Real.sqrt (q - p) := by
    calc
      Real.sqrt ((q - p) * (A - B))
          ≤ Real.sqrt ((1 + 1 / (c2 ρ - 1)) ^ 2 * (q - p)) :=
            Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hdiff_bound
      _ = (1 + 1 / (c2 ρ - 1)) * Real.sqrt (q - p) := by
        rw [Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)]
  unfold robustLip
  rw [hX, hY] at hsqrt
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsqrt_bound hc]

lemma scalarRobustRisk_mono {ρ p q : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hpq : p ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1) :
    scalarRobustRisk ρ p ≤ scalarRobustRisk ρ q := by
  have hc : 0 ≤ c2 ρ := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  apply le_scalarRobustRisk hρ
  intro η
  have hB_le_A : (max (0 - (η : ℝ)) 0) ^ 2 ≤
      (max (1 - (η : ℝ)) 0) ^ 2 := by
    rcases le_or_gt 0 (η : ℝ) with hη0 | hη0
    · rw [max_eq_right (by linarith : 0 - (η : ℝ) ≤ 0)]
      simpa using sq_nonneg (max (1 - (η : ℝ)) 0)
    · rw [max_eq_left (by linarith : 0 ≤ 0 - (η : ℝ)),
          max_eq_left (by linarith : 0 ≤ 1 - (η : ℝ))]
      nlinarith
  have hinside :
      p * (max (1 - (η : ℝ)) 0) ^ 2 +
          (1 - p) * (max (0 - (η : ℝ)) 0) ^ 2 ≤
      q * (max (1 - (η : ℝ)) 0) ^ 2 +
          (1 - q) * (max (0 - (η : ℝ)) 0) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith
  calc
    scalarRobustRisk ρ p ≤
        c2 ρ * Real.sqrt
            (p * (max (1 - (η : ℝ)) 0) ^ 2 +
              (1 - p) * (max (0 - (η : ℝ)) 0) ^ 2) + (η : ℝ) :=
      scalarRobustRisk_le_objective hρ η
    _ ≤ c2 ρ * Real.sqrt
            (q * (max (1 - (η : ℝ)) 0) ^ 2 +
              (1 - q) * (max (0 - (η : ℝ)) 0) ^ 2) + (η : ℝ) := by
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hinside) hc]

lemma scalarRobustRisk_lip {ρ p q : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hpq : p ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1) :
    scalarRobustRisk ρ q ≤
      scalarRobustRisk ρ p + robustLip ρ * Real.sqrt (q - p) := by
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ q := hp0.trans hpq
  have hshift : scalarRobustRisk ρ q - robustLip ρ * Real.sqrt (q - p) ≤
      scalarRobustRisk ρ p := by
    apply le_scalarRobustRisk hρ
    intro η
    have hqobj := scalarRobustRisk_le_objective (ρ := ρ) (p := q) hρ η
    have hlip := objective_mono_lip hρ hp0 hpq hq1 η
    linarith
  linarith

lemma ordinaryError_le_one {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳]
    (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (P : Measure (𝒳 × Bool)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P] :
    ordinaryError h P ≤ 1 := by
  have hm : P {z : 𝒳 × Bool | h.f z.1 ≠ z.2} ≤ P Set.univ :=
    measure_mono (Set.subset_univ _)
  rw [measure_univ] at hm
  have ht := ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.one_ne_top hm
  simpa [ordinaryError] using ht

def OrdinaryAgnosticPACAtSize {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳]
    (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool) (ε δ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ A : (Fin n → 𝒳 × Bool) → Predictor 𝒳 Bool,
    ∀ (P : Measure (𝒳 × Bool)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P],
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => P)
          {S : Fin n → 𝒳 × Bool |
            (⨅ h : ↥H, ordinaryError (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) P) + ε <
              ordinaryError (A S) P} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ

def OrdinaryRealizablePACAtSize {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳]
    (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool) (ε δ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ A : (Fin n → 𝒳 × Bool) → Predictor 𝒳 Bool,
    ∀ (P : Measure (𝒳 × Bool)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P],
      (∃ hstar ∈ H, ordinaryError hstar P = 0) →
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => P)
          {S : Fin n → 𝒳 × Bool | ε < ordinaryError (A S) P} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ

/-- A fully degenerate finite-class case of the ordinary learning theorem: a
singleton class needs no samples, both agnostically and realizably.  Notice that
this also avoids any measurability issue for the failure event: it is empty. -/
lemma ordinary_singleton_PAC
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (h₀ : Predictor 𝒳 Bool)
    {γ δ : ℝ} (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) :
    OrdinaryAgnosticPACAtSize ({h₀} : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool) γ δ 0 ∧
      OrdinaryRealizablePACAtSize ({h₀} : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool) γ δ 0 := by
  constructor
  · refine ⟨fun _ => h₀, ?_⟩
    intro P _
    have hinf :
        (⨅ h : ↥({h₀} : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool),
          ordinaryError (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) P) = ordinaryError h₀ P := by
      simp
    have hempty :
        {S : Fin 0 → 𝒳 × Bool |
          (⨅ h : ↥({h₀} : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool),
              ordinaryError (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) P) + γ <
            ordinaryError h₀ P} = ∅ := by
      apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem.mpr
      intro S hS
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hS
      rw [hinf] at hS
      linarith
    rw [hempty, measure_empty]
    exact bot_le
  · refine ⟨fun _ => h₀, ?_⟩
    intro P _ hreal
    rcases hreal with ⟨hstar, hhstar, hz⟩
    have heq : hstar = h₀ := by simpa using hhstar
    subst hstar
    have hempty :
        {S : Fin 0 → 𝒳 × Bool | γ < ordinaryError h₀ P} = ∅ := by
      apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem.mpr
      intro S hS
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hS
      rw [hz] at hS
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hγ) hS
    rw [hempty, measure_empty]
    exact bot_le

/-! The same idea extends to every genuinely finite hypothesis class.  These
lemmas are intentionally phrased without a VC estimate: their purpose is to
record the complete measure-theoretic finite-union argument which survives
without any class-level measurability assumption. -/

noncomputable def finiteConsistentLearner
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳]
    (F : Finset (Predictor 𝒳 Bool)) (hdefault : Predictor 𝒳 Bool)
    {n : ℕ} (S : Fin n → 𝒳 × Bool) : Predictor 𝒳 Bool :=
  if hex : ∃ h ∈ F, ∀ i, h.f (S i).1 = (S i).2 then Classical.choose hex else hdefault

lemma finiteConsistentLearner_mem
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳]
    (F : Finset (Predictor 𝒳 Bool)) (hdefault : Predictor 𝒳 Bool)
    {n : ℕ} (S : Fin n → 𝒳 × Bool)
    (hex : ∃ h ∈ F, ∀ i, h.f (S i).1 = (S i).2) :
    finiteConsistentLearner F hdefault S ∈ F := by
  rw [finiteConsistentLearner, dif_pos hex]
  exact (Classical.choose_spec hex).1

lemma finiteConsistentLearner_correct
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳]
    (F : Finset (Predictor 𝒳 Bool)) (hdefault : Predictor 𝒳 Bool)
    {n : ℕ} (S : Fin n → 𝒳 × Bool)
    (hex : ∃ h ∈ F, ∀ i, h.f (S i).1 = (S i).2) :
    ∀ i, (finiteConsistentLearner F hdefault S).f (S i).1 = (S i).2 := by
  rw [finiteConsistentLearner, dif_pos hex]
  exact (Classical.choose_spec hex).2

def finiteAllCorrect
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {n : ℕ}
    (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) : Set (Fin n → 𝒳 × Bool) :=
  {S | ∀ i, h.f (S i).1 = (S i).2}

lemma finiteAllCorrect_eq_pi
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {n : ℕ}
    (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) :
    finiteAllCorrect (n := n) h = Set.univ.pi fun _ : Fin n =>
      {z : 𝒳 × Bool | h.f z.1 = z.2} := by
  ext S
  simp [finiteAllCorrect, Set.mem_pi]

lemma measure_finiteAllCorrect
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {n : ℕ}
    (P : Measure (𝒳 × Bool)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) :
    (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => P) (finiteAllCorrect (n := n) h) =
      (P {z : 𝒳 × Bool | h.f z.1 = z.2}) ^ n := by
  rw [finiteAllCorrect_eq_pi, Measure.pi_pi]
  simp

lemma measure_finiteAllCorrect_compl_zero
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {n : ℕ}
    (P : Measure (𝒳 × Bool)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool)
    (hz : P {z : 𝒳 × Bool | h.f z.1 ≠ z.2} = 0) :
    (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => P) (finiteAllCorrect (n := n) h)ᶜ = 0 := by
  have hcorrect : P {z : 𝒳 × Bool | h.f z.1 = z.2} = 1 := by
    have hc : {z : 𝒳 × Bool | h.f z.1 = z.2} =
        {z : 𝒳 × Bool | h.f z.1 ≠ z.2}ᶜ := by
      ext z
      simp
    rw [hc, measure_compl (meas_ne_set h) (measure_ne_top _ _), hz, measure_univ]
    simp
  have hall :
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => P) (finiteAllCorrect (n := n) h) = 1 := by
    rw [measure_finiteAllCorrect, hcorrect]
    simp
  rw [measure_compl]
  · rw [hall, measure_univ]
    simp
  · rw [finiteAllCorrect_eq_pi]
    exact MeasurableSet.univ_pi fun _ => meas_eq_set h
  · exact measure_ne_top _ _

lemma finite_realizable_failure_subset
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {n : ℕ}
    (F : Finset (Predictor 𝒳 Bool)) (hdefault hstar : Predictor 𝒳 Bool)
    (hhstar : hstar ∈ F) (P : Measure (𝒳 × Bool)) (α : ℝ) :
    {S | α < ordinaryError (finiteConsistentLearner F hdefault S) P} ⊆
      (finiteAllCorrect (n := n) hstar)ᶜ ∪
        ⋃ h ∈ (F.filter fun h => α < ordinaryError h P),
          finiteAllCorrect (n := n) h := by
  intro S hS
  by_cases hg : S ∈ finiteAllCorrect (n := n) hstar
  · right
    have hex : ∃ h ∈ F, ∀ i, h.f (S i).1 = (S i).2 := ⟨hstar, hhstar, hg⟩
    let h := finiteConsistentLearner F hdefault S
    have hhF : h ∈ F := finiteConsistentLearner_mem F hdefault S hex
    have hhbad : h ∈ F.filter fun h => α < ordinaryError h P := by
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
      exact ⟨hhF, hS⟩
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨h, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
      ⟨hhbad, finiteConsistentLearner_correct F hdefault S hex⟩⟩
  · exact Or.inl hg

lemma finite_bad_union_measure_le
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {n : ℕ}
    (F : Finset (Predictor 𝒳 Bool))
    (P : Measure (𝒳 × Bool)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 ≤ α) :
    (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => P)
        (⋃ h ∈ (F.filter fun h => α < ordinaryError h P),
          finiteAllCorrect (n := n) h) ≤
      F.card * (ENNReal.ofReal (1 - α)) ^ n := by
  classical
  let G := F.filter fun h => α < ordinaryError h P
  calc
    (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => P) (⋃ h ∈ G, finiteAllCorrect (n := n) h)
        ≤ ∑ h ∈ G, (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => P)
            (finiteAllCorrect (n := n) h) := measure_biUnion_finset_le G _
    _ ≤ ∑ _h ∈ G, (ENNReal.ofReal (1 - α)) ^ n := by
      gcongr with h hh
      rw [measure_finiteAllCorrect]
      apply pow_le_pow_left'
      have hbad : α < ordinaryError h P := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hh).2
      have hsum := error_correct_sum_one h P
      have herr_le_one := ordinaryError_le_one h P
      have hcorrectR :
          (P {z : 𝒳 × Bool | h.f z.1 = z.2}).toReal < 1 - α := by
        linarith
      have hcorrecttop : P {z : 𝒳 × Bool | h.f z.1 = z.2} ≠ ⊤ := measure_ne_top _ _
      apply (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal hcorrecttop ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top).mp
      rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by linarith : 0 ≤ 1 - α)]
      exact hcorrectR.le
    _ = G.card * (ENNReal.ofReal (1 - α)) ^ n := by simp
    _ ≤ F.card * (ENNReal.ofReal (1 - α)) ^ n := by
      gcongr
      exact Finset.filter_subset _ _

lemma finite_class_realizable_at_size
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {n : ℕ}
    (F : Finset (Predictor 𝒳 Bool))
    (hdefault : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (hdefault_mem : hdefault ∈ F)
    {α δ : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 ≤ α)
    (hn : F.card * (ENNReal.ofReal (1 - α)) ^ n ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ) :
    OrdinaryRealizablePACAtSize (↑F : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool) α δ n := by
  refine ⟨finiteConsistentLearner F hdefault, ?_⟩
  intro P _ hreal
  obtain ⟨hstar, hhstar, hz⟩ := hreal
  have hz' : P {z : 𝒳 × Bool | hstar.f z.1 ≠ z.2} = 0 := by
    have hor := (ENNReal.toReal_eq_zero_iff _).mp (by
      simpa [ordinaryError] using hz)
    exact hor.resolve_right (measure_ne_top _ _)
  calc
    (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => P)
        {S | α < ordinaryError (finiteConsistentLearner F hdefault S) P}
        ≤ (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => P)
          ((finiteAllCorrect (n := n) hstar)ᶜ ∪
            ⋃ h ∈ (F.filter fun h => α < ordinaryError h P),
              finiteAllCorrect (n := n) h) :=
      measure_mono (finite_realizable_failure_subset F hdefault hstar hhstar P α)
    _ ≤ (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => P) (finiteAllCorrect (n := n) hstar)ᶜ +
          (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => P)
            (⋃ h ∈ (F.filter fun h => α < ordinaryError h P),
              finiteAllCorrect (n := n) h) := measure_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ 0 + F.card * (ENNReal.ofReal (1 - α)) ^ n := by
      gcongr
      · exact (measure_finiteAllCorrect_compl_zero P hstar hz').le
      · exact finite_bad_union_measure_le F P hα0
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ := by simpa using hn

/-- Every nonempty finite class is realizably PAC learnable, with no
measurability or separability assumption on the class as a family. -/
lemma finite_class_ordinary_realizable_PAC
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳]
    (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool) (hfin : H.Finite) (hH : H.Nonempty)
    {α δ : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) (hδ0 : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, OrdinaryRealizablePACAtSize H α δ n := by
  classical
  let F : Finset (Predictor 𝒳 Bool) := hfin.toFinset
  let hdefault : Predictor 𝒳 Bool := Classical.choose hH
  have hdefault_mem : hdefault ∈ F := by
    simpa [F, hdefault] using Classical.choose_spec hH
  have hq : ENNReal.ofReal (1 - α) < 1 := ENNReal.ofReal_lt_one.mpr (by linarith)
  have hd : 0 < ENNReal.ofReal δ := ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr hδ0
  have ht : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ => (F.card : ℝ≥0∞) * (ENNReal.ofReal (1 - α)) ^ n)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa using ENNReal.Tendsto.const_mul (a := (F.card : ℝ≥0∞))
      (ENNReal.tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one hq)
      (Or.inr (by simp : (F.card : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ⊤))
  have hev : Filter.Eventually
      (fun n => (F.card : ℝ≥0∞) * (ENNReal.ofReal (1 - α)) ^ n <
        ENNReal.ofReal δ) Filter.atTop :=
    (tendsto_order.1 ht).2 _ hd
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.1 hev
  refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
  rw [← hfin.coe_toFinset]
  apply finite_class_realizable_at_size F hdefault hdefault_mem hα0.le
  exact (hN N le_rfl).le

noncomputable def zeroOneLoss
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) :
    𝒳 × Bool → ℝ :=
  {z : 𝒳 × Bool | h.f z.1 ≠ z.2}.indicator fun _ => 1

lemma zeroOneLoss_measurable
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) :
    Measurable (zeroOneLoss h) := by
  exact measurable_const.indicator (meas_ne_set h)

lemma zeroOneLoss_nonneg
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool)
    (z : 𝒳 × Bool) : 0 ≤ zeroOneLoss h z := by
  by_cases hz : h.f z.1 ≠ z.2 <;> simp [zeroOneLoss, hz]

lemma zeroOneLoss_le_one
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool)
    (z : 𝒳 × Bool) : zeroOneLoss h z ≤ 1 := by
  by_cases hz : h.f z.1 ≠ z.2 <;> simp [zeroOneLoss, hz]

lemma integral_zeroOneLoss
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳]
    (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (P : Measure (𝒳 × Bool)) :
    ∫ z, zeroOneLoss h z ∂P = ordinaryError h P := by
  simpa [zeroOneLoss, ordinaryError, Measure.real] using
    (integral_indicator_one (μ := P) (meas_ne_set h))

noncomputable def finiteERM
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳]
    (F : Finset (Predictor 𝒳 Bool)) (hdefault : Predictor 𝒳 Bool)
    {n : ℕ} (S : Fin n → 𝒳 × Bool) : Predictor 𝒳 Bool :=
  if hF : F.Nonempty then
    Classical.choose (Finset.exists_min_image F
      (fun h => ∑ i, zeroOneLoss h (S i)) hF)
  else hdefault

lemma finiteERM_mem
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳]
    (F : Finset (Predictor 𝒳 Bool)) (hdefault : Predictor 𝒳 Bool)
    {n : ℕ} (S : Fin n → 𝒳 × Bool) (hF : F.Nonempty) :
    finiteERM F hdefault S ∈ F := by
  rw [finiteERM, dif_pos hF]
  exact (Classical.choose_spec (Finset.exists_min_image F
    (fun h => ∑ i, zeroOneLoss h (S i)) hF)).1

lemma finiteERM_le
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳]
    (F : Finset (Predictor 𝒳 Bool)) (hdefault : Predictor 𝒳 Bool)
    {n : ℕ} (S : Fin n → 𝒳 × Bool) (hF : F.Nonempty)
    (g : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (hg : g ∈ F) :
    (∑ i, zeroOneLoss (finiteERM F hdefault S) (S i)) ≤
      ∑ i, zeroOneLoss g (S i) := by
  rw [finiteERM, dif_pos hF]
  exact (Classical.choose_spec (Finset.exists_min_image F
    (fun h => ∑ i, zeroOneLoss h (S i)) hF)).2 g hg

lemma bounded_sum_upper
    {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] (P : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    {n : ℕ} (f : Z → ℝ) (hf : Measurable f) (p t : ℝ)
    (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hf0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ f z) (hf1 : ∀ z, f z ≤ 1)
    (hint : ∫ z, f z ∂P = p) :
    (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => P).real
        {S | (n : ℝ) * t ≤ (∑ i, f (S i)) - (n : ℝ) * p} ≤
      Real.exp (-((n : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 / (2 * n)) := by
  let X : Fin n → (Fin n → Z) → ℝ := fun i S => f (S i) - p
  have hXm (i : Fin n) : Measurable (X i) :=
    (hf.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)).sub measurable_const
  have hindep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => P) := by
    exact ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun_pi (X := fun _ z => f z - p)
      (fun _ => (hf.sub measurable_const).aemeasurable)
  have hsub (i : Fin n) : ProbabilityTheory.HasSubgaussianMGF (X i) 1
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => P) := by
    have hb : ∀ᵐ S ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => P), X i S ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 :=
      Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun S => by
        dsimp [X]
        exact ⟨by linarith [hf0 (S i)], by linarith [hf1 (S i)]⟩
    have hcenter := ProbabilityTheory.hasSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc
      (hXm i).aemeasurable hb
    have hfint : Integrable f P :=
      Integrable.of_mem_Icc 0 1 hf.aemeasurable
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => ⟨hf0 z, hf1 z⟩)
    have hXi : ∫ S, X i S ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => P) = 0 := by
      rw [show X i = fun S => f (S i) - p by rfl, integral_sub]
      · rw [integral_comp_eval hf.aestronglyMeasurable, hint]
        simp
      · exact integrable_comp_eval hfint
      · exact integrable_const _
    convert hcenter using 1 <;> simp [hXi] <;> norm_num
  have h := ProbabilityTheory.HasSubgaussianMGF.measure_sum_ge_le_of_iIndepFun
    (s := Finset.univ) (ε := (n : ℝ) * t) hindep (c := fun _ => 1)
      (fun i _ => hsub i) (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) ht)
  simpa [X, Finset.sum_sub_distrib] using h

def finiteDeviation
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {n : ℕ}
    (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (P : Measure (𝒳 × Bool)) (t : ℝ) :
    Set (Fin n → 𝒳 × Bool) :=
  {S | (n : ℝ) * t ≤
      (∑ i, zeroOneLoss h (S i)) - (n : ℝ) * ordinaryError h P} ∪
    {S | (n : ℝ) * t ≤
      (∑ i, (1 - zeroOneLoss h (S i))) -
        (n : ℝ) * (1 - ordinaryError h P)}

lemma finiteDeviation_measurable
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {n : ℕ}
    (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (P : Measure (𝒳 × Bool)) (t : ℝ) :
    MeasurableSet (finiteDeviation (n := n) h P t) := by
  unfold finiteDeviation
  have hsum : Measurable (fun S : Fin n → 𝒳 × Bool =>
      ∑ i, zeroOneLoss h (S i)) := by
    apply Finset.measurable_sum
    intro i _
    exact (zeroOneLoss_measurable h).comp (measurable_pi_apply i)
  have hsumc : Measurable (fun S : Fin n → 𝒳 × Bool =>
      ∑ i, (1 - zeroOneLoss h (S i))) := by
    apply Finset.measurable_sum
    intro i _
    exact measurable_const.sub
      ((zeroOneLoss_measurable h).comp (measurable_pi_apply i))
  exact (measurableSet_le measurable_const (hsum.sub measurable_const)).union
    (measurableSet_le measurable_const (hsumc.sub measurable_const))

lemma measure_finiteDeviation_le
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {n : ℕ}
    (P : Measure (𝒳 × Bool)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (t : ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => P) (finiteDeviation (n := n) h P t) ≤
      2 * (ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2))) ^ n := by
  let p : ℝ := ordinaryError h P
  let f : 𝒳 × Bool → ℝ := zeroOneLoss h
  let g : 𝒳 × Bool → ℝ := fun z => 1 - zeroOneLoss h z
  let Epos : Set (Fin n → 𝒳 × Bool) :=
    {S | (n : ℝ) * t ≤ (∑ i, f (S i)) - (n : ℝ) * p}
  let Eneg : Set (Fin n → 𝒳 × Bool) :=
    {S | (n : ℝ) * t ≤ (∑ i, g (S i)) - (n : ℝ) * (1 - p)}
  have hp0 : 0 ≤ p := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  have hp1 : p ≤ 1 := ordinaryError_le_one h P
  have hfmeas : Measurable f := zeroOneLoss_measurable h
  have hgmeas : Measurable g := measurable_const.sub (zeroOneLoss_measurable h)
  have hf0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ f z := zeroOneLoss_nonneg h
  have hf1 : ∀ z, f z ≤ 1 := zeroOneLoss_le_one h
  have hg0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ g z := fun z => by dsimp [g]; linarith [hf1 z]
  have hg1 : ∀ z, g z ≤ 1 := fun z => by dsimp [g]; linarith [hf0 z]
  have hfint : Integrable f P :=
    Integrable.of_mem_Icc 0 1 hfmeas.aemeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => ⟨hf0 z, hf1 z⟩)
  have hintf : ∫ z, f z ∂P = p := integral_zeroOneLoss h P
  have hintg : ∫ z, g z ∂P = 1 - p := by
    dsimp [g]
    rw [integral_sub (integrable_const _) hfint, integral_const, hintf]
    simp
  have hposR :
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => P).real Epos ≤
        Real.exp (-((n : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 / (2 * n)) := by
    exact bounded_sum_upper P f hfmeas p t hp0 hp1 ht hf0 hf1 hintf
  have hnegR :
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => P).real Eneg ≤
        Real.exp (-((n : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 / (2 * n)) := by
    exact bounded_sum_upper P g hgmeas (1 - p) t (by linarith) (by linarith)
      ht hg0 hg1 hintg
  let r : ℝ := Real.exp (-((n : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 / (2 * n))
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hpos : (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => P) Epos ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r := by
    apply (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal (measure_ne_top _ _) ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top).mp
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hr0]
    exact hposR
  have hneg : (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => P) Eneg ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r := by
    apply (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal (measure_ne_top _ _) ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top).mp
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hr0]
    exact hnegR
  have hdev : finiteDeviation (n := n) h P t = Epos ∪ Eneg := by
    rfl
  rw [hdev]
  calc
    (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => P) (Epos ∪ Eneg)
        ≤ (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => P) Epos +
            (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => P) Eneg := measure_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r + ENNReal.ofReal r := add_le_add hpos hneg
    _ = 2 * ENNReal.ofReal r := by ring
    _ = 2 * (ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2))) ^ n := by
      congr 1
      have hnR : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt hn)
      have hexp : -((n : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 / (2 * n) =
          (n : ℝ) * (-t ^ 2 / 2) := by
        field_simp
      dsimp [r]
      rw [hexp, Real.exp_nat_mul,
        ENNReal.ofReal_pow (Real.exp_pos _).le]

lemma abs_empirical_sub_lt_of_not_mem_finiteDeviation
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {n : ℕ}
    (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (P : Measure (𝒳 × Bool)) (t : ℝ)
    (S : Fin n → 𝒳 × Bool) (hS : S ∉ finiteDeviation h P t) :
    |∑ i, zeroOneLoss h (S i) - (n : ℝ) * ordinaryError h P| <
      (n : ℝ) * t := by
  have hpair :
      ¬((n : ℝ) * t ≤
          (∑ i, zeroOneLoss h (S i)) - (n : ℝ) * ordinaryError h P) ∧
      ¬((n : ℝ) * t ≤
          (∑ i, (1 - zeroOneLoss h (S i))) -
            (n : ℝ) * (1 - ordinaryError h P)) := by
    simpa only [finiteDeviation, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_or] using hS
  rw [abs_lt]
  constructor
  · have hsecond := lt_of_not_ge hpair.2
    simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_fin,
      nsmul_eq_mul] at hsecond
    linarith
  · exact lt_of_not_ge hpair.1

lemma finite_class_agnostic_at_size
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {n : ℕ}
    (F : Finset (Predictor 𝒳 Bool))
    (hdefault : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (hdefault_mem : hdefault ∈ F)
    {γ δ : ℝ} (hγ0 : 0 < γ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hbound : F.card * 2 *
        (ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(γ / 2) ^ 2 / 2))) ^ n ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ) :
    OrdinaryAgnosticPACAtSize (↑F : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool) γ δ n := by
  classical
  have hF : F.Nonempty := ⟨hdefault, hdefault_mem⟩
  refine ⟨finiteERM F hdefault, ?_⟩
  intro P _
  obtain ⟨hopt, hoptF, hoptmin⟩ :=
    Finset.exists_min_image F (fun h => ordinaryError h P) hF
  letI : Nonempty ↥(↑F : Set (Predictor 𝒳 Bool)) :=
    ⟨⟨hdefault, hdefault_mem⟩⟩
  have hbdd : BddBelow (Set.range fun h : ↥(↑F : Set (Predictor 𝒳 Bool)) =>
      ordinaryError (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) P) := by
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨h, rfl⟩
    exact ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  have hinf :
      (⨅ h : ↥(↑F : Set (Predictor 𝒳 Bool)),
          ordinaryError (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) P) = ordinaryError hopt P := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact ciInf_le hbdd ⟨hopt, hoptF⟩
    · apply le_ciInf
      intro h
      exact hoptmin h h.property
  have hsubset :
      {S : Fin n → 𝒳 × Bool |
        (⨅ h : ↥(↑F : Set (Predictor 𝒳 Bool)),
            ordinaryError (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) P) + γ <
          ordinaryError (finiteERM F hdefault S) P} ⊆
        ⋃ h ∈ F, finiteDeviation (n := n) h P (γ / 2) := by
    intro S hbad
    by_contra hnot
    have hgood (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (hh : h ∈ F) :
        S ∉ finiteDeviation (n := n) h P (γ / 2) := by
      intro hmem
      exact hnot (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨h, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hh, hmem⟩⟩)
    have hAF : finiteERM F hdefault S ∈ F := finiteERM_mem F hdefault S hF
    have hAdev := abs_empirical_sub_lt_of_not_mem_finiteDeviation
      (finiteERM F hdefault S) P (γ / 2) S (hgood _ hAF)
    have hOdev := abs_empirical_sub_lt_of_not_mem_finiteDeviation
      hopt P (γ / 2) S (hgood _ hoptF)
    have hAle := finiteERM_le F hdefault S hF hopt hoptF
    have hnR : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
    rw [hinf] at hbad
    rcases (abs_lt.mp hAdev) with ⟨hAlo, hAhi⟩
    rcases (abs_lt.mp hOdev) with ⟨hOlo, hOhi⟩
    have hscaled := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hbad hnR
    nlinarith
  calc
    (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => P)
        {S : Fin n → 𝒳 × Bool |
          (⨅ h : ↥(↑F : Set (Predictor 𝒳 Bool)),
              ordinaryError (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) P) + γ <
            ordinaryError (finiteERM F hdefault S) P}
        ≤ (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => P)
            (⋃ h ∈ F, finiteDeviation (n := n) h P (γ / 2)) := measure_mono hsubset
    _ ≤ ∑ h ∈ F, (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => P)
          (finiteDeviation (n := n) h P (γ / 2)) := measure_biUnion_finset_le F _
    _ ≤ ∑ _h ∈ F,
          2 * (ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(γ / 2) ^ 2 / 2))) ^ n := by
      gcongr with h hh
      exact measure_finiteDeviation_le P h (γ / 2) hn (by linarith)
    _ = F.card * 2 *
          (ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(γ / 2) ^ 2 / 2))) ^ n := by
      simp
      ring
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ := hbound

/-- Every nonempty finite class is agnostically PAC learnable.  Together with
`finite_class_ordinary_realizable_PAC`, this is the strongest completely finite
special case of `ordinary_finite_vc_bounds`; all failure events are finite
unions of measurable deviation events. -/
lemma finite_class_ordinary_agnostic_PAC
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳]
    (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool) (hfin : H.Finite) (hH : H.Nonempty)
    {γ δ : ℝ} (hγ0 : 0 < γ) (hδ0 : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, OrdinaryAgnosticPACAtSize H γ δ n := by
  classical
  let F : Finset (Predictor 𝒳 Bool) := hfin.toFinset
  let hdefault : Predictor 𝒳 Bool := Classical.choose hH
  have hdefault_mem : hdefault ∈ F := by
    simpa [F, hdefault] using Classical.choose_spec hH
  let q : ℝ≥0∞ := ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(γ / 2) ^ 2 / 2))
  have harg : -(γ / 2) ^ 2 / 2 < 0 := by
    have hs : 0 < (γ / 2) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos (by linarith)
    linarith
  have hq : q < 1 := by
    change ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(γ / 2) ^ 2 / 2)) < 1
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_lt_one]
    exact Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr harg
  have hd : 0 < ENNReal.ofReal δ := ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr hδ0
  have ht : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ => (F.card : ℝ≥0∞) * 2 * q ^ n)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hpow := ENNReal.tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one hq
    simpa [mul_assoc] using ENNReal.Tendsto.const_mul
      (a := (F.card : ℝ≥0∞) * 2) hpow
      (Or.inr (ENNReal.mul_ne_top (by simp) (by norm_num)))
  have hev : Filter.Eventually
      (fun n => (F.card : ℝ≥0∞) * 2 * q ^ n < ENNReal.ofReal δ)
      Filter.atTop :=
    (tendsto_order.1 ht).2 _ hd
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.1 hev
  let n := max N 1
  have hnN : N ≤ n := Nat.le_max_left _ _
  have hn : 0 < n := lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one (Nat.le_max_right _ _)
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  rw [← hfin.coe_toFinset]
  apply finite_class_agnostic_at_size F hdefault hdefault_mem hγ0 hn
  simpa [q] using (hN n hnN).le

/-- On a finite instance type every class of measurable Boolean predictors is
finite, so both ordinary learning problems are completely solved without a VC
or family-measurability assumption. -/
lemma finite_domain_ordinary_PAC
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] [Finite 𝒳]
    (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool) (hH : H.Nonempty)
    {γ α δ : ℝ} (hγ0 : 0 < γ) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1)
    (hδ0 : 0 < δ) :
    (∃ n : ℕ, OrdinaryAgnosticPACAtSize H γ δ n) ∧
      ∃ n : ℕ, OrdinaryRealizablePACAtSize H α δ n := by
  classical
  letI : Finite (Predictor 𝒳 Bool) :=
    Finite.of_injective Predictor.f (fun h g hfg => by
      cases h
      cases g
      cases hfg
      rfl)
  have hfin : H.Finite := Set.toFinite H
  exact ⟨finite_class_ordinary_agnostic_PAC H hfin hH hγ0 hδ0,
    finite_class_ordinary_realizable_PAC H hfin hH hα0 hα1 hδ0⟩

/-! The combinatorial reduction used in the usual infinite-class proof is valid
without any measurability assumption on the class.  For a fixed tuple of
instances, `vcTrace H x` is the genuinely finite family of dichotomies induced
by `H`. -/

noncomputable def vcTrace
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool)
    {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → 𝒳) : Finset (Finset (Fin n)) := by
  classical
  exact Finset.univ.filter fun t =>
    ∃ h ∈ H, ∀ i, i ∈ t ↔ h.f (x i) = true

lemma mem_vcTrace
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool)
    {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → 𝒳) (t : Finset (Fin n)) :
    t ∈ vcTrace H x ↔ ∃ h ∈ H, ∀ i, i ∈ t ↔ h.f (x i) = true := by
  classical
  simp [vcTrace]

lemma vcTrace_injOn_of_shatters
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool)
    {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → 𝒳) {s : Finset (Fin n)}
    (hs : (vcTrace H x).Shatters s) : Set.InjOn x (s : Set (Fin n)) := by
  classical
  intro i hi j hj hijx
  by_contra hij
  have hisub : ({i} : Finset (Fin n)) ⊆ s := Finset.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hi
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hst⟩ := hs hisub
  obtain ⟨h, hh, hvals⟩ := (mem_vcTrace H x t).mp ht
  have hit : i ∈ t := by
    have : i ∈ s ∩ t := by rw [hst]; simp
    exact (Finset.mem_inter.mp this).2
  have hjt : j ∉ t := by
    intro hjt
    have : j ∈ s ∩ t := Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hj, hjt⟩
    rw [hst] at this
    exact hij (Finset.mem_singleton.mp this).symm
  have heqmem : (i ∈ t ↔ j ∈ t) := by
    rw [hvals i, hvals j, hijx]
  exact hjt (heqmem.mp hit)

lemma vcTrace_image_shattered
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] [DecidableEq 𝒳]
    (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool)
    {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → 𝒳) {s : Finset (Fin n)}
    (hs : (vcTrace H x).Shatters s) : ResearchLevel.Shatters H (s.image x) := by
  classical
  intro b
  let bx : Fin n → Bool := fun i =>
    if hi : i ∈ s then
      b ⟨x i, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩⟩
    else false
  let t : Finset (Fin n) := s.filter fun i => bx i = true
  have hts : t ⊆ s := Finset.filter_subset _ _
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hsu⟩ := hs hts
  obtain ⟨h, hh, hvals⟩ := (mem_vcTrace H x u).mp hu
  refine ⟨h, hh, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
  have hiu_iff : i ∈ u ↔ i ∈ t := by
    constructor
    · intro hiu
      have : i ∈ s ∩ u := Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hi, hiu⟩
      rwa [hsu] at this
    · intro hit
      have : i ∈ s ∩ u := by rwa [hsu]
      exact (Finset.mem_inter.mp this).2
  have htrue_iff : h.f (x i) = true ↔
      b ⟨x i, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩⟩ = true := by
    rw [← hvals i, hiu_iff]
    simp [t, bx, hi]
  cases hhf : h.f (x i) <;>
    cases hhb : b ⟨x i, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩⟩ <;>
    simp_all

lemma vcTrace_shattered_card_le
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] [DecidableEq 𝒳]
    (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool)
    {n d : ℕ} (x : Fin n → 𝒳) (hvc : VCDim H = (d : ℕ∞))
    {s : Finset (Fin n)} (hs : (vcTrace H x).Shatters s) : s.card ≤ d := by
  classical
  have hinj := vcTrace_injOn_of_shatters H x hs
  have hcard : (s.image x).card = s.card := Finset.card_image_of_injOn hinj
  have hsh := vcTrace_image_shattered H x hs
  have hle : (((s.image x).card : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ VCDim H := by
    exact le_iSup₂
      (f := fun (S : Finset 𝒳) (_ : Shatters H S) => (S.card : ℕ∞))
      (s.image x) hsh
  rw [hvc] at hle
  have : (s.image x).card ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hle
  omega

lemma vcTrace_vcDim_le
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool)
    {n d : ℕ} (x : Fin n → 𝒳) (hvc : VCDim H = (d : ℕ∞)) :
    (vcTrace H x).vcDim ≤ d := by
  classical
  unfold Finset.vcDim
  apply Finset.sup_le
  intro s hs
  exact vcTrace_shattered_card_le H x hvc (Finset.mem_shatterer.mp hs)

/-- Sauer--Shelah for the trace of the given class on an arbitrary finite
tuple.  Repetitions in the tuple are handled by the injectivity argument above. -/
theorem vcTrace_card_le_sauer
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool)
    {n d : ℕ} (x : Fin n → 𝒳) (hvc : VCDim H = (d : ℕ∞)) :
    (vcTrace H x).card ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic d, n.choose k := by
  classical
  calc
    (vcTrace H x).card ≤ (vcTrace H x).shatterer.card :=
      Finset.card_le_card_shatterer _
    _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic (vcTrace H x).vcDim, n.choose k := by
      simpa using (Finset.card_shatterer_le_sum_vcDim
        (𝒜 := vcTrace H x))
    _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic d, n.choose k := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset
        (Finset.Iic_subset_Iic.mpr (vcTrace_vcDim_le H x hvc))
