lemma robust_excess_le_of_ordinary {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳]
    (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool) (hH : H.Nonempty)
    (A : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (P : Measure (𝒳 × Bool)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    {ρ γ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hord : ordinaryError A P ≤
      (⨅ h : ↥H, ordinaryError (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) P) + γ) :
    robustRisk A P ρ ≤
      (⨅ h : ↥H, robustRisk (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) P ρ) +
        robustLip ρ * Real.sqrt γ := by
  letI : Nonempty ↥H := hH.to_subtype
  have hbddOrd : BddBelow (Set.range fun h : ↥H =>
      ordinaryError (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) P) := by
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨h, rfl⟩
    exact ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  have hInf_le (h : ↥H) :
      (⨅ g : ↥H, ordinaryError (g : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) P) ≤
        ordinaryError (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) P :=
    ciInf_le hbddOrd h
  simp_rw [robustRisk_eq_scalar]
  have hbase :
      scalarRobustRisk ρ (ordinaryError A P) - robustLip ρ * Real.sqrt γ ≤
        ⨅ h : ↥H, scalarRobustRisk ρ
          (ordinaryError (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) P) := by
    apply le_ciInf
    intro h
    have hpA0 : 0 ≤ ordinaryError A P := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
    have hpA1 := ordinaryError_le_one A P
    have hph0 : 0 ≤ ordinaryError (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) P := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
    have hph1 := ordinaryError_le_one (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) P
    by_cases hle : ordinaryError A P ≤ ordinaryError (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) P
    · have hm := scalarRobustRisk_mono hρ hpA0 hle hph1
      have hterm : 0 ≤ robustLip ρ * Real.sqrt γ :=
        mul_nonneg (robustLip_pos hρ).le (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
      linarith
    · have hha : ordinaryError (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) P ≤ ordinaryError A P :=
        le_of_not_ge hle
      have hdiff : ordinaryError A P - ordinaryError (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) P ≤ γ := by
        have := hInf_le h
        linarith
      have hlip := scalarRobustRisk_lip hρ hph0 hha hpA1
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt
          (ordinaryError A P - ordinaryError (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) P) ≤
          Real.sqrt γ := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hdiff
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsqrt (robustLip_pos hρ).le
      linarith
  linarith

lemma ordinaryAgnosticPAC_lifts_to_robust
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳]
    (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool) (hH : H.Nonempty)
    (ρ ε δ γ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hscale : robustLip ρ * Real.sqrt γ ≤ ε)
    (hPAC : OrdinaryAgnosticPACAtSize H γ δ n) :
    AgnosticPACAtSize H ρ ε δ n := by
  rcases hPAC with ⟨A, hA⟩
  refine ⟨A, ?_⟩
  intro P _
  apply le_trans (measure_mono ?_) (hA P)
  intro S hfail
  by_contra hnordinary
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hfail hnordinary ⊢
  have hord : ordinaryError (A S) P ≤
      (⨅ h : ↥H, ordinaryError (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) P) + γ :=
    le_of_not_gt hnordinary
  have hrob := robust_excess_le_of_ordinary H hH (A S) P hρ hγ hord
  linarith

lemma agnosticSampleComplexity_le_of_ordinaryPAC
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳]
    (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool) (hH : H.Nonempty)
    (ρ ε δ γ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hscale : robustLip ρ * Real.sqrt γ ≤ ε)
    (hPAC : OrdinaryAgnosticPACAtSize H γ δ n) :
    agnosticSampleComplexity H ρ ε δ ≤ (n : ℕ∞) := by
  unfold agnosticSampleComplexity
  apply sInf_le
  exact ⟨n, rfl,
    ordinaryAgnosticPAC_lifts_to_robust H hH ρ ε δ γ n hρ hγ hscale hPAC⟩

lemma robustRisk_zero_error_zero {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳]
    (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (P : Measure (𝒳 × Bool)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hz : robustRisk h P ρ = 0) : ordinaryError h P = 0 := by
  have hle := robustRisk_ge_error h P ρ hρ
  rw [hz] at hle
  exact le_antisymm hle ENNReal.toReal_nonneg

lemma robustRisk_le_c2_sqrt_error {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳]
    (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (P : Measure (𝒳 × Bool)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) :
    robustRisk h P ρ ≤ c2 ρ * Real.sqrt (ordinaryError h P) := by
  let p : ℝ := ordinaryError h P
  let q : ℝ := (P {z : 𝒳 × Bool | h.f z.1 = z.2}).toReal
  have hp : 0 ≤ p := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  have hq : 0 ≤ q := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  have hpq : p + q = 1 := error_correct_sum_one h P
  let η0 : etaDomain ρ := ⟨0, zero_mem_etaDomain ρ hρ⟩
  let F : etaDomain ρ → ℝ := fun η =>
    c2 ρ * Real.sqrt
      (p * (max (1 - (η : ℝ)) 0) ^ 2 + q * (max (0 - (η : ℝ)) 0) ^ 2) + (η : ℝ)
  have hbelow : BddBelow (Set.range F) := by
    refine ⟨p, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨η, rfl⟩
    exact scalar_rms_add_eta_ge p q (η : ℝ) (c2 ρ) hp hq hpq
      (c2_ge_one ρ hρ) (eta_le_one ρ η)
  rw [robustRisk]
  change iInf F ≤ c2 ρ * Real.sqrt p
  calc
    iInf F ≤ F η0 := ciInf_le hbelow η0
    _ = c2 ρ * Real.sqrt p := by simp [F, η0]

lemma robust_failure_implies_error {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳]
    (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (P : Measure (𝒳 × Bool)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (ρ ε : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hfail : ε < robustRisk h P ρ) :
    ε ^ 2 / (1 + 2 * ρ) < ordinaryError h P := by
  have hupper := robustRisk_le_c2_sqrt_error h P ρ hρ
  have hp : 0 ≤ ordinaryError h P := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  have hden : 0 < 1 + 2 * ρ := by linarith
  have hc : 0 ≤ c2 ρ := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hcsq : (c2 ρ) ^ 2 = 1 + 2 * ρ := by
    simp [c2, Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt hden)]
  have hsqrt_sq : (Real.sqrt (ordinaryError h P)) ^ 2 = ordinaryError h P :=
    Real.sq_sqrt hp
  apply (div_lt_iff₀ hden).2
  nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (ordinaryError h P)]

lemma ordinaryPAC_lifts_to_robust {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳]
    (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool) (ρ ε δ : ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hPAC : OrdinaryRealizablePACAtSize H (ε ^ 2 / (1 + 2 * ρ)) δ n) :
    RealizablePACAtSize H ρ ε δ n := by
  rcases hPAC with ⟨A, hA⟩
  refine ⟨A, ?_⟩
  intro P _ hreal
  apply le_trans (measure_mono ?_) (hA P ?_)
  · intro S hS
    exact robust_failure_implies_error (A S) P ρ ε hρ hε hS
  · rcases hreal with ⟨hstar, hhstar, hz⟩
    exact ⟨hstar, hhstar, robustRisk_zero_error_zero hstar P ρ hρ hz⟩

lemma realizableSampleComplexity_le_of_ordinaryPAC
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool)
    (ρ ε δ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hPAC : OrdinaryRealizablePACAtSize H (ε ^ 2 / (1 + 2 * ρ)) δ n) :
    realizableSampleComplexity H ρ ε δ ≤ (n : ℕ∞) := by
  unfold realizableSampleComplexity
  apply sInf_le
  exact ⟨n, rfl, ordinaryPAC_lifts_to_robust H ρ ε δ n hρ hε hPAC⟩

lemma theorem7_rhs_lower {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d)
    {ρ ε δ : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) :
    (((d : ℝ) + 1 + Real.log (2 / δ)) / ε ^ 4) ≤
      ((d / ε ^ 4) * Real.log (d / ε ^ 4)
        + (1 / ε ^ 4) * max (1 / (c2 ρ - 1)) 1
        + (d / ε ^ 4) * Real.log (Real.exp 1 / d)
        + Real.log (2 / δ) / ε ^ 4) := by
  have hdR : 0 < (d : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have he4 : 0 < ε ^ 4 := by positivity
  have hdne : (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hdR
  have he4ne : ε ^ 4 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt he4
  have hAne : (d : ℝ) / ε ^ 4 ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero hdne he4ne
  have hBne : Real.exp 1 / (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
    div_ne_zero (Real.exp_ne_zero _) hdne
  have hprod : ((d : ℝ) / ε ^ 4) * (Real.exp 1 / (d : ℝ)) =
      Real.exp 1 / ε ^ 4 := by
    field_simp
  have hlogsum : Real.log ((d : ℝ) / ε ^ 4) +
      Real.log (Real.exp 1 / (d : ℝ)) = 1 - Real.log (ε ^ 4) := by
    rw [← Real.log_mul hAne hBne, hprod,
      Real.log_div (Real.exp_ne_zero _) he4ne, Real.log_exp]
  have he2lt : ε ^ 2 < 1 := by
    nlinarith [mul_pos hε0 (sub_pos.mpr hε1)]
  have he4le : ε ^ 4 ≤ 1 := by
    have hm : 0 ≤ ε ^ 2 * (1 - ε ^ 2) :=
      mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg ε) (sub_nonneg.mpr he2lt.le)
    nlinarith
  have hloge : Real.log (ε ^ 4) ≤ 0 := Real.log_nonpos (by positivity) he4le
  have hlog_ge : 1 ≤ Real.log ((d : ℝ) / ε ^ 4) +
      Real.log (Real.exp 1 / (d : ℝ)) := by
    rw [hlogsum]
    linarith
  have hfactor0 : 0 ≤ (d : ℝ) / ε ^ 4 := by positivity
  have hfirst :
      (d / ε ^ 4) * Real.log (d / ε ^ 4) +
        (d / ε ^ 4) * Real.log (Real.exp 1 / d) ≥ (d : ℝ) / ε ^ 4 := by
    rw [← mul_add]
    simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog_ge hfactor0
  have hsecond : (1 : ℝ) / ε ^ 4 ≤
      (1 / ε ^ 4) * max (1 / (c2 ρ - 1)) 1 := by
    have hcoef : 0 ≤ (1 : ℝ) / ε ^ 4 := by positivity
    have hm : (1 : ℝ) ≤ max (1 / (c2 ρ - 1)) 1 := le_max_right _ _
    nlinarith
  have hid : (((d : ℝ) + 1 + Real.log (2 / δ)) / ε ^ 4) =
      (d : ℝ) / ε ^ 4 + 1 / ε ^ 4 + Real.log (2 / δ) / ε ^ 4 := by
    ring
  rw [hid]
  linarith

/-! ### VC packing bound -/

noncomputable def disagree {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳]
    (Q : Measure 𝒳) (h g : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) : ℝ :=
  (Q {x | h.f x ≠ g.f x}).toReal

lemma measurableSet_agree {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (h g : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) :
    MeasurableSet {x : 𝒳 | h.f x = g.f x} := by
  have he : {x : 𝒳 | h.f x = g.f x}
      = (h.f ⁻¹' {true} ∩ g.f ⁻¹' {true}) ∪ (h.f ⁻¹' {false} ∩ g.f ⁻¹' {false}) := by
    ext x
    cases hh : h.f x <;> cases hg : g.f x <;> simp [hh, hg]
  rw [he]
  exact ((h.hf (by trivial)).inter (g.hf (by trivial))).union
        ((h.hf (by trivial)).inter (g.hf (by trivial)))

lemma disagree_nonneg {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (Q : Measure 𝒳)
    (h g : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) : 0 ≤ disagree Q h g := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg

lemma disagree_le_one {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (Q : Measure 𝒳) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    (h g : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) : disagree Q h g ≤ 1 := by
  have hm : Q {x : 𝒳 | h.f x ≠ g.f x} ≤ Q Set.univ := measure_mono (Set.subset_univ _)
  rw [measure_univ] at hm
  have := ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.one_ne_top hm
  simpa [disagree] using this

lemma measure_agree_eq {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (Q : Measure 𝒳) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    (h g : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) :
    Q {x | h.f x = g.f x} = ENNReal.ofReal (1 - disagree Q h g) := by
  have hcompl : {x : 𝒳 | h.f x ≠ g.f x} = {x : 𝒳 | h.f x = g.f x}ᶜ := by
    ext x; simp
  have hsum := measure_add_measure_compl (μ := Q) (measurableSet_agree h g)
  have h1 : Q {x : 𝒳 | h.f x = g.f x} ≠ ⊤ := measure_ne_top _ _
  have h2 : Q ({x : 𝒳 | h.f x = g.f x}ᶜ) ≠ ⊤ := measure_ne_top _ _
  have h3 := congrArg ENNReal.toReal hsum
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_add h1 h2] at h3
  simp only [measure_univ, ENNReal.toReal_one] at h3
  have hd : disagree Q h g = (Q ({x : 𝒳 | h.f x = g.f x}ᶜ)).toReal := by
    rw [disagree, hcompl]
  rw [hd, ← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal h1]
  congr 1
  linarith


/-- **VC packing bound.**  If `F` is a family of members of a class of VC dimension `d`
that are pairwise at disagreement-distance at least `α` under the instance distribution
`Q`, and if `m` is large enough that `|F|² (1-α)^m < 1`, then `|F|` is at most the
Sauer--Shelah bound at `m`.  No measurability assumption is made on the class: only
finitely many fixed measurable predictors are ever handled at once. -/
theorem vc_packing_card_le
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool)
    {d : ℕ} (hvc : VCDim H = (d : ℕ∞))
    (Q : Measure 𝒳) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 ≤ α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1)
    (F : Finset (Predictor 𝒳 Bool)) (hFH : ∀ h ∈ F, h ∈ H)
    (hsep : ∀ h ∈ F, ∀ g ∈ F, h ≠ g → α ≤ disagree Q h g)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : ((F.card : ℝ))^2 * (1 - α)^m < 1) :
    F.card ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic d, m.choose k := by
  classical
  set μ : Measure (Fin m → 𝒳) := Measure.pi (fun _ => Q) with hμ
  haveI : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := by rw [hμ]; infer_instance
  set Pairs : Finset (Predictor 𝒳 Bool × Predictor 𝒳 Bool) :=
    (F ×ˢ F).filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ p.2) with hPairs
  set E : Predictor 𝒳 Bool × Predictor 𝒳 Bool → Set (Fin m → 𝒳) :=
    fun p => Set.univ.pi (fun _ : Fin m => {y : 𝒳 | p.1.f y = p.2.f y}) with hE
  have hEle : ∀ p ∈ Pairs, μ (E p) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1-α)^m) := by
    intro p hp
    have hp' : p.1 ∈ F ∧ p.2 ∈ F ∧ p.1 ≠ p.2 := by
      have := Finset.mem_filter.mp hp
      exact ⟨(Finset.mem_product.mp this.1).1, (Finset.mem_product.mp this.1).2, this.2⟩
    have hsep' : α ≤ disagree Q p.1 p.2 := hsep _ hp'.1 _ hp'.2.1 hp'.2.2
    have : μ (E p) = (Q {y : 𝒳 | p.1.f y = p.2.f y})^m := by
      rw [hE, hμ]
      simp only
      rw [Measure.pi_pi]
      simp
    have hd1 : disagree Q p.1 p.2 ≤ 1 := disagree_le_one Q _ _
    rw [this, measure_agree_eq]
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_pow (by linarith)]
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    gcongr <;> linarith
  have hunion : μ (⋃ p ∈ Pairs, E p) < 1 := by
    calc μ (⋃ p ∈ Pairs, E p) ≤ ∑ p ∈ Pairs, μ (E p) := measure_biUnion_finset_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _p ∈ Pairs, ENNReal.ofReal ((1-α)^m) := Finset.sum_le_sum hEle
      _ = (Pairs.card : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal ((1-α)^m) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      _ ≤ ((F.card * F.card : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal ((1-α)^m) := by
          have hcard : Pairs.card ≤ F.card * F.card := by
            have h1 : Pairs ⊆ F ×ˢ F := Finset.filter_subset _ _
            have h2 := Finset.card_le_card h1
            simpa [Finset.card_product] using h2
          gcongr
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (((F.card : ℝ))^2 * (1-α)^m) := by
          rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity)]
          congr 1
          rw [show ((F.card : ℝ))^2 = ((F.card * F.card : ℕ) : ℝ) by push_cast; ring]
          exact (ENNReal.ofReal_natCast _).symm
      _ < 1 := ENNReal.ofReal_lt_one.mpr hm
  have hne : (⋃ p ∈ Pairs, E p) ≠ Set.univ := by
    intro hcon
    rw [hcon, measure_univ] at hunion
    exact lt_irrefl _ hunion
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x : Fin m → 𝒳, x ∉ ⋃ p ∈ Pairs, E p := by
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    exact hne (Set.eq_univ_of_forall hcon)
  set φ : Predictor 𝒳 Bool → Finset (Fin m) :=
    fun h => Finset.univ.filter (fun i => h.f (x i) = true) with hφ
  have hmemtrace : ∀ h ∈ F, φ h ∈ vcTrace H x := by
    intro h hh
    rw [mem_vcTrace]
    exact ⟨h, hFH h hh, by intro i; simp [hφ]⟩
  have hinj : Set.InjOn φ (F : Set (Predictor 𝒳 Bool)) := by
    intro h hh g hg hfg
    by_contra hne'
    have hpair : (h, g) ∈ Pairs := by
      rw [hPairs, Finset.mem_filter]
      exact ⟨Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hh, hg⟩, hne'⟩
    have hxE : x ∉ E (h, g) := by
      intro hmem
      exact hx (Set.mem_biUnion hpair hmem)
    apply hxE
    rw [hE]
    intro i _
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    have hiff : (i ∈ φ h) ↔ (i ∈ φ g) := by rw [hfg]
    simp only [hφ, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hiff
    by_cases hb : h.f (x i) = true
    · have hb2 : g.f (x i) = true := hiff.mp hb
      rw [hb, hb2]
    · have hb' : h.f (x i) = false := by
        cases hc : h.f (x i) with
        | false => rfl
        | true => exact absurd hc hb
      have hg' : g.f (x i) = false := by
        cases hc : g.f (x i) with
        | false => rfl
        | true => exact absurd (hiff.mpr hc) hb
      rw [hb', hg']
  calc F.card = (F.image φ).card := (Finset.card_image_of_injOn hinj).symm
    _ ≤ (vcTrace H x).card := by
        apply Finset.card_le_card
        intro t ht
        obtain ⟨h, hh, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ht
        exact hmemtrace h hh
    _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic d, m.choose k := vcTrace_card_le_sauer H x hvc



/-! ### Sauer sum numeric bound -/

section SauerNum
open Finset

/-- `∑_{k ≤ d} C(n,k) ≤ (e n / d)^d` for `0 < d ≤ n`. -/
lemma sum_Iic_choose_le_exp (n d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hdn : d ≤ n) :
    ((∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic d, n.choose k : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (Real.exp 1 * n / d) ^ d := by
  have hn : 0 < n := lt_of_lt_of_le hd hdn
  have hnR : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hdR : (0:ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  set x : ℝ := (d : ℝ) / n with hxdef
  have hx0 : 0 < x := div_pos hdR hnR
  have hx1 : x ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hxdef, div_le_one hnR]
    exact_mod_cast hdn
  have hxinv : (0:ℝ) < 1 / x := by positivity
  -- step 1 : each term is at most  C(n,k) x^k (1/x)^d
  have step1 : ((∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic d, n.choose k : ℕ) : ℝ)
      ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic d, ((n.choose k : ℝ) * x ^ k) * (1/x) ^ d := by
    push_cast
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro k hk
    have hkd : k ≤ d := Finset.mem_Iic.mp hk
    have hxk : x ^ d ≤ x ^ k := pow_le_pow_of_le_one hx0.le hx1 hkd
    have hc : (0:ℝ) ≤ (n.choose k : ℝ) := by positivity
    have : (1:ℝ) ≤ x ^ k * (1/x) ^ d := by
      have hrw : x ^ k * (1/x) ^ d = x ^ k / x ^ d := by
        rw [one_div, inv_pow, ← div_eq_mul_inv]
      rw [hrw, le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hx0 d)]
      simpa using hxk
    calc (n.choose k : ℝ) = (n.choose k : ℝ) * 1 := by ring
      _ ≤ (n.choose k : ℝ) * (x ^ k * (1/x) ^ d) := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this hc
      _ = ((n.choose k : ℝ) * x ^ k) * (1/x) ^ d := by ring
  -- step 2 : extend the sum to the whole range and use the binomial theorem
  have step2 : ∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic d, ((n.choose k : ℝ) * x ^ k)
      ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), ((n.choose k : ℝ) * x ^ k) := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
    · intro k hk
      have := Finset.mem_Iic.mp hk
      exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
    · intro k _ _
      positivity
  have hbin : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), ((n.choose k : ℝ) * x ^ k) = (x + 1) ^ n := by
    rw [add_pow]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k hk
    rw [one_pow]
    ring
  have hexp : (x + 1) ^ n ≤ Real.exp 1 ^ d := by
    have h1 : (x + 1) ^ n ≤ (Real.exp x) ^ n :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (Real.add_one_le_exp x) n
    have h2 : (Real.exp x) ^ n = Real.exp 1 ^ d := by
      rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul, ← Real.exp_nat_mul]
      congr 1
      rw [hxdef]
      field_simp
    linarith [h1, h2.le, h2.ge]
  have hfin : ((∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic d, n.choose k : ℕ) : ℝ)
      ≤ (Real.exp 1) ^ d * (1/x) ^ d := by
    calc ((∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic d, n.choose k : ℕ) : ℝ)
        ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic d, ((n.choose k : ℝ) * x ^ k) * (1/x) ^ d := step1
      _ = (∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic d, ((n.choose k : ℝ) * x ^ k)) * (1/x) ^ d := by
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      _ ≤ ((x + 1) ^ n) * (1/x) ^ d := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_trans step2 (le_of_eq hbin))
          positivity
      _ ≤ (Real.exp 1) ^ d * (1/x) ^ d := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hexp
          positivity
  have hxx : (1:ℝ)/x = (n:ℝ)/d := by
    rw [hxdef]; field_simp
  rw [hxx] at hfin
  calc ((∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic d, n.choose k : ℕ) : ℝ)
      ≤ (Real.exp 1) ^ d * ((n:ℝ)/d) ^ d := hfin
    _ = (Real.exp 1 * n / d) ^ d := by
        rw [← mul_pow]; congr 1; field_simp

end SauerNum


/-! ### The combinatorial core of the symmetrisation argument -/

section Counting
open Finset

/-- If `T` is a set of indices at which we exchange the two halves of a paired sample,
`a i` records whether a fixed predictor errs at the first member of the `i`-th pair and
`b i` whether it errs at the second one.  The number of exchange patterns which make the
predictor consistent on the first half and produce at least `r` errors on the second half
is at most `2 ^ (m - r)`. -/
def swapGood {m : ℕ} (a b : Fin m → Bool) (r : ℕ) : Finset (Finset (Fin m)) :=
  (Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin m))).filter (fun T =>
        (∀ i, (if i ∈ T then b i else a i) = false) ∧
        r ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => (if i ∈ T then a i else b i) = true)).card)

lemma mem_swapGood {m : ℕ} (a b : Fin m → Bool) (r : ℕ) (T : Finset (Fin m)) :
    T ∈ swapGood a b r ↔
      ((∀ i, (if i ∈ T then b i else a i) = false) ∧
        r ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => (if i ∈ T then a i else b i) = true)).card) := by
  rw [swapGood, Finset.mem_filter]
  exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, h⟩⟩

lemma card_swap_good_le {m : ℕ} (a b : Fin m → Bool) (r : ℕ) :
    (swapGood a b r).card ≤ 2 ^ (m - r) := by
  classical
  set G := swapGood a b r with hGdef
  rcases Finset.eq_empty_or_nonempty G with hemp | ⟨T₀, hT₀⟩
  · simp [hemp]
  · have hmemG : ∀ T, T ∈ G ↔ ((∀ i, (if i ∈ T then b i else a i) = false) ∧
        r ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => (if i ∈ T then a i else b i) = true)).card) := by
      intro T; rw [hGdef]; exact mem_swapGood a b r T
    have hT₀' := (hmemG T₀).mp hT₀
    -- no index can be an error on both sides
    have hnotboth : ∀ i, ¬ (a i = true ∧ b i = true) := by
      intro i ⟨ha, hb⟩
      have := hT₀'.1 i
      by_cases hi : i ∈ T₀
      · rw [if_pos hi] at this; rw [hb] at this; exact Bool.noConfusion this
      · rw [if_neg hi] at this; rw [ha] at this; exact Bool.noConfusion this
    set D : Finset (Fin m) := Finset.univ.filter (fun i => a i = true ∨ b i = true) with hDdef
    have hmemD : ∀ i, i ∈ D ↔ (a i = true ∨ b i = true) := by
      intro i; rw [hDdef]; simp
    -- membership in `T` is forced on `D`
    have hforced : ∀ T ∈ G, ∀ i ∈ D, (i ∈ T ↔ a i = true) := by
      intro T hT i hi
      have hcond := ((hmemG T).mp hT).1 i
      rcases (hmemD i).mp hi with ha | hb
      · have hb : b i = false := by
          cases hbb : b i
          · rfl
          · exact absurd ⟨ha, hbb⟩ (hnotboth i)
        constructor
        · intro _; exact ha
        · intro _
          by_contra hiT
          rw [if_neg hiT] at hcond
          rw [ha] at hcond; exact Bool.noConfusion hcond
      · have ha : a i = false := by
          cases haa : a i
          · rfl
          · exact absurd ⟨haa, hb⟩ (hnotboth i)
        constructor
        · intro hiT
          rw [if_pos hiT] at hcond
          rw [hb] at hcond; exact Bool.noConfusion hcond
        · intro h; rw [ha] at h; exact Bool.noConfusion h
    -- the set of second-half errors is exactly `D`
    have hDeq : ∀ T ∈ G,
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => (if i ∈ T then a i else b i) = true)) = D := by
      intro T hT
      ext i
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      constructor
      · intro hv
        rw [hmemD]
        by_cases hi : i ∈ T
        · rw [if_pos hi] at hv; exact Or.inl hv
        · rw [if_neg hi] at hv; exact Or.inr hv
      · intro hi
        have hfor := hforced T hT i hi
        rcases (hmemD i).mp hi with ha | hb
        · have hiT : i ∈ T := hfor.mpr ha
          rw [if_pos hiT]; exact ha
        · have ha : a i = false := by
            cases haa : a i
            · rfl
            · exact absurd ⟨haa, hb⟩ (hnotboth i)
          have hiT : i ∉ T := by
            intro hc
            have := hfor.mp hc
            rw [ha] at this; exact Bool.noConfusion this
          rw [if_neg hiT]; exact hb
    have hrD : r ≤ D.card := by
      have := ((hmemG T₀).mp hT₀).2
      rwa [hDeq T₀ hT₀] at this
    -- the map `T ↦ T \ D` is injective on `G`
    have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun T => T \ D) (G : Set (Finset (Fin m))) := by
      intro T hT T' hT' hEq
      dsimp only at hEq
      have hTdec : ∀ (U : Finset (Fin m)), U ∈ G →
          U = (U \ D) ∪ (D.filter (fun i => a i = true)) := by
        intro U hU
        ext i
        simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_filter]
        constructor
        · intro hiU
          by_cases hiD : i ∈ D
          · exact Or.inr ⟨hiD, (hforced U hU i hiD).mp hiU⟩
          · exact Or.inl ⟨hiU, hiD⟩
        · rintro (⟨h1, _⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩)
          · exact h1
          · exact (hforced U hU i h1).mpr h2
      rw [hTdec T hT, hTdec T' hT', hEq]
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun T => T \ D) (↑G : Set (Finset (Fin m)))
        (↑(((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)) \ D).powerset) : Set (Finset (Fin m))) := by
      intro T _
      simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_powerset]
      intro i hi
      simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff] at hi ⊢
      exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, hi.2⟩
    have hcard := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn (fun T => T \ D) hmaps hinj
    have hpow : ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)) \ D).powerset.card
        = 2 ^ (m - D.card) := by
      rw [Finset.card_powerset, ← Finset.compl_eq_univ_sdiff, Finset.card_compl,
        Fintype.card_fin]
    rw [hpow] at hcard
    refine hcard.trans ?_
    exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)

end Counting


/-! ### Symmetrisation -/

section Symmetrization
open Finset

/-- Exchange the two members of the `i`-th pair exactly for `i ∈ T`. -/
def swapPairs {Z : Type*} {m : ℕ} (T : Finset (Fin m)) (w : Fin m → Z × Z) : Fin m → Z × Z :=
  fun i => (if i ∈ T then (Prod.swap : Z × Z → Z × Z) else id) (w i)

lemma swapPairs_apply {Z : Type*} {m : ℕ} (T : Finset (Fin m))
    (w : Fin m → Z × Z) (i : Fin m) :
    swapPairs T w i = if i ∈ T then (w i).swap else w i := by
  unfold swapPairs
  by_cases h : i ∈ T <;> simp [h]

lemma measurable_swapPairs {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] {m : ℕ} (T : Finset (Fin m)) :
    Measurable (swapPairs T : (Fin m → Z × Z) → (Fin m → Z × Z)) := by
  apply measurable_pi_lambda
  intro i
  by_cases h : i ∈ T
  · simp only [swapPairs, h, if_true]
    exact measurable_swap.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)
  · simp only [swapPairs, h, if_false]
    exact measurable_pi_apply i

lemma measurePreserving_swapPairs {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z]
    (P : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure P] {m : ℕ} (T : Finset (Fin m)) :
    MeasurePreserving (swapPairs T : (Fin m → Z × Z) → (Fin m → Z × Z))
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P.prod P) (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P.prod P) := by
  have hrw : (swapPairs T : (Fin m → Z × Z) → (Fin m → Z × Z)) =
      fun a i => (if i ∈ T then (Prod.swap : Z × Z → Z × Z) else id) (a i) := rfl
  rw [hrw]
  refine measurePreserving_pi _ _ ?_
  intro i
  by_cases h : i ∈ T
  · rw [if_pos h]
    exact Measure.measurePreserving_swap
  · rw [if_neg h]
    exact MeasurePreserving.id _

/-- The symmetrisation inequality: if every paired sample admits at most `N` exchange
patterns landing in `E`, then `2 ^ m · μ E ≤ N`. -/
lemma symmetrization_le {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z]
    (P : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure P] {m : ℕ}
    (E : Set (Fin m → Z × Z)) (hE : MeasurableSet E) (N : ℕ)
    (hcount : ∀ w : Fin m → Z × Z,
      ∑ T ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin m))),
        Set.indicator (swapPairs T ⁻¹' E) (1 : (Fin m → Z × Z) → ℝ≥0∞) w ≤ (N : ℝ≥0∞)) :
    2 ^ m * (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P.prod P) E ≤ (N : ℝ≥0∞) := by
  classical
  set ν : Measure (Fin m → Z × Z) := Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P.prod P with hν
  haveI : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := by rw [hν]; infer_instance
  have hmeas : ∀ T : Finset (Fin m), MeasurableSet (swapPairs T ⁻¹' E) :=
    fun T => (measurable_swapPairs T) hE
  have hpre : ∀ T : Finset (Fin m), ν (swapPairs T ⁻¹' E) = ν E := by
    intro T
    exact (measurePreserving_swapPairs P T).measure_preimage hE.nullMeasurableSet
  have hsum : ∑ _T ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin m))), ν E = 2 ^ m * ν E := by
    rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    congr 1
    rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_finset, Fintype.card_fin]
    simp
  have hint : ∑ T ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin m))), ν (swapPairs T ⁻¹' E)
      = ∫⁻ w, ∑ T ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin m))),
          Set.indicator (swapPairs T ⁻¹' E) 1 w ∂ν := by
    rw [lintegral_finset_sum]
    · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun T _ => (lintegral_indicator_one (hmeas T)).symm
    · intro T _
      exact measurable_one.indicator (hmeas T)
  have hptw := hcount
  calc 2 ^ m * ν E = ∑ T ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin m))), ν (swapPairs T ⁻¹' E) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun T _ => hpre T, hsum]
    _ = ∫⁻ w, ∑ T ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin m))),
          Set.indicator (swapPairs T ⁻¹' E) 1 w ∂ν := hint
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ _w, (N : ℝ≥0∞) ∂ν := lintegral_mono hptw
    _ = (N : ℝ≥0∞) := by simp

end Symmetrization


/-! ### The ghost-sample event and its symmetrisation estimate -/

section Ghost
open Finset

variable {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳]

/-- Number of mistakes of `h` on the second members of the pairs. -/
def sndErrCount {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {m : ℕ}
    (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (w : Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool)) : ℕ :=
  (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => h.f ((w i).2).1 ≠ ((w i).2).2)).card

/-- The paired sample is *bad* if some member of the (countable) family is consistent with
all first members and errs on at least `r` second members. -/
def ghostEvent {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {m : ℕ}
    (e : ℕ → Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (r : ℕ) : Set (Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool)) :=
  {w | ∃ k, (∀ i, (e k).f ((w i).1).1 = ((w i).1).2) ∧ r ≤ sndErrCount (e k) w}

def patA {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {m : ℕ} (p : Fin (m+m) → Bool)
    (w : Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool)) : Fin m → Bool :=
  fun i => decide (p (Fin.castAdd m i) ≠ ((w i).1).2)

def patB {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {m : ℕ} (p : Fin (m+m) → Bool)
    (w : Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool)) : Fin m → Bool :=
  fun i => decide (p (Fin.natAdd m i) ≠ ((w i).2).2)

lemma measurableSet_ghostEvent {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {m : ℕ}
    (e : ℕ → Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (r : ℕ) :
    MeasurableSet (ghostEvent (m := m) e r) := by
  classical
  have hfst : ∀ i : Fin m, Measurable
      (fun w : Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool) => (w i).1) :=
    fun i => measurable_fst.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)
  have hsnd : ∀ i : Fin m, Measurable
      (fun w : Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool) => (w i).2) :=
    fun i => measurable_snd.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)
  have hA : ∀ h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool, MeasurableSet
      {w : Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool) | ∀ i, h.f ((w i).1).1 = ((w i).1).2} := by
    intro h
    have : {w : Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool) | ∀ i, h.f ((w i).1).1 = ((w i).1).2}
        = ⋂ i : Fin m, (fun w : Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool) => (w i).1) ⁻¹'
            {z : 𝒳 × Bool | h.f z.1 = z.2} := by
      ext w; simp [Set.mem_iInter]
    rw [this]
    exact MeasurableSet.iInter fun i => (hfst i) (meas_eq_set h)
  have hB : ∀ h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool, MeasurableSet
      {w : Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool) | r ≤ sndErrCount h w} := by
    intro h
    have hrep : {w : Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool) | r ≤ sndErrCount h w}
        = ⋃ S ∈ (Finset.univ.filter (fun S : Finset (Fin m) => r ≤ S.card)),
            ⋂ i ∈ S, (fun w : Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool) => (w i).2) ⁻¹'
              {z : 𝒳 × Bool | h.f z.1 ≠ z.2} := by
      ext w
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_preimage,
        Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      constructor
      · intro hw
        refine ⟨Finset.univ.filter (fun i => h.f ((w i).2).1 ≠ ((w i).2).2), hw, ?_⟩
        intro i hi
        exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
      · rintro ⟨S, hS, hmem⟩
        have hsub : S ⊆ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => h.f ((w i).2).1 ≠ ((w i).2).2) := by
          intro i hi
          exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, hmem i hi⟩
        exact le_trans hS (Finset.card_le_card hsub)
    rw [hrep]
    refine Finset.measurableSet_biUnion _ ?_
    intro S _
    exact Finset.measurableSet_biInter _ (fun i _ => (hsnd i) (meas_ne_set h))
  have hrep : ghostEvent (m := m) e r =
      ⋃ k : ℕ, ({w : Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool) |
          ∀ i, (e k).f ((w i).1).1 = ((w i).1).2} ∩
        {w : Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool) | r ≤ sndErrCount (e k) w}) := by
    ext w
    simp [ghostEvent, Set.mem_iUnion]
  rw [hrep]
  exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun k => (hA (e k)).inter (hB (e k))

/-- The pointwise (in the paired sample) estimate feeding the symmetrisation lemma. -/
lemma ghost_indicator_sum_le {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool)
    {d : ℕ} (hvc : VCDim H = (d : ℕ∞)) (e : ℕ → Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (he : ∀ k, e k ∈ H)
    {m : ℕ} (r : ℕ) (w : Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool)) :
    ∑ T ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin m))),
        Set.indicator (swapPairs T ⁻¹' (ghostEvent e r))
          (1 : (Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool)) → ℝ≥0∞) w
      ≤ (((∑ j ∈ Finset.Iic d, (m+m).choose j) * 2 ^ (m - r) : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) := by
  classical
  set x : Fin (m+m) → 𝒳 :=
    Fin.append (fun i => ((w i).1).1) (fun i => ((w i).2).1) with hx
  have hxl : ∀ i : Fin m, x (Fin.castAdd m i) = ((w i).1).1 := by
    intro i; rw [hx]; exact Fin.append_left _ _ i
  have hxr : ∀ i : Fin m, x (Fin.natAdd m i) = ((w i).2).1 := by
    intro i; rw [hx]; exact Fin.append_right _ _ i
  have hind : ∀ T : Finset (Fin m),
      Set.indicator (swapPairs T ⁻¹' (ghostEvent e r))
        (1 : (Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool)) → ℝ≥0∞) w
      = if swapPairs T w ∈ ghostEvent e r then 1 else 0 := by
    intro T
    by_cases hT : swapPairs T w ∈ ghostEvent e r
    · have hmem : w ∈ swapPairs T ⁻¹' ghostEvent e r := hT
      rw [if_pos hT, Set.indicator_of_mem hmem]
      rfl
    · have hmem : w ∉ swapPairs T ⁻¹' ghostEvent e r := hT
      rw [if_neg hT, Set.indicator_of_notMem hmem]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun T _ => hind T), Finset.sum_boole]
  have hsub : (Finset.univ.filter (fun T : Finset (Fin m) => swapPairs T w ∈ ghostEvent e r))
      ⊆ (vcTrace H x).biUnion
          (fun t => swapGood (patA (fun j => decide (j ∈ t)) w)
                             (patB (fun j => decide (j ∈ t)) w) r) := by
    intro T hT
    obtain ⟨k, hcons, hcnt⟩ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hT).2
    set h := e k with hh
    set t : Finset (Fin (m+m)) := Finset.univ.filter (fun j => h.f (x j) = true) with ht
    have hpt : ∀ j, (decide (j ∈ t)) = h.f (x j) := by
      intro j
      rw [ht]
      simp
    have htmem : t ∈ vcTrace H x := by
      rw [mem_vcTrace]
      refine ⟨h, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hh]; exact he k
      · intro j; rw [ht]; simp
    refine Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨t, htmem, ?_⟩
    rw [mem_swapGood]
    constructor
    · intro i
      have hci := hcons i
      rw [swapPairs_apply] at hci
      by_cases hi : i ∈ T
      · rw [if_pos hi] at hci ⊢
        rw [patB, hpt, hxr]
        simp only [decide_eq_false_iff_not, not_not]
        exact hci
      · rw [if_neg hi] at hci ⊢
        rw [patA, hpt, hxl]
        simp only [decide_eq_false_iff_not, not_not]
        exact hci
    · refine le_trans hcnt (le_of_eq ?_)
      rw [sndErrCount]
      apply congrArg
      apply Finset.filter_congr
      intro i _
      by_cases hi : i ∈ T
      · rw [swapPairs_apply, if_pos hi, if_pos hi, patA, hpt, hxl]
        simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
        exact Iff.rfl
      · rw [swapPairs_apply, if_neg hi, if_neg hi, patB, hpt, hxr]
        simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
  have hcard : (Finset.univ.filter
      (fun T : Finset (Fin m) => swapPairs T w ∈ ghostEvent e r)).card
      ≤ (∑ j ∈ Finset.Iic d, (m+m).choose j) * 2 ^ (m - r) := by
    calc (Finset.univ.filter
        (fun T : Finset (Fin m) => swapPairs T w ∈ ghostEvent e r)).card
        ≤ ((vcTrace H x).biUnion
            (fun t => swapGood (patA (fun j => decide (j ∈ t)) w)
                               (patB (fun j => decide (j ∈ t)) w) r)).card :=
          Finset.card_le_card hsub
      _ ≤ ∑ t ∈ vcTrace H x, (swapGood (patA (fun j => decide (j ∈ t)) w)
                               (patB (fun j => decide (j ∈ t)) w) r).card :=
          Finset.card_biUnion_le
      _ ≤ ∑ _t ∈ vcTrace H x, 2 ^ (m - r) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun t _ => card_swap_good_le _ _ _
      _ = (vcTrace H x).card * 2 ^ (m - r) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul]
      _ ≤ (∑ j ∈ Finset.Iic d, (m+m).choose j) * 2 ^ (m - r) :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (vcTrace_card_le_sauer H x hvc)
  exact_mod_cast Nat.cast_le.mpr hcard

end Ghost


/-! ### A Chebyshev lower bound for the number of mistakes on a fresh sample -/

section Cheb
open Finset ProbabilityTheory

lemma half_le_measure_many_errors {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z]
    (P : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure P] {m : ℕ}
    (f : Z → ℝ) (hf : Measurable f) (hf0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ f z) (hf1 : ∀ z, f z ≤ 1)
    {p α : ℝ} (hint : ∫ z, f z ∂P = p) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hαp : α ≤ p)
    (hm : 8 ≤ α * m) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) ≤
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P) {S | α * m / 2 ≤ ∑ i, f (S i)} := by
  classical
  set μ : Measure (Fin m → Z) := Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P with hμ
  haveI : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := by rw [hμ]; infer_instance
  have hp0 : 0 < p := lt_of_lt_of_le hα0 hαp
  have hmR : (0:ℝ) < m := by nlinarith
  have hfint : Integrable f P :=
    Integrable.of_mem_Icc 0 1 hf.aemeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => ⟨hf0 z, hf1 z⟩)
  have hp1 : p ≤ 1 := by
    rw [← hint]
    have := integral_mono hfint (integrable_const (1:ℝ)) (fun z => hf1 z)
    simpa using this
  set Xi : Fin m → (Fin m → Z) → ℝ := fun i S => f (S i) with hXi
  have hXim : ∀ i, Measurable (Xi i) := fun i => hf.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)
  have hmemLp : ∀ i, MemLp (Xi i) 2 μ := by
    intro i
    refine MemLp.of_bound (hXim i).aestronglyMeasurable 1 ?_
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun S => ?_
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hf0 _)]
    exact hf1 _
  have hEi : ∀ i, ∫ S, Xi i S ∂μ = p := by
    intro i
    rw [hμ, hXi]
    rw [integral_comp_eval hf.aestronglyMeasurable]
    exact hint
  have hindep : iIndepFun Xi μ := by
    rw [hμ, hXi]
    exact iIndepFun_pi (fun _ => hf.aemeasurable)
  have hvari : ∀ i, variance (Xi i) μ ≤ p := by
    intro i
    have hb := variance_le_sub_mul_sub (μ := μ) (X := Xi i) (a := 0) (b := 1)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun S => ⟨hf0 _, hf1 _⟩) (hXim i).aemeasurable
    rw [hEi i] at hb
    nlinarith [hb, hp0, hp1]
  set X : (Fin m → Z) → ℝ := ∑ i, Xi i with hX
  have hXapp : ∀ S, X S = ∑ i, f (S i) := by
    intro S
    rw [hX]
    simp [hXi]
  have hMemX : MemLp X 2 μ := by
    rw [hX]
    exact memLp_finset_sum' _ (fun i _ => hmemLp i)
  have hEX : ∫ S, X S ∂μ = m * p := by
    simp only [hX, Finset.sum_apply]
    rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => (hmemLp i).integrable (by norm_num))]
    simp [hEi]
  have hVarX : variance X μ ≤ m * p := by
    rw [hX]
    rw [ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun.variance_sum (fun i _ => hmemLp i)
      (fun i _ j _ hij => hindep.indepFun hij)]
    calc ∑ i : Fin m, variance (Xi i) μ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin m, p :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hvari i
      _ = m * p := by simp [mul_comm]
  set c : ℝ := (m : ℝ) * p / 2 with hc
  have hc0 : 0 < c := by rw [hc]; positivity
  have hcheb := ProbabilityTheory.meas_ge_le_variance_div_sq (μ := μ) hMemX hc0
  rw [hEX] at hcheb
  -- the bad set
  have hsub : {S : Fin m → Z | ¬ (α * m / 2 ≤ ∑ i, f (S i))}
      ⊆ {S | c ≤ |X S - (m : ℝ) * p|} := by
    intro S hS
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_le] at hS
    have h1 : X S < α * m / 2 := by rw [hXapp]; exact hS
    have h2 : α * m / 2 ≤ c := by
      rw [hc]
      have : α * (m:ℝ) ≤ (m:ℝ) * p := by nlinarith
      linarith
    have h3 : X S < c := lt_of_lt_of_le h1 h2
    have h4 : (m:ℝ) * p - X S ≥ c := by rw [hc] at h3 ⊢; linarith
    rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq, abs_sub_comm, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
    linarith
  have hbadle : μ {S : Fin m → Z | ¬ (α * m / 2 ≤ ∑ i, f (S i))} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) := by
    refine le_trans (measure_mono hsub) (le_trans hcheb ?_)
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    have hmp : (8:ℝ) ≤ (m:ℝ) * p := by nlinarith
    have hcsq : c^2 = ((m:ℝ)*p)^2/4 := by rw [hc]; ring
    rw [hcsq]
    nlinarith [hVarX, hmp]
  -- conclude
  have hGmeas : MeasurableSet {S : Fin m → Z | α * m / 2 ≤ ∑ i, f (S i)} := by
    have : Measurable (fun S : Fin m → Z => ∑ i, f (S i)) := by
      apply Finset.measurable_sum
      intro i _
      exact hf.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)
    exact measurableSet_le measurable_const this
  have hcompl : {S : Fin m → Z | α * m / 2 ≤ ∑ i, f (S i)}ᶜ
      = {S : Fin m → Z | ¬ (α * m / 2 ≤ ∑ i, f (S i))} := rfl
  have hadd := measure_add_measure_compl (μ := μ) hGmeas
  rw [hcompl, measure_univ] at hadd
  have hhalf : ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) + ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) = 1 := by
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_add (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
    norm_num
  have hfin : ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) + ENNReal.ofReal (1/2)
      ≤ μ {S : Fin m → Z | α * m / 2 ≤ ∑ i, f (S i)} + ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) := by
    rw [hhalf, ← hadd]
    exact add_le_add le_rfl hbadle
  exact (ENNReal.add_le_add_iff_right (by simp)).mp hfin

end Cheb


/-! ### The ghost-sample step -/

section GhostLow
open Finset

def errCount {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {m : ℕ} (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool)
    (S : Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool) : ℕ :=
  (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => h.f (S i).1 ≠ (S i).2)).card

lemma errCount_eq_sum {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {m : ℕ} (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool)
    (S : Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool) :
    ((errCount h S : ℕ) : ℝ) = ∑ i, zeroOneLoss h (S i) := by
  rw [errCount]
  rw [← Finset.sum_boole]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  by_cases hi : h.f (S i).1 = (S i).2
  · rw [if_neg (by simpa using hi)]
    simp [zeroOneLoss, hi]
  · rw [if_pos (by simpa using hi)]
    simp [zeroOneLoss, hi]

lemma measurableSet_errCount_ge {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {m : ℕ}
    (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (r : ℕ) :
    MeasurableSet {S : Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool | r ≤ errCount h S} := by
  classical
  have hrep : {S : Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool | r ≤ errCount h S}
      = ⋃ S₀ ∈ (Finset.univ.filter (fun S₀ : Finset (Fin m) => r ≤ S₀.card)),
          ⋂ i ∈ S₀, (fun S : Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool => S i) ⁻¹'
            {z : 𝒳 × Bool | h.f z.1 ≠ z.2} := by
    ext S
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_preimage,
      Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    constructor
    · intro hS
      refine ⟨Finset.univ.filter (fun i => h.f (S i).1 ≠ (S i).2), hS, ?_⟩
      intro i hi
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
    · rintro ⟨S₀, hS₀, hmem⟩
      have hsub : S₀ ⊆ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => h.f (S i).1 ≠ (S i).2) := by
        intro i hi
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, hmem i hi⟩
      exact le_trans hS₀ (Finset.card_le_card hsub)
  rw [hrep]
  refine Finset.measurableSet_biUnion _ ?_
  intro S₀ _
  exact Finset.measurableSet_biInter _
    (fun i _ => (measurable_pi_apply i) (meas_ne_set h))

lemma measurableSet_allCorrect {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {m : ℕ}
    (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) :
    MeasurableSet {S : Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool | ∀ i, h.f (S i).1 = (S i).2} := by
  have hrep : {S : Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool | ∀ i, h.f (S i).1 = (S i).2}
      = ⋂ i : Fin m, (fun S : Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool => S i) ⁻¹' {z : 𝒳 × Bool | h.f z.1 = z.2} := by
    ext S; simp [Set.mem_iInter]
  rw [hrep]
  exact MeasurableSet.iInter fun i => (measurable_pi_apply i) (meas_eq_set h)

/-- The two halves of a paired sample are independent. -/
lemma pi_prod_inter {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] (P : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    {m : ℕ} {U V : Set (Fin m → Z)} (hU : MeasurableSet U) (hV : MeasurableSet V) :
    (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P.prod P)
        ({w : Fin m → Z × Z | (fun i => (w i).1) ∈ U} ∩
          {w : Fin m → Z × Z | (fun i => (w i).2) ∈ V})
      = (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P) U * (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P) V := by
  have hmp := measurePreserving_arrowProdEquivProdArrow Z Z (Fin m)
    (fun _ => P) (fun _ => P)
  have hset : ({w : Fin m → Z × Z | (fun i => (w i).1) ∈ U} ∩
      {w : Fin m → Z × Z | (fun i => (w i).2) ∈ V})
      = (MeasurableEquiv.arrowProdEquivProdArrow Z Z (Fin m)) ⁻¹' (U ×ˢ V) := by
    ext w
    simp [MeasurableEquiv.arrowProdEquivProdArrow, Equiv.arrowProdEquivProdArrow,
      Set.mem_prod]
  rw [hset, hmp.measure_preimage (hU.prod hV).nullMeasurableSet, Measure.prod_prod]

lemma ghost_lower {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳]
    (e : ℕ → Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (P : Measure (𝒳 × Bool)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) {m : ℕ} (hm : 8 ≤ α * m) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) *
        (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P)
          {S | ∃ k, (∀ i, (e k).f (S i).1 = (S i).2) ∧ α < ordinaryError (e k) P}
      ≤ (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P.prod P) (ghostEvent e ⌈α * m / 2⌉₊) := by
  classical
  set r : ℕ := ⌈α * (m:ℝ) / 2⌉₊ with hr
  set Pm : Measure (Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool) := Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P with hPm
  set ν : Measure (Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool)) :=
    Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P.prod P with hν
  set C : ℕ → Set (Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool) :=
    fun k => {S | ∀ i, (e k).f (S i).1 = (S i).2} with hC
  set g : ℕ → Set (Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool) :=
    fun k => if α < ordinaryError (e k) P then C k else ∅ with hg
  set G : ℕ → Set (Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool) :=
    fun k => {S | r ≤ errCount (e k) S} with hG
  have hCmeas : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (C k) := fun k => measurableSet_allCorrect (e k)
  have hgmeas : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (g k) := by
    intro k
    rw [hg]
    by_cases hk : α < ordinaryError (e k) P
    · simp only [hk, if_true]; exact hCmeas k
    · simp only [hk, if_false]; exact MeasurableSet.empty
  have hGmeas : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (G k) :=
    fun k => measurableSet_errCount_ge (e k) r
  set D : ℕ → Set (Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool) := disjointed g with hD
  have hDmeas : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (D k) := fun k => MeasurableSet.disjointed hgmeas k
  have hDle : ∀ k, D k ⊆ g k := fun k => disjointed_le g k
  set F : ℕ → Set (Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool)) :=
    fun k => {w | (fun i => (w i).1) ∈ D k} ∩ {w | (fun i => (w i).2) ∈ G k} with hF
  have hFmeas : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (F k) := by
    intro k
    refine MeasurableSet.inter ?_ ?_
    · exact (measurable_pi_lambda _ (fun i => measurable_fst.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)))
        (hDmeas k)
    · exact (measurable_pi_lambda _ (fun i => measurable_snd.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)))
        (hGmeas k)
  have hFdisj : Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint F) := by
    intro i j hij
    have hd := disjoint_disjointed g hij
    refine Set.disjoint_left.mpr ?_
    intro w hw1 hw2
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hd hw1.1 hw2.1
  have hFsub : (⋃ k, F k) ⊆ ghostEvent e r := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hw
    have hk1 : (fun i => (w i).1) ∈ D k := hk.1
    have hk2 : (fun i => (w i).2) ∈ G k := hk.2
    have hkg : (fun i => (w i).1) ∈ g k := hDle k hk1
    by_cases hc : α < ordinaryError (e k) P
    · have hkC : (fun i => (w i).1) ∈ C k := by
        rw [hg] at hkg; simpa [hc] using hkg
      refine ⟨k, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro i; exact hkC i
      · exact hk2
    · rw [hg] at hkg
      simp only [hc, if_false] at hkg
      exact absurd hkg (Set.notMem_empty _)
  have hstep2 : ∀ k, ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) * Pm (D k) ≤ ν (F k) := by
    intro k
    have hprod : ν (F k) = Pm (D k) * Pm (G k) := by
      rw [hF, hν, hPm]
      exact pi_prod_inter P (hDmeas k) (hGmeas k)
    rw [hprod]
    by_cases hc : α < ordinaryError (e k) P
    · have hhalf : ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) ≤ Pm (G k) := by
        have hGeq : G k = {S : Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool |
            α * (m:ℝ) / 2 ≤ ∑ i, zeroOneLoss (e k) (S i)} := by
          ext S
          rw [hG]
          simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
          rw [← errCount_eq_sum, hr]
          exact Nat.ceil_le
        rw [hGeq, hPm]
        exact half_le_measure_many_errors P (zeroOneLoss (e k))
          (zeroOneLoss_measurable (e k)) (zeroOneLoss_nonneg (e k)) (zeroOneLoss_le_one (e k))
          (integral_zeroOneLoss (e k) P) hα0 (le_of_lt hc) hm
      calc ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) * Pm (D k) = Pm (D k) * ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) := by ring
        _ ≤ Pm (D k) * Pm (G k) := by exact mul_le_mul_left' hhalf _
    · have hDempty : D k = ∅ := by
        have : g k = ∅ := by rw [hg]; simp [hc]
        exact Set.eq_empty_of_subset_empty (this ▸ hDle k)
      rw [hDempty]
      simp
  have hAeq : {S : Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool |
      ∃ k, (∀ i, (e k).f (S i).1 = (S i).2) ∧ α < ordinaryError (e k) P} = ⋃ k, g k := by
    ext S
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_iUnion]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨k, hcons, hgt⟩
      exact ⟨k, by rw [hg]; simp only [hgt, if_true]; exact hcons⟩
    · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
      by_cases hc : α < ordinaryError (e k) P
      · rw [hg] at hk
        simp only [hc, if_true] at hk
        exact ⟨k, hk, hc⟩
      · rw [hg] at hk
        simp only [hc, if_false] at hk
        exact absurd hk (Set.notMem_empty _)
  rw [hAeq, ← iUnion_disjointed (f := g), ← hD]
  rw [measure_iUnion (disjoint_disjointed g) hDmeas]
  calc ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) * ∑' k, Pm (D k)
      = ∑' k, ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) * Pm (D k) := ENNReal.tsum_mul_left.symm
    _ ≤ ∑' k, ν (F k) := ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum hstep2
    _ = ν (⋃ k, F k) := (measure_iUnion hFdisj hFmeas).symm
    _ ≤ ν (ghostEvent e r) := measure_mono hFsub

end GhostLow


/-! ### The master VC estimate in the realizable case -/

section Master
open Finset

theorem realizable_vc_master {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool)
    {d : ℕ} (hvc : VCDim H = (d : ℕ∞)) (e : ℕ → Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (he : ∀ k, e k ∈ H)
    (P : Measure (𝒳 × Bool)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1) {m : ℕ} (hm : 8 ≤ α * m) :
    (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (⌈α * (m:ℝ) / 2⌉₊) *
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P)
        {S | ∃ k, (∀ i, (e k).f (S i).1 = (S i).2) ∧ α < ordinaryError (e k) P}
      ≤ 2 * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.Iic d, (m+m).choose j : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) := by
  classical
  set r : ℕ := ⌈α * (m:ℝ) / 2⌉₊ with hr
  set Γ : ℕ := ∑ j ∈ Finset.Iic d, (m+m).choose j with hΓ
  set a : ℝ≥0∞ := (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P)
    {S | ∃ k, (∀ i, (e k).f (S i).1 = (S i).2) ∧ α < ordinaryError (e k) P} with ha
  set ν : Measure (Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool)) :=
    Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P.prod P with hν
  have hmR : (0:ℝ) ≤ (m:ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg m
  have hrm : r ≤ m := by
    rw [hr]
    apply Nat.ceil_le.mpr
    nlinarith
  have hsym : 2 ^ m * ν (ghostEvent e r) ≤ ((Γ * 2 ^ (m - r) : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    rw [hν]
    exact symmetrization_le P (ghostEvent e r) (measurableSet_ghostEvent e r) _
      (ghost_indicator_sum_le H hvc e he r)
  have hgl : ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) * a ≤ ν (ghostEvent e r) := by
    rw [ha, hν, hr]
    exact ghost_lower e P hα0 hm
  have hchain : 2 ^ m * (ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) * a) ≤ (Γ : ℝ≥0∞) * 2 ^ (m - r) := by
    have h1 : (2:ℝ≥0∞) ^ m * (ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) * a) ≤ 2 ^ m * ν (ghostEvent e r) :=
      mul_le_mul_left' hgl _
    have h2 : ((Γ * 2 ^ (m - r) : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) = (Γ : ℝ≥0∞) * 2 ^ (m - r) := by
      push_cast; ring
    rw [← h2]
    exact le_trans h1 hsym
  have hmul : 2 ^ r * (2 ^ m * (ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) * a))
      ≤ 2 ^ r * ((Γ : ℝ≥0∞) * 2 ^ (m - r)) := by gcongr
  have hpow : (2:ℝ≥0∞) ^ r * ((Γ : ℝ≥0∞) * 2 ^ (m - r)) = 2 ^ m * (Γ : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    have : (2:ℝ≥0∞) ^ r * 2 ^ (m - r) = 2 ^ m := by
      rw [← pow_add]
      congr 1
      omega
    calc (2:ℝ≥0∞) ^ r * ((Γ : ℝ≥0∞) * 2 ^ (m - r))
        = ((2:ℝ≥0∞) ^ r * 2 ^ (m - r)) * (Γ : ℝ≥0∞) := by ring
      _ = 2 ^ m * (Γ : ℝ≥0∞) := by rw [this]
  have hleft : (2:ℝ≥0∞) ^ r * (2 ^ m * (ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) * a))
      = 2 ^ m * (2 ^ r * (ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) * a)) := by ring
  rw [hleft, hpow] at hmul
  have hcancel : (2:ℝ≥0∞) ^ r * (ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) * a) ≤ (Γ : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    have h2 : ((2:ℝ≥0∞) ^ m) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have h2' : ((2:ℝ≥0∞) ^ m) ≠ ⊤ := by
      exact ENNReal.pow_ne_top (by norm_num)
    exact (ENNReal.mul_le_mul_left h2 h2').mp hmul
  have hof : ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) * 2 = 1 := by
    rw [show (2:ℝ≥0∞) = ENNReal.ofReal 2 by simp, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num)]
    norm_num
  calc (2:ℝ≥0∞) ^ r * a = 2 * (2 ^ r * (ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) * a)) := by
        rw [show (2:ℝ≥0∞) * (2 ^ r * (ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) * a))
          = (ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) * 2) * (2 ^ r * a) by ring, hof, one_mul]
    _ ≤ 2 * (Γ : ℝ≥0∞) := by gcongr

end Master


/-! ### The consistent learner over a countable dense subfamily -/

section PAC
open Finset

open Classical in
/-- The first member of the enumerated family which is consistent with the sample. -/
noncomputable def firstConsistent {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳]
    (e : ℕ → Predictor 𝒳 Bool) {n : ℕ} (S : Fin n → 𝒳 × Bool) : Predictor 𝒳 Bool :=
  if h : ∃ k, ∀ i, (e k).f (S i).1 = (S i).2 then e (Nat.find h) else e 0

lemma firstConsistent_spec {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳]
    (e : ℕ → Predictor 𝒳 Bool) {n : ℕ} (S : Fin n → 𝒳 × Bool)
    (h : ∃ k, ∀ i, (e k).f (S i).1 = (S i).2) :
    ∃ k, (∀ i, (e k).f (S i).1 = (S i).2) ∧ e k = firstConsistent e S := by
  classical
  refine ⟨Nat.find h, Nat.find_spec h, ?_⟩
  rw [firstConsistent, dif_pos h]

lemma realizable_PAC_at_size {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool)
    {d : ℕ} (hvc : VCDim H = (d : ℕ∞))
    (H₀ : Set (Predictor 𝒳 Bool)) (hH₀ : H₀ ⊆ H)
    (e : ℕ → Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (hrange : H₀ = Set.range e)
    (hdense : ∀ h ∈ H, ∃ s : ℕ → Predictor 𝒳 Bool, (∀ i, s i ∈ H₀) ∧
        ∀ x, ∀ᶠ i in Filter.atTop, (s i).f x = h.f x)
    {α δ : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1) (hδ0 : 0 < δ) {m : ℕ} (hm : 8 ≤ α * m)
    (hbound : 2 * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.Iic d, (m+m).choose j : ℕ) : ℝ)
        ≤ 2 ^ (⌈α * (m:ℝ) / 2⌉₊) * δ) :
    OrdinaryRealizablePACAtSize H α δ m := by
  classical
  have he : ∀ k, e k ∈ H := by
    intro k
    apply hH₀
    rw [hrange]
    exact ⟨k, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨fun S => firstConsistent e S, ?_⟩
  intro P _ hreal
  obtain ⟨hstar, hstarH, hstar0⟩ := hreal
  set r : ℕ := ⌈α * (m:ℝ) / 2⌉₊ with hr
  set Γ : ℕ := ∑ j ∈ Finset.Iic d, (m+m).choose j with hΓ
  set Pm : Measure (Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool) := Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P with hPm
  set N : Set (Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool) :=
    {S | ¬ ∃ k, ∀ i, (e k).f (S i).1 = (S i).2} with hN
  set A : Set (Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool) :=
    {S | ∃ k, (∀ i, (e k).f (S i).1 = (S i).2) ∧ α < ordinaryError (e k) P} with hA
  have hsub : {S : Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool | α < ordinaryError (firstConsistent e S) P} ⊆ N ∪ A := by
    intro S hS
    by_cases hex : ∃ k, ∀ i, (e k).f (S i).1 = (S i).2
    · right
      obtain ⟨k, hcons, hk⟩ := firstConsistent_spec e S hex
      exact ⟨k, hcons, by rw [hk]; exact hS⟩
    · exact Or.inl hex
  -- the sample is almost surely consistent with some member of the family
  have hstarz : P {z : 𝒳 × Bool | hstar.f z.1 ≠ z.2} = 0 := by
    have hor := (ENNReal.toReal_eq_zero_iff _).mp (by simpa [ordinaryError] using hstar0)
    exact hor.resolve_right (measure_ne_top _ _)
  have hN0 : Pm N = 0 := by
    have hNsub : N ⊆ ⋃ j : Fin m, {S : Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool | hstar.f (S j).1 ≠ (S j).2} := by
      intro S hS
      by_contra hcon
      apply hS
      have hall : ∀ j : Fin m, hstar.f (S j).1 = (S j).2 := by
        intro j
        by_contra hj
        exact hcon (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j, hj⟩)
      obtain ⟨s, hsH₀, hslim⟩ := hdense hstar hstarH
      have hev : ∀ᶠ i in Filter.atTop, ∀ j : Fin m, (s i).f (S j).1 = hstar.f (S j).1 := by
        rw [Filter.eventually_all]
        intro j
        exact hslim (S j).1
      obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := hev.exists
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, e k = s i₀ := by
        have := hsH₀ i₀
        rw [hrange] at this
        obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := this
        exact ⟨k, hk⟩
      refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
      intro j
      rw [hk, hi₀ j, hall j]
    refine measure_mono_null hNsub ?_
    have hz : ∀ j : Fin m, Pm {S : Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool | hstar.f (S j).1 ≠ (S j).2} = 0 := by
      intro j
      have hpre : {S : Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool | hstar.f (S j).1 ≠ (S j).2}
          = (fun S : Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool => S j) ⁻¹' {z : 𝒳 × Bool | hstar.f z.1 ≠ z.2} := rfl
      rw [hpre, hPm]
      rw [(measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin m => P) j).measure_preimage
        (meas_ne_set hstar).nullMeasurableSet]
      exact hstarz
    exact measure_iUnion_null hz
  -- the VC bound on the remaining event
  have hmaster := realizable_vc_master H hvc e he P hα0 hα1 hm
  have hΓpos : (0:ℝ) < (Γ : ℝ) := by
    rw [hΓ]
    have : (0:ℕ) < ∑ j ∈ Finset.Iic d, (m+m).choose j := by
      apply Finset.sum_pos'
      · intro j _; exact Nat.zero_le _
      · exact ⟨0, Finset.mem_Iic.mpr (Nat.zero_le d), by simp⟩
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hcast : 2 * ((Γ : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ (2:ℝ≥0∞) ^ r * ENNReal.ofReal δ := by
    have h1 : 2 * ((Γ : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) = ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (Γ : ℝ)) := by
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num)]
      simp
    have h2 : (2:ℝ≥0∞) ^ r * ENNReal.ofReal δ = ENNReal.ofReal (2 ^ r * δ) := by
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity)]
      congr 1
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_pow (by norm_num)]
      simp
    rw [h1, h2]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hbound
  have hAle : Pm A ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ := by
    have hkey : (2:ℝ≥0∞) ^ r * Pm A ≤ (2:ℝ≥0∞) ^ r * ENNReal.ofReal δ := by
      refine le_trans ?_ hcast
      rw [hPm, hA, hr]
      exact hmaster
    have h2 : ((2:ℝ≥0∞) ^ r) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have h2' : ((2:ℝ≥0∞) ^ r) ≠ ⊤ := ENNReal.pow_ne_top (by norm_num)
    exact (ENNReal.mul_le_mul_left h2 h2').mp hkey
  calc Pm {S : Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool | α < ordinaryError (firstConsistent e S) P}
      ≤ Pm (N ∪ A) := measure_mono hsub
    _ ≤ Pm N + Pm A := measure_union_le _ _
    _ = Pm A := by rw [hN0, zero_add]
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ := hAle

end PAC


/-! ### Choice of the sample size -/

section Numerics
open Finset

lemma numeric_core {D E L t s u : ℝ}
    (hD1 : 1 ≤ D) (hE0 : 0 ≤ E) (hL1 : 0.693 ≤ L) (hL2 : L ≤ 0.694)
    (ht : 16 * (D + E) ≤ t) (hs : s ≤ t/8 + 2.8 * D) (hu : u ≤ E) :
    L + s + u ≤ (t/2) * L := by
  have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := by linarith
  have hmul : t * 0.693 ≤ t * L := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hL1 ht0
  linarith

lemma realizable_numeric {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) {α δ : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1)
    (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1/4) (m : ℕ)
    (hm : 16 * ((d:ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (1/α)) + Real.log (2/δ)) / α ≤ m) :
    8 ≤ α * m ∧ d ≤ m + m ∧
      2 * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.Iic d, (m+m).choose j : ℕ) : ℝ)
        ≤ 2 ^ (⌈α * (m:ℝ) / 2⌉₊) * δ := by
  have hdR : (1:ℝ) ≤ (d:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hdpos : (0:ℝ) < (d:ℝ) := by linarith
  have hd0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (d:ℝ) := le_of_lt hdpos
  have hlogα : 0 ≤ Real.log (1/α) := Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hα0]; linarith)
  have hD1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (d:ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (1/α)) := by nlinarith
  have hE0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.log (2/δ) := Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hδ0]; linarith)
  have hB1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (d:ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (1/α)) + Real.log (2/δ) := by linarith
  have hMpos : (0:ℝ) < (m:ℝ) := by
    have hq : (0:ℝ) < 16 * ((d:ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (1/α)) + Real.log (2/δ)) / α := by
      apply div_pos (by linarith) hα0
    linarith
  have ht : 16 * ((d:ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (1/α)) + Real.log (2/δ)) ≤ α * (m:ℝ) := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hα0] at hm
    linarith
  have hαm8 : 8 ≤ α * (m:ℝ) := by linarith
  have hdm : d ≤ m + m := by
    have hle : (d:ℝ) ≤ (m:ℝ) := by nlinarith
    have : d ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hle
    omega
  refine ⟨hαm8, hdm, ?_⟩
  have hL1 : (0.693:ℝ) ≤ Real.log 2 := le_of_lt (by linarith [Real.log_two_gt_d9])
  have hL2 : Real.log 2 ≤ 0.694 := le_of_lt (by linarith [Real.log_two_lt_d9])
  obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ : ∃ X : ℝ, X = Real.exp 1 * ((m:ℝ)+(m:ℝ)) / (d:ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hXpos : 0 < X := by rw [hX]; positivity
  have hsauer' : ((∑ j ∈ Finset.Iic d, (m+m).choose j : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ X ^ d := by
    have h := sum_Iic_choose_le_exp (m+m) d hd hdm
    rw [hX]
    refine le_trans h (le_of_eq ?_)
    norm_num
  -- logarithm of X
  have hlogX : Real.log X = 1 + Real.log 2 + Real.log (m:ℝ) - Real.log (d:ℝ) := by
    rw [hX, Real.log_div (by positivity) (ne_of_gt hdpos),
      Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity), Real.log_exp,
      show ((m:ℝ)+(m:ℝ)) = 2 * (m:ℝ) by ring,
      Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (ne_of_gt hMpos)]
    ring
  -- an upper bound for `log m`
  have hEq : (m:ℝ)*α/(8*(d:ℝ)) = (m:ℝ) / (8*(d:ℝ)/α) := by field_simp
  have h1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos
    (show (0:ℝ) < (m:ℝ)/(8*(d:ℝ)/α) by positivity)
  rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hMpos) (by positivity), ← hEq] at h1
  have hlog8d : Real.log (8*(d:ℝ)/α) = 3*Real.log 2 + Real.log (d:ℝ) + Real.log (1/α) := by
    rw [Real.log_div (by positivity) (ne_of_gt hα0),
      Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (ne_of_gt hdpos),
      show (8:ℝ) = 2^3 by norm_num, Real.log_pow, one_div, Real.log_inv]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hlogXle : Real.log X ≤ 4*Real.log 2 + (m:ℝ)*α/(8*(d:ℝ)) + Real.log (1/α) := by
    rw [hlogX]
    rw [hlog8d] at h1
    linarith
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogXle hd0
  have hexp : (d:ℝ) * (4*Real.log 2 + (m:ℝ)*α/(8*(d:ℝ)) + Real.log (1/α))
      = 4*Real.log 2*(d:ℝ) + α*(m:ℝ)/8 + (d:ℝ)*Real.log (1/α) := by
    field_simp
  rw [hexp] at hmul
  have h4 : 4*Real.log 2*(d:ℝ) ≤ 2.776*(d:ℝ) := by nlinarith
  have hpos2 : 0 ≤ (d:ℝ)*Real.log (1/α) := mul_nonneg hd0 hlogα
  have hdlogX : (d:ℝ) * Real.log X
      ≤ (α*(m:ℝ))/8 + 2.8 * ((d:ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (1/α))) := by
    have hDexp : (d:ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (1/α)) = (d:ℝ) + (d:ℝ)*Real.log (1/α) := by ring
    rw [hDexp]
    linarith
  have hlogδ : Real.log (1/δ) ≤ Real.log (2/δ) := by
    apply Real.log_le_log (by positivity)
    rw [div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hδ0]
    linarith
  have hkey : Real.log 2 + (d:ℝ) * Real.log X + Real.log (1/δ)
      ≤ (α * (m:ℝ) / 2) * Real.log 2 :=
    numeric_core hD1 hE0 hL1 hL2 ht hdlogX hlogδ
  -- exponentiate
  have hrge : α * (m:ℝ) / 2 ≤ (⌈α * (m:ℝ) / 2⌉₊ : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
  have hpow : Real.exp ((α * (m:ℝ) / 2) * Real.log 2) ≤ 2 ^ (⌈α * (m:ℝ) / 2⌉₊) := by
    have hstep : Real.exp ((α * (m:ℝ) / 2) * Real.log 2)
        ≤ Real.exp ((⌈α * (m:ℝ) / 2⌉₊ : ℝ) * Real.log 2) := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrge (by linarith)
    have h2 : Real.exp ((⌈α * (m:ℝ) / 2⌉₊ : ℝ) * Real.log 2) = 2 ^ (⌈α * (m:ℝ) / 2⌉₊) := by
      rw [Real.exp_nat_mul, Real.exp_log (by norm_num)]
    linarith [hstep, h2.le, h2.ge]
  have hmain : 2 * X ^ d ≤ Real.exp ((α * (m:ℝ) / 2) * Real.log 2) * δ := by
    have hlogL : Real.log (2 * X ^ d) = Real.log 2 + (d:ℝ) * Real.log X := by
      rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by positivity), Real.log_pow]
    have hlogR : Real.log (Real.exp ((α * (m:ℝ) / 2) * Real.log 2) * δ)
        = (α * (m:ℝ) / 2) * Real.log 2 + Real.log δ := by
      rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (ne_of_gt hδ0), Real.log_exp]
    have hlogδ' : Real.log (1/δ) = - Real.log δ := by rw [one_div, Real.log_inv]
    have hineq : Real.log (2 * X ^ d)
        ≤ Real.log (Real.exp ((α * (m:ℝ) / 2) * Real.log 2) * δ) := by
      rw [hlogL, hlogR]
      linarith [hkey, hlogδ'.le, hlogδ'.ge]
    calc 2 * X ^ d = Real.exp (Real.log (2 * X ^ d)) := (Real.exp_log (by positivity)).symm
      _ ≤ Real.exp (Real.log (Real.exp ((α * (m:ℝ) / 2) * Real.log 2) * δ)) :=
          Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hineq
      _ = Real.exp ((α * (m:ℝ) / 2) * Real.log 2) * δ := Real.exp_log (by positivity)
  calc 2 * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.Iic d, (m+m).choose j : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * X ^ d := by linarith
    _ ≤ Real.exp ((α * (m:ℝ) / 2) * Real.log 2) * δ := hmain
    _ ≤ 2 ^ (⌈α * (m:ℝ) / 2⌉₊) * δ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpow (le_of_lt hδ0)

end Numerics

/-! ### Uniform convergence and the agnostic VC bound -/

section AgnosticUC
open Finset
open scoped ENNReal


/-- The Rademacher moment-generating function identity: summing over all subsets `T`
of a finite index type, `exp (l * ∑ ± w i)` factorises. -/
lemma rad_mgf {m : ℕ} (w : Fin m → ℝ) (l : ℝ) :
    ∑ T : Finset (Fin m), Real.exp (l * ∑ i, (if i ∈ T then w i else -w i))
      = ∏ i, (Real.exp (l * w i) + Real.exp (-(l * w i))) := by
  classical
  rw [Fintype.prod_add]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
  intro T _
  have h1 : l * ∑ i, (if i ∈ T then w i else -w i)
      = ∑ i, (if i ∈ T then l * w i else -(l * w i)) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
    intro i _
    by_cases hi : i ∈ T <;> simp [hi, mul_neg]
  rw [h1, Real.exp_sum]
  have h2 : ∀ i, Real.exp (if i ∈ T then l * w i else -(l * w i))
      = if i ∈ T then Real.exp (l * w i) else Real.exp (-(l * w i)) := by
    intro i; by_cases hi : i ∈ T <;> simp [hi]
  rw [Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun i _ => h2 i)]
  rw [← Finset.prod_sdiff (Finset.subset_univ T)]
  rw [Finset.compl_eq_univ_sdiff]
  rw [mul_comm]
  congr 1
  · exact Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun i hi => by rw [if_pos hi])
  · refine Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun i hi => ?_)
    rw [if_neg (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hi).2]

/-- One-sided Hoeffding tail bound, in the purely combinatorial "counting subsets" form. -/
lemma card_signSum_ge_le {m : ℕ} (w : Fin m → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, |w i| ≤ 1) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ((Finset.univ.filter (fun T : Finset (Fin m) =>
        t ≤ ∑ i, (if i ∈ T then w i else -w i))).card : ℝ)
      ≤ 2 ^ m * Real.exp (- (t ^ 2) / (2 * m)) := by
  classical
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with hm | hm
  · subst hm
    have hcard : ((Finset.univ.filter (fun T : Finset (Fin 0) =>
        t ≤ ∑ i, (if i ∈ T then w i else -w i))).card : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
      have := Finset.card_filter_le (Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin 0)))
        (fun T => t ≤ ∑ i, (if i ∈ T then w i else -w i))
      have h2 : (Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin 0))).card = 1 := by simp
      rw [h2] at this
      exact_mod_cast this
    simpa using hcard
  · have hmR : (0:ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
    set l : ℝ := t / m with hl
    have hl0 : 0 ≤ l := by positivity
    set F := Finset.univ.filter (fun T : Finset (Fin m) =>
        t ≤ ∑ i, (if i ∈ T then w i else -w i)) with hF
    -- step 1: card F ≤ ∑ over all T of exp (l * (X T - t))
    have step1 : (F.card : ℝ) ≤ ∑ T : Finset (Fin m),
        Real.exp (l * ((∑ i, (if i ∈ T then w i else -w i)) - t)) := by
      have hsub : ∑ T ∈ F, (1:ℝ) ≤ ∑ T ∈ F,
          Real.exp (l * ((∑ i, (if i ∈ T then w i else -w i)) - t)) := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
        intro T hT
        have hTt : t ≤ ∑ i, (if i ∈ T then w i else -w i) := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hT).2
        have : (0:ℝ) ≤ l * ((∑ i, (if i ∈ T then w i else -w i)) - t) := by
          apply mul_nonneg hl0; linarith
        calc (1:ℝ) = Real.exp 0 := by simp
          _ ≤ _ := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr this
      have hall : ∑ T ∈ F, Real.exp (l * ((∑ i, (if i ∈ T then w i else -w i)) - t))
          ≤ ∑ T : Finset (Fin m), Real.exp (l * ((∑ i, (if i ∈ T then w i else -w i)) - t)) := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.filter_subset _ _) ?_
        intro T _ _
        exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
      have hc : ∑ T ∈ F, (1:ℝ) = (F.card : ℝ) := by simp
      linarith [hc.symm.trans_le (hsub.trans hall)]
    -- step 2: factorise
    have step2 : ∑ T : Finset (Fin m),
        Real.exp (l * ((∑ i, (if i ∈ T then w i else -w i)) - t))
        = Real.exp (-(l*t)) * ∏ i, (Real.exp (l * w i) + Real.exp (-(l * w i))) := by
      rw [← rad_mgf w l, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
      intro T _
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      congr 1
      ring
    -- step 3: bound each factor
    have step3 : ∀ i : Fin m, Real.exp (l * w i) + Real.exp (-(l * w i))
        ≤ 2 * Real.exp (l ^ 2 / 2) := by
      intro i
      have hcosh : Real.exp (l * w i) + Real.exp (-(l * w i))
          = 2 * Real.cosh (l * w i) := by
        rw [Real.cosh_eq]; ring
      rw [hcosh]
      have h1 : Real.cosh (l * w i) ≤ Real.cosh l := by
        rw [Real.cosh_le_cosh]
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hl0]
        nlinarith [abs_nonneg (w i), hw i, hl0]
      have h2 : Real.cosh l ≤ Real.exp (l ^ 2 / 2) := Real.cosh_le_exp_half_sq l
      linarith
    have step4 : ∏ i, (Real.exp (l * w i) + Real.exp (-(l * w i)))
        ≤ (2 * Real.exp (l ^ 2 / 2)) ^ m := by
      calc ∏ i, (Real.exp (l * w i) + Real.exp (-(l * w i)))
          ≤ ∏ _i : Fin m, (2 * Real.exp (l ^ 2 / 2)) := by
            refine Finset.prod_le_prod ?_ ?_
            · intro i _; positivity
            · intro i _; exact step3 i
        _ = (2 * Real.exp (l ^ 2 / 2)) ^ m := by simp
    have hfin : Real.exp (-(l*t)) * ((2 * Real.exp (l ^ 2 / 2)) ^ m)
        = 2 ^ m * Real.exp (- (t ^ 2) / (2 * m)) := by
      rw [mul_pow, ← Real.exp_nat_mul]
      rw [show Real.exp (-(l*t)) * (2 ^ m * Real.exp ((m:ℝ) * (l^2/2)))
          = (2:ℝ) ^ m * (Real.exp (-(l*t)) * Real.exp ((m:ℝ) * (l^2/2))) by ring,
        ← Real.exp_add]
      congr 2
      rw [hl]
      field_simp
      ring
    calc (F.card : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (-(l*t)) * ∏ i, (Real.exp (l * w i) + Real.exp (-(l * w i))) := by
          rw [← step2]; exact step1
      _ ≤ Real.exp (-(l*t)) * ((2 * Real.exp (l ^ 2 / 2)) ^ m) := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left step4 (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = 2 ^ m * Real.exp (- (t ^ 2) / (2 * m)) := hfin

/-- Signed difference between the number of first-half and second-half mistakes after
exchanging the pairs indexed by `T`. -/
noncomputable def swapDiff {m : ℕ} (a b : Fin m → Bool) (T : Finset (Fin m)) : ℝ :=
  ((Finset.univ.filter (fun i => (if i ∈ T then b i else a i) = true)).card : ℝ)
    - ((Finset.univ.filter (fun i => (if i ∈ T then a i else b i) = true)).card : ℝ)

/-- The weight attached to index `i`. -/
noncomputable def swapW {m : ℕ} (a b : Fin m → Bool) (i : Fin m) : ℝ :=
  (if b i = true then (1:ℝ) else 0) - (if a i = true then (1:ℝ) else 0)

lemma swapW_abs_le {m : ℕ} (a b : Fin m → Bool) (i : Fin m) : |swapW a b i| ≤ 1 := by
  rw [swapW]
  by_cases hb : b i = true <;> by_cases ha : a i = true <;> simp [hb, ha]

lemma swapDiff_eq {m : ℕ} (a b : Fin m → Bool) (T : Finset (Fin m)) :
    swapDiff a b T = ∑ i, (if i ∈ T then swapW a b i else -(swapW a b i)) := by
  classical
  rw [swapDiff, ← Finset.sum_boole, ← Finset.sum_boole, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
  intro i _
  by_cases hi : i ∈ T <;> simp [hi, swapW] <;> ring

lemma swapDiff_swap {m : ℕ} (a b : Fin m → Bool) (T : Finset (Fin m)) :
    swapDiff b a T = - swapDiff a b T := by
  rw [swapDiff, swapDiff]; ring

lemma card_swapDiff_ge_le {m : ℕ} (a b : Fin m → Bool) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ((Finset.univ.filter (fun T : Finset (Fin m) => t ≤ swapDiff a b T)).card : ℝ)
      ≤ 2 ^ m * Real.exp (- (t ^ 2) / (2 * m)) := by
  classical
  have := card_signSum_ge_le (swapW a b) (swapW_abs_le a b) ht
  refine le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) this
  congr 2
  apply Finset.filter_congr
  intro T _
  rw [swapDiff_eq]

lemma card_swapDiff_abs_le {m : ℕ} (a b : Fin m → Bool) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ((Finset.univ.filter (fun T : Finset (Fin m) => t ≤ |swapDiff a b T|)).card : ℝ)
      ≤ 2 ^ (m+1) * Real.exp (- (t ^ 2) / (2 * m)) := by
  classical
  have hsub : (Finset.univ.filter (fun T : Finset (Fin m) => t ≤ |swapDiff a b T|))
      ⊆ (Finset.univ.filter (fun T : Finset (Fin m) => t ≤ swapDiff a b T))
        ∪ (Finset.univ.filter (fun T : Finset (Fin m) => t ≤ swapDiff b a T)) := by
    intro T hT
    have h := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hT).2
    rw [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_filter]
    rcases abs_cases (swapDiff a b T) with ⟨he, _⟩ | ⟨he, _⟩
    · left; exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, by rw [he] at h; exact h⟩
    · right
      refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
      rw [swapDiff_swap, ← he]
      exact h
  have hcard := Finset.card_le_card hsub
  have hun := Finset.card_union_le
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun T : Finset (Fin m) => t ≤ swapDiff a b T))
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun T : Finset (Fin m) => t ≤ swapDiff b a T))
  have h1 := card_swapDiff_ge_le a b ht
  have h2 := card_swapDiff_ge_le b a ht
  have hR : ((Finset.univ.filter (fun T : Finset (Fin m) => t ≤ |swapDiff a b T|)).card : ℝ)
      ≤ ((Finset.univ.filter (fun T : Finset (Fin m) => t ≤ swapDiff a b T)).card : ℝ)
        + ((Finset.univ.filter (fun T : Finset (Fin m) => t ≤ swapDiff b a T)).card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast le_trans hcard hun
  have : (2:ℝ) ^ (m+1) * Real.exp (- (t ^ 2) / (2 * m))
      = 2 ^ m * Real.exp (- (t ^ 2) / (2 * m)) + 2 ^ m * Real.exp (- (t ^ 2) / (2 * m)) := by
    rw [pow_succ]; ring
  rw [this]
  linarith

section AgnGhost
open Finset

/-- Number of mistakes of `h` on the first members of the pairs. -/
def fstErrCount {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {m : ℕ}
    (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (w : Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool)) : ℕ :=
  (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => h.f ((w i).1).1 ≠ ((w i).1).2)).card

/-- The paired sample is *bad* if some member of the family has very different
mistake counts on the two halves. -/
def agnEvent {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {m : ℕ}
    (e : ℕ → Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (t : ℝ) : Set (Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool)) :=
  {w | ∃ k, t ≤ |((fstErrCount (e k) w : ℕ) : ℝ) - ((sndErrCount (e k) w : ℕ) : ℝ)|}

lemma fstErrCount_eq_sum {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {m : ℕ}
    (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (w : Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool)) :
    ((fstErrCount h w : ℕ) : ℝ) = ∑ i, zeroOneLoss h ((w i).1) := by
  classical
  rw [fstErrCount, ← Finset.sum_boole]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
  intro i _
  by_cases hi : h.f ((w i).1).1 = ((w i).1).2
  · rw [if_neg (by simpa using hi)]
    simp [zeroOneLoss, hi]
  · rw [if_pos (by simpa using hi)]
    simp [zeroOneLoss, hi]

lemma sndErrCount_eq_sum {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {m : ℕ}
    (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (w : Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool)) :
    ((sndErrCount h w : ℕ) : ℝ) = ∑ i, zeroOneLoss h ((w i).2) := by
  classical
  rw [sndErrCount, ← Finset.sum_boole]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
  intro i _
  by_cases hi : h.f ((w i).2).1 = ((w i).2).2
  · rw [if_neg (by simpa using hi)]
    simp [zeroOneLoss, hi]
  · rw [if_pos (by simpa using hi)]
    simp [zeroOneLoss, hi]

lemma measurable_fstErrCount {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {m : ℕ}
    (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) :
    Measurable (fun w : Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool) => ((fstErrCount h w : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
  have : (fun w : Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool) => ((fstErrCount h w : ℕ) : ℝ))
      = fun w => ∑ i, zeroOneLoss h ((w i).1) := by
    funext w; exact fstErrCount_eq_sum h w
  rw [this]
  refine Finset.measurable_sum _ ?_
  intro i _
  exact (zeroOneLoss_measurable h).comp (measurable_fst.comp (measurable_pi_apply i))

lemma measurable_sndErrCount {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {m : ℕ}
    (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) :
    Measurable (fun w : Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool) => ((sndErrCount h w : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
  have : (fun w : Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool) => ((sndErrCount h w : ℕ) : ℝ))
      = fun w => ∑ i, zeroOneLoss h ((w i).2) := by
    funext w; exact sndErrCount_eq_sum h w
  rw [this]
  refine Finset.measurable_sum _ ?_
  intro i _
  exact (zeroOneLoss_measurable h).comp (measurable_snd.comp (measurable_pi_apply i))

lemma measurableSet_agnEvent {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {m : ℕ}
    (e : ℕ → Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (t : ℝ) :
    MeasurableSet (agnEvent (m := m) e t) := by
  have hrep : agnEvent (m := m) e t
      = ⋃ k : ℕ, {w : Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool) |
          t ≤ |((fstErrCount (e k) w : ℕ) : ℝ) - ((sndErrCount (e k) w : ℕ) : ℝ)|} := by
    ext w; simp [agnEvent, Set.mem_iUnion]
  rw [hrep]
  refine MeasurableSet.iUnion fun k => ?_
  exact measurableSet_le measurable_const
    (((measurable_fstErrCount (e k)).sub (measurable_sndErrCount (e k))).abs)

/-- The pointwise (in the paired sample) counting estimate feeding the symmetrisation
lemma, agnostic version. -/
lemma agn_indicator_sum_le {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool)
    {d : ℕ} (hvc : VCDim H = (d : ℕ∞)) (e : ℕ → Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (he : ∀ k, e k ∈ H)
    {m : ℕ} {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (w : Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool)) :
    ∑ T ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin m))),
        Set.indicator (swapPairs T ⁻¹' (agnEvent e t))
          (1 : (Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool)) → ℝ≥0∞) w
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (((∑ j ∈ Finset.Iic d, (m+m).choose j : ℕ) : ℝ)
          * (2 ^ (m+1) * Real.exp (- (t ^ 2) / (2 * m)))) := by
  classical
  set x : Fin (m+m) → 𝒳 :=
    Fin.append (fun i => ((w i).1).1) (fun i => ((w i).2).1) with hx
  have hxl : ∀ i : Fin m, x (Fin.castAdd m i) = ((w i).1).1 := by
    intro i; rw [hx]; exact Fin.append_left _ _ i
  have hxr : ∀ i : Fin m, x (Fin.natAdd m i) = ((w i).2).1 := by
    intro i; rw [hx]; exact Fin.append_right _ _ i
  have hind : ∀ T : Finset (Fin m),
      Set.indicator (swapPairs T ⁻¹' (agnEvent e t))
        (1 : (Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool)) → ℝ≥0∞) w
      = if swapPairs T w ∈ agnEvent e t then 1 else 0 := by
    intro T
    by_cases hT : swapPairs T w ∈ agnEvent e t
    · have hmem : w ∈ swapPairs T ⁻¹' agnEvent e t := hT
      rw [if_pos hT, Set.indicator_of_mem hmem]
      rfl
    · have hmem : w ∉ swapPairs T ⁻¹' agnEvent e t := hT
      rw [if_neg hT, Set.indicator_of_notMem hmem]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun T _ => hind T), Finset.sum_boole]
  set FF := (Finset.univ.filter
      (fun T : Finset (Fin m) => swapPairs T w ∈ agnEvent e t)) with hFF
  have hsub : FF ⊆ (vcTrace H x).biUnion
      (fun τ => Finset.univ.filter (fun T : Finset (Fin m) =>
        t ≤ |swapDiff (patA (fun j => decide (j ∈ τ)) w)
                      (patB (fun j => decide (j ∈ τ)) w) T|)) := by
    intro T hT
    obtain ⟨k, hcnt⟩ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hT).2
    set h := e k with hh
    set τ : Finset (Fin (m+m)) := Finset.univ.filter (fun j => h.f (x j) = true) with hτ
    have hpt : ∀ j, (decide (j ∈ τ)) = h.f (x j) := by
      intro j; rw [hτ]; simp
    have hτmem : τ ∈ vcTrace H x := by
      rw [mem_vcTrace]
      refine ⟨h, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hh]; exact he k
      · intro j; rw [hτ]; simp
    refine Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨τ, hτmem, ?_⟩
    refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    have hA : ∀ i : Fin m,
        (patA (fun j => decide (j ∈ τ)) w i = true) ↔ (h.f ((w i).1).1 ≠ ((w i).1).2) := by
      intro i
      rw [patA, hpt, hxl]
      simp
    have hB : ∀ i : Fin m,
        (patB (fun j => decide (j ∈ τ)) w i = true) ↔ (h.f ((w i).2).1 ≠ ((w i).2).2) := by
      intro i
      rw [patB, hpt, hxr]
      simp
    have hfst : fstErrCount h (swapPairs T w)
        = (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => (if i ∈ T then patB (fun j => decide (j ∈ τ)) w i
            else patA (fun j => decide (j ∈ τ)) w i) = true)).card := by
      rw [fstErrCount]
      congr 1
      apply Finset.filter_congr
      intro i _
      by_cases hi : i ∈ T
      · rw [swapPairs_apply, if_pos hi, if_pos hi]
        simpa using (hB i).symm
      · rw [swapPairs_apply, if_neg hi, if_neg hi]
        simpa using (hA i).symm
    have hsnd : sndErrCount h (swapPairs T w)
        = (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => (if i ∈ T then patA (fun j => decide (j ∈ τ)) w i
            else patB (fun j => decide (j ∈ τ)) w i) = true)).card := by
      rw [sndErrCount]
      congr 1
      apply Finset.filter_congr
      intro i _
      by_cases hi : i ∈ T
      · rw [swapPairs_apply, if_pos hi, if_pos hi]
        simpa using (hA i).symm
      · rw [swapPairs_apply, if_neg hi, if_neg hi]
        simpa using (hB i).symm
    have hdiff : swapDiff (patA (fun j => decide (j ∈ τ)) w)
        (patB (fun j => decide (j ∈ τ)) w) T
        = ((fstErrCount h (swapPairs T w) : ℕ) : ℝ)
          - ((sndErrCount h (swapPairs T w) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      rw [swapDiff, hfst, hsnd]
    rw [hdiff]
    exact hcnt
  have hcard : (FF.card : ℝ) ≤ ((∑ j ∈ Finset.Iic d, (m+m).choose j : ℕ) : ℝ)
      * (2 ^ (m+1) * Real.exp (- (t ^ 2) / (2 * m))) := by
    have h1 : FF.card ≤ ∑ τ ∈ vcTrace H x, (Finset.univ.filter
        (fun T : Finset (Fin m) => t ≤ |swapDiff (patA (fun j => decide (j ∈ τ)) w)
          (patB (fun j => decide (j ∈ τ)) w) T|)).card :=
      le_trans (Finset.card_le_card hsub) Finset.card_biUnion_le
    have h1R : (FF.card : ℝ) ≤ ∑ τ ∈ vcTrace H x, ((Finset.univ.filter
        (fun T : Finset (Fin m) => t ≤ |swapDiff (patA (fun j => decide (j ∈ τ)) w)
          (patB (fun j => decide (j ∈ τ)) w) T|)).card : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast h1
    have h2 : ∑ τ ∈ vcTrace H x, ((Finset.univ.filter
        (fun T : Finset (Fin m) => t ≤ |swapDiff (patA (fun j => decide (j ∈ τ)) w)
          (patB (fun j => decide (j ∈ τ)) w) T|)).card : ℝ)
        ≤ ∑ _τ ∈ vcTrace H x, ((2:ℝ) ^ (m+1) * Real.exp (- (t ^ 2) / (2 * m))) := by
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
      intro τ _
      exact card_swapDiff_abs_le _ _ ht
    have h3 : ∑ _τ ∈ vcTrace H x, ((2:ℝ) ^ (m+1) * Real.exp (- (t ^ 2) / (2 * m)))
        = ((vcTrace H x).card : ℝ) * ((2:ℝ) ^ (m+1) * Real.exp (- (t ^ 2) / (2 * m))) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    have h4 : ((vcTrace H x).card : ℝ) ≤ ((∑ j ∈ Finset.Iic d, (m+m).choose j : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast vcTrace_card_le_sauer H x hvc
    have hpos : (0:ℝ) ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ (m+1) * Real.exp (- (t ^ 2) / (2 * m)) := by positivity
    calc (FF.card : ℝ) ≤ ((vcTrace H x).card : ℝ)
          * ((2:ℝ) ^ (m+1) * Real.exp (- (t ^ 2) / (2 * m))) := by
            rw [← h3]; linarith
      _ ≤ ((∑ j ∈ Finset.Iic d, (m+m).choose j : ℕ) : ℝ)
          * ((2:ℝ) ^ (m+1) * Real.exp (- (t ^ 2) / (2 * m))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h4 hpos
  have hcast : ((FF.card : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) = ENNReal.ofReal ((FF.card : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    simp [ENNReal.ofReal_natCast]
  rw [hcast]
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hcard

end AgnGhost

section SymReal
open Finset

/-- The symmetrisation inequality with a real-valued (extended) bound. -/
lemma symmetrization_le' {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z]
    (P : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure P] {m : ℕ}
    (E : Set (Fin m → Z × Z)) (hE : MeasurableSet E) (N : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hcount : ∀ w : Fin m → Z × Z,
      ∑ T ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin m))),
