        Set.indicator (swapPairs T ⁻¹' E) (1 : (Fin m → Z × Z) → ℝ≥0∞) w ≤ N) :
    2 ^ m * (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P.prod P) E ≤ N := by
  classical
  set ν : Measure (Fin m → Z × Z) := Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P.prod P with hν
  haveI : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := by rw [hν]; infer_instance
  have hmeas : ∀ T : Finset (Fin m), MeasurableSet (swapPairs T ⁻¹' E) :=
    fun T => (measurable_swapPairs T) hE
  have hpre : ∀ T : Finset (Fin m), ν (swapPairs T ⁻¹' E) = ν E := by
    intro T
    exact (measurePreserving_swapPairs P T).measure_preimage hE.nullMeasurableSet
  have hsum : ∑ _T ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin m))), ν E = 2 ^ m * ν E := by
    rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    congr 1
    rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_finset, Fintype.card_fin]
    simp
  have hint : ∑ T ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin m))), ν (swapPairs T ⁻¹' E)
      = ∫⁻ w, ∑ T ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin m))),
          Set.indicator (swapPairs T ⁻¹' E) 1 w ∂ν := by
    rw [lintegral_finset_sum]
    · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun T _ => (lintegral_indicator_one (hmeas T)).symm
    · intro T _
      exact measurable_one.indicator (hmeas T)
  calc 2 ^ m * ν E = ∑ T ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin m))), ν (swapPairs T ⁻¹' E) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun T _ => hpre T, hsum]
    _ = ∫⁻ w, ∑ T ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin m))),
          Set.indicator (swapPairs T ⁻¹' E) 1 w ∂ν := hint
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ _w, N ∂ν := lintegral_mono hcount
    _ = N := by simp

end SymReal

section Cheb2
open Finset ProbabilityTheory

/-- A two-sided Chebyshev bound: as soon as `m ≤ 2 c ^ 2`, at least half of the samples
have their number of "successes" within `c` of the mean. -/
lemma half_le_measure_close {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z]
    (P : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure P] {m : ℕ}
    (f : Z → ℝ) (hf : Measurable f) (hf0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ f z) (hf1 : ∀ z, f z ≤ 1)
    {p c : ℝ} (hint : ∫ z, f z ∂P = p) (hc0 : 0 < c) (hcm : (m:ℝ) ≤ 2 * c ^ 2) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) ≤
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P) {S | |(∑ i, f (S i)) - (m:ℝ) * p| < c} := by
  classical
  set μ : Measure (Fin m → Z) := Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P with hμ
  haveI : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := by rw [hμ]; infer_instance
  have hfint : Integrable f P :=
    Integrable.of_mem_Icc 0 1 hf.aemeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => ⟨hf0 z, hf1 z⟩)
  have hp0 : 0 ≤ p := by
    rw [← hint]
    exact integral_nonneg hf0
  have hp1 : p ≤ 1 := by
    rw [← hint]
    have := integral_mono hfint (integrable_const (1:ℝ)) (fun z => hf1 z)
    simpa using this
  set Xi : Fin m → (Fin m → Z) → ℝ := fun i S => f (S i) with hXi
  have hXim : ∀ i, Measurable (Xi i) := fun i => hf.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)
  have hmemLp : ∀ i, MemLp (Xi i) 2 μ := by
    intro i
    refine MemLp.of_bound (hXim i).aestronglyMeasurable 1 ?_
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun S => ?_
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hf0 _)]
    exact hf1 _
  have hEi : ∀ i, ∫ S, Xi i S ∂μ = p := by
    intro i
    rw [hμ, hXi]
    rw [integral_comp_eval hf.aestronglyMeasurable]
    exact hint
  have hindep : iIndepFun Xi μ := by
    rw [hμ, hXi]
    exact iIndepFun_pi (fun _ => hf.aemeasurable)
  have hvari : ∀ i, variance (Xi i) μ ≤ 1/4 := by
    intro i
    have hb := variance_le_sub_mul_sub (μ := μ) (X := Xi i) (a := 0) (b := 1)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun S => ⟨hf0 _, hf1 _⟩) (hXim i).aemeasurable
    rw [hEi i] at hb
    nlinarith [hb, sq_nonneg (p - 1/2)]
  set X : (Fin m → Z) → ℝ := ∑ i, Xi i with hX
  have hXapp : ∀ S, X S = ∑ i, f (S i) := by
    intro S
    rw [hX]
    simp [hXi]
  have hMemX : MemLp X 2 μ := by
    rw [hX]
    exact memLp_finset_sum' _ (fun i _ => hmemLp i)
  have hEX : ∫ S, X S ∂μ = m * p := by
    simp only [hX, Finset.sum_apply]
    rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => (hmemLp i).integrable (by norm_num))]
    simp [hEi]
  have hVarX : variance X μ ≤ (m:ℝ)/4 := by
    rw [hX]
    rw [ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun.variance_sum (fun i _ => hmemLp i)
      (fun i _ j _ hij => hindep.indepFun hij)]
    calc ∑ i : Fin m, variance (Xi i) μ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin m, (1/4 : ℝ) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hvari i
      _ = (m:ℝ)/4 := by simp; ring
  have hcheb := ProbabilityTheory.meas_ge_le_variance_div_sq (μ := μ) hMemX hc0
  rw [hEX] at hcheb
  have hbadle : μ {S : Fin m → Z | c ≤ |X S - (m:ℝ) * p|} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) := by
    refine le_trans hcheb ?_
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    nlinarith [hVarX, hcm]
  have hGmeas : MeasurableSet {S : Fin m → Z | |(∑ i, f (S i)) - (m:ℝ) * p| < c} := by
    have hms : Measurable (fun S : Fin m → Z => ∑ i, f (S i)) := by
      apply Finset.measurable_sum
      intro i _
      exact hf.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)
    exact measurableSet_lt ((hms.sub measurable_const).abs) measurable_const
  have hcompl : {S : Fin m → Z | |(∑ i, f (S i)) - (m:ℝ) * p| < c}ᶜ
      = {S : Fin m → Z | c ≤ |X S - (m:ℝ) * p|} := by
    ext S
    simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_lt, hXapp S]
  have hadd := measure_add_measure_compl (μ := μ) hGmeas
  rw [hcompl, measure_univ] at hadd
  have hhalf : ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) + ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) = 1 := by
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_add (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
    norm_num
  have hfin : ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) + ENNReal.ofReal (1/2)
      ≤ μ {S : Fin m → Z | |(∑ i, f (S i)) - (m:ℝ) * p| < c} + ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) := by
    rw [hhalf, ← hadd]
    exact add_le_add le_rfl hbadle
  exact (ENNReal.add_le_add_iff_right (by simp)).mp hfin

end Cheb2

section AgnGhostLow
open Finset

lemma measurable_errCount {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {m : ℕ} (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) :
    Measurable (fun S : Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool => ((errCount h S : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
  have : (fun S : Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool => ((errCount h S : ℕ) : ℝ))
      = fun S => ∑ i, zeroOneLoss h (S i) := by
    funext S; exact errCount_eq_sum h S
  rw [this]
  refine Finset.measurable_sum _ ?_
  intro i _
  exact (zeroOneLoss_measurable h).comp (measurable_pi_apply i)

lemma fstErrCount_eq_errCount {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {m : ℕ}
    (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (w : Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool)) :
    fstErrCount h w = errCount h (fun i => (w i).1) := rfl

lemma sndErrCount_eq_errCount {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {m : ℕ}
    (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (w : Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool)) :
    sndErrCount h w = errCount h (fun i => (w i).2) := rfl

/-- The ghost-sample step in the agnostic case. -/
lemma agn_ghost_lower {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳]
    (e : ℕ → Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (P : Measure (𝒳 × Bool)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    {γ : ℝ} (hγ0 : 0 < γ) {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ γ ^ 2 * m) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) *
        (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P)
          {S | ∃ k, γ * m < |((errCount (e k) S : ℕ) : ℝ)
              - (m:ℝ) * ordinaryError (e k) P|}
      ≤ (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P.prod P) (agnEvent e (γ * m / 2)) := by
  classical
  have hmpos : 0 < (m:ℝ) := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg γ]
  set Pm : Measure (Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool) := Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P with hPm
  set ν : Measure (Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool)) :=
    Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P.prod P with hν
  set g : ℕ → Set (Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool) :=
    fun k => {S | γ * m < |((errCount (e k) S : ℕ) : ℝ)
      - (m:ℝ) * ordinaryError (e k) P|} with hg
  set G : ℕ → Set (Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool) :=
    fun k => {S | |((errCount (e k) S : ℕ) : ℝ)
      - (m:ℝ) * ordinaryError (e k) P| < γ * m / 2} with hG
  have hgmeas : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (g k) := by
    intro k
    rw [hg]
    exact measurableSet_lt measurable_const
      (((measurable_errCount (e k)).sub measurable_const).abs)
  have hGmeas : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (G k) := by
    intro k
    rw [hG]
    exact measurableSet_lt (((measurable_errCount (e k)).sub measurable_const).abs)
      measurable_const
  set D : ℕ → Set (Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool) := disjointed g with hD
  have hDmeas : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (D k) := fun k => MeasurableSet.disjointed hgmeas k
  have hDle : ∀ k, D k ⊆ g k := fun k => disjointed_le g k
  set F : ℕ → Set (Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool)) :=
    fun k => {w | (fun i => (w i).1) ∈ D k} ∩ {w | (fun i => (w i).2) ∈ G k} with hF
  have hFmeas : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (F k) := by
    intro k
    refine MeasurableSet.inter ?_ ?_
    · exact (measurable_pi_lambda _ (fun i => measurable_fst.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)))
        (hDmeas k)
    · exact (measurable_pi_lambda _ (fun i => measurable_snd.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)))
        (hGmeas k)
  have hFdisj : Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint F) := by
    intro i j hij
    have hd := disjoint_disjointed g hij
    refine Set.disjoint_left.mpr ?_
    intro w hw1 hw2
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hd hw1.1 hw2.1
  have hFsub : (⋃ k, F k) ⊆ agnEvent e (γ * m / 2) := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hw
    have hk1 : (fun i => (w i).1) ∈ g k := hDle k hk.1
    have hk2 : (fun i => (w i).2) ∈ G k := hk.2
    rw [hg] at hk1
    rw [hG] at hk2
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hk1 hk2
    refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
    rw [fstErrCount_eq_errCount, sndErrCount_eq_errCount]
    set A := ((errCount (e k) (fun i => (w i).1) : ℕ) : ℝ)
    set B := ((errCount (e k) (fun i => (w i).2) : ℕ) : ℝ)
    set q := (m:ℝ) * ordinaryError (e k) P
    have h1 : |A - B| ≥ |A - q| - |B - q| := by
      have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (A - q) (B - q)
      have heq : (A - q) - (B - q) = A - B := by ring
      rw [heq] at this
      linarith
    linarith
  have hhalfG : ∀ k, ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) ≤ Pm (G k) := by
    intro k
    have hGeq : G k = {S : Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool |
        |(∑ i, zeroOneLoss (e k) (S i)) - (m:ℝ) * ordinaryError (e k) P| < γ * m / 2} := by
      ext S
      rw [hG]
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
      rw [errCount_eq_sum]
    rw [hGeq, hPm]
    refine half_le_measure_close P (zeroOneLoss (e k))
      (zeroOneLoss_measurable (e k)) (zeroOneLoss_nonneg (e k)) (zeroOneLoss_le_one (e k))
      (integral_zeroOneLoss (e k) P) (by positivity) ?_
    have : (γ * m / 2) ^ 2 = γ ^ 2 * (m:ℝ) * (m:ℝ) / 4 := by ring
    rw [this]
    nlinarith [hm, hmpos]
  have hstep2 : ∀ k, ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) * Pm (D k) ≤ ν (F k) := by
    intro k
    have hprod : ν (F k) = Pm (D k) * Pm (G k) := by
      rw [hF, hν, hPm]
      exact pi_prod_inter P (hDmeas k) (hGmeas k)
    rw [hprod]
    calc ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) * Pm (D k) = Pm (D k) * ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) := by ring
      _ ≤ Pm (D k) * Pm (G k) := mul_le_mul_left' (hhalfG k) _
  have hAeq : {S : Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool | ∃ k, γ * m < |((errCount (e k) S : ℕ) : ℝ)
      - (m:ℝ) * ordinaryError (e k) P|} = ⋃ k, g k := by
    ext S
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_iUnion, hg]
  rw [hAeq, ← iUnion_disjointed (f := g), ← hD]
  rw [measure_iUnion (disjoint_disjointed g) hDmeas]
  calc ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) * ∑' k, Pm (D k)
      = ∑' k, ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) * Pm (D k) := ENNReal.tsum_mul_left.symm
    _ ≤ ∑' k, ν (F k) := ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum hstep2
    _ = ν (⋃ k, F k) := (measure_iUnion hFdisj hFmeas).symm
    _ ≤ ν (agnEvent e (γ * m / 2)) := measure_mono hFsub

end AgnGhostLow

section AgnMaster
open Finset

/-- The master VC estimate in the agnostic case: uniform deviation of empirical from true
error over the whole countable family. -/
theorem agnostic_vc_master {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool)
    {d : ℕ} (hvc : VCDim H = (d : ℕ∞)) (e : ℕ → Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (he : ∀ k, e k ∈ H)
    (P : Measure (𝒳 × Bool)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    {γ : ℝ} (hγ0 : 0 < γ) {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ γ ^ 2 * m) :
    (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P)
        {S | ∃ k, γ * m < |((errCount (e k) S : ℕ) : ℝ)
            - (m:ℝ) * ordinaryError (e k) P|}
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (4 * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.Iic d, (m+m).choose j : ℕ) : ℝ)
          * Real.exp (- (γ ^ 2 * (m:ℝ)) / 8)) := by
  classical
  have hmpos : 0 < (m:ℝ) := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg γ]
  set Γ : ℝ := ((∑ j ∈ Finset.Iic d, (m+m).choose j : ℕ) : ℝ) with hΓ
  have hΓ0 : 0 ≤ Γ := by rw [hΓ]; positivity
  set E : ℝ := Real.exp (- (γ ^ 2 * (m:ℝ)) / 8) with hE
  have hE0 : 0 < E := Real.exp_pos _
  set t : ℝ := γ * m / 2 with ht
  have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := by rw [ht]; positivity
  set ν : Measure (Fin m → (𝒳 × Bool) × (𝒳 × Bool)) :=
    Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P.prod P with hν
  set Bad : Set (Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool) :=
    {S | ∃ k, γ * m < |((errCount (e k) S : ℕ) : ℝ)
        - (m:ℝ) * ordinaryError (e k) P|} with hBad
  -- the exponential simplifies
  have hexp : Real.exp (- (t ^ 2) / (2 * m)) = E := by
    rw [hE, ht]
    congr 1
    field_simp
    ring
  -- symmetrisation
  have hsym : (2:ℝ≥0∞) ^ m * ν (agnEvent e t) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Γ * (2 ^ (m+1) * E)) := by
    rw [hν]
    refine symmetrization_le' P (agnEvent e t) (measurableSet_agnEvent e t) _ ?_
    intro w
    have := agn_indicator_sum_le H hvc e he ht0 w
    rw [hexp] at this
    exact this
  have hsplit : ENNReal.ofReal (Γ * (2 ^ (m+1) * E))
      = (2:ℝ≥0∞) ^ m * ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Γ * E) := by
    have h1 : Γ * (2 ^ (m+1) * E) = (2:ℝ) ^ m * (2 * Γ * E) := by
      rw [pow_succ]; ring
    rw [h1, ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity), ENNReal.ofReal_pow (by norm_num)]
    congr 2
    simp
  have hcancel : ν (agnEvent e t) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Γ * E) := by
    rw [hsplit] at hsym
    have h2 : ((2:ℝ≥0∞) ^ m) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have h2' : ((2:ℝ≥0∞) ^ m) ≠ ⊤ := ENNReal.pow_ne_top (by norm_num)
    exact (ENNReal.mul_le_mul_left h2 h2').mp hsym
  have hlow := agn_ghost_lower e P hγ0 hm
  rw [← hBad, ← hν, ← ht] at hlow
  have hhalf : ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) * 2 = 1 := by
    rw [show (2:ℝ≥0∞) = ENNReal.ofReal 2 by simp, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num)]
    norm_num
  have hfin : (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P) Bad ≤ 2 * ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Γ * E) := by
    calc (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P) Bad
        = 2 * (ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) * (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P) Bad) := by
          rw [show (2:ℝ≥0∞) * (ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) * (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P) Bad)
            = (ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) * 2) * (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P) Bad by ring,
            hhalf, one_mul]
      _ ≤ 2 * ν (agnEvent e t) := by gcongr
      _ ≤ 2 * ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Γ * E) := by gcongr
  refine le_trans hfin (le_of_eq ?_)
  rw [show (2:ℝ≥0∞) = ENNReal.ofReal 2 by simp, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num)]
  congr 1
  ring

end AgnMaster

section AgnPAC
open Finset

lemma erm_exists {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (e : ℕ → Predictor 𝒳 Bool) {m : ℕ}
    (S : Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool) :
    ∃ k, ∀ j, errCount (e k) S ≤ errCount (e j) S := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (s := Set.range fun j => errCount (e j) S)
      (Set.range_nonempty _)
  refine ⟨k, fun j => ?_⟩
  simp only at hk
  rw [hk]
  exact Nat.sInf_le ⟨j, rfl⟩

/-- Empirical risk minimisation over the enumerated family (the minimum is attained
because the empirical error takes finitely many values). -/
noncomputable def ermPred {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (e : ℕ → Predictor 𝒳 Bool) {m : ℕ}
    (S : Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool) : Predictor 𝒳 Bool :=
  e (Classical.choose (erm_exists e S))

lemma ermPred_eq {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (e : ℕ → Predictor 𝒳 Bool) {m : ℕ}
    (S : Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool) : ∃ k, ermPred e S = e k :=
  ⟨Classical.choose (erm_exists e S), rfl⟩

lemma ermPred_le {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (e : ℕ → Predictor 𝒳 Bool) {m : ℕ}
    (S : Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool) (j : ℕ) : errCount (ermPred e S) S ≤ errCount (e j) S :=
  Classical.choose_spec (erm_exists e S) j

/-- Pointwise convergence of predictors forces convergence of their error probabilities. -/
lemma ordinaryError_tendsto {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳]
    (P : Measure (𝒳 × Bool)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (s : ℕ → Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool)
    (hlim : ∀ x, ∀ᶠ i in Filter.atTop, (s i).f x = h.f x) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun i => ordinaryError (s i) P) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (ordinaryError h P)) := by
  have hconv : ∀ᵐ z ∂P, Filter.Tendsto (fun i => zeroOneLoss (s i) z) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (zeroOneLoss h z)) := by
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => ?_
    have hev : (fun i => zeroOneLoss (s i) z) =ᶠ[Filter.atTop] (fun _ => zeroOneLoss h z) := by
      filter_upwards [hlim z.1] with i hi
      unfold zeroOneLoss
      rw [Set.indicator_apply, Set.indicator_apply]
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, hi]
    exact Filter.Tendsto.congr' hev.symm tendsto_const_nhds
  have hT := MeasureTheory.tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence
    (μ := P) (F := fun i => zeroOneLoss (s i)) (f := zeroOneLoss h) (fun _ => (1:ℝ))
    (fun i => (zeroOneLoss_measurable (s i)).aestronglyMeasurable)
    (integrable_const 1)
    (fun i => Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (zeroOneLoss_nonneg _ _)]
      exact zeroOneLoss_le_one _ _)
    hconv
  simpa only [integral_zeroOneLoss] using hT

/-- The agnostic PAC guarantee at a given sample size. -/
lemma agnostic_PAC_at_size {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool)
    {d : ℕ} (hvc : VCDim H = (d : ℕ∞))
    (H₀ : Set (Predictor 𝒳 Bool)) (hH₀ : H₀ ⊆ H)
    (e : ℕ → Predictor 𝒳 Bool) (hrange : H₀ = Set.range e)
    (hdense : ∀ h ∈ H, ∃ s : ℕ → Predictor 𝒳 Bool, (∀ i, s i ∈ H₀) ∧
        ∀ x, ∀ᶠ i in Filter.atTop, (s i).f x = h.f x)
    (hHne : H.Nonempty)
    {γ δ : ℝ} (hγ0 : 0 < γ) {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ (γ/2) ^ 2 * m)
    (hbound : 4 * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.Iic d, (m+m).choose j : ℕ) : ℝ)
        * Real.exp (- ((γ/2) ^ 2 * (m:ℝ)) / 8) ≤ δ) :
    OrdinaryAgnosticPACAtSize H γ δ m := by
  classical
  have he : ∀ k, e k ∈ H := by
    intro k
    apply hH₀
    rw [hrange]
    exact ⟨k, rfl⟩
  have hγ20 : 0 < γ / 2 := by linarith
  have hmpos : 0 < (m:ℝ) := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (γ/2)]
  haveI : Nonempty ↥H := by
    obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := hHne
    exact ⟨⟨h, hh⟩⟩
  refine ⟨fun S => ermPred e S, ?_⟩
  intro P _
  set Bad : Set (Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool) :=
    {S | ∃ k, (γ/2) * m < |((errCount (e k) S : ℕ) : ℝ)
        - (m:ℝ) * ordinaryError (e k) P|} with hBad
  have hsub : {S : Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool |
      (⨅ h : ↥H, ordinaryError (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) P) + γ < ordinaryError (ermPred e S) P}
      ⊆ Bad := by
    intro S hS
    by_contra hnb
    simp only [hBad, Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_exists, not_lt] at hnb
    obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀⟩ := ermPred_eq e S
    -- uniform convergence gives the ERM comparison
    have hcomp : ∀ k, ordinaryError (ermPred e S) P ≤ ordinaryError (e k) P + γ := by
      intro k
      have h1 := hnb k₀
      have h2 := hnb k
      have h3 : errCount (ermPred e S) S ≤ errCount (e k) S := ermPred_le e S k
      have h3R : ((errCount (e k₀) S : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ((errCount (e k) S : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        rw [← hk₀]
        exact_mod_cast h3
      have hb1 : (m:ℝ) * ordinaryError (e k₀) P
          ≤ ((errCount (e k₀) S : ℕ) : ℝ) + (γ/2) * m := by
        have := abs_le.mp h1
        linarith [this.1, this.2]
      have hb2 : ((errCount (e k) S : ℕ) : ℝ)
          ≤ (m:ℝ) * ordinaryError (e k) P + (γ/2) * m := by
        have := abs_le.mp h2
        linarith [this.1, this.2]
      have hmm : (m:ℝ) * ordinaryError (e k₀) P
          ≤ (m:ℝ) * ordinaryError (e k) P + γ * m := by linarith
      have hfin : ordinaryError (e k₀) P ≤ ordinaryError (e k) P + γ := by
        have := (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hmpos).mpr hmm
        nlinarith [hmm, hmpos]
      rw [hk₀]
      exact hfin
    -- pass to the closure
    have hall : ∀ h : ↥H, ordinaryError (ermPred e S) P - γ
        ≤ ordinaryError (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) P := by
      rintro ⟨h, hh⟩
      obtain ⟨s, hsH₀, hslim⟩ := hdense h hh
      have hs : ∀ i, ordinaryError (ermPred e S) P - γ ≤ ordinaryError (s i) P := by
        intro i
        have := hsH₀ i
        rw [hrange] at this
        obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := this
        have := hcomp k
        rw [hk] at this
        linarith
      have hlim := ordinaryError_tendsto P s h hslim
      exact ge_of_tendsto' hlim hs
    have hinf : ordinaryError (ermPred e S) P - γ
        ≤ ⨅ h : ↥H, ordinaryError (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) P := le_ciInf hall
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hS
    linarith
  calc (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P) {S : Fin m → 𝒳 × Bool |
        (⨅ h : ↥H, ordinaryError (h : Predictor 𝒳 Bool) P) + γ
          < ordinaryError (ermPred e S) P}
      ≤ (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => P) Bad := measure_mono hsub
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (4 * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.Iic d, (m+m).choose j : ℕ) : ℝ)
          * Real.exp (- ((γ/2) ^ 2 * (m:ℝ)) / 8)) := by
        rw [hBad]
        exact agnostic_vc_master H hvc e he P hγ20 hm
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hbound

end AgnPAC

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
lemma agnostic_numeric {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) {γ δ : ℝ} (hγ0 : 0 < γ) (hγ1 : γ < 1)
    (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) (m : ℕ)
    (hm : 400 * ((d:ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (1/γ)) + Real.log (2/δ)) / γ ^ 2 ≤ m) :
    2 ≤ (γ/2) ^ 2 * m ∧ d ≤ m + m ∧
      4 * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.Iic d, (m+m).choose j : ℕ) : ℝ)
        * Real.exp (- ((γ/2) ^ 2 * (m:ℝ)) / 8) ≤ δ := by
  have hdR : (1:ℝ) ≤ (d:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hdpos : (0:ℝ) < (d:ℝ) := by linarith
  have hd0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (d:ℝ) := le_of_lt hdpos
  have hγ2 : (0:ℝ) < γ ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hγ2le : γ ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  have hL : 0 ≤ Real.log (1/γ) := Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hγ0]; linarith)
  set D : ℝ := (d:ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (1/γ)) with hDdef
  have hD1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ D := by rw [hDdef]; nlinarith
  set E : ℝ := Real.log (2/δ) with hEdef
  have hE0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ E := Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hδ0]; linarith)
  have hB1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ D + E := by linarith
  have hmpos : (0:ℝ) < (m:ℝ) := by
    have hq : (0:ℝ) < 400 * (D + E) / γ ^ 2 := by
      apply div_pos (by linarith) hγ2
    linarith
  have ht : 400 * (D + E) ≤ γ ^ 2 * (m:ℝ) := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hγ2] at hm
    linarith
  have h8 : (8:ℝ) ≤ γ ^ 2 * (m:ℝ) := by nlinarith
  have hdm : d ≤ m + m := by
    have hDd : (d:ℝ) ≤ D := by rw [hDdef]; nlinarith
    have h1 : 400 * (d:ℝ) ≤ γ ^ 2 * (m:ℝ) := by linarith
    have h2 : γ ^ 2 * (m:ℝ) ≤ (m:ℝ) := by nlinarith
    have hle : (d:ℝ) ≤ (m:ℝ) := by linarith
    have : d ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hle
    omega
  refine ⟨by nlinarith, hdm, ?_⟩
  have hL1 : (0.693:ℝ) ≤ Real.log 2 := le_of_lt (by linarith [Real.log_two_gt_d9])
  have hL2 : Real.log 2 ≤ 0.694 := le_of_lt (by linarith [Real.log_two_lt_d9])
  obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ : ∃ X : ℝ, X = Real.exp 1 * ((m:ℝ)+(m:ℝ)) / (d:ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hXpos : 0 < X := by rw [hX]; positivity
  have hsauer' : ((∑ j ∈ Finset.Iic d, (m+m).choose j : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ X ^ d := by
    have h := sum_Iic_choose_le_exp (m+m) d hd hdm
    rw [hX]
    refine le_trans h (le_of_eq ?_)
    norm_num
  have hlogX : Real.log X = 1 + Real.log 2 + Real.log (m:ℝ) - Real.log (d:ℝ) := by
    rw [hX, Real.log_div (by positivity) (ne_of_gt hdpos),
      Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity), Real.log_exp,
      show ((m:ℝ)+(m:ℝ)) = 2 * (m:ℝ) by ring,
      Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (ne_of_gt hmpos)]
    ring
  -- bound `log m`
  have hEq : (m:ℝ)*γ^2/(64*(d:ℝ)) = (m:ℝ) / (64*(d:ℝ)/γ^2) := by field_simp
  have h1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos
    (show (0:ℝ) < (m:ℝ)/(64*(d:ℝ)/γ^2) by positivity)
  rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hmpos) (by positivity), ← hEq] at h1
  have hlog64 : Real.log (64*(d:ℝ)/γ^2)
      = 6*Real.log 2 + Real.log (d:ℝ) + 2 * Real.log (1/γ) := by
    rw [Real.log_div (by positivity) (ne_of_gt hγ2),
      Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (ne_of_gt hdpos),
      show (64:ℝ) = 2^6 by norm_num, Real.log_pow, Real.log_pow, one_div, Real.log_inv]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [hlog64] at h1
  have hlogXle : Real.log X
      ≤ 7*Real.log 2 + 2 * Real.log (1/γ) + (m:ℝ)*γ^2/(64*(d:ℝ)) := by
    rw [hlogX]; linarith
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogXle hd0
  have hexp : (d:ℝ) * (7*Real.log 2 + 2 * Real.log (1/γ) + (m:ℝ)*γ^2/(64*(d:ℝ)))
      = 7*Real.log 2*(d:ℝ) + 2*(d:ℝ)*Real.log (1/γ) + γ^2*(m:ℝ)/64 := by
    field_simp
  rw [hexp] at hmul
  have hdlogX : (d:ℝ) * Real.log X ≤ γ^2*(m:ℝ)/64 + 4.858 * D := by
    have hDexp : D = (d:ℝ) + (d:ℝ)*Real.log (1/γ) := by rw [hDdef]; ring
    rw [hDexp]
    have h7 : 7*Real.log 2*(d:ℝ) ≤ 4.858*(d:ℝ) := by nlinarith
    have hpos2 : 0 ≤ (d:ℝ)*Real.log (1/γ) := mul_nonneg hd0 hL
    linarith
  have hlogδ : Real.log (1/δ) ≤ E := by
    rw [hEdef]
    apply Real.log_le_log (by positivity)
    rw [div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hδ0]
    linarith
  have hlog4 : Real.log 4 = 2 * Real.log 2 := by
    rw [show (4:ℝ) = 2^2 by norm_num, Real.log_pow]; push_cast; ring
  have hkey : Real.log 4 + (d:ℝ) * Real.log X + Real.log (1/δ)
      ≤ γ^2*(m:ℝ)/32 := by
    rw [hlog4]
    linarith [hD1, hE0, ht, hdlogX, hlogδ, hL2]
  have hmain : 4 * X ^ d ≤ Real.exp (γ^2*(m:ℝ)/32) * δ := by
    have hlogL : Real.log (4 * X ^ d) = Real.log 4 + (d:ℝ) * Real.log X := by
      rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by positivity), Real.log_pow]
    have hlogR : Real.log (Real.exp (γ^2*(m:ℝ)/32) * δ)
        = γ^2*(m:ℝ)/32 + Real.log δ := by
      rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (ne_of_gt hδ0), Real.log_exp]
    have hlogδ' : Real.log (1/δ) = - Real.log δ := by rw [one_div, Real.log_inv]
    have hineq : Real.log (4 * X ^ d) ≤ Real.log (Real.exp (γ^2*(m:ℝ)/32) * δ) := by
      rw [hlogL, hlogR]
      linarith [hkey, hlogδ'.le, hlogδ'.ge]
    calc 4 * X ^ d = Real.exp (Real.log (4 * X ^ d)) := (Real.exp_log (by positivity)).symm
      _ ≤ Real.exp (Real.log (Real.exp (γ^2*(m:ℝ)/32) * δ)) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hineq
      _ = Real.exp (γ^2*(m:ℝ)/32) * δ := Real.exp_log (by positivity)
  have hEeq : (- ((γ/2) ^ 2 * (m:ℝ)) / 8) = - (γ^2*(m:ℝ)/32) := by ring
  rw [hEeq]
  have hexp0 : (0:ℝ) < Real.exp (- (γ^2*(m:ℝ)/32)) := Real.exp_pos _
  calc 4 * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.Iic d, (m+m).choose j : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.exp (- (γ^2*(m:ℝ)/32))
      ≤ (4 * X ^ d) * Real.exp (- (γ^2*(m:ℝ)/32)) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hexp0.le
        linarith
    _ ≤ (Real.exp (γ^2*(m:ℝ)/32) * δ) * Real.exp (- (γ^2*(m:ℝ)/32)) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmain hexp0.le
    _ = δ := by
        rw [mul_comm (Real.exp (γ^2*(m:ℝ)/32)) δ, mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
        simp

end AgnNumerics

/-- The separable-class ordinary agnostic finite-VC theorem. -/
theorem ordinary_agnostic_vc_bound_sep :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧
      ∀ {𝒳 : Type u} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool),
        H.Nonempty →
        (∃ H₀ ⊆ H, H₀.Countable ∧ ∀ h ∈ H, ∃ s : ℕ → Predictor 𝒳 Bool,
            (∀ i, s i ∈ H₀) ∧ ∀ x, ∀ᶠ i in Filter.atTop, (s i).f x = h.f x) →
        ∀ d : ℕ, VCDim H = (d : ℕ∞) → 0 < d →
        ∀ γ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∃ n : ℕ, OrdinaryAgnosticPACAtSize H γ δ n ∧
        (n : ℝ) ≤ K * (((d : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (1 / γ)) + Real.log (2 / δ)) / γ ^ 2) := by
  refine ⟨500, by norm_num, ?_⟩
  intro 𝒳 _ H hH hsep d hvc hd γ hγ δ hδ
  obtain ⟨hγ0, hγ1⟩ := hγ
  obtain ⟨hδ0, hδ1⟩ := hδ
  obtain ⟨H₀, hH₀sub, hH₀cnt, hdense⟩ := hsep
  have hH₀ne : H₀.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := hH
    obtain ⟨s, hs, _⟩ := hdense h hh
    exact ⟨s 0, hs 0⟩
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hH₀cnt.exists_eq_range hH₀ne
  have hdR : (1:ℝ) ≤ (d:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hγ2 : (0:ℝ) < γ ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hγ2le : γ ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  have hL : 0 ≤ Real.log (1/γ) := Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hγ0]; linarith)
  have hE0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.log (2/δ) := Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hδ0]; linarith)
  have hB1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (d:ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (1/γ)) + Real.log (2/δ) := by nlinarith
  set B : ℝ := (d:ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (1/γ)) + Real.log (2/δ) with hB
  set m : ℕ := ⌈400 * B / γ ^ 2⌉₊ with hmdef
  have hBγ : (1:ℝ) ≤ B / γ ^ 2 := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hγ2]
    nlinarith
  have hm : 400 * B / γ ^ 2 ≤ (m:ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
  obtain ⟨h2, hdm, hbound⟩ := agnostic_numeric hd hγ0 hγ1 hδ0 hδ1 m hm
  refine ⟨m, agnostic_PAC_at_size H hvc H₀ hH₀sub e he hdense hH hγ0 h2 hbound, ?_⟩
  have hub : (m:ℝ) < 400 * B / γ ^ 2 + 1 := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (by positivity)
  have : 400 * B / γ ^ 2 + 1 ≤ 500 * (B / γ ^ 2) := by
    rw [show 400 * B / γ ^ 2 = 400 * (B / γ ^ 2) by ring]
    linarith
  linarith

/-- The separable-class ordinary realizable finite-VC theorem. -/
theorem ordinary_realizable_vc_bound_sep :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧
      ∀ {𝒳 : Type u} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool),
        H.Nonempty →
        (∃ H₀ ⊆ H, H₀.Countable ∧ ∀ h ∈ H, ∃ s : ℕ → Predictor 𝒳 Bool,
            (∀ i, s i ∈ H₀) ∧ ∀ x, ∀ᶠ i in Filter.atTop, (s i).f x = h.f x) →
        ∀ d : ℕ, VCDim H = (d : ℕ∞) → 0 < d →
        ∀ α ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) (1 / 4),
      ∃ n : ℕ, OrdinaryRealizablePACAtSize H α δ n ∧
        (n : ℝ) ≤ K * (((d : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (1 / α)) + Real.log (2 / δ)) / α) := by
  refine ⟨100, by norm_num, ?_⟩
  intro 𝒳 _ H hH hsep d hvc hd α hα δ hδ
  obtain ⟨hα0, hα1⟩ := hα
  obtain ⟨hδ0, hδ1⟩ := hδ
  obtain ⟨H₀, hH₀sub, hH₀cnt, hdense⟩ := hsep
  have hH₀ne : H₀.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := hH
    obtain ⟨s, hs, _⟩ := hdense h hh
    exact ⟨s 0, hs 0⟩
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hH₀cnt.exists_eq_range hH₀ne
  have hdR : (1:ℝ) ≤ (d:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hlogα : 0 ≤ Real.log (1/α) := Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hα0]; linarith)
  have hE0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.log (2/δ) := Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hδ0]; linarith)
  have hB1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (d:ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (1/α)) + Real.log (2/δ) := by nlinarith
  set B : ℝ := (d:ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (1/α)) + Real.log (2/δ) with hB
  set m : ℕ := ⌈16 * B / α⌉₊ with hmdef
  have hBα : (1:ℝ) ≤ B / α := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hα0]
    nlinarith
  have hm : 16 * B / α ≤ (m:ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
  obtain ⟨h8, hdm, hbound⟩ := realizable_numeric hd hα0 hα1 hδ0 hδ1 m hm
  refine ⟨m, realizable_PAC_at_size H hvc H₀ hH₀sub e he hdense hα0 (le_of_lt hα1) hδ0 h8 hbound,
    ?_⟩
  have hub : (m:ℝ) < 16 * B / α + 1 := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (by positivity)
  have : 16 * B / α + 1 ≤ 100 * (B / α) := by
    rw [show 16 * B / α = 16 * (B/α) by ring]
    linarith
  linarith

/-- Sharpened form of the `theorem7` right-hand side lower bound. -/
lemma theorem7_rhs_lower2 {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d)
    {ρ ε δ : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) :
    (((d : ℝ) * (1 + 4 * Real.log (1 / ε)) + 1 + Real.log (2 / δ)) / ε ^ 4) ≤
      ((d / ε ^ 4) * Real.log (d / ε ^ 4)
        + (1 / ε ^ 4) * max (1 / (c2 ρ - 1)) 1
        + (d / ε ^ 4) * Real.log (Real.exp 1 / d)
        + Real.log (2 / δ) / ε ^ 4) := by
  have hdR : 0 < (d : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have he4 : 0 < ε ^ 4 := by positivity
  have hdne : (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hdR
  have he4ne : ε ^ 4 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt he4
  have hAne : (d : ℝ) / ε ^ 4 ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero hdne he4ne
  have hBne : Real.exp 1 / (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
    div_ne_zero (Real.exp_ne_zero _) hdne
  have hprod : ((d : ℝ) / ε ^ 4) * (Real.exp 1 / (d : ℝ)) =
      Real.exp 1 / ε ^ 4 := by
    field_simp
  have hlogsum : Real.log ((d : ℝ) / ε ^ 4) +
      Real.log (Real.exp 1 / (d : ℝ)) = 1 - Real.log (ε ^ 4) := by
    rw [← Real.log_mul hAne hBne, hprod,
      Real.log_div (Real.exp_ne_zero _) he4ne, Real.log_exp]
  have hlog4 : Real.log (ε ^ 4) = 4 * Real.log ε := by
    rw [Real.log_pow]; norm_num
  have hloginv : Real.log (1 / ε) = - Real.log ε := by
    rw [one_div, Real.log_inv]
  have hlog_ge : 1 + 4 * Real.log (1 / ε) = Real.log ((d : ℝ) / ε ^ 4) +
      Real.log (Real.exp 1 / (d : ℝ)) := by
    rw [hlogsum, hlog4, hloginv]; ring
  have hfactor0 : 0 ≤ (d : ℝ) / ε ^ 4 := by positivity
  have hfirst :
      (d / ε ^ 4) * Real.log (d / ε ^ 4) +
        (d / ε ^ 4) * Real.log (Real.exp 1 / d) =
      ((d : ℝ) / ε ^ 4) * (1 + 4 * Real.log (1 / ε)) := by
    rw [← mul_add, ← hlog_ge]
  have hsecond : (1 : ℝ) / ε ^ 4 ≤
      (1 / ε ^ 4) * max (1 / (c2 ρ - 1)) 1 := by
    have hcoef : 0 ≤ (1 : ℝ) / ε ^ 4 := by positivity
    have hm : (1 : ℝ) ≤ max (1 / (c2 ρ - 1)) 1 := le_max_right _ _
    nlinarith
  have hid : ((((d : ℝ) * (1 + 4 * Real.log (1 / ε))) + 1 + Real.log (2 / δ)) / ε ^ 4) =
      ((d : ℝ) / ε ^ 4) * (1 + 4 * Real.log (1 / ε)) + 1 / ε ^ 4
        + Real.log (2 / δ) / ε ^ 4 := by
    field_simp
  rw [hid]
  linarith [hfirst, hsecond]

end Upper

theorem theorem7 :
    ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ →
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool),
        H.Nonempty →
        (∃ H₀ ⊆ H, H₀.Countable ∧ ∀ h ∈ H, ∃ s : ℕ → Predictor 𝒳 Bool,
            (∀ i, s i ∈ H₀) ∧ ∀ x, ∀ᶠ i in Filter.atTop, (s i).f x = h.f x) →
        ∀ d : ℕ, VCDim H = (d : ℕ∞) → 0 < d →
        ∀ ε ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∃ n : ℕ, agnosticSampleComplexity H ρ ε δ ≤ (n : ℕ∞) ∧
        (n : ℝ) ≤ C * ((d / ε ^ 4) * Real.log (d / ε ^ 4)
                        + (1 / ε ^ 4) * max (1 / (c2 ρ - 1)) 1
                        + (d / ε ^ 4) * Real.log (Real.exp 1 / d)
                        + Real.log (2 / δ) / ε ^ 4) := by
  intro ρ hρ
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hbound⟩ := Upper.ordinary_agnostic_vc_bound_sep
  set L : ℝ := Upper.robustLip ρ with hLdef
  have hLpos : 0 < L := Upper.robustLip_pos hρ
  have hLone : 1 < L := Upper.one_lt_robustLip hρ
  have hlogL : 0 ≤ Real.log L := Real.log_nonneg hLone.le
  refine ⟨K * L ^ 4 * (2 + 2 * Real.log L), by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro 𝒳 _ H hH hsep d hvc hd ε hε δ hδ
  set γ : ℝ := (ε / L) ^ 2 with hγdef
  have hε0 : 0 < ε := hε.1
  have hε1 : ε < 1 := hε.2
  have hrpos : 0 < ε / L := div_pos hε0 hLpos
  have hrlt : ε / L < 1 := by
    apply (div_lt_one hLpos).2
    exact hε1.trans hLone
  have hγ0 : 0 < γ := by positivity
  have hγ1 : γ < 1 := by

    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧

theorem theorem12 :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool),
        H.Nonempty →
        (∃ H₀ ⊆ H, H₀.Countable ∧ ∀ h ∈ H, ∃ s : ℕ → Predictor 𝒳 Bool,
            (∀ i, s i ∈ H₀) ∧ ∀ x, ∀ᶠ i in Filter.atTop, (s i).f x = h.f x) →

                            * (d * Real.log (2 * Real.exp 1 / d) + Real.log (2 / δ))) := by
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hbound⟩ := Upper.ordinary_realizable_vc_bound_sep
  refine ⟨K, hK, ?_⟩
  intro 𝒳 _ H hH hsep d hvc hd ρ hρ ε hε δ hδ

  have hεpos : 0 < ε := hε.1
  have hεone : ε < 1 := hε.2
  have hden : 0 < 1 + 2 * ρ := by linarith

  have hαone : α < 1 := by
    rw [hαdef]
    apply (div_lt_one hden).2
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (ε - 1), sq_nonneg ε]
  obtain ⟨n, hnPAC, hn⟩ := hbound (𝒳 := 𝒳) H hH hsep d hvc hd α ⟨hαpos, hαone⟩ δ hδ
  refine ⟨n, Upper.realizableSampleComplexity_le_of_ordinaryPAC
    H ρ ε δ n hρ hεpos ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hαdef]; exact hnPAC
  · -- transform the α-bound into the required shape
    have hdR : (1:ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hd
    have hdpos : (0:ℝ) < (d : ℝ) := by linarith
    have hlogd : 0 ≤ Real.log d := Real.log_nonneg hdR
    have hlogα : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / α) := by
      apply Real.log_nonneg
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hαpos]; linarith
    have hlogδ : 0 ≤ Real.log (2 / δ) := by
      apply Real.log_nonneg
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hδ.1]; linarith [hδ.2]
    -- the target, rewritten in terms of α
    have hform :
        ((16 * (d : ℝ) / α) * Real.log (8 * (d : ℝ) / α)

            Real.log (8 * (1 + 2 * ρ) * d / ε ^ 2)
          + (8 * (1 + 2 * ρ) / ε ^ 2) *
              (d * Real.log (2 * Real.exp 1 / d) + Real.log (2 / δ))) := by
      rw [hαdef]
      have h1 : (8 : ℝ) * d / (ε ^ 2 / (1 + 2 * ρ)) = 8 * (1 + 2 * ρ) * d / ε ^ 2 := by
        field_simp
      rw [h1]
      have hne : ε ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have hne2 : (1 + 2 * ρ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hden
      field_simp
    rw [← hform]
    refine hn.trans ?_
    -- K * ((d(1+log(1/α)) + log(2/δ))/α) ≤ K * (16d/α * log(8d/α) + (8/α)(d log(2e/d) + log(2/δ)))
    have hlogcomb : 2 * Real.log (8 * (d : ℝ) / α) + Real.log (2 * Real.exp 1 / d)
        = Real.log (128 * Real.exp 1 * d / α ^ 2) := by
      have e8 : (8 : ℝ) * d / α > 0 := by positivity
      have e2 : (2 : ℝ) * Real.exp 1 / d > 0 := by positivity
      rw [show (2:ℝ) * Real.log (8 * (d : ℝ) / α) = Real.log ((8 * (d:ℝ) / α) ^ 2) by
        rw [Real.log_pow]; norm_num]
      rw [← Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity)]

      field_simp
      ring
    have hbig : (d : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (1 / α)) + Real.log (2 / δ)

          + 8 * ((d:ℝ) * Real.log (2 * Real.exp 1 / d) + Real.log (2 / δ)) := by
      have hrw : 16 * (d:ℝ) * Real.log (8 * (d : ℝ) / α)
          + 8 * ((d:ℝ) * Real.log (2 * Real.exp 1 / d) + Real.log (2 / δ))
          = 8 * (d:ℝ) * (2 * Real.log (8 * (d : ℝ) / α) + Real.log (2 * Real.exp 1 / d))
            + 8 * Real.log (2 / δ) := by ring
      rw [hrw, hlogcomb]
      have hlow : 1 + Real.log (1 / α) ≤ 8 * Real.log (128 * Real.exp 1 * d / α ^ 2) := by
        have hsplit : Real.log (128 * Real.exp 1 * d / α ^ 2)
            = Real.log 128 + 1 + Real.log d + 2 * Real.log (1 / α) := by

            Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity),

          + (8 / α) * ((d : ℝ) * Real.log (2 * Real.exp 1 / d) + Real.log (2 / δ)) := by

          + (8 / α) * ((d : ℝ) * Real.log (2 * Real.exp 1 / d) + Real.log (2 / δ))

            + 8 * ((d:ℝ) * Real.log (2 * Real.exp 1 / d) + Real.log (2 / δ))) / α := by

### Proof of Lemma 11

Before proving Lemma 11, we first give several important lemmas which are closely related to the convergence rate of Algorithm 3.

Lemma 21 Letting $\mathbf x_{t}, \mathbf y_{t}, \mathbf s_{t}$ be generated by Algorithm 3, it holds that

$$
\begin{array}{l}{{\displaystyle h(\bar{x}_{t+1})-h(x^{*})\le(1-\alpha)(h(\bar{x}_{t})-h(x^{*}))-\left\langle\bar{G}_{t},(1-\alpha)\bar{x}_{t}+\alpha x^{*}-\bar{y}_{t}\right\rangle}}\\ {{\displaystyle~-\eta\left(\frac 34-\frac{\eta L}2\right)\left\|\bar{G}_{t}\right\|^{2}-\frac{\mu\alpha}2\left\|x^{*}-\bar{y}_{t}\right\|^{2}}}\\ {{\displaystyle~+\frac{13\eta}m\left\|\mathbf s_{t}-\mathbf 1\bar{s}_{t}\right\|^{2}+\frac{20M^{2}\eta+10\eta^{-1}}m\left\|\mathbf y_{t}-\mathbf 1\bar{y}_{t}\right\|^{2}}.}\end{array}\tag{56}
$$

Proof By µ-strong convexity , L-smoothness of $f(x)$ and the property of proximal operator, we have

$$
\begin{array}{l}{h(\mathbf{prox}_{\eta,r}(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}-\eta\mathbf{s}_{t}^{(i)})))=f(\mathbf{prox}_{\eta,r}(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}-\eta\mathbf{s}_{t}^{(i)})))+r(\mathbf{prox}_{\eta,r}(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}-\eta\mathbf{s}_{t}^{(i)})))}\\ {=f(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}+\mathbf{prox}_{\eta,r}(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}-\eta\mathbf{s}_{t}^{(i)})-\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)})+r(\mathbf{prox}_{\eta,r}(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}-\eta\mathbf{s}_{t}^{(i)})))}\\ {\leq f(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)})+\nabla f(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)})^{\top}\left(\mathbf{prox}_{\eta,r}(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}-\eta\mathbf{s}_{t}^{(i)})-\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}\right)+\frac{L}{2}\left\|\mathbf{prox}_{\eta,r}(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}-\eta\mathbf{s}_{t}^{(i)})-\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}\right\|^{2}}\\ {\quad+r(z)+\frac{1}{\eta}(\mathbf{prox}_{\eta,r}(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}-\eta\mathbf{s}_{t}^{(i)})-\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}+\eta\mathbf{s}_{t}^{(i)})^{\top}(z-\mathbf{prox}_{\eta,r}(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}-\eta\mathbf{s}_{t}^{(i)}))}\\ {\leq h(z)-\nabla f(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)})^{\top}(z-\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)})-\frac{\mu}{2}\left\|z-\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}\right\|^{2}+\nabla f(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)})^{\top}\left(\mathbf{prox}_{\eta,r}(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}-\eta\mathbf{s}_{t}^{(i)})-\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}\right)}\\ {\quad+\frac{L}{2}\left\|\mathbf{prox}_{\eta,r}(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}-\eta\mathbf{s}_{t}^{(i)})-\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}\right\|^{2}+\frac{1}{\eta}(\mathbf{prox}_{\eta,r}(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}-\eta\mathbf{s}_{t}^{(i)})-\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}+\eta\mathbf{s}_{t}^{(i)})^{\top}(z-\mathbf{prox}_{\eta,r}(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}-\eta\mathbf{s}_{t}^{(i)}))}\\ {=h(z)-\left\langle\nabla f(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}),z-\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}\right\rangle-\frac{\mu}{2}\left\|z-\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}\right\|^{2}-\eta\left\langle\nabla f(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}),G_{t}^{(i)}\right\rangle+\frac{\eta^{2}L}{2}\left\|G_{t}^{(i)}\right\|^{2}}\\ {\quad+\left\langle\mathbf{s}_{t}^{(i)}-G_{t}^{(i)},z-\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}+\eta G_{t}^{(i)}\right\rangle}\\ {=h(z)-\left\langle\nabla f(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)})-\mathbf{s}_{t}^{(i)}+G_{t}^{(i)},z-\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}\right\rangle-\frac{\mu}{2}\left\|z-\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}\right\|^{2}}\\ {\quad-\eta\left\langle\nabla f(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)})-\mathbf{s}_{t}^{(i)},G_{t}^{(i)}\right\rangle-\eta\left(1-\frac{\eta L}{2}\right)\left\|G_{t}^{i}\right\|^{2}}\end{array}\tag{57}
$$

for any given $z \in \mathbb{R}^{d}$. Multiplying $1 - \alpha$ on both sides of Eq. (57) and setting $z = \bar{x}_{t}$ , we get

$$
\begin{array}{r l}&{\quad(1-\alpha)h(\mathbf{prox}_{\eta,r}(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}-\eta\mathbf{s}_{t}^{(i)}))}\\ &{\leq(1-\alpha)h(\bar{x}_{t})-(1-\alpha)\left\langle\nabla f(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)})-\mathbf{s}_{t}^{(i)}+G_{t}^{(i)},\bar{x}_{t}-\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}\right\rangle-\frac{\mu(1-\alpha)}{2}\left\|\bar{x}_{t}-\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}\right\|^{2}}\\ &{\quad-(1-\alpha)\eta\left\langle\nabla f(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)})-\mathbf{s}_{t}^{(i)},G_{t}^{(i)}\right\rangle-(1-\alpha)\eta\left(1-\frac{\eta L}{2}\right)\left\|G_{t}^{i}\right\|^{2}.}\end{array}
$$

Similarly, multiplying α on both sides of Eq. (57) and setting $z = x^{*}$ , we obtain that

$$
\begin{array}{r l}&{\quad\alpha h(\mathbf{prox}_{\eta,r}(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}-\eta\mathbf{s}_{t}^{(i)}))}\\ &{\leq\alpha h(x^{*})-\alpha\left\langle\nabla f(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)})-\mathbf{s}_{t}^{(i)}+G_{t}^{(i)},x^{*}-\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}\right\rangle-\displaystyle\frac{\mu\alpha}{2}\left\|x^{*}-\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}\right\|^{2}}\\ &{\quad-\alpha\eta\left\langle\nabla f(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)})-\mathbf{s}_{t}^{(i)},G_{t}^{(i)}\right\rangle-\alpha\eta\left(1-\displaystyle\frac{\eta L}{2}\right)\left\|G_{t}^{i}\right\|^{2}.}\end{array}
$$

Adding above two inequalities, we have

$$
\begin{array}{r l}&{\quad h(\mathbf{prox}_{\eta,r}(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}-\eta\mathbf{s}_{t}^{(i)}))-h(x^{*})}\\ &{\leq(1-\alpha)\left(h(\bar{x}_{t})-h(x^{*})\right)-\left\langle\nabla f(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)})-\mathbf{s}_{t}^{(i)}+G_{t}^{(i)},(1-\alpha)\bar{x}_{t}+\alpha x^{*}-\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}\right\rangle}\\ &{\quad-\eta\left\langle\nabla f(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)})-\mathbf{s}_{t}^{(i)},G_{t}^{(i)}\right\rangle-\eta\left(1-\displaystyle\frac{\eta L}{2}\right)\left\|G_{t}^{i}\right\|^{2}-\displaystyle\frac{\mu\alpha}{2}\left\|x^{*}-\mathbf{y}_{t}^{i}\right\|^{2}.}\end{array}\tag{58}
$$

Note that by Jensen's inequality, we can get that

$$
\left\|x^{*}-{\bar{y}}_{t}\right\|=\left\|x^{*}-{\frac{1}{m}}\sum_{i=1}^{m}\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}\right\|\leq{\sqrt{{\frac{1}{m}}\sum_{i=1}^{m}\left\|x^{*}-\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}\right\|^{2}}}.\tag{59}
$$

Now, we begin to prove that ${\sqrt{\rho}}<\lambda_{1}(\mathbf{A})$ . We can conclude this result once it holds $p ({\sqrt{\rho}}) < 0$ This is because $p(\zeta)$ will have a root between $\sqrt{\rho}$ and $1 / 2$ and $\lambda_{1}(\mathbf{A})$ must be no less than this root. We have

$$
\begin{array}{r l}&{\quad p(\sqrt{\rho})}\\ &{=\sqrt{\rho}p_{0}(\sqrt{\rho})-32\rho^{2}(M/L)^{2}+20\rho^{2}M/L}\\ &{=\rho\left(\sqrt{\rho}-\rho(4+5M/L)-4\sqrt{\rho}\left(8\rho(M/L)^{2}+5M/L+1-5\rho M/L\right)-32\rho(M/L)^{2}+20\rho M/L\right)}\\ &{=\rho\left(-(20M/L+3)\sqrt{\rho}-\rho(4+5M/L)-4\rho^{3/2}\left(8(M/L)^{2}-5M/L\right)-\rho\left(32(M/L)^{2}-15M/L\right)\right)}\\ &{<\rho\left(-(20M/L+3)\sqrt{\rho}-\rho(4+5M/L)\right)}\\ &{<0,}\end{array}
$$

where the first inequality is because of $M / L \geq 1$

Since v is the eigenvector associated with $\lambda_{1}(\mathbf{A})$ , we can obtain that $\mathbf{A}\mathbf{v}=\lambda_{1}(\mathbf{A})\mathbf{v}$ and have the following equations

$$
2{\bf v}(2)+2{\bf v}(3)=\lambda_{1}({\bf A}){\bf v}(1),\tag{53}
$$

$$
2\rho\mathbf{v}(1)+4\rho\mathbf{v}(2)+4\rho\mathbf{v}(3)=\lambda_{1}(\mathbf{A})\mathbf{v}(2),\tag{54}
$$

$$
\rho\frac{M}{L}\mathbf{v}(1)+8\rho\left(\frac{M}{L}\right)^{2}\mathbf{v}(2)+5\rho\frac{M}{L}\mathbf{v}(3)=\lambda_{1}(\mathbf{A})\mathbf{v}(3).\tag{55}
$$

By Eqs. (53) and (54), we can obtain that

$$
2\rho\mathbf{v}(1)=\lambda_{1}(\mathbf{A})\mathbf{v}(2)-2\rho\lambda_{1}(\mathbf{A})\mathbf{v}(1),
$$

which implies that

$$
\mathbf{v}(1)=\frac{\lambda_{1}(\mathbf{A})\mathbf{v}(2)}{2\rho(1+\lambda_{1}(\mathbf{A}))}.
$$

Replacing above equation to Eq. (55), we can obtain that

$$
\frac{M\lambda_{1}(\mathbf{A})\mathbf{v}(2)}{2L(1+\lambda_{1}(\mathbf{A}))}=\lambda_{1}(\mathbf{A})\mathbf{v}(3)-\left(8\rho\left(\frac{M}{L}\right)^{2}\mathbf{v}(2)+\frac{5\rho M}{L}\mathbf{v}(3)\right)<\lambda_{1}(\mathbf{A})\mathbf{v}(3),
$$

which implies that

$$
\mathbf{v}(2)\leq\frac{2L(1+\lambda_{1}(\mathbf A))\mathbf{v}(3)}{M}\leq\frac{3L\mathbf{v}(3)}{M}\leq 3\mathbf{v}(3),
$$

where the second inequality is because of $\rho \le 1 / 2$ Combining Eq. (53), we can obtain that

$$
\mathbf{v}(1)\leq\frac{2\left(3\mathbf{v}(3)+\mathbf{v}(3)\right)}{\lambda_{1}(\mathbf{A})}\leq\frac{8\mathbf{v}(3)}{\sqrt{\rho}},
$$

where the last inequality is because of $\lambda_{1}(\mathbf{A})\geq{\sqrt{\rho}}.$

context.name: Setup: decentralized composite problem (Section 1, eq. (1))
context.statement:
In this paper, we consider the decentralized optimization problem, where the objective function is composed of m local functions $f_{i}(x)$ that are located on m different agents. The agents form a connected and undirected network and each of them only accesses its local function and communicates

with its neighbors. All of the agents target to cooperatively solve the convex optimization problem

$$
\operatorname*{min}_{x\in\mathbb{R}^{d}}h(x)\triangleq f(x)+r(x)\quad\mathrm{with}\quad f(x)\triangleq\frac{1}{m}\sum_{i=1}^{m}f_{i}(x),\tag{1}
$$

where $f(x)$ is L-smooth and $\mu$-strongly convex, $r(x)$ is convex but may be non-differentiable.

context.name: Notation: aggregate variables, averages, prox and generalized gradients (Section 3, eqs. (2)-(6))
context.statement:
## 3. Preliminaries

We let $x_{i}\in \mathbb{R}^{d}$ be the local copy of the variable of x for agent i and we introduce the aggregate variable $\mathbf{x}\in \mathbb{R}^{m \times d}$ , aggregate objective function $F(\mathbf{x})$ and aggregate gradient $\nabla F(\mathbf{x})\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times d}$ as

$$
\mathbf{x}=\left[\begin{array}{l}{x_{1}^{\top}}\\ {\vdots}\\ {x_{m}^{\top}}\end{array}\right],\quad F(\mathbf{x})=\frac{1}{m}\sum_{i=1}^{m}f_{i}(x_{i})\quad\mathrm{and}\quad\nabla F(\mathbf{x})=\left[\begin{array}{l}{\nabla f_{1}(x_{1})^{\top}}\\ {\vdots}\\ {\nabla f_{m}(x_{m})^{\top}}\end{array}\right].\tag{2}
$$

We denote that

$$
\bar{\boldsymbol{x}}_{t}=\frac{1}{m}\sum_{i=0}^{m}\mathbf{x}_{t}^{(i)},\quad\bar{y}_{t}=\frac{1}{m}\sum_{i=0}^{m}\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}\quad\mathrm{and}\quad\bar{g}_{t}=\frac{1}{m}\sum_{i=0}^{m}\nabla f_{i}(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}),\tag{3}
$$

where $\mathbf{x}^{(i)}$ means the i-th row of matrix x. Moreover, we use $\lVert \cdot \rVert$ to denote the Frobenius norm of vector or matrix and use $\langle x,y\rangle$ to denote the inner product of vectors x and y.

Furthermore, we denote

$$
R(\mathbf{x})=\frac{1}{m}\sum_{i=1}^{m}r(x_{i}).
$$

Accordingly, we introduce the proximal operator and aggregated proximal operator with respect to $r(\cdot)$ and $R(\cdot)$ as

$$
\mathbf{prox}_{\eta,r}(x)=\operatorname*{argmin}_{z\in\mathbb{R}^{d}}\left(r(z)+\frac{1}{2\eta}\|z-x\|^{2}\right)\mathrm{~a n d~}\mathbf{prox}_{m\eta,R}(\mathbf{x})=\operatorname*{argmin}_{z\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times d}}\left(R(\mathbf{z})+\frac{1}{2 m\eta}\|\mathbf{z}-\mathbf{x}\|^{2}\right).\tag{4}
$$

Using above notations, we define the (aggregated) generalized gradients as

$$
G_{t}=\eta^{-1}\left(\mathbf{y}_{t}-\mathbf{prox}_{\eta m,R}(\mathbf{y}_{t}-\eta\mathbf{s}_{t})\right)\ \mathrm{~a n d~}\ G_{t}^{(i)}=\eta^{-1}\left(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}-\mathbf{prox}_{\eta,r}(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)}-\eta\mathbf{s}_{t}^{(i)})\right)\tag{5}
$$

We also denote

$$
\bar{G}_{t}=\frac{1}{m}\sum_{i=1}^{m}G_{t}^{(i)}.\tag{6}
$$

context.name: Definitions: L-smoothness, strong convexity, local smoothness, condition numbers (eqs. (7)-(9))
context.statement:
Then we introduce the following definitions that will be used in the whole paper:

We say $f(x)$ is L-smooth if for all $x,y\in\mathbb{R}^{d}$ , it holds that

$$
f(y)\leq f(x)+\langle\nabla f(x),y-x\rangle+{\frac{L}{2}}\left\|y-x\right\|^{2}.
$$

We say $f(x)$ is µ-strongly convex, if for all $x,y\in\mathbb{R}^{d}$ , it holds that

$$
f(y)\geq f(x)+\langle\nabla f(x),y-x\rangle+{\frac{\mu}{2}}\left\|y-x\right\|^{2}.
$$

We say $f_{i}(x)$ is locally Mi-smooth if for all $x,y\in\mathbb{R}^{d}$ , it holds that

$$
f_{i}(y)\leq f_{i}(x)+\langle\nabla f_{i}(x),y-x\rangle+{\frac{M_{i}}{2}}\left\|y-x\right\|^{2}.
$$

We say $f_{i}(x)$ is locally νi-strongly convex if for all $x,y\in\mathbb{R}^{d}$ ,it holds that

$$
f_{i}(y)\geq f_{i}(x)+\langle\nabla f_{i}(x),y-x\rangle+{\frac{\nu_{i}}{2}}\left\|y-x\right\|^{2}.
$$

Based on the smoothness and strong convexity, we can define global and local condition numbers of the objective function as

$$
\kappa_{g}=\frac{L}{\mu},\qquad\hat{\kappa}_{g}=\frac{M}{\mu}\qquad\mathrm{and}\qquad\kappa_{\ell}=\frac{M}{\nu},\tag{7}
$$

where

$$
M=\operatorname*{max}_{i\in\{1,...,m\}}M_{i}\mathrm{~a n d~}\nu=\operatorname*{min}_{i\in\{1,...,m\}}\nu_{i}.\tag{8}
$$

It is easy to verify that

$$
L\leq M\qquad\mathrm{and}\qquad\kappa_{g}\leq\hat{\kappa}_{g}\leq\kappa_{\ell}.\tag{9}
$$

context.name: Assumption: properties of the weight matrix W
context.statement:
For the topology of the network, we let W be the weight matrix associated with the network, indicating how agents are connected to each other. We assume that the weight matrix W has the following properties:

1. W is symmetric with $W_{i,j}\neq 0$ if and if only agents i and j are connected or $i = j ;$

$$
2 .\ \mathbf{0}\preceq W\preceq I,W\mathbf{1}=\mathbf{1},\mathrm{null}(I-W)=\mathrm{span}(\mathbf{1});
$$

where we use I to denote the $m \times m$ identity matrix and $\mathbf{1}=[1,\ldots,1]^{\top}\in\mathbb{R}^{m}$ denotes the vector with all ones. The weight matrix has an important property that $\begin{array}{r}{W^{\infty}= \frac{1}{m}\mathbf{1}\mathbf{1}^{\top}}\end{array}$ (Xiao and Boyd, 2004). Thus, one can achieve the effect of averaging local $x_{i}$ on different agents by using Wx for iterations. Instead of directly multiplying W, Liu and Morse (2011) proposed a more efficient way to achieve averaging described in Algorithm 2, which has the following important proposition.

context.name: Proposition 1 (FastMix averaging and contraction)
context.statement:
Proposition 1 Let $\mathbf{x}^{K}$ be the output of Algorithm 2 with $\eta_{w}=1/(1+\sqrt{1-\lambda_{2}^{2}(W)})$ and we denote $\begin{array}{r}{\bar{\boldsymbol{x}}= \frac{1}{m}\mathbf{1}^{\top}\mathbf{x}^{0}}\end{array}$ Then it holds that

$$
\bar{x}=\frac{1}{m}\mathbf{1}^{\mathsf{T}}\mathbf{x}^{K}\quad and\quad\|\mathbf{x}_{K}-\mathbf{1}\bar{x}\|\leq\sqrt{14}\left(1-\left(1-\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\right)\sqrt{1-\lambda_{2}(W)}\right)^{K}\|\mathbf{x}_{0}-\mathbf{1}\bar{x}\|,
$$

where $\lambda_{2}(W)$ is the second largest eigenvalue of W.

context.name: Algorithm 1 (Mudag)
context.statement:
Algorithm 1 Mudag   
1: Input: $x_{0},\eta,\alpha$ , and K   
2: Initialization: $\mathbf{x}_{0}= \mathbf{1}x_{0}, \mathbf{y}_{0}= \mathbf{x}_{0}$   
3: $\mathbf{x}_{1}=\mathrm{FastMix}(\mathbf{y}_{0}-\eta\nabla F(\mathbf{y}_{0}))$   
4: $\begin{array}{r}{\mathbf{y}_{1}=\mathbf{x}_{1}+\frac{1-\alpha}{1+\alpha}(\mathbf{x}_{1}-\mathbf{x}_{0})}\end{array}$   
5: for $t=1,\dots,T$ do   
6: $\mathbf{x}_{t+1}={\mathrm{FastMix}}(\mathbf{y}_{t}+(\mathbf{x}_{t}-\mathbf{y}_{t-1})-\eta(\nabla F(\mathbf{y}_{t})-\nabla F(\mathbf{y}_{t-1})),\ K)$   
7: $\begin{array}{r}{\mathbf{y}_{t+1}=\mathbf{x}_{t+1}+\frac{1-\alpha}{1+\alpha}\left(\mathbf{x}_{t+1}-\mathbf{x}_{t}\right)}\end{array}$   
8: end for   
9: Output: $\mathbf{x}_{T}$

context.name: Algorithm 2 (FastMix)
context.statement:
Algorithm 2 FastMix   
1: Input: $\mathbf{x}^{0},K,W$ and $\eta_{w}$   
2: $\mathbf{x}^{- 1}= \mathbf{x}^{0}$   
3: for $k=0,\ldots,K$ do   
4: $\mathbf{x}^{k+1}=(1+\eta_{w})W\mathbf{x}^{k}-\eta_{w}\mathbf{x}^{k-1}$   
5: end for   
6: Output: $\mathbf{x}^{K}$

context.name: ProxMudag updates (eqs. (10)-(12)) and Algorithm 3
context.statement:
Our algorithms are based on the multi-consensus, gradient-tracking and Nesterov's acceleration technique. We first introduce ProxMudag (Algorithm 3) for solving the problem with $r(x)\neq 0$ It has the following algorithmic procedure:

$$
\begin{array}{r}{{\bf x}_{t+1}={\bf prox}_{\eta m,R}({\bf y}_{t}-\eta{\bf s}_{t}),}\end{array}\tag{10}
$$

$$
\mathbf{y}_{t+1}=\mathrm{FastMix}\left(\mathbf{x}_{t+1}+\frac{1-\alpha}{1+\alpha}(\mathbf{x}_{t+1}-\mathbf{x}_{t}),K\right),\tag{11}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{r}{\mathbf{s}_{t+1}=\mathrm{FastMix}(\mathbf{s}_{t}+\nabla F(\mathbf{y}_{t+1})-\nabla F(\mathbf{y}_{t}),\ K),}\end{array}\tag{12}
$$

where η is the step size and K is the step number in multi-consensus. We can observe that Eqs. (10) and (11) belong to the algorithmic framework of accelerated proximal gradient descent since $\mathbf{s}_{t}$ can approximate the average gradient. In Eq. (12), we introduce $\mathbf{s}_{t}$ to track the gradient by using history information and the gradient difference. Thus, $\mathbf{s}_{t}$ can well approximate the average gradient ${\bf 1}\bar{g}_{t}$ (defined in Eq. (3)). Furthermore, the variable $\mathbf{y}_{t}$ can also approximate $\mathbf{1}\bar{y}_{t}$ well by the "FastMix" operator. Since both $\bar{y}_{t}$ and $\bar{g}_{t}$ well approximate the averages, then we can obtain that $\bar{g}_{t}\approx\nabla f(\bar{y}_{t})$ Thus, the convergence properties of our algorithm are similar to the centralized accelerated proximal gradient descent, which is the main idea behind our approach to the decentralized optimization. In other words, we combine multi-consensus with gradient-tracking to approximate the centralized accelerated proximal gradient descent. As we will show, this seemingly simple idea leads to establishing a near optimal algorithm for the decentralized optimization. Note that Algorithm 3 only takes two multi-consensus steps at each iteration. In contrast, the algorithm in conference version (Ye et al., 2020, Algorithm 1) of this paper requires three multi-consensus steps at each round.

Algorithm 3 ProxMudag   
1: Input: $x_{0},\eta,\alpha,K$   
2: Initialization: $\mathbf{x}_{0}=\mathbf{1}x_{0},\mathbf{y}_{0}=\mathbf{x}_{0},\mathbf{s}_{0}=\nabla F(\mathbf{x}_{0})$   
3: for $t=0,\ldots,T$ do   
4: $\mathbf{x}_{t+1}=\mathbf{prox}_{\eta m,R}(\mathbf{y}_{t}-\eta\mathbf{s}_{t})$   
5: $\begin{array}{r}{\mathbf{y}_{t+1}=\mathrm{FastMix}\left(\mathbf{x}_{t+1}+\frac{1-\alpha}{1+\alpha}(\mathbf{x}_{t+1}-\mathbf{x}_{t}),K\right)}\end{array}$   
6: $\mathbf{s}_{t+1}=\mathrm{FastMix}(\mathbf{s}_{t}+\nabla F(\mathbf{y}_{t+1})-\nabla F(\mathbf{y}_{t}),\ K)$   
7: end for   
8: Output: $\mathbf{x}_{T}$

context.name: Mudag updates (eqs. (13)-(16))
context.statement:
In the case of $r(x)=0$ , we propose Mudag (Algorithm 1) that only needs one multi-consensus step for each iteration. The Mudag has the following algorithmic procedure:

$$
\begin{array}{r l}&{\mathbf{x}_{t+1}=\mathrm{FastMix}(\mathbf{y}_{t}+(\mathbf{x}_{t}-\mathbf{y}_{t-1})-\eta(\nabla F(\mathbf{y}_{t})-\nabla F(\mathbf{y}_{t-1})),\ K),}\\ &{\mathbf{y}_{t+1}=\mathbf{x}_{t+1}+\displaystyle\frac{1-\alpha}{1+\alpha}\left(\mathbf{x}_{t+1}-\mathbf{x}_{t}\right).}\end{array}\tag{13}
$$

To understand Mudag from perspective of gradient tracking, we can reformulate the above procedure in a form similar to Eqs. (10) to (12) as follows (The reformulation is proved in Lemma 23)

$$
\mathbf{x}_{t+1}=\mathrm{FastMix}\left(\mathbf{y}_{t}-\eta\mathbf{s}_{t},K\right),\tag{14}
$$

$$
{\bf y}_{t+1}={\bf x}_{t+1}+\frac{1-\alpha}{1+\alpha}({\bf x}_{t+1}-{\bf x}_{t}),\tag{15}
$$

$$
\mathbf{s}_{t+1}=\mathrm{FastMix}(\mathbf{s}_{t},K)+(\nabla F(\mathbf{y}_{t+1})-\nabla F(\mathbf{y}_{t}))-\eta^{-1}(\mathrm{FastMix}(\mathbf{y}_{t},K)-\mathbf{y}_{t}).\tag{16}
$$

context.name: Theorem 2 (parameter setting for Algorithm 1)
context.statement:
Theorem 2 Let $f(x)$ be L-smooth and µ-strongly convex. Assume each $f_{i}(x)$ is M-smooth. We set $\eta = 1 / L$ and $\alpha = \sqrt{\mu \eta}$ in Algorithm 1. Letting K in Algorithm 1 satisfy that

$$
K=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{\sqrt{2}-1}\sqrt{\frac{1}{1-\lambda_{2}(W)}}\log\left(\frac{\sqrt{14}}{\rho}\right)\qquad with\qquad\rho\leq\frac{1}{4^{3}\cdot 9\cdot 288}\cdot\left(\frac{L}{M}\right)^{4}\kappa_{g}^{-3},
$$

then the sequence $\left\{\bar{x}_{t}\right\}$ satisfies that

$$
f(\bar{x}_{T})-f(x^{*})\leq\left(1-\frac{\alpha}{2}\right)^{T}\left(f(\bar{x}_{0})-f(x^{*})+\frac{\mu\|\bar{x}_{0}-x^{*}\|^{2}}{2}+\frac{\mu}{288m}\sum_{i=1}^{m}\|\nabla f_{i}(\bar{x}_{0})-\nabla f(\bar{x}_{0})\|^{2}\right),
$$

where $x^{*}$ is the global minimum of $f(x)$ To achieve $\mathbf{x}_{T}$ such that $\|\mathbf{x}_{T}-\mathbf{1}x^{*}\|^{2}={\mathcal{O}}(m\epsilon/\mu)$ and $f({\bar{x}}_{T})-f(x^{*})\leq\epsilon,$ the computation and communication complexities of Algorithm 1 are at most

$$
T=\mathcal{O}\left(\sqrt{\kappa_{g}}\log\left(\frac{1}{\epsilon}\right)\right)\qquad and\qquad Q=\mathcal{O}\left(\sqrt{\frac{\kappa_{g}}{1-\lambda_{2}(W)}}\log\left(\frac{M\kappa_{g}}{L}\right)\log\left(\frac{1}{\epsilon}\right)\right)
$$

respectively.

context.name: Theorem 3 (parameter setting for Algorithm 3)
context.statement:
Theorem 3 Let $f(x)$ be L-smooth and µ-strongly convex. Assume each $f_{i}(x)$ is M-smooth. We set $\eta=1/(2L)$ and $\alpha = \sqrt{\mu \eta}$ in Algorithm 3. Letting K in Algorithm 3 satisfy that

$$
K=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{\sqrt{2}-1}\sqrt{\frac{1}{1-\lambda_{2}(W)}}\log{\left(\frac{\sqrt{14}}{\rho}\right)}\qquad with\qquad\rho\leq\frac{1}{5.5\cdot 10^{8}}\cdot\left(\frac{L}{M}\right)^{6}\kappa_{g}^{-3/2},
$$

then sequence $\{\bar{x}_{t}\}$ generated by Algorithm 3 satisfies that

$$
h(\bar{x}_{T})-h(x^{*})\leq\left(1-\frac{\alpha}{2}\right)^{T}\left(h(\bar{x}_{0})-h(x^{*})+\frac{\mu\|\bar{x}_{0}-x^{*}\|^{2}}{2}+\frac{52L}{m}\sum_{i}^{m}\|\nabla f_{i}(\bar{x}_{0})-\nabla f(\bar{x}_{0})\|^{2}\right),
$$

where $x^{*}$ is the global minimum of $h(x)$ . To achieve $\mathbf{x}_{T}$ such that $\|\mathbf{x}_{T}-\mathbf{1}x^{*}\|^{2}={\mathcal{O}}(m\epsilon/\mu)$ and $h(\bar{x}_{T})-h(x^{*})\leq\epsilon,$ , the computation and communication complexities of Algorithm 1 are at most

$$
T=\mathcal{O}\left(\sqrt{\kappa_{g}}\log\left(\frac{1}{\epsilon}\right)\right)\qquad and\qquad Q=\mathcal{O}\left(\sqrt{\frac{\kappa_{g}}{1-\lambda_{2}(W)}}\log\left(\frac{M\kappa_{g}}{L}\right)\log\left(\frac{1}{\epsilon}\right)\right)
$$

respectively.

context.name: Lyapunov function V_t and v_bar_t (eqs. (17)-(18))
context.statement:
We first introduce the Lyapunov function as follows

$$
V_{t}=h(\bar{x}_{t})-h(x^{*})+\frac{\mu}{2}\left\|\bar{v}_{t}-x^{*}\right\|^{2},\tag{17}
$$

where $\bar{v}_{t}$ is defined as

$$
\bar{v}_{t}=\bar{x}_{t-1}+\frac{1}{\alpha}\big(\bar{x}_{t}-\bar{x}_{t-1}\big)\quad\mathrm{with}\qquad\alpha=\sqrt{\mu\eta}.\tag{18}
$$

context.name: Lemma 8
Lemma 17 (row-wise prox)
context.statement:
Lemma 17 Letting $\mathbf{prox}_{\eta m,R}^{(i)}(\mathbf{x})$ denote the i-th row of the matrix $\mathbf{prox}_{\eta m,R}(\mathbf{x})$ (defined in Eqn. (4)), we have the following equation

$$
\begin{array}{r}{\mathbf{prox}_{\eta m,R}^{(i)}(\mathbf{x})=\mathbf{prox}_{\eta,r}(\mathbf{x}^{(i)}),}\end{array}
$$

which implies that $G_{t}^{(i)}$ equals to the i-th row of $G_{t}$ defined in Eq. (5).

context.name: Lemma 19
context.statement:
Lemma 19 Letting $\mathbf{s}_{t}^{(i)}$ be the i-th row of $\mathbf{s}_{t}$ and $G_{t}^{(i)},\bar{G}_{t}$ (defined in Eqs. (5), (6)) generated by Algorithm 3, we have

$$
\sum_{i=1}^{m}\left\|\mathbf{s}_{t}^{(i)}-\nabla f(\mathbf{y}_{t}^{(i)})\right\|^{2}\leq 2\left\|\mathbf{s}_{t}-\mathbf{1}\bar{s}_{t}\right\|^{2}+8M^{2}\left\|\mathbf{y}_{t}-\mathbf{1}\bar{y}_{t}\right\|^{2}\tag{44}
$$

and

$$
\eta^{2}\sum_{i=1}^{m}\left\|G_{t}^{(i)}-\bar{G}_{t}\right\|^{2}\leq 18\left\|\mathbf{y}_{t}-\mathbf{1}\bar{y}_{t}\right\|^{2}+16\eta^{2}\left\|\mathbf{s}_{t}-\mathbf{1}\bar{s}_{t}\right\|^{2}.\tag{45}
$$

context.name: Lemma 14
context.statement:
Lemma 14 For $\textstyle{\bar{x}}_{t},{\bar{y}}_{t}$ and $\bar{v}_{t}$ defined in Eqs. (3) and (18), then we can obtain that

$$
\bar{y}_{t}-\bar{x}_{t}=\alpha(\bar{v}_{t}-\bar{y}_{t}),\tag{36}
$$

$$
\bar{y}_{t + 1}= \frac{\bar{x}_{t + 1}+ \alpha \bar{v}_{t + 1}}{1 + \alpha},\tag{37}
$$

and

$$
\bar{v}_{t+1}=\left\{\begin{array}{l l}{(1-\alpha)\bar{v}_{t}+\alpha\bar{y}_{t}-\displaystyle\frac{\eta}{\alpha}\bar{G}_{t}\quad}&{r(x),isconvex,}\\ {(1-\alpha)\bar{v}_{t}+\alpha\bar{y}_{t}-\displaystyle\frac{\eta}{\alpha}\bar{g}_{t},\quad}&{r(x)=0.}\end{array}\right.\tag{38}
$$

context.name: Lemma 13
context.statement:
Lemma 13 We have

$$
\|\nabla F(\mathbf{y})-\nabla F(\mathbf{x})\|\leq M\|\mathbf{y}-\mathbf{x}\|\tag{33}
$$

and

$$
\left\|{\bar{g}}_{t}- \nabla f ({\bar{y}}_{t}) \right\| \leq{\frac{M}{\sqrt{m}}}\left\| \mathbf{y}_{t}- \mathbf{1}{\bar{y}}_{t}\right\| .\tag{34}
$$

Furthermore, we have the $\left(L+2/\eta\right)$ -smooth property for the generalized gradient $\tilde{\nabla}h(\cdot)$ (defined in Eq. (42)), i.e.,

$$
\left\|\tilde{\nabla}h(x)-\tilde{\nabla}h(y)\right\|\leq\left(\frac{2}{\eta}+L\right)\|x-y\|.\tag{35}
$$

context.name: Lemma 15
context.statement:
Lemma 15 Let $f(x)$ be µ-strongly convex. For $\bar{y}_{t},$ and $V_{t}$ defined in Eqs. (3) and (17) and $x^{*}$ being the optimum, we have the following inequality,

$$
\|{\bar{y}}_{t}- x^{*}\| \leq \sqrt{\frac{2 V_{t}}{\mu}}.\tag{39}
$$

context.name: Lemma 16 (generalized gradient, eq. (42))
context.statement:
Lemma 16 (Nesterov (2018)) Letting $\tilde{\nabla}h(x)$ the generalized gradient of $h(x)$ (refer to Eq. (1)) be defined as

$$
\tilde{\nabla}h(x)\triangleq\frac{x-\mathbf{prox}_{\eta,r}(x-\eta\nabla f(x))}{\eta},w i t h\eta b e i n g t h e s t e p s i z e,\tag{42}
$$

then it holds that $\tilde{\nabla}h(x^{*})=0$ if $x^{*}$ minimizes $h(x)$

context.name: Lemma 23 (reformulation of Algorithm 1)
context.statement:
Lemma 23 The update procedure of Algorithm 1 can be represented as

$$
\mathbf{x}_{t+1}=\mathrm{FastMix}\left(\mathbf{y}_{t}-\eta\mathbf{s}_{t},K\right),\tag{64}
$$

$$
{\bf y}_{t+1}={\bf x}_{t+1}+\frac{1-\alpha}{1+\alpha}({\bf x}_{t+1}-{\bf x}_{t}),\tag{65}
$$

$$
\mathbf{s}_{t+1}=\mathrm{FastMix}(\mathbf{s}_{t},K)+(\nabla F(\mathbf{y}_{t+1})-\nabla F(\mathbf{y}_{t}))-\eta^{-1}(\mathrm{FastMix}(\mathbf{y}_{t},K)-\mathbf{y}_{t}),\tag{66}
$$

with ${\bf s}_{0}= \nabla F ({\bf y}_{0})$

context.name: Lemma 24
context.statement:
Lemma 24 Let $\bar{x}_{t}, \bar{y}_{t}, \bar{g}_{t}$ (defined in Eq. (3)) be generated by Algorithm 1. Then they satisfy the following equalities:

$$
\begin{array}{l l}{\bar{x}_{t+1}=\bar{y}_{t}-\eta\bar{g}_{t},}\\ {\bar{y}_{t+1}=\bar{x}_{t+1}+\displaystyle\frac{1-\alpha}{1+\alpha}(\bar{x}_{t+1}-\bar{x}_{t}),}\\ {\bar{s}_{t+1}=\bar{s}_{t}+\bar{g}_{t+1}-\bar{g}_{t}=\bar{g}_{t+1}.}\end{array}\tag{68}
$$

context.name: Lemma 9 and the matrix A (eqs. (22)-(23))
context.statement:
Lemma 9 Let $\mathbf{z}_{t}\ =\ \left[\left\|\mathbf{x}_{t}-\mathbf{1}\bar{x}_{t}\right\|,\left\|\mathbf{y}_{t}-\mathbf{1}\bar{y}_{t}\right\|,\eta\left\|\mathbf{s}_{t}-\mathbf{1}\bar{s}_{t}\right\|\right]^{\top}$ with $\mathbf x_{t}, \ \mathbf y_{t}$ and st generated by Algorithm 3, then it holds that

$$
\mathbf{z}_{t+1}\leq\mathbf{A}\mathbf{z}_{t}+\frac{4\rho\sqrt{m}M}{L}\left[0,0,\sqrt{\frac{2V_{t}}{\mu}}\right]^{\top},\tag{22}
$$

where $\rho$ and $\mathbf{A}$ are defined as

$$
\rho=\left(1-\sqrt{1-\lambda_{2}(W)}\right)^{K}\quad and\quad\mathbf{A}=\left[\begin{array}{c c c}{0}&{2}&{2}\\ {2\rho}&{4\rho}&{4\rho}\\ {\rho M/L}&{8\rho M^{2}/L^{2}}&{5\rho M/L}\end{array}\right].\tag{23}
$$
