section AGDHelpers

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]

private lemma nsq (a b : ℝ) (p q : E) :
    ‖a • p + b • q‖^2 = a^2*‖p‖^2 + 2*a*b*(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) p q) + b^2*‖q‖^2 := by
  rw [norm_add_sq_real, norm_smul, norm_smul, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right]
  simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs]
  ring

private lemma nsq_sub (c : ℝ) (u g : E) :
    ‖u - c • g‖^2 = ‖u‖^2 - 2*c*(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) u g) + c^2*‖g‖^2 := by
  have h : u - c • g = (1:ℝ) • u + (-c) • g := by module
  rw [h, nsq]; ring

private lemma nsq_conv (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a + b = 1) (p q : E) :
    ‖a • p + b • q‖^2 ≤ a*‖p‖^2 + b*‖q‖^2 := by
  rw [nsq]
  have h := real_inner_le_norm p q
  have h2 : (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) p q) ≤ (‖p‖^2 + ‖q‖^2)/2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖p‖ - ‖q‖), h]
  have key : 2*a*b*(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) p q) ≤ a*b*(‖p‖^2+‖q‖^2) := by
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (mul_nonneg ha hb)]
  have hb' : b = 1 - a := by linarith
  subst hb'
  nlinarith [key]

private lemma strong_subgrad
    (L μ : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (hμ : 0 ≤ μ) (f : E → ℝ) (g : E → E)
    (hs : IsSmooth L f g) (hc : StrongConvexOn Set.univ μ f) (x y : E) :
    f x + (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (g x) (y - x)) + (μ/2) * ‖y - x‖^2 ≤ f y := by
  set N : ℝ := ‖y - x‖^2 with hN
  have hNnn : 0 ≤ N := by positivity
  set I : ℝ := (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (g x) (y - x)) with hI
  have key : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → f x + I + (μ/2) * N ≤ f y + (L/2) * t * N := by
    intro t ht
    have h1t : (0:ℝ) < 1 + t := by linarith
    set w : E := x + t • (x - y) with hw
    have hab : t/(1+t) + 1/(1+t) = 1 := by field_simp; ring
    have hcomb : (t/(1+t)) • y + (1/(1+t)) • w = x := by
      rw [hw]; match_scalars <;> field_simp <;> ring
    have hsc := hc.2 (Set.mem_univ y) (Set.mem_univ w) (by positivity) (by positivity) hab
    rw [hcomb] at hsc
    have hyw : ‖y - w‖ = (1+t) * ‖y - x‖ := by
      have h : y - w = (1+t) • (y - x) := by rw [hw]; module
      rw [h, norm_smul]
      simp [abs_of_pos h1t]
    rw [hyw] at hsc
    have hsm := hs x w
    have hwx : w - x = t • (x - y) := by rw [hw]; module
    rw [hwx, norm_smul, real_inner_smul_right] at hsm
    have hxy : ‖x - y‖ = ‖y - x‖ := norm_sub_rev x y
    rw [hxy] at hsm
    have hinn : (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (g x) (x - y)) = - I := by
      rw [hI, ← inner_neg_right]; congr 1; abel
    rw [hinn] at hsm
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht] at hsc hsm
    have hA : t / (1 + t) * (1 / (1 + t)) * (μ / 2 * ((1 + t) * ‖y - x‖) ^ 2)
        = t * (μ/2) * N := by rw [hN]; field_simp
    rw [hA] at hsc
    have hclean : (1+t) * f x ≤ t * f y + f w - (1+t) * (t * (μ/2) * N) := by
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsc h1t.le
      have h3 : (1+t) * (t / (1 + t) * f y + 1 / (1 + t) * f w - t * (μ / 2) * N)
          = t * f y + f w - (1+t) * (t * (μ/2) * N) := by field_simp
      linarith [h2, h3.le, h3.ge]
    have hsm2 : f w ≤ f x + t * (-I) + L / 2 * (t * ‖y - x‖) ^ 2 := hsm
    have hsq : L / 2 * (t * ‖y - x‖) ^ 2 = (L/2) * t^2 * N := by rw [hN]; ring
    rw [hsq] at hsm2
    have hmain : t * (f x + I + (μ/2) * N) ≤ t * (f y + (L/2) * t * N) := by
      nlinarith [hclean, hsm2, mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg t) hμ) hNnn]
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hmain ht
  by_cases h : N = 0
  · have h1 := key 1 one_pos
    rw [h] at h1 ⊢
    simpa using h1
  · have hpos : 0 < N := lt_of_le_of_ne hNnn (Ne.symm h)
    refine le_of_forall_pos_le_add ?_
    intro ε hε
    have ht : 0 < ε / ((L/2) * N) := by positivity
    have h1 := key _ ht
    have heq : (L/2) * (ε / ((L/2) * N)) * N = ε := by field_simp
    linarith [h1, heq.le, heq.ge]

private lemma grad_sq_le (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (f : E → ℝ) (G : E → E)
    (hs : IsSmooth L f G) (xs : E) (hxs : ∀ x, f xs ≤ f x) (y : E) :
    ‖G y‖^2 ≤ 2*L*(f y - f xs) := by
  have h := hs y (y - (1/L) • G y)
  have e1 : y - (1/L) • G y - y = -((1/L) • G y) := by module
  rw [e1, inner_neg_right, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq,
     norm_neg, norm_smul] at h
  simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs, div_pow, one_pow] at h
  have hy := hxs (y - (1/L) • G y)
  have hLne : (L:ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hL
  have hkey : f xs ≤ f y - (1/(2*L)) * ‖G y‖^2 := by
    refine le_trans hy (le_trans h (le_of_eq ?_))
    field_simp
    ring
  have h4 : (1/(2*L)) * ‖G y‖^2 ≤ f y - f xs := by linarith
  have h2 : 0 < 2*L := by linarith
  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, one_mul, div_le_iff₀ h2] at h4
  linarith [h4]

private lemma grad_zero_at_min (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (f : E → ℝ) (G : E → E)
    (hs : IsSmooth L f G) (xs : E) (hxs : ∀ x, f xs ≤ f x) : G xs = 0 := by
  have h := grad_sq_le L hL f G hs xs hxs xs
  rw [sub_self, mul_zero] at h
  have h2 : ‖G xs‖ = 0 := by
    have h3 : ‖G xs‖^2 = 0 := le_antisymm h (sq_nonneg _)
    exact pow_eq_zero_iff (two_ne_zero) |>.mp h3
  exact norm_eq_zero.mp h2

set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
private lemma agd_core
    (μ L α : ℝ) (hμ : 0 < μ) (hL : 0 < L) (hα : 0 < α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1)
    (hμL : μ = α^2 * L)
    (f : E → ℝ) (G : E → E) (hs : IsSmooth L f G) (hc : StrongConvexOn Set.univ μ f)
    (xs : E) (hxs : ∀ x, f xs ≤ f x)
    (xb z yb x1b z1 g : E)
    (hyb : yb = (1/(1+α)) • xb + (α/(1+α)) • z)
    (hx1b : x1b = yb - (1/L) • g)
    (hz1 : z1 = (1-α) • z + α • yb - (α/μ) • g)
    (Er : ℝ) (hEr : ‖g - G yb‖^2 ≤ Er) :
    (f x1b - f xs) + (μ/2)*‖z1 - xs‖^2
      ≤ (1 - (3/4)*α) * ((f xb - f xs) + (μ/2)*‖z - xs‖^2) + (1 + 8/α^3) * Er / L := by
  subst hμL
  have h1a : (0:ℝ) < 1 + α := by linarith
  have hLne : (L:ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hL
  have hαne : (α:ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hα
  have hsub := strong_subgrad L (α^2*L) hL (by positivity) f G hs hc
  have hGxs : G xs = 0 := grad_zero_at_min L hL f G hs xs hxs
  obtain ⟨Gy, hGyd⟩ : ∃ w : E, w = G yb := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨e, hed⟩ : ∃ w : E, w = g - Gy := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨u, hud⟩ : ∃ w : E, w = (1-α) • (z - xs) + α • (yb - xs) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hGyd] at hEr
  rw [← hed] at hEr
  -- vector identities
  have hz1u : z1 - xs = u - (α/(α^2*L)) • g := by rw [hz1, hud]; module
  have hnormz1 : ‖z1 - xs‖^2
      = ‖u‖^2 - 2*(α/(α^2*L))*(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) u g) + (α/(α^2*L))^2*‖g‖^2 := by
    rw [hz1u]; exact nsq_sub _ _ _
  have hybxs : yb - xs = (1/(1+α)) • (xb - xs) + (α/(1+α)) • (z - xs) := by
    rw [hyb]; match_scalars <;> (field_simp; try ring)
  have hzy : z - yb = (1/α) • (yb - xb) := by
    rw [hyb]; match_scalars <;> (field_simp; try ring)
  -- inner product decompositions
  have hgGe : g = Gy + e := by rw [hed]; abel
  have hIug : (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) u g) = (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) u Gy) + (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) u e) := by
    nth_rewrite 1 [hgGe]; rw [inner_add_right]
  have hzxs : z - xs = (1/α) • (yb - xb) + (yb - xs) := by rw [← hzy]; abel
  have hIzG : (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (z - xs) Gy)
      = (1/α) * (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (yb - xb) Gy) + (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (yb - xs) Gy) := by
    rw [hzxs, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left]
  have hIuG : (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) u Gy)
      = ((1-α)/α) * (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (yb - xb) Gy) + (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (yb - xs) Gy) := by
    rw [hud, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left, hIzG]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hconvu : ‖u‖^2 ≤ (1-α)*‖z - xs‖^2 + α*‖yb - xs‖^2 := by
    rw [hud]; exact nsq_conv (1-α) α (by linarith) hα.le (by ring) _ _
  -- subgradient inequalities
  have hsub1 : f yb - f xb ≤ (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (yb - xb) Gy) := by
    have h := hsub yb xb
    rw [← hGyd] at h
    have hcomm : (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) Gy (xb - yb)) = -(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (yb - xb) Gy) := by
      rw [real_inner_comm, ← inner_neg_left]; congr 1; abel
    rw [hcomm] at h
    have hnn : 0 ≤ α^2*L/2 * ‖xb - yb‖^2 := by positivity
    linarith
  have hsub2 : f yb - f xs + (α^2*L/2)*‖yb - xs‖^2 ≤ (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (yb - xs) Gy) := by
    have h := hsub yb xs
    rw [← hGyd] at h
    have hcomm : (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) Gy (xs - yb)) = -(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (yb - xs) Gy) := by
      rw [real_inner_comm, ← inner_neg_left]; congr 1; abel
    have hn : ‖xs - yb‖ = ‖yb - xs‖ := norm_sub_rev _ _
    rw [hcomm, hn] at h
    linarith
  -- smoothness step
  have hsm : f x1b ≤ f yb - (1/L)*(‖g‖^2/2) + (1/L)*(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) e g) := by
    have h := hs yb x1b
    rw [← hGyd] at h
    have e1 : x1b - yb = -((1/L) • g) := by rw [hx1b]; module
    rw [e1, inner_neg_right, real_inner_smul_right, norm_neg, norm_smul] at h
    have hGyg : (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) Gy g) = ‖g‖^2 - (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) e g) := by
      have hg2 : Gy = g - e := by rw [hed]; abel
      rw [hg2, inner_sub_left, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    rw [hGyg] at h
    have habs : ‖(1/L : ℝ)‖ = 1/L := by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos]; positivity
    rw [habs] at h
    have hq : L/2 * (1/L*‖g‖)^2 = (1/L)*(‖g‖^2/2) := by field_simp; try ring
    rw [hq] at h
    linarith
  -- master inequality
  have hstep : (α^2*L/2)*‖z1 - xs‖^2 = (α^2*L/2)*‖u‖^2
      - (1-α)*(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (yb - xb) Gy)
      - α*(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (yb - xs) Gy) - α*(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) u e)
      + (1/L)*(‖g‖^2/2) := by
    rw [hnormz1, hIug, hIuG]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hmaster : (f x1b - f xs) + (α^2*L/2)*‖z1 - xs‖^2
      ≤ (1-α)*((f xb - f xs) + (α^2*L/2)*‖z - xs‖^2)
        + (1/L)*(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) e g) - α*(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) u e) := by
    have m1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsub1 (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - α)
    have m2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsub2 hα.le
    have m3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hconvu (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ α^2*L/2)
    rw [hstep]
    nlinarith [hsm, m1, m2, m3]
  -- ===== phase 2 : absorbing the error terms =====
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ f xb - f xs := by linarith [hxs xb]
  have hAy0 : 0 ≤ f yb - f xs := by linarith [hxs yb]
  have hPnn : (0:ℝ) ≤ ‖z - xs‖^2 := sq_nonneg _
  have hfz : f z - f xs ≤ (L/2)*‖z - xs‖^2 := by
    have h := hs xs z
    rw [hGxs, inner_zero_left] at h
    linarith
  have hconvf : f yb ≤ (1/(1+α))*f xb + (α/(1+α))*f z := by
    have hab : 1/(1+α) + α/(1+α) = 1 := by field_simp
    have h := hc.2 (Set.mem_univ xb) (Set.mem_univ z) (by positivity) (by positivity) hab
    rw [← hyb] at h
    simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h
    have hnn : 0 ≤ (1/(1+α))*(α/(1+α))*(α^2*L/2*‖xb - z‖^2) := by positivity
    linarith
  have hmul : (1+α) * (f yb - f xs) ≤ (f xb - f xs) + α * (f z - f xs) := by
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hconvf h1a.le
    have h3 : (1+α) * ((1/(1+α))*f xb + (α/(1+α))*f z) = f xb + α * f z := by field_simp
    linarith [h2, h3.le, h3.ge]
  have hAyV : α*(f yb - f xs) ≤ (f xb - f xs) + (α^2*L/2)*‖z - xs‖^2 := by
    have h4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmul hα.le
    have h5 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfz (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ α^2)
    linarith [h4, h5, mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg α) hAy0,
      mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1-α) hA0]
  have hxbxs : (α^2*L/2)*‖xb - xs‖^2 ≤ f xb - f xs := by
    have h := hsub xs xb
    rw [hGxs, inner_zero_left] at h
    linarith
  have hQconv : ‖yb - xs‖^2 ≤ (1/(1+α))*‖xb - xs‖^2 + (α/(1+α))*‖z - xs‖^2 := by
    rw [hybxs]
    exact nsq_conv (1/(1+α)) (α/(1+α)) (by positivity) (by positivity) (by field_simp) _ _
  have hQV : (α^2*L/2)*‖yb - xs‖^2 ≤ (f xb - f xs) + (α^2*L/2)*‖z - xs‖^2 := by
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hQconv
      (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ (1+α)*(α^2*L/2))
    have heq : (1+α)*(α^2*L/2)*((1/(1+α))*‖xb - xs‖^2 + (α/(1+α))*‖z - xs‖^2)
        = (α^2*L/2)*‖xb - xs‖^2 + α*((α^2*L/2)*‖z - xs‖^2) := by field_simp; try ring
    have hn1 : 0 ≤ α*((α^2*L/2)*‖yb - xs‖^2) := by positivity
    have hn2 : 0 ≤ (1-α)*((α^2*L/2)*‖z - xs‖^2) := by
      apply mul_nonneg (by linarith); positivity
    linarith [hm, heq.le, heq.ge, hxbxs, hn1, hn2]
  have hUV : (α^2*L/2)*‖u‖^2 ≤ (f xb - f xs) + (α^2*L/2)*‖z - xs‖^2 := by
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hconvu (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ α^2*L/2)
    have h6 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hQV hα.le
    linarith [hm, h6, mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1-α) hA0]
  have hNG : ‖Gy‖^2 ≤ 2*L*(f yb - f xs) := by
    rw [hGyd]; exact grad_sq_le L hL f G hs xs hxs yb
  have hNGV : α*‖Gy‖^2 ≤ 2*L*((f xb - f xs) + (α^2*L/2)*‖z - xs‖^2) := by
    have h7 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hNG hα.le
    have h8 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hAyV (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2*L)
    linarith
  have hIeg : (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) e g) = (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) e Gy) + ‖e‖^2 := by
    nth_rewrite 1 [hgGe]
    rw [inner_add_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  have hCS1 : (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) e Gy) ≤ ‖e‖*‖Gy‖ := real_inner_le_norm _ _
  have hCS2 : -(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) u e) ≤ ‖u‖*‖e‖ :=
    le_trans (neg_le_abs _) (abs_real_inner_le_norm u e)
  have hne2 : (0:ℝ) ≤ ‖e‖^2 := sq_nonneg _
  set V : ℝ := (f xb - f xs) + (α^2*L/2)*‖z - xs‖^2 with hVdef
  have hVnn : 0 ≤ V := by rw [hVdef]; have : (0:ℝ) ≤ (α^2*L/2)*‖z - xs‖^2 := by positivity
                          linarith
  have hB1 : (1/L)*(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) e g) ≤ (α/8)*V + (1/L + 4/(α^2*L))*‖e‖^2 := by
    have hy1 : ‖e‖*‖Gy‖ ≤ (4/α^2)*‖e‖^2 + (α^2/16)*‖Gy‖^2 := by
      have heq : (4/α^2)*‖e‖^2 + (α^2/16)*‖Gy‖^2 - ‖e‖*‖Gy‖
          = (4/α^2)*(‖e‖ - (α^2/8)*‖Gy‖)^2 := by field_simp; try ring
      have hnn : (0:ℝ) ≤ (4/α^2)*(‖e‖ - (α^2/8)*‖Gy‖)^2 := by positivity
      linarith [heq.le, heq.ge, hnn]
    have h1 : (1/L)*(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) e Gy) ≤ (1/L)*(‖e‖*‖Gy‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hCS1 (by positivity)
    have h2 : (1/L)*(‖e‖*‖Gy‖) ≤ (1/L)*((4/α^2)*‖e‖^2 + (α^2/16)*‖Gy‖^2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy1 (by positivity)
    have h3 : (α/(16*L))*(α*‖Gy‖^2) ≤ (α/(16*L))*(2*L*V) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hNGV (by positivity)
    have h4 : (α/(16*L))*(2*L*V) = (α/8)*V := by field_simp; try ring
    have h5 : (1/L)*((4/α^2)*‖e‖^2 + (α^2/16)*‖Gy‖^2)
        = (4/(α^2*L))*‖e‖^2 + (α/(16*L))*(α*‖Gy‖^2) := by field_simp; try ring
    rw [hIeg]
    linarith [h1, h2, h3, h4.le, h4.ge, h5.le, h5.ge]
  have hB2 : -(α*(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) u e)) ≤ (α/8)*V + (4/(α*L))*‖e‖^2 := by
    have hy2 : ‖u‖*‖e‖ ≤ (4/(α^2*L))*‖e‖^2 + ((α^2*L)/16)*‖u‖^2 := by
      have heq : (4/(α^2*L))*‖e‖^2 + ((α^2*L)/16)*‖u‖^2 - ‖u‖*‖e‖
          = (4/(α^2*L))*(‖e‖ - ((α^2*L)/8)*‖u‖)^2 := by field_simp; try ring
      have hnn : (0:ℝ) ≤ (4/(α^2*L))*(‖e‖ - ((α^2*L)/8)*‖u‖)^2 := by positivity
      linarith [heq.le, heq.ge, hnn]
    have h7 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hCS2 hα.le
    have h8 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy2 hα.le
    have h9 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hUV (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ α/8)
    have h10 : α*((4/(α^2*L))*‖e‖^2 + ((α^2*L)/16)*‖u‖^2)
        = (4/(α*L))*‖e‖^2 + (α/8)*((α^2*L/2)*‖u‖^2) := by field_simp; try ring
    linarith [h7, h8, h9, h10.le, h10.ge]
  have hCle : (1/L + 4/(α^2*L) + 4/(α*L)) ≤ (1+8/α^3)/L := by
    have hd : (1+8/α^3)/L - (1/L + 4/(α^2*L) + 4/(α*L))
        = (8 - 4*α - 4*α^2)/(α^3*L) := by field_simp; try ring
    have hnn : (0:ℝ) ≤ (8 - 4*α - 4*α^2)/(α^3*L) := by
      apply div_nonneg (by nlinarith) (by positivity)
    linarith [hd.le, hd.ge, hnn]
  have hDnn : (0:ℝ) ≤ (1+8/α^3)/L := by positivity
  have hC : (1/L + 4/(α^2*L) + 4/(α*L))*‖e‖^2 ≤ (1 + 8/α^3)*Er/L := by
    have s1 : (1/L + 4/(α^2*L) + 4/(α*L))*‖e‖^2 ≤ ((1+8/α^3)/L)*‖e‖^2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCle hne2
    have s2 : ((1+8/α^3)/L)*‖e‖^2 ≤ ((1+8/α^3)/L)*Er :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hEr hDnn
    have s3 : ((1+8/α^3)/L)*Er = (1 + 8/α^3)*Er/L := by ring
    linarith [s1, s2, s3.le, s3.ge]
  linarith [hmaster, hB1, hB2, hC]


private lemma young2 (c x y : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) : x*y ≤ c*x^2 + (1/(4*c))*y^2 := by
  have hnn := mul_nonneg hc.le (sq_nonneg (x - y/(2*c)))
  have e : c*(x - y/(2*c))^2 = c*x^2 - x*y + (1/(4*c))*y^2 := by field_simp; ring
  linarith [hnn, e.le, e.ge]

set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
private lemma prox_agd_core
    (μ L η α : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (hηeq : η = 1/(2*L)) (hα : 0 < α)
    (hμeq : μ = α^2/η) (hα1 : α + α^2/4 ≤ 1)
    (h : E → ℝ) (xs : E)
    (hstr : ∀ x, (μ/2)*‖x - xs‖^2 ≤ h x - h xs)
    (xb v yb v1 qb Gb D : E)
    (hyb : yb = (1/(1+α)) • xb + (α/(1+α)) • v)
    (hv1 : v1 = (1-α) • v + α • yb - (α/μ) • Gb)
    (Errv : ℝ)
    (key : ∀ z : E, h qb ≤ h z - (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (D + Gb) (z - yb))
              - η*(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) D Gb)
              - η*(1 - η*L/2)*‖Gb‖^2 - (μ/2)*‖z - yb‖^2 + Errv) :
    (h qb - h xs) + (μ/2)*‖v1 - xs‖^2
      ≤ (1-α)*((h xb - h xs) + (μ/2)*‖v - xs‖^2)
        + (2*η + 1/(2*μ) + 2*(α+α^2/4)^2/(μ*α^2))*‖D‖^2 + Errv := by
  have hηpos : 0 < η := by rw [hηeq]; positivity
  have hηne : η ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hηpos
  have hαne : α ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hα
  have hμpos : 0 < μ := by rw [hμeq]; positivity
  have hμne : μ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hμpos
  have h1a : (0:ℝ) < 1 + α := by linarith
  have hηL : η*L = 1/2 := by rw [hηeq]; field_simp
  have hα2 : α^2 = μ*η := by rw [hμeq]; field_simp
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ : ∃ b:ℝ, b = α^2/4 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hβpos : 0 < β := by rw [hβ]; positivity
  have hβne : β ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hβpos
  have hA'pos : (0:ℝ) < α + β := by linarith
  have hA'1 : α + β ≤ 1 := by rw [hβ]; linarith
  have hβη : β = η*μ/4 := by rw [hβ, hα2]; ring
  -- expand key
  have key' : ∀ z : E, h qb ≤ h z - (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) D (z - yb))
      - (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) Gb (z - yb)) - η*(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) D Gb)
      - (3*η/4)*‖Gb‖^2 - (μ/2)*‖z - yb‖^2 + Errv := by
    intro z
    have hk := key z
    rw [inner_add_left] at hk
    have hc : η*(1 - η*L/2) = 3*η/4 := by
      have hh : η*L/2 = 1/4 := by rw [show η*L/2 = (η*L)/2 from by ring, hηL]; norm_num
      rw [hh]; ring
    rw [hc] at hk
    linarith
  -- Lemma-22 part
  have hL22 : (μ/2)*‖v1 - xs‖^2 ≤ (1-α)*((μ/2)*‖v - xs‖^2) + α*((μ/2)*‖xs - yb‖^2)
      + ((1-α)*(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) Gb (xb - yb)) + α*(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) Gb (xs - yb)))
      + (η/2)*‖Gb‖^2 := by
    obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ : ∃ w : E, w = (1-α) • (v - xs) + α • (yb - xs) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hv1u : v1 - xs = U - (α/μ) • Gb := by rw [hv1, hU]; module
    have hnorm : ‖v1 - xs‖^2 = ‖U‖^2 - 2*(α/μ)*(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) U Gb) + (α/μ)^2*‖Gb‖^2 := by
      rw [hv1u]; exact nsq_sub _ _ _
    have hconv : ‖U‖^2 ≤ (1-α)*‖v - xs‖^2 + α*‖yb - xs‖^2 := by
      rw [hU]; exact nsq_conv (1-α) α (by linarith) hα.le (by ring) _ _
    have hnegU : (-α) • U = (1-α) • (xb - yb) + α • (xs - yb) := by
      rw [hU, hyb]; match_scalars <;> (field_simp; try ring)
    have hUG : (-α)*(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) U Gb)
        = (1-α)*(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) Gb (xb - yb)) + α*(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) Gb (xs - yb)) := by
      have e1 : (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) ((-α) • U) Gb) = (-α)*(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) U Gb) :=
        real_inner_smul_left _ _ _
      rw [← e1, hnegU, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left,
        real_inner_comm (xb - yb) Gb, real_inner_comm (xs - yb) Gb]
    have hnr : ‖yb - xs‖ = ‖xs - yb‖ := norm_sub_rev _ _
    rw [hnr] at hconv
    have hcoef : (μ/2)*(α/μ)^2 = η/2 := by field_simp; linarith [hα2]
    have hexp : (μ/2)*‖v1 - xs‖^2
        = (μ/2)*‖U‖^2 + (-α)*(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) U Gb) + ((μ/2)*(α/μ)^2)*‖Gb‖^2 := by
      rw [hnorm]; field_simp; ring
    rw [hexp, hcoef, hUG]
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hconv (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ μ/2)
    linarith
  have m1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (key' xb) (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - (α+β))
  have m2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (key' xs) hA'pos.le
  have hGxs : (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) Gb (xb - yb)) - (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) Gb (xs - yb))
      = (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) Gb (xb - xs)) := by
    rw [← inner_sub_right]; congr 1; abel
  have hA := hstr xb
  have hAnn : 0 ≤ h xb - h xs := le_trans (by positivity) hA
  -- (a)
  have habs1 : β*(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) Gb (xb - yb)) - β*(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) Gb (xs - yb))
      ≤ (η/8)*‖Gb‖^2 + β*(h xb - h xs) := by
    have hsplit : β*(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) Gb (xb - yb)) - β*(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) Gb (xs - yb))
        = β*(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) Gb (xb - xs)) := by rw [← hGxs]; ring
    rw [hsplit]
    have hCS1 : (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) Gb (xb - xs)) ≤ ‖Gb‖*‖xb - xs‖ := real_inner_le_norm _ _
    have hy : ‖Gb‖*‖xb - xs‖ ≤ (η/(8*β))*‖Gb‖^2 + (2*β/η)*‖xb - xs‖^2 := by
      have hyy := young2 (η/(8*β)) ‖Gb‖ ‖xb - xs‖ (by positivity)
      have e : (1/(4*(η/(8*β)))) = 2*β/η := by field_simp; try ring
      rw [e] at hyy; exact hyy
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_trans hCS1 hy) hβpos.le
    have e2 : β*((η/(8*β))*‖Gb‖^2 + (2*β/η)*‖xb - xs‖^2)
        = (η/8)*‖Gb‖^2 + β*((μ/2)*‖xb - xs‖^2) := by
      rw [hβη]; field_simp; try ring
    have h5 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hA hβpos.le
    linarith [h1, e2.le, e2.ge, h5]
  -- (b)
  have habs2 : -(η*(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) D Gb)) ≤ (η/8)*‖Gb‖^2 + 2*η*‖D‖^2 := by
    have hCS : -(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) D Gb) ≤ ‖Gb‖*‖D‖ := by
      have hb := abs_real_inner_le_norm D Gb
      have h2 : -(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) D Gb) ≤ |inner (𝕜 := ℝ) D Gb| := neg_le_abs _
      calc -(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) D Gb) ≤ ‖D‖*‖Gb‖ := le_trans h2 hb
        _ = ‖Gb‖*‖D‖ := by ring
    have hy : ‖Gb‖*‖D‖ ≤ (1/8)*‖Gb‖^2 + 2*‖D‖^2 := by
      have hyy := young2 (1/8) ‖Gb‖ ‖D‖ (by norm_num)
      norm_num at hyy; linarith
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_trans hCS hy) hηpos.le
    linarith [h1]
  -- (c1)
  have habs3 : -((1-(α+β))*(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) D (xb - yb)))
      ≤ (1-(α+β))*((μ/2)*‖xb - yb‖^2) + (1/(2*μ))*‖D‖^2 := by
    have hCS : -(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) D (xb - yb)) ≤ ‖xb - yb‖*‖D‖ := by
      have hb := abs_real_inner_le_norm D (xb - yb)
      have h2 : -(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) D (xb - yb)) ≤ |inner (𝕜 := ℝ) D (xb - yb)| := neg_le_abs _
      calc -(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) D (xb - yb)) ≤ ‖D‖*‖xb - yb‖ := le_trans h2 hb
        _ = ‖xb - yb‖*‖D‖ := by ring
    have hy : ‖xb - yb‖*‖D‖ ≤ (μ/2)*‖xb - yb‖^2 + (1/(2*μ))*‖D‖^2 := by
      have hyy := young2 (μ/2) ‖xb - yb‖ ‖D‖ (by positivity)
      have e : (1/(4*(μ/2))) = 1/(2*μ) := by field_simp; try ring
      rw [e] at hyy; exact hyy
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_trans hCS hy) (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - (α+β))
    have h2 : (1-(α+β))*((1/(2*μ))*‖D‖^2) ≤ (1/(2*μ))*‖D‖^2 := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hA'pos.le (show (0:ℝ) ≤ (1/(2*μ))*‖D‖^2 by positivity)]
    nlinarith [h1, h2]
  -- (c2)
  have habs4 : -((α+β)*(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) D (xs - yb)))
      ≤ (μ*β/2)*‖xs - yb‖^2 + (2*(α+α^2/4)^2/(μ*α^2))*‖D‖^2 := by
    have hCS : -(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) D (xs - yb)) ≤ ‖xs - yb‖*‖D‖ := by
      have hb := abs_real_inner_le_norm D (xs - yb)
      have h2 : -(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) D (xs - yb)) ≤ |inner (𝕜 := ℝ) D (xs - yb)| := neg_le_abs _
      calc -(inner (𝕜 := ℝ) D (xs - yb)) ≤ ‖D‖*‖xs - yb‖ := le_trans h2 hb
        _ = ‖xs - yb‖*‖D‖ := by ring
    have hy : ‖xs - yb‖*‖D‖ ≤ (μ*β/(2*(α+β)))*‖xs - yb‖^2 + ((α+β)/(2*μ*β))*‖D‖^2 := by
      have hyy := young2 (μ*β/(2*(α+β))) ‖xs - yb‖ ‖D‖ (by positivity)
      have e : (1/(4*(μ*β/(2*(α+β))))) = (α+β)/(2*μ*β) := by field_simp; try ring
      rw [e] at hyy; exact hyy
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_trans hCS hy) hA'pos.le
    have e2 : (α+β)*((μ*β/(2*(α+β)))*‖xs - yb‖^2 + ((α+β)/(2*μ*β))*‖D‖^2)
        = (μ*β/2)*‖xs - yb‖^2 + (2*(α+α^2/4)^2/(μ*α^2))*‖D‖^2 := by
      rw [hβ]; field_simp; try ring
    linarith [h1, e2.le, e2.ge]
  linarith [m1, m2, hL22, habs1, habs2, habs3, habs4]

end AGDHelpers

private lemma strong_smooth_mu_le_fin_succ {n : ℕ} (μ L : ℝ)
    (hμ : 0 < μ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) → ℝ)
    (g : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
    (hs : IsSmooth L f g) (hc : StrongConvexOn Set.univ μ f) : μ ≤ L := by
  let e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) :=
    EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin (n + 1)) (1 : ℝ)
  have hlo := strong_subgrad L μ hL hμ.le f g hs hc (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) e
  have hup := hs (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) e
  have he : ‖e - (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
    simp [e, EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
  rw [he] at hlo hup
  nlinarith

private lemma alpha_quarter_small (μ L η α : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 < L) (hμL : μ ≤ L) (hηeq : η = 1/(2*L))
    (hαsq : α^2 = μ*η) (hα : 0 ≤ α) :
    α + α^2/4 ≤ 1 := by
  have hs : α^2 ≤ (1/2:ℝ) := by
    calc
      α^2 = μ/(2*L) := by rw [hαsq, hηeq]; ring
      _ ≤ L/(2*L) := (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right (by positivity)).2 hμL
      _ = 1/2 := by field_simp
  nlinarith

private lemma sum_centered {m d : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (x : Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    ∑ i, (x i - rowAvg x) = 0 := by
  have hmR : (m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt hm)
  simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
    Fintype.card_fin, rowAvg]
  rw [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℝ, smul_smul]
  match_scalars
  field_simp
  ring

private lemma rowAvg_sub {m d : ℕ}
    (x y : Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    rowAvg (fun i => x i - y i) = rowAvg x - rowAvg y := by
  simp [rowAvg, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, smul_sub]

private lemma rowAvg_add {m d : ℕ}
    (x y : Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    rowAvg (fun i => x i + y i) = rowAvg x + rowAvg y := by
  simp [rowAvg, Finset.sum_add_distrib, smul_add]

private lemma rowAvg_smul {m d : ℕ} (c : ℝ)
    (x : Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    rowAvg (fun i => c • x i) = c • rowAvg x := by
  simp [rowAvg, ← Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul, mul_comm]

private lemma avg_inner_left {m d : ℕ}
    (x : Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    (1/(m:ℝ)) * ∑ i, inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (x i) z = inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (rowAvg x) z := by
  rw [rowAvg, real_inner_smul_left, sum_inner]

private lemma avg_inner_right {m d : ℕ}
    (x : Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    (1/(m:ℝ)) * ∑ i, inner (𝕜 := ℝ) z (x i) = inner (𝕜 := ℝ) z (rowAvg x) := by
  rw [rowAvg, real_inner_smul_right, inner_sum]

private lemma rowAvg_centered {m d : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (x : Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    rowAvg (fun i => x i - rowAvg x) = 0 := by
  rw [rowAvg, sum_centered hm, smul_zero]

private lemma variance_identity {m d : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (x : Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    (1/(m:ℝ)) * ∑ i, ‖x i‖^2 =
      ‖rowAvg x‖^2 + (1/(m:ℝ)) * ∑ i, ‖x i - rowAvg x‖^2 := by
  have hmR : (m:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt hm)
  have hinner : (1/(m:ℝ)) * ∑ i, inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (x i) (rowAvg x)
      = ‖rowAvg x‖^2 := by
    rw [avg_inner_left, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  have hinner2 : (1/(m:ℝ)) * ∑ i, 2 * inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (x i) (rowAvg x)
      = 2 * ‖rowAvg x‖^2 := by
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
    nlinarith
  simp_rw [norm_sub_sq_real]
  simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const,
    Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  rw [nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hs : (1/(m:ℝ)) * ((m:ℝ) * ‖rowAvg x‖^2) = ‖rowAvg x‖^2 := by field_simp
  linear_combination hinner2 - hs

private theorem prox_first_order
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) {R : E → ℝ} (hR : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ R)
    {a xp : E} (hp : IsProxStep c R a xp) (z : E) :
    R xp ≤ R z + inner (𝕜 := ℝ) ((1 / c) • (xp - a)) (z - xp) := by
  apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
  intro eps heps
  let C : ℝ := (1 / (2 * c)) * ‖z - xp‖ ^ 2
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := by
    dsimp [C]
    positivity
  let t : ℝ := eps / (eps + C + 1)
  have hden : 0 < eps + C + 1 := by positivity
  have ht : 0 < t := by
    dsimp [t]
    positivity
  have ht1 : t < 1 := by
    dsimp [t]
    exact (div_lt_one hden).2 (by linarith [hC])
  let u : E := (1 - t) • xp + t • z
  have hconv : R u ≤ (1 - t) * R xp + t * R z := by
    dsimp [u]
    exact hR.2 (Set.mem_univ xp) (Set.mem_univ z)
      (by linarith) ht.le (by ring)
  have hobj := hp u
  have hobj' :
      R xp + (1 / (2 * c)) * ‖xp - a‖ ^ 2 ≤
        ((1 - t) * R xp + t * R z) +
          (1 / (2 * c)) * ‖u - a‖ ^ 2 :=
    hobj.trans (add_le_add hconv le_rfl)
  have hu : u - a = (xp - a) + t • (z - xp) := by
    dsimp [u]
    module
  rw [hu, norm_add_sq_real, real_inner_smul_right, norm_smul] at hobj'
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht] at hobj'
  have hmain :
      R xp ≤ R z + inner (𝕜 := ℝ) ((1 / c) • (xp - a)) (z - xp) + C * t := by
    rw [real_inner_smul_left]
    dsimp [C]
    have hcne : c ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hc
    field_simp [hcne] at hobj' ⊢
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg t]
  have hratio : C / (eps + C + 1) ≤ 1 := by
    exact (div_le_one hden).2 (by linarith)
  have hCt : C * t ≤ eps := by
    calc
      C * t = eps * (C / (eps + C + 1)) := by
        dsimp [t]
        ring
      _ ≤ eps * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hratio heps.le
      _ = eps := by ring
  linarith

private lemma convex_rowAvg {m d : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (R : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ) (hR : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ R)
    (x : Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    R (rowAvg x) ≤ (1/(m:ℝ)) * ∑ i, R (x i) := by
  have hmR : (m:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt hm)
  have hweights : ∑ i : Fin m, (1/(m:ℝ)) = 1 := by
    simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
  have h := hR.map_sum_le
    (t := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m))) (w := fun _ => (1/(m:ℝ))) (p := x)
    (fun _ _ => by positivity) hweights (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _)
  simpa only [rowAvg, ← Finset.smul_sum, smul_eq_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum] using h

private lemma rowAvg_const {m d : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    rowAvg (fun _ : Fin m => z) = z := by
  have hmR : (m:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt hm)
  simp only [rowAvg, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  rw [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℝ, smul_smul]
  match_scalars
  field_simp

private lemma avg_inner_covariance {m d : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (a b : Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    (1/(m:ℝ)) * ∑ i, inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (a i) (b i) =
      inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (rowAvg a) (rowAvg b) +
        (1/(m:ℝ)) * ∑ i, inner (𝕜 := ℝ)
          (a i - rowAvg a) (b i - rowAvg b) := by
  have hmR : (m:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt hm)
  have hpoint : ∀ i, inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (a i) (b i) =
      inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (rowAvg a) (rowAvg b) +
      inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (a i - rowAvg a) (b i - rowAvg b) +
      inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (a i - rowAvg a) (rowAvg b) +
      inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (rowAvg a) (b i - rowAvg b) := by
    intro i
    simp only [inner_sub_left, inner_sub_right]
    ring
  have hcross1 : ∑ i, inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (a i - rowAvg a) (rowAvg b) = 0 := by
    rw [← sum_inner, sum_centered hm, inner_zero_left]
  have hcross2 : ∑ i, inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (rowAvg a) (b i - rowAvg b) = 0 := by
    rw [← inner_sum, sum_centered hm, inner_zero_right]
  simp_rw [hpoint]
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rw [hcross1, hcross2]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, add_zero]
  rw [nsmul_eq_mul]
  field_simp

private lemma avg_sum_add_mul {m : ℕ} (η : ℝ) (a b : Fin m → ℝ) :
    (1/(m:ℝ)) * ∑ i, a i + η * ((1/(m:ℝ)) * ∑ i, b i) =
      (1/(m:ℝ)) * ∑ i, (a i + η * b i) := by
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  ring

private lemma avg_prox_inner_decomp {m d : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (η : ℝ)
    (y s G : Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    (1/(m:ℝ)) * ∑ i, inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (s i - G i) (z - (y i - η • G i)) =
      inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (rowAvg s - rowAvg G) (z - rowAvg y)
      + η * inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (rowAvg s) (rowAvg G) - η * ‖rowAvg G‖^2
      + (1/(m:ℝ)) * ∑ i,
          (- inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (s i - rowAvg s) (y i - rowAvg y)
           + inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (G i - rowAvg G) (y i - rowAvg y)
           + η * inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (s i - rowAvg s) (G i - rowAvg G)
           - η * ‖G i - rowAvg G‖^2) := by
  have hsplit :
      (1/(m:ℝ)) * ∑ i, inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (s i - G i) (z - (y i - η • G i)) =
        (1/(m:ℝ)) * ∑ i, inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (s i - G i) (z - y i)
        + η * ((1/(m:ℝ)) * ∑ i, inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (s i - G i) (G i)) := by
    have hp : ∀ i, z - (y i - η • G i) = (z - y i) + η • G i := by
      intro i
      module
    simp_rw [hp, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
    ring
  have hcov1 := avg_inner_covariance hm (fun i => s i - G i) (fun i => z - y i)
  have hcov2 := avg_inner_covariance hm (fun i => s i - G i) G
  have havgSG : rowAvg (fun i => s i - G i) = rowAvg s - rowAvg G :=
    rowAvg_sub s G
  have havgZY : rowAvg (fun i => z - y i) = z - rowAvg y := by
    rw [rowAvg_sub, rowAvg_const hm]
  have hcSG : ∀ i, (s i - G i) - rowAvg (fun j => s j - G j) =
      (s i - rowAvg s) - (G i - rowAvg G) := by
    intro i
    rw [havgSG]
    abel
  have hcZY : ∀ i, (z - y i) - rowAvg (fun j => z - y j) =
      -(y i - rowAvg y) := by
    intro i
    rw [havgZY]
    abel
  have hterm1 : ∀ i,
      inner (𝕜 := ℝ)
        ((s i - G i) - rowAvg (fun j => s j - G j))
        ((z - y i) - rowAvg (fun j => z - y j)) =
      - inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (s i - rowAvg s) (y i - rowAvg y)
        + inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (G i - rowAvg G) (y i - rowAvg y) := by
    intro i
    rw [hcSG, hcZY, inner_neg_right, inner_sub_left]
    ring
  have hterm2 : ∀ i,
      inner (𝕜 := ℝ)
        ((s i - G i) - rowAvg (fun j => s j - G j))
        (G i - rowAvg G) =
      inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (s i - rowAvg s) (G i - rowAvg G)
        - ‖G i - rowAvg G‖^2 := by
    intro i
    rw [hcSG, inner_sub_left, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  have hcombine :
      (1/(m:ℝ)) * ∑ i,
          (- inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (s i - rowAvg s) (y i - rowAvg y)
            + inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (G i - rowAvg G) (y i - rowAvg y))
        + η * ((1/(m:ℝ)) * ∑ i,
          (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (s i - rowAvg s) (G i - rowAvg G)
            - ‖G i - rowAvg G‖^2)) =
      (1/(m:ℝ)) * ∑ i,
          (- inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (s i - rowAvg s) (y i - rowAvg y)
           + inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (G i - rowAvg G) (y i - rowAvg y)
           + η * inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (s i - rowAvg s) (G i - rowAvg G)
           - η * ‖G i - rowAvg G‖^2) := by
    calc
      _ = (1/(m:ℝ)) * ∑ i,
          ((- inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (s i - rowAvg s) (y i - rowAvg y)
            + inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (G i - rowAvg G) (y i - rowAvg y))
           + η * (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (s i - rowAvg s) (G i - rowAvg G)
            - ‖G i - rowAvg G‖^2)) :=
        avg_sum_add_mul η _ _
      _ = _ := by
        apply congrArg
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        ring
  have hcentral :
      inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (rowAvg s - rowAvg G) (rowAvg G) =
        inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (rowAvg s) (rowAvg G) - ‖rowAvg G‖^2 := by
    rw [inner_sub_left, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  rw [hsplit, hcov1, hcov2]
  simp_rw [hterm1, hterm2]
  rw [havgSG, havgZY]
  rw [hcentral]
  linear_combination hcombine

#check avg_prox_inner_decomp

private lemma young_real (c x y : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    x*y ≤ c*x^2 + (1/(4*c))*y^2 := by
  have hnn := mul_nonneg hc.le (sq_nonneg (x - y/(2*c)))
  have he : c*(x - y/(2*c))^2 =
      c*x^2 - x*y + (1/(4*c))*y^2 := by
    field_simp
    ring
  linarith [hnn, he.le, he.ge]

private lemma prox_center_error_bound {d : ℕ} (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η)
    (s g y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    - inner (𝕜 := ℝ) s y + inner (𝕜 := ℝ) g y
        + η * inner (𝕜 := ℝ) s g - η * ‖g‖^2
      ≤ 2*η*‖s‖^2 + 2*η⁻¹*‖y‖^2 := by
  have hsy0 : - inner (𝕜 := ℝ) s y ≤ ‖s‖ * ‖y‖ :=
    le_trans (neg_le_abs _) (abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _)
  have hsy1 := young_real (η/2) ‖s‖ ‖y‖ (by positivity)
  have hsy : - inner (𝕜 := ℝ) s y ≤
      (η/2)*‖s‖^2 + (1/(2*η))*‖y‖^2 := by
    have hc : 1 / (4 * (η / 2)) = 1/(2*η) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [hc] at hsy1
    exact hsy0.trans hsy1
  have hgy0 : inner (𝕜 := ℝ) g y ≤ ‖g‖ * ‖y‖ :=
    real_inner_le_norm _ _
  have hgy1 := young_real (η/4) ‖g‖ ‖y‖ (by positivity)
  have hgy : inner (𝕜 := ℝ) g y ≤
      (η/4)*‖g‖^2 + (1/η)*‖y‖^2 := by
    have hc : 1 / (4 * (η / 4)) = 1/η := by field_simp
    rw [hc] at hgy1
    exact hgy0.trans hgy1
  have hsg0 : inner (𝕜 := ℝ) s g ≤ ‖s‖ * ‖g‖ :=
    real_inner_le_norm _ _
  have hsg1 := young_real (1/4) ‖g‖ ‖s‖ (by norm_num)
  have hsg : η * inner (𝕜 := ℝ) s g ≤
      (η/4)*‖g‖^2 + η*‖s‖^2 := by
    have h0 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsg0 hη.le
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsg1 hη.le
    norm_num at h1
    nlinarith
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ η*‖s‖^2 := by positivity
  have hy0 : 0 ≤ η⁻¹*‖y‖^2 := by positivity
  have hg0 : 0 ≤ η*‖g‖^2 := by positivity
  ring_nf at hsy hgy hsg ⊢
  nlinarith [hsy, hgy, hsg, hs0, hy0, hg0]

private theorem prox_average_key {m d : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (L μ η : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (hμ : 0 ≤ μ) (hη : 0 < η)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
    (gradf : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (R : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
    (hfsmooth : IsSmooth L f gradf)
    (hfstrong : ∀ x y, f x + inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (gradf x) (y - x)
        + (μ/2)*‖y-x‖^2 ≤ f y)
    (hRconv : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ R)
    (y x s G : Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (hG : ∀ i, x i = y i - η • G i)
    (hprox : ∀ i, IsProxStep η R (y i - η • s i) (x i))
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    f (rowAvg x) + R (rowAvg x) ≤
      f z + R z
        - inner (𝕜 := ℝ)
            ((gradf (rowAvg y) - rowAvg s) + rowAvg G) (z - rowAvg y)
        - η * inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (gradf (rowAvg y) - rowAvg s) (rowAvg G)
        - η * (1 - η*L/2) * ‖rowAvg G‖^2
        - (μ/2)*‖z-rowAvg y‖^2
        + (2*η/(m:ℝ))*∑ i, ‖s i-rowAvg s‖^2
        + (2*η⁻¹/(m:ℝ))*∑ i, ‖y i-rowAvg y‖^2 := by
  have hmR : (0:ℝ) < (m:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hηne : η ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hη
  have hGi : ∀ i, (1/η) • (x i - (y i - η • s i)) = s i - G i := by
    intro i
    calc
      (1/η) • (x i - (y i - η • s i)) =
          (1/η) • (η • (s i - G i)) := by
            rw [hG i]
            congr 1
            module
      _ = s i - G i := by
        rw [smul_smul]
        have he : (1/η)*η = 1 := by field_simp
        rw [he, one_smul]
  have hRi : ∀ i, R (x i) ≤
      R z + inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (s i - G i) (z - (y i - η • G i)) := by
    intro i
    have hp := prox_first_order hη hRconv (hprox i) z
    rw [hGi i] at hp
    calc
      R (x i) ≤ R z + inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (s i - G i) (z - x i) := hp
      _ = R z + inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (s i - G i) (z - (y i - η • G i)) := by
        rw [hG i]
  have hRavg := convex_rowAvg hm R hRconv x
  have hRsum := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) => hRi i)
  have hRsum' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hRsum (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1/(m:ℝ))
  have hRstep : R (rowAvg x) ≤
      R z + (1/(m:ℝ))*∑ i,
        inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (s i - G i) (z - (y i - η • G i)) := by
    calc
      R (rowAvg x) ≤ (1/(m:ℝ))*∑ i, R (x i) := hRavg
      _ ≤ (1/(m:ℝ))*∑ i,
          (R z + inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (s i-G i) (z-(y i-η • G i))) := hRsum'
      _ = R z + (1/(m:ℝ))*∑ i,
          inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (s i-G i) (z-(y i-η • G i)) := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
          Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
        field_simp
  rw [avg_prox_inner_decomp hm η y s G z] at hRstep
  have hxavg : rowAvg x = rowAvg y - η • rowAvg G := by
    rw [show x = fun i => y i - η • G i from funext hG, rowAvg_sub, rowAvg_smul]
  have hfstep0 := hfsmooth (rowAvg y) (rowAvg x)
  have hdiff : rowAvg x - rowAvg y = (-η) • rowAvg G := by
    rw [hxavg]
    module
  rw [hdiff, real_inner_smul_right, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg,
    abs_of_pos hη] at hfstep0
  have hfstep : f (rowAvg x) ≤
      f (rowAvg y) - η * inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (gradf (rowAvg y)) (rowAvg G)
        + (L/2)*(η^2*‖rowAvg G‖^2) := by
    nlinarith [hfstep0]
  have hfstr := hfstrong (rowAvg y) z
  have herri : ∀ i,
      (- inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (s i-rowAvg s) (y i-rowAvg y)
       + inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (G i-rowAvg G) (y i-rowAvg y)
       + η * inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (s i-rowAvg s) (G i-rowAvg G)
       - η * ‖G i-rowAvg G‖^2)
      ≤ 2*η*‖s i-rowAvg s‖^2 + 2*η⁻¹*‖y i-rowAvg y‖^2 :=
    fun i => prox_center_error_bound η hη _ _ _
  have herrsum0 := Finset.sum_le_sum
    (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) => herri i)
  have herrsum := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left herrsum0
    (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1/(m:ℝ))
  have herr :
      (1/(m:ℝ))*∑ i,
        (- inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (s i-rowAvg s) (y i-rowAvg y)
         + inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (G i-rowAvg G) (y i-rowAvg y)
         + η * inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (s i-rowAvg s) (G i-rowAvg G)
         - η * ‖G i-rowAvg G‖^2)
      ≤ (2*η/(m:ℝ))*∑ i, ‖s i-rowAvg s‖^2
        + (2*η⁻¹/(m:ℝ))*∑ i, ‖y i-rowAvg y‖^2 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (1/(m:ℝ))*∑ i,
          (2*η*‖s i-rowAvg s‖^2 + 2*η⁻¹*‖y i-rowAvg y‖^2) := herrsum
      _ = _ := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum]
        ring
  have hsum := add_le_add hfstep hRstep
  have hmain := add_le_add hsum herr
  simp only [inner_add_left, inner_sub_left] at hmain ⊢
  nlinarith [hfstr]


private theorem composite_growth
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (μ : ℝ) (hμ : 0 ≤ μ) (f R : E → ℝ)
    (hf : StrongConvexOn Set.univ μ f) (hR : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ R)
    (xs : E) (hmin : ∀ x, f xs + R xs ≤ f x + R x) (x : E) :
    (μ/2)*‖x-xs‖^2 ≤ (f x + R x) - (f xs + R xs) := by
  apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
  intro eps heps
  let A : ℝ := (μ/2)*‖x-xs‖^2
  have hA : 0 ≤ A := by dsimp [A]; positivity
  let t : ℝ := eps/(eps+A+1)
  have hden : 0 < eps+A+1 := by positivity
  have ht : 0 < t := by dsimp [t]; positivity
  have ht1 : t < 1 := by
    dsimp [t]
    exact (div_lt_one hden).2 (by linarith [hA])
  have hw0 : 0 ≤ 1-t := by linarith
  have hcombF := hf.2 (Set.mem_univ xs) (Set.mem_univ x)
    hw0 ht.le (by ring)
  have hcombR := hR.2 (Set.mem_univ xs) (Set.mem_univ x)
    hw0 ht.le (by ring)
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hcombF hcombR
  have hnorm : ‖xs-x‖ = ‖x-xs‖ := norm_sub_rev _ _
  rw [hnorm] at hcombF
  have hminimum := hmin ((1-t) • xs + t • x)
  have hmain : (1-t)*A ≤ (f x + R x) - (f xs + R xs) := by
    dsimp only [A]
    nlinarith [hcombF, hcombR, hminimum]
  have hratio : A/(eps+A+1) ≤ 1 := by
    exact (div_le_one hden).2 (by linarith)
  have htA : t*A ≤ eps := by
    calc
      t*A = eps*(A/(eps+A+1)) := by dsimp [t]; ring
      _ ≤ eps*1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hratio heps.le
      _ = eps := by ring
  dsimp only [A] at hmain htA
  nlinarith


private lemma prox_core_error_coeff (μ L η α : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 < L) (hη : 0 < η) (hα : 0 < α)
    (hηeq : η = 1/(2*L)) (hμeq : μ = α^2/η) (hα1 : α ≤ 1) :
    2*η + 1/(2*μ) + 2*(α+α^2/4)^2/(μ*α^2)
      ≤ (1+8/α^3)/L := by
  have hμ : 0 < μ := by rw [hμeq]; positivity
  have hα2 : α^2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  have hα3 : α^3 ≤ 1 := by
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hα2 hα.le
    nlinarith
  rw [hηeq, hμeq, hηeq]
  field_simp
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hα.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hα1),
    mul_nonneg hα.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hα2),
    mul_nonneg hα.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hα3)]



private theorem avg_lipschitz_error {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (g : Fin m → E → E) (y : Fin m → E) (yb : E)
    (hLip : ∀ i x z, ‖g i x - g i z‖ ≤ M * ‖x - z‖) :
    ‖(1 / (m : ℝ)) • ∑ i, g i (y i) - (1 / (m : ℝ)) • ∑ i, g i yb‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (M ^ 2 / (m : ℝ)) * ∑ i, ‖y i - yb‖ ^ 2 := by
  have hmR : 0 < (m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm
  let u : Fin m → E := fun i => g i (y i) - g i yb
  have hsumid : (∑ i, g i (y i)) - ∑ i, g i yb = ∑ i, u i := by
    dsimp only [u]
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  have hvec : (1 / (m : ℝ)) • ∑ i, g i (y i) -
      (1 / (m : ℝ)) • ∑ i, g i yb = (1 / (m : ℝ)) • ∑ i, u i := by
    rw [← smul_sub, hsumid]
  have hnormSum := norm_sum_le Finset.univ u
  have hterm : ∀ i, ‖u i‖ ≤ M * ‖y i - yb‖ := by
    intro i
    exact hLip i (y i) yb
  have hsumTerm : (∑ i, ‖u i‖) ≤ M * ∑ i, ‖y i - yb‖ := by
    calc
      (∑ i, ‖u i‖) ≤ ∑ i, M * ‖y i - yb‖ := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hterm i
      _ = M * ∑ i, ‖y i - yb‖ := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  have hsumNorm : ‖∑ i, u i‖ ≤ M * ∑ i, ‖y i - yb‖ := hnormSum.trans hsumTerm
  have hnorm : ‖(1 / (m : ℝ)) • ∑ i, u i‖ ≤
      (1 / (m : ℝ)) * M * ∑ i, ‖y i - yb‖ := by
    rw [norm_smul]
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (one_div_pos.mpr hmR)]
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsumNorm (one_div_nonneg.mpr hmR.le)
    simpa only [mul_assoc] using hh
  have hrhs0 : 0 ≤ (1 / (m : ℝ)) * M * ∑ i, ‖y i - yb‖ := by positivity
  have hnormsq : ‖(1 / (m : ℝ)) • ∑ i, u i‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ((1 / (m : ℝ)) * M * ∑ i, ‖y i - yb‖) ^ 2 :=
    (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) hrhs0).2 hnorm
  have hcs : (∑ i, ‖y i - yb‖) ^ 2 ≤
      (m : ℝ) * ∑ i, ‖y i - yb‖ ^ 2 := by
    simpa using (sq_sum_le_card_mul_sum_sq
      (s := Finset.univ) (f := fun i : Fin m => ‖y i - yb‖))
  rw [hvec]
  have hw := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcs
    (sq_nonneg ((1 / (m : ℝ)) * M))
  calc
    ‖(1 / (m : ℝ)) • ∑ i, u i‖ ^ 2 ≤
        ((1 / (m : ℝ)) * M * ∑ i, ‖y i - yb‖) ^ 2 := hnormsq
    _ ≤ ((1 / (m : ℝ)) * M) ^ 2 *
        ((m : ℝ) * ∑ i, ‖y i - yb‖ ^ 2) := by
      convert hw using 1 <;> ring
    _ = (M ^ 2 / (m : ℝ)) * ∑ i, ‖y i - yb‖ ^ 2 := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hmR]

private lemma sq_avg_le {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (a : Fin m → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) :
    ((1/(m:ℝ)) * ∑ i, a i)^2 ≤ (1/(m:ℝ)) * ∑ i, (a i)^2 := by
  have hmR : (0:ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have h := sq_sum_le_card_mul_sum_sq (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m))) (f := a)
  simp only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at h
  rw [mul_pow, div_pow, one_pow, div_mul_eq_mul_div, one_mul, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
  calc (∑ i, a i)^2 ≤ (m:ℝ) * ∑ i, (a i)^2 := h
    _ = 1/(m:ℝ) * (∑ i, (a i)^2) * (m:ℝ)^2 := by field_simp


theorem lemma11 {d m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (μ L M η α : ℝ)
    (hμ : 0 < μ) (hL : 0 < L) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hLM : L ≤ M) (hη : 0 < η) (hηeq : η = 1 / (2 * L))
    (hα : α = Real.sqrt (μ * η)) (hα1 : α ≤ 1)
    (R : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ) (hRconv : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ R)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
    (gradf : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (hfsmooth : IsSmooth L f gradf) (hfconv : StrongConvexOn Set.univ μ f)
    (Fi : Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)

    (hFismooth : ∀ i, IsSmooth M (Fi i) (gradFi i))

    (hFiLip : ∀ i x y, ‖gradFi i x - gradFi i y‖ ≤ M * ‖x - y‖)

    (K : ℕ)
    (W : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) (ηw : ℝ) (hW : ∀ j, ∑ i, W i j = 1)

    (hηw : ηw = 1 / (1 + Real.sqrt (1 - lam2 ^ 2)))
    (hyt : yt = FastMix W ηw (fun i => xt i + ((1 - α) / (1 + α)) • (xt i - xtprev i)) K)
    (hxt1 : ∀ i, IsProxStep η R (yt i - η • st i) (xt1 i))
    (hyt1 : yt1 = FastMix W ηw (fun i => xt1 i + ((1 - α) / (1 + α)) • (xt1 i - xt i)) K)
    (hst1 : st1 = FastMix W ηw (fun i => st i + gradFi i (yt1 i) - gradFi i (yt i)) K)
    (hgtrack : rowAvg st = (1 / (m : ℝ)) • ∑ i, gradFi i (yt i))
    (Vt Vt1 : ℝ)
    (hVt : Vt = (f (rowAvg xt) + R (rowAvg xt) - (f xstar + R xstar))

  cases d with

      have hzero (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 0)) : x = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      have hVt0 : Vt = 0 := by
        rw [hVt]
        simp [hzero]
      have hVt10 : Vt1 = 0 := by
        rw [hVt1]
        simp [hzero]
      have hs0 : (∑ i, ‖st i - rowAvg st‖ ^ 2) = 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro i hi
        rw [hzero (st i - rowAvg st)]
        simp
      have hy0 : (∑ i, ‖yt i - rowAvg yt‖ ^ 2) = 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro i hi
        rw [hzero (yt i - rowAvg yt)]
        simp

      simp
  | succ n =>
      have hmR : (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm
      have hαpos : 0 < α := by
        rw [hα]
        exact Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (mul_pos hμ hη)
      have hαsq : α ^ 2 = μ * η := by
        rw [hα, Real.sq_sqrt (mul_nonneg hμ.le hη.le)]

private lemma charpoly_fin_three (a11 a12 a13 a21 a22 a23 a31 a32 a33 p q s : ℝ)
    (hp : p = -(a11+a22+a33))
    (hq : q = a11*a22 - a12*a21 + a11*a33 - a13*a31 + a22*a33 - a23*a32)
    (hs : s = -(a11*a22*a33 - a11*a23*a32 - a12*a21*a33 + a12*a23*a31
              + a13*a21*a32 - a13*a22*a31)) :
    (!![a11,a12,a13; a21,a22,a23; a31,a32,a33] : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ).charpoly
      = X^3 + C p * X^2 + C q * X + C s := by
  subst hp; subst hq; subst hs
  simp [Matrix.charpoly, Matrix.det_fin_three, Matrix.charmatrix]
  ring

private lemma cubic_expand (p q r : ℝ) :
    (X - C p)*(X - C q)*(X - C r)
      = X^3 - C (p+q+r) * X^2 + C (p*q+p*r+q*r) * X - C (p*q*r) := by
  simp only [map_add, map_mul]
  ring

private lemma cubic_factor_of (a b c p q r : ℝ) (h1 : p+q+r = -a)
    (h2 : p*q+p*r+q*r = b) (h3 : p*q*r = -c) :
    (X^3 + C a*X^2 + C b*X + C c : ℝ[X]) = (X - C p)*(X - C q)*(X - C r) := by
  rw [cubic_expand, h1, h2, h3, map_neg, map_neg]
  ring

targets.statement: Theorem 6 Naive(ε,δ) is an (ε, δ)-PAC algorithm, and its arm sample complexity is $O\left((n/\varepsilon^{2})\log(n/\delta)\right)$.

targets.label: Theorem 8
targets.statement:
Theorem 8 Assume $\Delta_{i} > 0$ for every $i = 2, 3, \ldots, n$. Let the constant $c$ in Algorithm 3 be any value with $c > 4$, and let $0 < \delta < 1$. Then the Successive Elimination algorithm (Algorithm 3) is (0, δ)-PAC in the following sense: with probability no less than $1 - \delta$, there exists a time from which on the set of surviving arms consists exactly of the best arm, and the number of samples drawn before that time is at most (where the constant hidden in the O depends on c alone)

$$
O\left(\sum_{i=2}^{n}\frac{\ln(\frac{n}{\delta\Delta_{i}})}{\Delta_{i}^{2}}\right).
$$

targets.label: Theorem 10
targets.statement:
Theorem 10 Median Elimination(ε,δ) is an (ε, δ)-PAC algorithm, with sample complexity

$$
O\left(\frac{n}{\varepsilon^{2}}\log\left(\frac{1}{\delta}\right)\right).
$$

nl_proof:
### Proof of Theorem 6

Proof The bound on the sample complexity follows directly from how the algorithm is defined. It remains to show the (ε, δ)-PAC property. Fix an arm $a^{\prime}$ with $\mathbb{E}(R(a^{\prime}))<r^{*}-\varepsilon$. We bound the probability that $\hat{p}_{a^{\prime}}> \hat{p}_{a^{*}}$:

$$
\begin{array}{r c l}{P\left(\hat{p}_{a^{\prime}}>\hat{p}_{a^{*}}\right)}&{\leq}&{P\left(\hat{p}_{a^{\prime}}>\mathbb{E}[R(a^{\prime})]+\varepsilon/2 \text{ or }\hat{p}_{a^{*}}<r^{*}-\varepsilon/2\right)}\\ &{\leq}&{P\left(\hat{p}_{a^{\prime}}>\mathbb{E}[R(a^{\prime})]+\varepsilon/2\right)+P\left(\hat{p}_{a^{*}}<r^{*}-\varepsilon/2\right)}\\ &{\leq}&{2\exp(-2(\varepsilon/2)^{2}\ell),}\end{array}
$$

in which the final step is an application of Hoeffding's inequality. If we take $\ell=(2/\varepsilon^{2})\ln(2n/\delta)$, then $P\left(\hat{p}_{a^{\prime}}>\hat{p}_{a^{*}}\right)\leq\delta/n$. A sum over all candidate arms $a^{\prime}$ then shows that the probability of failure does not exceed $(n-1)(\delta/n)<\delta .$

### Proof of Theorem 8

Proof The core of the argument is that, for every time t and every action a, the empirical probability $\hat{p}_{a}^{t}$ lies within $\alpha_{t}$ of the true probability $p_{a}$. Indeed, for each time t and each action $a \in S_{t}$,

$$
\mathbf{P}[ | \hat{p}_{a}^{t}- p_{a}| \geq \alpha_{t}] \leq 2 e^{- 2 \alpha_{t}^{2}t}\leq \frac{2 \delta}{c n t^{2}}.
$$

Choosing the constant c larger than 4 and applying the union bound, we get that with probability at least $1 - \delta / n$, simultaneously for all times t and all actions $a \in S_{t}$, $| \hat{p}_{a}^{t}- p_{a}| \leq \alpha_{t}$. Consequently, with probability $1 - \delta$ the best arm is never removed. Moreover, because $\alpha_{t}$ tends to zero as t grows, every non-best arm is removed at some point. Hence the algorithm is (0, δ)-PAC.

We now turn to the arm sample complexity. For a non-best arm $a_{i}$ to be removed, we must arrive at a time $t_{i}$ satisfying

$$
\hat{\Delta}_{t_{i}}= \hat{p}_{a_{1}}^{t_{i}}- \hat{p}_{a_{i}}^{t_{i}}\geq 2 \alpha_{t_{i}}.
$$

Combining the definition of $\alpha_{t}$ with the assumption $| \hat{p}_{a}^{t}- p_{a}| \leq \alpha_{t}$ gives

$$
\Delta_{i}-2\alpha_{t}=\left(p_{1}-\alpha_{t}\right)-\left(p_{i}+\alpha_{t}\right)\geq\hat{p}_{1}-\hat{p}_{i}\geq 2\alpha_{t},
$$

and this is valid with probability no less than $1 - \frac{\delta}{n}$ when

$$
t_{i}=O\left(\frac{\ln\left(n/\delta\Delta_{i}\right)}{\Delta_{i}^{2}}\right).
$$

In conclusion, with probability at least $1 - \delta$ the total number of arm samples equals $2 t_{2}+ \sum_{i = 3}^{n}t_{i}$, and the proof is complete.

### Proof of Theorem 10

We begin by showing that during the $\ell$-th phase, the expected reward of the best arm in $S_{\ell}$ decreases by no more than $\varepsilon_{\ell}$.

Lemma 11 For the Median Elimination(ε, δ) algorithm, every phase $\ell$ satisfies

$$
\mathbf{P}[ \max_{j \in S_{\ell}}p_{j}\leq \max_{i \in S_{\ell + 1}}p_{i}+ \varepsilon_{\ell}] \geq 1 - \delta_{\ell}.
$$

Proof We may assume, without loss of generality, that we are in the first round and that $p_{1}$ denotes the reward of the best arm. To bound the probability of failure, consider the event $E_{1}= \{\hat{p}_{1}< p_{1}- \varepsilon_{1}/ 2 \}$, i.e., the event that the empirical estimate for the best arm is pessimistic. Because the sampling is sufficient, $\mathbf{P}[ E_{1}] \le \delta_{1}/ 3$.

Suppose $E_{1}$ fails to hold. We compute the probability that a given arm $j$ that is not $\varepsilon_{1}$-optimal appears empirically better than the best arm:

$$
\mathbf{P}\left[ \hat{p}_{j}\geq \hat{p}_{1}\mid \hat{p}_{1}\geq p_{1}- \varepsilon_{1}/ 2 \right] \leq \mathbf{P}\left[ \hat{p}_{j}\geq p_{j}+ \varepsilon_{1}/ 2 \mid \hat{p}_{1}\geq p_{1}- \varepsilon_{1}/ 2 \right] \leq \delta_{1}/ 3
$$

Write #bad for the number of arms that fail to be $\varepsilon_{1}$-optimal yet are empirically better than the best arm. Then $\mathbf{E}[\#\mathrm{bad} \mid \hat{p}_{1}\ge p_{1}- \varepsilon_{1}/ 2 ] \le n \delta_{1}/ 3$. Applying Markov's inequality yields

$$
\mathbf{P}[ \# \mathrm{bad}\geq n / 2 \mid \hat{p}_{1}\geq p_{1}- \varepsilon_{1}/ 2 ] \leq \frac{n \delta_{1}/ 3}{n / 2}= 2 \delta_{1}/ 3 .
$$

A union bound now shows that the failure probability is at most $\delta_{1}$.

We next show that the arm sample complexity is at most $O((n/\varepsilon^{2})\log(1/\delta))$.

Lemma 12 Median Elimination(ε, δ) has sample complexity $O\left((n/\varepsilon^{2})\log(1/\delta)\right)$.

Proof In round $\ell$ the algorithm draws $4n_{\ell}\log(3/\delta_{\ell})/\varepsilon_{\ell}^{2}$ arm samples. The definitions give

1. $\delta_{1}= \delta / 2 \ ; \ \delta_{\ell}= \delta_{\ell - 1}/ 2 = \delta / 2^{\ell}$

2. $n_{1}= n ~ ; ~ n_{\ell}= n_{\ell - 1}/ 2 = n / 2^{\ell - 1}$

3. $\varepsilon_{1}=\varepsilon/4\ ;\ \varepsilon_{\ell}=\frac{3}{4}\varepsilon_{\ell-1}=\left(\frac{3}{4}\right)^{\ell-1}\varepsilon/4$

Hence

$$
\begin{array}{r c l}{\displaystyle\sum_{\ell=1}^{\log_{2}(n)}\frac{n_{\ell}\log(3/\delta_{\ell})}{(\varepsilon_{\ell}/2)^{2}}}&{=}&{\displaystyle 4\sum_{\ell=1}^{\log_{2}(n)}\frac{n/2^{\ell-1}\log(2^{\ell}3/\delta)}{\big((\frac 34)^{\ell-1}\varepsilon/4\big)^{2}}}\\ &{=}&{\displaystyle 64\sum_{\ell=1}^{\log_{2}(n)}n(\frac 89)^{\ell-1}(\frac{\log(1/\delta)}{\varepsilon^{2}}+\frac{\log(3)}{\varepsilon^{2}}+\frac{\ell\log(2)}{\varepsilon^{2}})}\\ &{\leq}&{\displaystyle 64\frac{n\log(1/\delta)}{\varepsilon^{2}}\sum_{\ell=1}^{\infty}(\frac 89)^{\ell-1}(\ell C^{\prime}+C)=O(\frac{n\log(1/\delta)}{\varepsilon^{2}})}\end{array}
$$

We are now ready to prove Theorem 10.

Proof Lemma 12 gives a bound of $O\left(n\log(1/\delta)/\varepsilon^{2}\right)$ on the sample complexity. Lemma 11 says that in each round the algorithm fails with probability $\delta_{i}$, so the failure probability over all rounds is at most $\sum_{i=1}^{\log_{2}(n)}\delta_{i}\leq\delta$. Each round lowers the optimal reward among the surviving arms by no more than $\varepsilon_{i}$, so the overall error is at most $\sum_{i=1}^{\log_{2}(n)}\varepsilon_{i}\leq\varepsilon.$

context.name: Setup: multi-armed bandit model (Section 2.1)
context.statement:
The model consists of a set A of arms, where $n = \left| A \right|$. Sampling an arm $a \in A$ yields a reward given by a random variable $R(a)$. Rewards are assumed binary: for each arm $a \in A$, $R(a)\in\{0,1\}$ (every result holds unchanged when the reward is bounded in [0, 1], and, with suitable modifications, more generally whenever the reward is bounded). We write $a_{1},\cdots,a_{n}$ for the arms and set $p_{i}=\mathbb{E}[R(a_{i})]$. To simplify notation, the arms are indexed in order of expected reward, $p_{1}> p_{2}> \ldots > p_{n}$.

The best arm, denoted $a^{*}$, is an arm whose expected reward is highest; its expected reward $r^{*}$ is called the optimal reward. A non-best arm is an arm with expected reward strictly smaller than $r^{*}$, the expected reward of the best arm. An arm a is ε-optimal if its expected reward is within ε of the optimal reward, that is, $\mathbb{E}[R(a)]\geq r^{*}-\varepsilon$.

At every time step t, an algorithm for the MAB problem samples some arm $a_{t}$ and obtains a reward $r_{t}$ (whose distribution is $R(a_{t})$). Its choice may depend on the history (that is, the actions taken and rewards received) up to time t − 1. In the end, the algorithm has to commit to one arm and select it.

context.name: Definition 1 ((ε,δ)-PAC algorithm) and Remark 2 (worst-case sample complexity)
context.statement:
Definition 1 An algorithm for the multi armed bandit is an $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-PAC algorithm with sample complexity T if, upon termination, it outputs an ε-optimal arm a' with probability at least 1 − δ, and the number of time steps it executes before terminating is at most T.

Remark 2 The MAB algorithm is allowed to terminate before T steps have elapsed. The sample complexity used here is that of the worst trajectory. Mannor and Tsitsiklis (2004) studied the expected sample complexity (with expectation over both the model and the algorithm), which behaves as $\Omega((n+\log(1/\delta))/\varepsilon^{2})$; this differs from the complexity established below in Theorem 10. Note also that the algorithm of Mannor and Tsitsiklis (2004) does not have a worst-case bound on its running time.

context.name: Lemma 4 (Hoeffding, 1963)
context.statement:
Large deviation bounds are used repeatedly in this paper. Since boundedness is assumed, Hoeffding's inequality is available.

Lemma 4 (Hoeffding, 1963) Let X be a set, let D be a probability distribution on X, and let $f_{1},\ldots,f_{m}$ be real-valued functions on X with $f_{i}: X \longrightarrow [ a_{i}, b_{i}]$ for $i=1,\ldots,m$, where $a_{i}$ and $b_{i}$ are real numbers with $a_{i}< b_{i}$. Let $x_{1},\ldots,x_{m}$ be samples drawn independently and identically from D. Then

$$
\begin{array}{r l r}{\mathbf{P}\left[\frac{1}{m}\displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^{m}f_{i}(x_{i})-\left(\frac{1}{m}\displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^{m}\int_{a_{i}}^{b_{i}}f_{i}(x)D(x)\right)\ge\varepsilon\right]}&{\le}&{e^{-\frac{2\varepsilon^{2}m^{2}}{\sum_{i=1}^{m}(b_{i}-a_{i})^{2}}}}\\ {\mathbf{P}\left[\frac{1}{m}\displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^{m}f_{i}(x_{i})-\left(\frac{1}{m}\displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^{m}\int_{a_{i}}^{b_{i}}f_{i}(x)D(x)\right)\le-\varepsilon\right]}&{\le}&{e^{-\frac{2\varepsilon^{2}m^{2}}{\sum_{i=1}^{m}(b_{i}-a_{i})^{2}}}.}\end{array}
$$

context.name: Naive algorithm: Section 3 overview and Algorithm 1
context.statement:
This section studies (ε, δ)-PAC algorithms for the MAB problem, i.e., algorithms that must, with probability 1 − δ, output an ε-optimal arm. The starting point is a naive approach: sample every arm $1/(\varepsilon/2)^{2}\ln(2n/\delta)$ times and return the arm whose empirical reward is largest. This naive algorithm has sample complexity $O(n/\varepsilon^{2}\log(n/\delta))$, and it is given as Algorithm 1. Section 3.1 treats an algorithm that removes arms one at a time, and Section 3.2 ends with the Median Elimination algorithm, which attains worst-case optimal sample complexity.

Algorithm 1 (Naive Algorithm).
Given: accuracy $\varepsilon > 0$ and confidence $\delta > 0$. Returns: one arm.
1. For each arm $a \in A$: draw $\ell = \frac{4}{\varepsilon^{2}}\ln (\frac{2 n}{\delta})$ samples of $a$, and record their mean reward as $\hat{p}_{a}$.
2. Return $a^{\prime}= \arg \max_{a \in A}\{\hat{p}_{a}\}$.

context.name: Gap Δ_i (Section 3.1)
context.statement: Define $\Delta_{i}= p_{1}- p_{i}> 0$.

context.name: Algorithm 3: Successive elimination with unknown biases
context.statement:
We now drop the assumption that the arms' expected rewards are known beforehand, and present the Successive Elimination algorithm, which handles an arbitrary set of biases. Algorithm 3 below identifies the best arm (not merely an ε-best one) with high probability; Remark 9 later describes how to turn it into an (ε, δ)-PAC algorithm.

Algorithm 3 (Successive elimination with unknown biases).
Given: $\delta > 0$. Returns: one arm.
1. Initialise $t = 1$ and $S = A$, and put $\hat{p}_{a}^{1}= 0$ for each arm a.
2. Draw one sample from each arm $a \in S$; write $\hat{p}_{a}^{t}$ for the mean reward of arm a up to time $t$.
3. Loop body:
   (a) compute $\hat{p}_{max}^{t}= \max_{a \in S}\hat{p}_{a}^{t}$ and $\alpha_{t}=\sqrt{\ln(cnt^{2}/\delta)/t}$, with c a constant;
   (b) remove from $S$ (i.e. $S = S \backslash \{a \}$) every arm $a \in S$ for which $\hat{p}_{max}^{t}- \hat{p}_{a}^{t}\geq 2 \alpha_{t}$;
   (c) increase $t$ by one ($t = t + 1$).
4. Repeat step 3 until $| S | > 1$ (termination condition exactly as printed in the paper).

import Mathlib

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory

namespace ResearchLevel

def epsOptimal {n : ℕ} (p : Fin n → ℝ) (pmax ε : ℝ) (a : Fin n) : Prop :=
  pmax - p a ≤ ε

noncomputable def empMean {n ℓ : ℕ} {Ω : Type*} (X : Fin n → Fin ℓ → Ω → ℝ)
    (ω : Ω) (a : Fin n) : ℝ :=
  (∑ k, X a k ω) / ℓ

open Classical in

noncomputable def naiveOutput {n ℓ : ℕ} [NeZero n] {Ω : Type*}
    (X : Fin n → Fin ℓ → Ω → ℝ) (ω : Ω) : Fin n :=
  (Finite.exists_max (empMean X ω)).choose

noncomputable def empMeanT {n : ℕ} {Ω : Type*} (X : Fin n → ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (a : Fin n) (t : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : ℝ :=
  (∑ k ∈ Finset.range t, X a k ω) / t

noncomputable def confRadiusSE (c : ℝ) (n t : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (Real.log (c * n * (t : ℝ) ^ 2 / δ) / t)

noncomputable def phaseEps (ε : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => ε / 4
  | (ℓ + 1) => (3 / 4) * phaseEps ε ℓ

noncomputable def phaseDelta (δ : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => δ / 2
  | (ℓ + 1) => phaseDelta δ ℓ / 2

noncomputable def empMeanPhase {n : ℕ} {Ω : Type*} (X : Fin n → ℕ → ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (a : Fin n) (ℓ m : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : ℝ :=

theorem successive_elimination_PAC :

      (hX_ident : ∀ a k, IdentDistrib (X a k) (X a 0) P P)
      (S : ℕ → Ω → Finset (Fin n))

import Mathlib

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory

namespace ResearchLevel

def epsOptimal {n : ℕ} (p : Fin n → ℝ) (pmax ε : ℝ) (a : Fin n) : Prop :=
  pmax - p a ≤ ε

noncomputable def empMean {n ℓ : ℕ} {Ω : Type*} (X : Fin n → Fin ℓ → Ω → ℝ)
    (ω : Ω) (a : Fin n) : ℝ :=
  (∑ k, X a k ω) / ℓ

open Classical in

noncomputable def naiveOutput {n ℓ : ℕ} [NeZero n] {Ω : Type*}
    (X : Fin n → Fin ℓ → Ω → ℝ) (ω : Ω) : Fin n :=
  (Finite.exists_max (empMean X ω)).choose

noncomputable def empMeanT {n : ℕ} {Ω : Type*} (X : Fin n → ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (a : Fin n) (t : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : ℝ :=
  (∑ k ∈ Finset.range t, X a k ω) / t

noncomputable def confRadiusSE (c : ℝ) (n t : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (Real.log (c * n * (t : ℝ) ^ 2 / δ) / t)

noncomputable def phaseEps (ε : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => ε / 4
  | (ℓ + 1) => (3 / 4) * phaseEps ε ℓ

noncomputable def phaseDelta (δ : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => δ / 2
  | (ℓ + 1) => phaseDelta δ ℓ / 2

noncomputable def empMeanPhase {n : ℕ} {Ω : Type*} (X : Fin n → ℕ → ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (a : Fin n) (ℓ m : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : ℝ :=
  (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, X a ℓ k ω) / m

section Helpers

variable {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]

/-- Hoeffding's inequality for a sum of independent `[0,1]`-valued random variables with
common mean `μ`. -/
theorem hoeffding_sum {ι : Type*} (Y : ι → Ω → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) (s : Finset ι)
    (hmeas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (Y i) P)
    (hbound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, Y i ω ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, Y i ω ∂P = μ)
    (hindep : iIndepFun Y P) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) :
    P.real {ω | η ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, (Y i ω - μ)} ≤ Real.exp (- (2 * η^2) / s.card) := by
  have hsub : ∀ i ∈ s, HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω => Y i ω - μ) (1/4 : NNReal) P := by
    intro i _
    have := hasSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc (X := Y i) (μ := P) (a := 0) (b := 1) (hmeas i) (hbound i)
    rw [hmean i] at this
    convert this using 2
    norm_num
  have hind2 : iIndepFun (fun i => fun ω => Y i ω - μ) P :=
    hindep.comp (fun (_ : ι) (x : ℝ) => x - μ) (fun i => by fun_prop)
  have := HasSubgaussianMGF.measure_sum_ge_le_of_iIndepFun hind2 hsub hη
  refine this.trans_eq ?_
  congr 1
  rw [Finset.sum_const]
  push_cast
  rw [nsmul_eq_mul]
  rcases eq_or_ne (s.card : ℝ) 0 with h | h
  · simp [h]
  · field_simp
    ring

/-- Upper deviation bound for an empirical mean. -/
theorem emp_dev_upper {ι : Type*} (Y : ι → Ω → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (hmeas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (Y i) P)
    (hbound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, Y i ω ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, Y i ω ∂P = μ)
    (hindep : iIndepFun Y P) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) :
    P.real {ω | η ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, Y i ω) / s.card - μ} ≤ Real.exp (-2 * η^2 * s.card) := by
  have hc : (0:ℝ) < s.card := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.2 hs
  have hset : {ω | η ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, Y i ω) / s.card - μ}
      = {ω | (s.card : ℝ) * η ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, (Y i ω - μ)} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    rw [le_sub_iff_add_le, le_div_iff₀ hc]
    constructor
    · intro h; nlinarith
    · intro h; nlinarith
  rw [hset]
  refine (hoeffding_sum Y μ s hmeas hbound hmean hindep (by positivity)).trans_eq ?_
  congr 1
  field_simp

/-- Lower deviation bound for an empirical mean. -/
theorem emp_dev_lower {ι : Type*} (Y : ι → Ω → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (hmeas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (Y i) P)
    (hbound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, Y i ω ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, Y i ω ∂P = μ)
    (hindep : iIndepFun Y P) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) :
    P.real {ω | η ≤ μ - (∑ i ∈ s, Y i ω) / s.card} ≤ Real.exp (-2 * η^2 * s.card) := by
  have hc : (0:ℝ) < s.card := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.2 hs
  have key := emp_dev_upper (fun i ω => 1 - Y i ω) (1 - μ) s hs
    (fun i => (hmeas i).const_sub 1)
    (fun i => by
      filter_upwards [hbound i] with ω hω
      constructor <;> [linarith [hω.2]; linarith [hω.1]])
    (fun i => by
      have hint : Integrable (Y i) P := Integrable.of_mem_Icc 0 1 (hmeas i) (hbound i)
      rw [integral_sub (integrable_const 1) hint, hmean i, integral_const]
      simp)
    (hindep.comp (fun (_ : ι) (x : ℝ) => 1 - x) (fun i => by fun_prop)) hη
  refine le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) key
  congr 1
  ext ω
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rw [sub_div]
  field_simp
  constructor <;> intro h <;> nlinarith

theorem markov_count {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (q : ι → Ω → Prop) [∀ i ω, Decidable (q i ω)]
    (hA : ∀ i, MeasurableSet {ω | q i ω}) (k : ℝ) :
    k * P.real {ω | k ≤ (((Finset.univ : Finset ι).filter (fun i => q i ω)).card : ℝ)}
      ≤ ∑ i, P.real {ω | q i ω} := by
  set A : ι → Set Ω := fun i => {ω | q i ω} with hAdef
  set f : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => ∑ i, (A i).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) ω with hf
  have hfe : ∀ ω, f ω = (((Finset.univ : Finset ι).filter (fun i => q i ω)).card : ℝ) := by
    intro ω
    rw [hf]
    simp only [Set.indicator_apply]
    rw [Finset.card_filter]
    push_cast
    rfl
  have hnn : 0 ≤ᵐ[P] f := by
    filter_upwards with ω
    rw [hfe]
    positivity
  have hint : Integrable f P := by
    apply integrable_finset_sum
    intro i _
    exact (integrable_const (1:ℝ)).indicator (hA i)
  have hmk := mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg hnn hint k
  have hI : ∫ ω, f ω ∂P = ∑ i, P.real (A i) := by
    rw [hf, integral_finset_sum]
    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      rw [show A i = {ω | q i ω} from rfl, integral_indicator_const (1:ℝ) (hA i)]
      simp [smul_eq_mul]
    · intro i _
      exact (integrable_const (1:ℝ)).indicator (hA i)
  rw [hI] at hmk
  refine le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) hmk
  congr 2
  ext ω
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, hfe ω]

end Helpers

/-- `log x ≤ x / y + log y - 1` for positive `x, y`. -/
theorem log_le_div_add (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) :
    Real.log x ≤ x / y + Real.log y - 1 := by
  have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (x := x / y) (by positivity)

theorem sum_inv_sq_le (N : ℕ) : ∑ t ∈ Finset.range N, (1:ℝ)/((t:ℝ)+1)^2 ≤ 2 := by

        nlinarith
      push_cast
      push_cast at ih
      linarith [ih, hstep]
  cases N with
  | zero => norm_num
  | succ M =>
    have := key M
    have h : (0:ℝ) < (M:ℝ)+1 := by positivity
    have : (0:ℝ) < 1/((M:ℝ)+1) := by positivity
    linarith [key M]

theorem key_time (c : ℝ) (hc : 4 < c) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (Δ : ℝ) (hΔ : 0 < Δ) (hΔ1 : Δ ≤ 1) (u : ℕ)

  have hΔ2 : (0:ℝ) < Δ^2 := by positivity
  have hΔ2le : Δ^2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith

  · have hlogW : Real.log (c * (n:ℝ) * (u:ℝ)^2 / δ) = Real.log c + B + 2 * Real.log u := by

theorem conf_prob (c : ℝ) (hc : 4 < c) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)

    field_simp; ring

  rw [inv_le_inv₀ (by positivity) hZpos]
  nlinarith


theorem phaseEps_eq (ε : ℝ) (ℓ : ℕ) : phaseEps ε ℓ = (3/4)^ℓ * (ε/4) := by
  induction ℓ with
  | zero => simp [phaseEps]
  | succ ℓ ih => rw [phaseEps, ih]; ring

  induction ℓ with
  | zero => simp [phaseDelta]

    ∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.range N, phaseEps ε ℓ ≤ ε := by

    intro N

    | zero => simp

  rw [key N]
