theorem geom_sum_89' (N : ℕ) : ∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.range N, ((ℓ:ℝ)+1) * ((8:ℝ)/9)^ℓ ≤ 81 := by
  have key : ∀ N : ℕ, ∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.range N, ((ℓ:ℝ)+1) * ((8:ℝ)/9)^ℓ
      ≤ 81 - (9*(N:ℝ)+81) * (8/9)^N := by
    intro N
    induction N with
    | zero => simp
    | succ N ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
      have h : (81:ℝ) - (9*(N:ℝ)+81) * (8/9)^N + ((N:ℝ)+1) * (8/9)^N
          = 81 - (9*((N:ℝ)+1)+81) * (8/9)^(N+1) := by
        rw [pow_succ]; ring
      push_cast
      linarith [ih, h]
  have h2 := key N
  nlinarith [pow_nonneg (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 8/9) N, Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) N]

theorem geom_sum_half (N : ℕ) : ∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.range N, ((1:ℝ)/2)^ℓ ≤ 2 := by
  have key : ∀ N : ℕ, ∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.range N, ((1:ℝ)/2)^ℓ = 2 - 2 * (1/2)^N := by
    intro N
    induction N with
    | zero => simp
    | succ N ih => rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]; ring
  rw [key N]
  nlinarith [pow_nonneg (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1/2) N]

/-- The purely combinatorial core of the median-elimination analysis. -/
theorem median_comb {n : ℕ} (p : Fin n → ℝ) (astar : Fin n) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (L : ℕ) (Sc : ℕ → Finset (Fin n)) (med : ℕ → ℝ) (pm : Fin n → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hSnonempty : ∀ ℓ, (Sc ℓ).Nonempty)
    (hScard : ∀ ℓ, 2 * (Sc (ℓ+1)).card ≤ (Sc ℓ).card + 1)
    (hScard_lo : ∀ ℓ, (Sc ℓ).card ≤ 2 * (Sc (ℓ+1)).card)
    (hSstep_lo : ∀ ℓ, (Sc ℓ).filter (fun a => med ℓ < pm a ℓ) ⊆ Sc (ℓ+1))
    (hSstep_hi : ∀ ℓ, Sc (ℓ+1) ⊆ (Sc ℓ).filter (fun a => med ℓ ≤ pm a ℓ))
    (hcard_lo : ∀ ℓ, n ≤ 2^ℓ * (Sc ℓ).card)
    (hSLcard : (Sc L).card = 1)
    (hstar0 : astar ∈ Sc 0)
    (h1 : ∀ ℓ, ℓ < L → ¬ (phaseEps ε ℓ/2 ≤ p astar - pm astar ℓ))
    (h2 : ∀ ℓ, ℓ < L → (((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter
        (fun a => phaseEps ε ℓ/2 ≤ pm a ℓ - p a)).card : ℝ) < (n:ℝ)/(8*2^ℓ))
    (h3 : ∀ ℓ, ℓ < L → (((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter
        (fun a => phaseEps ε ℓ/2 ≤ p a - pm a ℓ)).card : ℝ) < (n:ℝ)/(8*2^ℓ)) :
    ∀ a ∈ Sc L, p astar - p a ≤ ε := by
  classical
  have hepsnn : ∀ ℓ, (0:ℝ) ≤ phaseEps ε ℓ := by
    intro ℓ; rw [phaseEps_eq]; positivity
  set σ : ℕ → ℝ := fun ℓ => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range ℓ, phaseEps ε j with hσdef
  have hσsucc : ∀ ℓ, σ (ℓ+1) = σ ℓ + phaseEps ε ℓ := by
    intro ℓ; simp [hσdef, Finset.sum_range_succ]
  have hσ0 : ∀ ℓ, (0:ℝ) ≤ σ ℓ := by
    intro ℓ
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => hepsnn j)
  set Bs : ℕ → Finset (Fin n) := fun ℓ => (Sc ℓ).filter (fun a => ¬ (p astar - p a ≤ σ ℓ))
    with hBsdef
  have hsub : ∀ ℓ, Sc (ℓ+1) ⊆ Sc ℓ := fun ℓ => (hSstep_hi ℓ).trans (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
  have hNle : ∀ ℓ, (n:ℝ)/(8*2^ℓ) ≤ ((Sc ℓ).card : ℝ)/8 := by
    intro ℓ
    have h := hcard_lo ℓ
    have hR : (n:ℝ) ≤ 2^ℓ * ((Sc ℓ).card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h
    have hp : (0:ℝ) < 2^ℓ := by positivity
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
    nlinarith
  have inv : ∀ ℓ, ℓ ≤ L → (astar ∈ Sc ℓ ∨ 4 * (Bs ℓ).card ≤ (Sc ℓ).card) := by
    intro ℓ
    induction ℓ with
    | zero => intro _; exact Or.inl hstar0
    | succ ℓ ih =>
      intro hle
      have hℓL : ℓ < L := by omega
      have ihh := ih (by omega)
      by_cases hstar : astar ∈ Sc (ℓ+1)
      · exact Or.inl hstar
      right
      have hs'pos : 1 ≤ (Sc (ℓ+1)).card := Finset.card_pos.2 (hSnonempty (ℓ+1))
      by_cases hA : ∃ g, g ∈ Sc ℓ ∧ g ∉ Sc (ℓ+1) ∧ (p astar - p g ≤ σ ℓ) ∧
          ¬ (phaseEps ε ℓ/2 ≤ p g - pm g ℓ)
      · -- Case A : an eliminated good arm which did not deviate downwards
        obtain ⟨g, hgS, hgout, hggood, hgdev⟩ := hA
        have hmedg : pm g ℓ ≤ med ℓ := by
          by_contra hcon
          push_neg at hcon
          exact hgout (hSstep_lo ℓ (Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hgS, hcon⟩))
        have hgd : p g - pm g ℓ < phaseEps ε ℓ/2 := not_le.1 hgdev
        have hBsub : Bs (ℓ+1) ⊆ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter
            (fun a => phaseEps ε ℓ/2 ≤ pm a ℓ - p a) := by
          intro b hb
          rw [hBsdef] at hb
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hb
          obtain ⟨hbS, hbbad⟩ := hb
          refine Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
          by_contra hcon
          push_neg at hcon
          apply hbbad
          have hmedb : med ℓ ≤ pm b ℓ := (Finset.mem_filter.1 (hSstep_hi ℓ hbS)).2
          rw [hσsucc]
          linarith
        have hc1 : ((Bs (ℓ+1)).card : ℝ) ≤ (((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter
            (fun a => phaseEps ε ℓ/2 ≤ pm a ℓ - p a)).card : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card hBsub
        have hc2 := (hc1.trans_lt (h2 ℓ hℓL)).trans_le (hNle ℓ)
        have hc3 : ((Sc ℓ).card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ((Sc (ℓ+1)).card : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast hScard_lo ℓ
        have : (4 * (Bs (ℓ+1)).card : ℝ) ≤ ((Sc (ℓ+1)).card : ℝ) := by
          push_cast
          linarith
        exact_mod_cast this
      · -- Case B : every eliminated good arm deviated downwards
        push_neg at hA
        have hastar : astar ∉ Sc ℓ := by
          intro hmem
          exact h1 ℓ hℓL (hA astar hmem hstar (by simp [hσ0 ℓ]))
        have ihh' : 4 * (Bs ℓ).card ≤ (Sc ℓ).card := ihh.resolve_left hastar
        set H : Finset (Fin n) := (Sc ℓ).filter (fun a => p astar - p a ≤ σ ℓ) with hHdef
        have hHcard : H.card + (Bs ℓ).card = (Sc ℓ).card := by
          rw [hHdef, hBsdef]
          exact Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not _
        set E : Finset (Fin n) := H.filter (fun a => a ∉ Sc (ℓ+1)) with hEdef
        set H' : Finset (Fin n) := H.filter (fun a => a ∈ Sc (ℓ+1)) with hH'def
        have hHsplit : H'.card + E.card = H.card := by
          rw [hH'def, hEdef]
          exact Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not _
        have hEsub : E ⊆ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter
            (fun a => phaseEps ε ℓ/2 ≤ p a - pm a ℓ) := by
          intro g hg
          rw [hEdef, hHdef] at hg
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hg
          exact Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hA g hg.1.1 hg.2 hg.1.2⟩
        have hdisj : Disjoint H' (Bs (ℓ+1)) := by
          rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
          intro a ha hb
          rw [hH'def, hHdef] at ha
          rw [hBsdef] at hb
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at ha hb
          exact hb.2 (le_trans ha.1.2 (by rw [hσsucc]; linarith [hepsnn ℓ]))
        have hunion : H' ∪ Bs (ℓ+1) ⊆ Sc (ℓ+1) := by
          refine Finset.union_subset ?_ ?_
          · intro a ha; rw [hH'def] at ha; exact (Finset.mem_filter.1 ha).2
          · intro a ha; rw [hBsdef] at ha; exact (Finset.mem_filter.1 ha).1
        have hcard3 : H'.card + (Bs (ℓ+1)).card ≤ (Sc (ℓ+1)).card := by
          have := Finset.card_le_card hunion
          rwa [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisj] at this
        have hEcard : ((E).card : ℝ) ≤ ((Sc ℓ).card : ℝ)/8 := by
          have h := (Nat.cast_le (α := ℝ)).2 (Finset.card_le_card hEsub)
          exact (h.trans_lt (h3 ℓ hℓL)).le.trans (hNle ℓ)
        -- real arithmetic
        have e1 : (H.card : ℝ) + ((Bs ℓ).card : ℝ) = ((Sc ℓ).card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hHcard
        have e2 : (H'.card : ℝ) + (E.card : ℝ) = (H.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hHsplit
        have e3 : (H'.card : ℝ) + ((Bs (ℓ+1)).card : ℝ) ≤ ((Sc (ℓ+1)).card : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast hcard3
        have e4 : 4 * ((Bs ℓ).card : ℝ) ≤ ((Sc ℓ).card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast ihh'
        have e5 : 2 * ((Sc (ℓ+1)).card : ℝ) ≤ ((Sc ℓ).card : ℝ) + 1 := by
          exact_mod_cast hScard ℓ
        have e6 : (1:ℝ) ≤ ((Sc (ℓ+1)).card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hs'pos
        have hzero : ((Bs (ℓ+1)).card : ℝ) < 1 := by linarith
        have : (Bs (ℓ+1)).card = 0 := by
          have : (Bs (ℓ+1)).card < 1 := by exact_mod_cast hzero
          omega
        rw [this]
        omega
  -- conclusion
  intro a ha
  have hεL : σ L ≤ ε := sum_phaseEps_le ε (le_of_lt hε) L
  rcases inv L le_rfl with hstar | hcard
  · have hae : a = astar := Finset.card_le_one.1 (le_of_eq hSLcard) a ha astar hstar
    rw [hae]
    simp
    linarith
  · have hB0 : (Bs L).card = 0 := by rw [hSLcard] at hcard; omega
    have hanot : a ∉ Bs L := by
      rw [Finset.card_eq_zero] at hB0
      rw [hB0]; simp
    rw [hBsdef] at hanot
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, not_and, not_not] at hanot
    have := hanot ha
    linarith

/-- Correctness of median elimination.  The analysis uses only (i) deviation bounds for the
fixed optimal arm `astar` and (ii) Markov bounds on the *number* of arms whose empirical mean
deviates; no conditioning on the (adaptively chosen) active set is required. -/
theorem median_correct {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (p : Fin n → ℝ) (astar : Fin n)
    (ε δ : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
    (L : ℕ) (hL : L = Nat.clog 2 n) (m : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hm : ∀ ℓ, ℓ < L →
      (1 / (phaseEps ε ℓ / 2) ^ 2) * Real.log (3 / phaseDelta δ ℓ) ≤ m ℓ)
    (X : Fin n → ℕ → ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (hX_meas : ∀ a ℓ k, Measurable (X a ℓ k))
    (hX_bound : ∀ a ℓ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, X a ℓ k ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hX_mean : ∀ a ℓ k, ∫ ω, X a ℓ k ω ∂P = p a)
    (hX_indep : iIndepFun (fun q : Fin n × ℕ × ℕ => X q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) P)
    (S : ℕ → Ω → Finset (Fin n))
    (hS0 : ∀ ω, S 0 ω = Finset.univ)
    (hSnonempty : ∀ ℓ ω, (S ℓ ω).Nonempty)
    (hScard : ∀ ℓ ω, 2 * (S (ℓ + 1) ω).card ≤ (S ℓ ω).card + 1)
    (hScard_lo : ∀ ℓ ω, (S ℓ ω).card ≤ 2 * (S (ℓ + 1) ω).card)
    (median : ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (hSstep_lo : ∀ ℓ ω, (S ℓ ω).filter
        (fun a => median ℓ ω < empMeanPhase X a ℓ (m ℓ) ω) ⊆ S (ℓ + 1) ω)
    (hSstep_hi : ∀ ℓ ω, S (ℓ + 1) ω ⊆ (S ℓ ω).filter
        (fun a => median ℓ ω ≤ empMeanPhase X a ℓ (m ℓ) ω)) :
    1 - δ ≤ P.real {ω | ∀ a ∈ S L ω, epsOptimal p (p astar) ε a} := by
  have hnR : (1:ℝ) ≤ (n:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hnpos : (0:ℝ) < (n:ℝ) := by linarith
  have hepspos : ∀ ℓ, 0 < phaseEps ε ℓ := by
    intro ℓ; rw [phaseEps_eq]; positivity
  have hdeltapos : ∀ ℓ, 0 < phaseDelta δ ℓ := by
    intro ℓ; rw [phaseDelta_eq]; positivity
  have hdeltalt : ∀ ℓ, phaseDelta δ ℓ < 1 := by
    intro ℓ
    rw [phaseDelta_eq]
    have h1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ 2^(ℓ+1) := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
    rw [div_lt_one (by positivity)]
    linarith
  have hlogpos : ∀ ℓ, 0 < Real.log (3 / phaseDelta δ ℓ) := by
    intro ℓ
    apply Real.log_pos
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ (hdeltapos ℓ)]
    linarith [hdeltalt ℓ]
  have hmpos : ∀ ℓ, ℓ < L → 0 < m ℓ := by
    intro ℓ hℓ
    have h := hm ℓ hℓ
    have h2 : (0:ℝ) < (1 / (phaseEps ε ℓ / 2) ^ 2) * Real.log (3 / phaseDelta δ ℓ) := by
      have := hepspos ℓ
      have := hlogpos ℓ
      positivity
    have : (0:ℝ) < (m ℓ : ℝ) := lt_of_lt_of_le h2 h
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hcard_lo : ∀ ℓ ω, n ≤ 2^ℓ * (S ℓ ω).card := by
    intro ℓ ω
    induction ℓ with
    | zero => simp [hS0 ω]
    | succ ℓ ih =>
      have h1 : (S ℓ ω).card ≤ 2 * (S (ℓ+1) ω).card := hScard_lo ℓ ω
      have h2 : 2^ℓ * (S ℓ ω).card ≤ 2^ℓ * (2 * (S (ℓ+1) ω).card) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h1
      have h3 : (2:ℕ)^(ℓ+1) * (S (ℓ+1) ω).card = 2^ℓ * (2 * (S (ℓ+1) ω).card) := by ring
      omega
  have hcard_hi : ∀ ℓ ω, 2^ℓ * (S ℓ ω).card + 1 ≤ n + 2^ℓ := by
    intro ℓ ω
    induction ℓ with
    | zero => simp [hS0 ω]
    | succ ℓ ih =>
      have h1 : 2 * (S (ℓ+1) ω).card ≤ (S ℓ ω).card + 1 := hScard ℓ ω
      have h2 : 2^ℓ * (2 * (S (ℓ+1) ω).card) ≤ 2^ℓ * ((S ℓ ω).card + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h1
      have h3 : (2:ℕ)^(ℓ+1) * (S (ℓ+1) ω).card = 2^ℓ * (2 * (S (ℓ+1) ω).card) := by ring
      have h4 : (2:ℕ)^ℓ * ((S ℓ ω).card + 1) = 2^ℓ * (S ℓ ω).card + 2^ℓ := by ring
      have h5 : (2:ℕ)^(ℓ+1) = 2 * 2^ℓ := by ring
      omega
  have hSLcard : ∀ ω, (S L ω).card = 1 := by
    intro ω
    have h1 := hcard_hi L ω
    have h2 : n ≤ 2^L := by rw [hL]; exact Nat.le_pow_clog (by norm_num) n
    have h3 : 0 < (S L ω).card := Finset.card_pos.2 (hSnonempty L ω)
    have h4 : (0:ℕ) < 2^L := Nat.two_pow_pos L
    nlinarith [h1, h2, h3, h4]
  -- measurability / independence
  have hmeasEMP : ∀ (a : Fin n) (ℓ : ℕ), Measurable (fun ω => empMeanPhase X a ℓ (m ℓ) ω) := by
    intro a ℓ
    unfold empMeanPhase
    exact (Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun k _ => hX_meas a ℓ k)).div_const _
  have hindepX : ∀ (a : Fin n) (ℓ : ℕ), iIndepFun (fun k : ℕ => X a ℓ k) P := by
    intro a ℓ
    have hinj : Function.Injective (fun k : ℕ => ((a, (ℓ, k)) : Fin n × ℕ × ℕ)) := by
      intro k k' h; simpa using h
    exact iIndepFun.precomp (g := fun k : ℕ => ((a, (ℓ, k)) : Fin n × ℕ × ℕ)) hinj hX_indep
  have hexpb : ∀ ℓ, ℓ < L →
      Real.exp (-2 * (phaseEps ε ℓ/2)^2 * ((m ℓ : ℕ):ℝ)) ≤ (phaseDelta δ ℓ/3)^2 := by
    intro ℓ hℓ
    have hd := hdeltapos ℓ
    have he := hepspos ℓ
    have hep : (0:ℝ) < (phaseEps ε ℓ/2)^2 := by positivity
    have h := hm ℓ hℓ
    have h2 : 2 * Real.log (3/phaseDelta δ ℓ) ≤ 2*(phaseEps ε ℓ/2)^2*((m ℓ:ℕ):ℝ) := by
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h
        (le_of_lt (show (0:ℝ) < 2*(phaseEps ε ℓ/2)^2 by linarith))
      have he2 : 2*(phaseEps ε ℓ/2)^2 * ((1 / (phaseEps ε ℓ / 2) ^ 2) * Real.log (3 / phaseDelta δ ℓ))
          = 2 * Real.log (3/phaseDelta δ ℓ) := by
        field_simp
      rw [he2] at hmul
      linarith
    have hpos3 : (0:ℝ) < 3 / phaseDelta δ ℓ := by positivity
    calc Real.exp (-2 * (phaseEps ε ℓ/2)^2 * ((m ℓ:ℕ):ℝ))
        ≤ Real.exp (-(Real.log (3/phaseDelta δ ℓ) + Real.log (3/phaseDelta δ ℓ))) := by
          apply Real.exp_le_exp.2; linarith
      _ = (phaseDelta δ ℓ/3)^2 := by
          rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log hpos3]
          field_simp
  have hdevU : ∀ ℓ, ℓ < L → ∀ a : Fin n,
      P.real {ω | phaseEps ε ℓ/2 ≤ empMeanPhase X a ℓ (m ℓ) ω - p a}
        ≤ (phaseDelta δ ℓ/3)^2 := by
    intro ℓ hℓ a
    have hmne : (Finset.range (m ℓ)).Nonempty := ⟨0, by simp [hmpos ℓ hℓ]⟩
    have h := emp_dev_upper (P := P) (fun k : ℕ => X a ℓ k) (p a) (Finset.range (m ℓ)) hmne
      (fun k => (hX_meas a ℓ k).aemeasurable) (fun k => hX_bound a ℓ k)
      (fun k => hX_mean a ℓ k) (hindepX a ℓ) (η := phaseEps ε ℓ/2)
      (by have := hepspos ℓ; linarith)
    simp only [Finset.card_range] at h
    exact h.trans (hexpb ℓ hℓ)
  have hdevL : ∀ ℓ, ℓ < L → ∀ a : Fin n,
      P.real {ω | phaseEps ε ℓ/2 ≤ p a - empMeanPhase X a ℓ (m ℓ) ω}
        ≤ (phaseDelta δ ℓ/3)^2 := by
    intro ℓ hℓ a
    have hmne : (Finset.range (m ℓ)).Nonempty := ⟨0, by simp [hmpos ℓ hℓ]⟩
    have h := emp_dev_lower (P := P) (fun k : ℕ => X a ℓ k) (p a) (Finset.range (m ℓ)) hmne
      (fun k => (hX_meas a ℓ k).aemeasurable) (fun k => hX_bound a ℓ k)
      (fun k => hX_mean a ℓ k) (hindepX a ℓ) (η := phaseEps ε ℓ/2)
      (by have := hepspos ℓ; linarith)
    simp only [Finset.card_range] at h
    exact h.trans (hexpb ℓ hℓ)
  -- Markov bounds on the number of deviating arms
  have hMarkovP : ∀ ℓ, ℓ < L →
      P.real {ω | (n:ℝ)/(8*2^ℓ) ≤ (((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter
        (fun a => phaseEps ε ℓ/2 ≤ empMeanPhase X a ℓ (m ℓ) ω - p a)).card : ℝ)}
      ≤ 8*2^ℓ * (phaseDelta δ ℓ/3)^2 := by
    intro ℓ hℓ
    have hk : (0:ℝ) < (n:ℝ)/(8*2^ℓ) := by positivity
    have h1 := markov_count (P := P)
        (fun (a : Fin n) ω => phaseEps ε ℓ/2 ≤ empMeanPhase X a ℓ (m ℓ) ω - p a)
        (fun a => measurableSet_le measurable_const ((hmeasEMP a ℓ).sub_const _))
        ((n:ℝ)/(8*2^ℓ))
    have h2 : ∑ a : Fin n, P.real {ω | phaseEps ε ℓ/2 ≤ empMeanPhase X a ℓ (m ℓ) ω - p a}
        ≤ (n:ℝ) * (phaseDelta δ ℓ/3)^2 := by
      refine (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun a _ => hdevU ℓ hℓ a)).trans ?_
      rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
    have h3 := h1.trans h2
    have heq : (n:ℝ)/(8*2^ℓ) * (8*2^ℓ * (phaseDelta δ ℓ/3)^2) = (n:ℝ) * (phaseDelta δ ℓ/3)^2 := by
      field_simp
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left (by rw [heq]; exact h3) hk
  have hMarkovM : ∀ ℓ, ℓ < L →
      P.real {ω | (n:ℝ)/(8*2^ℓ) ≤ (((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter
        (fun a => phaseEps ε ℓ/2 ≤ p a - empMeanPhase X a ℓ (m ℓ) ω)).card : ℝ)}
      ≤ 8*2^ℓ * (phaseDelta δ ℓ/3)^2 := by
    intro ℓ hℓ
    have hk : (0:ℝ) < (n:ℝ)/(8*2^ℓ) := by positivity
    have h1 := markov_count (P := P)
        (fun (a : Fin n) ω => phaseEps ε ℓ/2 ≤ p a - empMeanPhase X a ℓ (m ℓ) ω)
        (fun a => measurableSet_le measurable_const (measurable_const.sub (hmeasEMP a ℓ)))
        ((n:ℝ)/(8*2^ℓ))
    have h2 : ∑ a : Fin n, P.real {ω | phaseEps ε ℓ/2 ≤ p a - empMeanPhase X a ℓ (m ℓ) ω}
        ≤ (n:ℝ) * (phaseDelta δ ℓ/3)^2 := by
      refine (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun a _ => hdevL ℓ hℓ a)).trans ?_
      rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
    have h3 := h1.trans h2
    have heq : (n:ℝ)/(8*2^ℓ) * (8*2^ℓ * (phaseDelta δ ℓ/3)^2) = (n:ℝ) * (phaseDelta δ ℓ/3)^2 := by
      field_simp
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left (by rw [heq]; exact h3) hk
  -- the bad event
  set W : ℕ → Set Ω := fun ℓ =>
      ({ω | phaseEps ε ℓ/2 ≤ p astar - empMeanPhase X astar ℓ (m ℓ) ω} ∪
       {ω | (n:ℝ)/(8*2^ℓ) ≤ (((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter
          (fun a => phaseEps ε ℓ/2 ≤ empMeanPhase X a ℓ (m ℓ) ω - p a)).card : ℝ)}) ∪
       {ω | (n:ℝ)/(8*2^ℓ) ≤ (((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter
          (fun a => phaseEps ε ℓ/2 ≤ p a - empMeanPhase X a ℓ (m ℓ) ω)).card : ℝ)} with hWdef
  have hterm : ∀ ℓ : ℕ,
      (phaseDelta δ ℓ/3)^2 + 8*2^ℓ*(phaseDelta δ ℓ/3)^2 + 8*2^ℓ*(phaseDelta δ ℓ/3)^2
        ≤ (17/36)*δ^2*((1:ℝ)/2)^ℓ := by
    intro ℓ
    have hu : (1:ℝ) ≤ (2:ℝ)^ℓ := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
    have hupos : (0:ℝ) < (2:ℝ)^ℓ := by positivity
    have hpd : (phaseDelta δ ℓ/3)^2 = δ^2/(36*((2:ℝ)^ℓ)^2) := by
      rw [phaseDelta_eq]
      field_simp
      ring
    have hhalf : ((1:ℝ)/2)^ℓ = 1/(2:ℝ)^ℓ := by rw [div_pow]; norm_num
    rw [hpd, hhalf]
    have expand : δ^2/(36*((2:ℝ)^ℓ)^2) + 8*2^ℓ*(δ^2/(36*((2:ℝ)^ℓ)^2))
        + 8*2^ℓ*(δ^2/(36*((2:ℝ)^ℓ)^2))
        = δ^2*(1+16*(2:ℝ)^ℓ)/(36*((2:ℝ)^ℓ)^2) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [expand, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    have hrhs : 17/36*δ^2*(1/(2:ℝ)^ℓ)*(36*((2:ℝ)^ℓ)^2) = 17*δ^2*(2:ℝ)^ℓ := by
      field_simp
    rw [hrhs]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg δ) (sub_nonneg.2 hu)]
  have hBadBound : P.real (⋃ ℓ ∈ Finset.range L, W ℓ) ≤ (17/18)*δ^2 := by
    refine (measureReal_biUnion_finset_le _ _).trans ?_
    have hstep : ∀ ℓ ∈ Finset.range L, P.real (W ℓ) ≤ (17/36)*δ^2*((1:ℝ)/2)^ℓ := by
      intro ℓ hℓ
      rw [Finset.mem_range] at hℓ
      have hu1 := measureReal_union_le
        (μ := P) ({ω | phaseEps ε ℓ/2 ≤ p astar - empMeanPhase X astar ℓ (m ℓ) ω} ∪
       {ω | (n:ℝ)/(8*2^ℓ) ≤ (((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter
          (fun a => phaseEps ε ℓ/2 ≤ empMeanPhase X a ℓ (m ℓ) ω - p a)).card : ℝ)})
       ({ω | (n:ℝ)/(8*2^ℓ) ≤ (((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter
          (fun a => phaseEps ε ℓ/2 ≤ p a - empMeanPhase X a ℓ (m ℓ) ω)).card : ℝ)})
      have hu2 := measureReal_union_le
        (μ := P) ({ω | phaseEps ε ℓ/2 ≤ p astar - empMeanPhase X astar ℓ (m ℓ) ω})
       ({ω | (n:ℝ)/(8*2^ℓ) ≤ (((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter
          (fun a => phaseEps ε ℓ/2 ≤ empMeanPhase X a ℓ (m ℓ) ω - p a)).card : ℝ)})
      have hA := hdevL ℓ hℓ astar
      have hB := hMarkovP ℓ hℓ
      have hC := hMarkovM ℓ hℓ
      have hT := hterm ℓ
      rw [hWdef]
      simp only
      linarith
    refine (Finset.sum_le_sum hstep).trans ?_
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
    have hg := geom_sum_half L
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg δ]
  have hcover : (Set.univ : Set Ω) ⊆
      {ω | ∀ a ∈ S L ω, epsOptimal p (p astar) ε a} ∪ (⋃ ℓ ∈ Finset.range L, W ℓ) := by
    intro ω _
    by_cases hb : ω ∈ (⋃ ℓ ∈ Finset.range L, W ℓ)
    · exact Or.inr hb
    left
    have hb' : ∀ ℓ, ℓ < L → ω ∉ W ℓ := by
      intro ℓ hℓ hmem
      exact hb (Set.mem_biUnion (Finset.mem_range.2 hℓ) hmem)
    have hb1 : ∀ ℓ, ℓ < L →
        ¬ (phaseEps ε ℓ/2 ≤ p astar - empMeanPhase X astar ℓ (m ℓ) ω) := by
      intro ℓ hℓ hcon
      exact hb' ℓ hℓ (Or.inl (Or.inl hcon))
    have hb2 : ∀ ℓ, ℓ < L → (((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter
        (fun a => phaseEps ε ℓ/2 ≤ empMeanPhase X a ℓ (m ℓ) ω - p a)).card : ℝ)
        < (n:ℝ)/(8*2^ℓ) := by
      intro ℓ hℓ
      exact not_le.1 (fun hcon => hb' ℓ hℓ (Or.inl (Or.inr hcon)))
    have hb3 : ∀ ℓ, ℓ < L → (((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter
        (fun a => phaseEps ε ℓ/2 ≤ p a - empMeanPhase X a ℓ (m ℓ) ω)).card : ℝ)
        < (n:ℝ)/(8*2^ℓ) := by
      intro ℓ hℓ
      exact not_le.1 (fun hcon => hb' ℓ hℓ (Or.inr hcon))
    intro a ha
    exact median_comb p astar ε hε L (fun ℓ => S ℓ ω) (fun ℓ => median ℓ ω)
      (fun a ℓ => empMeanPhase X a ℓ (m ℓ) ω)
      (fun ℓ => hSnonempty ℓ ω) (fun ℓ => hScard ℓ ω) (fun ℓ => hScard_lo ℓ ω)
      (fun ℓ => hSstep_lo ℓ ω) (fun ℓ => hSstep_hi ℓ ω) (fun ℓ => hcard_lo ℓ ω)
      (hSLcard ω) (by show astar ∈ S 0 ω; rw [hS0 ω]; exact Finset.mem_univ _) hb1 hb2 hb3 a ha
  have huniv : (1:ℝ) ≤ P.real ({ω | ∀ a ∈ S L ω, epsOptimal p (p astar) ε a}
      ∪ (⋃ ℓ ∈ Finset.range L, W ℓ)) := by
    have := measureReal_mono (μ := P) hcover
    rwa [probReal_univ] at this
  have hsum := measureReal_union_le (μ := P)
    {ω | ∀ a ∈ S L ω, epsOptimal p (p astar) ε a} (⋃ ℓ ∈ Finset.range L, W ℓ)
  nlinarith [hBadBound, huniv, hsum]

/-- The sample-complexity bound for median elimination. -/
theorem median_complexity {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (ε δ : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
    (L : ℕ) (hL : L = Nat.clog 2 n) (m : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hm_le : ∀ ℓ, ℓ < L →
      (m ℓ : ℝ) ≤ (1 / (phaseEps ε ℓ / 2) ^ 2) * Real.log (3 / phaseDelta δ ℓ) + 1)
    (c : ℕ → ℕ) (hc0 : c 0 = n) (hcstep : ∀ ℓ, 2 * c (ℓ + 1) ≤ c ℓ + 1) :
    (∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.range L, (c ℓ : ℝ) * (m ℓ : ℝ))
      ≤ 20000 * (((n : ℝ) / ε ^ 2) * Real.log (3 / δ) + n) := by
  have hnR : (1:ℝ) ≤ (n:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hnpos : (0:ℝ) < (n:ℝ) := by linarith
  have hcard_hi : ∀ ℓ, 2^ℓ * c ℓ + 1 ≤ n + 2^ℓ := by
    intro ℓ
    induction ℓ with
    | zero => simp [hc0]
    | succ ℓ ih =>
      have h1 : 2 * c (ℓ+1) ≤ c ℓ + 1 := hcstep ℓ
      have h2 : 2^ℓ * (2 * c (ℓ+1)) ≤ 2^ℓ * (c ℓ + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h1
      have h3 : (2:ℕ)^(ℓ+1) * c (ℓ+1) = 2^ℓ * (2 * c (ℓ+1)) := by ring
      have h4 : (2:ℕ)^ℓ * (c ℓ + 1) = 2^ℓ * c ℓ + 2^ℓ := by ring
      have h5 : (2:ℕ)^(ℓ+1) = 2 * 2^ℓ := by ring
      omega
  have hlog2 : (0.69:ℝ) < Real.log 2 := by linarith [Real.log_two_gt_d9]
  have hlog2' : Real.log 2 < 0.7 := by linarith [Real.log_two_lt_d9]
  have hAgt : Real.log 2 < Real.log (3/δ) := by
    apply Real.log_lt_log (by norm_num)
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ hδ]; linarith
  set A := Real.log (3/δ) with hAdef
  have hApos : (0.69:ℝ) < A := by linarith
  have hε2 : (0:ℝ) < ε^2 := by positivity
  have hne : (0:ℝ) ≤ (n:ℝ)/ε^2 := by positivity
  have hterm : ∀ ℓ ∈ Finset.range L,
      (c ℓ : ℝ) * (m ℓ : ℝ)
        ≤ 128 * ((n:ℝ)/ε^2) * A * (8/9)^ℓ
          + 128 * ((n:ℝ)/ε^2) * Real.log 2 * (((ℓ:ℝ)+1) * (8/9)^ℓ)
          + 2*(n:ℝ)*(1/2)^ℓ := by
    intro ℓ hℓ
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hℓ
    have hn2 : 1 < n := by
      by_contra hcon
      have : n = 1 := by omega
      rw [hL, this, Nat.clog_one_right] at hℓ
      omega
    have hpow : (2:ℕ)^ℓ ≤ n := by
      have h1 : (2:ℕ)^(Nat.clog 2 n - 1) < n := Nat.pow_pred_clog_lt_self (by norm_num) hn2
      have h2 : ℓ ≤ Nat.clog 2 n - 1 := by omega
      have h3 : (2:ℕ)^ℓ ≤ 2^(Nat.clog 2 n - 1) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) h2
      omega
    have hpowR : (0:ℝ) < (2:ℝ)^ℓ := by positivity
    have hcN : 2^ℓ * c ℓ ≤ 2*n := by
      have := hcard_hi ℓ
      omega
    have hc : (c ℓ : ℝ) ≤ 2*(n:ℝ)/2^ℓ := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hpowR]
      have : ((2:ℕ)^ℓ * c ℓ : ℕ) ≤ ((2*n : ℕ)) := hcN
      have h2 := (Nat.cast_le (α := ℝ)).2 this
      push_cast at h2
      linarith
    have hepsL : (1:ℝ) / (phaseEps ε ℓ / 2)^2 = (64/ε^2) * (16/9)^ℓ := by
      have h34 : (((3:ℝ)/4)^ℓ)^2 = ((9:ℝ)/16)^ℓ := by
        rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm ℓ 2, pow_mul]; norm_num
      have h169 : ((16:ℝ)/9)^ℓ = 1 / ((9:ℝ)/16)^ℓ := by
        rw [eq_div_iff (by positivity), ← mul_pow]; norm_num
      rw [phaseEps_eq, h169,
        show ((3:ℝ)/4)^ℓ * (ε/4)/2 = ((3:ℝ)/4)^ℓ * ε/8 by ring, div_pow, mul_pow, h34]
      have hpos : (0:ℝ) < ((9:ℝ)/16)^ℓ := by positivity
      field_simp
      norm_num
    have hlogL : Real.log (3 / phaseDelta δ ℓ) = A + ((ℓ:ℝ)+1) * Real.log 2 := by
      rw [phaseDelta_eq]
      have he : (3:ℝ) / (δ / 2^(ℓ+1)) = (3/δ) * 2^(ℓ+1) := by
        field_simp
      rw [he, Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity), Real.log_pow, hAdef]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hmm : (m ℓ : ℝ) ≤ (64/ε^2) * (16/9)^ℓ * (A + ((ℓ:ℝ)+1)*Real.log 2) + 1 := by
      have h := hm_le ℓ hℓ
      rw [hepsL, hlogL] at h
      exact h
    have hcnn : (0:ℝ) ≤ (c ℓ : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hmnn : (0:ℝ) ≤ (m ℓ : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hrhs : (0:ℝ) ≤ (64/ε^2) * (16/9)^ℓ * (A + ((ℓ:ℝ)+1)*Real.log 2) + 1 := by
      have h1 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (64/ε^2) * (16/9)^ℓ := by positivity
      have h2 : (0:ℝ) ≤ A + ((ℓ:ℝ)+1)*Real.log 2 := by
        have : (0:ℝ) ≤ ((ℓ:ℝ)+1)*Real.log 2 := by positivity
        linarith
      nlinarith
    have hprod := mul_le_mul hc hmm hmnn (by positivity)
    refine hprod.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [show ((8:ℝ)/9)^ℓ = ((16:ℝ)/9)^ℓ / 2^ℓ by rw [← div_pow]; norm_num,
      show ((1:ℝ)/2)^ℓ = 1/2^ℓ by rw [div_pow]; norm_num]
    have hεne : ε ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hε
    have h2ne : ((2:ℝ)^ℓ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp
    ring
  calc (∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.range L, (c ℓ : ℝ) * (m ℓ : ℝ))
      ≤ ∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.range L, (128 * ((n:ℝ)/ε^2) * A * (8/9)^ℓ
          + 128 * ((n:ℝ)/ε^2) * Real.log 2 * (((ℓ:ℝ)+1) * (8/9)^ℓ)
          + 2*(n:ℝ)*(1/2)^ℓ) := Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
    _ = 128 * ((n:ℝ)/ε^2) * A * (∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.range L, ((8:ℝ)/9)^ℓ)
          + 128 * ((n:ℝ)/ε^2) * Real.log 2 * (∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.range L, (((ℓ:ℝ)+1) * ((8:ℝ)/9)^ℓ))
          + 2*(n:ℝ)*(∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.range L, ((1:ℝ)/2)^ℓ) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib,
          ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    _ ≤ 128 * ((n:ℝ)/ε^2) * A * 9
          + 128 * ((n:ℝ)/ε^2) * Real.log 2 * 81
          + 2*(n:ℝ)*2 := by
        have g1 := geom_sum_89 L
        have g2 := geom_sum_89' L
        have g3 := geom_sum_half L
        have c1 : (0:ℝ) ≤ 128 * ((n:ℝ)/ε^2) * A := by nlinarith [hne, hApos]
        have c2 : (0:ℝ) ≤ 128 * ((n:ℝ)/ε^2) * Real.log 2 := by nlinarith [hne, hlog2]
        have c3 : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2*(n:ℝ) := by positivity
        linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left g1 c1, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left g2 c2,
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left g3 c3]
    _ ≤ 20000 * (((n:ℝ)/ε^2) * A + (n:ℝ)) := by
        have k1 : (0:ℝ) ≤ ((n:ℝ)/ε^2) * (A - 0.69) := mul_nonneg hne (by linarith)
        have k2 : (0:ℝ) ≤ ((n:ℝ)/ε^2) * (0.7 - Real.log 2) := mul_nonneg hne (by linarith)
        nlinarith [k1, k2, hne, hnpos]

theorem naive_PAC :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    ∀ {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
      {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (p : Fin n → ℝ)
      (astar : Fin n) (hopt : ∀ a, p a ≤ p astar)
      (ε δ : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
      (ℓ : ℕ) (hℓ : (2 / ε ^ 2) * Real.log (2 * n / δ) ≤ ℓ)
      (hℓ_le : (ℓ : ℝ) ≤ (2 / ε ^ 2) * Real.log (2 * n / δ) + 1)
      (X : Fin n → Fin ℓ → Ω → ℝ)
      (hX_meas : ∀ a k, Measurable (X a k))
      (hX_bound : ∀ a k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, X a k ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
      (hX_mean : ∀ a k, ∫ ω, X a k ω ∂P = p a)
      (hX_indep : iIndepFun (fun q : Fin n × Fin ℓ => X q.1 q.2) P)
      (hX_ident : ∀ a (k k' : Fin ℓ), ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X a k) (X a k') P P),
    (1 - δ ≤ P.real {ω | epsOptimal p (p astar) ε (naiveOutput X ω)}) ∧
    ((n : ℝ) * ℓ ≤ C * ((n / ε ^ 2) * Real.log (2 * n / δ) + n)) := by
  refine ⟨2, by norm_num, ?_⟩
  intro Ω _ P _ n _ p astar hopt ε δ hε hδ hδ1 ℓ hℓ hℓ_le X hX_meas hX_bound hX_mean hX_indep
    hX_ident
  have hn1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (n:ℝ) := by
    have : 1 ≤ n := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 (NeZero.ne n)
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hnpos : (0:ℝ) < (n:ℝ) := by linarith
  have hL : 0 < Real.log (2 * (n:ℝ) / δ) := by
    apply Real.log_pos
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ hδ]
    nlinarith
  have hε2 : (0:ℝ) < ε^2 := by positivity
  have hℓpos : (0:ℝ) < (ℓ:ℝ) := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hℓ
  have hℓ0 : 0 < ℓ := by exact_mod_cast hℓpos
  constructor
  · -- probability part
    have hne : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin ℓ)).Nonempty := ⟨⟨0, hℓ0⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
    have hexp : Real.exp (-2 * (ε/2)^2 * ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin ℓ)).card : ℝ))
        ≤ δ/(2*(n:ℝ)) := by
      have hcard : ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin ℓ)).card : ℝ) = (ℓ:ℝ) := by simp
      rw [hcard]
      have hid : Real.log (2 * (n:ℝ)/δ) = ((2/ε^2) * Real.log (2*(n:ℝ)/δ)) * (ε^2/2) := by
        field_simp
      have h1 : Real.log (2*(n:ℝ)/δ) ≤ 2*(ε/2)^2*(ℓ:ℝ) := by
        rw [hid]; nlinarith
      calc Real.exp (-2*(ε/2)^2*(ℓ:ℝ)) ≤ Real.exp (-Real.log (2*(n:ℝ)/δ)) := by
            apply Real.exp_le_exp.2; linarith
        _ = δ/(2*(n:ℝ)) := by
            rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log (by positivity), inv_div]
    have hdevU : ∀ a : Fin n, P.real {ω | ε/2 ≤ empMean X ω a - p a} ≤ δ/(2*(n:ℝ)) := by
      intro a
      have hinj : Function.Injective (fun k : Fin ℓ => ((a, k) : Fin n × Fin ℓ)) := by
        intro k k' h; simpa using h
      have hindep : iIndepFun (fun k : Fin ℓ => X a k) P :=
        iIndepFun.precomp (g := fun k : Fin ℓ => ((a, k) : Fin n × Fin ℓ)) hinj hX_indep
      have := emp_dev_upper (P := P) (fun k : Fin ℓ => X a k) (p a) Finset.univ hne
        (fun k => (hX_meas a k).aemeasurable) (fun k => hX_bound a k) (fun k => hX_mean a k)
        hindep (η := ε/2) (by positivity)
      refine le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) (this.trans hexp)
      congr 1
      ext ω
      simp [empMean]
    have hdevL : ∀ a : Fin n, P.real {ω | ε/2 ≤ p a - empMean X ω a} ≤ δ/(2*(n:ℝ)) := by
      intro a
      have hinj : Function.Injective (fun k : Fin ℓ => ((a, k) : Fin n × Fin ℓ)) := by
        intro k k' h; simpa using h
      have hindep : iIndepFun (fun k : Fin ℓ => X a k) P :=
        iIndepFun.precomp (g := fun k : Fin ℓ => ((a, k) : Fin n × Fin ℓ)) hinj hX_indep
      have := emp_dev_lower (P := P) (fun k : Fin ℓ => X a k) (p a) Finset.univ hne
        (fun k => (hX_meas a k).aemeasurable) (fun k => hX_bound a k) (fun k => hX_mean a k)
        hindep (η := ε/2) (by positivity)
      refine le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) (this.trans hexp)
      congr 1
      ext ω
      simp [empMean]
    set B : Set Ω := ⋃ a : Fin n,
      ({ω | ε/2 ≤ empMean X ω a - p a} ∪ {ω | ε/2 ≤ p a - empMean X ω a}) with hBdef
    have hBle : P.real B ≤ δ := by
      refine (measureReal_iUnion_fintype_le _).trans ?_
      have hterm : ∀ a : Fin n,
          P.real ({ω | ε/2 ≤ empMean X ω a - p a} ∪ {ω | ε/2 ≤ p a - empMean X ω a})
            ≤ δ/(n:ℝ) := by
        intro a
        refine (measureReal_union_le _ _).trans ?_
        have heq : δ/(2*(n:ℝ)) + δ/(2*(n:ℝ)) = δ/(n:ℝ) := by field_simp; ring
        linarith [hdevU a, hdevL a]
      refine (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun a _ => hterm a)).trans ?_
      rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
      norm_num
    have hgood : Bᶜ ⊆ {ω | epsOptimal p (p astar) ε (naiveOutput X ω)} := by
      intro ω hω
      simp only [hBdef, Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
        not_exists, not_or, not_le] at hω
      have hmax : ∀ x, empMean X ω x ≤ empMean X ω (naiveOutput X ω) :=
        (Finite.exists_max (empMean X ω)).choose_spec
      have h1 := (hω astar).2
      have h2 := (hω (naiveOutput X ω)).1
      have h3 := hmax astar
      show p astar - p (naiveOutput X ω) ≤ ε
      linarith
    have hcompl : {ω | epsOptimal p (p astar) ε (naiveOutput X ω)}ᶜ ⊆ B :=
      Set.compl_subset_comm.1 hgood
    have hmono : P.real {ω | epsOptimal p (p astar) ε (naiveOutput X ω)}ᶜ ≤ P.real B :=
      measureReal_mono hcompl (measure_ne_top _ _)
    have huniv : P.real (Set.univ : Set Ω) ≤
        P.real {ω | epsOptimal p (p astar) ε (naiveOutput X ω)} +
        P.real ({ω | epsOptimal p (p astar) ε (naiveOutput X ω)}ᶜ) := by
      rw [← Set.union_compl_self {ω | epsOptimal p (p astar) ε (naiveOutput X ω)}]
      exact measureReal_union_le _ _
    rw [probReal_univ] at huniv
    linarith
  · -- complexity part
    have hid : (n:ℝ)*((2/ε^2)*Real.log (2*(n:ℝ)/δ)) = 2*(((n:ℝ)/ε^2)*Real.log (2*(n:ℝ)/δ)) := by
      field_simp
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hℓ_le (le_of_lt hnpos)]

theorem successive_elimination_PAC :
    ∀ (c : ℝ), 4 < c →
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    ∀ {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
      {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (p : Fin n → ℝ)
      (astar : Fin n) (hopt : ∀ a, p a ≤ p astar)
      (hgap : ∀ a, a ≠ astar → p a < p astar)
      (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
      (X : Fin n → ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
      (hX_meas : ∀ a k, Measurable (X a k))
      (hX_bound : ∀ a k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, X a k ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
      (hX_mean : ∀ a k, ∫ ω, X a k ω ∂P = p a)
      (hX_indep : iIndepFun (fun q : Fin n × ℕ => X q.1 q.2) P)
      (hX_ident : ∀ a k, IdentDistrib (X a k) (X a 0) P P)
      (S : ℕ → Ω → Finset (Fin n))
      (hS0 : ∀ ω, S 0 ω = Finset.univ)
      (hSsub : ∀ t ω, S (t + 1) ω ⊆ S t ω)
      (hSrule : ∀ t ω a, a ∈ S t ω →
          (a ∈ S (t + 1) ω ↔
            ∀ b ∈ S t ω, empMeanT X b (t + 1) ω - empMeanT X a (t + 1) ω <
              2 * confRadiusSE c n (t + 1) δ)),
      1 - δ ≤ P.real {ω | ∃ T : ℕ,
        (∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (S t ω).card : ℝ) ≤
          C * ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.erase astar,
            Real.log (n / (δ * (p astar - p a))) / (p astar - p a) ^ 2
        ∧ ∀ t, T ≤ t → S t ω = {astar}} := by
  intro c hc
  refine ⟨2 * (1000 * (1 + c) + 2), by nlinarith, ?_⟩
  intro Ω _ P _ n _ p astar hopt hgap δ hδ hδ1 X hX_meas hX_bound hX_mean hX_indep hX_ident
    S hS0 hSsub hSrule
  have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 (NeZero.ne n)
  have hnR : (1:ℝ) ≤ (n:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn1
  have hint : ∀ a k, Integrable (X a k) P := fun a k =>
    Integrable.of_mem_Icc 0 1 (hX_meas a k).aemeasurable (hX_bound a k)
  have hp0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a := by
    intro a
    rw [← hX_mean a 0]
    exact integral_nonneg_of_ae (by filter_upwards [hX_bound a 0] with ω hω using hω.1)
  have hp1 : ∀ a, p a ≤ 1 := by
    intro a
    rw [← hX_mean a 0]
    have h := integral_mono_ae (hint a 0) (integrable_const (1:ℝ))
      (by filter_upwards [hX_bound a 0] with ω hω using hω.2)
    simpa using h
  have hindep : ∀ a : Fin n, iIndepFun (fun k : ℕ => X a k) P := by
    intro a
    have hinj : Function.Injective (fun k : ℕ => ((a, k) : Fin n × ℕ)) := by
      intro k k' h; simpa using h
    exact iIndepFun.precomp (g := fun k : ℕ => ((a, k) : Fin n × ℕ)) hinj hX_indep
  -- deviation bound for a single (t,a)
  have hBbound : ∀ (t : ℕ) (a : Fin n),
      P.real ({ω | confRadiusSE c n (t+1) δ ≤ empMeanT X a (t+1) ω - p a} ∪
              {ω | confRadiusSE c n (t+1) δ ≤ p a - empMeanT X a (t+1) ω})
        ≤ 2 * δ / (c * n * ((t:ℝ)+1)^2) := by
    intro t a
    have hne : (Finset.range (t+1)).Nonempty := ⟨0, by simp⟩
    have hη : 0 ≤ confRadiusSE c n (t+1) δ := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have hU := emp_dev_upper (P := P) (fun k : ℕ => X a k) (p a) (Finset.range (t+1)) hne
      (fun k => (hX_meas a k).aemeasurable) (fun k => hX_bound a k) (fun k => hX_mean a k)
      (hindep a) hη
    have hLo := emp_dev_lower (P := P) (fun k : ℕ => X a k) (p a) (Finset.range (t+1)) hne
      (fun k => (hX_meas a k).aemeasurable) (fun k => hX_bound a k) (fun k => hX_mean a k)
      (hindep a) hη
    simp only [Finset.card_range] at hU hLo
    have hcp := conf_prob c hc δ hδ hδ1 n hn1 (t+1) (by omega)
    push_cast at hcp
    refine (measureReal_union_le _ _).trans ?_
    have e1 : {ω | confRadiusSE c n (t+1) δ ≤ empMeanT X a (t+1) ω - p a}
        = {ω | confRadiusSE c n (t+1) δ ≤ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (t+1), X a i ω) / ((t+1 : ℕ):ℝ)
              - p a} := rfl
    have e2 : {ω | confRadiusSE c n (t+1) δ ≤ p a - empMeanT X a (t+1) ω}
        = {ω | confRadiusSE c n (t+1) δ ≤ p a
              - (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (t+1), X a i ω) / ((t+1 : ℕ):ℝ)} := rfl
    rw [e1, e2]
    have hexp : Real.exp (-2 * (confRadiusSE c n (t+1) δ)^2 * ((t+1 : ℕ):ℝ))
        ≤ δ / (c * n * ((t:ℝ)+1)^2) := by push_cast; exact hcp
    have hU' := hU.trans hexp
    have hLo' := hLo.trans hexp
    have : 2 * δ / (c * (n:ℝ) * ((t:ℝ)+1)^2)
        = δ / (c * (n:ℝ) * ((t:ℝ)+1)^2) + δ / (c * (n:ℝ) * ((t:ℝ)+1)^2) := by ring
    rw [this]
    have hcast : ((t+1 : ℕ):ℝ) = (t:ℝ)+1 := by push_cast; ring
    rw [hcast] at hU' hLo'
    linarith [hU', hLo']
  -- union bound
  set Bs : ℕ → Fin n → Set Ω := fun t a =>
    ({ω | confRadiusSE c n (t+1) δ ≤ empMeanT X a (t+1) ω - p a} ∪
     {ω | confRadiusSE c n (t+1) δ ≤ p a - empMeanT X a (t+1) ω}) with hBsdef
  set Apart : ℕ → Set Ω := fun N => ⋃ t ∈ Finset.range N, ⋃ a : Fin n, Bs t a with hApartdef
  have hAmono : Monotone Apart := by
    intro N M hNM x hx
    simp only [hApartdef, Set.mem_iUnion, Finset.mem_range] at hx ⊢
    obtain ⟨t, htN, a, ha⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨t, lt_of_lt_of_le htN hNM, a, ha⟩
  have hcpos : (0:ℝ) < c := by linarith
  have hAb : ∀ N, P.real (Apart N) ≤ 4 * δ / c := by
    intro N
    have h1 : P.real (Apart N) ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.range N, P.real (⋃ a : Fin n, Bs t a) :=
      measureReal_biUnion_finset_le _ _
    have h2 : ∀ t : ℕ, P.real (⋃ a : Fin n, Bs t a) ≤ 2 * δ / (c * ((t:ℝ)+1)^2) := by
      intro t
      refine (measureReal_iUnion_fintype_le _).trans ?_
      refine (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun a _ => hBbound t a)).trans ?_
      rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
      have hnne : (n:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by linarith
      have htne : ((t:ℝ)+1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp
      norm_num
    have h3 : ∑ t ∈ Finset.range N, (2 * δ / (c * ((t:ℝ)+1)^2))
        = (2*δ/c) * ∑ t ∈ Finset.range N, (1:ℝ)/((t:ℝ)+1)^2 := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun t _ => ?_)
      have htne : ((t:ℝ)+1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp
    have h4 : (2*δ/c) * ∑ t ∈ Finset.range N, (1:ℝ)/((t:ℝ)+1)^2 ≤ (2*δ/c) * 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sum_inv_sq_le N) (by positivity)
    have h5 := (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun t (_ : t ∈ Finset.range N) => h2 t))
    rw [h3] at h5
    have : (2*δ/c)*2 = 4*δ/c := by ring
    linarith
  set Bad : Set Ω := ⋃ N, Apart N with hBaddef
  have hBadb : P.real Bad ≤ 4 * δ / c := by
    have hmu : P Bad = ⨆ N, P (Apart N) := hAmono.measure_iUnion
    have hle : ∀ N, P (Apart N) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (4*δ/c) := by
      intro N
      exact (ENNReal.le_ofReal_iff_toReal_le (measure_ne_top _ _) (by positivity)).2 (hAb N)
    have hb : P Bad ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (4*δ/c) := by rw [hmu]; exact iSup_le hle
    have := ENNReal.toReal_mono (by finiteness) hb
    rwa [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity)] at this
  -- deterministic part
  set u : Fin n → ℕ := fun a =>
    ⌈(1000*(1+c)) * Real.log ((n:ℝ)/(δ*(p astar - p a))) / (p astar - p a)^2⌉₊ with hudef
  have hkey : ∀ a : Fin n, a ≠ astar → 1 ≤ u a ∧
      confRadiusSE c n (u a) δ ≤ (p astar - p a)/4 ∧
      (u a : ℝ) ≤ (1000*(1+c)+2) * Real.log ((n:ℝ)/(δ*(p astar - p a))) / (p astar - p a)^2 := by
    intro a hne
    have hΔ : 0 < p astar - p a := by linarith [hgap a hne]
    have hΔ1 : p astar - p a ≤ 1 := by linarith [hp0 a, hp1 astar]
    have hn2 : 2 ≤ n := by
      have hnt : Nontrivial (Fin n) := ⟨⟨a, astar, hne⟩⟩
      have h := Fintype.one_lt_card (α := Fin n)
      simpa using h
    have hLpos : 0 < Real.log ((n:ℝ)/(δ*(p astar - p a))) := by
      apply Real.log_pos
      rw [lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      have : (2:ℝ) ≤ (n:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn2
      nlinarith
    have hnn : (0:ℝ) ≤ (1000*(1+c)) * Real.log ((n:ℝ)/(δ*(p astar - p a))) / (p astar - p a)^2 := by
      have : (0:ℝ) < 1000*(1+c) := by linarith
      positivity
    exact key_time c hc δ hδ hδ1 n hn2 _ hΔ hΔ1 (u a) (Nat.le_ceil _)
      (Nat.ceil_lt_add_one hnn).le
  have hdet : Badᶜ ⊆ {ω | ∃ T : ℕ,
      (∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (S t ω).card : ℝ) ≤
        (2 * (1000 * (1 + c) + 2)) * ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.erase astar,
          Real.log (n / (δ * (p astar - p a))) / (p astar - p a) ^ 2
      ∧ ∀ t, T ≤ t → S t ω = {astar}} := by
    intro ω hω
    have hdev : ∀ (t : ℕ) (a : Fin n),
        empMeanT X a (t+1) ω - p a < confRadiusSE c n (t+1) δ ∧
        p a - empMeanT X a (t+1) ω < confRadiusSE c n (t+1) δ := by
      intro t a
      have hnot : ω ∉ Bs t a := by
        intro hmem
        refine hω ?_
        simp only [hBaddef, Set.mem_iUnion]
        refine ⟨t+1, ?_⟩
        simp only [hApartdef, Set.mem_iUnion, Finset.mem_range]
        exact ⟨t, Nat.lt_succ_self t, a, hmem⟩
      simp only [hBsdef, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_or, not_le] at hnot
      exact hnot
    have hstar : ∀ t, astar ∈ S t ω := by
      intro t
      induction t with
      | zero => rw [hS0]; exact Finset.mem_univ _
      | succ t ih =>
        rw [hSrule t ω astar ih]
        intro b hb
        have h1 := (hdev t b).1
        have h2 := (hdev t astar).2
        have h3 := hopt b
        linarith
    have hSmono : ∀ t t', t ≤ t' → S t' ω ⊆ S t ω := by
      have key : ∀ (t d : ℕ), S (t+d) ω ⊆ S t ω := by
        intro t d
        induction d with
        | zero => exact subset_rfl
        | succ d ih =>
          have he : t + (d+1) = (t+d)+1 := by ring
          rw [he]
          exact (hSsub (t+d) ω).trans ih
      intro t t' h
      obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h
      exact key t d
    have hout : ∀ a : Fin n, a ≠ astar → ∀ t, u a ≤ t → a ∉ S t ω := by
      intro a hne t ht
      obtain ⟨k1, hk2, hk3⟩ := hkey a hne
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v, u a = v + 1 := ⟨u a - 1, by omega⟩
      rw [hv] at hk2
      have hnotin : a ∉ S (v+1) ω := by
        by_cases hmem : a ∈ S v ω
        · intro hcon
          have h := (hSrule v ω a hmem).1 hcon astar (hstar v)
          have h1 := (hdev v astar).2
          have h2 := (hdev v a).1
          linarith
        · exact fun hcon => hmem (hSsub v ω hcon)
      rw [hv] at ht
      intro hcon
      exact hnotin (hSmono (v+1) t ht hcon)
    refine ⟨(Finset.univ.erase astar).sup u, ?_, ?_⟩
    · set T : ℕ := (Finset.univ.erase astar).sup u with hTdef
      have e1 : ∀ t, (S t ω).card = ∑ a : Fin n, (if a ∈ S t ω then 1 else 0) := by
        intro t; simp [Finset.sum_ite_mem]
      have e2 : ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (S t ω).card
          = ∑ a : Fin n, ((Finset.range T).filter (fun t => a ∈ S t ω)).card := by
        simp_rw [e1]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => (Finset.card_filter _ _).symm)
      have e3 : ∀ a : Fin n, a ≠ astar →
          ((Finset.range T).filter (fun t => a ∈ S t ω)).card ≤ u a := by
        intro a hne
        have hsub : (Finset.range T).filter (fun t => a ∈ S t ω) ⊆ Finset.range (u a) := by
          intro t htt
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at htt ⊢
          by_contra hcon
          exact hout a hne t (by omega) htt.2
        calc ((Finset.range T).filter (fun t => a ∈ S t ω)).card
            ≤ (Finset.range (u a)).card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
          _ = u a := Finset.card_range _
      have e4 : ((Finset.range T).filter (fun t => astar ∈ S t ω)).card ≤ T := by
        calc ((Finset.range T).filter (fun t => astar ∈ S t ω)).card
            ≤ (Finset.range T).card := Finset.card_le_card (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
          _ = T := Finset.card_range _
      have e5 : T ≤ ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.erase astar, u a := by
        apply Finset.sup_le
        intro a ha
        exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => Nat.zero_le _) ha
      have e6 : ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.erase astar,
            ((Finset.range T).filter (fun t => a ∈ S t ω)).card
          ≤ ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.erase astar, u a :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun a ha => e3 a (Finset.mem_erase.1 ha).1)
      have eNat : ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (S t ω).card
          ≤ 2 * ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.erase astar, u a := by
        rw [e2, ← Finset.add_sum_erase Finset.univ _ (Finset.mem_univ astar)]
        omega
      have hfin : ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.erase astar, ((u a : ℝ))
          ≤ ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.erase astar,
              ((1000*(1+c)+2) * Real.log ((n:ℝ)/(δ*(p astar - p a))) / (p astar - p a)^2) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun a ha => (hkey a (Finset.mem_erase.1 ha).1).2.2)
      have hpull : ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.erase astar,
              ((1000*(1+c)+2) * Real.log ((n:ℝ)/(δ*(p astar - p a))) / (p astar - p a)^2)
          = (1000*(1+c)+2) * ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.erase astar,
              (Real.log ((n:ℝ)/(δ*(p astar - p a))) / (p astar - p a)^2) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => by ring)
      have eR : (∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, ((S t ω).card : ℝ))
          ≤ 2 * ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.erase astar, ((u a : ℝ)) := by
        have := (Nat.cast_le (α := ℝ)).2 eNat
        push_cast at this
        exact this
      rw [hpull] at hfin
      calc (∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, ((S t ω).card : ℝ))
          ≤ 2 * ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.erase astar, ((u a : ℝ)) := eR
        _ ≤ 2 * ((1000*(1+c)+2) * ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.erase astar,
              (Real.log ((n:ℝ)/(δ*(p astar - p a))) / (p astar - p a)^2)) := by linarith
        _ = (2 * (1000 * (1 + c) + 2)) * ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.erase astar,
              Real.log ((n:ℝ) / (δ * (p astar - p a))) / (p astar - p a) ^ 2 := by ring
    · intro t ht
      apply Finset.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.2
      refine ⟨hstar t, ?_⟩
      intro x hx
      by_contra hne
      exact hout x hne t
        (le_trans (Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨hne, Finset.mem_univ _⟩)) ht) hx
  -- conclusion
  set G : Set Ω := {ω | ∃ T : ℕ,
      (∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (S t ω).card : ℝ) ≤
        (2 * (1000 * (1 + c) + 2)) * ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.erase astar,
          Real.log (n / (δ * (p astar - p a))) / (p astar - p a) ^ 2
      ∧ ∀ t, T ≤ t → S t ω = {astar}} with hGdef
  have hcompl : Gᶜ ⊆ Bad := Set.compl_subset_comm.1 hdet
  have hmono2 : P.real Gᶜ ≤ P.real Bad := measureReal_mono hcompl (measure_ne_top _ _)
  have huniv : P.real (Set.univ : Set Ω) ≤ P.real G + P.real Gᶜ := by
    rw [← Set.union_compl_self G]
    exact measureReal_union_le _ _
  rw [probReal_univ] at huniv
  have hlast : 4*δ/c ≤ δ := by rw [div_le_iff₀ hcpos]; nlinarith
  linarith


theorem median_elimination_PAC :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    ∀ {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
      {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (p : Fin n → ℝ)
      (astar : Fin n) (hopt : ∀ a, p a ≤ p astar)
      (ε δ : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
      (L : ℕ) (hL : L = Nat.clog 2 n)
      (m : ℕ → ℕ)
      (hm : ∀ ℓ, ℓ < L →
        (1 / (phaseEps ε ℓ / 2) ^ 2) * Real.log (3 / phaseDelta δ ℓ) ≤ m ℓ)
      (hm_le : ∀ ℓ, ℓ < L →
        (m ℓ : ℝ) ≤ (1 / (phaseEps ε ℓ / 2) ^ 2) * Real.log (3 / phaseDelta δ ℓ) + 1)
      (X : Fin n → ℕ → ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
      (hX_meas : ∀ a ℓ k, Measurable (X a ℓ k))
      (hX_bound : ∀ a ℓ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, X a ℓ k ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
      (hX_mean : ∀ a ℓ k, ∫ ω, X a ℓ k ω ∂P = p a)
      (hX_indep : iIndepFun (fun q : Fin n × ℕ × ℕ => X q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) P)
    (hX_ident : ∀ a ℓ k, IdentDistrib (X a ℓ k) (X a 0 0) P P)
      (S : ℕ → Ω → Finset (Fin n)) (hS_meas : ∀ ℓ s, MeasurableSet {ω | S ℓ ω = s})
      (hS0 : ∀ ω, S 0 ω = Finset.univ)
      (hSnonempty : ∀ ℓ ω, (S ℓ ω).Nonempty)
      (hScard : ∀ ℓ ω, 2 * (S (ℓ + 1) ω).card ≤ (S ℓ ω).card + 1)
      (hScard_lo : ∀ ℓ ω, (S ℓ ω).card ≤ 2 * (S (ℓ + 1) ω).card)
      (median : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (hmedian_meas : ∀ ℓ, Measurable (median ℓ))
      (hmedian_ge : ∀ ℓ ω, 2 * ((S ℓ ω).filter
          (fun a => median ℓ ω ≤ empMeanPhase X a ℓ (m ℓ) ω)).card ≥ (S ℓ ω).card)
      (hmedian_le : ∀ ℓ ω, 2 * ((S ℓ ω).filter
          (fun a => empMeanPhase X a ℓ (m ℓ) ω ≤ median ℓ ω)).card ≥ (S ℓ ω).card)
      (hSstep_lo : ∀ ℓ ω, (S ℓ ω).filter
          (fun a => median ℓ ω < empMeanPhase X a ℓ (m ℓ) ω) ⊆ S (ℓ + 1) ω)
      (hSstep_hi : ∀ ℓ ω, S (ℓ + 1) ω ⊆ (S ℓ ω).filter
          (fun a => median ℓ ω ≤ empMeanPhase X a ℓ (m ℓ) ω))
      (hS_adapted : ∀ ℓ ω ω',
          (∀ a j k, j ≤ ℓ → X a j k ω = X a j k ω') → S (ℓ + 1) ω = S (ℓ + 1) ω')
      (hmedian_adapted : ∀ ℓ ω ω',
          (∀ a j k, j ≤ ℓ → X a j k ω = X a j k ω') → median ℓ ω = median ℓ ω'),
    (1 - δ ≤ P.real {ω | ∀ a ∈ S L ω, epsOptimal p (p astar) ε a}) ∧
    (∀ ω, (∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.range L, (S ℓ ω).card * m ℓ : ℝ) ≤
        C * ((n / ε ^ 2) * Real.log (3 / δ) + n)) := by
  refine ⟨20000, by norm_num, ?_⟩
  intro Ω _ P _ n hn p astar hopt ε δ hε hδ hδ1 L hL m hm hm_le X hX_meas hX_bound hX_mean
    hX_indep hX_ident S hS_meas hS0 hSnonempty hScard hScard_lo median hmedian_meas
    hmedian_ge hmedian_le hSstep_lo hSstep_hi hS_adapted hmedian_adapted
  refine ⟨median_correct P hn p astar ε δ hε hδ hδ1 L hL m hm X hX_meas hX_bound hX_mean
      hX_indep S hS0 hSnonempty hScard hScard_lo median hSstep_lo hSstep_hi, ?_⟩
