section Abstract

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]

lemma hasDerivAt_lineE (u v : E) (t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => u + s • v) v t := by
  have h : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => s • v) v t := by
    simpa using (hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const v
  simpa using h.const_add u

lemma fderiv_apply_eq_inner {F : E → ℝ} {x : E} (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F x) (v : E) :
    fderiv ℝ F x v = inner ℝ (gradient F x) v := by
  have h := hF.hasGradientAt.hasFDerivAt
  rw [h.fderiv]
  rfl

lemma hasDerivAt_line_gradient {F : E → ℝ} (hF : Differentiable ℝ F) (u v : E) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => F (u + s • v)) (inner ℝ (gradient F (u + t • v)) v) t := by
  have h := (hF (u + t • v)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t (hasDerivAt_lineE u v t)
  rw [← fderiv_apply_eq_inner (hF _) v]
  exact h

/-- If `ψ'' ≥ -C` on `[0,b]` then `ψ b ≥ ψ 0 + ψ' 0 * b - C b²/2`. -/
lemma taylor_lower_bound (ψ ψ' ψ'' : ℝ → ℝ) (b C : ℝ) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (h1 : ∀ t, HasDerivAt ψ (ψ' t) t) (h2 : ∀ t, HasDerivAt ψ' (ψ'' t) t)
    (h3 : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) b, -C ≤ ψ'' t) :
    ψ 0 + ψ' 0 * b - C * b^2/2 ≤ ψ b := by
  set g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => ψ t - ψ 0 - ψ' 0 * t + C * t^2/2 with hgdef
  set g' : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => ψ' t - ψ' 0 + C * t with hg'def
  have hgd : ∀ t, HasDerivAt g (g' t) t := by
    intro t
    have e1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ψ s - ψ 0 - ψ' 0 * s) (ψ' t - ψ' 0) t := by
      have := ((h1 t).sub_const (ψ 0)).sub ((hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul (ψ' 0))
      simpa using this
    have e2 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => C * s^2/2) (C * t) t := by
      have := ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 t).const_mul C).div_const 2
      simp at this
      convert this using 1
      ring
    simpa [hgdef, hg'def] using e1.add e2
  have hg'd : ∀ t, HasDerivAt g' (ψ'' t + C) t := by
    intro t
    have := ((h2 t).sub_const (ψ' 0)).add ((hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul C)
    simpa using this
  have hmono' : MonotoneOn g' (Set.Icc 0 b) := by
    apply monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg (convex_Icc 0 b)
    · exact fun t _ => ((hg'd t).continuousAt).continuousWithinAt
    · exact fun t _ => (hg'd t).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    · intro t ht
      rw [(hg'd t).deriv]
      rw [interior_Icc] at ht
      have := h3 t ⟨le_of_lt ht.1, le_of_lt ht.2⟩
      linarith
  have hg'0 : g' 0 = 0 := by simp [hg'def]
  have hg'nonneg : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) b, 0 ≤ g' t := by
    intro t ht
    have := hmono' (Set.left_mem_Icc.mpr hb) ht ht.1
    rw [hg'0] at this
    exact this
  have hmono : MonotoneOn g (Set.Icc 0 b) := by
    apply monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg (convex_Icc 0 b)
    · exact fun t _ => ((hgd t).continuousAt).continuousWithinAt
    · exact fun t _ => (hgd t).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    · intro t ht
      rw [(hgd t).deriv]
      rw [interior_Icc] at ht
      exact hg'nonneg t ⟨le_of_lt ht.1, le_of_lt ht.2⟩
  have h0 : g 0 = 0 := by simp [hgdef]
  have := hmono (Set.left_mem_Icc.mpr hb) (Set.right_mem_Icc.mpr hb) hb
  rw [h0] at this
  simp only [hgdef] at this
  linarith

/-- Along every line, `F` has first and second derivatives, with the second derivative bounded
below by `-κ ‖v‖² F`. -/
def LineSecondDeriv (F : E → ℝ) (κ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v : E, ∃ G' G'' : ℝ → ℝ,
    (∀ t, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => F (u + s • v)) (G' t) t) ∧
    (∀ t, HasDerivAt G' (G'' t) t) ∧
    (∀ t, -(κ * ‖v‖^2 * F (u + t • v)) ≤ G'' t)

lemma quasi_convex {F : E → ℝ} {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hFpos : ∀ x, 0 ≤ F x)
    (hLS : LineSecondDeriv F κ) (u v : E) (hd : κ * ‖v - u‖^2 ≤ 1/2)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) :
    F (u + t • (v - u)) ≤ (4/3) * max (F u) (F v) := by
  obtain ⟨G', G'', hG1, hG2, hG3⟩ := hLS u (v - u)
  set ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => F (u + s • (v - u)) with hψdef
  have hcont : ContinuousOn ψ (Set.Icc 0 1) :=
    fun s _ => ((hG1 s).continuousAt).continuousWithinAt
  obtain ⟨α, hα, hmax⟩ :=
    (isCompact_Icc (a := (0:ℝ)) (b := 1)).exists_isMaxOn ⟨0, by norm_num⟩ hcont
  have hψ0 : ψ 0 = F u := by simp [hψdef]
  have hψ1 : ψ 1 = F v := by simp [hψdef]
  have hMnn : 0 ≤ ψ α := hFpos _
  have hmaxnn : 0 ≤ max (F u) (F v) := le_trans (hFpos u) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hkey : ψ α ≤ (4/3) * max (F u) (F v) := by
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hα.1 with h0 | h0
    · rw [← h0, hψ0]
      have : F u ≤ max (F u) (F v) := le_max_left _ _
      linarith
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hα.2 with h1 | h1
    · rw [h1, hψ1]
      have : F v ≤ max (F u) (F v) := le_max_right _ _
      linarith
    -- interior case
    have hnbhd : Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ∈ nhds α := by
      apply Icc_mem_nhds h0 h1
    have hlocmax : IsLocalMax ψ α := hmax.isLocalMax hnbhd
    have hG'α : G' α = 0 := by
      rw [← (hG1 α).deriv]
      exact hlocmax.deriv_eq_zero
    have hsub : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => α - r) (-1) s := by
      intro s
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id s).const_sub α
    have hχ1 : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => ψ (α - r)) (-G' (α - s)) s := by
      intro s
      have h := (hG1 (α - s)).comp s (hsub s)
      simpa using h
    have hχ2 : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => -G' (α - r)) (G'' (α - s)) s := by
      intro s
      have h := ((hG2 (α - s)).comp s (hsub s)).neg
      simpa using h
    set C : ℝ := κ * ‖v - u‖^2 * ψ α with hCdef
    have hbound : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) α, -C ≤ G'' (α - s) := by
      intro s hs
      have hmem : α - s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 := by
        constructor
        · linarith [hs.2]
        · linarith [hs.1, hα.2]
      have h1' : ψ (α - s) ≤ ψ α := hmax hmem
      have h2' := hG3 (α - s)
      have hkκ : 0 ≤ κ * ‖v - u‖^2 := by positivity
      have : κ * ‖v - u‖^2 * ψ (α - s) ≤ κ * ‖v - u‖^2 * ψ α :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1' hkκ
      have h3' : -(κ * ‖v - u‖^2 * ψ α) ≤ -(κ * ‖v - u‖^2 * ψ (α - s)) := by linarith
      exact le_trans h3' h2'
    have htay := taylor_lower_bound (fun r : ℝ => ψ (α - r)) (fun s => -G' (α - s))
      (fun s => G'' (α - s)) α C hα.1 hχ1 hχ2 hbound
    simp only [sub_zero, sub_self] at htay
    rw [hG'α] at htay
    have hα2 : α^2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [hα.1, hα.2]
    have hkκ : 0 ≤ κ * ‖v - u‖^2 := by positivity
    have hCα : C * α^2/2 ≤ ψ α / 4 := by
      rw [hCdef]
      have a2 : 0 ≤ κ * ‖v - u‖^2 * ψ α := mul_nonneg hkκ hMnn
      have step1 : κ * ‖v - u‖^2 * ψ α * α^2 ≤ κ * ‖v - u‖^2 * ψ α := by nlinarith
      have step2 : κ * ‖v - u‖^2 * ψ α ≤ (1/2) * ψ α := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hd hMnn
      linarith
    have hFu : F u ≤ max (F u) (F v) := le_max_left _ _
    rw [hψ0] at htay
    linarith
  exact le_trans (hmax ht) hkey

lemma key_lower {F : E → ℝ} {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hFpos : ∀ x, 0 ≤ F x)
    (hFdiff : Differentiable ℝ F) (hLS : LineSecondDeriv F κ) (u v : E)
    (hd : κ * ‖v - u‖^2 ≤ 1/2) :
    F u + inner ℝ (gradient F u) (v - u) - (1/3) * (F u + F v) ≤ F v := by
  obtain ⟨G', G'', hG1, hG2, hG3⟩ := hLS u (v - u)
  have hψ0 : F (u + (0:ℝ) • (v - u)) = F u := by simp
  have hψ1 : F (u + (1:ℝ) • (v - u)) = F v := by simp
  have hG'0 : G' 0 = inner ℝ (gradient F u) (v - u) := by
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => F (u + s • (v - u)))
        (inner ℝ (gradient F (u + (0:ℝ) • (v - u))) (v - u)) 0 :=
      hasDerivAt_line_gradient hFdiff u (v - u) 0
    have h2 := (hG1 0).unique h1
    rw [h2]
    simp
  have hkκ : 0 ≤ κ * ‖v - u‖^2 := by positivity
  have hbound : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1,
      -(κ * ‖v - u‖^2 * ((4/3) * max (F u) (F v))) ≤ G'' s := by
    intro s hs
    have h1 := hG3 s
    have h2 : F (u + s • (v - u)) ≤ (4/3) * max (F u) (F v) :=
      quasi_convex hκ hFpos hLS u v hd s hs
    have h3 : κ * ‖v - u‖^2 * F (u + s • (v - u))
        ≤ κ * ‖v - u‖^2 * ((4/3) * max (F u) (F v)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hkκ
    linarith
  have htay := taylor_lower_bound (fun s : ℝ => F (u + s • (v - u))) G' G'' 1
    (κ * ‖v - u‖^2 * ((4/3) * max (F u) (F v))) (by norm_num) hG1 hG2 hbound
  simp only [one_pow, mul_one] at htay
  rw [hψ0, hψ1, hG'0] at htay
  have hmax : max (F u) (F v) ≤ F u + F v := by
    rcases max_cases (F u) (F v) with ⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨h, _⟩ <;> rw [h] <;> linarith [hFpos u, hFpos v]
  have hmaxnn : 0 ≤ max (F u) (F v) := le_trans (hFpos u) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hCle : κ * ‖v - u‖^2 * ((4/3) * max (F u) (F v)) / 2 ≤ (1/3) * (F u + F v) := by
    have h1 : κ * ‖v - u‖^2 * ((4/3) * max (F u) (F v))
        ≤ (1/2) * ((4/3) * max (F u) (F v)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hd (by linarith)
    linarith
  linarith

lemma smooth_upper {F : E → ℝ} (hFdiff : Differentiable ℝ F) {LF : ℝ} (hLF : 0 ≤ LF)
    (hsmooth : ∀ u v : E, ‖gradient F u - gradient F v‖ ≤ LF * ‖u - v‖) (x y : E) :
    F y ≤ F x + inner ℝ (gradient F x) (y - x) + LF/2 * ‖y - x‖^2 := by
  set δ : E := y - x with hδ
  set c : ℝ := inner ℝ (gradient F x) δ with hc
  set h : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => F x + t * c + LF/2 * t^2 * ‖δ‖^2 - F (x + t • δ) with hhdef
  set h' : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => c + LF * t * ‖δ‖^2 - inner ℝ (gradient F (x + t • δ)) δ with hh'def
  have hhd : ∀ t, HasDerivAt h (h' t) t := by
    intro t
    have e1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => F x + s * c) c t := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).mul_const c).const_add (F x)
    have e2 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => LF/2 * s^2 * ‖δ‖^2) (LF * t * ‖δ‖^2) t := by
      have := (((hasDerivAt_pow 2 t).const_mul (LF/2)).mul_const (‖δ‖^2))
      simp only [Nat.cast_ofNat, pow_one, Nat.add_one_sub_one] at this
      convert this using 1
      ring
    have e3 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => F (x + s • δ))
        (inner ℝ (gradient F (x + t • δ)) δ) t := hasDerivAt_line_gradient hFdiff x δ t
    have := (e1.add e2).sub e3
    simpa [hhdef, hh'def] using this
  have hnn : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, 0 ≤ h' t := by
    intro t ht
    have hip : inner ℝ (gradient F (x + t • δ) - gradient F x) δ
        ≤ ‖gradient F (x + t • δ) - gradient F x‖ * ‖δ‖ := real_inner_le_norm _ _
    have hsm : ‖gradient F (x + t • δ) - gradient F x‖ ≤ LF * (t * ‖δ‖) := by
      have := hsmooth (x + t • δ) x
      have he : ‖x + t • δ - x‖ = t * ‖δ‖ := by
        rw [add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ht.1]
      rwa [he] at this
    have hexp : inner ℝ (gradient F (x + t • δ) - gradient F x) δ
        = inner ℝ (gradient F (x + t • δ)) δ - c := by
      rw [hc, inner_sub_left]
    have hd0 : 0 ≤ ‖δ‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have : inner ℝ (gradient F (x + t • δ)) δ - c ≤ LF * (t * ‖δ‖) * ‖δ‖ := by
      rw [← hexp]
      exact le_trans hip (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsm hd0)
    simp only [hh'def]
    nlinarith
  have hmono : MonotoneOn h (Set.Icc 0 1) := by
    apply monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg (convex_Icc 0 1)
    · exact fun t _ => ((hhd t).continuousAt).continuousWithinAt
    · exact fun t _ => (hhd t).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    · intro t ht
      rw [(hhd t).deriv]
      rw [interior_Icc] at ht
      exact hnn t ⟨le_of_lt ht.1, le_of_lt ht.2⟩
  have h0 : h 0 = 0 := by simp [hhdef]
  have h1 := hmono (Set.left_mem_Icc.mpr (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1))
    (Set.right_mem_Icc.mpr (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1)) (by norm_num)
  rw [h0] at h1
  simp only [hhdef] at h1
  have hy : x + (1:ℝ) • δ = y := by rw [hδ]; simp
  rw [hy] at h1
  linarith

lemma descent {F : E → ℝ} (hFdiff : Differentiable ℝ F) {LF η : ℝ} (hLF : 0 < LF)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hηLF : η ≤ 1/LF)
    (hsmooth : ∀ u v : E, ‖gradient F u - gradient F v‖ ≤ LF * ‖u - v‖) (x : E) :
    F (x - η • gradient F x) ≤ F x - (η/2) * ‖gradient F x‖^2 := by
  have h := smooth_upper hFdiff (le_of_lt hLF) hsmooth x (x - η • gradient F x)
  have hd : x - η • gradient F x - x = -(η • gradient F x) := by abel
  rw [hd] at h
  have h1 : inner ℝ (gradient F x) (-(η • gradient F x)) = -(η * ‖gradient F x‖^2) := by
    rw [inner_neg_right, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  have h2 : ‖-(η • gradient F x)‖^2 = η^2 * ‖gradient F x‖^2 := by
    rw [norm_neg, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hη), mul_pow]
  rw [h1, h2] at h
  have hLFη : LF * η ≤ 1 := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hLF] at hηLF
    linarith
  have hgnn : (0:ℝ) ≤ ‖gradient F x‖^2 := sq_nonneg _
  nlinarith

lemma gd_step {F : E → ℝ} {κ η : ℝ} (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hFpos : ∀ x, 0 ≤ F x) (hFdiff : Differentiable ℝ F) (hLS : LineSecondDeriv F κ)
    (hdesc : ∀ x : E, F (x - η • gradient F x) ≤ F x - (η/2) * ‖gradient F x‖^2)
    (x w : E) (hd : κ * ‖x - w‖^2 ≤ 1/2) :
    ‖x - η • gradient F x - w‖^2
      ≤ ‖x - w‖^2 + 2*η*F w - 2*η*F (x - η • gradient F x) + (2*η/3)*(F x + F w) := by
  set g : E := gradient F x with hg
  have hkl : F x + inner ℝ g (w - x) - (1/3)*(F x + F w) ≤ F w :=
    key_lower hκ hFpos hFdiff hLS x w (by rwa [norm_sub_rev])
  have hde := hdesc x
  have hinner : (inner ℝ (x - w) g : ℝ) = - inner ℝ g (w - x) := by
    have h1 : (inner ℝ g (w - x) : ℝ) = inner ℝ (w - x) g := real_inner_comm _ _
    have h2 : (inner ℝ (w - x) g : ℝ) = - inner ℝ (x - w) g := by
      rw [show w - x = -(x - w) from by abel, inner_neg_left]
    rw [h1, h2]; ring
  have hexp : ‖x - η • g - w‖^2
      = ‖x - w‖^2 + 2*η*(inner ℝ g (w - x) : ℝ) + η^2*‖g‖^2 := by
    have he : x - η • g - w = (x - w) - η • g := by abel
    rw [he, norm_sub_sq_real, real_inner_smul_right, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hη), mul_pow, hinner]
    ring
  have m1 : 2*η*(inner ℝ g (w - x) : ℝ)
      ≤ 2*η*(F w - F x + (1/3)*(F x + F w)) := by
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2*η)
    linarith
  have m2 : η*(η*‖g‖^2) ≤ η*(2*(F x - F (x - η • g))) := by
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (le_of_lt hη)
    linarith
  rw [hexp]
  nlinarith [m1, m2]

theorem abstract_gd {F : E → ℝ} {κ η : ℝ} (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hFpos : ∀ x, 0 ≤ F x) (hFdiff : Differentiable ℝ F)
    (hLS : LineSecondDeriv F κ)
    (hdesc : ∀ x : E, F (x - η • gradient F x) ≤ F x - (η/2) * ‖gradient F x‖^2)
    (w0 : E) (ws : ℕ → E) (hws0 : ws 0 = w0)
    (hwsS : ∀ t, ws (t+1) = ws t - η • gradient F (ws t))
    (T : ℕ) (w : E)
    (hnorm1 : η * T * F w ≤ ‖w - w0‖^2) (hnorm2 : η * F w0 ≤ ‖w - w0‖^2)
    (hwidth : 18 * κ * ‖w - w0‖^2 ≤ 1) :
    (∀ t, t ≤ T → ‖ws t - w‖ ≤ 3 * ‖w - w0‖)
    ∧ (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, F (ws t) ≤ 2 * (T:ℝ) * F w + (5/4) * ‖w - w0‖^2 / η) := by
  have hA0nn : (0:ℝ) ≤ ‖w - w0‖ := norm_nonneg _
  have hAt0 : ‖ws 0 - w‖ = ‖w - w0‖ := by rw [hws0, norm_sub_rev]
  have hFwnn : 0 ≤ F w := hFpos w
  have hsub0 : ∀ t : ℕ, (∑ s ∈ Finset.range t, F (ws s))
      ≤ F w0 + ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 t, F (ws s) := by
    intro t
    have hsubset : Finset.range t ⊆ insert 0 (Finset.Icc 1 t) := by
      intro s hs
      rw [Finset.mem_range] at hs
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos s with h | h
      · simp [h]
      · exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨h, le_of_lt hs⟩)
    have := Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsubset (fun i _ _ => hFpos (ws i))
    calc (∑ s ∈ Finset.range t, F (ws s))
        ≤ ∑ s ∈ insert 0 (Finset.Icc 1 t), F (ws s) := this
      _ = F w0 + ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 t, F (ws s) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_insert (by simp)]
          rw [hws0]
  have main : ∀ t, t ≤ T → ‖ws t - w‖^2 + 2*η*(∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 t, F (ws s))
      ≤ ‖w - w0‖^2 + (8/3)*η*(t:ℝ)*F w + (2/3)*η*(∑ s ∈ Finset.range t, F (ws s)) := by
    intro t
    induction t with
    | zero =>
        intro _
        simp only [Finset.Icc_self, Nat.cast_zero, Finset.range_zero, Finset.sum_empty,
          Finset.Icc_eq_empty_of_lt, mul_zero, add_zero]
        rw [hAt0]
        simp
    | succ k ih =>
        intro hk
        have hk' : k ≤ T := Nat.le_of_succ_le hk
        have ihk := ih hk'
        have hS1nn : 0 ≤ ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k, F (ws s) :=
          Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hFpos (ws i))
        have hkT : η * (k:ℝ) * F w ≤ ‖w - w0‖^2 := by
          have hkTc : (k:ℝ) ≤ (T:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk'
          nlinarith [hnorm1, mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hη) hFwnn]
        have hnormk : ‖ws k - w‖^2 ≤ 9 * ‖w - w0‖^2 := by
          have h1 := hsub0 k
          nlinarith [ihk, h1, hS1nn, hnorm2, hkT, mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hη) hFwnn]
        have hdk : κ * ‖ws k - w‖^2 ≤ 1/2 := by
          nlinarith [hnormk, hwidth, hκ, sq_nonneg (‖w - w0‖)]
        have hstep := gd_step hκ hη hFpos hFdiff hLS hdesc (ws k) w hdk
        rw [← hwsS k] at hstep
        rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega : 1 ≤ k + 1), Finset.sum_range_succ]
        push_cast
        linarith [hstep, ihk]
  constructor
  · intro t ht
    have hmt := main t ht
    have h1 := hsub0 t
    have hS1nn : 0 ≤ ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 t, F (ws s) :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hFpos (ws i))
    have htT : η * (t:ℝ) * F w ≤ ‖w - w0‖^2 := by
      have htTc : (t:ℝ) ≤ (T:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast ht
      nlinarith [hnorm1, mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hη) hFwnn]
    have hsq : ‖ws t - w‖^2 ≤ 9 * ‖w - w0‖^2 := by
      nlinarith [hmt, h1, hS1nn, hnorm2, htT]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (ws t - w), hA0nn, hsq]
  · have hmt := main T le_rfl
    have h1 := hsub0 T
    have hsqnn : (0:ℝ) ≤ ‖ws T - w‖^2 := sq_nonneg _
    have hkey : η * (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, F (ws t))
        ≤ η * (2 * (T:ℝ) * F w + (5/4) * ‖w - w0‖^2 / η) := by
      have hcancel : η * ((5/4) * ‖w - w0‖^2 / η) = (5/4) * ‖w - w0‖^2 := by
        field_simp
      rw [mul_add, hcancel]
      nlinarith [hmt, h1, hsqnn, hnorm2]
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hkey hη

lemma F_antitone {F : E → ℝ} {η : ℝ}
    (hdesc : ∀ x : E, F (x - η • gradient F x) ≤ F x - (η/2) * ‖gradient F x‖^2)
    (hηnn : 0 ≤ η)
    (ws : ℕ → E) (hwsS : ∀ t, ws (t+1) = ws t - η • gradient F (ws t)) :
    ∀ s t : ℕ, s ≤ t → F (ws t) ≤ F (ws s) := by
  have hstep : ∀ t : ℕ, F (ws (t+1)) ≤ F (ws t) := by
    intro t
    have h := hdesc (ws t)
    rw [← hwsS t] at h
    have : 0 ≤ (η/2) * ‖gradient F (ws t)‖^2 := by positivity
    linarith
  intro s t hst
  induction t with
  | zero => simp_all
  | succ k ih =>
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge s (k+1) with h | h
      · have hsk : s ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp h
        exact le_trans (hstep k) (ih hsk)
      · have : s = k + 1 := le_antisymm hst h
        rw [this]

end Abstract

section Helpers

variable {m d n : ℕ}

/-- Explicit gradient (as a vector in `Params m d`) of `w ↦ phi a σ w x`. -/
noncomputable def gphi (a : Fin m → ℝ) (σ : ℝ → ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (w : Params m d) : Params m d :=
  WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => ((1 / Real.sqrt (m:ℝ)) * (a j * deriv σ (inner ℝ (w j) x))) • x)

lemma gphi_apply (a : Fin m → ℝ) (σ : ℝ → ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (w : Params m d) (j : Fin m) :
    gphi a σ x w j = ((1 / Real.sqrt (m:ℝ)) * (a j * deriv σ (inner ℝ (w j) x))) • x := rfl

lemma inner_gphi (a : Fin m → ℝ) (σ : ℝ → ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (w v : Params m d) :
    inner ℝ (gphi a σ x w) v
      = (1 / Real.sqrt (m:ℝ)) * ∑ j, a j * deriv σ (inner ℝ (w j) x) * inner ℝ (v j) x := by
  rw [PiLp.inner_apply, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
  rw [show (gphi a σ x w).ofLp j = gphi a σ x w j from rfl, gphi_apply, real_inner_smul_left,
    real_inner_comm x (v.ofLp j)]
  ring

lemma hasFDerivAt_phi {σ : ℝ → ℝ} (hσ : Differentiable ℝ σ) (a : Fin m → ℝ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (w : Params m d) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun w : Params m d => phi a σ w x) (innerSL ℝ (gphi a σ x w)) w := by
  have key : ∀ j : Fin m, HasFDerivAt (fun w : Params m d => σ (inner ℝ (w j) x))
      ((deriv σ (inner ℝ (w j) x)) •
        ((innerSL ℝ x).comp (PiLp.proj 2 (fun _ : Fin m => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) j))) w := by
    intro j
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun w : Params m d => (inner ℝ (w j) x : ℝ))
        ((innerSL ℝ x).comp (PiLp.proj 2 (fun _ : Fin m => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) j)) w := by
      have he : (fun w : Params m d => (inner ℝ (w j) x : ℝ))
          = fun w => ((innerSL ℝ x).comp
              (PiLp.proj 2 (fun _ : Fin m => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) j)) w := by
        funext w; simp [real_inner_comm]
      rw [he]
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt _
    exact (hσ _).hasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt w h1
  have hsum : HasFDerivAt (fun w : Params m d => ∑ j, a j * σ (inner ℝ (w j) x))
      (∑ j, a j • ((deriv σ (inner ℝ (w j) x)) •
        ((innerSL ℝ x).comp (PiLp.proj 2 (fun _ : Fin m => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) j)))) w :=
    by
      have h := HasFDerivAt.sum
        (fun j (_ : j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m))) => (key j).const_mul (a j))
      have he : (∑ j : Fin m, fun (y : Params m d) => a j * σ (inner ℝ (y j) x))
          = fun y : Params m d => ∑ j, a j * σ (inner ℝ (y j) x) := by
        funext y; simp [Finset.sum_apply]
      rwa [he] at h
  have h2 := hsum.const_mul (1 / Real.sqrt (m:ℝ))
  have : (fun w : Params m d => phi a σ w x)
      = fun w : Params m d => (1 / Real.sqrt (m:ℝ)) * ∑ j, a j * σ (inner ℝ (w j) x) := rfl
  rw [this]
  convert h2 using 1
  ext v
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp', Function.comp_apply, innerSL_apply_apply, PiLp.proj_apply,
    smul_eq_mul]
  rw [inner_gphi, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
  rw [real_inner_comm x (v.ofLp j)]
  ring

lemma norm_sq_params (w : Params m d) : ‖w‖^2 = ∑ j, ‖w j‖^2 := by
  rw [PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2, Real.sq_sqrt]
  positivity

lemma norm_gphi_le {σ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ R : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (a : Fin m → ℝ) (ha : ∀ j, a j = 1 ∨ a j = -1)
    (hσ' : ∀ u, |deriv σ u| ≤ ℓ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ R) (w : Params m d) :
    ‖gphi a σ x w‖ ≤ ℓ * R := by
  have hmR : (0:ℝ) < (m:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hsm : Real.sqrt (m:ℝ) > 0 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hmR
  have hb : ∀ j : Fin m, ‖gphi a σ x w j‖^2 ≤ (ℓ*R)^2 / (m:ℝ) := by
    intro j
    rw [gphi_apply, norm_smul]
    have h1 : |a j| = 1 := by rcases ha j with h | h <;> simp [h]
    have h2 : |deriv σ (inner ℝ (w j) x)| ≤ ℓ := hσ' _
    have h3 : ‖(1 / Real.sqrt (m:ℝ)) * (a j * deriv σ (inner ℝ (w j) x))‖
        ≤ ℓ / Real.sqrt (m:ℝ) := by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_mul, h1, one_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 / Real.sqrt (m:ℝ))]
      rw [one_div]
      rw [inv_mul_eq_div, div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hsm]
      exact h2
    have hxn : ‖x‖ ≤ R := hx
    have : ‖(1 / Real.sqrt (m:ℝ)) * (a j * deriv σ (inner ℝ (w j) x))‖ * ‖x‖
        ≤ (ℓ / Real.sqrt (m:ℝ)) * R := by
      apply mul_le_mul h3 hxn (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    calc (‖(1 / Real.sqrt (m:ℝ)) * (a j * deriv σ (inner ℝ (w j) x))‖ * ‖x‖)^2
        ≤ ((ℓ / Real.sqrt (m:ℝ)) * R)^2 := by
          apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) this
      _ = (ℓ*R)^2 / (m:ℝ) := by
          rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt hmR)]
  have hsum : ‖gphi a σ x w‖^2 ≤ (ℓ*R)^2 := by
    rw [norm_sq_params]
    calc ∑ j : Fin m, ‖gphi a σ x w j‖^2 ≤ ∑ _j : Fin m, (ℓ*R)^2 / (m:ℝ) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => hb j)
      _ = (ℓ*R)^2 := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
          field_simp
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (gphi a σ x w), mul_nonneg hℓ hR]

lemma hasGradientAt_of_hasFDerivAt {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [CompleteSpace E] {F : E → ℝ} {y x : E} (h : HasFDerivAt F (innerSL ℝ y) x) :
    HasGradientAt F y x := by
  rw [hasGradientAt_iff_hasFDerivAt]
  convert h using 1

lemma innerSL_smul_real {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (c : ℝ) (y : E) : innerSL ℝ (c • y) = c • innerSL ℝ y := by
  ext z; simp

/-- Explicit gradient of the `i`-th sample loss. -/
noncomputable def gFhatI (a : Fin m → ℝ) (σ f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (xs : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ys : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n)
    (w : Params m d) : Params m d :=
  (deriv f (ys i * phi a σ w (xs i)) * ys i) • gphi a σ (xs i) w

/-- Explicit gradient of the empirical loss. -/
noncomputable def gF (a : Fin m → ℝ) (σ f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (xs : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ys : Fin n → ℝ)
    (w : Params m d) : Params m d :=
  (1/(n:ℝ)) • ∑ i, gFhatI a σ f xs ys i w

lemma hasFDerivAt_FhatI {σ f : ℝ → ℝ} (hσ : Differentiable ℝ σ) (hf : Differentiable ℝ f)
    (a : Fin m → ℝ) (xs : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ys : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n)
    (w : Params m d) :
    HasFDerivAt (FhatI a σ f xs ys i) (innerSL ℝ (gFhatI a σ f xs ys i w)) w := by
  have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun w : Params m d => ys i * phi a σ w (xs i))
      ((ys i) • innerSL ℝ (gphi a σ (xs i) w)) w :=
    (hasFDerivAt_phi hσ a (xs i) w).const_mul (ys i)
  have h2 := (hf _).hasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt w h1
  have he : (deriv f (ys i * phi a σ w (xs i))) • ((ys i) • innerSL ℝ (gphi a σ (xs i) w))
      = innerSL ℝ (gFhatI a σ f xs ys i w) := by
    rw [gFhatI, innerSL_smul_real, smul_smul]
  rw [← he]
  exact h2

lemma gradient_FhatI {σ f : ℝ → ℝ} (hσ : Differentiable ℝ σ) (hf : Differentiable ℝ f)
    (a : Fin m → ℝ) (xs : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ys : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n)
    (w : Params m d) :
    gradient (FhatI a σ f xs ys i) w = gFhatI a σ f xs ys i w :=
  (hasGradientAt_of_hasFDerivAt (hasFDerivAt_FhatI hσ hf a xs ys i w)).gradient

lemma hasFDerivAt_Fhat {σ f : ℝ → ℝ} (hσ : Differentiable ℝ σ) (hf : Differentiable ℝ f)
    (a : Fin m → ℝ) (xs : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ys : Fin n → ℝ)
    (w : Params m d) :
    HasFDerivAt (Fhat a σ f xs ys) (innerSL ℝ (gF a σ f xs ys w)) w := by
  have hsum : HasFDerivAt (fun w : Params m d => ∑ i, FhatI a σ f xs ys i w)
      (∑ i, innerSL ℝ (gFhatI a σ f xs ys i w)) w := by
    have h := HasFDerivAt.sum
      (fun i (_ : i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))) => hasFDerivAt_FhatI hσ hf a xs ys i w)
    have he : (∑ i : Fin n, fun (y : Params m d) => FhatI a σ f xs ys i y)
        = fun y : Params m d => ∑ i, FhatI a σ f xs ys i y := by
      funext y; simp [Finset.sum_apply]
    rwa [he] at h
  have h2 := hsum.const_mul (1/(n:ℝ))
  have he : (fun w : Params m d => Fhat a σ f xs ys w)
      = fun w : Params m d => (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, FhatI a σ f xs ys i w := rfl
  have he2 : (1/(n:ℝ)) • (∑ i, innerSL ℝ (gFhatI a σ f xs ys i w))
      = innerSL ℝ (gF a σ f xs ys w) := by
    rw [gF, innerSL_smul_real]
    congr 1
    ext z
    simp [PiLp.inner_apply, Finset.sum_apply]
  rw [show Fhat a σ f xs ys = fun w : Params m d => (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, FhatI a σ f xs ys i w from rfl,
    ← he2]
  exact h2

lemma gradient_Fhat {σ f : ℝ → ℝ} (hσ : Differentiable ℝ σ) (hf : Differentiable ℝ f)
    (a : Fin m → ℝ) (xs : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ys : Fin n → ℝ)
    (w : Params m d) :
    gradient (Fhat a σ f xs ys) w = gF a σ f xs ys w :=
  (hasGradientAt_of_hasFDerivAt (hasFDerivAt_Fhat hσ hf a xs ys w)).gradient

lemma norm_gradient_FhatI_le {σ f : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ R : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hσ : Differentiable ℝ σ) (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (hσ' : ∀ u, |deriv σ u| ≤ ℓ)
    (hfsb : ∀ u, |deriv f u| ≤ f u)
    (a : Fin m → ℝ) (ha : ∀ j, a j = 1 ∨ a j = -1)
    (xs : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ys : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, ‖xs i‖ ≤ R) (hy : ∀ i, ys i = 1 ∨ ys i = -1) (i : Fin n) (w : Params m d) :
    ‖gradient (FhatI a σ f xs ys i) w‖ ≤ ℓ * R * FhatI a σ f xs ys i w := by
  rw [gradient_FhatI hσ hf, gFhatI, norm_smul]
  have h1 : |ys i| = 1 := by rcases hy i with h | h <;> simp [h]
  have hq : |deriv f (ys i * phi a σ w (xs i))| ≤ f (ys i * phi a σ w (xs i)) := hfsb _
  have hqnn : 0 ≤ f (ys i * phi a σ w (xs i)) := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hq
  have h2 : ‖gphi a σ (xs i) w‖ ≤ ℓ * R := norm_gphi_le hm hℓ hR a ha hσ' (xs i) (hx i) w
  have h3 : ‖deriv f (ys i * phi a σ w (xs i)) * ys i‖
      ≤ f (ys i * phi a σ w (xs i)) := by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, h1, mul_one]
    exact hq
  calc ‖deriv f (ys i * phi a σ w (xs i)) * ys i‖ * ‖gphi a σ (xs i) w‖
      ≤ f (ys i * phi a σ w (xs i)) * (ℓ * R) :=
        mul_le_mul h3 h2 (norm_nonneg _) hqnn
    _ = ℓ * R * FhatI a σ f xs ys i w := by rw [FhatI]; ring

/-- Derivative along a line of the network output. -/
noncomputable def Pt1 (a : Fin m → ℝ) (σ : ℝ → ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (u v : Params m d) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / Real.sqrt (m:ℝ)) *
    ∑ j, a j * deriv σ (inner ℝ (u j) x + t * inner ℝ (v j) x) * inner ℝ (v j) x

/-- Second derivative along a line of the network output. -/
noncomputable def Pt2 (a : Fin m → ℝ) (σ : ℝ → ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (u v : Params m d) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / Real.sqrt (m:ℝ)) *
    ∑ j, a j * deriv (deriv σ) (inner ℝ (u j) x + t * inner ℝ (v j) x) *
      (inner ℝ (v j) x)^2

lemma inner_line_apply (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (u v : Params m d) (t : ℝ) (j : Fin m) :
    inner ℝ ((u + t • v) j) x = inner ℝ (u j) x + t * inner ℝ (v j) x := by
  show inner ℝ (u j + t • v j) x = _
  rw [inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left]

lemma inner_gphi_line (a : Fin m → ℝ) (σ : ℝ → ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (u v : Params m d) (t : ℝ) :
    inner ℝ (gphi a σ x (u + t • v)) v = Pt1 a σ x u v t := by
  rw [inner_gphi, Pt1]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
  rw [inner_line_apply]

lemma hasDerivAt_finsum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (F : ι → ℝ → ℝ) (F' : ι → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, HasDerivAt (F i) (F' i) t) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => ∑ i ∈ s, F i y) (∑ i ∈ s, F' i) t := by
  have h2 := HasDerivAt.sum h
  have he : (∑ i ∈ s, fun y : ℝ => F i y) = fun y : ℝ => ∑ i ∈ s, F i y := by
    funext y; simp [Finset.sum_apply]
  rwa [he] at h2

lemma hasDerivAt_line {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (u v : E) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => u + s • v) v t := by
  have h : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => s • v) v t := by
    simpa using (hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const v
  simpa using h.const_add u

lemma hasDerivAt_phi_line {σ : ℝ → ℝ} (hσ : Differentiable ℝ σ) (a : Fin m → ℝ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (u v : Params m d) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => phi a σ (u + s • v) x) (Pt1 a σ x u v t) t := by
  have h := (hasFDerivAt_phi hσ a x (u + t • v)).comp_hasDerivAt t (hasDerivAt_line u v t)
  rw [← inner_gphi_line]
  exact h

lemma hasDerivAt_Pt1 {σ : ℝ → ℝ} (hσd : Differentiable ℝ (deriv σ)) (a : Fin m → ℝ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (u v : Params m d) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (Pt1 a σ x u v) (Pt2 a σ x u v t) t := by
  have key : ∀ j : Fin m,
      HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => a j * deriv σ (inner ℝ (u j) x + s * inner ℝ (v j) x)
          * inner ℝ (v j) x)
        (a j * deriv (deriv σ) (inner ℝ (u j) x + t * inner ℝ (v j) x)
          * (inner ℝ (v j) x)^2) t := by
    intro j
    have h0 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => inner ℝ (u j) x + s * inner ℝ (v j) x)
        (inner ℝ (v j) x) t := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).mul_const (inner ℝ (v j) x : ℝ)).const_add
        (inner ℝ (u j) x : ℝ)
    have h1 := (hσd _).hasDerivAt.comp t h0
    have h2 := (h1.const_mul (a j)).mul_const (inner ℝ (v j) x : ℝ)
    convert h2 using 1
    ring
  have hsum : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ∑ j, a j * deriv σ (inner ℝ (u j) x + s * inner ℝ (v j) x)
      * inner ℝ (v j) x)
      (∑ j, a j * deriv (deriv σ) (inner ℝ (u j) x + t * inner ℝ (v j) x)
        * (inner ℝ (v j) x)^2) t :=
    hasDerivAt_finsum _ _ _ _ (fun j _ => key j)
  exact hsum.const_mul _

lemma abs_Pt2_le {σ : ℝ → ℝ} {L R : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (a : Fin m → ℝ) (ha : ∀ j, a j = 1 ∨ a j = -1)
    (hσ'' : ∀ y, |deriv (deriv σ) y| ≤ L)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ R)
    (u v : Params m d) (t : ℝ) :
    |Pt2 a σ x u v t| ≤ (1 / Real.sqrt (m:ℝ)) * (L * R^2 * ‖v‖^2) := by
  have hmR : (0:ℝ) < (m:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hsm : (0:ℝ) < Real.sqrt (m:ℝ) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hmR
  rw [Pt2, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 / Real.sqrt (m:ℝ))]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
  calc |∑ j, a j * deriv (deriv σ) (inner ℝ (u j) x + t * inner ℝ (v j) x)
          * (inner ℝ (v j) x)^2|
      ≤ ∑ j, |a j * deriv (deriv σ) (inner ℝ (u j) x + t * inner ℝ (v j) x)
          * (inner ℝ (v j) x)^2| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ j, L * (R^2 * ‖v j‖^2) := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => ?_)
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
        have h1 : |a j| = 1 := by rcases ha j with h | h <;> simp [h]
        have h2 : |(inner ℝ (v j) x : ℝ)^2| = (inner ℝ (v j) x : ℝ)^2 := abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)
        rw [h1, one_mul, h2]
        have h3 : (inner ℝ (v j) x : ℝ)^2 ≤ R^2 * ‖v j‖^2 := by
          have h4 : |(inner ℝ (v j) x : ℝ)| ≤ ‖v j‖ * ‖x‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
          have h5 : ‖v j‖ * ‖x‖ ≤ ‖v j‖ * R := by
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx (norm_nonneg _)
          nlinarith [abs_nonneg (inner ℝ (v j) x : ℝ), sq_abs (inner ℝ (v j) x : ℝ),
            norm_nonneg (v j), hR]
        exact mul_le_mul (hσ'' _) h3 (by positivity) hL
    _ = L * R^2 * ‖v‖^2 := by
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum, norm_sq_params]
        ring

/-- First derivative of the empirical loss along the line `s ↦ u + s • v`. -/
noncomputable def dF1 (a : Fin m → ℝ) (σ f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (xs : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ys : Fin n → ℝ)
    (u v : Params m d) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, deriv f (ys i * phi a σ (u + t • v) (xs i)) * (ys i * Pt1 a σ (xs i) u v t)

/-- Second derivative of the empirical loss along the line `s ↦ u + s • v`. -/
noncomputable def dF2 (a : Fin m → ℝ) (σ f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (xs : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ys : Fin n → ℝ)
    (u v : Params m d) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, (deriv (deriv f) (ys i * phi a σ (u + t • v) (xs i))
      * (ys i * Pt1 a σ (xs i) u v t)^2
    + deriv f (ys i * phi a σ (u + t • v) (xs i)) * (ys i * Pt2 a σ (xs i) u v t))

lemma hasDerivAt_q {σ : ℝ → ℝ} (hσ : Differentiable ℝ σ) (a : Fin m → ℝ)
    (xs : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ys : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n)
    (u v : Params m d) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ys i * phi a σ (u + s • v) (xs i))
      (ys i * Pt1 a σ (xs i) u v t) t :=
  (hasDerivAt_phi_line hσ a (xs i) u v t).const_mul (ys i)

lemma hasDerivAt_Fhat_line {σ f : ℝ → ℝ} (hσ : Differentiable ℝ σ) (hf : Differentiable ℝ f)
    (a : Fin m → ℝ) (xs : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ys : Fin n → ℝ)
    (u v : Params m d) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => Fhat a σ f xs ys (u + s • v)) (dF1 a σ f xs ys u v t) t := by
  have key : ∀ i : Fin n, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => f (ys i * phi a σ (u + s • v) (xs i)))
      (deriv f (ys i * phi a σ (u + t • v) (xs i)) * (ys i * Pt1 a σ (xs i) u v t)) t :=
    fun i => (hf _).hasDerivAt.comp t (hasDerivAt_q hσ a xs ys i u v t)
  have hsum := hasDerivAt_finsum (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))
    (fun i s => f (ys i * phi a σ (u + s • v) (xs i)))
    (fun i => deriv f (ys i * phi a σ (u + t • v) (xs i)) * (ys i * Pt1 a σ (xs i) u v t))
    t (fun i _ => key i)
  exact hsum.const_mul _

lemma hasDerivAt_dF1 {σ f : ℝ → ℝ} (hσ : Differentiable ℝ σ) (hσd : Differentiable ℝ (deriv σ))
    (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (hfd : Differentiable ℝ (deriv f))
    (a : Fin m → ℝ) (xs : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ys : Fin n → ℝ)
    (u v : Params m d) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (dF1 a σ f xs ys u v) (dF2 a σ f xs ys u v t) t := by
  have key : ∀ i : Fin n, HasDerivAt
      (fun s : ℝ => deriv f (ys i * phi a σ (u + s • v) (xs i)) * (ys i * Pt1 a σ (xs i) u v s))
      (deriv (deriv f) (ys i * phi a σ (u + t • v) (xs i)) * (ys i * Pt1 a σ (xs i) u v t)^2
        + deriv f (ys i * phi a σ (u + t • v) (xs i)) * (ys i * Pt2 a σ (xs i) u v t)) t := by
    intro i
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => deriv f (ys i * phi a σ (u + s • v) (xs i)))
        (deriv (deriv f) (ys i * phi a σ (u + t • v) (xs i)) * (ys i * Pt1 a σ (xs i) u v t)) t :=
      (hfd _).hasDerivAt.comp t (hasDerivAt_q hσ a xs ys i u v t)
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ys i * Pt1 a σ (xs i) u v s)
        (ys i * Pt2 a σ (xs i) u v t) t :=
      (hasDerivAt_Pt1 hσd a (xs i) u v t).const_mul (ys i)
    have h3 := h1.mul h2
    convert h3 using 1
    ring
  have hsum := hasDerivAt_finsum (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))
    (fun i s => deriv f (ys i * phi a σ (u + s • v) (xs i)) * (ys i * Pt1 a σ (xs i) u v s))
    (fun i => deriv (deriv f) (ys i * phi a σ (u + t • v) (xs i))
        * (ys i * Pt1 a σ (xs i) u v t)^2
      + deriv f (ys i * phi a σ (u + t • v) (xs i)) * (ys i * Pt2 a σ (xs i) u v t))
    t (fun i _ => key i)
  exact hsum.const_mul _

lemma deriv_deriv_nonneg {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (hfconv : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f)
    (y : ℝ) : 0 ≤ deriv (deriv f) y := by
  have hmono : Monotone (deriv f) := by
    have h := hfconv.monotoneOn_deriv (fun x _ => hf x)
    intro p q hpq
    exact h (Set.mem_univ p) (Set.mem_univ q) hpq
  exact hmono.deriv_nonneg

lemma dF2_lower {σ f : ℝ → ℝ} {L R : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (hfconv : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f)
    (hfsb : ∀ y, |deriv f y| ≤ f y)
    (hσ'' : ∀ y, |deriv (deriv σ) y| ≤ L)
    (a : Fin m → ℝ) (ha : ∀ j, a j = 1 ∨ a j = -1)
    (xs : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ys : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, ‖xs i‖ ≤ R) (hy : ∀ i, ys i = 1 ∨ ys i = -1)
    (u v : Params m d) (t : ℝ) :
    -(L * R^2 / Real.sqrt (m:ℝ) * ‖v‖^2) * Fhat a σ f xs ys (u + t • v)
      ≤ dF2 a σ f xs ys u v t := by
  have hmR : (0:ℝ) < (m:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hsm : (0:ℝ) < Real.sqrt (m:ℝ) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hmR
  set κ : ℝ := L * R^2 / Real.sqrt (m:ℝ) * ‖v‖^2 with hκdef
  have hterm : ∀ i : Fin n,
      -κ * f (ys i * phi a σ (u + t • v) (xs i))
      ≤ deriv (deriv f) (ys i * phi a σ (u + t • v) (xs i))
          * (ys i * Pt1 a σ (xs i) u v t)^2
        + deriv f (ys i * phi a σ (u + t • v) (xs i)) * (ys i * Pt2 a σ (xs i) u v t) := by
    intro i
    have hfq : 0 ≤ f (ys i * phi a σ (u + t • v) (xs i)) :=
      le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hfsb _)
    have h1 : 0 ≤ deriv (deriv f) (ys i * phi a σ (u + t • v) (xs i))
        * (ys i * Pt1 a σ (xs i) u v t)^2 :=
      mul_nonneg (deriv_deriv_nonneg hf hfconv _) (sq_nonneg _)
    have hy1 : |ys i| = 1 := by rcases hy i with h | h <;> simp [h]
    have hb := abs_Pt2_le hm hL hR a ha hσ'' (xs i) (hx i) u v t
    have h2 : |deriv f (ys i * phi a σ (u + t • v) (xs i)) * (ys i * Pt2 a σ (xs i) u v t)|
        ≤ κ * f (ys i * phi a σ (u + t • v) (xs i)) := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, hy1, one_mul]
      calc |deriv f (ys i * phi a σ (u + t • v) (xs i))| * |Pt2 a σ (xs i) u v t|
          ≤ f (ys i * phi a σ (u + t • v) (xs i))
              * ((1 / Real.sqrt (m:ℝ)) * (L * R^2 * ‖v‖^2)) :=
            mul_le_mul (hfsb _) hb (abs_nonneg _) hfq
        _ = κ * f (ys i * phi a σ (u + t • v) (xs i)) := by rw [hκdef]; ring
    have h3 := neg_abs_le (deriv f (ys i * phi a σ (u + t • v) (xs i))
      * (ys i * Pt2 a σ (xs i) u v t))
    linarith
  have hsum : ∑ i, (-κ * f (ys i * phi a σ (u + t • v) (xs i)))
      ≤ ∑ i, (deriv (deriv f) (ys i * phi a σ (u + t • v) (xs i))
          * (ys i * Pt1 a σ (xs i) u v t)^2
        + deriv f (ys i * phi a σ (u + t • v) (xs i)) * (ys i * Pt2 a σ (xs i) u v t)) :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hterm i)
  have hsum2 : -κ * ∑ i, f (ys i * phi a σ (u + t • v) (xs i))
      ≤ ∑ i, (deriv (deriv f) (ys i * phi a σ (u + t • v) (xs i))
          * (ys i * Pt1 a σ (xs i) u v t)^2
        + deriv f (ys i * phi a σ (u + t • v) (xs i)) * (ys i * Pt2 a σ (xs i) u v t)) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]; exact hsum
  have hnn : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 / (n:ℝ) := by positivity
  calc -κ * Fhat a σ f xs ys (u + t • v)
      = (1/(n:ℝ)) * (-κ * ∑ i, f (ys i * phi a σ (u + t • v) (xs i))) := by
        rw [Fhat]; ring
    _ ≤ (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, (deriv (deriv f) (ys i * phi a σ (u + t • v) (xs i))
          * (ys i * Pt1 a σ (xs i) u v t)^2
        + deriv f (ys i * phi a σ (u + t • v) (xs i)) * (ys i * Pt2 a σ (xs i) u v t)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum2 hnn
    _ = dF2 a σ f xs ys u v t := rfl

/-- The constant continuous-linear functional `w ↦ ⟪xs i, w j⟫`. -/
noncomputable def Kmap (xs : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (i : Fin n) (j : Fin m) :
    Params m d →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  (innerSL ℝ (xs i)).comp (PiLp.proj 2 (fun _ : Fin m => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) j)

lemma Kmap_apply (xs : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (i : Fin n) (j : Fin m)
    (w : Params m d) : Kmap xs i j w = inner ℝ (xs i) (w j) := rfl

lemma differentiable_inner_proj (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (j : Fin m) :
    Differentiable ℝ (fun w : Params m d => (inner ℝ (w j) x : ℝ)) := by
  have he : (fun w : Params m d => (inner ℝ (w j) x : ℝ))
      = fun w : Params m d =>
        ((innerSL ℝ x).comp (PiLp.proj 2 (fun _ : Fin m => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) j)) w := by
    funext w; simp [real_inner_comm]
  rw [he]
  exact (ContinuousLinearMap.differentiable _)

lemma differentiable_phi {σ : ℝ → ℝ} (hσ : Differentiable ℝ σ) (a : Fin m → ℝ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) : Differentiable ℝ (fun w : Params m d => phi a σ w x) :=
  fun w => (hasFDerivAt_phi hσ a x w).differentiableAt

/-- Coefficient appearing in the explicit formula for the Fréchet derivative. -/
noncomputable def cco (a : Fin m → ℝ) (σ f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (xs : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ys : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) (j : Fin m)
    (w : Params m d) : ℝ :=
  (1/(n:ℝ)) * (deriv f (ys i * phi a σ w (xs i)) * ys i)
    * ((1 / Real.sqrt (m:ℝ)) * (a j * deriv σ (inner ℝ (w j) (xs i))))

/-- Explicit Fréchet derivative of the empirical loss. -/
noncomputable def DF (a : Fin m → ℝ) (σ f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (xs : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ys : Fin n → ℝ)
    (w : Params m d) : Params m d →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  ∑ i, ∑ j, (cco a σ f xs ys i j w) • Kmap xs i j

lemma innerSL_gF_eq_DF (a : Fin m → ℝ) (σ f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (xs : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ys : Fin n → ℝ) (w : Params m d) :
    innerSL ℝ (gF a σ f xs ys w) = DF a σ f xs ys w := by
  ext z
  rw [DF]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    Kmap_apply, innerSL_apply_apply]
  rw [gF]
  rw [show (inner ℝ ((1/(n:ℝ)) • ∑ i, gFhatI a σ f xs ys i w) z : ℝ)
      = (1/(n:ℝ)) * inner ℝ (∑ i, gFhatI a σ f xs ys i w) z from real_inner_smul_left _ _ _]
  rw [show (inner ℝ (∑ i, gFhatI a σ f xs ys i w) z : ℝ)
      = ∑ i, (inner ℝ (gFhatI a σ f xs ys i w) z : ℝ) from
    sum_inner (𝕜 := ℝ) Finset.univ (fun i => gFhatI a σ f xs ys i w) z, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
  rw [gFhatI, real_inner_smul_left, inner_gphi]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
  rw [cco, real_inner_comm (xs i) (z.ofLp j)]
  ring

lemma differentiable_cco {σ f : ℝ → ℝ} (hσ : Differentiable ℝ σ)
    (hσd : Differentiable ℝ (deriv σ)) (hf : Differentiable ℝ f)
    (hfd : Differentiable ℝ (deriv f))
    (a : Fin m → ℝ) (xs : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ys : Fin n → ℝ)
    (i : Fin n) (j : Fin m) : Differentiable ℝ (cco a σ f xs ys i j) := by
  have h1 : Differentiable ℝ (fun w : Params m d => deriv f (ys i * phi a σ w (xs i))) :=
    hfd.comp (((differentiable_phi hσ a (xs i)).const_mul (ys i)))
  have h2 : Differentiable ℝ (fun w : Params m d => deriv σ (inner ℝ (w j) (xs i))) :=
    hσd.comp (differentiable_inner_proj (xs i) j)
  exact (((h1.mul_const (ys i)).const_mul (1/(n:ℝ)))).mul
    ((h2.const_mul (a j)).const_mul (1 / Real.sqrt (m:ℝ)))

lemma fderiv_Fhat_eq {σ f : ℝ → ℝ} (hσ : Differentiable ℝ σ) (hf : Differentiable ℝ f)
    (a : Fin m → ℝ) (xs : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ys : Fin n → ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (Fhat a σ f xs ys) = DF a σ f xs ys := by
  funext w
  rw [(hasFDerivAt_Fhat hσ hf a xs ys w).fderiv, innerSL_gF_eq_DF]

lemma differentiable_DF {σ f : ℝ → ℝ} (hσ : Differentiable ℝ σ)
    (hσd : Differentiable ℝ (deriv σ)) (hf : Differentiable ℝ f)
    (hfd : Differentiable ℝ (deriv f))
    (a : Fin m → ℝ) (xs : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ys : Fin n → ℝ) :
    Differentiable ℝ (DF a σ f xs ys) := by
  intro w
  refine DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun i _ => ?_)
  refine DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun j _ => ?_)
  exact ((differentiable_cco hσ hσd hf hfd a xs ys i j).smul_const (Kmap xs i j)) w

lemma iteratedFDeriv_two_line {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (F : E → ℝ) (hF2 : Differentiable ℝ (fderiv ℝ F)) (w v : E) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 F w (fun _ => v) = deriv (fun t : ℝ => fderiv ℝ F (w + t • v) v) 0 := by
  have h1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 F w (fun _ => v) = (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) w v) v := by
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_right]
    simp [iteratedFDeriv_one_apply, Fin.init]
  have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => fderiv ℝ F y v) ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) w).flip v) w := by
    have h := (hF2 w).hasFDerivAt.clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_const v w)
    simpa using h
  have h2' : HasFDerivAt (fun y => fderiv ℝ F y v) ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) w).flip v)
      ((fun s : ℝ => w + s • v) 0) := by simpa using h2
  have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => fderiv ℝ F (w + t • v) v)
      (((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) w).flip v) v) 0 := by
    have h := h2'.comp_hasDerivAt 0 (hasDerivAt_line w v 0)
    exact h
  rw [h1, h3.deriv, ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply]

lemma dF1_eq_fderiv {σ f : ℝ → ℝ} (hσ : Differentiable ℝ σ) (hf : Differentiable ℝ f)
    (a : Fin m → ℝ) (xs : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ys : Fin n → ℝ)
    (u v : Params m d) (t : ℝ) :
    dF1 a σ f xs ys u v t = fderiv ℝ (Fhat a σ f xs ys) (u + t • v) v := by
  have h1 := hasDerivAt_Fhat_line hσ hf a xs ys u v t
  have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => Fhat a σ f xs ys (u + s • v))
      (fderiv ℝ (Fhat a σ f xs ys) (u + t • v) v) t := by
    have h := (hasFDerivAt_Fhat hσ hf a xs ys (u + t • v)).comp_hasDerivAt t
      (hasDerivAt_line u v t)
    rw [(hasFDerivAt_Fhat hσ hf a xs ys (u + t • v)).fderiv]
    exact h
  exact h1.unique h2

lemma iteratedFDeriv_two_Fhat {σ f : ℝ → ℝ} (hσ : Differentiable ℝ σ)
    (hσd : Differentiable ℝ (deriv σ)) (hf : Differentiable ℝ f)
    (hfd : Differentiable ℝ (deriv f))
    (a : Fin m → ℝ) (xs : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ys : Fin n → ℝ)
    (w v : Params m d) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (Fhat a σ f xs ys) w (fun _ => v) = dF2 a σ f xs ys w v 0 := by
  have hF2 : Differentiable ℝ (fderiv ℝ (Fhat a σ f xs ys)) := by
    rw [fderiv_Fhat_eq hσ hf a xs ys]
    exact differentiable_DF hσ hσd hf hfd a xs ys
  rw [iteratedFDeriv_two_line _ hF2 w v]
  have he : (fun t : ℝ => fderiv ℝ (Fhat a σ f xs ys) (w + t • v) v)
      = dF1 a σ f xs ys w v := by
    funext t; rw [dF1_eq_fderiv hσ hf]
  rw [he]
  exact (hasDerivAt_dF1 hσ hσd hf hfd a xs ys w v 0).deriv

end Helpers

theorem lemma3_1 {m d n : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n)
    (R ℓ L : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (a : Fin m → ℝ) (ha : ∀ j, a j = 1 ∨ a j = -1)
    (hbal : (∑ j, a j) = 0)
    (σ f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hσ : Differentiable ℝ σ) (hσd : Differentiable ℝ (deriv σ)) (hσ' : ∀ u, |deriv σ u| ≤ ℓ)
    (hσ'' : ∀ u, |deriv (deriv σ) u| ≤ L)
    (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (hfd : Differentiable ℝ (deriv f)) (hfpos : ∀ u, 0 ≤ f u)

    (hfconv : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f)
    (hfsb : ∀ u, |deriv f u| ≤ f u)
    (hfdec : Antitone f)
    (hflim : Filter.Tendsto f Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
    (xs : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ys : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, ‖xs i‖ ≤ R) (hy : ∀ i, ys i = 1 ∨ ys i = -1)
    (w : Params m d) :
    (∀ i, ‖gradient (FhatI a σ f xs ys i) w‖ ≤ ℓ * R * FhatI a σ f xs ys i w)
    ∧ (∀ v : Params m d,
        -(L * R ^ 2 / Real.sqrt (m : ℝ)) * Fhat a σ f xs ys w * ‖v‖ ^ 2
          ≤ iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (Fhat a σ f xs ys) w (fun _ => v)) := by
  constructor
  · intro i
    exact norm_gradient_FhatI_le hm hℓ hR hσ hf hσ' hfsb a ha xs ys hx hy i w
  · intro v
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_two_Fhat hσ hσd hf hfd a xs ys w v]
    have h := dF2_lower (σ := σ) hm hL hR hf hfconv hfsb hσ'' a ha xs ys hx hy w v 0
    rw [show w + (0:ℝ) • v = w by simp] at h
    calc -(L * R ^ 2 / Real.sqrt (m : ℝ)) * Fhat a σ f xs ys w * ‖v‖ ^ 2
        = -(L * R^2 / Real.sqrt (m:ℝ) * ‖v‖^2) * Fhat a σ f xs ys w := by ring
      _ ≤ dF2 a σ f xs ys w v 0 := h

theorem thm3_2 {m d n : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (R ℓ L LF η : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hLF : 0 < LF) (hη0 : 0 < η) (hη : η ≤ 1 / LF)
    (a : Fin m → ℝ) (ha : ∀ j, a j = 1 ∨ a j = -1)
    (hbal : (∑ j, a j) = 0)
    (σ f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hσ : Differentiable ℝ σ) (hσd : Differentiable ℝ (deriv σ)) (hσ' : ∀ u, |deriv σ u| ≤ ℓ)
    (hσ'' : ∀ u, |deriv (deriv σ) u| ≤ L)
    (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (hfd : Differentiable ℝ (deriv f)) (hfpos : ∀ u, 0 ≤ f u)
    (hfconv : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f) (hf' : ∀ u, |deriv f u| ≤ 1)
    (hf'' : ∀ u, deriv (deriv f) u ≤ 1) (hfsb : ∀ u, |deriv f u| ≤ f u)
    (hfdec : Antitone f)
    (hflim : Filter.Tendsto f Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
    (xs : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ys : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, ‖xs i‖ ≤ R) (hy : ∀ i, ys i = 1 ∨ ys i = -1)
    (w0 w : Params m d)
    (hsmooth : ∀ u v, ‖gradient (Fhat a σ f xs ys) u - gradient (Fhat a σ f xs ys) v‖
        ≤ LF * ‖u - v‖)
    (hnorm : ‖w - w0‖ ^ 2 ≥ max (η * T * Fhat a σ f xs ys w) (η * Fhat a σ f xs ys w0))
    (hwidth : (m : ℝ) ≥ 18 ^ 2 * L ^ 2 * R ^ 4 * ‖w - w0‖ ^ 4) :
    let ws := gdSeq a σ f xs ys η w0
    Fhat a σ f xs ys (ws T)
        ≤ (1 / (T : ℝ)) * ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, Fhat a σ f xs ys (ws t)
    ∧ (1 / (T : ℝ)) * ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, Fhat a σ f xs ys (ws t)
        ≤ 2 * Fhat a σ f xs ys w + 5 * ‖w - w0‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η * (T : ℝ))
    ∧ ∀ t, 1 ≤ t → t ≤ T → ‖ws t - w0‖ ≤ 4 * ‖w - w0‖ := by
  intro ws
  have hmR : (0:ℝ) < (m:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hsm : (0:ℝ) < Real.sqrt (m:ℝ) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hmR
  have hTT : (0:ℝ) < (T:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hT
  have hFpos : ∀ x : Params m d, 0 ≤ Fhat a σ f xs ys x := by
    intro x
    rw [Fhat]
    exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hfpos _))
  have hFdiff : Differentiable ℝ (Fhat a σ f xs ys) :=
    fun x => (hasFDerivAt_Fhat hσ hf a xs ys x).differentiableAt
  have hκ : (0:ℝ) ≤ L * R^2 / Real.sqrt (m:ℝ) := by positivity
  have hLS : LineSecondDeriv (Fhat a σ f xs ys) (L * R^2 / Real.sqrt (m:ℝ)) := by
    intro u v
    refine ⟨dF1 a σ f xs ys u v, dF2 a σ f xs ys u v,
      fun t => hasDerivAt_Fhat_line hσ hf a xs ys u v t,
      fun t => hasDerivAt_dF1 hσ hσd hf hfd a xs ys u v t, fun t => ?_⟩
    have h := dF2_lower hm hL hR hf hfconv hfsb hσ'' a ha xs ys hx hy u v t
    linarith
  have hdesc : ∀ x : Params m d, Fhat a σ f xs ys (x - η • gradient (Fhat a σ f xs ys) x)
      ≤ Fhat a σ f xs ys x - (η/2) * ‖gradient (Fhat a σ f xs ys) x‖^2 :=
    fun x => descent hFdiff hLF hη0 hη hsmooth x
  have hws0 : ws 0 = w0 := rfl
  have hwsS : ∀ t, ws (t+1) = ws t - η • gradient (Fhat a σ f xs ys) (ws t) := fun t => rfl
  have hwid : 18 * (L * R^2 / Real.sqrt (m:ℝ)) * ‖w - w0‖^2 ≤ 1 := by
    have hc : (0:ℝ) ≤ 18 * L * R^2 * ‖w - w0‖^2 := by positivity
    have hsq : (18 * L * R^2 * ‖w - w0‖^2)^2 ≤ (m:ℝ) := by nlinarith [hwidth]
    have hle : 18 * L * R^2 * ‖w - w0‖^2 ≤ Real.sqrt (m:ℝ) := by
      have h2 := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hsq
      rwa [Real.sqrt_sq hc] at h2
    rw [show 18 * (L * R^2 / Real.sqrt (m:ℝ)) * ‖w - w0‖^2
        = (18 * L * R^2 * ‖w - w0‖^2) / Real.sqrt (m:ℝ) by ring, div_le_one hsm]
    exact hle
  have hnorm1 : η * (T:ℝ) * Fhat a σ f xs ys w ≤ ‖w - w0‖^2 := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hnorm
  have hnorm2 : η * Fhat a σ f xs ys w0 ≤ ‖w - w0‖^2 := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hnorm
  obtain ⟨hAbound, hSum⟩ := abstract_gd hκ hη0 hFpos hFdiff hLS hdesc w0 ws hws0 hwsS T w
    hnorm1 hnorm2 hwid
  have hA2 : (0:ℝ) ≤ ‖w - w0‖^2 := sq_nonneg _
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hanti := F_antitone hdesc (le_of_lt hη0) ws hwsS
    have hcard : (Finset.Icc 1 T).card = T := by rw [Nat.card_Icc]; omega
    have hlow : (T:ℝ) * Fhat a σ f xs ys (ws T)
        ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, Fhat a σ f xs ys (ws t) := by
      have h := Finset.card_nsmul_le_sum (Finset.Icc 1 T) (fun t => Fhat a σ f xs ys (ws t))
        (Fhat a σ f xs ys (ws T)) (fun i hi => hanti i T (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hi).2)
      rw [hcard, nsmul_eq_mul] at h
      exact h
    have h2 : (1/(T:ℝ)) * ((T:ℝ) * Fhat a σ f xs ys (ws T))
        ≤ (1/(T:ℝ)) * (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, Fhat a σ f xs ys (ws t)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlow (by positivity)
    rw [show (1/(T:ℝ)) * ((T:ℝ) * Fhat a σ f xs ys (ws T)) = Fhat a σ f xs ys (ws T) by
      field_simp] at h2
    exact h2
  · have step : (1/(T:ℝ)) * (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, Fhat a σ f xs ys (ws t))
        ≤ (1/(T:ℝ)) * (2*(T:ℝ)*Fhat a σ f xs ys w + (5/4)*‖w - w0‖^2/η) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hSum (by positivity)
    have eqn : (1/(T:ℝ)) * (2*(T:ℝ)*Fhat a σ f xs ys w + (5/4)*‖w - w0‖^2/η)
        = 2*Fhat a σ f xs ys w + (5/4)*‖w - w0‖^2/(η*(T:ℝ)) := by
      field_simp
    have fin : (5/4)*‖w - w0‖^2/(η*(T:ℝ)) ≤ 5*‖w - w0‖^2/(2*η*(T:ℝ)) := by
      rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hA2 (le_of_lt hη0)) (le_of_lt hTT)]
    linarith
  · intro t _ htT
    have h := hAbound t htT
    have htri : ‖ws t - w0‖ ≤ ‖ws t - w‖ + ‖w - w0‖ := by
      calc ‖ws t - w0‖ = ‖(ws t - w) + (w - w0)‖ := by congr 1; abel
        _ ≤ ‖ws t - w‖ + ‖w - w0‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    linarith

theorem thm3_3 {m d n : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (R ℓ L LF η : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hLF : 0 < LF) (hη0 : 0 < η)
    (a : Fin m → ℝ) (ha : ∀ j, a j = 1 ∨ a j = -1)
    (hbal : (∑ j, a j) = 0)
    (σ f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hσ : Differentiable ℝ σ) (hσd : Differentiable ℝ (deriv σ)) (hσ' : ∀ u, |deriv σ u| ≤ ℓ)
    (hσ'' : ∀ u, |deriv (deriv σ) u| ≤ L)
    (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (hfd : Differentiable ℝ (deriv f)) (hfpos : ∀ u, 0 ≤ f u)
    (hfconv : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f) (hf' : ∀ u, |deriv f u| ≤ 1)
    (hf'' : ∀ u, deriv (deriv f) u ≤ 1) (hfsb : ∀ u, |deriv f u| ≤ f u)
    (hfdec : Antitone f)
    (hflim : Filter.Tendsto f Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
    (xs : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (ys : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, ‖xs i‖ ≤ R) (hy : ∀ i, ys i = 1 ∨ ys i = -1)
    (w0 : Params m d)
    (hsmooth : ∀ u v, ‖gradient (Fhat a σ f xs ys) u - gradient (Fhat a σ f xs ys) v‖
        ≤ LF * ‖u - v‖)
    (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hgpos : ∀ ε, 0 < ε → 0 < g ε)
    (hgdec : ∀ ε₁ ε₂, 0 < ε₁ → ε₁ ≤ ε₂ → g ε₂ ≤ g ε₁)

    (ε₀ : ℝ) (hε₀ : 0 < ε₀)
    (hreal : ∀ ε, 0 < ε → ε ≤ ε₀ → ∃ wε : Params m d,
        Fhat a σ f xs ys wε ≤ ε ∧ ‖wε - w0‖ = g ε)
    (hTsmall : 1 / (T : ℝ) ≤ ε₀)
    (hFw0 : 0 < Fhat a σ f xs ys w0)
    (hη : η ≤ min (1 / LF) (min (g 1 ^ 2) (g 1 ^ 2 / Fhat a σ f xs ys w0)))
    (hwidth : (m : ℝ) ≥ 18 ^ 2 * L ^ 2 * R ^ 4 * g (1 / (T : ℝ)) ^ 4) :
    let ws := gdSeq a σ f xs ys η w0
    Fhat a σ f xs ys (ws T)
        ≤ 2 / (T : ℝ) + 5 * g (1 / (T : ℝ)) ^ 2 / (2 * η * (T : ℝ))
    ∧ ∀ t, 1 ≤ t → t ≤ T → ‖ws t - w0‖ ≤ 4 * g (1 / (T : ℝ)) := by
  
  intro ws
  have hTT : (0:ℝ) < (T:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hT
  have hT1 : (1:ℝ)/(T:ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [div_le_one hTT]
    exact_mod_cast hT
  have hεpos : (0:ℝ) < 1/(T:ℝ) := by positivity
  obtain ⟨wε, hwε1, hwε2⟩ := hreal (1/(T:ℝ)) hεpos hTsmall
  have hηLF : η ≤ 1/LF := le_trans hη (min_le_left _ _)
  have hηg1 : η ≤ g 1 ^ 2 := le_trans hη (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
  have hηg2 : η ≤ g 1 ^ 2 / Fhat a σ f xs ys w0 :=
    le_trans hη (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
  have hg1pos : 0 < g 1 := hgpos 1 one_pos
  have hgmono : g 1 ≤ g (1/(T:ℝ)) := hgdec (1/(T:ℝ)) 1 hεpos hT1
  have hgsq : g 1 ^ 2 ≤ g (1/(T:ℝ))^2 := by nlinarith
  have hFpos : ∀ x : Params m d, 0 ≤ Fhat a σ f xs ys x := by
    intro x
    rw [Fhat]
    exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hfpos _))
  have hnorm' : ‖wε - w0‖ ^ 2 ≥ max (η * T * Fhat a σ f xs ys wε) (η * Fhat a σ f xs ys w0) := by
    rw [ge_iff_le, hwε2]
    apply max_le
    · have hstep : η * (T:ℝ) * Fhat a σ f xs ys wε ≤ η * (T:ℝ) * (1/(T:ℝ)) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hwε1 (by positivity)
      have heq : η * (T:ℝ) * (1/(T:ℝ)) = η := by field_simp
      rw [heq] at hstep
      linarith
    · have hstep : η * Fhat a σ f xs ys w0
          ≤ (g 1 ^ 2 / Fhat a σ f xs ys w0) * Fhat a σ f xs ys w0 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hηg2 (le_of_lt hFw0)
      have heq : (g 1 ^ 2 / Fhat a σ f xs ys w0) * Fhat a σ f xs ys w0 = g 1 ^ 2 := by
        field_simp
      rw [heq] at hstep
      linarith
  have hwidth' : (m : ℝ) ≥ 18 ^ 2 * L ^ 2 * R ^ 4 * ‖wε - w0‖ ^ 4 := by
    rw [hwε2]; exact hwidth
  have hmain := thm3_2 hm hn T hT R ℓ L LF η hR hℓ hL hLF hη0 hηLF a ha hbal σ f
    hσ hσd hσ' hσ'' hf hfd hfpos hfconv hf' hf'' hfsb hfdec hflim xs ys hx hy w0 wε hsmooth
    hnorm' hwidth'
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hmain
  constructor
  · have hb : Fhat a σ f xs ys (ws T)
        ≤ 2 * Fhat a σ f xs ys wε + 5 * ‖wε - w0‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η * (T:ℝ)) := le_trans h1 h2
    rw [hwε2] at hb
    have : 2 * Fhat a σ f xs ys wε ≤ 2 * (1/(T:ℝ)) := by linarith
    have h2T : 2 * (1/(T:ℝ)) = 2/(T:ℝ) := by ring
    linarith [hb, this, h2T.le, h2T.ge]
  · intro t ht1 ht2
    have := h3 t ht1 ht2
    rwa [hwε2] at this

end ResearchLevel

targets.label: Lemma 11 (minimax strong duality)
targets.statement:
Lemma 11 Let U be an uncertainty set given by (4) that satisfies R1 or R2. For any h $\in T(\mathcal{X},\mathcal{Y})$ , we have that

$$
\operatorname*{sup}_{\mathbf{p}\in\mathcal{U}}\ell(\mathbf{h},\mathbf{p})=\operatorname*{min}_{\mu\in\mathbb{R}^{m}}1-\tau^{T}\pmb{\mu}+\operatorname*{sup}_{x\in\mathcal{X},y\in\mathcal{Y}}\left\{\Phi(x,y)^{T}\pmb{\mu}-\mathrm{h}(y|x)\right\}+\lambda^{T}|\mu|\tag{37}
$$

targets.label: Theorem 5
targets.statement:
Theorem 5 Let U be an uncertainty set given by (4), h be any classification rule, and $\underline{{R}}(\mathcal{U},\mathrm{h})$ and $\overline{{R}}(\mathcal{U},\mathrm{h})$ be given by

$$
\underline{{R}}(\mathcal{U},\mathrm{h})=\operatorname*{sup}_{\mu}\ 1-{\tau^{T}}\mu+\operatorname*{inf}_{x\in\mathcal{X},y\in\mathcal{Y}}\{\Phi(x,y)^{T}\mu-\mathrm{h}(y|x)\}-{\lambda^{T}}|\mu|\tag{20}
$$

$$
\overline{{R}}(\mathcal{U},\mathrm{h})=\operatorname*{inf}_{\mu}\ 1-\tau^{T}\pmb{\mu}+\operatorname*{sup}_{x\in\mathcal{X},y\in\mathcal{Y}}\{\Phi(x,y)^{T}\pmb{\mu}-\mathrm{h}(y|x)\}+\pmb{\lambda}^{T}|\pmb{\mu}|.\tag{21}
$$

Then, for any ${\mathrm{p}}\in \mathcal{U}$ we have that $\underline{{R}}(\mathcal{U},\mathrm{h})\le\ell(\mathrm{h},\mathrm{p})\le\overline{{R}}(\mathcal{U},\mathrm{h})$ . In addition, if U satisfies R1 or R2 the optimal values in (20) and (21) are attained.

Theorem 4 Let the mean vector be given by $\tau = \tau_{n}$ as in (5) for n training samples, and $\mathcal{F}$ be a family of bounded scalar features, that is $|\psi(x)|\leq C$ for all $\psi \in{\mathcal{F}}$ and $x \in \mathcal{X}$

If $\left| \mathcal{F}\right| < \infty$ and $\Phi$ is given by (16) using all $D = |\mathcal{F}|$ scalar features of $\mathcal{F}$ (so that $m = |\mathcal{F}||\mathcal{Y}|$), $\lambda_{\delta}^{(i)}$ for $i=1,2,\ldots,m$ can be taken as

$$
\lambda_{\delta}^{(i)}=C\sqrt{\frac{2\log 2\vert\mathcal{F}\vert\vert\mathcal{Y}\vert/\delta}{n}}.\tag{17}
$$
