### Proof of Lemma 11 (minimax strong duality)

In the first step of the proof we show that the right hand side of (36) is equivalent to the Fenchel dual of the left hand side, then the second step of the proof shows that strong duality holds if U satisfies R1 or R2.

Let $0 \leq r \leq m$ be the number of non-zero components of λ (without loss of generality we assume such components are the r first components of λ), and $M(\mathcal{X}\times\mathcal{Y})$ be the set of signed Borel measures over $\mathcal{X}\times \mathcal{Y}$ with bounded total variation. The set $M(\mathcal{X}\times\mathcal{Y})$ is a Banach space with the total variation norm (see e.g., Chapter 10 in Aliprantis and Border (1994)).

If A is the linear mapping

$$
\begin{array}{r l}{A:}&{M(\mathcal{X}\times\mathcal{Y})\ \to\ \mathbb{R}^{r+m+1}}\\ &{\qquad \textrm{p}\mapsto [\int\Phi_{1}(x,y)d\mathrm{p}(x,y),-\int\Phi_{1}(x,y)d\mathrm{p}(x,y),\int\Phi_{2}(x,y)d\mathrm{p}(x,y),\int d\mathrm{p}(x,y)]}\end{array}\tag{38}
$$

where $\Phi_{1}(x,y)\in\mathbb{R}^{r}$ denotes the first r components of $\Phi(x,y)$ and $\Phi_{2}(x,y)\in\mathbb{R}^{m-r}$ denotes the last $m - r$ components of $\Phi(x,y)$ . A is bounded and its adjoint operator is

$$
\begin{array}{r}{\begin{array}{l c l l}{A^{*}:}&{\mathbb{R}^{r+m+1}}&{\to}&{F({\mathcal X}\times{\mathcal Y})\subseteq(M({\mathcal X}\times{\mathcal Y}))^{*}}\\ &{\mu_{1},\mu_{2},\mu_{3},\nu}&{\mapsto}&{\Phi_{1}(\cdot,\cdot)^{\mathrm{T}}(\mu_{1}-\mu_{2})+\Phi_{2}(\cdot,\cdot)^{\mathrm{T}}\mu_{3}+\nu .}\end{array}}\end{array}\tag{39}
$$

where $F(\mathcal{X}\times\mathcal{Y})$ is the set of bounded Borel measurable functions over $\mathcal{X}\times \mathcal{Y}$.

Then, we have that

$$
\operatorname*{sup}_{\mathbf{p}\in\mathcal{U}}\ell(\mathrm{h,p})=\operatorname*{sup}_{\mathbf{p}\in\mathcal{U}}1-\int\mathrm{h}(y|x)d\mathbf{p}(x,y)=1-\operatorname*{inf}_{\mathbf{p}\in M(\mathcal{X}\times\mathcal{Y})}f(\mathbf{p})+g(A(\mathbf{p}))\tag{40}
$$

where f and g are the lower semi-continuous convex functions

$$
\begin{array}{rlcl}g:&\mathbb{R}^{r+m+1}&\to&\mathbb{R}\cup\{\infty\}\\ &({\bf a}_{1},{\bf a}_{2},{\bf a}_{3},b)&\mapsto&\left\{\begin{array}{ll}0&\mathrm{if}\ \ {\bf a}_{1}\preceq\tau_{1}+\lambda_{1},\ {\bf a}_{2}\preceq-\tau_{1}+\lambda_{1},{\bf a}_{3}=\tau_{2},b=1\\ \infty&\mathrm{otherwise}\end{array}\right.\end{array}\tag{41}
$$

for $\tau_{1},\lambda_{1}\in\mathbb{R}^{r}\ (\mathrm{resp.}\ \tau_{2},\lambda_{2}\in\mathbb{R}^{m-r})$ given by the first r (resp. last $m-r)$ components of $\tau$ and λ, and

$$
\begin{array}{rlcl}f\colon&M(\mathcal{X}\times\mathcal{Y})&\to&\mathbb{R}\cup\{\infty\}\\ &\mathrm{p}&\mapsto&\left\{\begin{array}{ll}\int\mathrm{h}(y|x)d\mathrm{p}(x,y)&\mathrm{if}\ \mathrm{p}\ \text{is nonnegative}\\ \infty&\mathrm{otherwise}.\end{array}\right.\end{array}\tag{42}
$$

Then, the Fenchel dual (see e.g., Borwein and Zhu (2004)) of (40) is

$$
1-\operatorname*{sup}_{\mu_{1},\mu_{2},\mu_{3},\nu}-f^{*}(A^{*}(\mu_{1},\mu_{2},\mu_{3},\nu))-g^{*}(-\mu_{1},-\mu_{2},-\mu_{3},-\nu)\tag{43}
$$

where $f^{*}$ and $g^{*}$ are the conjugate functions of f and g. If $w\in F(\mathcal{X}\times\mathcal{Y})$ , we have that

$$
\begin{array}{rl}f^{*}(w)&=\sup_{\mathrm{p}\succeq 0}\int(w(x,y)-\mathrm{h}(y|x))d\mathrm{p}(x,y)\\ &=\left\{\begin{array}{lll}0&\mathrm{if}&w(x,y)\leq\mathrm{h}(y|x),\ \forall x,y\in\mathcal{X}\times\mathcal{Y}\\ \infty&\mathrm{otherwise}&\end{array}\right.\end{array}
$$

and $g^{*}(-{\pmb\mu}_{1},-{\pmb\mu}_{2},-{\pmb\mu}_{3},-\nu)$ is given by

$$
\begin{array}{rl}\sup&-\mathbf{a}_{1}^{\mathrm{T}}\mu_{1}-\mathbf{a}_{2}^{\mathrm{T}}\mu_{2}-\tau_{2}^{\mathrm{T}}\mu_{3}-\nu\\ \mathrm{s.t.}&\mathbf{a}_{1}\preceq\tau_{1}+\lambda_{1},\ \mathbf{a}_{2}\preceq-\tau_{1}+\lambda_{1}\\ =&\left\{\begin{array}{ll}-(\tau_{1}+\lambda_{1})^{\mathrm{T}}\mu_{1}+(\tau_{1}-\lambda_{1})^{\mathrm{T}}\mu_{2}-\tau_{2}^{\mathrm{T}}\mu_{3}-\nu&\mathrm{if}\ -\mu_{1}\succeq\mathbf{0},-\mu_{2}\succeq\mathbf{0}\\ \infty&\mathrm{otherwise.}\end{array}\right.\end{array}
$$

Hence, the dual problem (43) becomes

$$
\begin{array}{rll}\inf_{\mu_{1},\mu_{2},\mu_{3},\nu}&1-(\tau_{1}+\lambda_{1})^{\mathrm{T}}\mu_{1}-(-\tau_{1}+\lambda_{1})^{\mathrm{T}}\mu_{2}-\tau_{2}^{\mathrm{T}}\mu_{3}-\nu&\\ \mathrm{s.t.}&\Phi_{1}(x,y)^{\mathrm{T}}(\mu_{1}-\mu_{2})+\Phi_{2}(x,y)^{\mathrm{T}}\mu_{3}+\nu\leq\mathrm{h}(y|x),\ \forall(x,y)\in\mathcal{X}\times\mathcal{Y}&\\ &-\mu_{1}\succeq\mathbf{0},-\mu_{2}\succeq\mathbf{0}&\\ =\inf_{\mu_{1},\mu_{2},\mu_{3},\nu}&1+(\tau_{1}+\lambda_{1})^{\mathrm{T}}\mu_{1}+(-\tau_{1}+\lambda_{1})^{\mathrm{T}}\mu_{2}-\tau_{2}\mu_{3}-\nu&\\ \mathrm{s.t.}&\Phi_{1}(x,y)^{\mathrm{T}}(\mu_{2}-\mu_{1})+\Phi_{2}(x,y)^{\mathrm{T}}\mu_{3}+\nu\leq\mathrm{h}(y|x),\ \forall(x,y)\in\mathcal{X}\times\mathcal{Y}&(44)\\ &\mu_{1}\succeq\mathbf{0},\mu_{2}\succeq\mathbf{0}&\\ =\inf_{\mu,\nu}&1-\tau^{\mathrm{T}}\mu+\lambda^{\mathrm{T}}|\mu| -\nu&\\ \mathrm{s.t.}&\Phi(x,y)^{\mathrm{T}}\mu+\nu\leq\mathrm{h}(y|x),\ \forall(x,y)\in\mathcal{X}\times\mathcal{Y}&(45)\\ =\inf_{\mu}&1-\tau^{\mathrm{T}}\mu+\sup_{(x,y)\in\mathcal{X}\times\mathcal{Y}}\left\{\Phi(x,y)^{\mathrm{T}}\mu-\mathrm{h}(y|x)\right\}+\lambda^{\mathrm{T}}|\mu|.&(46)\end{array}
$$

The expression in (45) is obtained taking ${\pmb \mu}= [ ({\pmb \mu}_{2}-{\pmb \mu}_{1})^{\mathrm{T}},{\pmb \mu}_{3}^{\mathrm{T}}]^{\mathrm{T}}$ . Firstly, in (44) we can consider only pairs $\pmb{\mu}_{1}, \pmb{\mu}_{2}$ such that $\pmb{\mu}_{1}+ \pmb{\mu}_{2}= | \pmb{\mu}_{1}- \pmb{\mu}_{2}|$ because for any pair $\pmb{\mu}_{1}, \pmb{\mu}_{2}$ feasible in (44), we have that $\tilde{\pmb{\mu}}_{1}=(\pmb{\mu}_{2}-\pmb{\mu}_{1})_{+},\tilde{\pmb{\mu}}_{2}=(\pmb{\mu}_{1}-\pmb{\mu}_{2})_{+}$ is a feasible pair because $\tilde{\pmb{\mu}}_{1}- \tilde{\pmb{\mu}}_{2}= \pmb{\mu}_{1}- \pmb{\mu}_{2}$ , and we also have that $\lambda_{1}^{\mathrm{T}}|\tilde{{\pmb\mu}}_{1}-\tilde{{\pmb\mu}}_{2}| =\lambda_{1}^{\mathrm{T}}(\tilde{{\pmb\mu}}_{1}+\tilde{{\pmb\mu}}_{2})\leq\lambda_{1}^{\mathrm{T}}({\pmb\mu}_{1}+{\pmb\mu}_{2})$ Then, we obtain (45) from (44) because

$$
\begin{array}{c}{{\tau_{1}^{\mathrm{T}}(\mu_{2}-\mu_{1})+\tau_{2}^{\mathrm{T}}\mu_{3}=\tau^{\mathrm{T}}\mu}}\\ {{\lambda_{1}^{\mathrm{T}}|\mu_{2}-\mu_{1}| =\lambda^{\mathrm{T}}|\mu|,\mathrm{~since~}\lambda_{2}=0}}\\ {{\Phi_{1}(x,y)^{\mathrm{T}}(\mu_{2}-\mu_{1})+\Phi_{2}(x,y)^{\mathrm{T}}\mu_{3}=\Phi(x,y)^{\mathrm{T}}\mu .}}\end{array}
$$

The expression in (46) is obtained since for any feasible $(\mu,\nu)$ in (45) we have that $(\mu,\tilde{\nu})$ is feasible if

$$
\tilde{\nu}=\operatorname*{inf}_{(x,y)\in\mathcal{X}\times\mathcal{Y}}\{\mathrm{h}(y|x)-\Phi(x,y)^{\mathrm{T}}\pmb{\mu}\}
$$

and $\tilde{\nu}\geq \nu .$ Then, the inequality in (36) follows by weak duality.

For the second step of the proof, if U satisfies R1, we have that strong duality holds because the dual becomes the Lagrange dual and the constraints in (40) are linear affine (see e.g., Chapter 5 in Boyd and Vandenberghe (2004)). If U satisfies R2, we show in the following that strong duality holds because $\mathbf{0}\in\operatorname{int}(\operatorname{dom}g-A\operatorname{dom}f)$ (see e.g., Chapter 4 in Borwein and Zhu (2004)), where dom denotes the set where an extended-valued function takes finite values, and int denotes the interior of a set.

If U satisfies R2.1, there exists $R > 0$ such that $R<\lambda^{(i)}- |\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\Phi^{(i)}(x,y)-\tau^{(i)}|$ for $i=1,2,\dots,m$ . Then, the second step of the proof is obtained by showing that if $0 < \varepsilon <$ $R/(R+1+\|\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi\}\|_{2})<1$ , we have that the ball with radius ε centered in $\mathbf{0}\in \mathbb{R}^{r + m + 1}$, $B(\mathbf{0},\varepsilon)$ satisfies $B(\mathbf{0},\varepsilon)\subset(\operatorname{dom}g-A\operatorname{dom}f)\subset\mathbb{R}^{r+m+1}$.

We have that for any $\mathbf{z}\in B(\mathbf{0},\varepsilon)\subset\mathbb{R}^{2m+1}$ , there exist $\pmb{\xi}_{1},\pmb{\xi}_{2}\in B(\mathbf{0},R)\subset\mathbb{R}^{m}$ such that

$$
\begin{array}{c}{{\left(z^{(1)},z^{(2)},\ldots,z^{(m)}\right)=\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi\}+\xi_{1}-(1-z^{(2m+1)})\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi\}}}\\ {{\left(z^{(m+1)},z^{(m+2)},\ldots,z^{(2m)}\right)= -\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi\}+\xi_{2}+(1-z^{(2m+1)})\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi\}}}\\ {{z^{(2m+1)}=1-(1-z^{(2m+1)})}}\end{array}
$$

because we have that

$$
\|\big(z^{(1)},z^{(2)},\ldots,z^{(m)}\big)-z^{(2m+1)}\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi\}\|_{2}\leq\varepsilon(1+\|\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi\}\|_{2})<R
$$

$$
\|\big(z^{(m+1)},z^{(m+2)},\dots,z^{(2m)}\big)+z^{(2m+1)}\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi\}\|_{2}\leq\varepsilon(1+\|\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi\}\|_{2})<R.
$$

Then, the result is obtained observing that

$$
\left(\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi\}+\pmb{\xi}_{1},-\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi\}+\pmb{\xi}_{2},1\right)\in\mathrm{dom}g
$$

because $R<\lambda^{(i)}- |\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\Phi^{(i)}(x,y)-\tau^{(i)}|$ for $i=1,2,\dots,m$ ,and

$$
\left((1-z^{(2 m+1)})\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi\},-(1-z^{(2 m+1)})\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi\},(1-z^{(2 m+1)})\right)\in A\mathrm{dom}f
$$

because $|z^{(2m+1)}|\leq\varepsilon<1$ and hence $(1-z^{(2m+1)})\mathrm{p}$ is a nonnegative measure.

If U satisfies R2.2, we have that $\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi\}\in\mathrm{int}(\mathrm{Conv}S)$ , where S denotes the support of $\Phi(x,y){\mathrm{~if~}}(x,y)\sim{\mathrm{p}}$ , and Conv denotes the convex hull of a set. Firstly, int $(\mathrm{Conv}S)\ne\emptyset$ because S and hence (Conv $S)\supseteq S$ are not contained in a proper affine subspace. In the case that $\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi\}\in\overline{{\mathrm{Conv}S}}\backslash\mathrm{Conv}S$ , using the Hanh-Banach separation theorem (see e.g., Theorem 2, Sec 5.12 in Luenberger (1997)), there would exists a hyperplane ${\Gamma}= \{{\bf{z}};{\pmb{\alpha}}^{\mathrm{{T}}}{\bf{z}}= c \}\subset \mathbb{R}^{m}$ such that $\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi \}\in \Gamma$ and ${\pmb{\alpha}}^{\mathrm{T}}{\bf z}\geq c$ for all $\mathbf{z}\in\operatorname{Conv}S$ Then, the real-valued random variable $\alpha^{\mathrm{T}}\Phi(x,y)-{\overset{}{c}}$ with $(x,y)\sim\mathrm{p}$ is nonnegative with probability one and has expectation zero. Therefore, $\alpha^{\mathrm{T}}\Phi(x,y)=c$ with probability one, and we would have that the S is contained in the hyperplane Γ, which leads to a contradiction.

Let $R > 0$ be such that

$$
\begin{array}{r}{1 .\ R<\lambda^{(i)}- |\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\Phi^{(i)}(x,y)-\tau^{(i)}|\ \mathrm{for}\ i=1,2,\dots,r,\ \mathrm{and}}\end{array}
$$

2. for any $\boldsymbol{\xi}$ in the Euclidean ball of $\mathbb{R}^{m}$ centered at 0 with radius $R,B(\mathbf{0},R)$ , we have that $\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi\}+\pmb{\xi}\in\mathrm{Conv}S .$ that is, there exists $\mathrm{p}_{\xi}\in\Delta(\mathcal{X}\times\mathcal{Y})$ such that ${\mathbb E}_{\mathrm{p}_{\xi}}\{\Phi \}={\mathbb E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi \}+ \xi$

As in the previous case, the second step of the proof is obtained by showing that if $0<\varepsilon<R/(R+1+\|\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi\}\|_{2})<1$ , we have that $B(\mathbf{0},\varepsilon)\subset(\operatorname{dom}g-A\operatorname{dom}f)\subset\mathbb{R}^{r+m+1}$ If $r = 0$ , we have that for any $\mathbf{z}\in B(\mathbf{0},\varepsilon)\subset\mathbb{R}^{m+1}$ , there exist $\pmb{\xi}_{3}\in B(\mathbf{0},R)$ such that

$$
\begin{array}{r l}&{\bigl(z^{(1)},z^{(2)},\ldots,z^{(m)}\bigr)=\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi\}-(1-z^{(m+1)})(\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi\}+\pmb{\xi}_{3})}\\ &{\qquad z^{(m+1)}=1-(1-z^{(m+1)})}\end{array}
$$

because we have that

$$
\frac{\|-\left(z^{(1)},z^{(2)},\ldots,z^{(m)}\right)+z^{(m+1)}\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi\}\|_{2}}{1-z^{m+1}}\leq\frac{\varepsilon}{1-\varepsilon}(1+\|\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi\}\|_{2})<R.
$$

Then, the result is obtained observing that

$$
\left(\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi\},1\right)\in\mathrm{dom}g
$$

and

$$
{\big(}(1-z^{(m+1)})(\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi\}+\pmb{\xi}_{3}),(1-z^{(m+1)}){\big)}\in A\mathrm{dom}f
$$

because $|z^{(m+1)}|\leq\varepsilon<1$ and hence $(1-z^{(m+1)})\mathrm{p}_{\pmb{\xi}_{3}}$ is a nonnegative measure, for $\mathrm{p}_{\xi_{3}}$ satisfying ${\mathbb E}_{\mathrm{p}_{\xi_{3}}}\{\Phi \}={\mathbb E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi \}+ \pmb{\xi}_{3}$ .

If $\textit{0}< \textit{r}< \textit{m}$ ,we have that for any $\mathbf{z}~\in~B(\mathbf{0},\varepsilon)\subset~\mathbb{R}^{r+m+1}$ , there exist $\pmb{\xi}_{1},\pmb{\xi}_{2}\in B(\mathbf{0},R)\subset\mathbb{R}^{r}$ , and $\pmb{\xi}_{3}\in B(\mathbf{0},R)\subset\mathbb{R}^{m-r}$ such that

$$
\begin{array}{r l}&{\qquad\bigl(z^{(1)},z^{(2)},\ldots,z^{(r)}\bigr)=\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\bigl\{\Phi_{1}\bigr\}+\xi_{1}-\bigl(1-z^{(r+m+1)}\bigr)\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\bigl\{\Phi_{1}\bigr\}}\\ &{\qquad\bigl(z^{(r+1)},z^{(2)},\ldots,z^{(2r)}\bigr)= -\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\bigl\{\Phi_{1}\bigr\}+\xi_{2}+\bigl(1-z^{(r+m+1)}\bigr)\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\bigl\{\Phi_{1}\bigr\}}\\ &{\bigl(z^{(2r+1)},z^{(2r+2)},\ldots,z^{(r+m)}\bigr)=\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\bigl\{\Phi_{2}\bigr\}-\bigl(1-z^{(r+m+1)}\bigr)(\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\bigl\{\Phi_{2}\bigr\}+\xi_{3})}\\ &{\qquad z^{(r+m+1)}=1-\bigl(1-z^{(r+m+1)}\bigr)}\end{array}
$$

because we have that

$$
\begin{array}{c}{{\|\big(z^{(1)},z^{(2)},\dots,z^{(m)}\big)-z^{(r+m+1)}\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi_{1}\}\|_{2}\leq\varepsilon\big(1+\|\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi\}\|_{2}\big)<R}}\\ {{\|\big(z^{(r+1)},z^{(r+2)},\dots,z^{(2r)}\big)+z^{(r+m+1)}\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi_{1}\}\|_{2}\leq\varepsilon\big(1+\|\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi\}\|_{2}\big)<R}}\\ {{\|-\left(z^{(2r+1)},z^{(2r+2)},\dots,z^{(r+m)}\right)+z^{(r+m+1)}\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi_{2}\}\|_{2}}\leq\frac{\varepsilon}{1-\varepsilon}(1+\|\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi\}\|_{2})<R.}\end{array}
$$

Then, the result is obtained observing that

$$
\bigl(\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi_{1}\}+\pmb{\xi}_{1},-\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi_{1}\}+\pmb{\xi}_{2},\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi_{2}\},1\bigr)\in\mathrm{dom}g
$$

because $R<\lambda^{(i)}- |\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\Phi^{(i)}(x,y)-\tau^{(i)}|\mathrm{~for~}i=1,2,\dots,r.$ and

$$
(1-z^{(r+m+1)})\big(\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi_{1}\},-\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi_{1}\},\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi_{2}\}+\pmb{\xi}_{3},1\big)\in A\mathrm{dom}f
$$

because $|z^{(r+m+1)}|\leq\varepsilon<1$ and hence $(1-z^{(r+m+1)})\mathrm{p}_{\pmb{\xi}_{3}}$ is a nonnegative measure, for $\mathrm{p}_{\xi_{3}}$ satisfying $\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}_{\xi_{3}}}\{\Phi_{1}\}= \mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi_{1}\}$ and ${\mathbb E}_{\mathrm{p}_{\xi_{3}}}\{\Phi_{2}\}={\mathbb E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi_{2}\}+ \xi_{3}$ that exists because $\|(\mathbf{0}^{\mathrm{T}},\pmb{\xi}_{3}^{\mathrm{T}})^{\mathrm{T}}\|_{2}\leq R$

Finally, since strong duality holds and U is not empty we have that the optimal value in (37) is finite and hence the optimal in the dual is attained (Borwein and Zhu, 2004) and the 'inf' in (36) becomes 'min'.

### Proof of Theorem 5

Proof The result for $\overline{{R}}(\mathcal{U},\mathrm{h})$ is a direct consequence of Lemma 11, and the second result for $\underline{{R}}(\mathcal{U},\mathrm{h})$ is obtained analogously since

$$
\begin{array}{l}{\displaystyle\operatorname*{inf}_{\mathrm{p}\in\mathcal{U}}\ell(\mathrm{h},\mathrm{p})= -\operatorname*{sup}_{\mathrm{p}\in\mathcal{U}}-1-\int\big(-\mathrm{h}(y|x)\big)\mathrm{d}\mathrm{p}(x,y)}\\ {\displaystyle\qquad\geq-\operatorname*{inf}_{\mu}-1-\tau^{\mathrm{T}}\mu+\lambda^{\mathrm{T}}|\mu| +\operatorname*{sup}_{x\in\mathcal{X},y\in\mathcal{Y}}\{\Phi(x,y)^{\mathrm{T}}\mu+\mathrm{h}(y|x)\}}\end{array}
$$

that leads to the expression in (20) changing the notation for the variable in the optimization from µ to −µ.

### Proof of Theorem 4 (Hoeffding case, eq. 17)

Proof The first result is a direct consequence of Hoeffding's inequality and the union bound since each component of $\Phi$ is bounded by its corresponding scalar feature.

context.name: Notation (Section 1)
context.statement: Notation: calligraphic upper case letters denote sets, $\mathrm{e . g .}, \mathcal{Z}; | \mathcal{Z}|$ denotes de cardinality of set $\mathcal{Z};$ vectors and matrices are denoted by bold lower and upper case letters, respectively, e.g., v and M; for a vector v, $\|\mathbf{v}\|,\|\mathbf{v}\|_{1}$ , and $\| \mathbf{v}\|_{\infty}$ denote its L2-, L1-, and L-infinity norms, respectively, $\mathbf{v}^{\mathrm{T}}$ denotes its transpose, $v^{(i)}$ denotes its i-th component, $| \mathbf{v}|$ and $\mathbf{v}_{+}$ denote the vector given by the component-wise absolute value and positive part of $\mathbf{v},$ respectively, and diag(v) denotes the diagonal matrix with diagonal given by v; probability distributions and classification rules are denoted by upright fonts, e.g., p and $\mathrm{h}; \mathbb{E}_{z \sim \mathrm{p}}$ or simply $\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}$ denotes the expectation w.r.t. probability distribution p of random variable $z ;$ for a probability distribution p over $\mathcal{X}\times \mathcal{Y}$ , we denote by ${\mathrm{p}}_{x},{\mathrm{p}}_{y}$ its corresponding marginals over $\mathcal{X}$ and $\mathcal{Y}$, respectively, and by $\mathrm{p}_{x \mid y}$ the corresponding conditional distribution given $y \in \mathcal{Y}; \preceq$ and $\succeq$ denote vector (component-wise) inequalities; $\mathbf{1}$ denotes a vector with all components equal to 1 and $\mathbb{I}\{\cdot \}$ denotes the indicator function; finally, for a function of two variables $f:\mathcal{X}\times\mathcal{Y}\to\mathcal{Z},f(x,\cdot)$ denotes the function $f(x,\cdot):\mathcal{Y}\to\mathcal{Z}$ obtained by fixing $x \in \mathcal{X}$

context.name: Setup: instances, labels, distributions, classification rules (Section 2.1)
context.statement: Classification techniques assign instances in a set $\mathcal{X}$ to labels in a set $\mathcal{Y}$, where $\mathcal{X}$ is a Borel subset of $\mathbb{R}^{d}$ and $\mathcal{Y}$ is a finite set represented by $\{1,2,\ldots,|\mathcal{Y}|\}$ . We denote by $\Delta(\mathcal{X}\times\mathcal{Y})$ the set of Borel probability measures p on $\mathcal{X}\times \mathcal{Y}$ , also referred to as probability distributions. Both randomized and deterministic classification rules are given by functions from instances to probability distributions on labels (Markov transitions). We denote the set of all classification rules by $\mathrm{T}(\mathcal{X},\mathcal{Y})$ , and for $\mathrm{~h~}\in\mathrm{~T~}(\mathcal{X},\mathcal{Y})$ we denote by $\mathrm{h}(y|x)$ the probability with which instance $x \in \mathcal{X}$ is classified by label $y\in\mathcal{Y}\ (\mathrm{h}(y|x)\in\{0,1\}$ if labels are deterministically assigned to instances).

context.name: 0-1 loss and expected loss l(h,p) (Section 2.1)
context.statement:
Supervised classification techniques use n training instance-label pairs $(x_{1},y_{1}),(x_{2},y_{2}),\ldots,(x_{n},y_{n})$ from the underlying distribution $\mathrm{p}^{\ast}$ to find classification rules that assign labels to instances with small error probability. If $\mathrm{p}^{*}\in\Delta(\mathcal{X}\times\mathcal{Y})$ is the true underlying distribution of instance-label pairs, the error probability of a classification rule $\mathrm{h}\in\mathrm{T}(\mathcal{X},\mathcal{Y})$ is its expected 0-1 loss denoted by $R\mathrm{(h)}$ , that is

$$
R(\mathrm{h})=\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}^{*}}\{\ell(\mathrm{h},(x,y))\}
$$

with $\ell(\mathrm{h},(x,y))=1-\mathrm{h}(y|x)$ the 0-1 loss of rule h at instance-label pair $(x,y)$ . In the following, we overload the notation for the loss function and denote the expected loss of h with respect to probability distribution p as $\ell(\mathrm{h},\mathrm{p}): =\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\ell(\mathrm{h},(x,y))\}$

context.name: Feature mapping: bounded Borel measurable (Section 2.2)
context.statement: The proposed MRCs minimize the worst-case expected 0-1 loss with respect to distributions in uncertainty sets that can contain the true underlying distribution with a tunable confidence. These uncertainty sets are given by constraints on the expectations of a vector-valued bounded and Borel measurable function $\Phi : \mathcal{X}\times \mathcal{Y}\to \mathbb{R}^{m}$ referred to as feature mapping, e.g., multiple polynomials on x and y or one-hot encodings of the last layers in an NN. Such mappings are commonly used in machine learning to represent instance-label pairs as real vectors (see e.g., Mohri et al. (2018); Bengio et al. (2013) and next Section 3.1).

context.name: Uncertainty set (4) and regularity conditions R1, R2 (Section 2.2)
context.statement:
In the following we consider uncertainty sets

$$
\mathcal{U}=\left\{{\mathrm p}\in\Delta(\mathcal{X},\mathcal{Y}):~|\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi\}-\pmb{\tau}|\preceq\lambda\right\}\tag{4}
$$

given by a feature mapping $\Phi$ together with mean and confidence vectors $\tau \in \mathbb{R}^{m}$ and $\pmb{\lambda}\in \mathbb{R}^{m}$ , and satisfying one of the following regularity conditions.

R1 The set $\mathcal{X}$ is finite and there exists a probability measure p in $\mathcal{U}$

R2 There exists a probability measure p in $\mathcal{U}$ such that $|\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}}\{\Phi(x,y)^{(i)}\}-\pmb{\tau}^{(i)}| <\lambda^{(i)}$ for any $i\in\{1,2,\dots,m\}$ with $\lambda^{(i)}>0$ and

R2.1 $\lambda^{(i)}>0$ for all $i\in\{1,2,\dots,m\}$ or

R2.2 the support of the r.v. $\Phi(x,y)$ for $(x,y)\sim\mathrm{p}$ is not contained in a proper affine subspace of $\mathbb{R}^{m}$

context.name: Role of the regularity conditions (Section 2.2)
context.statement: These regularity conditions are utilized to ensure strong duality holds for the inner maximization in the minimax problems, and they are satisfied with wide generality.

context.name: Mean vector estimate tau_n, eq. (5) (Section 2.2)
context.statement:
The mean vector $\tau \in \mathbb{R}^{m}$ in (4) is an estimate of the feature mapping expectation $\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}^{*}}\{\Phi \}$ with respect to the underlying distribution. In this paper, we consider expectation estimates obtained as the sample average

$$
\tau_{n}=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\Phi(x_{i},y_{i})\tag{5}
$$

obtained from the n training samples $(x_{1},y_{1}),(x_{2},y_{2}),\dotsc,(x_{n},y_{n})$ that are assumed to be independent samples from the underlying distribution $\mathrm{p}^{\ast}$ . Nevertheless, it is important to note that most of the results presented in the paper as well as the general methodology proposed can be utilized with general types of expectation estimates. Alternative estimators for the expectation can be preferred in several practical scenarios including cases with different distributions at training and test (Mohri and Medina, 2012; Mazuelas and Perez, 2020; Álvarez et al., 2022) and cases where the distribution of features has heavy tails (Lugosi and Mendelson, 2019; Hsu and Sabato, 2016).

context.name: Confidence vector lambda (Section 2.2)
context.statement: The confidence vector $\pmb{\lambda}\in \mathbb{R}^{m}$ in (4) is an estimate of the mean vector component-wise accuracy $\left| \mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{p}^{*}}\{\Phi \}- \tau \right|$ , and controls the size of the uncertainty set considered. In particular, if λ corresponds to the length of confidence intervals at level $1 - \delta$ centered at $\tau$, then the true underlying distribution is included in the uncertainty set (4) with probability at least $1 - \delta$. Section 3.2 describes how to choose such confidence vectors for different feature mappings.

context.name: Feature mapping (16): one-hot label blocks of scalar features (Section 3.1)
context.statement:
Most of the results presented in the paper are valid for general feature mappings $\Phi : \mathcal{X}\times \mathcal{Y}\to \mathbb{R}^{m}$. In this section we describe feature mappings that are common in supervised classification and will be used later in the paper. Such feature mappings are given by real-valued functions over the set of instances $\psi : \mathcal{X}\to \mathbb{R}$ , referred to as scalar features. The most common and simple way to define feature mappings over $\mathcal{X}$ and $\mathcal{Y}$ is to use multiple scalar features over $\mathcal{X}$ together with a one-hot encoding of the elements of $\mathcal{Y}$ (Tsochantaridis et al., 2005; Crammer et al., 2006; Mohri et al., 2018) as follows

$$
\Phi(x,y)=[\mathbb{I}\{y=1\}\Psi(x)^{\mathrm{T}},\mathbb{I}\{y=2\}\Psi(x)^{\mathrm{T}},\ldots,\mathbb{I}\{y= |\mathcal{Y}|\}\Psi(x)^{\mathrm{T}}]^{\mathrm{T}}=\mathbf{e}_{y}\otimes\Psi(x)\tag{16}
$$

where $\Psi(x)=[\psi_{1}(x),\psi_{2}(x),\ldots,\psi_{D}(x)]^{\mathrm{T}}$ for D scalar features $\psi_{1},\psi_{2},\ldots,\psi_{D},\mathbf{e}_{y}$ is the $y \mathrm{- t h}$ vector in the standard basis of $\mathbb{R}^{| \mathcal{Y}|}$ , and $\otimes$ denotes the Kronecker product. The feature mapping $\Phi$ represents each instance-label pair $(x,y)$ by an m-dimensional real vector with $m = | \mathcal{Y}| D$ , so that $\Phi(x,y)$ is composed by $|\mathcal{Y}|$ $D$-dimensional blocks with values $\Psi(x)$ in the block corresponding to y and zero otherwise. Other feature mappings can exploit relationships among classes as described for instance in Bakir et al. (2007); Caponnetto et al. (2008).

context.name: Section 3.2 setup and coverage definition of lambda_delta
context.statement:
In this section, we describe conditions for confidence vectors λ that lead to uncertainty sets given by (4) that contain the true underlying distribution with high probability. Specifically, we consider uncertainty sets U given by feature mappings defined by (16) using scalar features in a family $\mathcal{F}$ together with mean vectors obtained as in (5) using the sample average of n independent samples from the underlying distribution $\mathrm{p}^{\ast}$

We denote by $\lambda_{\delta}$ any confidence vector that has coverage probability at least $1-\delta,$ $\begin{array}{r}{\mathrm{i.e.,}\operatorname{\mathbb{P}}\{|{\mathbb{E}}_{\mathrm{p}^{*}}\{\Phi\}-\pmb{\tau}|\preceq\lambda_{\delta}\}\geq 1-\delta,}\end{array}$ so that the underlying distribution $\mathrm{p}^{\ast}$ is included with probability at least $1 - \delta$ in the uncertainty set given by $\lambda_{\delta}$ . The following result describes such confidence vectors in terms of the cardinality $|\mathcal{F}|$, the empirical variance of the feature mapping, and the Rademacher complexity $\mathcal{R}_{n}(\mathcal{F})$ . In most of the results in the paper, we utilize feature mappings given by scalar features chosen before the training samples are observed. In such cases, appropriate confidence vectors are given in terms of the cardinality $| \mathcal F |$ , i.e., the number of scalar features used. However, the methods proposed can also be used with data-dependent feature mappings. In such cases, appropriate confidence vectors are given in terms of the Rademacher complexity $\mathcal{R}_{n}(\mathcal{F})$ where $\mathcal{F}$ is the family of candidate scalar features. For instance, $\mathcal{F}$ can be family of all decision stumps and the feature mapping can be defined using the decision stumps found by one-dimensional decision trees learned using the training samples, as in Mazuelas et al. (2020).

context.name: Lemma 11, display (36) (weak duality bound, Appendix A)
context.statement:
Lemma 11 Let U be an uncertainty set given by (4). For any h $\in T(\mathcal{X},\mathcal{Y})$ , we have that

$$
\operatorname*{sup}_{\mathbf{p}\in\mathcal{U}}\ell(\mathbf{h},\mathbf{p})\le\operatorname*{inf}_{\mu\in\mathbb{R}^{m}}1-\tau^{T}\pmb{\mu}+\operatorname*{sup}_{x\in\mathcal{X},y\in\mathcal{Y}}\left\{\Phi(x,y)^{T}\pmb{\mu}-\mathrm{h}(y|x)\right\}+\lambda^{T}|\mu|\tag{36}
$$

section Weak

variable {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {𝒴 : Type*} [Fintype 𝒴] [MeasurableSpace 𝒴]
  {m : ℕ}

lemma aux_h_le_one (h : 𝒳 → 𝒴 → ℝ) (hnn : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ h x y)
    (hsum : ∀ x, ∑ y, h x y = 1) (x : 𝒳) (y : 𝒴) : h x y ≤ 1 := by
  rw [← hsum x]
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hnn x j) (Finset.mem_univ y)

lemma aux_integrable_of_bdd (p : Measure (𝒳 × 𝒴)) [IsFiniteMeasure p]
    (f : 𝒳 × 𝒴 → ℝ) (hf : Measurable f) (K : ℝ) (hK : ∀ z, |f z| ≤ K) :
    Integrable f p := by
  refine (integrable_const K).mono' hf.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
  filter_upwards with z
  simpa using hK z

lemma aux_bdd_lin (Φ : 𝒳 → 𝒴 → Fin m → ℝ) (B : ℝ) (hΦbdd : ∀ x y i, |Φ x y i| ≤ B)
    (μ : Fin m → ℝ) (z : 𝒳 × 𝒴) :
    |∑ i, Φ z.1 z.2 i * μ i| ≤ B * ∑ i, |μ i| := by
  calc |∑ i, Φ z.1 z.2 i * μ i| ≤ ∑ i, |Φ z.1 z.2 i * μ i| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ i, B * |μ i| := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => ?_)
        rw [abs_mul]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hΦbdd _ _ i) (abs_nonneg _)
    _ = B * ∑ i, |μ i| := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]


variable (Φ : 𝒳 → 𝒴 → Fin m → ℝ) (h : 𝒳 → 𝒴 → ℝ) (B : ℝ)

lemma aux_integral_f (p : Measure (𝒳 × 𝒴)) [IsFiniteMeasure p]
    (hΦmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => Φ z.1 z.2 i))
    (hΦbdd : ∀ x y i, |Φ x y i| ≤ B)
    (hhmeas : Measurable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => h z.1 z.2))
    (hrule_nonneg : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ h x y) (hrule_sum : ∀ x, ∑ y, h x y = 1)
    (μ : Fin m → ℝ) :
    ∫ z, ((∑ i, Φ z.1 z.2 i * μ i) - h z.1 z.2) ∂p
      = (∑ i, featExpectM Φ p i * μ i) - ∫ z, h z.1 z.2 ∂p := by
  have hiΦ : ∀ i, Integrable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => Φ z.1 z.2 i) p := fun i =>
    aux_integrable_of_bdd p _ (hΦmeas i) B (fun z => hΦbdd _ _ i)
  have hih : Integrable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => h z.1 z.2) p :=
    aux_integrable_of_bdd p _ hhmeas 1 (fun z => by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (hrule_nonneg _ _)]
      exact aux_h_le_one h hrule_nonneg hrule_sum _ _)
  have hisum : Integrable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => ∑ i, Φ z.1 z.2 i * μ i) p :=
    integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => (hiΦ i).mul_const _)
  rw [integral_sub hisum hih]
  congr 1
  rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => (hiΦ i).mul_const _)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
  rw [integral_mul_const]
  rfl

lemma aux_weak_upper (τ lam : Fin m → ℝ) (p : Measure (𝒳 × 𝒴))
    (hΦmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => Φ z.1 z.2 i))
    (hΦbdd : ∀ x y i, |Φ x y i| ≤ B)
    (hhmeas : Measurable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => h z.1 z.2))
    (hrule_nonneg : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ h x y) (hrule_sum : ∀ x, ∑ y, h x y = 1)
    (hp : inUncertaintySetM Φ τ lam p) (μ : Fin m → ℝ) :
    expectedLossM h p ≤ 1 - (∑ i, τ i * μ i)
      + (⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - h q.1 q.2)) + (∑ i, lam i * |μ i|) := by
  obtain ⟨hprob, hcon⟩ := hp
  have hbddabove : BddAbove (Set.range (fun q : 𝒳 × 𝒴 =>
      (∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - h q.1 q.2)) := by
    refine ⟨B * ∑ i, |μ i|, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨q, rfl⟩
    have h1 := aux_bdd_lin Φ B hΦbdd μ q
    have h2 := hrule_nonneg q.1 q.2
    have := (abs_le.mp h1).2
    linarith
  have hle : ∀ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - h q.1 q.2)
      ≤ (⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - h q.1 q.2)) := fun q => le_ciSup hbddabove q
  have hiΦ : ∀ i, Integrable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => Φ z.1 z.2 i) p := fun i =>
    aux_integrable_of_bdd p _ (hΦmeas i) B (fun z => hΦbdd _ _ i)
  have hih : Integrable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => h z.1 z.2) p :=
    aux_integrable_of_bdd p _ hhmeas 1 (fun z => by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (hrule_nonneg _ _)]
      exact aux_h_le_one h hrule_nonneg hrule_sum _ _)
  have hif : Integrable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => (∑ i, Φ z.1 z.2 i * μ i) - h z.1 z.2) p :=
    (integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => (hiΦ i).mul_const _)).sub hih
  have hint_le : ∫ z, ((∑ i, Φ z.1 z.2 i * μ i) - h z.1 z.2) ∂p
      ≤ (⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - h q.1 q.2)) := by
    have := integral_mono hif (integrable_const _) hle
    simpa using this
  rw [aux_integral_f Φ h B p hΦmeas hΦbdd hhmeas hrule_nonneg hrule_sum μ] at hint_le
  have hEL : expectedLossM h p = 1 - ∫ z, h z.1 z.2 ∂p := by
    rw [expectedLossM, integral_sub (integrable_const _) hih]
    simp
  have hcon2 : |∑ i, (featExpectM Φ p i - τ i) * μ i| ≤ ∑ i, lam i * |μ i| := by
    calc |∑ i, (featExpectM Φ p i - τ i) * μ i|
        ≤ ∑ i, |(featExpectM Φ p i - τ i) * μ i| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ i, lam i * |μ i| := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => by
          rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hcon i) (abs_nonneg _))
  have hsplit : (∑ i, (featExpectM Φ p i - τ i) * μ i)
      = (∑ i, featExpectM Φ p i * μ i) - (∑ i, τ i * μ i) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
  rw [hEL]
  rw [hsplit] at hcon2
  have hc := abs_le.mp hcon2
  linarith [hc.1, hc.2]

lemma aux_weak_lower (τ lam : Fin m → ℝ) (p : Measure (𝒳 × 𝒴))
    (hΦmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => Φ z.1 z.2 i))
    (hΦbdd : ∀ x y i, |Φ x y i| ≤ B)
    (hhmeas : Measurable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => h z.1 z.2))
    (hrule_nonneg : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ h x y) (hrule_sum : ∀ x, ∑ y, h x y = 1)
    (hp : inUncertaintySetM Φ τ lam p) (μ : Fin m → ℝ) :
    1 - (∑ i, τ i * μ i)
      + (⨅ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - h q.1 q.2)) - (∑ i, lam i * |μ i|)
      ≤ expectedLossM h p := by
  obtain ⟨hprob, hcon⟩ := hp
  have hbddbelow : BddBelow (Set.range (fun q : 𝒳 × 𝒴 =>
      (∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - h q.1 q.2)) := by
    refine ⟨-(B * ∑ i, |μ i|) - 1, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨q, rfl⟩
    have h1 := aux_bdd_lin Φ B hΦbdd μ q
    have h2 := aux_h_le_one h hrule_nonneg hrule_sum q.1 q.2
    have := (abs_le.mp h1).1
    linarith
  have hle : ∀ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, (⨅ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - h q.1 q.2))
      ≤ ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - h q.1 q.2) := fun q => ciInf_le hbddbelow q
  have hiΦ : ∀ i, Integrable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => Φ z.1 z.2 i) p := fun i =>
    aux_integrable_of_bdd p _ (hΦmeas i) B (fun z => hΦbdd _ _ i)
  have hih : Integrable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => h z.1 z.2) p :=
    aux_integrable_of_bdd p _ hhmeas 1 (fun z => by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (hrule_nonneg _ _)]
      exact aux_h_le_one h hrule_nonneg hrule_sum _ _)
  have hif : Integrable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => (∑ i, Φ z.1 z.2 i * μ i) - h z.1 z.2) p :=
    (integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => (hiΦ i).mul_const _)).sub hih
  have hint_le : (⨅ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - h q.1 q.2))
      ≤ ∫ z, ((∑ i, Φ z.1 z.2 i * μ i) - h z.1 z.2) ∂p := by
    have := integral_mono (integrable_const _) hif hle
    simpa using this
  rw [aux_integral_f Φ h B p hΦmeas hΦbdd hhmeas hrule_nonneg hrule_sum μ] at hint_le
  have hEL : expectedLossM h p = 1 - ∫ z, h z.1 z.2 ∂p := by
    rw [expectedLossM, integral_sub (integrable_const _) hih]
    simp
  have hcon2 : |∑ i, (featExpectM Φ p i - τ i) * μ i| ≤ ∑ i, lam i * |μ i| := by
    calc |∑ i, (featExpectM Φ p i - τ i) * μ i|
        ≤ ∑ i, |(featExpectM Φ p i - τ i) * μ i| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ i, lam i * |μ i| := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => by
          rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hcon i) (abs_nonneg _))
  have hsplit : (∑ i, (featExpectM Φ p i - τ i) * μ i)
      = (∑ i, featExpectM Φ p i * μ i) - (∑ i, τ i * μ i) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
  rw [hEL]
  rw [hsplit] at hcon2
  have hc := abs_le.mp hcon2
  linarith [hc.1, hc.2]

end Weak

lemma aux_coercive_min {m : ℕ} (Ψ : (Fin m → ℝ) → ℝ) (hcont : Continuous Ψ)
    (α β : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hlb : ∀ μ, α * (∑ i, |μ i|) + β ≤ Ψ μ) :
    ∃ μ₀, ∀ μ, Ψ μ₀ ≤ Ψ μ := by
  set r : ℝ := (Ψ 0 - β) / α with hrdef
  have hβ : β ≤ Ψ 0 := by
    have := hlb 0
    simpa using this
  have hr : 0 ≤ r := div_nonneg (by linarith) hα.le
  have hcomp : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall (0 : Fin m → ℝ) r) := isCompact_closedBall _ _
  have hne : (Metric.closedBall (0 : Fin m → ℝ) r).Nonempty := ⟨0, by simp [hr]⟩
  obtain ⟨μ₀, hμ₀mem, hμ₀⟩ := hcomp.exists_isMinOn hne hcont.continuousOn
  refine ⟨μ₀, fun μ => ?_⟩
  by_cases hμ : μ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : Fin m → ℝ) r
  · exact isMinOn_iff.mp hμ₀ μ hμ
  · have h1 : r < ‖μ‖ := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hμ
    have h2 : ‖μ‖ ≤ ∑ i, |μ i| := by
      refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg ?_).2 (fun i => ?_)
      · exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
      · exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |μ i|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_univ i)
    have h3 : Ψ μ₀ ≤ Ψ 0 := isMinOn_iff.mp hμ₀ 0 (by simp [hr])
    have h4 := hlb μ
    have h5 : α * r + β ≤ α * (∑ i, |μ i|) + β := by nlinarith
    have h6 : α * r = Ψ 0 - β := by
      rw [hrdef]
      field_simp
    linarith


lemma aux_coercive_min_on {m : ℕ} (Ψ : (Fin m → ℝ) → ℝ) (hcont : Continuous Ψ)
    (T : Set (Fin m → ℝ)) (hTc : IsClosed T) (hT0 : (0 : Fin m → ℝ) ∈ T)
    (α β : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hlb : ∀ μ ∈ T, α * (∑ i, |μ i|) + β ≤ Ψ μ) :
    ∃ μ₀ ∈ T, ∀ μ ∈ T, Ψ μ₀ ≤ Ψ μ := by
  set r : ℝ := (Ψ 0 - β) / α with hrdef
  have hβ : β ≤ Ψ 0 := by simpa using hlb 0 hT0
  have hr : 0 ≤ r := div_nonneg (by linarith) hα.le
  have hcomp : IsCompact (T ∩ Metric.closedBall (0 : Fin m → ℝ) r) :=
    (isCompact_closedBall _ _).inter_left hTc
  have hne : (T ∩ Metric.closedBall (0 : Fin m → ℝ) r).Nonempty := ⟨0, hT0, by simp [hr]⟩
  obtain ⟨μ₀, hμ₀mem, hμ₀⟩ := hcomp.exists_isMinOn hne hcont.continuousOn
  refine ⟨μ₀, hμ₀mem.1, fun μ hμT => ?_⟩
  by_cases hμ : μ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : Fin m → ℝ) r
  · exact isMinOn_iff.mp hμ₀ μ ⟨hμT, hμ⟩
  · have h1 : r < ‖μ‖ := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hμ
    have h2 : ‖μ‖ ≤ ∑ i, |μ i| := by
      refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg ?_).2 (fun i => ?_)
      · exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
      · exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |μ i|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_univ i)
    have h3 : Ψ μ₀ ≤ Ψ 0 := isMinOn_iff.mp hμ₀ 0 ⟨hT0, by simp [hr]⟩
    have h4 := hlb μ hμT
    have h5 : α * r + β ≤ α * (∑ i, |μ i|) + β := by nlinarith
    have h6 : α * r = Ψ 0 - β := by rw [hrdef]; field_simp
    linarith


lemma aux_sup'_smul {J : Type*} (T : Finset J) (hT : T.Nonempty) (σ : ℝ) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (f : J → ℝ) : T.sup' hT (fun j => σ * f j) = σ * T.sup' hT f :=
  (Finset.comp_sup'_eq_sup'_comp hT (fun x : ℝ => σ * x)
    (fun x y => mul_max_of_nonneg x y hσ)).symm

lemma aux_sup'_add_const {J : Type*} (T : Finset J) (hT : T.Nonempty) (a : ℝ)
    (f : J → ℝ) : T.sup' hT (fun j => f j + a) = T.sup' hT f + a :=
  (Finset.comp_sup'_eq_sup'_comp hT (fun x : ℝ => x + a)
    (fun x y => (max_add_add_right x y a).symm)).symm

lemma aux_VS_closed {m : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin m)) :
    IsClosed {e : Fin m → ℝ | ∀ i, i ∉ S → e i = 0} := by
  have hEq : {e : Fin m → ℝ | ∀ i, i ∉ S → e i = 0}
      = ⋂ i ∈ {i : Fin m | i ∉ S}, {e : Fin m → ℝ | e i = 0} := by
    ext e
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_iInter]
  rw [hEq]
  exact isClosed_biInter (fun i _ => isClosed_eq (continuous_apply i) continuous_const)

lemma aux_poly_min {m : ℕ} {J : Type*} [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    (c : J → Fin m → ℝ) (d : J → ℝ) :
    ∀ (k : ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin m)), S.card = k →
    ∀ (T : Finset J) (hT : T.Nonempty) (lb : ℝ),
      (∀ μ : Fin m → ℝ, (∀ i, i ∉ S → μ i = 0) →
          lb ≤ T.sup' hT (fun j => (∑ i, c j i * μ i) + d j)) →
      ∃ μ₀ : Fin m → ℝ, (∀ i, i ∉ S → μ₀ i = 0) ∧
        ∀ μ : Fin m → ℝ, (∀ i, i ∉ S → μ i = 0) →
          T.sup' hT (fun j => (∑ i, c j i * μ₀ i) + d j)
            ≤ T.sup' hT (fun j => (∑ i, c j i * μ i) + d j) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      intro S hS T hT lb _
      have hSempty : S = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp hS
      refine ⟨0, fun i _ => rfl, fun μ hμ => ?_⟩
      have hμ0 : μ = 0 := by
        funext i
        exact hμ i (by simp [hSempty])
      rw [hμ0]
  | succ k ih =>
      intro S hS T hT lb hlb
      classical
      have hlbD : lb ≤ T.sup' hT d := by
        have := hlb 0 (fun i _ => rfl)
        simpa using this
      by_cases hA : ∃ e : Fin m → ℝ, (∀ i, i ∉ S → e i = 0) ∧ e ≠ 0 ∧
          ∀ j ∈ T, (∑ i, c j i * e i) ≤ 0
      · obtain ⟨e, heS, hene, hele⟩ := hA
        set T' : Finset J := T.filter (fun j => (∑ i, c j i * e i) = 0) with hT'def
        have hT'sub : T' ⊆ T := Finset.filter_subset _ _
        obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀e⟩ : ∃ i, e i ≠ 0 := by
          by_contra hcon
          push_neg at hcon
          exact hene (funext hcon)
        have hi₀S : i₀ ∈ S := by
          by_contra hcon
          exact hi₀e (heS i₀ hcon)
        have hT'ne : T'.Nonempty := by
          by_contra hemp
          rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hemp
          have hneg : ∀ j ∈ T, (∑ i, c j i * e i) < 0 := by
            intro j hj
            rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (hele j hj) with hlt | heq
            · exact hlt
            · exfalso
              have hmem : j ∈ T' := by
                rw [hT'def]; exact Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hj, heq⟩
              rw [hemp] at hmem
              exact absurd hmem (Finset.notMem_empty j)
          have hκneg : T.sup' hT (fun j => (∑ i, c j i * e i)) < 0 :=
            (Finset.sup'_lt_iff hT).2 hneg
          set κ : ℝ := T.sup' hT (fun j => (∑ i, c j i * e i)) with hκ
          set D : ℝ := T.sup' hT d with hD
          set t : ℝ := (lb - D - 1) / κ with ht
          have htpos : 0 < t := by
            rw [ht]
            apply div_pos_of_neg_of_neg
            · linarith
            · exact hκneg
          have hmem : ∀ i, i ∉ S → (fun i => t * e i) i = 0 := by
            intro i hi; simp only; rw [heS i hi]; ring
          have hlow := hlb (fun i => t * e i) hmem
          have hbound : T.sup' hT (fun j => (∑ i, c j i * (t * e i)) + d j) ≤ t * κ + D := by
            refine Finset.sup'_le hT _ (fun j hj => ?_)
            have h1 : (∑ i, c j i * (t * e i)) = t * (∑ i, c j i * e i) := by
              rw [Finset.mul_sum]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
            rw [h1]
            have h2 : (∑ i, c j i * e i) ≤ κ := by
              rw [hκ]; exact Finset.le_sup' (fun j => ∑ i, c j i * e i) hj
            have h3 : d j ≤ D := by rw [hD]; exact Finset.le_sup' d hj
            nlinarith
          have hκne : κ ≠ 0 := ne_of_lt hκneg
          have htκ : t * κ = lb - D - 1 := by
            rw [ht]; field_simp
          linarith
        have hGF : ∀ μ : Fin m → ℝ,
            T'.sup' hT'ne (fun j => (∑ i, c j i * μ i) + d j)
              ≤ T.sup' hT (fun j => (∑ i, c j i * μ i) + d j) :=
          fun μ => Finset.sup'_mono _ hT'sub hT'ne
        have hGinv : ∀ (μ : Fin m → ℝ) (s : ℝ),
            T'.sup' hT'ne (fun j => (∑ i, c j i * (μ i + s * e i)) + d j)
              = T'.sup' hT'ne (fun j => (∑ i, c j i * μ i) + d j) := by
          intro μ s
          refine Finset.sup'_congr hT'ne rfl (fun j hj => ?_)
          have hj0 : (∑ i, c j i * e i) = 0 := by
            rw [hT'def] at hj
            exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2
          have hexp : (∑ i, c j i * (μ i + s * e i))
              = (∑ i, c j i * μ i) + s * (∑ i, c j i * e i) := by
            rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
            exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
          rw [hexp, hj0]
          ring
        have hFt : ∀ μ : Fin m → ℝ, ∃ t : ℝ,
            T.sup' hT (fun j => (∑ i, c j i * (μ i + t * e i)) + d j)
              ≤ T'.sup' hT'ne (fun j => (∑ i, c j i * μ i) + d j) := by
          intro μ
          set G : ℝ := T'.sup' hT'ne (fun j => (∑ i, c j i * μ i) + d j) with hG
          refine ⟨∑ j ∈ T.filter (fun j => (∑ i, c j i * e i) ≠ 0),
            |(G - ((∑ i, c j i * μ i) + d j)) / (∑ i, c j i * e i)|, ?_⟩
          set t : ℝ := ∑ j ∈ T.filter (fun j => (∑ i, c j i * e i) ≠ 0),
            |(G - ((∑ i, c j i * μ i) + d j)) / (∑ i, c j i * e i)| with htdef
          refine Finset.sup'_le hT _ (fun j hj => ?_)
          have hlin : (∑ i, c j i * (μ i + t * e i)) + d j
              = ((∑ i, c j i * μ i) + d j) + t * (∑ i, c j i * e i) := by
            rw [show (∑ i, c j i * (μ i + t * e i))
                = (∑ i, c j i * μ i) + t * (∑ i, c j i * e i) from by
              rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
              exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)]
            ring
          rw [hlin]
          by_cases hj0 : (∑ i, c j i * e i) = 0
          · rw [hj0, mul_zero, add_zero]
            have hmem : j ∈ T' := by
              rw [hT'def]; exact Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hj, hj0⟩
            exact Finset.le_sup' (fun j => (∑ i, c j i * μ i) + d j) hmem
          · have hlt : (∑ i, c j i * e i) < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (hele j hj) hj0
            have hjmem : j ∈ T.filter (fun j => (∑ i, c j i * e i) ≠ 0) :=
              Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hj, hj0⟩
            have hterm : |(G - ((∑ i, c j i * μ i) + d j)) / (∑ i, c j i * e i)| ≤ t := by
              rw [htdef]
              exact Finset.single_le_sum
                (f := fun j => |(G - ((∑ i, c j i * μ i) + d j)) / (∑ i, c j i * e i)|)
                (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _) hjmem
            have h1 : (G - ((∑ i, c j i * μ i) + d j)) / (∑ i, c j i * e i) ≤ t :=
              le_trans (le_abs_self _) hterm
            have h2 := (div_le_iff_of_neg hlt).mp h1
            linarith
        set S' : Finset (Fin m) := S.erase i₀ with hS'
        have hS'card : S'.card = k := by
          rw [hS', Finset.card_erase_of_mem hi₀S, hS]
          omega
        have hlb' : ∀ μ : Fin m → ℝ, (∀ i, i ∉ S' → μ i = 0) →
            lb ≤ T'.sup' hT'ne (fun j => (∑ i, c j i * μ i) + d j) := by
          intro μ hμ
          obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hFt μ
          have hmem : ∀ i, i ∉ S → (fun i => μ i + t * e i) i = 0 := by
            intro i hi
            have h1 : μ i = 0 := hμ i (fun hh => hi (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hh))
            simp only
            rw [h1, heS i hi]; ring
          exact le_trans (hlb _ hmem) ht
        obtain ⟨ν, hνS', hνmin⟩ := ih S' hS'card T' hT'ne lb hlb'
        have hνminS : ∀ μ : Fin m → ℝ, (∀ i, i ∉ S → μ i = 0) →
            T'.sup' hT'ne (fun j => (∑ i, c j i * ν i) + d j)
              ≤ T'.sup' hT'ne (fun j => (∑ i, c j i * μ i) + d j) := by
          intro μ hμ
          set sc : ℝ := -(μ i₀ / e i₀) with hsc
          have hmem : ∀ i, i ∉ S' → (fun i => μ i + sc * e i) i = 0 := by
            intro i hi
            simp only
            rcases eq_or_ne i i₀ with rfl | hne
            · rw [hsc]; field_simp; ring
            · have hiS : i ∉ S := by
                intro hh; exact hi (Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨hne, hh⟩)
              rw [hμ i hiS, heS i hiS]; ring
          have hres := hνmin _ hmem
          rwa [hGinv μ sc] at hres
        obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hFt ν
        refine ⟨fun i => ν i + t * e i, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro i hi
          have hν0 : ν i = 0 := hνS' i (fun hh => hi (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hh))
          simp only
          rw [hν0, heS i hi]; ring
        · intro μ hμ
          calc T.sup' hT (fun j => (∑ i, c j i * (ν i + t * e i)) + d j)
              ≤ T'.sup' hT'ne (fun j => (∑ i, c j i * ν i) + d j) := ht
            _ ≤ T'.sup' hT'ne (fun j => (∑ i, c j i * μ i) + d j) := hνminS μ hμ
            _ ≤ T.sup' hT (fun j => (∑ i, c j i * μ i) + d j) := hGF μ
      · push_neg at hA
        obtain ⟨i₁, hi₁⟩ : S.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by rw [hS]; omega)
        set A : Set (Fin m → ℝ) := {e | (∀ i, i ∉ S → e i = 0) ∧ (∑ i, |e i|) = 1} with hAdef
        have hAeq : A = {e : Fin m → ℝ | ∀ i, i ∉ S → e i = 0}
            ∩ {e : Fin m → ℝ | (∑ i, |e i|) = 1} := rfl
        have hAcl : IsClosed A := by
          rw [hAeq]
          exact (aux_VS_closed S).inter (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
        have hAsub : A ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : Fin m → ℝ) 1 := by
          intro e he
          simp only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
          refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg zero_le_one).2 (fun i => ?_)
          have h1 : |e i| ≤ ∑ j, |e j| :=
            Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |e j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
              (Finset.mem_univ i)
          rw [he.2] at h1
          simpa using h1
        have hAcomp : IsCompact A :=
          Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded hAcl
            (Metric.isBounded_closedBall.subset hAsub)
        have hAne : A.Nonempty := by
          refine ⟨fun i => if i = i₁ then 1 else 0, ?_, ?_⟩
          · intro i hi
            have : i ≠ i₁ := by rintro rfl; exact hi hi₁
            simp [this]
          · have habs : ∀ x : Fin m, |if x = i₁ then (1:ℝ) else 0|
                = if x = i₁ then (1:ℝ) else 0 := by
              intro x; split <;> simp
            simp_rw [habs]
            simp
        have hgcont : Continuous
            (fun μ : Fin m → ℝ => T.sup' hT (fun j => ∑ i, c j i * μ i)) :=
          Continuous.finset_sup'_apply hT (fun j _ => by fun_prop)
        obtain ⟨e₀, he₀A, he₀min⟩ := hAcomp.exists_isMinOn hAne hgcont.continuousOn
        set α : ℝ := T.sup' hT (fun j => ∑ i, c j i * e₀ i) with hαdef
        have he₀ne : e₀ ≠ 0 := by
          intro hcon
          have := he₀A.2
          rw [hcon] at this
          simp at this
        have hαpos : 0 < α := by
          obtain ⟨j, hjT, hj⟩ := hA e₀ he₀A.1 he₀ne
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith) (Finset.le_sup' (fun j => ∑ i, c j i * e₀ i) hjT)
        have hhom : ∀ (σ : ℝ), 0 ≤ σ → ∀ (μ : Fin m → ℝ),
            T.sup' hT (fun j => ∑ i, c j i * (σ * μ i))
              = σ * T.sup' hT (fun j => ∑ i, c j i * μ i) := by
          intro σ hσ μ
          have h1 : ∀ j, (∑ i, c j i * (σ * μ i)) = σ * (∑ i, c j i * μ i) := by
            intro j; rw [Finset.mul_sum]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
          simp_rw [h1]
          exact aux_sup'_smul T hT σ hσ _
        have hglb : ∀ μ : Fin m → ℝ, (∀ i, i ∉ S → μ i = 0) →
            α * (∑ i, |μ i|) ≤ T.sup' hT (fun j => ∑ i, c j i * μ i) := by
          intro μ hμ
          rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (Finset.sum_nonneg
            (fun i (_ : i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m))) => abs_nonneg (μ i))) with hz | hpos
          · have hμ0 : μ = 0 := by
              funext i
              have := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
                (fun i (_ : i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m))) => abs_nonneg (μ i))).mp hz.symm
                i (Finset.mem_univ i)
              exact abs_eq_zero.mp this
            rw [hμ0]
            simp
          · set σ : ℝ := ∑ i, |μ i| with hσdef
            have hσ : 0 < σ := hpos
            have heeA : (fun i => σ⁻¹ * μ i) ∈ A := by
              refine ⟨fun i hi => by simp [hμ i hi], ?_⟩
              have habs : ∀ i, |σ⁻¹ * μ i| = σ⁻¹ * |μ i| := by
                intro i; rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.2 hσ)]
              simp_rw [habs]
              rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← hσdef]
              field_simp
            have h1 : α ≤ T.sup' hT (fun j => ∑ i, c j i * (σ⁻¹ * μ i)) :=
              isMinOn_iff.mp he₀min _ heeA
            have hmid : σ * T.sup' hT (fun j => ∑ i, c j i * (σ⁻¹ * μ i))
                = T.sup' hT (fun j => ∑ i, c j i * μ i) := by
              rw [← hhom σ hσ.le]
              exact Finset.sup'_congr hT rfl (fun j _ =>
                Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by
                  rw [show σ * (σ⁻¹ * μ i) = μ i from by field_simp]))
            calc α * σ = σ * α := by ring
              _ ≤ σ * T.sup' hT (fun j => ∑ i, c j i * (σ⁻¹ * μ i)) := by nlinarith
              _ = T.sup' hT (fun j => ∑ i, c j i * μ i) := hmid
        set dmin : ℝ := T.inf' hT d with hdmin
        have hFlb : ∀ μ ∈ {e : Fin m → ℝ | ∀ i, i ∉ S → e i = 0},
            α * (∑ i, |μ i|) + dmin ≤ T.sup' hT (fun j => (∑ i, c j i * μ i) + d j) := by
          intro μ hμ
          have h1 := hglb μ hμ
          have h2 : T.sup' hT (fun j => ∑ i, c j i * μ i) + dmin
              ≤ T.sup' hT (fun j => (∑ i, c j i * μ i) + d j) := by
            rw [← aux_sup'_add_const T hT dmin (fun j => ∑ i, c j i * μ i)]
            refine Finset.sup'_le hT _ (fun j hj => ?_)
            have hd : dmin ≤ d j := Finset.inf'_le _ hj
            exact le_trans (by linarith : (∑ i, c j i * μ i) + dmin ≤ (∑ i, c j i * μ i) + d j)
              (Finset.le_sup' (fun j => (∑ i, c j i * μ i) + d j) hj)
          linarith
        obtain ⟨μ₀, hμ₀mem, hμ₀⟩ := aux_coercive_min_on
          (fun μ : Fin m → ℝ => T.sup' hT (fun j => (∑ i, c j i * μ i) + d j))
          (Continuous.finset_sup'_apply hT (fun j _ => by fun_prop))
          {e : Fin m → ℝ | ∀ i, i ∉ S → e i = 0} (aux_VS_closed S) (fun i _ => rfl)
          α dmin hαpos hFlb
        exact ⟨μ₀, hμ₀mem, hμ₀⟩

section CiSup

variable {Q : Type*} [Nonempty Q] {m : ℕ}

lemma aux_ciSup_bddAbove (a : Q → Fin m → ℝ) (b : Q → ℝ) (B Kb : ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ q i, |a q i| ≤ B) (hKb : ∀ q, |b q| ≤ Kb) (μ : Fin m → ℝ) :
    BddAbove (Set.range (fun q : Q => (∑ i, a q i * μ i) + b q)) := by
  refine ⟨B * (∑ i, |μ i|) + Kb, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨q, rfl⟩
  have h1 : |∑ i, a q i * μ i| ≤ B * ∑ i, |μ i| := by
    calc |∑ i, a q i * μ i| ≤ ∑ i, |a q i * μ i| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ i, B * |μ i| := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => by
          rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hB q i) (abs_nonneg _))
      _ = B * ∑ i, |μ i| := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  have h2 := (abs_le.mp h1).2
  have h3 := (abs_le.mp (hKb q)).2
  linarith

lemma aux_ciSup_shift (a : Q → Fin m → ℝ) (b : Q → ℝ) (B Kb : ℝ) (hB0 : 0 ≤ B)
    (hB : ∀ q i, |a q i| ≤ B) (hKb : ∀ q, |b q| ≤ Kb) (μ ν : Fin m → ℝ) :
    (⨆ q : Q, ((∑ i, a q i * μ i) + b q))
      ≤ (⨆ q : Q, ((∑ i, a q i * ν i) + b q)) + B * ∑ i, |μ i - ν i| := by
  refine ciSup_le (fun q => ?_)
  have hsplit : (∑ i, a q i * μ i) + b q
      = ((∑ i, a q i * ν i) + b q) + (∑ i, a q i * (μ i - ν i)) := by
    have hh : (∑ i, a q i * ν i) + (∑ i, a q i * (μ i - ν i)) = ∑ i, a q i * μ i := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
    linarith
  have h1 : (∑ i, a q i * (μ i - ν i)) ≤ B * ∑ i, |μ i - ν i| := by
    calc (∑ i, a q i * (μ i - ν i)) ≤ ∑ i, |a q i * (μ i - ν i)| :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => le_abs_self _)
      _ ≤ ∑ i, B * |μ i - ν i| := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => by
          rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hB q i) (abs_nonneg _))
      _ = B * ∑ i, |μ i - ν i| := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  have h2 : ((∑ i, a q i * ν i) + b q) ≤ ⨆ q : Q, ((∑ i, a q i * ν i) + b q) :=
    le_ciSup (aux_ciSup_bddAbove a b B Kb hB hKb ν) q
  rw [hsplit]
  linarith

lemma aux_ciSup_cont (a : Q → Fin m → ℝ) (b : Q → ℝ) (B Kb : ℝ) (hB0 : 0 ≤ B)
    (hB : ∀ q i, |a q i| ≤ B) (hKb : ∀ q, |b q| ≤ Kb) :
    Continuous (fun μ : Fin m → ℝ => ⨆ q : Q, ((∑ i, a q i * μ i) + b q)) := by
  rw [Metric.continuous_iff]
  intro ν ε hε
  refine ⟨ε / (B * m + 1), by positivity, fun μ hd => ?_⟩
  have hsum : (∑ i, |μ i - ν i|) ≤ (m : ℝ) * dist μ ν := by
    have hb : ∀ i : Fin m, |μ i - ν i| ≤ dist μ ν := by
      intro i
      have := dist_le_pi_dist μ ν i
      simpa [Real.dist_eq] using this
    calc (∑ i, |μ i - ν i|) ≤ ∑ _i : Fin m, dist μ ν := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hb i)
      _ = (m : ℝ) * dist μ ν := by simp [mul_comm]
  have h1 := aux_ciSup_shift a b B Kb hB0 hB hKb μ ν
  have h2 := aux_ciSup_shift a b B Kb hB0 hB hKb ν μ
  have habs : (∑ i, |ν i - μ i|) = ∑ i, |μ i - ν i| :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => abs_sub_comm _ _)
  rw [habs] at h2
  have hkey : B * (∑ i, |μ i - ν i|) ≤ B * ((m:ℝ) * dist μ ν) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum hB0
  have hdd : dist μ ν < ε / (B * m + 1) := hd
  have hpos : (0:ℝ) < B * m + 1 := by positivity
  have hfin : B * ((m:ℝ) * dist μ ν) < ε := by
    have : B * (m:ℝ) * dist μ ν < B * (m:ℝ) * (ε / (B * m + 1)) ∨ B * (m:ℝ) = 0 := by
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ B * (m:ℝ)) with h | h
      · right; exact h.symm
      · left; exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hdd h
    rcases this with h | h
    · have h2' : B * (m:ℝ) * (ε / (B * m + 1)) ≤ ε := by
        rw [mul_div_assoc']
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hpos]
        nlinarith [hε.le]
      calc B * ((m:ℝ) * dist μ ν) = B * (m:ℝ) * dist μ ν := by ring
        _ < B * (m:ℝ) * (ε / (B * m + 1)) := h
        _ ≤ ε := h2'
    · calc B * ((m:ℝ) * dist μ ν) = B * (m:ℝ) * dist μ ν := by ring
        _ = 0 * dist μ ν := by rw [h]
        _ = 0 := by ring
        _ < ε := hε
  rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_lt]
  constructor <;> linarith

lemma aux_ciSup_smul (a : Q → Fin m → ℝ) (B : ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ q i, |a q i| ≤ B) (σ : ℝ) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (μ : Fin m → ℝ) :
    (⨆ q : Q, (∑ i, a q i * (σ * μ i))) = σ * ⨆ q : Q, (∑ i, a q i * μ i) := by
  have hbdd : ∀ ν : Fin m → ℝ, BddAbove (Set.range (fun q : Q => ∑ i, a q i * ν i)) := by
    intro ν
    have := aux_ciSup_bddAbove a (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) B 0 hB (fun q => by simp) ν
    simpa using this
  have hrw : ∀ (ν : Fin m → ℝ) (q : Q), (∑ i, a q i * (σ * ν i)) = σ * (∑ i, a q i * ν i) := by
    intro ν q
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
  simp_rw [hrw]
  exact (Real.mul_iSup_of_nonneg hσ _).symm

end CiSup

lemma aux_homog_min {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (D : (Fin m → ℝ) → ℝ) (hcont : Continuous D)
    (hhom : ∀ (σ : ℝ), 0 ≤ σ → ∀ μ, D (fun i => σ * μ i) = σ * D μ)
    (hpos : ∀ μ : Fin m → ℝ, μ ≠ 0 → 0 < D μ) :
    ∃ α : ℝ, 0 < α ∧ ∀ μ, α * (∑ i, |μ i|) ≤ D μ := by
  classical
  set A : Set (Fin m → ℝ) := {e | (∑ i, |e i|) = 1} with hAdef
  have hAcl : IsClosed A := isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) continuous_const
  have hAsub : A ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : Fin m → ℝ) 1 := by
    intro e he
    simp only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
    refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg zero_le_one).2 (fun i => ?_)
    have h1 : |e i| ≤ ∑ j, |e j| :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |e j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    rw [he] at h1
    simpa using h1
  have hAcomp : IsCompact A :=
    Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded hAcl (Metric.isBounded_closedBall.subset hAsub)
  have hAne : A.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨fun i => if i = ⟨0, hm⟩ then 1 else 0, ?_⟩
    have habs : ∀ x : Fin m, |if x = (⟨0, hm⟩ : Fin m) then (1:ℝ) else 0|
        = if x = (⟨0, hm⟩ : Fin m) then (1:ℝ) else 0 := by
      intro x; split <;> simp
    show (∑ i, |if i = (⟨0, hm⟩ : Fin m) then (1:ℝ) else 0|) = 1
    simp_rw [habs]
    simp
  obtain ⟨e₀, he₀A, he₀min⟩ := hAcomp.exists_isMinOn hAne hcont.continuousOn
  have he₀ne : e₀ ≠ 0 := by
    intro hcon
    have := he₀A
    rw [hAdef] at this
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at this
    rw [hcon] at this
    simp at this
  refine ⟨D e₀, hpos e₀ he₀ne, fun μ => ?_⟩
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (Finset.sum_nonneg
      (fun i (_ : i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m))) => abs_nonneg (μ i))) with hz | hpz
  · have hμ0 : μ = 0 := by
      funext i
      have := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
        (fun i (_ : i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m))) => abs_nonneg (μ i))).mp hz.symm
        i (Finset.mem_univ i)
      exact abs_eq_zero.mp this
    have hD0 : D 0 = 0 := by
      have := hhom 0 le_rfl 0
      simpa using this
    rw [← hz, hμ0, hD0]
    simp
  · set σ : ℝ := ∑ i, |μ i| with hσdef
    have hσ : 0 < σ := hpz
    have heeA : (fun i => σ⁻¹ * μ i) ∈ A := by
      show (∑ i, |σ⁻¹ * μ i|) = 1
      have habs : ∀ i, |σ⁻¹ * μ i| = σ⁻¹ * |μ i| := by
        intro i; rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.2 hσ)]
      simp_rw [habs]
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← hσdef]
      field_simp
    have h1 : D e₀ ≤ D (fun i => σ⁻¹ * μ i) := isMinOn_iff.mp he₀min _ heeA
    have h2 : D (fun i => σ * (σ⁻¹ * μ i)) = σ * D (fun i => σ⁻¹ * μ i) :=
      hhom σ hσ.le _
    have h3 : (fun i => σ * (σ⁻¹ * μ i)) = μ := by
      funext i; field_simp
    rw [h3] at h2
    rw [h2]
    nlinarith


section Attain

variable {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {𝒴 : Type*} [Fintype 𝒴] [MeasurableSpace 𝒴]
  {m : ℕ}

lemma aux_integral_lin (Φ : 𝒳 → 𝒴 → Fin m → ℝ) (B : ℝ) (p : Measure (𝒳 × 𝒴))
    [IsFiniteMeasure p]
    (hΦmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => Φ z.1 z.2 i))
    (hΦbdd : ∀ x y i, |Φ x y i| ≤ B) (μ : Fin m → ℝ) :
    ∫ z, (∑ i, Φ z.1 z.2 i * μ i) ∂p = ∑ i, featExpectM Φ p i * μ i := by
  have hiΦ : ∀ i, Integrable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => Φ z.1 z.2 i) p := fun i =>
    aux_integrable_of_bdd p _ (hΦmeas i) B (fun z => hΦbdd _ _ i)
  rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => (hiΦ i).mul_const _)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
  rw [integral_mul_const]
  rfl

lemma aux_lin_le_sup (Φ : 𝒳 → 𝒴 → Fin m → ℝ) (B : ℝ) [Nonempty (𝒳 × 𝒴)]
    (hΦbdd : ∀ x y i, |Φ x y i| ≤ B) (μ : Fin m → ℝ) (q : 𝒳 × 𝒴) :
    (∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) ≤ ⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, (∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) := by
  have hbd := aux_ciSup_bddAbove (Q := 𝒳 × 𝒴) (fun q i => Φ q.1 q.2 i) (fun _ => (0:ℝ))
    B 0 (fun q i => hΦbdd _ _ i) (fun q => by simp) μ
  simp only [add_zero] at hbd
  exact le_ciSup hbd q

lemma aux_int_le_sup (Φ : 𝒳 → 𝒴 → Fin m → ℝ) (B : ℝ) (p : Measure (𝒳 × 𝒴))
    [IsProbabilityMeasure p] [Nonempty (𝒳 × 𝒴)]
    (hΦmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => Φ z.1 z.2 i))
    (hΦbdd : ∀ x y i, |Φ x y i| ≤ B) (μ : Fin m → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, featExpectM Φ p i * μ i) ≤ ⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, (∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) := by
  rw [← aux_integral_lin Φ B p hΦmeas hΦbdd μ]
  have hiΦ : ∀ i, Integrable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => Φ z.1 z.2 i) p := fun i =>
    aux_integrable_of_bdd p _ (hΦmeas i) B (fun z => hΦbdd _ _ i)
  have hint : Integrable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => ∑ i, Φ z.1 z.2 i * μ i) p :=
    integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => (hiΦ i).mul_const _)
  have := integral_mono hint (integrable_const _)
    (fun q => aux_lin_le_sup Φ B hΦbdd μ q)
  simpa using this

lemma aux_ciSup_bddAbove' {Q : Type*} [Nonempty Q] (a : Q → Fin m → ℝ) (b : Q → ℝ) (B Kb : ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ q i, |a q i| ≤ B) (hKb : ∀ q, |b q| ≤ Kb) (μ : Fin m → ℝ) :
    BddAbove (Set.range (fun q : Q => (∑ i, a q i * μ i) - b q)) := by
  have h := aux_ciSup_bddAbove a (fun q => -(b q)) B Kb hB
    (fun q => by rw [abs_neg]; exact hKb q) μ
  simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using h

lemma aux_ciSup_cont' {Q : Type*} [Nonempty Q] (a : Q → Fin m → ℝ) (b : Q → ℝ) (B Kb : ℝ)
    (hB0 : 0 ≤ B) (hB : ∀ q i, |a q i| ≤ B) (hKb : ∀ q, |b q| ≤ Kb) :
    Continuous (fun μ : Fin m → ℝ => ⨆ q : Q, ((∑ i, a q i * μ i) - b q)) := by
  have h := aux_ciSup_cont a (fun q => -(b q)) B Kb hB0 hB
    (fun q => by rw [abs_neg]; exact hKb q)
  simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using h

lemma aux_lin_cont (τ : Fin m → ℝ) : Continuous (fun μ : Fin m → ℝ => ∑ i, τ i * μ i) :=
  continuous_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => continuous_const.mul (continuous_apply i))

lemma aux_abs_cont (lam : Fin m → ℝ) : Continuous (fun μ : Fin m → ℝ => ∑ i, lam i * |μ i|) :=
  continuous_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => continuous_const.mul ((continuous_apply i).abs))

lemma aux_D_pos (Φ : 𝒳 → 𝒴 → Fin m → ℝ) (τ lam : Fin m → ℝ) (B : ℝ)
    [Nonempty (𝒳 × 𝒴)]
    (hΦmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => Φ z.1 z.2 i))
    (hΦbdd : ∀ x y i, |Φ x y i| ≤ B)
    (hreg2 : R2 Φ τ lam) (μ : Fin m → ℝ) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) :
    0 < -(∑ i, τ i * μ i) + (⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, (∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i)) + (∑ i, lam i * |μ i|) := by
  obtain ⟨p, ⟨hprob, hcon⟩, hstrict, hdisj⟩ := hreg2
  haveI := hprob
  set SΦ : ℝ := ⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, (∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) with hSΦ
  have h1 : (∑ i, featExpectM Φ p i * μ i) ≤ SΦ :=
    aux_int_le_sup Φ B p hΦmeas hΦbdd μ
  have h2 : (∑ i, (featExpectM Φ p i - τ i) * μ i) + (∑ i, lam i * |μ i|)
      = ∑ i, ((featExpectM Φ p i - τ i) * μ i + lam i * |μ i|) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  have hterm : ∀ i, 0 ≤ (featExpectM Φ p i - τ i) * μ i + lam i * |μ i| := by
    intro i
    have hb : |(featExpectM Φ p i - τ i) * μ i| ≤ lam i * |μ i| := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hcon i) (abs_nonneg _)
    have := (abs_le.mp hb).1
    linarith
  have hsplit : -(∑ i, τ i * μ i) + SΦ + (∑ i, lam i * |μ i|)
      = (SΦ - (∑ i, featExpectM Φ p i * μ i))
        + ((∑ i, (featExpectM Φ p i - τ i) * μ i) + (∑ i, lam i * |μ i|)) := by
    have : (∑ i, (featExpectM Φ p i - τ i) * μ i)
        = (∑ i, featExpectM Φ p i * μ i) - (∑ i, τ i * μ i) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
    rw [this]; ring
  rw [hsplit]
  rcases hdisj with hall | hnoaff
  · -- all lam i > 0
    obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ : ∃ i, μ i ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hcon2
      push_neg at hcon2
      exact hμ (funext hcon2)
    have hstr := hstrict i₀ (hall i₀)
    have hpos0 : 0 < (featExpectM Φ p i₀ - τ i₀) * μ i₀ + lam i₀ * |μ i₀| := by
      have hb : |(featExpectM Φ p i₀ - τ i₀) * μ i₀| < lam i₀ * |μ i₀| := by
        rw [abs_mul]
        exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hstr (abs_pos.2 hi₀)
      have := (abs_lt.mp hb).1
      linarith
    have hsum : 0 < ∑ i, ((featExpectM Φ p i - τ i) * μ i + lam i * |μ i|) := by
      refine lt_of_lt_of_le hpos0 ?_
      exact Finset.single_le_sum
        (f := fun i => (featExpectM Φ p i - τ i) * μ i + lam i * |μ i|)
        (fun i _ => hterm i) (Finset.mem_univ i₀)
    rw [h2]
    linarith
  · -- no affine relation
    have hsumnn : 0 ≤ ∑ i, ((featExpectM Φ p i - τ i) * μ i + lam i * |μ i|) :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hterm i)
    rw [h2]
    have hstrictpos : 0 < SΦ - (∑ i, featExpectM Φ p i * μ i) := by
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le h1 with hlt | heq
      · linarith
      · exfalso
        apply hnoaff
        refine ⟨μ, SΦ, hμ, ?_⟩
        have hiΦ : ∀ i, Integrable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => Φ z.1 z.2 i) p := fun i =>
          aux_integrable_of_bdd p _ (hΦmeas i) B (fun z => hΦbdd _ _ i)
        have hint : Integrable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => ∑ i, Φ z.1 z.2 i * μ i) p :=
          integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => (hiΦ i).mul_const _)
        have hfint : Integrable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => SΦ - ∑ i, Φ z.1 z.2 i * μ i) p :=
          (integrable_const _).sub hint
        have hfnn : (0 : (𝒳 × 𝒴) → ℝ) ≤ fun z => SΦ - ∑ i, Φ z.1 z.2 i * μ i := by
          intro z
          simp only [Pi.zero_apply, sub_nonneg]
          exact aux_lin_le_sup Φ B hΦbdd μ z
        have hfzero : ∫ z, (SΦ - ∑ i, Φ z.1 z.2 i * μ i) ∂p = 0 := by
          rw [integral_sub (integrable_const _) hint]
          rw [aux_integral_lin Φ B p hΦmeas hΦbdd μ]
          simp [← heq]
        have hae := (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hfnn hfint).mp hfzero
        filter_upwards [hae] with z hz
        simp only [Pi.zero_apply, sub_eq_zero] at hz
        rw [show (∑ i, μ i * Φ z.1 z.2 i) = ∑ i, Φ z.1 z.2 i * μ i from
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => mul_comm _ _)]
        exact hz.symm
    linarith

lemma aux_attain [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝒴]
    (Φ : 𝒳 → 𝒴 → Fin m → ℝ) (τ lam : Fin m → ℝ) (B : ℝ) (hB0 : 0 ≤ B)
    (hΦmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => Φ z.1 z.2 i))
    (hΦbdd : ∀ x y i, |Φ x y i| ≤ B)
    (cst : ℝ) (g : 𝒳 × 𝒴 → ℝ) (Kg : ℝ) (hKg0 : 0 ≤ Kg)
    (hgbdd : ∀ z, |g z| ≤ Kg)
    (hlam : ∀ i, 0 ≤ lam i)
    (hne : Nonempty (𝒳 × 𝒴))
    (hreg : R1 Φ τ lam ∨ R2 Φ τ lam)
    (lb : ℝ)
    (hlb : ∀ μ : Fin m → ℝ, lb ≤ cst - (∑ i, τ i * μ i)
        + (⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - g q)) + (∑ i, lam i * |μ i|)) :
    ∃ μ₀ : Fin m → ℝ, ∀ μ : Fin m → ℝ,
      cst - (∑ i, τ i * μ₀ i) + (⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ₀ i) - g q))
        + (∑ i, lam i * |μ₀ i|)
      ≤ cst - (∑ i, τ i * μ i) + (⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - g q))
        + (∑ i, lam i * |μ i|) := by
  classical
  have hΨcont : Continuous (fun μ : Fin m → ℝ => cst - (∑ i, τ i * μ i)
      + (⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - g q)) + (∑ i, lam i * |μ i|)) := by
    have h1 := aux_lin_cont (m := m) τ
    have h2 := aux_ciSup_cont' (Q := 𝒳 × 𝒴) (fun q i => Φ q.1 q.2 i) g B Kg hB0
      (fun q i => hΦbdd _ _ i) hgbdd
    have h3 := aux_abs_cont (m := m) lam
    exact ((continuous_const.sub h1).add h2).add h3
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with hm0 | hmpos
  · subst hm0
    exact ⟨0, fun μ => by rw [Subsingleton.elim μ (0 : Fin 0 → ℝ)]⟩
  rcases hreg with hreg1 | hreg2
  · -- R1 : polyhedral
    obtain ⟨hfin, p, hpU⟩ := hreg1
    haveI : Fintype 𝒳 := Fintype.ofFinite 𝒳
    haveI hneJ : Nonempty ((𝒳 × 𝒴) × (Fin m → Bool)) :=
      ⟨⟨Classical.choice hne, fun _ => true⟩⟩
    set cc : ((𝒳 × 𝒴) × (Fin m → Bool)) → Fin m → ℝ :=
      fun j i => Φ j.1.1 j.1.2 i - τ i + lam i * (if j.2 i then (1:ℝ) else -1) with hcc
    set dd : ((𝒳 × 𝒴) × (Fin m → Bool)) → ℝ := fun j => cst - g j.1 with hdd
    have hterm : ∀ (q : 𝒳 × 𝒴) (sg : Fin m → Bool) (μ : Fin m → ℝ),
        (∑ i, cc (q, sg) i * μ i) + dd (q, sg)
          = ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - g q) + (cst - (∑ i, τ i * μ i))
            + (∑ i, lam i * ((if sg i then (1:ℝ) else -1) * μ i)) := by
      intro q sg μ
      have hexp : (∑ i, cc (q, sg) i * μ i)
          = (∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - (∑ i, τ i * μ i)
            + (∑ i, lam i * ((if sg i then (1:ℝ) else -1) * μ i)) := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by simp only [hcc]; ring)
      rw [hexp]
      simp only [hdd]
      ring
    have hsign : ∀ (μ : Fin m → ℝ) (sg : Fin m → Bool),
        (∑ i, lam i * ((if sg i then (1:ℝ) else -1) * μ i)) ≤ ∑ i, lam i * |μ i| := by
      intro μ sg
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => ?_)
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (hlam i)
      rcases Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true (sg i) with hb | hb <;> rw [hb]
      · simpa using le_abs_self (μ i)
      · simpa using neg_le_abs (μ i)
    have hsigneq : ∀ μ : Fin m → ℝ, ∃ sg : Fin m → Bool,
        (∑ i, lam i * ((if sg i then (1:ℝ) else -1) * μ i)) = ∑ i, lam i * |μ i| := by
      intro μ
      refine ⟨fun i => decide (0 ≤ μ i), Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)⟩
      by_cases hpos : 0 ≤ μ i
      · simp [hpos, abs_of_nonneg hpos]
      · push_neg at hpos
        simp [hpos.not_ge, abs_of_neg hpos]
    have hbddJ : ∀ μ : Fin m → ℝ, BddAbove (Set.range
        (fun j : (𝒳 × 𝒴) × (Fin m → Bool) => (∑ i, cc j i * μ i) + dd j)) :=
      fun μ => Set.Finite.bddAbove (Set.finite_range _)
    have hbddQ : ∀ μ : Fin m → ℝ, BddAbove (Set.range
        (fun q : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => (∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - g q)) :=
      fun μ => aux_ciSup_bddAbove' (Q := 𝒳 × 𝒴) (fun q i => Φ q.1 q.2 i) g B Kg
        (fun q i => hΦbdd _ _ i) hgbdd μ
    have hkey : ∀ μ : Fin m → ℝ,
        cst - (∑ i, τ i * μ i) + (⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - g q))
          + (∑ i, lam i * |μ i|)
        = ⨆ j : (𝒳 × 𝒴) × (Fin m → Bool), ((∑ i, cc j i * μ i) + dd j) := by
      intro μ
      refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
      · obtain ⟨sg, hsg⟩ := hsigneq μ
        have hq : ∀ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - g q)
            ≤ (⨆ j : (𝒳 × 𝒴) × (Fin m → Bool), ((∑ i, cc j i * μ i) + dd j))
              - (cst - (∑ i, τ i * μ i)) - (∑ i, lam i * |μ i|) := by
          intro q
          have h1 : (∑ i, cc (q, sg) i * μ i) + dd (q, sg)
              ≤ ⨆ j : (𝒳 × 𝒴) × (Fin m → Bool), ((∑ i, cc j i * μ i) + dd j) :=
            le_ciSup (hbddJ μ) (q, sg)
          rw [hterm q sg μ, hsg] at h1
          linarith
        have h2 := ciSup_le hq
        linarith
      · refine ciSup_le (fun j => ?_)
        obtain ⟨q, sg⟩ := j
        rw [hterm q sg μ]
        have h1 : ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - g q)
            ≤ ⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - g q) := le_ciSup (hbddQ μ) q
        have h2 := hsign μ sg
        linarith
    have hlb' : ∀ μ : Fin m → ℝ, (∀ i, i ∉ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)) → μ i = 0) →
        lb ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset ((𝒳 × 𝒴) × (Fin m → Bool))).sup'
          Finset.univ_nonempty (fun j => (∑ i, cc j i * μ i) + dd j) := by
      intro μ _
      rw [Finset.sup'_univ_eq_ciSup, ← hkey μ]
      exact hlb μ
    obtain ⟨μ₀, _, hmin⟩ := aux_poly_min cc dd (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).card
      Finset.univ rfl (Finset.univ : Finset ((𝒳 × 𝒴) × (Fin m → Bool)))
      Finset.univ_nonempty lb hlb'
    refine ⟨μ₀, fun μ => ?_⟩
    have h := hmin μ (fun i hi => absurd (Finset.mem_univ i) hi)
    rw [Finset.sup'_univ_eq_ciSup, Finset.sup'_univ_eq_ciSup, ← hkey μ₀, ← hkey μ] at h
    exact h
  · -- R2 : coercive
    set D : (Fin m → ℝ) → ℝ := fun μ => -(∑ i, τ i * μ i)
      + (⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, (∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i)) + (∑ i, lam i * |μ i|) with hD
    have hDcont : Continuous D := by
      have h1 := aux_lin_cont (m := m) τ
      have h2 := aux_ciSup_cont (Q := 𝒳 × 𝒴) (fun q i => Φ q.1 q.2 i) (fun _ => (0:ℝ))
        B 0 hB0 (fun q i => hΦbdd _ _ i) (fun q => by simp)
      simp only [add_zero] at h2
      exact ((h1.neg).add h2).add (aux_abs_cont (m := m) lam)
    have hDhom : ∀ (σ : ℝ), 0 ≤ σ → ∀ μ, D (fun i => σ * μ i) = σ * D μ := by
      intro σ hσ μ
      have e1 : (∑ i, τ i * (σ * μ i)) = σ * ∑ i, τ i * μ i := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
      have e2 : (⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, (∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * (σ * μ i)))
          = σ * ⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, (∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) :=
        aux_ciSup_smul (Q := 𝒳 × 𝒴) (fun q i => Φ q.1 q.2 i) B
          (fun q i => hΦbdd _ _ i) σ hσ μ
      have e3 : (∑ i, lam i * |σ * μ i|) = σ * ∑ i, lam i * |μ i| := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hσ]; ring
      simp only [hD]
      rw [e1, e2, e3]
      ring
    have hDpos : ∀ μ : Fin m → ℝ, μ ≠ 0 → 0 < D μ := by
      intro μ hμ
      exact aux_D_pos Φ τ lam B hΦmeas hΦbdd hreg2 μ hμ
    obtain ⟨α, hαpos, hα⟩ := aux_homog_min hmpos D hDcont hDhom hDpos
    refine aux_coercive_min _ hΨcont α (cst - Kg) hαpos (fun μ => ?_)
    have hSge : (⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, (∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i))
        ≤ (⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - g q)) + Kg := by
      refine ciSup_le (fun q => ?_)
      have h1 : ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - g q)
          ≤ ⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - g q) :=
        le_ciSup (aux_ciSup_bddAbove' (Q := 𝒳 × 𝒴) (fun q i => Φ q.1 q.2 i) g B Kg
          (fun q i => hΦbdd _ _ i) hgbdd μ) q
      have h2 := (abs_le.mp (hgbdd q)).2
      linarith
    have hα' := hα μ
    simp only [hD] at hα'
    linarith

lemma aux_iInf_neg {ι : Sort*} [Nonempty ι] (f : ι → ℝ) (hbdd : BddAbove (Set.range f)) :
    (⨅ i, -f i) = -(⨆ i, f i) := by
  have hbb : BddBelow (Set.range (fun i => -f i)) := by
    obtain ⟨ub, hub⟩ := hbdd
    refine ⟨-ub, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    have : f i ≤ ub := hub ⟨i, rfl⟩
    simpa using this
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · have h1 : (⨆ i, f i) ≤ -(⨅ i, -f i) := by
      refine ciSup_le (fun i => ?_)
      have : (⨅ j, -f j) ≤ -f i := ciInf_le hbb i
      linarith
    linarith
  · refine le_ciInf (fun i => ?_)
    have : f i ≤ ⨆ j, f j := le_ciSup hbdd i
    linarith

lemma aux_GΨ (Φ : 𝒳 → 𝒴 → Fin m → ℝ) (τ lam : Fin m → ℝ) (h : 𝒳 → 𝒴 → ℝ) (B : ℝ)
    [Nonempty (𝒳 × 𝒴)] (hΦbdd : ∀ x y i, |Φ x y i| ≤ B) (hhbdd : ∀ z : 𝒳 × 𝒴, |h z.1 z.2| ≤ 1)
    (ν : Fin m → ℝ) :
    1 - (∑ i, τ i * -ν i) + (⨅ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * -ν i) - h q.1 q.2))
      - (∑ i, lam i * |-ν i|)
    = -((-1) - (∑ i, τ i * ν i)
      + (⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * ν i) - -(h q.1 q.2)))
      + (∑ i, lam i * |ν i|)) := by
  have e1 : (∑ i, τ i * -ν i) = -(∑ i, τ i * ν i) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
  have e2 : (∑ i, lam i * |-ν i|) = ∑ i, lam i * |ν i| :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by rw [abs_neg])
  have hbdd : BddAbove (Set.range (fun q : 𝒳 × 𝒴 =>
      (∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * ν i) - -(h q.1 q.2))) :=
    aux_ciSup_bddAbove' (Q := 𝒳 × 𝒴) (fun q i => Φ q.1 q.2 i) (fun q => -(h q.1 q.2)) B 1
      (fun q i => hΦbdd _ _ i) (fun q => by rw [abs_neg]; exact hhbdd q) ν
  have e3 : (⨅ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * -ν i) - h q.1 q.2))
      = -(⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * ν i) - -(h q.1 q.2))) := by
    rw [← aux_iInf_neg _ hbdd]
    refine iInf_congr (fun q => ?_)
    have : (∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * -ν i) = -(∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * ν i) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
    rw [this]
    ring
  rw [e1, e2, e3]
  ring

end Attain


theorem theorem5 {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] [StandardBorelSpace 𝒳] {𝒴 : Type*} [Fintype 𝒴]
    [MeasurableSpace 𝒴] [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝒴] {m : ℕ} (Φ : 𝒳 → 𝒴 → Fin m → ℝ) (τ lam : Fin m → ℝ)
    (h : 𝒳 → 𝒴 → ℝ) (p : Measure (𝒳 × 𝒴))

    (hΦmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => Φ z.1 z.2 i))
    (hΦbdd : ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ x y i, |Φ x y i| ≤ B)

    (hhmeas : Measurable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => h z.1 z.2))
    (hrule_nonneg : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ h x y) (hrule_sum : ∀ x, ∑ y, h x y = 1)
    (hp : inUncertaintySetM Φ τ lam p)
    (hba : BddAbove (Set.range (fun μ : Fin m → ℝ => 1 - (∑ i, τ i * μ i)
      + (⨅ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - h q.1 q.2)) - (∑ i, lam i * |μ i|))))
    (hbb : BddBelow (Set.range (fun μ : Fin m → ℝ => 1 - (∑ i, τ i * μ i)
      + (⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - h q.1 q.2)) + (∑ i, lam i * |μ i|)))) :
    (RunderM Φ τ lam h ≤ expectedLossM h p ∧ expectedLossM h p ≤ RoverM Φ τ lam h)
      ∧ ((R1 Φ τ lam ∨ R2 Φ τ lam) →
          (∃ μ : Fin m → ℝ, 1 - (∑ i, τ i * μ i)
              + (⨅ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - h q.1 q.2))
              - (∑ i, lam i * |μ i|) = RunderM Φ τ lam h)
        ∧ (∃ μ : Fin m → ℝ, 1 - (∑ i, τ i * μ i)
              + (⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - h q.1 q.2))
              + (∑ i, lam i * |μ i|) = RoverM Φ τ lam h)) := by
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hΦbdd
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · exact ciSup_le (fun μ => aux_weak_lower Φ h B τ lam p hΦmeas hB hhmeas hrule_nonneg hrule_sum hp μ)
  · exact le_ciInf (fun μ => aux_weak_upper Φ h B τ lam p hΦmeas hB hhmeas hrule_nonneg hrule_sum hp μ)
  · intro hreg
    obtain ⟨hprob, hcon⟩ := hp
    haveI := hprob
    have hne : Nonempty (𝒳 × 𝒴) := by
      by_contra hcon2
      rw [not_nonempty_iff] at hcon2
      have h1 : (p Set.univ) = 1 := measure_univ
      rw [Set.univ_eq_empty_iff.2 hcon2] at h1
      simp at h1
    haveI := hne
    have hlam : ∀ i, 0 ≤ lam i := fun i => le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hcon i)
    have hB0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ |B| := abs_nonneg B
    have hB' : ∀ x y i, |Φ x y i| ≤ |B| := fun x y i => le_trans (hB x y i) (le_abs_self B)
    have hh1 : ∀ z : 𝒳 × 𝒴, |h z.1 z.2| ≤ 1 := fun z => by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (hrule_nonneg _ _)]
      exact aux_h_le_one h hrule_nonneg hrule_sum _ _
    constructor
    · -- lower bound attained
      obtain ⟨ub, hub⟩ := id hba
      have hlbΨ : ∀ ν : Fin m → ℝ, -ub ≤ (-1) - (∑ i, τ i * ν i)
          + (⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * ν i) - -(h q.1 q.2)))
          + (∑ i, lam i * |ν i|) := by
        intro ν
        have h1 : 1 - (∑ i, τ i * -ν i)
            + (⨅ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * -ν i) - h q.1 q.2))
            - (∑ i, lam i * |-ν i|) ≤ ub := hub (Set.mem_range_self (fun i => -ν i))
        rw [aux_GΨ Φ τ lam h |B| hB' hh1 ν] at h1
        linarith
      obtain ⟨μ₀, hμ₀⟩ := aux_attain Φ τ lam |B| hB0 hΦmeas hB' (-1)
        (fun z => -(h z.1 z.2)) 1 zero_le_one (fun z => by rw [abs_neg]; exact hh1 z)
        hlam hne hreg (-ub) hlbΨ
      refine ⟨fun i => -μ₀ i, ?_⟩
      have hmax : ∀ μ : Fin m → ℝ,
          1 - (∑ i, τ i * μ i) + (⨅ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - h q.1 q.2))
            - (∑ i, lam i * |μ i|)
          ≤ 1 - (∑ i, τ i * -μ₀ i)
            + (⨅ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * -μ₀ i) - h q.1 q.2))
            - (∑ i, lam i * |-μ₀ i|) := by
        intro μ
        have e1 := aux_GΨ Φ τ lam h |B| hB' hh1 (fun i => -μ i)
        simp only [neg_neg] at e1
        have e2 := aux_GΨ Φ τ lam h |B| hB' hh1 μ₀
        have e3 := hμ₀ (fun i => -μ i)
        linarith
      exact le_antisymm (le_ciSup hba _) (ciSup_le hmax)
    · -- upper bound attained
      obtain ⟨lb0, hlb0⟩ := id hbb
      have hlbF : ∀ μ : Fin m → ℝ, lb0 ≤ 1 - (∑ i, τ i * μ i)
          + (⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - h q.1 q.2))
          + (∑ i, lam i * |μ i|) := fun μ => hlb0 (Set.mem_range_self μ)
      obtain ⟨μ₀, hμ₀⟩ := aux_attain Φ τ lam |B| hB0 hΦmeas hB' 1
        (fun z => h z.1 z.2) 1 zero_le_one hh1 hlam hne hreg lb0 hlbF
      exact ⟨μ₀, le_antisymm (le_ciInf hμ₀) (ciInf_le hbb μ₀)⟩


section StrongDual

open Pointwise

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false

variable {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝒳]
  {𝒴 : Type*} [Fintype 𝒴] [MeasurableSpace 𝒴] [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝒴] {m : ℕ}

lemma sd_mix_prob (p₁ p₂ : Measure (𝒳 × 𝒴)) [IsProbabilityMeasure p₁] [IsProbabilityMeasure p₂]
    {θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ} (h1 : 0 ≤ θ₁) (h2 : 0 ≤ θ₂) (hsum : θ₁ + θ₂ = 1) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (ENNReal.ofReal θ₁ • p₁ + ENNReal.ofReal θ₂ • p₂) := by
  constructor
  rw [Measure.add_apply, Measure.smul_apply, Measure.smul_apply, measure_univ, measure_univ,
