    smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, mul_one, ← ENNReal.ofReal_add h1 h2, hsum,
    ENNReal.ofReal_one]

lemma sd_mix_integral (p₁ p₂ : Measure (𝒳 × 𝒴))
    {θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ} (h1 : 0 ≤ θ₁) (h2 : 0 ≤ θ₂) (f : 𝒳 × 𝒴 → ℝ)
    (hf1 : Integrable f p₁) (hf2 : Integrable f p₂) :
    ∫ z, f z ∂(ENNReal.ofReal θ₁ • p₁ + ENNReal.ofReal θ₂ • p₂)
      = θ₁ * (∫ z, f z ∂p₁) + θ₂ * (∫ z, f z ∂p₂) := by
  rw [integral_add_measure (hf1.smul_measure ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top)
      (hf2.smul_measure ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top),
    integral_smul_measure, integral_smul_measure, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal h1,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal h2, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]

/-- The set of pairs `(w, t)` such that some probability measure `p` has feature expectations
within `lam` of `w + τ` and mean loss at most `t`. -/
def sdSet (Φ : 𝒳 → 𝒴 → Fin m → ℝ) (τ lam : Fin m → ℝ) (h : 𝒳 → 𝒴 → ℝ) :
    Set ((Fin m → ℝ) × ℝ) :=
  {z | ∃ p : Measure (𝒳 × 𝒴), IsProbabilityMeasure p ∧
        (∀ i, |z.1 i - (featExpectM Φ p i - τ i)| ≤ lam i) ∧ (∫ q, h q.1 q.2 ∂p) ≤ z.2}

variable (Φ : 𝒳 → 𝒴 → Fin m → ℝ) (τ lam : Fin m → ℝ) (h : 𝒳 → 𝒴 → ℝ) (B : ℝ)

lemma sd_convex
    (hΦmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => Φ z.1 z.2 i))
    (hΦbdd : ∀ x y i, |Φ x y i| ≤ B)
    (hhmeas : Measurable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => h z.1 z.2))
    (hhbdd : ∀ z : 𝒳 × 𝒴, |h z.1 z.2| ≤ 1) :
    Convex ℝ (sdSet Φ τ lam h) := by
  rintro z ⟨p₁, hp₁, hc₁, hl₁⟩ z' ⟨p₂, hp₂, hc₂, hl₂⟩ θ₁ θ₂ hθ₁ hθ₂ hθ
  haveI := hp₁; haveI := hp₂
  have hiΦ1 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => Φ z.1 z.2 i) p₁ := fun i =>
    aux_integrable_of_bdd p₁ _ (hΦmeas i) B (fun z => hΦbdd _ _ i)
  have hiΦ2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => Φ z.1 z.2 i) p₂ := fun i =>
    aux_integrable_of_bdd p₂ _ (hΦmeas i) B (fun z => hΦbdd _ _ i)
  have hih1 : Integrable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => h z.1 z.2) p₁ :=
    aux_integrable_of_bdd p₁ _ hhmeas 1 hhbdd
  have hih2 : Integrable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => h z.1 z.2) p₂ :=
    aux_integrable_of_bdd p₂ _ hhmeas 1 hhbdd
  refine ⟨ENNReal.ofReal θ₁ • p₁ + ENNReal.ofReal θ₂ • p₂,
    sd_mix_prob p₁ p₂ hθ₁ hθ₂ hθ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    have hfe : featExpectM Φ (ENNReal.ofReal θ₁ • p₁ + ENNReal.ofReal θ₂ • p₂) i
        = θ₁ * featExpectM Φ p₁ i + θ₂ * featExpectM Φ p₂ i :=
      sd_mix_integral p₁ p₂ hθ₁ hθ₂ _ (hiΦ1 i) (hiΦ2 i)
    have hz : (θ₁ • z + θ₂ • z').1 i = θ₁ * z.1 i + θ₂ * z'.1 i := rfl
    rw [hz, hfe]
    have e : θ₁ * z.1 i + θ₂ * z'.1 i - (θ₁ * featExpectM Φ p₁ i + θ₂ * featExpectM Φ p₂ i - τ i)
        = θ₁ * (z.1 i - (featExpectM Φ p₁ i - τ i))
          + θ₂ * (z'.1 i - (featExpectM Φ p₂ i - τ i)) := by
      have : τ i = θ₁ * τ i + θ₂ * τ i := by rw [← add_mul, hθ, one_mul]
      nlinarith [this]
    rw [e]
    calc |θ₁ * (z.1 i - (featExpectM Φ p₁ i - τ i))
            + θ₂ * (z'.1 i - (featExpectM Φ p₂ i - τ i))|
        ≤ |θ₁ * (z.1 i - (featExpectM Φ p₁ i - τ i))|
            + |θ₂ * (z'.1 i - (featExpectM Φ p₂ i - τ i))| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ = θ₁ * |z.1 i - (featExpectM Φ p₁ i - τ i)|
            + θ₂ * |z'.1 i - (featExpectM Φ p₂ i - τ i)| := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hθ₁, abs_of_nonneg hθ₂]
      _ ≤ θ₁ * lam i + θ₂ * lam i := by
            exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hc₁ i) hθ₁)
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hc₂ i) hθ₂)
      _ = lam i := by rw [← add_mul, hθ, one_mul]
  · have hint : (∫ q, h q.1 q.2 ∂(ENNReal.ofReal θ₁ • p₁ + ENNReal.ofReal θ₂ • p₂))
        = θ₁ * (∫ q, h q.1 q.2 ∂p₁) + θ₂ * (∫ q, h q.1 q.2 ∂p₂) :=
      sd_mix_integral p₁ p₂ hθ₁ hθ₂ _ hih1 hih2
    rw [hint]
    have hz : (θ₁ • z + θ₂ • z').2 = θ₁ * z.2 + θ₂ * z'.2 := rfl
    rw [hz]
    exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl₁ hθ₁) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl₂ hθ₂)

lemma sd_up (z : (Fin m → ℝ) × ℝ) (hz : z ∈ sdSet Φ τ lam h) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    (z.1, z.2 + s) ∈ sdSet Φ τ lam h := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hc, hl⟩ := hz
  exact ⟨p, hp, hc, by simpa using hl.trans (by linarith)⟩

lemma sd_mem_of_point (q : 𝒳 × 𝒴) (v : Fin m → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ i, |v i| ≤ lam i) (t : ℝ) (ht : h q.1 q.2 ≤ t) :
    ((fun i => Φ q.1 q.2 i - τ i + v i), t) ∈ sdSet Φ τ lam h := by
  refine ⟨Measure.dirac q, inferInstance, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    have : featExpectM Φ (Measure.dirac q) i = Φ q.1 q.2 i := by
      simpa [featExpectM] using integral_dirac (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => Φ z.1 z.2 i) q
    simp only [this]
    have : Φ q.1 q.2 i - τ i + v i - (Φ q.1 q.2 i - τ i) = v i := by ring
    rw [this]
    exact hv i
  · simpa using (integral_dirac (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => h z.1 z.2) q).le.trans ht

lemma sd_dual_repr (f : ((Fin m → ℝ) × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) :
    ∃ (μ : Fin m → ℝ) (c : ℝ), ∀ z : (Fin m → ℝ) × ℝ,
      f z = (∑ i, μ i * z.1 i) + c * z.2 := by
  classical
  set L : (Fin m → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ :=
    (f : ((Fin m → ℝ) × ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ).comp (LinearMap.inl ℝ (Fin m → ℝ) ℝ) with hL
  refine ⟨fun i => L (fun j => if i = j then (1:ℝ) else 0), f (0, 1), fun z => ?_⟩
  have h1 : f z = f ((z.1, (0:ℝ)) : (Fin m → ℝ) × ℝ) + f ((0 : Fin m → ℝ), z.2) := by
    rw [← map_add]
    congr 1
    ext <;> simp
  have h2 : f ((0 : Fin m → ℝ), z.2) = z.2 * f (0, 1) := by
    have he : ((0 : Fin m → ℝ), z.2) = z.2 • ((0 : Fin m → ℝ), (1:ℝ)) := by
      ext <;> simp
    rw [he, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  have h3 : f (z.1, (0:ℝ)) = L z.1 := rfl
  rw [h1, h2, h3, LinearMap.pi_apply_eq_sum_univ L z.1]
  rw [mul_comm (f (0,1)) z.2]
  congr 1
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm])

lemma sd_RoverM_le [Nonempty (𝒳 × 𝒴)] (hlam : ∀ i, 0 ≤ lam i)
    (hbb : BddBelow (Set.range (fun μ : Fin m → ℝ => 1 - (∑ i, τ i * μ i)
      + (⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - h q.1 q.2)) + (∑ i, lam i * |μ i|))))
    (α : ℝ) (ν : Fin m → ℝ)
    (hν : ∀ (q : 𝒳 × 𝒴) (v : Fin m → ℝ), (∀ i, |v i| ≤ lam i) →
      (∑ i, ν i * (Φ q.1 q.2 i - τ i + v i)) - h q.1 q.2 ≤ α - 1) :
    RoverM Φ τ lam h ≤ α := by
  classical
  set v : Fin m → ℝ := fun i => if 0 ≤ ν i then lam i else -lam i with hv
  have hvbdd : ∀ i, |v i| ≤ lam i := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : 0 ≤ ν i
    · simp [hv, hi, abs_of_nonneg (hlam i)]
    · simp [hv, hi, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (hlam i)]
  have hvid : ∀ i, ν i * v i = lam i * |ν i| := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : 0 ≤ ν i
    · simp [hv, hi, abs_of_nonneg hi]; ring
    · push_neg at hi
      simp [hv, hi.not_ge, abs_of_neg hi]; ring
  have key : ∀ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, (∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * ν i) - h q.1 q.2
      ≤ (α - 1) + (∑ i, τ i * ν i) - (∑ i, lam i * |ν i|) := by
    intro q
    have h1 := hν q v hvbdd
    have hexp : (∑ i, ν i * (Φ q.1 q.2 i - τ i + v i))
        = (∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * ν i) - (∑ i, τ i * ν i) + (∑ i, lam i * |ν i|) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      rw [← hvid i]; ring
    rw [hexp] at h1
    linarith
  have hsup : (⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * ν i) - h q.1 q.2))
      ≤ (α - 1) + (∑ i, τ i * ν i) - (∑ i, lam i * |ν i|) := ciSup_le key
  have := ciInf_le hbb ν
  simp only [RoverM]
  calc (⨅ μ : Fin m → ℝ, (1 - (∑ i, τ i * μ i)
        + (⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - h q.1 q.2)) + (∑ i, lam i * |μ i|)))
      ≤ 1 - (∑ i, τ i * ν i)
        + (⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * ν i) - h q.1 q.2)) + (∑ i, lam i * |ν i|) := this
    _ ≤ α := by linarith

lemma sd_separate_open (E : Set ((Fin m → ℝ) × ℝ)) (hconv : Convex ℝ E)
    (hup : ∀ z ∈ E, ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → (z.1, z.2 + s) ∈ E)
    (hint : (interior E).Nonempty) (β : ℝ) (hx₀ : ((0 : Fin m → ℝ), β) ∉ E) :
    ∃ (μ : Fin m → ℝ) (γ : ℝ), 0 ≤ γ ∧ (γ ≠ 0 ∨ μ ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ z ∈ E, (∑ i, μ i * z.1 i) - γ * z.2 ≤ -(γ * β) := by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := geometric_hahn_banach_open_point (hconv.interior) isOpen_interior
    (fun hc => hx₀ (interior_subset hc))
  obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀⟩ := hint
  have hfE : ∀ z ∈ E, f z ≤ f ((0 : Fin m → ℝ), β) := by
    have hcl : E ⊆ closure (interior E) := by
      rw [hconv.closure_interior_eq_closure_of_nonempty_interior ⟨z₀, hz₀⟩]
      exact subset_closure
    have hclosed : IsClosed {y : (Fin m → ℝ) × ℝ | f y ≤ f ((0 : Fin m → ℝ), β)} :=
      isClosed_le f.continuous continuous_const
    intro z hz
    exact hclosed.closure_subset_iff.mpr (fun y hy => (hf y hy).le) (hcl hz)
  obtain ⟨μ, c, hrepr⟩ := sd_dual_repr f
  have hx0v : f ((0 : Fin m → ℝ), β) = c * β := by
    rw [hrepr]; simp
  have hmain : ∀ z ∈ E, (∑ i, μ i * z.1 i) + c * z.2 ≤ c * β := by
    intro z hz
    have := hfE z hz
    rwa [hrepr, hx0v] at this
  have hc : c ≤ 0 := by
    by_contra hcpos
    push_neg at hcpos
    set A : ℝ := (∑ i, μ i * z₀.1 i) with hA
    set s : ℝ := max 0 ((c * β - A - c * z₀.2) / c + 1) with hs
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := le_max_left _ _
    have hzE : z₀ ∈ E := interior_subset hz₀
    have h1 := hmain (z₀.1, z₀.2 + s) (hup z₀ hzE s hs0)
    simp only at h1
    have h2 : (c * β - A - c * z₀.2) / c + 1 ≤ s := le_max_right _ _
    have h3 : c * ((c * β - A - c * z₀.2) / c + 1) ≤ c * s :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hcpos.le
    rw [mul_add, mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hcpos), mul_one] at h3
    nlinarith [h1, h3]
  refine ⟨μ, -c, by linarith, ?_, ?_⟩
  · by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    obtain ⟨hc0, hμ0⟩ := hcon
    have hc0' : c = 0 := by linarith [neg_eq_zero.mp hc0]
    have : ∀ z : (Fin m → ℝ) × ℝ, f z = 0 := by
      intro z
      rw [hrepr, hc0', hμ0]
      simp
    have hlt := hf z₀ hz₀
    rw [this z₀, this ((0 : Fin m → ℝ), β)] at hlt
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hlt
  · intro z hz
    have := hmain z hz
    linarith [this]

lemma sd_separate_closed (E : Set ((Fin m → ℝ) × ℝ)) (hconv : Convex ℝ E)
    (hup : ∀ z ∈ E, ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → (z.1, z.2 + s) ∈ E)
    (hEne : E.Nonempty) (hclosed : IsClosed E) (β : ℝ)
    (hx₀ : ((0 : Fin m → ℝ), β) ∉ E) :
    ∃ (μ : Fin m → ℝ) (γ u : ℝ), 0 ≤ γ ∧ 0 < u ∧
      ∀ z ∈ E, (∑ i, μ i * z.1 i) - γ * z.2 ≤ -(γ * β) - u := by
  obtain ⟨f, u, hfu, hfE⟩ := geometric_hahn_banach_point_closed hconv hclosed hx₀
  obtain ⟨μ, c, hrepr⟩ := sd_dual_repr f
  obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀⟩ := hEne
  have hx0v : f ((0 : Fin m → ℝ), β) = c * β := by rw [hrepr]; simp
  have hmain : ∀ z ∈ E, u ≤ (∑ i, μ i * z.1 i) + c * z.2 := by
    intro z hz
    have := hfE z hz
    rw [hrepr] at this
    linarith
  have hcβ : c * β < u := by rw [← hx0v]; exact hfu
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := by
    by_contra hcneg
    push_neg at hcneg
    set A : ℝ := (∑ i, μ i * z₀.1 i) with hA
    set s : ℝ := max 0 ((u - A - c * z₀.2) / c + 1) with hs
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := le_max_left _ _
    have h1 := hmain (z₀.1, z₀.2 + s) (hup z₀ hz₀ s hs0)
    simp only at h1
    have h2 : (u - A - c * z₀.2) / c + 1 ≤ s := le_max_right _ _
    have h3 : c * s ≤ c * ((u - A - c * z₀.2) / c + 1) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left h2 hcneg.le
    rw [mul_add, mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_lt hcneg), mul_one] at h3
    rw [mul_add] at h1
    linarith [h1, h3]
  refine ⟨fun i => -μ i, c, u - c * β, hc, by linarith, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  have h1 := hmain z hz
  have h2 : (∑ i, (fun i => -μ i) i * z.1 i) = -(∑ i, μ i * z.1 i) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
  rw [h2]
  linarith


lemma sd_sign_vec (hlam : ∀ i, 0 ≤ lam i) (μ : Fin m → ℝ) :
    ∃ v : Fin m → ℝ, (∀ i, |v i| ≤ lam i) ∧ (∑ i, μ i * v i) = ∑ i, lam i * |μ i| := by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun i => if 0 ≤ μ i then lam i else -lam i, fun i => ?_, ?_⟩
  · by_cases hi : 0 ≤ μ i
    · simp [hi, abs_of_nonneg (hlam i)]
    · simp [hi, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (hlam i)]
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    by_cases hi : 0 ≤ μ i
    · simp only [hi, if_true, abs_of_nonneg hi]; ring
    · push_neg at hi
      simp only [hi.not_ge, if_false, abs_of_neg hi]; ring

lemma sd_x0_not_mem
    (hhmeas : Measurable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => h z.1 z.2))
    (hhbdd : ∀ z : 𝒳 × 𝒴, |h z.1 z.2| ≤ 1) (α : ℝ)
    (hW : ∀ p : Measure (𝒳 × 𝒴), inUncertaintySetM Φ τ lam p → expectedLossM h p < α) :
    ((0 : Fin m → ℝ), 1 - α) ∉ sdSet Φ τ lam h := by
  rintro ⟨p, hp, hc, hl⟩
  haveI := hp
  have hih : Integrable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => h z.1 z.2) p := aux_integrable_of_bdd p _ hhmeas 1 hhbdd
  have hfeas : inUncertaintySetM Φ τ lam p := by
    refine ⟨hp, fun i => ?_⟩
    have hci := hc i
    have he : |featExpectM Φ p i - τ i| = |(0 : Fin m → ℝ) i - (featExpectM Φ p i - τ i)| := by
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply, zero_sub, abs_neg]
    rw [he]
    exact hci
  have hEL : expectedLossM h p = 1 - ∫ z, h z.1 z.2 ∂p := by
    rw [expectedLossM, integral_sub (integrable_const _) hih]; simp
  have hlt := hW p hfeas
  rw [hEL] at hlt
  simp only at hl
  linarith

lemma sd_gamma_zero_R2 [Nonempty (𝒳 × 𝒴)]
    (hΦmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => Φ z.1 z.2 i))
    (hΦbdd : ∀ x y i, |Φ x y i| ≤ B)
    (hreg2 : R2 Φ τ lam) (hlam : ∀ i, 0 ≤ lam i)
    (μ : Fin m → ℝ) (hμ : μ ≠ 0)
    (hsep : ∀ (q : 𝒳 × 𝒴) (v : Fin m → ℝ), (∀ i, |v i| ≤ lam i) →
        (∑ i, μ i * (Φ q.1 q.2 i - τ i + v i)) ≤ 0) : False := by
  obtain ⟨v, hvb, hvs⟩ := sd_sign_vec lam hlam μ
  have key : ∀ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, (∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i)
      ≤ (∑ i, τ i * μ i) - (∑ i, lam i * |μ i|) := by
    intro q
    have h1 := hsep q v hvb
    have hexp : (∑ i, μ i * (Φ q.1 q.2 i - τ i + v i))
        = (∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - (∑ i, τ i * μ i) + (∑ i, μ i * v i) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
    rw [hexp, hvs] at h1
    linarith
  have hsup : (⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, (∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i))
      ≤ (∑ i, τ i * μ i) - (∑ i, lam i * |μ i|) := ciSup_le key
  have hD := aux_D_pos Φ τ lam B hΦmeas hΦbdd hreg2 μ hμ
  linarith

lemma sd_gamma_zero_R1
    (hΦmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => Φ z.1 z.2 i))
    (hΦbdd : ∀ x y i, |Φ x y i| ≤ B) (hlam : ∀ i, 0 ≤ lam i)
    (p : Measure (𝒳 × 𝒴)) (hp : inUncertaintySetM Φ τ lam p)
    (μ : Fin m → ℝ) (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 < u)
    (hsep : ∀ (q : 𝒳 × 𝒴) (v : Fin m → ℝ), (∀ i, |v i| ≤ lam i) →
        (∑ i, μ i * (Φ q.1 q.2 i - τ i + v i)) ≤ -u) : False := by
  obtain ⟨hprob, hcon⟩ := hp
  haveI := hprob
  obtain ⟨v, hvb, hvs⟩ := sd_sign_vec lam hlam μ
  have hiΦ : ∀ i, Integrable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => Φ z.1 z.2 i) p := fun i =>
    aux_integrable_of_bdd p _ (hΦmeas i) B (fun z => hΦbdd _ _ i)
  have hint : Integrable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => ∑ i, μ i * (Φ z.1 z.2 i - τ i)) p :=
    integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => ((hiΦ i).sub (integrable_const _)).const_mul _)
  have key : ∀ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, (∑ i, μ i * (Φ q.1 q.2 i - τ i)) ≤ -u - (∑ i, lam i * |μ i|) := by
    intro q
    have h1 := hsep q v hvb
    have hexp : (∑ i, μ i * (Φ q.1 q.2 i - τ i + v i))
        = (∑ i, μ i * (Φ q.1 q.2 i - τ i)) + (∑ i, μ i * v i) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
    rw [hexp, hvs] at h1
    linarith
  have hmono : (∫ z, (∑ i, μ i * (Φ z.1 z.2 i - τ i)) ∂p) ≤ -u - (∑ i, lam i * |μ i|) := by
    have := integral_mono hint (integrable_const _) key
    simpa using this
  have hg : (∫ z, (∑ i, μ i * (Φ z.1 z.2 i - τ i)) ∂p)
      = ∑ i, μ i * (featExpectM Φ p i - τ i) := by
    rw [integral_finset_sum (f := fun i => fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => μ i * (Φ z.1 z.2 i - τ i))
      Finset.univ (fun i _ => ((hiΦ i).sub (integrable_const _)).const_mul _)]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [integral_const_mul, integral_sub (hiΦ i) (integrable_const _)]
    simp [featExpectM]
  rw [hg] at hmono
  have hb : |∑ i, μ i * (featExpectM Φ p i - τ i)| ≤ ∑ i, lam i * |μ i| := by
    calc |∑ i, μ i * (featExpectM Φ p i - τ i)|
        ≤ ∑ i, |μ i * (featExpectM Φ p i - τ i)| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ i, lam i * |μ i| := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => by
          rw [abs_mul, mul_comm]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hcon i) (abs_nonneg _))
  have := (abs_le.mp hb).1
  linarith

def sdLam (lam : Fin m → ℝ) : Set (Fin m → ℝ) := {v | ∀ i, |v i| ≤ lam i}

lemma sdLam_convex : Convex ℝ (sdLam lam) := by
  intro v hv w hw θ₁ θ₂ hθ₁ hθ₂ hθ i
  have h1 : (θ₁ • v + θ₂ • w) i = θ₁ * v i + θ₂ * w i := rfl
  rw [h1]
  calc |θ₁ * v i + θ₂ * w i| ≤ |θ₁ * v i| + |θ₂ * w i| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ = θ₁ * |v i| + θ₂ * |w i| := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hθ₁, abs_of_nonneg hθ₂]
    _ ≤ θ₁ * lam i + θ₂ * lam i :=
        add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hv i) hθ₁)
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hw i) hθ₂)
    _ = lam i := by rw [← add_mul, hθ, one_mul]

lemma sdLam_eq_pi : sdLam lam = Set.univ.pi (fun i => Set.Icc (-lam i) (lam i)) := by
  ext v
  simp only [sdLam, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_pi, Set.mem_univ, forall_true_left, Set.mem_Icc]
  constructor
  · intro hv i; exact abs_le.mp (hv i)
  · intro hv i; exact abs_le.mpr (hv i)

lemma sdLam_compact : IsCompact (sdLam lam) := by
  rw [sdLam_eq_pi]
  exact isCompact_univ_pi (fun i => isCompact_Icc)

def sdBase (Φ : 𝒳 → 𝒴 → Fin m → ℝ) (τ : Fin m → ℝ) (h : 𝒳 → 𝒴 → ℝ) :
    Set ((Fin m → ℝ) × ℝ) :=
  Set.range (fun q : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => (((fun i => Φ q.1 q.2 i - τ i) : Fin m → ℝ), h q.1 q.2))

def sdPoly (Φ : 𝒳 → 𝒴 → Fin m → ℝ) (τ lam : Fin m → ℝ) (h : 𝒳 → 𝒴 → ℝ) :
    Set ((Fin m → ℝ) × ℝ) :=
  (convexHull ℝ (sdBase Φ τ h + (sdLam lam) ×ˢ ({0} : Set ℝ)))
    + (({0} : Set (Fin m → ℝ)) ×ˢ Set.Ici (0:ℝ))

lemma sdPoly_convex : Convex ℝ (sdPoly Φ τ lam h) :=
  (convex_convexHull ℝ _).add ((convex_singleton _).prod (convex_Ici _))

lemma sdPoly_closed [Finite 𝒳] : IsClosed (sdPoly Φ τ lam h) := by
  haveI : Finite (𝒳 × 𝒴) := by infer_instance
  have hK : IsCompact (convexHull ℝ (sdBase Φ τ h + (sdLam lam) ×ˢ ({0} : Set ℝ))) := by
    rw [convexHull_add, ((sdLam_convex (lam := lam)).prod (convex_singleton (0:ℝ))).convexHull_eq]
    exact ((Set.finite_range _).isCompact_convexHull).add
      (IsCompact.prod (sdLam_compact (lam := lam)) isCompact_singleton)
  exact IsClosed.add_left_of_isCompact (isClosed_singleton.prod isClosed_Ici) hK

lemma sdPoly_up (z : (Fin m → ℝ) × ℝ) (hz : z ∈ sdPoly Φ τ lam h) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    (z.1, z.2 + s) ∈ sdPoly Φ τ lam h := by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, w, hw, hyw⟩ := hz
  have hw1 : w.1 = (0 : Fin m → ℝ) := by simpa using hw.1
  have hw2 : (0:ℝ) ≤ w.2 := hw.2
  have h1 : y.1 + w.1 = z.1 := congrArg Prod.fst hyw
  have h2 : y.2 + w.2 = z.2 := congrArg Prod.snd hyw
  refine ⟨y, hy, ((0 : Fin m → ℝ), w.2 + s), Set.mem_prod.mpr ⟨rfl, add_nonneg hw2 hs⟩, ?_⟩
  refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
  · show y.1 + (0 : Fin m → ℝ) = z.1
    rw [← h1, hw1]
  · show y.2 + (w.2 + s) = z.2 + s
    rw [← h2]; ring

lemma sdPoly_mem (q : 𝒳 × 𝒴) (v : Fin m → ℝ) (hv : ∀ i, |v i| ≤ lam i) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : h q.1 q.2 ≤ t) :
    (((fun i => Φ q.1 q.2 i - τ i + v i) : Fin m → ℝ), t) ∈ sdPoly Φ τ lam h := by
  refine ⟨(((fun i => Φ q.1 q.2 i - τ i + v i) : Fin m → ℝ), h q.1 q.2), ?_,
    ((0 : Fin m → ℝ), t - h q.1 q.2), ⟨rfl, by simpa using ht⟩, ?_⟩
  · refine subset_convexHull ℝ _ ?_
    refine ⟨(((fun i => Φ q.1 q.2 i - τ i) : Fin m → ℝ), h q.1 q.2), ⟨q, rfl⟩, (v, 0), ⟨hv, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · funext i; simp
    · simp
  · refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · simp
    · simp

lemma sdPoly_subset (B : ℝ)
    (hΦmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => Φ z.1 z.2 i))
    (hΦbdd : ∀ x y i, |Φ x y i| ≤ B)
    (hhmeas : Measurable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => h z.1 z.2))
    (hhbdd : ∀ z : 𝒳 × 𝒴, |h z.1 z.2| ≤ 1) :
    sdPoly Φ τ lam h ⊆ sdSet Φ τ lam h := by
  have hconv : Convex ℝ (sdSet Φ τ lam h) := sd_convex Φ τ lam h B hΦmeas hΦbdd hhmeas hhbdd
  have hbase : sdBase Φ τ h + (sdLam lam) ×ˢ ({0} : Set ℝ) ⊆ sdSet Φ τ lam h := by
    rintro z ⟨y, ⟨q, rfl⟩, w, hw, hyw⟩
    have hw1 : w.1 ∈ sdLam lam := hw.1
    have hw2 : w.2 = 0 := by simpa using hw.2
    have hz : z = (((fun i => Φ q.1 q.2 i - τ i + w.1 i) : Fin m → ℝ), h q.1 q.2) := by
      rw [← hyw]
      refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
      · funext i; simp
      · simp [hw2]
    rw [hz]
    exact sd_mem_of_point Φ τ lam h q w.1 hw1 (h q.1 q.2) le_rfl
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨y, hy, w, hw, hyw⟩ := hz
  obtain ⟨hw1, hw2⟩ := hw
  have hy' : y ∈ sdSet Φ τ lam h := convexHull_min hbase hconv hy
  have hw1' : w.1 = (0 : Fin m → ℝ) := by simpa using hw1
  have hz' : z = (y.1, y.2 + w.2) := by
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · rw [← hyw]; simp [hw1']
    · rw [← hyw]; simp
  rw [hz']
  exact sd_up Φ τ lam h y hy' w.2 (by simpa using hw2)

def sdBary (Φ : 𝒳 → 𝒴 → Fin m → ℝ) (τ : Fin m → ℝ) : Set (Fin m → ℝ) :=
  {w | ∃ p : Measure (𝒳 × 𝒴), IsProbabilityMeasure p ∧ ∀ i, w i = featExpectM Φ p i - τ i}

def sdAval (Φ : 𝒳 → 𝒴 → Fin m → ℝ) (τ : Fin m → ℝ) : Set (Fin m → ℝ) :=
  Set.range (fun q : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => ((fun i => Φ q.1 q.2 i - τ i) : Fin m → ℝ))

lemma sdBary_convex (B : ℝ)
    (hΦmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => Φ z.1 z.2 i))
    (hΦbdd : ∀ x y i, |Φ x y i| ≤ B) :
    Convex ℝ (sdBary Φ τ) := by
  rintro w ⟨p₁, hp₁, hw₁⟩ w' ⟨p₂, hp₂, hw₂⟩ θ₁ θ₂ hθ₁ hθ₂ hθ
  haveI := hp₁; haveI := hp₂
  have hiΦ1 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => Φ z.1 z.2 i) p₁ := fun i =>
    aux_integrable_of_bdd p₁ _ (hΦmeas i) B (fun z => hΦbdd _ _ i)
  have hiΦ2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => Φ z.1 z.2 i) p₂ := fun i =>
    aux_integrable_of_bdd p₂ _ (hΦmeas i) B (fun z => hΦbdd _ _ i)
  refine ⟨ENNReal.ofReal θ₁ • p₁ + ENNReal.ofReal θ₂ • p₂,
    sd_mix_prob p₁ p₂ hθ₁ hθ₂ hθ, fun i => ?_⟩
  have hfe : featExpectM Φ (ENNReal.ofReal θ₁ • p₁ + ENNReal.ofReal θ₂ • p₂) i
      = θ₁ * featExpectM Φ p₁ i + θ₂ * featExpectM Φ p₂ i :=
    sd_mix_integral p₁ p₂ hθ₁ hθ₂ _ (hiΦ1 i) (hiΦ2 i)
  have hlhs : (θ₁ • w + θ₂ • w') i = θ₁ * w i + θ₂ * w' i := rfl
  rw [hlhs, hfe, hw₁ i, hw₂ i]
  linear_combination (-(τ i)) * hθ

lemma sdAval_subset_bary : sdAval Φ τ ⊆ sdBary Φ τ := by
  rintro w ⟨q, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨Measure.dirac q, inferInstance, fun i => ?_⟩
  have : featExpectM Φ (Measure.dirac q) i = Φ q.1 q.2 i := by
    simpa [featExpectM] using integral_dirac (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => Φ z.1 z.2 i) q
  rw [this]

lemma sd_span_top
    (p : Measure (𝒳 × 𝒴)) [IsProbabilityMeasure p] (q₀ : 𝒳 × 𝒴)
    (hno : ¬ ∃ (α : Fin m → ℝ) (c : ℝ), α ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ᵐ z ∂p, (∑ i, α i * Φ z.1 z.2 i) = c) :
    Submodule.span ℝ ((fun w : Fin m → ℝ => w - (fun i => Φ q₀.1 q₀.2 i - τ i)) ''
      (sdAval Φ τ)) = ⊤ := by
  classical
  set w₀ : Fin m → ℝ := fun i => Φ q₀.1 q₀.2 i - τ i with hw₀
  set V := Submodule.span ℝ ((fun w : Fin m → ℝ => w - w₀) '' (sdAval Φ τ)) with hV
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨f, hf0, hfker⟩ := Submodule.exists_le_ker_of_lt_top V (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr hne)
  set α : Fin m → ℝ := fun i => f (fun j => if i = j then (1:ℝ) else 0) with hα
  have hfx : ∀ x : Fin m → ℝ, f x = ∑ i, x i * α i := by
    intro x
    rw [LinearMap.pi_apply_eq_sum_univ f x]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by rw [smul_eq_mul])
  have hα0 : α ≠ 0 := by
    intro hcon
    apply hf0
    refine LinearMap.ext (fun x => ?_)
    rw [hfx x, hcon]
    simp
  refine hno ⟨α, (∑ i, w₀ i * α i) + ∑ i, τ i * α i, hα0, Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_⟩
  intro z
  have hmem : ((fun i => Φ z.1 z.2 i - τ i) : Fin m → ℝ) - w₀ ∈ V :=
    Submodule.subset_span ⟨(fun i => Φ z.1 z.2 i - τ i), ⟨z, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  have hker : f (((fun i => Φ z.1 z.2 i - τ i) : Fin m → ℝ) - w₀) = 0 := hfker hmem
  rw [map_sub, hfx, hfx] at hker
  have hexp : (∑ i, ((fun i => Φ z.1 z.2 i - τ i) : Fin m → ℝ) i * α i)
      = (∑ i, α i * Φ z.1 z.2 i) - ∑ i, τ i * α i := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by simp; ring)
  rw [hexp] at hker
  linarith

lemma sd_hull_interior_nonempty [Nonempty (𝒳 × 𝒴)] (B : ℝ)
    (hΦmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => Φ z.1 z.2 i))
    (hΦbdd : ∀ x y i, |Φ x y i| ≤ B)
    (p : Measure (𝒳 × 𝒴)) [IsProbabilityMeasure p]
    (hno : ¬ ∃ (α : Fin m → ℝ) (c : ℝ), α ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ᵐ z ∂p, (∑ i, α i * Φ z.1 z.2 i) = c) :
    (interior (convexHull ℝ (sdAval Φ τ))).Nonempty := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨q₀⟩ : Nonempty (𝒳 × 𝒴) := inferInstance
  set w₀ : Fin m → ℝ := fun i => Φ q₀.1 q₀.2 i - τ i with hw₀def
  have hV := sd_span_top Φ τ p q₀ hno
  have haff : affineSpan ℝ (sdAval Φ τ) = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    rintro x -
    have hw₀ : w₀ ∈ affineSpan ℝ (sdAval Φ τ) := subset_affineSpan ℝ _ ⟨q₀, rfl⟩
    have hxV : x - w₀ ∈ Submodule.span ℝ
        ((fun w : Fin m → ℝ => w - w₀) '' (sdAval Φ τ)) := by
      rw [hV]; trivial
    have hle : Submodule.span ℝ ((fun w : Fin m → ℝ => w - w₀) '' (sdAval Φ τ))
        ≤ vectorSpan ℝ (sdAval Φ τ) := by
      rw [vectorSpan_def]
      refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_
      rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
      exact Submodule.subset_span (Set.vsub_mem_vsub hw ⟨q₀, rfl⟩)
    have hdir : x - w₀ ∈ (affineSpan ℝ (sdAval Φ τ)).direction := by
      rw [direction_affineSpan]
      exact hle hxV
    have := AffineSubspace.vadd_mem_of_mem_direction hdir hw₀
    simpa using this
  refine ((convex_convexHull ℝ (sdAval Φ τ)).interior_nonempty_iff_affineSpan_eq_top).mpr ?_
  rw [affineSpan_convexHull]
  exact haff

lemma sd_featExpect_dirac (q : 𝒳 × 𝒴) (i : Fin m) :
    featExpectM Φ (Measure.dirac q) i = Φ q.1 q.2 i := by
  simpa [featExpectM] using integral_dirac (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => Φ z.1 z.2 i) q

lemma sd_int_h_le_one (p : Measure (𝒳 × 𝒴)) [IsProbabilityMeasure p]
    (hhmeas : Measurable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => h z.1 z.2))
    (hhbdd : ∀ z : 𝒳 × 𝒴, |h z.1 z.2| ≤ 1) :
    (∫ q, h q.1 q.2 ∂p) ≤ 1 := by
  have hih : Integrable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => h z.1 z.2) p := aux_integrable_of_bdd p _ hhmeas 1 hhbdd
  have := integral_mono hih (integrable_const (1:ℝ)) (fun z => (abs_le.mp (hhbdd z)).2)
  simpa using this

lemma sd_interior_nonempty [Nonempty (𝒳 × 𝒴)] (B : ℝ)
    (hΦmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => Φ z.1 z.2 i))
    (hΦbdd : ∀ x y i, |Φ x y i| ≤ B)
    (hhmeas : Measurable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => h z.1 z.2))
    (hhbdd : ∀ z : 𝒳 × 𝒴, |h z.1 z.2| ≤ 1)
    (hlam : ∀ i, 0 ≤ lam i) (hreg2 : R2 Φ τ lam) :
    (interior (sdSet Φ τ lam h)).Nonempty := by
  obtain ⟨p, ⟨hprob, hcon⟩, hstrict, hdisj⟩ := hreg2
  haveI := hprob
  obtain ⟨q₀⟩ : Nonempty (𝒳 × 𝒴) := inferInstance
  rcases hdisj with hall | hno
  · set U : Set ((Fin m → ℝ) × ℝ) :=
      (⋂ i : Fin m, {z : (Fin m → ℝ) × ℝ | |z.1 i - (Φ q₀.1 q₀.2 i - τ i)| < lam i})
        ∩ {z : (Fin m → ℝ) × ℝ | 1 < z.2} with hUdef
    have hUopen : IsOpen U := by
      refine IsOpen.inter (isOpen_iInter_of_finite (fun i => ?_)) ?_
      · exact isOpen_lt
          ((((continuous_apply i).comp continuous_fst).sub continuous_const).abs)
          continuous_const
      · exact isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_snd
    have hUsub : U ⊆ sdSet Φ τ lam h := by
      intro z hz
      refine ⟨Measure.dirac q₀, inferInstance, fun i => ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [sd_featExpect_dirac Φ q₀ i]
        have := Set.mem_iInter.mp hz.1 i
        exact le_of_lt this
      · rw [integral_dirac (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => h z.1 z.2) q₀]
        have h1 := (abs_le.mp (hhbdd q₀)).2
        have h2 : (1:ℝ) < z.2 := hz.2
        linarith
    refine ⟨(((fun i => Φ q₀.1 q₀.2 i - τ i) : Fin m → ℝ), (2:ℝ)), ?_⟩
    refine interior_maximal hUsub hUopen ?_
    refine ⟨Set.mem_iInter.mpr (fun i => ?_), ?_⟩
    · show |(Φ q₀.1 q₀.2 i - τ i) - (Φ q₀.1 q₀.2 i - τ i)| < lam i
      simpa using hall i
    · show (1:ℝ) < (2:ℝ)
      norm_num
  · obtain ⟨w₁, hw₁⟩ := sd_hull_interior_nonempty Φ τ B hΦmeas hΦbdd p hno
    set U : Set ((Fin m → ℝ) × ℝ) :=
      {z : (Fin m → ℝ) × ℝ | z.1 ∈ interior (convexHull ℝ (sdAval Φ τ))}
        ∩ {z : (Fin m → ℝ) × ℝ | 1 < z.2} with hUdef
    have hUopen : IsOpen U :=
      IsOpen.inter (isOpen_interior.preimage continuous_fst)
        (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_snd)
    have hUsub : U ⊆ sdSet Φ τ lam h := by
      intro z hz
      have h1 : z.1 ∈ convexHull ℝ (sdAval Φ τ) := interior_subset hz.1
      have h2 : z.1 ∈ sdBary Φ τ :=
        convexHull_min (sdAval_subset_bary Φ τ) (sdBary_convex Φ τ B hΦmeas hΦbdd) h1
      obtain ⟨p', hp', hw⟩ := h2
      haveI := hp'
      refine ⟨p', hp', fun i => ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [← hw i, sub_self, abs_zero]
        exact hlam i
      · have h3 := sd_int_h_le_one h p' hhmeas hhbdd
        have h4 : (1:ℝ) < z.2 := hz.2
        linarith
    exact ⟨(w₁, (2:ℝ)), interior_maximal hUsub hUopen ⟨hw₁, by norm_num⟩⟩


lemma sd_strong [Nonempty (𝒳 × 𝒴)]
    (hΦmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => Φ z.1 z.2 i))
    (hΦbdd : ∀ x y i, |Φ x y i| ≤ B)
    (hhmeas : Measurable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => h z.1 z.2))
    (hhbdd : ∀ z : 𝒳 × 𝒴, |h z.1 z.2| ≤ 1)
    (hlam : ∀ i, 0 ≤ lam i) (hreg : R1 Φ τ lam ∨ R2 Φ τ lam)
    (hbb : BddBelow (Set.range (fun μ : Fin m → ℝ => 1 - (∑ i, τ i * μ i)
      + (⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - h q.1 q.2)) + (∑ i, lam i * |μ i|))))
    (α : ℝ)
    (hW : ∀ p : Measure (𝒳 × 𝒴), inUncertaintySetM Φ τ lam p → expectedLossM h p < α) :
    RoverM Φ τ lam h ≤ α := by
  have hx₀ : ((0 : Fin m → ℝ), 1 - α) ∉ sdSet Φ τ lam h :=
    sd_x0_not_mem Φ τ lam h hhmeas hhbdd α hW
  obtain ⟨q₀⟩ : Nonempty (𝒳 × 𝒴) := inferInstance
  have hv0 : ∀ i, |(0 : Fin m → ℝ) i| ≤ lam i := fun i => by simpa using hlam i
  rcases hreg with hreg1 | hreg2
  · obtain ⟨hfin, p₀, hp₀⟩ := hreg1
    haveI : Finite 𝒳 := hfin
    have hx₀' : ((0 : Fin m → ℝ), 1 - α) ∉ sdPoly Φ τ lam h := fun hc =>
      hx₀ (sdPoly_subset Φ τ lam h B hΦmeas hΦbdd hhmeas hhbdd hc)
    obtain ⟨μ, γ, u, hγ, hu, hsep⟩ := sd_separate_closed (sdPoly Φ τ lam h)
      (sdPoly_convex Φ τ lam h) (sdPoly_up Φ τ lam h)
      ⟨_, sdPoly_mem Φ τ lam h q₀ 0 hv0 (h q₀.1 q₀.2) le_rfl⟩
      (sdPoly_closed Φ τ lam h) (1 - α) hx₀'
    have hsep' : ∀ (q : 𝒳 × 𝒴) (v : Fin m → ℝ), (∀ i, |v i| ≤ lam i) →
        (∑ i, μ i * (Φ q.1 q.2 i - τ i + v i)) - γ * h q.1 q.2 ≤ -(γ * (1 - α)) - u :=
      fun q v hv => hsep _ (sdPoly_mem Φ τ lam h q v hv (h q.1 q.2) le_rfl)
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hγ with hγ0 | hγpos
    · exfalso
      refine sd_gamma_zero_R1 Φ τ lam B hΦmeas hΦbdd hlam p₀ hp₀ μ u hu (fun q v hv => ?_)
      have hthis := hsep' q v hv
      rw [← hγ0] at hthis
      simpa using hthis
    · refine sd_RoverM_le Φ τ lam h hlam hbb α (fun i => μ i / γ) (fun q v hv => ?_)
      have h1 := hsep' q v hv
      have h2 : (∑ i, (fun i => μ i / γ) i * (Φ q.1 q.2 i - τ i + v i))
          = (∑ i, μ i * (Φ q.1 q.2 i - τ i + v i)) / γ := by
        rw [Finset.sum_div]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
      rw [h2]
      have h3 : (∑ i, μ i * (Φ q.1 q.2 i - τ i + v i)) / γ ≤ h q.1 q.2 + (α - 1) := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hγpos]
        nlinarith [h1, hu, hγpos]
      linarith
  · have hint := sd_interior_nonempty Φ τ lam h B hΦmeas hΦbdd hhmeas hhbdd hlam hreg2
    obtain ⟨μ, γ, hγ, hnz, hsep⟩ := sd_separate_open (sdSet Φ τ lam h)
      (sd_convex Φ τ lam h B hΦmeas hΦbdd hhmeas hhbdd) (sd_up Φ τ lam h) hint (1 - α) hx₀
    have hsep' : ∀ (q : 𝒳 × 𝒴) (v : Fin m → ℝ), (∀ i, |v i| ≤ lam i) →
        (∑ i, μ i * (Φ q.1 q.2 i - τ i + v i)) - γ * h q.1 q.2 ≤ -(γ * (1 - α)) :=
      fun q v hv => hsep _ (sd_mem_of_point Φ τ lam h q v hv (h q.1 q.2) le_rfl)
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hγ with hγ0 | hγpos
    · exfalso
      have hμ : μ ≠ 0 := by
        rcases hnz with h1 | h2
        · exact absurd hγ0.symm h1
        · exact h2
      refine sd_gamma_zero_R2 Φ τ lam B hΦmeas hΦbdd hreg2 hlam μ hμ (fun q v hv => ?_)
      have hthis := hsep' q v hv
      rw [← hγ0] at hthis
      simpa using hthis
    · refine sd_RoverM_le Φ τ lam h hlam hbb α (fun i => μ i / γ) (fun q v hv => ?_)
      have h1 := hsep' q v hv
      have h2 : (∑ i, (fun i => μ i / γ) i * (Φ q.1 q.2 i - τ i + v i))
          = (∑ i, μ i * (Φ q.1 q.2 i - τ i + v i)) / γ := by
        rw [Finset.sum_div]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
      rw [h2]
      have h3 : (∑ i, μ i * (Φ q.1 q.2 i - τ i + v i)) / γ ≤ h q.1 q.2 + (α - 1) := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hγpos]
        nlinarith [h1, hγpos]
      linarith
end StrongDual

theorem lemma11_strongDuality {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] [StandardBorelSpace 𝒳]
    {𝒴 : Type*} [Fintype 𝒴] [MeasurableSpace 𝒴] [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝒴]
    [Nonempty 𝒳] [Nonempty 𝒴] {m : ℕ}
    (Φ : 𝒳 → 𝒴 → Fin m → ℝ) (τ lam : Fin m → ℝ) (h : 𝒳 → 𝒴 → ℝ)
    (hΦmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => Φ z.1 z.2 i))
    (hΦbdd : ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ x y i, |Φ x y i| ≤ B)
    (hhmeas : Measurable (fun z : 𝒳 × 𝒴 => h z.1 z.2))
    (hrule_nonneg : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ h x y) (hrule_sum : ∀ x, ∑ y, h x y = 1)
    (hlam : ∀ i, 0 ≤ lam i)
    (hreg : R1 Φ τ lam ∨ R2 Φ τ lam) :
    worstCaseRiskM Φ τ lam h = RoverM Φ τ lam h
      ∧ ∃ μ : Fin m → ℝ, RoverM Φ τ lam h = 1 - (∑ i, τ i * μ i)
          + (⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - h q.1 q.2))
          + (∑ i, lam i * |μ i|) := by
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hΦbdd
  haveI hne : Nonempty (𝒳 × 𝒴) := inferInstance
  have hB' : ∀ x y i, |Φ x y i| ≤ |B| := fun x y i => le_trans (hB x y i) (le_abs_self B)
  have hB0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ |B| := abs_nonneg B
  have hh1 : ∀ z : 𝒳 × 𝒴, |h z.1 z.2| ≤ 1 := fun z => by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (hrule_nonneg _ _)]
    exact aux_h_le_one h hrule_nonneg hrule_sum _ _
  obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀⟩ : ∃ p : Measure (𝒳 × 𝒴), inUncertaintySetM Φ τ lam p := by
    rcases hreg with ⟨_, p, hp⟩ | ⟨p, hp, _, _⟩
    · exact ⟨p, hp⟩
    · exact ⟨p, hp⟩
  have hFge : ∀ μ : Fin m → ℝ, expectedLossM h p₀ ≤ 1 - (∑ i, τ i * μ i)
      + (⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - h q.1 q.2)) + (∑ i, lam i * |μ i|) :=
    fun μ => aux_weak_upper Φ h |B| τ lam p₀ hΦmeas hB' hhmeas hrule_nonneg hrule_sum hp₀ μ
  have hbb : BddBelow (Set.range (fun μ : Fin m → ℝ => 1 - (∑ i, τ i * μ i)
      + (⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ i) - h q.1 q.2)) + (∑ i, lam i * |μ i|))) := by
    refine ⟨expectedLossM h p₀, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨μ, rfl⟩
    exact hFge μ
  obtain ⟨μ₀, hμ₀⟩ := aux_attain Φ τ lam |B| hB0 hΦmeas hB' 1
    (fun z => h z.1 z.2) 1 zero_le_one hh1 hlam hne hreg (expectedLossM h p₀) hFge
  have hattain : RoverM Φ τ lam h = 1 - (∑ i, τ i * μ₀ i)
      + (⨆ q : 𝒳 × 𝒴, ((∑ i, Φ q.1 q.2 i * μ₀ i) - h q.1 q.2)) + (∑ i, lam i * |μ₀ i|) :=
    le_antisymm (ciInf_le hbb μ₀) (le_ciInf hμ₀)
  have hWne : {r : ℝ | ∃ p, inUncertaintySetM Φ τ lam p ∧ r = expectedLossM h p}.Nonempty :=
    ⟨expectedLossM h p₀, p₀, hp₀, rfl⟩
  have hWub : ∀ r ∈ {r : ℝ | ∃ p, inUncertaintySetM Φ τ lam p ∧ r = expectedLossM h p},
      r ≤ RoverM Φ τ lam h := by
    rintro r ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    exact le_ciInf (fun μ =>
      aux_weak_upper Φ h |B| τ lam p hΦmeas hB' hhmeas hrule_nonneg hrule_sum hp μ)
  have hbdA : BddAbove {r : ℝ | ∃ p, inUncertaintySetM Φ τ lam p ∧ r = expectedLossM h p} :=
    ⟨RoverM Φ τ lam h, hWub⟩
  have hle : sSup {r : ℝ | ∃ p, inUncertaintySetM Φ τ lam p ∧ r = expectedLossM h p}
      ≤ RoverM Φ τ lam h := csSup_le hWne hWub
  have hge : RoverM Φ τ lam h
      ≤ sSup {r : ℝ | ∃ p, inUncertaintySetM Φ τ lam p ∧ r = expectedLossM h p} := by
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    set α : ℝ := (sSup {r : ℝ | ∃ p, inUncertaintySetM Φ τ lam p ∧ r = expectedLossM h p}
      + RoverM Φ τ lam h) / 2 with hαdef
    have h1 : sSup {r : ℝ | ∃ p, inUncertaintySetM Φ τ lam p ∧ r = expectedLossM h p} < α := by
      rw [hαdef]; linarith
    have h2 : α < RoverM Φ τ lam h := by rw [hαdef]; linarith
    have hW' : ∀ p : Measure (𝒳 × 𝒴), inUncertaintySetM Φ τ lam p → expectedLossM h p < α := by
      intro p hp
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_csSup hbdA ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩) h1
    have := sd_strong Φ τ lam h |B| hΦmeas hB' hhmeas hh1 hlam hreg hbb α hW'
    linarith
  exact ⟨le_antisymm hle hge, μ₀, hattain⟩

lemma hoeff_one_sided {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure P] {n : ℕ} (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (X : Fin n → Ω → ℝ) (a : ℝ)
    (hbdd : ∀ k ω, |X k ω| ≤ C)
    (hmeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k))
    (hindep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P)
    (hmean : ∀ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ∂P = a)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    P.real {ω | ε ≤ ∑ k, (X k ω - a)} ≤ Real.exp (-ε ^ 2 / (2 * ((n:ℝ) * C^2))) := by
  set c : NNReal := (‖C + C‖₊ / 2) ^ 2 with hc
  have hindep' : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun (fun k => fun ω => X k ω - a) P := by
    have := hindep.comp (fun _ => fun x : ℝ => x - a) (fun _ => measurable_id.sub_const a)
    exact this
  have hsub : ∀ k : Fin n, ProbabilityTheory.HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω => X k ω - a) c P := by
    intro k
    have h := ProbabilityTheory.hasSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc (X := X k) (μ := P) (a := -C) (b := C)
      (hmeas k).aemeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => by
        simpa [Set.mem_Icc] using abs_le.mp (hbdd k ω)))
    simpa [hmean k, sub_neg_eq_add] using h
  have key := ProbabilityTheory.HasSubgaussianMGF.measure_sum_ge_le_of_iIndepFun
    hindep' (c := fun _ => c) (s := Finset.univ) (fun k _ => hsub k) hε
  have hcoe : ((∑ _k : Fin n, c : NNReal) : ℝ) = (n:ℝ) * C^2 := by
    simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul,
      NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_natCast, hc, NNReal.coe_pow, NNReal.coe_div,
      coe_nnnorm, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ C + C)]
    push_cast
    ring
  rwa [hcoe] at key

lemma hoeff_two_sided {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure P] {n : ℕ} (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (X : Fin n → Ω → ℝ) (a : ℝ)
    (hbdd : ∀ k ω, |X k ω| ≤ C)
    (hmeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k))
    (hindep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P)
    (hmean : ∀ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ∂P = a)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    P.real {ω | ε ≤ |∑ k, (X k ω - a)|} ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-ε ^ 2 / (2 * ((n:ℝ) * C^2))) := by
  have h1 := hoeff_one_sided P C hC X a hbdd hmeas hindep hmean hε
  have h2 := hoeff_one_sided P C hC (fun k => fun ω => -(X k ω)) (-a)
    (fun k ω => by simpa using hbdd k ω) (fun k => (hmeas k).neg)
    (hindep.comp (fun _ => fun x : ℝ => -x) (fun _ => measurable_neg))
    (fun k => by rw [integral_neg, hmean k]) hε
  have hsub : {ω | ε ≤ |∑ k, (X k ω - a)|} ⊆
      {ω | ε ≤ ∑ k, (X k ω - a)} ∪ {ω | ε ≤ ∑ k, (-(X k ω) - -a)} := by
    intro ω hω
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hω
    rcases abs_cases (∑ k, (X k ω - a)) with ⟨he, _⟩ | ⟨he, _⟩
    · left; simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]; linarith [hω, he.symm]
    · right
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
      have : ∑ k, (-(X k ω) - -a) = -∑ k, (X k ω - a) := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]; congr 1; ext k; ring
      rw [this]; linarith [hω, he.symm]
  calc P.real {ω | ε ≤ |∑ k, (X k ω - a)|}
      ≤ P.real ({ω | ε ≤ ∑ k, (X k ω - a)} ∪ {ω | ε ≤ ∑ k, (-(X k ω) - -a)}) :=
        measureReal_mono hsub
    _ ≤ P.real {ω | ε ≤ ∑ k, (X k ω - a)} + P.real {ω | ε ≤ ∑ k, (-(X k ω) - -a)} :=
        measureReal_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-ε ^ 2 / (2 * ((n:ℝ) * C^2))) + Real.exp (-ε ^ 2 / (2 * ((n:ℝ) * C^2))) := by
        exact add_le_add h1 h2
    _ = 2 * Real.exp (-ε ^ 2 / (2 * ((n:ℝ) * C^2))) := by ring

theorem theorem4_hoeffding {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure P] (m n : ℕ) (C δ : ℝ)
    (τ : Fin m → ℝ) (Z : Fin n → Ω → Fin m → ℝ)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
    (nY : ℕ) (hnY : 0 < nY) (labelOf : Fin m → Fin nY)
    (D : ℕ) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hblocks : ∀ y : Fin nY, (Finset.univ.filter fun i => labelOf i = y).card = D)
    (hlabelOnto : Function.Surjective labelOf)
    (honehot : ∀ k ω, ∃ y : Fin nY, ∀ i, labelOf i ≠ y → Z k ω i = 0)
    (hbdd : ∀ k i ω, |Z k ω i| ≤ C)
    (hmeas : ∀ k, Measurable (Z k))
    (hindep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun Z P)
    (hident : ∀ k l, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (Z k) (Z l) P P)
    (hmean : ∀ k i, ∫ ω, Z k ω i ∂P = τ i) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (1 - δ)
      ≤ P {ω | ∀ i : Fin m, |τ i - (∑ k, Z k ω i) / (n : ℝ)| ≤ lambdaDelta C δ m n} := by
  set S : Set Ω := {ω | ∀ i : Fin m, |τ i - (∑ k, Z k ω i) / (n : ℝ)| ≤ lambdaDelta C δ m n}
    with hS
  set lam := lambdaDelta C δ m n with hlamdef
  have hnpos : (0:ℝ) < (n:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hmpos : (0:ℝ) < (m:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm
  -- main real-valued bound
  have hmain : 1 - δ ≤ P.real S := by
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hC with hC0 | hCpos
    · -- C = 0
      have hZ : ∀ k ω i, Z k ω i = 0 := by
        intro k ω i
        have h := hbdd k i ω
        rw [← hC0] at h
        exact abs_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm h (abs_nonneg _))
      have hτ : ∀ i, τ i = 0 := by
        intro i
        have := hmean ⟨0, hn⟩ i
        rw [← this]
        simp [hZ]
      have hlam0 : lam = 0 := by
        rw [hlamdef, lambdaDelta, ← hC0]; ring
      have hSuniv : S = Set.univ := by
        ext ω
        simp [hS, hτ, hZ, ← hlamdef, hlam0]
      rw [hSuniv]
      simp only [measureReal_univ_eq_one]
      linarith
    · -- 0 < C
      set L := Real.log (2 * (m:ℝ) / δ) with hL
      have hone : (1:ℝ) < 2 * (m:ℝ) / δ := by
        rw [lt_div_iff₀ hδ]
        have : (1:ℝ) ≤ (m:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm
        nlinarith
      have hLpos : 0 < L := Real.log_pos hone
      have hlamnonneg : 0 ≤ lam := by
        rw [hlamdef, lambdaDelta]
        have : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * L / (n:ℝ) := by positivity
        positivity
      have hlamsq : lam ^ 2 = C ^ 2 * (2 * L / (n:ℝ)) := by
        rw [hlamdef, lambdaDelta, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
      -- per-component bound
      have hcomp : ∀ i : Fin m,
          P.real {ω | (n:ℝ) * lam ≤ |∑ k, (Z k ω i - τ i)|} ≤ δ / (m:ℝ) := by
        intro i
        have hb := hoeff_two_sided P C hC (fun k => fun ω => Z k ω i) (τ i)
          (fun k ω => hbdd k i ω) (fun k => (measurable_pi_apply i).comp (hmeas k))
          (hindep.comp (fun _ => fun v : Fin m → ℝ => v i) (fun _ => measurable_pi_apply i))
          (fun k => hmean k i) (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ (n:ℝ) * lam)
        have hexp : -((n:ℝ) * lam) ^ 2 / (2 * ((n:ℝ) * C ^ 2)) = -L := by
          rw [mul_pow, hlamsq]
          field_simp
        rw [hexp] at hb
        have hval : Real.exp (-L) = δ / (2 * (m:ℝ)) := by
          rw [Real.exp_neg, hL, Real.exp_log (by positivity)]
          field_simp
        rw [hval] at hb
        have h2 : 2 * (δ / (2 * (m:ℝ))) = δ / (m:ℝ) := by field_simp
        linarith [hb, h2.le, h2.ge]
      -- union bound
      have hsubset : Sᶜ ⊆ ⋃ i : Fin m, {ω | (n:ℝ) * lam ≤ |∑ k, (Z k ω i - τ i)|} := by
        intro ω hω
        simp only [hS, Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_forall, not_le] at hω
        obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hω
        refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i, ?_⟩
        simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
        have hsplit : ∑ k, (Z k ω i - τ i) = (∑ k, Z k ω i) - (n:ℝ) * τ i := by
          rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
          simp [mul_comm]
        have hstep : (n:ℝ) * lam ≤ (n:ℝ) * |τ i - (∑ k, Z k ω i) / (n:ℝ)| :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hi.le (le_of_lt hnpos)
        have heq : |∑ k, (Z k ω i - τ i)| = (n:ℝ) * |τ i - (∑ k, Z k ω i) / (n:ℝ)| := by
          have hrw : τ i - (∑ k, Z k ω i) / (n:ℝ) = (-(∑ k, (Z k ω i - τ i))) / (n:ℝ) := by
            rw [hsplit]; field_simp; ring
          rw [hrw, abs_div, abs_neg, abs_of_pos hnpos]
          field_simp
        rw [heq]
        exact hstep
      have hcompl : P.real Sᶜ ≤ δ := by
        calc P.real Sᶜ ≤ P.real (⋃ i : Fin m, {ω | (n:ℝ) * lam ≤ |∑ k, (Z k ω i - τ i)|}) :=
              measureReal_mono hsubset
          _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin m, P.real {ω | (n:ℝ) * lam ≤ |∑ k, (Z k ω i - τ i)|} :=
              measureReal_iUnion_fintype_le _
          _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin m, δ / (m:ℝ) := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hcomp i)
          _ = δ := by
              simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
              field_simp
      have hcover : (1:ℝ) ≤ P.real S + P.real Sᶜ := by
        have := measureReal_union_le (μ := P) S Sᶜ
        rw [Set.union_compl_self] at this
        simpa using this
      linarith
  -- conclude
  have hstep := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hmain
  rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.real, ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (measure_ne_top P S)] at hstep
  exact hstep

end ResearchLevel

targets.label: Lemma 16
targets.statement:
Lemma 16 Let $G:\{-1,1\}^{k}\to\{-1,1\}$ and let ${\mathcal{F}}_{1},\ldots,{\mathcal{F}}_{k}\subseteq\{-1,1\}^{\mathcal{X}}$ be hypothesis classes with $\operatorname{VC}(\mathcal{F}_{j})~=~d_{j}$ Denote $\begin{array}{r}{\bar{d}: = \frac{1}{k}\sum_{i = 1}^{k}d_{j}}\end{array}$ . Define the function class $G\left({\mathcal{F}}_{1},\ldots,{\mathcal{F}}_{k}\right)= :$ $\{\mathcal{X}\ni x\mapsto G\left(f_{1}(x),\ldots,f_{k}(x)\right):f_{i}\in\mathcal{F}_{i}\}$ . Then,

$$
\mathrm{VC}\left(G\left(\mathcal{F}_{1},\ldots,\mathcal{F}_{k}\right)\right)\leq 2k\log_2(3k)\bar{d}
$$

targets.label: Lemma 1
targets.statement: Lemma 1 For any class $\mathcal{H}$ of VC dimension d, and any adversary $\rho : \mathcal{X}\to 2^{\mathcal{X}}$ such that $|\rho(x)|\leq$ $k,$ the VC-dimension of the zero-one robust loss class $L_{\mathcal{H}}^{\rho}=\left\{(x,y)\mapsto\operatorname*{max}_{z\in\rho(x)}\mathbb{I}\left[h(z)\neq y\right]:h\in\mathcal{H}\right\}$ is at most ${\mathcal{O}}(d\log k)$

targets.label: Lemma 14
targets.statement:
Lemma 14 For all $\mathcal{F}\subseteq \mathbb{R}^{\mathcal{X}}$ and $\gamma > 0$ ,we have

$$
\mathrm{fat}_{\gamma}(\mathcal{F})=\operatorname*{max}_{r\in\mathbb{R}^{\mathcal{X}}}\mathrm{fat}_{\gamma}^{0}(\mathcal{F}-r),\tag{7}
$$

where ${\mathcal{F}}- r ~ = ~ \{f - r : f \in{\mathcal{F}}\}$ is the r-shifted class; in particular, the maximum is always achieved.

nl_proof:
### Proof of Lemma 16

Proof We adapt the argument of Blumer et al. (1989, Lemma 3.2.3), which is stated therein for k-fold unions and intersections. The $k = 1$ case is trivial, so assume $k \geq 2$ For any $S \subseteq{\mathcal{X}}$ ,define

$G\left({\mathcal{F}}_{1},\ldots,{\mathcal{F}}_{k}\right)(S)\subseteq\{-1,1\}^{S}$ to be the restriction of $G\left(\mathcal{F}_{1},\ldots,\mathcal{F}_{k}\right)$ to $S .$ The key observation is that

$$
\begin{array}{r c l}{|G\left(\mathcal{F}_{1},\dots,\mathcal{F}_{k}\right)(S)|}&{\le}&{\displaystyle\prod_{j=1}^{k}|\mathcal{F}_{j}(S)|}\\ &{\le}&{\displaystyle\prod_{j=1}^{k}(e|S| /d_{j})^{d_{j}}}\\ &{\le}&{\displaystyle(e|S| /\bar{d})^{\bar{d}k}.}\end{array}
$$

The last inequality requires proof. After taking logarithms and dividing both sides by $k,$ it is equivalent to the claim that

$$
\bar{d}\log \bar{d}\leq \frac{1}{k}\sum_{j = 1}^{k}d_{j}\log d_{j}\ ,
$$

an immediate consequence of Jensen's inequality applied to the convex function $f(x)=x\log x$

The rest of the argument is identical that of Blumer et al.: one readily verifies that for $m =$ $|S| =2\bar{d}k\log(3k)$ , we have $(em/\bar{d})^{\bar{d}k}<2^{m}$

### Proof of Lemma 1

Proof [of Lemma 1] Take an arbitrary sample $S=\{(x_{1},y_{1}),....,(x_{n},y_{n})\}$ . Construct the set that contains all possible corrupted examples on inputs from $\begin{array}{r}{S,S_{\rho}=\bigcup_{i\in [n]}\left\{z:z\in\rho(x_{i})\right\}}\end{array}$ , the size of $S_{\rho}$ is at most nk. Denote by $L_{\mathcal{H}}^{\rho}(S)$ the set of all possible behaviors on $S$ using functions in $L_{\mathcal{H}}^{\rho},$ and by $\mathcal{H}(S_{\rho})$ , the set of all possible behaviors on $S_{\rho}$ using functions in $\mathcal{H}$. Namely, $L_{\mathcal{H}}^{\rho}(S)=\{(\ell(x_{1},y_{1}),\ldots,\ell(x_{n},y_{n})):\ell\in L_{\mathcal{H}}^{\rho}\}$ and ${\mathcal{H}}(S_{\rho})~=~\{(h(z_{1}),\ldots,h(z_{m})):h\in{\mathcal{H}}\}$ Observe that each pattern in the set $L_{\mathcal{H}}^{\rho}(S)$ will map to at least one pattern in $\mathcal{H}(S_{\rho})$ , implying that the size of $L_{\mathcal{H}}^{\rho}(S)$ is at most the size of $\mathcal{H}(S_{\rho})$ . Using Sauer's lemma, the size of $\mathcal{H}(S_{\rho})$ is at most $(nk)^{d}$ , solving for n such that $(nk)^{d}<2^{n}$ yields the stated bound.

### Proof of Lemma 14

Proof Fix $\mathcal{F}$ and $\gamma .$ For any choice of $r\in \mathbb{R}^{\mathcal{X}}$ , if ${\mathcal{F}}- r$ γ-shatters some set $S \subseteq{\mathcal{X}}$ at zero, then then $\mathcal{F}$ $\gamma$-shatters $S$ in the usual sense with shift $r_{S}\in \mathbb{R}^{S}$ (i.e., the restriction of r to S). This proves that the left-hand side of Eq. (7) is at least as large as the right-hand side. Conversely, suppose that $\mathcal{F}$ $\gamma$-shatters some $S \subseteq{\mathcal{X}}$ in the usual sense, with some shift $r\in \mathbb{R}^{S}$ . Choosing $r^{\prime}\in \mathbb{R}^{\mathcal{X}}$ by $r_{S}^{\prime}= r$ and $r_{\mathcal{X}\backslash S}^{\prime}= 0$ , we see that ${\mathcal{F}}- r^{\prime}$ γ-shatters S at zero. This proves the other direction and hence the claim.

context.name: Model: domain, labels, adversary rho with |rho(x)| <= k (Section 2)
context.statement:
There is an unknown distribution D over some domain $\mathcal{X}$ of uncorrupted examples and a finite domain of corrupted examples $\mathcal{Z}$ , possibly the same as $\mathcal{X}$. Our setting is the agnostic PAC-learning framework in a deterministic scenario. The label of each input is uniquely determined by an arbitrary unknown target function $c : \mathcal{X}\to \mathcal{Y}$ . The function c maps each uncorrupted input $x \in \mathcal{X}$ to a label $c(x)=y$ , where the set of labels $\mathcal{Y}$ can be $\{1,\ldots,l\}$ or $\mathbb{R}$.

The adversary is able to corrupt an input by mapping an uncorrupted input $x \in \mathcal{X}$ to a corrupted one $z \in{\mathcal{Z}}$ . There is a mapping $\rho$ which for every $x \in \mathcal{X}$ defines a set $\rho(x)\subseteq{\mathcal{Z}}$ ,such that $|\rho(x)|\le k$ The adversary can map an uncorrupted input x to any corrupted input $z\in\rho(x)$ . We assume that the learner has an access to $\rho(\cdot)$ during the training phase.

context.name: Zero-one robust loss, eq. (2) (Section 1.1)
context.statement:
Montasser et al. (2019, 2020b) defined a loss function $\ell:\mathcal{H}\times\mathcal{X}\times\mathcal{Y}\to\{0,1\}$ as follows

$$
\ell_{2}(h,x,y)=\operatorname*{max}_{z\in\rho(x)}\mathbb{I}\left[h(z)\neq y\right],\tag{2}
$$

which we refer to as the zero-one robust loss.

context.name: Notation (Section 1.3)
context.statement: Notation. d denotes the VC dimension, $d^{*}$ denote the dual dual-VC dimension, $\mathrm{fat}_{\gamma}(\cdot)$ is the γ—fat shattering dimension, and k is the size of possible corruptions for each input. $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\cdot)$ stands for for omitting poly-logarithmic factors of $d,d^{*},1/\epsilon,1/\delta$

context.name: Fat-shattering dimension and shift (Section 3.1)
context.statement:
Fat-Shattering Dimension. For $\mathcal{F}\subset \mathbb{R}^{\mathcal{X}}$ and $\gamma ~ > ~ 0$ , we say that $\mathcal{F}$ $\gamma$-shatters a set $S \ =$ $\{x_{1},\ldots,x_{m}\}\subset\mathcal{X}$ if there exists an $r=(r_{1},\ldots,r_{m})\in\mathbb{R}^{m}$ such that for each $b\in\{-1,1\}^{m}$ there is a function $f_{b}\in \mathcal{F}$ such that

$$
\forall i\in [m]:\begin{cases}f_{b}(x_{i})\geq r_{i}+\gamma&\text{if } b_{i}=1\\ f_{b}(x_{i})\leq r_{i}-\gamma&\text{if } b_{i}= -1\end{cases}.
$$

We refer to r as the shift. The γ-fat-shattering dimension, denoted by $\mathrm{fat}_{\gamma}(\mathcal{F})$ , is the size of the largest γ-shattered set (possibly ∞).

context.name: Growth function and VC-dimension (Section 3.1)
context.statement:
Growth Function. The growth function $\Pi_{\mathcal{H}}: \mathbb{N}\mapsto \mathbb{N}$ for a binary function class $\mathcal{H}:\mathcal{X}\mapsto\{0,1\}$ is defined by

$$
\forall m\in\mathbb{N},\ \Pi_{\mathcal{H}}(m)=\operatorname*{max}_{\{x_{1},\ldots,x_{m}\}\subseteq\mathcal{X}}|\left\{(h(x_{1}),\ldots,h(x_{m})):h\in\mathcal{H}\right\}|
$$

And the VC-dimension of $\mathcal{H}$ is defined by

$$
\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal{H})=\operatorname*{max}\left\{m:\Pi_{\mathcal{H}}(m)=2^{m}\right\}.
$$

context.name: Shattering at zero, fat^0_gamma (Section 6.1)
context.statement: Before presenting the proof, we introduce some auxiliary notions. We say that $\mathcal{F}$ “$\gamma$-shatters a set $S$ at zero” if the shift $r$ is constrained to be 0 in the the usual γ-shattering definition (has appeared previously in Gottlieb et al. (2014)). The analogous dimension will be denoted by $\mathrm{fat}_{\gamma}^{0}(\mathcal{F})$.
