import Mathlib

namespace ResearchLevel

variable {𝒳 : Type*}

def ShattersF (H : Set (𝒳 → Bool)) (S : Finset 𝒳) : Prop :=
  ∀ b : S → Bool, ∃ h ∈ H, ∀ x : S, h x.val = b x

noncomputable def VCDimF (H : Set (𝒳 → Bool)) : ℕ∞ :=
  ⨆ (S : Finset 𝒳) (_ : ShattersF H S), (S.card : ℕ∞)

def combinedClass {k : ℕ} (G : (Fin k → Bool) → Bool)
    (F : Fin k → Set (𝒳 → Bool)) : Set (𝒳 → Bool) :=
  { g | ∃ f : Fin k → (𝒳 → Bool), (∀ j, f j ∈ F j) ∧ ∀ x, g x = G (fun j => f j x) }

def robustLossClass (H : Set (𝒳 → Bool)) (ρ : 𝒳 → Finset 𝒳) :
    Set (𝒳 × Bool → Bool) :=
  { g | ∃ h ∈ H, ∀ xy : 𝒳 × Bool,
      g xy = (ρ xy.1).sup (fun z => decide (h z ≠ xy.2)) }

def GammaShatters (γ : ℝ) (F : Set (𝒳 → ℝ)) (S : Finset 𝒳) : Prop :=
  ∃ r : 𝒳 → ℝ, ∀ b : 𝒳 → Bool, ∃ f ∈ F, ∀ x ∈ S,
    (b x = true → f x ≥ r x + γ) ∧ (b x = false → f x ≤ r x - γ)

def GammaShattersZero (γ : ℝ) (F : Set (𝒳 → ℝ)) (S : Finset 𝒳) : Prop :=
  ∀ b : 𝒳 → Bool, ∃ f ∈ F, ∀ x ∈ S,
    (b x = true → f x ≥ γ) ∧ (b x = false → f x ≤ - γ)

noncomputable def fatDim (γ : ℝ) (F : Set (𝒳 → ℝ)) : ℕ∞ :=
  ⨆ (S : Finset 𝒳) (_ : GammaShatters γ F S), (S.card : ℕ∞)

noncomputable def fatDimZero (γ : ℝ) (F : Set (𝒳 → ℝ)) : ℕ∞ :=
  ⨆ (S : Finset 𝒳) (_ : GammaShattersZero γ F S), (S.card : ℕ∞)

def shiftClass (F : Set (𝒳 → ℝ)) (r : 𝒳 → ℝ) : Set (𝒳 → ℝ) :=
  { g | ∃ f ∈ F, g = fun x => f x - r x }

private lemma gammaShatters_mono {γ : ℝ} {F : Set (𝒳 → ℝ)}
    {S T : Finset 𝒳} (hT : GammaShatters γ F T) (hST : S ⊆ T) :
    GammaShatters γ F S := by
  rcases hT with ⟨r, hr⟩
  refine ⟨r, fun b => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfb⟩ := hr b
  exact ⟨f, hf, fun x hx => hfb x (hST hx)⟩

private lemma gammaShattersZero_shift_iff {γ : ℝ} {F : Set (𝒳 → ℝ)}
    {S : Finset 𝒳} (r : 𝒳 → ℝ) :
    GammaShattersZero γ (shiftClass F r) S ↔
      ∀ b : 𝒳 → Bool, ∃ f ∈ F, ∀ x ∈ S,
        (b x = true → f x ≥ r x + γ) ∧
        (b x = false → f x ≤ r x - γ) := by
  constructor
  · intro h b
    obtain ⟨g, ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩, hgb⟩ := h b
    refine ⟨f, hf, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    have hx' := hgb x hx
    constructor
    · intro hb
      have hx'' := hx'.1 hb
      dsimp only at hx''
      linarith
    · intro hb
      have hx'' := hx'.2 hb
      dsimp only at hx''
      linarith
  · intro h b
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hfb⟩ := h b
    refine ⟨fun x => f x - r x, ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    have hx' := hfb x hx
    constructor
    · intro hb
      have hx'' := hx'.1 hb
      dsimp only
      linarith
    · intro hb
      have hx'' := hx'.2 hb
      dsimp only
      linarith

private lemma fatDimZero_shift_le {γ : ℝ} (F : Set (𝒳 → ℝ)) (r : 𝒳 → ℝ) :
    fatDimZero γ (shiftClass F r) ≤ fatDim γ F := by
  rw [fatDimZero, fatDim]
  refine iSup_le fun S => iSup_le fun hS => ?_
  have hS' : GammaShatters γ F S :=
    ⟨r, (gammaShattersZero_shift_iff r).mp hS⟩
  exact le_iSup_of_le S (le_iSup_of_le hS' (le_refl _))

private lemma exists_shift_of_fatDim_ne_top {γ : ℝ} (F : Set (𝒳 → ℝ))
    (hfin : fatDim γ F ≠ ⊤) :
    ∃ r : 𝒳 → ℝ, fatDimZero γ (shiftClass F r) = fatDim γ F := by
  classical
  let I := {S : Finset 𝒳 // GammaShatters γ F S}
  have hrewrite : fatDim γ F = ⨆ i : I, (i.1.card : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [fatDim, iSup_subtype']
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty I with
  | inl hempty =>
      let r : 𝒳 → ℝ := fun _ => 0
      have hdim : fatDim γ F = 0 := by
        rw [hrewrite]
        apply le_antisymm
        · refine iSup_le fun i => ?_
          exact isEmptyElim i
        · exact bot_le
      refine ⟨r, le_antisymm (fatDimZero_shift_le F r) ?_⟩
      rw [hdim]
      exact bot_le
  | inr hnonempty =>
      have hlt : (⨆ i : I, (i.1.card : ℕ∞)) < ⊤ := by
        rw [← hrewrite]
        exact lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr hfin
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := ENat.exists_eq_iSup_of_lt_top hlt
      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := i.2
      have hi0 : GammaShattersZero γ (shiftClass F r) i.1 :=
        (gammaShattersZero_shift_iff r).mpr hr
      refine ⟨r, le_antisymm (fatDimZero_shift_le F r) ?_⟩
      rw [hrewrite, ← hi]
      exact le_iSup_of_le i.1 (le_iSup_of_le hi0 (le_refl _))

private lemma exists_disjoint_gammaShattered_of_top {γ : ℝ}
    (F : Set (𝒳 → ℝ)) (hinf : fatDim γ F = ⊤)
    (U : Finset 𝒳) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ S : Finset 𝒳,
      GammaShatters γ F S ∧ Disjoint S U ∧ S.card = n := by
  classical
  have hlt : (↑(U.card + n) : ℕ∞) < fatDim γ F := by
    rw [hinf]
    exact ENat.coe_lt_top _
  rw [fatDim, lt_iSup_iff] at hlt
  obtain ⟨T, hlt⟩ := hlt
  rw [lt_iSup_iff] at hlt
  obtain ⟨hT, hcard⟩ := hlt
  have hcard' : U.card + n < T.card := ENat.coe_lt_coe.mp hcard
  have hinter : (U ∩ T).card ≤ U.card :=
    Finset.card_le_card Finset.inter_subset_left
  have hdiff : n ≤ (T \ U).card := by
    rw [Finset.card_sdiff]
    omega
  obtain ⟨S, hST, hScard⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq hdiff
  refine ⟨S, gammaShatters_mono hT (hST.trans Finset.sdiff_subset), ?_, hScard⟩
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxS hxU
  exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp (hST hxS)).2 hxU

private lemma exists_shift_of_fatDim_eq_top {γ : ℝ} (F : Set (𝒳 → ℝ))
    (hinf : fatDim γ F = ⊤) :
    ∃ r : 𝒳 → ℝ, fatDimZero γ (shiftClass F r) = fatDim γ F := by
  classical
  let pick (U : Finset 𝒳) (n : ℕ) : Finset 𝒳 :=
    Classical.choose (exists_disjoint_gammaShattered_of_top F hinf U n)
  have hpick (U : Finset 𝒳) (n : ℕ) :
      GammaShatters γ F (pick U n) ∧
        Disjoint (pick U n) U ∧ (pick U n).card = n :=
    Classical.choose_spec (exists_disjoint_gammaShattered_of_top F hinf U n)
  let A : ℕ → Finset 𝒳 := fun n =>
    Nat.rec ∅ (fun m U => U ∪ pick U (m + 1)) n
  let B : ℕ → Finset 𝒳 := fun n => pick (A n) (n + 1)
  have hA_succ (n : ℕ) : A (n + 1) = A n ∪ B n := by
    simp only [A, B, Nat.rec_add_one]
  have hB (n : ℕ) :
      GammaShatters γ F (B n) ∧
        Disjoint (B n) (A n) ∧ (B n).card = n + 1 := by
    exact hpick (A n) (n + 1)
  have hA_step (n : ℕ) : A n ⊆ A (n + 1) := by
    rw [hA_succ]
    exact Finset.subset_union_left
  have hA_mono : Monotone A := monotone_nat_of_le_succ hA_step
  have hB_subset_A {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m < n) : B m ⊆ A n := by
    have hm : B m ⊆ A (m + 1) := by
      rw [hA_succ]
      exact Finset.subset_union_right
    exact hm.trans (hA_mono (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hmn))
  have hB_pairwise : Pairwise fun m n => Disjoint (B m) (B n) := by
    intro m n hmn
    rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hmn with hlt | hgt
    · exact (Finset.disjoint_of_subset_right (hB_subset_A hlt) (hB n).2.1).symm
    · exact Finset.disjoint_of_subset_right (hB_subset_A hgt) (hB m).2.1
  let q : ℕ → 𝒳 → ℝ := fun n => Classical.choose (hB n).1
  have hq (n : ℕ) :
      ∀ b : 𝒳 → Bool, ∃ f ∈ F, ∀ x ∈ B n,
        (b x = true → f x ≥ q n x + γ) ∧
        (b x = false → f x ≤ q n x - γ) :=
    Classical.choose_spec (hB n).1
  let idx : 𝒳 → ℕ := fun x =>
    if hx : ∃ n, x ∈ B n then Nat.find hx else 0
  have hidx (n : ℕ) {x : 𝒳} (hx : x ∈ B n) : idx x = n := by
    have hex : ∃ m, x ∈ B m := ⟨n, hx⟩
    have hmem : x ∈ B (Nat.find hex) := Nat.find_spec hex
    have heq : Nat.find hex = n := by
      by_contra hne
      exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hB_pairwise hne)) hmem hx
    simpa only [idx, dif_pos hex] using heq
  let r : 𝒳 → ℝ := fun x => q (idx x) x
  have hzero (n : ℕ) :
      GammaShattersZero γ (shiftClass F r) (B n) := by
    apply (gammaShattersZero_shift_iff r).mpr
    intro b
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hfb⟩ := hq n b
    refine ⟨f, hf, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    simpa only [r, hidx n hx] using hfb x hx
  have hztop : fatDimZero γ (shiftClass F r) = ⊤ := by
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hne
    have hle : (↑((B m).card) : ℕ∞) ≤
        fatDimZero γ (shiftClass F r) :=
      le_iSup_of_le (B m) (le_iSup_of_le (hzero m) (le_refl _))
    rw [(hB m).2.2, ← hm] at hle
    have hbad : m + 1 ≤ m := ENat.coe_le_coe.mp hle
    omega
  exact ⟨r, hztop.trans hinf.symm⟩

private noncomputable def boolTrace (H : Set (𝒳 → Bool)) (S : Finset 𝒳) :
    Finset (Finset S) := by
  classical
  exact Finset.univ.filter fun T =>
    ∃ h ∈ H, ∀ x : S, (x ∈ T ↔ h x.1 = true)

private lemma mem_boolTrace (H : Set (𝒳 → Bool)) (S : Finset 𝒳) (T : Finset S) :
    T ∈ boolTrace H S ↔ ∃ h ∈ H, ∀ x : S, (x ∈ T ↔ h x.1 = true) := by
  classical
  simp [boolTrace]

private lemma shattersF_of_trace_shatters [DecidableEq 𝒳]
    (H : Set (𝒳 → Bool)) (S : Finset 𝒳)
    (T : Finset S) (hT : (boolTrace H S).Shatters T) :
    ShattersF H (T.map ⟨Subtype.val, Subtype.val_injective⟩) := by
  classical
  intro b
  let c : S → Bool := fun x =>
    if hx : x ∈ T then
      b ⟨x.1, Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩⟩
    else false
  let P : Finset S := T.filter fun x => c x = true
  have hPT : P ⊆ T := Finset.filter_subset _ _
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hinter⟩ := hT hPT
  obtain ⟨h, hh, hreal⟩ := (mem_boolTrace H S V).mp hV
  refine ⟨h, hh, fun y => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hxT, hxy⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp y.2
  let xu : ↥(T.map ⟨Subtype.val, Subtype.val_injective⟩) :=
    ⟨x.1, Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨x, hxT, rfl⟩⟩
  have hxuy : xu = y := Subtype.ext hxy
  subst y
  have hmem : x ∈ V ↔ c x = true := by
    have heq := congrArg (fun W : Finset S => x ∈ W) hinter
    apply iff_of_eq
    simpa only [Finset.mem_inter, hxT, true_and, P, Finset.mem_filter] using heq
  have hb : h x.1 = true ↔ b xu = true := by
    rw [← hreal x, hmem]
    simp only [c, dif_pos hxT]
    have harg :
        (⟨x.1, Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨x, hxT, rfl⟩⟩ :
          ↥(T.map ⟨Subtype.val, Subtype.val_injective⟩)) = xu := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rfl
    rw [harg]
  cases hhx : h x.1 <;> cases hbx : b xu <;> simp_all

private lemma trace_vcDim_le [DecidableEq 𝒳]
    (H : Set (𝒳 → Bool)) (S : Finset 𝒳) (d : ℕ)
    (hd : VCDimF H = (d : ℕ∞)) : (boolTrace H S).vcDim ≤ d := by
  unfold Finset.vcDim
  apply Finset.sup_le
  intro T hT
  have hsh := shattersF_of_trace_shatters H S T (Finset.mem_shatterer.mp hT)
  have hle :
      (↑((T.map ⟨Subtype.val, Subtype.val_injective⟩).card) : ℕ∞) ≤
        VCDimF H :=
    le_iSup_of_le (T.map ⟨Subtype.val, Subtype.val_injective⟩)
      (le_iSup_of_le hsh (le_refl _))
  rw [hd] at hle
  rw [Finset.card_map] at hle
  exact ENat.coe_le_coe.mp hle

private lemma sum_choose_le_exp (N d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdN : d ≤ N) :
    ((∑ i ∈ Finset.Iic d, N.choose i : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      (Real.exp 1 * (N : ℝ) / (d : ℝ)) ^ d := by
  have hdR : 0 < (d : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hN : 1 ≤ N := hd.trans hdN
  have hNR : 0 < (N : ℝ) := by positivity
  let x : ℝ := (d : ℝ) / (N : ℝ)
  have hx : 0 < x := div_pos hdR hNR
  have hxle : x ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hNR).2 (by exact_mod_cast hdN)
  have hfirst :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.Iic d, (N.choose i : ℝ)) ≤
        x⁻¹ ^ d * ∑ i ∈ Finset.Iic d, (N.choose i : ℝ) * x ^ i := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i hi
    have hid : i ≤ d := Finset.mem_Iic.mp hi
    have hpow : x ^ d ≤ x ^ i :=
      pow_le_pow_of_le_one hx.le hxle hid
    have hone : 1 ≤ x⁻¹ ^ d * x ^ i := by
      calc
        1 = x⁻¹ ^ d * x ^ d := by
          rw [← mul_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ hx.ne']
          simp
        _ ≤ x⁻¹ ^ d * x ^ i :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow (by positivity)
    calc
      (N.choose i : ℝ) = 1 * (N.choose i : ℝ) := by ring
      _ ≤ (x⁻¹ ^ d * x ^ i) * (N.choose i : ℝ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hone (by positivity)
      _ = x⁻¹ ^ d * ((N.choose i : ℝ) * x ^ i) := by ring
  have hsubset : Finset.Iic d ⊆ Finset.range (N + 1) := by
    intro i hi
    rw [Finset.mem_range]
    exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le ((Finset.mem_Iic.mp hi).trans hdN)
  have hsecond :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.Iic d, (N.choose i : ℝ) * x ^ i) ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (N.choose i : ℝ) * x ^ i := by
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsubset (by
      intro i hi hit
      positivity)
  have hbinom :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (N.choose i : ℝ) * x ^ i) =
        (x + 1) ^ N := by
    simpa [mul_comm] using (add_pow x 1 N).symm
  have hexp : (x + 1) ^ N ≤ Real.exp (N * x) := by
    calc
      (x + 1) ^ N ≤ (Real.exp x) ^ N :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith [hx]) (Real.add_one_le_exp x) N
      _ = Real.exp (N * x) := (Real.exp_nat_mul x N).symm
  rw [Nat.cast_sum]
  calc
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.Iic d, (N.choose i : ℝ))
        ≤ x⁻¹ ^ d * ∑ i ∈ Finset.Iic d, (N.choose i : ℝ) * x ^ i := hfirst
    _ ≤ x⁻¹ ^ d * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (N.choose i : ℝ) * x ^ i := by
      gcongr
    _ = x⁻¹ ^ d * (x + 1) ^ N := by rw [hbinom]
    _ ≤ x⁻¹ ^ d * Real.exp (N * x) := by gcongr
    _ = (Real.exp 1 * (N : ℝ) / (d : ℝ)) ^ d := by
      have hNx : (N : ℝ) * x = d := by
        dsimp [x]
        field_simp
      rw [hNx, ← Real.exp_one_pow]
      rw [← mul_pow]
      congr 1
      dsimp [x]
      field_simp

private lemma growth_lt_two_pow (k m s : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hs : 1 ≤ s)
    (hlarge : 2 * Real.logb 2 (3 * (k : ℝ)) * (s : ℝ) < (m : ℝ)) :
    (Real.exp 1 * ((k * m : ℕ) : ℝ) / (s : ℝ)) ^ s < (2 : ℝ) ^ m := by
  have hkR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hkpos : (0 : ℝ) < k := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hkR
  have hsR : (0 : ℝ) < s := by positivity
  have hlog2 : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have h3k : 0 < (3 : ℝ) * k := mul_pos (by norm_num) hkpos
  let L : ℝ := Real.logb 2 (3 * (k : ℝ))
  have hL : 0 < L := by
    dsimp [L, Real.logb]
    exact div_pos (Real.log_pos (by nlinarith)) hlog2
  let a0 : ℝ := 2 * L
  let a : ℝ := (m : ℝ) / (s : ℝ)
  have ha : a0 < a := by
    apply (lt_div_iff₀ hsR).2
    simpa only [a0, a] using hlarge
  have ha0 : 0 < a0 := by dsimp [a0]; positivity
  have ha_pos : 0 < a := ha0.trans ha
  have hpowL : (2 : ℝ) ^ L = 3 * (k : ℝ) := by
    exact Real.rpow_logb (by norm_num) (by norm_num) h3k
  have hpow_a0 : (2 : ℝ) ^ a0 = (3 * (k : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by
    rw [show a0 = L + L by simp [a0]; ring, Real.rpow_add (by norm_num), hpowL]
    ring
  have helog : Real.exp 1 * Real.log (3 * (k : ℝ)) ≤ 3 * (k : ℝ) := by
    have h := Real.exp_one_mul_le_exp (x := Real.log (3 * (k : ℝ)))
    rwa [Real.exp_log h3k] at h
  have hlog2lower : (2 : ℝ) / 3 < Real.log 2 := by
    nlinarith [Real.log_two_gt_d9]
  have hbase_num : Real.exp 1 * (k : ℝ) * a0 < (3 * (k : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by
    have hleft :
        2 * (k : ℝ) * (Real.exp 1 * Real.log (3 * (k : ℝ))) ≤
          2 * (k : ℝ) * (3 * (k : ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left helog (by positivity)
    have hright :
        6 * (k : ℝ) ^ 2 < 9 * (k : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log 2 := by
      have hk2 : 0 < 9 * (k : ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
      nlinarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hlog2lower hk2]
    have hdiv :
        (2 * Real.exp 1 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log (3 * (k : ℝ))) /
            Real.log 2 < 9 * (k : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      apply (div_lt_iff₀ hlog2).2
      nlinarith
    dsimp [a0, L, Real.logb]
    convert hdiv using 1 <;> ring
  have hbase : Real.exp 1 * (k : ℝ) * a0 < (2 : ℝ) ^ a0 := by
    rwa [hpow_a0]
  let t : ℝ := a / a0
  have ht : 1 < t := (lt_div_iff₀ ha0).2 (by simpa [t] using ha)
  have htpos : 0 < t := zero_lt_one.trans ht
  have ha0log : 1 ≤ a0 * Real.log 2 := by
    have hlogmono : Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log (3 * (k : ℝ)) := by
      apply Real.log_le_log (by norm_num)
      nlinarith
    have htwo : 1 < 2 * Real.log 2 := by
      nlinarith [Real.log_two_gt_d9]
    dsimp [a0, L, Real.logb]
    field_simp
    nlinarith
  have hlogt : Real.log t < a0 * Real.log 2 * (t - 1) := by
    have h₁ := Real.log_lt_sub_one_of_pos htpos ht.ne'
    have h₂ : t - 1 ≤ a0 * Real.log 2 * (t - 1) :=
      (le_mul_iff_one_le_left (by linarith)).2 ha0log
    exact h₁.trans_le h₂
  have ht_rpow : t < (2 : ℝ) ^ (a - a0) := by
    calc
      t = Real.exp (Real.log t) := (Real.exp_log htpos).symm
      _ < Real.exp (a0 * Real.log 2 * (t - 1)) := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr hlogt
      _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (a - a0) := by
        rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by norm_num)]
        congr 1
        dsimp [t]
        field_simp
  have hmain : Real.exp 1 * (k : ℝ) * a < (2 : ℝ) ^ a := by
    have ha_eq : a = a0 * t := by
      dsimp [t]
      field_simp
    rw [ha_eq]
    calc
      Real.exp 1 * (k : ℝ) * (a0 * t) =
          (Real.exp 1 * (k : ℝ) * a0) * t := by ring
      _ < (2 : ℝ) ^ a0 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (a - a0) :=
        mul_lt_mul hbase ht_rpow.le htpos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _).le
      _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (a0 + (a - a0)) :=
        (Real.rpow_add (by norm_num) _ _).symm
      _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (a0 * t) := by rw [← ha_eq]; ring
  have hbase_eq :
      Real.exp 1 * (((k * m : ℕ) : ℝ)) / (s : ℝ) =
        Real.exp 1 * (k : ℝ) * a := by
    dsimp [a]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [hbase_eq]
  have hp := pow_lt_pow_left₀ hmain (by positivity) (by omega : s ≠ 0)
  calc
    (Real.exp 1 * (k : ℝ) * a) ^ s < ((2 : ℝ) ^ a) ^ s := hp
    _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (a * (s : ℝ)) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast]
    _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ m := by
      rw [show a * (s : ℝ) = (m : ℝ) by dsimp [a]; field_simp]
      exact Real.rpow_natCast 2 m

private lemma labels_le_prod_trace {k : ℕ}
    (G : (Fin k → Bool) → Bool) (F : Fin k → Set (𝒳 → Bool))
    (S : Finset 𝒳) (hS : ShattersF (combinedClass G F) S) :
    2 ^ S.card ≤ ∏ j, (boolTrace (F j) S).card := by
  classical
  let P := (j : Fin k) → ↥(boolTrace (F j) S)
  have hex (b : S → Bool) :
      ∃ p : P, ∀ x : S,
        b x = G (fun j => decide (x ∈ (p j).1)) := by
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hgb⟩ := hS b
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hgf⟩ := hg
    let p : P := fun j =>
      ⟨Finset.univ.filter fun x : S => f j x.1 = true,
        (mem_boolTrace (F j) S _).mpr ⟨f j, hf j, by simp⟩⟩
    refine ⟨p, fun x => ?_⟩
    rw [← hgb x, hgf x]
    congr 2
    funext j
    dsimp [p]
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    cases hfx : f j x.1 <;> simp_all
  let φ : (S → Bool) → P := fun b => Classical.choose (hex b)
  have hφ (b : S → Bool) :
      ∀ x : S, b x = G (fun j => decide (x ∈ (φ b j).1)) :=
    Classical.choose_spec (hex b)
  have hφinj : Function.Injective φ := by
    intro b c hbc
    funext x
    rw [hφ b x, hφ c x, hbc]
  have hc := Fintype.card_le_of_injective φ hφinj
  simpa only [P, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_bool, Fintype.card_coe,
    Fintype.card_pi] using hc

private lemma prod_shatterer_le_sum_choose [DecidableEq 𝒳] {k : ℕ}
    (F : Fin k → Set (𝒳 → Bool)) (d : Fin k → ℕ)
    (hd : ∀ j, VCDimF (F j) = (d j : ℕ∞)) (S : Finset 𝒳) :
    (∏ j, (boolTrace (F j) S).shatterer.card) ≤
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.Iic (∑ j, d j), (k * S.card).choose i := by
  classical
  let A : Fin k → Finset (Finset S) := fun j => (boolTrace (F j) S).shatterer
  let P := (j : Fin k) → ↥(A j)
  let tag : P → Finset ((j : Fin k) × S) := fun p =>
    Finset.univ.sigma fun j => (p j).1
  have htag_inj : Function.Injective tag := by
    intro p q hpq
    funext j
    apply Subtype.ext
    ext x
    have hx := congrArg (fun W : Finset ((j : Fin k) × S) => Sigma.mk j x ∈ W) hpq
    apply iff_of_eq
    simpa only [tag, Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] using hx
  let J : Finset (Finset ((j : Fin k) × S)) := Finset.univ.image tag
  have hJcard : J.card = ∏ j, (A j).card := by
    calc
      J.card = (Finset.univ : Finset P).card := by
        exact Finset.card_image_of_injective _ htag_inj
      _ = Fintype.card P := Finset.card_univ
      _ = ∏ j, (A j).card := by simp only [P, Fintype.card_pi, Fintype.card_coe]
  have htag_card (p : P) : (tag p).card = ∑ j, ((p j).1.card) := by
    simp [tag]
  have hJmem (T : Finset ((j : Fin k) × S)) (hT : T ∈ J) :
      T.card ≤ ∑ j, d j := by
    simp only [J, Finset.mem_image] at hT
    obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hT
    rw [htag_card]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro j hj
    exact (Finset.mem_shatterer.mp (p j).2).card_le_vcDim.trans
      (trace_vcDim_le (F j) S (d j) (hd j))
  have hJvc : J.vcDim ≤ ∑ j, d j := by
    unfold Finset.vcDim
    apply Finset.sup_le
    intro T hT
    obtain ⟨U, hUJ, hTU⟩ := (Finset.mem_shatterer.mp hT).exists_superset
    exact (Finset.card_le_card hTU).trans (hJmem U hUJ)
  calc
    (∏ j, (boolTrace (F j) S).shatterer.card) = J.card := by
      rw [hJcard]
    _ ≤ J.shatterer.card := Finset.card_le_card_shatterer J
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Iic J.vcDim,
        (Fintype.card ((j : Fin k) × S)).choose i :=
      Finset.card_shatterer_le_sum_vcDim
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Iic (∑ j, d j),
        (Fintype.card ((j : Fin k) × S)).choose i := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset (Finset.Iic_subset_Iic.mpr hJvc)
    _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.Iic (∑ j, d j), (k * S.card).choose i := by
      simp [Fintype.card_sigma]

private lemma combined_shattered_card_count {k : ℕ}
    (G : (Fin k → Bool) → Bool) (F : Fin k → Set (𝒳 → Bool))
    (d : Fin k → ℕ) (hd : ∀ j, VCDimF (F j) = (d j : ℕ∞))
    (S : Finset 𝒳) (hS : ShattersF (combinedClass G F) S) :
    2 ^ S.card ≤
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.Iic (∑ j, d j), (k * S.card).choose i := by
  classical
  calc
    2 ^ S.card ≤ ∏ j, (boolTrace (F j) S).card :=
      labels_le_prod_trace G F S hS
    _ ≤ ∏ j, (boolTrace (F j) S).shatterer.card := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod
      · intro j hj
        exact Nat.zero_le _
      · intro j hj
        exact Finset.card_le_card_shatterer _
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Iic (∑ j, d j), (k * S.card).choose i :=
      prod_shatterer_le_sum_choose F d hd S

private lemma card_real_le_of_two_pow_le_sum_choose (k m s : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hcount : 2 ^ m ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Iic s, (k * m).choose i) :
    (m : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.logb 2 (3 * (k : ℝ)) * (s : ℝ) := by
  by_cases hs0 : s = 0
  · subst s
    have hm0 : m = 0 := by
      by_contra hm
      have hmpos : 0 < m := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hm
      have htwo : 2 ≤ 2 ^ m := Nat.le_pow hmpos
      have hiic : Finset.Iic (0 : ℕ) = {0} := by
        ext i
        simp
      rw [hiic] at hcount
      simp only [Finset.sum_singleton, Nat.choose_zero_right] at hcount
      omega
    subst m
    norm_num
  have hs : 1 ≤ s := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hs0
  have hkpos : 0 < k := lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hk
  have hmkm : m ≤ k * m := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left m hkpos
  have hlogb : 1 ≤ Real.logb 2 (3 * (k : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      1 = Real.logb 2 2 := (Real.logb_self_eq_one (by norm_num)).symm
      _ ≤ Real.logb 2 (3 * (k : ℝ)) := by
        apply Real.logb_le_logb_of_le (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
        have hkR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk
        nlinarith
  by_cases hskm : s ≤ k * m
  · have hbinom := sum_choose_le_exp (k * m) s hs hskm
    have hp : (2 : ℝ) ^ m ≤
        ((∑ i ∈ Finset.Iic s, (k * m).choose i : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hcount
    have hp' : (2 : ℝ) ^ m ≤
        (Real.exp 1 * ((k * m : ℕ) : ℝ) / (s : ℝ)) ^ s :=
      hp.trans hbinom
    by_contra hnot
    have hlarge :
        2 * Real.logb 2 (3 * (k : ℝ)) * (s : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) :=
      lt_of_not_ge hnot
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hp') (growth_lt_two_pow k m s hk hs hlarge)
  · have hms : m < s := hmkm.trans_lt (lt_of_not_ge hskm)
    have hC : 1 ≤ 2 * Real.logb 2 (3 * (k : ℝ)) := by nlinarith
    have hmsR : (m : ℝ) ≤ (s : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hms.le
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hC) (Nat.cast_nonneg s)]

private lemma combined_shattered_card_real_le {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (G : (Fin k → Bool) → Bool) (F : Fin k → Set (𝒳 → Bool))
    (d : Fin k → ℕ) (hd : ∀ j, VCDimF (F j) = (d j : ℕ∞))
    (S : Finset 𝒳) (hS : ShattersF (combinedClass G F) S) :
    (S.card : ℝ) ≤
      2 * (k : ℝ) * Real.logb 2 (3 * k) * ((∑ j, (d j : ℝ)) / k) := by
  have hsimple : (S.card : ℝ) ≤
      2 * Real.logb 2 (3 * (k : ℝ)) * ((∑ j, d j : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
    card_real_le_of_two_pow_le_sum_choose k S.card (∑ j, d j) hk
      (combined_shattered_card_count G F d hd S hS)
  have hkR : (k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  rw [Nat.cast_sum] at hsimple
  convert hsimple using 1 <;> field_simp <;> ring

theorem lemma16 {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (G : (Fin k → Bool) → Bool)
    (F : Fin k → Set (𝒳 → Bool)) (d : Fin k → ℕ)
    (hd : ∀ j, VCDimF (F j) = (d j : ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ D : ℕ, VCDimF (combinedClass G F) = (D : ℕ∞) ∧
      (D : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (k : ℝ) * Real.logb 2 (3 * k) * ((∑ j, (d j : ℝ)) / k) := by
  classical
  let B : ℝ :=
    2 * (k : ℝ) * Real.logb 2 (3 * k) * ((∑ j, (d j : ℝ)) / k)
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := by
    have hkone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk
    have hkR : (0 : ℝ) < k := by positivity
    have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.logb 2 (3 * (k : ℝ)) := by
      exact Real.logb_nonneg (by norm_num) (by nlinarith)
    dsimp [B]
    positivity
  have hcard (S : Finset 𝒳) (hS : ShattersF (combinedClass G F) S) :
      (S.card : ℝ) ≤ B := by
    exact combined_shattered_card_real_le hk G F d hd S hS
  have hdimle : VCDimF (combinedClass G F) ≤ (⌈B⌉₊ : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [VCDimF]
    refine iSup_le fun S => iSup_le fun hS => ?_
    apply ENat.coe_le_coe.mpr
    exact_mod_cast (hcard S hS).trans (Nat.le_ceil B)
  have hfin : VCDimF (combinedClass G F) ≠ ⊤ :=
    (hdimle.trans_lt (ENat.coe_lt_top _)).ne
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hfin
  let I := {S : Finset 𝒳 // ShattersF (combinedClass G F) S}
  have hrewrite : VCDimF (combinedClass G F) =
      ⨆ i : I, (i.1.card : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [VCDimF, iSup_subtype']
  refine ⟨D, hD.symm, ?_⟩
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty I with
  | inl hempty =>
      have hdim0 : VCDimF (combinedClass G F) = 0 := by
        rw [hrewrite]
        apply le_antisymm
        · refine iSup_le fun i => isEmptyElim i
        · exact bot_le
      have hD0 : D = 0 := by
        apply ENat.coe_inj.mp
        simpa using hD.trans hdim0
      rw [hD0]
      norm_num
      simpa only [B] using hB
  | inr hnonempty =>
      have hlt : (⨆ i : I, (i.1.card : ℕ∞)) < ⊤ := by
        rw [← hrewrite]
        exact lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr hfin
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := ENat.exists_eq_iSup_of_lt_top hlt
      have hDi : D = i.1.card := by
        apply ENat.coe_inj.mp
        rw [hD, hrewrite, ← hi]
      rw [hDi]
      exact hcard i.1 i.2

private lemma robust_labels_le_trace [DecidableEq 𝒳]
    (H : Set (𝒳 → Bool)) (ρ : 𝒳 → Finset 𝒳)
    (S : Finset (𝒳 × Bool)) (hS : ShattersF (robustLossClass H ρ) S) :
    let Z := S.biUnion fun xy => ρ xy.1
    2 ^ S.card ≤ (boolTrace H Z).card := by
  classical
  let Z : Finset 𝒳 := S.biUnion fun xy => ρ xy.1
  let P := ↥(boolTrace H Z)
  let recon : P → 𝒳 → Bool := fun p z =>
    if hz : z ∈ Z then decide (⟨z, hz⟩ ∈ p.1) else false
  have hex (b : S → Bool) :
      ∃ p : P, ∀ xy : S,
        b xy = (ρ xy.1.1).sup (fun z => decide (recon p z ≠ xy.1.2)) := by
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hgb⟩ := hS b
    obtain ⟨h, hh, hgdef⟩ := hg
    let p : P :=
      ⟨Finset.univ.filter fun z : Z => h z.1 = true,
        (mem_boolTrace H Z _).mpr ⟨h, hh, by simp⟩⟩
    refine ⟨p, fun xy => ?_⟩
    rw [← hgb xy, hgdef xy.1]
    apply Finset.sup_congr rfl
    intro z hz
    have hzZ : z ∈ Z := Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨xy.1, xy.2, hz⟩
    have hr : recon p z = h z := by
      dsimp [recon, p]
      simp only [dif_pos hzZ, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      cases hhz : h z <;> simp_all
    rw [hr]
  let φ : (S → Bool) → P := fun b => Classical.choose (hex b)
  have hφ (b : S → Bool) :
      ∀ xy : S,
        b xy = (ρ xy.1.1).sup (fun z => decide (recon (φ b) z ≠ xy.1.2)) :=
    Classical.choose_spec (hex b)
  have hφinj : Function.Injective φ := by
    intro b c hbc
    funext xy
    rw [hφ b xy, hφ c xy, hbc]
  have hc := Fintype.card_le_of_injective φ hφinj
  simpa only [P, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_bool, Fintype.card_coe] using hc

private lemma robust_shattered_card_count [DecidableEq 𝒳]
    (k d : ℕ) (H : Set (𝒳 → Bool)) (ρ : 𝒳 → Finset 𝒳)
    (hρ : ∀ x, (ρ x).card ≤ k) (hd : VCDimF H = (d : ℕ∞))
    (S : Finset (𝒳 × Bool)) (hS : ShattersF (robustLossClass H ρ) S) :
    2 ^ S.card ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Iic d, (k * S.card).choose i := by
  classical
  let Z : Finset 𝒳 := S.biUnion fun xy => ρ xy.1
  have hZ : Z.card ≤ k * S.card := by
    calc
      Z.card ≤ ∑ xy ∈ S, (ρ xy.1).card := Finset.card_biUnion_le
      _ ≤ ∑ xy ∈ S, k := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro xy hxy
        exact hρ xy.1
      _ = k * S.card := by simp [mul_comm]
  calc
    2 ^ S.card ≤ (boolTrace H Z).card := robust_labels_le_trace H ρ S hS
    _ ≤ (boolTrace H Z).shatterer.card := Finset.card_le_card_shatterer _
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Iic (boolTrace H Z).vcDim,
        (Fintype.card Z).choose i := Finset.card_shatterer_le_sum_vcDim
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Iic d, (Fintype.card Z).choose i := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset
        (Finset.Iic_subset_Iic.mpr (trace_vcDim_le H Z d hd))
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Iic d, (k * S.card).choose i := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i hi
      rw [Fintype.card_coe]
      exact Nat.choose_le_choose i hZ

private lemma two_logb_three_mul_le_ten_log (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    2 * Real.logb 2 (3 * (k : ℝ)) ≤ 10 * Real.log (k : ℝ) := by
  have hkR : (2 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hkpos : (0 : ℝ) < k := by positivity
  have hlogk : 0 < Real.log (k : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hlog2 : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hthree : Real.log 3 ≤ 2 * Real.log (k : ℝ) := by
    calc
      Real.log 3 ≤ Real.log ((k : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
        apply Real.log_le_log (by norm_num)
        nlinarith
      _ = 2 * Real.log (k : ℝ) := by rw [Real.log_pow]; norm_num
  have hmul : Real.log (3 * (k : ℝ)) ≤ 3 * Real.log (k : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hkpos.ne']
    linarith
  have hlog2lower : (3 : ℝ) / 5 ≤ Real.log 2 := by
    nlinarith [Real.log_two_gt_d9]
  dsimp [Real.logb]
  rw [show 2 * (Real.log (3 * (k : ℝ)) / Real.log 2) =
      (2 * Real.log (3 * (k : ℝ))) / Real.log 2 by ring]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hlog2).2
  have hleft : 2 * Real.log (3 * (k : ℝ)) ≤
      6 * Real.log (k : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hright : 6 * Real.log (k : ℝ) ≤
      10 * Real.log (k : ℝ) * Real.log 2 := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hlog2lower) hlogk.le]
  linarith

private lemma robust_shattered_card_real_le (k d : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (H : Set (𝒳 → Bool)) (ρ : 𝒳 → Finset 𝒳)
    (hρ : ∀ x, (ρ x).card ≤ k) (hd : VCDimF H = (d : ℕ∞))
    (S : Finset (𝒳 × Bool)) (hS : ShattersF (robustLossClass H ρ) S) :
    (S.card : ℝ) ≤ 10 * (d : ℝ) * Real.log (k : ℝ) := by
  classical
  have hbasic : (S.card : ℝ) ≤
      2 * Real.logb 2 (3 * (k : ℝ)) * (d : ℝ) :=
    card_real_le_of_two_pow_le_sum_choose k S.card d (hk.trans' (by omega))
      (robust_shattered_card_count k d H ρ hρ hd S hS)
  calc
    (S.card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.logb 2 (3 * (k : ℝ)) * (d : ℝ) := hbasic
    _ ≤ (10 * Real.log (k : ℝ)) * (d : ℝ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (two_logb_three_mul_le_ten_log k hk)
        (Nat.cast_nonneg d)
    _ = 10 * (d : ℝ) * Real.log (k : ℝ) := by ring

theorem lemma1 :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ (k d : ℕ) (H : Set (𝒳 → Bool)) (ρ : 𝒳 → Finset 𝒳),

  | inr hnonempty =>

targets.label: Theorem 1
targets.statement: Theorem 1 (Asymptotic Bias of the Posterior Mode of 1-Node BNN+LV) Fix any $W \in \mathbb{R}$ and any bounded prior $p_{W}(W)$ on W. Suppose that inputs $\{x_{1},\ldots,x_{N}\}$ are sampled i.i.d from $p_{x}$ with finite first and second moments (mean $\mu_{x}$ and variance $\sigma_{x}^{2}$ ) , and that $\{z_{1},\dots,z_{N}\}$ are sampled i.i.d from $\mathcal{N}(0,\sigma_{z}^{2})$ , where $\mu_{x}^{2}+ \sigma_{x}^{2}> \sigma_{z}^{2}$ . Suppose $p_{W}(W)>0$ . For every $C$ with $\frac{\sigma_{x}^{2}+ \mu_{x}^{2}- \sigma_{z}^{2}}{\sigma_{x}^{2}+ \mu_{x}^{2}+ \sigma_{z}^{2}}< C < 1$ such that $p_{W}(\widehat{W}^{(C)})>0$ , the probability that the scaled values $(\widehat{W}^{(C)},\{\widehat{z}_{n}^{(C)}\}_{n=1}^{N})$ are more likely than $\left(W,\{z_{n}\}_{n=1}^{N}\right)$ under the posterior approaches 1 as $N \to \infty$

targets.label: Theorem 2
targets.statement: Theorem 2 (Asymptotic Bias of the Posterior Mode of 1-Layer BNN+LV) Fix any set of parameters W and any bounded prior $p_{W}(W)$ on W with $p_{W}(W)>0$ . Suppose that $\{x_{1},\ldots,x_{N}\}$ is sampled i.i.d from $p_{x}$ , with finite first and second moments (the dth marginal having mean $\mu_{x_{d}}$ and variance $\sigma_{x_{d}}^{2}$ ), and that $\{z_{1},\dots,z_{N}\}$ are sampled i.i.d from $\mathcal{N}(0,\sigma_{z}^{2}\cdot I)$ . There exists an alternate set of parameters $\left(\widehat{W},\{\widehat{z}_{n}\}_{n=1}^{N}\right)$ with $p_{W}(\widehat{W})>0$ and $\widehat{z}_{n}= T z_{n}- T x_{n}$ , where $T=\mathrm{diag}(t)$ with $0 < | t_{d}| < \sqrt{\frac{\sigma_{z}^{2}}{\mu_{x_{d}}^{2}+ \sigma_{x_{d}}^{2}+ \sigma_{z}^{2}}}$ for every $d$ , such that the probability that these alternative parameters are valued as more likely than $\left(W,\{z_{n}\}_{n=1}^{N}\right)$ under the posterior approaches 1 as $N \to \infty$

targets.label: Concentration crux (Cantelli step, Appendix B.1/B.2)
targets.statement: Concentration crux of Theorems 1 and 2 (Appendix B.1/B.2, the step where Cantelli's inequality is applied), for the concrete per-sample log-prior-ratio average $R_N$. Throughout, $p_z$ is the Gaussian latent prior and $z$ is independent of $x$. (Theorem 1, 1-node model, Appendix B.1.) Suppose that inputs $x_1, x_2, \ldots$ are sampled i.i.d. from $p_x$ with finite first and second moments $\mu_x, \sigma_x^2$, and that $z_1, z_2, \ldots$ are sampled i.i.d. from $\mathcal{N}(0, \sigma_z^2)$, where $\mu_x^2 + \sigma_x^2 > \sigma_z^2$. Let $C$ satisfy $0 < \frac{\sigma_x^2 + \mu_x^2 - \sigma_z^2}{\sigma_x^2 + \mu_x^2 + \sigma_z^2} < C < 1$, let $\widehat{z}_n^{(C)} = (C-1)x_n + C z_n$, and let $R_N^{(C)} = \frac{1}{N} \sum_{n=1}^{N} \big(\log p_z(\widehat{z}_n^{(C)}) - \log p_z(z_n)\big)$. Then $\Pr[R_N^{(C)} > 0] \to 1$ as $N \to \infty$. (Theorem 2, 1-layer model, Appendix B.2.) Suppose that $x_1, x_2, \ldots \in \mathbb{R}^D$ are sampled i.i.d. from $p_x$ with finite first and second moments, the $d$th marginal of $x$ having mean $\mu_{x_d}$ and variance $\sigma_{x_d}^2$, and that $z_1, z_2, \ldots$ are sampled i.i.d. from $\mathcal{N}(0, \sigma_z^2 \cdot I)$. Let $T = \mathrm{diag}(t)$ with $0 < |t_d| < \sqrt{\frac{\sigma_z^2}{\mu_{x_d}^2 + \sigma_{x_d}^2 + \sigma_z^2}}$ for every $d$, let $\widehat{z}_n = T z_n - T x_n$, and let $R_N = \frac{1}{N} \sum_{n=1}^{N} \big(\log p_z(\widehat{z}_n) - \log p_z(z_n)\big)$. Then $\Pr[R_N > 0] \to 1$ as $N \to \infty$. (In the paper, the condition on $C$, resp. on $t_d$, is what makes $\mathbb{E}[R_N] > 0$, after which Cantelli's inequality gives $\Pr[R_N < 0] \to 0$.)

nl_proof:
### Proof of Theorem 1

We assume the model in Equation 15. We denote the prior on $W$ as $p_{W}$ and suppose that it is bounded, we denote the prior on $z$ as $p_{z}$ , and we suppose that $p_{x}$, the distribution over the input $x$, has bounded first and second moments $\mu_{x}$ and $\sigma_{x}^{2}.$ For any non-zero constant $0 < C < 1$ , we define

$$
\widehat W^{(C)}=W/C,~\widehat z_{n}^{(C)}=(C-1)x_{n}+Cz_{n},
$$

and we define $D_{N}^{(C)}$ to be the difference between the scaled parameters $(\widehat{W}^{(C)},\widehat{z}_{1}^{(C)},\dots\widehat{z}_{N}^{(C)})$ and the ground-truth parameters $(W,z_{1},\dots z_{N})$ under the joint posterior log $p(W,Z|\mathcal{D})$

For any set of parameters $(W,z_{1},\dots z_{N})$ , we show that we can find alternate parameters $(\widehat{W}^{(C)},\widehat{z}_{1}^{(C)},\ldots\widehat{z}_{N}^{(C)})$ , that are scored as more likely under the log-posterior log $p(W,\{z_{n}\}|\mathcal{D})$ To do this, we first show that the alternative parameters are scored as equally likely under the log-likelihood, and then we show that the alternate parameters are scored as more likely under the log-prior.

Since we have that

$$
\operatorname*{max}\left\{W^{\mathrm{true}}(x+z_{n}^{\mathrm{true}}),\alpha W^{\mathrm{true}}(x+z_{n}^{\mathrm{true}})\right\}=\operatorname*{max}\left\{\widehat{W}^{(C)}(x+\widehat{z}_{n}^{(C)}),\alpha\widehat{W}^{(C)}(x+\widehat{z}_{n}^{(C)})\right\},
$$

we see that the alternate parameters are as likely as the original parameters under the likelihood; that is,

$$
\prod_{n}p(y_{n}|x_{n},z_{n}^{\mathrm{true}},W^{\mathrm{true}})=\prod_{n}p\left(y_{n}|x_{n},\widehat{z}_{n}^{(C)},\widehat{W}^{(C)}\right).
$$

Since the likelihood under both sets of parameters is equal, the difference between the log-posterior, $D_{N}^{(C)}$ , is simply the difference of the two sets of parameters under the log-prior:

$$
D_{N}^{(C)}=\log p_{W}(\widehat{W}^{(C)})-\log p_{W}(W)+\sum_{n=1}^{N}\log p_{z}(\widehat{z}_{n}^{(C)})-\log p_{z}(z_{n}).
$$

We now show that as $N \to \infty$ , the probability that $(\widehat{W}^{(C)},\widehat{z}_{1}^{(C)},\dots\widehat{z}_{N}^{(C)})$ is valued higher than $(W,z_{1},\dots z_{N})$ in the posterior approaches 1. That is,

$$
\operatorname*{lim}_{N\to\infty}\operatorname*{Pr}\left[D_{N}^{(C)}>0\right]=\operatorname*{lim}_{N\to\infty}\mathbb{E}_{p_{x}p_{z}}\left[\mathbb{I}(D_{N}^{(C)}>0)\right]=1.
$$

Since we are only interested in the sign of $D_{N}^{(C)}$ , we demonstrate, equivalently, that

$$
\operatorname*{lim}_{N\to\infty}\mathbb{E}_{p_{x}p_{z}}[\mathbb{I}(\frac{1}{N}\cdot D_{N}^{(C)}>0)]=1 .
$$

Expanding $\frac{1}{N}\cdot D_{N}^{(C)}$ , we obtain

$$
\frac{1}{N}\cdot D_{N}^{(C)}=\underbrace{\frac{1}{N}\cdot\left(\log p_{W}(\widehat{W}^{(C)})-\log p_{W}(W)\right)}_{L_{N}^{(C)}}+\underbrace{\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}\log p_{z}(\widehat{z}_{n}^{(C)})-\log p_{z}(z_{n})}_{R_{N}^{(C)}}.
$$

We note that as $N \to \infty$ , the term $L_{N}^{(C)}$ approaches 0. Thus, it suffices to analyze the sign of $R_{N}^{(C)}$ ; that is, we compute $\mathrm{Pr}[R_{N}^{(C)}>0]$

Let $\mathbb{E}\left[R_{N}^{(C)}\right]$ and $\mathbb{V}\left[R_{N}^{(C)}\right]$ denote the mean and variance of the random variable $R_{N}^{(C)}$ We next show that $\mathbb{E}\left[R_{N}^{(C)}\right]$ is positive, allowing us to use Cantelli's Inequality to bound the probability that $R_{N}^{(C)}$ is negative under $p_{x}$ and $p_{z}$ as follows:

$$
\begin{array}{r l}&{\operatorname*{Pr}\left[R_{N}^{(C)}<0\right]=\operatorname*{Pr}\left[R_{N}^{(C)}-\mathbb{E}\left[R_{N}^{(C)}\right]< -\mathbb{E}\left[R_{N}^{(C)}\right]\right]}\\ &{\qquad=1-\operatorname*{Pr}\left[R_{N}^{(C)}-\mathbb{E}\left[R_{N}^{(C)}\right]\geq-\mathbb{E}\left[R_{N}^{(C)}\right]\right]}\\ &{\qquad\leq\frac{\mathbb{V}\left[R_{N}^{(C)}\right]}{\mathbb{V}\left[R_{N}^{(C)}\right]+\mathbb{E}\left[R_{N}^{(C)}\right]^{2}}.}\end{array}
$$

As $N \to \infty$ , we show that this upper bound on $\mathrm{Pr}\left[R_{N}^{(C)}<0\right]$ approaches 0.

We start by expanding $R_{N}^{(C)}$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}
R_{N}^{(C)}&=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}\log p_{z}(\widehat{z}_{n}^{(C)})-\log p_{z}(z_{n})\\
&= -\frac{1}{2\sigma_{z}^{2}}\cdot\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}(\widehat{z}_{n}^{(C)})^{2}-z_{n}^{2}\\
&=\frac{1}{2\sigma_{z}^{2}}\cdot\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}z_{n}^{2}-(\widehat{z}_{n}^{(C)})^{2}\\
2\sigma_{z}^{2}\cdot R_{N}^{(C)}&=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}z_{n}^{2}-(\widehat{z}_{n}^{(C)})^{2}\\
&=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}z_{n}^{2}-((C-1)x_{n}+Cz_{n})^{2}\\
&=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}(2C-C^{2}-1)\cdot x_{n}^{2}+(1-C^{2})\cdot z_{n}^{2}+(2C-2C^{2})\cdot x_{n}z_{n}\\
&=(2C-C^{2}-1)\cdot\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}x_{n}^{2}+(1-C^{2})\cdot\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}z_{n}^{2}+(2C-2C^{2})\cdot\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}x_{n}z_{n}
\end{aligned}
$$

The variance of $R_{N}^{(C)}$ can be computed as follows:

$$
\mathbb{V}\left[R_{N}^{(C)}\right]=\frac{\mathbb{V}\left[R_{1}^{(C)}\right]}{N}.
$$

Therefore, as N increases, the variance approaches 0 at a rate of $1 / N$

The mean of $R_{N}^{(C)}$ can be written as:

$$
\begin{array}{r l}&{2\sigma_{z}^{2}\cdot\mathbb{E}\left[R_{N}^{(C)}\right]=(2C-C^{2}-1)\cdot\mathbb{E}_{p_{x}}\left[x^{2}\right]+(1-C^{2})\cdot\mathbb{E}_{p_{z}}\left[z^{2}\right]+(2C-2C^{2})\cdot\mathbb{E}_{p_{x}p_{z}}\left[xz\right]}\\ &{\qquad=(2C-C^{2}-1)\cdot(\sigma_{x}^{2}+\mu_{x}^{2})+(1-C^{2})\cdot\sigma_{z}^{2}+(2C-2C^{2})\cdot\mu_{x}\cdot 0}\\ &{\qquad=(2C-C^{2}-1)\cdot(\sigma_{x}^{2}+\mu_{x}^{2})+(1-C^{2})\cdot\sigma_{z}^{2}}\end{array}
$$

Thus, the mean is positive when

$$
0<\frac{\sigma_{x}^{2}+\mu_{x}^{2}-\sigma_{z}^{2}}{\sigma_{x}^{2}+\mu_{x}^{2}+\sigma_{z}^{2}}<C<1,
$$

which is satisfied whenever $\sigma_{x}^{2}+ \mu_{x}^{2}> \sigma_{z}^{2}$

Now, by Cantelli's Inequality, we have that:

$$
\operatorname*{Pr}\left[R_{N}^{(C)}<0\right]\leq\frac{\mathbb{V}\left[R_{N}^{(C)}\right]}{\mathbb{V}\left[R_{N}^{(C)}\right]+\mathbb{E}\left[R_{N}^{(C)}\right]^{2}}=\frac{\mathbb{V}\left[R_{1}^{(C)}\right]}{\mathbb{V}\left[R_{1}^{(C)}\right]+N\cdot\mathbb{E}\left[R_{N}^{(C)}\right]^{2}},
$$

which shows that $\mathrm{Pr}\left[R_{N}^{(C)}<0\right]$ approaches 0 as $N \to \infty$

### Proof of Theorem 2

The proof follows in the same fashion as the one for Theorem 1. We assume the model in Equation 16. For a given $W$ ,let $\widehat{W}$ denote the set $\{\widehat{W}^{x},\widehat{W}^{z},W^{\mathrm{out}},\widehat{b}^{\mathrm{hidden}},b^{\mathrm{out}}\}$ , where

$$
\widehat{W}^{x}=W^{x}+W^{z}S,\widehat{W}^{z}=R,\widehat{z}=T z-T S x-U,\widehat{b}^{\mathrm{hidden}}=b+R U,
$$

for any choice of diagonal matrix $S \in \mathbb{R}^{D \times D}$ , vector $U \in \mathbb{R}^{D}$ , and any factorization $W^{z}= R T$ where $T \in \mathbb{R}^{D \times D}$

For any set of parameters $(W,z_{1},\dots z_{N})$ , we show that we can find alternate parameters $(\widehat{W},\widehat{z}_{1}\ldots\widehat{z}_{N})$ , that are scored as more likely under the log-posterior log $p(W,\{z_{n}\}|\mathcal{D})$ . We define $D_{N}$ to be the difference between the scaled parameters $(\widehat{W},\widehat{z}_{1},\ldots\widehat{z}_{N})$ and the ground-truth parameters $(W,z_{1},\dots z_{N})$ under the joint posterior log $p(W,Z|\mathcal{D})$ . Since $f(x_{n},z_{n};W)=$ $f(x_{n},{\widehat{z}}_{n};{\widehat{W}})$ by construction, the alternate parameters are equally as likely as the original parameters under the likelihood: $p(y_{n}|x_{n},z_{n},W)=p(y_{n}|x_{n},\widehat{z}_{n},\widehat{W})$ . As such, $D_{N}$ is simply the difference of the two sets of parameters under the log-prior:

$$
D_{N}=\log p_{W}(\widehat{W})-\log p_{W}(W)+\sum_{n=1}^{N}\log p_{z}(\widehat{z}_{n})-\log p_{z}(z_{n}).
$$

We now show that as $N \to \infty$ , the probability that $(\widehat{W},\widehat{z}_{1},\ldots\widehat{z}_{N})$ is valued higher than $(W,z_{1},\dots z_{N})$ in the posterior approaches 1. That is,

$$
\operatorname*{lim}_{N\to\infty}\operatorname*{Pr}\left[D_{N}>0\right]=\operatorname*{lim}_{N\to\infty}\mathbb{E}_{p_{x}p_{z}}\left[\mathbb{I}(D_{N}>0)\right]=1.
$$

Since we are only interested in the sign of $D_{N}$ , we demonstrate, equivalently, that

$$
\operatorname*{lim}_{N\to\infty}\mathbb{E}_{p_{x}p_{z}}[\mathbb{I}(\frac{1}{N}\cdot D_{N}>0)]=1 .
$$

Expanding $\frac{1}{N}\cdot D_{N}$ , we obtain

$$
\frac{1}{N}\cdot D_{N}=\underbrace{\frac{1}{N}\cdot\Big(\log p_{W}(\widehat{W})-\log p_{W}(W)\Big)}_{L_{N}}+\underbrace{\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}\log p_{z}(\widehat{z}_{n})-\log p_{z}(z_{n})}_{R_{N}}.
$$

We note that as $N \to \infty$ , the term $L_{N}$ approaches 0. Thus, it suffices to analyze the sign of $R_{N};$ that is, we compute $\mathrm{Pr}[R_{N}>0]$

Let diag(t) represent a diagonal matrix with diagonal elements $t_{1},\ldots,t_{D}$ . For simplicity, we set $U=0,S=I,R=W^{z}T^{-1}$ and $T=\mathrm{diag}(t)$ (where $t_{d}\neq 0)$ , giving us:

$$
\widehat{W}^{x}=W^{x}+W^{z},\quad\widehat{W}^{z}=W^{z}T^{-1},\quad\widehat{z}=T\cdot z-T\cdot x,\quad\widehat{b}^{\mathrm{hidden}}=b .
$$

Following the proof for Theorem 1, it suffices to show that the mean of $R_{N}$ is positive and that the its variance approaches 0 at a rate of $1 / N$ in order to prove that $\mathrm{Pr}\left[R_{N}<0\right]$ approaches 0 as $N \to \infty$

For this model, $R_{N}$ is defined as:

$$
\begin{array}{c l}{\displaystyle{R_{N}=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}\log p_{z}(\hat{z}_{n})-\log p_{z}(z_{n})}}\\ {\displaystyle{2\sigma_{z}^{2}\cdot R_{N}=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}z_{n}^{\top}z_{n}-(Tz_{n}-Tx_{n})^{\top}(Tz_{n}-Tx_{n})}}\\ {\displaystyle{=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}\sum_{d=1}^{D}-t_{d}^{2}\cdot x_{n,d}^{2}+2t_{d}^{2}\cdot x_{n,d}\cdot z_{n,d}-t_{d}^{2}z_{n,d}^{2}+z_{n,d}^{2}}}\\ {\displaystyle{=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}\sum_{d=1}^{D}-t_{d}^{2}\cdot x_{n,d}^{2}+2t_{d}^{2}\cdot x_{n,d}\cdot z_{n,d}+(1-t_{d}^{2})\cdot z_{n,d}^{2}}}\end{array}
$$

The mean of $R_{N}$ can be computed as follows:

$$
\begin{array}{l}{{\displaystyle\mathbb{E}\left[R_{N}\right]=\sum_{d=1}^{D}-t_{d}^{2}\cdot\mathbb{E}_{p_{x_{d}}}\left[x^{2}\right]+2t_{d}^{2}\cdot\mathbb{E}_{p_{x_{d}}}\left[x\right]\cdot\mathbb{E}_{p_{z_{d}}}\left[z\right]+\left(1-t_{d}^{2}\right)\cdot\mathbb{E}_{p_{z_{d}}}\left[z^{2}\right]}}\\ {~}\\ {{\displaystyle=\sum_{d=1}^{D}-t_{d}^{2}\cdot\mathbb{E}_{p_{x_{d}}}\left[x^{2}\right]+2t_{d}^{2}\cdot\mathbb{E}_{p_{x_{d}}}\left[x\right]\cdot 0+\left(1-t_{d}^{2}\right)\cdot\mathbb{E}_{p_{z_{d}}}\left[z^{2}\right]}}\\ {{\displaystyle~}}\\ {{\displaystyle=\sum_{d=1}^{D}-t_{d}^{2}\cdot\left(\mu_{x_{d}}^{2}+\sigma_{x_{d}}^{2}\right)+\left(1-t_{d}^{2}\right)\cdot\sigma_{z_{d}}^{2}}}\end{array}
$$

where $p_{x_{d}}, p_{z_{d}}$ are the dth marginals of $p_{x}, p_{z}$ , and $\mu_{x_{d}}, \sigma_{x_{d}}^{2}$ are the mean and variance of the dth marginal of x. As such, for any $t_{d}$ that satisfies the following conditions,

$$
0 < | t_{d}| < \sqrt{\frac{\sigma_{z}^{2}}{\mu_{x_{d}}^{2}+ \sigma_{x_{d}}^{2}+ \sigma_{z}^{2}}},
$$

$\mathbb{E}\left[ R_{N}\right]$ is positive. Just as in the proof for the 1-Node $\mathrm{B N N + L V}$ , the variance of $R_{N}$ can be computed as follows:

$$
\mathbb{V}\left[ R_{N}\right] = \frac{\mathbb{V}\left[ R_{1}\right]}{N}.
$$

Therefore, as N increases, the variance approaches 0 at a rate of $1 / N$ . Now, by Cantelli's Inequality, we have that:

$$
\operatorname*{Pr}\left[R_{N}<0\right]\leq\frac{\mathbb{V}\left[R_{N}\right]}{\mathbb{V}\left[R_{N}\right]+\mathbb{E}\left[R_{N}\right]^{2}}=\frac{\mathbb{V}\left[R_{1}\right]}{\mathbb{V}\left[R_{1}\right]+N\cdot\mathbb{E}\left[R_{N}\right]^{2}},
$$

which shows that $\mathrm{Pr}\left[R_{N}^{(C)}<0\right]$ approaches 0 as $N \to \infty$

context.name: Setup: data, BNN and BNN+LV model, joint posterior (Section 3, Eqs. 1-3)
context.statement:
Let $\mathcal{D}=\{(x_{1},y_{1}),...(x_{N},y_{N})\}$ be a data-set of N observations from the true data distribution $p(y|x)p(x)$ , in which each input $\boldsymbol{x}_{n}\in \mathbb{R}^{D}$ is a D-dimensional vector and each output $y_{n}\in \mathbb{R}^{L}$ is L-dimensional. Let I denote the identity matrix and let capital letters denote sets of variables, e.g. $X = \{x_{n}\}_{n = 1}^{N}, Y = \{y_{n}\}_{n = 1}^{N}, Z = \{z_{n}\}_{n = 1}^{N}$ . See Appendix A for a summary of the notation.

A Bayesian Neural Network (BNN). A BNN assumes a predictor of the form $y =$ $f(x;W)+\epsilon$ , where f is a neural network parametrized by W and $\epsilon\sim\mathcal{N}(0,\sigma_{\epsilon}^{2}\cdot I)$ is a normally distributed noise variable. It places a prior p(W ) on the network parameters; given a data-set $\mathcal{D},$ we can apply Bayesian inference to compute the posterior distribution $p(W|\mathcal{D})$ over W or the posterior predictive distribution $p(\boldsymbol{y}^{*}|\boldsymbol{x}^{*},\mathcal{D})$ of over outputs $y^{*}$ given a new input $x^{*}$ . As commonly done, we assume $p(W)=\mathcal{N}(0,\sigma_{w}^{2}\cdot I)$

A Bayesian Neural Network with Latent Variables (BNN+LV). A BNN+LV enables more flexible noise distributions for BNNs by introducing a latent variable $z_{n}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,\sigma_{z}^{2}\cdot I)$ for each observation $(x_{n},y_{n})$ (Depeweg et al., 2018). It assumes the following data generation process (Figure 1):

$$
\begin{array}{l}{{W\sim p(W),\quad z_{n}\sim p(z),\quad\epsilon_{n}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,\sigma_{\epsilon}^{2}\cdot I),}}\\ {{y_{n}=f(x_{n},z_{n};W)+\epsilon_{n},\quad n=1,\ldots,N.}}\end{array}\tag{1}
$$

In this model, z is independent from $x,$ and can represent either white noise or meaningful latent explanatory variables. When $f$ is non-linear, BNN+LV is able to model heteroscedastic noise by transforming $z .$ Inference for BNN+LVs involves approximating the posterior distribution,

$$
p(W,Z|\mathcal D)\propto p(W)\cdot\prod_{n}p(y_{n}|x_{n},z_{n},W)p(z_{n}),\tag{2}
$$

(where $Z=\{z_{1},\ldots,z_{N}\})$ , over both network weights W and the latent input $z_{n}$ for each observation $x_{n}$. When Z represents meaningful latent variables, we may infer the latent information $z_{n}$ for each input $x_{n}$ by marginalizing $p(W,Z|\mathcal{D})$ over W. For a new input $x^{*}$ the posterior predictive is given by the expected likelihood under the posterior of $W$, and the prior of $z$ (Depeweg et al., 2018):

$$
\begin{array}{l}{{p(y^{*}|x^{*},\mathcal{D})=\displaystyle\int p(y^{*}|x^{*},W)p(W|\mathcal{D})dW}}\\ {{\displaystyle\qquad=\int\int p(y^{*}|x^{*},z^{*},W)p(z^{*})dz^{*}p(W|\mathcal{D})dW.}}\end{array}\tag{3}
$$

context.name: Notation (Appendix A)
context.statement:

$(x^{*},y^{*})$ A point from the test-set.
$z_{n}$ The latent code corresponding to the nth observation. Since the latent variables are sampled i.i.d from the prior, $p(z_{n})=p(z)$.
$z^{*}$ The latent code corresponding to $x^{*}$ . Again, $p(z^{*})=$ $p(z)$
$\mathcal{D}$ $\{(x_{n},y_{n})\}_{n=1}^{N}$

$Y$ $\{y_{n}\}_{n = 1}^{N}$
$Z$ $\{z_{n}\}_{n = 1}^{N}$
$p(y|x)p(x)$ or $p(y|x;W^{\mathrm{true}})p(x)$ The ground-truth data-generating distribution (that generated $\mathcal{D}$).
$f(\cdot,\cdot;W)$ A neural network $f$ parameterized by weights $W .$
$W$ The set of all neural network weights $w_{i}$
$p(W,Z|\mathcal{D})$ The BNN+LV joint posterior (Equation 2).
$p(W|\mathcal{D})$ The marginal posterior of the weights, $\begin{array}{r}{\int_{Z}p(W,Z|\mathcal{D})dZ}\end{array}$ (intractable).
$q_{\phi}(Z,W|\mathcal D)=q_{\phi}(Z|\mathcal D)q_{\phi}(W|\mathcal D)$ The mean-field variational approximation of the joint posterior (Equation 4), parameterized by φ.
$Z^{\mathrm{MAP}},W^{\mathrm{MAP}}$ The MAP of the true joint posterior: $Z^{\mathrm{MAP}},W^{\mathrm{MAP}}=$ $\operatorname{argmax}_{Z,W}p(Z,W|\mathcal{D})$
$Z^{\mathrm{true}},W^{\mathrm{true}}$ The ground-truth data-generating weights $W^{\mathrm{true}}$ and latent codes $Z^{\mathrm{true}}=\{z_{n}^{\mathrm{true}}\}_{n=1}^{N}$ that produced the observed data.
$\widehat{Z}, \widehat{W}$ The alternative set of latent variables $\widehat{Z}\ = \ \{\widehat{z}_{n}\}_{n = 1}^{N}$ and weights, defined in Equation 8, that have a higher probability under the joint posterior.
$q_{\phi}(z)$ The aggregated posterior (Equation 11).
$q_{\phi}(z|x)$ The approximate posterior marginalized over y: $\begin{array}{r}{\int_{y}q_{\phi}(z|x,y)p(y|x)dy}\end{array}$ . Since we only observe one y for every x, we cannot obtain unbiased estimates of this distribution in practice.

context.name: Section 4 preamble: well-specified model
context.statement: For intuition and clarity, we begin by characterizing likelihood non-identifiability and posterior bias for a single node of a BNN+LV and then generalize these results to a 1-layer $\mathrm{B N N + L V}$ . We assume the model is well-specified.

context.name: 1-node non-identifiability: W/C and (C-1)x+Cz (Section 4.1)
context.statement:
Non-Identifiability. Consider univariate output generated by a single hidden-node neural network with LeakyReLU activation. For simplicity, we study a case with zero network biases, unit output weights, and additive input noise:

$$
f(x,z;W)=\operatorname*{max}\left\{W(x+z),\alpha W(x+z)\right\},
$$

where $0 < \alpha < 1$ . For any non-zero constant $C,$ the pair $\widehat W^{(C)}=W/C,\widehat z^{(C)}=(C-1)x+Cz$ reconstructs the observed data equally well:

$$
\operatorname*{max}\left\{W(x+z),\alpha W(x+z)\right\}=\operatorname*{max}\left\{\widehat{W}^{(C)}\left(x+\widehat{z}^{(C)}\right),\alpha\widehat{W}^{(C)}\left(x+\widehat{z}^{(C)}\right)\right\}.
$$

Now, suppose that the output is observed with Gaussian noise: $\displaystyle y\sim\mathcal{N}(f(x,z;W),\sigma_{\epsilon}^{2})$ . Then the true values of the parameter W and the latent input noise z are equally likely as $\widehat{W}^{(C)}$ and $\widehat{z}^{(C)}$ under the likelihood: $p(y|f(x,z,W),\sigma_{\epsilon}^{2})=p(y|f(x,\widehat{z}^{(C)},\widehat{W}^{(C)}),\sigma_{\epsilon}^{2})$ . We show in Theorem 1 that for this model, the posterior over the model parameter and latent inputs W, Z is biased away from the ground-truth towards parameters that generalize poorly as the sample size grows, regardless of the choice of W prior.

context.name: 1-node model (Appendix B.1, Eq. 15)
context.statement:
Consider univariate output generated by a single hidden-node neural network with LeakyReLU activation:

$$
\begin{array}{l}{z\sim\mathcal{N}(0,\sigma_{z}^{2})}\\ {\epsilon\sim\mathcal{N}(0,\sigma_{\epsilon}^{2})}\\ {y=\operatorname*{max}\left\{W(x+z),\alpha W(x+z)\right\}+\epsilon}\end{array}\tag{15}
$$

where α is a fixed constant in (0, 1).

context.name: 1-layer non-identifiability (Section 4.2, Eq. 8)
context.statement:
Non-Identifiability. Sources of non-identifiability increase when f is a neural network. Consider a single-output neural network, f, that takes as input x and z (represented as a concatenated vector in $\mathbb{R}^{2 D})$ and has a single hidden layer containing H hidden nodes. At the output node, we fix the activation to be the identity. Thus, the activation of the output node is computed as

$$
a^{\mathrm{out}}=(a^{\mathrm{hidden}})^{\top}W^{\mathrm{out}}+b^{\mathrm{out}},
$$

where $W^{\mathrm{out}}$ is a H-dimensional weight vector, $b^{\mathrm{out}}$ is the bias and $a^{\mathrm{hidden}}$ is the H-dimensional vector of activations of the hidden nodes. We can further expand $a^{\mathrm{hidden}}$ as

$$
a^{\mathrm{hidden}}=g\left(W^{x}x+W^{z}z+b^{\mathrm{hidden}}\right),
$$

where $W^{x}$ and $W^{z}$ are weight matrices in $\mathbb{R}^{H \times D}$ , $b^{\mathrm{hidden}}$ is a H-dimensional bias vector and $g$ is the activation function, applied element-wise. We characterize ways that the models parameters and the latent input variables z are non-identifiable given a set of observed data. For any choice of diagonal matrix $S \in \mathbb{R}^{D \times D}$ , vector $U \in \mathbb{R}^{D}$ , and any factorization $W^{z}= R T$ where T is in $\mathbb{R}^{D \times D}$ , we can express $a^{\mathrm{hidden}}$ in two equivalent ways:

$$
a^{\mathrm{hidden}}=g\left(W^{x}x+W^{z}z+b^{\mathrm{hidden}}\right)=g\left(\widehat{W}^{x}x+\widehat{W}^{z}\widehat{z}+\widehat{b}^{\mathrm{hidden}}\right)
$$

by setting:

$$
\widehat{W}^{x}=W^{x}+W^{z}S,\widehat{W}^{z}=R,\widehat{z}=T z-T S x-U,\widehat{b}^{\mathrm{hidden}}=b+R U .\tag{8}
$$

Suppose that the output is observed with Gaussian noise: $\displaystyle y\sim\mathcal{N}(f(x,z;W),\sigma_{\epsilon}^{2})$ , where W denotes the set of weights $(W^{\mathrm{out}},W^{x},W^{z},b^{\mathrm{out}},b^{\mathrm{hidden}})$ . Then, by only observing outputs generated by this network given observed input, one cannot identify ground-truth parameter and latent variable values under the likelihood: $p(y|f(x,z,W),\sigma_{\epsilon}^{2})=p(y|f(x,\widehat{z},\widehat{W}),\sigma_{\epsilon}^{2})$ . Just like in the case of a network with a single node, we show in Theorem 2 that the joint posterior is biased away from the ground-truth parameters, regardless of the choice of weight prior.

context.name: 1-layer model (Appendix B.2, Eq. 16)
context.statement:
Let W be the set of network weights $\{W^{x},W^{z},W^{\mathrm{out}},b^{\mathrm{hidden}},b^{\mathrm{out}}\}$ . Consider a data-set generated from the following model:

$$
\begin{array}{r}{\begin{array}{c}{W\sim p(W)}\\ {z\sim\mathcal{N}(0,\sigma_{z}^{2}\cdot I)}\\ {\epsilon\sim N(0,\sigma_{\epsilon}^{2})}\\ {a^{\mathrm{hidden}}=g\left(W^{x}x+W^{z}z+b^{\mathrm{hidden}}\right),}\\ {y=(a^{\mathrm{hidden}})^{\top}W^{\mathrm{out}}+b^{\mathrm{out}}+\epsilon}\end{array}}\end{array}\tag{16}
$$

context.name: Generative modeling assumptions 1-2 (Section 4.3)
context.statement:
Generally, when assuming a probabilistic model, we hope that in the limit of infinite data, inference recovers model parameters that satisfy our generative modeling assumptions. For example, when assuming a BNN, we hope that in the limit of infinite data, the MLE and MAP over the weights parameterize the true function that generated the data. For the BNN+LV model, however, the parameters given by the MAP of the joint posterior $W^{\mathrm{MAP}},Z^{\mathrm{MAP}}$ do not satisfy our generative modeling assumptions. To illustrate this, we compare $W^{\mathrm{MAP}},Z^{\mathrm{MAP}}$ with the ground-truth data generating parameters, $W^{\mathrm{true}},Z^{\mathrm{true}}$ ; under our ground-truth data-generating process from Equation 1, $Z^{\mathrm{true}}$ satisfies two modeling assumptions:

Assumption 1: $z^{\mathrm{true}}$ is independent of x—that is, $p(z,x)$ factorizes.

Assumption 2: $z^{\mathrm{true}}$ is distributed like the prior $p(z)$

context.name: From the proof of Theorem 1 (the priors p_W, p_z and the quantity D_N^(C))
context.statement:
We assume the model in Equation 15. We denote the prior on $W$ as $p_{W}$ and suppose that it is bounded, we denote the prior on $z$ as $p_{z}$ , and we suppose that $p_{x}$, the distribution over the input $x$, has bounded first and second moments $\mu_{x}$ and $\sigma_{x}^{2}.$ For any non-zero constant $0 < C < 1$ , we define

$$
\widehat W^{(C)}=W/C,~\widehat z_{n}^{(C)}=(C-1)x_{n}+Cz_{n},
$$

and we define $D_{N}^{(C)}$ to be the difference between the scaled parameters $(\widehat{W}^{(C)},\widehat{z}_{1}^{(C)},\dots\widehat{z}_{N}^{(C)})$ and the ground-truth parameters $(W,z_{1},\dots z_{N})$ under the joint posterior log $p(W,Z|\mathcal{D})$

For any set of parameters $(W,z_{1},\dots z_{N})$ , we show that we can find alternate parameters $(\widehat{W}^{(C)},\widehat{z}_{1}^{(C)},\ldots\widehat{z}_{N}^{(C)})$ , that are scored as more likely under the log-posterior log $p(W,\{z_{n}\}|\mathcal{D})$ To do this, we first show that the alternative parameters are scored as equally likely under the log-likelihood, and then we show that the alternate parameters are scored as more likely under the log-prior.

Since we have that

$$
\operatorname*{max}\left\{W^{\mathrm{true}}(x+z_{n}^{\mathrm{true}}),\alpha W^{\mathrm{true}}(x+z_{n}^{\mathrm{true}})\right\}=\operatorname*{max}\left\{\widehat{W}^{(C)}(x+\widehat{z}_{n}^{(C)}),\alpha\widehat{W}^{(C)}(x+\widehat{z}_{n}^{(C)})\right\},
$$

we see that the alternate parameters are as likely as the original parameters under the likelihood; that is,

$$
\prod_{n}p(y_{n}|x_{n},z_{n}^{\mathrm{true}},W^{\mathrm{true}})=\prod_{n}p\left(y_{n}|x_{n},\widehat{z}_{n}^{(C)},\widehat{W}^{(C)}\right).
$$

Since the likelihood under both sets of parameters is equal, the difference between the log-posterior, $D_{N}^{(C)}$ , is simply the difference of the two sets of parameters under the log-prior:

$$
D_{N}^{(C)}=\log p_{W}(\widehat{W}^{(C)})-\log p_{W}(W)+\sum_{n=1}^{N}\log p_{z}(\widehat{z}_{n}^{(C)})-\log p_{z}(z_{n}).
$$

      (μx σx σz : ℝ) (hσz : 0 < σz)

      (hXindep : iIndepFun X μ) (hXid : ∀ n, IdentDistrib (X n) (X 0) μ μ)

      (hXint1 : Integrable (X 0) μ) (hXint2 : Integrable (fun ω => (X 0 ω) ^ 2) μ)

      (hZindep : iIndepFun Z μ)
      (hZgauss : ∀ n, Measure.map (Z n) μ = gaussianReal 0 (Real.toNNReal (σz ^ 2)))

      (hcond : σz ^ 2 < μx ^ 2 + σx ^ 2)

      (hClo : (σx ^ 2 + μx ^ 2 - σz ^ 2) / (σx ^ 2 + μx ^ 2 + σz ^ 2) < C)

import Mathlib

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Filter Topology

namespace ResearchLevel

noncomputable def logPriorRatioZ (σz C x z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (z ^ 2 - ((C - 1) * x + C * z) ^ 2) / (2 * σz ^ 2)

noncomputable def Dseq1 {Ω : Type*} (Δw σz C : ℝ) (X Z : ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (N : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : ℝ :=
  Δw + ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, logPriorRatioZ σz C (X n ω) (Z n ω)

noncomputable def logPriorRatioZ2 {D : ℕ} (σz : ℝ) (t x z : Fin D → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ d, ((z d) ^ 2 - (t d * (z d - x d)) ^ 2)) / (2 * σz ^ 2)

noncomputable def Dseq2 {Ω : Type*} {D : ℕ} (Δw σz : ℝ) (t : Fin D → ℝ)
    (X Z : ℕ → Ω → (Fin D → ℝ)) (N : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : ℝ :=
  Δw + ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, logPriorRatioZ2 σz t (X n ω) (Z n ω)

private def pairShuffle {α β : Type*} (p : (α × α) × (β × β)) :
    (α × β) × (α × β) :=
  ((p.1.1, p.2.1), (p.1.2, p.2.2))

private lemma measurable_pairShuffle {α β : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β] :
    Measurable (@pairShuffle α β) := by
  fun_prop

private lemma measurePreserving_pairShuffle
    {α β : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    (A B : Measure α) (C D : Measure β)
    [SFinite A] [SFinite B] [SFinite C] [SFinite D] :
    MeasurePreserving pairShuffle ((A.prod B).prod (C.prod D))
      ((A.prod C).prod (B.prod D)) := by
  let h₁ := measurePreserving_prodAssoc A B (C.prod D)
  let h₂inner :=
    (measurePreserving_prodAssoc B C D).symm MeasurableEquiv.prodAssoc
  let h₂ := (MeasurePreserving.id A).prod h₂inner
  let h₃inner :=
    (Measure.measurePreserving_swap (μ := B) (ν := C)).prod (MeasurePreserving.id D)
  let h₃ := (MeasurePreserving.id A).prod h₃inner
  let h₄inner := measurePreserving_prodAssoc C B D
  let h₄ := (MeasurePreserving.id A).prod h₄inner
  let h₅ :=
    (measurePreserving_prodAssoc A C (B.prod D)).symm MeasurableEquiv.prodAssoc
  have h := h₅.comp (h₄.comp (h₃.comp (h₂.comp h₁)))
  convert h using 1 <;> rfl

private lemma pairwise_indep_prodMk
    {Ω α β : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (X : ℕ → Ω → α) (Z : ℕ → Ω → β)
    (hX : iIndepFun X P) (hZ : iIndepFun Z P)
    (hXZ : IndepFun (fun ω n => X n ω) (fun ω n => Z n ω) P)
    (hXae : ∀ n, AEMeasurable (X n) P) (hZae : ∀ n, AEMeasurable (Z n) P) :
    Pairwise fun i j =>
      IndepFun (fun ω => (X i ω, Z i ω)) (fun ω => (X j ω, Z j ω)) P := by
  intro i j hij
  have hXX : IndepFun (X i) (X j) P := hX.indepFun hij
  have hZZ : IndepFun (Z i) (Z j) P := hZ.indepFun hij
  have hblock :
      IndepFun (fun ω => (X i ω, X j ω)) (fun ω => (Z i ω, Z j ω)) P := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using
      hXZ.comp (φ := fun x : ℕ → α => (x i, x j))
        (ψ := fun z : ℕ → β => (z i, z j)) (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
  have hXiZi : IndepFun (X i) (Z i) P := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using
      hXZ.comp (φ := fun x : ℕ → α => x i) (ψ := fun z : ℕ → β => z i)
        (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
  have hXjZj : IndepFun (X j) (Z j) P := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using
      hXZ.comp (φ := fun x : ℕ → α => x j) (ψ := fun z : ℕ → β => z j)
        (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
  have hXXmap :=
    (indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map (hXae i) (hXae j)).mp hXX
  have hZZmap :=
    (indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map (hZae i) (hZae j)).mp hZZ
  have hblockmap :=
    (indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map
      ((hXae i).prodMk (hXae j)) ((hZae i).prodMk (hZae j))).mp hblock
  have hXZiMap :=
    (indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map (hXae i) (hZae i)).mp hXiZi
  have hXZjMap :=
    (indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map (hXae j) (hZae j)).mp hXjZj
  apply (indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map
    ((hXae i).prodMk (hZae i)) ((hXae j).prodMk (hZae j))).mpr
  let q : Ω → (α × α) × (β × β) :=
    fun ω => ((X i ω, X j ω), (Z i ω, Z j ω))
  have hq : AEMeasurable q P :=
    ((hXae i).prodMk (hXae j)).prodMk ((hZae i).prodMk (hZae j))
  change P.map (pairShuffle ∘ q) = _
  rw [← AEMeasurable.map_map_of_aemeasurable measurable_pairShuffle.aemeasurable hq]
  rw [hblockmap, hXXmap, hZZmap]
  rw [(measurePreserving_pairShuffle (P.map (X i)) (P.map (X j))
    (P.map (Z i)) (P.map (Z j))).map_eq]
  rw [hXZiMap, hXZjMap]

private lemma tendsto_measure_pos_of_ae_tendsto
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure P]
    (f : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (hf : ∀ n, AEStronglyMeasurable (f n) P)
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hlim : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, Tendsto (fun n => f n ω) atTop (𝓝 a)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => P {ω | 0 < f n ω}) atTop (𝓝 (P Set.univ)) := by
  let g : ℕ → Ω → ℝ := fun n => (hf n).mk (f n)
  have hgmeas : ∀ n, Measurable (g n) := fun n => (hf n).measurable_mk
  have hfg : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ∀ n, f n ω = g n ω := by
    rw [ae_all_iff]
    exact fun n => (hf n).ae_eq_mk
  have hmeasure : ∀ n, P {ω | 0 < f n ω} = P {ω | 0 < g n ω} := by
    intro n
    apply measure_congr
    filter_upwards [(hf n).ae_eq_mk] with ω hω
    change (0 < f n ω) = (0 < g n ω)
    rw [hω]
  have hgind : Tendsto (fun n => P {ω | 0 < g n ω}) atTop (𝓝 (P Set.univ)) := by
    apply tendsto_measure_of_ae_tendsto_indicator_of_isFiniteMeasure atTop
      MeasurableSet.univ (fun n => measurableSet_lt measurable_const (hgmeas n))
    filter_upwards [hlim, hfg] with ω hω hfgω
    have hevent : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, 0 < f n ω := hω.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds ha)
    filter_upwards [hevent] with n hn
    change (0 < g n ω) ↔ True
    simp only [iff_true]
    rwa [← hfgω n]
  refine hgind.congr' (Eventually.of_forall fun n => ?_)
  exact (hmeasure n).symm

theorem asymptotic_bias_one_node
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasureSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (X Z : ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (μx σx σz : ℝ) (hσz : 0 < σz)

    (hXindep : iIndepFun X P) (hXid : ∀ n, IdentDistrib (X n) (X 0) P P)

    (hXint1 : Integrable (X 0) P) (hXint2 : Integrable (fun ω => (X 0 ω) ^ 2) P)
    (hμx : ∫ ω, X 0 ω ∂P = μx) (hσx : ∫ ω, (X 0 ω) ^ 2 ∂P = σx ^ 2 + μx ^ 2)

    (hZindep : iIndepFun Z P)
    (hZgauss : ∀ n, Measure.map (Z n) P = gaussianReal 0 (Real.toNNReal (σz ^ 2)))

    (hXZ : IndepFun (fun ω n => X n ω) (fun ω n => Z n ω) P)

    (hcond : σz ^ 2 < μx ^ 2 + σx ^ 2)

    (Δw : ℝ)

    (W : ℝ) (pW : ℝ → ℝ) (hpWbdd : ∃ M, ∀ w, pW w ≤ M) (hpWposW : 0 < pW W)
    (C : ℝ)
    (hClo : (σx ^ 2 + μx ^ 2 - σz ^ 2) / (σx ^ 2 + μx ^ 2 + σz ^ 2) < C)
    (hChi : C < 1)
    (hpWposWC : 0 < pW (W / C)) (hΔw : Δw = Real.log (pW (W / C)) - Real.log (pW W)) :
    Tendsto (fun N => P {ω | 0 < Dseq1 Δw σz C X Z N ω}) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
  let G : Measure ℝ := gaussianReal 0 (Real.toNNReal (σz ^ 2))
  have hXae : ∀ n, AEMeasurable (X n) P := fun n => (hXid n).aemeasurable_fst
  have hZae : ∀ n, AEMeasurable (Z n) P := by
    intro n
    apply AEMeasurable.of_map_ne_zero
    rw [hZgauss n]
    exact IsProbabilityMeasure.ne_zero G
  have hZlaw : ∀ n, IdentDistrib (Z n) id P G := by
    intro n
    exact ⟨hZae n, measurable_id.aemeasurable, by simpa [G] using hZgauss n⟩
  have hXLp0 : MemLp (X 0) 2 P :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hXint1.1).mpr hXint2
  have hXLp : ∀ n, MemLp (X n) 2 P := fun n => (hXid n).memLp_iff.mpr hXLp0
  have hZLp : ∀ n, MemLp (Z n) 2 P := by
    intro n
    have hid : MemLp id 2 (P.map (Z n)) := by
      rw [hZgauss n]
      exact memLp_id_gaussianReal' 2 (by simp)
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using hid.comp_of_map (hZae n)
  have hZmean : ∀ n, ∫ ω, Z n ω ∂P = 0 := by
    intro n
    simpa [G] using (hZlaw n).integral_eq
  have hZvar : ∀ n, variance (Z n) P = σz ^ 2 := by
    intro n
    calc
      variance (Z n) P = variance id G := (hZlaw n).variance_eq
      _ = (Real.toNNReal (σz ^ 2) : ℝ) := variance_id_gaussianReal
      _ = σz ^ 2 := by simp [sq_nonneg]
  have hZsecond : ∀ n, ∫ ω, (Z n ω) ^ 2 ∂P = σz ^ 2 := by
    intro n
    have hv := variance_eq_sub (hZLp n)
    rw [hZvar n, hZmean n] at hv
    norm_num at hv ⊢
    linarith
  have hpair : Pairwise fun i j =>
      IndepFun (fun ω => (X i ω, Z i ω)) (fun ω => (X j ω, Z j ω)) P :=
    pairwise_indep_prodMk P X Z hXindep hZindep hXZ hXae hZae
  have hpairid : ∀ n,
      IdentDistrib (fun ω => (X n ω, Z n ω)) (fun ω => (X 0 ω, Z 0 ω)) P P := by
    intro n
    have hn : IndepFun (X n) (Z n) P := by
      simpa [Function.comp_def] using
        hXZ.comp (φ := fun x : ℕ → ℝ => x n) (ψ := fun z : ℕ → ℝ => z n)
          (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
    have h0 : IndepFun (X 0) (Z 0) P := by
      simpa [Function.comp_def] using
        hXZ.comp (φ := fun x : ℕ → ℝ => x 0) (ψ := fun z : ℕ → ℝ => z 0)
          (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
    refine ⟨(hXae n).prodMk (hZae n), (hXae 0).prodMk (hZae 0), ?_⟩
    rw [(indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map (hXae n) (hZae n)).mp hn]
    rw [(indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map (hXae 0) (hZae 0)).mp h0]
    rw [(hXid n).map_eq, hZgauss n, hZgauss 0]
  let Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ := fun n ω => logPriorRatioZ σz C (X n ω) (Z n ω)
  have hlogmeas : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => logPriorRatioZ σz C p.1 p.2) := by
    unfold logPriorRatioZ
    fun_prop
  have hYid : ∀ n, IdentDistrib (Y n) (Y 0) P P := by
    intro n
    simpa [Y, Function.comp_def] using (hpairid n).comp hlogmeas
  have hYpair : Pairwise fun i j => IndepFun (Y i) (Y j) P := by
    intro i j hij
    simpa [Y, Function.comp_def] using (hpair hij).comp hlogmeas hlogmeas
  have hcrossInd : IndepFun (X 0) (Z 0) P := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using
      hXZ.comp (φ := fun x : ℕ → ℝ => x 0) (ψ := fun z : ℕ → ℝ => z 0)
        (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
  have hZint0 : Integrable (Z 0) P := (hZLp 0).integrable one_le_two
  have hcrossInt : Integrable (fun ω => X 0 ω * Z 0 ω) P :=
    hcrossInd.integrable_mul hXint1 hZint0
  have hcrossMean : ∫ ω, X 0 ω * Z 0 ω ∂P = 0 := by
    rw [hcrossInd.integral_fun_mul_eq_mul_integral hXint1.1 hZint0.1]
    rw [hμx, hZmean 0, mul_zero]
  have hlinLp : MemLp (fun ω => (C - 1) * X 0 ω + C * Z 0 ω) 2 P :=
    (hXLp0.const_mul (C - 1)).add ((hZLp 0).const_mul C)
  have hlinInt : Integrable (fun ω => ((C - 1) * X 0 ω + C * Z 0 ω) ^ 2) P :=
    hlinLp.integrable_sq
  have hlinMean :
      ∫ ω, ((C - 1) * X 0 ω + C * Z 0 ω) ^ 2 ∂P =
        (C - 1) ^ 2 * (σx ^ 2 + μx ^ 2) + C ^ 2 * σz ^ 2 := by
    have heq : (fun ω => ((C - 1) * X 0 ω + C * Z 0 ω) ^ 2) =
        fun ω => ((C - 1) ^ 2 * (X 0 ω) ^ 2 +
          (2 * (C - 1) * C) * (X 0 ω * Z 0 ω)) + C ^ 2 * (Z 0 ω) ^ 2 := by
      funext ω
      ring
    rw [heq]
    let Aterm : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => (C - 1) ^ 2 * (X 0 ω) ^ 2
    let Bterm : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => (2 * (C - 1) * C) * (X 0 ω * Z 0 ω)
    let Eterm : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => C ^ 2 * (Z 0 ω) ^ 2
    have hA : Integrable Aterm P := hXint2.const_mul ((C - 1) ^ 2)
    have hB : Integrable Bterm P := hcrossInt.const_mul (2 * (C - 1) * C)
    have hE : Integrable Eterm P := (hZLp 0).integrable_sq.const_mul (C ^ 2)
    have hsum :
        (∫ ω, (Aterm ω + Bterm ω) + Eterm ω ∂P) =
          (∫ ω, Aterm ω ∂P) + (∫ ω, Bterm ω ∂P) + (∫ ω, Eterm ω ∂P) := by
      calc
        _ = (∫ ω, Aterm ω + Bterm ω ∂P) + ∫ ω, Eterm ω ∂P :=
          integral_add (hA.add hB) hE
        _ = _ := by rw [integral_add hA hB]
    rw [show (∫ ω, (C - 1) ^ 2 * X 0 ω ^ 2 + 2 * (C - 1) * C *
      (X 0 ω * Z 0 ω) + C ^ 2 * Z 0 ω ^ 2 ∂P) =
        (∫ ω, Aterm ω ∂P) + (∫ ω, Bterm ω ∂P) + (∫ ω, Eterm ω ∂P) by
          simpa [Aterm, Bterm, Eterm] using hsum]
    simp only [Aterm, Bterm, Eterm, integral_const_mul]
    rw [hσx, hcrossMean, hZsecond 0]
    ring
  let mY : ℝ :=
    (σz ^ 2 - ((C - 1) ^ 2 * (σx ^ 2 + μx ^ 2) + C ^ 2 * σz ^ 2)) /
      (2 * σz ^ 2)
  have hYint0 : Integrable (Y 0) P := by
    have hi := ((hZLp 0).integrable_sq.sub hlinInt).div_const (2 * σz ^ 2)
    simpa [Y, logPriorRatioZ] using hi
  have hYmean : ∫ ω, Y 0 ω ∂P = mY := by
    change (∫ ω, (Z 0 ω ^ 2 - ((C - 1) * X 0 ω + C * Z 0 ω) ^ 2) /
      (2 * σz ^ 2) ∂P) = mY
    rw [integral_div, integral_sub (hZLp 0).integrable_sq hlinInt]
    rw [hZsecond 0, hlinMean]
  have hABpos : 0 < (σx ^ 2 + μx ^ 2) + σz ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hσz]
  have hlo := (div_lt_iff₀ hABpos).mp hClo
  have hbracket :
      0 < C * ((σx ^ 2 + μx ^ 2) + σz ^ 2) -
        ((σx ^ 2 + μx ^ 2) - σz ^ 2) := by
    linarith
  have hnum :
      0 < σz ^ 2 - ((C - 1) ^ 2 * (σx ^ 2 + μx ^ 2) + C ^ 2 * σz ^ 2) := by
    have hp := mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hChi) hbracket
    nlinarith [hp]
  have hmY : 0 < mY := by
    dsimp [mY]
    exact div_pos hnum (mul_pos zero_lt_two (sq_pos_of_pos hσz))
  have hslln := strong_law_ae Y hYint0 hYpair hYid
  let F : ℕ → Ω → ℝ := fun N ω => (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * Dseq1 Δw σz C X Z N ω
  have hYint : ∀ n, Integrable (Y n) P := fun n => (hYid n).integrable_iff.mpr hYint0
  have hFint : ∀ N, Integrable (F N) P := by
    intro N
    have hsum : Integrable (fun ω => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, Y n ω) P := by
      fun_prop
    have hbase : Integrable (fun ω => Δw + ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, Y n ω) P := by
      fun_prop
    have hscaled := hbase.const_mul (N : ℝ)⁻¹
    simpa [F, Dseq1, Y] using hscaled
  have hFlim : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, Tendsto (fun N => F N ω) atTop (𝓝 mY) := by
    filter_upwards [hslln] with ω hω
    rw [hYmean] at hω
    have hc : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => Δw / (N : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
      tendsto_const_div_atTop_nhds_zero_nat Δw
    have hadd := hc.add hω
    simpa [F, Dseq1, Y, div_eq_mul_inv, smul_eq_mul, mul_add, mul_comm] using hadd
  have hposF : Tendsto (fun N => P {ω | 0 < F N ω}) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    simpa using tendsto_measure_pos_of_ae_tendsto P F (fun N => (hFint N).1) mY hmY hFlim
  refine hposF.congr' ?_
  filter_upwards [eventually_atTop.2 ⟨1, fun _ hn => hn⟩] with N hN
  congr 1
  ext ω
  change (0 < F N ω) ↔ (0 < Dseq1 Δw σz C X Z N ω)
  dsimp [F]
  have hNpos : 0 < (N : ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hN)
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases mul_pos_iff.mp h with hp | hn
    · exact hp.2
    · exact (not_lt_of_ge hNpos.le hn.1).elim
  · exact fun h => mul_pos hNpos h

theorem asymptotic_bias_one_layer
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasureSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    {D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D)
    (X Z : ℕ → Ω → (Fin D → ℝ))
    (μx σx : Fin D → ℝ) (σz : ℝ) (hσz : 0 < σz)

    (hXindep : iIndepFun X P) (hXid : ∀ n, IdentDistrib (X n) (X 0) P P)

    (hXint : ∀ d, Integrable (fun ω => X 0 ω d) P ∧
                  Integrable (fun ω => (X 0 ω d) ^ 2) P)
    (hμx : ∀ d, ∫ ω, X 0 ω d ∂P = μx d)
    (hσx : ∀ d, ∫ ω, (X 0 ω d) ^ 2 ∂P = (σx d) ^ 2 + (μx d) ^ 2)

    (hZindep : iIndepFun Z P)
    (hZcoord : ∀ n, iIndepFun (fun d ω => Z n ω d) P)
    (hZgauss : ∀ n d, Measure.map (fun ω => Z n ω d) P = gaussianReal 0 (Real.toNNReal (σz ^ 2)))

    (hXZ : IndepFun (fun ω n => X n ω) (fun ω n => Z n ω) P)

    (pW : (Fin D → ℝ) → ℝ) (hpWbdd2 : ∃ M, ∀ v, pW v ≤ M) (W : Fin D → ℝ) (hpWposW : 0 < pW W) :
    ∃ (t : Fin D → ℝ) (Ŵ : Fin D → ℝ),
      (∀ d, 0 < |t d| ∧ |t d| < Real.sqrt (σz ^ 2 / ((μx d) ^ 2 + (σx d) ^ 2 + σz ^ 2))) ∧

  let K : Fin D → ℝ := fun d => (μx d) ^ 2 + (σx d) ^ 2 + σz ^ 2

  let G : Measure ℝ := gaussianReal 0 (Real.toNNReal (σz ^ 2))

    intro d

  let Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ := fun n ω => logPriorRatioZ2 σz t (X n ω) (Z n ω)

  filter_upwards [eventually_atTop.2 ⟨1, fun _ hn => hn⟩] with N hN

    · exact hp.2
    · exact (not_lt_of_ge hNpos.le hn.1).elim

noncomputable def RavgZ1 {Ω : Type*} (σz C : ℝ) (X Z : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (N : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : ℝ :=
  (1 / (N : ℝ)) * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, logPriorRatioZ σz C (X n ω) (Z n ω)

noncomputable def RavgZ2 {Ω : Type*} {D : ℕ} (σz : ℝ) (t : Fin D → ℝ)
    (X Z : ℕ → Ω → (Fin D → ℝ)) (N : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : ℝ :=
  (1 / (N : ℝ)) * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, logPriorRatioZ2 σz t (X n ω) (Z n ω)

theorem bias_concentration_cantelli
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasureSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] :
    (∀ (X Z : ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
      (μx σx σz : ℝ) (hσz : 0 < σz)

      (hXindep : iIndepFun X μ) (hXid : ∀ n, IdentDistrib (X n) (X 0) μ μ)

      (hXint1 : Integrable (X 0) μ) (hXint2 : Integrable (fun ω => (X 0 ω) ^ 2) μ)
      (hμx : ∫ ω, X 0 ω ∂μ = μx) (hσx : ∫ ω, (X 0 ω) ^ 2 ∂μ = σx ^ 2 + μx ^ 2)

      (hZindep : iIndepFun Z μ)
      (hZgauss : ∀ n, Measure.map (Z n) μ = gaussianReal 0 (Real.toNNReal (σz ^ 2)))

      (hXZ : IndepFun (fun ω n => X n ω) (fun ω n => Z n ω) μ)

      (hcond : σz ^ 2 < μx ^ 2 + σx ^ 2)
      (C : ℝ)
      (hClo : (σx ^ 2 + μx ^ 2 - σz ^ 2) / (σx ^ 2 + μx ^ 2 + σz ^ 2) < C)
      (hChi : C < 1),
      Tendsto (fun N => μ {ω | 0 < RavgZ1 σz C X Z N ω}) atTop (𝓝 1)) ∧
    (∀ {D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D)
      (X Z : ℕ → Ω → (Fin D → ℝ))
      (μx σx : Fin D → ℝ) (σz : ℝ) (hσz : 0 < σz)

      (hXindep : iIndepFun X μ) (hXid : ∀ n, IdentDistrib (X n) (X 0) μ μ)

      (hXint : ∀ d, Integrable (fun ω => X 0 ω d) μ ∧
                    Integrable (fun ω => (X 0 ω d) ^ 2) μ)
      (hμx : ∀ d, ∫ ω, X 0 ω d ∂μ = μx d)
      (hσx : ∀ d, ∫ ω, (X 0 ω d) ^ 2 ∂μ = (σx d) ^ 2 + (μx d) ^ 2)

      (hZindep : iIndepFun Z μ)
      (hZcoord : ∀ n, iIndepFun (fun d ω => Z n ω d) μ)
      (hZgauss : ∀ n d, Measure.map (fun ω => Z n ω d) μ = gaussianReal 0 (Real.toNNReal (σz ^ 2)))

      (hXZ : IndepFun (fun ω n => X n ω) (fun ω n => Z n ω) μ)

      (t : Fin D → ℝ)
      (ht : ∀ d, 0 < |t d| ∧ |t d| < Real.sqrt (σz ^ 2 / ((μx d) ^ 2 + (σx d) ^ 2 + σz ^ 2))),
      Tendsto (fun N => μ {ω | 0 < RavgZ2 σz t X Z N ω}) atTop (𝓝 1)) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro X Z μx σx σz hσz hXindep hXid hXint1 hXint2 hμx hσx hZindep hZgauss hXZ hcond C hClo hChi
    let G : Measure ℝ := gaussianReal 0 (Real.toNNReal (σz ^ 2))
    have hXae : ∀ n, AEMeasurable (X n) μ := fun n => (hXid n).aemeasurable_fst
    have hZae : ∀ n, AEMeasurable (Z n) μ := by
      intro n
      apply AEMeasurable.of_map_ne_zero
      rw [hZgauss n]
      exact IsProbabilityMeasure.ne_zero G
    have hZlaw : ∀ n, IdentDistrib (Z n) id μ G := by
      intro n
      exact ⟨hZae n, measurable_id.aemeasurable, by simpa [G] using hZgauss n⟩
    have hXLp0 : MemLp (X 0) 2 μ :=
      (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hXint1.1).mpr hXint2
    have hXLp : ∀ n, MemLp (X n) 2 μ := fun n => (hXid n).memLp_iff.mpr hXLp0
    have hZLp : ∀ n, MemLp (Z n) 2 μ := by
      intro n
      have hid : MemLp id 2 (μ.map (Z n)) := by
        rw [hZgauss n]
        exact memLp_id_gaussianReal' 2 (by simp)
      simpa [Function.comp_def] using hid.comp_of_map (hZae n)
    have hZmean : ∀ n, ∫ ω, Z n ω ∂μ = 0 := by
      intro n
      simpa [G] using (hZlaw n).integral_eq
    have hZvar : ∀ n, variance (Z n) μ = σz ^ 2 := by
      intro n
      calc
        variance (Z n) μ = variance id G := (hZlaw n).variance_eq
        _ = (Real.toNNReal (σz ^ 2) : ℝ) := variance_id_gaussianReal
        _ = σz ^ 2 := by simp [sq_nonneg]
    have hZsecond : ∀ n, ∫ ω, (Z n ω) ^ 2 ∂μ = σz ^ 2 := by
      intro n
      have hv := variance_eq_sub (hZLp n)
      rw [hZvar n, hZmean n] at hv
      norm_num at hv ⊢
      linarith
    have hpair : Pairwise fun i j =>
        IndepFun (fun ω => (X i ω, Z i ω)) (fun ω => (X j ω, Z j ω)) μ :=
      pairwise_indep_prodMk μ X Z hXindep hZindep hXZ hXae hZae
    have hpairid : ∀ n,
        IdentDistrib (fun ω => (X n ω, Z n ω)) (fun ω => (X 0 ω, Z 0 ω)) μ μ := by
      intro n
      have hn : IndepFun (X n) (Z n) μ := by
        simpa [Function.comp_def] using
          hXZ.comp (φ := fun x : ℕ → ℝ => x n) (ψ := fun z : ℕ → ℝ => z n)
            (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
      have h0 : IndepFun (X 0) (Z 0) μ := by
        simpa [Function.comp_def] using
          hXZ.comp (φ := fun x : ℕ → ℝ => x 0) (ψ := fun z : ℕ → ℝ => z 0)
            (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
      refine ⟨(hXae n).prodMk (hZae n), (hXae 0).prodMk (hZae 0), ?_⟩
      rw [(indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map (hXae n) (hZae n)).mp hn]
      rw [(indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map (hXae 0) (hZae 0)).mp h0]
      rw [(hXid n).map_eq, hZgauss n, hZgauss 0]
    let Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ := fun n ω => logPriorRatioZ σz C (X n ω) (Z n ω)
    have hlogmeas : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => logPriorRatioZ σz C p.1 p.2) := by
      unfold logPriorRatioZ
      fun_prop
    have hYid : ∀ n, IdentDistrib (Y n) (Y 0) μ μ := by
      intro n
      simpa [Y, Function.comp_def] using (hpairid n).comp hlogmeas
    have hYpair : Pairwise fun i j => IndepFun (Y i) (Y j) μ := by
      intro i j hij
      simpa [Y, Function.comp_def] using (hpair hij).comp hlogmeas hlogmeas
    have hcrossInd : IndepFun (X 0) (Z 0) μ := by
      simpa [Function.comp_def] using
        hXZ.comp (φ := fun x : ℕ → ℝ => x 0) (ψ := fun z : ℕ → ℝ => z 0)
          (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
    have hZint0 : Integrable (Z 0) μ := (hZLp 0).integrable one_le_two
    have hcrossInt : Integrable (fun ω => X 0 ω * Z 0 ω) μ :=
      hcrossInd.integrable_mul hXint1 hZint0
    have hcrossMean : ∫ ω, X 0 ω * Z 0 ω ∂μ = 0 := by
      rw [hcrossInd.integral_fun_mul_eq_mul_integral hXint1.1 hZint0.1]
