solution:
import Mathlib

open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
open MeasureTheory

namespace ResearchLevel

noncomputable def sigmaGamma {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
  (WithLp.equiv 2 (Fin d → ℝ)).symm (fun i => Real.sign (x i) * |x i| ^ γ)

noncomputable def lpNorm {d : ℕ} (r : ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) : ℝ :=
  (∑ i, |x i| ^ r) ^ (1 / r)

noncomputable def onesNorm (p : ℝ) (d : ℕ) : ℝ := (d : ℝ) ^ (1 / p)

private lemma continuous_lpNorm_sq {d : ℕ} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    Continuous (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) => (lpNorm r x) ^ 2) := by
  apply Continuous.pow
  unfold lpNorm
  apply Continuous.rpow_const
  · exact continuous_finset_sum _ fun i _ =>
      (PiLp.continuous_apply (p := 2) (β := fun _ : Fin d => ℝ) i).abs.rpow_const
        (fun _ => Or.inr hr.le)
  · intro x
    exact Or.inr (one_div_nonneg.mpr hr.le)

private lemma sigmaGamma_apply {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (i : Fin d) : sigmaGamma γ x i = Real.sign (x i) * |x i| ^ γ := by
  rfl

private lemma inner_sigma_eq_sum {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    ⟪x, sigmaGamma γ x⟫ = ∑ i, x i * (Real.sign (x i) * |x i| ^ γ) := by
  simp [PiLp.inner_apply, sigmaGamma, RCLike.inner_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  ring

private lemma norm_sigma_sq_eq_sum {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    ‖sigmaGamma γ x‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ i, |Real.sign (x i) * |x i| ^ γ| ^ 2 := by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
  simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  congr 2

private lemma scalar_inner (x γ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) :
    x * (Real.sign x * |x| ^ γ) = |x| ^ (1 + γ) := by
  rcases lt_trichotomy x 0 with hx | rfl | hx
  · rw [Real.sign_of_neg hx, abs_of_neg hx]
    have hp : 0 < -x := neg_pos.mpr hx
    rw [show 1 + γ = γ + 1 by ring, Real.rpow_add_one hp.ne']
    ring
  · simp only [Real.sign_zero, zero_mul, abs_zero]
    rw [Real.zero_rpow]
    linarith
  · rw [Real.sign_of_pos hx, abs_of_pos hx]
    rw [show 1 + γ = γ + 1 by ring, Real.rpow_add_one hx.ne']
    ring

private lemma scalar_norm_bound (x γ : ℝ) (_hγ : 0 ≤ γ) :
    |Real.sign x * |x| ^ γ| ^ 2 ≤ |x| ^ (2 * γ) := by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · subst x
    simp only [Real.sign_zero, zero_mul, abs_zero]
    rw [show (0 : ℝ) ^ 2 = 0 by norm_num]
    exact Real.rpow_nonneg (le_refl 0) _
  · have hs : |Real.sign x| = 1 := by
      rcases Real.sign_apply_eq_of_ne_zero x hx with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
    rw [abs_mul, hs, one_mul,
      abs_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (abs_nonneg x) γ)]
    calc
      (|x| ^ γ) ^ 2 = (|x| ^ γ) ^ (2 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_two _).symm
      _ = |x| ^ (γ * 2) := (Real.rpow_mul (abs_nonneg x) γ 2).symm
      _ = |x| ^ (2 * γ) := by ring_nf
      _ ≤ |x| ^ (2 * γ) := le_rfl

private lemma sum_rpow_le_card_factor {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (q : ℝ)
    (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1) (a : Fin d → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) :
    (∑ i, a i ^ q) ≤ (d : ℝ) ^ (1 - q) * (∑ i, a i) ^ q := by
  have hdR : 0 < (d : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hw : ∑ _i : Fin d, (1 / (d : ℝ)) = 1 := by
    simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
  have hJ := (Real.concaveOn_rpow hq0 hq1).le_map_sum
    (t := Finset.univ) (w := fun _ : Fin d => 1 / (d : ℝ)) (p := a)
    (fun _ _ => by positivity) hw (fun i _ => ha i)
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hJ
  have hscaled : (1 / (d : ℝ)) * (∑ i, a i ^ q) ≤
      ((1 / (d : ℝ)) * (∑ i, a i)) ^ q := by
    simpa only [Finset.mul_sum] using hJ
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hscaled hdR.le
  have hsum_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ i, a i := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => ha i
  calc
    (∑ i, a i ^ q) = (d : ℝ) * ((1 / (d : ℝ)) * (∑ i, a i ^ q)) := by
      field_simp
    _ ≤ (d : ℝ) * (((1 / (d : ℝ)) * (∑ i, a i)) ^ q) := hmul
    _ = (d : ℝ) ^ (1 - q) * (∑ i, a i) ^ q := by
      rw [show (1 / (d : ℝ)) * (∑ i, a i) = (∑ i, a i) / (d : ℝ) by ring]
      rw [Real.div_rpow hsum_nonneg hdR.le]
      rw [Real.rpow_sub hdR 1 q, Real.rpow_one]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hdR q)]

lemma powerball_lower {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ < 1)
    (p : ℝ) (hp : p = (1 + γ) / (1 - γ)) (hd : 0 < d)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (hx : sigmaGamma γ x ≠ 0) :
    (⟪x, sigmaGamma γ x⟫) ^ 2 / ‖sigmaGamma γ x‖ ^ 2
      ≥ (lpNorm (1 + γ) x) ^ 2 / onesNorm p d := by
  let r : ℝ := 1 + γ
  let q : ℝ := 2 * γ / r
  let A : ℝ := ∑ i, |x i| ^ r
  let B : ℝ := ∑ i, |x i| ^ (2 * γ)
  have hr : 0 < r := by dsimp [r]; linarith
  have hdR : 0 < (d : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hpR : 0 < p := by
    rw [hp]
    exact div_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ q := by
    dsimp [q]
    positivity
  have hq1 : q ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp [q, r]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by linarith : 0 < 1 + γ)).2
    linarith
  have hex : ∃ i : Fin d, sigmaGamma γ x i ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    apply hx
    ext i
    exact h i
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hex
  have hxi : x i ≠ 0 := by
    intro hxi
    apply hi
    rw [sigmaGamma_apply]
    simp only [hxi, Real.sign_zero, abs_zero, zero_mul]
  have hA : 0 < A := by
    apply Finset.sum_pos'
    · intro j hj
      exact Real.rpow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) _
    · refine ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (abs_pos.mpr hxi) r⟩
  have hinner : ⟪x, sigmaGamma γ x⟫ = A := by
    rw [inner_sigma_eq_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    exact scalar_inner (x j) γ hγ0
  have hnormB : ‖sigmaGamma γ x‖ ^ 2 ≤ B := by
    rw [norm_sigma_sq_eq_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro j hj
    exact scalar_norm_bound (x j) γ hγ0
  have hB : B ≤ (d : ℝ) ^ (1 - q) * A ^ q := by
    have hJ := sum_rpow_le_card_factor hd q hq0 hq1
      (fun j : Fin d => |x j| ^ r)
      (fun j => Real.rpow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) _)
    calc
      B = ∑ j, (|x j| ^ r) ^ q := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        calc
          |x j| ^ (2 * γ) = |x j| ^ (r * q) := by
            congr 1
            dsimp [q, r]
            field_simp
          _ = (|x j| ^ r) ^ q := Real.rpow_mul (abs_nonneg (x j)) r q
      _ ≤ (d : ℝ) ^ (1 - q) * (∑ j, |x j| ^ r) ^ q := hJ
      _ = (d : ℝ) ^ (1 - q) * A ^ q := by rfl
  have hnorm : ‖sigmaGamma γ x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (d : ℝ) ^ (1 - q) * A ^ q :=
    hnormB.trans hB
  have hNpos : 0 < ‖sigmaGamma γ x‖ ^ 2 := pow_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hx) _
  have hDpos : 0 < (d : ℝ) ^ (1 / p) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hdR _
  have hexpD : 1 - q = 1 / p := by
    rw [hp]
    dsimp [q, r]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt (by linarith : 0 < 1 + γ),
      ne_of_gt (by linarith : 0 < 1 - γ)]
    ring
  have hfactor : (A ^ (1 / r)) ^ 2 * A ^ q = A ^ 2 := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_two, ← Real.rpow_mul hA.le]
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hA]
    have he : 1 / r * 2 + q = 2 := by
      dsimp [q, r]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt (by linarith : 0 < 1 + γ)]
    rw [he, Real.rpow_two]
  rw [hinner]
  change (lpNorm r x) ^ 2 / (d : ℝ) ^ (1 / p) ≤
    A ^ 2 / ‖sigmaGamma γ x‖ ^ 2
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hDpos hNpos).2
  unfold lpNorm
  change (A ^ (1 / r)) ^ 2 * ‖sigmaGamma γ x‖ ^ 2 ≤
    A ^ 2 * (d : ℝ) ^ (1 / p)
  calc
    _ ≤ (A ^ (1 / r)) ^ 2 * ((d : ℝ) ^ (1 - q) * A ^ q) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnorm (sq_nonneg _)
    _ = A ^ 2 * (d : ℝ) ^ (1 / p) := by
      rw [hexpD]
      calc
        (A ^ (1 / r)) ^ 2 * ((d : ℝ) ^ (1 / p) * A ^ q) =
            ((A ^ (1 / r)) ^ 2 * A ^ q) * (d : ℝ) ^ (1 / p) := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [hfactor]

private lemma lpNorm_sq_le_ones_mul_norm_sq {d : ℕ} (γ p : ℝ)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ < 1) (hp : p = (1 + γ) / (1 - γ))
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    (lpNorm (1 + γ) x) ^ 2 ≤ (d : ℝ) ^ (1 / p) * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
  let r : ℝ := 1 + γ
  let q : ℝ := 2 / r
  have hr : 0 < r := by dsimp [r]; linarith
  have hq : 1 ≤ q := by
    dsimp [q, r]
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (by linarith : 0 < 1 + γ)).2
    linarith
  have h := Real.rpow_sum_le_const_mul_sum_rpow_of_nonneg
    (s := Finset.univ) (f := fun i : Fin d => |x i| ^ r) hq
    (fun i hi => Real.rpow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) _)
  calc
    (lpNorm (1 + γ) x) ^ 2 = (∑ i, |x i| ^ r) ^ q := by
      unfold lpNorm
      let S : ℝ := ∑ i, |x i| ^ r
      have hS : 0 ≤ S := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ =>
        Real.rpow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) _
      calc
        (S ^ (1 / (1 + γ))) ^ 2 = (S ^ (1 / (1 + γ))) ^ (2 : ℝ) :=
          (Real.rpow_two _).symm
        _ = S ^ ((1 / (1 + γ)) * 2) :=
          (Real.rpow_mul hS (1 / (1 + γ)) 2).symm
        _ = S ^ q := by
          congr 1
          dsimp [q, r]
          ring
        _ = _ := by rfl
    _ ≤ (d : ℝ) ^ (q - 1) * ∑ i, (|x i| ^ r) ^ q := by
      simpa only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using h
    _ = (d : ℝ) ^ (1 / p) * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
      have he : q - 1 = 1 / p := by
        rw [hp]
        dsimp [q, r]
        field_simp [ne_of_gt (by linarith : 0 < 1 + γ),
          ne_of_gt (by linarith : 0 < 1 - γ)]
        ring
      rw [he, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      calc
        (|x i| ^ r) ^ q = |x i| ^ (r * q) :=
          (Real.rpow_mul (abs_nonneg (x i)) r q).symm
        _ = |x i| ^ (2 : ℝ) := by
          congr 1
          dsimp [q]
          field_simp [ne_of_gt hr]
        _ = ‖x i‖ ^ 2 := by
          rw [Real.rpow_two, Real.norm_eq_abs]

private lemma lpNorm_nonneg {d : ℕ} (r : ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    0 ≤ lpNorm r x := by
  unfold lpNorm
  exact Real.rpow_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ =>
    Real.rpow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) _) _

private lemma lpNorm_add_le {d : ℕ} {r : ℝ} (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    lpNorm r (x + y) ≤ lpNorm r x + lpNorm r y := by
  unfold lpNorm
  simpa only [Finset.mem_univ, Pi.add_apply] using
    (Real.Lp_add_le Finset.univ (fun i : Fin d => x i) (fun i => y i) hr)

private lemma normalized_lpNorm_le_norm {d : ℕ} (γ p : ℝ)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ < 1) (hp : p = (1 + γ) / (1 - γ))
    (hd : 0 < d) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    lpNorm (1 + γ) x / Real.sqrt ((d : ℝ) ^ (1 / p)) ≤ ‖x‖ := by
  have hpR : 0 < p := by
    rw [hp]
    exact div_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hdR : 0 < (d : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hD : 0 < (d : ℝ) ^ (1 / p) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hdR _
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt ((d : ℝ) ^ (1 / p)) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hD
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hs).2
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (lpNorm_nonneg _ _) (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) hs.le)).mp
  calc
    (lpNorm (1 + γ) x) ^ 2 ≤ (d : ℝ) ^ (1 / p) * ‖x‖ ^ 2 :=
      lpNorm_sq_le_ones_mul_norm_sq γ p hγ0 hγ1 hp x
    _ = (‖x‖ * Real.sqrt ((d : ℝ) ^ (1 / p))) ^ 2 := by
      rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hD.le]
      ring

private lemma scalar_descent_half (t A U V G : ℝ)
    (ht0 : 0 < t) (hth : t ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (_hU : 0 ≤ U) (hV : 0 ≤ V) (hG : 0 ≤ G)
    (hGA : G ≤ A + V) :
    -(A ^ 2) / 2 + A * (U + V) ≤
      -(1 - t) / 4 * G ^ 2 + (U ^ 2 + V ^ 2) / t := by
  have hsqG : G ^ 2 ≤ (A + V) ^ 2 :=
    (sq_le_sq₀ hG (add_nonneg hA hV)).2 hGA
  have hnegG : -(1 - t) / 4 * (A + V) ^ 2 ≤
      -(1 - t) / 4 * G ^ 2 := by
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left hsqG (by linarith)
  have hyoungU : A * U ≤ t / 4 * A ^ 2 + U ^ 2 / t := by
    rw [show t / 4 * A ^ 2 + U ^ 2 / t =
        (t ^ 2 / 4 * A ^ 2 + U ^ 2) / t by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt ht0]]
    apply (le_div_iff₀ ht0).2
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (t / 2 * A - U)]
  have hrem : 0 ≤ 1 / t - (1 - t) / 4 - ((3 - t) / 2) ^ 2 := by
    have hsecond : 0 ≤ t ^ 2 - 6 * t + 4 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg t]
    have hnum : 0 ≤ (1 - t) * (t ^ 2 - 6 * t + 4) :=
      mul_nonneg (by linarith) hsecond
    rw [show 1 / t - (1 - t) / 4 - ((3 - t) / 2) ^ 2 =
        ((1 - t) * (t ^ 2 - 6 * t + 4)) / (4 * t) by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt ht0]
      ring]
    positivity
  have hVpart :
      -(A ^ 2) / 2 + t / 4 * A ^ 2 + A * V ≤
        -(1 - t) / 4 * (A + V) ^ 2 + V ^ 2 / t := by
    apply sub_nonneg.mp
    rw [show
      (-(1 - t) / 4 * (A + V) ^ 2 + V ^ 2 / t) -
          (-(A ^ 2) / 2 + t / 4 * A ^ 2 + A * V) =
        (A / 2 - (3 - t) / 2 * V) ^ 2 +
          (1 / t - (1 - t) / 4 - ((3 - t) / 2) ^ 2) * V ^ 2 by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt ht0]
      ring]
    positivity
  calc
    -(A ^ 2) / 2 + A * (U + V) =
        (-(A ^ 2) / 2 + A * V) + A * U := by ring
    _ ≤ (-(A ^ 2) / 2 + A * V) + (t / 4 * A ^ 2 + U ^ 2 / t) := by
      gcongr
    _ ≤ (-(1 - t) / 4 * (A + V) ^ 2 + V ^ 2 / t) + U ^ 2 / t := by
      linarith
    _ ≤ -(1 - t) / 4 * G ^ 2 + (U ^ 2 + V ^ 2) / t := by
      calc
        _ ≤ (-(1 - t) / 4 * G ^ 2 + V ^ 2 / t) + U ^ 2 / t := by
          gcongr
        _ = _ := by ring

private lemma inner_sigma_pos {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (hx : sigmaGamma γ x ≠ 0) :
    0 < ⟪x, sigmaGamma γ x⟫ := by
  rw [inner_sigma_eq_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_pos'
  · intro i hi
    rw [scalar_inner (x i) γ hγ0]
    exact Real.rpow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) _
  · have hex : ∃ i : Fin d, sigmaGamma γ x i ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra h
      push_neg at h
      apply hx
      ext i
      exact h i
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hex
    have hxi : x i ≠ 0 := by
      intro hxi
      apply hi
      rw [sigmaGamma_apply]
      simp only [hxi, Real.sign_zero, abs_zero, zero_mul]
    refine ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, ?_⟩
    rw [scalar_inner (x i) γ hγ0]
    exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (abs_pos.mpr hxi) _

private lemma raw_powerball_descent {d : ℕ} (γ L : ℝ) (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
    (gradf : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (hsmooth : ∀ x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
      f x ≤ f y + ⟪gradf y, x - y⟫ + L / 2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2)
    (x ν xnext : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (η : ℝ)
    (hσ : sigmaGamma γ ν ≠ 0)
    (hη : η = ⟪ν, sigmaGamma γ ν⟫ /
      (L * ‖sigmaGamma γ ν‖ ^ 2))
    (hnext : xnext = x - η • sigmaGamma γ ν) :
    f xnext - f x ≤ (1 / L) *
      (-(⟪ν, sigmaGamma γ ν⟫ / ‖sigmaGamma γ ν‖) ^ 2 / 2 +
        (⟪ν, sigmaGamma γ ν⟫ / ‖sigmaGamma γ ν‖) * ‖ν - gradf x‖) := by
  let z := sigmaGamma γ ν
  let I : ℝ := ⟪ν, z⟫
  let N : ℝ := ‖z‖
  have hN : 0 < N := by
    dsimp [N, z]
    exact norm_pos_iff.mpr hσ
  have hI : 0 < I := by
    dsimp [I, z]
    exact inner_sigma_pos γ hγ0 ν hσ
  have hdiff : xnext - x = -η • z := by
    rw [hnext]
    module
  have hcs : ⟪ν - gradf x, z⟫ ≤ ‖ν - gradf x‖ * N := by
    exact real_inner_le_norm _ _
  have hη' : η = I / (L * N ^ 2) := by
    simpa only [I, N, z] using hη
  have hbase := hsmooth xnext x
  rw [hdiff] at hbase
  have hIz : ⟪gradf x, z⟫ = I - ⟪ν - gradf x, z⟫ := by
    dsimp [I]
    rw [inner_sub_left]
    ring
  have hform :
      ⟪gradf x, -η • z⟫ + L / 2 * ‖-η • z‖ ^ 2 =
        -(I ^ 2) / (2 * L * N ^ 2) +
          I / (L * N ^ 2) * ⟪ν - gradf x, z⟫ := by
    rw [hη']
    simp only [inner_smul_right, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, norm_neg]
    rw [show ‖z‖ = N by rfl]
    rw [abs_of_pos (div_pos hI (mul_pos hL (sq_pos_of_pos hN)))]
    rw [hIz]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hL, ne_of_gt hN]
    ring
  have hcoef : 0 ≤ I / (L * N ^ 2) := by positivity
  have hupper :
      -(I ^ 2) / (2 * L * N ^ 2) +
          I / (L * N ^ 2) * ⟪ν - gradf x, z⟫ ≤
        -(I ^ 2) / (2 * L * N ^ 2) +
          I / (L * N ^ 2) * (‖ν - gradf x‖ * N) := by
    gcongr
  calc
    f xnext - f x ≤ ⟪gradf x, -η • z⟫ + L / 2 * ‖-η • z‖ ^ 2 := by
      linarith
    _ = -(I ^ 2) / (2 * L * N ^ 2) +
          I / (L * N ^ 2) * ⟪ν - gradf x, z⟫ := hform
    _ ≤ -(I ^ 2) / (2 * L * N ^ 2) +
          I / (L * N ^ 2) * (‖ν - gradf x‖ * N) := hupper
    _ = (1 / L) * (-(I / N) ^ 2 / 2 + (I / N) * ‖ν - gradf x‖) := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hL, ne_of_gt hN]
    _ = _ := by rfl

private lemma powerball_descent_bound {d : ℕ}
    (γ p L t : ℝ) (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ < 1)
    (hp : p = (1 + γ) / (1 - γ)) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hL : 0 < L) (ht0 : 0 < t) (hth : t ≤ 1 / 2)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
    (gradf : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (hsmooth : ∀ x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
      f x ≤ f y + ⟪gradf y, x - y⟫ + L / 2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2)
    (x g ν xnext : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (η : ℝ)
    (hσ : sigmaGamma γ ν ≠ 0)
    (hη : η = ⟪ν, sigmaGamma γ ν⟫ /
      (L * ‖sigmaGamma γ ν‖ ^ 2))
    (hnext : xnext = x - η • sigmaGamma γ ν) :
    f xnext - f x ≤
      -(1 - t) / (4 * L * (d : ℝ) ^ (1 / p)) * (lpNorm (1 + γ) g) ^ 2 +
        1 / (L * t) * (‖g - gradf x‖ ^ 2 + ‖ν - g‖ ^ 2) := by
  let D : ℝ := (d : ℝ) ^ (1 / p)
  let A : ℝ := ⟪ν, sigmaGamma γ ν⟫ / ‖sigmaGamma γ ν‖
  let U : ℝ := ‖g - gradf x‖
  let V : ℝ := ‖ν - g‖
  let G : ℝ := lpNorm (1 + γ) g / Real.sqrt D
  have hpR : 0 < p := by
    rw [hp]
    exact div_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hdR : 0 < (d : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hD : 0 < D := by
    dsimp [D]
    exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hdR _
  have hsD : 0 < Real.sqrt D := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hD
  have hA : 0 < A := by
    dsimp [A]
    exact div_pos (inner_sigma_pos γ hγ0 ν hσ) (norm_pos_iff.mpr hσ)
  have hU : 0 ≤ U := by dsimp [U]; positivity
  have hV : 0 ≤ V := by dsimp [V]; positivity
  have hG : 0 ≤ G := by
    dsimp [G]
    exact div_nonneg (lpNorm_nonneg _ _) hsD.le
  have hdiff : ‖ν - gradf x‖ ≤ U + V := by
    calc
      ‖ν - gradf x‖ = ‖(ν - g) + (g - gradf x)‖ := by congr 1 <;> module
      _ ≤ ‖ν - g‖ + ‖g - gradf x‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = U + V := by dsimp [U, V]; ring
  have hnuRatio : lpNorm (1 + γ) ν / Real.sqrt D ≤ A := by
    have hpb := powerball_lower γ hγ0 hγ1 p hp hd ν hσ
    have hleft : (lpNorm (1 + γ) ν / Real.sqrt D) ^ 2 =
        (lpNorm (1 + γ) ν) ^ 2 / D := by
      rw [div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hD.le]
    have hright : A ^ 2 =
        (⟪ν, sigmaGamma γ ν⟫) ^ 2 / ‖sigmaGamma γ ν‖ ^ 2 := by
      dsimp [A]
      rw [div_pow]
    apply (sq_le_sq₀ (div_nonneg (lpNorm_nonneg _ _) hsD.le) hA.le).mp
    rw [hleft, hright]
    simpa only [D, onesNorm] using hpb
  have herrRatio : lpNorm (1 + γ) (g - ν) / Real.sqrt D ≤ ‖g - ν‖ := by
    simpa only [D] using
      normalized_lpNorm_le_norm γ p hγ0 hγ1 hp hd (g - ν)
  have hGA : G ≤ A + V := by
    have hlp : lpNorm (1 + γ) g ≤
        lpNorm (1 + γ) ν + lpNorm (1 + γ) (g - ν) := by
      calc
        lpNorm (1 + γ) g = lpNorm (1 + γ) (ν + (g - ν)) := by
          congr 2 <;> module
        _ ≤ _ := lpNorm_add_le (by linarith : 1 ≤ 1 + γ) _ _
    calc
      G ≤ (lpNorm (1 + γ) ν + lpNorm (1 + γ) (g - ν)) / Real.sqrt D :=
        (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hsD).2 hlp
      _ = lpNorm (1 + γ) ν / Real.sqrt D +
          lpNorm (1 + γ) (g - ν) / Real.sqrt D := by ring
      _ ≤ A + ‖g - ν‖ := add_le_add hnuRatio herrRatio
      _ = A + V := by dsimp [V]; rw [norm_sub_rev]
  have hscalar := scalar_descent_half t A U V G ht0 hth hA.le hU hV hG hGA
  have hraw := raw_powerball_descent γ L hγ0 hL f gradf hsmooth
    x ν xnext η hσ hη hnext
  calc
    f xnext - f x ≤ (1 / L) *
        (-(A ^ 2) / 2 + A * ‖ν - gradf x‖) := by
      simpa only [A] using hraw
    _ ≤ (1 / L) * (-(A ^ 2) / 2 + A * (U + V)) := by
      gcongr
    _ ≤ (1 / L) *
        (-(1 - t) / 4 * G ^ 2 + (U ^ 2 + V ^ 2) / t) := by
      gcongr
    _ = -(1 - t) / (4 * L * (d : ℝ) ^ (1 / p)) *
          (lpNorm (1 + γ) g) ^ 2 +
        1 / (L * t) * (‖g - gradf x‖ ^ 2 + ‖ν - g‖ ^ 2) := by
      dsimp [G, U, V, D]
      rw [div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hD.le]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hL, ne_of_gt ht0, ne_of_gt hD]
      ring

private lemma telescope_integral_bound
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    (K Sout T : ℕ) (hT : T = K * Sout) (a c : ℝ)
    (F X : ℕ → ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (fstar : ℝ)
    (hlink : ∀ s ω, F 0 (s + 1) ω = F K s ω)
    (hmin : ∀ ω, fstar ≤ F K Sout ω)
    (hXint : ∀ k s, k < K → s < Sout → Integrable (X k s) μ)
    (hDint : ∀ k s, Integrable (fun ω => F (k + 1) (s + 1) ω - F k (s + 1) ω) μ)
    (hintGap : Integrable (fun ω => F K 0 ω - fstar) μ)
    (hstep : ∀ k s,
      (∫ ω, (F (k + 1) (s + 1) ω - F k (s + 1) ω) ∂μ) ≤
        -a * (∫ ω, X k s ω ∂μ) + c) :
    a * (∫ ω, (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, X k s ω) ∂μ) ≤
      (∫ ω, (F K 0 ω - fstar) ∂μ) + (T : ℝ) * c := by
  have hXsumInt :
      (∫ ω, (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, X k s ω) ∂μ) =
        ∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, (∫ ω, X k s ω ∂μ) := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout,
          (∫ ω, (∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, X k s ω) ∂μ) := by
            apply integral_finset_sum
            intro s hs
            apply integrable_finset_sum
            intro k hk
            exact hXint k s (Finset.mem_range.mp hk) (Finset.mem_range.mp hs)
      _ = _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro s hs
        exact integral_finset_sum _ (fun k hk =>
          hXint k s (Finset.mem_range.mp hk) (Finset.mem_range.mp hs))
  let Dlt : ℕ → ℕ → Ω → ℝ := fun k s ω =>
    F (k + 1) (s + 1) ω - F k (s + 1) ω
  have hDsumInt : Integrable
      (fun ω => ∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, Dlt k s ω) μ := by
    apply integrable_finset_sum
    intro s hs
    apply integrable_finset_sum
    intro k hk
    simpa only [Dlt] using hDint k s
  have hDtelescope : ∀ ω,
      (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, Dlt k s ω) =
        F K Sout ω - F K 0 ω := by
    intro ω
    calc
      _ = ∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout,
          (F K (s + 1) ω - F 0 (s + 1) ω) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro s hs
            simpa only [Dlt] using
              (Finset.sum_range_sub (fun k => F k (s + 1) ω) K)
      _ = ∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout,
          (F K (s + 1) ω - F K s ω) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro s hs
            rw [hlink s ω]
      _ = _ := by
        simpa using (Finset.sum_range_sub (fun s => F K s ω) Sout)
  have hFinalInt : Integrable (fun ω => F K Sout ω - F K 0 ω) μ :=
    hDsumInt.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hDtelescope)
  have hDsumIntegral :
      (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
          (∫ ω, Dlt k s ω ∂μ)) =
        ∫ ω, (F K Sout ω - F K 0 ω) ∂μ := by
    calc
      _ = ∫ ω, (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout,
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, Dlt k s ω) ∂μ := by
            symm
            calc
              _ = ∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout,
                  (∫ ω, (∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, Dlt k s ω) ∂μ) := by
                    apply integral_finset_sum
                    intro s hs
                    apply integrable_finset_sum
                    intro k hk
                    simpa only [Dlt] using hDint k s
              _ = _ := by
                apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
                intro s hs
                exact integral_finset_sum _ (fun k hk => by
                  simpa only [Dlt] using hDint k s)
      _ = _ := integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hDtelescope)
  have hgapLower :
      -(∫ ω, (F K 0 ω - fstar) ∂μ) ≤
        ∫ ω, (F K Sout ω - F K 0 ω) ∂μ := by
    rw [← integral_neg]
    apply integral_mono hintGap.neg hFinalInt
    intro ω
    simp only [Pi.neg_apply]
    linarith [hmin ω]
  have hsumStep :
      (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
          (∫ ω, Dlt k s ω ∂μ)) ≤
        -a * (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
          (∫ ω, X k s ω ∂μ)) + (K * Sout : ℕ) * c := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
          (-a * (∫ ω, X k s ω ∂μ) + c) := by
            exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun s _ =>
              Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => by
                simpa only [Dlt] using hstep k s
      _ = _ := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_const,
          Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
        push_cast
        ring
  have hmaster :
      -(∫ ω, (F K 0 ω - fstar) ∂μ) ≤
        -a * (∫ ω, (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout,
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, X k s ω) ∂μ) + (T : ℝ) * c := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∫ ω, (F K Sout ω - F K 0 ω) ∂μ := hgapLower
      _ = ∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
          (∫ ω, Dlt k s ω ∂μ) := hDsumIntegral.symm
      _ ≤ -a * (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
          (∫ ω, X k s ω ∂μ)) + (K * Sout : ℕ) * c := hsumStep
      _ = -a * (∫ ω, (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout,
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, X k s ω) ∂μ) + (T : ℝ) * c := by
            rw [hXsumInt]
            rw [hT]
  linarith

theorem theorem1 {d n K Sout T b : ℕ}
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hT : T = K * Sout) (hT1 : 1 ≤ T) (hK : 0 < K) (hSout : 0 < Sout)
    (hb : 0 < b) (hbn : b ≤ n) (hd : 0 < d) (hn : 0 < n)
    (γ p L θ onesP σ2 : ℝ) (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ < 1) (hp : p = (1 + γ) / (1 - γ))
    (hL : 0 < L) (hθ0 : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ2)
    (honesP : onesP = onesNorm p d)
    (fi : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
    (gradfi : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (hsmoothi : ∀ i, ∀ x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
      ‖gradfi i x - gradfi i y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖)
    (hdiff : ∀ i, ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), HasGradientAt (fi i) (gradfi i x) x)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
    (gradf : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (hf : f = fun w => (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, fi i w)
    (hgradf : gradf = fun w => (1 / (n : ℝ)) • ∑ i, gradfi i w)
    (hsmooth : ∀ x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
      f x ≤ f y + ⟪gradf y, x - y⟫ + L / 2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2)
    (wstar : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (hmin : ∀ x, f wstar ≤ f x)
    (W gS : ℕ → ℕ → Ω → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (gSt : ℕ → ℕ → Ω → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (nu : ℕ → ℕ → Ω → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (eta : ℕ → ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (Sidx : ℕ → ℕ → Ω → Finset (Fin n))
    (hindepS : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun (ι := ℕ × ℕ)
        (m := fun _ => (⊤ : MeasurableSpace (Finset (Fin n))))
        (fun ks ω => Sidx ks.1 ks.2 ω) μ)
    (hScard : ∀ k s ω, (Sidx k s ω).card = b)
    (hgS : ∀ k s ω, gS k s ω = (1 / (b : ℝ)) • ∑ i ∈ Sidx k s ω, gradfi i (W k (s + 1) ω))
    (hgSt : ∀ k s ω, gSt k s ω = (1 / (b : ℝ)) • ∑ i ∈ Sidx k s ω, gradfi i (W K s ω))
    (hnu : ∀ k s ω, nu k s ω = gS k s ω - gSt k s ω + gradf (W K s ω))
    (heta : ∀ k s ω, eta k s ω
      = ⟪nu k s ω, sigmaGamma γ (nu k s ω)⟫ / (L * ‖sigmaGamma γ (nu k s ω)‖ ^ 2))
    (hsigmaNu : ∀ k < K, ∀ s < Sout, ∀ ω, sigmaGamma γ (nu k s ω) ≠ 0)
    (hupd : ∀ k s ω,
      W (k + 1) (s + 1) ω = W k (s + 1) ω - eta k s ω • sigmaGamma γ (nu k s ω))
    (hlink : ∀ s ω, W 0 (s + 1) ω = W K s ω)

    (hintGS : ∀ k s, Integrable (fun ω => gS k s ω) μ)
    (hintGSt : ∀ k s, Integrable (fun ω => gSt k s ω) μ)
    (hintGW : ∀ k s, Integrable (fun ω => gradf (W k (s + 1) ω)) μ)
    (hintGWt : ∀ s, Integrable (fun ω => gradf (W K s ω)) μ)
    (hunb1 : ∀ k s, ∫ ω, gS k s ω ∂μ = ∫ ω, gradf (W k (s + 1) ω) ∂μ)
    (hunb2 : ∀ k s, ∫ ω, gSt k s ω ∂μ = ∫ ω, gradf (W K s ω) ∂μ)

    (hintVar1 : ∀ k s, Integrable (fun ω => ‖gS k s ω - gradf (W k (s + 1) ω)‖ ^ 2) μ)
    (hintVar2 : ∀ k s, Integrable (fun ω => ‖gSt k s ω - gradf (W K s ω)‖ ^ 2) μ)
    (hvar1 : ∀ k s, ∫ ω, ‖gS k s ω - gradf (W k (s + 1) ω)‖ ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ σ2 / (b : ℝ))
    (hvar2 : ∀ k s, ∫ ω, ‖gSt k s ω - gradf (W K s ω)‖ ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ σ2 / (b : ℝ))
    (hvarPrim : ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
      (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, ‖gradfi i w - gradf w‖ ^ 2 ≤ σ2)
    (hintSum : Integrable (fun ω => ∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout,
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, (lpNorm (1 + γ) (gS k s ω)) ^ 2) μ)
    (hintGap : Integrable (fun ω => f (W K 0 ω) - f wstar) μ) :
    (1 / (T : ℝ)) * (∫ ω, (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout,
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, (lpNorm (1 + γ) (gS k s ω)) ^ 2) ∂μ)
      ≤ (4 * L * onesP) / ((T : ℝ) * (1 - θ))
          * (∫ ω, (f (W K 0 ω) - f wstar) ∂μ)
        + 8 * onesP * σ2 / ((b : ℝ) * θ * (1 - θ)) := by
  let X : ℕ → ℕ → Ω → ℝ := fun k s ω =>
    (lpNorm (1 + γ) (gS k s ω)) ^ 2
  let F : ℕ → ℕ → Ω → ℝ := fun k s ω => f (W k s ω)
  let t : ℝ := min θ (1 / 2)
  let a : ℝ := (1 - t) / (4 * L * onesP)
  let c : ℝ := 2 * σ2 / (L * (b : ℝ) * t)
  have hr : 0 < 1 + γ := by linarith
  have hbR : 0 < (b : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have hTR : 0 < (T : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hT1)
  have hpR : 0 < p := by
    rw [hp]
    exact div_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hones : 0 < onesP := by
    rw [honesP, onesNorm]
    exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast hd) _
  have ht0 : 0 < t := by
    dsimp [t]
    exact lt_min hθ0 (by norm_num)
  have hth : t ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    dsimp [t]
    exact min_le_right _ _
  have ht1 : t < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt hth (by norm_num)
  have ha : 0 < a := by
    dsimp [a]
    exact div_pos (sub_pos.mpr ht1) (by positivity)
  have hXnonneg : ∀ k s ω, 0 ≤ X k s ω := by
    intro k s ω
    simp only [X]
    positivity
  have hXmeas : ∀ k s, AEStronglyMeasurable (X k s) μ := by
    intro k s
    exact (continuous_lpNorm_sq hr).comp_aestronglyMeasurable
      (hintGS k s).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hXint : ∀ k s, k < K → s < Sout → Integrable (X k s) μ := by
    intro k s hk hs
    apply hintSum.mono' (hXmeas k s)
    filter_upwards with ω
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hXnonneg k s ω)]
    have hinner : X k s ω ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range K, X j s ω :=
      Finset.single_le_sum
        (fun j _ => hXnonneg j s ω) (Finset.mem_range.mpr hk)
    have houter : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range K, X j s ω) ≤
        ∑ t ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range K, X j t ω :=
      Finset.single_le_sum
        (fun t _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => hXnonneg j t ω))
        (Finset.mem_range.mpr hs)
    simpa only [X] using hinner.trans houter
  let E1 : ℕ → ℕ → Ω → ℝ := fun k s ω =>
    ‖gS k s ω - gradf (W k (s + 1) ω)‖ ^ 2
  let E2 : ℕ → ℕ → Ω → ℝ := fun k s ω =>
    ‖gSt k s ω - gradf (W K s ω)‖ ^ 2
  have hpoint : ∀ k < K, ∀ s < Sout, ∀ ω,
      F (k + 1) (s + 1) ω - F k (s + 1) ω ≤
        -a * X k s ω + (1 / (L * t)) * (E1 k s ω + E2 k s ω) := by
    intro k hk s hs ω
    have hbase := powerball_descent_bound γ p L t hγ0 hγ1 hp hd hL ht0 hth
      f gradf hsmooth (W k (s + 1) ω) (gS k s ω) (nu k s ω)
        (W (k + 1) (s + 1) ω) (eta k s ω)
        (hsigmaNu k hk s hs ω) (heta k s ω) (hupd k s ω)
    have hv : ‖nu k s ω - gS k s ω‖ ^ 2 = E2 k s ω := by
      simp only [E2]
      rw [hnu]
      rw [show gS k s ω - gSt k s ω + gradf (W K s ω) - gS k s ω =
          -(gSt k s ω - gradf (W K s ω)) by module, norm_neg]
    rw [hv] at hbase
    simp only [F, X, E1, a, honesP, onesNorm]
    ring_nf at hbase ⊢
    exact hbase
  have htotalPoint : ∀ ω,
      a * (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, X k s ω) ≤
        f (W K 0 ω) - f wstar + (1 / (L * t)) *
          (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
            (E1 k s ω + E2 k s ω)) := by
    intro ω
    have hsummed :
        (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
          (F (k + 1) (s + 1) ω - F k (s + 1) ω)) ≤
          ∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
            (-a * X k s ω + (1 / (L * t)) * (E1 k s ω + E2 k s ω)) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun s hs => Finset.sum_le_sum fun k hk =>
        hpoint k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk) s (Finset.mem_range.mp hs) ω
    have htel :
        (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
          (F (k + 1) (s + 1) ω - F k (s + 1) ω)) =
            f (W K Sout ω) - f (W K 0 ω) := by
      calc
        _ = ∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout,
            (F K (s + 1) ω - F 0 (s + 1) ω) := by
              apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
              intro s hs
              simpa using (Finset.sum_range_sub (fun k => F k (s + 1) ω) K)
        _ = ∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout,
            (F K (s + 1) ω - F K s ω) := by
              apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
              intro s hs
              simp only [F]
              rw [hlink s ω]
        _ = _ := by
          simp only [F]
          simpa using (Finset.sum_range_sub (fun s => f (W K s ω)) Sout)
    have hrhs :
        (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
          (-a * X k s ω + (1 / (L * t)) * (E1 k s ω + E2 k s ω))) =
          -a * (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, X k s ω) +
            (1 / (L * t)) * (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
              (E1 k s ω + E2 k s ω)) := by
      have hfac (r : ℝ) (E : ℕ → ℕ → Ω → ℝ) :
          (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, r * E k s ω) =
            r * (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, E k s ω) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro s hs
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      simp only [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      rw [hfac (-a) X, hfac (1 / (L * t)) E1, hfac (1 / (L * t)) E2]
    rw [htel, hrhs] at hsummed
    linarith [hmin (W K Sout ω)]
  have hEint : Integrable
      (fun ω => ∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
        (E1 k s ω + E2 k s ω)) μ := by
    apply integrable_finset_sum
    intro s hs
    apply integrable_finset_sum
    intro k hk
    have h1 : Integrable (E1 k s) μ := by simpa only [E1] using hintVar1 k s
    have h2 : Integrable (E2 k s) μ := by simpa only [E2] using hintVar2 k s
    exact h1.add h2
  have hEbound :
      (∫ ω, (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
        (E1 k s ω + E2 k s ω)) ∂μ) ≤
          (T : ℝ) * (2 * σ2 / (b : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
          (∫ ω, (E1 k s ω + E2 k s ω) ∂μ) := by
            calc
              _ = ∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout,
                  (∫ ω, (∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, (E1 k s ω + E2 k s ω)) ∂μ) := by
                    apply integral_finset_sum
                    intro s hs
                    apply integrable_finset_sum
                    intro k hk
                    have h1 : Integrable (E1 k s) μ := by
                      simpa only [E1] using hintVar1 k s
                    have h2 : Integrable (E2 k s) μ := by
                      simpa only [E2] using hintVar2 k s
                    exact h1.add h2
              _ = _ := by
                apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
                intro s hs
                exact integral_finset_sum _ (fun k hk => by
                  have h1 : Integrable (E1 k s) μ := by
                    simpa only [E1] using hintVar1 k s
                  have h2 : Integrable (E2 k s) μ := by
                    simpa only [E2] using hintVar2 k s
                  exact h1.add h2)
      _ = ∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
          ((∫ ω, E1 k s ω ∂μ) + (∫ ω, E2 k s ω ∂μ)) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro s hs
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro k hk
            rw [integral_add (by simpa only [E1] using hintVar1 k s)
              (by simpa only [E2] using hintVar2 k s)]
      _ ≤ ∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
          (σ2 / (b : ℝ) + σ2 / (b : ℝ)) := by
            exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun s _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ =>
              add_le_add (by simpa only [E1] using hvar1 k s)
                (by simpa only [E2] using hvar2 k s)
      _ = (T : ℝ) * (2 * σ2 / (b : ℝ)) := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
        rw [hT]
        push_cast
        ring
  have hleftInt : Integrable
      (fun ω => a * (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, X k s ω)) μ := by
    simpa only [X] using hintSum.const_mul a
  have hrightInt : Integrable
      (fun ω => f (W K 0 ω) - f wstar + (1 / (L * t)) *
        (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
          (E1 k s ω + E2 k s ω))) μ :=
    hintGap.add (hEint.const_mul (1 / (L * t)))
  have hintIneq := integral_mono hleftInt hrightInt htotalPoint
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_add hintGap (hEint.const_mul (1 / (L * t))),
    integral_const_mul] at hintIneq
  have hcoef : 0 ≤ 1 / (L * t) := by positivity
  have hprod :
      a * (∫ ω, (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout,
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, X k s ω) ∂μ) ≤
        (∫ ω, (f (W K 0 ω) - f wstar) ∂μ) + (T : ℝ) * c := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (∫ ω, (f (W K 0 ω) - f wstar) ∂μ) +
          (1 / (L * t)) * (∫ ω, (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout,
            ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, (E1 k s ω + E2 k s ω)) ∂μ) := hintIneq
      _ ≤ (∫ ω, (f (W K 0 ω) - f wstar) ∂μ) +
          (1 / (L * t)) * ((T : ℝ) * (2 * σ2 / (b : ℝ))) := by
            gcongr
      _ = _ := by
        dsimp [c]
        ring
  have hobj :
      (∫ ω, (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout,
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, X k s ω) ∂μ) ≤
        ((∫ ω, (f (W K 0 ω) - f wstar) ∂μ) + (T : ℝ) * c) / a := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ ha).2
    simpa only [F, mul_comm] using hprod
  change (1 / (T : ℝ)) *
      (∫ ω, (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, X k s ω) ∂μ) ≤ _
  calc
    _ ≤ (1 / (T : ℝ)) *
        (((∫ ω, (f (W K 0 ω) - f wstar) ∂μ) + (T : ℝ) * c) / a) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hobj (by positivity)
    _ = (4 * L * onesP) / ((T : ℝ) * (1 - t))
          * (∫ ω, (f (W K 0 ω) - f wstar) ∂μ)
        + 8 * onesP * σ2 / ((b : ℝ) * t * (1 - t)) := by
      dsimp [a, c]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hTR, ne_of_gt hL, ne_of_gt hbR, ne_of_gt ht0,
        ne_of_gt hones, ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr ht1)]
      ring
    _ ≤ (4 * L * onesP) / ((T : ℝ) * (1 - θ))
          * (∫ ω, (f (W K 0 ω) - f wstar) ∂μ)
        + 8 * onesP * σ2 / ((b : ℝ) * θ * (1 - θ)) := by
      have hgap0 : 0 ≤ ∫ ω, (f (W K 0 ω) - f wstar) ∂μ := by
        apply integral_nonneg
        intro ω
        exact sub_nonneg.mpr (hmin (W K 0 ω))
      have htθ : t ≤ θ := by
        dsimp [t]
        exact min_le_left _ _
      have hprodcomp : θ * (1 - θ) ≤ t * (1 - t) := by
        by_cases hθh : θ ≤ 1 / 2
        · have htEq : t = θ := by
            dsimp [t]
            exact min_eq_left hθh
          rw [htEq]
        · have hhalfθ : 1 / 2 ≤ θ := le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hθh)
          have htEq : t = 1 / 2 := by
            dsimp [t]
            exact min_eq_right hhalfθ
          rw [htEq]
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (θ - 1 / 2)]
      have hdent : 0 < (T : ℝ) * (1 - t) :=
        mul_pos hTR (sub_pos.mpr ht1)
      have hdenθ : 0 < (T : ℝ) * (1 - θ) :=
        mul_pos hTR (sub_pos.mpr hθ1)
      have hgapcoef :
          (4 * L * onesP) / ((T : ℝ) * (1 - t)) ≤
            (4 * L * onesP) / ((T : ℝ) * (1 - θ)) := by
        apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hdent hdenθ).2
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hTR.le
      have hdentv : 0 < (b : ℝ) * t * (1 - t) :=
        mul_pos (mul_pos hbR ht0) (sub_pos.mpr ht1)
      have hdenθv : 0 < (b : ℝ) * θ * (1 - θ) :=
        mul_pos (mul_pos hbR hθ0) (sub_pos.mpr hθ1)
      have hdencomp :
          (b : ℝ) * θ * (1 - θ) ≤ (b : ℝ) * t * (1 - t) := by
        calc
          (b : ℝ) * θ * (1 - θ) = (b : ℝ) * (θ * (1 - θ)) := by ring
          _ ≤ (b : ℝ) * (t * (1 - t)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprodcomp hbR.le
          _ = (b : ℝ) * t * (1 - t) := by ring
      have hvarcoef :
          8 * onesP * σ2 / ((b : ℝ) * t * (1 - t)) ≤
            8 * onesP * σ2 / ((b : ℝ) * θ * (1 - θ)) := by
        apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hdentv hdenθv).2
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdencomp (by positivity)
      exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hgapcoef hgap0) hvarcoef

theorem theorem2 {d n K Sout T b bH : ℕ}
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hT : T = K * Sout) (hT1 : 1 ≤ T) (hK : 0 < K) (hSout : 0 < Sout)
    (hb : 0 < b) (hbHpos : 0 < bH) (hbn : b ≤ n) (hbHn : bH ≤ n) (hd : 0 < d) (hn : 0 < n)
    (γ p L θ onesP σ2 ζ τ : ℝ) (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ < 1) (hp : p = (1 + γ) / (1 - γ))
    (hL : 0 < L) (hθ0 : 0 < θ) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ2)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hζ : 0 < ζ)
    (hbH2 : 0 < 2 * (bH : ℝ) - θ * (bH : ℝ) - 1)
    (honesP : onesP = onesNorm p d)
    (fi : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
    (gradfi : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (hsmoothi : ∀ i, ∀ x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
      ‖gradfi i x - gradfi i y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖)
    (hdiff : ∀ i, ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), HasGradientAt (fi i) (gradfi i x) x)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
    (gradf : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (hf : f = fun w => (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, fi i w)
    (hgradf : gradf = fun w => (1 / (n : ℝ)) • ∑ i, gradfi i w)
    (hsmooth : ∀ x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
      f x ≤ f y + ⟪gradf y, x - y⟫ + L / 2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2)
    (wstar : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (hmin : ∀ x, f wstar ≤ f x)
    (W gS : ℕ → ℕ → Ω → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (gSt : ℕ → ℕ → Ω → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (nu : ℕ → ℕ → Ω → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (eta : ℕ → ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (Sidx : ℕ → ℕ → Ω → Finset (Fin n)) (SidxH : ℕ → ℕ → Ω → Finset (Fin n))
    (hindepS : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun (ι := ℕ × ℕ)
        (m := fun _ => (⊤ : MeasurableSpace (Finset (Fin n))))
        (fun ks ω => Sidx ks.1 ks.2 ω) μ)
    (hindepSH : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun (ι := ℕ × ℕ)
        (m := fun _ => (⊤ : MeasurableSpace (Finset (Fin n))))
        (fun ks ω => SidxH ks.1 ks.2 ω) μ)
    (gSHa gSHb : ℕ → ℕ → Ω → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (hScard : ∀ k s ω, (Sidx k s ω).card = b)
    (hSHcard : ∀ k s ω, (SidxH k s ω).card = bH)
    (hgS : ∀ k s ω, gS k s ω = (1 / (b : ℝ)) • ∑ i ∈ Sidx k s ω, gradfi i (W k (s + 1) ω))
    (hgSt : ∀ k s ω, gSt k s ω = (1 / (b : ℝ)) • ∑ i ∈ Sidx k s ω, gradfi i (W K s ω))
    (hgSHa : ∀ k s ω, gSHa k s ω = (1 / (bH : ℝ)) • ∑ i ∈ SidxH k s ω, gradfi i (W (k + 1) (s + 1) ω))
    (hgSHb : ∀ k s ω, gSHb k s ω = (1 / (bH : ℝ)) • ∑ i ∈ SidxH k s ω, gradfi i (W k (s + 1) ω))
    (hnu : ∀ k s ω, nu k s ω = gS k s ω - gSt k s ω + gradf (W K s ω))
    (eta0 : ℝ) (heta0 : ∀ s ω, eta 0 s ω = eta0)
    (heta : ∀ k s ω, eta (k + 1) s ω = (ζ / bH)
      * (‖W (k + 1) (s + 1) ω - W k (s + 1) ω‖ ^ 2
        / (⟪W (k + 1) (s + 1) ω - W k (s + 1) ω,
              sigmaGamma γ (gSHa k s ω) - sigmaGamma γ (gSHb k s ω)⟫
            + τ * ‖W (k + 1) (s + 1) ω - W k (s + 1) ω‖ ^ 2)))
    (hupd : ∀ k s ω,
      W (k + 1) (s + 1) ω = W k (s + 1) ω - eta k s ω • sigmaGamma γ (nu k s ω))
    (hlink : ∀ s ω, W 0 (s + 1) ω = W K s ω)

    (hΔW : ∀ k < K, ∀ s < Sout, ∀ ω, W (k + 1) (s + 1) ω - W k (s + 1) ω ≠ 0)

    (hbb_ip : ∀ k s ω, 0 ≤ ⟪W (k + 1) (s + 1) ω - W k (s + 1) ω,
        sigmaGamma γ (gSHa k s ω) - sigmaGamma γ (gSHb k s ω)⟫)
    (hLem1 : ∀ k s ω, eta k s ω ≤ ζ / ((bH : ℝ) * τ))

    (hintGS : ∀ k s, Integrable (fun ω => gS k s ω) μ)
    (hintGSt : ∀ k s, Integrable (fun ω => gSt k s ω) μ)
    (hintGW : ∀ k s, Integrable (fun ω => gradf (W k (s + 1) ω)) μ)
    (hintGWt : ∀ s, Integrable (fun ω => gradf (W K s ω)) μ)
    (hunb1 : ∀ k s, ∫ ω, gS k s ω ∂μ = ∫ ω, gradf (W k (s + 1) ω) ∂μ)
    (hunb2 : ∀ k s, ∫ ω, gSt k s ω ∂μ = ∫ ω, gradf (W K s ω) ∂μ)

    (hintVar1 : ∀ k s, Integrable (fun ω => ‖gS k s ω - gradf (W k (s + 1) ω)‖ ^ 2) μ)
    (hintVar2 : ∀ k s, Integrable (fun ω => ‖gSt k s ω - gradf (W K s ω)‖ ^ 2) μ)
    (hvar1 : ∀ k s, ∫ ω, ‖gS k s ω - gradf (W k (s + 1) ω)‖ ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ σ2 / (b : ℝ))
    (hvar2 : ∀ k s, ∫ ω, ‖gSt k s ω - gradf (W K s ω)‖ ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ σ2 / (b : ℝ))
    (hvarPrim : ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
      (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, ‖gradfi i w - gradf w‖ ^ 2 ≤ σ2)
    (hintSum : Integrable (fun ω => ∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout,
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, (lpNorm (1 + γ) (gS k s ω)) ^ 2) μ)
    (hintGap : Integrable (fun ω => f (W K 0 ω) - f wstar) μ)
    (hintFgap : ∀ k s,
      Integrable (fun ω => f (W (k + 1) (s + 1) ω) - f (W k (s + 1) ω)) μ)
    (hdescent : ∀ k < K, ∀ s < Sout,
      (∫ ω, (f (W (k + 1) (s + 1) ω) - f (W k (s + 1) ω)) ∂μ)
        ≤ -((2 * (bH : ℝ) - θ * (bH : ℝ) - 1) / (4 * L * (bH : ℝ) ^ 2 * onesP))
              * (∫ ω, (lpNorm (1 + γ) (gS k s ω)) ^ 2 ∂μ)
          + 2 * σ2 / (L * (bH : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) * θ)) :
    (1 / (T : ℝ)) * (∫ ω, (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout,
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, (lpNorm (1 + γ) (gS k s ω)) ^ 2) ∂μ)
      ≤ 4 * (bH : ℝ) ^ 2 * L * onesP
          / ((2 * (bH : ℝ) - θ * (bH : ℝ) - 1) * (T : ℝ))
          * (∫ ω, (f (W K 0 ω) - f wstar) ∂μ)
        + 8 * σ2 * (bH : ℝ) * onesP
          / ((2 * (bH : ℝ) - θ * (bH : ℝ) - 1) * (b : ℝ) * θ) := by
  let X : ℕ → ℕ → Ω → ℝ := fun k s ω =>
    (lpNorm (1 + γ) (gS k s ω)) ^ 2
  let Dlt : ℕ → ℕ → Ω → ℝ := fun k s ω =>
    f (W (k + 1) (s + 1) ω) - f (W k (s + 1) ω)
  let a : ℝ :=
    (2 * (bH : ℝ) - θ * (bH : ℝ) - 1) /
      (4 * L * (bH : ℝ) ^ 2 * onesP)
  let c : ℝ := 2 * σ2 / (L * (bH : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) * θ)

  have hr : 0 < 1 + γ := by linarith
  have hbR : 0 < (b : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have hbHR : 0 < (bH : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hbHpos
  have hTR : 0 < (T : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hT1)
  have hpR : 0 < p := by
    rw [hp]
    exact div_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hones : 0 < onesP := by
    rw [honesP, onesNorm]
    exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast hd) _
  have ha : 0 < a := by
    dsimp [a]
    positivity

  have hXnonneg : ∀ k s ω, 0 ≤ X k s ω := by
    intro k s ω
    simp only [X]
    positivity
  have hXmeas : ∀ k s, AEStronglyMeasurable (X k s) μ := by
    intro k s
    exact (continuous_lpNorm_sq hr).comp_aestronglyMeasurable
      (hintGS k s).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hXint : ∀ k s, k < K → s < Sout → Integrable (X k s) μ := by
    intro k s hk hs
    apply hintSum.mono' (hXmeas k s)
    filter_upwards with ω
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hXnonneg k s ω)]
    have hinner : X k s ω ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range K, X j s ω :=
      Finset.single_le_sum
        (fun j _ => hXnonneg j s ω) (Finset.mem_range.mpr hk)
    have houter : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range K, X j s ω) ≤
        ∑ t ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range K, X j t ω :=
      Finset.single_le_sum
        (fun t _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => hXnonneg j t ω))
        (Finset.mem_range.mpr hs)
    simpa only [X] using hinner.trans houter

  have hXsumInt :
      (∫ ω, (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, X k s ω) ∂μ) =
        ∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, (∫ ω, X k s ω ∂μ) := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout,
          (∫ ω, (∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, X k s ω) ∂μ) := by
            apply integral_finset_sum
            intro s hs
            apply integrable_finset_sum
            intro k hk
            exact hXint k s (Finset.mem_range.mp hk) (Finset.mem_range.mp hs)
      _ = _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro s hs
        exact integral_finset_sum _ (fun k hk =>
          hXint k s (Finset.mem_range.mp hk) (Finset.mem_range.mp hs))

  have hDint : ∀ k s, Integrable (Dlt k s) μ := by
    intro k s
    simpa only [Dlt] using hintFgap k s
  have hDsumInt : Integrable
      (fun ω => ∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, Dlt k s ω) μ := by
    apply integrable_finset_sum
    intro s hs
    apply integrable_finset_sum
    intro k hk
    exact hDint k s
  have hDtelescope : ∀ ω,
      (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, Dlt k s ω) =
        f (W K Sout ω) - f (W K 0 ω) := by
    intro ω
    calc
      _ = ∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout,
          (f (W K (s + 1) ω) - f (W 0 (s + 1) ω)) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro s hs
            simpa only [Dlt] using
              (Finset.sum_range_sub (fun k => f (W k (s + 1) ω)) K)
      _ = ∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout,
          (f (W K (s + 1) ω) - f (W K s ω)) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro s hs
            rw [hlink s ω]
      _ = _ := by
        simpa using (Finset.sum_range_sub (fun s => f (W K s ω)) Sout)
  have hFinalInt : Integrable
      (fun ω => f (W K Sout ω) - f (W K 0 ω)) μ :=
    hDsumInt.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hDtelescope)
  have hDsumIntegral :
      (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
          (∫ ω, Dlt k s ω ∂μ)) =
        ∫ ω, (f (W K Sout ω) - f (W K 0 ω)) ∂μ := by
    calc
      _ = ∫ ω, (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout,
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, Dlt k s ω) ∂μ := by
            symm
            calc
              _ = ∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout,
                  (∫ ω, (∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, Dlt k s ω) ∂μ) := by
                    apply integral_finset_sum
                    intro s hs
                    exact integrable_finset_sum _ (fun k hk => hDint k s)
              _ = _ := by
                apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
                intro s hs
                exact integral_finset_sum _ (fun k hk => hDint k s)
      _ = _ := integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hDtelescope)

  have hgapLower :
      -(∫ ω, (f (W K 0 ω) - f wstar) ∂μ) ≤
        ∫ ω, (f (W K Sout ω) - f (W K 0 ω)) ∂μ := by
    rw [← integral_neg]
    apply integral_mono hintGap.neg hFinalInt
    intro ω
    simp only [Pi.neg_apply]
    have hm := hmin (W K Sout ω)
    linarith

  have hstep : ∀ k < K, ∀ s < Sout,
      (∫ ω, Dlt k s ω ∂μ) ≤ -a * (∫ ω, X k s ω ∂μ) + c := by
    intro k hk s hs
    simpa only [Dlt, X, a, c] using hdescent k hk s hs
  have hsumStep :
      (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
          (∫ ω, Dlt k s ω ∂μ)) ≤
        -a * (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
          (∫ ω, X k s ω ∂μ)) + (K * Sout : ℕ) * c := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
          (-a * (∫ ω, X k s ω ∂μ) + c) := by
            exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun s hs =>
              Finset.sum_le_sum fun k hk =>
                hstep k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk) s (Finset.mem_range.mp hs)
      _ = _ := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_const,
          Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
        push_cast
        ring

  have hmaster :
      -(∫ ω, (f (W K 0 ω) - f wstar) ∂μ) ≤
        -a * (∫ ω, (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout,
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, X k s ω) ∂μ) + (T : ℝ) * c := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∫ ω, (f (W K Sout ω) - f (W K 0 ω)) ∂μ := hgapLower
      _ = ∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
          (∫ ω, Dlt k s ω ∂μ) := hDsumIntegral.symm
      _ ≤ -a * (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
          (∫ ω, X k s ω ∂μ)) + (K * Sout : ℕ) * c := hsumStep
      _ = -a * (∫ ω, (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout,
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, X k s ω) ∂μ) + (T : ℝ) * c := by
            rw [hXsumInt]
            rw [hT]
  have hprod :
      a * (∫ ω, (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout,
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, X k s ω) ∂μ) ≤
        (∫ ω, (f (W K 0 ω) - f wstar) ∂μ) + (T : ℝ) * c := by
    linarith
  have hobj :
      (∫ ω, (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout,
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, X k s ω) ∂μ) ≤
        ((∫ ω, (f (W K 0 ω) - f wstar) ∂μ) + (T : ℝ) * c) / a :=
    (le_div_iff₀ ha).2 (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hprod)

  change (1 / (T : ℝ)) *
      (∫ ω, (∑ s ∈ Finset.range Sout, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, X k s ω) ∂μ) ≤ _
  calc
    _ ≤ (1 / (T : ℝ)) *
        (((∫ ω, (f (W K 0 ω) - f wstar) ∂μ) + (T : ℝ) * c) / a) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hobj (by positivity)
    _ = 4 * (bH : ℝ) ^ 2 * L * onesP
          / ((2 * (bH : ℝ) - θ * (bH : ℝ) - 1) * (T : ℝ))
          * (∫ ω, (f (W K 0 ω) - f wstar) ∂μ)
        + 8 * σ2 * (bH : ℝ) * onesP
          / ((2 * (bH : ℝ) - θ * (bH : ℝ) - 1) * (b : ℝ) * θ) := by
      dsimp [a, c]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hTR, ne_of_gt hL, ne_of_gt hbHR, ne_of_gt hbR,
        ne_of_gt hθ0, ne_of_gt hones, ne_of_gt hbH2]
      ring

end ResearchLevel

targets.label: Theorem 8
targets.statement:
Theorem 8 Let $\mathcal{L}:\mathcal{Y}\times\mathcal{A}\longrightarrow[0,1]$ be a loss function, and let $\phi:\mathcal{Y}\times\mathcal{A}\longrightarrow[0,1]$ be a cost function that dominates it. Take $F$ to be a class of functions from $\mathcal{X}$ into $\mathcal{A}$, and suppose the pairs $(X_{i},Y_{i})_{i=1}^{n}$ are drawn independently from the probability measure $P$. Then for every integer $n$ and every $0 < \delta < 1$, the following holds with probability no less than $1 - \delta$ over samples of size $n$: for all $f$ in $F$,

$$
\mathbf{E}\mathcal{L}(Y,f(X))\leq\hat{\mathbf{E}}_{n}\phi(Y,f(X))+R_{n}(\tilde{\phi}\circ F)+\sqrt{\frac{8\ln(2/\delta)}{n}},
$$

with $\tilde{\phi}\circ F=\{(x,y)\mapsto\phi(y,f(x))-\phi(y,0):f\in F\}$

targets.label: Theorem 5(b)
targets.statement:
Theorem 5 Suppose $P$ is a probability distribution on $\mathcal{X}\times \left\{\pm 1 \right\}$, $F$ is a collection of functions on $\mathcal{X}$ taking values in $\{\pm 1 \}$, and the training sample $(X_{i},Y_{i})_{i=1}^{n}$ is distributed according to $P^{n}$

(b) With probability no less than $1 - \delta$, the following inequality holds simultaneously for all $f$ in $F$:

$$
P(Y\neq f(X))\leq\hat{P}_{n}(Y\neq f(X))+\frac{R_{n}(F)}{2}+\sqrt{\frac{\ln(1/\delta)}{2n}}.
$$

targets.label: Theorem 11 (second bound)
targets.statement:
Theorem 11 Suppose $F$ is a class of functions taking values in $[-1, 1]$. Then for every integer $n$,

$$
P\left\{\Big|R_{n}(F)-\hat{R}_{n}(F)\Big|\geq\epsilon\right\}\leq 2\exp\left(\frac{-\epsilon^{2}n}{8}\right),
$$

In that framework there are an input space $\mathcal{X}$, an action space $\mathcal{A}$ and an output space $\mathcal{Y}$. The $n$ training examples $(X_{1},Y_{1}),\dots,(X_{n},Y_{n})$ are drawn independently from a probability measure $P$ on $\mathcal{X}\times \mathcal{Y}$. A loss function $\mathcal{L}:\mathcal{Y}\times\mathcal{A}\longrightarrow[0,1]$ is given, where $\mathcal{L}(y,a)$ measures the cost incurred by choosing action $a \in{\mathcal{A}}$ when the outcome turns out to be $y \in \mathcal{Y}$. Learning seeks a function $f$ from $\mathcal{X}$ to ${\mathcal{A}}$ whose expected loss $\mathbf{E}{\mathcal{L}}(Y,f(X))$ is as small as possible.

Definition 2 Suppose $\mu$ is a probability distribution on a set $\mathcal{X}$, and $X_{1},\ldots,X_{n}$ are independent samples drawn from $\mu$. Let $F$ be a class of functions from $\mathcal{X}$ to $\mathbb{R}$. The maximum discrepancy of $F$ is the random variable

$$
\hat{D}_{n}(F)=\operatorname*{sup}_{f\in F}\left(\frac{2}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n/2}f(X_{i})-\frac{2}{n}\sum_{i=n/2+1}^{n}f(X_{i})\right).
$$

Its expectation, the expected maximum discrepancy of $F$, is written $D_{n}(F)=\mathbf{E}\hat{D}_{n}(F)$

Next, let

$$
{\hat{R}}_{n}(F)=\mathbf{E}[\operatorname*{sup}_{f\in F}|{\frac{2}{n}}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\sigma_{i}f(X_{i})| |X_{1},\ldots,X_{n}]\ ,
$$

with $\sigma_{1},\ldots,\sigma_{n}$ independent random variables, each uniform on $\{\pm 1 \}$. The Rademacher complexity of $F$ is then $R_{n}(F)=\mathbf{E}\hat{R}_{n}(F)$. In the same way, let

$$
\hat{G}_{n}(F)=\mathbf{E}[\operatorname*{sup}_{f\in F}|{\frac{2}{n}}\sum_{i=1}^{n}g_{i}f(X_{i})| |X_{1},\ldots,X_{n}]\ ,
$$

with $g_{1},\ldots,g_{n}$ independent Gaussian $N(0,1)$ random variables. The Gaussian complexity of $F$ is $G_{n}(F)=\mathbf{E}\hat{G}_{n}(F)$

      (∀ k, k ≠ j → x k = y k) → |g x - g y| ≤ c)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (t * (g x -
      ∫ y, g y ∂(Measure.pi (fun _ => μ))))) (Measure.pi (fun _ => μ)) ∧
    (∫ x, Real.exp (t * (g x - ∫ y, g y ∂(Measure.pi (fun _ => μ))))
        ∂(Measure.pi (fun _ => μ))) ≤
      Real.exp ((n : ℝ) * c ^ 2 * t ^ 2 / 8) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      let a : ℝ := g default
      have hgconst : g = fun _ => a := by
        funext x
        exact congrArg g (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
      rw [hgconst]
      simp
  | succ n ih =>
      let ν : Measure (Fin n → Ω) := Measure.pi (fun _ => μ)
      let e : (Fin (n + 1) → Ω) ≃ᵐ Ω × (Fin n → Ω) :=
        MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => Ω) 0
      let G : Ω × (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun p => g (Fin.cons p.1 p.2)
      let h : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun z => ∫ x, G (x, z) ∂μ
      have he : MeasurePreserving e (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => μ)) (μ.prod ν) := by
        simpa [e, ν] using
          (measurePreserving_piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => μ) 0)
      have heinv : ⇑e.symm = fun p => Fin.cons p.1 p.2 := by
        funext p
        ext k
        refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun l => ?_) k <;>
          simp [e, MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_symm_apply]
      have hGmeas : Measurable G := by
        rw [show G = g ∘ e.symm by funext p; simp [G, heinv]]
        exact hgmeas.comp e.symm.measurable
      have hGint : Integrable G (μ.prod ν) := by
        rw [show G = g ∘ e.symm by funext p; simp [G, heinv]]
        exact (he.symm.integrable_comp hgmeas.aestronglyMeasurable).2 hgint
      have hhmeas : Measurable h := by
        exact hGmeas.stronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_left'.measurable
      have hhint : Integrable h ν := by
        exact hGint.integral_prod_right
      have hGcoord0 (x y : Ω) (z : Fin n → Ω) : |G (x, z) - G (y, z)| ≤ c := by
        apply hdiff _ _ 0
        intro k hk
        cases k using Fin.cases with
        | zero => exact (hk rfl).elim
        | succ l => simp [G]
      have hGsecint (z : Fin n → Ω) : Integrable (fun x => G (x, z)) μ := by
        let x0 : Ω := Classical.choice inferInstance
        apply Integrable.of_mem_Icc (G (x0, z) - c) (G (x0, z) + c)
        · exact (hGmeas.comp (by fun_prop)).aemeasurable
        · apply ae_of_all
          intro x
          have hx := abs_le.mp (hGcoord0 x x0 z)
          constructor <;> linarith
      have hGtail (x : Ω) (z z' : Fin n → Ω) (j : Fin n)
          (hzz' : ∀ k, k ≠ j → z k = z' k) : |G (x, z) - G (x, z')| ≤ c := by
        apply hdiff _ _ (Fin.succ j)
        intro k hk
        cases k using Fin.cases with
        | zero => simp [G]
        | succ l =>
          simp only [G, Fin.cons_succ]
          apply hzz' l
          intro hlj
          exact hk (congrArg Fin.succ hlj)
      have hhdiff : ∀ (z z' : Fin n → Ω) (j : Fin n),
          (∀ k, k ≠ j → z k = z' k) → |h z - h z'| ≤ c := by
        intro z z' j hzz'
        rw [show h z - h z' = ∫ x, (G (x, z) - G (x, z')) ∂μ by
          exact (integral_sub (hGsecint z) (hGsecint z')).symm]
        have hb := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
          (μ := μ) (f := fun x => G (x, z) - G (x, z'))
          (ae_of_all _ fun x => by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hGtail x z z' j hzz')
        simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hb
      have hi := ih h hhmeas hhint hhdiff
      have hcenter (x : Ω) (z : Fin n → Ω) : |G (x, z) - h z| ≤ c := by
        rw [show G (x, z) - h z = ∫ y, (G (x, z) - G (y, z)) ∂μ by
          rw [integral_sub (integrable_const _) (hGsecint z)]
          simp [h]]
        have hb := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
          (μ := μ) (f := fun y => G (x, z) - G (y, z))
          (ae_of_all _ fun y => by
            simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hGcoord0 x y z)
        simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hb
      let A : Ω × (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ :=
        fun p => Real.exp (t * (G p - h p.2))
      let B : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ :=
        fun z => Real.exp (t * (h z - ∫ z', h z' ∂ν))
      let C : Ω × (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun p => A p * B p.2
      have hAmeas : Measurable A := by
        dsimp [A]
        fun_prop
      have hBmeas : Measurable B := by
        dsimp [B]
        fun_prop
      have hBint : Integrable B ν := by
        simpa [B, ν] using hi.1
      have hAbound (p : Ω × (Fin n → Ω)) :
          A p ≤ Real.exp (|t| * c) := by
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        calc
          t * (G p - h p.2) ≤ |t * (G p - h p.2)| := le_abs_self _
          _ = |t| * |G p - h p.2| := abs_mul _ _
          _ ≤ |t| * c := by gcongr; exact hcenter p.1 p.2
      have hCmeas : Measurable C := by
        dsimp [C]
        fun_prop
      have hCint : Integrable C (μ.prod ν) := by
        apply Integrable.mono ((hBint.comp_snd μ).const_mul (Real.exp (|t| * c)))
          hCmeas.aestronglyMeasurable
        apply ae_of_all
        intro p
        simp only [C, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_exp]
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (Real.exp_nonneg _)]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hAbound p) (abs_nonneg _)
      have hAsection (z : Fin n → Ω) :
          ∫ x, A (x, z) ∂μ ≤ Real.exp (c ^ 2 * t ^ 2 / 8) := by
        simpa [A, h] using
          bartlett_centered_mgf μ (fun x => G (x, z))
            (hGmeas.comp (by fun_prop)) (hGsecint z) c hc
            (fun x y => hGcoord0 x y z) t ht
      have hmean_prod : ∫ p, G p ∂(μ.prod ν) = ∫ z, h z ∂ν := by
        simpa [h] using integral_prod_symm G hGint
      have hmean_orig :
          (∫ x, g x ∂(Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => μ))) =
            ∫ p, G p ∂(μ.prod ν) := by
        have hm := he.symm.integral_comp' g
        simpa [G, heinv] using hm.symm
      have hcomp :
          (fun x => Real.exp (t * (g x -
            ∫ y, g y ∂(Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => μ))))) ∘ e.symm = C := by
        funext p
        rw [hmean_orig, hmean_prod]
        simp only [Function.comp_apply, heinv]
        change Real.exp (t * (G p - ∫ z, h z ∂ν)) = A p * B p.2
        rw [← Real.exp_add]
        congr 1
        ring
      have hresult_int : Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (t * (g x -
          ∫ y, g y ∂(Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => μ)))))
          (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => μ)) := by
        apply (he.symm.integrable_comp (by fun_prop)).mp
        rw [hcomp]
        exact hCint
      refine ⟨hresult_int, ?_⟩
      have horig_eq :
          (∫ x, Real.exp (t * (g x -
              ∫ y, g y ∂(Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => μ))))
              ∂(Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => μ))) =
            ∫ p, C p ∂(μ.prod ν) := by
        rw [← hcomp]
        exact (he.symm.integral_comp' _).symm
      rw [horig_eq]
      calc
        (∫ p, C p ∂(μ.prod ν)) = ∫ z, ∫ x, C (x, z) ∂μ ∂ν :=
          integral_prod_symm C hCint
        _ ≤ ∫ z, Real.exp (c ^ 2 * t ^ 2 / 8) * B z ∂ν := by
          apply integral_mono hCint.integral_prod_right
            (hBint.const_mul (Real.exp (c ^ 2 * t ^ 2 / 8)))
          intro z
          change (∫ x, C (x, z) ∂μ) ≤ Real.exp (c ^ 2 * t ^ 2 / 8) * B z
          rw [show (∫ x, C (x, z) ∂μ) = (∫ x, A (x, z) ∂μ) * B z by
            simp only [C]
            exact integral_mul_const (μ := μ) (B z) (fun x : Ω => A (x, z))]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hAsection z) (Real.exp_nonneg _)
        _ = Real.exp (c ^ 2 * t ^ 2 / 8) * ∫ z, B z ∂ν :=
          integral_const_mul _ _
        _ ≤ Real.exp (c ^ 2 * t ^ 2 / 8) *
            Real.exp ((n : ℝ) * c ^ 2 * t ^ 2 / 8) := by
          gcongr
          simpa [B, ν] using hi.2
        _ = Real.exp (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * c ^ 2 * t ^ 2 / 8) := by
          rw [← Real.exp_add]
          congr 1
          push_cast
          ring

private theorem bartlett_mcdiarmid_pi {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (g : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ) (hgmeas : Measurable g)
    (hgint : Integrable g (Measure.pi (fun _ => μ)))
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hdiff : ∀ (x y : Fin n → Ω) (j : Fin n),
      (∀ k, k ≠ j → x k = y k) → |g x - g y| ≤ c)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => μ)).real
        {x | g x - ∫ y, g y ∂(Measure.pi (fun _ => μ)) ≥ ε} ≤
      Real.exp (-2 * ε ^ 2 / ((n : ℝ) * c ^ 2)) := by
  let s : ℝ := 4 * ε / ((n : ℝ) * c ^ 2)
  have hs : 0 < s := by positivity
  have hm := bartlett_mgf_pi μ n g hgmeas hgint c hc.le hdiff s hs
  calc
    (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => μ)).real
        {x | g x - ∫ y, g y ∂(Measure.pi (fun _ => μ)) ≥ ε} ≤
        Real.exp (-s * ε) * ProbabilityTheory.mgf
          (fun x => g x - ∫ y, g y ∂(Measure.pi (fun _ => μ)))
          (Measure.pi (fun _ => μ)) s := by
      exact ProbabilityTheory.measure_ge_le_exp_mul_mgf ε hs.le hm.1
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-s * ε) *
        Real.exp ((n : ℝ) * c ^ 2 * s ^ 2 / 8) := by
      rw [ProbabilityTheory.mgf]
      gcongr
      exact hm.2
    _ = Real.exp (-2 * ε ^ 2 / ((n : ℝ) * c ^ 2)) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      congr 1
      dsimp [s]
      have hn0 : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt hn
      field_simp
      ring

private lemma bartlett_iSup_lipschitz {ι : Type*} [Nonempty ι]
    (a b : ι → ℝ) (ha : BddAbove (Set.range a)) (hb : BddAbove (Set.range b))
    (c : ℝ) (h : ∀ i, |a i - b i| ≤ c) :
    |(⨆ i, a i) - ⨆ i, b i| ≤ c := by
  have hab : (⨆ i, a i) ≤ (⨆ i, b i) + c := by
    refine ciSup_le fun i => ?_
    have hi := (abs_le.mp (h i)).2
    have hib := le_ciSup hb i
    linarith
  have hba : (⨆ i, b i) ≤ (⨆ i, a i) + c := by
    refine ciSup_le fun i => ?_
    have hi := (abs_le.mp (h i)).1
    have hia := le_ciSup ha i
    linarith
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor <;> linarith

private lemma bartlett_sign_abs {n : ℕ} (σ : Signs n) (k : Fin n) :
    |(σ k : ℝ)| = 1 := by
  have hk := (σ k).property
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hk
  rcases hk with hk | hk <;> simp [hk]

private lemma bartlett_inner_bddAbove {𝒮 : Type*} {ι : Type*}
    (n : ℕ) (F : ι → 𝒮 → ℝ) (hF : ∀ i s, F i s ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (S : Fin n → 𝒮) (σ : Signs n) :
    BddAbove (Set.range fun i =>
      |(2 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * F i (S k)|) := by
  classical
  refine ⟨|2 / (n : ℝ)| * (n : ℝ), ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  change |(2 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * F i (S k)| ≤
    |2 / (n : ℝ)| * (n : ℝ)
  rw [abs_mul]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (abs_nonneg _)
  calc
    |∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * F i (S k)| ≤
        ∑ k : Fin n, |(σ k : ℝ) * F i (S k)| :=
      Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _k : Fin n, (1 : ℝ) := by
      gcongr with k
      rw [abs_mul, bartlett_sign_abs, one_mul]
      exact abs_le.mpr (hF i (S k))
    _ = (n : ℝ) := by simp

private def bartlett_signSwap {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (s : ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ)) : Ω × Ω ≃ᵐ Ω × Ω :=
  if (s : ℤ) = 1 then MeasurableEquiv.refl _ else MeasurableEquiv.prodComm

private lemma bartlett_signSwap_diff {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (s : ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ)) (p : Ω × Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    f (bartlett_signSwap s p).2 - f (bartlett_signSwap s p).1 =
      (s : ℝ) * (f p.2 - f p.1) := by
  have hs := s.property
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hs
  rcases hs with hs | hs
  · simpa [bartlett_signSwap, hs, MeasurableEquiv.prodComm,
      Equiv.prodComm] using
      (show f p.1 - f p.2 = (-1 : ℝ) * (f p.2 - f p.1) by ring)
  · simp [bartlett_signSwap, hs]

private lemma bartlett_signSwap_measurePreserving {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [SigmaFinite μ] (s : ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ)) :
    MeasurePreserving (bartlett_signSwap s) (μ.prod μ) (μ.prod μ) := by
  have hs := s.property
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hs
  rcases hs with hs | hs
  · simpa [bartlett_signSwap, hs] using
      (Measure.measurePreserving_swap (μ := μ) (ν := μ))
  · simpa [bartlett_signSwap, hs] using MeasurePreserving.id (μ.prod μ)

private def bartlett_signSwapPi {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {n : ℕ}
    (σ : Signs n) : (Fin n → Ω × Ω) ≃ᵐ (Fin n → Ω × Ω) :=
  MeasurableEquiv.piCongrRight (fun k => bartlett_signSwap (σ k))

private lemma bartlett_signSwapPi_measurePreserving {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [SigmaFinite μ] {n : ℕ} (σ : Signs n) :
    MeasurePreserving (bartlett_signSwapPi σ)
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => μ.prod μ))
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => μ.prod μ)) := by
  let e : (Fin n → Ω × Ω) ≃ᵐ (Fin n → Ω × Ω) :=
    bartlett_signSwapPi (Ω := Ω) σ
  letI (k : Fin n) : SigmaFinite
      ((μ.prod μ).map (bartlett_signSwap (σ k))) :=
    (bartlett_signSwap (σ k)).sigmaFinite_map
  refine ⟨e.measurable, ?_⟩
  change (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => μ.prod μ)).map
      (fun z k => bartlett_signSwap (σ k) (z k)) = _
  rw [Measure.pi_map_pi (fun k =>
    (bartlett_signSwap (σ k)).measurable.aemeasurable)]
  congr 1
  funext k
  exact (bartlett_signSwap_measurePreserving μ (σ k)).map_eq

private lemma bartlett_signSwapPi_sum_diff {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {n : ℕ} (σ : Signs n) (z : Fin n → Ω × Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    (∑ k : Fin n, f ((bartlett_signSwapPi σ z) k).2) -
        (∑ k : Fin n, f ((bartlett_signSwapPi σ z) k).1) =
      ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * (f (z k).2 - f (z k).1) := by
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  change f (bartlett_signSwap (σ k) (z k)).2 -
      f (bartlett_signSwap (σ k) (z k)).1 = _
  exact bartlett_signSwap_diff (σ k) (z k) f

private lemma bartlett_integral_mem_Icc {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hfmeas : Measurable f) (hf : ∀ x, f x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂μ) ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
  have hfint : Integrable f μ :=
    Integrable.of_mem_Icc (-1) 1 hfmeas.aemeasurable (ae_of_all _ hf)
  constructor
  · simpa using integral_mono (μ := μ) (integrable_const (-1 : ℝ)) hfint
      (fun x => (hf x).1)
  · simpa using integral_mono (μ := μ) hfint (integrable_const (1 : ℝ))
      (fun x => (hf x).2)

private lemma bartlett_empirical_mem_Icc {Ω : Type*} (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (S : Fin n → Ω) :
    (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k : Fin n, f (S k) ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
  have hnR : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hinv : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ := (inv_pos.mpr hnR).le
  constructor
  · calc
      (-1 : ℝ) = (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ _k : Fin n, (-1 : ℝ) := by
        simp [ne_of_gt hnR]
      _ ≤ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k : Fin n, f (S k) := by
        gcongr with k
        exact (hf (S k)).1
  · calc
      (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k : Fin n, f (S k) ≤
          (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ _k : Fin n, (1 : ℝ) := by
        gcongr with k
        exact (hf (S k)).2
      _ = 1 := by simp [ne_of_gt hnR]

private lemma bartlett_empirical_change_le {Ω : Type*} (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (S S' : Fin n → Ω) (j : Fin n) (hSS' : ∀ k, k ≠ j → S k = S' k) :
    |(n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k : Fin n, f (S k) -
      (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k : Fin n, f (S' k)| ≤ 2 / (n : ℝ) := by
  have hnR : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hsum :
      (∑ k : Fin n, f (S k)) - ∑ k : Fin n, f (S' k) =
        f (S j) - f (S' j) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_single j
    · intro k _ hkj
      rw [hSS' k hkj]
      simp
    · simp
  rw [← mul_sub, hsum, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hnR.le)]
  have hd : |f (S j) - f (S' j)| ≤ 2 := by
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith [(hf (S j)).1, (hf (S j)).2,
      (hf (S' j)).1, (hf (S' j)).2]
  calc
    (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * |f (S j) - f (S' j)| ≤ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * 2 := by gcongr
    _ = 2 / (n : ℝ) := by ring

private lemma bartlett_empirical01_change_le {Ω : Type*} (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (S S' : Fin n → Ω) (j : Fin n) (hSS' : ∀ k, k ≠ j → S k = S' k) :
    |(n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k : Fin n, f (S k) -
      (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k : Fin n, f (S' k)| ≤ 1 / (n : ℝ) := by
  have hnR : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hsum :
      (∑ k : Fin n, f (S k)) - ∑ k : Fin n, f (S' k) =
        f (S j) - f (S' j) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_single j
    · intro k _ hkj
      rw [hSS' k hkj]
      simp
    · simp
  rw [← mul_sub, hsum, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hnR.le)]
  have hd : |f (S j) - f (S' j)| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith [(hf (S j)).1, (hf (S j)).2,
      (hf (S' j)).1, (hf (S' j)).2]
  simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd (inv_nonneg.mpr hnR.le)

private lemma bartlett_iSup_sub_mem_Icc {ι : Type*} [Nonempty ι]
    (a b : ι → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (hb : ∀ i, b i ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    (⨆ i, a i - b i) ∈ Set.Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2 := by
  have hBdd : BddAbove (Set.range fun i => a i - b i) := by
    refine ⟨2, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    linarith [(ha i).2, (hb i).1]
  constructor
  · let i : ι := Classical.choice inferInstance
    have hi := le_ciSup hBdd i
    dsimp [i] at hi
    linarith [(ha i).1, (hb i).2]
  · refine ciSup_le fun i => ?_
    linarith [(ha i).2, (hb i).1]

private theorem bartlett_symmetrization_affine
    {Ω : Type*} {ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Nonempty ι] [Countable ι]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (f q : ι → Ω → ℝ)
    (hfmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (f i))
    (hf : ∀ i x, f i x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)

  classical

  have hdevint : Integrable dev ν := by

    fun_prop

        intro k _

        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl

  have hDBdd (p : (Fin n → Ω) × (Fin n → Ω)) :

    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩

  let H : (Fin n → Ω × Ω) → ℝ := fun z =>

  have hep : MeasurePreserving ep ρ (ν.prod ν) := by

    rfl

    rw [← hcompHD]

  have hsign (z : Fin n → Ω × Ω) (σ : Signs n) :

    dsimp [H]
    refine ciSup_le fun i => ?_
    let U : ℝ := (2 / (n : ℝ)) *
      ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * q i (z k).2
    let V : ℝ := (2 / (n : ℝ)) *
      ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * q i (z k).1

            ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * q i (z k).1) := by

      simp_rw [mul_sub, show ∀ k : Fin n,
        (σ k : ℝ) * (a * q i (z k).2) =
          a * ((σ k : ℝ) * q i (z k).2) by intro k; ring,
        show ∀ k : Fin n,
        (σ k : ℝ) * (a * q i (z k).1) =
          a * ((σ k : ℝ) * q i (z k).1) by intro k; ring]
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    have hterm :

      have hreplace :

            ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) *
              (a * (q i (z k).2 - q i (z k).1)) := by

        intro k _

      dsimp [U, V]
      ring
    rw [hterm]
    have hU : |U| ≤

      exact le_ciSup

    have hV : |V| ≤

      _ = |a| / 2 * |U - V| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_div]; norm_num
      _ ≤ |a| / 2 * (|U| + |V|) := by

  letI : Nonempty (Signs n) :=

    rw [← hc]

    have heσ := bartlett_signSwapPi_measurePreserving μ σ

  have hAvgInt : Integrable Avg ρ := by
    dsimp [Avg]
    exact (integrable_finset_sum Finset.univ fun σ _ => hHswap_int σ).const_mul _
  have hH_eq_Avg : (∫ z, H z ∂ρ) = ∫ z, Avg z ∂ρ := by
    calc

          ∑ _σ : Signs n, ∫ z, H z ∂ρ := by
        simp [ne_of_gt hmpos]
      _ = (Fintype.card (Signs n) : ℝ)⁻¹ *

        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro σ _
        exact (hHswap_eq σ).symm
      _ = ∫ z, Avg z ∂ρ := by

        dsimp [Avg]
        rw [integral_const_mul, integral_finset_sum]
        intro σ _

    |a| / 2 *
      (paperEmpRad n q (fun k => (z k).2) +
        paperEmpRad n q (fun k => (z k).1))
  have hAvg_le_R (z : Fin n → Ω × Ω) : Avg z ≤ R z := by
    let Ay : Signs n → ℝ := fun σ =>

    let Ax : Signs n → ℝ := fun σ =>
      ⨆ i, |(2 / (n : ℝ)) *
        ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * q i (z k).1|

        ∑ σ : Signs n, H (bartlett_signSwapPi σ z) ≤
      |a| / 2 *
        ((Fintype.card (Signs n) : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ σ : Signs n, Ay σ +
          (Fintype.card (Signs n) : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ σ : Signs n, Ax σ)
    calc
      (Fintype.card (Signs n) : ℝ)⁻¹ *

          ∑ σ : Signs n, (|a| / 2 * (Ay σ + Ax σ)) := by

      _ = |a| / 2 *
          ((Fintype.card (Signs n) : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ σ : Signs n, Ay σ +

        simp_rw [mul_add]
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum]
        ring

  have hRint : Integrable R ρ := by
    rw [← hRcomp]

    simp
  have hfst : (∫ p, rad p.1 ∂(ν.prod ν)) = ∫ S, rad S ∂ν := by

    simp
  have hRp_integral : (∫ p, Rp p ∂(ν.prod ν)) =

    dsimp [Rp]
    rw [integral_const_mul,
      integral_add (hradint.comp_snd ν) (hradint.comp_fst ν), hsnd, hfst]
    ring
  have hR_integral : (∫ z, R z ∂ρ) = |a| * ∫ S, rad S ∂ν := by
    rw [← hRcomp]
    change (∫ z, Rp (ep z) ∂ρ) = _
    rw [hep.integral_comp' Rp, hRp_integral]
  calc
    (∫ z, H z ∂ρ) = ∫ z, Avg z ∂ρ := hH_eq_Avg
    _ ≤ ∫ z, R z ∂ρ := integral_mono hAvgInt hRint hAvg_le_R
    _ = |a| * ∫ S, rad S ∂ν := hR_integral

theorem thm8 {Ω : Type u} {𝒳 : Type*} {𝒱 : Type*} {𝒜 : Type*} {ι : Type v}
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Zero 𝒜] [Nonempty ι] [Countable ι]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → 𝒳) (Y : Ω → 𝒱)
    (L φ : 𝒱 → 𝒜 → ℝ)
    (hL01 : ∀ y a, L y a ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hφ01 : ∀ y a, φ y a ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hdom : ∀ y a, L y a ≤ φ y a)
    (F : ι → 𝒳 → 𝒜)
    (hLmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun ω => L (Y ω) (F i (X ω))))
    (hφmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun ω => φ (Y ω) (F i (X ω))))
    (hφ0meas : Measurable (fun ω => φ (Y ω) 0))
    (n : ℕ)
    (hRadInt : Integrable
      (fun ω : Fin n → Ω =>
        paperEmpRad n (centeredClass φ F) (fun k => (X (ω k), Y (ω k))))
      (Measure.pi (fun _ => μ)))
    (hDevMeas : Measurable
      (fun ω : Fin n → Ω =>
        ⨆ i : ι, ((∫ ω' : Ω, centeredClass φ F i (X ω', Y ω') ∂μ)
          - ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k : Fin n, centeredClass φ F i (X (ω k), Y (ω k))))))
    (hn : 0 < n) (δ : ℝ) (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) :
    1 - δ ≤
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => μ)).real
        {ω : Fin n → Ω |
          ∀ i, expectedLoss μ X Y L (F i) ≤
            empiricalCost n X Y φ (F i) ω
            + paperRad n (centeredClass φ F) μ (fun ω' => (X ω', Y ω'))
            + Real.sqrt (8 * Real.log (2 / δ) / n)} := by
  classical
  letI : Nonempty Ω := Measure.nonempty_of_neZero μ
  let ν : Measure (Fin n → Ω) := Measure.pi (fun _ => μ)
  let f : ι → Ω → ℝ := fun i ω =>
    centeredClass φ F i (X ω, Y ω)
  let f0 : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => φ (Y ω) 0
  let emp : ι → (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun i S =>
    (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k : Fin n, f i (S k)
  let emp0 : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun S =>
    (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k : Fin n, f0 (S k)
  let g : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun S =>
    ⨆ i, (∫ x, f i x ∂μ) - emp i S
  let b : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun S => (∫ x, f0 x ∂μ) - emp0 S
  let R : ℝ := paperRad n (centeredClass φ F) μ
    (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω))
  have hfmeas (i : ι) : Measurable (f i) := by
    exact (hφmeas i).sub hφ0meas
  have hf (i : ι) (ω : Ω) : f i ω ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
    dsimp [f, centeredClass]
    rcases hφ01 (Y ω) (F i (X ω)) with ⟨hlo, hhi⟩
    rcases hφ01 (Y ω) 0 with ⟨h0lo, h0hi⟩
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hf0 (ω : Ω) : f0 ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := hφ01 _ _
  have hf0meas : Measurable f0 := by simpa [f0] using hφ0meas
  have hsymm : (∫ S, g S ∂ν) ≤ R := by
    have h := bartlett_symmetrization_affine μ n hn f f hfmeas hf hf 1
      (by intro i x y; ring)
      (by simpa [g, emp, f] using hDevMeas)
      (by simpa [ν, f] using hRadInt)
    simpa [g, emp, ν, R, f, Function.id_def] using h
  have hmean (i : ι) : (∫ x, f i x ∂μ) ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 :=
    bartlett_integral_mem_Icc μ (f i) (hfmeas i) (hf i)
  have hemp (i : ι) (S : Fin n → Ω) : emp i S ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 :=
    bartlett_empirical_mem_Icc n hn (f i) (hf i) S
  have hgmem (S : Fin n → Ω) : g S ∈ Set.Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2 := by
    exact bartlett_iSup_sub_mem_Icc
      (fun i => ∫ x, f i x ∂μ) (fun i => emp i S) hmean (fun i => hemp i S)
  have hgmeas : Measurable g := by
    simpa [g, emp, f] using hDevMeas
  have hgint : Integrable g ν :=
    Integrable.of_mem_Icc (-2) 2 hgmeas.aemeasurable (ae_of_all _ hgmem)
  have hgBdd (S : Fin n → Ω) :
      BddAbove (Set.range fun i => (∫ x, f i x ∂μ) - emp i S) := by
    refine ⟨2, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    linarith [(hmean i).2, (hemp i S).1]
  have hgchange : ∀ (S S' : Fin n → Ω) (j : Fin n),
      (∀ k, k ≠ j → S k = S' k) → |g S - g S'| ≤ 2 / (n : ℝ) := by
    intro S S' j hSS'
    apply bartlett_iSup_lipschitz
      (fun i => (∫ x, f i x ∂μ) - emp i S)
      (fun i => (∫ x, f i x ∂μ) - emp i S')
      (hgBdd S) (hgBdd S') (2 / (n : ℝ))
    intro i
    rw [show ((∫ x, f i x ∂μ) - emp i S) -
        ((∫ x, f i x ∂μ) - emp i S') = -(emp i S - emp i S') by ring,
      abs_neg]
    exact bartlett_empirical_change_le n hn (f i) (hf i) S S' j hSS'
  have hf0int : Integrable f0 μ :=
    Integrable.of_mem_Icc 0 1 hf0meas.aemeasurable (ae_of_all _ hf0)
  have hmean0 : (∫ x, f0 x ∂μ) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    constructor
    · simpa using integral_mono (μ := μ) (integrable_const (0 : ℝ)) hf0int
        (fun x => (hf0 x).1)
    · simpa using integral_mono (μ := μ) hf0int (integrable_const (1 : ℝ))
        (fun x => (hf0 x).2)
  have hemp0 (S : Fin n → Ω) : emp0 S ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    have hnR : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
    have hinv : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ := (inv_pos.mpr hnR).le
    constructor
    · exact mul_nonneg hinv (Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => (hf0 (S k)).1)
    · calc
        emp0 S ≤ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ _k : Fin n, (1 : ℝ) := by
          dsimp [emp0]
          gcongr with k
          exact (hf0 (S k)).2
