  have hbmeas : Measurable b := by
    dsimp [b, emp0]
    exact measurable_const.sub
      (((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).measurable_sum fun k _ =>
        hf0meas.comp (measurable_pi_apply k)).const_mul _)
  have hbmem (S : Fin n → Ω) : b S ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
    dsimp [b]
    constructor <;> linarith [hmean0.1, hmean0.2, (hemp0 S).1, (hemp0 S).2]
  have hbint : Integrable b ν :=
    Integrable.of_mem_Icc (-1) 1 hbmeas.aemeasurable (ae_of_all _ hbmem)
  have hbchange : ∀ (S S' : Fin n → Ω) (j : Fin n),
      (∀ k, k ≠ j → S k = S' k) → |b S - b S'| ≤ 1 / (n : ℝ) := by
    intro S S' j hSS'
    rw [show b S - b S' = -(emp0 S - emp0 S') by simp [b], abs_neg]
    exact bartlett_empirical01_change_le n hn f0 hf0 S S' j hSS'
  let ℓ : ℝ := Real.log (2 / δ)
  let ε : ℝ := Real.sqrt (2 * ℓ / n)
  let T : ℝ := Real.sqrt (8 * ℓ / n)
  have hratio : 1 < (2 / δ : ℝ) := by
    have : δ < 2 := lt_trans hδ1 (by norm_num)
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ hδ0]
    simpa using this
  have hℓ : 0 < ℓ := Real.log_pos hratio
  have hε : 0 < ε := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by positivity)
  have hεsq : ε ^ 2 = 2 * ℓ / n := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hTsq : T ^ 2 = 8 * ℓ / n := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hT : T = 2 * ε := by
    have hT0 : 0 ≤ T := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have hε0 : 0 ≤ ε := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have hsquares : T ^ 2 = 4 * ε ^ 2 := by
      calc
        T ^ 2 = 8 * ℓ / n := hTsq
        _ = 4 * (2 * ℓ / n) := by ring
        _ = 4 * ε ^ 2 := by rw [hεsq]
    nlinarith
  have htailg : ν.real {S | g S - ∫ T, g T ∂ν ≥ ε} ≤ δ / 2 := by
    have hc : 0 < 2 / (n : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hmc := bartlett_mcdiarmid_pi μ n hn g hgmeas hgint
      (2 / (n : ℝ)) hc hgchange ε hε
    have hexp : -2 * ε ^ 2 / ((n : ℝ) * (2 / (n : ℝ)) ^ 2) = -ℓ := by
      rw [hεsq]
      have hn0 : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt hn
      field_simp
    rw [hexp] at hmc
    calc
      _ ≤ Real.exp (-ℓ) := hmc
      _ = δ / 2 := by
        rw [Real.exp_neg]
        dsimp [ℓ]
        rw [Real.exp_log (by positivity : 0 < (2 / δ : ℝ))]
        field_simp
  have htailb : ν.real {S | b S - ∫ T, b T ∂ν ≥ ε} ≤ δ / 2 := by

    have hmc := bartlett_mcdiarmid_pi μ n hn b hbmeas hbint

    have hexp : -2 * ε ^ 2 / ((n : ℝ) * (1 / (n : ℝ)) ^ 2) = -4 * ℓ := by
      rw [hεsq]
      have hn0 : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt hn
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [hexp] at hmc
    calc
      _ ≤ Real.exp (-4 * ℓ) := hmc
      _ ≤ Real.exp (-ℓ) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
      _ = δ / 2 := by
        rw [Real.exp_neg]
        dsimp [ℓ]
        rw [Real.exp_log (by positivity : 0 < (2 / δ : ℝ))]
        field_simp
  let A : Set (Fin n → Ω) := {S | g S - ∫ T, g T ∂ν ≥ ε}
  let B : Set (Fin n → Ω) := {S | b S - ∫ T, b T ∂ν ≥ ε}

    apply (measurableSet_Ici.preimage (hgmeas.sub_const _)).union

  have hbad : ν.real (A ∪ B) ≤ δ := by
    calc
      ν.real (A ∪ B) ≤ ν.real A + ν.real B := measureReal_union_le _ _
      _ ≤ δ / 2 + δ / 2 := add_le_add (by simpa [A] using htailg)

  have hcomp : 1 - δ ≤ ν.real (A ∪ B)ᶜ := by
    rw [measureReal_compl hABmeas, probReal_univ]
    linarith
  apply hcomp.trans
  apply measureReal_mono ?_ (measure_ne_top ν _)
  intro S hS
  rw [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_union] at hS
  push_neg at hS
  rcases hS with ⟨hSg, hSb⟩
  intro i
  have hgi : (∫ x, f i x ∂μ) - emp i S ≤ g S :=
    le_ciSup (hgBdd S) i
  have hSg' : g S - (∫ T, g T ∂ν) < ε := by
    simpa [A, not_le] using hSg
  have hgdev : g S < (∫ T, g T ∂ν) + ε := by linarith
  have hbmean : (∫ T, b T ∂ν) = 0 := by
    have hemp0int : Integrable emp0 ν := by
      exact Integrable.of_mem_Icc 0 1
        ((((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).measurable_sum fun k _ =>

        (ae_of_all _ hemp0)
    have hmean_emp0 : (∫ x, f0 x ∂μ) = ∫ S, emp0 S ∂ν := by
      symm
      calc
        (∫ S, emp0 S ∂ν) =
            (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∫ S, ∑ k : Fin n, f0 (S k) ∂ν := integral_const_mul _ _
        _ = (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k : Fin n, ∫ S, f0 (S k) ∂ν := by
          rw [integral_finset_sum]
          intro k _
          simpa [ν] using integrable_comp_eval
            (μ := fun _ : Fin n => μ) (i := k) hf0int

          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro k _

            (μ := fun _ : Fin n => μ) (i := k) hf0meas.aestronglyMeasurable
        _ = ∫ x, f0 x ∂μ := by
          have hn0 : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt hn

    rw [show b = fun S => (∫ x, f0 x ∂μ) - emp0 S by rfl,

    simp

    simpa [B, not_le] using hSb

  change (∫ x, f0 x ∂μ) - emp0 S < ε at hbdev
  have hEL : expectedLoss μ X Y L (F i) ≤ ∫ x, φ (Y x) (F i (X x)) ∂μ := by
    apply integral_mono
    · exact Integrable.of_mem_Icc 0 1 (hLmeas i).aemeasurable
        (ae_of_all _ fun x => hL01 _ _)
    · exact Integrable.of_mem_Icc 0 1 (hφmeas i).aemeasurable
        (ae_of_all _ fun x => hφ01 _ _)
    · exact fun x => hdom _ _
  have hcenter_int : (∫ x, φ (Y x) (F i (X x)) ∂μ) =
      (∫ x, f i x ∂μ) + ∫ x, f0 x ∂μ := by
    have hcint : Integrable (f i) μ :=
      Integrable.of_mem_Icc (-1) 1 (hfmeas i).aemeasurable (ae_of_all _ fun x => hf i x)
    rw [show (fun x => φ (Y x) (F i (X x))) = fun x => f i x + f0 x by
      funext x; simp [f, f0, centeredClass]]
    exact integral_add hcint hf0int
  have hemp_decomp : empiricalCost n X Y φ (F i) S = emp i S + emp0 S := by
    dsimp [empiricalCost, emp, emp0, f, f0, centeredClass]
    rw [← mul_add, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    ring
  have hRmean : (∫ T, g T ∂ν) ≤ R := hsymm
  dsimp only [expectedLoss] at hEL
  rw [hcenter_int] at hEL
  rw [hemp_decomp]
  change (∫ ω, L (Y ω) (F i (X ω)) ∂μ) ≤ _
  change _ ≤ _ + R + Real.sqrt (8 * Real.log (2 / δ) / n)
  change _ ≤ _ + R + T
  rw [hT]
  linarith

private lemma bartlett_sign_mul_mem (x y : ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ)) :
    (x : ℤ) * (y : ℤ) ∈ ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ) := by
  have hx := x.property
  have hy := y.property
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hx hy ⊢
  rcases hx with hx | hx <;> rcases hy with hy | hy <;> simp [hx, hy]

private lemma bartlett_sign_sq (x : ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ)) :
    (x : ℤ) * (x : ℤ) = 1 := by
  have hx := x.property
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hx
  rcases hx with hx | hx <;> simp [hx]

private def bartlett_signMul {n : ℕ} (τ σ : Signs n) : Signs n :=
  fun k => ⟨(τ k : ℤ) * (σ k : ℤ), bartlett_sign_mul_mem (τ k) (σ k)⟩

private def bartlett_signMulEquiv {n : ℕ} (τ : Signs n) : Signs n ≃ Signs n where
  toFun := bartlett_signMul τ
  invFun := bartlett_signMul τ
  left_inv σ := by
    funext k
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (τ k : ℤ) * ((τ k : ℤ) * (σ k : ℤ)) = (σ k : ℤ)
    rw [← mul_assoc, bartlett_sign_sq, one_mul]
  right_inv σ := by
    funext k
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (τ k : ℤ) * ((τ k : ℤ) * (σ k : ℤ)) = (σ k : ℤ)
    rw [← mul_assoc, bartlett_sign_sq, one_mul]

private def bartlett_realSigns {n : ℕ} (y : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hy : ∀ k, y k ∈ ({-1, 1} : Set ℝ)) : Signs n :=
  fun k => if h : y k = -1 then ⟨-1, by simp⟩ else ⟨1, by simp⟩

private lemma bartlett_realSigns_coe {n : ℕ} (y : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hy : ∀ k, y k ∈ ({-1, 1} : Set ℝ)) (k : Fin n) :
    ((bartlett_realSigns y hy k : ℤ) : ℝ) = y k := by
  have hk := hy k
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hk
  rcases hk with hk | hk
  · simp [bartlett_realSigns, hk]
  · norm_num [bartlett_realSigns, hk]

private lemma paperEmpRad_mul_labels {𝒳 : Type*} {ι : Type*} [Nonempty ι]
    (n : ℕ) (F : ι → 𝒳 → ℝ) (S : Fin n → 𝒳) (y : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hy : ∀ k, y k ∈ ({-1, 1} : Set ℝ)) :
    paperEmpRad n (fun i (p : 𝒳 × ℝ) => p.2 * F i p.1)
        (fun k => (S k, y k)) = paperEmpRad n F S := by
  classical
  let τ : Signs n := bartlett_realSigns y hy
  let e : Signs n ≃ Signs n := bartlett_signMulEquiv τ
  unfold paperEmpRad
  congr 1
  calc
    (∑ σ : Signs n, ⨆ i,
        |(2 / (n : ℝ)) *
          ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * (y k * F i (S k))|) =
      ∑ σ : Signs n, ⨆ i,
        |(2 / (n : ℝ)) *
          ∑ k : Fin n, ((e σ) k : ℝ) * F i (S k)| := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro σ _
        congr 1
        funext i
        congr 2
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro k _
        dsimp [e, bartlett_signMulEquiv, bartlett_signMul, τ]
        rw [Int.cast_mul, bartlett_realSigns_coe y hy k]
        ring
    _ = ∑ σ : Signs n, ⨆ i,
        |(2 / (n : ℝ)) *
          ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * F i (S k)| :=
      e.sum_comp (fun σ : Signs n => ⨆ i,
        |(2 / (n : ℝ)) *
          ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * F i (S k)|)

private lemma bartlett_zeroOne_eq (y a : ℝ)
    (hy : y ∈ ({-1, 1} : Set ℝ)) (ha : a ∈ ({-1, 1} : Set ℝ)) :
    zeroOneLoss y a = (1 - y * a) / 2 := by
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy ha
  rcases hy with hy | hy <;> rcases ha with ha | ha <;>
    norm_num [zeroOneLoss, hy, ha]

theorem theorem5b_rademacher_bound {Ω : Type u} {𝒳 : Type*} {ι : Type v}
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Nonempty ι] [Countable ι]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → 𝒳) (Y : Ω → ℝ)
    (hY : ∀ ω, Y ω ∈ ({-1, 1} : Set ℝ))
    (F : ι → 𝒳 → ℝ) (hF : ∀ i x, F i x ∈ ({-1, 1} : Set ℝ))
    (hLmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun ω => zeroOneLoss (Y ω) (F i (X ω))))
    (n : ℕ)
    (hRadInt : Integrable
      (fun ω : Fin n → Ω => paperEmpRad n F (fun k => X (ω k)))
      (Measure.pi (fun _ => μ)))
    (hn : 0 < n) (δ : ℝ) (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
    (hEvt : MeasurableSet
      {ω : Fin n → Ω |
        ∀ i, expectedLoss μ X Y zeroOneLoss (F i) ≤
          empiricalCost n X Y zeroOneLoss (F i) ω
          + paperRad n F μ X / 2
          + Real.sqrt (Real.log (1 / δ) / (2 * n))}) :
    1 - δ ≤
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => μ)).real
        {ω : Fin n → Ω |
          ∀ i, expectedLoss μ X Y zeroOneLoss (F i) ≤
            empiricalCost n X Y zeroOneLoss (F i) ω
            + paperRad n F μ X / 2
            + Real.sqrt (Real.log (1 / δ) / (2 * n))} := by
  classical
  letI : Nonempty Ω := Measure.nonempty_of_neZero μ
  let ν : Measure (Fin n → Ω) := Measure.pi (fun _ => μ)
  let f : ι → Ω → ℝ := fun i ω => zeroOneLoss (Y ω) (F i (X ω))
  let q : ι → Ω → ℝ := fun i ω => Y ω * F i (X ω)
  let emp : ι → (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun i S =>
    (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k : Fin n, f i (S k)
  let g : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun S =>
    ⨆ i, (∫ x, f i x ∂μ) - emp i S
  let R : ℝ := paperRad n F μ X
  have hfmeas (i : ι) : Measurable (f i) := by simpa [f] using hLmeas i
  have hf01 (i : ι) (ω : Ω) : f i ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    dsimp [f, zeroOneLoss]
    split <;> simp
  have hf (i : ι) (ω : Ω) : f i ω ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
    rcases hf01 i ω with ⟨hlo, hhi⟩
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hq (i : ι) (ω : Ω) : q i ω ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
    have hy := hY ω
    have ha := hF i (X ω)
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy ha
    rcases hy with hy | hy <;> rcases ha with ha | ha <;>
      simp [q, hy, ha]
  have haff (i : ι) (x y : Ω) :
      f i x - f i y = (-1 / 2 : ℝ) * (q i x - q i y) := by
    rw [show f i x = (1 - q i x) / 2 by
      simpa [f, q] using bartlett_zeroOne_eq (Y x) (F i (X x)) (hY x) (hF i (X x)),
      show f i y = (1 - q i y) / 2 by
      simpa [f, q] using bartlett_zeroOne_eq (Y y) (F i (X y)) (hY y) (hF i (X y))]
    ring
  have hrad_eq (S : Fin n → Ω) :
      paperEmpRad n q S = paperEmpRad n F (fun k => X (S k)) := by
    have h := paperEmpRad_mul_labels n F (fun k => X (S k))
      (fun k => Y (S k)) (fun k => hY (S k))
    simpa [q] using h
  have hqRadInt : Integrable (fun S : Fin n → Ω => paperEmpRad n q S) ν := by
    rw [show (fun S : Fin n → Ω => paperEmpRad n q S) =
        fun S => paperEmpRad n F (fun k => X (S k)) by
      funext S; exact hrad_eq S]
    simpa [ν] using hRadInt
  have hqRad : paperRad n q μ id = R := by
    unfold paperRad
    rw [show (fun S : Fin n → Ω => paperEmpRad n q (fun k => id (S k))) =
        fun S => paperEmpRad n F (fun k => X (S k)) by
      funext S
      simpa using hrad_eq S]
    rfl
  have hempmeas (i : ι) : Measurable (emp i) := by
    dsimp [emp]
    exact ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).measurable_sum (fun k _ =>
      (hfmeas i).comp (measurable_pi_apply k))).const_mul _
  have hgmeas : Measurable g := by
    dsimp [g]
    apply Measurable.iSup
    intro i
    exact measurable_const.sub (hempmeas i)
  have hsymm : (∫ S, g S ∂ν) ≤ R / 2 := by
    have h := bartlett_symmetrization_affine μ n hn f q hfmeas hf hq
      (-1 / 2) haff hgmeas hqRadInt
    rw [hqRad] at h
    norm_num at h ⊢
    linarith
  have hfint (i : ι) : Integrable (f i) μ :=
    Integrable.of_mem_Icc 0 1 (hfmeas i).aemeasurable
      (ae_of_all _ fun x => hf01 i x)
  have hmean (i : ι) : (∫ x, f i x ∂μ) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    constructor
    · simpa using integral_mono (μ := μ) (integrable_const (0 : ℝ)) (hfint i)
        (fun x => (hf01 i x).1)
    · simpa using integral_mono (μ := μ) (hfint i) (integrable_const (1 : ℝ))
        (fun x => (hf01 i x).2)
  have hemp (i : ι) (S : Fin n → Ω) : emp i S ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    have hnR : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
    constructor
    · dsimp [emp]
      exact mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hnR.le)
        (Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => (hf01 i (S k)).1)
    · calc
        emp i S ≤ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ _k : Fin n, (1 : ℝ) := by
          dsimp [emp]
          gcongr with k
          exact (hf01 i (S k)).2
        _ = 1 := by simp [ne_of_gt hnR]
  have hgBdd (S : Fin n → Ω) :
      BddAbove (Set.range fun i => (∫ x, f i x ∂μ) - emp i S) := by
    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    linarith [(hmean i).2, (hemp i S).1]
  have hgmem (S : Fin n → Ω) : g S ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
    have hBdd := hgBdd S
    constructor
    · let i : ι := Classical.choice inferInstance
      have hi := le_ciSup hBdd i
      linarith [(hmean i).1, (hemp i S).2]
    · refine ciSup_le fun i => ?_
      linarith [(hmean i).2, (hemp i S).1]
  have hgint : Integrable g ν :=
    Integrable.of_mem_Icc (-1) 1 hgmeas.aemeasurable (ae_of_all _ hgmem)
  have hgchange : ∀ (S S' : Fin n → Ω) (j : Fin n),
      (∀ k, k ≠ j → S k = S' k) → |g S - g S'| ≤ 1 / (n : ℝ) := by
    intro S S' j hSS'
    apply bartlett_iSup_lipschitz
      (fun i => (∫ x, f i x ∂μ) - emp i S)
      (fun i => (∫ x, f i x ∂μ) - emp i S')
      (hgBdd S) (hgBdd S') (1 / (n : ℝ))
    intro i
    rw [show ((∫ x, f i x ∂μ) - emp i S) -
        ((∫ x, f i x ∂μ) - emp i S') = -(emp i S - emp i S') by ring,
      abs_neg]
    exact bartlett_empirical01_change_le n hn (f i) (hf01 i) S S' j hSS'
  let ℓ : ℝ := Real.log (1 / δ)
  let ε : ℝ := Real.sqrt (ℓ / (2 * n))
  have hratio : 1 < (1 / δ : ℝ) := by
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ hδ0]
    simpa using hδ1
  have hℓ : 0 < ℓ := Real.log_pos hratio
  have hε : 0 < ε := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by positivity)
  have hεsq : ε ^ 2 = ℓ / (2 * n) := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have htail : ν.real {S | g S - ∫ T, g T ∂ν ≥ ε} ≤ δ := by
    have hc : 0 < 1 / (n : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hmc := bartlett_mcdiarmid_pi μ n hn g hgmeas hgint
      (1 / (n : ℝ)) hc hgchange ε hε
    have hexp : -2 * ε ^ 2 / ((n : ℝ) * (1 / (n : ℝ)) ^ 2) = -ℓ := by
      rw [hεsq]
      have hn0 : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt hn
      field_simp
    rw [hexp] at hmc
    calc
      _ ≤ Real.exp (-ℓ) := hmc
      _ = δ := by
        rw [Real.exp_neg]
        dsimp [ℓ]
        rw [Real.exp_log (by positivity : 0 < (1 / δ : ℝ))]
        field_simp
  let A : Set (Fin n → Ω) := {S | g S - ∫ T, g T ∂ν ≥ ε}
  have hAmeas : MeasurableSet A := by
    exact measurableSet_Ici.preimage (hgmeas.sub_const _)
  have hcomp : 1 - δ ≤ ν.real Aᶜ := by
    rw [measureReal_compl hAmeas, probReal_univ]
    have : ν.real A ≤ δ := by simpa [A] using htail
    linarith
  apply hcomp.trans
  apply measureReal_mono ?_ (measure_ne_top ν _)
  intro S hS
  intro i
  have hS' : g S - (∫ T, g T ∂ν) < ε := by
    simpa [A, not_le] using hS
  have hgi : (∫ x, f i x ∂μ) - emp i S ≤ g S :=
    le_ciSup (hgBdd S) i
  have hgmean : (∫ T, g T ∂ν) ≤ R / 2 := hsymm
  change expectedLoss μ X Y zeroOneLoss (F i) ≤
    empiricalCost n X Y zeroOneLoss (F i) S + R / 2 + ε
  change (∫ x, f i x ∂μ) ≤ emp i S + R / 2 + ε
  linarith

private lemma bartlett_finite_average_lipschitz {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    (a b : α → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (h : ∀ x, |a x - b x| ≤ c) :
    |(Fintype.card α : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ x, a x -
        (Fintype.card α : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ x, b x| ≤ c := by
  classical
  have hmpos : 0 < (Fintype.card α : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hinv : 0 ≤ (Fintype.card α : ℝ)⁻¹ := (inv_pos.mpr hmpos).le
  rw [← mul_sub, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, abs_mul,
    abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hmpos)]
  calc
    (Fintype.card α : ℝ)⁻¹ * |∑ x, (a x - b x)| ≤
        (Fintype.card α : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ x, |a x - b x| := by
      gcongr
      exact Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ (Fintype.card α : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ _x : α, c := by
      gcongr with x
      exact h x
    _ = c := by
      simp [ne_of_gt hmpos]

private lemma bartlett_signed_sum_change_le {𝒮 : Type*} {ι : Type*}
    (n : ℕ) (F : ι → 𝒮 → ℝ) (hF : ∀ i s, F i s ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (S S' : Fin n → 𝒮) (j : Fin n) (hSS' : ∀ k, k ≠ j → S k = S' k)
    (σ : Signs n) (i : ι) :
    |(∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * F i (S k)) -
      ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * F i (S' k)| ≤ 2 := by
  classical
  have hsum :
      (∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * F i (S k)) -
          ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * F i (S' k) =
        (σ j : ℝ) * (F i (S j) - F i (S' j)) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    calc
      ∑ k : Fin n, ((σ k : ℝ) * F i (S k) - (σ k : ℝ) * F i (S' k)) =
          ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * (F i (S k) - F i (S' k)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro k _
        ring
      _ = (σ j : ℝ) * (F i (S j) - F i (S' j)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_eq_single j
        · intro k _ hkj
          rw [hSS' k hkj]
          simp
        · simp
  rw [hsum, abs_mul, bartlett_sign_abs, one_mul, abs_le]
  rcases hF i (S j) with ⟨hSlo, hShi⟩
  rcases hF i (S' j) with ⟨hS'lo, hS'hi⟩
  constructor <;> linarith

private lemma bartlett_inner_change_le {𝒮 : Type*} {ι : Type*} [Nonempty ι]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (F : ι → 𝒮 → ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ i s, F i s ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (S S' : Fin n → 𝒮) (j : Fin n) (hSS' : ∀ k, k ≠ j → S k = S' k)
    (σ : Signs n) :
    |(⨆ i, |(2 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * F i (S k)|) -
      (⨆ i, |(2 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * F i (S' k)|)| ≤
        4 / (n : ℝ) := by
  have hnR : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hcoef : 0 ≤ 2 / (n : ℝ) := by positivity
  apply bartlett_iSup_lipschitz
    (fun i => |(2 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * F i (S k)|)
    (fun i => |(2 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * F i (S' k)|)
    (bartlett_inner_bddAbove n F hF S σ)
    (bartlett_inner_bddAbove n F hF S' σ)
    (4 / (n : ℝ))
  intro i
  calc
    abs (abs ((2 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * F i (S k)) -
        abs ((2 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * F i (S' k))) ≤
        |(2 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * F i (S k) -
          (2 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * F i (S' k)| :=
      abs_abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub _ _
    _ = (2 / (n : ℝ)) *
        |(∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * F i (S k)) -
          ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * F i (S' k)| := by
      rw [← mul_sub, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hcoef]
    _ ≤ (2 / (n : ℝ)) * 2 := by
      gcongr
      exact bartlett_signed_sum_change_le n F hF S S' j hSS' σ i
    _ = 4 / (n : ℝ) := by ring

private lemma paperEmpRad_change_le {𝒮 : Type*} {ι : Type*} [Nonempty ι]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (F : ι → 𝒮 → ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ i s, F i s ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (S S' : Fin n → 𝒮) (j : Fin n)
    (hSS' : ∀ k, k ≠ j → S k = S' k) :
    |paperEmpRad n F S - paperEmpRad n F S'| ≤ 4 / (n : ℝ) := by
  letI : Nonempty (Signs n) :=
    ⟨fun _ => ⟨1, by simp [Signs]⟩⟩
  unfold paperEmpRad
  apply bartlett_finite_average_lipschitz
    (fun σ : Signs n =>
      ⨆ i, |(2 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * F i (S k)|)
    (fun σ : Signs n =>
      ⨆ i, |(2 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * F i (S' k)|)
    (4 / (n : ℝ)) (by positivity)
  intro σ
  exact bartlett_inner_change_le n hn F hF S S' j hSS' σ

private lemma bartlett_two_sided_union {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    (ν : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (g : α → ℝ) (ε b : ℝ)
    (hupper : ν.real {x | g x - ∫ y, g y ∂ν ≥ ε} ≤ b)
    (hlower : ν.real {x | (-g x) - ∫ y, -g y ∂ν ≥ ε} ≤ b) :
    ν.real {x | |(∫ y, g y ∂ν) - g x| ≥ ε} ≤ 2 * b := by
  calc
    ν.real {x | |(∫ y, g y ∂ν) - g x| ≥ ε} ≤
        ν.real ({x | g x - ∫ y, g y ∂ν ≥ ε} ∪
          {x | (-g x) - ∫ y, -g y ∂ν ≥ ε}) := by
      refine measureReal_mono ?_ (measure_ne_top ν _)
      intro x hx
      change ε ≤ |(∫ y, g y ∂ν) - g x| at hx
      rw [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
      rcases (le_abs.mp hx) with hx | hx
      · right
        rw [integral_neg]
        linarith
      · left
        linarith
    _ ≤ ν.real {x | g x - ∫ y, g y ∂ν ≥ ε} +
        ν.real {x | (-g x) - ∫ y, -g y ∂ν ≥ ε} :=
      measureReal_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ b + b := add_le_add hupper hlower
    _ = 2 * b := by ring

theorem thm11_rademacher_concentration {Ω : Type u} {𝒮 : Type w} {ι : Type v}
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Nonempty ι]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → 𝒮)
    (F : ι → 𝒮 → ℝ) (hF : ∀ i s, F i s ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hRadInt : Integrable
      (fun ω : Fin n → Ω => paperEmpRad n F (fun k => X (ω k)))
      (Measure.pi (fun _ => μ)))
    (hMcD : ∀ (g : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ) (c : ℝ), 0 ≤ c →
        Integrable g (Measure.pi (fun _ => μ)) →
        (∀ (ω ω' : Fin n → Ω) (j : Fin n),
            (∀ k, k ≠ j → ω k = ω' k) → |g ω - g ω'| ≤ c) →
        ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t →
          (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => μ)).real
              {ω | g ω - ∫ ω', g ω' ∂(Measure.pi (fun _ => μ)) ≥ t}
            ≤ Real.exp (-2 * t ^ 2 / (n * c ^ 2)))
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => μ)).real
        {ω : Fin n → Ω |
          |paperRad n F μ X - paperEmpRad n F (fun k => X (ω k))| ≥ ε}
      ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(ε ^ 2 * n) / 8) := by
  let ν : Measure (Fin n → Ω) := Measure.pi (fun _ => μ)
  let g : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ :=
    fun ω => paperEmpRad n F (fun k => X (ω k))
  have hc : 0 ≤ 4 / (n : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hchange : ∀ (ω ω' : Fin n → Ω) (j : Fin n),
      (∀ k, k ≠ j → ω k = ω' k) → |g ω - g ω'| ≤ 4 / (n : ℝ) := by
    intro ω ω' j hω
    exact paperEmpRad_change_le n hn F hF _ _ j (fun k hk => congrArg X (hω k hk))
  have hgint : Integrable g (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => μ)) := by
    simpa [g] using hRadInt
  have hexponent :
      -2 * ε ^ 2 / ((n : ℝ) * (4 / (n : ℝ)) ^ 2) =
        -(ε ^ 2 * n) / 8 := by
    have hn0 : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt hn
    field_simp
    ring
  have hupper :
      ν.real {ω | g ω - ∫ ω', g ω' ∂ν ≥ ε} ≤
        Real.exp (-(ε ^ 2 * n) / 8) := by
    have h := hMcD g (4 / (n : ℝ)) hc hgint hchange ε hε
    rw [hexponent] at h
    simpa [ν] using h
  have hlower :
      ν.real {ω | (-g ω) - ∫ ω', -g ω' ∂ν ≥ ε} ≤
        Real.exp (-(ε ^ 2 * n) / 8) := by
    have hnegchange : ∀ (ω ω' : Fin n → Ω) (j : Fin n),
        (∀ k, k ≠ j → ω k = ω' k) →
          |(-g ω) - (-g ω')| ≤ 4 / (n : ℝ) := by
      intro ω ω' j hω
      rw [show (-g ω) - (-g ω') = -(g ω - g ω') by ring, abs_neg]
      exact hchange ω ω' j hω
    have h := hMcD (fun ω => -g ω) (4 / (n : ℝ)) hc hgint.neg
      hnegchange ε hε
    rw [hexponent] at h
    simpa [ν] using h
  simpa [ν, g, paperRad] using
    bartlett_two_sided_union ν g ε (Real.exp (-(ε ^ 2 * n) / 8)) hupper hlower

end

targets.label: Theorem 1
targets.statement:
Theorem 1. Suppose that the regularizer ψ $: \mathcal{X}\mapsto \mathbb{R}$ is 1-strongly convex with respect to the norm $\| \cdot \|$ , and let $\| \cdot \|_{*}$ be the dual norm of $\| \cdot \|$ . The dynamic regret of OpTIMISTIC OMD whose update rule is specified in (6) is bounded as follows:

$$
\begin{array}{r}{\displaystyle\sum_{t=1}^{T}f_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t})-\displaystyle\sum_{t=1}^{T}f_{t}(\mathbf{u}_{t})\leq\displaystyle\sum_{t=1}^{T}\eta_{t}\|\nabla f_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t})-M_{t}\|_{*}^{2}+\displaystyle\sum_{t=1}^{T}\frac{1}{\eta_{t}}\Big(\mathcal{D}_{\psi}(\mathbf{u}_{t},\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t})-\mathcal{D}_{\psi}(\mathbf{u}_{t},\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t+1})\Big)}\\ {-\displaystyle\sum_{t=1}^{T}\frac{1}{\eta_{t}}\Big(\mathcal{D}_{\psi}(\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t+1},\mathbf{x}_{t})+\mathcal{D}_{\psi}(\mathbf{x}_{t},\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t})\Big),}\end{array}\tag{7}
$$

which holds for any comparator sequence $\mathbf{u}_{1},\dots,\mathbf{u}_{T}\in\mathcal{X}$

targets.label: Lemma 4
targets.statement:
Lemma 4 (Bregman proximal inequality (Chen and Teboulle, 1993, Lemma 3.2)). Let X be a convex set in a Banach space. Let $f : \mathcal{X}\mapsto \mathbb{R}$ be a closed proper convex function on X. Given a convex regularizer $\psi : \mathcal{X}\mapsto \mathbb{R}$ , we denote its induced Bregman divergence by $\mathcal{D}_{\psi}(\cdot,\cdot)$ . Then, any update of the form

$$
\mathbf{x}_{k}=\underset{\mathbf{x}\in\mathcal{X}}{\arg\operatorname*{min}}\{f(\mathbf{x})+\mathcal{D}_{\psi}(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{x}_{k-1})\}
$$

satisfies the following inequality for any $\mathbf{u}\in \mathcal{X}$

$$
\begin{array}{r}{f ({\mathbf x}_{k}) - f ({\mathbf u}) \le \mathcal{D}_{\psi}({\mathbf u},{\mathbf x}_{k - 1}) - \mathcal{D}_{\psi}({\mathbf u},{\mathbf x}_{k}) - \mathcal{D}_{\psi}({\mathbf x}_{k},{\mathbf x}_{k - 1}) .}\end{array}\tag{60}
$$

targets.label: Lemma 1 (dynamic regret of OEGD)
targets.statement:
Lemma 1. Under Assumptions 1, 2, and 3, by choosing $\begin{array}{r}{\eta \le \frac{1}{4 L}}\end{array}$ , dynamic regret of OEGD (namely, OPTIMISTIC OMD with $\begin{array}{r}{\psi(\mathbf{x})=\frac{1}{2}\|\mathbf{x}\|_{2}^{2}}\end{array}$ and $M_{t}=\nabla f_{t-1}(\mathbf x_{t-1}))$ satisfies

$$
\sum_{t=1}^{T}f_{t}(\mathbf x_{t})-\sum_{t=1}^{T}f_{t}(\mathbf u_{t})\leq\eta(G^{2}+2V_{T})+\frac{1}{2\eta}(D^{2}+2DP_{T})\tag{9}
$$

for any comparator sequence $\mathbf{u}_{1},\dots,\mathbf{u}_{T}\in\mathcal{X}$

nl_proof:
### Proof of Theorem 1

Proof The instantaneous dynamic regret can be upper bounded and decomposed as

$$
f_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t})-f_{t}(\mathbf{u}_{t})\leq\underbrace{\langle\nabla f_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t})-M_{t},\mathbf{x}_{t}-\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t+1}\rangle}_{\mathrm{term~(a)}}+\underbrace{\langle M_{t},\mathbf{x}_{t}-\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t+1}\rangle}_{\mathrm{term~(b)}}+\underbrace{\langle\nabla f_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t}),\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t+1}-\mathbf{u}_{t}\rangle}_{\mathrm{term~(c)}}.
$$

In the following, we use the stability lemma (Lemma 5) to bound term (a) and appeal to the Bregman proximal inequality (Lemma 4) to bound term (b) and term (c).

We first investigate term (a). Intuitively, the prediction $\mathbf{x}_{t}$ should be close the $\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t + 1}$ when the optimistic vector $M_{t}$ is close to the gradient of the next iteration $\nabla f_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t})$ . The intuition is formalized in the stability lemma (Chiang et al., 2012, Propostion 7), as restated in Lemma 5 of Appendix C, which implies $\|\mathbf{x}_{t}-\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t+1}\|\leq\eta_{t}\|\nabla f_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t})-M_{t}\|_{*}$ and consequently,

$$
\begin{array}{r}{\mathbf{term}\left(\mathbf{a}\right)\leq\|\nabla f_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t})-M_{t}\|_{*}\|\mathbf{x}_{t}-\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t+1}\|\leq\eta_{t}\|\nabla f_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t})-M_{t}\|_{*}^{2}.}\end{array}
$$

We now analyze term (b) and term (c). By the Bregman proximal inequality (Lemma 4) and the OPTIMISTIC OMD update step $\mathbf{x}_{t}=\arg\operatorname*{min}_{\mathbf{x}\in\mathcal{X}}\{\eta_{t}\langle M_{t},\mathbf{x}\rangle+\mathcal{D}_{\psi}(\mathbf{x},\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t})\}$ , we have

$$
\mathbf{term\ (b)}=\langle M_{t},\mathbf{x}_{t}-\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t+1}\rangle\leq\frac{1}{\eta_{t}}\Big(\mathcal{D}_{\psi}(\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t+1},\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t})-\mathcal{D}_{\psi}(\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t+1},\mathbf{x}_{t})-\mathcal{D}_{\psi}(\mathbf{x}_{t},\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t})\Big).
$$

Similarly, the update $\begin{array}{r}{\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t+1}=\arg\operatorname*{min}_{\mathbf{x}\in\mathcal{X}}\{\eta_{t}\langle\nabla f_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t}),\mathbf{x}\rangle+\mathcal{D}_{\psi}(\mathbf{x},\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t})\}}\end{array}$ implies

$$
\mathbf{term~}(\mathbf{c})=\langle\nabla f_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t}),\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t+1}-\mathbf{u}_{t}\rangle\leq\frac{1}{\eta_{t}}\Big(\mathcal{D}_{\psi}(\mathbf{u}_{t},\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t})-\mathcal{D}_{\psi}(\mathbf{u}_{t},\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t+1})-\mathcal{D}_{\psi}(\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t+1},\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t})\Big).
$$

Combining the three upper bounds completes the proof.

### Proof of Lemma 4

(The source gives no proof of this result.)

### Proof of Lemma 1 (dynamic regret of OEGD)

Proof [of Lemma 1] We first show a general result for Optimistic OMD with an arbitrary optimistic vector $M_{t}\in \mathbb{R}^{d}$ and the regularizer $\begin{array}{r}{\psi(\mathbf{x})=\frac{1}{2}\|\mathbf{x}\|_{2}^{2}}\end{array}$ , and then prove Lemma 1 by simply substituting $M_{t}=\nabla f_{t-1}(\mathbf x_{t-1})$ into it.

It is well-known that $\begin{array}{r}{\psi(\mathbf{x})=\frac{1}{2}\|\mathbf{x}\|_{2}^{2}}\end{array}$ is 1-strongly convex with respect to the Euclidean norm $\| \cdot \|_{2}$ and $\begin{array}{r}{\mathcal{D}_{\psi}(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y})=\frac{1}{2}\|\mathbf{x}-\mathbf{y}\|_{2}^{2}}\end{array}$ . Thus, Theorem 1 implies

$$
\begin{array}{r}{\displaystyle\sum_{t=1}^{T}f_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t})-\displaystyle\sum_{t=1}^{T}f_{t}(\mathbf{u}_{t})\leq\eta\sum_{t=1}^{T}\lVert\nabla f_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t})-M_{t}\rVert_{2}^{2}+\displaystyle\frac{1}{2\eta}\displaystyle\sum_{t=1}^{T}\left(\lVert\mathbf{u}_{t}-\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t}\rVert_{2}^{2}-\lVert\mathbf{u}_{t}-\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t+1}\rVert_{2}^{2}\right)}\\ {\displaystyle-\displaystyle\frac{1}{2\eta}\displaystyle\sum_{t=1}^{T}\left(\lVert\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t+1}-\mathbf{x}_{t}\rVert_{2}^{2}+\lVert\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t}-\mathbf{x}_{t}\rVert_{2}^{2}\right).}\end{array}
$$

Notice that the second term can be upper bounded as follows.

$$
\sum_{t=1}^{T}\left(\lVert\mathbf{u}_{t}-\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t}\rVert_{2}^{2}-\lVert\mathbf{u}_{t}-\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t+1}\rVert_{2}^{2}\right)\leq\lVert\mathbf{u}_{1}-\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{1}\rVert_{2}^{2}+\sum_{t=2}^{T}\left(\lVert\mathbf{u}_{t}-\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t}\rVert_{2}^{2}-\lVert\mathbf{u}_{t-1}-\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t}\rVert_{2}^{2}\right)
$$

$$
\leq \|{\bf u}_{1}- \widehat{{\bf x}}_{1}\|_{2}^{2}+ \sum_{t = 2}^{T}\|{\bf u}_{t}-{\bf u}_{t - 1}\|_{2}\|{\bf u}_{t}- \widehat{{\bf x}}_{t}+{\bf u}_{t - 1}- \widehat{{\bf x}}_{t}\|_{2}\leq D^{2}+ 2 D \sum_{t = 2}^{T}\|{\bf u}_{t}-{\bf u}_{t - 1}\|_{2}.
$$

We further evaluate the last term using the inequality of $a^{2}+b^{2}\geq(a+b)^{2}/2$ and obtain

$$
\sum_{t=1}^{T}\left(\lVert\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t+1}-\mathbf{x}_{t}\rVert_{2}^{2}+\lVert\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t}-\mathbf{x}_{t}\rVert_{2}^{2}\right)\geq\sum_{t=2}^{T}\left(\lVert\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t}-\mathbf{x}_{t-1}\rVert_{2}^{2}+\lVert\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t}-\mathbf{x}_{t}\rVert_{2}^{2}\right)\geq\frac{1}{2}\sum_{t=2}^{T}\lVert\mathbf{x}_{t}-\mathbf{x}_{t-1}\rVert_{2}^{2}.
$$

Hence, combining all the three inequalities, we get the following result:

$$
\sum_{t=1}^{T}f_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t})-\sum_{t=1}^{T}f_{t}(\mathbf{u}_{t})\leq\eta\sum_{t=1}^{T}\lVert\nabla f_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t})-M_{t}\rVert_{2}^{2}+\frac{1}{\eta}(D^{2}+2DP_{T})-\frac{1}{4\eta}\sum_{t=2}^{T}\lVert\mathbf{x}_{t}-\mathbf{x}_{t-1}\rVert_{2}^{2}.
$$

When choosing the optimism as the last-round gradient $M_{t}=\nabla f_{t-1}(\mathbf x_{t-1})$ , the adaptivity term $\begin{array}{r}{\sum_{t=1}^{T}\lVert\nabla f_{t}(\mathbf x_{t})-M_{t}\rVert_{2}^{2}}\end{array}$ can be upper bounded in the following way:

$$
\begin{array}{r l r}{{\sum_{t=1}^{T}\|\nabla f_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t})-M_{t}\|_{2}^{2}\le G^{2}+2\sum_{t=2}^{T}\Big(\|\nabla f_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t})-\nabla f_{t-1}(\mathbf{x}_{t})\|_{2}^{2}+\|\nabla f_{t-1}(\mathbf{x}_{t})-\nabla f_{t-1}(\mathbf{x}_{t-1})\|_{2}^{2}\Big)}}\\ &{}&{\le G^{2}+2\sum_{t=2}^{T}\underset{\mathbf{x}\in\mathcal{X}}{\operatorname*{sup}}\|\nabla f_{t}(\mathbf{x})-\nabla f_{t-1}(\mathbf{x})\|_{2}^{2}+2 L^{2}\underset{t=2}{\overset{T}{\sum}}\|\mathbf{x}_{t}-\mathbf{x}_{t-1}\|_{2}^{2},}\end{array}
$$

where the last step exploits L-smoothness of online functions. Therefore,

$$
\begin{array}{l}{\displaystyle\sum_{t=1}^{T}f_{t}(\mathbf x_{t})-\sum_{t=1}^{T}f_{t}(\mathbf u_{t})\leq\eta(G^{2}+2V_{T})+\frac{1}{2\eta}(D^{2}+2DP_{T})+\left(2\eta L^{2}-\frac{1}{4\eta}\right)\sum_{t=2}^{T}\lVert\mathbf x_{t}-\mathbf x_{t-1}\rVert_{2}^{2}}\\ {\displaystyle\qquad\leq\eta(G^{2}+2V_{T})+\frac{1}{2\eta}(D^{2}+2DP_{T}),}\end{array}
$$

where $\eta\leq 1/(4L)$ ensures the last term to be non-positive. This ends the proof.

context.name: Setup: online convex optimization protocol (Introduction)
context.statement: At iteration t, the player chooses a decision vector $\mathbf{x}_{t}$ from a convex set $\boldsymbol{\mathcal{X}}\subseteq \mathbb{R}^{d}$ . Subsequently, the adversary discloses a convex function $f_{t}: \mathcal{X}\mapsto \mathbb{R}$ ,and the player incurs a loss denoted by $f_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t})$

context.name: Setup: problem setup and feedback models (Section 3.1)
context.statement:
Online Convex Optimization (OCO) can be modeled as an iterated game between the player and the environments. At iteration $t \in [ T ]$ , the player first chooses the decision $\mathbf{x}_{t}$ from a convex feasible set $\boldsymbol{\mathcal{X}}\subseteq \mathbb{R}^{d}$ , then the environments reveal the loss function $f_{t}: \mathcal{X}\mapsto \mathbb{R}$ and the player suffers the loss $f_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t})$ and observes a certain information about the function $f_{t}(\cdot).$ 2 According to the revealed information, the online learning problems are typically classified into full-information online learning and partial-information online learning (or sometimes called bandit online learning). In this paper, we focus on the full-information one, which can be further categorized into the following two setups:

(i) multi-gradient feedback: the player can access the entire gradient function $\nabla f_{t}(\cdot)$ and thus can evaluate the gradient multiple times at each round;

(ii) one-gradient feedback: the player can observe the gradient information $\nabla f_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t})$ after submitting the decision $\mathbf{x}_{t}$ at each round.

In Section 4.2, we develop the Sword algorithm, which achieves the gradient-variation dynamic regret under the multi-gradient feedback model. In Section 4.3, we present an improved algorithm called Sword++ that can achieve the same dynamic regret guarantee (up to constants) under the more challenging one-gradient feedback model.

To handle non-stationary environments, we focus on the dynamic regret measure, which compares the online algorithm to a sequence of time-varying comparators $\mathbf{u}_{1},\dots,\mathbf{u}_{T}\in\mathcal{X}$ as defined in (2). An upper bound of dynamic regret should be a function of comparators, and typically the bound depends on some regularities that measure the fluctuation of the comparator sequence, such as the path length $\begin{array}{r}{P_{T}= \sum_{t = 2}^{T}\lVert \mathbf{u}_{t}- \mathbf{u}_{t - 1}\rVert_{2}}\end{array}$ Throughout the paper, we focus on the Euclidean norm for simplicity, and it is straightforward to extend our results to general primal-dual norms.

In addition to the regret measure, we further consider the gradient query complexity. Note that algorithms designed for the multi-gradient feedback model may query the gradients for multiple times at each round. However, most algorithms designed for the static regret minimization only require one gradient per iteration, namely, using $\nabla f_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t})$ for the next update only. Therefore, it is more desirable to achieve the favorable regret guarantees under the one-gradient feedback model. In other words, our aim is to develop first-order methods for dynamic regret minimization that require only one gradient query per iteration.

context.name: Dynamic regret, eq. (2)
context.statement:
To address this limitation, dynamic regret is proposed to compete with changing comparators $\mathbf{u}_{1},\dots,\mathbf{u}_{T}\in\mathcal{X}$

$$
\mathrm{D-Regret}_{T}(\mathbf{u}_{1},\ldots,\mathbf{u}_{T})=\sum_{t=1}^{T}f_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t})-\sum_{t=1}^{T}f_{t}(\mathbf{u}_{t}),\tag{2}
$$

context.name: Optimistic OMD: update rule (6), Bregman divergence, strong convexity (Section 3.2)
context.statement:
We employ the algorithmic framework of Optimistic Online Mirror Descent (OpTIMISTIC OMD) (Chiang et al., 2012; Rakhlin and Sridharan, 2013) as a general building block for designing algorithms for non-stationary online learning. Optimistic OMD is an algorithmic realization of optimistic online learning. Compared to the standard online learning setup, the player receives an additional element at each round: an optimistic vector $M_{t}\in \mathbb{R}^{d}$ This vector acts as a predictive hint or an optimistic estimate of the upcoming gradient, thereby called "optimistic vector" or simply "optimism". Optimistic OMD starts from the initial point $\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{1}\in \mathcal{X}$ and performs the following two-step updates at each round:

$$
\begin{array}{r l}&{\mathbf{x}_{t}=\underset{\mathbf{x}\in\mathcal{X}}{\arg\operatorname*{min}}~\big\{\eta_{t}\langle M_{t},\mathbf{x}\rangle+\mathcal{D}_{\psi}(\mathbf{x},\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t})\big\},}\\ &{\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t+1}=\underset{\mathbf{x}\in\mathcal{X}}{\arg\operatorname*{min}}~\big\{\eta_{t}\langle\nabla f_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t}),\mathbf{x}\rangle+\mathcal{D}_{\psi}(\mathbf{x},\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t})\big\},}\end{array}\tag{6}
$$

which firstly updates by the optimistic vector $M_{t}$ and then updates by the received gradient $\nabla f_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t})$ . In above, $\eta_{t}> 0$ is a (potentially) time-varying step size, and $\mathcal{D}_{\psi}(\cdot,\cdot)$ denotes the Bregman divergence associated with the regularizer $\psi$ defined as $\mathcal{D}_{\psi}(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y})=\psi(\mathbf{x})-\psi(\mathbf{y})-$ $\langle\nabla\psi(\mathbf{y}),\mathbf{x}-\mathbf{y}\rangle$ . We may assume the regularizer to be σ-strongly convex with respect to the norm $\begin{array}{r}{\|\cdot\|,\operatorname{i.e.,}\psi(\mathbf{y})\geq\psi(\mathbf{x})+\langle\nabla\psi(\mathbf{x}),\mathbf{y}-\mathbf{x}\rangle+\frac{\sigma}{2}\|\mathbf{y}-\mathbf{x}\|^{2}}\end{array}$ holds for any $\mathbf{x}, \mathbf{y}\in{\mathcal{X}}$ . We have the following general result regarding dynamic regret of optimistic OMD.

context.name: Lemma 5 (stability lemma, Chiang et al. 2012, Proposition 7)
context.statement: Lemma 5 (stability lemma (Chiang et al., 2012, Proposition 7)). Consider the following two updates: $\begin{array}{r}{(i)\mathbf{x}_{*}=\arg\operatorname*{min}_{\mathbf{x}\in\mathcal{X}}\langle\mathbf{a},\mathbf{x}\rangle+\mathcal{D}_{\psi}(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{c})}\end{array}$ , and $(i i)\mathbf{x}_{*}^{\prime}=\arg\operatorname*{min}_{\mathbf{x}\in\mathcal{X}}\langle\mathbf{a}^{\prime},\mathbf{x}\rangle+\mathcal{D}_{\psi}(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{c})$ When the regularizer $\psi : \mathcal{X}\mapsto \mathbb{R}$ is a 1-strongly convex function with respect to the norm $\| \cdot \|$ , we have $\| \mathbf{x}_{*}- \mathbf{x}_{*}^{\prime}\| \leq \| \mathbf{a}- \mathbf{a}^{\prime}\|_{*}$

context.name: Assumption 1 (bounded gradients)
context.statement: Assumption 1. The norm of the gradients of online functions over the domain $\mathcal{X}$ is bounded by G, i.e., $\|\nabla f_{t}(\mathbf{x})\|_{2}\leq G$ , for all $\mathbf{x}\in \mathcal{X}$ and $t \in [ T ]$ .

context.name: Assumption 2 (domain contains origin, diameter D)
context.statement: Assumption 2. The domain $\mathcal{X}\subseteq \mathbb{R}^{d}$ contains the origin $\mathbf{0}$, and the diameter of the domain $\mathcal{X}$ is at most D, i.e., $\| \mathbf{x}- \mathbf{x}^{\prime}\|_{2}\leq D$ for any $\mathbf{x}, \mathbf{x}^{\prime}\in \mathcal{X}$

context.name: Assumption 3 (L-smoothness)
context.statement: Assumption 3. All the online functions are L-smooth, i.e., $\|\nabla f_{t}(\mathbf{x})-\nabla f_{t}(\mathbf{x}^{\prime})\|_{2}\leq L\|\mathbf{x}-\mathbf{x}^{\prime}\|_{2}$ for any $\mathbf{x}, \mathbf{x}^{\prime}\in \mathbb{R}^{d}$ and $t \in [ T ]$

context.name: Remark: Theorem 1 does not need smoothness
context.statement: We have the following remarks regarding the assumptions. The general dynamic regret analysis of Optimistic OMD (Theorem 1) does not require the smoothness assumption. Nevertheless, this assumption is crucial for achieving problem-dependent dynamic regret bounds.

context.name: OEGD update (8) and its reduction to Optimistic OMD (Section 4.1)
context.statement:
In the study of static regret, Chiang et al. (2012) propose the online extra-gradient descent (OEGD) algorithm and prove that the algorithm enjoys gradient-variation static regret. Specifically, OEGD starts from $\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{1}\in \mathcal{X}$ and then updates by

$$
\begin{array}{r}{\mathbf{x}_{t}=\Pi_{\mathcal{X}}\left[\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t}-\eta\nabla f_{t-1}(\mathbf{x}_{t-1})\right],\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t+1}=\Pi_{\mathcal{X}}\left[\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t}-\eta\nabla f_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t})\right],}\end{array}\tag{8}
$$

where we define $f_{0}(\mathbf{x}_{0})=\mathbf{0}$ and $\Pi_{\mathcal{X}}[ \cdot ]$ the Euclidean projection onto the nearest point in $\mathcal{X}.$ We consider a fixed step size $\eta > 0$ for simplicity. For convex and smooth functions, Chiang et al. (2012) prove that OEGD enjoys an $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{1+V_{T}})$ gradient-variation static regret.

Actually, OEGD can be viewed as a specialization of Optimistic OMD (6) presented in Section 3.2, by choosing the regularizer $\begin{array}{r}{\psi(\mathbf{x})=\frac{1}{2}\|\mathbf{x}\|_{2}^{2}}\end{array}$ and the optimistic vector $M_{t}=$ $\nabla f_{t-1}\big(\mathbf{x}_{t-1}\big)$ as well as a fixed step size $\eta > 0$ Therefore, Theorem 1 directly implies the following dynamic regret upper bound for OEGD, with proof in Appendix A.

context.name: Path length P_T, eq. (4)
context.statement:
$$
P_{T}= \sum_{t = 2}^{T}\lVert \mathbf{u}_{t}- \mathbf{u}_{t - 1}\rVert_{2}\tag{4}
$$

is the path length of comparators $\mathbf{u}_{1},\ldots,\mathbf{u}_{T}$ and thus reflects the non-stationarity of environments.

context.name: Gradient variation V_T, eq. (5)
context.statement:
Specifically, we focus on the following two problem-dependent quantities: the gradient variation of online functions $V_{T}$ , and the cumulative loss of the comparator sequence $F_{T}$ , defined as

$$
V_{T}=\sum_{t=2}^{T}\operatorname*{sup}_{\mathbf x\in\mathcal X}\|\nabla f_{t}(\mathbf x)-\nabla f_{t-1}(\mathbf x)\|_{2}^{2},~\mathrm{and}~F_{T}=\sum_{t=1}^{T}f_{t}(\mathbf u_{t}).\tag{5}
$$

    have hconvM : ConvexOn ℝ X (fun z => η t * M t z) := by
      refine ⟨hXconv, ?_⟩
      intro a ha b hb α β hα hβ hab
      simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      ring_nf
      exact le_rfl
    have hconvG : ConvexOn ℝ X (fun z => η t * gradf t (x t) z) := by
      refine ⟨hXconv, ?_⟩
      intro a ha b hb α β hα hβ hab
      simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      ring_nf
      exact le_rfl
    have hpM := bregman_proximal_of_min X (fun z => η t * M t z) ψ gradψ
      (x t) (xhat t) (xhat (t + 1)) hXconv hxt hyt hconvM
      (hψgrad (x t) hxt) (hx t ht)
    have hpGx := bregman_proximal_of_min X
      (fun z => η t * gradf t (x t) z) ψ gradψ
      (xhat (t + 1)) (xhat t) (x t) hXconv hyt hxt hconvG
      (hψgrad (xhat (t + 1)) hyt) (hxhat t ht)
    have hpGu := bregman_proximal_of_min X
      (fun z => η t * gradf t (x t) z) ψ gradψ
      (xhat (t + 1)) (xhat t) (u t) hXconv hyt hut hconvG
      (hψgrad (xhat (t + 1)) hyt) (hxhat t ht)
    have hDyx : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖xhat (t + 1) - x t‖ ^ 2 ≤
        bregmanDual ψ gradψ (xhat (t + 1)) (x t) := by
      have hs := hsc (x t) hxt (xhat (t + 1)) hyt
      rw [bregmanDual]
      linarith
    have hDxy : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖x t - xhat (t + 1)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        bregmanDual ψ gradψ (x t) (xhat (t + 1)) := by
      have hs := hsc (xhat (t + 1)) hyt (x t) hxt
      rw [bregmanDual]
      linarith
    have hDsum : ‖x t - xhat (t + 1)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        bregmanDual ψ gradψ (xhat (t + 1)) (x t) +
          bregmanDual ψ gradψ (x t) (xhat (t + 1)) := by
      rw [norm_sub_rev (xhat (t + 1)) (x t)] at hDyx
      linarith
    have hproxsum :
        bregmanDual ψ gradψ (xhat (t + 1)) (x t) +
            bregmanDual ψ gradψ (x t) (xhat (t + 1))
          ≤ η t * ((gradf t (x t) - M t) (x t - xhat (t + 1))) := by
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, map_sub]
      linarith
    have hdistsq : ‖x t - xhat (t + 1)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        η t * ((gradf t (x t) - M t) (x t - xhat (t + 1))) :=
      hDsum.trans hproxsum
    have hdual : (gradf t (x t) - M t) (x t - xhat (t + 1)) ≤
        ‖gradf t (x t) - M t‖ * ‖x t - xhat (t + 1)‖ :=
      (Real.le_norm_self _).trans ((gradf t (x t) - M t).le_opNorm _)
    have hstab : ‖x t - xhat (t + 1)‖ ≤
        η t * ‖gradf t (x t) - M t‖ := by
      by_cases hz : ‖x t - xhat (t + 1)‖ = 0
      · rw [hz]
        exact mul_nonneg hηt.le (norm_nonneg _)
      · have hzpos : 0 < ‖x t - xhat (t + 1)‖ :=
          lt_of_le_of_ne (norm_nonneg _) (Ne.symm hz)
        have hmul : ‖x t - xhat (t + 1)‖ ^ 2 ≤
            η t * (‖gradf t (x t) - M t‖ * ‖x t - xhat (t + 1)‖) :=
          hdistsq.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdual hηt.le)
        have hmul' : ‖x t - xhat (t + 1)‖ * ‖x t - xhat (t + 1)‖ ≤
            (η t * ‖gradf t (x t) - M t‖) * ‖x t - xhat (t + 1)‖ := by
          simpa only [pow_two, mul_assoc] using hmul
        exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right hmul' hzpos
    have htermA : (gradf t (x t) - M t) (x t - xhat (t + 1)) ≤
        η t * ‖gradf t (x t) - M t‖ ^ 2 := by
      calc
        (gradf t (x t) - M t) (x t - xhat (t + 1))
            ≤ ‖gradf t (x t) - M t‖ * ‖x t - xhat (t + 1)‖ := hdual
        _ ≤ ‖gradf t (x t) - M t‖ *
              (η t * ‖gradf t (x t) - M t‖) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hstab (norm_nonneg _)
        _ = η t * ‖gradf t (x t) - M t‖ ^ 2 := by ring
    have hscaled : η t *
        (M t (x t - xhat (t + 1)) +
          gradf t (x t) (xhat (t + 1) - u t)) ≤
        bregmanDual ψ gradψ (u t) (xhat t)
          - bregmanDual ψ gradψ (u t) (xhat (t + 1))
          - bregmanDual ψ gradψ (xhat (t + 1)) (x t)
          - bregmanDual ψ gradψ (x t) (xhat t) := by
      simp only [map_sub]
      linarith
    have hbc :
        M t (x t - xhat (t + 1)) +
            gradf t (x t) (xhat (t + 1) - u t)
          ≤ (1 / η t) *
                (bregmanDual ψ gradψ (u t) (xhat t)
                  - bregmanDual ψ gradψ (u t) (xhat (t + 1)))
              - (1 / η t) *
                (bregmanDual ψ gradψ (xhat (t + 1)) (x t)
                  + bregmanDual ψ gradψ (x t) (xhat t)) := by
      calc
        M t (x t - xhat (t + 1)) + gradf t (x t) (xhat (t + 1) - u t)
            = (1 / η t) * (η t *
                (M t (x t - xhat (t + 1)) +
                  gradf t (x t) (xhat (t + 1) - u t))) := by
              field_simp
        _ ≤ (1 / η t) *
              (bregmanDual ψ gradψ (u t) (xhat t)
                - bregmanDual ψ gradψ (u t) (xhat (t + 1))
                - bregmanDual ψ gradψ (xhat (t + 1)) (x t)
                - bregmanDual ψ gradψ (x t) (xhat t)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hscaled (one_div_pos.mpr hηt).le
        _ = (1 / η t) *
                (bregmanDual ψ gradψ (u t) (xhat t)
                  - bregmanDual ψ gradψ (u t) (xhat (t + 1)))
              - (1 / η t) *
                (bregmanDual ψ gradψ (xhat (t + 1)) (x t)
                  + bregmanDual ψ gradψ (x t) (xhat t)) := by ring
    have hreg : f t (x t) - f t (u t) ≤ gradf t (x t) (x t - u t) := by
      have hc := subgrad_of_convexOn_hasFDerivAt (hfconv t ht) hxt hut (hfgrad t ht)
      simp only [map_sub] at hc ⊢
      linarith
    calc
      f t (x t) - f t (u t) ≤ gradf t (x t) (x t - u t) := hreg
      _ = (gradf t (x t) - M t) (x t - xhat (t + 1))
            + (M t (x t - xhat (t + 1))
              + gradf t (x t) (xhat (t + 1) - u t)) := by
          simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, map_sub]
          ring
      _ ≤ η t * ‖gradf t (x t) - M t‖ ^ 2
            + ((1 / η t) *
                (bregmanDual ψ gradψ (u t) (xhat t)
                  - bregmanDual ψ gradψ (u t) (xhat (t + 1)))
              - (1 / η t) *
                (bregmanDual ψ gradψ (xhat (t + 1)) (x t)
                  + bregmanDual ψ gradψ (x t) (xhat t))) :=
          add_le_add htermA hbc
      _ = η t * ‖gradf t (x t) - M t‖ ^ 2
          + (1 / η t) * (bregmanDual ψ gradψ (u t) (xhat t)
              - bregmanDual ψ gradψ (u t) (xhat (t + 1)))
          - (1 / η t) * (bregmanDual ψ gradψ (xhat (t + 1)) (x t)
              + bregmanDual ψ gradψ (x t) (xhat t)) := by ring
  calc
    (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, f t (x t)) - (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, f t (u t))
        = ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, (f t (x t) - f t (u t)) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    _ ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T,
          (η t * ‖gradf t (x t) - M t‖ ^ 2
            + (1 / η t) * (bregmanDual ψ gradψ (u t) (xhat t)
                - bregmanDual ψ gradψ (u t) (xhat (t + 1)))
            - (1 / η t) * (bregmanDual ψ gradψ (xhat (t + 1)) (x t)
                + bregmanDual ψ gradψ (x t) (xhat t))) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum hpoint
    _ = (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, η t * ‖gradf t (x t) - M t‖ ^ 2)
        + (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T,
            (1 / η t) * (bregmanDual ψ gradψ (u t) (xhat t)
              - bregmanDual ψ gradψ (u t) (xhat (t + 1))))
        - (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T,
            (1 / η t) * (bregmanDual ψ gradψ (xhat (t + 1)) (x t)
              + bregmanDual ψ gradψ (x t) (xhat t))) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

theorem lemma4_bregmanProximal
    {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
    (X : Set F) (f ψ : F → ℝ) (gradψ : F → (F →L[ℝ] ℝ))
    (xk xkm1 u : F)

    (hXconv : Convex ℝ X)
    (hxkX : xk ∈ X) (hxkm1X : xkm1 ∈ X) (huX : u ∈ X)

    (hfconv : ConvexOn ℝ X f)
    (hflsc : LowerSemicontinuousOn f X)

    (hψconv : ConvexOn ℝ X ψ)

    (hψgrad : HasFDerivAt ψ (gradψ xk) xk)
    (hψgrad' : HasFDerivAt ψ (gradψ xkm1) xkm1)

    (hprox : ∀ z ∈ X,
      f xk + bregmanDual ψ gradψ xk xkm1 ≤ f z + bregmanDual ψ gradψ z xkm1) :
    f xk - f u
      ≤ bregmanDual ψ gradψ u xkm1 - bregmanDual ψ gradψ u xk
          - bregmanDual ψ gradψ xk xkm1 := by
  let d : F := u - xk
  have hlim : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun t : ℝ => t⁻¹ • (ψ (xk + t • d) - ψ xk) - gradψ xkm1 d)
      (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0))
      (nhds (gradψ xk d - gradψ xkm1 d)) :=
    (hψgrad.hasLineDerivAt d).tendsto_slope_zero_right.sub_const _
  have hev : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0),
      f xk - f u ≤ t⁻¹ • (ψ (xk + t • d) - ψ xk) - gradψ xkm1 d := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin,
      (eventually_lt_nhds (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num)).filter_mono inf_le_left]
      with t htpos htone
    have ht0 : 0 < t := htpos
    have ht1 : t ≤ 1 := le_of_lt htone
    have hzEq : xk + t • d = (1 - t) • xk + t • u := by
      dsimp [d]
      module
    have hzX : xk + t • d ∈ X := by
      rw [hzEq]
      exact hXconv hxkX huX (sub_nonneg.mpr ht1) ht0.le (by ring)
    have hfline : f (xk + t • d) ≤ (1 - t) * f xk + t * f u := by
      rw [hzEq]
      simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using
        hfconv.2 hxkX huX (sub_nonneg.mpr ht1) ht0.le (by ring)
    have hp := hprox (xk + t • d) hzX
    have hlin : gradψ xkm1 (xk + t • d - xkm1) =
        gradψ xkm1 (xk - xkm1) + t * gradψ xkm1 d := by
      have harg : xk + t • d - xkm1 = (xk - xkm1) + t • d := by module
      rw [harg, map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [bregmanDual, bregmanDual, hlin] at hp
    have hraw : t * (f xk - f u) ≤
        ψ (xk + t • d) - ψ xk - t * gradψ xkm1 d := by
      linarith
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    calc
      f xk - f u = t⁻¹ * (t * (f xk - f u)) := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ ht0.ne', one_mul]
      _ ≤ t⁻¹ * (ψ (xk + t • d) - ψ xk - t * gradψ xkm1 d) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hraw (inv_nonneg.mpr ht0.le)
      _ = t⁻¹ * (ψ (xk + t • d) - ψ xk) - gradψ xkm1 d := by
        rw [mul_sub, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ ht0.ne', one_mul]
  have hfirst : f xk - f u ≤ gradψ xk d - gradψ xkm1 d :=
    ge_of_tendsto hlim hev
  dsimp [bregmanDual, d] at hfirst ⊢
  simp only [map_sub] at hfirst ⊢
  linarith

private theorem bregmanDual_normSq (a b : E) :
    bregmanDual (fun z : E => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖z‖ ^ 2)
        (fun z => innerSL ℝ z) a b = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖a - b‖ ^ 2 := by
  rw [bregmanDual, innerSL_apply_apply, norm_sub_sq_real]
  simp only [inner_sub_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  rw [real_inner_comm b a]
  ring

private theorem hasFDerivAt_half_normSq (z : E) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun z : E => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖z‖ ^ 2) (innerSL ℝ z) z := by
  convert (hasStrictFDerivAt_norm_sq z).hasFDerivAt.const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ) using 1
  ext v
  simp [innerSL_apply_apply]

private theorem norm_innerSL_sub (a b : E) :
    ‖innerSL ℝ a - innerSL ℝ b‖ = ‖a - b‖ := by
  rw [← (innerSL ℝ).map_sub, innerSL_apply_norm]

private theorem norm_add_sq_le_two (a b : E) :
    ‖a + b‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (‖a‖ ^ 2 + ‖b‖ ^ 2) := by
  have hadd := norm_add_le a b
  have hsquare : ‖a + b‖ ^ 2 ≤ (‖a‖ + ‖b‖) ^ 2 :=
    (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (add_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))).2 hadd
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖a‖ - ‖b‖)]

theorem lemma1_OEGD
    {T : ℕ} (X : Set E)
    (f : ℕ → E → ℝ) (gradf : ℕ → E → E)
    (x xhat u : ℕ → E) (η G D L : ℝ)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hL : 0 < L) (hηL : η ≤ 1 / (4 * L))
    (hXne : X.Nonempty)

    (hXconv : Convex ℝ X)

    (hG : ∀ t, ∀ a ∈ X, ‖gradf t a‖ ≤ G)
    (hgrad0 : ∀ a, gradf 0 a = 0)

    (h0X : (0 : E) ∈ X) (hD : ∀ a ∈ X, ∀ b ∈ X, ‖a - b‖ ≤ D)

    (hsmooth : ∀ t, ∀ a b, ‖gradf t a - gradf t b‖ ≤ L * ‖a - b‖)

    (hconv : ∀ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, ∀ a ∈ X, ∀ b ∈ X,
      f t a + ⟪gradf t a, b - a⟫ ≤ f t b)

    (hfgrad : ∀ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, ∀ a, HasGradientAt (f t) (gradf t a) a)

    (hu : ∀ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, u t ∈ X)

    (hxX : ∀ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, x t ∈ X)
    (hxhat1 : xhat 1 ∈ X)
    (hxhatX : ∀ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, xhat (t + 1) ∈ X)

    (hx : ∀ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, ∀ z ∈ X,
      (1 / 2) * ‖x t - xhat t‖ ^ 2 + η * ⟪gradf (t - 1) (x (t - 1)), x t⟫
        ≤ (1 / 2) * ‖z - xhat t‖ ^ 2 + η * ⟪gradf (t - 1) (x (t - 1)), z⟫)

    (hxhat : ∀ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, ∀ z ∈ X,
      (1 / 2) * ‖xhat (t + 1) - xhat t‖ ^ 2 + η * ⟪gradf t (x t), xhat (t + 1)⟫
        ≤ (1 / 2) * ‖z - xhat t‖ ^ 2 + η * ⟪gradf t (x t), z⟫) :
    (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, f t (x t)) - (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, f t (u t))
      ≤ η * (G ^ 2 + 2 * gradVarSup X gradf T)
        + (1 / (2 * η)) * (D ^ 2 + 2 * D * pathLength u T) := by
  let gd : ℕ → E → (E →L[ℝ] ℝ) := fun t z => innerSL ℝ (gradf t z)
  let gψ : E → (E →L[ℝ] ℝ) := fun z => innerSL ℝ z
  let ψq : E → ℝ := fun z => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖z‖ ^ 2
  let md : ℕ → (E →L[ℝ] ℝ) :=
    fun t => innerSL ℝ (gradf (t - 1) (x (t - 1)))
  let ηc : ℕ → ℝ := fun _ => η
  have hηc : ∀ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, 0 < ηc t := by
    intro t ht
    exact hη
  have hscq : ∀ a ∈ X, ∀ b ∈ X,
      ψq a + gψ a (b - a) + (1 / 2) * ‖b - a‖ ^ 2 ≤ ψq b := by
    intro a ha b hb
    change (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖a‖ ^ 2 + (innerSL ℝ a) (b - a) +
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖b - a‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖b‖ ^ 2
    apply le_of_eq
    rw [innerSL_apply_apply, norm_sub_sq_real]
    simp only [inner_sub_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    rw [real_inner_comm a b]
    ring
  have hψqgrad : ∀ z ∈ X, HasFDerivAt ψq (gψ z) z := by
    intro z hz
    exact hasFDerivAt_half_normSq z
  have hconvd : ∀ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, ∀ a ∈ X, ∀ b ∈ X,
      f t a + gd t a (b - a) ≤ f t b := by
    intro t ht a ha b hb
    simpa only [gd, innerSL_apply_apply] using hconv t ht a ha b hb
  have hxd : ∀ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, ∀ z ∈ X,
      ηc t * md t (x t) + bregmanDual ψq gψ (x t) (xhat t) ≤
        ηc t * md t z + bregmanDual ψq gψ z (xhat t) := by
    intro t ht z hz
    simpa only [ηc, md, ψq, gψ, innerSL_apply_apply, bregmanDual_normSq,
      add_comm] using hx t ht z hz
  have hxhatd : ∀ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, ∀ z ∈ X,
      ηc t * gd t (x t) (xhat (t + 1)) +
          bregmanDual ψq gψ (xhat (t + 1)) (xhat t) ≤
        ηc t * gd t (x t) z + bregmanDual ψq gψ z (xhat t) := by
    intro t ht z hz
    simpa only [ηc, gd, ψq, gψ, innerSL_apply_apply, bregmanDual_normSq,
      add_comm] using hxhat t ht z hz
  have hfgradd : ∀ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, HasFDerivAt (f t) (gd t (x t)) (x t) :=
    fun t ht => (hfgrad t ht (x t)).hasFDerivAt
  have hfconvd : ∀ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, ConvexOn ℝ X (f t) := by
    intro t ht
    refine ⟨hXconv, ?_⟩
    intro a ha b hb θ φ hθ hφ hθφ
    have hc : θ • a + φ • b ∈ X := hXconv ha hb hθ hφ hθφ
    have h1 := hconvd t ht _ hc a ha
    have h2 := hconvd t ht _ hc b hb
    have hlin : θ * gd t (θ • a + φ • b) (a - (θ • a + φ • b))
        + φ * gd t (θ • a + φ • b) (b - (θ • a + φ • b)) = 0 := by
      have hv : θ • (a - (θ • a + φ • b)) + φ • (b - (θ • a + φ • b)) = 0 := by
        calc θ • (a - (θ • a + φ • b)) + φ • (b - (θ • a + φ • b))
            = (θ • a + φ • b) - (θ + φ) • (θ • a + φ • b) := by
              rw [smul_sub, smul_sub, add_smul]; abel
          _ = 0 := by rw [hθφ, one_smul, sub_self]
      have := congrArg (gd t (θ • a + φ • b)) hv
      rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul, map_zero, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul] at this
      exact this
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    have hsplit : f t (θ • a + φ • b) = θ * f t (θ • a + φ • b) + φ * f t (θ • a + φ • b) := by
      rw [← add_mul, hθφ, one_mul]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hθ, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hφ]
  have hconvp : ∀ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, ∀ b ∈ X,
      f t (x t) + gd t (x t) (b - x t) ≤ f t b :=
    fun t ht b hb => hconvd t ht (x t) (hxX t ht) b hb
  have hmain := theorem1 (T := T) X f gd ψq gψ x xhat u md ηc
    hXconv hηc hscq hψqgrad hfconvd hfgradd hu hxX hxhat1 hxhatX hxd hxhatd
  simp only [ηc, gd, md, ψq, gψ, norm_innerSL_sub, bregmanDual_normSq] at hmain
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := hXne
  have hG0 : 0 ≤ G := (norm_nonneg (gradf 0 x₀)).trans (hG 0 x₀ hx₀)
  have hD0 : 0 ≤ D := by
    have hd0 := hD 0 h0X 0 h0X
    simpa using hd0
  have hadapt : ∀ n ≤ T,
      (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n,
          ‖gradf t (x t) - gradf (t - 1) (x (t - 1))‖ ^ 2)
        ≤ G ^ 2 + 2 * gradVarSup X gradf n
          + 2 * L ^ 2 * (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 2 n, ‖x t - x (t - 1)‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        intro hn
        simp [gradVarSup]
        positivity
    | succ n ih =>
        intro hn
        by_cases hn0 : n = 0
        · subst n
          have hx1 : x 1 ∈ X := hxX 1 (by
            rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
            omega)
          have hg1 := hG 1 (x 1) hx1
          have hg1sq : ‖gradf 1 (x 1)‖ ^ 2 ≤ G ^ 2 :=
            (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) hG0).2 hg1
          simpa [gradVarSup, hgrad0] using hg1sq
        · have hnpos : 1 ≤ n := by omega
          have ihn := ih (by omega)

targets.label: Theorem 4
targets.statement: Theorem 4 Any strategic classification instance $\mathrm{STRAC}\langle\mathcal{H},R,c\rangle$ is agnostic PAC learnable with sample complexity $m_{\mathcal{H},R,c}(\delta,\epsilon)\leq C\epsilon^{-2}[d+\log(\frac{1}{\delta})]$ by the SERM in Eq. (4), where $d=SVC(\mathcal{H},R,c)$ is the strategic VC-dimension and $C$ is an absolute constant.

targets.label: Proposition 9
targets.statement: Proposition 9 For any hypothesis class H, any preference set R satisfying $0\notin R,$ and any separable cost function $c(z;\pmb{x})$ , we have $SVC(\mathcal{H},R,c)\leq 2$

targets.label: Lemma 12
targets.statement:
Lemma 12 For any seminorm $l : \mathbb{R}^{d}\to \mathbb{R}_{\ge 0}$ , and the cost function $c ({\boldsymbol{z}};{\pmb x}) = l ({\boldsymbol{z}}-{\pmb x})$ induced by l, the minimum manipulation cost for x to move to the hyperplane ${\pmb w}\cdot{\pmb x}+ b = 0$ is given by the following:

$$
\operatorname*{min}_{{\pmb x}^{\prime}}\{c({\pmb x}^{\prime};{\pmb x}):{\pmb w}\cdot{\pmb x}^{\prime}+b=0\}=\frac{|{\pmb w}\cdot{\pmb x}+b|}{l^{*}({\pmb w})}
$$

where $\begin{array}{r}{l^{\ast}(\pmb{w})=\operatorname*{sup}_{z\in{\cal B}}\{\pmb{w}\cdot z\}\in\mathbb{R}_{\ge 0}\cup\{+\infty\}}\end{array}$ , and $B=\{z:l(z)\leq 1\}$ is the unit ball induced by l. Assume $l^{*}(\pmb{w})>0$; when $l^{*}(\pmb{w})= +\infty$ the right-hand side is read as $0$.

nl_proof:
### Proof of Theorem 4

Proof Let $\mathcal{Y}=\{+1,-1\}$ . Define another binary hypothesis class $\tilde{H}~=~\{\kappa_{c}(h)~:~h~\in$ $H \}$ , where $\kappa_{c}~ : ~ ({\mathcal X}~ \to ~{\mathcal Y}) ~ \to ~ ({\mathcal X}~ \times ~ R ~ \to ~{\mathcal Y})$ is a mapping such that $\kappa_{c}(h)({\pmb x},r)~=$ $h(\Delta_{c}({\pmb x},r;h)),\forall({\pmb x},r)\in\mathcal{X}\times R.$ Note that the input of classifier $\kappa_{c}(h)$ consists of both the feature vector x and the preference r. By the definition of SVC, we have

$$
\operatorname{VC}(\tilde{H})=\operatorname{SVC}(\mathcal{H},R,c)=d.
$$

Given any distribution D, cost function $c$, and $h \in \mathcal H$ , the strategic 0-1 loss of h is $L_{c}(h,\mathcal{D})=\mathbb{E}_{({\pmb x},y,r)\sim\mathcal{D}}\Big[\mathbb{I}\big [\kappa_{c}(h)({\pmb x},r)\neq y\big]\Big]=L(\kappa_{c}(h),\mathcal{D})$ , where $L(\tilde{h},\mathcal{D})$ is the standard expected risk of the newly defined $\tilde{h}\in \tilde{\mathcal{H}}$ under the distribution D in the non-strategic setting. Therefore, studying the PAC sample complexity upper bound for H under the strategic setting $\langle R,c\rangle$ is equivalent to studying the sample complexity for $\tilde{H}$ in the nonstrategic setting. The latter problem can be addressed by employing the standard PAC learning analysis. From the Fundamental Theorem of Statistical Learning (Theorem 6.8 in (Shalev-Shwartz and Ben-David, 2014)), we know $\tilde{H}$ is agnostic PAC learnable with sample complexity $\begin{array}{r}{O(\epsilon^{-2}(\operatorname{VC}(\tilde{H})+\log\frac{1}{\delta}))}\end{array}$ , meaning that there exists a constant C such that for any $(\delta,\epsilon)\in(0,1)^{2}$ and any distribution D for $(x,y,r)$ , as long as $\begin{array}{r}{n\geq C{\cdot}\epsilon^{-2}(\operatorname{VC}(\tilde{H}){+}\log\frac{1}{\delta})}\end{array}$ with at least probability $1 - \delta$ ,we have

$$
L(\tilde{h}^{*},\mathcal{D})-\operatorname*{inf}_{\tilde{h}\in\tilde{H}}L(\tilde{h},\mathcal{D})\leq\epsilon,
$$

where $\tilde{h}^{*}$ is the solution of ERM with n i.i.d. samples from D as input. Let $h^{*}$ be the solution of the corresponding SERM conditioned on the same n i.i.d. samples from D. By the definition of $\tilde{H}$ and $L_{c},$ we have ${\cal L}_{c}(h^{\ast},{\mathcal D})={\cal L}(\tilde{h}^{\ast},{\mathcal D})$ , and $\begin{array}{r}{\operatorname*{inf}_{h\in\mathcal{H}}L_{c}(h,\mathcal{D})\ =}\end{array}$ $\operatorname{inf}_{\tilde{h}\in\tilde{H}}L(\tilde{h},{\mathcal{D}})$ . Therefore, with probability $1 - \delta$ ,we have

$$
L_{c}(h^{*},\mathcal{D})-\operatorname*{inf}_{h\in\mathcal{H}}L_{c}(h,\mathcal{D})\leq\epsilon,
$$

which implies $\mathrm{STRAC}\langle\mathcal{H},R,c\rangle$ is agnostic PAC learnable with sample complexity $O(\epsilon^{-2}[d+$ $\log(\frac{1}{\delta})])$ by the SERM.

### Proof of Proposition 9

Proof Define the adversarial region for an adversary $({\pmb x},r)$ as $N(\pmb{x},r)=\{z\in\mathcal{X}:c_{2}(z)\leq$ $c_{1}({\pmb x}) + | r | \}\supseteq \{{\pmb x}\}$ . Since staying with the same feature has no cost, this implies $c ({\pmb x};{\pmb x}) = 0$ or equivalently $c_{2}({\pmb x}) \leq c_{1}({\pmb x})$ for any $\mathbf{\boldsymbol{x}}\in \mathcal{X}$ . Then, the best response function for $({\pmb x},r)$ can be characterized by

1. if $h(\pmb{x})=\mathrm{sgn}(r)$ , then $h(\Delta(\mathbf{\boldsymbol{x}},r;h))=\mathrm{sgn}(r)$

2. if $h(\pmb{x})= -\mathrm{sgn}(r)$ , then

$$
h(\Delta(\mathbf{x},r;h))=\begin{cases}-\mathrm{sgn}(r),&\forall z\in N(\mathbf{x},r):h(z)= -\mathrm{sgn}(r)\\ \mathrm{sgn}(r),&\exists z\in N(\mathbf{x},r):h(z)=\mathrm{sgn}(r)\end{cases}\tag{16}
$$

Suppose there are three points $\{(x_{i},r_{i})\}_{i=1}^{3}$ that can be shattered by H. Let $b_{i}\ =$ $c_{1}({\pmb x}_{i}) + r_{i}$ and w.l.o.g. let $b_{1}~ \leq ~ b_{2}~ \leq ~ b_{3}$ From $b_{1}~ \leq ~ b_{2}~ \leq ~ b_{3}$ we have $N(\pmb{x}_{1},r_{1})\subseteq$ $N ({\pmb x}_{2}, r_{2}) \subseteq N ({\pmb x}_{3}, r_{3})$

By Pigeonhole principle, there must exists two elements in $\{r_{1}, r_{2}, r_{3}\}$ which have the same sign. Suppose these two elements are $r_{1}, r_{2}$ and consider the following two cases:

1. $r_{1}>0,r_{2}>0$ . From Equation 16, for any $h\in\mathcal{H},\ h(\Delta({\pmb x}_{2},r_{2};h))= -1$ means $h(z)= -1,\forall z\in N(x_{2},r_{2})$ . Note that $N(\pmb{x}_{1},r_{1})\subseteq N(\pmb{x}_{2},r_{2})$ , we also have $h(z)=$ $-1,\forall z\ \in\ N(\pmb{x}_{1},r_{1})$ . As a result, $h(\Delta(\pmb{x}_{1},r_{1};h))= -1$ , meaning the sign pattern $\{+,-\}$ cannot be achieved by any $h \in \mathcal H$ for $\{({\pmb x}_{1},r_{1}),({\pmb x}_{2},r_{2})\}$ .

2. $r_{1}<0,r_{2}<0$ From Equation 16, for any $h\in\mathcal{H},\ h(\Delta({\pmb x}_{2},r_{2};h))\ =\ 1$ means $h(z)=1,\forall z\in N(x_{2},r_{2})$ . Similarly, from $N(\pmb{x}_{1},r_{1})\subseteq N(\pmb{x}_{2},r_{2})$ we conclude $h(z)=$ $1,\forall z\in N(\pmb{x}_{1},r_{1})$ and $h(\Delta(\pmb{x}_{1},r_{1};h))=1$ , meaning the sign pattern $\{-,+\}$ cannot be achieved by any $h \in \mathcal H$ for $\{(\pmb{x}_{1},r_{1}),(\pmb{x}_{2},r_{2})\}$ .

Therefore, $\{(x_{i},r_{i})\}_{i=1}^{3}$ cannot be shattered by H, which implies $\mathrm{SVC}(\mathcal{H},R,c)\leq 2$
