context.name: Setup: data points, preferences, classifiers (Section 2)
context.statement: Basic Setup. We consider binary classification, where each data point is characterized by a tuple $(x,y,r)$ . Like classic classification setups, $\mathbf{\boldsymbol{x}}\in \mathcal{X}$ is the feature vector and $y \in$ $\{+1,-1\}$ is its label. The only difference of our setup from classic classification problems is the additional $r \in R \subseteq \mathbb{R}$ , which is the data point's (positive or negative) preference/reward of being labeled as +1. The data point's reward for label −1 is, without loss of generality, normalized to be 0. A classifier is a mapping $h:\mathcal{X}\to\{+1,-1\}$ . Our model is essentially the same as that of (Hardt et al., 2016; Miller et al., 2019), except that the r in our model can be any real value from set R whereas the aforementioned works assume $r = 1$ for all data points. Notably, we also allow r to be negative, which means some data points prefer to be classified as label $-1$. This generalization is natural and very useful because it allows much richer agent preferences. For instance, it casts the adversarial/robust classification problem as a special case of our model as well (see discussions later). Intuitively, the set R captures the richness of agents' preferences. As we will prove, how rich it is will affect both the statistical learnability and computational tractability of the learning problem.

context.name: Setup: strategic manipulation and cost functions (Section 2)
context.statement:
The Strategic Manipulation of Test Data. We consider strategic behaviors during the test phase and assume that the training data is unaltered/uncontaminated. An illustration of the setup can be found in Figure 1. A generic test data point is denoted as $(x,y,r)$ . The test data point is strategic and may shift its feature to vector z with cost $c(z;\pmb{x})$ where $c : \mathcal{X}\times \mathcal{X}\to \mathbb{R}_{\ge 0}$ . In general, function c can be an arbitrary non-negative cost function. In our study of strategic linear classification, we assume the cost functions are induced by seminorms. We will consider the following two types of cost functions, with increasing generality.

1. Instance-invariant cost functions: A cost function c is instance-invariant if there is a common function l such that $c(z;\pmb{x})=l(\pmb{z}-\pmb{x})$ for any point $(x,y,r)$ .

2. Instance-wise cost functions: With instance-wise cost functions, each data point is allowed to possess its own loss function. To capture this situation, we need to augment each data point's representation from $(x,y,r)$ to $({\pmb x},y,r,l)$ , where l is a function depending on x such that $c ({\boldsymbol{z}};{\pmb x}) = l ({\boldsymbol{z}}-{\pmb x})$ for some semi-norm l. For notational convenience, we often refer to function l associated with this data point as $l_{x}$ though we emphasize that this is a slight abuse of notation because $l_{x}$ is determined not just by the data point's feature x but rather by the data point itself.4

Both cases have been considered in previous works. For instance, the separable cost function studied in (Hardt et al., 2016) is instance-wise, and the cost function induced by a seminorm as assumed by the main theorem of (Cullina et al., 2018) is instance-invariant. We shall prove later that the choice among these two types of cost functions will largely affect the efficient learnability of the problem.

context.name: Eq. (1): data point best response and tie-breaking
context.statement:
Given a classifier h, the strategic test data point $(x,y,r)$ may shift its feature vector to z and would like to pick the best such z by solving the following optimization problem:

Data Point Best Response:

$$
\Delta_{c}(\pmb{x},r;h)=\arg\operatorname*{max}_{\pmb{\mathrm{z}}\in\mathcal{X}}\big [\mathbb{I}(h(\pmb{z})=1)\cdot r-c(\pmb{z};\pmb{x})\big].\tag{1}
$$

where $\mathbb{I}(S)$ is the indicator function and $[\mathbb{I}(h(z)=1)\cdot r-c(z;\pmb{x})]$ is the quasi-linear utility function of data point $(x,y,r)$ . We call $\Delta_{c}({\pmb x},r;h)$ the manipulated feature. When there are multiple best responses, we assume the data point may choose any best response and thus will adopt the standard worst-case analysis. Note that the test data's strategic behaviors do not change its true label. Such strategic gaming behaviors differ from strategic improvements (see (Miller et al., 2019) for more discussions on their differences). We also point out that the preference r is assumed to be known for any training data (though no need to be known for testing data). While this may appear a strong assumption at the first glance, we believe this parameter can be estimated in real applications (e.g., how much it matters to someone for being admitted to a university, for receiving a loan or for being tested COVID positive). An interesting future direction may be to understand how robust the strategic classifier is to the estimation error of r in the training data.

context.name: StraC problem and Eq. (2): strategic 0-1 loss (Section 2.1)
context.statement:
A STRAC problem is described by a hypothesis class H, the set of preferences R and a manipulation cost function c. We thus denote it as $\mathrm{STRAC}\langle\mathcal{H},R,c\rangle$ . Adopting the standard statistical learning framework, the input to our learning task is n uncontaminated training data points $({\pmb x}_{1},y_{1},r_{1}),\dots,({\pmb x}_{n},y_{n},r_{n})$ drawn independently and identically (i.i.d.) from distribution D. Given these training data, we look to learn a classifier $h \in \mathcal H$ which minimizes the basic 0-1 loss, defined as follows:

Strategic 0-1 Loss of classifier h :

$$
L_{c}(h;\mathcal{D})=\operatorname*{Pr}_{(\mathbf{x},y,r)\sim\mathcal{D}}\big [h(\Delta_{c}(\mathbf{x},r;h))\neq y\big].\tag{2}
$$

Notably, the classifier h in the above loss definition takes the manipulated feature $\textstyle\Delta_{c}({\pmb x},r;h)\big)$ as input and, nevertheless, looks to correctly predict the true label y. For notational convenience, we sometimes omit c when it is clear from the context and simply write $\Delta({\pmb x},r;h)$ and $L(h;\mathcal{D})$ .

context.name: Definition 1 (Strategic Shattering Coefficients)
context.statement:
In this section, we introduce the notion of strategic VC-dimension (SVC) and show that it properly captures the behaviors of a hypothesis class in the strategic setup introduced above. We then show the connection of SVC with previous studies on both strategic and adversarial learning. Before formally introducing SVC, we first define the shattering coefficients in strategic setups.

Definition 1 (Strategic Shattering Coefficients) The n-th shattering coefficient of any strategic classification problem $\mathrm{STRAC}\langle\mathcal{H},R,c\rangle$ is defined as

$$
\sigma_{n}(\mathcal{H},R,c)=\operatorname*{max}_{(\boldsymbol{x},\boldsymbol{r})\in\mathcal{X}^{n}\times R^{n}}~|\{(h(\Delta_{c}(\boldsymbol{x}_{1},\boldsymbol{r}_{1};h)),\cdots,h(\Delta_{c}(\boldsymbol{x}_{n},\boldsymbol{r}_{n};h)):h\in\mathcal{H}\}|,
$$

where $\Delta_{c}(\pmb{x}_{i},r_{i};h)$ defined in Eq. (1) is a best response of data point $({\pmb x}_{i}, y_{i}, r_{i})$ to classifier h under cost function c.

That is, $\sigma_{n}(\mathcal{H},R,c)$ captures the maximum number of classification behaviors/outcomes (among all choices of data points) that classifiers in H can possibly induce by using manipulated features as input. Like classic definition of shattering coefficient, the $\sigma_{n}(\mathcal{H},R,c)$ here does not involve the labels of the data points at all. In contrast, in the shattering coefficient definition for adversarial VC-dimension of (Cullina et al., 2018), the "max" is allowed to be over data labels as well. This is an important difference compared to our setting. Given the definition of the strategic shattering coefficients, the definition of strategic VC-dimension is standard.

context.name: Definition 2 (Strategic VC-dimension), Eq. (3)
context.statement:
Definition 2 The Strategic VC-dimension (SVC) for strategic classification problem $\mathrm{STRAC}\langle\mathcal{H},R,c\rangle$ is defined as

$$
S V C(\mathcal{H},R,c)=\operatorname*{sup}\{n\in\mathbb{N}:\sigma_{n}(\mathcal{H},R,c)=2^{n}\}.\tag{3}
$$

context.name: SERM, Eq. (4)
context.statement:
We show that the SVC defined above correctly characterizes the learnability of any strategic classification problem $\mathrm{STRAC}\langle\mathcal{H},R,c\rangle$ . We consider the standard Empirical risk minimization (ERM) paradigm for strategic classification, but take into account training data's manipulation behaviors. Specifically, given any cost function c, any n uncontaminated training data points $(\mathbf{x}_{1},y_{1},r_{1}),\cdot\cdot\cdot,(\mathbf{x}_{n},y_{n},r_{n})$ drawn independently and identically (i.i.d.) from the same distribution $\mathcal{D}.$ , the strategic empirical risk minimization (SERM) problem computes a classifier $h \in \mathcal H$ that minimizes the empirical strategic 0-1 loss in Eq. (2). Formally, the SERM for $\mathrm{STRAC}\langle\mathcal{H},R,c\rangle$ is defined as follows:

$$
\mathrm{SERM}:\quad\mathrm{argmin}_{h\in\mathcal{H}}\ L_{c}(h,\{(x_{i},y_{i},r_{i})\}_{i=1}^{n})=\sum_{i=1}^{n}\mathbb{I}\big [h(\Delta_{c}(\mathbf{x}_{i},r_{i};h))\neq y_{i}\big]\tag{4}
$$

where $L_{c}(h,\{(x_{i},y_{i},r_{i})\}_{i=1}^{n})$ is the empirical loss (compared to the expected loss $L_{c}(h,\mathcal{D})$ defined in Eq. (2)). Unlike the standard (non-strategic) ERM problem and similar in spirit to the "incentive-aware ERM" in (Zhang and Conitzer, 2021), classifiers in the SERM problem take each data point's strategic response $\Delta_{c}~({\bf x}_{i},r_{i};h)$ as input, while not the original feature vector $\pmb{x}_{i}$

context.name: Definition 3 (PAC-Learnability)
context.statement:
Given the definition of strategic VC-dimension and the SERM framework, we state the sample complexity result for PAC-learning in our strategic setup:

Definition 3 (PAC-Learnability) In a strategic classification problem $\mathrm{STRAC}\langle\mathcal{H},R,c\rangle$ the hypothesis class $\mathcal{H}\subseteq(\mathcal{X}\to\{+1,-1\})$ is Probably Approximately Correctly (PAC) learnable by an algorithm A if there is a function $m_{\mathcal{H},R,c}:(0,1)^{2}\to\mathbb{N}$ such that $\forall(\delta,\epsilon)\in$ $(0,1)^{2}$ , for any $n\ge m_{\mathcal{H},R,c}(\delta,\epsilon)$ and any distribution D for $({\pmb x},y,r)$ , with at least probability $1 - \delta$ , we have $L_{c}(h^{\ast},\mathcal{D})\leq\epsilon$ where $h^{*}$ is the output of the algorithm A with n i.i.d. samples from D as input. The problem is agnostic PAC learnable if $\begin{array}{r}{L_{c}(h^{*},\mathcal{D})-\operatorname*{inf}_{h\in\mathcal{H}}L_{c}(h,\mathcal{D})\leq\epsilon}\end{array}$

context.name: Separable cost functions (Section 3.2)
context.statement:
Not only restricting the set R of preference values can reduce the SVC. This subsection shows that restricting to special classes of cost functions can also lead to a small SVC. One special class of cost functions studied in many previous works is the separable cost functions (Hardt et al., 2016; Milli et al., 2019; Hu et al., 2019a). Formally, a cost function $c(z;\pmb{x})$ is separable if there exists function $c_{1}, c_{2}: \mathcal{X}\to \mathbb{R}$ such that $c(\pmb{z};\pmb{x})=\operatorname*{max}\left\{c_{2}(\pmb{z})-c_{1}(\pmb{x}),0\right\}$

The following Proposition 9 shows that when the cost function is separable, SVC is at most 2 for any hypothesis class H and any class of preference set $R .^{5}$ Therefore, separable cost function essentially reduces any classification problem to a problem in lower dimension. Together with Theorem 4, Proposition 9 also recovers the PAC-learnability result of (Hardt et al., 2016) in their strategic-robust learning model (specifically, Theorem 1.8 of (2016)) and, moreover, generalizes their learnability from homogeneous agent preferences to the case with arbitrary agent preference values.

context.name: Remark after Proposition 9: role of 0 not in R
context.statement: The assumption $0 \notin R$ implies that each agent must strictly prefer either label +1 or $- 1$ . This assumption is necessary since if $0\in R,$ SVC will be at least the classic VC dimension of H and thus Proposition 9 cannot hold. We remark that the above SVC upper bound 2 holds for any hypothesis class H. This bound 2 is tight for some classes of hypothesis, e.g., linear classifiers.

context.name: Setup: strategic linear classification (Section 4)
context.statement:
This section instantiates our previous general framework in one of the most fundamental special cases, i.e., linear classification. We will study both the statistical and computational efficiency in strategic linear classification. Naturally, we will restrict $\mathcal{X}\subseteq \mathbb{R}^{d}$ in this section. Moreover, the cost functions are always assumed to be induced by seminorms.6 A linear classifier is defined by a hyperplane ${\pmb w}\cdot{\pmb x}+ b = 0$; feature vector x is classified as +1 if and only if ${\pmb w}\cdot{\pmb x}+ b \ge 0$ With slight abuse of notation, we sometimes also call $({\boldsymbol{\mathbf{\mathit{w}}}},{\boldsymbol{b}})$ a hyperplane or a linear classifier. Let $\mathcal{H}_{d}$ denote the hypothesis set of all d-dimensional linear classifiers. For linear classifier $({\boldsymbol{\mathbf{\mathit{w}}}},{\boldsymbol{b}})$ , the data point's best response can be more explicitly expressed as:

$$
\Delta_{c}(x,r;w,b)=\arg\operatorname*{max}_{z}\left[\mathbb{I}(w\cdot z+b\ge 0)\cdot r-c(z;\pmb{x})\right].
$$

context.name: Theorem 11 (statement; Lemma 12 is a tool in its proof)
context.statement:
Theorem 11 Consider an instance of strategic linear classification $\mathrm{STRAC}\langle\mathcal{H}_{d},R,c\rangle$ . For any instance-invariant cost function $c ({\boldsymbol{z}};{\pmb x}) = l ({\boldsymbol{z}}-{\pmb x})$ where l is a seminorm, we have $S V C(\mathcal{H}_{d},R,c)=d+1-\mathrm{dim}(V_{l})$ for any bounded R, where $V_{l}$ is the largest linear space contained in the ball $B=\{\pmb{x}:l(\pmb{x})\leq 1\}$

In particular, if l is a norm $(i . e .,l(\pmb{x})=0\operatorname{iff}\pmb{x}=0)$ , then dim $(V_{l})=0$ and $SVC(\mathcal{H},R,c)=$ $d + 1$

context.name: Facts about the seminorm unit ball and l* (proof of Theorem 11)
context.statement: For any seminorm l, it is known the set $B=\{x:l(x)\leq 1\}$ is nonempty, closed, convex, and origin-symmetric. Let $l^{*}(\pmb{w})=\operatorname*{sup}_{z\in B}\{\pmb{w}\cdot\pmb{z}\}$ . We have $l^{*}(w)>0$ for all $\pmb{w} \neq \mathbf{0}$ since 0 is an interior point of B.

namespace UCdev

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped ENNReal NNReal

/-! ## The Rademacher (sign) measure -/

/-- The uniform measure on `Bool`. -/
noncomputable def signMeasure : Measure Bool :=
  (1/2 : ℝ≥0∞) • (Measure.dirac true + Measure.dirac false)

instance : IsProbabilityMeasure signMeasure := by
  constructor
  simp [signMeasure]
  exact ENNReal.inv_two_add_inv_two

lemma integral_signMeasure (g : Bool → ℝ) :
    ∫ b, g b ∂signMeasure = (g true + g false) / 2 := by
  rw [signMeasure]
  rw [integral_smul_measure, integral_add_measure (by simp) (by simp), integral_dirac,
    integral_dirac]
  simp
  ring

/-- The uniform measure on sign vectors. -/
noncomputable def signPi (n : ℕ) : Measure (Fin n → Bool) :=
  Measure.pi (fun _ => signMeasure)

instance (n : ℕ) : IsProbabilityMeasure (signPi n) := by
  unfold signPi; infer_instance

/-- `sgn b = 1` if `b = false` and `-1` if `b = true`. -/
def sgn (b : Bool) : ℝ := if b then -1 else 1

lemma sgn_mem_Icc (b : Bool) : sgn b ∈ Set.Icc (-1:ℝ) 1 := by
  cases b <;> norm_num [sgn]

lemma integral_sgn_mul (v : ℝ) : ∫ b, sgn b * v ∂signMeasure = 0 := by
  rw [integral_signMeasure]
  simp [sgn]

/-! ## A general Hoeffding inequality for i.i.d. coordinates of a product measure -/

lemma integral_pi_coord {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] (D : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure D]
    {n : ℕ} (j : Fin n) (g : Z → ℝ) (hg : Measurable g) :
    ∫ s, g (s j) ∂(Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)) = ∫ z, g z ∂D := by
  conv_rhs => rw [← (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin n => D) j).map_eq]
  rw [integral_map (measurable_pi_apply j).aemeasurable hg.aestronglyMeasurable]

/-- Hoeffding's inequality for a sum of functions of independent coordinates. -/
lemma pi_hoeffding {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] (D : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure D]
    (n : ℕ) (φ : Fin n → Z → ℝ) (hφ : ∀ j, Measurable (φ j))
    (a b : Fin n → ℝ) (hab : ∀ j z, φ j z ∈ Set.Icc (a j) (b j)) (hab' : ∀ j, a j ≤ b j)
    (hmean : ∀ j, ∫ z, φ j z ∂D = 0) (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)).real {s | u ≤ ∑ j, φ j (s j)}
      ≤ Real.exp (-u ^ 2 / (2 * ∑ j, ((b j - a j) / 2) ^ 2)) := by
  classical
  set μ := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D) with hμ
  set X : Fin n → (Fin n → Z) → ℝ := fun j s => φ j (s j) with hX
  have hindep : iIndepFun X μ :=
    iIndepFun_pi (μ := fun _ : Fin n => D) (X := fun (j : Fin n) (z : Z) => φ j z)
      (fun j => (hφ j).aemeasurable)
  have hsubG : ∀ j : Fin n, HasSubgaussianMGF (X j) ((‖b j - a j‖₊ / 2) ^ 2) μ := by
    intro j
    refine hasSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc_of_integral_eq_zero (μ := μ) (X := X j)
      ((hφ j).comp (measurable_pi_apply j)).aemeasurable ?_ ?_
    · filter_upwards with s
      exact hab j (s j)
    · show ∫ s, φ j (s j) ∂μ = 0
      rw [hμ, integral_pi_coord D j (φ j) (hφ j)]
      exact hmean j
  have hmain := HasSubgaussianMGF.measure_sum_ge_le_of_iIndepFun hindep
    (c := fun j => (‖b j - a j‖₊ / 2) ^ 2) (s := Finset.univ) (fun j _ => hsubG j) hu
  have hcast : ((∑ j : Fin n, (‖b j - a j‖₊ / 2) ^ 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)
      = ∑ j, ((b j - a j) / 2) ^ 2 := by
    push_cast
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by have := hab' j; linarith)]
  simpa [hcast] using hmain

lemma integral_signPi_coord {n : ℕ} (j : Fin n) (g : Bool → ℝ) :
    ∫ σ, g (σ j) ∂(signPi n) = ∫ b, g b ∂signMeasure := by
  rw [← (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin n => signMeasure) j).map_eq,
    integral_map (measurable_pi_apply j).aemeasurable
      (Measurable.of_discrete (f := g)).aestronglyMeasurable]
  rfl

/-- One-sided Hoeffding bound for Rademacher sums. -/
lemma rademacher_tail {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → ℝ) (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    (signPi n).real {σ | u ≤ ∑ j, sgn (σ j) * v j}
      ≤ Real.exp (-u ^ 2 / (2 * ∑ j, (v j) ^ 2)) := by
  classical
  set X : Fin n → (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ := fun j σ => sgn (σ j) * v j with hX
  have hindep : iIndepFun X (signPi n) := by
    have := iIndepFun_pi (μ := fun _ : Fin n => signMeasure)
      (X := fun (j : Fin n) (b : Bool) => sgn b * v j)
      (fun j => (Measurable.of_discrete (f := fun b : Bool => sgn b * v j)).aemeasurable)
    exact this
  have hsubG : ∀ j : Fin n, HasSubgaussianMGF (X j) (‖v j‖₊ ^ 2) (signPi n) := by
    intro j
    have hmean : ∫ σ, X j σ ∂(signPi n) = 0 := by
      rw [hX]
      simp only
      rw [integral_signPi_coord j (fun b => sgn b * v j)]
      exact integral_sgn_mul (v j)
    have hbd : ∀ᵐ σ ∂(signPi n), X j σ ∈ Set.Icc (-|v j|) (|v j|) := by
      filter_upwards with σ
      rcases sgn_mem_Icc (σ j) with ⟨h1, h2⟩
      constructor
      · rcases le_or_lt 0 (v j) with h | h
        · nlinarith [abs_of_nonneg h]
        · nlinarith [abs_of_neg h]
      · rcases le_or_lt 0 (v j) with h | h
        · nlinarith [abs_of_nonneg h]
        · nlinarith [abs_of_neg h]
    have := hasSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc_of_integral_eq_zero
      (μ := signPi n) (X := X j)
      (Measurable.aemeasurable (by fun_prop)) hbd hmean
    have heq : (‖|v j| - -|v j|‖₊ / 2 : ℝ≥0) ^ 2 = ‖v j‖₊ ^ 2 := by
      have : |v j| - -|v j| = 2 * |v j| := by ring
      rw [this]
      congr 1
      rw [nnnorm_mul]
      simp [Real.nnnorm_abs]
    rwa [heq] at this
  have hmain := HasSubgaussianMGF.measure_sum_ge_le_of_iIndepFun hindep
    (c := fun j => ‖v j‖₊ ^ 2) (s := Finset.univ) (fun j _ => hsubG j) hu
  have hcast : ((∑ j : Fin n, ‖v j‖₊ ^ 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) = ∑ j, (v j) ^ 2 := by
    push_cast
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  rw [hcast] at hmain
  exact hmain

/-- Two-sided version of `pi_hoeffding`. -/
lemma pi_hoeffding_abs {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] (D : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure D]
    (n : ℕ) (φ : Fin n → Z → ℝ) (hφ : ∀ j, Measurable (φ j))
    (a b : Fin n → ℝ) (hab : ∀ j z, φ j z ∈ Set.Icc (a j) (b j)) (hab' : ∀ j, a j ≤ b j)
    (hmean : ∀ j, ∫ z, φ j z ∂D = 0) (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)).real {s | u ≤ |∑ j, φ j (s j)|}
      ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-u ^ 2 / (2 * ∑ j, ((b j - a j) / 2) ^ 2)) := by
  classical
  set μ := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D) with hμ
  have h1 := pi_hoeffding D n φ hφ a b hab hab' hmean u hu
  have h2 := pi_hoeffding D n (fun j z => -(φ j z)) (fun j => (hφ j).neg)
    (fun j => -(b j)) (fun j => -(a j))
    (fun j z => by
      rcases hab j z with ⟨h1, h2⟩
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
    (fun j => by have := hab' j; linarith)
    (fun j => by rw [integral_neg, hmean j, neg_zero]) u hu
  have hsub : {s : Fin n → Z | u ≤ |∑ j, φ j (s j)|}
      ⊆ {s | u ≤ ∑ j, φ j (s j)} ∪ {s | u ≤ ∑ j, -(φ j (s j))} := by
    intro s hs
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hs
    rcases abs_cases (∑ j, φ j (s j)) with ⟨he, _⟩ | ⟨he, _⟩
    · left; simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]; linarith [hs, he.symm ▸ hs]
    · right
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      rw [he] at hs
      linarith
  have hle := measureReal_mono (μ := μ) hsub (by simp [hμ])
  have hunion : μ.real ({s : Fin n → Z | u ≤ ∑ j, φ j (s j)}
      ∪ {s | u ≤ ∑ j, -(φ j (s j))}) ≤ μ.real {s : Fin n → Z | u ≤ ∑ j, φ j (s j)}
      + μ.real {s : Fin n → Z | u ≤ ∑ j, -(φ j (s j))} := measureReal_union_le _ _
  have heq : ∑ j, ((-(a j) - -(b j)) / 2) ^ 2 = ∑ j, ((b j - a j) / 2) ^ 2 := by
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    ring_nf
  rw [heq] at h2
  linarith

/-- Indicator of a Boolean test. -/
def ind (b : Bool) : ℝ := if b then 1 else 0

lemma ind_mem_Icc (b : Bool) : ind b ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 := by
  cases b <;> norm_num [ind]

lemma measurable_ind {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] {g : Z → Bool} (hg : Measurable g) :
    Measurable (fun z => ind (g z)) :=
  (Measurable.of_discrete (f := ind)).comp hg

lemma integral_ind {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] (D : Measure Z) (g : Z → Bool)
    (hg : Measurable g) :
    ∫ z, ind (g z) ∂D = (D {z | g z = true}).toReal := by
  have hset : MeasurableSet {z | g z = true} := hg (measurableSet_singleton true)
  have h1 : (fun z => ind (g z)) = Set.indicator {z | g z = true} (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) := by
    funext z
    by_cases h : g z = true
    · simp [ind, h, Set.indicator_of_mem, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at h
      simp [ind, h, Set.indicator_of_notMem, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  rw [h1, integral_indicator_const (1:ℝ) hset]
  simp [measureReal_def]

lemma integrable_ind {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] (D : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure D]
    (g : Z → Bool) (hg : Measurable g) : Integrable (fun z => ind (g z)) D := by
  refine Integrable.of_mem_Icc 0 1 (measurable_ind hg).aemeasurable ?_
  filter_upwards with z
  exact ind_mem_Icc (g z)

/-- Hoeffding's inequality for the empirical count of a Boolean test. -/
lemma emp_hoeffding {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] (D : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure D]
    (g : Z → Bool) (hg : Measurable g) (n : ℕ) (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)).real
        {s | u ≤ |∑ j, (ind (g (s j)) - (D {z | g z = true}).toReal)|}
      ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-u ^ 2 / (2 * ((n:ℝ) / 4))) := by
  classical
  set p := (D {z | g z = true}).toReal with hp
  have hp0 : 0 ≤ p := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  have hp1 : p ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hp]
    have h : D {z | g z = true} ≤ 1 := prob_le_one
    exact ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal (by norm_num) (by simpa using h)
  have hmeas : ∀ _j : Fin n, Measurable (fun z : Z => ind (g z) - p) :=
    fun _ => (measurable_ind hg).sub measurable_const
  have hbd : ∀ (j : Fin n) (z : Z), (fun _ (z : Z) => ind (g z) - p) j z ∈
      Set.Icc ((fun _ : Fin n => -p) j) ((fun _ : Fin n => 1 - p) j) := by
    intro j z
    rcases ind_mem_Icc (g z) with ⟨h1, h2⟩
    exact ⟨by simpa using (by linarith : -p ≤ ind (g z) - p),
      by simpa using (by linarith : ind (g z) - p ≤ 1 - p)⟩
  have hab' : ∀ _j : Fin n, (-p : ℝ) ≤ 1 - p := fun _ => by linarith
  have hmean : ∀ _j : Fin n, ∫ z, (ind (g z) - p) ∂D = 0 := by
    intro j
    rw [integral_sub (integrable_ind D g hg) (integrable_const p), integral_ind D g hg, ← hp]
    simp
  have hmain := pi_hoeffding_abs D n (fun _ z => ind (g z) - p) hmeas
    (fun _ => -p) (fun _ => 1 - p) hbd hab' hmean u hu
  have heq : (∑ _j : Fin n, (((1 - p) - -p) / 2) ^ 2) = (n:ℝ) / 4 := by
    have : ∀ _j : Fin n, (((1 - p) - -p) / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2 = 1/4 := by
      intro j; ring_nf
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => this j)]
    simp
    ring
  rw [heq] at hmain
  exact hmain

/-! ## Symmetrization -/

/-- Empirical average of a Boolean test on a sample. -/
noncomputable def empAvg {Z : Type*} {n : ℕ} (g : Z → Bool) (s : Fin n → Z) : ℝ :=
  (∑ j, ind (g (s j))) / n

/-- True risk. -/
noncomputable def riskOf {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] (D : Measure Z) (g : Z → Bool) : ℝ :=
  (D {z | g z = true}).toReal

lemma measurable_empAvg {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] {n : ℕ} (g : Z → Bool)
    (hg : Measurable g) : Measurable (fun s : Fin n → Z => empAvg g s) := by
  unfold empAvg
  refine Measurable.div_const ?_ _
  refine Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun j _ => ?_)
  exact (measurable_ind hg).comp (measurable_pi_apply j)

lemma empAvg_bound {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] (D : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure D]
    (g : Z → Bool) (hg : Measurable g) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hnt : 8 ≤ (n:ℝ) * t ^ 2) :
    (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)) {s | t/2 < |empAvg g s - riskOf D g|}
      ≤ 1/2 := by
  classical
  set μ := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D) with hμ
  simp only [riskOf]
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p : ℝ, (D {z | g z = true}).toReal = p := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [hp]
  have hn0 : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hsub : {s : Fin n → Z | t/2 < |empAvg g s - p|}
      ⊆ {s : Fin n → Z | (n:ℝ) * (t/2) ≤ |∑ j, (ind (g (s j)) - p)|} := by
    intro s hs
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hs ⊢
    have hsum : ∑ j, (ind (g (s j)) - p) = (n:ℝ) * (empAvg g s - p) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      simp [empAvg]
      field_simp
    rw [hsum, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hn0.le]
    have := hs
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg (empAvg g s - p)]
  have hmeas : MeasurableSet {s : Fin n → Z | (n:ℝ) * (t/2) ≤ |∑ j, (ind (g (s j)) - p)|} := by
    refine measurableSet_le measurable_const ?_
    refine (Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun j _ => ?_)).abs
    exact ((measurable_ind hg).comp (measurable_pi_apply j)).sub measurable_const
  have hH := emp_hoeffding D g hg n ((n:ℝ) * (t/2)) (by positivity)
  rw [hp] at hH
  have hexp : 2 * Real.exp (-((n:ℝ) * (t/2)) ^ 2 / (2 * ((n:ℝ)/4))) ≤ 1/2 := by
    have hEq : (-((n:ℝ) * (t/2)) ^ 2 / (2 * ((n:ℝ)/4))) = -((n:ℝ) * t ^ 2)/2 := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [hEq]
    have h4 : (-((n:ℝ) * t ^ 2)/2) ≤ -4 := by linarith
    have := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h4
    have he4 : Real.exp (-4) ≤ 1/4 := by
      rw [Real.exp_neg]
      rw [inv_le_comm₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
      have : (4:ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 4 := by
        have h1 : (1:ℝ) + 4 ≤ Real.exp 4 := by
          have := Real.add_one_le_exp (4:ℝ)
          linarith
        linarith
      linarith
    linarith
  have hreal : μ.real {s : Fin n → Z | (n:ℝ) * (t/2) ≤ |∑ j, (ind (g (s j)) - p)|} ≤ 1/2 :=
    le_trans hH hexp
  have hfin : μ {s : Fin n → Z | (n:ℝ) * (t/2) ≤ |∑ j, (ind (g (s j)) - p)|} ≤ 1/2 := by
    have hne : μ {s : Fin n → Z | (n:ℝ) * (t/2) ≤ |∑ j, (ind (g (s j)) - p)|} ≠ ⊤ :=
      measure_ne_top _ _
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hne]
    calc ENNReal.ofReal (μ {s : Fin n → Z | (n:ℝ) * (t/2) ≤ |∑ j, (ind (g (s j)) - p)|}).toReal
        ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hreal
      _ = 1/2 := by
          rw [ENNReal.ofReal_div_of_pos (by norm_num)]
          simp
  exact le_trans (measure_mono hsub) hfin

/-- **Symmetrization**: the deviation of the empirical average from the true risk is
controlled by the deviation between two independent samples. -/
lemma symmetrization {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] (D : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure D]
    {ι : Type*} [Countable ι] (f : ι → Z → Bool) (hf : ∀ i, Measurable (f i))
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (hnt : 8 ≤ (n:ℝ) * t ^ 2) :
    (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)) {s | ∃ i, t < |empAvg (f i) s - riskOf D (f i)|}
      ≤ 2 * ((Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)).prod (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)))
          {q : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z) |
            ∃ i, t/2 < |empAvg (f i) q.1 - empAvg (f i) q.2|} := by
  classical
  set μ := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D) with hμ
  set Bad := {s : Fin n → Z | ∃ i, t < |empAvg (f i) s - riskOf D (f i)|} with hBad
  set Bad2 := {q : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z) |
    ∃ i, t/2 < |empAvg (f i) q.1 - empAvg (f i) q.2|} with hBad2
  have hBadm : MeasurableSet Bad := by
    have hEq : Bad = ⋃ i : ι, {s : Fin n → Z | t < |empAvg (f i) s - riskOf D (f i)|} := by
      ext s; simp [hBad]
    rw [hEq]
    exact MeasurableSet.iUnion (fun i => measurableSet_lt measurable_const
      (((measurable_empAvg (f i) (hf i)).sub measurable_const).abs))
  have hBad2m : MeasurableSet Bad2 := by
    have hEq : Bad2 = ⋃ i : ι, {q : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z) |
        t/2 < |empAvg (f i) q.1 - empAvg (f i) q.2|} := by
      ext q; simp [hBad2]
    rw [hEq]
    refine MeasurableSet.iUnion (fun i => measurableSet_lt measurable_const ?_)
    exact (((measurable_empAvg (f i) (hf i)).comp measurable_fst).sub
      ((measurable_empAvg (f i) (hf i)).comp measurable_snd)).abs
  have hkey : ∀ s ∈ Bad, (1:ℝ≥0∞)/2 ≤ μ (Prod.mk s ⁻¹' Bad2) := by
    intro s hs
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hs
    have hAm : MeasurableSet {s' : Fin n → Z | t/2 < |empAvg (f i) s' - riskOf D (f i)|} :=
      measurableSet_lt measurable_const
        (((measurable_empAvg (f i) (hf i)).sub measurable_const).abs)
    have hA : μ {s' : Fin n → Z | t/2 < |empAvg (f i) s' - riskOf D (f i)|} ≤ 1/2 :=
      empAvg_bound D (f i) (hf i) n hn t ht hnt
    have hcompl : (1:ℝ≥0∞)/2
        ≤ μ ({s' : Fin n → Z | t/2 < |empAvg (f i) s' - riskOf D (f i)|}ᶜ) := by
      rw [prob_compl_eq_one_sub hAm]
      have h2 : (1:ℝ≥0∞) - 1/2 = 1/2 := by
        rw [one_div]
        exact ENNReal.sub_eq_of_eq_add (by simp) ENNReal.inv_two_add_inv_two.symm
      calc (1:ℝ≥0∞)/2 = 1 - 1/2 := h2.symm
        _ ≤ 1 - μ {s' : Fin n → Z | t/2 < |empAvg (f i) s' - riskOf D (f i)|} :=
            tsub_le_tsub_left hA 1
    refine le_trans hcompl (measure_mono ?_)
    intro s' hs'
    simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_lt] at hs'
    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
    have h1 : |empAvg (f i) s - riskOf D (f i)| - |empAvg (f i) s' - riskOf D (f i)|
        ≤ |empAvg (f i) s - empAvg (f i) s'| := by
      have h2 := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (empAvg (f i) s - riskOf D (f i))
        (empAvg (f i) s' - riskOf D (f i))
      have h3 : (empAvg (f i) s - riskOf D (f i)) - (empAvg (f i) s' - riskOf D (f i))
          = empAvg (f i) s - empAvg (f i) s' := by ring
      rwa [h3] at h2
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    linarith
  have hprod : (μ.prod μ) Bad2 = ∫⁻ s, μ (Prod.mk s ⁻¹' Bad2) ∂μ := Measure.prod_apply hBad2m
  have hint : (1/2 : ℝ≥0∞) * μ Bad ≤ (μ.prod μ) Bad2 := by
    rw [hprod]
    calc (1/2 : ℝ≥0∞) * μ Bad
        = ∫⁻ s, Set.indicator Bad (fun _ => (1:ℝ≥0∞)/2) s ∂μ := by
          rw [lintegral_indicator hBadm]
          simp [mul_comm]
      _ ≤ ∫⁻ s, μ (Prod.mk s ⁻¹' Bad2) ∂μ := by
          refine lintegral_mono (fun s => ?_)
          by_cases h : s ∈ Bad
          · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem h]
            exact hkey s h
          · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem h]
            exact zero_le _
  have h2half : (2:ℝ≥0∞) * (1/2) = 1 := by
    rw [one_div, ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
  calc μ Bad = 2 * ((1/2 : ℝ≥0∞) * μ Bad) := by rw [← mul_assoc, h2half, one_mul]
    _ ≤ 2 * ((μ.prod μ) Bad2) := by exact mul_le_mul_left' hint 2

/-! ## Reindexing invariance of product measures -/

lemma pi_map_reindex {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] (D : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure D]
    {J : Type*} [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] (e : J ≃ J) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun w : J → Z => fun j => w (e j))
      (Measure.pi fun _ : J => D) (Measure.pi fun _ : J => D) := by
  have hmeas : Measurable (fun w : J → Z => fun j => w (e j)) :=
    measurable_pi_lambda _ (fun j => measurable_pi_apply (e j))
  refine ⟨hmeas, ?_⟩
  refine (Measure.pi_eq ?_).symm
  intro s hs
  have hpre : (fun w : J → Z => fun j => w (e j)) ⁻¹' (Set.pi Set.univ s)
      = Set.pi Set.univ (fun j => s (e.symm j)) := by
    ext w
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_pi, Set.mem_univ, forall_true_left]
    constructor
    · intro h j
      have := h (e.symm j)
      simpa using this
    · intro h j
      have h2 := h (e j)
      rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] at h2
      exact h2
  rw [Measure.map_apply hmeas (MeasurableSet.univ_pi hs), hpre,
    Measure.pi_pi]
  exact Equiv.prod_comp e.symm (fun j => D (s j))

end UCdev

set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
open scoped symmDiff
open Finset

namespace VCcomb

variable {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [Fintype α]

/-- Restriction of a set along a list of coordinates. -/
def restr {m : ℕ} (φ : Fin m → α) (s : Finset α) : Finset (Fin m) :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun j => φ j ∈ s)

@[simp] lemma mem_restr {m : ℕ} (φ : Fin m → α) (s : Finset α) (j : Fin m) :
    j ∈ restr φ s ↔ φ j ∈ s := by simp [restr]

/-- The VC dimension of a restricted family is at most that of the original family. -/
lemma vcDim_image_restr_le {m : ℕ} (φ : Fin m → α) (Q : Finset (Finset α)) :
    (Q.image (restr φ)).vcDim ≤ Q.vcDim := by
  classical
  refine Finset.sup_le ?_
  intro S hS
  rw [Finset.mem_shatterer] at hS
  -- φ is injective on S
  have hinj : Set.InjOn φ S := by
    intro j hj j' hj' hjj'
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hSu⟩ := hS (show ({j} : Finset (Fin m)) ⊆ S by
      simpa using hj)
    rw [Finset.mem_image] at hu
    obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := hu
    have h1 : j ∈ S ∩ restr φ s := by rw [hSu]; simp
    have h2 : j' ∉ S ∩ restr φ s := by
      rw [hSu, Finset.mem_singleton]; exact fun h => hne h.symm
    simp only [Finset.mem_inter, mem_restr] at h1 h2
    exact h2 ⟨hj', by rw [← hjj']; exact h1.2⟩
  -- Q shatters the image
  have hsh : Q.Shatters (S.image φ) := by
    intro U hU
    -- pull back U
    set T : Finset (Fin m) := S.filter (fun j => φ j ∈ U) with hT
    have hTS : T ⊆ S := Finset.filter_subset _ _
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hSu⟩ := hS hTS
    rw [Finset.mem_image] at hu
    obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := hu
    refine ⟨s, hs, ?_⟩
    ext a
    simp only [Finset.mem_inter, Finset.mem_image]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨j, hj, rfl⟩, has⟩
      have : j ∈ S ∩ restr φ s := by simp [hj, has]
      rw [hSu, hT] at this
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at this
      exact this.2
    · intro haU
      have haS : a ∈ S.image φ := hU haU
      rw [Finset.mem_image] at haS
      obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := haS
      have hjT : j ∈ T := by simp [hT, hj, haU]
      have : j ∈ S ∩ restr φ s := by rw [hSu]; exact hjT
      simp only [Finset.mem_inter, mem_restr] at this
      exact ⟨⟨j, hj, rfl⟩, this.2⟩
  have := hsh.card_le_vcDim
  rwa [Finset.card_image_of_injOn hinj] at this

/-- Core counting step: if the family is well separated, some choice of `m` coordinates
separates all its members. -/
lemma exists_injOn_restr [Nonempty α] (Q : Finset (Finset α)) (m : ℕ) (q : ℝ)
    (hq0 : 0 ≤ q)
    (hsep : ∀ s ∈ Q, ∀ t ∈ Q, s ≠ t →
      ((Fintype.card α - (s ∆ t).card : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ q * Fintype.card α)
    (hlt : (Q.card : ℝ) * (Q.card : ℝ) * q ^ m < 1) :
    ∃ φ : Fin m → α, ∀ s ∈ Q, ∀ t ∈ Q, restr φ s = restr φ t → s = t := by
  classical
  set N := Fintype.card α with hN
  have hN0 : 0 < N := Fintype.card_pos
  set P : Finset ((Finset α) × (Finset α)) := (Q ×ˢ Q).filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ p.2) with hP
  set Bad : Finset (Fin m → α) :=
    P.biUnion (fun p => Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin m => (p.1 ∆ p.2)ᶜ)) with hBad
  have hcardBad : (Bad.card : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) ^ m := by
    have h1 : Bad.card ≤ ∑ p ∈ P, (Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin m => (p.1 ∆ p.2)ᶜ)).card :=
      Finset.card_biUnion_le
    have h2 : ∀ p ∈ P, ((Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin m => (p.1 ∆ p.2)ᶜ)).card : ℝ)
        ≤ (q * N) ^ m := by
      intro p hp
      rw [Fintype.card_piFinset]
      simp only [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      rw [Finset.card_compl]
      push_cast
      refine pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) ?_ m
      simp only [hP, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at hp
      exact hsep p.1 hp.1.1 p.2 hp.1.2 hp.2
    have h3 : ((∑ p ∈ P, (Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin m => (p.1 ∆ p.2)ᶜ)).card : ℕ) : ℝ)
        ≤ (P.card : ℝ) * (q * N) ^ m := by
      push_cast
      calc ∑ p ∈ P, ((Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin m => (p.1 ∆ p.2)ᶜ)).card : ℝ)
          ≤ ∑ _p ∈ P, (q * N) ^ m := Finset.sum_le_sum h2
        _ = (P.card : ℝ) * (q * N) ^ m := by rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    have h4 : (P.card : ℝ) ≤ (Q.card : ℝ) * (Q.card : ℝ) := by
      have : P.card ≤ (Q ×ˢ Q).card := Finset.card_filter_le _ _
      rw [Finset.card_product] at this
      exact_mod_cast this
    have h5 : (Bad.card : ℝ) ≤ (Q.card : ℝ) * (Q.card : ℝ) * (q * N) ^ m := by
      refine le_trans (by exact_mod_cast h1) (le_trans h3 ?_)
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h4 (by positivity)
    have h6 : (Q.card : ℝ) * (Q.card : ℝ) * (q * N) ^ m < (N:ℝ) ^ m := by
      rw [mul_pow, ← mul_assoc]
      have hNpow : (0:ℝ) < (N:ℝ) ^ m := by positivity
      calc (Q.card : ℝ) * (Q.card : ℝ) * q ^ m * (N:ℝ) ^ m
          < 1 * (N:ℝ) ^ m := by
            exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hlt hNpow
        _ = (N:ℝ) ^ m := one_mul _
    linarith
  have hne : Bad ≠ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m → α)) := by
    intro h
    have : (Bad.card : ℝ) = (N:ℝ) ^ m := by
      rw [h]
      simp [Finset.card_univ, hN]
    linarith [hcardBad, this.ge, this.le]
  obtain ⟨φ, _, hφ⟩ : ∃ φ ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m → α)), φ ∉ Bad := by
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    exact hne (Finset.eq_univ_of_forall (fun φ => hcon φ (Finset.mem_univ φ)))
  refine ⟨φ, fun s hs t ht hst => ?_⟩
  by_contra hne2
  apply hφ
  rw [hBad, Finset.mem_biUnion]
  refine ⟨(s, t), ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [hP, hs, ht, hne2]
  · rw [Fintype.mem_piFinset]
    intro j
    simp only [Finset.mem_compl, Finset.mem_symmDiff]
    have : (j ∈ restr φ s) = (j ∈ restr φ t) := by rw [hst]
    simp only [mem_restr, eq_iff_iff] at this
    tauto


/-- Sauer bound arithmetic: `∑_{k ≤ d} C(m,k) ≤ (e m / d)^d`. -/
lemma sum_choose_le (d m : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdm : d ≤ m) :
    ((∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic d, (m.choose k) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (Real.exp 1 * m / d) ^ d := by
  have hm : 1 ≤ m := le_trans hd hdm
  have hd0 : (0:ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hm0 : (0:ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  set x : ℝ := (d:ℝ)/(m:ℝ) with hx
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by positivity
  have hx1 : x ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hx, div_le_one hm0]; exact_mod_cast hdm
  have step1 : ((∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic d, (m.choose k) : ℕ) : ℝ)
      ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic d, ((m.choose k : ℝ) * x ^ k) / x ^ d := by
    push_cast
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
    intro k hk
    have hkd : k ≤ d := Finset.mem_Iic.mp hk
    have hpow : x ^ d ≤ x ^ k := pow_le_pow_of_le_one hx0.le hx1 hkd
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    have : (0:ℝ) ≤ (m.choose k : ℝ) := by positivity
    nlinarith [this, hpow]
  have step2 : ∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic d, ((m.choose k : ℝ) * x ^ k)
      ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m+1), ((m.choose k : ℝ) * x ^ k) := by
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ ?_
    · intro k hk
      simp only [Finset.mem_Iic] at hk
      simp only [Finset.mem_range]
      omega
    · intro k _ _; positivity
  have step3 : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m+1), ((m.choose k : ℝ) * x ^ k) = (1 + x) ^ m := by
    rw [show (1:ℝ) + x = x + 1 by ring, add_pow]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => ?_
    rw [one_pow, mul_one]
    ring
  have step4 : (1 + x) ^ m ≤ Real.exp 1 ^ d := by
    have h1 : (1 + x) ^ m ≤ (Real.exp x) ^ m := by
      refine pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) ?_ m
      have := Real.add_one_le_exp x
      linarith
    have h2 : (Real.exp x) ^ m = Real.exp 1 ^ d := by
      rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul, ← Real.exp_nat_mul]
      congr 1
      rw [hx]
      field_simp
    linarith [h1, h2.le, h2.ge]
  have hfin : ((∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic d, (m.choose k) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (Real.exp 1) ^ d / x ^ d := by
    calc ((∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic d, (m.choose k) : ℕ) : ℝ)
        ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic d, ((m.choose k : ℝ) * x ^ k) / x ^ d := step1
      _ = (∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic d, ((m.choose k : ℝ) * x ^ k)) / x ^ d := by
          rw [Finset.sum_div]
      _ ≤ (Real.exp 1) ^ d / x ^ d := by
          apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
          linarith [step2, step3.le, step3.ge, step4]
  refine hfin.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  rw [hx, div_pow, div_div_eq_mul_div, mul_div_assoc, div_pow, mul_pow, mul_div_assoc]

/-- Sauer-Shelah in the form we need. -/
lemma card_le_of_vcDim {β : Type*} [DecidableEq β] [Fintype β] (A : Finset (Finset β)) (d : ℕ)
    (hvc : A.vcDim ≤ d) : A.card ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic d, (Fintype.card β).choose k := by
  refine le_trans A.card_le_card_shatterer ?_
  refine le_trans Finset.card_shatterer_le_sum_vcDim ?_
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset (Finset.Iic_subset_Iic.mpr hvc)

/-- **Packing bound** for families of bounded VC dimension. -/
lemma packing_bound (Q : Finset (Finset α)) (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hvc : Q.vcDim ≤ d)
    (a : ℝ) (ha0 : 0 < a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1)
    (hsep : ∀ s ∈ Q, ∀ t ∈ Q, s ≠ t → a * (Fintype.card α) < ((s ∆ t).card : ℝ)) :
    (Q.card : ℝ) ≤ (3/a) ^ (4*d) := by
  classical
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  set B : ℝ := (3/a) ^ (4*d) with hBdef
  have hu1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ 3/a := by rw [le_div_iff₀ ha0]; linarith
  have h3a : (3:ℝ) ≤ 3/a := by rw [le_div_iff₀ ha0]; nlinarith
  have hB81 : (81:ℝ) ≤ B := by
    have h1 : (3:ℝ)^(4*d) ≤ (3/a)^(4*d) := by
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) h3a _
    have h2 : (81:ℝ) ≤ (3:ℝ)^(4*d) := by
      have : (3:ℝ)^(4*1) ≤ (3:ℝ)^(4*d) := by
        refine pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
      norm_num at this ⊢
      linarith
    linarith
  have hB0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ B := by linarith
  set M : ℕ := ⌊B⌋₊ + 1 with hMdef
  have hMle : M ≤ Q.card := by
    have := (Nat.floor_lt hB0).mpr hcon
    omega
  have hBM : B < (M:ℝ) := by
    rw [hMdef]; push_cast; exact Nat.lt_floor_add_one B
  have hMub : (M:ℝ) ≤ 2 * B := by
    have h1 : ((⌊B⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ B := Nat.floor_le hB0
    rw [hMdef]; push_cast; linarith
  obtain ⟨T, hTQ, hTcard⟩ := Finset.le_card_iff_exists_subset_card.mp hMle
  have hM81 : (81:ℝ) ≤ (M:ℝ) := le_trans hB81 hBM.le
  have hM2 : 2 ≤ M := by
    have h2 : (2:ℝ) ≤ (M:ℝ) := by linarith
    exact_mod_cast h2
  -- α is nonempty
  have hαne : Nonempty α := by
    by_contra h
    rw [not_nonempty_iff] at h
    have hc : (Finset.univ : Finset (Finset α)).card = 1 := by
      rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_finset]
      have : Fintype.card α = 0 := Fintype.card_eq_zero
      rw [this]; norm_num
    have hle : T.card ≤ 1 := le_trans (Finset.card_le_univ T) (le_of_eq hc)
    omega
  -- basic facts about M
  have hM0 : (0:ℝ) < (M:ℝ) := by linarith
  have hlogM : 4 * (d:ℝ) * Real.log 3 ≤ Real.log M := by
    have h1 : Real.log B ≤ Real.log M := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hBM.le
    have h2 : (4*d : ℕ) * Real.log 3 ≤ Real.log B := by
      rw [hBdef, Real.log_pow]
      have : Real.log 3 ≤ Real.log (3/a) := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) h3a
      have h4 : (0:ℝ) ≤ ((4*d : ℕ):ℝ) := by positivity
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this h4
    push_cast at h2
    linarith
  have hlog3 : (1:ℝ) ≤ Real.log 3 := by
    have : Real.exp 1 ≤ 3 := by
      have := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
      linarith
    calc (1:ℝ) = Real.log (Real.exp 1) := by rw [Real.log_exp]
      _ ≤ Real.log 3 := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) this
  have hd0 : (0:ℝ) < (d:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hlogM4 : 4 * (d:ℝ) ≤ Real.log M := by nlinarith
  -- choose the number of sampled coordinates
  set m : ℕ := ⌈2 * Real.log M / a⌉₊ + 1 with hmdef
  have hmlb : 2 * Real.log M / a + 1 ≤ (m:ℝ) := by
    have := Nat.le_ceil (2 * Real.log M / a)
    rw [hmdef]; push_cast; linarith
  have hmub : (m:ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.log M / a + 2 := by
    have := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (a := 2 * Real.log M / a)
      (by positivity)
    rw [hmdef]; push_cast; linarith
  have hdm : d ≤ m := by
    have h1 : (d:ℝ) ≤ (m:ℝ) := by
      have h2 : 2 * Real.log M / a ≥ 2 * Real.log M := by
        rw [ge_iff_le, le_div_iff₀ ha0]
        nlinarith [Real.log_nonneg (by linarith : (1:ℝ) ≤ (M:ℝ))]
      nlinarith
    exact_mod_cast h1
  -- the separated family restricted to `m` coordinates is injective
  set q : ℝ := 1 - a with hqdef
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ q := by rw [hqdef]; linarith
  have hqm : q ^ m ≤ Real.exp (-(a * m)) := by
    calc q ^ m ≤ (Real.exp (-a)) ^ m := by
          refine pow_le_pow_left₀ hq0 ?_ m
          have := Real.add_one_le_exp (-a)
          rw [hqdef]; linarith
      _ = Real.exp (-(a * m)) := by
          rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]; congr 1; ring
  have hkey : (T.card : ℝ) * (T.card : ℝ) * q ^ m < 1 := by
    have hexp : Real.exp (-(a * m)) < (M:ℝ)⁻¹ * (M:ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      have h1 : 2 * Real.log M + a ≤ a * m := by
        have : a * (2 * Real.log M / a + 1) ≤ a * m := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmlb ha0.le
        rw [mul_add, mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt ha0), mul_one] at this
        linarith
      have h2 : Real.exp (-(a*m)) ≤ Real.exp (-(2 * Real.log M + a)) := by
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr; linarith
      have h3 : Real.exp (-(2 * Real.log M + a)) = (M:ℝ)⁻¹ * (M:ℝ)⁻¹ * Real.exp (-a) := by
        rw [show -(2 * Real.log M + a) = (-Real.log M) + (-Real.log M) + (-a) by ring]
        rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log hM0]
      have h4 : Real.exp (-a) < 1 := by
        rw [Real.exp_lt_one_iff]; linarith
      have h5 : (0:ℝ) < (M:ℝ)⁻¹ * (M:ℝ)⁻¹ := by positivity
      nlinarith
    have hTc : (T.card : ℝ) = (M:ℝ) := by rw [hTcard]
    rw [hTc]
    calc (M:ℝ) * (M:ℝ) * q ^ m ≤ (M:ℝ) * (M:ℝ) * Real.exp (-(a*m)) := by
          have : (0:ℝ) ≤ (M:ℝ) * (M:ℝ) := by positivity
          nlinarith
      _ < (M:ℝ) * (M:ℝ) * ((M:ℝ)⁻¹ * (M:ℝ)⁻¹) := by
          have : (0:ℝ) < (M:ℝ) * (M:ℝ) := by positivity
          exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hexp this
      _ = 1 := by field_simp
  have hsepT : ∀ s ∈ T, ∀ t ∈ T, s ≠ t →
      ((Fintype.card α - (s ∆ t).card : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ q * Fintype.card α := by
    intro s hs t ht hst
    have hlt := hsep s (hTQ hs) t (hTQ ht) hst
    have hle : (s ∆ t).card ≤ Fintype.card α :=
      (Finset.card_le_univ (s ∆ t)).trans_eq Finset.card_univ
    have hcast : ((Fintype.card α - (s ∆ t).card : ℕ) : ℝ)
        = (Fintype.card α : ℝ) - ((s ∆ t).card : ℝ) := by
      push_cast [hle]; ring
    have hring : q * (Fintype.card α : ℝ)
        = (Fintype.card α : ℝ) - a * (Fintype.card α : ℝ) := by rw [hqdef]; ring
    rw [hcast, hring]
    linarith
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := exists_injOn_restr T m q hq0 hsepT hkey
  -- conclude by Sauer-Shelah on `Fin m`
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (restr φ) T := by
    intro s hs t ht h
    exact hφ s hs t ht h
  have hcardeq : (T.image (restr φ)).card = M := by
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injOn hinj, hTcard]
  have hvcT : (T.image (restr φ)).vcDim ≤ d :=
    le_trans (vcDim_image_restr_le φ T) (le_trans (Finset.vcDim_mono hTQ) hvc)
  have hsauer : M ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic d, m.choose k := by
    rw [← hcardeq]
    have := card_le_of_vcDim (T.image (restr φ)) d hvcT
    simpa using this
  have hMle2 : (M:ℝ) ≤ (Real.exp 1 * m / d) ^ d := by
    refine le_trans ?_ (sum_choose_le d m hd hdm)
    exact_mod_cast hsauer
  -- numeric contradiction
  have hexp1 : Real.exp 1 ≤ 2.7182818286 := le_of_lt Real.exp_one_lt_d9
  have hlog3u : Real.log 3 ≤ 2 := by
    have : Real.log 3 ≤ 3 - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num)
    linarith
  have hkeynum : Real.exp 1 * (m:ℝ) / d ≤ (3/a) ^ 4 := by
    have hloga : Real.log (3/a) ≤ 3/a - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by positivity)
    have hlogMub : Real.log M ≤ Real.log 2 + 4 * d * Real.log (3/a) := by
      have h1 : Real.log M ≤ Real.log (2*B) := Real.log_le_log hM0 hMub
      have h2 : Real.log (2*B) = Real.log 2 + Real.log B := by
        rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by linarith)]
      have h3 : Real.log B = (4*d : ℕ) * Real.log (3/a) := by
        rw [hBdef, Real.log_pow]
      rw [h2, h3] at h1
      push_cast at h1
      linarith
    have hlog2 : Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by
      have : Real.log 2 ≤ 2 - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num)
      linarith
    have hd1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (d:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hd
    have hainv : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1/a := by rw [le_div_iff₀ ha0]; linarith
    have h3ainv : 3/a = 3 * (1/a) := by ring
    -- m ≤ 2 (1 + 4 d (3/a)) / a + 2
    have hmb : (m:ℝ) ≤ 2 * (1 + 4 * d * (3/a)) * (1/a) + 2 := by
      have : 2 * Real.log M / a ≤ 2 * (1 + 4 * d * (3/a)) * (1/a) := by
        rw [div_eq_mul_one_div]
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (by positivity)
        nlinarith
      linarith
    set u : ℝ := 1/a with hu
    have hu1' : (1:ℝ) ≤ u := hainv
    have h3au : 3/a = 3*u := by rw [hu]; ring
    rw [h3au] at hmb ⊢
    have hfinal : Real.exp 1 * (m:ℝ) / d ≤ 80 * u^2 := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hd0]
      have hm2 : (m:ℝ) ≤ 2 * (1 + 12 * d * u) * u + 2 := by
        have h12 : 4 * (d:ℝ) * (3*u) = 12 * d * u := by ring
        linarith [hmb, h12]
      have he : Real.exp 1 * (m:ℝ) ≤ 2.7182818286 * (2 * (1 + 12 * d * u) * u + 2) := by
        have hmpos : (0:ℝ) ≤ (m:ℝ) := by positivity
        nlinarith [Real.exp_pos 1]
      have hA : u ≤ u^2 * d := by nlinarith
      have hB2 : (1:ℝ) ≤ u^2 * d := by nlinarith
      nlinarith [he, hA, hB2]
    have h81 : 80 * u^2 ≤ (3*u)^4 := by
      have he4 : (3*u:ℝ)^4 = 81 * u^4 := by ring
      rw [he4]
      have h1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ u^2 := by nlinarith
      have h2 : u^2 ≤ u^2 * u^2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg u]
      nlinarith [h2, sq_nonneg u]
    linarith
  have hfin2 : (M:ℝ) ≤ ((3/a)^4) ^ d := by
    refine le_trans hMle2 ?_
    refine pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hkeynum d
  have heqB : ((3/a)^4) ^ d = B := by rw [hBdef, ← pow_mul]
  rw [heqB] at hfin2
  linarith

/-- **Covering number bound**: a family of VC dimension at most `d` admits an
`a·N`-net of size at most `(3/a)^(4d)` in the Hamming metric. -/
lemma exists_net (A : Finset (Finset α)) (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hvc : A.vcDim ≤ d)
    (a : ℝ) (ha0 : 0 < a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) :
    ∃ T ⊆ A, (T.card : ℝ) ≤ (3/a) ^ (4*d) ∧
      ∀ s ∈ A, ∃ t ∈ T, ((s ∆ t).card : ℝ) ≤ a * Fintype.card α := by
  classical
  set S : Finset (Finset (Finset α)) :=
    A.powerset.filter (fun T => ∀ s ∈ T, ∀ t ∈ T, s ≠ t → a * (Fintype.card α) < ((s ∆ t).card : ℝ))
    with hS
  have hSne : S.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨∅, ?_⟩
    rw [hS, Finset.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨Finset.empty_mem_powerset A, by simp⟩
  obtain ⟨T, hTS, hTmax⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image S Finset.card hSne
  rw [hS, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_powerset] at hTS
  obtain ⟨hTA, hTsep⟩ := hTS
  refine ⟨T, hTA, packing_bound T d hd (le_trans (Finset.vcDim_mono hTA) hvc) a ha0 ha1 hTsep, ?_⟩
  intro s hs
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  have hsT : s ∉ T := by
    intro hsT
    have := hcon s hsT
    simp only [symmDiff_self, Finset.bot_eq_empty, Finset.card_empty, Nat.cast_zero] at this
    have hnn : (0:ℝ) ≤ a * (Fintype.card α) := by positivity
    linarith
  have hmem : insert s T ∈ S := by
    rw [hS, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_powerset]
    refine ⟨Finset.insert_subset hs hTA, ?_⟩
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    rw [Finset.mem_insert] at hx hy
    rcases hx with rfl | hx
    · rcases hy with rfl | hy
      · exact absurd rfl hxy
      · exact hcon y hy
    · rcases hy with rfl | hy
      · have h := hcon x hx
        rwa [symmDiff_comm] at h
      · exact hTsep x hx y hy hxy
  have := hTmax _ hmem
  rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hsT] at this
  omega

end VCcomb

open MeasureTheory
namespace Chaining

lemma geom_sum_le_inv (r : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ r) (h1 : r < 1) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, r^k ≤ (1-r)⁻¹ := by
  have h2 : (0:ℝ) < 1 - r := by linarith
  have hmul : (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, r^k) * (r - 1) = r^n - 1 := geom_sum_mul r n
  have hpos : (0:ℝ) ≤ r^n := by positivity
  rw [inv_eq_one_div, le_div_iff₀ h2]
  nlinarith [hmul, hpos]

lemma sqrt_le_of_sq_le (x y : ℝ) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (h : x ≤ y^2) : Real.sqrt x ≤ y :=
  (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h).trans_eq (Real.sqrt_sq hy)

/-- Triangle inequality for the Hamming distance. -/
lemma card_symmDiff_triangle {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (s t u : Finset α) :
    (s ∆ u).card ≤ (s ∆ t).card + (t ∆ u).card := by
  have hsub : s ∆ u ⊆ (s ∆ t) ∪ (t ∆ u) := by
    intro a ha
    simp only [Finset.mem_symmDiff, Finset.mem_union] at ha ⊢
    tauto
  exact le_trans (Finset.card_le_card hsub) (Finset.card_union_le _ _)

variable {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [Fintype α]

theorem chaining_tail
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (A : Finset (Finset α)) (u₀ : Finset α) (hu₀ : u₀ ∈ A)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hvc : A.vcDim ≤ d)
    (hN : 1 ≤ Fintype.card α)
    (Y : Finset α → Ω → ℝ)
    (hsub : ∀ u ∈ A, ∀ v ∈ A, ∀ B : ℝ, 0 < B → ((u ∆ v).card : ℝ) ≤ B →
      ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → P.real {ω | x ≤ Y u ω - Y v ω} ≤ Real.exp (-(x^2)/(4*B)))
    (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) :
    P.real {ω | ∃ u ∈ A, 128 * Real.sqrt ((Fintype.card α : ℝ) * ((d:ℝ) + lam))
        < |Y u ω - Y u₀ ω|} ≤ Real.exp (-lam) := by
  classical
  set Nn := Fintype.card α with hNn
  have hNr : (1:ℝ) ≤ (Nn:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hd1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (d:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hd
  -- ## Step 1: nets at all dyadic scales
  have hnet : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ (T : Finset (Finset α)) (p : Finset α → Finset α),
      T ⊆ A ∧ ((T.card : ℝ) ≤ (3 * 2^k)^(4*d)) ∧ (∀ s, p s ∈ T) ∧
      (∀ s ∈ A, ((s ∆ p s).card : ℝ) ≤ (Nn:ℝ) * (1/2)^k) ∧ (k = 0 → ∀ s, p s = u₀) := by
    intro k
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk
    · refine ⟨{u₀}, fun _ => u₀, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa using hu₀
      · simp only [Finset.card_singleton, Nat.cast_one, pow_zero, mul_one]
        exact one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
      · intro s; simp
      · intro s hs
        simp only [pow_zero, mul_one]
        exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_le_univ (s ∆ u₀)).trans_eq Finset.card_univ
      · intro _ _; rfl
    · have ha1 : ((1:ℝ)/2)^k ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      obtain ⟨T, hTA, hTcard, hTnet⟩ :=
        VCcomb.exists_net A d hd hvc ((1/2:ℝ)^k) (by positivity) ha1
      have hp : ∀ s : Finset α, ∃ t, t ∈ T ∧ (s ∈ A → ((s ∆ t).card:ℝ) ≤ (Nn:ℝ)*(1/2)^k) := by
        intro s
        by_cases hs : s ∈ A
        · obtain ⟨t, ht, hdist⟩ := hTnet s hs
          exact ⟨t, ht, fun _ => by rw [mul_comm] at hdist; exact hdist⟩
        · obtain ⟨t, ht, _⟩ := hTnet u₀ hu₀
          exact ⟨t, ht, fun h => absurd h hs⟩
      choose p hp1 hp2 using hp
      refine ⟨T, p, hTA, ?_, hp1, hp2, fun h => absurd h (by omega)⟩
      refine le_trans hTcard (le_of_eq ?_)
      congr 1
      rw [div_pow, one_pow, div_div_eq_mul_div, div_one]
  choose T p hTA hTcard hpT hpnet hp0 using hnet
  -- ## Step 2: parameters
  set bd : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => 3 * (Nn:ℝ) * (1/2)^(k+1) with hbd
  set xx : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => Real.sqrt (6 * (Nn:ℝ) * (1/2)^k * (lam + 8*(d:ℝ)*(k+2))) with hxx
  have hbd0 : ∀ k, 0 < bd k := by intro k; rw [hbd]; positivity
  have hxx0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ xx k := by intro k; rw [hxx]; exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hxxsq : ∀ k, (xx k)^2 = 6 * (Nn:ℝ) * (1/2)^k * (lam + 8*(d:ℝ)*(k+2)) := by
    intro k
    rw [hxx]
    refine Real.sq_sqrt ?_
    positivity
  -- ## Step 3: the bad events
  set E : ℕ → Set Ω := fun k =>
    ⋃ t ∈ T k, ⋃ t' ∈ T (k+1),
      {ω | ((t ∆ t').card : ℝ) ≤ bd k ∧ xx k < |Y t' ω - Y t ω|} with hE
  have hpairbd : ∀ (k : ℕ) (t : Finset α), t ∈ T k → ∀ t' ∈ T (k+1),
      P.real {ω | ((t ∆ t').card : ℝ) ≤ bd k ∧ xx k < |Y t' ω - Y t ω|}
        ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(lam + 8*(d:ℝ)*(k+2))) := by
    intro k t ht t' ht'
    by_cases hdist : ((t ∆ t').card : ℝ) ≤ bd k
    · have hexp : -(xx k)^2 / (4 * bd k) = -(lam + 8*(d:ℝ)*(k+2)) := by
        rw [hxxsq k, hbd]
        have h2 : (4:ℝ) * (3 * (Nn:ℝ) * (1/2)^(k+1)) = 6 * (Nn:ℝ) * (1/2)^k := by
          rw [pow_succ]
          ring
        rw [h2]
        field_simp
      have hs1 := hsub t' (hTA _ ht') t (hTA _ ht) (bd k) (hbd0 k) (by
        rwa [symmDiff_comm]) (xx k) (hxx0 k)
      have hs2 := hsub t (hTA _ ht) t' (hTA _ ht') (bd k) (hbd0 k) hdist (xx k) (hxx0 k)
      rw [hexp] at hs1 hs2
      have hsubset : {ω | ((t ∆ t').card : ℝ) ≤ bd k ∧ xx k < |Y t' ω - Y t ω|}
          ⊆ {ω | xx k ≤ Y t' ω - Y t ω} ∪ {ω | xx k ≤ Y t ω - Y t' ω} := by
        intro ω hω
        obtain ⟨-, hlt⟩ := hω
        rcases abs_cases (Y t' ω - Y t ω) with ⟨he, _⟩ | ⟨he, _⟩
        · left; simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]; rw [he] at hlt; linarith
        · right; simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]; rw [he] at hlt; linarith
      calc P.real {ω | ((t ∆ t').card : ℝ) ≤ bd k ∧ xx k < |Y t' ω - Y t ω|}
          ≤ P.real ({ω | xx k ≤ Y t' ω - Y t ω} ∪ {ω | xx k ≤ Y t ω - Y t' ω}) :=
            measureReal_mono hsubset
        _ ≤ P.real {ω | xx k ≤ Y t' ω - Y t ω} + P.real {ω | xx k ≤ Y t ω - Y t' ω} :=
            measureReal_union_le _ _
        _ ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(lam + 8*(d:ℝ)*(k+2))) := by linarith
    · have : {ω | ((t ∆ t').card : ℝ) ≤ bd k ∧ xx k < |Y t' ω - Y t ω|} = ∅ := by
        ext ω; simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
        rintro ⟨h, -⟩; exact hdist h
      rw [this]
      simp only [measureReal_empty]
      positivity
  -- ## Step 4: measure of each bad event
  have hl2' : (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.log 2 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
  have hl2 : Real.log 2 ≤ 0.6932 := by
    have := Real.log_two_lt_d9; linarith
  have hl3 : Real.log 3 ≤ 2 * Real.log 2 := by
    have h4 : Real.log 3 ≤ Real.log 4 := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    have h5 : Real.log 4 = 2 * Real.log 2 := by
      rw [show (4:ℝ) = 2^2 by norm_num, Real.log_pow]; push_cast; ring
    linarith
  have hEbd : ∀ k : ℕ, P.real (E k) ≤ Real.exp (-lam) * (1/2)^(k+2) := by
    intro k
    have h1 : P.real (E k) ≤ ∑ t ∈ T k, P.real (⋃ t' ∈ T (k+1),
        {ω | ((t ∆ t').card : ℝ) ≤ bd k ∧ xx k < |Y t' ω - Y t ω|}) := by
      rw [hE]; exact measureReal_biUnion_finset_le _ _
    have h2 : ∀ t ∈ T k, P.real (⋃ t' ∈ T (k+1),
        {ω | ((t ∆ t').card : ℝ) ≤ bd k ∧ xx k < |Y t' ω - Y t ω|})
        ≤ ((T (k+1)).card : ℝ) * (2 * Real.exp (-(lam + 8*(d:ℝ)*(k+2)))) := by
      intro t ht
      refine le_trans (measureReal_biUnion_finset_le _ _) ?_
      calc ∑ t' ∈ T (k+1), P.real {ω | ((t ∆ t').card : ℝ) ≤ bd k ∧ xx k < |Y t' ω - Y t ω|}
          ≤ ∑ _t' ∈ T (k+1), 2 * Real.exp (-(lam + 8*(d:ℝ)*(k+2))) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun t' ht' => hpairbd k t ht t' ht')
        _ = ((T (k+1)).card : ℝ) * (2 * Real.exp (-(lam + 8*(d:ℝ)*(k+2)))) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    have h3 : P.real (E k) ≤ ((T k).card : ℝ) *
        (((T (k+1)).card : ℝ) * (2 * Real.exp (-(lam + 8*(d:ℝ)*(k+2))))) := by
      refine le_trans h1 ?_
      calc ∑ t ∈ T k, P.real (⋃ t' ∈ T (k+1),
              {ω | ((t ∆ t').card : ℝ) ≤ bd k ∧ xx k < |Y t' ω - Y t ω|})
          ≤ ∑ _t ∈ T k, ((T (k+1)).card : ℝ) * (2 * Real.exp (-(lam + 8*(d:ℝ)*(k+2)))) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum h2
        _ = _ := by rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    refine le_trans h3 ?_
    -- numeric bound
    set W : ℝ := 2 * (3 * 2^k)^(4*d) * (3 * 2^(k+1))^(4*d) * 2^(k+2) with hW
    have hW0 : (0:ℝ) < W := by rw [hW]; positivity
    have hlogW : Real.log W ≤ 8 * (d:ℝ) * (k+2) := by
      have e1 : Real.log W = Real.log 2 + (4*d : ℕ) * Real.log (3 * 2^k)
          + (4*d : ℕ) * Real.log (3 * 2^(k+1)) + (k+2 : ℕ) * Real.log 2 := by
        rw [hW]
        rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity), Real.log_mul (by positivity)
          (by positivity), Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity),
          Real.log_pow, Real.log_pow, Real.log_pow]
      have e2 : Real.log (3 * 2^k) = Real.log 3 + k * Real.log 2 := by
        rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by positivity), Real.log_pow]
      have e3 : Real.log (3 * 2^(k+1)) = Real.log 3 + (k+1 : ℕ) * Real.log 2 := by
        rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by positivity), Real.log_pow]
      rw [e1, e2, e3]
      push_cast
      have hk0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (k:ℝ) := by positivity
      nlinarith [hl2, hl2', hl3, hd1, hk0, mul_nonneg hk0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hd1)]
    have hWexp : W ≤ Real.exp (8 * (d:ℝ) * (k+2)) := by
      rw [← Real.log_le_iff_le_exp hW0]; exact hlogW
    have hTk : ((T k).card : ℝ) ≤ (3 * 2^k)^(4*d) := hTcard k
    have hTk1 : ((T (k+1)).card : ℝ) ≤ (3 * 2^(k+1))^(4*d) := hTcard (k+1)
    have hexpsplit : Real.exp (-(lam + 8*(d:ℝ)*(k+2)))
        = Real.exp (-lam) * (Real.exp (8*(d:ℝ)*((k:ℝ)+2)))⁻¹ := by
      rw [← Real.exp_neg, ← Real.exp_add]
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [hexpsplit]
    have hexppos : (0:ℝ) < Real.exp (8*(d:ℝ)*((k:ℝ)+2)) := Real.exp_pos _
    have hkey : ((T k).card : ℝ) * (((T (k+1)).card : ℝ) * 2) * (Real.exp (8*(d:ℝ)*((k:ℝ)+2)))⁻¹
        ≤ (1/2)^(k+2) := by
      rw [mul_inv_le_iff₀ hexppos]
      have hWW : ((T k).card : ℝ) * (((T (k+1)).card : ℝ) * 2) ≤ W * ((1/2)^(k+2)) := by
        rw [hW]
        have h2k : (2:ℝ)^(k+2) * (1/2)^(k+2) = 1 := by
          rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num
        have : 2 * (3 * (2:ℝ)^k)^(4*d) * (3 * 2^(k+1))^(4*d) * 2^(k+2) * (1/2)^(k+2)
            = 2 * (3 * (2:ℝ)^k)^(4*d) * (3 * 2^(k+1))^(4*d) := by
          rw [mul_assoc (2 * (3 * (2:ℝ)^k)^(4*d) * (3 * 2^(k+1))^(4*d)), h2k, mul_one]
        rw [this]
        have hn1 : (0:ℝ) ≤ ((T (k+1)).card : ℝ) := by positivity
        have hn2 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (3 * (2:ℝ)^(k+1))^(4*d) := by positivity
        nlinarith [hTk, hTk1, Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) (T k).card]
      have hpow : (0:ℝ) ≤ (1/2:ℝ)^(k+2) := by positivity
      calc ((T k).card : ℝ) * (((T (k+1)).card : ℝ) * 2) ≤ W * ((1/2)^(k+2)) := hWW
        _ ≤ Real.exp (8*(d:ℝ)*((k:ℝ)+2)) * (1/2)^(k+2) := by
            have : W ≤ Real.exp (8*(d:ℝ)*((k:ℝ)+2)) := by
              refine le_trans hWexp (le_of_eq ?_); norm_num
            nlinarith [hpow]
        _ = (1/2)^(k+2) * Real.exp (8*(d:ℝ)*((k:ℝ)+2)) := by ring
    have hexpnn : (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (-lam) := (Real.exp_pos _).le
    calc ((T k).card : ℝ) * (((T (k+1)).card : ℝ) *
            (2 * (Real.exp (-lam) * (Real.exp (8*(d:ℝ)*((k:ℝ)+2)))⁻¹)))
        = Real.exp (-lam) * (((T k).card : ℝ) * (((T (k+1)).card : ℝ) * 2)
            * (Real.exp (8*(d:ℝ)*((k:ℝ)+2)))⁻¹) := by ring
      _ ≤ Real.exp (-lam) * (1/2)^(k+2) := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hkey hexpnn
  -- ## Step 5: total measure of the union of bad events
  have hUnion : P.real (⋃ k ∈ Finset.range Nn, E k) ≤ Real.exp (-lam) := by
    refine le_trans (measureReal_biUnion_finset_le _ _) ?_
    have h1 : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range Nn, P.real (E k)
        ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range Nn, Real.exp (-lam) * (1/2:ℝ)^(k+2) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k _ => hEbd k)
    have h2 : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range Nn, Real.exp (-lam) * (1/2:ℝ)^(k+2)
        = Real.exp (-lam) * (1/4) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range Nn, (1/2:ℝ)^k := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
      rw [pow_add]
      ring
    have h3 : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range Nn, (1/2:ℝ)^k ≤ 2 := by
      have := geom_sum_le_inv (1/2 : ℝ) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) Nn
      norm_num at this
      linarith
    have hexpnn : (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (-lam) := (Real.exp_pos _).le
    have h4 : Real.exp (-lam) * (1/4) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range Nn, (1/2:ℝ)^k
        ≤ Real.exp (-lam) * (1/4) * 2 := by
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (by positivity)
    linarith [h1, h2.le, h2.ge, h4]
  -- ## Step 6: the chaining bound
  have hxxbd : ∀ k : ℕ, xx k ≤ 15 * (27/32:ℝ)^k * Real.sqrt ((Nn:ℝ) * ((d:ℝ) + lam)) := by
    intro k
    rw [hxx]
    refine sqrt_le_of_sq_le _ _ (by positivity) ?_
    have hNL : (0:ℝ) ≤ (Nn:ℝ) * ((d:ℝ) + lam) := by positivity
    have hsq : (15 * (27/32:ℝ)^k * Real.sqrt ((Nn:ℝ) * ((d:ℝ) + lam)))^2
        = 225 * (729/1024:ℝ)^k * ((Nn:ℝ) * ((d:ℝ) + lam)) := by
      rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hNL, ← pow_mul, mul_comm k 2, pow_mul]
      norm_num
    rw [hsq]
    -- bound the argument
    have hb1 : lam + 8*(d:ℝ)*((k:ℝ)+2) ≤ ((d:ℝ) + lam) * (8*(k:ℝ)+17) := by
      have hk0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (k:ℝ) := by positivity
      nlinarith [hlam, hd1, mul_nonneg hlam hk0]
    have hb2 : 8*(k:ℝ)+17 ≤ 36 * (81/64:ℝ)^k := by
      have hbern : (1:ℝ) + k * (17/64) ≤ (1 + 17/64)^k := by
        have := one_add_mul_le_pow (a := (17/64:ℝ)) (by norm_num) k
        linarith
      norm_num at hbern
      nlinarith [hbern]
    have hb3 : ((1:ℝ)/2)^k * (81/64:ℝ)^k = (81/128:ℝ)^k := by
      rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num
    have hb4 : (81/128:ℝ)^k ≤ (729/1024:ℝ)^k :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num) k
    have hN0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (Nn:ℝ) := by positivity
    have hpow0 : (0:ℝ) < ((1:ℝ)/2)^k := by positivity
    have hDL : (0:ℝ) ≤ (d:ℝ) + lam := by linarith
    calc 6 * (Nn:ℝ) * (1/2)^k * (lam + 8*(d:ℝ)*((k:ℝ)+2))
        ≤ 6 * (Nn:ℝ) * (1/2)^k * (((d:ℝ) + lam) * (8*(k:ℝ)+17)) := by
          have : (0:ℝ) ≤ 6 * (Nn:ℝ) * (1/2)^k := by positivity
          nlinarith [hb1]
      _ ≤ 6 * (Nn:ℝ) * (1/2)^k * (((d:ℝ) + lam) * (36 * (81/64:ℝ)^k)) := by
          have h0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ 6 * (Nn:ℝ) * (1/2)^k * ((d:ℝ) + lam) := by positivity
          nlinarith [hb2, h0]
      _ = 216 * (Nn:ℝ) * ((d:ℝ) + lam) * ((81/128:ℝ)^k) := by
          rw [← hb3]; ring
      _ ≤ 216 * (Nn:ℝ) * ((d:ℝ) + lam) * ((729/1024:ℝ)^k) := by
          have h0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ 216 * (Nn:ℝ) * ((d:ℝ) + lam) := by positivity
          nlinarith [hb4, h0]
      _ ≤ 225 * (729/1024:ℝ)^k * ((Nn:ℝ) * ((d:ℝ) + lam)) := by
          have h0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (Nn:ℝ) * ((d:ℝ) + lam) := hNL
          have h1 : (0:ℝ) < (729/1024:ℝ)^k := by positivity
          nlinarith [h0, h1]
  have hsumxx : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range Nn, xx k
      ≤ 128 * Real.sqrt ((Nn:ℝ) * ((d:ℝ) + lam)) := by
    have h1 : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range Nn, xx k
        ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range Nn, 15 * (27/32:ℝ)^k * Real.sqrt ((Nn:ℝ) * ((d:ℝ) + lam)) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k _ => hxxbd k)
    have h2 : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range Nn, 15 * (27/32:ℝ)^k * Real.sqrt ((Nn:ℝ) * ((d:ℝ) + lam))
        = 15 * Real.sqrt ((Nn:ℝ) * ((d:ℝ) + lam)) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range Nn, (27/32:ℝ)^k := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
      ring
    have h3 : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range Nn, (27/32:ℝ)^k ≤ 32/5 := by
      have := geom_sum_le_inv (27/32 : ℝ) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) Nn
      norm_num at this
      linarith
    have hs0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt ((Nn:ℝ) * ((d:ℝ) + lam)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have h4 : 15 * Real.sqrt ((Nn:ℝ) * ((d:ℝ) + lam)) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range Nn, (27/32:ℝ)^k
        ≤ 15 * Real.sqrt ((Nn:ℝ) * ((d:ℝ) + lam)) * (32/5) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (by positivity)
    nlinarith [h1, h2.le, h2.ge, h4, hs0]
  -- ## Step 7: inclusion
  have hincl : {ω | ∃ u ∈ A, 128 * Real.sqrt ((Nn:ℝ) * ((d:ℝ) + lam)) < |Y u ω - Y u₀ ω|}
      ⊆ ⋃ k ∈ Finset.range Nn, E k := by
    intro ω hω
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hω
    obtain ⟨u, huA, hlt⟩ := hω
    by_contra hnot
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, exists_prop, not_exists, not_and] at hnot
    -- distances along the chain
    have hdistchain : ∀ k : ℕ, ((p k u ∆ p (k+1) u).card : ℝ) ≤ bd k := by
      intro k
      have t1 := hpnet k u huA
      have t2 := hpnet (k+1) u huA
      have t3 : (p k u ∆ p (k+1) u).card ≤ (p k u ∆ u).card + (u ∆ p (k+1) u).card :=
        card_symmDiff_triangle _ _ _
      have t4 : (p k u ∆ u).card = (u ∆ p k u).card := by rw [symmDiff_comm]
      have t5 : ((p k u ∆ p (k+1) u).card : ℝ)
          ≤ ((u ∆ p k u).card : ℝ) + ((u ∆ p (k+1) u).card : ℝ) := by
        rw [← t4]; exact_mod_cast t3
      have t6 : (Nn:ℝ) * (1/2)^k + (Nn:ℝ) * (1/2)^(k+1) = bd k := by
        rw [hbd, pow_succ]; ring
      linarith
    have hincr : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range Nn, |Y (p (k+1) u) ω - Y (p k u) ω| ≤ xx k := by
      intro k hk
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      refine hnot k hk ?_
      rw [hE]
      simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, exists_prop]
      exact ⟨p k u, hpT k u, p (k+1) u, hpT (k+1) u, hdistchain k, hcon⟩
    -- termination of the chain
    have hterm : p Nn u = u := by
      have h1 := hpnet Nn u huA
      have h2 : (Nn:ℝ) * (1/2:ℝ)^Nn < 1 := by
        have h3 : (Nn:ℝ) < 2^Nn := by
          have := Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := Nn)
          exact_mod_cast this
        rw [div_pow, one_pow] at h1 ⊢
        rw [mul_one_div, div_lt_one (by positivity)]
        exact h3
      have h4 : ((u ∆ p Nn u).card : ℝ) < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt h1 h2
      have h5 : (u ∆ p Nn u).card = 0 := by
        by_contra h6
        have : (1:ℝ) ≤ ((u ∆ p Nn u).card : ℝ) := by
          have : 1 ≤ (u ∆ p Nn u).card := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr h6
          exact_mod_cast this
        linarith
      have h7 : u ∆ p Nn u = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp h5
      have h8 : u = p Nn u := by
        rwa [← Finset.bot_eq_empty, symmDiff_eq_bot] at h7
      exact h8.symm
    -- telescoping
    have htel : Y u ω - Y u₀ ω
        = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range Nn, (Y (p (k+1) u) ω - Y (p k u) ω) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_range_sub (f := fun k => Y (p k u) ω) Nn]
      rw [hterm, hp0 0 rfl u]
    have hbound : |Y u ω - Y u₀ ω| ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range Nn, xx k := by
      rw [htel]
      refine le_trans (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _) ?_
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum hincr
    linarith [hbound, hsumxx]
  exact le_trans (measureReal_mono hincl (measure_ne_top P _)) hUnion

end Chaining
