open scoped symmDiff ENNReal NNReal
open Finset MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory

namespace RadDev

/-! ## The Rademacher (sign) measure -/

/-- The uniform measure on `Bool`. -/
noncomputable def signMeasure : Measure Bool :=
  (1/2 : ℝ≥0∞) • (Measure.dirac true + Measure.dirac false)

instance : IsProbabilityMeasure signMeasure := by
  constructor
  simp [signMeasure]
  exact ENNReal.inv_two_add_inv_two

lemma integral_signMeasure (g : Bool → ℝ) :
    ∫ b, g b ∂signMeasure = (g true + g false) / 2 := by
  rw [signMeasure]
  rw [integral_smul_measure, integral_add_measure (by simp) (by simp), integral_dirac,
    integral_dirac]
  simp
  ring

/-- The uniform measure on sign vectors. -/
noncomputable def signPi (n : ℕ) : Measure (Fin n → Bool) :=
  Measure.pi (fun _ => signMeasure)

instance (n : ℕ) : IsProbabilityMeasure (signPi n) := by
  unfold signPi; infer_instance

/-- `sgn b = 1` if `b = false` and `-1` if `b = true`. -/
def sgn (b : Bool) : ℝ := if b then -1 else 1

lemma sgn_mem_Icc (b : Bool) : sgn b ∈ Set.Icc (-1:ℝ) 1 := by
  cases b <;> norm_num [sgn]

lemma integral_sgn_mul (v : ℝ) : ∫ b, sgn b * v ∂signMeasure = 0 := by
  rw [integral_signMeasure]
  simp [sgn]

lemma integral_signPi_coord {n : ℕ} (j : Fin n) (g : Bool → ℝ) :
    ∫ σ, g (σ j) ∂(signPi n) = ∫ b, g b ∂signMeasure := by
  rw [← (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin n => signMeasure) j).map_eq,
    integral_map (measurable_pi_apply j).aemeasurable
      (Measurable.of_discrete (f := g)).aestronglyMeasurable]
  rfl

/-- One-sided Hoeffding bound for Rademacher sums. -/
lemma rademacher_tail {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → ℝ) (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    (signPi n).real {σ | u ≤ ∑ j, sgn (σ j) * v j}
      ≤ Real.exp (-u ^ 2 / (2 * ∑ j, (v j) ^ 2)) := by
  classical
  set X : Fin n → (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ := fun j σ => sgn (σ j) * v j with hX
  have hindep : iIndepFun X (signPi n) := by
    have := iIndepFun_pi (μ := fun _ : Fin n => signMeasure)
      (X := fun (j : Fin n) (b : Bool) => sgn b * v j)
      (fun j => (Measurable.of_discrete (f := fun b : Bool => sgn b * v j)).aemeasurable)
    exact this
  have hsubG : ∀ j : Fin n, HasSubgaussianMGF (X j) (‖v j‖₊ ^ 2) (signPi n) := by
    intro j
    have hmean : ∫ σ, X j σ ∂(signPi n) = 0 := by
      rw [hX]
      simp only
      rw [integral_signPi_coord j (fun b => sgn b * v j)]
      exact integral_sgn_mul (v j)
    have hbd : ∀ᵐ σ ∂(signPi n), X j σ ∈ Set.Icc (-|v j|) (|v j|) := by
      filter_upwards with σ
      rcases sgn_mem_Icc (σ j) with ⟨h1, h2⟩
      constructor
      · rcases le_or_lt 0 (v j) with h | h
        · nlinarith [abs_of_nonneg h]
        · nlinarith [abs_of_neg h]
      · rcases le_or_lt 0 (v j) with h | h
        · nlinarith [abs_of_nonneg h]
        · nlinarith [abs_of_neg h]
    have := hasSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc_of_integral_eq_zero
      (μ := signPi n) (X := X j)
      (Measurable.aemeasurable (by fun_prop)) hbd hmean
    have heq : (‖|v j| - -|v j|‖₊ / 2 : ℝ≥0) ^ 2 = ‖v j‖₊ ^ 2 := by
      have : |v j| - -|v j| = 2 * |v j| := by ring
      rw [this]
      congr 1
      rw [nnnorm_mul]
      simp [Real.nnnorm_abs]
    rwa [heq] at this
  have hmain := HasSubgaussianMGF.measure_sum_ge_le_of_iIndepFun hindep
    (c := fun j => ‖v j‖₊ ^ 2) (s := Finset.univ) (fun j _ => hsubG j) hu
  have hcast : ((∑ j : Fin n, ‖v j‖₊ ^ 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) = ∑ j, (v j) ^ 2 := by
    push_cast
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  rw [hcast] at hmain
  exact hmain


/-! ## The Rademacher process attached to a double sample -/

/-- Coordinatewise difference of the two halves of a trace set. -/
def phi {n : ℕ} (u : Finset (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) (j : Fin n) : ℝ :=
  (if Sum.inl j ∈ u then (1:ℝ) else 0) - (if Sum.inr j ∈ u then (1:ℝ) else 0)

/-- The Rademacher process attached to a trace set. -/
def Yproc {n : ℕ} (u : Finset (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) (σ : Fin n → Bool) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j, sgn (σ j) * phi u j

@[simp] lemma Yproc_empty {n : ℕ} (σ : Fin n → Bool) : Yproc (∅ : Finset (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) σ = 0 := by
  simp [Yproc, phi]

lemma sq_diff_ind {β : Type*} [DecidableEq β] (u v : Finset β) (x : β) :
    ((if x ∈ u then (1:ℝ) else 0) - (if x ∈ v then (1:ℝ) else 0))^2
      = (if x ∈ u ∆ v then (1:ℝ) else 0) := by
  by_cases h1 : x ∈ u <;> by_cases h2 : x ∈ v <;>
    simp [h1, h2, Finset.mem_symmDiff]

lemma card_sum_split {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) :
    ((S.card : ℝ)) = ∑ j : Fin n, ((if Sum.inl j ∈ S then (1:ℝ) else 0)
      + (if Sum.inr j ∈ S then (1:ℝ) else 0)) := by
  classical
  have h1 : ∑ x : Fin n ⊕ Fin n, (if x ∈ S then (1:ℝ) else 0) = (S.card : ℝ) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_ite_mem]
    simp
  rw [← h1, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]

lemma sum_sq_phi_le {n : ℕ} (u v : Finset (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) :
    ∑ j : Fin n, (phi u j - phi v j)^2 ≤ 2 * (((u ∆ v).card : ℝ)) := by
  classical
  rw [card_sum_split, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_
  have e1 := sq_diff_ind u v (Sum.inl j)
  have e2 := sq_diff_ind u v (Sum.inr j)
  set a : ℝ := (if Sum.inl j ∈ u then (1:ℝ) else 0) - (if Sum.inl j ∈ v then (1:ℝ) else 0) with ha
  set b : ℝ := (if Sum.inr j ∈ u then (1:ℝ) else 0) - (if Sum.inr j ∈ v then (1:ℝ) else 0) with hb
  have hphi : phi u j - phi v j = a - b := by rw [ha, hb, phi, phi]; ring
  rw [hphi]
  have h2 : (a - b)^2 ≤ 2 * (a^2 + b^2) := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a+b)]
  rw [e1, e2] at h2
  linarith

lemma Yproc_sub {n : ℕ} (u v : Finset (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) (σ : Fin n → Bool) :
    Yproc u σ - Yproc v σ = ∑ j, sgn (σ j) * (phi u j - phi v j) := by
  rw [Yproc, Yproc, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by ring

/-- The sub-Gaussian increment bound for the Rademacher process. -/
lemma Yproc_tail {n : ℕ} (u v : Finset (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B)
    (hdist : (((u ∆ v).card : ℝ)) ≤ B) (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    (signPi n).real {σ | x ≤ Yproc u σ - Yproc v σ} ≤ Real.exp (-x^2/(4*B)) := by
  classical
  set c : Fin n → ℝ := fun j => phi u j - phi v j with hc
  have hset : {σ : Fin n → Bool | x ≤ Yproc u σ - Yproc v σ}
      = {σ | x ≤ ∑ j, sgn (σ j) * c j} := by
    ext σ; simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, hc, ← Yproc_sub]
  have hsum : ∑ j, (c j)^2 ≤ 2 * B := by
    have := sum_sq_phi_le u v
    have h2 : (2:ℝ) * (((u ∆ v).card : ℝ)) ≤ 2 * B := by linarith
    simp only [hc]
    linarith
  have hsum0 : 0 ≤ ∑ j, (c j)^2 := Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hsum0 with heq | hpos
  · -- degenerate: all coefficients vanish
    have hzero : ∀ j, c j = 0 := by
      intro j
      have := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun j _ => sq_nonneg (c j))).mp heq.symm j
        (Finset.mem_univ j)
      exact pow_eq_zero_iff (n := 2) (by norm_num) |>.mp this
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hx with hx0 | hx0
    · have : Real.exp (-x^2/(4*B)) = 1 := by
        rw [← hx0]; norm_num
      rw [this]
      calc (signPi n).real {σ : Fin n → Bool | x ≤ Yproc u σ - Yproc v σ}
          ≤ (signPi n).real Set.univ := measureReal_mono (Set.subset_univ _)
            (measure_ne_top _ _)
        _ = 1 := by simp [measureReal_def]
    · have hempty : {σ : Fin n → Bool | x ≤ Yproc u σ - Yproc v σ} = ∅ := by
        ext σ
        simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_le]
        rw [Yproc_sub]
        have : ∑ j, sgn (σ j) * (phi u j - phi v j) = 0 := by
          refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j _ => ?_
          have := hzero j
          simp only [hc] at this
          rw [this, mul_zero]
        rw [this]
        linarith
      rw [hempty]
      simp only [measureReal_empty]
      positivity
  · rw [hset]
    refine le_trans (rademacher_tail c x hx) ?_
    refine Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_
    rw [neg_div, neg_div, neg_le_neg_iff]
    refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg x) (by positivity) ?_
    linarith


/-! ## Stubs (proved elsewhere) -/

lemma vcDim_le_of_no_shatter {β : Type*} [DecidableEq β] [Fintype β]
    (A : Finset (Finset β)) (d : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ S : Finset β, S.card = d + 1 → ¬ A.Shatters S) : A.vcDim ≤ d := by
  unfold Finset.vcDim
  refine Finset.sup_le ?_
  intro S hS
  rw [Finset.mem_shatterer] at hS
  by_contra hcard
  have hle : d + 1 ≤ S.card := by omega
  obtain ⟨T, hTS, hTcard⟩ := Finset.le_card_iff_exists_subset_card.mp hle
  exact h T hTcard (hS.mono_right hTS)

lemma vcDim_insert_le {β : Type*} [DecidableEq β] [Fintype β] (u₁ : Finset β)
    (A : Finset (Finset β)) : (insert u₁ A).vcDim ≤ A.vcDim + 1 := by
  unfold Finset.vcDim
  refine Finset.sup_le ?_
  intro S hS
  rw [Finset.mem_shatterer] at hS
  by_cases hSA : A.Shatters S
  · exact hSA.card_le_vcDim.trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  by_cases hS0 : S = ∅
  · subst S
    simp
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hS0
  have hErase : A.Shatters (S.erase a) := by
    intro T hT
    have hTS : T ⊆ S := hT.trans (Finset.erase_subset _ _)
    have haT : a ∉ T := by
      intro haT
      exact (Finset.mem_erase.mp (hT haT)).1 rfl
    obtain ⟨u, hu, huEq⟩ := hS hTS
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hu with rfl | huA
    · obtain ⟨v, hv, hvEq⟩ := hS (Finset.insert_subset ha hTS)
      have hvA : v ∈ A := by
        rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hv with rfl | hvA
        · have hbad : T = insert a T := huEq.symm.trans hvEq
          have : a ∈ T := by rw [hbad]; simp
          exact absurd this haT
        · exact hvA
      refine ⟨v, hvA, ?_⟩
      ext x
      have hx := Finset.ext_iff.mp hvEq x
      simp only [Finset.mem_inter, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_insert] at hx ⊢
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨hxa, hxS⟩, hxv⟩
        rcases hx.mp ⟨hxS, hxv⟩ with hxa' | hxT
        · exact absurd hxa' hxa
        · exact hxT
      · intro hxT
        have hxvS := hx.mpr (Or.inr hxT)
        exact ⟨⟨fun hxa => haT (hxa ▸ hxT), hxvS.1⟩, hxvS.2⟩
    · refine ⟨u, huA, ?_⟩
      ext x
      have hx := Finset.ext_iff.mp huEq x
      simp only [Finset.mem_inter, Finset.mem_erase] at hx ⊢
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨_, hxS⟩, hxu⟩
        exact hx.mp ⟨hxS, hxu⟩
      · intro hxT
        have hxuS := hx.mpr hxT
        exact ⟨⟨fun hxa => haT (hxa ▸ hxT), hxuS.1⟩, hxuS.2⟩
  have hcard := hErase.card_le_vcDim
  unfold Finset.vcDim at hcard
  rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem ha] at hcard
  omega

theorem chaining_tail {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [Fintype α]
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (A : Finset (Finset α)) (u₀ : Finset α) (hu₀ : u₀ ∈ A)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hvc : A.vcDim ≤ d)
    (hN : 1 ≤ Fintype.card α)
    (Y : Finset α → Ω → ℝ)
    (hsub : ∀ u ∈ A, ∀ v ∈ A, ∀ B : ℝ, 0 < B → ((u ∆ v).card : ℝ) ≤ B →
      ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → P.real {ω | x ≤ Y u ω - Y v ω} ≤ Real.exp (-(x^2)/(4*B)))
    (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) :
    P.real {ω | ∃ u ∈ A, 128 * Real.sqrt ((Fintype.card α : ℝ) * ((d:ℝ) + lam))
        < |Y u ω - Y u₀ ω|} ≤ Real.exp (-lam) :=
  Chaining.chaining_tail P A u₀ hu₀ d hd hvc hN Y hsub lam hlam

/-! ## The conditional (Rademacher) bound -/

open Classical in
/-- The trace of hypothesis `i` on the double sample `w`. -/
noncomputable def trace {Z : Type*} {ι : Type*} (f : ι → Z → Bool) {n : ℕ}
    (w : (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) → Z) (i : ι) : Finset (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun x => f i (w x) = true)

lemma mem_trace {Z : Type*} {ι : Type*} (f : ι → Z → Bool) {n : ℕ}
    (w : (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) → Z) (i : ι) (x : Fin n ⊕ Fin n) :
    x ∈ trace f w i ↔ f i (w x) = true := by
  classical
  simp [trace]

theorem cond_bound {Z : Type*} {ι : Type*} (f : ι → Z → Bool)
    (G : Set Z) (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (hvc : ∀ z : Fin (d+1) → Z, (∀ j, z j ∈ G) →
      ¬ ∀ v : Fin (d+1) → Bool, ∃ i, ∀ j, f i (z j) = v j)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (w : (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) → Z) (hw : ∀ x, w x ∈ G)
    (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) (r : ℝ)
    (hr : 128 * Real.sqrt ((2*(n:ℝ)) * (((d:ℝ)+1) + lam)) ≤ r) :
    (signPi n).real {σ | ∃ i : ι, r < |Yproc (trace f w i) σ|} ≤ Real.exp (-lam) := by
  classical
  set Tr : Finset (Finset (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) :=
    Finset.univ.filter (fun u => ∃ i : ι, u = trace f w i) with hTr
  set A : Finset (Finset (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) := insert ∅ Tr with hA
  have hemp : (∅ : Finset (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) ∈ A := Finset.mem_insert_self _ _
  -- the trace family has VC dimension at most `d`
  have hvcTr : Tr.vcDim ≤ d := by
    refine vcDim_le_of_no_shatter Tr d ?_
    intro S hScard hSsh
    -- enumerate `S`
    set g : Fin (d+1) → (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) :=
      fun j => (S.equivFin.symm (Fin.cast hScard.symm j) : Fin n ⊕ Fin n) with hg
    have hginj : Function.Injective g := by
      intro j j' hjj'
      have : S.equivFin.symm (Fin.cast hScard.symm j) = S.equivFin.symm (Fin.cast hScard.symm j') :=
        Subtype.ext hjj'
      have h2 := S.equivFin.symm.injective this
      exact Fin.cast_injective hScard.symm h2
    have hgS : ∀ j, g j ∈ S := fun j => (S.equivFin.symm (Fin.cast hScard.symm j)).2
    refine hvc (fun j => w (g j)) (fun j => hw _) ?_
    intro v
    set T : Finset (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) :=
      Finset.image g (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => v j = true)) with hT
    have hTS : T ⊆ S := by
      intro x hx
      rw [hT, Finset.mem_image] at hx
      obtain ⟨j, -, rfl⟩ := hx
      exact hgS j
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hu2⟩ := hSsh hTS
    rw [hTr, Finset.mem_filter] at hu
    obtain ⟨-, i, rfl⟩ := hu
    refine ⟨i, fun j => ?_⟩
    have hiff : g j ∈ trace f w i ↔ v j = true := by
      constructor
      · intro hmem
        have : g j ∈ S ∩ trace f w i := Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hgS j, hmem⟩
        rw [hu2, hT, Finset.mem_image] at this
        obtain ⟨j', hj', hj'2⟩ := this
        have : j' = j := hginj hj'2
        subst this
        exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj').2
      · intro hv
        have hmemT : g j ∈ T := by
          rw [hT, Finset.mem_image]
          exact ⟨j, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ j, hv⟩, rfl⟩
        rw [← hu2] at hmemT
        exact (Finset.mem_inter.mp hmemT).2
    rw [mem_trace] at hiff
    show f i (w (g j)) = v j
    revert hiff
    cases f i (w (g j)) <;> cases v j <;> simp
  have hvcA : A.vcDim ≤ d + 1 := by
    rw [hA]
    exact le_trans (vcDim_insert_le _ _) (by omega)
  have hcard : Fintype.card (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) = 2 * n := by
    simp [Fintype.card_sum]; ring
  have hNge : 1 ≤ Fintype.card (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) := by rw [hcard]; omega
  have hmain := chaining_tail (signPi n) A ∅ hemp (d+1) (by omega) hvcA hNge
    Yproc
    (fun u _ v _ B hB hdist x hx => Yproc_tail u v B hB hdist x hx)
    lam hlam
  refine le_trans (measureReal_mono ?_ (measure_ne_top _ _)) hmain
  intro σ hσ
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hσ
  refine ⟨trace f w i, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hA]
    refine Finset.mem_insert_of_mem ?_
    rw [hTr, Finset.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, i, rfl⟩
  · simp only [Yproc_empty, sub_zero]
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ hi
    refine le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) hr
    congr 2
    rw [hcard]
    push_cast
    ring

end RadDev


namespace PACBridge

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped ENNReal NNReal symmDiff
open Finset

/-- Coordinate-swapping involution associated to a Rademacher sign vector. -/
def swp {n : ℕ} (σ : Fin n → Bool) : (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) ≃ (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) where
  toFun := fun x => Sum.elim (fun j => if σ j then Sum.inr j else Sum.inl j)
    (fun j => if σ j then Sum.inl j else Sum.inr j) x
  invFun := fun x => Sum.elim (fun j => if σ j then Sum.inr j else Sum.inl j)
    (fun j => if σ j then Sum.inl j else Sum.inr j) x
  left_inv := by
    intro x
    cases x with
    | inl j => by_cases h : σ j = true <;> simp [h]
    | inr j => by_cases h : σ j = true <;> simp [h]
  right_inv := by
    intro x
    cases x with
    | inl j => by_cases h : σ j = true <;> simp [h]
    | inr j => by_cases h : σ j = true <;> simp [h]

@[simp] lemma swp_inl {n : ℕ} (σ : Fin n → Bool) (j : Fin n) :
    swp σ (Sum.inl j) = if σ j then Sum.inr j else Sum.inl j := rfl

@[simp] lemma swp_inr {n : ℕ} (σ : Fin n → Bool) (j : Fin n) :
    swp σ (Sum.inr j) = if σ j then Sum.inl j else Sum.inr j := rfl

lemma phi_trace {Z : Type*} {ι : Type*} (f : ι → Z → Bool) {n : ℕ}
    (w : (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) → Z) (i : ι) (j : Fin n) :
    RadDev.phi (RadDev.trace f w i) j =
      UCdev.ind (f i (w (Sum.inl j))) - UCdev.ind (f i (w (Sum.inr j))) := by
  classical
  unfold RadDev.phi UCdev.ind
  rw [if_congr (RadDev.mem_trace f w i (Sum.inl j)) rfl rfl,
    if_congr (RadDev.mem_trace f w i (Sum.inr j)) rfl rfl]

/-- Swapping the double sample turns its empirical difference into the Rademacher process. -/
lemma emp_swap_eq {Z : Type*} {ι : Type*} (f : ι → Z → Bool) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (w : (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) → Z) (i : ι) (σ : Fin n → Bool) :
    UCdev.empAvg (f i) (fun j => w (swp σ (Sum.inl j)))
        - UCdev.empAvg (f i) (fun j => w (swp σ (Sum.inr j)))
      = RadDev.Yproc (RadDev.trace f w i) σ / n := by
  classical
  unfold UCdev.empAvg RadDev.Yproc
  rw [div_sub_div_same, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  rw [phi_trace]
  by_cases h : σ j = true
  · simp only [swp_inl, swp_inr, h, if_true, RadDev.sgn]
    ring
  · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at h
    simp only [swp_inl, swp_inr, h, RadDev.sgn, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    ring

end PACBridge

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory

noncomputable def cUC : ℝ := 2 ^ 40

lemma cUC_pos : (0 : ℝ) < cUC := by unfold cUC; positivity
lemma cUC_ge_one : (1 : ℝ) ≤ cUC := by unfold cUC; norm_num

theorem uniform_convergence
    {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] (D : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure D]
    {ι : Type*} [Countable ι] (f : ι → Z → Bool) (hf : ∀ i, Measurable (f i))
    (G : Set Z) (hG : D Gᶜ = 0)
    (d : ℕ) (hd1 : 1 ≤ d)
    (hvc : ∀ z : Fin (d+1) → Z, (∀ j, z j ∈ G) →
      ¬ ∀ v : Fin (d+1) → Bool, ∃ i, ∀ j, f i (z j) = v j)
    (n : ℕ) (t lam : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    (hn : cUC * ((d:ℝ) + lam) ≤ n * t ^ 2) :
    1 - Real.exp (-lam) ≤
      ((Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D))
        {s : Fin n → Z | ∀ i : ι,
          |(((Finset.univ.filter (fun j => f i (s j) = true)).card : ℝ)) / n
              - (D {z | f i z = true}).toReal| ≤ t}).toReal := by
  classical
  set μ : Measure (Fin n → Z) := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D) with hμ
  set P : Measure ((Fin n ⊕ Fin n) → Z) := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n ⊕ Fin n => D) with hP
  set S : Measure (Fin n → Bool) := RadDev.signPi n with hS
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := by rw [hμ]; infer_instance
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure P := by rw [hP]; infer_instance
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure S := by rw [hS]; infer_instance
  have hdR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hd1
  have hdl1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ) + lam := by linarith
  have hlhs : 0 < cUC * ((d : ℝ) + lam) :=
    mul_pos cUC_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hdl1)
  have hnprod : 0 < (n : ℝ) * t ^ 2 := lt_of_lt_of_le hlhs hn
  have hnR : (0 : ℝ) < n := by
    by_contra hn'
    have : (n : ℝ) = 0 :=
      le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hn') (Nat.cast_nonneg n)
    rw [this, zero_mul] at hnprod
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hnprod
  have hn0 : 0 < n := by exact_mod_cast hnR
  have hnt8 : (8 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) * t ^ 2 := by
    have hmul := mul_le_mul (by unfold cUC; norm_num : (8 : ℝ) ≤ cUC) hdl1 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
      (le_of_lt cUC_pos)
    norm_num at hmul
    exact hmul.trans hn
  set Bad : Set (Fin n → Z) :=
    {s | ∃ i : ι, t < |UCdev.empAvg (f i) s - UCdev.riskOf D (f i)|} with hBad
  set Bad2 : Set ((Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z)) :=
    {q | ∃ i : ι, t/2 < |UCdev.empAvg (f i) q.1 - UCdev.empAvg (f i) q.2|} with hBad2
  have hBadm : MeasurableSet Bad := by
    have heq : Bad = ⋃ i : ι, {s | t < |UCdev.empAvg (f i) s - UCdev.riskOf D (f i)|} := by
      ext s
      simp [hBad]
    rw [heq]
    exact MeasurableSet.iUnion (fun i => measurableSet_lt measurable_const
      (((UCdev.measurable_empAvg (f i) (hf i)).sub measurable_const).abs))
  have hBad2m : MeasurableSet Bad2 := by
    have heq : Bad2 = ⋃ i : ι,
        {q | t/2 < |UCdev.empAvg (f i) q.1 - UCdev.empAvg (f i) q.2|} := by
      ext q
      simp [hBad2]
    rw [heq]
    refine MeasurableSet.iUnion (fun i => measurableSet_lt measurable_const ?_)
    exact (((UCdev.measurable_empAvg (f i) (hf i)).comp measurable_fst).sub
      ((UCdev.measurable_empAvg (f i) (hf i)).comp measurable_snd)).abs
  have hsymm : μ Bad ≤ 2 * (μ.prod μ) Bad2 := by
    simpa only [hμ, hBad, hBad2] using
      UCdev.symmetrization D f hf n hn0 t ht hnt8
  let e := MeasurableEquiv.sumPiEquivProdPi
    (fun _ : Fin n ⊕ Fin n => Z)
  set B : Set ((Fin n ⊕ Fin n) → Z) :=
    {w | ∃ i : ι, t/2 <
      |UCdev.empAvg (f i) (fun j => w (Sum.inl j)) -
        UCdev.empAvg (f i) (fun j => w (Sum.inr j))|} with hB
  have hBpre : B = e ⁻¹' Bad2 := by
    ext w
    rfl
  have hmp : MeasurePreserving e P (μ.prod μ) := by
    simpa only [hP, hμ] using
      (measurePreserving_sumPiEquivProdPi
        (fun _ : Fin n ⊕ Fin n => D))
  have hBm : MeasurableSet B := by
    rw [hBpre]
    exact hmp.measurable hBad2m
  have hPB : P B = (μ.prod μ) Bad2 := by
    rw [hBpre]
    exact hmp.measure_preimage hBad2m.nullMeasurableSet
  set swapAll :
      (((Fin n ⊕ Fin n) → Z) × (Fin n → Bool)) → ((Fin n ⊕ Fin n) → Z) :=
    fun q x => q.1 (PACBridge.swp q.2 x) with hswapAll
  have hswapAllm : Measurable swapAll := by
    rw [measurable_pi_iff]
    intro x
    cases x with
    | inl j =>
        have hj : MeasurableSet
            {q : (((Fin n ⊕ Fin n) → Z) × (Fin n → Bool)) | q.2 j = true} :=
          by
            change MeasurableSet
              ((fun q : (((Fin n ⊕ Fin n) → Z) × (Fin n → Bool)) => q.2 j) ⁻¹'
                ({true} : Set Bool))
            exact ((measurable_pi_apply j).comp measurable_snd)
              (measurableSet_singleton true)
        change Measurable (fun q :
            (((Fin n ⊕ Fin n) → Z) × (Fin n → Bool)) =>
              q.1 (if q.2 j then Sum.inr j else Sum.inl j))
        have heq : (fun q :
            (((Fin n ⊕ Fin n) → Z) × (Fin n → Bool)) =>
              q.1 (if q.2 j then Sum.inr j else Sum.inl j)) =
            (fun q => if q.2 j = true then q.1 (Sum.inr j) else q.1 (Sum.inl j)) := by
          funext q
          cases q.2 j <;> simp
        rw [heq]
        exact Measurable.ite hj
          ((measurable_pi_apply (Sum.inr j)).comp measurable_fst)
          ((measurable_pi_apply (Sum.inl j)).comp measurable_fst)
    | inr j =>
        have hj : MeasurableSet
            {q : (((Fin n ⊕ Fin n) → Z) × (Fin n → Bool)) | q.2 j = true} :=
          by
            change MeasurableSet
              ((fun q : (((Fin n ⊕ Fin n) → Z) × (Fin n → Bool)) => q.2 j) ⁻¹'
                ({true} : Set Bool))
            exact ((measurable_pi_apply j).comp measurable_snd)
              (measurableSet_singleton true)
        change Measurable (fun q :
            (((Fin n ⊕ Fin n) → Z) × (Fin n → Bool)) =>
              q.1 (if q.2 j then Sum.inl j else Sum.inr j))
        have heq : (fun q :
            (((Fin n ⊕ Fin n) → Z) × (Fin n → Bool)) =>
              q.1 (if q.2 j then Sum.inl j else Sum.inr j)) =
            (fun q => if q.2 j = true then q.1 (Sum.inl j) else q.1 (Sum.inr j)) := by
          funext q
          cases q.2 j <;> simp
        rw [heq]
        exact Measurable.ite hj
          ((measurable_pi_apply (Sum.inl j)).comp measurable_fst)
          ((measurable_pi_apply (Sum.inr j)).comp measurable_fst)
  set E : Set (((Fin n ⊕ Fin n) → Z) × (Fin n → Bool)) := swapAll ⁻¹' B with hE
  have hEm : MeasurableSet E := by
    rw [hE]
    exact hswapAllm hBm
  have hEeq : (P.prod S) E = P B := by
    rw [Measure.prod_apply_symm hEm]
    have hsec : ∀ σ : Fin n → Bool,
        P ((fun w => (w, σ)) ⁻¹' E) = P B := by
      intro σ
      have hreindex :
          MeasurePreserving
            (fun w : (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) → Z => fun x => w (PACBridge.swp σ x)) P P := by
        simpa only [hP] using
          (UCdev.pi_map_reindex D (PACBridge.swp σ))
      have hpre : (fun w => (w, σ)) ⁻¹' E =
          (fun w : (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) → Z => fun x => w (PACBridge.swp σ x)) ⁻¹' B := by
        ext w
        rfl
      rw [hpre]
      exact hreindex.measure_preimage hBm.nullMeasurableSet
    simp_rw [hsec]
    simp
  set lam' : ℝ := lam + 1 with hlam'
  set r : ℝ := (n : ℝ) * t / 2 with hrdef
  have hlam'0 : 0 ≤ lam' := by rw [hlam']; linarith
  have hthreshold :
      128 * Real.sqrt ((2*(n:ℝ)) * (((d:ℝ)+1) + lam')) ≤ r := by
    have hK :
        ((d : ℝ) + 1) + lam' ≤ 3 * ((d : ℝ) + lam) := by
      rw [hlam']
      linarith
    have hc : (393216 : ℝ) ≤ cUC := by
      unfold cUC
      norm_num
    have hbig :
        131072 * (((d : ℝ) + 1) + lam') ≤ (n : ℝ) * t ^ 2 := by
      calc
        131072 * (((d : ℝ) + 1) + lam')
            ≤ 393216 * ((d : ℝ) + lam) := by nlinarith
        _ ≤ cUC * ((d : ℝ) + lam) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (by linarith)
        _ ≤ (n : ℝ) * t ^ 2 := hn
    have harg : 0 ≤ (2*(n:ℝ)) * (((d:ℝ)+1) + lam') := by
      have : 0 ≤ ((d : ℝ) + 1) + lam' := by positivity
      positivity
    have hsqrt :
        (128 * Real.sqrt ((2*(n:ℝ)) * (((d:ℝ)+1) + lam'))) ^ 2
          = 32768 * (n : ℝ) * (((d : ℝ) + 1) + lam') := by
      rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt harg]
      ring
    have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbig (show 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) / 4 by positivity)
    have hsq :
        (128 * Real.sqrt ((2*(n:ℝ)) * (((d:ℝ)+1) + lam'))) ^ 2
          ≤ r ^ 2 := by
      rw [hsqrt, hrdef]
      nlinarith
    have hleft :
        0 ≤ 128 * Real.sqrt ((2*(n:ℝ)) * (((d:ℝ)+1) + lam')) := by positivity
    have hright : 0 ≤ r := by rw [hrdef]; positivity
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg
      (128 * Real.sqrt ((2*(n:ℝ)) * (((d:ℝ)+1) + lam')) + r)]
  have hDae : ∀ᵐ z ∂D, z ∈ G := by
    rw [ae_iff]
    exact hG
  have hPae : ∀ᵐ w ∂P, ∀ x, w x ∈ G := by
    rw [ae_all_iff]
    intro x
    have hx := (measurePreserving_eval
      (fun _ : Fin n ⊕ Fin n => D) x).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hDae
    simpa only [hP] using hx
  have hcondAE : ∀ᵐ w ∂P,
      S (Prod.mk w ⁻¹' E) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-lam')) := by
    filter_upwards [hPae] with w hw
    have hsub : Prod.mk w ⁻¹' E ⊆
        {σ : Fin n → Bool | ∃ i : ι, r < |RadDev.Yproc (RadDev.trace f w i) σ|} := by
      intro σ hσ
      change swapAll (w, σ) ∈ B at hσ
      rw [hB] at hσ
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hσ
      refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
      rw [hswapAll, PACBridge.emp_swap_eq f hn0 w i σ, abs_div, abs_of_pos hnR] at hi
      rw [hrdef]
      have himul := (lt_div_iff₀ hnR).mp hi
      nlinarith
    have hcb := RadDev.cond_bound f G d hd1 hvc n hn0 w hw lam' hlam'0 r hthreshold
    have hreal : S.real (Prod.mk w ⁻¹' E) ≤ Real.exp (-lam') := by
      refine (measureReal_mono hsub (measure_ne_top S _)).trans ?_
      simpa only [hS] using hcb
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (measure_ne_top S _)]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hreal
  have hEupper : (P.prod S) E ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-lam')) := by
    rw [Measure.prod_apply hEm]
    calc
      (∫⁻ w, S (Prod.mk w ⁻¹' E) ∂P)
          ≤ ∫⁻ _w, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-lam')) ∂P :=
            lintegral_mono_ae hcondAE
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-lam')) := by simp
  have hPBen : P B ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-lam')) := by
    rw [← hEeq]
    exact hEupper
  have hPBreal : P.real B ≤ Real.exp (-lam') := by
    rw [measureReal_def]
    calc
      (P B).toReal ≤ (ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-lam'))).toReal :=
        ENNReal.toReal_mono (by simp) hPBen
      _ = Real.exp (-lam') := ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hsymmReal : μ.real Bad ≤ 2 * (μ.prod μ).real Bad2 := by
    rw [measureReal_def, measureReal_def]
    have htop : 2 * (μ.prod μ) Bad2 ≠ ∞ := by
      exact ENNReal.mul_ne_top (by norm_num) (measure_ne_top _ _)
    have hle := ENNReal.toReal_mono htop hsymm
    simpa using hle
  have hbad : μ.real Bad ≤ Real.exp (-lam) := by
    have hbad2 : (μ.prod μ).real Bad2 ≤ Real.exp (-lam') := by
      rw [measureReal_def, ← hPB]
      simpa only [measureReal_def] using hPBreal
    have he : (2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-1) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Real.exp_neg, mul_inv_le_iff₀ (Real.exp_pos 1)]
      have := Real.add_one_le_exp (1 : ℝ)
      linarith
    have hexp : 2 * Real.exp (-lam') ≤ Real.exp (-lam) := by
      rw [hlam', show -(lam + 1) = -lam + -1 by ring, Real.exp_add]
      have hnonneg : 0 ≤ Real.exp (-lam) := (Real.exp_pos _).le
      nlinarith
    linarith
  have hemp : ∀ (i : ι) (s : Fin n → Z),
      UCdev.empAvg (f i) s =
        (((Finset.univ.filter (fun j => f i (s j) = true)).card : ℝ)) / n := by
    intro i s
    unfold UCdev.empAvg
    congr 1
    calc
      ∑ j, UCdev.ind (f i (s j)) =
          ∑ j, if f i (s j) = true then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
            cases f i (s j) <;> simp [UCdev.ind]
      _ = ((Finset.univ.filter (fun j => f i (s j) = true)).card : ℝ) := by
            simp
  set Good : Set (Fin n → Z) :=
    {s | ∀ i : ι,
      |(((Finset.univ.filter (fun j => f i (s j) = true)).card : ℝ)) / n
        - (D {z | f i z = true}).toReal| ≤ t} with hGood
  have hGoodBad : Good = Badᶜ := by
    ext s
    simp only [hGood, hBad, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_compl_iff, not_exists, not_lt,
      UCdev.riskOf, hemp]
  change 1 - Real.exp (-lam) ≤ μ.real Good
  rw [hGoodBad, measureReal_compl hBadm, probReal_univ]
  linarith

end PACMain

variable {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]

/-- Existence of an empirical risk minimiser. -/
private lemma exists_serm {H : Set (X → Bool)} (hH : H.Nonempty) (c : X → X → ℝ)
    (Δ : (X → Bool) → X → ℝ → X) (N : ℕ) (s : Fin N → X × Bool × ℝ) :
    ∃ h, IsSERM H c Δ h s := by
  classical
  set S : Set ℕ := {k : ℕ | ∃ h ∈ H, empStrategicLoss c Δ h s = k} with hS
  obtain ⟨h0, hh0⟩ := hH
  have hSne : S.Nonempty := ⟨_, h0, hh0, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨h, hh, hk⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem hSne
  refine ⟨h, hh, fun h' hh' => ?_⟩
  rw [hk]
  exact Nat.sInf_le ⟨h', hh', rfl⟩

/-- If `SVC = 0`, all hypotheses induce the same strategic label at every valid point. -/
private lemma svc_zero_const {H : Set (X → Bool)} {R : Set ℝ} {c : X → X → ℝ}
    {Δ : (X → Bool) → X → ℝ → X} (hd : SVC H R c Δ = 0)
    {h h' : X → Bool} (hh : h ∈ H) (hh' : h' ∈ H) {x : X} {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ R) :
    h (Δ h x r) = h' (Δ h' x r) := by
  by_contra hne
  have hshat : StrategicShatters H R c Δ 1 := by
    refine ⟨fun _ => x, fun _ => r, fun _ => hr, ?_⟩
    intro v
    by_cases hv : v 0 = h (Δ h x r)
    · exact ⟨h, hh, fun i => by rw [Subsingleton.elim i 0]; exact hv.symm⟩
    · refine ⟨h', hh', fun i => ?_⟩
      rw [Subsingleton.elim i 0]
      revert hv hne
      cases v 0 <;> cases h (Δ h x r) <;> cases h' (Δ h' x r) <;> simp
  have hle : ((1:ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ SVC H R c Δ :=
    le_iSup₂ (f := fun n (_ : StrategicShatters H R c Δ n) => (n : ℕ∞)) 1 hshat
  rw [hd] at hle
  simp at hle

/-- If `SVC = 0`, all hypotheses have the same strategic risk. -/
private lemma risk_eq_of_svc_zero {H : Set (X → Bool)} {R : Set ℝ} {c : X → X → ℝ}
    {Δ : (X → Bool) → X → ℝ → X} (hd : SVC H R c Δ = 0)
    {D : Measure (X × Bool × ℝ)} (hDR : D {p : X × Bool × ℝ | p.2.2 ∉ R} = 0)
    {h h' : X → Bool} (hh : h ∈ H) (hh' : h' ∈ H) :
    strategicRisk c Δ h D = strategicRisk c Δ h' D := by
  unfold strategicRisk
  congr 1
  refine measure_congr ?_
  have hae : ∀ᵐ p ∂D, p.2.2 ∈ R := by
    rw [ae_iff]
    exact hDR
  filter_upwards [hae] with p hp
  show (h (Δ h p.1 p.2.2) ≠ p.2.1) = (h' (Δ h' p.1 p.2.2) ≠ p.2.1)
  rw [svc_zero_const hd hh hh' hp]

theorem strategic_agnostic_PAC :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ (X : Type*) [MeasurableSpace X]
        (H : Set (X → Bool)) (_hH : H.Nonempty) (_hH_ctble : H.Countable)
        (R : Set ℝ) (c : X → X → ℝ) (_hc : ∀ x y : X, 0 ≤ c x y)
    (_hc0 : ∀ x : X, c x x = 0)
        (Δ : (X → Bool) → X → ℝ → X)
        (_hΔ : ∀ h ∈ H, ∀ x, ∀ r ∈ R, IsBestResponse c h x r (Δ h x r))
        (_hmeas : ∀ h ∈ H, Measurable (fun p : X × Bool × ℝ => h (Δ h p.1 p.2.2)))
        (d : ℕ) (_hd : SVC H R c Δ = (d : ℕ∞)),
      ∃ m : ℝ → ℝ → ℕ,
        (∀ δ ε : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < 1 → 0 < ε → ε < 1 →
            (m δ ε : ℝ) ≤ C * (ε ^ 2)⁻¹ * ((d : ℝ) + Real.log (1 / δ))) ∧
        ∃ A : (N : ℕ) → (Fin N → X × Bool × ℝ) → (X → Bool),
          (∀ N s, IsSERM H c Δ (A N s) s) ∧
          ∀ δ ε : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < 1 → 0 < ε → ε < 1 →
          ∀ n : ℕ, m δ ε ≤ n →
          ∀ D : MeasureTheory.Measure (X × Bool × ℝ), MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure D →

          D {p : X × Bool × ℝ | p.2.2 ∉ R} = 0 →
            1 - δ ≤
              ((MeasureTheory.Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D))
                {s : Fin n → X × Bool × ℝ |
                  strategicRisk c Δ (A n s) D - ⨅ h : ↥H, strategicRisk c Δ (h : X → Bool) D
                    ≤ ε}).toReal := by
  classical
  refine ⟨8 * PACMain.cUC, by have := PACMain.cUC_pos; positivity, ?_⟩
  intro X _ H hH hHc R c _hc _hc0 Δ hΔ hmeas d hd
  choose A hA using (fun (N : ℕ) (s : Fin N → X × Bool × ℝ) => exists_serm hH c Δ N s)
  have hHne : Nonempty ↥H := hH.to_subtype
  -- nonnegativity of the sample-complexity expression
  have hcap : ∀ δ ε : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < 1 → 0 < ε → ε < 1 →
      0 ≤ 8 * PACMain.cUC * (ε ^ 2)⁻¹ * ((d : ℝ) + Real.log (1 / δ)) := by
    intro δ ε hδ0 hδ1 hε0 hε1
    have h1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1/δ := by rw [le_div_iff₀ hδ0]; linarith
    have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log (1/δ) := Real.log_nonneg h1
    have := PACMain.cUC_pos
    positivity
  by_cases hd0 : d = 0
  · -- degenerate case: every hypothesis has the same strategic risk
    refine ⟨fun _ _ => 0, fun δ ε hδ0 hδ1 hε0 hε1 => ?_, A, hA, ?_⟩
    · simpa using hcap δ ε hδ0 hδ1 hε0 hε1
    · intro δ ε hδ0 hδ1 hε0 hε1 n _ D hD hDR
      have hd' : SVC H R c Δ = 0 := by rw [hd, hd0]; simp
      have hset : {s : Fin n → X × Bool × ℝ |
          strategicRisk c Δ (A n s) D - ⨅ h : ↥H, strategicRisk c Δ (h : X → Bool) D ≤ ε}
          = Set.univ := by
        ext s
        simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
        have hle : strategicRisk c Δ (A n s) D
            ≤ ⨅ h : ↥H, strategicRisk c Δ (h : X → Bool) D := by
          refine le_ciInf fun h => ?_
          exact le_of_eq (risk_eq_of_svc_zero hd' hDR (hA n s).1 h.2)
        linarith
      rw [hset, measure_univ]
      simp
      linarith
  · -- main case
    have hd1 : 1 ≤ d := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hd0
    refine ⟨fun δ ε => ⌊8 * PACMain.cUC * (ε ^ 2)⁻¹ * ((d : ℝ) + Real.log (1 / δ))⌋₊,
      fun δ ε hδ0 hδ1 hε0 hε1 => Nat.floor_le (hcap δ ε hδ0 hδ1 hε0 hε1), A, hA, ?_⟩
    intro δ ε hδ0 hδ1 hε0 hε1 n hn D hD hDR
    set lam : ℝ := Real.log (1 / δ) with hlamdef
    have hlam : 0 ≤ lam := Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hδ0]; linarith)
    have hdR : (1:ℝ) ≤ (d:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hd1
    -- the induced family of Boolean tests
    set f : ↥H → (X × Bool × ℝ) → Bool :=
      fun i p => decide ((i : X → Bool) (Δ (i : X → Bool) p.1 p.2.2) ≠ p.2.1) with hfdef
    have hf : ∀ i : ↥H, Measurable (f i) := by
      intro i
      exact (Measurable.of_discrete (f := fun q : Bool × Bool => decide (q.1 ≠ q.2))).comp
        ((hmeas (i : X → Bool) i.2).prodMk (measurable_fst.comp measurable_snd))
    have hcount : Countable ↥H := hHc.to_subtype
    set G : Set (X × Bool × ℝ) := {p | p.2.2 ∈ R} with hGdef
    have hG : D Gᶜ = 0 := hDR
    -- VC dimension of the induced family is at most `d`
    have hvc : ∀ z : Fin (d+1) → (X × Bool × ℝ), (∀ j, z j ∈ G) →
        ¬ ∀ v : Fin (d+1) → Bool, ∃ i : ↥H, ∀ j, f i (z j) = v j := by
      intro z hz hshat
      have hstrat : StrategicShatters H R c Δ (d+1) := by
        refine ⟨fun j => (z j).1, fun j => (z j).2.2, fun j => hz j, ?_⟩
        intro v
        obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hshat (fun j => decide (v j ≠ (z j).2.1))
        refine ⟨(i : X → Bool), i.2, fun j => ?_⟩
        have := hi j
        simp only [hfdef, decide_eq_decide] at this
        revert this
        cases (i : X → Bool) (Δ (i : X → Bool) (z j).1 (z j).2.2) <;> cases v j <;>
          cases (z j).2.1 <;> simp
      have hle : ((d+1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ SVC H R c Δ :=
        le_iSup₂ (f := fun k (_ : StrategicShatters H R c Δ k) => (k : ℕ∞)) (d+1) hstrat
      rw [hd] at hle
      have : d + 1 ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hle
      omega
    -- the sample size is large enough
    have hcapge : (2:ℝ) ≤ 8 * PACMain.cUC * (ε ^ 2) ⁻¹ * ((d:ℝ) + lam) := by
      have h1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (ε ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        rw [le_inv_comm₀ one_pos (by positivity)]
        nlinarith
      have h2 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (d:ℝ) + lam := by linarith
      have h5 : (1:ℝ) ≤ PACMain.cUC := PACMain.cUC_ge_one
      have heq : 8 * PACMain.cUC * (ε ^ 2)⁻¹ * ((d:ℝ) + lam)
          = 8 * (PACMain.cUC * ((ε ^ 2)⁻¹ * ((d:ℝ) + lam))) := by ring
      rw [heq]
      have h6 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (ε ^ 2)⁻¹ * ((d:ℝ) + lam) := by nlinarith
      have h7 : (1:ℝ) ≤ PACMain.cUC * ((ε ^ 2)⁻¹ * ((d:ℝ) + lam)) := by nlinarith
      linarith
    have hnge : 8 * PACMain.cUC * (ε ^ 2)⁻¹ * ((d:ℝ) + lam) / 2 ≤ (n:ℝ) := by
      have h3 : ((⌊8 * PACMain.cUC * (ε ^ 2)⁻¹ * ((d:ℝ) + lam)⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (n:ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hn
      have h4 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one (8 * PACMain.cUC * (ε ^ 2)⁻¹ * ((d:ℝ) + lam))
      linarith
    have hn0 : (0:ℝ) < (n:ℝ) := by linarith
    have hnt : PACMain.cUC * ((d:ℝ) + lam) ≤ (n:ℝ) * (ε/2) ^ 2 := by
      have hε2 : (0:ℝ) < ε ^ 2 := by positivity
      have key := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hnge (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ ε ^ 2 / 4)
      calc PACMain.cUC * ((d:ℝ) + lam)
          = (8 * PACMain.cUC * (ε ^ 2)⁻¹ * ((d:ℝ) + lam) / 2) * (ε ^ 2 / 4) := by
            field_simp; ring
        _ ≤ (n:ℝ) * (ε ^ 2 / 4) := key
        _ = (n:ℝ) * (ε/2) ^ 2 := by ring
    have huc := PACMain.uniform_convergence D f hf G hG d hd1 hvc n (ε/2) lam (by linarith) hlam hnt
    -- translate the conclusion
    have hcard : ∀ (i : ↥H) (s : Fin n → X × Bool × ℝ),
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => f i (s j) = true)).card
          = empStrategicLoss c Δ (i : X → Bool) s := by
      intro i s
      unfold empStrategicLoss
      apply congrArg
      apply Finset.filter_congr
      intro j _
      simp [hfdef]
    have hrisk : ∀ i : ↥H, (D {z | f i z = true}).toReal
        = strategicRisk c Δ (i : X → Bool) D := by
      intro i
      unfold strategicRisk
      congr 2
      ext p
      simp [hfdef]
    have hexp : Real.exp (-lam) = δ := by
      have h1 : -lam = Real.log δ := by
        rw [hlamdef, one_div, Real.log_inv]; ring
      rw [h1, Real.exp_log hδ0]
    have hsub : {s : Fin n → X × Bool × ℝ | ∀ i : ↥H,
          |(((Finset.univ.filter (fun j => f i (s j) = true)).card : ℝ)) / n
              - (D {z | f i z = true}).toReal| ≤ ε/2}
        ⊆ {s : Fin n → X × Bool × ℝ |
            strategicRisk c Δ (A n s) D - ⨅ h : ↥H, strategicRisk c Δ (h : X → Bool) D ≤ ε} := by
      intro s hs
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hs ⊢
      have key : ∀ h : ↥H,
          strategicRisk c Δ (A n s) D - ε ≤ strategicRisk c Δ (h : X → Bool) D := by
        intro h
        have h1 := hs ⟨A n s, (hA n s).1⟩
        have h2 := hs h
        rw [hcard, hrisk] at h1
        rw [hcard, hrisk] at h2
        rw [abs_le] at h1 h2
        have h3 : (empStrategicLoss c Δ (A n s) s : ℝ)
            ≤ (empStrategicLoss c Δ (h : X → Bool) s : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast (hA n s).2 (h : X → Bool) h.2
        have h4 : (empStrategicLoss c Δ (A n s) s : ℝ) / n
            ≤ (empStrategicLoss c Δ (h : X → Bool) s : ℝ) / n := by
          apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h3 hn0.le
        simp only at h1 h2
        linarith [h1.1, h1.2, h2.1, h2.2]
      have := le_ciInf key
      linarith
    calc 1 - δ = 1 - Real.exp (-lam) := by rw [hexp]
      _ ≤ ((Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D))
            {s : Fin n → X × Bool × ℝ | ∀ i : ↥H,
              |(((Finset.univ.filter (fun j => f i (s j) = true)).card : ℝ)) / n
                  - (D {z | f i z = true}).toReal| ≤ ε/2}).toReal := huc
      _ ≤ _ := ENNReal.toReal_mono (measure_ne_top _ _) (measure_mono hsub)

private lemma sep_cost_le_abs {X : Type*} (c : X → X → ℝ)
    (hc0 : ∀ x : X, c x x = 0) (h : X → Bool) (x : X) (r : ℝ) (z : X)
    (hz : IsBestResponse c h x r z) (hlab : h z = decide (0 < r)) :
    c z x ≤ |r| := by
  have hx := hz x
  unfold stratUtil at hx
  rw [hc0] at hx
  by_cases hr : (0:ℝ) < r
  · rw [decide_eq_true hr] at hlab
    rw [hlab] at hx
    rw [abs_of_pos hr]
    have h0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (if h x then r else 0) := by
      split
      · exact le_of_lt hr
      · exact le_refl 0
    simp only [if_true] at hx
    linarith
  · rw [decide_eq_false hr] at hlab
    rw [hlab] at hx
    have hr' : r ≤ 0 := not_lt.mp hr
    rw [abs_of_nonpos hr']
    have h0 : r ≤ (if h x then r else 0) := by
      split
      · exact le_refl r
      · exact hr'
    norm_num at hx
    linarith

-- Lemma A : if the best response gets the *non*-preferred label, then every point within
-- cost |r| also gets that non-preferred label.
private lemma sep_nonpref_forces {X : Type*} (c : X → X → ℝ) (hc : ∀ x y : X, 0 ≤ c x y)
    (h : X → Bool) (x : X) (r : ℝ) (z : X)
    (hz : IsBestResponse c h x r z)
    (hne : h z ≠ decide (0 < r))
    (htie : (∃ z', IsBestResponse c h x r z' ∧ h z' = decide (0 < r)) → h z = decide (0 < r))
    (y : X) (hy : c y x ≤ |r|) : h y = h z := by
  by_contra hyz
  have hylab : h y = decide (0 < r) := by
    revert hyz hne
    generalize (decide (0 < r)) = p
    cases h y <;> cases h z <;> cases p <;> simp
  have hle : stratUtil c h x r z ≤ stratUtil c h x r y := by
    unfold stratUtil
    by_cases hr : (0:ℝ) < r
    · rw [decide_eq_true hr] at hylab
      rw [hylab]
      have hzf : h z = false := by
        rw [decide_eq_true hr] at hne
        exact Bool.not_eq_true _ |>.mp hne
      rw [hzf]
      rw [abs_of_pos hr] at hy
      have := hc z x
      norm_num
      linarith
    · rw [decide_eq_false hr] at hylab
      rw [hylab]
      have hzt : h z = true := by
        rw [decide_eq_false hr] at hne
        exact Bool.not_eq_false _ |>.mp hne
      rw [hzt]
      have hr' : r ≤ 0 := not_lt.mp hr
      rw [abs_of_nonpos hr'] at hy
      have := hc z x
      norm_num
      linarith
  have br : IsBestResponse c h x r y := fun z' => (hz z').trans hle
  exact hne (htie ⟨y, br, hylab⟩)

theorem separable_SVC_le_two
    {X : Type*} (H : Set (X → Bool)) (R : Set ℝ) (c : X → X → ℝ) (_hc : ∀ x y : X, 0 ≤ c x y)
    (Δ : (X → Bool) → X → ℝ → X)
    (hΔ : ∀ h ∈ H, ∀ (x : X), ∀ r ∈ R, IsBestResponse c h x r (Δ h x r))

    (htie : ∀ h ∈ H, ∀ (x : X), ∀ r ∈ R,
      (∃ z, IsBestResponse c h x r z ∧ h z = decide (0 < r)) →
      h (Δ h x r) = decide (0 < r))
    (hR : (0 : ℝ) ∉ R) (hsep : SeparableCost c) (hc0 : ∀ x : X, c x x = 0) :
    SVC H R c Δ ≤ 2 := by
  obtain ⟨c₁, c₂, hcdef⟩ := hsep
  apply iSup_le
  intro n
  apply iSup_le
  intro hn
  by_contra hlt
  have hn3 : 3 ≤ n := by
    by_contra hle
    push_neg at hle
    exact hlt (by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hle)
  obtain ⟨x, r, hrR, hsh⟩ := hn
  -- main pairwise claim
  have main : ∀ a b : Fin n, a ≠ b → (decide (0 < r a) = decide (0 < r b)) →
      c₁ (x a) + |r a| ≤ c₁ (x b) + |r b| → False := by
    intro a b hab hsign hle
    obtain ⟨h, hH, hv⟩ := hsh (fun i => if i = a then decide (0 < r b) else !(decide (0 < r b)))
    have hva : h (Δ h (x a) (r a)) = decide (0 < r b) := by
      have := hv a; simpa using this
    have hvb : h (Δ h (x b) (r b)) = !(decide (0 < r b)) := by
      have := hv b; simpa [hab.symm] using this
    -- cost of a's best response
    have hca : c (Δ h (x a) (r a)) (x a) ≤ |r a| :=
      sep_cost_le_abs c hc0 h (x a) (r a) _ (hΔ h hH (x a) (r a) (hrR a)) (by rw [hva, hsign])
    -- translate to b's neighbourhood
    have hcb : c (Δ h (x a) (r a)) (x b) ≤ |r b| := by
      rw [hcdef] at hca ⊢
      have h1 : c₂ (Δ h (x a) (r a)) - c₁ (x a) ≤ |r a| := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hca
      have h2 : (0:ℝ) ≤ |r b| := abs_nonneg _
      exact max_le (by linarith) h2
    have hforce := sep_nonpref_forces c _hc h (x b) (r b) _ (hΔ h hH (x b) (r b) (hrR b))
      (by rw [hvb]; simp) (htie h hH (x b) (r b) (hrR b)) _ hcb
    rw [hva, hvb] at hforce
    simp at hforce
  have main2 : ∀ a b : Fin n, a ≠ b → (decide (0 < r a) = decide (0 < r b)) → False := by
    intro a b hab hs
    rcases le_total (c₁ (x a) + |r a|) (c₁ (x b) + |r b|) with hle | hle
    · exact main a b hab hs hle
    · exact main b a hab.symm hs.symm hle
  -- pigeonhole on three indices
  have h0 : (0:ℕ) < n := by omega
  have h1 : (1:ℕ) < n := by omega
  have h2 : (2:ℕ) < n := by omega
  set i0 : Fin n := ⟨0, h0⟩
  set i1 : Fin n := ⟨1, h1⟩
  set i2 : Fin n := ⟨2, h2⟩
  have e01 : i0 ≠ i1 := by simp [i0, i1, Fin.ext_iff]
  have e02 : i0 ≠ i2 := by simp [i0, i2, Fin.ext_iff]
  have e12 : i1 ≠ i2 := by simp [i1, i2, Fin.ext_iff]
  rcases Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true (decide (0 < r i0)) with p0 | p0 <;>
  rcases Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true (decide (0 < r i1)) with p1 | p1 <;>
  rcases Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true (decide (0 < r i2)) with p2 | p2
  · exact main2 i0 i1 e01 (by rw [p0, p1])
  · exact main2 i0 i1 e01 (by rw [p0, p1])
  · exact main2 i0 i2 e02 (by rw [p0, p2])
  · exact main2 i1 i2 e12 (by rw [p1, p2])
  · exact main2 i1 i2 e12 (by rw [p1, p2])
  · exact main2 i0 i2 e02 (by rw [p0, p2])
  · exact main2 i0 i1 e01 (by rw [p0, p1])
  · exact main2 i0 i1 e01 (by rw [p0, p1])


private lemma dotp_smul {d : ℕ} (w u : Fin d → ℝ) (a : ℝ) :
    dotp w (fun i => a * u i) = a * dotp w u := by
  simp only [dotp, Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)

private lemma dotp_add {d : ℕ} (w u v : Fin d → ℝ) :
    dotp w (fun i => u i + v i) = dotp w u + dotp w v := by
  simp [dotp, Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_add]

private lemma l_zero {d : ℕ} {l : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ}
    (hhom : ∀ (a : ℝ) (u : Fin d → ℝ), l (fun i => a * u i) = |a| * l u) :
    l 0 = 0 := by
  have := hhom 0 0
  simpa using this

private lemma l_neg {d : ℕ} {l : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ}
    (hhom : ∀ (a : ℝ) (u : Fin d → ℝ), l (fun i => a * u i) = |a| * l u) (u : Fin d → ℝ) :
    l (fun i => -u i) = l u := by
  have := hhom (-1) u
  simpa using this

private lemma l_sum_le {d : ℕ} {l : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ}
    (hhom : ∀ (a : ℝ) (u : Fin d → ℝ), l (fun i => a * u i) = |a| * l u)
    (htri : ∀ u v : Fin d → ℝ, l (fun i => u i + v i) ≤ l u + l v)
    (s : Finset (Fin d)) (f : Fin d → (Fin d → ℝ)) :
    l (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, l (f i) := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp [l_zero hhom]
  | insert a s ha ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha]
      exact le_trans (htri (f a) (∑ i ∈ s, f i)) (by linarith)

private lemma l_single {d : ℕ} {l : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ}
    (hhom : ∀ (a : ℝ) (u : Fin d → ℝ), l (fun i => a * u i) = |a| * l u)
    (i : Fin d) (t : ℝ) :
    l (Pi.single i t) = |t| * l (Pi.single i 1) := by
  classical
  have h : (Pi.single i t : Fin d → ℝ) = fun j => t * ((Pi.single i (1:ℝ) : Fin d → ℝ) j) := by
    funext j
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst hj; simp
    · simp [Pi.single_apply, hj]
  rw [h, hhom]

private lemma l_bound {d : ℕ} {l : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ}
    (hnn : ∀ u : Fin d → ℝ, 0 ≤ l u)
    (hhom : ∀ (a : ℝ) (u : Fin d → ℝ), l (fun i => a * u i) = |a| * l u)
    (htri : ∀ u v : Fin d → ℝ, l (fun i => u i + v i) ≤ l u + l v) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ u : Fin d → ℝ, l u ≤ C * ‖u‖ := by
  classical
  refine ⟨∑ i, l (Pi.single i 1), Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hnn _), ?_⟩
  intro u
  have h1 : (∑ i, Pi.single i (u i)) = u := Finset.univ_sum_single u
  calc l u = l (∑ i, Pi.single i (u i)) := by rw [h1]
    _ ≤ ∑ i, l (Pi.single i (u i)) := l_sum_le hhom htri _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ i, ‖u‖ * l (Pi.single i 1) := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => ?_)
        rw [l_single hhom]
        have h2 : |u i| ≤ ‖u‖ := by
          have := norm_le_pi_norm u i
          simpa using this
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 (hnn _)
    _ = (∑ i, l (Pi.single i 1)) * ‖u‖ := by
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)

private lemma l_sub_le {d : ℕ} {l : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ}
    (hhom : ∀ (a : ℝ) (u : Fin d → ℝ), l (fun i => a * u i) = |a| * l u)
    (htri : ∀ u v : Fin d → ℝ, l (fun i => u i + v i) ≤ l u + l v) (u v : Fin d → ℝ) :
    |l u - l v| ≤ l (u - v) := by
  have h1 : l u ≤ l (u - v) + l v := by
    have := htri (u - v) v
    have h2 : (fun i => (u - v) i + v i) = u := by funext i; simp
    rw [h2] at this
    exact this
  have h2 : l v ≤ l (u - v) + l u := by
    have := htri (v - u) u
    have h3 : (fun i => (v - u) i + u i) = v := by funext i; simp
    rw [h3] at this
    have h4 : l (v - u) = l (u - v) := by
      have := l_neg hhom (u - v)
      have h5 : (fun i => -((u - v) i)) = v - u := by funext i; simp
      rw [h5] at this
      exact this
    rw [h4] at this
    exact this
  rw [abs_sub_le_iff]
  constructor <;> linarith

private lemma l_continuous {d : ℕ} {l : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ}
    (hnn : ∀ u : Fin d → ℝ, 0 ≤ l u)
    (hhom : ∀ (a : ℝ) (u : Fin d → ℝ), l (fun i => a * u i) = |a| * l u)
    (htri : ∀ u v : Fin d → ℝ, l (fun i => u i + v i) ≤ l u + l v) :
    Continuous l := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hCb⟩ := l_bound hnn hhom htri
  have : LipschitzWith (Real.toNNReal C) l := by
    apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
    intro u v
    rw [Real.dist_eq, Real.coe_toNNReal C hC, dist_eq_norm]
    exact le_trans (l_sub_le hhom htri u v) (hCb _)
  exact this.continuous

private lemma dotp_continuous {d : ℕ} (w : Fin d → ℝ) : Continuous (fun z : Fin d → ℝ => dotp w z) := by
  unfold dotp
  exact continuous_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => continuous_const.mul (continuous_apply i))

private lemma sup_attained {d : ℕ} {l : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ} {w : Fin d → ℝ} {lstar : ℝ}
    (hnn : ∀ u : Fin d → ℝ, 0 ≤ l u)
    (hhom : ∀ (a : ℝ) (u : Fin d → ℝ), l (fun i => a * u i) = |a| * l u)
    (htri : ∀ u v : Fin d → ℝ, l (fun i => u i + v i) ≤ l u + l v)
    (hlstar : 0 < lstar)
    (hlub : IsLUB {t : ℝ | ∃ z : Fin d → ℝ, l z ≤ 1 ∧ t = dotp w z} lstar) :
    ∃ z : Fin d → ℝ, l z ≤ 1 ∧ dotp w z = lstar := by
  classical
  have hcont : Continuous l := l_continuous hnn hhom htri
  have hlsmul : ∀ (a : ℝ) (u : Fin d → ℝ), l (a • u) = |a| * l u := fun a u => hhom a u
  have hladd : ∀ (u v : Fin d → ℝ), l (u + v) ≤ l u + l v := fun u v => htri u v
  have hl0 : l (0 : Fin d → ℝ) = 0 := l_zero hhom
  have hub : ∀ z : Fin d → ℝ, l z ≤ 1 → dotp w z ≤ lstar := fun z hz => hlub.1 ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
  -- the kernel functional vanishes on the kernel of l
  have hker : ∀ z : Fin d → ℝ, l z = 0 → dotp w z = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    by_contra hne
    set a : ℝ := (lstar + 1) / dotp w z with ha
    have h1 : l (a • z) ≤ 1 := by rw [hlsmul, hz]; simp
    have h2 : dotp w (a • z) = lstar + 1 := by
      have : dotp w (a • z) = a * dotp w z := dotp_smul w z a
      rw [this, ha]
      field_simp
    have := hub _ h1
    rw [h2] at this
    linarith
  -- the kernel as a submodule
  set K : Submodule ℝ (Fin d → ℝ) :=
    { carrier := {z : Fin d → ℝ | l z = 0}
      zero_mem' := hl0
      add_mem' := by
        intro u v hu hv
        simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at *
        have := hladd u v
        rw [hu, hv] at this
        exact le_antisymm (by linarith) (hnn _)
      smul_mem' := by
        intro a u hu
        simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at *
        rw [hlsmul, hu, mul_zero] } with hK
  have hKmem : ∀ z : Fin d → ℝ, z ∈ K ↔ l z = 0 := fun z => Iff.rfl
  obtain ⟨W, hcompl⟩ := K.exists_isCompl
  -- decomposition
  have hdecomp : ∀ z : Fin d → ℝ, ∃ v : Fin d → ℝ, v ∈ W ∧ l v = l z ∧ dotp w v = dotp w z := by
    intro z
    have hz : z ∈ K ⊔ W := by rw [hcompl.sup_eq_top]; trivial
    obtain ⟨y, hy, v, hv, hyv⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hz
    refine ⟨v, hv, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hy0 : l y = 0 := (hKmem y).mp hy
      have h1 : l z ≤ l v := by
        have := hladd y v
        rw [hyv, hy0] at this
        linarith
      have h2 : l v ≤ l z := by
        have := hladd ((-1 : ℝ) • y) z
        have h3 : ((-1 : ℝ) • y) + z = v := by rw [← hyv]; module
        rw [h3, hlsmul, hy0] at this
        simpa using this
      linarith
    · have hy0 : dotp w y = 0 := hker y ((hKmem y).mp hy)
      have : dotp w z = dotp w y + dotp w v := by rw [← hyv]; exact dotp_add w y v
      rw [this, hy0, zero_add]
  -- W is closed
  have hWclosed : IsClosed (W : Set (Fin d → ℝ)) := W.closed_of_finiteDimensional
  -- coercivity of l on W
  obtain ⟨m, hm0, hmco⟩ : ∃ m : ℝ, 0 < m ∧ ∀ v : Fin d → ℝ, v ∈ W → m * ‖v‖ ≤ l v := by
    by_cases hA : ((W : Set (Fin d → ℝ)) ∩ Metric.sphere 0 1).Nonempty
    · have hAcompact : IsCompact ((W : Set (Fin d → ℝ)) ∩ Metric.sphere 0 1) := by
        apply Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded
        · exact hWclosed.inter Metric.isClosed_sphere
        · exact Metric.isBounded_sphere.subset Set.inter_subset_right
      obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀, hv₀min⟩ := hAcompact.exists_isMinOn hA hcont.continuousOn
      have hv₀W : v₀ ∈ W := hv₀.1
      have hv₀n : ‖v₀‖ = 1 := by
        have := hv₀.2
        simpa [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using this
      have hlv₀ : 0 < l v₀ := by
        rcases (hnn v₀).lt_or_eq with h | h
        · exact h
        · exfalso
          have hK0 : v₀ ∈ K := (hKmem v₀).mpr h.symm
          have hv0 : v₀ = 0 := by
            have hbot := hcompl.inf_eq_bot
            have hmem : v₀ ∈ K ⊓ W := ⟨hK0, hv₀W⟩
            rw [hbot] at hmem
            simpa using hmem
          rw [hv0] at hv₀n
          simp at hv₀n
      refine ⟨l v₀, hlv₀, ?_⟩
      intro v hv
      rcases eq_or_ne v 0 with rfl | hv0
      · simp [hl0]
      · have hnv : 0 < ‖v‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hv0
        have hmemA : (‖v‖⁻¹ • v) ∈ ((W : Set (Fin d → ℝ)) ∩ Metric.sphere 0 1) := by
          refine ⟨W.smul_mem _ hv, ?_⟩
          simp only [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_zero_right, norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm]
          field_simp
        have hmin := isMinOn_iff.mp hv₀min _ hmemA
        rw [hlsmul, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hnv), inv_mul_eq_div] at hmin
        exact (le_div_iff₀ hnv).mp hmin
    · exfalso
      have hW0 : ∀ v : Fin d → ℝ, v ∈ W → v = 0 := by
        intro v hv
        by_contra hv0
        have hnv : 0 < ‖v‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hv0
        refine hA ⟨‖v‖⁻¹ • v, W.smul_mem _ hv, ?_⟩
        simp only [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_zero_right, norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm]
        field_simp
      have hzero : ∀ z : Fin d → ℝ, dotp w z = 0 := by
        intro z
        obtain ⟨v, hvW, _, hdv⟩ := hdecomp z
        rw [← hdv, hW0 v hvW]
        simp [dotp]
      have : lstar ≤ 0 := by
        apply hlub.2
        rintro t ⟨z, _, rfl⟩
        rw [hzero z]
      linarith
  -- the compact slice
  set S : Set (Fin d → ℝ) := {v : Fin d → ℝ | v ∈ W ∧ l v ≤ 1} with hS
  have hScompact : IsCompact S := by
    apply Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded
    · exact hWclosed.inter (isClosed_le hcont continuous_const)
    · apply Bornology.IsBounded.subset (Metric.isBounded_closedBall (x := (0 : Fin d → ℝ)) (r := m⁻¹))
      intro v hv
      simp only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      have := hmco v hv.1
      have h2 : m * ‖v‖ ≤ 1 := le_trans this hv.2
      rw [inv_eq_one_div, le_div_iff₀ hm0]
      linarith [mul_comm m ‖v‖]
  have hSne : S.Nonempty := ⟨0, W.zero_mem, by rw [hl0]; norm_num⟩
  obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀S, hz₀max⟩ := hScompact.exists_isMaxOn hSne (dotp_continuous w).continuousOn
  refine ⟨z₀, hz₀S.2, ?_⟩
  have hle : dotp w z₀ ≤ lstar := hub _ hz₀S.2
  have hge : lstar ≤ dotp w z₀ := by
    apply hlub.2
    rintro t ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨v, hvW, hlv, hdv⟩ := hdecomp z
    rw [← hdv]
    exact hz₀max ⟨hvW, by rw [hlv]; exact hz⟩
  linarith

private lemma abs_dotp_le {d : ℕ} {l : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ} {w : Fin d → ℝ} {lstar : ℝ}
    (hnn : ∀ u : Fin d → ℝ, 0 ≤ l u)
    (hhom : ∀ (a : ℝ) (u : Fin d → ℝ), l (fun i => a * u i) = |a| * l u)
    (hlstar : 0 < lstar)
    (hub : ∀ z : Fin d → ℝ, l z ≤ 1 → dotp w z ≤ lstar) (u : Fin d → ℝ) :
    |dotp w u| ≤ lstar * l u := by
  have hlsmul : ∀ (a : ℝ) (v : Fin d → ℝ), l (a • v) = |a| * l v := fun a v => hhom a v
  have hdsmul : ∀ (a : ℝ) (v : Fin d → ℝ), dotp w (a • v) = a * dotp w v :=
    fun a v => dotp_smul w v a
  have main : ∀ v : Fin d → ℝ, dotp w v ≤ lstar * l v := by
    intro v
    rcases (hnn v).lt_or_eq with hv | hv
    · -- 0 < l v
      have h1 : l ((l v)⁻¹ • v) ≤ 1 := by
        rw [hlsmul, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hv), inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hv)]
      have h2 := hub _ h1
      rw [hdsmul] at h2
      calc dotp w v = (l v) * ((l v)⁻¹ * dotp w v) := by field_simp
        _ ≤ (l v) * lstar := by
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (le_of_lt hv)
        _ = lstar * l v := by ring
    · -- l v = 0
      have hz : dotp w v = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        set a : ℝ := (lstar + 1) / dotp w v with ha
        have h1 : l (a • v) ≤ 1 := by rw [hlsmul, ← hv]; simp
        have h2 := hub _ h1
        rw [hdsmul, ha] at h2
        field_simp at h2
        linarith
      rw [hz, ← hv]
      simp
  refine abs_le.mpr ⟨?_, main u⟩
  have h3 := main ((-1 : ℝ) • u)
  rw [hdsmul, hlsmul] at h3
  simp at h3
  linarith

private lemma seminorm_add_null {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    (p : Seminorm ℝ E) {u : E} (hu : p u = 0) (v : E) : p (u + v) = p v := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · simpa [hu] using map_add_le_add p u v
  · have h := map_add_le_add p (-u) (u + v)
    simpa [hu] using h

private lemma seminorm_max_or_null {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (p : Seminorm ℝ E) (f : E →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) :
    (∃ u, p u = 0 ∧ f u ≠ 0) ∨
    ((∀ u, p u = 0 → f u = 0) ∧
    ∃ z, p z ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ u, p u ≤ 1 → f u ≤ f z) := by
  classical
  by_cases hn : ∃ u, p u = 0 ∧ f u ≠ 0
  · exact Or.inl hn
  right
  have hfnull : ∀ u, p u = 0 → f u = 0 := by
    intro u hu
    by_contra hf
    exact hn ⟨u, hu, hf⟩
  refine ⟨hfnull, ?_⟩
  let K : Submodule ℝ E :=
    { carrier := {u | p u = 0}
      zero_mem' := map_zero p
      add_mem' := by
        intro u v hu hv
        change p u = 0 at hu
        change p v = 0 at hv
        exact le_antisymm (by simpa [hu, hv] using map_add_le_add p u v)
          (apply_nonneg p (u + v))
      smul_mem' := by
        intro a u hu
        change p (a • u) = 0
        rw [map_smul_eq_mul, hu, mul_zero] }
  obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ := K.exists_isCompl
  let q : Seminorm ℝ V := p.comp V.subtype
  let n : AddGroupNorm V :=
    { q.toAddGroupSeminorm with
      eq_zero_of_map_eq_zero' := by
        intro u hu
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact Submodule.disjoint_def.mp hV.disjoint u hu u.property }
  letI : NormedAddCommGroup V := n.toNormedAddCommGroup
  letI : NormedSpace ℝ V :=
    { norm_smul_le := by
        intro a u
        exact (map_smul_eq_mul q a u).le }
  have hnorm (u : V) : ‖u‖ = p u := rfl
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hmax⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall (0 : V) 1).exists_isMaxOn
    (by exact ⟨0, by simp⟩) (f.comp V.subtype).continuous_of_finiteDimensional.continuousOn
  refine ⟨z, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, hnorm] using hz
  · intro u hu
    obtain ⟨k, v, hk, hv, hkv⟩ :=
      Submodule.codisjoint_iff_exists_add_eq.mp hV.codisjoint u
    have hk0 : p k = 0 := hk
    have hpv : p v ≤ 1 := by
      rw [← hkv, seminorm_add_null p hk0] at hu
      exact hu
    have hfv : f u = f v := by
      rw [← hkv, map_add, hfnull k hk0, zero_add]
    rw [hfv]
    exact hmax (by simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, hnorm] using hpv :
      (⟨v, hv⟩ : V) ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : V) 1)

private lemma seminorm_fiber_least {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (p : Seminorm ℝ E) (f : E →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (c : ℝ) (s : EReal) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hS : IsLUB {t : EReal | ∃ z : E, p z ≤ 1 ∧ t = (f z : EReal)} s) :
    IsLeast {t : EReal | ∃ u : E, f u = c ∧ t = (p u : EReal)}
      ((|c| : ℝ) / s) := by
  rcases seminorm_max_or_null p f with ⟨v, hpv, hfv⟩ | ⟨hfnull, z, hpz, hmax⟩
  · have hfree (r : ℝ) : (r : EReal) ≤ s := by
      apply hS.1
      refine ⟨(r / f v) • v, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [map_smul_eq_mul, hpv, mul_zero]
        exact zero_le_one
      · rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hfv]
    have htop : s = ⊤ := by
      cases s using EReal.rec with
      | bot => exact (not_lt_bot hs).elim
      | coe r =>
        have h := hfree (r + 1)
        have h' : r + 1 ≤ r := EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp h
        linarith
      | top => rfl
    rw [htop, EReal.div_top]
    constructor
    · refine ⟨(c / f v) • v, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hfv]
      · rw [map_smul_eq_mul, hpv, mul_zero, EReal.coe_zero]
    · rintro t ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
      exact_mod_cast apply_nonneg p u
  · have hsval : s = (f z : EReal) := by
      apply hS.unique
      apply IsGreatest.isLUB
      refine ⟨⟨z, hpz, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      rintro t ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
      exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr (hmax u hu)
    have hpos : 0 < f z := by
      rw [hsval] at hs
      exact_mod_cast hs
    have hbound (u : E) : |f u| ≤ f z * p u := by
      by_cases hu0 : p u = 0
      · simp [hu0, hfnull u hu0]
      have hu : 0 < p u := lt_of_le_of_ne (apply_nonneg p u) (Ne.symm hu0)
      have hunit : p ((p u)⁻¹ • u) = 1 := by
        rw [map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hu),
          inv_mul_cancel₀ hu0]
      have hhi := hmax ((p u)⁻¹ • u) hunit.le
      have hlo := hmax (-((p u)⁻¹ • u)) (by simpa using hunit.le)
      have habs : |f ((p u)⁻¹ • u)| ≤ f z := by
        apply abs_le.mpr
        constructor
        · simpa using neg_le_neg hlo
        · exact hhi
      rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hu),
        ← div_eq_inv_mul] at habs
      exact (div_le_iff₀ hu).mp habs
    have hpzone : p z = 1 := by
      have hz := hbound z
      rw [abs_of_pos hpos] at hz
      nlinarith
    rw [hsval, ← EReal.coe_div]
    constructor
    · refine ⟨(c / f z) • z, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hpos.ne']
      · rw [map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hpzone, mul_one,
          abs_div, abs_of_pos hpos]
    · rintro t ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
      apply EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr
      apply (div_le_iff₀ hpos).mpr
      rw [← hu, mul_comm]
      exact hbound u

theorem min_manipulation_cost_lower_bound
    {d : ℕ} (l : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ) (w : Fin d → ℝ) (b : ℝ) (x : Fin d → ℝ)
    (lstar : EReal) (hlstar : 0 < lstar)
    (hnn  : ∀ u : Fin d → ℝ, 0 ≤ l u)
    (hhom : ∀ (a : ℝ) (u : Fin d → ℝ), l (fun i => a * u i) = |a| * l u)
    (htri : ∀ u v : Fin d → ℝ, l (fun i => u i + v i) ≤ l u + l v)
    (hlub : IsLUB {t : EReal | ∃ z : Fin d → ℝ, l z ≤ 1 ∧ t = ((dotp w z : ℝ) : EReal)} lstar) :
    IsLeast {t : EReal | ∃ x' : Fin d → ℝ, dotp w x' + b = 0 ∧
        t = ((l (fun i => x' i - x i) : ℝ) : EReal)}
      (((|dotp w x + b| : ℝ) : EReal) / lstar) := by
  let p : Seminorm ℝ (Fin d → ℝ) := Seminorm.ofSMulLE l
    (by
      apply le_antisymm
      · simpa using (hhom 0 (0 : Fin d → ℝ)).le
      · exact hnn 0)
    htri (by
      intro a u
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using (hhom a u).le)
  let f : (Fin d → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ :=
    { toFun := dotp w
      map_add' := by
        intro u v
        simp [dotp, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      map_smul' := by
        intro a u
        simp [dotp, Finset.mul_sum, mul_left_comm] }
  have h := seminorm_fiber_least p f (-(dotp w x + b)) lstar hlstar hlub
  have hset : {t : EReal | ∃ u : Fin d → ℝ, f u = -(dotp w x + b) ∧
      t = (p u : EReal)} =
      {t : EReal | ∃ x' : Fin d → ℝ, dotp w x' + b = 0 ∧
      t = ((l (fun i => x' i - x i) : ℝ) : EReal)} := by
    ext t
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨x + u, ?_, ?_⟩
      · change f (x + u) + b = 0
        rw [map_add, hu]
        change dotp w x + -(dotp w x + b) + b = 0
        ring
      · congr 1
        change l u = l (fun i => (x + u) i - x i)
        congr 1
        ext i
        simp
    · rintro ⟨x', hx', rfl⟩
      refine ⟨x' - x, ?_, rfl⟩
      rw [map_sub]
      change dotp w x' - dotp w x = -(dotp w x + b)
      linarith
  simpa only [abs_neg, hset] using h

end ResearchLevel

Lemma 8 Suppose that Assumption 1 holds. Let $\begin{array}{r}{\eta \le \frac{1}{4 L}}\end{array}$ and $0 \leq \theta \leq 1$ . In each epoch of Algorithm 1 where the "if condition" triggers, when $\begin{array}{r}{\|\nabla f(\mathbf{y}^{\mathcal{K}-1})\|>\frac{B}{\eta}}\end{array}$ , we have

$$
f(\mathbf{x}^{\mathcal{K}})-f(\mathbf{x}^{0})\leq-\frac{B^{2}}{4\eta}.
$$

targets.statement:
Corollary 12 Suppose that Assumption 1 holds. Use the parameter settings in Theorem 1. In each epoch of Algorithm 1 where the "if condition" triggers, we have

$$
f(\mathbf{x}^{\mathcal{K}})-f(\mathbf{x}^{0})\leq-\frac{7\epsilon^{3/2}}{8\sqrt{\rho}}.\tag{20}

targets.label: Lemma 13
targets.statement: Lemma 13 Suppose that Assumption 1 holds. Use the parameter settings in Theorem 1. In the last epoch of Algorithm 1 where the "if condition" does not trigger, we have $\|\nabla f(\hat{\mathbf{y}})\|\leq 82\epsilon$

nl_proof:
### Proof of Lemma 8

Proof As the gradient is L-Lipschitz, we have

$$
\begin{array}{r l}f({\mathbf x}^{k+1})&\le f({\mathbf y}^{k})+\Big\langle\nabla f({\mathbf y}^{k}),{\mathbf x}^{k+1}-{\mathbf y}^{k}\Big\rangle+\frac{L}{2}\|{\mathbf x}^{k+1}-{\mathbf y}^{k}\|^{2}\\ &=f({\mathbf y}^{k})-\eta\|\nabla f({\mathbf y}^{k})\|^{2}+\frac{L\eta^{2}}{2}\|\nabla f({\mathbf y}^{k})\|^{2}\\ &\le f({\mathbf y}^{k})-\frac{7\eta}{8}\|\nabla f({\mathbf y}^{k})\|^{2},\end{array}\tag{11}
$$

where we use the AGD iteration on line 4 of Algorithm 1 and $\begin{array}{r}{\eta \le \frac{1}{4 L}}\end{array}$ . From the L-gradient Lipschitz, we also have

$$
f(\mathbf{x}^{k})\geq f(\mathbf{y}^{k})+\left\langle\nabla f(\mathbf{y}^{k}),\mathbf{x}^{k}-\mathbf{y}^{k}\right\rangle-\frac{L}{2}\|\mathbf{x}^{k}-\mathbf{y}^{k}\|^{2}.
$$

So we have

$$
\begin{array}{r l}&{\quad f({\mathbf x}^{k+1})-f({\mathbf x}^{k})}\\ &{\le-\left\langle\nabla f({\mathbf y}^{k}),{\mathbf x}^{k}-{\mathbf y}^{k}\right\rangle+\frac{L}{2}\|{\mathbf x}^{k}-{\mathbf y}^{k}\|^{2}-\frac{7\eta}{8}\|\nabla f({\mathbf y}^{k})\|^{2}}\\ &{=\frac{1}{\eta}\left\langle{\mathbf x}^{k+1}-{\mathbf y}^{k},{\mathbf x}^{k}-{\mathbf y}^{k}\right\rangle+\frac{L}{2}\|{\mathbf x}^{k}-{\mathbf y}^{k}\|^{2}-\frac{7\eta}{8}\|\nabla f({\mathbf y}^{k})\|^{2}}\\ &{=\frac{1}{2\eta}\left(\|{\mathbf x}^{k+1}-{\mathbf y}^{k}\|^{2}+\|{\mathbf x}^{k}-{\mathbf y}^{k}\|^{2}-\|{\mathbf x}^{k+1}-{\mathbf x}^{k}\|^{2}\right)+\frac{L}{2}\|{\mathbf x}^{k}-{\mathbf y}^{k}\|^{2}-\frac{7\eta}{8}\|\nabla f({\mathbf y}^{k})\|^{2}}\\ &{\stackrel{\mathrm{a~}}{\le}\frac{5}{8\eta}\|{\mathbf x}^{k}-{\mathbf y}^{k}\|^{2}-\frac{1}{2\eta}\|{\mathbf x}^{k+1}-{\mathbf x}^{k}\|^{2}-\frac{3\eta}{8}\|\nabla f({\mathbf y}^{k})\|^{2}}\\ &{\stackrel{b}{\le}\frac{5}{8\eta}\|{\mathbf x}^{k}-{\mathbf x}^{k-1}\|^{2}-\frac{1}{2\eta}\|{\mathbf x}^{k+1}-{\mathbf x}^{k}\|^{2}-\frac{3\eta}{8}\|\nabla f({\mathbf y}^{k})\|^{2},}\end{array}
$$

where we use $\begin{array}{r}{L \leq \frac{1}{4 \eta}}\end{array}$ in $\overset{a}{\leq}$ and $\|{\mathbf{x}}^{k}-{\mathbf{y}}^{k}\|=(1-\theta)\|{\mathbf{x}}^{k}-{\mathbf{x}}^{k-1}\|\leq\|{\mathbf{x}}^{k}-{\mathbf{x}}^{k-1}\|$ in $\overset{b}{\leq}$. Summing over $k=0,\cdots,\mathcal{K}-1$ and using $\mathbf{x}^{0}= \mathbf{x}^{- 1}$ , we have

$$
f(\mathbf{x}^{\mathcal{K}})-f(\mathbf{x}^{0})\leq\frac{1}{8\eta}\sum_{k=0}^{\mathcal{K}-2}\|\mathbf{x}^{k+1}-\mathbf{x}^{k}\|^{2}-\frac{3\eta}{8}\sum_{k=0}^{\mathcal{K}-1}\|\nabla f(\mathbf{y}^{k})\|^{2}
$$

$$
\overset{c}{\leq}\frac{B^{2}}{8\eta}-\frac{3\eta}{8}\|\nabla f(\mathbf{y}^{\mathcal{K}-1})\|^{2}\overset{d}{\leq}\frac{B^{2}}{8\eta}-\frac{3B^{2}}{8\eta}= -\frac{B^{2}}{4\eta},
$$

where we use (8b) in $\overset{c}{\leq}$ and $\|\nabla f(\mathbf{y}^{\mathcal{K}-1})\|>\frac{B}{\eta}$ in $\overset{d}{\leq}$.

### Proof of Corollary 12

Proof Since $g_{j}(x)$ is quadratic, we have

$$
\begin{array}{r l}g_{j}(\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k+1})&=g_{j}(\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k})+\left\langle\nabla g_{j}(\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}),\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k+1}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}\right\rangle+\frac{\lambda_{j}}{2}|\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k+1}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}|^{2}\\ &\overset{a}{=}g_{j}(\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k})-\frac{1}{\eta}\left\langle\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k+1}-\widetilde{\mathbf{y}}_{j}^{k}+\eta\widetilde{\delta}_{j}^{k},\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k+1}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}\right\rangle\\ &\quad+\left\langle\nabla g_{j}(\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k})-\nabla g_{j}(\widetilde{\mathbf{y}}_{j}^{k}),\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k+1}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}\right\rangle+\frac{\lambda_{j}}{2}|\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k+1}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}|^{2}\\ &\quad+\lambda_{j}\left\langle\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\widetilde{\mathbf{y}}_{j}^{k},\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k+1}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}\right\rangle+\frac{\lambda_{j}}{2}|\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k+1}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}|^{2}\\ &=g_{j}(\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k})+\frac{1}{2\eta}\left(|\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\widetilde{\mathbf{y}}_{j}^{k}|^{2}- |\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k+1}-\widetilde{\mathbf{y}}_{j}^{k}|^{2}- |\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k+1}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}|^{2}\right)\\ &\quad-\left\langle\widetilde{\delta}_{j}^{k},\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k+1}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}\right\rangle+\frac{\lambda_{j}}{2}\left(|\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k+1}-\widetilde{\mathbf{y}}_{j}^{k}|^{2}- |\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\widetilde{\mathbf{y}}_{j}^{k}|^{2}\right)\\ &\le g_{j}(\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k})+\frac{1}{2\eta}\left(|\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\widetilde{\mathbf{y}}_{j}^{k}|^{2}- |\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k+1}-\widetilde{\mathbf{y}}_{j}^{k}|^{2}- |\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k+1}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}|^{2}\right)\\ &\quad+\frac{1}{2\alpha}|\widetilde{\delta}_{j}^{k}|^{2}+\frac{\alpha}{2}|\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k+1}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}|^{2}+\frac{\lambda_{j}}{2}\left(|\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k+1}-\widetilde{\mathbf{y}}_{j}^{k}|^{2}- |\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\widetilde{\mathbf{y}}_{j}^{k}|^{2}\right),\end{array}
$$

for some positive constant α to be specified later, where we use (14b) in $\overset{a}{=}$. Using $L \geq \lambda_{j}\geq$ $- \frac{\theta}{\eta}$ when $\begin{array}{r}{j\in{\cal S}_{1}=\left\{j:\lambda_{j}\geq-\frac{\theta}{\eta}\right\}\mathrm{and}\left(-\frac{1}{2\eta}+\frac{\lambda_{j}}{2}\right)|\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k+1}-\widetilde{\mathbf{y}}_{j}^{k}|^{2}\leq\left(-2 L+\frac{L}{2}\right)|\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k+1}-\widetilde{\mathbf{y}}_{j}^{k}|^{2}\leq 0}\end{array}$, we have for each $j \in S_{1}$

$$
\begin{array}{r l r}{{g_{j}(\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k+1})\le g_{j}(\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k})+\frac{1}{2\eta}(|\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\widetilde{\mathbf{y}}_{j}^{k}|^{2}- |\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k+1}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}|^{2})+\frac{1}{2\alpha}|\widetilde{\delta}_{j}^{k}|^{2}+\frac{\alpha}{2}|\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k+1}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}|^{2}+\frac{\theta}{2\eta}|\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\widetilde{\mathbf{y}}_{j}^{k}|^{2}}}\\ &{}&{\overset{b}{=}g_{j}(\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k})+\frac{(1+\theta)(1-\theta)^{2}}{2\eta}|\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k-1}|^{2}-(\frac{1}{2\eta}-\frac{\alpha}{2})|\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k+1}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}|^{2}+\frac{1}{2\alpha}|\widetilde{\delta}_{j}^{k}|^{2},\qquad}\end{array}
$$

where we use (14a) in $\overset{b}{=}$ . Defining the potential function

$$
\ell_{j}^{k+1}=g_{j}(\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k+1})+\frac{(1+\theta)(1-\theta)^{2}}{2\eta}|\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k+1}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}|^{2},

we have

$$
\begin{array}{r l}&{\ell_{j}^{k+1}\leq\ell_{j}^{k}-\left(\displaystyle\frac{1}{2\eta}-\displaystyle\frac{\alpha}{2}-\displaystyle\frac{(1+\theta)(1-\theta)^{2}}{2\eta}\right)|\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k+1}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}|^{2}+\displaystyle\frac{1}{2\alpha}|\widetilde{\delta}_{j}^{k}|^{2}}\\ &{\quad\leq\ell_{j}^{k}-\displaystyle\frac{3\theta}{8\eta}|\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k+1}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}|^{2}+\displaystyle\frac{2\eta}{\theta}|\widetilde{\delta}_{j}^{k}|^{2},}\end{array}

where we let $\begin{array}{r}{\alpha = \frac{\theta}{4 \eta}}\end{array}$ in $\overset{c}{\leq}$ such that $\begin{array}{r}{\frac{1}{2\eta}-\frac{\theta}{8\eta}-\frac{(1+\theta)(1-\theta)^{2}}{2\eta}=\frac{3\theta}{8\eta}+\frac{\theta^{2}}{2\eta}-\frac{\theta^{3}}{2\eta}\geq\frac{3\theta}{8\eta}}\end{array}$ . Summing over $k=0,1,\cdots,\mathcal{K}-1$ and $j \in S_{1}$ , using $\mathbf{x}^{0}- \mathbf{x}^{- 1}= 0$ ,we have

$$
\begin{array}{r}{\displaystyle\sum_{j\in S_{1}}g_{j}(\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{\mathcal{K}})\leq\displaystyle\sum_{j\in S_{1}}\ell_{j}^{\mathcal{K}}\leq\displaystyle\sum_{j\in S_{1}}g_{j}(\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{0})-\displaystyle\sum_{j\in S_{1}}\frac{3\theta}{8\eta}\displaystyle\sum_{k=0}^{\mathcal{K}-1}\vert\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k+1}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}\vert^{2}+\displaystyle\frac{2\eta}{\theta}\displaystyle\sum_{k=0}^{\mathcal{K}-1}\|\widetilde\delta^{k}\|^{2}}\\ {\overset{d}{\leq}\displaystyle\sum_{j\in S_{1}}g_{j}(\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{0})-\displaystyle\sum_{j\in S_{1}}\frac{3\theta}{8\eta}\displaystyle\sum_{k=0}^{\mathcal{K}-1}\vert\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k+1}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}\vert^{2}+\displaystyle\frac{8\eta\rho^{2}B^{4}\mathcal{K}}{\theta},}\end{array}
$$

where we use (15) in $\overset{d}{\leq}$.

Proof Denoting $\begin{array}{r}{\mathbf{v}_{j}=\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{0}-\frac{1}{\lambda_{j}}\widetilde{\nabla}_{j}f(\mathbf{x}^{0}),g_{j}(x)}\end{array}$ can be rewritten as

$$
\begin{array}{l}{{\displaystyle g_{j}(x)=\frac{\lambda_{j}}{2}\left(x-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{0}+\frac{1}{\lambda_{j}}\widetilde{\nabla}_{j}f(\mathbf{x}^{0})\right)^{2}-\frac{1}{2\lambda_{j}}\vert\widetilde{\nabla}_{j}f(\mathbf{x}^{0})\vert^{2}}}\\ {{\displaystyle~=\frac{\lambda_{j}}{2}\vert x-\mathbf{v}_{j}\vert^{2}-\frac{1}{2\lambda_{j}}\vert\widetilde{\nabla}_{j}f(\mathbf{x}^{0})\vert^{2}.}}\end{array}
$$

For each $\begin{array}{r}{j \in \mathcal{S}_{2}= \{j : \lambda_{j}< - \frac{\theta}{\eta}\}}\end{array}$ , we have

$$
\begin{array}{l}{{\displaystyle g_{j}({\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}}_{j}^{k + 1}) - g_{j}({\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}}_{j}^{k}) = \frac{\lambda_{j}}{2}|{\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}}_{j}^{k + 1}- \mathbf{v}_{j}|^{2}- \frac{\lambda_{j}}{2}|{\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}}_{j}^{k}- \mathbf{v}_{j}|^{2}}\ ~}\\ {{\displaystyle ~ = \frac{\lambda_{j}}{2}|{\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}}_{j}^{k + 1}-{\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}}_{j}^{k}|^{2}+ \lambda_{j}\left\langle{\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}}_{j}^{k + 1}-{\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}}_{j}^{k},{\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}}_{j}^{k}- \mathbf{v}_{j}\right\rangle}\ ~}\\ {{\displaystyle ~ \leq - \frac{\theta}{2 \eta}|{\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}}_{j}^{k + 1}-{\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}}_{j}^{k}|^{2}+ \lambda_{j}\left\langle{\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}}_{j}^{k + 1}-{\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}}_{j}^{k},{\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}}_{j}^{k}- \mathbf{v}_{j}\right\rangle}.}\end{array}\tag{18}
$$

So we only need to bound the second term. From (14b) and (14a), we have

$$
\begin{array}{r l}&{\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k+1}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}=\widetilde{\mathbf{y}}_{j}^{k}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\eta\nabla g_{j}(\widetilde{\mathbf{y}}_{j}^{k})-\eta\widetilde{\delta}_{j}^{k}}\\ &{\qquad=(1-\theta)(\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k-1})-\eta\nabla g_{j}(\widetilde{\mathbf{y}}_{j}^{k})-\eta\widetilde{\delta}_{j}^{k}}\\ &{\qquad=(1-\theta)(\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k-1})-\eta\lambda_{j}(\widetilde{\mathbf{y}}_{j}^{k}-\mathbf{v}_{j})-\eta\widetilde{\delta}_{j}^{k}}\\ &{\qquad=(1-\theta)(\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k-1})-\eta\lambda_{j}(\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\mathbf{v}_{j}+(1-\theta)(\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k-1}))-\eta\widetilde{\delta}_{j}^{k}.}\end{array}
$$

So for each $j \in S_{2}$ , we have

$$
\begin{array}{r l}&{\quad\lambda_{j}\Big\langle\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k+1}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k},\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\mathbf{v}_{j}\Big\rangle}\\ &{=(1-\theta)\lambda_{j}\Big\langle\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k-1},\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\mathbf{v}_{j}\Big\rangle-\eta\lambda_{j}^{2}|\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\mathbf{v}_{j}|^{2}-\eta\lambda_{j}^{2}(1-\theta)\Big\langle\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k-1},\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\mathbf{v}_{j}\Big\rangle-\eta\lambda_{j}\Big\langle\widetilde{\delta}_{j}^{k},\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\mathbf{v}_{j}\Big\rangle}\\ &{\leq(1-\theta)\lambda_{j}\Big\langle\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k-1},\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\mathbf{v}_{j}\Big\rangle-\eta\lambda_{j}^{2}|\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\mathbf{v}_{j}|^{2}}\\ &{\quad+\frac{\eta\lambda_{j}^{2}(1-\theta)}{2}\Big(|\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k-1}|^{2}+ &{=(1-\theta)\lambda_{j}\Big\langle\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k-1},\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\mathbf{v}_{j}\Big\rangle+\frac{\eta\lambda_{j}^{2}(1-\theta)}{2}|\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k-1}|^{2}+\frac{\eta}{2(1+\theta)}|\widetilde{\delta}_{j}^{k}|^{2}}\\ &{=(1-\theta)\lambda_{j}\Big\langle\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k-1},\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k-1}-\mathbf{v}_{j}\Big\rangle+(1-\theta)\lambda_{j}|\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k-1}|^{2}+\frac{\eta\lambda_{j}^{2}(1-\theta)}{2}|\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k-1}|^{2}+\frac{\eta}{2(1+\theta)}|\widetilde{\delta}_{j}^{k}|^{2}}\\ &{\overset{a}{\leq}(1-\theta)\lambda_{j}\Big\langle\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k-1},\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k-1}-\mathbf{v}_{j}\Big\rangle+\frac{\eta}{2}|\widetilde{\delta}_{j}^{k}|^{2},}\end{array}
$$

where we use $\begin{array}{r}{\left(1+\frac{\eta\lambda_{j}}{2}\right)(1-\theta)\ge\left(1-\frac{\eta L}{2}\right)(1-\theta)\ge 0}\end{array}$ and $\lambda_{j}< 0$ when $j \in{\cal S}_{2}$ in $\overset{a}{\geq}$ So we have

$$
\begin{array}{r l r}{{\lambda_{j}\left\langle\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k+1}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k},\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{k}-\mathbf{v}_{j}\right\rangle\le(1-\theta)^{k}\lambda_{j}\left\langle\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{1}-\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{0},\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{0}-\mathbf{v}_{j}\right\rangle+\displaystyle\frac{\eta}{2}\sum_{t=1}^{k}(1-\theta)^{k-t}|\widetilde{\delta}_{j}^{t}|^{2}}}\\ &{}&{\overset{b}{=}-(1-\theta)^{k}\eta\lambda_{j}^{2}|\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}_{j}^{0}-\mathbf{v}_{j}|^{2}+\displaystyle\frac{\eta}{2}\sum_{t=1}^{k}(1-\theta)^{k-t}|\widetilde{\delta}_{j}^{t}|^{2}}\\ &{}&{\le\displaystyle\frac{\eta}{2}\sum_{t=1}^{k}(1-\theta)^{k-t}|\widetilde{\delta}_{j}^{t}|^{2},}\end{array}
$$

where we use

$$
\begin{array}{c}{{{\widetilde{\bf x}}_{j}^{1}-{\widetilde{\bf x}}_{j}^{0}={\widetilde{\bf x}}_{j}^{1}-{\widetilde{\bf y}}_{j}^{0}= -\eta\widetilde\nabla_{j}f({\bf y}^{0})= -\eta\widetilde\nabla_{j}f({\bf x}^{0})}}\\ {{{\mathrm{}}}}\\ {{{\mathrm{}}= -\eta\nabla g_{j}(\widetilde{\bf x}_{j}^{0})= -\eta\lambda_{j}(\widetilde{\bf x}_{j}^{0}-{\bf v}_{j})}}\end{array}
