private lemma integral_mul_sq_le_sq_integral_sq {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (μ : Measure X) (f g : X → ℝ)
    (hf2 : Integrable (fun x => (f x) ^ 2) μ)
    (hg2 : Integrable (fun x => (g x) ^ 2) μ)
    (hfg : Integrable (fun x => f x * g x) μ)
    (hgpos : 0 < ∫ x, (g x) ^ 2 ∂μ) :
    (∫ x, f x * g x ∂μ) ^ 2
      ≤ (∫ x, (f x) ^ 2 ∂μ) * (∫ x, (g x) ^ 2 ∂μ) := by
  let A : ℝ := ∫ x, (f x) ^ 2 ∂μ
  let B : ℝ := ∫ x, (g x) ^ 2 ∂μ
  let C : ℝ := ∫ x, f x * g x ∂μ
  have ht1 : Integrable (fun x => B ^ 2 * (f x) ^ 2) μ := hf2.const_mul _
  have ht2 : Integrable (fun x => (2 * B * C) * (f x * g x)) μ := hfg.const_mul _
  have ht3 : Integrable (fun x => C ^ 2 * (g x) ^ 2) μ := hg2.const_mul _
  have hexpand :
      (fun x => (B * f x - C * g x) ^ 2) =
        (fun x => B ^ 2 * (f x) ^ 2 - (2 * B * C) * (f x * g x) +
          C ^ 2 * (g x) ^ 2) := by
    funext x
    ring
  have heval :
      (∫ x, (B * f x - C * g x) ^ 2 ∂μ) = B * (B * A - C ^ 2) := by
    rw [hexpand]
    calc
      (∫ x, B ^ 2 * (f x) ^ 2 - (2 * B * C) * (f x * g x) +
          C ^ 2 * (g x) ^ 2 ∂μ) =
          (∫ x, B ^ 2 * (f x) ^ 2 - (2 * B * C) * (f x * g x) ∂μ) +
            ∫ x, C ^ 2 * (g x) ^ 2 ∂μ := by
              exact integral_add (ht1.sub ht2) ht3
      _ = ((∫ x, B ^ 2 * (f x) ^ 2 ∂μ) -
            ∫ x, (2 * B * C) * (f x * g x) ∂μ) +
            ∫ x, C ^ 2 * (g x) ^ 2 ∂μ := by
              rw [integral_sub ht1 ht2]
      _ = B * (B * A - C ^ 2) := by
            simp only [integral_const_mul]
            ring
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ x, (B * f x - C * g x) ^ 2 ∂μ :=
    integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg _)
  have hfactor : 0 ≤ B * (B * A - C ^ 2) := heval ▸ hnonneg
  have hcore : 0 ≤ B * A - C ^ 2 :=
    nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right hfactor (by simpa [B] using hgpos)
  simpa [A, B, C, mul_comm] using (sub_nonneg.mp hcore)

private lemma condErr_nonneg_of_abs_le_one (a b : ℝ) (ha : |a| ≤ 1) :
    0 ≤ condErr a b := by
  rcases abs_le.mp ha with ⟨haL, haU⟩
  unfold condErr
  split_ifs <;> linarith

private lemma condErr_le_one_of_abs_le_one (a b : ℝ) (ha : |a| ≤ 1) :
    condErr a b ≤ 1 := by
  rcases abs_le.mp ha with ⟨haL, haU⟩
  unfold condErr
  split_ifs <;> linarith

private lemma condErr_self_le_one_sub_sq (a : ℝ) (ha : |a| ≤ 1) :
    condErr a a ≤ 1 - a ^ 2 := by
  rcases abs_le.mp ha with ⟨haL, haU⟩
  unfold condErr
  split_ifs with hp hn
  · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr haU) (by linarith : 0 ≤ a + 1)]
  · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ 1 - a) (by linarith : 0 ≤ a + 1)]
  · have : a = 0 := by linarith
    simp [this]

private lemma measurable_condErr_comp {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    {h S : X → ℝ} (hh : Measurable h) (hS : Measurable S) :
    Measurable (fun x => condErr (h x) (S x)) := by
  unfold condErr
  apply Measurable.ite
  · exact measurableSet_lt measurable_const hS
  · fun_prop
  · apply Measurable.ite
    · exact measurableSet_lt hS measurable_const
    · fun_prop
    · exact measurable_const

private lemma integrable_bounded_one {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {f : X → ℝ}
    (hf : Measurable f) (hb : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ 1) : Integrable f μ := by
  apply Integrable.of_bound hf.aestronglyMeasurable 1
  filter_upwards [] with x
  simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hb x

private lemma integrable_sq_bounded_one {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {f : X → ℝ}
    (hf : Measurable f) (hb : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ 1) :
    Integrable (fun x => (f x) ^ 2) μ := by
  apply Integrable.of_bound (hf.pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable 1
  filter_upwards [] with x
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
  rcases abs_le.mp (hb x) with ⟨hL, hU⟩
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (f x - 1), sq_nonneg (f x + 1)]

private lemma integrable_mul_bounded_one {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {f g : X → ℝ}
    (hf : Measurable f) (hg : Measurable g)
    (hfb : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ 1) (hgb : ∀ x, |g x| ≤ 1) :
    Integrable (fun x => f x * g x) μ := by
  apply Integrable.of_bound (hf.mul hg).aestronglyMeasurable 1
  filter_upwards [] with x
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
  nlinarith [abs_nonneg (f x), abs_nonneg (g x), hfb x, hgb x]

private lemma integrable_condErr_comp {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {h S : X → ℝ}
    (hh : Measurable h) (hS : Measurable S) (hb : ∀ x, |h x| ≤ 1) :
    Integrable (fun x => condErr (h x) (S x)) μ := by
  apply Integrable.of_bound (measurable_condErr_comp hh hS).aestronglyMeasurable 1
  filter_upwards [] with x
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (condErr_nonneg_of_abs_le_one _ _ (hb x))]
  exact condErr_le_one_of_abs_le_one _ _ (hb x)

private lemma abs_integral_le_one {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {f : X → ℝ}
    (hf : Measurable f) (hb : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ 1) :
    |∫ x, f x ∂μ| ≤ 1 := by
  have hfi : Integrable f μ := integrable_bounded_one μ hf hb
  calc
    |∫ x, f x ∂μ| = ‖∫ x, f x ∂μ‖ := rfl
    _ ≤ ∫ x, ‖f x‖ ∂μ := norm_integral_le_integral_norm f
    _ ≤ ∫ _x : X, (1 : ℝ) ∂μ := by
      apply integral_mono hfi.norm (integrable_const 1)
      intro x
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hb x
    _ = 1 := by simp

theorem prop4 {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (h : X → ℝ) (hh_meas : Measurable h) (hh_bdd : ∀ x, |h x| ≤ 1) :
    (∃ S : X → ℝ, Measurable S ∧ (∀ x, |S x| ≤ 1) ∧ 0 < cMu2 μ S ∧
        riskD μ h S ≤ cBound μ h S ∧
        cBound μ h S = labelVarMean μ h) ∧
    (∀ S : X → ℝ, Measurable S → (∀ x, |S x| ≤ 1) → 0 < cMu2 μ S →
        labelVarMean μ h ≤ cBound μ h S) := by
  have hh_int : Integrable h μ := integrable_bounded_one μ hh_meas hh_bdd
  have hh2_int : Integrable (fun x => (h x) ^ 2) μ :=
    integrable_sq_bounded_one μ hh_meas hh_bdd
  have hlabel_int : Integrable (fun x => 1 - (h x) ^ 2) μ :=
    (integrable_const 1).sub hh2_int
  have hlabel : labelVarMean μ h = 1 - cMu2 μ h := by
    rw [labelVarMean, cMu2, integral_sub (integrable_const 1) hh2_int]
    simp
  have hh2_nonneg : 0 ≤ cMu2 μ h := by
    exact integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg _)
  constructor
  · by_cases hpos : 0 < cMu2 μ h
    · refine ⟨h, hh_meas, hh_bdd, hpos, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [riskD]
        exact integral_mono (integrable_condErr_comp μ hh_meas hh_meas hh_bdd)
          hlabel_int (fun x => condErr_self_le_one_sub_sq (h x) (hh_bdd x))
          |>.trans_eq (by
            change labelVarMean μ h = cBound μ h h
            rw [hlabel]
            have hmom : cMu1 μ h h = cMu2 μ h := by
              simp [cMu1, cMu2, pow_two]
            rw [cBound, hmom]
            simp [pow_two, hpos.ne'])
      · rw [hlabel]
        have hmom : cMu1 μ h h = cMu2 μ h := by
          simp [cMu1, cMu2, pow_two]
        rw [cBound, hmom]
        simp [pow_two, hpos.ne']
    · have hz : cMu2 μ h = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hpos) hh2_nonneg
      have hh2_ae : (fun x => (h x) ^ 2) =ᵐ[μ] 0 :=
        (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg (h x)) hh2_int).mp hz
      have hh_ae : h =ᵐ[μ] 0 := by
        filter_upwards [hh2_ae] with x hx
        dsimp at hx ⊢
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (h x)]
      have hh_mean : ∫ x, h x ∂μ = 0 := by
        rw [integral_congr_ae hh_ae]
        simp
      let S : X → ℝ := fun _ => 1
      have hS_meas : Measurable S := measurable_const
      have hS_bdd : ∀ x, |S x| ≤ 1 := by intro x; simp [S]
      have hS2 : cMu2 μ S = 1 := by simp [cMu2, S]
      have hcross : cMu1 μ h S = 0 := by simp [cMu1, S, hh_mean]
      have hcb : cBound μ h S = 1 := by simp [cBound, hcross, hS2]
      refine ⟨S, hS_meas, hS_bdd, by simp [hS2], ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hcb, riskD]
        have hone_int : Integrable (fun _ : X => (1 : ℝ)) μ := integrable_const 1
        have := integral_mono (integrable_condErr_comp μ hh_meas hS_meas hh_bdd)
          hone_int (fun x => condErr_le_one_of_abs_le_one (h x) (S x) (hh_bdd x))
        simpa using this
      · rw [hcb, hlabel, hz]
        norm_num
  · intro S hS_meas hS_bdd hSpos
    have hS2_int : Integrable (fun x => (S x) ^ 2) μ :=
      integrable_sq_bounded_one μ hS_meas hS_bdd
    have hhS_int : Integrable (fun x => h x * S x) μ :=
      integrable_mul_bounded_one μ hh_meas hS_meas hh_bdd hS_bdd
    have hcs := integral_mul_sq_le_sq_integral_sq μ h S hh2_int hS2_int hhS_int hSpos
    have hdiv : (cMu1 μ h S) ^ 2 / cMu2 μ S ≤ cMu2 μ h := by
      apply (div_le_iff₀ hSpos).2
      simpa [cMu1, cMu2] using hcs
    rw [hlabel, cBound]
    linarith

private lemma weighted_tsum_memLp_two {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Countable ι]
    (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (q : ι → ℝ) (hq_nonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ q i) (hq_summable : Summable q)
    (hq_sum : ∑' i, q i = 1)
    (F : ι → Ω → ℝ) (hF_meas : ∀ i, Measurable (F i))
    (hF_bdd : ∀ i ω, |F i ω| ≤ 1) :
    MemLp (fun ω => ∑' i, q i * F i ω) 2 P := by
  have hnorm_sum (ω : Ω) : Summable (fun i => ‖q i * F i ω‖) := by
    apply hq_summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun i => norm_nonneg _)
    intro i
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hq_nonneg i)]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (hq_nonneg i) (hF_bdd i ω)
  have hsum_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => ∑' i, q i * F i ω) P := by
    apply aestronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto_ae (Filter.atTop : Filter (Finset ι))
    · intro s
      exact s.aestronglyMeasurable_fun_sum fun i _ =>
        (hF_meas i).aestronglyMeasurable.const_mul (q i)
    · filter_upwards [] with ω
      exact (hnorm_sum ω).of_norm.hasSum
  apply MemLp.of_bound hsum_meas 1
  filter_upwards [] with ω
  calc
    ‖∑' i, q i * F i ω‖ ≤ ∑' i, ‖q i * F i ω‖ :=
      norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm (hnorm_sum ω)
    _ ≤ ∑' i, q i := by
      apply Summable.tsum_le_tsum
      · intro i
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hq_nonneg i)]
        exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (hq_nonneg i) (hF_bdd i ω)
      · exact hnorm_sum ω
      · exact hq_summable
    _ = 1 := hq_sum

private lemma integral_weighted_tsum {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Countable ι]
    (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (q : ι → ℝ) (hq_nonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ q i) (hq_summable : Summable q)
    (F : ι → Ω → ℝ) (hF_meas : ∀ i, Measurable (F i))
    (hF_bdd : ∀ i ω, |F i ω| ≤ 1) :
    ∫ ω, ∑' i, q i * F i ω ∂P = ∑' i, q i * ∫ ω, F i ω ∂P := by
  have hnorm_sum (ω : Ω) : Summable (fun i => ‖q i * F i ω‖) := by
    apply hq_summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun i => norm_nonneg _)
    intro i
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hq_nonneg i)]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (hq_nonneg i) (hF_bdd i ω)
  have hhas :
      HasSum (fun i => ∫ ω, q i * F i ω ∂P)
        (∫ ω, ∑' i, q i * F i ω ∂P) := by
    apply hasSum_integral_of_dominated_convergence (fun i _ => q i)
    · intro i
      exact (hF_meas i).aestronglyMeasurable.const_mul (q i)
    · intro i
      filter_upwards [] with ω
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hq_nonneg i)]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (hq_nonneg i) (hF_bdd i ω)
    · filter_upwards [] with ω
      exact hq_summable
    · exact integrable_const _
    · filter_upwards [] with ω
      exact (hnorm_sum ω).of_norm.hasSum
  calc
    (∫ ω, ∑' i, q i * F i ω ∂P) = ∑' i, ∫ ω, q i * F i ω ∂P :=
      hhas.tsum_eq.symm
    _ = ∑' i, q i * ∫ ω, F i ω ∂P := by
      apply tsum_congr
      intro i
      exact integral_const_mul (q i) (F i)

private lemma weighted_covariance_summable {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Countable ι]
    (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (q : ι → ℝ) (hq_nonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ q i) (hq_summable : Summable q)
    (F : ι → Ω → ℝ) (hF_meas : ∀ i, Measurable (F i))
    (hF_bdd : ∀ i ω, |F i ω| ≤ 1) :
    Summable (fun p : ι × ι =>
      q p.1 * q p.2 * cov[F p.1, F p.2; P]) := by
  have hpair : Summable (fun p : ι × ι => q p.1 * q p.2) :=
    hq_summable.mul_of_nonneg hq_summable hq_nonneg hq_nonneg
  have hmem (i : ι) : MemLp (F i) 2 P := by
    apply MemLp.of_bound (hF_meas i).aestronglyMeasurable 1
    filter_upwards [] with ω
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hF_bdd i ω
  apply Summable.of_norm_bounded (hpair.mul_left 2)
  intro p
  have hi := abs_integral_le_one P (hF_meas p.1) (hF_bdd p.1)
  have hj := abs_integral_le_one P (hF_meas p.2) (hF_bdd p.2)
  have hij : |∫ ω, F p.1 ω * F p.2 ω ∂P| ≤ 1 := by
    apply abs_integral_le_one P ((hF_meas p.1).mul (hF_meas p.2))
    intro ω
    rw [abs_mul]
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg (F p.1 ω), abs_nonneg (F p.2 ω),
      hF_bdd p.1 ω, hF_bdd p.2 ω]
  have hcov : |cov[F p.1, F p.2; P]| ≤ 2 := by
    rw [covariance_eq_sub (hmem p.1) (hmem p.2)]
    calc
      |(∫ ω, F p.1 ω * F p.2 ω ∂P) -
          (∫ ω, F p.1 ω ∂P) * ∫ ω, F p.2 ω ∂P| ≤
          |∫ ω, F p.1 ω * F p.2 ω ∂P| +
            |(∫ ω, F p.1 ω ∂P) * ∫ ω, F p.2 ω ∂P| := abs_sub _ _
      _ ≤ 1 + 1 := by
        gcongr
        rw [abs_mul]
        nlinarith [abs_nonneg (∫ ω, F p.1 ω ∂P),
          abs_nonneg (∫ ω, F p.2 ω ∂P)]
      _ = 2 := by norm_num
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg
    (mul_nonneg (hq_nonneg p.1) (hq_nonneg p.2))]
  simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcov
      (mul_nonneg (hq_nonneg p.1) (hq_nonneg p.2)))

private lemma variance_weighted_tsum_eq {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Countable ι]
    (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (q : ι → ℝ) (hq_nonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ q i) (hq_summable : Summable q)
    (hq_sum : ∑' i, q i = 1)
    (F : ι → Ω → ℝ) (hF_meas : ∀ i, Measurable (F i))
    (hF_bdd : ∀ i ω, |F i ω| ≤ 1) :
    Var[fun ω => ∑' i, q i * F i ω; P] =
      ∑' i, ∑' j, q i * q j * cov[F i, F j; P] := by
  let S : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => ∑' i, q i * F i ω
  have hmem (i : ι) : MemLp (F i) 2 P := by
    apply MemLp.of_bound (hF_meas i).aestronglyMeasurable 1
    filter_upwards [] with ω
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hF_bdd i ω
  have hSmem : MemLp S 2 P := by
    exact weighted_tsum_memLp_two P q hq_nonneg hq_summable hq_sum F hF_meas hF_bdd
  have hterm_norm (ω : Ω) : Summable (fun i => ‖q i * F i ω‖) := by
    apply hq_summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun i => norm_nonneg _)
    intro i
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hq_nonneg i)]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (hq_nonneg i) (hF_bdd i ω)
  have hpair_nonneg (p : ι × ι) : 0 ≤ q p.1 * q p.2 :=
    mul_nonneg (hq_nonneg p.1) (hq_nonneg p.2)
  have hpair_sum : Summable (fun p : ι × ι => q p.1 * q p.2) :=
    hq_summable.mul_of_nonneg hq_summable hq_nonneg hq_nonneg
  have hprod_meas (p : ι × ι) : Measurable (fun ω => F p.1 ω * F p.2 ω) :=
    (hF_meas p.1).mul (hF_meas p.2)
  have hprod_bdd (p : ι × ι) (ω : Ω) : |F p.1 ω * F p.2 ω| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [abs_mul]
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg (F p.1 ω), abs_nonneg (F p.2 ω),
      hF_bdd p.1 ω, hF_bdd p.2 ω]
  have hsquare (ω : Ω) :
      S ω ^ 2 = ∑' p : ι × ι, q p.1 * q p.2 * (F p.1 ω * F p.2 ω) := by
    have hmul := tsum_mul_tsum_of_summable_norm (hterm_norm ω) (hterm_norm ω)
    rw [pow_two]
    change (∑' i, q i * F i ω) * (∑' i, q i * F i ω) = _
    rw [hmul]
    apply tsum_congr
    intro p
    ring
  have hsecond :
      ∫ ω, S ω ^ 2 ∂P =
        ∑' p : ι × ι, q p.1 * q p.2 *
          ∫ ω, F p.1 ω * F p.2 ω ∂P := by
    calc
      (∫ ω, S ω ^ 2 ∂P) =
          ∫ ω, ∑' p : ι × ι,
            (q p.1 * q p.2) * (F p.1 ω * F p.2 ω) ∂P :=
        integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all P hsquare)
      _ = ∑' p : ι × ι, (q p.1 * q p.2) *
            ∫ ω, F p.1 ω * F p.2 ω ∂P :=
        integral_weighted_tsum P (fun p : ι × ι => q p.1 * q p.2)
          hpair_nonneg hpair_sum (fun p ω => F p.1 ω * F p.2 ω)
          hprod_meas hprod_bdd
  have hmean :
      ∫ ω, S ω ∂P = ∑' i, q i * ∫ ω, F i ω ∂P := by
    exact integral_weighted_tsum P q hq_nonneg hq_summable F hF_meas hF_bdd
  have hmean_norm : Summable (fun i => ‖q i * ∫ ω, F i ω ∂P‖) := by
    apply hq_summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun i => norm_nonneg _)
    intro i
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hq_nonneg i)]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (hq_nonneg i)
      (abs_integral_le_one P (hF_meas i) (hF_bdd i))
  have hmeansq :
      (∫ ω, S ω ∂P) ^ 2 =
        ∑' p : ι × ι, q p.1 * q p.2 *
          ((∫ ω, F p.1 ω ∂P) * ∫ ω, F p.2 ω ∂P) := by
    rw [hmean, pow_two,
      tsum_mul_tsum_of_summable_norm hmean_norm hmean_norm]
    apply tsum_congr
    intro p
    ring
  have hA : Summable (fun p : ι × ι =>
      q p.1 * q p.2 * ∫ ω, F p.1 ω * F p.2 ω ∂P) := by
    apply Summable.of_norm_bounded hpair_sum
    intro p
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hpair_nonneg p)]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (hpair_nonneg p)
      (abs_integral_le_one P (hprod_meas p) (hprod_bdd p))
  have hB : Summable (fun p : ι × ι =>
      q p.1 * q p.2 *
        ((∫ ω, F p.1 ω ∂P) * ∫ ω, F p.2 ω ∂P)) := by
    apply Summable.of_norm_bounded hpair_sum
    intro p
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hpair_nonneg p), abs_mul]
    have hi := abs_integral_le_one P (hF_meas p.1) (hF_bdd p.1)
    have hj := abs_integral_le_one P (hF_meas p.2) (hF_bdd p.2)
    have hp : |∫ ω, F p.1 ω ∂P| * |∫ ω, F p.2 ω ∂P| ≤ 1 := by
      nlinarith [abs_nonneg (∫ ω, F p.1 ω ∂P),
        abs_nonneg (∫ ω, F p.2 ω ∂P)]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (hpair_nonneg p) hp
  have hcov : Summable (fun p : ι × ι =>
      q p.1 * q p.2 * cov[F p.1, F p.2; P]) :=
    weighted_covariance_summable P q hq_nonneg hq_summable F hF_meas hF_bdd
  calc
    Var[S; P] = (∫ ω, S ω ^ 2 ∂P) - (∫ ω, S ω ∂P) ^ 2 := by
      simpa [Pi.pow_apply] using variance_eq_sub hSmem
    _ = (∑' p : ι × ι,
          q p.1 * q p.2 * ∫ ω, F p.1 ω * F p.2 ω ∂P) -
        ∑' p : ι × ι, q p.1 * q p.2 *
          ((∫ ω, F p.1 ω ∂P) * ∫ ω, F p.2 ω ∂P) := by
      rw [hsecond, hmeansq]
    _ = ∑' p : ι × ι, q p.1 * q p.2 * cov[F p.1, F p.2; P] := by
      rw [← hA.tsum_sub hB]
      apply tsum_congr
      intro p
      rw [covariance_eq_sub (hmem p.1) (hmem p.2)]
      simp only [Pi.mul_apply]
      ring
    _ = ∑' i, ∑' j, q i * q j * cov[F i, F j; P] := hcov.tsum_prod

theorem prop3 {Ω X ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace X] [Countable ι]
    (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (Q : ι → ℝ) (hQ_nonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ Q i) (hQ_summable : Summable Q) (hQ_sum : ∑' i, Q i = 1)
    (f : ι → X → ℝ) (hf_bdd : ∀ i x, |f i x| ≤ 1)
    (xx : Ω → X) (yy : Ω → ℝ) (hy : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, yy ω = 1 ∨ yy ω = -1)
    (g : X → ℝ) (hdet : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, yy ω = g (xx ω))
    (hacc : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, 0 < yy ω * f i (xx ω))
    (hmeas_x : Measurable xx) (hmeas_y : Measurable yy)
    (hmeas_f : ∀ i, Measurable (f i)) :
    Var[margin Q f xx yy; P]
      ≤ (∑' i, (Q i) ^ 2)
        + ∑' i, ∑' j : {j // j ≠ i},
            Q i * Q (j : ι) * cov[fun ω => f i (xx ω), fun ω => f (j : ι) (xx ω); P] := by
  let F : ι → Ω → ℝ := fun i ω => f i (xx ω)
  let S : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => ∑' i, Q i * F i ω
  have hF_meas (i : ι) : Measurable (F i) := (hmeas_f i).comp hmeas_x
  have hF_bdd (i : ι) (ω : Ω) : |F i ω| ≤ 1 := hf_bdd i (xx ω)
  have hSmem : MemLp S 2 P :=
    weighted_tsum_memLp_two P Q hQ_nonneg hQ_summable hQ_sum F hF_meas hF_bdd
  have hterm_norm (ω : Ω) : Summable (fun i => ‖Q i * F i ω‖) := by
    apply hQ_summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun i => norm_nonneg _)
    intro i
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hQ_nonneg i)]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (hQ_nonneg i) (hF_bdd i ω)
  have hS_bdd (ω : Ω) : |S ω| ≤ 1 := by
    change |∑' i, Q i * F i ω| ≤ 1
    calc
      |∑' i, Q i * F i ω| = ‖∑' i, Q i * F i ω‖ := rfl
      _ ≤ ∑' i, ‖Q i * F i ω‖ := norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm (hterm_norm ω)
      _ ≤ ∑' i, Q i := by
        apply Summable.tsum_le_tsum
        · intro i
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hQ_nonneg i)]
          exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (hQ_nonneg i) (hF_bdd i ω)
        · exact hterm_norm ω
        · exact hQ_summable
      _ = 1 := hQ_sum
  have hacc_all : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ∀ i, 0 < yy ω * F i ω := by
    apply eventually_countable_forall.mpr
    intro i
    simpa [F] using hacc i
  have hmargin_abs : margin Q f xx yy =ᵐ[P] fun ω => |S ω| := by
    filter_upwards [hy, hacc_all] with ω hyω haω
    change yy ω * (∑' i, Q i * F i ω) = |S ω|
    change yy ω * S ω = |S ω|
    rcases hyω with hy1 | hyn1
    · have hSnonneg : 0 ≤ S ω := by
        apply tsum_nonneg
        intro i
        have hFi : 0 ≤ F i ω := by
          have hi := haω i
          rw [hy1, one_mul] at hi
          exact hi.le
        exact mul_nonneg (hQ_nonneg i) hFi
      rw [hy1, one_mul, abs_of_nonneg hSnonneg]
    · have hSnonpos : S ω ≤ 0 := by
        have hneg : 0 ≤ ∑' i, -(Q i * F i ω) := by
          apply tsum_nonneg
          intro i
          have hFi : F i ω ≤ 0 := by
            have hi := haω i
            rw [hyn1, neg_one_mul] at hi
            linarith
          exact neg_nonneg.mpr (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (hQ_nonneg i) hFi)
        rw [tsum_neg] at hneg
        exact neg_nonneg.mp hneg
      rw [hyn1, neg_one_mul, abs_of_nonpos hSnonpos]
  have hM_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (margin Q f xx yy) P := by
    change AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => yy ω * S ω) P
    exact hmeas_y.aestronglyMeasurable.mul hSmem.1
  have hMmem : MemLp (margin Q f xx yy) 2 P := by
    apply MemLp.of_bound hM_meas 1
    filter_upwards [hmargin_abs] with ω hm
    rw [hm, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_abs]
    exact hS_bdd ω
  have hsq_int :
      ∫ ω, (margin Q f xx yy ω) ^ 2 ∂P = ∫ ω, (S ω) ^ 2 ∂P := by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [hmargin_abs] with ω hm
    rw [hm]
    exact sq_abs (S ω)
  have hmean_eq :
      ∫ ω, margin Q f xx yy ω ∂P = ∫ ω, |S ω| ∂P :=
    integral_congr_ae hmargin_abs
  have hmean_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ ω, margin Q f xx yy ω ∂P := by
    rw [hmean_eq]
    exact integral_nonneg (fun ω => abs_nonneg (S ω))
  have habs_mean : |∫ ω, S ω ∂P| ≤ ∫ ω, margin Q f xx yy ω ∂P := by
    rw [hmean_eq]
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_integral_le_integral_norm S
  have hmean_sq :
      (∫ ω, S ω ∂P) ^ 2 ≤ (∫ ω, margin Q f xx yy ω ∂P) ^ 2 := by
    have hmul := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr habs_mean)
      (add_nonneg hmean_nonneg (abs_nonneg (∫ ω, S ω ∂P)))
    nlinarith [sq_abs (∫ ω, S ω ∂P)]
  have hvar_margin_score : Var[margin Q f xx yy; P] ≤ Var[S; P] := by
    rw [variance_eq_sub hMmem, variance_eq_sub hSmem]
    simp only [Pi.pow_apply]
    rw [hsq_int]
    linarith
  have hvarS : Var[S; P] =
      ∑' i, ∑' j, Q i * Q j * cov[F i, F j; P] := by
    exact variance_weighted_tsum_eq P Q hQ_nonneg hQ_summable hQ_sum
      F hF_meas hF_bdd
  have hFmem (i : ι) : MemLp (F i) 2 P := by
    apply MemLp.of_bound (hF_meas i).aestronglyMeasurable 1
    filter_upwards [] with ω
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hF_bdd i ω
  have hvarF_le_one (i : ι) : Var[F i; P] ≤ 1 := by
    calc
      Var[F i; P] ≤ ∫ ω, (F i ω) ^ 2 ∂P := by
        simpa [Pi.pow_apply] using
          variance_le_expectation_sq (hF_meas i).aestronglyMeasurable
      _ ≤ ∫ _ω : Ω, (1 : ℝ) ∂P := by
        apply integral_mono
          (integrable_sq_bounded_one P (hF_meas i) (hF_bdd i))
          (integrable_const 1)
        intro ω
        rcases abs_le.mp (hF_bdd i ω) with ⟨hlo, hhi⟩
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (F i ω - 1), sq_nonneg (F i ω + 1)]
      _ = 1 := by simp
  have hdiag_le (i : ι) :
      Q i * Q i * cov[F i, F i; P] ≤ (Q i) ^ 2 := by
    rw [covariance_self (hF_meas i).aemeasurable]
    simpa [pow_two] using
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hvarF_le_one i) (sq_nonneg (Q i)))
  have hcov_pair : Summable (fun p : ι × ι =>
      Q p.1 * Q p.2 * cov[F p.1, F p.2; P]) :=
    weighted_covariance_summable P Q hQ_nonneg hQ_summable F hF_meas hF_bdd
  have hpairQ : Summable (fun p : ι × ι => Q p.1 * Q p.2) :=
    hQ_summable.mul_of_nonneg hQ_summable hQ_nonneg hQ_nonneg
  have hdiag_inj : Function.Injective (fun i : ι => (i, i)) := by
    intro i j hij
    exact congrArg Prod.fst hij
  have hdiag_cov : Summable (fun i => Q i * Q i * cov[F i, F i; P]) := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using hcov_pair.comp_injective hdiag_inj
  have hdiag_Q : Summable (fun i => (Q i) ^ 2) := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def, pow_two] using hpairQ.comp_injective hdiag_inj
  let e : ((i : ι) × {j // j ≠ i}) → ι × ι :=
    fun p => (p.1, (p.2 : ι))
  have he_inj : Function.Injective e := by
    rintro ⟨i, j⟩ ⟨i', j'⟩ hp
    have hi : i = i' := congrArg Prod.fst hp
    subst i'
    have hj : (j : ι) = (j' : ι) := congrArg Prod.snd hp
    have : j = j' := Subtype.ext hj
    subst j'
    rfl
  have hoff_flat : Summable (fun p : ((i : ι) × {j // j ≠ i}) =>
      Q p.1 * Q (p.2 : ι) * cov[F p.1, F (p.2 : ι); P]) := by
    simpa [e, Function.comp_def] using hcov_pair.comp_injective he_inj
  have hoff : Summable (fun i => ∑' j : {j // j ≠ i},
      Q i * Q (j : ι) * cov[F i, F (j : ι); P]) := hoff_flat.sigma
  have hinner (i : ι) : Summable (fun j =>
      Q i * Q j * cov[F i, F j; P]) := by
    have hinj : Function.Injective (fun j : ι => (i, j)) := by
      intro j k hjk
      exact congrArg Prod.snd hjk
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using hcov_pair.comp_injective hinj
  have hsplit (i : ι) :
      (∑' j, Q i * Q j * cov[F i, F j; P]) =
        Q i * Q i * cov[F i, F i; P] +
          ∑' j : {j // j ≠ i},
            Q i * Q (j : ι) * cov[F i, F (j : ι); P] := by
    have hs := (hinner i).sum_add_tsum_subtype_compl ({i} : Finset ι)
    let ee : {x : ι // x ∉ ({i} : Finset ι)} ≃ {x : ι // x ≠ i} :=
      { toFun := fun x => ⟨x, by simpa using x.property⟩
        invFun := fun x => ⟨x, by simpa using x.property⟩
        left_inv := fun x => Subtype.ext rfl
        right_inv := fun x => Subtype.ext rfl }
    have hcomp :
        (∑' x : {x : ι // x ∉ ({i} : Finset ι)},
          Q i * Q (x : ι) * cov[F i, F (x : ι); P]) =
        ∑' x : {x : ι // x ≠ i},
          Q i * Q (x : ι) * cov[F i, F (x : ι); P] := by
      simpa [ee] using
        (Equiv.tsum_eq ee (fun x : {x : ι // x ≠ i} =>
          Q i * Q (x : ι) * cov[F i, F (x : ι); P]))
    rw [← hcomp]
    simpa using hs.symm
  have hvar_split : Var[S; P] =
      ∑' i, (Q i * Q i * cov[F i, F i; P] +
        ∑' j : {j // j ≠ i},
          Q i * Q (j : ι) * cov[F i, F (j : ι); P]) := by
    rw [hvarS]
    apply tsum_congr
    intro i
    exact hsplit i
  have hscore_rhs : Var[S; P] ≤
      (∑' i, (Q i) ^ 2) +
        ∑' i, ∑' j : {j // j ≠ i},
          Q i * Q (j : ι) * cov[F i, F (j : ι); P] := by
    rw [hvar_split, ← hdiag_Q.tsum_add hoff]
    apply Summable.tsum_le_tsum
    · intro i
      exact add_le_add (hdiag_le i) le_rfl
    · exact hdiag_cov.add hoff
    · exact hdiag_Q.add hoff
  exact hvar_margin_score.trans (by simpa [F, S] using hscore_rhs)

private lemma integral_aggVote_eq_three_fifths {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (P : Measure Ω) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (V : Fin n → Ω → ℝ)
    (hVint : ∀ i, Integrable (V i) P)
    (hV1 : ∀ i, ∫ ω, V i ω ∂P = 3 / 5) :
    ∫ ω, aggVote n V ω ∂P = 3 / 5 := by
  change (∫ ω, (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, V i ω ∂P) = 3 / 5
  rw [integral_const_mul,
    integral_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hVint i)]
  simp_rw [hV1]
  rw [Finset.sum_const]
  simp [nsmul_eq_mul, hn.ne']

private lemma integral_sq_aggVote {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (P : Measure Ω) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (V : Fin n → Ω → ℝ)
    (hVcrossint : ∀ i j, Integrable (fun ω => V i ω * V j ω) P)
    (hV2 : ∀ i, ∫ ω, (V i ω) ^ 2 ∂P = 1)
    (hVuncorr : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → ∫ ω, V i ω * V j ω ∂P = 9 / 25) :
    ∫ ω, (aggVote n V ω) ^ 2 ∂P =
      (16 + 9 * (n : ℝ)) / (25 * (n : ℝ)) := by
  have hsquare (ω : Ω) :
      (∑ i, V i ω) ^ 2 = ∑ i, ∑ j, V i ω * V j ω := by
    rw [pow_two, Finset.sum_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  have hinter (i : Fin n) :
      ∫ ω, ∑ j, V i ω * V j ω ∂P = ∑ j, ∫ ω, V i ω * V j ω ∂P := by
    exact integral_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun j _ => hVcrossint i j)
  have hinner (i : Fin n) :
      ∑ j, ∫ ω, V i ω * V j ω ∂P =
        1 + ((n : ℝ) - 1) * (9 / 25) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_add_sum_diff_singleton (Finset.mem_univ i)]
    have hdiag : ∫ ω, V i ω * V i ω ∂P = 1 := by
      simpa [pow_two] using hV2 i
    rw [hdiag]
    have hoff :
        ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ \ {i}, ∫ ω, V i ω * V x ω ∂P =
          ∑ _x ∈ Finset.univ \ {i}, (9 / 25 : ℝ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      apply hVuncorr
      have hji : j ≠ i := by simpa using (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hj).2
      exact hji.symm
    have hcard : (Finset.univ \ {i} : Finset (Fin n)).card = n - 1 := by
      rw [Finset.sdiff_singleton_eq_erase,
        Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ i), Finset.card_univ,
        Fintype.card_fin]
    rw [hoff, Finset.sum_const, hcard]
    simp [nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_sub (show 1 ≤ n from hn)]
  change (∫ ω, ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, V i ω) ^ 2 ∂P) =
    (16 + 9 * (n : ℝ)) / (25 * (n : ℝ))
  simp only [mul_pow]
  rw [integral_const_mul]
  have hsum_int (i : Fin n) : Integrable (fun ω => ∑ j, V i ω * V j ω) P :=
    integrable_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => hVcrossint i j)
  calc
    ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ 2) * ∫ ω, (∑ i, V i ω) ^ 2 ∂P =
        ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ 2) * ∫ ω, ∑ i, ∑ j, V i ω * V j ω ∂P := by
          congr 1
          exact integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all P hsquare)
    _ = ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ 2) * ∑ i, ∫ ω, ∑ j, V i ω * V j ω ∂P := by
          rw [integral_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hsum_int i)]
    _ = ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ 2) * ∑ _i : Fin n,
          (1 + ((n : ℝ) - 1) * (9 / 25)) := by
          congr 1
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i hi
          rw [hinter, hinner]
    _ = (16 + 9 * (n : ℝ)) / (25 * (n : ℝ)) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const]
          simp [nsmul_eq_mul]
          field_simp
          ring

theorem cbound_counterexample {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (V : Fin n → Ω → ℝ) (Y : Ω → ℝ)
    (hVint : ∀ i, Integrable (V i) P)
    (hVcrossint : ∀ i j, Integrable (fun ω => V i ω * V j ω) P)
    (hYint : Integrable Y P)
    (hYSint : Integrable (fun ω => Y ω * aggVote n V ω) P)
    (hV1 : ∀ i, ∫ ω, V i ω ∂P = 3 / 5)
    (hV2 : ∀ i, ∫ ω, (V i ω) ^ 2 ∂P = 1)
    (hVuncorr : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → ∫ ω, V i ω * V j ω ∂P = 9 / 25)
    (hY1 : ∫ ω, Y ω ∂P = 3 / 5)
    (hYsq : ∀ ω, (Y ω) ^ 2 = 1)
    (hYindep : ∫ ω, Y ω * aggVote n V ω ∂P
        = (∫ ω, Y ω ∂P) * (∫ ω, aggVote n V ω ∂P))
    (X : Type*) [MeasurableSpace X] (xx : Ω → X) (v : Fin n → X → ℝ)
    (hVroute : ∀ i ω, V i ω = v i (xx ω))
    (hv_pm : ∀ i x, v i x = 1 ∨ v i x = -1)
    (hv_meas : ∀ i, Measurable (v i))
    (hVindep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun V P)
    (hYXindep : ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun Y xx P) :
    cBound P Y (aggVote n V) = (400 + 144 * (n : ℝ)) / (400 + 225 * (n : ℝ))
      ∧ (16 : ℝ) / 25 < cBound P Y (aggVote n V) := by
  have hnR : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hmean : ∫ ω, aggVote n V ω ∂P = 3 / 5 :=

  have hmu2 : cMu2 P (aggVote n V) =
      (16 + 9 * (n : ℝ)) / (25 * (n : ℝ)) := by
    exact integral_sq_aggVote P n hn V hVcrossint hV2 hVuncorr
  have hformula :
      cBound P Y (aggVote n V) =
        (400 + 144 * (n : ℝ)) / (400 + 225 * (n : ℝ)) := by
    rw [cBound, hmu1, hmu2]
    have h16 : 16 + 9 * (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have h400 : 400 + 225 * (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity

  refine ⟨hformula, ?_⟩
  rw [hformula]

targets.label: Lemma 6 (Lipschitz property of EU)
targets.statement: Lemma 6 (Lipschitz property of EU) $E_{\beta}$ is Lipschitz continuous with respect to the supremum norm over ${\mathcal{D}}_{M}$ with $L_{M}= |\exp(\beta M)-1|$ , Moreover, $L_{M}$ is tight with respect to both $\beta$ and M, i.e., for every $\beta \neq 0$ and every $M > 0$ there exist $F,G\in{\mathcal{D}}_{M}$ with $\| F - G \|_{\infty}> 0$ and $|E_{\beta}(F)-E_{\beta}(G)| =L_{M}\|F-G\|_{\infty}$.

targets.label: Lemma 12
targets.statement:
Lemma 12 (Bound on the optimistic constant) For any distributions $\{F_{i}\}_{i\in [n]}\subseteq\mathcal{D}(a,b)$ and any $\theta,\theta^{\prime}\in\Delta_{n}$ it holds that if $c \geq \| \theta - \theta^{\prime}\|_{1}$ , then

$$
\sum_{i=1}^{n}\theta_{i}F_{i}\preceq\mathrm{O}_{c}^{\infty}\left(\sum_{i=1}^{n}\theta_{i}^{\prime}F_{i}\right).
$$

targets.label: Lemma 8 (Optimality of the distributional optimism operator)
targets.statement:
Lemma 8 Let ρ be a functional (not necessarily a risk measure) satisfying (M). For any $G\in{\mathcal{D}}(a,b)$ , it holds that if $G\in B_{\infty}(F,c)$ , then $G \preceq \mathrm{O}_{c}^{\infty}F$ . Moreover, it holds that

$$
\mathrm{O}_{c}^{\infty}F\in\arg\operatorname*{max}_{G\in B_{\infty}(F,c)\cap\mathcal{D}(a,b)}\rho(G).
$$

nl_proof:
### Proof of Lemma 6 (Lipschitz property of EU)

Proof We first provide the proof for the case $\beta > 0$ . For any $F,G\in{\mathcal{D}}_{M}$ , without loss of generality we assume $\begin{array}{r}{\int_{0}^{M}G(x)d\exp(\beta x)-\int_{0}^{M}F(x)d\exp(\beta x)\geq 0}\end{array}$ ,otherwise we switch the order.

$$
\begin{array}{l}{\displaystyle|E_{\beta}(F)-E_{\beta}(G)| = |\int_{0}^{M}\exp(\beta x)dF(x)-\int_{0}^{M}\exp(\beta x)dG(x)|}\\ {\displaystyle= |\exp(\beta x)F(x)|_{0}^{M}-\int_{0}^{M}F(x)d\exp(\beta x)-\exp(\beta x)G(x)\big|_{0}^{M}+\int_{0}^{M}G(x)d\exp(\beta x)|}\\ {\displaystyle=\int_{0}^{M}(G(x)-F(x))d\exp(\beta x)\le\int_{0}^{M}|G(x)-F(x)|d\exp(\beta x)}\\ {\displaystyle\le\|F-G\|_{\infty}\int_{0}^{M}1d\exp(\beta x)=(\exp(\beta M)-1)\|F-G\|_{\infty}.}\end{array}
$$

For the case $\beta < 0$ , we assume $\begin{array}{r}{\int_{0}^{M}G(x)d\exp(\beta x)-\int_{0}^{M}F(x)d\exp(\beta x)\geq 0.}\end{array}$

$$
\begin{array}{l l}{\displaystyle|E_{\beta}(F)-E_{\beta}(G)| =\int_{0}^{M}(G(x)-F(x))d\exp(\beta x)=\int_{0}^{M}(G(x)-F(x))\beta\exp(\beta x)dx}\\ {\displaystyle\le\int_{0}^{M}|G(x)-F(x)| |\beta|\exp(\beta x)dx}\\ {\displaystyle\le\|F-G\|_{\infty}\int_{0}^{M}-1d\exp(\beta x)=\left(1-\exp(\beta M)\right)\|F-G\|_{\infty}}\\ {\displaystyle= |\exp(\beta M)-1|\left\|F-G\right\|_{\infty}.}\end{array}
$$

Thus $L_{M}= |\exp(\beta M)-1|$ for EU. To show the tightness of the constant, consider two scaled Bernoulli distributions $F=(1-\mu_{1})\psi_{0}+\mu_{1}\psi_{M}$ and $G=(1-\mu_{2})\psi_{0}+\mu_{2}\psi_{M}$ , where $\mu_{1},\mu_{2}\in(0,1)$ are some constants. It holds that

$$
\begin{array}{c}{{\left|E_{\beta}(F)-E_{\beta}(G)\right| =\left|\mu_{1}\exp(\beta M)+1-\mu_{1}-(\mu_{2}\exp(\beta M)+1-\mu_{2})\right|}}\\ {{{}}}\\ {{=\left|\mu_{1}-\mu_{2}\right|\left|\exp(\beta M)-1\right| =\left\|F-G\right\|_{\infty}L_{M},}}\end{array}
$$

where the last equality holds since $\|F-G\|_{\infty}= |F(0)-G(0)| = |\mu_{1}-\mu_{2}|$ (independent of M ). More formally, we have

$$
\operatorname*{inf}_{M>0,\beta>0}\operatorname*{sup}_{F,G\in\mathcal{D}_{M}}\frac{|E_{\beta}(F)-E_{\beta}(G)|}{\|F-G\|_{\infty}}= |\exp(\beta M)-1| =L_{M}.
$$

### Proof of Lemma 12

Proof Without loss of generality assume $F \in \mathcal{D}_{M}^{n}$ . By Lemma 11, for any x

$$
\left|\sum_{i=1}^{n}(\theta_{i}^{\prime}-\theta_{i})F_{i}(x)\right|\leq\left\|\theta^{\prime}-\theta\right\|_{1}.
$$

For any $x\in [0,M+1)$

$$
\begin{array}{r l r}{{\mathrm{O}_{c}^{\infty}(\sum_{i=1}^{n}\theta_{i}^{\prime}F_{i})(x)=[\sum_{i=1}^{n}\theta_{i}^{\prime}F_{i}(x)-c]^{+}=[\sum_{i=1}^{n}\theta_{i}F_{i}(x)+\sum_{i=1}^{n}(\theta_{i}^{\prime}-\theta_{i})F_{i}(x)-c]^{+}}}\\ &{}&{\leq [\sum_{i=1}^{n}\theta_{i}F_{i}(x)+\|\theta^{\prime}-\theta\|_{1}-c]^{+}\leq [\sum_{i=1}^{n}\theta_{i}F_{i}(x)]^{+}=\sum_{i=1}^{n}\theta_{i}F_{i}(x).}\end{array}
$$

### Proof of Lemma 8 (Optimality of the distributional optimism operator)

Proof Consider any $G\in\mathcal{D}([a,b])\cap B_{\infty}(F,c)$ . By the definition of $B_{\infty}(F,c)$ , we have $\begin{array}{r}{\operatorname*{sup}_{x\in [a,b]}|F(x)-G(x)|\leq c}\end{array}$ Therefore, for any $x\in [a,b]$ , we have $G(x)\geq\operatorname*{max}(F(x)-c,0)=$ $(\mathrm{O}_{c}^{\infty}F)(x)$ . Since ${\mathrm{O}}_{c}^{\infty}F$ dominates any G in $\mathcal{D}([a,b])\cap B_{\infty}(F,c)$ and considering (M) of $\rho,$ we arrive at the conclusion.

context.name: Notations (Section 2.1)
context.statement: We write $[M:N]\triangleq\{M,M+1,\ldots,N\}$ and $[ N ] \triangleq [ 1 : N ]$ for any positive integers $M \leq N .$ We adopt the convention that $\textstyle \sum_{i = n}^{m}a_{i}\triangleq 0{\mathrm{~ i f ~}}n > m$ and $\textstyle \prod_{i = n}^{m}a_{i}\triangleq 1{\mathrm{~ i f ~}}n > m$ .We use $\mathbb{I}\{\cdot \}$ to denote the indicator function. For any $x \in \mathbb{R}$ , we define $[x]^{+}\triangleq\operatorname*{max}\{x,0\}$ . We denote by $\delta_{c}$ the Dirac measure at $c .$ Similarly, $\psi_{c}$ represents the unit step function at $c,$ corresponding to the CDF of $\delta_{c}$ . We denote by $\Delta(\mathcal{S}),\mathcal{D}(a,b),\mathcal{D}_{M}$ and $\mathcal{D}$ the set of distributions supported on a set $\mathcal{S},[a,b],[0,M]$ and the set of all distributions respectively. We use $(x_{1},x_{2};p)$ to denote a binary r.v. taking values $x_{1}$ and $x_{2}$ with probability $1 - p$ and $p .$ For a discrete set $x=\{x_{1},\cdots,x_{n}\}$ and a probability vector $p=(p_{1},\cdot\cdot\cdot,p_{n})$ , the notation $(x,p)$ represents the discrete distribution with $\mathbb{P}(X=x_{i})=p_{i}$ . For a discrete distribution $\eta=\left(x,p\right)$ , we use $| \eta | = | x |$ to denote the number of atoms of the distribution $\eta$ . We use $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\cdot)$ to denote $\mathcal{O}(\cdot)$ omitting logarithmic factors. A table of notation is provided in Appendix A.

context.name: Stochastic dominance and risk-measure properties (M), (TI), (DI) (Section 2.3)
context.statement:
Consider two random variables $X \sim F$ and $Y \sim G$ . We assert that Y dominates $X,$ and correspondingly, G dominates $F,$ denoted as $Y \succeq X$ and $G \succeq F$ , if and only if for every real number x, the inequality $F(x)\geq G(x)$ holds true. A risk measure, $\rho,$ is a function mapping a set of random variables, denoted as $\mathcal{X}$ , to the real numbers. This mapping adheres to several crucial properties:

• Monotonicity (M): $X\preceq Y\Rightarrow\rho(X)\leq\rho(Y),\forall X,Y\in{\mathcal{X}}$

Translation-invariance $(\mathbf{TI})\colon\rho(X+c)=\rho(X)+c,\forall X\in{\mathcal{X}},\forall c\in\mathbb{R},$

Distribution-invariance (DI): $F_{X_{1}}=F_{X_{2}}\Rightarrow\rho(X_{1})=\rho(X_{2})$

A mapping $\rho : \mathcal{X}\to \mathbb{R}$ qualifies as a risk measure if it satisfies both (M) and (TI). Additionally, a risk measure that also adheres to (DI) is termed a distribution-invariant risk measure. Distribution-invariant risk measure allows us to simplify notation by denoting $\rho(F_{X})$ as $\rho(X)$

context.name: Entropic risk measure EntRM (Section 2.3)
context.statement:
We direct our attention to a specific distribution-invariant risk measure, EntRM, a prominent risk measure in domains requiring risk-sensitive decision-making, such as mathematical finance (Föllmer and Schied, 2016), Markovian decision processes (Bäuerle and Rieder, 2014). For a random variable $X \sim F$ and a non-zero coefficient $\beta,$ the EntRM is defined as:

$$
U_{\beta}(X)\triangleq{\frac{1}{\beta}}\log\left(\mathbb{E}_{X\sim F}\left[e^{\beta X}\right]\right)={\frac{1}{\beta}}\log\left(\int_{\mathbb{R}}e^{\beta x}dF(x)\right).
$$

context.name: Supremum distance, l1 distance, norm balls B_infty(F,c) and B_1(P,c)
context.statement: We begin by establishing additional notations. For two Cumulative Distribution Functions (CDFs) F and G, the supremum distance between them is defined as $\| F - G \|_{\infty}\triangleq$ $\begin{array}{r}{\operatorname*{sup}_{x}|F(x)-G(x)|}\end{array}$ We define the $\ell_{1}$ distance between two Probability Mass Functions $(\mathrm{PMFs})$ with the same support P and $Q$ as $\begin{array}{r}{\| P - Q \|_{1}\triangleq \sum_{i}| P_{i}- Q_{i}|}\end{array}$ . Furthermore, the set $B_{\infty}(F,c): =\{G\in\mathcal{D}|\|G-F\|_{\infty}\leq c\}$ denotes the supremum norm ball of CDFs centered at F with radius c. Analogously, $B_{1}(P,c)$ represents the $\ell_{1}$ norm ball of PMFs centered at P with radius c.

context.name: Exponential utility E_beta (Section 4.1)
context.statement:
Our analysis explores the relationship between EntRM and Exponential Utility (EU). The EU is defined as follows:

$$
E_{\beta}(F)\triangleq e^{\beta U_{\beta}(F)}=\int_{\mathbb{R}}e^{\beta x}dF(x),
$$

where it serves as an exponential transformation of the EntRM. Notably, this transformation preserves the order in the sense that for any non-zero $\beta,\forall\beta\neq 0$

$$
U_{\beta}(F)\geq U_{\beta}(G)\Longleftrightarrow\mathrm{sign}(\beta)E_{\beta}(F)\geq\mathrm{sign}(\beta)E_{\beta}(G).
$$

context.name: Lipschitz constant L_M of E_beta over D_M
context.statement:
We further present two important properties of EU, instrumental in formulating the regret upper bounds: Lipschitz continuity and linearity. Denote by $L_{M}$ the Lipschitz constant of $E_{\beta}: \mathcal{D}_{M}\to \mathbb{R}$ with respect to the infinity norm $\left\| \cdot \right\|_{\infty}$ , which satisfies:

$$
E_{\beta}(F)-E_{\beta}(G)\leq L_{M}\|F-G\|_{\infty},\forall F,G\in\mathcal{D}_{M}.
$$

context.name: Definition 7 and the distributional optimism operator O_c^infty (Section 4.2)
context.statement:
Definition 7 Given two CDFs F and G, we say that F is more optimistic than G if $F \geq G$

This definition aligns with the intuitive notion that a more optimistic distribution should possess a larger EntRM value. Given that the exponential transformation preserves order, F is more optimistic than G if and only if $E_{\beta}(F)\ge E_{\beta}(G)$ . Following the methodology of Keramati et al. (2020), we introduce the distributional optimism operator $\mathrm{O}_{c}^{\infty}:\mathcal{D}(a,b)\mapsto$ $\mathcal{D}(a,b)$ for a level $c\in(0,1)$ as

$$
(\mathrm{O}_{c}^{\infty}F)(x)\triangleq [F(x)-c\mathbb{I}_{[a,b)}(x)]^{+}.
$$

This operator shifts the distribution F down by a maximum of c over $[a,b)$ , ensuring that the resulting function ${\mathrm{O}}_{c}^{\infty}F$ remains a valid CDF in $\mathcal{D}(a,b)$ and optimistically dominates all other CDFs within the confidence ball $B_{\infty}(F,c)^{3}$ . In particular, ${\mathrm{O}}_{c}^{\infty}F$ represents maximum permissible downward adjustment under the constraints of the infinity ball, ensuring that for any distribution $G\in B_{\infty}(F,c)$

$$
(\mathrm{O}_{c}^{\infty}F)(x)\leq G(x),\forall x\in\mathbb{R}.
$$

context.name: Lemma 11
context.statement:
Lemma 11 For any $F_{i}\in \mathcal{D}$ and any $\theta,\theta^{\prime}\in\Delta_{n}$ with any $n \geq 2$ , it holds that

$$
\left\| \sum_{i = 1}^{n}\theta_{i}F_{i}- \sum_{i = 1}^{n}\theta_{i}^{\prime}F_{i}\right\|_{\infty}\leq \left\| \theta - \theta^{\prime}\right\|_{1}.
$$

import Mathlib

open MeasureTheory

namespace ResearchLevel

noncomputable def EU (β : ℝ) (μ : Measure ℝ) : ℝ := ∫ x, Real.exp (β * x) ∂μ

def InDab (a b : ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=

    ∧ (∀ x, ContinuousWithinAt F (Set.Ici x) x)

private lemma integral_eq_integral_Ioc_meas_lt {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    {μ : Measure α} {f : α → ℝ} {L : ℝ}
    (hf : Integrable f μ) (hf0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] f) (hfL : f ≤ᵐ[μ] fun _ => L) :
    ∫ x, f x ∂μ = ∫ t in Set.Ioc 0 L, μ.real {x | t < f x} := by
  rw [hf.integral_eq_integral_meas_lt hf0]
  rw [setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_ae_diff_eq_zero
    nullMeasurableSet_Ioi Set.Ioc_subset_Ioi_self]
  apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
  intro t ht
  have htL : L < t := by
    simp_all only [Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_Ioi, Set.mem_Ioc, not_and, not_le]
  have hzero : μ {x | L < f x} = 0 := by
    rw [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem]
    filter_upwards [hfL] with x hx using not_lt.mpr hx
  rw [measureReal_def, ENNReal.toReal_eq_zero_iff]
  exact Or.inl <| measure_mono_null (fun x hx => htL.trans hx) hzero

private lemma cdf_abs_bdd (μ ν : Measure ℝ) :
    BddAbove (Set.range fun x : ℝ =>
      |ProbabilityTheory.cdf μ x - ProbabilityTheory.cdf ν x|) := by
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · linarith [ProbabilityTheory.cdf_nonneg μ x, ProbabilityTheory.cdf_le_one ν x]
  · linarith [ProbabilityTheory.cdf_nonneg ν x, ProbabilityTheory.cdf_le_one μ x]

private lemma cdf_abs_le_iSup (μ ν : Measure ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    |ProbabilityTheory.cdf μ x - ProbabilityTheory.cdf ν x|
      ≤ ⨆ y : ℝ, |ProbabilityTheory.cdf μ y - ProbabilityTheory.cdf ν y| :=
  le_ciSup (cdf_abs_bdd μ ν) x

private lemma abs_integral_sub_le_cdf_iSup_of_tail_Ioi {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (μ ν : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (q : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hqμ : Integrable q μ) (hqν : Integrable q ν)
    (hqμ0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] q) (hqν0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[ν] q)
    (hqμL : q ≤ᵐ[μ] fun _ => L) (hqνL : q ≤ᵐ[ν] fun _ => L)
    (htail : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioc 0 L, ∃ r : ℝ, {x | t < q x} = Set.Ioi r) :
    |(∫ x, q x ∂μ) - ∫ x, q x ∂ν|
      ≤ L * ⨆ x : ℝ, |ProbabilityTheory.cdf μ x - ProbabilityTheory.cdf ν x| := by
  let D : ℝ := ⨆ x : ℝ,
    |ProbabilityTheory.cdf μ x - ProbabilityTheory.cdf ν x|
  let Tμ : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => μ.real {x | t < q x}
  let Tν : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => ν.real {x | t < q x}
  have hTμanti : Antitone Tμ := by
    intro s t hst
    exact measureReal_mono (fun x hx => hst.trans_lt hx)
  have hTνanti : Antitone Tν := by
    intro s t hst
    exact measureReal_mono (fun x hx => hst.trans_lt hx)
  have hTμint : IntegrableOn Tμ (Set.Ioc 0 L) := by
    refine IntegrableOn.of_bound (by rw [Real.volume_Ioc]; finiteness)
      hTμanti.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable 1 ?_
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro t
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg measureReal_nonneg]
    have hmono := measureReal_mono (μ := μ) (Set.subset_univ {x | t < q x})
    simpa only [Tμ, probReal_univ] using hmono
  have hTνint : IntegrableOn Tν (Set.Ioc 0 L) := by
    refine IntegrableOn.of_bound (by rw [Real.volume_Ioc]; finiteness)
      hTνanti.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable 1 ?_
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro t
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg measureReal_nonneg]
    have hmono := measureReal_mono (μ := ν) (Set.subset_univ {x | t < q x})
    simpa only [Tν, probReal_univ] using hmono
  have htail_bound : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioc 0 L, |Tμ t - Tν t| ≤ D := by
    intro t ht
    rcases htail t ht with ⟨r, hr⟩
    have hμtail : μ.real (Set.Ioi r) = 1 - ProbabilityTheory.cdf μ r := by
      calc
        μ.real (Set.Ioi r) = μ.real (Set.Iic r)ᶜ := by
          congr 2
          ext x
          simp
        _ = μ.real Set.univ - μ.real (Set.Iic r) :=
          measureReal_compl measurableSet_Iic
        _ = 1 - ProbabilityTheory.cdf μ r := by
          rw [probReal_univ, ProbabilityTheory.cdf_eq_real]
    have hνtail : ν.real (Set.Ioi r) = 1 - ProbabilityTheory.cdf ν r := by
      calc
        ν.real (Set.Ioi r) = ν.real (Set.Iic r)ᶜ := by
          congr 2
          ext x
          simp
        _ = ν.real Set.univ - ν.real (Set.Iic r) :=
          measureReal_compl measurableSet_Iic
        _ = 1 - ProbabilityTheory.cdf ν r := by
          rw [probReal_univ, ProbabilityTheory.cdf_eq_real]
    change |μ.real {x | t < q x} - ν.real {x | t < q x}| ≤ D
    rw [hr, hμtail, hνtail]
    have hsup := cdf_abs_le_iSup μ ν r
    change |1 - ProbabilityTheory.cdf μ r - (1 - ProbabilityTheory.cdf ν r)| ≤ D
    calc
      |1 - ProbabilityTheory.cdf μ r - (1 - ProbabilityTheory.cdf ν r)| =
          |ProbabilityTheory.cdf μ r - ProbabilityTheory.cdf ν r| := by
        rw [show 1 - ProbabilityTheory.cdf μ r -
          (1 - ProbabilityTheory.cdf ν r) =
            ProbabilityTheory.cdf ν r - ProbabilityTheory.cdf μ r by ring,
          abs_sub_comm]
      _ ≤ D := by simpa only [D] using hsup
  have hqμeq : ∫ x, q x ∂μ = ∫ t in Set.Ioc 0 L, Tμ t := by
    simpa only [Tμ] using integral_eq_integral_Ioc_meas_lt hqμ hqμ0 hqμL
  have hqνeq : ∫ x, q x ∂ν = ∫ t in Set.Ioc 0 L, Tν t := by
    simpa only [Tν] using integral_eq_integral_Ioc_meas_lt hqν hqν0 hqνL
  rw [hqμeq, hqνeq, ← integral_sub hTμint hTνint]
  calc
    |∫ t in Set.Ioc 0 L, Tμ t - Tν t| ≤
        ∫ t in Set.Ioc 0 L, |Tμ t - Tν t| := abs_integral_le_integral_abs
    _ ≤ ∫ _ in Set.Ioc 0 L, D := by
      exact setIntegral_mono_on (hTμint.sub hTνint).abs
        (integrableOn_const (by rw [Real.volume_Ioc]; finiteness))
        measurableSet_Ioc htail_bound
    _ = L * D := by simp [hL]

private lemma eu_lipschitz_pos {M β : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hβ : 0 < β)
    (μ ν : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hμ : μ (Set.Icc 0 M) = 1) (hν : ν (Set.Icc 0 M) = 1) :
    |EU β μ - EU β ν| ≤ (Real.exp (β * M) - 1) *
      ⨆ x : ℝ, |ProbabilityTheory.cdf μ x - ProbabilityTheory.cdf ν x| := by
  let q : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => Real.exp (β * x) - 1
  let L : ℝ := Real.exp (β * M) - 1
  have hμae : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) M :=
    (ae_mem_iff_measure_eq measurableSet_Icc.nullMeasurableSet).2 (by simpa using hμ)
  have hνae : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) M :=
    (ae_mem_iff_measure_eq measurableSet_Icc.nullMeasurableSet).2 (by simpa using hν)
  have hexpμ : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (β * x)) μ := by
    simpa only [id_eq] using
      (ProbabilityTheory.integrable_exp_mul_of_mem_Icc (μ := μ) (X := id) (t := β)
        measurable_id.aemeasurable hμae)
  have hexpν : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (β * x)) ν := by
    simpa only [id_eq] using
      (ProbabilityTheory.integrable_exp_mul_of_mem_Icc (μ := ν) (X := id) (t := β)
        measurable_id.aemeasurable hνae)
  have hqμ : Integrable q μ := by
    exact hexpμ.sub (integrable_const 1)
  have hqν : Integrable q ν := by
    exact hexpν.sub (integrable_const 1)
  have hL : 0 ≤ L := by
    dsimp [L]
    rw [sub_nonneg, Real.one_le_exp_iff]
    exact mul_nonneg hβ.le hM
  have hqμ0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] q := by
    filter_upwards [hμae] with x hx
    dsimp [q]
    rw [sub_nonneg, Real.one_le_exp_iff]
    exact mul_nonneg hβ.le hx.1
  have hqν0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[ν] q := by
    filter_upwards [hνae] with x hx
    dsimp [q]
    rw [sub_nonneg, Real.one_le_exp_iff]
    exact mul_nonneg hβ.le hx.1
  have hqμL : q ≤ᵐ[μ] fun _ => L := by
    filter_upwards [hμae] with x hx
    dsimp [q, L]
    exact sub_le_sub_right (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx.2 hβ.le)) 1
  have hqνL : q ≤ᵐ[ν] fun _ => L := by
    filter_upwards [hνae] with x hx
    dsimp [q, L]
    exact sub_le_sub_right (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx.2 hβ.le)) 1
  have htail : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioc 0 L, ∃ r : ℝ, {x | t < q x} = Set.Ioi r := by
    intro t ht
    have ht1 : 0 < t + 1 := by linarith [ht.1]
    refine ⟨Real.log (t + 1) / β, ?_⟩
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_Ioi, q]
    calc
      t < Real.exp (β * x) - 1 ↔ t + 1 < Real.exp (β * x) := by
        constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith
      _ ↔ Real.log (t + 1) < β * x := (Real.log_lt_iff_lt_exp ht1).symm
      _ ↔ Real.log (t + 1) / β < x := by
        rw [div_lt_iff₀ hβ]
        simp only [mul_comm]
  have hmain := abs_integral_sub_le_cdf_iSup_of_tail_Ioi hL μ ν q
    hqμ hqν hqμ0 hqν0 hqμL hqνL htail
  have hqμeq : ∫ x, q x ∂μ = EU β μ - 1 := by
    calc
      ∫ x, q x ∂μ = (∫ x, Real.exp (β * x) ∂μ) - ∫ _x, (1 : ℝ) ∂μ := by
        simpa only [q] using integral_sub hexpμ (integrable_const 1)
      _ = EU β μ - 1 := by simp [EU]
  have hqνeq : ∫ x, q x ∂ν = EU β ν - 1 := by
    calc
      ∫ x, q x ∂ν = (∫ x, Real.exp (β * x) ∂ν) - ∫ _x, (1 : ℝ) ∂ν := by
        simpa only [q] using integral_sub hexpν (integrable_const 1)
      _ = EU β ν - 1 := by simp [EU]
  calc
    |EU β μ - EU β ν| = |(∫ x, q x ∂μ) - ∫ x, q x ∂ν| := by
      rw [hqμeq, hqνeq, sub_sub_sub_cancel_right]
    _ ≤ L * ⨆ x : ℝ,
        |ProbabilityTheory.cdf μ x - ProbabilityTheory.cdf ν x| := hmain
    _ = (Real.exp (β * M) - 1) * ⨆ x : ℝ,
        |ProbabilityTheory.cdf μ x - ProbabilityTheory.cdf ν x| := by rfl

private lemma eu_lipschitz_neg {M β : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hβ : β < 0)
    (μ ν : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hμ : μ (Set.Icc 0 M) = 1) (hν : ν (Set.Icc 0 M) = 1) :
    |EU β μ - EU β ν| ≤ (1 - Real.exp (β * M)) *
      ⨆ x : ℝ, |ProbabilityTheory.cdf μ x - ProbabilityTheory.cdf ν x| := by
  let q : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => 1 - Real.exp (β * x)
  let L : ℝ := 1 - Real.exp (β * M)
  have hμae : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) M :=
    (ae_mem_iff_measure_eq measurableSet_Icc.nullMeasurableSet).2 (by simpa using hμ)
  have hνae : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) M :=
    (ae_mem_iff_measure_eq measurableSet_Icc.nullMeasurableSet).2 (by simpa using hν)
  have hexpμ : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (β * x)) μ := by
    simpa only [id_eq] using
      (ProbabilityTheory.integrable_exp_mul_of_mem_Icc (μ := μ) (X := id) (t := β)
        measurable_id.aemeasurable hμae)
  have hexpν : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (β * x)) ν := by
    simpa only [id_eq] using
      (ProbabilityTheory.integrable_exp_mul_of_mem_Icc (μ := ν) (X := id) (t := β)
        measurable_id.aemeasurable hνae)
  have hqμ : Integrable q μ := by
    exact (integrable_const 1).sub hexpμ
  have hqν : Integrable q ν := by
    exact (integrable_const 1).sub hexpν
  have hL : 0 ≤ L := by
    dsimp [L]
    rw [sub_nonneg, Real.exp_le_one_iff]
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hβ.le hM
  have hqμ0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] q := by
    filter_upwards [hμae] with x hx
    dsimp [q]
    rw [sub_nonneg, Real.exp_le_one_iff]
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hβ.le hx.1
  have hqν0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[ν] q := by
    filter_upwards [hνae] with x hx
    dsimp [q]
    rw [sub_nonneg, Real.exp_le_one_iff]
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hβ.le hx.1
  have hqμL : q ≤ᵐ[μ] fun _ => L := by
    filter_upwards [hμae] with x hx
    dsimp [q, L]
    exact sub_le_sub_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left hx.2 hβ.le)) 1
  have hqνL : q ≤ᵐ[ν] fun _ => L := by
    filter_upwards [hνae] with x hx
    dsimp [q, L]
    exact sub_le_sub_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left hx.2 hβ.le)) 1
  have htail : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioc 0 L, ∃ r : ℝ, {x | t < q x} = Set.Ioi r := by
    intro t ht
    have hexp_le : Real.exp (β * M) ≤ 1 - t := by
      dsimp [L] at ht
      linarith [ht.2]
    have h1t : 0 < 1 - t := (Real.exp_pos (β * M)).trans_le hexp_le
    refine ⟨Real.log (1 - t) / β, ?_⟩
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_Ioi, q]
    calc
      t < 1 - Real.exp (β * x) ↔ Real.exp (β * x) < 1 - t := by
        constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith
      _ ↔ β * x < Real.log (1 - t) := (Real.lt_log_iff_exp_lt h1t).symm
      _ ↔ Real.log (1 - t) / β < x := by
        rw [div_lt_iff_of_neg hβ]
        simp only [mul_comm]
  have hmain := abs_integral_sub_le_cdf_iSup_of_tail_Ioi hL μ ν q
    hqμ hqν hqμ0 hqν0 hqμL hqνL htail
  have hqμeq : ∫ x, q x ∂μ = 1 - EU β μ := by
    calc
      ∫ x, q x ∂μ = (∫ _x, (1 : ℝ) ∂μ) - ∫ x, Real.exp (β * x) ∂μ := by
        simpa only [q] using integral_sub (integrable_const 1) hexpμ
      _ = 1 - EU β μ := by simp [EU]
  have hqνeq : ∫ x, q x ∂ν = 1 - EU β ν := by
    calc
      ∫ x, q x ∂ν = (∫ _x, (1 : ℝ) ∂ν) - ∫ x, Real.exp (β * x) ∂ν := by
        simpa only [q] using integral_sub (integrable_const 1) hexpν
      _ = 1 - EU β ν := by simp [EU]
  calc
    |EU β μ - EU β ν| = |(∫ x, q x ∂μ) - ∫ x, q x ∂ν| := by
      rw [hqμeq, hqνeq,
        show 1 - EU β μ - (1 - EU β ν) = EU β ν - EU β μ by ring,
        abs_sub_comm]
    _ ≤ L * ⨆ x : ℝ,
        |ProbabilityTheory.cdf μ x - ProbabilityTheory.cdf ν x| := hmain
    _ = (1 - Real.exp (β * M)) * ⨆ x : ℝ,
        |ProbabilityTheory.cdf μ x - ProbabilityTheory.cdf ν x| := by rfl

theorem lemma6_lipschitz {M β : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hβ : β ≠ 0)
    (μ ν : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hμ : μ (Set.Icc 0 M) = 1) (hν : ν (Set.Icc 0 M) = 1) :
    (|EU β μ - EU β ν|
      ≤ |Real.exp (β * M) - 1|
          * ⨆ x : ℝ, |ProbabilityTheory.cdf μ x - ProbabilityTheory.cdf ν x|)
    ∧ (0 < M → ∃ μ₀ ν₀ : Measure ℝ, IsProbabilityMeasure μ₀ ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure ν₀ ∧
        μ₀ (Set.Icc 0 M) = 1 ∧ ν₀ (Set.Icc 0 M) = 1 ∧
        0 < (⨆ x : ℝ, |ProbabilityTheory.cdf μ₀ x - ProbabilityTheory.cdf ν₀ x|) ∧
        |EU β μ₀ - EU β ν₀|
          = |Real.exp (β * M) - 1|
              * ⨆ x : ℝ, |ProbabilityTheory.cdf μ₀ x - ProbabilityTheory.cdf ν₀ x|) := by
  constructor
  · by_cases hβpos : 0 < β
    · have hexp : 1 ≤ Real.exp (β * M) := by
        rw [Real.one_le_exp_iff]
        positivity
      simpa [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hexp)] using
        eu_lipschitz_pos hM hβpos μ ν hμ hν
    · have hβneg : β < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hβpos) hβ
      have hexp : Real.exp (β * M) ≤ 1 := by
        rw [Real.exp_le_one_iff]
        exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hβneg.le hM
      simpa [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hexp)] using
        eu_lipschitz_neg hM hβneg μ ν hμ hν
  · intro hMpos
    let μ₀ : Measure ℝ := Measure.dirac 0
    let ν₀ : Measure ℝ := Measure.dirac M
    have hμ₀prob : IsProbabilityMeasure μ₀ := by
      dsimp [μ₀]
      infer_instance
    have hν₀prob : IsProbabilityMeasure ν₀ := by
      dsimp [ν₀]
      infer_instance
    have hμ₀supp : μ₀ (Set.Icc 0 M) = 1 := by
      simp [μ₀, hM]
    have hν₀supp : ν₀ (Set.Icc 0 M) = 1 := by
      simp [ν₀, hM]
    letI : IsProbabilityMeasure μ₀ := hμ₀prob
    letI : IsProbabilityMeasure ν₀ := hν₀prob
    have hcdfμ₀ : ProbabilityTheory.cdf μ₀ 0 = 1 := by
      rw [ProbabilityTheory.cdf_eq_real, measureReal_def]
      simp [μ₀]
    have hcdfν₀ : ProbabilityTheory.cdf ν₀ 0 = 0 := by
      rw [ProbabilityTheory.cdf_eq_real, measureReal_def]
      simp [ν₀, hMpos.not_ge]
    have hsup : (⨆ x : ℝ,
        |ProbabilityTheory.cdf μ₀ x - ProbabilityTheory.cdf ν₀ x|) = 1 := by
      apply le_antisymm
      · apply ciSup_le
        intro x
        rw [abs_le]
        constructor
        · linarith [ProbabilityTheory.cdf_nonneg μ₀ x,
            ProbabilityTheory.cdf_le_one ν₀ x]
        · linarith [ProbabilityTheory.cdf_nonneg ν₀ x,
            ProbabilityTheory.cdf_le_one μ₀ x]
      · calc
          1 = |ProbabilityTheory.cdf μ₀ 0 - ProbabilityTheory.cdf ν₀ 0| := by
            rw [hcdfμ₀, hcdfν₀]
            norm_num
          _ ≤ ⨆ x : ℝ,
              |ProbabilityTheory.cdf μ₀ x - ProbabilityTheory.cdf ν₀ x| :=
            cdf_abs_le_iSup μ₀ ν₀ 0
    refine ⟨μ₀, ν₀, hμ₀prob, hν₀prob, hμ₀supp, hν₀supp, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hsup]
      norm_num
    · rw [hsup]
      simp [EU, μ₀, ν₀, abs_sub_comm]

private lemma weighted_cdf_sum_sub_le_l1 {n : ℕ}
    (F : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ) (hFrange : ∀ i x, F i x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (θ θ' : Fin n → ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    (∑ i, θ' i * F i x) - (∑ i, θ i * F i x) ≤ ∑ i, |θ i - θ' i| := by
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
  have hF0 : 0 ≤ F i x := (hFrange i x).1
  have hF1 : F i x ≤ 1 := (hFrange i x).2
  calc
    θ' i * F i x - θ i * F i x = (θ' i - θ i) * F i x := by ring
    _ ≤ |(θ' i - θ i) * F i x| := le_abs_self _
    _ = |θ' i - θ i| * F i x := by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hF0]
    _ ≤ |θ' i - θ i| * 1 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hF1 (abs_nonneg _)
    _ = |θ i - θ' i| := by rw [mul_one, abs_sub_comm]

theorem lemma12_optimistic_bound {n : ℕ} (a b c : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b) (hc0 : 0 < c)
    (F : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hFmono : ∀ i, Monotone (F i))
    (hFright : ∀ i x, ContinuousWithinAt (F i) (Set.Ici x) x)
    (hFrange : ∀ i x, F i x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hFlo : ∀ i x, x < a → F i x = 0)
    (hFhi : ∀ i x, b ≤ x → F i x = 1)
    (θ θ' : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hθnn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ θ i) (hθ'nn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ θ' i)
    (hθsum : ∑ i, θ i = 1) (hθ'sum : ∑ i, θ' i = 1)
    (hc : ∑ i, |θ i - θ' i| ≤ c) :
    ∀ x, optimismInf a b c (fun y => ∑ i, θ' i * F i y) x
        ≤ (∑ i, θ i * F i x) := by
  intro x
  by_cases hxa : x < a
  · have hxnot : x ∉ Set.Ico a b := fun hx => (not_le_of_gt hxa) hx.1
    simp [optimismInf, hFlo _ x hxa, hxnot]
  · have hax : a ≤ x := le_of_not_gt hxa
    by_cases hxb : x < b
    · have hxmem : x ∈ Set.Ico a b := ⟨hax, hxb⟩
      have hsum0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i, θ i * F i x :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hθnn i) (hFrange i x).1
      have hdiff :
          (∑ i, θ' i * F i x) - (∑ i, θ i * F i x) ≤ c :=
        (weighted_cdf_sum_sub_le_l1 F hFrange θ θ' x).trans hc
      simp only [optimismInf, Set.indicator_of_mem hxmem, mul_one]
      apply max_le
      · linarith
      · exact hsum0
    · have hbx : b ≤ x := le_of_not_gt hxb
      have hxnot : x ∉ Set.Ico a b := fun hx => (not_le_of_gt hx.2) hbx
      simp [optimismInf, hFhi _ x hbx, hθsum, hθ'sum, hxnot]

private lemma optimismInf_le_of_ball {a b c : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (F G : ℝ → ℝ) (hF : InDab a b F) (hG : InDab a b G)
    (hclose : ∀ x, |G x - F x| ≤ c) :
    ∀ x, optimismInf a b c F x ≤ G x := by
  intro x
  by_cases hxa : x < a
  · have hxnot : x ∉ Set.Ico a b := fun hx => (not_le_of_gt hxa) hx.1
    simp [optimismInf, hxnot, hF.2.2.2.1 x hxa, hG.2.2.2.1 x hxa]
  · have hax : a ≤ x := le_of_not_gt hxa
    by_cases hxb : x < b
    · have hxmem : x ∈ Set.Ico a b := ⟨hax, hxb⟩
      have hbelow : F x - c ≤ G x := by
        have habs := hclose x
        have hneg : -|G x - F x| ≤ G x - F x := neg_abs_le _
        linarith
      simp only [optimismInf, Set.indicator_of_mem hxmem, mul_one]
      exact max_le hbelow (hG.2.1 x).1
    · have hbx : b ≤ x := le_of_not_gt hxb
      have hxnot : x ∉ Set.Ico a b := fun hx => (not_le_of_gt hx.2) hbx
      simp [optimismInf, hxnot, hF.2.2.2.2 x hbx, hG.2.2.2.2 x hbx]

private lemma optimismInf_monotone {a b c : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hc0 : 0 < c)
    (F : ℝ → ℝ) (hF : InDab a b F) :
    Monotone (optimismInf a b c F) := by
  intro x y hxy
  by_cases hxa : x < a
  · have hxnot : x ∉ Set.Ico a b := fun hx => (not_le_of_gt hxa) hx.1
    have hxzero : optimismInf a b c F x = 0 := by
      simp [optimismInf, hxnot, hF.2.2.2.1 x hxa]
    rw [hxzero]
    exact le_max_right _ _
  · have hax : a ≤ x := le_of_not_gt hxa
    by_cases hbx : b ≤ x
    · have hby : b ≤ y := hbx.trans hxy
      have hxnot : x ∉ Set.Ico a b := fun hx => (not_le_of_gt hx.2) hbx
      have hynot : y ∉ Set.Ico a b := fun hy => (not_le_of_gt hy.2) hby
      simp [optimismInf, hxnot, hynot, hF.2.2.2.2 x hbx, hF.2.2.2.2 y hby]
    · have hxb : x < b := lt_of_not_ge hbx
      have hxmem : x ∈ Set.Ico a b := ⟨hax, hxb⟩
      by_cases hyb : y < b
      · have hay : a ≤ y := hax.trans hxy

targets.label: ch1_proposition_1_11
targets.statement: If \(f\) is twice continuously differentiable on its domain \(\Omega\), then \(f\) is convex if and only if \(\nabla^2 f(x)\succeq 0\) for all \(x\in\Omega\).

nl_proof:
Suppose \(f\) is convex and our goal is to show that the Hessian is positive semidefinite. Let \(y=x + \alpha u\) for some arbitrary vector \(u\) and scalar \(\alpha\). Proposition first-order-lower-bound shows
\[
f(y) - f(x) -\nabla f(x)^\top (y-x) \geqslant 0
\]
Hence, by Proposition first-order-taylor,
\begin{align*}
0&\leqslant  \int_0^1 (1-\gamma)\frac{\partial^2 f(x+\gamma(y-x))}{\partial\gamma^2}\,\mathrm{d}\gamma\\
&=  (1-\gamma)\frac{\partial^2 f(x+\gamma(y-x))}{\partial\gamma^2}
\quad\text{for some $\gamma\in(0,1)$} \tag{by the mean value theorem}\\
&= (1-\gamma)(y-x)^\top \nabla^2 f(x+\gamma (y-x))(y-x)
\tag{by Fact 1d-nd-hessian}\,.
\end{align*}
Plugging in our choice of \(y\), this shows \(0\leqslant u^\top \nabla^2 f(x+\alpha\gamma u)u\). Letting \(\alpha\) tend to zero establishes that \(\nabla^2 f(x)\succeq 0\). (Note that \(\gamma\) generally depends on \(\alpha\) but is always bounded by \(1\).)

Now, suppose the Hessian is positive semidefinite everywhere in \(\Omega\) and our goal is to show that the function \(f\) is convex. Using the same derivation as above, we can see that the second-order error term in Taylor's theorem must be non-negative. Hence, the first-order approximation is a global lower bound and so the function \(f\) is convex by Proposition first-order-lower-bound.

+ \nabla f(x)^\top (y-x)
+ \int_0^1 (1-\gamma)\frac{\partial^2 f(x+\gamma(y-x))}{\partial\gamma^2}\,\mathrm{d}\gamma
\]

import Mathlib

namespace GraduateLevel

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]

theorem ch1_proposition_1_11 {f : E → ℝ} {s : Set E}
    (hs : Convex ℝ s) (hs_open : IsOpen s) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f s) :
    ConvexOn ℝ s f ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ u : E, 0 ≤ iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f x ![u, u] := by
  let A (a u : E) : ℝ →ᵃ[ℝ] E :=
    { toFun := fun t ↦ a + t • u
      linear := LinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ E u
      map_vadd' := by
        intro p v
        simp only [LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply, vadd_eq_add, add_smul]
        module }
  have hA (a u : E) (t : ℝ) : A a u t = a + t • u := rfl
  have hdiff (x : E) (hx : x ∈ s) :
      HasFDerivAt f (fderiv ℝ f x) x :=
    ((hf.contDiffAt (hs_open.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt
  have hline (a u : E) (t : ℝ) (ht : a + t • u ∈ s) :
      HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ ↦ f (a + r • u)) (fderiv ℝ f (a + t • u) u) t := by
    apply (hdiff _ ht).comp_hasDerivAt t
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const u).const_add a
  have hline2 (a u : E) (t : ℝ) (ht : a + t • u ∈ s) :
      HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ ↦ fderiv ℝ f (a + r • u) u)
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f (a + t • u) ![u, u]) t := by
    have hp := hf.contDiffAt (hs_open.mem_nhds ht)
    have hfd : HasFDerivAt (fderiv ℝ f)
        (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) (a + t • u)) (a + t • u) :=
      ((hp.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt
    have he := (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ u).hasFDerivAt.comp (a + t • u) hfd
    have hin : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ ↦ a + r • u) u t := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const u).const_add a
    have hc := he.comp_hasDerivAt t hin
    simpa [iteratedFDeriv_two_apply] using hc
  constructor
  · intro hconv x hx u
    let T : Set ℝ := (A x u) ⁻¹' s
    have hTopen : IsOpen T := hs_open.preimage
      (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const))
    have hTconv : Convex ℝ T := hs.affine_preimage (A x u)
    have hgc : ConvexOn ℝ T (fun t ↦ f (x + t • u)) := by
      simpa [T, A, Function.comp_def] using hconv.comp_affineMap (A x u)
    have hgd : ∀ t ∈ T, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun r ↦ f (x + r • u)) t := by
      intro t ht
      exact (hline x u t ht).differentiableAt
    have hmono := hgc.monotoneOn_deriv hgd
    have hz : (0 : ℝ) ∈ T := by simpa [T, A] using hx
    have hqmono : MonotoneOn (fun t ↦ fderiv ℝ f (x + t • u) u) T := by
      intro a ha b hb hab
      simpa [(hline x u a ha).deriv, (hline x u b hb).deriv] using hmono ha hb hab
    have hd2 := hline2 x u 0 (by simpa using hx)
    have := hqmono.derivWithin_nonneg (x := (0 : ℝ))
    rw [derivWithin_of_isOpen hTopen hz, hd2.deriv] at this
    simpa using this
  · intro hpos
    rw [ConvexOn]
    refine ⟨hs, ?_⟩
    intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
    let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t ↦ f (x + t • (y - x))
    have hseg (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : x + t • (y - x) ∈ s :=
      hs.add_smul_sub_mem hx hy ht
    have hg' : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivWithinAt g (fderiv ℝ f (x + t • (y - x)) (y - x)) (Set.Icc 0 1) t := by
      intro t ht
      exact (hline x (y-x) t (hseg t ht)).hasDerivWithinAt
    have hg'' : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivWithinAt (fun r ↦ fderiv ℝ f (x + r • (y-x)) (y-x))
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f (x + t • (y-x)) ![y-x, y-x]) (Set.Icc 0 1) t := by
      intro t ht
      exact (hline2 x (y-x) t (hseg t ht)).hasDerivWithinAt
    have hgc : ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) g := by
      apply convexOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt2_nonneg (f' := fun t ↦
        fderiv ℝ f (x + t • (y-x)) (y-x)) (f'' := fun t ↦
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f (x + t • (y-x)) ![y-x, y-x]) (convex_Icc 0 1)
      · exact fun t ht ↦ (hg' t ht).continuousWithinAt
      · intro t ht; exact (hg' t (interior_subset ht)).mono interior_subset
      · intro t ht; exact (hg'' t (interior_subset ht)).mono interior_subset
      · intro t ht; exact hpos _ (hseg t (interior_subset ht)) _
    have hc := hgc.2 (x := (0 : ℝ)) (y := (1 : ℝ)) (by simp) (by simp) ha hb hab
    have heq : x + b • (y - x) = a • x + b • y := by
      have ha' : a = 1 - b := by linarith
      rw [ha']
      module
    simpa [g, heq, smul_eq_mul] using hc

targets.label: ch11_theorem_11_6
targets.statement:
Assume \(\ell(w, z)\) is \(\alpha\)-strongly convex over the domain \(\Omega\) and \(L\)-Lipschitz. Let \(\hat w_S = \arg \min_{w\in \Omega} \frac{1}{m} \sum_{i=1}^m \ell(w, z_i)\) denote the empirical risk minimizer (ERM). Then, ERM satisfies
\[
\Delta_{\sup} (\text{ERM}) \leqslant \frac{4L^2}{\alpha m}\,.
\]

nl_proof:
Denote by \(\hat w_S\) the empirical risk minimizer on a sample \(S.\) Fix arbitrary samples \(S,S'\) of size \(m\) and an index \(i\in[m].\) We need to show that
\[
|(\ell(\hat w_{S^{(i)}},z_i')-\ell(\hat w_{S},z_i'))|\leqslant\frac{4L^2}{\alpha m}\,.
\]
On one hand, by strong convexity we know that
\[
R_S(\hat w_{S^{(i)}}) - R_S(\hat w_{S}) \geqslant \frac{\alpha}{2} \| \hat w_{S} - \hat w_{S^{(i)}} \|^2 \,.
\]
On the other hand,
\begin{align*}
&R_S(\hat w_{S^{(i)}})-R_S(\hat w_{S})\\
&=\frac{1}{m}(\ell(\hat w_{S^{(i)}},z_i)-\ell(\hat w_{S},z_i))+\frac{1}{m}\sum_{i\neq j}(\ell(\hat w_{S^{(i)}},z_j)-\ell(\hat w_{S},z_j))\\
&=\frac{1}{m}(\ell(\hat w_{S^{(i)}},z_i)-\ell(\hat w_{S},z_i))+\frac{1}{m}(\ell(\hat w_{S},z_i')-\ell(\hat w_{S^{(i)}},z_i'))+\left(R_{S^{(i)}}(\hat w_{S^{(i)}})-R_{S^{(i)}}(\hat w_{S})\right)\\
&\leqslant\frac{1}{m}|\ell(\hat w_{S^{(i)}},z_i)-\ell(\hat w_{S},z_i)| +\frac{1}{m}|(\ell(\hat w_{S},z_i')-\ell(\hat w_{S^{(i)}},z_i'))|\\
&\leqslant\frac{2L}{m}\|\hat w_{S^{(i)}}-\hat w_{S}\|\,.
\end{align*}
Here, we used that
\[
R_{S^{(i)}}(\hat w_{S^{(i)}}) - R_{S^{(i)}}(\hat w_{S})) \leqslant 0
\]
and the fact that \(\ell\) is \(L\)-Lipschitz.

Putting it all together \(\| \hat w_{S^{(i)}} - \hat w_{S} \| \leqslant \frac{4 L}{\alpha m}\). Then by the Lipschitz condition we have that
\[
\frac{1}{m}|(\ell(\hat w_{S^{(i)}},z_i')-\ell(\hat w_{S},z_i'))|\leqslant L\|\hat w_{S^{(i)}}-\hat w_{S}\|\leqslant\frac{4L^2}{\alpha m}\,.
\]
Hence, \(\Delta_{\sup}(\text{ERM}) \leqslant \frac{4 L ^ 2}{\alpha m}\).

context.name: Strong convexity
context.statement: A function \(f\colon\Omega\to\mathbb{R}\) is \emph{\(\alpha\)-strongly convex} if, for all \(x,y\in\Omega\), the following inequality holds for some \(\alpha>0\): \[ f(y) \geqslant f(x) + g(x)^\top(y-x) + \frac{\alpha}{2}\left\lVert x-y\right\rVert^2 \]

context.statement:
The uniform stability of an algorithm \(A\) is defined as
\[
\Delta_{\sup}(A) = \sup_{S, S' \in (X\times Y)^m } \sup_{i \in [m]} |\ell(A(S), z_i') - \ell(A(S^{(i)}, z_i')|
\]

private lemma Strongly_Convex_Bound {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {s : Set E} {f : E → ℝ} (m : ℝ) (strongly_convex : StrongConvexOn s m f) :
    ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ s → ∀ ⦃y⦄, y ∈ s →
      ∀ ⦃a⦄, 0 < a → ∀ ⦃b⦄, 0 < b → a + b = 1 → f (a • x + b • y)

  intro x xs y ys a ap b bp abp
  rcases strongly_convex with ⟨_, sc⟩
  have anneg : a ≥ 0 := by linarith
  have bnneg : b ≥ 0 := by linarith
  rcases sc xs ys anneg bnneg abp with ineq
  simp at ineq

noncomputable def empRisk {E Z : Type*} {m : ℕ} (ℓ : E → Z → ℝ) (S : Fin m → Z) (w : E) : ℝ :=

theorem ch11_theorem_11_6
    {E Z : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]

    (ℓ : E → Z → ℝ) (α L : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hL : 0 ≤ L)

    (hLip : ∀ z : Z, ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, |ℓ w z - ℓ w' z| ≤ L * ‖w - w'‖)
    (erm : (Fin m → Z) → E)
    (herm : ∀ S : Fin m → Z, IsMinOn (empRisk ℓ S) Ω (erm S) ∧ erm S ∈ Ω) :
    ∀ (S S' : Fin m → Z) (i : Fin m),

      exact Strongly_Convex_Bound α (hsc (P j)) ha hb
        (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    have hsum : ∑ j, ℓ (((1:ℝ)/2) • a + ((1:ℝ)/2) • b) (P j)
        ≤ ∑ j : Fin m, ((1/2) * ℓ a (P j) + (1/2) * ℓ b (P j)
            - α / 2 * (1/2) * (1/2) * ‖a - b‖ ^ 2) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => h1 j)
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum,
      Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul] at hsum
    have hle : empRisk ℓ P a ≤ empRisk ℓ P (((1:ℝ)/2) • a + ((1:ℝ)/2) • b) :=
      isMinOn_iff.mp hmin _ hc
    simp only [empRisk] at hle ⊢
    have hmne : (m:ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hmR
    have hpos : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 / (m:ℝ) := by positivity
    have hC := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum hpos
    have expand : (1 / (m:ℝ)) * (1 / 2 * ∑ j, ℓ a (P j) + 1 / 2 * ∑ j, ℓ b (P j)

        = (1/2) * ((1 / (m:ℝ)) * ∑ j, ℓ a (P j)) + (1/2) * ((1 / (m:ℝ)) * ∑ j, ℓ b (P j))
          - α / 8 * ‖a - b‖ ^ 2 := by
      field_simp; ring
    rw [expand] at hC
    linarith
  intro S S' i
  set T := Function.update S i (S' i) with hT
  set u := erm S with hu
  set v := erm T with hv
  have huΩ : u ∈ Ω := (herm S).2
  have hvΩ : v ∈ Ω := (herm T).2
  have h1 : α / 4 * ‖u - v‖ ^ 2 ≤ empRisk ℓ S v - empRisk ℓ S u :=
    main S u v huΩ hvΩ (herm S).1
  have h2 : α / 4 * ‖v - u‖ ^ 2 ≤ empRisk ℓ T u - empRisk ℓ T v :=
    main T v u hvΩ huΩ (herm T).1
  rw [norm_sub_rev v u] at h2
  -- difference of the two empirical risks
  have hdiff : ∀ w : E, empRisk ℓ S w - empRisk ℓ T w
      = (1 / (m:ℝ)) * (ℓ w (S i) - ℓ w (S' i)) := by
    intro w
    simp only [empRisk, ← mul_sub]
    congr 1
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · simp [hT]
    · intro j _ hj
      simp [hT, Function.update_of_ne hj]
    · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ i) h
  have hsum2 : α / 2 * ‖u - v‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (1 / (m:ℝ)) * ((ℓ v (S i) - ℓ u (S i)) + (ℓ u (S' i) - ℓ v (S' i))) := by
    have e1 := hdiff u
    have e2 := hdiff v
    have : (empRisk ℓ S v - empRisk ℓ S u) + (empRisk ℓ T u - empRisk ℓ T v)
        = (1 / (m:ℝ)) * ((ℓ v (S i) - ℓ u (S i)) + (ℓ u (S' i) - ℓ v (S' i))) := by
      have := e1; have := e2
      nlinarith [e1, e2]
    linarith [h1, h2, this.symm.le, this.le]
  have hLip1 : ℓ v (S i) - ℓ u (S i) ≤ L * ‖u - v‖ := by
    have := hLip (S i) v hvΩ u huΩ
    have h := (abs_le.mp this).2
    rw [norm_sub_rev] at h
    linarith
  have hLip2 : ℓ u (S' i) - ℓ v (S' i) ≤ L * ‖u - v‖ := by
    have := hLip (S' i) u huΩ v hvΩ
    exact le_trans (abs_le.mp this).2 (le_refl _)
  have hmpos : (0:ℝ) < 1 / (m:ℝ) := by positivity
  have hstep : α / 2 * ‖u - v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 / (m:ℝ)) * (2 * L * ‖u - v‖) := by
    refine le_trans hsum2 ?_
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (le_of_lt hmpos)
    linarith
  have hd : ‖u - v‖ ≤ 4 * L / (α * m) := by
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (norm_nonneg (u - v)) with h0 | h0
    · rw [← h0]
      positivity
    · rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      have hm2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hstep (le_of_lt hmR)
      have hrw : (1 / (m:ℝ) * (2 * L * ‖u - v‖)) * (m:ℝ) = 2 * L * ‖u - v‖ := by
        field_simp
      rw [hrw] at hm2
      nlinarith [hm2, h0]
  have hfinal : |ℓ v (S' i) - ℓ u (S' i)| ≤ L * ‖u - v‖ := by
    have := hLip (S' i) v hvΩ u huΩ
    rwa [norm_sub_rev] at this
  refine le_trans hfinal ?_

    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd hL
  refine le_trans this (le_of_eq ?_)
  field_simp

end GraduateLevel

targets.label: ch13_proposition_13_2
targets.statement: Let \(\Omega \subseteq \mathbb{R}^d\) be a closed convex set. Let \(\mathcal{A}\) denote the affine set \(\{x : Ax = b\}\) for some \(A \in \mathbb{R}^{n \times d}\) and \(b \in \mathbb{R}^n\). Suppose that the set \(\operatorname{ri}(\Omega) \cap \mathcal{A}\) is non-empty. Then for any \(x \in \Omega \cap \mathcal{A}\), \[\mathcal{N}_{\Omega \cap \mathcal{A}}(x) = \mathcal{N}_{\Omega}(x) + \{A^\top \lambda : \lambda \in \mathbb{R}^n\}\,.\]

nl_proof: The ``\(\supseteq\)'' assertion is straightforward. To see this, suppose \(z \in \Omega \cap \mathcal{A}\) and note that \(z-x \in \operatorname{null}(A)\) so that \((z-x)^\top A^\top \lambda = \lambda^\top A(z-x) = 0\) for all \(\lambda \in \mathbb{R}^n\). If \(u \in \mathcal{N}_{\Omega}(x)\), then \((z-x)^\top u \leqslant 0\), so for \(\lambda \in \mathbb{R}^n\), we have \[\langle z-x, u + A^\top \lambda \rangle = \langle z-x, u \rangle \leqslant 0\] implying that \(u + A^\top \lambda \in \mathcal{N}_{\Omega \cap \mathcal{A}}(x)\). For the reverse inclusion, let \(v \in \mathcal{N}_{\Omega \cap \mathcal{A}}(x)\). Then we have \[v^\top (z-x) \leqslant 0 \text{ for all } z \in \Omega \cap \mathcal{A}.\] Now define the sets \[\begin{aligned} C_1 &= \left\{ (y,\mu) \in \mathbb{R}^{d+1} : y = z-x,\,\, z \in \Omega,\,\, \mu \leqslant v^\top y \right\}\\ C_2 &= \left\{ (y,\mu) \in \mathbb{R}^{d+1} : y \in \operatorname{ker}(A),\,\, \mu = 0 \right\}\,. \end{aligned}\] Note that \(\operatorname{ri}(C_1) \cap C_2 = \emptyset\) because otherwise there would exist a \((\hat{y},\hat{\mu})\) such that \[v^\top \hat{y} > \hat{\mu} = 0\] and \(\hat{y} \in \mathcal{T}_{\Omega \cap \mathcal{A}}(x)\). This would contradict our assumption that \(v \in \mathcal{N}_{\Omega \cap \mathcal{A}}(x)\). Since their intersection is empty, we can properly separate \(\operatorname{ri}(C_1)\) from \(C_2\). Indeed, since \(C_2\) is a subspace and \(C_1\) has nonempty relative interior, there must be a \((w,\gamma)\) such that \[\inf_{(y,\mu)\in C_1} \{ w^\top y + \gamma \mu\} < \sup_{(y,\mu)\in C_1} \{ w^\top y + \gamma \mu\} \leqslant 0\] while \[w^\top u = 0 \text{ for all } u \in \ker(A).\] In particular, this means that \(w = A^\top \lambda\) for some \(\lambda \in \mathbb{R}^n\). Now, \(\gamma\) must be nonnegative, as otherwise, \[\sup_{(y,\mu)\in C_1} \{ w^\top y + \gamma \mu\} = \infty\] (which can be seen by letting \(\mu\) tend to negative infinity). If \(\gamma = 0\), then \[\sup_{y \in C_1} w^\top y \leqslant 0\] but the set \(\{y : w^\top y = 0\}\) does not contain the set \(\{z-x : z \in \Omega\}\) as the infimum is strictly negative. This means that the relative interior of \(\Omega - \{x\}\) cannot intersect the kernel of \(A\) which contradicts our assumptions. Thus, we can conclude that \(\gamma\) is strictly positive. By homogeneity, we may as well assume that \(\gamma = 1\). To complete the argument, note that we now have \[(w+v)^\top (z-x) \leqslant 0 \text{ for all } z \in \Omega.\] This means that \(v+w \in \mathcal{N}_{\Omega}(x)\) and we have already shown that \(w = A^\top \lambda\). Thus, \[v = (v+w)-w \in \mathcal{N}_{\Omega}(x) + \mathcal{N}_{\mathcal{A}}(x)\,.\]

context.name: Convex set
context.statement: A set \(K\subseteq\mathbb{R}^n\) is convex if the line segment between any two points in \(K\) is also contained in \(K\). Formally, for all \(x,y\in K\) and all scalars \(\gamma\in[0,1]\) we have \(\gamma x+(1-\gamma)y\in K\).
