solution:
import Mathlib

open scoped Pointwise RealInnerProductSpace

namespace GraduateLevel

set_option maxHeartbeats 800000

def normalCone {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (S : Set E) (x : E) : Set E :=
  {u | ∀ z ∈ S, inner ℝ (z - x) u ≤ 0}

theorem ch13_proposition_13_2
    {d n : ℕ}
    (Ω : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)))
    (hΩclosed : IsClosed Ω) (hΩconvex : Convex ℝ Ω)
    (A : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) →ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (𝒜 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)))
    (h𝒜 : 𝒜 = {x | A x = b})
    (hCQ : (intrinsicInterior ℝ Ω ∩ 𝒜).Nonempty)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (hx : x ∈ Ω ∩ 𝒜) :
    normalCone (Ω ∩ 𝒜) x
      = normalCone Ω x
        + Set.range (fun μ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) => (LinearMap.adjoint A) μ) := by
  classical
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  let H : Submodule ℝ E := LinearMap.ker A
  let L : Submodule ℝ E := (affineSpan ℝ Ω).direction
  let S : Submodule ℝ E := H ⊔ L
  have hxΩ : x ∈ Ω := by
    rw [← hΩclosed.closure_eq]
    exact subset_closure hx.1
  have hxA : A x = b := by
    have := hx.2
    rw [h𝒜] at this
    exact this
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀ri, hx₀A⟩ := hCQ
  have hx₀Ω : x₀ ∈ Ω := intrinsicInterior_subset hx₀ri
  have hx₀eq : A x₀ = b := by
    rw [h𝒜] at hx₀A
    exact hx₀A
  have hdiffH : x₀ - x ∈ H := by
    change A (x₀ - x) = 0
    rw [map_sub, hx₀eq, hxA, sub_self]
  have hdiffL (z : E) (hz : z ∈ Ω) : z - x ∈ L := by
    exact AffineSubspace.vsub_mem_direction
      (subset_affineSpan ℝ Ω hz) (subset_affineSpan ℝ Ω hxΩ)
  have hdiffS (z : E) (hz : z ∈ Ω) : z - x ∈ S :=
    show z - x ∈ H ⊔ L from Submodule.mem_sup.2
      ⟨0, H.zero_mem, z - x, hdiffL z hz, zero_add _⟩
  let K : ConvexCone ℝ S :=
    { carrier := {y | ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∃ z ∈ Ω, (y : E) = c • (z - x)}
      smul_mem' := by
        rintro a ha y ⟨c, hc, z, hz, hy⟩
        refine ⟨a * c, mul_nonneg ha.le hc, z, hz, ?_⟩
        simp only [Submodule.coe_smul, hy, mul_smul]
      add_mem' := by
        rintro y ⟨c, hc, z, hz, hy⟩ w ⟨e, he, t, ht, hw⟩
        by_cases hs : c + e = 0
        · have hc0 : c = 0 := by linarith
          have he0 : e = 0 := by linarith
          refine ⟨0, le_rfl, x, hxΩ, ?_⟩
          simp [hy, hw, hc0, he0]
        · have hspos : 0 < c + e := lt_of_le_of_ne (add_nonneg hc he) (Ne.symm hs)
          let z' : E := (c / (c + e)) • z + (e / (c + e)) • t
          have hz' : z' ∈ Ω := by
            apply hΩconvex hz ht
            · exact div_nonneg hc hspos.le
            · exact div_nonneg he hspos.le
            · field_simp
          refine ⟨c + e, hspos.le, z', hz', ?_⟩
          simp only [Submodule.coe_add, hy, hw]
          dsimp [z']
          have hc' : (c + e) * (c / (c + e)) = c := by
            field_simp
          have he' : (c + e) * (e / (c + e)) = e := by
            field_simp
          simp only [smul_sub, smul_add, smul_smul, hc', he']
          module }
  have hgen (z : E) (hz : z ∈ Ω) :
      (⟨z - x, hdiffS z hz⟩ : S) ∈ K :=
    ⟨1, zero_le_one, z, hz, by simp⟩
  have hstep : ∀ l : L, ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧
      x₀ + c • (l : E) ∈ Ω := by
    intro l
    letI : Nonempty (affineSpan ℝ Ω) :=
      ⟨⟨x, subset_affineSpan ℝ Ω hxΩ⟩⟩
    rw [mem_intrinsicInterior] at hx₀ri
    obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀, hq₀val⟩ := hx₀ri
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 isOpen_interior q₀ hq₀
    let c : ℝ := ε / (2 * (‖(l : E)‖ + 1))
    have hc : 0 < c := by
      dsimp [c]
      positivity
    have hl : (l : E) ∈ (affineSpan ℝ Ω).direction := l.property
    let lv : (affineSpan ℝ Ω).direction := ⟨(l : E), hl⟩
    let q : affineSpan ℝ Ω := (c • lv) +ᵥ q₀
    have hqdist : dist q q₀ < ε := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm_vsub, vadd_vsub]
      change ‖c • (l : E)‖ < ε
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hc]
      dsimp [c]
      have hn : 0 ≤ ‖(l : E)‖ := norm_nonneg _
      field_simp
      nlinarith
    have hqΩ : (q : E) ∈ Ω := by
      change q ∈ (Subtype.val ⁻¹' Ω)
      exact interior_subset (hball (Metric.mem_ball.2 hqdist))
    refine ⟨c, hc, ?_⟩
    have hqcoe : (q : E) = c • (l : E) + x₀ := by
      dsimp [q, lv]
      change c • (l : E) + (q₀ : E) = _
      rw [hq₀val]
    rw [hqcoe] at hqΩ
    simpa [add_comm] using hqΩ
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · intro v hv
    let P : Submodule ℝ S := H.comap S.subtype
    let f₀ : P →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ :=
      { toFun := fun y => - inner ℝ (y.1 : E) v
        map_add' := by
          intro a b
          simp only [Submodule.coe_add, inner_add_left, neg_add_rev]
          abel
        map_smul' := by
          intro c a
          simp [real_inner_smul_left] }
    let f : S →ₗ.[ℝ] ℝ := LinearPMap.mk P f₀
    have hnonneg : ∀ y : f.domain, (y : S) ∈ K → 0 ≤ f y := by
      intro y hyK
      obtain ⟨c, hc, z, hzΩ, hy⟩ := hyK
      change 0 ≤ -inner ℝ (((y : f.domain) : S) : E) v
      have hyH : ((y : S) : E) ∈ H := y.property
      change A ((y : S) : E) = 0 at hyH
      rw [hy, map_smul] at hyH
      by_cases hc0 : c = 0
      · rw [hy, hc0, zero_smul, inner_zero_left]
        norm_num
      have hzA : A z = b := by
        have : A (z - x) = 0 := by
          rcases smul_eq_zero.mp hyH with h | h
          · exact (hc0 h).elim
          · exact h
        rw [map_sub, hxA, sub_eq_zero] at this
        exact this
      have hvz : inner ℝ (z - x) v ≤ 0 :=
        hv z ⟨hzΩ, by simpa [h𝒜] using hzA⟩
      rw [hy, real_inner_smul_left]
      exact neg_nonneg.mpr (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hc hvz)
    have hdense : ∀ y : S, ∃ p : f.domain, (p : S) + y ∈ K := by
      intro y
      obtain ⟨h, hhH, l, hlL, hly⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 y.property
      let l' : L := ⟨l, hlL⟩
      obtain ⟨c, hc, hzΩ⟩ := hstep l'
      let z : E := x₀ + c • l
      have hzΩ' : z ∈ Ω := by simpa [z, l'] using hzΩ
      have hk : (c⁻¹ : ℝ) • (⟨z - x, hdiffS z hzΩ'⟩ : S) ∈ K :=
        K.smul_mem (inv_pos.2 hc) (hgen z hzΩ')
      let pe : E := c⁻¹ • (x₀ - x) - h
      have hpeH : pe ∈ H := H.sub_mem (H.smul_mem _ hdiffH) hhH
      have hpeS : pe ∈ S := show pe ∈ H ⊔ L from
        Submodule.mem_sup.2 ⟨pe, hpeH, 0, L.zero_mem, add_zero _⟩
      let pS : S := ⟨pe, hpeS⟩
      have hpP : pS ∈ P := hpeH
      refine ⟨⟨pS, hpP⟩, ?_⟩
      convert hk using 1
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp only [Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_smul]
      dsimp [pS, pe, z]
      rw [← hly]
      have hci : c⁻¹ * c = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hc.ne'
      simp only [smul_sub, smul_add, smul_smul, hci, one_smul]
      module
    obtain ⟨g, hgf, hgK⟩ := riesz_extension K f hnonneg hdense
    obtain ⟨gE, hgE⟩ := LinearMap.exists_extend g
    let u : E := - LinearMap.adjoint gE (1 : ℝ)
    have hgu (y : S) : g y = - inner ℝ (y : E) u := by
      have hext : gE (y : E) = g y := by
        have := LinearMap.congr_fun hgE y
        exact this
      rw [← hext]
      dsimp [u]
      rw [inner_neg_right, neg_neg]
      rw [LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]
      simp
    have hu : u ∈ normalCone Ω x := by
      intro z hzΩ
      have hzK := hgen z hzΩ
      have := hgK _ hzK
      rw [hgu] at this
      exact neg_nonneg.mp (by simpa using this)
    have hvuH : v - u ∈ Hᗮ := by
      rw [Submodule.mem_orthogonal']
      intro y hyH
      have hyS : y ∈ S := Submodule.mem_sup.2
        ⟨y, hyH, 0, L.zero_mem, add_zero _⟩
      let ys : S := ⟨y, hyS⟩
      have hysP : ys ∈ P := hyH
      have heq := hgf (⟨ys, hysP⟩ : f.domain)
      rw [hgu] at heq
      change inner ℝ (v - u) y = 0
      dsimp [f, f₀] at heq
      change -inner ℝ y u = -inner ℝ y v at heq
      have heq0 : inner ℝ y u = inner ℝ y v := neg_inj.mp heq
      have heq' : inner ℝ u y = inner ℝ v y := by
        calc
          inner ℝ u y = inner ℝ y u := real_inner_comm _ _
          _ = inner ℝ y v := heq0
          _ = inner ℝ v y := real_inner_comm _ _
      rw [inner_sub_left, heq', sub_self]
    have hvurange :
        v - u ∈ LinearMap.range (LinearMap.adjoint A) := by
      let Ac := LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap A
      have hcorth : (LinearMap.ker Ac)ᗮ =
          LinearMap.range (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Ac) := by
        rw [ContinuousLinearMap.orthogonal_ker]
        apply SetLike.coe_injective
        rw [Submodule.topologicalClosure_coe]
        exact (LinearMap.range
          (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Ac)).closed_of_finiteDimensional.closure_eq
      have : v - u ∈ (LinearMap.ker Ac)ᗮ := by
        rw [LinearMap.ker_toContinuousLinearMap]
        exact hvuH
      rw [hcorth] at this
      simpa [Ac, ← LinearMap.adjoint_toContinuousLinearMap] using this
    obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ := hvurange
    refine ⟨u, hu, LinearMap.adjoint A μ, ⟨μ, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [hμ]
    change u + (v - u) = v
    abel
  · rintro v ⟨u, hu, w, ⟨μ, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    intro z hz
    rw [inner_add_right]
    have hAu := hu z hz.1
    have hzA : A z = b := by
      rw [h𝒜] at hz
      exact hz.2
    rw [LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right, map_sub, hzA, hxA, sub_self, inner_zero_left]
    simpa using hAu

end GraduateLevel

nl_proof:
Fix any direction \(d \in \mathbb{R}^n\).
\begin{enumerate}
    \item \(g(\alpha) := f(x^* + \alpha d)\). Then
    \[
        0 \leqslant \lim_{\alpha \to 0} \frac{f(x^* + \alpha d) - f(x^*)}{\alpha} = \frac{\partial g(0)}{\partial \alpha} = d^\top \nabla f(x^*)
    \]
    The inequality follows because \(x^*\) is a local minimum, \(0 \leqslant f(x^* + \alpha d) - f(x^*)\) for sufficiently small \(\alpha\). So, we can construct a sequence with only positive \(\alpha\) that converges to \(x^*\) such that each element \(0 \leqslant \frac{f(x^* + \alpha_n d) - f(x^*)}{\alpha_n}\) which implies that statement given that \(f\) is locally differentiable. Since \(d\) is arbitrary, this implies that \(\nabla f(x^*) = 0\).
    \item First we represent \(f(x^* + \alpha d) - f(x^*)\) using the 2nd order Taylor expansion.
    \[
        f(x^* + \alpha d) - f(x^*) = \alpha \nabla f(x^*)^\top d + \frac{\alpha^2}{2} d^\top \nabla^2 f(x^*) d + O(\alpha^2) = \frac{\alpha^2}{2} d^\top \nabla^2 f(x^*) d + O(\alpha^2)
    \]
    Now we do the following
    \[
        0 \leqslant \lim_{\alpha \to 0} \frac{f(x^* + \alpha d) - f(x^*)}{\alpha^2} = \lim_{\alpha \to 0} \frac{1}{2} d^\top \nabla^2 f(x^*) d + \frac{O(\alpha^2)}{\alpha^2} = \frac{1}{2} d^\top \nabla^2 f(x^*) d
    \]
    Because \(d\) is arbitrary, this implies that \(\nabla^2 f(x^*) \succeq 0\) (Positive semidefinite).
\end{enumerate}

      dsimp [ℓ]

      simpa [ℓ] using hC2

private lemma taylor_bnd {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (g : E → E) (g' : E → E →L[ℝ] E) (hg : ∀ z, HasFDerivAt g (g' z) z)
    (hL : LipschitzWith 1 g') (a b : E) :
    ‖g b - g a - g' a (b - a)‖ ≤ (1/2) * ‖b - a‖^2 := by
  set d := b - a with hd
  set w := g' a d with hw
  set u : ℝ → E := fun s => g (a + s • d) - g a - s • w with hu
  set u' : ℝ → E := fun s => g' (a + s • d) d - w with hu'
  have hderiv : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt u (u' s) s := by
    intro s
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => a + s • d) d s := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id s).smul_const d).const_add a
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => g (a + s • d)) (g' (a + s • d) d) s :=
      (hg (a + s • d)).comp_hasDerivAt s h1
    have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => s • w) w s := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id s).smul_const w
    exact (h2.sub_const (g a)).sub h3
  set B : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => ‖d‖^2 * s^2 / 2 with hB
  set B' : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => ‖d‖^2 * s with hB'
  have hBd : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt B (B' s) s := by
    intro s
    have : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ‖d‖^2 * s^2 / 2) (‖d‖^2 * (2*s) / 2) s := by
      simpa using (((hasDerivAt_pow 2 s).const_mul (‖d‖^2)).div_const 2)
    convert this using 1
    simp [hB']; ring
  have key := image_norm_le_of_norm_deriv_right_le_deriv_boundary
    (f := u) (a := 0) (b := 1) (f' := u')
    (fun s _ => ((hderiv s).continuousAt).continuousWithinAt)
    (fun s _ => (hderiv s).hasDerivWithinAt)
    (by simp [hu, hB]) hBd
    (by
      intro s hs
      have hs0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ s := hs.1
      have hlip : ‖g' (a + s • d) - g' a‖ ≤ ‖s • d‖ := by
        have := hL.dist_le_mul (a + s • d) a
        simp only [dist_eq_norm] at this
        simpa using this
      have : u' s = (g' (a + s • d) - g' a) d := by simp [hu', hw]
      rw [this]
      calc ‖(g' (a + s • d) - g' a) d‖ ≤ ‖g' (a + s • d) - g' a‖ * ‖d‖ :=
            ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
        _ ≤ ‖s • d‖ * ‖d‖ := by gcongr
        _ = B' s := by simp [hB', norm_smul, abs_of_nonneg hs0]; ring)
    (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
  have hu1 : u 1 = g b - g a - g' a (b - a) := by simp [hu, hd, hw]
  rw [hu1] at key
  calc ‖g b - g a - g' a (b-a)‖ ≤ B 1 := key
    _ = 1/2 * ‖b-a‖^2 := by simp [hB, hd]; ring

theorem ch23_theorem_23_1
    {n : ℕ} (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f)
    (hLip : LipschitzWith 1 (fun x => fderiv ℝ (gradient f) x))
    (xstar : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hstar : gradient f xstar = 0)
    (hpd : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n),
        α * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪(fderiv ℝ (gradient f) xstar) v, v⟫)
    (x : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (h0 : ‖x 0 - xstar‖ ≤ α / 2)
    (hnewton : ∀ t, ∃ H : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) ≃L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n),
        (↑H = fderiv ℝ (gradient f) (x t)) ∧
        x (t + 1) = x t - H.symm (gradient f (x t))) :
    ∀ t, ‖x (t + 1) - xstar‖ ≤ (1 / α) * ‖x t - xstar‖ ^ 2 := by
  have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ (gradient f) := by
    have h1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ f) := hf.fderiv_right (by norm_num)
    have h2 : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun z => (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))).symm (fderiv ℝ f z)) :=
      (((InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap).contDiff).comp h1
    have he : (gradient f) = fun z => (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))).symm (fderiv ℝ f z) := rfl
    rw [he]
    exact h2.differentiable le_rfl
  have hgd : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), HasFDerivAt (gradient f) (fderiv ℝ (gradient f) z) z :=
    fun z => (hdiff z).hasFDerivAt
  have hHlip : ∀ y z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n),
      ‖fderiv ℝ (gradient f) y - fderiv ℝ (gradient f) z‖ ≤ ‖y - z‖ := by
    intro y z
    have h := hLip.dist_le_mul y z
    simp only [dist_eq_norm] at h
    simpa only [NNReal.coe_one, one_mul] using h
  have hpdy : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), ‖y - xstar‖ ≤ α / 2 →
      ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n),
      (α/2) * ‖v‖^2 ≤ ⟪(fderiv ℝ (gradient f) y) v, v⟫ := by
    intro y hy v
    have hdec : ⟪(fderiv ℝ (gradient f) y) v, v⟫
        = ⟪(fderiv ℝ (gradient f) xstar) v, v⟫
          + ⟪(fderiv ℝ (gradient f) y - fderiv ℝ (gradient f) xstar) v, v⟫ := by
      simp [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, inner_sub_left]
    have hAB : ‖fderiv ℝ (gradient f) y - fderiv ℝ (gradient f) xstar‖ ≤ α/2 :=
      le_trans (hHlip y xstar) hy
    have hop : ‖(fderiv ℝ (gradient f) y - fderiv ℝ (gradient f) xstar) v‖ ≤ (α/2) * ‖v‖ :=
      le_trans (ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hAB (norm_nonneg v))
    have hb : |⟪(fderiv ℝ (gradient f) y - fderiv ℝ (gradient f) xstar) v, v⟫| ≤ (α/2) * ‖v‖^2 := by
      have h1 := abs_real_inner_le_norm ((fderiv ℝ (gradient f) y - fderiv ℝ (gradient f) xstar) v) v
      have h2 : ‖(fderiv ℝ (gradient f) y - fderiv ℝ (gradient f) xstar) v‖ * ‖v‖
          ≤ ((α/2) * ‖v‖) * ‖v‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hop (norm_nonneg v)
      nlinarith [h1, h2]
    have h1 := hpd v
    have h2 : -((α/2) * ‖v‖^2)
        ≤ ⟪(fderiv ℝ (gradient f) y - fderiv ℝ (gradient f) xstar) v, v⟫ :=
      neg_le_of_abs_le hb
    rw [hdec]
    linarith
  have hinv : ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), ‖y - xstar‖ ≤ α / 2 →
      ∀ (H : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) ≃L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)),
      (↑H = fderiv ℝ (gradient f) y) →
      ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), ‖H.symm w‖ ≤ (2/α) * ‖w‖ := by
    intro y hy H hH w
    set v := H.symm w with hv
    have hHv : (fderiv ℝ (gradient f) y) v = w := by
      rw [← hH, hv]; simp
    have h1 : (α/2) * ‖v‖^2 ≤ ⟪(fderiv ℝ (gradient f) y) v, v⟫ := hpdy y hy v
    rw [hHv] at h1
    have h3 : ⟪w, v⟫ ≤ ‖w‖ * ‖v‖ := real_inner_le_norm w v
    have h4 : (α/2) * ‖v‖^2 ≤ ‖w‖ * ‖v‖ := le_trans h1 h3
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (norm_nonneg v) with h | h
    · rw [← h]
      have : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2/α * ‖w‖ := by positivity
      linarith
    · rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hα]
      nlinarith
  have step : ∀ t, ‖x t - xstar‖ ≤ α / 2 →
      ‖x (t+1) - xstar‖ ≤ (1/α) * ‖x t - xstar‖^2 := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨H, hH, hstep⟩ := hnewton t
    set A := fderiv ℝ (gradient f) (x t) with hA
    set v := x t - xstar with hvdef
    set G := gradient f (x t) with hG
    have hAv : H.symm (A v) = v := by rw [← hH]; simp
    have hkey : x (t+1) - xstar = H.symm (A v - G) := by
      rw [hstep, map_sub, hAv, hvdef]
      abel
    have htay := taylor_bnd (gradient f) (fun z => fderiv ℝ (gradient f) z) hgd hLip (x t) xstar
    have hxv : xstar - x t = -v := by rw [hvdef]; abel
    have heq : gradient f xstar - gradient f (x t) - A (xstar - x t) = A v - G := by
      rw [hstar, hxv, map_neg, ← hG]
      abel
    simp only [← hA] at htay
    rw [heq] at htay
    have hnormeq : ‖xstar - x t‖ = ‖v‖ := by rw [hxv, norm_neg]
    rw [hnormeq] at htay
    have hb := hinv (x t) ht H hH (A v - G)
    rw [← hkey] at hb
    have hfin : (2/α) * ‖A v - G‖ ≤ (2/α) * ((1/2) * ‖v‖^2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htay (by positivity)
    have : (2/α) * ((1/2) * ‖v‖^2) = (1/α) * ‖v‖^2 := by field_simp
    linarith [le_trans hb hfin]
  have ball : ∀ t, ‖x t - xstar‖ ≤ α / 2 := by
    intro t
    induction t with
    | zero => exact h0
    | succ k ih =>
        have h1 := step k ih
        have hn : (0:ℝ) ≤ ‖x k - xstar‖ := norm_nonneg _
        have hsq : ‖x k - xstar‖^2 ≤ α^2/4 := by nlinarith
        have hpos : (0:ℝ) < 1/α := by positivity
        have h2 : (1/α) * ‖x k - xstar‖^2 ≤ α/4 := by
          have hc : (1/α) * ‖x k - xstar‖^2 ≤ (1/α) * (α^2/4) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq (le_of_lt hpos)
          have he : (1/α) * (α^2/4) = α/4 := by field_simp
          linarith [hc, he.le, he.ge]
        linarith
  exact fun t => step t (ball t)

end GraduateLevel

targets.label: ch14_theorem_14_1
targets.statement:
\[\mathbb{P}\left(\forall f\in F,R(f)\leq\frac{2^{9/2}}{\sqrt{n}}\int_{0}^{d(0,f)}\log^{1/2}\mathcal{D}(F,\varepsilon,d)d\varepsilon+2^{7/2}d(0,f)\sqrt{\frac{u}{n}}\right)\geq 1-e^{-u}\]
for any \(u > 0\)

nl_proof:
Without loss of generality, assume \(0 \in F\)
Kolmogorov's chaining technique: define a sequence of subsets
\[\{0\}=F_{0}\subseteq F_{1}\dots\subseteq F_{j}\subseteq\dots\subseteq F\]
where \(F_{j}\) is defined such that
(1) \(\forall f,g\in F_{j},d(f,g)>2^{-j}\)
(2) \(\forall f \in F\) ,we can find \(g\in F_{j}\) such that \(d(f,g)\leq 2^{-j}\)
How to construct \(F_{j+1}\) if we have \(F_{j}\)
\(F_{j+1}: =F_{j}\)
· Find \(f\in F,d(f,g)>2^{-(j+1)}\) for all \(g\in F_{j+1}\)
· Repeat until you cannot find such f
Define projection \(\pi_{j}:F\mapsto F_{j}\) as follows: for \(f \in F\) find \(g\in F_{j}\) with \(d(f,g)\leq 2^{-j}\) and set \(\pi_{j}(f)=g\) For any \(f \in F\)
\[\begin{array}{ l }{f=\displaystyle\pi_{0}(f)+(\pi_{1}(f)-\pi_{0}(f))+(\pi_{2}(f)-\pi_{1}(f))\cdot\cdot\cdot}\\ {\displaystyle=\sum_{j=1}^{\infty}(\pi_{j}(f)-\pi_{j-1}(f))}\end{array}\]
Moreover,
\[\begin{array}{ r l r }{{d(\pi_{j-1}(f),\pi_{j}(f))\leq d(\pi_{j-1}(f),f)+d(f,\pi_{j}(f))}}\\ &{}&\\ &{}&{\leq 2^{-(j-1)}+2^{-j}=3\cdot 2^{-j}\leq 2^{-j+2}}\end{array}\]
Define the links
\[L_{j-1,j}=\{f-g:f\in F_{j},g\in F_{j-1},d(f,g)\leq 2^{-j+2}\}.\]
Since R is linear, \(\begin{array}{ r }{R(f)=\sum_{j=1}^{\infty}R(\pi_{j}(f)-\pi_{j-1}(f))}\end{array}\) . We first show how to control R on the links. Assume \(\ell\in L_{j-1,j}\) . Then by Hoeffding's inequality
\[\begin{array}{ r l r }{{\mathbb{P}(\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\varepsilon_{i}\ell_{i}\geq t)\leq\exp(-\frac{t^{2}}{2\sum\frac{1}{n^{2}}\ell_{i}^{2}})}}\\ &{}&\\ &{}&{=\exp(-\frac{n t^{2}}{2\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\ell_{i}^{2}})}\\ &{}&{\leq\exp(-\frac{n t^{2}}{2\cdot 2^{-2 j+4}})}\end{array}\]
Note that
\[\mathrm{card}L_{j-1,j}\leq\mathrm{card}F_{j-1}\cdot\mathrm{card}F_{j}\leq(\mathrm{card}F_{j})^{2}.\]
\[\begin{array}{ r l r }{{\mathbb{P}(\forall\ell\in L_{j-1,j},R(\ell)=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\varepsilon_{i}\ell_{i}\leq t)\geq 1-(\mathrm{card}F_{j})^{2}e^{-\frac{n t^{2}}{2\cdot 2^{-2 j+5}}}}}\\ &{}&\\ &{}&{=1-\frac{1}{(\mathrm{card}F_{j})^{2}}e^{-u}}\end{array}\]
after changing the variable such that

import Mathlib

open MeasureTheory
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal

noncomputable section

namespace GraduateLevel

def EmpL2 (n : ℕ) : Type := Fin n → ℝ

instance (n : ℕ) : Zero (EmpL2 n) := inferInstanceAs (Zero (Fin n → ℝ))

def empEmbed (n : ℕ) : EmpL2 n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) :=
  fun f => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin n) ℝ).symm (fun i => f i / Real.sqrt n)

instance (n : ℕ) : PseudoMetricSpace (EmpL2 n) :=
  PseudoMetricSpace.induced (empEmbed n) inferInstance

def radProc (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → ℝ) (ε : Fin n → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, ε i * f i

def IsPacking {A : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace A] (t : Finset A) (eps : ℝ) (s : Set A) : Prop :=
  ↑t ⊆ s ∧ (↑t : Set A).Pairwise fun x y => eps < dist x y

noncomputable def packingNumber {A : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace A] (eps : ℝ) (s : Set A) : WithTop ℕ :=
  sSup {n | ∃ t, IsPacking t eps s ∧ ↑t.card = n}

/- ###################################################################### -/
/-  Part 1 : the Rademacher product measure                              -/
/- ###################################################################### -/

open ProbabilityTheory in
def rad : Measure ℝ := ((1 : ℝ≥0∞) / 2) • (Measure.dirac (-1 : ℝ) + Measure.dirac 1)

instance : IsProbabilityMeasure rad := by
  constructor; simp [rad]; exact ENNReal.inv_two_add_inv_two

lemma rad_integral (g : ℝ → ℝ) : ∫ x, g x ∂rad = (g (-1) + g 1)/2 := by
  rw [rad, integral_smul_measure,
    integral_add_measure (integrable_dirac (by finiteness)) (integrable_dirac (by finiteness)),
    integral_dirac, integral_dirac]
  simp; ring

lemma rad_ae (p : ℝ → Prop) (h : p (-1)) (h' : p 1) : ∀ᵐ x ∂rad, p x := by
  have : rad {x | ¬ p x} = 0 := by rw [rad]; simp [h, h']
  exact this

def radP (n : ℕ) : Measure (Fin n → ℝ) := Measure.pi (fun _ => rad)

instance (n : ℕ) : IsProbabilityMeasure (radP n) := by unfold radP; infer_instance

open ProbabilityTheory in
lemma coord_subG (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω : Fin n → ℝ => c * ω i) (‖c‖₊^2) (radP n) := by
  have hmp : MeasurePreserving (Function.eval i) (radP n) rad := by
    unfold radP; exact measurePreserving_eval _ i
  have key : HasSubgaussianMGF (fun x : ℝ => c * x) (‖c‖₊^2) rad := by
    have h := hasSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc_of_integral_eq_zero (μ := rad)
      (X := fun x : ℝ => c * x) (a := -|c|) (b := |c|)
      (by fun_prop)
      (rad_ae _ (by constructor <;> nlinarith [abs_nonneg c, neg_abs_le c, le_abs_self c])
        (by constructor <;> nlinarith [abs_nonneg c, neg_abs_le c, le_abs_self c]))
      (by rw [rad_integral]; ring)
    convert h using 2
    rw [show |c| - -|c| = 2*|c| by ring]
    simp [nnnorm_mul]
  exact HasSubgaussianMGF.of_map (Y := Function.eval i) (hmp.measurable.aemeasurable)
    (by rw [hmp.map_eq]; exact key)

open ProbabilityTheory in
lemma indep_coords (n : ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) :
    iIndepFun (fun (i : Fin n) (ω : Fin n → ℝ) => c i * ω i) (radP n) := by
  unfold radP
  exact iIndepFun_pi (X := fun i (x : ℝ) => c i * x) (fun i => by fun_prop)

/- ###################################################################### -/
/-  Part 2 : the empirical L² pseudometric                               -/
/- ###################################################################### -/

section Metric
variable {n : ℕ}

lemma dist_eq' (a b : EmpL2 n) :
    dist a b = Real.sqrt (∑ i, ((a i - b i) / Real.sqrt n)^2) := by
  show dist (empEmbed n a) (empEmbed n b) = _
  rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_eq]
  simp [empEmbed, Real.dist_eq, sq_abs, sub_div]

lemma dist_sq (hn : 0 < n) (a b : EmpL2 n) :
    (dist a b)^2 = (∑ i, ((a : Fin n → ℝ) i - b i)^2) / n := by
  have hn' : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  rw [dist_eq', Real.sq_sqrt]
  · rw [Finset.sum_div]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hn'.le]
  · positivity

lemma sum_sq_eq (hn : 0 < n) (a : EmpL2 n) :
    (∑ i, ((a : Fin n → ℝ) i)^2) = n * (dist (0 : EmpL2 n) a)^2 := by
  have hn' : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  rw [dist_sq hn]
  have : ∀ i, ((0 : EmpL2 n) i - a i)^2 = (a i)^2 := by
    intro i; show ((0:ℝ) - a i)^2 = _; ring
  simp only [this]
  field_simp

end Metric

/- ###################################################################### -/
/-  Part 3 : Hoeffding + symmetry                                        -/
/- ###################################################################### -/

section Prob
variable {n : ℕ}

lemma hoeff (hn : 0 < n) (a : Fin n → ℝ) (v : ℝ) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    (radP n).real {ω | dist (0 : EmpL2 n) a * Real.sqrt (2*v/n) < radProc n a ω}
      ≤ Real.exp (-v) := by
  have hn' : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  set D := dist (0 : EmpL2 n) a with hD
  have hD0 : 0 ≤ D := dist_nonneg
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hD0 with h0 | hpos
  · have hsum : (∑ i, (a i)^2) = 0 := by rw [sum_sq_eq hn a, ← hD, ← h0]; ring
    have ha : ∀ i, a i = 0 := by
      intro i
      have := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun i _ => sq_nonneg (a i))).mp hsum i (Finset.mem_univ i)
      exact pow_eq_zero_iff (n := 2) (by norm_num) |>.mp this
    have : {ω : Fin n → ℝ | D * Real.sqrt (2*v/n) < radProc n a ω} = ∅ := by
      ext ω; simp [radProc, ha, ← h0]
    rw [this]; simp [Real.exp_nonneg]
  · have hsub : {ω : Fin n → ℝ | D * Real.sqrt (2*v/n) < radProc n a ω}
        ⊆ {ω : Fin n → ℝ | D * Real.sqrt (2*v/n) ≤ ∑ i, (a i / n) * ω i} := by
      intro ω hω
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hω ⊢
      have hr : radProc n a ω = ∑ i, (a i / n) * ω i := by
        rw [radProc, Finset.mul_sum]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring
      rw [hr] at hω; exact hω.le
    have hε : 0 ≤ D * Real.sqrt (2*v/n) := by positivity
    refine (measureReal_mono hsub (measure_ne_top _ _)).trans ?_
    have key := ProbabilityTheory.HasSubgaussianMGF.measure_sum_ge_le_of_iIndepFun
      (indep_coords n (fun i => a i / n)) (c := fun i => ‖a i / (n:ℝ)‖₊^2)
      (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => coord_subG n (a i / n) i) hε
    refine key.trans_eq ?_
    congr 1
    have hcsum : ((∑ i, ‖a i / (n:ℝ)‖₊^2 : NNReal) : ℝ) = D^2 / n := by
      push_cast
      have hh : ∀ i : Fin n, ‖a i / (n:ℝ)‖^2 = (a i)^2 / (n:ℝ)^2 := by
        intro i; rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, div_pow]
      simp only [hh]
      rw [← Finset.sum_div, sum_sq_eq hn a]
      field_simp
      exact congrArg (· ^ 2) hD.symm
    rw [hcsum]
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    field_simp

lemma rad_neg : rad.map (fun x : ℝ => -x) = rad := by
  rw [rad, Measure.map_smul, Measure.map_add _ _ (by fun_prop),
    Measure.map_dirac (by fun_prop), Measure.map_dirac (by fun_prop)]
  norm_num
  rw [add_comm]

lemma radP_neg (n : ℕ) : (radP n).map (fun ω : Fin n → ℝ => -ω) = radP n := by
  unfold radP
  rw [show (fun ω : Fin n → ℝ => -ω) = (fun (x : Fin n → ℝ) i => (fun (y:ℝ) => -y) (x i)) from rfl]
  rw [Measure.pi_map_pi (fun i => (by fun_prop : AEMeasurable (fun y : ℝ => -y) rad))]
  simp [rad_neg]

lemma symm_half (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    (radP n).real {ω | t < radProc n a ω} ≤ 1/2 := by
  have hcont : Continuous (fun ω : Fin n → ℝ => radProc n a ω) := by
    unfold radProc; fun_prop
  set S : Set (Fin n → ℝ) := {ω | 0 < radProc n a ω} with hS
  set S' : Set (Fin n → ℝ) := {ω | radProc n a ω < 0} with hS'
  have hSm : MeasurableSet S := measurableSet_lt measurable_const hcont.measurable
  have hS'm : MeasurableSet S' := measurableSet_lt hcont.measurable measurable_const
  have hneg : ∀ ω : Fin n → ℝ, radProc n a (-ω) = - radProc n a ω := by
    intro ω
    simp only [radProc, Pi.neg_apply, neg_mul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, mul_neg]
  have hpre : (fun ω : Fin n → ℝ => -ω) ⁻¹' S = S' := by
    ext ω
    simp only [hS, hS', Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_setOf_eq, hneg]
    constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith
  have heq : radP n S' = radP n S := by
    rw [← hpre, ← Measure.map_apply (by fun_prop) hSm, radP_neg]
  have hdisj : Disjoint S S' := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]; intro ω h1 h2; simp only [hS, hS', Set.mem_setOf_eq] at h1 h2; linarith
  have hle : (radP n).real S + (radP n).real S' ≤ 1 := by
    rw [← measureReal_union hdisj hS'm]
    have := measureReal_mono (μ := radP n) (Set.subset_univ (S ∪ S')) (measure_ne_top (radP n) _)
    simpa using this
  have heqr : (radP n).real S' = (radP n).real S := by
    unfold Measure.real; rw [heq]
  rw [heqr] at hle
  have hsub : {ω : Fin n → ℝ | t < radProc n a ω} ⊆ S := fun ω hω => lt_of_le_of_lt ht hω
  refine (measureReal_mono hsub (measure_ne_top _ _)).trans ?_
  linarith

end Prob

/- ###################################################################### -/
/-  Part 4 : packing numbers                                             -/
/- ###################################################################### -/

section Packing
variable {A : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace A]

lemma untopD_coe_eq (x : ℕ∞) (h : x ≠ ⊤) : ((x.untopD 0 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) = x := by
  lift x to ℕ using h; simp

lemma card_le_packing {t : Finset A} {eps : ℝ} {s : Set A} (h : IsPacking t eps s) :
    (t.card : ℕ∞) ≤ packingNumber eps s :=
  le_sSup ⟨t, h, rfl⟩

lemma card_le_packNat {t : Finset A} {eps : ℝ} {s : Set A} (h : IsPacking t eps s)
    (hfin : packingNumber eps s ≠ ⊤) : t.card ≤ (packingNumber eps s).untopD 0 := by
  have := card_le_packing h
  rw [← untopD_coe_eq _ hfin] at this
  exact_mod_cast this

lemma exists_max_packing {eps : ℝ} {s : Set A} (hfin : packingNumber eps s ≠ ⊤) :
    ∃ t : Finset A, IsPacking t eps s ∧ t.card = (packingNumber eps s).untopD 0 := by
  set N := (packingNumber eps s).untopD 0 with hN
  by_contra hc
  push_neg at hc
  have hlt : ∀ t : Finset A, IsPacking t eps s → (t.card : ℕ∞) ≤ ((N - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
    intro t ht
    have h1 : t.card ≤ N := card_le_packNat ht hfin
    have h2 : t.card ≠ N := hc t ht
    have : t.card ≤ N - 1 := Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_ne h1 h2)
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hsup : packingNumber eps s ≤ ((N - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
    apply sSup_le
    rintro x ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    exact hlt t ht
  rw [← untopD_coe_eq _ hfin, ← hN] at hsup
  have hNle : N ≤ N - 1 := by exact_mod_cast hsup
  have hN0 : N = 0 := by omega
  exact hc ∅ ⟨by simp, by simp⟩ (by simp [hN0])

/-- A packing of maximum cardinality is a net. -/
lemma max_packing_isNet {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 ≤ eps) {s : Set A} (hfin : packingNumber eps s ≠ ⊤)
    {t : Finset A} (ht : IsPacking t eps s) (hcard : t.card = (packingNumber eps s).untopD 0) :
    ∀ f ∈ s, ∃ g ∈ t, dist f g ≤ eps := by
  classical
  intro f hf
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  have hfnot : f ∉ t := by
    intro hft
    have h2 := hcon f hft
    rw [dist_self] at h2
    linarith
  have hins : IsPacking (insert f t) eps s := by
    constructor
    · rw [Finset.coe_insert]; exact Set.insert_subset hf ht.1
    · rw [Finset.coe_insert]
      intro x hx y hy hxy
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Finset.mem_coe] at hx hy
      rcases hx with rfl | hx
      · rcases hy with rfl | hy
        · exact absurd rfl hxy
        · exact hcon y hy
      · rcases hy with rfl | hy
        · rw [dist_comm]; exact hcon x hx
        · exact ht.2 (by simpa using hx) (by simpa using hy) hxy
  have := card_le_packNat hins hfin
  rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hfnot, hcard] at this
  omega

/-- packing numbers are antitone in the scale -/
lemma packing_antitone {eps eps' : ℝ} (h : eps ≤ eps') (s : Set A) :
    packingNumber eps' s ≤ packingNumber eps s := by
  apply sSup_le
  rintro x ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
  exact le_sSup ⟨t, ⟨ht.1, fun a ha b hb hab => lt_of_le_of_lt h (ht.2 ha hb hab)⟩, rfl⟩

end Packing

/- ###################################################################### -/
/-  Part 5 : elementary facts about `radProc`                            -/
/- ###################################################################### -/

section RadProc
variable {n : ℕ}

lemma radProc_sub (a b : Fin n → ℝ) (ω : Fin n → ℝ) :
    radProc n (a - b) ω = radProc n a ω - radProc n b ω := by
  simp only [radProc, Pi.sub_apply, mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, mul_sub]

lemma dist_zero_sub (a b : Fin n → ℝ) :
    dist (0 : EmpL2 n) (show EmpL2 n from a - b)
      = dist (show EmpL2 n from a) (show EmpL2 n from b) := by
  rw [dist_eq', dist_eq']
  congr 1
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  have h : (((0 : EmpL2 n) : Fin n → ℝ) i - (a - b) i) = -(a i - b i) := by
    show (0:ℝ) - (a i - b i) = -(a i - b i); ring
  rw [h, neg_div, neg_pow]
  simp

lemma radProc_le_dist (hn : 0 < n) (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ω : Fin n → ℝ) (hω : ∀ i, |ω i| ≤ 1) :
    radProc n a ω ≤ dist (0 : EmpL2 n) a := by
  have hn' : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  set D := dist (0 : EmpL2 n) a with hDdef
  have hD0 : 0 ≤ D := dist_nonneg
  have hcs := Real.sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt Finset.univ ω a
  have h1 : (∑ i : Fin n, (ω i)^2) ≤ (n:ℝ) := by
    have hb : ∀ i : Fin n, (ω i)^2 ≤ (1:ℝ) := by
      intro i
      have := abs_le.mp (hω i)
      nlinarith [this.1, this.2]
    calc (∑ i : Fin n, (ω i)^2) ≤ ∑ _i : Fin n, (1:ℝ) := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hb i)
      _ = (n:ℝ) := by simp
  have h2 : (∑ i : Fin n, (a i)^2) = (n:ℝ) * D^2 := sum_sq_eq hn a
  have h3 : Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin n, (ω i)^2) ≤ Real.sqrt n := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h1
  have h4 : Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin n, (a i)^2) = Real.sqrt n * D := by
    rw [h2, Real.sqrt_mul hn'.le, Real.sqrt_sq hD0]
  have h6 : Real.sqrt n * Real.sqrt n = (n:ℝ) := Real.mul_self_sqrt hn'.le
  have h5 : (∑ i : Fin n, ω i * a i) ≤ (n:ℝ) * D := by
    refine hcs.trans ?_
    rw [h4]
    calc Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin n, (ω i)^2) * (Real.sqrt n * D)
        ≤ Real.sqrt n * (Real.sqrt n * D) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h3 (by positivity)
      _ = (n:ℝ) * D := by rw [← mul_assoc, h6]
  rw [radProc, one_div]
  calc (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * (∑ i, ω i * a i) ≤ (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * ((n:ℝ) * D) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h5 (by positivity)
    _ = D := by field_simp

end RadProc

/- ###################################################################### -/
/-  Part 6 : a convergent series bound                                   -/
/- ###################################################################### -/

/-- `Wser m = ∑_{p=2}^m p⁻³`. -/
def Wser (m : ℕ) : ℝ := ∑ p ∈ Finset.Ioc 1 m, (1:ℝ)/(p:ℝ)^3

lemma Wser_nonneg (m : ℕ) : 0 ≤ Wser m :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => by positivity

lemma Wser_mono {a b : ℕ} (h : a ≤ b) : Wser a ≤ Wser b := by
  unfold Wser
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.Ioc_subset_Ioc_right h) ?_
  intro i _ _; positivity

lemma Wser_succ (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) : Wser (m+1) = Wser m + 1/((m:ℝ)+1)^3 := by
  unfold Wser
  rw [← Finset.sum_Ioc_consecutive _ hm (Nat.le_succ m)]
  congr 1
  rw [show Finset.Ioc m (m+1) = {m+1} from by ext x; simp only [Finset.mem_Ioc, Finset.mem_singleton]; omega]
  push_cast
  simp

lemma Wser_le (m : ℕ) : Wser m ≤ 5/24 := by
  rcases le_or_gt m 1 with h | h
  · have he : Finset.Ioc 1 m = (∅ : Finset ℕ) := by
      rw [Finset.Ioc_eq_empty]; omega
    simp only [Wser, he, Finset.sum_empty]
    norm_num
  · have key : ∀ m : ℕ, 2 ≤ m → Wser m ≤ 5/24 - 1/(2*(m:ℝ)*((m:ℝ)+1)) := by
      intro m hm
      induction m, hm using Nat.le_induction with
      | base =>
        rw [show Wser 2 = 1/8 from by
          unfold Wser
          rw [show Finset.Ioc 1 2 = ({2} : Finset ℕ) from by ext x; simp only [Finset.mem_Ioc, Finset.mem_singleton]; omega]
          norm_num]
        norm_num
      | succ m hm ih =>
        have hm' : (2:ℝ) ≤ (m:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm
        have hmpos : (0:ℝ) < (m:ℝ) := by linarith
        rw [Wser_succ m (by omega)]
        have e1 : 1/(2*(m:ℝ)*((m:ℝ)+1)) - 1/(2*((m:ℝ)+1)*((m:ℝ)+1+1))
            = 1/((m:ℝ)*((m:ℝ)+1)*((m:ℝ)+2)) := by
          field_simp; ring
        have e2 : 1/((m:ℝ)+1)^3 ≤ 1/((m:ℝ)*((m:ℝ)+1)*((m:ℝ)+2)) := by
          refine one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) ?_
          nlinarith
        push_cast
        linarith [ih]
    have hge : 0 < 1/(2*(m:ℝ)*((m:ℝ)+1)) := by
      have : (0:ℝ) < (m:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one h.le
      positivity
    linarith [key m h]

lemma Wser_diff_ge {a b : ℕ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hab : a < b) :
    (1:ℝ)/(b:ℝ)^3 ≤ Wser b - Wser a := by
  have hsplit : Wser a + ∑ p ∈ Finset.Ioc a b, (1:ℝ)/(p:ℝ)^3 = Wser b := by
    unfold Wser
    exact Finset.sum_Ioc_consecutive _ ha hab.le
  have hmem : b ∈ Finset.Ioc a b := by simp [hab]
  have := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun p : ℕ => (1:ℝ)/(p:ℝ)^3)
    (fun i _ => by positivity) hmem
  linarith

/- ###################################################################### -/
/-  Part 7 : a coherent family of maximal packings ("nets")              -/
/- ###################################################################### -/

section Nets
variable {A : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace A]

lemma half_pow_le {i j : ℕ} (h : i ≤ j) : (1/2:ℝ)^j ≤ (1/2:ℝ)^i := by
  exact pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) h

lemma exists_nets (s : Set A) (hfin : ∀ j : ℕ, packingNumber ((1/2:ℝ)^j) s ≠ ⊤) :
    ∃ T : ℕ → Finset A,
      (∀ j, (T j).card = (packingNumber ((1/2:ℝ)^j) s).untopD 0) ∧
      (∀ j, ∀ f ∈ s, ∃ g ∈ T j, dist f g ≤ (1/2:ℝ)^j) ∧
      (∀ j, (packingNumber ((1/2:ℝ)^(j+1)) s).untopD 0
              = (packingNumber ((1/2:ℝ)^j) s).untopD 0 → T (j+1) = T j) := by
  classical
  choose t ht hcard using fun j : ℕ => exists_max_packing (hfin j)
  set N : ℕ → ℕ := fun j => (packingNumber ((1/2:ℝ)^j) s).untopD 0 with hN
  refine ⟨fun j => Nat.rec (t 0) (fun i prev => if N (i+1) = N i then prev else t (i+1)) j,
    ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => exact hcard 0
    | succ i ih =>
      show (if N (i+1) = N i then _ else t (i+1)).card = N (i+1)
      by_cases h : N (i+1) = N i
      · rw [if_pos h, ih, h]
      · rw [if_neg h]; exact hcard (i+1)
  · -- net property
    intro j
    have hpack : ∀ j : ℕ, IsPacking
        (Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => Finset A) (t 0)
          (fun i prev => if N (i+1) = N i then prev else t (i+1)) j) ((1/2:ℝ)^j) s := by
      intro j
      induction j with
      | zero => exact ht 0
      | succ i ih =>
        show IsPacking (if N (i+1) = N i then _ else t (i+1)) _ _
        by_cases h : N (i+1) = N i
        · rw [if_pos h]
          exact ⟨ih.1, fun x hx y hy hxy =>
            lt_of_le_of_lt (half_pow_le (Nat.le_succ i)) (ih.2 hx hy hxy)⟩
        · rw [if_neg h]; exact ht (i+1)
    have hcd : ∀ j : ℕ, (Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => Finset A) (t 0)
          (fun i prev => if N (i+1) = N i then prev else t (i+1)) j).card = N j := by
      intro j
      induction j with
      | zero => exact hcard 0
      | succ i ih =>
        show (if N (i+1) = N i then _ else t (i+1)).card = N (i+1)
        by_cases h : N (i+1) = N i
        · rw [if_pos h, ih, h]
        · rw [if_neg h]; exact hcard (i+1)
    exact max_packing_isNet (by positivity) (hfin j) (hpack j) (hcd j)
  · intro j hj
    show (if N (j+1) = N j then _ else t (j+1)) = _
    rw [if_pos hj]

end Nets

/- ###################################################################### -/
/-  Part 8 : nearest–point projection onto a finite set                  -/
/- ###################################################################### -/

def nearest {A : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace A] (T : Finset A) (f : A) : A :=
  if h : T.Nonempty then Classical.choose (T.exists_min_image (dist f) h) else f

lemma nearest_mem {A : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace A] {T : Finset A} (h : T.Nonempty) (f : A) :
    nearest T f ∈ T := by
  unfold nearest; rw [dif_pos h]
  exact (Classical.choose_spec (T.exists_min_image (dist f) h)).1

lemma nearest_le {A : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace A] {T : Finset A} (h : T.Nonempty) (f : A) :
    ∀ g ∈ T, dist f (nearest T f) ≤ dist f g := by
  unfold nearest; rw [dif_pos h]
  exact (Classical.choose_spec (T.exists_min_image (dist f) h)).2

/- ###################################################################### -/
/-  Part 9 : lower bound of an integral by a dyadic sum                  -/
/- ###################################################################### -/

lemma integral_ge_dyadic_sum {φ : ℝ → ℝ} {D : ℝ}
    (hphi0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x)
    (hint : IntervalIntegrable φ MeasureTheory.volume 0 D)
    (c : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hmono : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc ((1/2:ℝ)^(m+1)) ((1/2:ℝ)^m), c m ≤ φ x)
    (k J : ℕ) (hkJ : k ≤ J) (hk : (1/2:ℝ)^k ≤ D) :
    ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc k J, (1/2:ℝ)^(m+1) * c m ≤ ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..D, φ x := by
  have hD : 0 ≤ D := le_trans (by positivity) hk
  have hsub : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ y → y ≤ D → IntervalIntegrable φ MeasureTheory.volume x y := by
    intro x y hx hxy hy
    refine hint.mono_set ?_
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hxy, Set.uIcc_of_le hD]
    exact Set.Icc_subset_Icc hx hy
  have hpow_le : ∀ m : ℕ, (1/2:ℝ)^(m+1) ≤ (1/2:ℝ)^m := fun m => half_pow_le (Nat.le_succ m)
  have hpow_leD : ∀ m : ℕ, k ≤ m → (1/2:ℝ)^m ≤ D := fun m hm =>
    le_trans (half_pow_le hm) hk
  -- one step
  have hstep : ∀ m : ℕ, k ≤ m → (1/2:ℝ)^(m+1) * c m
      ≤ ∫ x in ((1/2:ℝ)^(m+1))..((1/2:ℝ)^m), φ x := by
    intro m hm
    have hii : IntervalIntegrable φ MeasureTheory.volume ((1/2:ℝ)^(m+1)) ((1/2:ℝ)^m) :=
      hsub _ _ (by positivity) (hpow_le m) (hpow_leD m hm)
    have h1 : (∫ x in ((1/2:ℝ)^(m+1))..((1/2:ℝ)^m), c m)
        ≤ ∫ x in ((1/2:ℝ)^(m+1))..((1/2:ℝ)^m), φ x := by
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (hpow_le m) intervalIntegrable_const hii ?_
      intro x hx
      exact hmono m x hx
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const] at h1
    have : (1/2:ℝ)^m - (1/2:ℝ)^(m+1) = (1/2:ℝ)^(m+1) := by ring
    simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h1
    rw [this] at h1
    exact h1
  -- the telescoped sum
  have main : ∀ J : ℕ, k ≤ J →
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc k J, (1/2:ℝ)^(m+1) * c m
        ≤ ∫ x in ((1/2:ℝ)^(J+1))..((1/2:ℝ)^k), φ x := by
    intro J hJ
    induction J, hJ using Nat.le_induction with
    | base =>
      rw [Finset.Icc_self, Finset.sum_singleton]
      exact hstep k le_rfl
    | succ J hJ ih =>
      have hsplit : ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc k (J+1), (1/2:ℝ)^(m+1) * c m
          = (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc k J, (1/2:ℝ)^(m+1) * c m) + (1/2:ℝ)^(J+1+1) * c (J+1) :=
        Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega) _
      rw [hsplit]
      have hadj : (∫ x in ((1/2:ℝ)^(J+1+1))..((1/2:ℝ)^(J+1)), φ x)
          + (∫ x in ((1/2:ℝ)^(J+1))..((1/2:ℝ)^k), φ x)
          = ∫ x in ((1/2:ℝ)^(J+1+1))..((1/2:ℝ)^k), φ x := by
        refine intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
          (hsub _ _ (by positivity) (hpow_le (J+1)) (hpow_leD (J+1) (by omega)))
          (hsub _ _ (by positivity) (half_pow_le (by omega)) (hpow_leD k le_rfl))
      have := hstep (J+1) (by omega)
      linarith [ih, hadj]
  refine le_trans (main J hkJ) ?_
  -- extend the integral to [0, D]
  have e1 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..((1/2:ℝ)^(J+1)), φ x) + (∫ x in ((1/2:ℝ)^(J+1))..D, φ x)
      = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..D, φ x :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
      (hsub _ _ le_rfl (by positivity) (le_trans (half_pow_le (by omega : k ≤ J+1)) hk))
      (hsub _ _ (by positivity) (le_trans (half_pow_le (by omega : k ≤ J+1)) hk) le_rfl)
  have e2 : (∫ x in ((1/2:ℝ)^(J+1))..((1/2:ℝ)^k), φ x) + (∫ x in ((1/2:ℝ)^k)..D, φ x)
      = ∫ x in ((1/2:ℝ)^(J+1))..D, φ x :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
      (hsub _ _ (by positivity) (half_pow_le (by omega : k ≤ J+1)) (hpow_leD k le_rfl))
      (hsub _ _ (by positivity) (hpow_leD k le_rfl) le_rfl)
  have p1 : 0 ≤ ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..((1/2:ℝ)^(J+1)), φ x :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by positivity) (fun x _ => hphi0 x)
  have p2 : 0 ≤ ∫ x in ((1/2:ℝ)^k)..D, φ x :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (hpow_leD k le_rfl) (fun x _ => hphi0 x)
  linarith

/- ###################################################################### -/
/-  Part 10 : a `tsum` helper                                            -/
/- ###################################################################### -/

lemma tsum_le_of_partial_sums {c : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞} {B : ℝ≥0∞}
    (h : ∀ M : ℕ, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range M, c i ≤ B) : ∑' i, c i ≤ B := by
  rw [ENNReal.tsum_eq_iSup_sum]
  refine iSup_le fun s => ?_
  have hsub : s ⊆ Finset.range (s.sup id + 1) := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_range]
    have hle : id x ≤ s.sup id := Finset.le_sup hx
    simpa using Nat.lt_succ_of_le hle
  exact le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset hsub) (h _)

lemma sqrt_add_le_add {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    Real.sqrt (a + b) ≤ Real.sqrt a + Real.sqrt b := by
  have key : a + b ≤ (Real.sqrt a + Real.sqrt b)^2 := by
    have h1 : Real.sqrt a ^ 2 = a := Real.sq_sqrt ha
    have h2 : Real.sqrt b ^ 2 = b := Real.sq_sqrt hb
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg a, Real.sqrt_nonneg b]
  calc Real.sqrt (a+b) ≤ Real.sqrt ((Real.sqrt a + Real.sqrt b)^2) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt key
    _ = Real.sqrt a + Real.sqrt b := Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)

lemma two_rpow_92 : (2:ℝ)^(9/2:ℝ) = 16 * Real.sqrt 2 := by
  rw [show (9/2:ℝ) = 4 + 1/2 by norm_num, Real.rpow_add (by norm_num)]
  rw [show (4:ℝ) = ((4:ℕ):ℝ) by norm_num, Real.rpow_natCast]
  rw [← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
  norm_num

lemma two_rpow_72 : (2:ℝ)^(7/2:ℝ) = 8 * Real.sqrt 2 := by
  rw [show (7/2:ℝ) = 3 + 1/2 by norm_num, Real.rpow_add (by norm_num)]
  rw [show (3:ℝ) = ((3:ℕ):ℝ) by norm_num, Real.rpow_natCast]
  rw [← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
  norm_num

lemma sqrt_two_v {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {a b u L : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    Real.sqrt (2 * (a*u + b*L) / n)
      ≤ Real.sqrt (2*a) * Real.sqrt (u/n) + Real.sqrt (2*b) * (Real.sqrt L / Real.sqrt n) := by
  have hn' : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hsplit : 2 * (a*u + b*L) / n = (2*a) * (u/n) + (2*b) * (L/n) := by field_simp; try ring
  have e1 : Real.sqrt ((2*a) * (u/(n:ℝ))) = Real.sqrt (2*a) * Real.sqrt (u/n) :=
    Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity) _
  have e2 : Real.sqrt ((2*b) * (L/(n:ℝ))) = Real.sqrt (2*b) * (Real.sqrt L / Real.sqrt n) := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity), Real.sqrt_div hL]
  rw [hsplit]
  refine (sqrt_add_le_add (by positivity) (by positivity)).trans ?_
  rw [e1, e2]

lemma sqrt8_eq : Real.sqrt 8 = 2 * Real.sqrt 2 := by
  rw [show (8:ℝ) = 2^2*2 by norm_num, Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity), Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)]

lemma five_sqrt5_le : 5*Real.sqrt 5 ≤ 8*Real.sqrt 2 := by
  have h5 : Real.sqrt 5 ^2 = 5 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  have h2 : Real.sqrt 2 ^2 = 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg 5, Real.sqrt_nonneg 2]

lemma six_sqrt14_le : 6*Real.sqrt 14 ≤ 16*Real.sqrt 2 := by
  have h14 : Real.sqrt 14 ^2 = 14 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  have h2 : Real.sqrt 2 ^2 = 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg 14, Real.sqrt_nonneg 2]

lemma sqrt_vS {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {u L : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hL : 0 ≤ L) :
    Real.sqrt (2 * ((5/2)*u + 4*L) / n)
      ≤ Real.sqrt 5 * Real.sqrt (u/n) + 2*Real.sqrt 2 * (Real.sqrt L / Real.sqrt n) := by
  have h := sqrt_two_v hn (a := 5/2) (b := 4) hu hL (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have e1 : Real.sqrt (2*(5/2:ℝ)) = Real.sqrt 5 := by norm_num
  have e2 : Real.sqrt (2*(4:ℝ)) = 2*Real.sqrt 2 := by
    rw [show (2:ℝ)*4 = 8 by norm_num]; exact sqrt8_eq
  rw [e1, e2] at h
  exact h

lemma sqrt_vL {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {u L : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hL : 0 ≤ L) :
    Real.sqrt (2 * ((5/2)*u + 7*L) / n)
      ≤ Real.sqrt 5 * Real.sqrt (u/n) + Real.sqrt 14 * (Real.sqrt L / Real.sqrt n) := by
  have h := sqrt_two_v hn (a := 5/2) (b := 7) hu hL (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have e1 : Real.sqrt (2*(5/2:ℝ)) = Real.sqrt 5 := by norm_num
  have e2 : Real.sqrt (2*(7:ℝ)) = Real.sqrt 14 := by norm_num
  rw [e1, e2] at h
  exact h

/- ###################################################################### -/
/-  Part 12 : the theorem                                                -/
/- ###################################################################### -/

set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000 in
theorem ch14_theorem_14_1
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (P : Measure (Fin n → ℝ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (hP : P = Measure.pi
        (fun _ : Fin n => ((1 : ℝ≥0∞) / 2) • (Measure.dirac (-1 : ℝ) + Measure.dirac 1)))
    (F : Set (EmpL2 n))
    (hFbdd : ∀ f ∈ F, ∀ i, |(f : Fin n → ℝ) i| ≤ 1)
    (hFin : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → packingNumber ε F ≠ ⊤)
    (hD : ∀ f ∈ F, ∀ ε ∈ Set.Ioo (0:ℝ) (dist (0 : EmpL2 n) f),
        (1 : ℝ) ≤ (((packingNumber ε F).untopD 0 : ℕ) : ℝ))
    (hInt : ∀ f ∈ F, IntervalIntegrable
        (fun ε => Real.sqrt (Real.log (((packingNumber ε F).untopD 0 : ℕ) : ℝ)))
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 (dist (0 : EmpL2 n) f))
    (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 < u) :
    (1 : ℝ) - Real.exp (-u) ≤
      (P {ω | ∀ f ∈ F, radProc n (f : Fin n → ℝ) ω ≤
          (2 ^ (9/2 : ℝ) / Real.sqrt n) *
            (∫ ε in (0:ℝ)..(dist (0 : EmpL2 n) f),
                Real.sqrt (Real.log (((packingNumber ε F).untopD 0 : ℕ) : ℝ)))
          + 2 ^ (7/2 : ℝ) * dist (0 : EmpL2 n) f * Real.sqrt (u / n)}).toReal := by
  classical
  have hn' : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hPeq : P = radP n := hP
  rw [hPeq]
  obtain ⟨Gset, hGset⟩ : ∃ G : Set (Fin n → ℝ), G =
      {ω | ∀ f ∈ F, radProc n (f : Fin n → ℝ) ω ≤
          (2 ^ (9/2 : ℝ) / Real.sqrt n) *
            (∫ ε in (0:ℝ)..(dist (0 : EmpL2 n) f),
                Real.sqrt (Real.log (((packingNumber ε F).untopD 0 : ℕ) : ℝ)))
          + 2 ^ (7/2 : ℝ) * dist (0 : EmpL2 n) f * Real.sqrt (u / n)} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hGset]
  rcases Set.eq_empty_or_nonempty F with hFe | hFne
  · have hsu : Gset = Set.univ := by rw [hGset]; ext ω; simp [hFe]
    rw [hsu, measure_univ]
    simp only [ENNReal.toReal_one]
    linarith [Real.exp_pos (-u)]
  -- ###  the real work  ###
  have hfin : ∀ j : ℕ, packingNumber ((1/2:ℝ)^j) F ≠ ⊤ := fun j => hFin _ (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨T, hTcard, hTnet, hTstab⟩ := exists_nets F hfin
  obtain ⟨N, hNdef⟩ : ∃ N : ℕ → ℕ, ∀ j, N j = (packingNumber ((1/2:ℝ)^j) F).untopD 0 :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hTcard' : ∀ j, (T j).card = N j := by intro j; rw [hNdef]; exact hTcard j
  have hN1 : ∀ j, 1 ≤ N j := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨f0, hf0⟩ := hFne
    have hpk : IsPacking ({f0} : Finset (EmpL2 n)) ((1/2:ℝ)^j) F := by
      refine ⟨by simpa using hf0, ?_⟩
      intro x hx y hy hxy
      simp only [Finset.coe_singleton, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx hy
      exact absurd (hx.trans hy.symm) hxy
    have := card_le_packNat hpk (hfin j)
    rw [← hNdef] at this
    simpa using this
  have hNmono : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → N i ≤ N j := by
    intro i j hij
    have h1 := packing_antitone (half_pow_le hij) F
    rw [← untopD_coe_eq _ (hfin i), ← untopD_coe_eq _ (hfin j), ← hNdef, ← hNdef] at h1
    exact_mod_cast h1
  have hTne : ∀ j, (T j).Nonempty := by
    intro j; rw [← Finset.card_pos, hTcard' j]; exact hN1 j
  have hlogN : ∀ j, 0 ≤ Real.log (N j) := by
    intro j
    apply Real.log_nonneg
    exact_mod_cast hN1 j
  -- the events
  obtain ⟨Ev, hEv⟩ : ∃ Ev : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ → Set (Fin n → ℝ),
      ∀ a v, Ev a v = {ω | dist (0:EmpL2 n) a * Real.sqrt (2*v/n) < radProc n a ω} :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨vS, hvS⟩ : ∃ vS : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ i, vS i = (5/2)*u + 4 * Real.log (N i) := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨vL, hvL⟩ : ∃ vL : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ i, vL i = (5/2)*u + 7 * Real.log (N i) := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hvS0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ vS i := by
    intro i; rw [hvS]; have := hlogN i; linarith
  have hvL0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ vL i := by
    intro i; rw [hvL]; have := hlogN i; linarith
  obtain ⟨BadS, hBadS⟩ : ∃ BadS : ℕ → Set (Fin n → ℝ), ∀ i, BadS i =
      if (0 < i ∧ N i = N (i-1)) then ∅ else ⋃ h ∈ T i, Ev (h : Fin n → ℝ) (vS i) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨BadL, hBadL⟩ : ∃ BadL : ℕ → Set (Fin n → ℝ), ∀ j, BadL j =
      if N (j+1) = N j then ∅
      else ⋃ g ∈ T j, ⋃ h ∈ T (j+1), Ev ((show Fin n → ℝ from h) - (show Fin n → ℝ from g)) (vL (j+1)) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Wset, hWset⟩ : ∃ W : Set (Fin n → ℝ), W = {ω | ∀ i, |ω i| ≤ 1} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Bad, hBad⟩ : ∃ B : Set (Fin n → ℝ), B = (⋃ i, BadS i) ∪ (⋃ j, BadL j) ∪ Wsetᶜ :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  -- ###  Claim A : Bad ᶜ ⊆ Gset  ###
  have claimA : Badᶜ ⊆ Gset := by
    intro ω hω
    rw [hBad] at hω
    simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_union, not_or] at hω
    obtain ⟨⟨hωS, hωL⟩, hωW⟩ := hω
    have hωW' : ∀ i, |ω i| ≤ 1 := by
      have hmem : ω ∈ Wset := not_not.mp hωW
      rw [hWset] at hmem; exact hmem
    have hEvnot : ∀ (a : Fin n → ℝ) (v : ℝ), ω ∉ Ev a v →
        radProc n a ω ≤ dist (0:EmpL2 n) a * Real.sqrt (2*v/n) := by
      intro a v h
      rw [hEv] at h
      simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_lt] using h
    -- the "start" bound holds at every level
    have hstart : ∀ i, ∀ h ∈ T i, radProc n (show Fin n → ℝ from h) ω
        ≤ dist (0:EmpL2 n) (show Fin n → ℝ from h) * Real.sqrt (2 * vS i / n) := by
      intro i
      induction i with
      | zero =>
        intro h hh
        have hnb : ω ∉ BadS 0 := fun hc => hωS (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨0, hc⟩)
        rw [hBadS, if_neg (by rintro ⟨hcc, -⟩; exact absurd hcc (lt_irrefl 0))] at hnb
        exact hEvnot _ _ (fun hc => hnb (Set.mem_biUnion hh hc))
      | succ i ih =>
        intro h hh
        by_cases hc : N (i+1) = N i
        · have hTeq : T (i+1) = T i := hTstab i (by rw [← hNdef, ← hNdef]; exact hc)
          have hvSeq : vS (i+1) = vS i := by rw [hvS, hvS, hc]
          rw [hvSeq]
          exact ih h (by rw [← hTeq]; exact hh)
        · have hnb : ω ∉ BadS (i+1) := fun hcc => hωS (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i+1, hcc⟩)
          rw [hBadS, if_neg (by rintro ⟨-, h2⟩; exact hc (by simpa using h2))] at hnb
          exact hEvnot _ _ (fun hc2 => hnb (Set.mem_biUnion hh hc2))
    rw [hGset]
    intro f hf
    obtain ⟨Df, hDf⟩ : ∃ d : ℝ, d = dist (0 : EmpL2 n) f := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hDf0 : 0 ≤ Df := by rw [hDf]; exact dist_nonneg
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hDf0 with hD0 | hDpos
    · -- degenerate case  f = 0
      have hsum : (∑ i, ((f : Fin n → ℝ) i)^2) = 0 := by
        rw [sum_sq_eq hn f, ← hDf, ← hD0]; ring
      have hfz : ∀ i, (f : Fin n → ℝ) i = 0 := by
        intro i
        have h2 := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
          (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) => sq_nonneg ((f : Fin n → ℝ) i))).mp hsum i
          (Finset.mem_univ i)
        exact pow_eq_zero_iff (n := 2) (by norm_num) |>.mp h2
      have hr0 : radProc n (f : Fin n → ℝ) ω = 0 := by
        simp [radProc, hfz]
      have hdd : dist (0 : EmpL2 n) f = 0 := by rw [← hDf, ← hD0]
      rw [hr0, hdd]
      simp
    · -- the main case
      have hDle1 : Df ≤ 1 := by
        have hsum : (∑ i : Fin n, ((f : Fin n → ℝ) i)^2) ≤ (n:ℝ) := by
          calc (∑ i : Fin n, ((f : Fin n → ℝ) i)^2) ≤ ∑ _i : Fin n, (1:ℝ) := by
                refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => ?_)
                have hb := abs_le.mp (hFbdd f hf i)
                nlinarith [hb.1, hb.2]
            _ = (n:ℝ) := by simp
        rw [sum_sq_eq hn f, ← hDf] at hsum
        have h2 : Df^2 ≤ 1 := by
          have h3 : (n:ℝ) * Df^2 ≤ (n:ℝ) * 1 := by linarith
          exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h3 hn'
        nlinarith [h2, hDf0]
      have hex : ∃ j : ℕ, (1/2:ℝ)^j ≤ Df := by
        obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hDpos (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
        exact ⟨j, hj.le⟩
      obtain ⟨k, hk1, hk2⟩ : ∃ k : ℕ, (1/2:ℝ)^k ≤ Df ∧ Df < 2 * (1/2:ℝ)^k := by
        refine ⟨Nat.find hex, Nat.find_spec hex, ?_⟩
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (Nat.find hex) with h0 | hpos
        · rw [h0]; norm_num; linarith
        · have hlt : ¬ ((1/2:ℝ)^(Nat.find hex - 1) ≤ Df) := Nat.find_min hex (by omega)
          push_neg at hlt
          have hkk : Nat.find hex - 1 + 1 = Nat.find hex := by omega
          have heq : (1/2:ℝ)^(Nat.find hex - 1) = 2 * (1/2:ℝ)^(Nat.find hex) := by
            conv_rhs => rw [← hkk]
            rw [pow_succ]; ring
          linarith
      obtain ⟨pi, hpi⟩ : ∃ p : ℕ → EmpL2 n, ∀ j, p j = nearest (T j) f := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
      have hpimem : ∀ j, pi j ∈ T j := by intro j; rw [hpi]; exact nearest_mem (hTne j) f
      have hpidist : ∀ j, dist f (pi j) ≤ (1/2:ℝ)^j := by
        intro j
        obtain ⟨g, hg, hgd⟩ := hTnet j f hf
        rw [hpi]
        exact le_trans (nearest_le (hTne j) f g hg) hgd
      -- the "link" bound
      have hlink : ∀ j, radProc n ((show Fin n → ℝ from pi (j+1)) -
            (show Fin n → ℝ from pi j)) ω
          ≤ dist (pi (j+1)) (pi j) * Real.sqrt (2 * vL (j+1) / n) := by
        intro j
        by_cases hc : N (j+1) = N j
        · have he : pi (j+1) = pi j := by
            rw [hpi, hpi, hTstab j (by rw [← hNdef, ← hNdef]; exact hc)]
          rw [he]
          have hz : (show Fin n → ℝ from pi j) - (show Fin n → ℝ from pi j)
              = (0 : Fin n → ℝ) := by ext i; simp
          rw [hz, show radProc n (0 : Fin n → ℝ) ω = 0 by simp [radProc]]
          exact mul_nonneg dist_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
        · have hnb : ω ∉ BadL j := fun hcc => hωL (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j, hcc⟩)
          rw [hBadL, if_neg hc] at hnb
          have hnotev : ω ∉ Ev ((show Fin n → ℝ from pi (j+1)) -
              (show Fin n → ℝ from pi j)) (vL (j+1)) := by
            intro hc2
            exact hnb (Set.mem_biUnion (hpimem j) (Set.mem_biUnion (hpimem (j+1)) hc2))
          have hres := hEvnot _ _ hnotev
          rwa [dist_zero_sub] at hres
      -- distances along the chain
      have hlinkdist : ∀ j, dist (pi (j+1)) (pi j) ≤ 3 * (1/2:ℝ)^(j+1) := by
        intro j
        have h1 := dist_triangle (pi (j+1)) f (pi j)
        have h2 : dist (pi (j+1)) f = dist f (pi (j+1)) := dist_comm _ _
        have h3 := hpidist (j+1)
        have h4 := hpidist j
        have h5 : (1/2:ℝ)^j = 2 * (1/2:ℝ)^(j+1) := by rw [pow_succ]; ring
        rw [h2] at h1
        linarith
      have hstartdist : dist (0 : EmpL2 n) (pi k) ≤ 2 * Df := by
        have h1 := dist_triangle (0 : EmpL2 n) f (pi k)
        rw [← hDf] at h1
        linarith [hpidist k, hk1]
      -- the chain bound
      obtain ⟨cb, hcb⟩ : ∃ cb : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ J, cb J =
          2*Real.sqrt 5 * Df * Real.sqrt (u/n)
          + (16*Real.sqrt 2/Real.sqrt n) *
              (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc k J, (1/2:ℝ)^(m+1) * Real.sqrt (Real.log ((N m : ℕ):ℝ)))
          + 3*Real.sqrt 5 * ((1/2:ℝ)^k - (1/2:ℝ)^J) * Real.sqrt (u/n) := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
      have hsqn : (0:ℝ) < Real.sqrt n := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hn'
      have hchain : ∀ J, k ≤ J → radProc n (show Fin n → ℝ from pi J) ω ≤ cb J := by
        intro J hJ
        induction J, hJ using Nat.le_induction with
        | base =>
          have h1 := hstart k (pi k) (hpimem k)
          have h2 : Real.sqrt (2 * vS k / n)
              ≤ Real.sqrt 5 * Real.sqrt (u/n)
                + 2*Real.sqrt 2 * (Real.sqrt (Real.log ((N k : ℕ):ℝ)) / Real.sqrt n) := by
            rw [hvS]
            exact sqrt_vS hn hu.le (hlogN k)
          have h3 : dist (0:EmpL2 n) (show Fin n → ℝ from pi k) * Real.sqrt (2 * vS k / n)
              ≤ (2*Df) * (Real.sqrt 5 * Real.sqrt (u/n)
                + 2*Real.sqrt 2 * (Real.sqrt (Real.log ((N k : ℕ):ℝ)) / Real.sqrt n)) := by
            refine mul_le_mul hstartdist h2 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (by linarith)
          have h4 : (2*Df) * (Real.sqrt 5 * Real.sqrt (u/n)
                + 2*Real.sqrt 2 * (Real.sqrt (Real.log ((N k : ℕ):ℝ)) / Real.sqrt n))
              ≤ cb k := by
            rw [hcb, Finset.Icc_self, Finset.sum_singleton]
            have hDf2 : Df ≤ 4 * (1/2:ℝ)^(k+1) := by
              have : (1/2:ℝ)^k = 2 * (1/2:ℝ)^(k+1) := by rw [pow_succ]; ring
              linarith
            have hL : (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (Real.log ((N k : ℕ):ℝ)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
            have hkey : 4*Real.sqrt 2 * Df * (Real.sqrt (Real.log ((N k : ℕ):ℝ)) / Real.sqrt n)
                ≤ (16*Real.sqrt 2/Real.sqrt n) *
                  ((1/2:ℝ)^(k+1) * Real.sqrt (Real.log ((N k : ℕ):ℝ))) := by
              have hQ : (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (Real.log ((N k : ℕ):ℝ)) / Real.sqrt n := by positivity
              have hco : 4*Real.sqrt 2 * Df ≤ 16*Real.sqrt 2 * (1/2:ℝ)^(k+1) := by
                nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg 2, hDf2]
              have hstep := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hco hQ
              have heq : (16*Real.sqrt 2 * (1/2:ℝ)^(k+1)) *
                  (Real.sqrt (Real.log ((N k : ℕ):ℝ)) / Real.sqrt n)
                  = (16*Real.sqrt 2/Real.sqrt n) *
                  ((1/2:ℝ)^(k+1) * Real.sqrt (Real.log ((N k : ℕ):ℝ))) := by
                field_simp; try ring
              rw [← heq]
              exact hstep
            nlinarith [hkey, Real.sqrt_nonneg 5, Real.sqrt_nonneg 2, hL]
          linarith
        | succ J hJ ih =>
          have hsplit : radProc n (show Fin n → ℝ from pi (J+1)) ω
              = radProc n (show Fin n → ℝ from pi J) ω
                + radProc n ((show Fin n → ℝ from pi (J+1)) -
                    (show Fin n → ℝ from pi J)) ω := by
            rw [radProc_sub]; ring
          have h1 := hlink J
          have h2 : Real.sqrt (2 * vL (J+1) / n)
              ≤ Real.sqrt 5 * Real.sqrt (u/n)
                + Real.sqrt 14 * (Real.sqrt (Real.log ((N (J+1) : ℕ):ℝ)) / Real.sqrt n) := by
            rw [hvL]
            exact sqrt_vL hn hu.le (hlogN (J+1))
          have h3 : dist (pi (J+1)) (pi J) * Real.sqrt (2 * vL (J+1) / n)
              ≤ (3*(1/2:ℝ)^(J+1)) * (Real.sqrt 5 * Real.sqrt (u/n)
                + Real.sqrt 14 * (Real.sqrt (Real.log ((N (J+1) : ℕ):ℝ)) / Real.sqrt n)) :=
            mul_le_mul (hlinkdist J) h2 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          have hIcc : (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc k (J+1), (1/2:ℝ)^(m+1) *
                Real.sqrt (Real.log ((N m : ℕ):ℝ)))
              = (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc k J, (1/2:ℝ)^(m+1) * Real.sqrt (Real.log ((N m : ℕ):ℝ)))
                + (1/2:ℝ)^(J+1+1) * Real.sqrt (Real.log ((N (J+1) : ℕ):ℝ)) :=
            Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega) _
          have hL : (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (Real.log ((N (J+1) : ℕ):ℝ)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
          have hkey : 3*Real.sqrt 14 * (1/2:ℝ)^(J+1) *
                (Real.sqrt (Real.log ((N (J+1) : ℕ):ℝ)) / Real.sqrt n)
              ≤ (16*Real.sqrt 2/Real.sqrt n) *
                ((1/2:ℝ)^(J+1+1) * Real.sqrt (Real.log ((N (J+1) : ℕ):ℝ))) := by
            have hQ : (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (Real.log ((N (J+1) : ℕ):ℝ)) / Real.sqrt n := by
              positivity
            have hp : (1/2:ℝ)^(J+1) = 2 * (1/2:ℝ)^(J+1+1) := by rw [pow_succ]; ring
            have hco : 3*Real.sqrt 14 * (1/2:ℝ)^(J+1)
                ≤ 16*Real.sqrt 2 * (1/2:ℝ)^(J+1+1) := by
              rw [hp]
              nlinarith [six_sqrt14_le, pow_pos (show (0:ℝ) < 1/2 by norm_num) (J+1+1)]
            have hstep := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hco hQ
            have heq : (16*Real.sqrt 2 * (1/2:ℝ)^(J+1+1)) *
                (Real.sqrt (Real.log ((N (J+1) : ℕ):ℝ)) / Real.sqrt n)
                = (16*Real.sqrt 2/Real.sqrt n) *
                ((1/2:ℝ)^(J+1+1) * Real.sqrt (Real.log ((N (J+1) : ℕ):ℝ))) := by
              field_simp; try ring
            rw [← heq]
            exact hstep
          have hgeo : ((1/2:ℝ)^k - (1/2:ℝ)^(J+1))
              = ((1/2:ℝ)^k - (1/2:ℝ)^J) + (1/2:ℝ)^(J+1) := by
            have : (1/2:ℝ)^J = 2*(1/2:ℝ)^(J+1) := by rw [pow_succ]; ring
            linarith
          rw [hsplit, hcb, hIcc, hgeo]
          rw [hcb] at ih
          nlinarith [ih, h1, h3, hkey]
      -- the tail term
      have htail : ∀ J, radProc n (f : Fin n → ℝ) ω
          ≤ radProc n (show Fin n → ℝ from pi J) ω + (1/2:ℝ)^J := by
        intro J
        have h1 : radProc n ((show Fin n → ℝ from f) - (show Fin n → ℝ from pi J)) ω
            ≤ dist (0:EmpL2 n) ((show Fin n → ℝ from f) - (show Fin n → ℝ from pi J)) :=
          radProc_le_dist hn _ ω hωW'
        rw [dist_zero_sub] at h1
        have h2 := hpidist J
        have h3 : radProc n ((show Fin n → ℝ from f) - (show Fin n → ℝ from pi J)) ω
            = radProc n (f : Fin n → ℝ) ω - radProc n (show Fin n → ℝ from pi J) ω :=
          radProc_sub _ _ _
        rw [h3] at h1
        linarith
      -- the dyadic sum is dominated by the entropy integral
      have hentropy : ∀ J, k ≤ J →
          (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc k J, (1/2:ℝ)^(m+1) * Real.sqrt (Real.log ((N m : ℕ):ℝ)))
            ≤ ∫ ε in (0:ℝ)..(dist (0 : EmpL2 n) f),
                Real.sqrt (Real.log (((packingNumber ε F).untopD 0 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
        intro J hJ
        refine integral_ge_dyadic_sum (φ := fun ε =>
            Real.sqrt (Real.log (((packingNumber ε F).untopD 0 : ℕ) : ℝ)))
          (fun x => Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (hInt f hf)
          (fun m => Real.sqrt (Real.log ((N m : ℕ):ℝ))) ?_ k J hJ (by rw [← hDf]; exact hk1)
        intro m x hx
        have hxpos : (0:ℝ) < x := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hx.1
        have hxle : x ≤ (1/2:ℝ)^m := hx.2
        have hmono : packingNumber ((1/2:ℝ)^m) F ≤ packingNumber x F :=
          packing_antitone hxle F
        have hfx : packingNumber x F ≠ ⊤ := hFin x hxpos
        have hNle : N m ≤ ((packingNumber x F).untopD 0 : ℕ) := by
          rw [hNdef]
          rw [← untopD_coe_eq _ (hfin m), ← untopD_coe_eq _ hfx] at hmono
          exact_mod_cast hmono
        refine Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (Real.log_le_log ?_ ?_)
        · exact_mod_cast hN1 m
        · exact_mod_cast hNle
      -- put everything together
      refine le_of_forall_pos_le_add ?_
      intro δ hδ
      obtain ⟨J0, hJ0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hδ (show (1/2:ℝ) < 1 by norm_num)
      obtain ⟨J, hJ1, hJ2⟩ : ∃ J : ℕ, k ≤ J ∧ (1/2:ℝ)^J ≤ δ :=
        ⟨max k J0, le_max_left _ _, le_trans (half_pow_le (le_max_right _ _)) hJ0.le⟩
      refine le_trans (htail J) ?_
      have hc := hchain J hJ1
      rw [hcb] at hc
      have hI := hentropy J hJ1
      have hIpos : (0:ℝ) ≤ ∫ ε in (0:ℝ)..(dist (0 : EmpL2 n) f),
          Real.sqrt (Real.log (((packingNumber ε F).untopD 0 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
        refine intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by rw [← hDf]; exact hDf0) ?_
        intro x _; exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _
      have hq : (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (u/n) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
      have hcoef : (16*Real.sqrt 2/Real.sqrt n) *
            (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc k J, (1/2:ℝ)^(m+1) * Real.sqrt (Real.log ((N m : ℕ):ℝ)))
          ≤ (2 ^ (9/2 : ℝ) / Real.sqrt n) *
            (∫ ε in (0:ℝ)..(dist (0 : EmpL2 n) f),
                Real.sqrt (Real.log (((packingNumber ε F).untopD 0 : ℕ) : ℝ))) := by
        rw [two_rpow_92]
        have hpos : (0:ℝ) ≤ 16*Real.sqrt 2/Real.sqrt n := by positivity
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hI hpos
      have hu2 : 2*Real.sqrt 5 * Df * Real.sqrt (u/n)
            + 3*Real.sqrt 5 * ((1/2:ℝ)^k - (1/2:ℝ)^J) * Real.sqrt (u/n)
          ≤ 2 ^ (7/2 : ℝ) * dist (0 : EmpL2 n) f * Real.sqrt (u/n) := by
        rw [two_rpow_72, ← hDf]
        have h1 : (1/2:ℝ)^k - (1/2:ℝ)^J ≤ Df := by
          have := pow_pos (show (0:ℝ) < 1/2 by norm_num) J
          linarith
        have h2 : (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt 5 := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
        have h3 : 3*Real.sqrt 5 * ((1/2:ℝ)^k - (1/2:ℝ)^J) * Real.sqrt (u/n)
            ≤ 3*Real.sqrt 5 * Df * Real.sqrt (u/n) := by
          have hc : (0:ℝ) ≤ 3*Real.sqrt 5 := by positivity
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hc) hq
        have h4 : 5*Real.sqrt 5 * Df * Real.sqrt (u/n)
            ≤ 8*Real.sqrt 2 * Df * Real.sqrt (u/n) := by
          have hc : (0:ℝ) ≤ Df * Real.sqrt (u/n) := mul_nonneg hDf0 hq
          calc 5*Real.sqrt 5 * Df * Real.sqrt (u/n)
              = (5*Real.sqrt 5) * (Df * Real.sqrt (u/n)) := by ring
            _ ≤ (8*Real.sqrt 2) * (Df * Real.sqrt (u/n)) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right five_sqrt5_le hc
            _ = 8*Real.sqrt 2 * Df * Real.sqrt (u/n) := by ring
        linarith
      linarith
  -- ###  Claim B : the measure of Bad is small  ###
  have claimB : (radP n).real Bad ≤ Real.exp (-u) := by
    obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ E : ℝ, E = Real.exp (-((5/2)*u)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hEpos : 0 < E := by rw [hE]; exact Real.exp_pos _
    have hEle1 : E ≤ 1 := by
      rw [hE]; rw [Real.exp_le_one_iff]; linarith

import Mathlib

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Real

namespace GraduateLevel

def RadSigns (n : ℕ) : Type := Fin n → ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ)

instance {n} : Fintype (RadSigns n) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Fintype (Fin n → { x // x ∈ ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ) }))

instance {n} : Nonempty (RadSigns n) := ⟨fun _ => ⟨1, by simp⟩⟩

private lemma rad_abs {n : ℕ} (σ : RadSigns n) (i : Fin n) : |((σ i : ℤ) : ℝ)| = 1 := by
  have h := (σ i).2
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at h
  rcases h with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num

noncomputable def Xs {n : ℕ} {T : Type*} (t : T → Fin n → ℝ) (Ψ : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ)
    (σ : RadSigns n) (τ : T) : ℝ := ∑ i, ((σ i : ℤ) : ℝ) * Ψ i (t τ i)

noncomputable def Sg {n : ℕ} {T : Type*} (t : T → Fin n → ℝ) (Ψ : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ σ : RadSigns n, max (⨆ τ : T, Xs t Ψ σ τ) 0

private def negOne (x : ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ)) : ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ) :=
  ⟨-(x : ℤ), by
    have h := x.2
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at h ⊢
    rcases h with h | h <;> simp [h]⟩

private lemma negOne_val (x : ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ)) : ((negOne x : ℤ) : ℝ) = -((x : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
  simp [negOne]

private lemma negOne_negOne (x : ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ)) : negOne (negOne x) = x := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [negOne]

private def flipAt {n : ℕ} (k : Fin n) (σ : RadSigns n) : RadSigns n :=
  fun i => if i = k then negOne (σ i) else σ i

private def negAll {n : ℕ} (σ : RadSigns n) : RadSigns n := fun i => negOne (σ i)

private lemma flipAt_inv {n : ℕ} (k : Fin n) : Function.Involutive (flipAt (n := n) k) := by
  intro σ
  funext i
  by_cases h : i = k <;> simp [flipAt, h, negOne_negOne]

private lemma negAll_inv {n : ℕ} : Function.Involutive (negAll (n := n)) := by
  intro σ
  funext i
  simp [negAll, negOne_negOne]

private lemma sum_flip {n : ℕ} (k : Fin n) (F : RadSigns n → ℝ) :
    ∑ σ : RadSigns n, F (flipAt k σ) = ∑ σ : RadSigns n, F σ :=
  Fintype.sum_equiv (flipAt_inv k).toPerm _ _ (fun _ => rfl)

private lemma sum_negAll {n : ℕ} (F : RadSigns n → ℝ) :
    ∑ σ : RadSigns n, F (negAll σ) = ∑ σ : RadSigns n, F σ :=
  Fintype.sum_equiv (negAll_inv).toPerm _ _ (fun _ => rfl)

private lemma Xs_negAll {n : ℕ} {T : Type*} (t : T → Fin n → ℝ) (Ψ : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ)
    (σ : RadSigns n) (τ : T) : Xs t Ψ (negAll σ) τ = -(Xs t Ψ σ τ) := by
  simp only [Xs, negAll, negOne_val, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
  intro i _
  ring

private lemma Xs_bound {n : ℕ} {T : Type*} (t : T → Fin n → ℝ) (M : ℝ)
    (hM : ∀ τ, ∑ i, |t τ i| ≤ M) (Ψ : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ) (hΨ : ∀ i s, |Ψ i s| ≤ |s|)
    (σ : RadSigns n) (τ : T) : |Xs t Ψ σ τ| ≤ M := by
  calc |Xs t Ψ σ τ| ≤ ∑ i, |((σ i : ℤ) : ℝ) * Ψ i (t τ i)| :=
        Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ i, |t τ i| := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
        intro i _
        rw [abs_mul, rad_abs, one_mul]
        exact hΨ i (t τ i)
    _ ≤ M := hM τ

private lemma bddAbove_of_bound {T : Type*} (a : T → ℝ) (M : ℝ) (h : ∀ τ, a τ ≤ M) :
    BddAbove (Set.range a) := by
  refine ⟨M, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨τ, rfl⟩
  exact h τ

private lemma key_two {T : Type*} [Nonempty T] (f g u : T → ℝ)
    (h1 : ∀ a b : T, u a - u b ≤ |g a - g b|)
    (h2 : ∀ a : T, |u a| ≤ |g a|)
    (hbu : BddAbove (Set.range fun τ => f τ + u τ))
    (hbu' : BddAbove (Set.range fun τ => f τ - u τ))
    (hbg : BddAbove (Set.range fun τ => f τ + g τ))
    (hbg' : BddAbove (Set.range fun τ => f τ - g τ)) :
    max (⨆ τ, (f τ + u τ)) 0 + max (⨆ τ, (f τ - u τ)) 0
      ≤ max (⨆ τ, (f τ + g τ)) 0 + max (⨆ τ, (f τ - g τ)) 0 := by
  set P := ⨆ τ, (f τ + u τ) with hP
  set Q := ⨆ τ, (f τ - u τ) with hQ
  set A := ⨆ τ, (f τ + g τ) with hA
  set B := ⨆ τ, (f τ - g τ) with hB
  have hAle : A ≤ max A 0 := le_max_left _ _
  have hBle : B ≤ max B 0 := le_max_left _ _
  have hA0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ max A 0 := le_max_right _ _
  have hB0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ max B 0 := le_max_right _ _

      rw [hP]
      refine ciSup_le ?_
      intro a
      have hq : Q ≤ A + B - (f a + u a) := by
        rw [hQ]
        refine ciSup_le ?_
        intro b
        rcases le_total (g b) (g a) with h | h
        · have hab := h1 a b
          rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)] at hab
          have hA' : f a + g a ≤ A := le_ciSup hbg a
          have hB' : f b - g b ≤ B := le_ciSup hbg' b
          linarith
        · have hab := h1 a b
          rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)] at hab
          have hA' : f b + g b ≤ A := le_ciSup hbg b
          have hB' : f a - g a ≤ B := le_ciSup hbg' a
          linarith
      linarith
    linarith
  have F2 : P ≤ max A 0 + max B 0 := by
    rw [hP]
    refine ciSup_le ?_
    intro a
    have hu : u a ≤ |g a| := le_trans (le_abs_self _) (h2 a)
    rcases le_total 0 (g a) with h | h
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg h] at hu
      have hA' : f a + g a ≤ A := le_ciSup hbg a
      linarith
    · rw [abs_of_nonpos h] at hu
      have hB' : f a - g a ≤ B := le_ciSup hbg' a
      linarith
  have F3 : Q ≤ max A 0 + max B 0 := by
    rw [hQ]
    refine ciSup_le ?_
    intro a
    have hu : -u a ≤ |g a| := le_trans (neg_le_abs _) (h2 a)
    rcases le_total 0 (g a) with h | h
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg h] at hu
      have hA' : f a + g a ≤ A := le_ciSup hbg a
      linarith
    · rw [abs_of_nonpos h] at hu
      have hB' : f a - g a ≤ B := le_ciSup hbg' a
      linarith
  rcases le_or_lt P 0 with hp0 | hp0 <;> rcases le_or_lt Q 0 with hq0 | hq0
  · rw [max_eq_right hp0, max_eq_right hq0]; linarith
  · rw [max_eq_right hp0, max_eq_left hq0.le]; linarith
  · rw [max_eq_left hp0.le, max_eq_right hq0]; linarith
  · rw [max_eq_left hp0.le, max_eq_left hq0.le]; linarith

private lemma step {n : ℕ} {T : Type*} [Nonempty T] (t : T → Fin n → ℝ) (M : ℝ)

    (Ψ : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ) (hΨb : ∀ i s, |Ψ i s| ≤ |s|)
    (hΨL : ∀ i s s', |Ψ i s' - Ψ i s| ≤ |s' - s|)
    (k : Fin n) :
    Sg t Ψ ≤ Sg t (Function.update Ψ k (fun s => s)) := by
  classical
  set Ψ' := Function.update Ψ k (fun s : ℝ => s) with hΨ'
  have hΨ'b : ∀ i s, |Ψ' i s| ≤ |s| := by
    intro i s
    by_cases h : i = k
    · subst h; simp [hΨ']
    · rw [hΨ', Function.update_of_ne h]; exact hΨb i s

      max (⨆ τ : T, Xs t Ψ σ τ) 0 + max (⨆ τ : T, Xs t Ψ (flipAt k σ) τ) 0

    intro σ

    set u : T → ℝ := fun τ => ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * Ψ k (t τ k) with hudef
    set g : T → ℝ := fun τ => ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * (t τ k) with hgdef
    have hsplit : ∀ (Θ : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ) (ρ : RadSigns n) (τ : T),

              + ((ρ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * Θ k (t τ k) := by
      intro Θ ρ τ
      rw [Xs, ← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ k)]

        (∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase k, ((flipAt k σ i : ℤ) : ℝ) * Θ i (t τ i))
          = ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase k, ((σ i : ℤ) : ℝ) * Θ i (t τ i) := by

theorem ch26_lemma_26_1
    {n : ℕ} {T : Type*} [Nonempty T]
    (t : T → (Fin n → ℝ))
    (φ : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hφ0 : ∀ i, φ i 0 = 0)
    (hφL : ∀ i s s', |φ i s' - φ i s| ≤ |s' - s|)
    (hbddφ : ∀ σ : RadSigns n,
      BddAbove (Set.range (fun τ : T => |∑ i : Fin n, (σ i : ℝ) * φ i (t τ i)|)))
    (hbdd : ∀ σ : RadSigns n,
      BddAbove (Set.range (fun τ : T => |∑ i : Fin n, (σ i : ℝ) * t τ i|))) :
    (Fintype.card (RadSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ∑ σ : RadSigns n,
          ⨆ τ : T, |∑ i : Fin n, (σ i : ℝ) * φ i (t τ i)|
      ≤ 2 * ((Fintype.card (RadSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ∑ σ : RadSigns n,
          ⨆ τ : T, |∑ i : Fin n, (σ i : ℝ) * t τ i|) := by
  classical
  set M : ℝ := Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
      (fun σ : RadSigns n => ⨆ τ : T, |∑ i : Fin n, ((σ i : ℤ) : ℝ) * t τ i|) with hMdef
  have hM : ∀ τ, ∑ i, |t τ i| ≤ M := by
    intro τ
    refine
      let σ : RadSigns n := fun i => if 0 ≤ t τ i then ⟨1, by simp⟩ else ⟨-1, by simp⟩
      ?_
    have h1 : ∑ i, |t τ i| = ∑ i : Fin n, ((σ i : ℤ) : ℝ) * t τ i := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
      intro i _
      by_cases h : 0 ≤ t τ i
      · simp [σ, h, abs_of_nonneg h]
      · simp [σ, h, abs_of_neg (not_le.mp h)]
    calc ∑ i, |t τ i| = ∑ i : Fin n, ((σ i : ℤ) : ℝ) * t τ i := h1
      _ ≤ |∑ i : Fin n, ((σ i : ℤ) : ℝ) * t τ i| := le_abs_self _
      _ ≤ ⨆ τ : T, |∑ i : Fin n, ((σ i : ℤ) : ℝ) * t τ i| := le_ciSup (hbdd σ) τ
      _ ≤ M := by
          rw [hMdef]
          exact Finset.le_sup'
            (fun ρ : RadSigns n => ⨆ τ : T, |∑ i : Fin n, ((ρ i : ℤ) : ℝ) * t τ i|)
            (Finset.mem_univ σ)
  have hφb : ∀ i s, |φ i s| ≤ |s| := by
    intro i s
    have := hφL i 0 s
    rw [hφ0 i, sub_zero, sub_zero] at this
    exact this
  have hidb : ∀ (i : Fin n) (s : ℝ), |(fun (_ : Fin n) (y : ℝ) => y) i s| ≤ |s| := by
    intro i s; exact le_rfl
  have hyb_b : ∀ (s : Finset (Fin n)) (i : Fin n) (x : ℝ),
      |(if i ∈ s then (fun y : ℝ => y) else φ i) x| ≤ |x| := by
    intro s i x
    by_cases h : i ∈ s
    · simp [h]
    · simp only [h, if_false]; exact hφb i x
  have hyb_L : ∀ (s : Finset (Fin n)) (i : Fin n) (a b : ℝ),

        - (if i ∈ s then (fun y : ℝ => y) else φ i) a| ≤ |b - a| := by
    intro s i a b
    by_cases h : i ∈ s
    · simp [h]
    · simp only [h, if_false]; exact hφL i a b

    | empty => simp

        refine ih.trans ?_

    intro Θ hΘ ρ
    exact bddAbove_of_bound _ M (fun τ => le_of_abs_le (Xs_bound t M hM Θ hΘ ρ τ))
  have hbddabs : ∀ (Θ : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ i s, |Θ i s| ≤ |s|) → ∀ ρ : RadSigns n,
      BddAbove (Set.range fun τ : T => |Xs t Θ ρ τ|) := by
    intro Θ hΘ ρ
    exact bddAbove_of_bound _ M (fun τ => Xs_bound t M hM Θ hΘ ρ τ)

  have stepA : (∑ σ : RadSigns n, ⨆ τ : T, |Xs t φ σ τ|) ≤ 2 * Sg t φ := by

      have h2 : Xs t φ (negAll σ) τ ≤ ⨆ τ : T, Xs t φ (negAll σ) τ :=
        le_ciSup (hbdd' φ hφb (negAll σ)) τ
      rw [Xs_negAll] at h2
      have m1 : max (Xs t φ σ τ) 0 ≤ max (⨆ τ : T, Xs t φ σ τ) 0 := by
        exact max_le_max h1 le_rfl
      have m2 : max (-(Xs t φ σ τ)) 0 ≤ max (⨆ τ : T, Xs t φ (negAll σ) τ) 0 := by
        exact max_le_max h2 le_rfl
      have : |Xs t φ σ τ| = max (Xs t φ σ τ) 0 + max (-(Xs t φ σ τ)) 0 := by
        rcases le_total 0 (Xs t φ σ τ) with h | h
        · rw [abs_of_nonneg h, max_eq_left h, max_eq_right (by linarith)]; ring
        · rw [abs_of_nonpos h, max_eq_right h, max_eq_left (by linarith)]; ring
      rw [this]
      linarith
    have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun σ (_ : σ ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (RadSigns n))) => hper σ)
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib] at hsum
    have hre : ∑ σ : RadSigns n, max (⨆ τ : T, Xs t φ (negAll σ) τ) 0 = Sg t φ :=
      sum_negAll (fun σ => max (⨆ τ : T, Xs t φ σ τ) 0)
    rw [hre] at hsum
    have hSg : Sg t φ = ∑ σ : RadSigns n, max (⨆ τ : T, Xs t φ σ τ) 0 := rfl
    rw [← hSg] at hsum
    linarith
  -- Step C : Sg (id) ≤ sum of sup of abs
  have stepC : Sg t (fun _ => fun y : ℝ => y)
      ≤ ∑ σ : RadSigns n, ⨆ τ : T, |Xs t (fun _ => fun y : ℝ => y) σ τ| := by
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
    intro σ _
    have hb := hbddabs (fun _ => fun y : ℝ => y) hidb σ

      refine ciSup_le ?_
      intro τ
      exact le_trans (le_abs_self _) (le_ciSup hb τ)
    have h0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ ⨆ τ : T, |Xs t (fun _ => fun y : ℝ => y) σ τ| := by
      obtain ⟨τ0⟩ := ‹Nonempty T›
      exact le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (le_ciSup hb τ0)
    exact max_le h1 h0
  have hfinal : (∑ σ : RadSigns n, ⨆ τ : T, |Xs t φ σ τ|)
      ≤ 2 * ∑ σ : RadSigns n, ⨆ τ : T, |Xs t (fun _ => fun y : ℝ => y) σ τ| := by
    linarith
  simp only [Xs] at hfinal
  have hc : (0:ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card (RadSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ := by positivity
  refine le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfinal hc) (le_of_eq (by ring))

end GraduateLevel

Let
\[V(x)=\mathbb{E}_{x^{\prime}}\operatorname*{sup}_{f\in\mathcal{F}}\sum_{i=1}^{n}(f(x_{i})-f(x_{i}^{\prime}))^{2}\]
and \(a \leq f \leq b\) for all \(f\in{\mathcal{F}}\) . Then
\[\begin{array}{ r }{\operatorname{\mathbb{P}}\left(V\leq 4\operatorname{\mathbb{E}}V+(b-a)^{2}t\right)\geq 1-4\cdot 2^{-t}.}\end{array}\]
