theorem ch4_theorem_4_8 :
    ∃ c₀ c₁ c₂ : ℝ, 0 < c₀ ∧ 0 < c₁ ∧ 0 < c₂ ∧
      ∀ {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
        {𝒳 𝒴 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] [MeasurableSpace 𝒴]
        (p n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (κ B : ℝ)
        (ℓ : (𝒳 × 𝒴) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p) → ℝ)
        (Z : Fin n → Ω → (𝒳 × 𝒴)),
        1 ≤ p → 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ κ → 0 < B →
        (∀ z θ, ‖θ‖ ≤ B → ℓ z θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
        (∀ z θ θ', ‖θ‖ ≤ B → ‖θ'‖ ≤ B → |ℓ z θ - ℓ z θ'| ≤ κ * dist θ θ') →
        iIndepFun Z μ →
        (∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (Z i) (Z 0) μ μ) →
        (∀ θ, Measurable (fun z => ℓ z θ)) →
        (∀ i θ, AEMeasurable (fun ω => ℓ (Z i ω) θ) μ) →
        let L : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p) → ℝ := fun θ => ∫ ω, ℓ (Z 0 ω) θ ∂μ
        let Lhat : Ω → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p) → ℝ := fun ω θ => (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, ℓ (Z i ω) θ
        1 - c₁ * Real.exp (- c₂ * p) ≤
          μ.real {ω | ∀ θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p), ‖θ‖ ≤ B →
            |Lhat ω θ - L θ| ≤ c₀ * Real.sqrt (p * max (Real.log (κ * B * n)) 1 / n)} := sorry

end GraduateLevel
solution:
import Mathlib

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Real

namespace GraduateLevel

/-! ## Covering/packing machinery

Only the declarations on the call path from `exists_maximal_packing`,
`maximal_packing_isENet`, and `packing_card_bound` down to Mathlib primitives are
included here (covering numbers, `IsENet` monotonicity, optimal nets, etc. are not
needed and are omitted). -/

section CoveringPacking

/-- `t` is an `eps`-packing for `s` if it is contained in `s` and any two distinct points are
`eps`-separated. -/
def local_IsPacking {A : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace A] (t : Finset A) (eps : ℝ) (s : Set A) : Prop :=
  (↑t ⊆ s) ∧ (t : Set A).Pairwise (fun x y => eps < dist x y)

/-- `t` is an `eps`-net for `s` if the `eps`-balls around `t` cover `s`. -/
def local_IsENet {A : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace A] (t : Finset A) (eps : ℝ) (s : Set A) : Prop :=
  s ⊆ ⋃ x ∈ t, Metric.closedBall x eps

variable {A : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace A]

/-- A maximal packing is a covering: if no point of `s` can be added to a packing `t`,
    then `t` is an `eps`-net for `s`. Requires `eps ≥ 0` for the closed ball condition. -/
lemma local_isENet_of_maximal {t : Finset A} {eps : ℝ} {s : Set A}
    (heps : 0 ≤ eps)
    (hmax : ∀ a ∈ s, a ∉ t → ∃ x ∈ t, dist a x ≤ eps) :
    local_IsENet t eps s := by
  intro a ha
  by_cases hat : a ∈ t
  · exact Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨a, hat, Metric.mem_closedBall_self heps⟩
  · obtain ⟨x, hx_mem, hx_dist⟩ := hmax a ha hat
    exact Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨x, hx_mem, Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr hx_dist⟩

/-- A maximal packing is an ε-net: if no point of s can be added while maintaining
    ε-separation, then the packing is an ε-net. -/
lemma local_maximal_packing_isENet {E : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace E]
    {t : Finset E} {eps : ℝ} {s : Set E}
    (heps : 0 ≤ eps)
    (_hpacking : local_IsPacking t eps s)
    (hmaximal : ∀ x ∈ s, x ∉ t → ∃ y ∈ t, dist x y ≤ eps) :
    local_IsENet t eps s :=
  local_isENet_of_maximal heps hmaximal

/-- The existence of a maximal packing in a totally bounded set. -/
lemma local_exists_maximal_packing {E : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace E]
    {s : Set E} (eps : ℝ) (heps : 0 < eps) (hs : TotallyBounded s) :
    ∃ t : Finset E, local_IsPacking t eps s ∧
      (∀ x ∈ s, x ∉ t → ∃ y ∈ t, dist x y ≤ eps) := by
  classical
  have heps2 : 0 < eps / 2 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨cover, _, hcover_finite, hcover⟩ := Metric.finite_approx_of_totallyBounded hs (eps / 2) heps2
  have hbound : ∀ t : Finset E, local_IsPacking t eps s → t.card ≤ cover.ncard := by
    intro t ht
    have ht_sep : (t : Set E).Pairwise (fun x y => eps < dist x y) := ht.2
    have hmaps : ∀ x ∈ t, ∃ c ∈ cover, x ∈ Metric.ball c (eps / 2) := fun x hx => by
      have hxs := ht.1 hx
      have := hcover hxs
      simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at this
      obtain ⟨c, hc, hxball⟩ := this
      exact ⟨c, hc, hxball⟩
    let f : t → cover := fun ⟨x, hx⟩ => ⟨(hmaps x hx).choose, (hmaps x hx).choose_spec.1⟩
    have hf_inj : Function.Injective f := by
      intro ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ heq
      simp only [f, Subtype.mk.injEq] at heq
      have hxc := (hmaps x hx).choose_spec.2
      have hyc : y ∈ Metric.ball (hmaps y hy).choose (eps / 2) := (hmaps y hy).choose_spec.2
      by_cases hxy : x = y
      · exact Subtype.ext hxy
      · exfalso
        have hsep_xy := ht_sep hx hy hxy
        have heq' : (hmaps x hx).choose = (hmaps y hy).choose := heq
        have hdist : dist x y < eps := by
          calc dist x y ≤ dist x (hmaps x hx).choose + dist (hmaps x hx).choose y := dist_triangle _ _ _
            _ < eps / 2 + eps / 2 := by
              apply add_lt_add
              · exact Metric.mem_ball.mp hxc
              · rw [heq', dist_comm]; exact Metric.mem_ball.mp hyc
            _ = eps := by ring
        linarith
    haveI : Finite cover := hcover_finite
    haveI : Fintype cover := Fintype.ofFinite cover
    calc t.card = Fintype.card t := by rw [Fintype.card_coe]
      _ ≤ Fintype.card cover := Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf_inj
      _ = cover.ncard := by
          rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card cover]
          simp [Set.toFinset_card]
  let bound := cover.ncard
  have iterate : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ t : Finset E, local_IsPacking t eps s → bound - t.card = n →
      ∃ t' : Finset E, t ⊆ t' ∧ local_IsPacking t' eps s ∧
        (∀ x ∈ s, x ∉ t' → ∃ y ∈ t', dist x y ≤ eps) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro t ht_pack heq
      use t, Finset.Subset.refl t, ht_pack
      intro x hxs hxt
      by_contra h
      push_neg at h
      have hx_sep : ∀ y ∈ t, eps < dist x y := fun y hy => h y hy
      have ht'_pack : local_IsPacking (insert x t) eps s := by
        constructor
        · intro y hy
          rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_insert] at hy
          rcases hy with rfl | hy
          · exact hxs
          · exact ht_pack.1 hy
        · intro y hy z hz hyz
          rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_insert] at hy hz
          rcases hy with rfl | hy <;> rcases hz with rfl | hz
          · exact absurd rfl hyz
          · exact hx_sep z hz
          · rw [dist_comm]; exact hx_sep y hy
          · exact ht_pack.2 hy hz hyz
      have h_bound := hbound (insert x t) ht'_pack
      have h_card : (insert x t).card = t.card + 1 := Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hxt
      omega
    | succ n ih =>
      intro t ht_pack heq
      by_cases hmaximal : ∀ x ∈ s, x ∉ t → ∃ y ∈ t, dist x y ≤ eps
      · use t, Finset.Subset.refl t, ht_pack, hmaximal
      · push_neg at hmaximal
        obtain ⟨x, hxs, hxt, hx_sep⟩ := hmaximal
        have ht'_pack : local_IsPacking (insert x t) eps s := by
          constructor
          · intro y hy
            rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_insert] at hy
            rcases hy with rfl | hy
            · exact hxs
            · exact ht_pack.1 hy
          · intro y hy z hz hyz
            rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_insert] at hy hz
            rcases hy with rfl | hy <;> rcases hz with rfl | hz
            · exact absurd rfl hyz
            · have := hx_sep z hz; linarith
            · have := hx_sep y hy; rw [dist_comm]; linarith
            · exact ht_pack.2 hy hz hyz
        have h_card : (insert x t).card = t.card + 1 := Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hxt
        have h_gap : bound - (insert x t).card = n := by omega
        obtain ⟨t'', ht''_sub, ht''_pack, ht''_max⟩ := ih (insert x t) ht'_pack h_gap
        exact ⟨t'', Finset.Subset.trans (Finset.subset_insert x t) ht''_sub, ht''_pack, ht''_max⟩
  have hempty_pack : local_IsPacking (∅ : Finset E) eps s := by
    constructor
    · simp
    · simp
  have hgap : bound - (∅ : Finset E).card = bound := by simp
  obtain ⟨t, _, ht_pack, ht_max⟩ := iterate bound ∅ hempty_pack hgap
  exact ⟨t, ht_pack, ht_max⟩

section EuclideanBall

variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]

/-- The closed Euclidean ball of radius R centered at 0 in EuclideanSpace ℝ ι. -/
abbrev local_euclideanBall (R : ℝ) : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) := Metric.closedBall 0 R

omit [Nonempty ι] in
/-- The Euclidean ball is totally bounded (since it's compact in finite dimensions). -/
lemma local_euclideanBall_totallyBounded (R : ℝ) :
    TotallyBounded (local_euclideanBall R : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)) :=
  (isCompact_closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) R).totallyBounded

/-- If points x and y are ε-separated (dist x y > ε), then the closed balls of radius ε/2
    around them are disjoint. -/
lemma local_closedBall_half_disjoint {E : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace E] {x y : E} {eps : ℝ}
    (_heps : 0 ≤ eps) (hsep : eps < dist x y) :
    Disjoint (Metric.closedBall x (eps / 2)) (Metric.closedBall y (eps / 2)) := by
  apply Metric.closedBall_disjoint_closedBall
  calc eps / 2 + eps / 2 = eps := by ring
    _ < dist x y := hsep

/-- For a packing, the half-radius balls around distinct points are pairwise disjoint. -/
lemma local_packing_halfBalls_pairwiseDisjoint {E : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace E]
    {t : Finset E} {eps : ℝ} {s : Set E}
    (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (hpacking : local_IsPacking t eps s) :
    (t : Set E).PairwiseDisjoint (fun x => Metric.closedBall x (eps / 2)) := by
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  have hsep := hpacking.2 hx hy hxy
  exact local_closedBall_half_disjoint heps hsep

/-- A half-radius ball around a point in closedBall(0, R) is contained in closedBall(0, R + eps/2). -/
lemma local_halfBall_subset_enlargedBall {E : Type*} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E]
    {x : E} {R eps : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) R) :
    Metric.closedBall x (eps / 2) ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) (R + eps / 2) := by
  intro z hz
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hx hz ⊢
  simp only [dist_zero_right] at hx ⊢
  have h1 : ‖z‖ = ‖z - x + x‖ := by simp
  calc ‖z‖ = ‖z - x + x‖ := h1
    _ ≤ ‖z - x‖ + ‖x‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ = dist z x + ‖x‖ := by rw [dist_eq_norm]
    _ ≤ eps / 2 + R := by linarith [hz, hx]
    _ = R + eps / 2 := by ring

/-- Union of half-balls around a packing in B(0, R) is contained in B(0, R + eps/2). -/
lemma local_packing_halfBalls_subset {E : Type*} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E]
    {t : Finset E} {R eps : ℝ} {s : Set E}
    (hpacking : local_IsPacking t eps s) (hs : s ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) R) :
    (⋃ x ∈ t, Metric.closedBall x (eps / 2)) ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) (R + eps / 2) := by
  intro z hz
  rw [Set.mem_iUnion₂] at hz
  obtain ⟨x, hxt, hzx⟩ := hz
  have hxs : x ∈ s := hpacking.1 hxt
  have hxR : x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) R := hs hxs
  exact local_halfBall_subset_enlargedBall hxR hzx

omit [Nonempty ι] in
/-- Key volume lemma: The volume of disjoint half-balls equals the sum of individual volumes. -/
lemma local_volume_disjoint_union_closedBalls
    {t : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {eps : ℝ} (_heps : 0 ≤ eps)
    (hpwd : (t : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)).PairwiseDisjoint
        (fun x => Metric.closedBall x (eps / 2))) :
    MeasureTheory.volume (⋃ x ∈ t, Metric.closedBall x (eps / 2)) =
    ∑ x ∈ t, MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.closedBall x (eps / 2)) := by
  have hmeas : ∀ b ∈ t, MeasurableSet (Metric.closedBall b (eps / 2)) :=
    fun _ _ => measurableSet_closedBall
  exact measure_biUnion_finset hpwd hmeas

/-- The constant factor in the volume of a unit ball. -/
noncomputable def local_euclideanBallVolumeConst (d : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  Real.pi.sqrt ^ d / Real.Gamma (d / 2 + 1)

lemma local_euclideanBallVolumeConst_pos (d : ℕ) : 0 < local_euclideanBallVolumeConst d := by
  unfold local_euclideanBallVolumeConst
  apply div_pos
  · exact pow_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr Real.pi_pos) d
  · have h : (0 : ℝ) < (d : ℝ) / 2 + 1 := by positivity
    exact Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos h

/-- The volume of a closed ball with radius r equals r^d times the unit ball volume. -/
lemma local_volume_closedBall_eq_rpow (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.closedBall x r) =
    ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ Fintype.card ι * local_euclideanBallVolumeConst (Fintype.card ι)) := by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.volume_closedBall]
  have hr_pow : ENNReal.ofReal r ^ Fintype.card ι = ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ Fintype.card ι) := by
    induction Fintype.card ι with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, ih]
      rw [mul_comm (ENNReal.ofReal _) (ENNReal.ofReal r)]
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hr]
      rw [mul_comm r (r ^ n)]
  rw [hr_pow]
  unfold local_euclideanBallVolumeConst
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (pow_nonneg hr _)]

/-- Key cardinality bound: For a packing in B(0, R), we have
    |t| ≤ ((R + ε/2) / (ε/2))^d = (1 + 2R/ε)^d -/
lemma local_packing_card_bound_aux
    {t : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {R eps : ℝ}
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (heps : 0 < eps)
    (hpacking : local_IsPacking t eps (local_euclideanBall R)) :
    (t.card : ℝ) ≤ ((R + eps / 2) / (eps / 2)) ^ Fintype.card ι := by
  have hpwd := local_packing_halfBalls_pairwiseDisjoint (le_of_lt heps) hpacking
  have hsub := local_packing_halfBalls_subset hpacking (le_refl _)
  have hvol_eq := local_volume_disjoint_union_closedBalls (le_of_lt heps) hpwd
  have hvol_le : MeasureTheory.volume (⋃ x ∈ t, Metric.closedBall x (eps / 2)) ≤
      MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (R + eps / 2)) :=
    MeasureTheory.measure_mono hsub
  have heps_half_pos : 0 < eps / 2 := by linarith
  have heps_half_nonneg : 0 ≤ eps / 2 := le_of_lt heps_half_pos
  have hR_plus_pos : 0 ≤ R + eps / 2 := by linarith
  have hvol_small : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι, MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.closedBall x (eps / 2)) =
      ENNReal.ofReal ((eps / 2) ^ Fintype.card ι * local_euclideanBallVolumeConst (Fintype.card ι)) :=
    fun x => local_volume_closedBall_eq_rpow x (eps / 2) heps_half_nonneg
  have hvol_large : MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (R + eps / 2)) =
      ENNReal.ofReal ((R + eps / 2) ^ Fintype.card ι * local_euclideanBallVolumeConst (Fintype.card ι)) :=
    local_volume_closedBall_eq_rpow 0 (R + eps / 2) hR_plus_pos
  have hvol_sum : ∑ x ∈ t, MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.closedBall x (eps / 2)) =
      t.card * ENNReal.ofReal ((eps / 2) ^ Fintype.card ι * local_euclideanBallVolumeConst (Fintype.card ι)) := by
    simp only [hvol_small]
    rw [Finset.sum_const]
    simp only [nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [hvol_eq, hvol_sum] at hvol_le
  rw [hvol_large] at hvol_le
  have hconst_pos := local_euclideanBallVolumeConst_pos (Fintype.card ι)
  have hsmall_pos : 0 < (eps / 2) ^ Fintype.card ι * local_euclideanBallVolumeConst (Fintype.card ι) :=
    mul_pos (pow_pos heps_half_pos _) hconst_pos
  have hlarge_pos : 0 < (R + eps / 2) ^ Fintype.card ι * local_euclideanBallVolumeConst (Fintype.card ι) :=
    mul_pos (pow_pos (by linarith : 0 < R + eps / 2) _) hconst_pos
  have hlarge_nonneg : 0 ≤ (R + eps / 2) ^ Fintype.card ι * local_euclideanBallVolumeConst (Fintype.card ι) :=
    le_of_lt hlarge_pos
  have h : t.card * ENNReal.ofReal ((eps / 2) ^ Fintype.card ι * local_euclideanBallVolumeConst (Fintype.card ι)) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ((R + eps / 2) ^ Fintype.card ι * local_euclideanBallVolumeConst (Fintype.card ι)) := hvol_le
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_natCast] at h
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg _)] at h
  have h' := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff hlarge_nonneg |>.mp h
  have hdiv : t.card * ((eps / 2) ^ Fintype.card ι * local_euclideanBallVolumeConst (Fintype.card ι)) ≤
      (R + eps / 2) ^ Fintype.card ι * local_euclideanBallVolumeConst (Fintype.card ι) := h'
  have hcancel : (t.card : ℝ) ≤ (R + eps / 2) ^ Fintype.card ι / (eps / 2) ^ Fintype.card ι := by
    have hne : (eps / 2) ^ Fintype.card ι * local_euclideanBallVolumeConst (Fintype.card ι) ≠ 0 :=
      ne_of_gt hsmall_pos
    have hsmall_nonneg : 0 ≤ (eps / 2) ^ Fintype.card ι * local_euclideanBallVolumeConst (Fintype.card ι) :=
      le_of_lt hsmall_pos
    calc (t.card : ℝ)
      _ = t.card * ((eps / 2) ^ Fintype.card ι * local_euclideanBallVolumeConst (Fintype.card ι)) /
          ((eps / 2) ^ Fintype.card ι * local_euclideanBallVolumeConst (Fintype.card ι)) := by
        rw [mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hne]
      _ ≤ (R + eps / 2) ^ Fintype.card ι * local_euclideanBallVolumeConst (Fintype.card ι) /
          ((eps / 2) ^ Fintype.card ι * local_euclideanBallVolumeConst (Fintype.card ι)) := by
        apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hdiv hsmall_nonneg
      _ = (R + eps / 2) ^ Fintype.card ι / (eps / 2) ^ Fintype.card ι := by
        rw [mul_div_mul_right _ _ (ne_of_gt hconst_pos)]
  have hdiv_eq : (R + eps / 2) ^ Fintype.card ι / (eps / 2) ^ Fintype.card ι =
      ((R + eps / 2) / (eps / 2)) ^ Fintype.card ι := by
    rw [← div_pow]
  rw [hdiv_eq] at hcancel
  exact hcancel

/-- Main bound: For a packing, |t| ≤ (1 + 2R/ε)^d. -/
lemma local_packing_card_bound
    {t : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {R eps : ℝ}
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (heps : 0 < eps)
    (hpacking : local_IsPacking t eps (local_euclideanBall R)) :
    (t.card : ℝ) ≤ (1 + 2 * R / eps) ^ Fintype.card ι := by
  have h := local_packing_card_bound_aux hR heps hpacking
  have heq : (R + eps / 2) / (eps / 2) = 1 + 2 * R / eps := by
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [heq] at h
  exact h

end EuclideanBall

end CoveringPacking

/-! ## Hoeffding inequality

`hoeffding_sum`'s proof is a thin wrapper around Mathlib's own
`ProbabilityTheory.hasSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc` and
`ProbabilityTheory.HasSubgaussianMGF.measure_sum_ge_le_of_iIndepFun`. -/

section HoeffdingSum

variable {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)

/-- **Hoeffding's inequality** (two-sided, sum of independent bounded random variables). -/
theorem local_hoeffding_sum [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {n : ℕ} {X : Fin n → Ω → ℝ} (h_indep : iIndepFun X μ)
    {a b : Fin n → ℝ}
    (h_bound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X i ω ∈ Set.Icc (a i) (b i))
    (h_meas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) μ)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    μ.real {ω | ε ≤ |∑ i : Fin n, (X i ω - μ[X i])|}
      ≤ 2 * exp (- ε ^ 2 / (2 * (∑ i : Fin n, ((‖b i - a i‖₊ : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2))) := by
  have h_subG : ∀ i : Fin n,
      HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω ↦ X i ω - μ[X i]) ((‖b i - a i‖₊ / 2) ^ 2) μ :=
    fun i ↦ hasSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc (h_meas i) (h_bound i)
  have h_indep_Y : iIndepFun (fun i ω ↦ X i ω - μ[X i]) μ := by
    show iIndepFun (fun i ↦ (fun x : ℝ ↦ x - μ[X i]) ∘ X i) μ
    exact h_indep.comp (fun i ↦ fun x : ℝ ↦ x - μ[X i])
      (fun i ↦ measurable_id.sub measurable_const)
  have h_right : μ.real {ω | ε ≤ ∑ i : Fin n, (X i ω - μ[X i])} ≤
      exp (- ε ^ 2 / (2 * (∑ i : Fin n, ((‖b i - a i‖₊ : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2))) := by
    have h1 := HasSubgaussianMGF.measure_sum_ge_le_of_iIndepFun (μ := μ)
      (s := Finset.univ) h_indep_Y (fun i _ ↦ h_subG i) hε
    convert h1 using 2
    push_cast [NNReal.coe_sum, NNReal.coe_pow, NNReal.coe_div, NNReal.coe_ofNat]
    rfl
  have h_neg : ∀ i : Fin n,
      HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω ↦ -(X i ω - μ[X i])) ((‖b i - a i‖₊ / 2) ^ 2) μ :=
    fun i ↦ (h_subG i).neg
  have h_indep_neg : iIndepFun (fun i ω ↦ -(X i ω - μ[X i])) μ := by
    show iIndepFun (fun i ↦ (Neg.neg : ℝ → ℝ) ∘ (fun ω ↦ X i ω - μ[X i])) μ
    exact h_indep_Y.comp (fun _ ↦ (Neg.neg : ℝ → ℝ)) (fun _ ↦ measurable_neg)

      exp (- ε ^ 2 / (2 * (∑ i : Fin n, ((‖b i - a i‖₊ : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2))) := by
    have h1 := HasSubgaussianMGF.measure_sum_ge_le_of_iIndepFun (μ := μ)

    rw [show {ω | ε ≤ -(∑ i : Fin n, (X i ω - μ[X i]))} =

  have h_union : {ω | ε ≤ |S ω|} ⊆ {ω | ε ≤ S ω} ∪ {ω | ε ≤ -S ω} := by
    intro ω hω
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_union] at *

        gcongr
    _ = 2 * exp (- ε ^ 2 / (2 * (∑ i : Fin n, ((‖b i - a i‖₊ : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2))) := by ring

end HoeffdingSum

targets.label: ch5_theorem_5_10
targets.statement:
Let \(C(\theta)=\sum_{j=1}^{m}\left|w_{j}\right|\left\|u_{j}\right\|_{2}\), and for some constant \(B > 0\) consider the hypothesis class
\[
\mathcal{H}=\left\{f_{\theta} \mid C(\theta) \leq B\right\}.
\]
If \(\left\|x^{(i)}\right\|_{2} \leq C\) for all \(i \in\{1, \ldots, n\}\), then
\[
R_{S}(\mathcal{H}) \leq \frac{2 B C}{\sqrt{n}}.
\]

nl_proof:
Due to the positive homogeneity of the ReLU function \(\phi\), it will be useful to define the \(\ell_2\)-normalized weight vector \(\bar{u}_j \stackrel{\Delta}{=} u_j / \|u_j\|_2\) so that \(\phi\left(u_j^\top x\right) = \|u_j\|_2 \cdot \phi(\bar{u}_j^\top x)\). The empirical Rademacher complexity satisfies
\[
\begin{aligned}
R_S(\mathcal{H}) &= \frac{1}{n}\mathbb{E}_{\sigma}\left[ \sup_{\theta} \sum_{i=1}^n \sigma_i f_{\theta}\left(x^{(i)}\right) \right] \\
&= \frac{1}{n}\mathbb{E}_{\sigma}\left[ \sup_{\theta} \sum_{i=1}^n \sigma_i \left[\sum_{j=1}^m w_j \phi\left(u_j^\top x^{(i)}\right) \right] \right] \quad \text{(by definition of }f_\theta\text{)} \\
&= \frac{1}{n}\mathbb{E}_{\sigma}\left[ \sup_{\theta} \sum_{i=1}^n \sigma_i \left[\sum_{j=1}^m w_j \|u_j\|_2 \phi\left(\bar{u}_j^\top x^{(i)}\right) \right] \right] \quad \text{(by positive homogeneity of }\phi\text{)} \\
&= \frac{1}{n}\mathbb{E}_{\sigma}\left[ \sup_{\theta} \sum_{j=1}^m w_j \|u_j\|_2 \left[ \sum_{i=1}^n \sigma_i \phi\left(\bar{u}_j^\top x^{(i)}\right) \right] \right] \\
&\leq \frac{1}{n}\mathbb{E}_{\sigma}\left[ \sup_{\theta} \sum_{j=1}^m |w_j| \|u_j\|_2 \max_{k \in [n]}\left| \sum_{i=1}^n \sigma_i \phi\left(\bar{u}_k^\top x^{(i)}\right) \right| \right] \quad \left(\text{because }\sum_j \alpha_j \beta_j \leq \sum_j |\alpha_j| \max_{k} |\beta_k|\right) \\
&\leq \frac{B}{n} \mathbb{E}_{\sigma}\left[ \sup_{\theta = (w, U)} \max_{k \in [n]} \left| \sum_{i=1}^n \sigma_i \phi\left(\bar{u}_k^\top x^{(i)}\right) \right| \right] \quad \text{(because }C(\theta) \leq B\text{)} \\
&= \frac{B}{n} \mathbb{E}_{\sigma}\left[ \sup_{\bar{u}: \|\bar{u}\|_2 = 1} \left| \sum_{i=1}^n \sigma_i \phi\left(\bar{u}^\top x^{(i)}\right) \right| \right] \\
&\le \frac{B}{n} \mathbb{E}_{\sigma}\left[ \sup_{\bar{u}: \|\bar{u}\|_2 \le 1} \left| \sum_{i=1}^n \sigma_i \phi\left(\bar{u}^\top x^{(i)}\right) \right| \right] \\
&\le \frac{2B}{n} \mathbb{E}_{\sigma}\left[ \sup_{\bar{u}: \|\bar{u}\|_2 \le 1} \sum_{i=1}^n \sigma_i \phi\left(\bar{u}^\top x^{(i)}\right) \right] \quad \text{(see the referenced result)} \\
&= 2B \cdot R_S(\mathcal{H}'),
\end{aligned}
\]
where \(\mathcal{H}' = \left\{x \mapsto \phi(\bar{u}^\top x) : \bar{u} \in \mathbb{R}^d, \|\bar{u}\|_2 \leq 1 \right\}\). By Talagrand's lemma, since \(\phi\) is \(1\)-Lipschitz, \(R_S(\mathcal{H}') \leq R_S(\mathcal{H}'')\) where \(\mathcal{H}'' = \left\{x \mapsto \bar{u}^\top x : \bar{u} \in \mathbb{R}^d, \|\bar{u}\|_2 \leq 1 \right\}\) is a linear hypothesis space. Using \(R_S(\mathcal{H}'') \leq \frac{C}{\sqrt{n}}\) by the referenced \(\ell_2\) linear-model theorem then concludes the proof.

Notably, the referenced lemma's assumption holds in the current context, since
\[
\sup_{\theta} \langle \sigma, f_{\theta}(x) \rangle = \sup_{\bar{u}: \|\bar{u}\|_2 \le 1} \sum_{i=1}^n \sigma_i \phi\left(\bar{u}^\top x^{(i)}\right) \geq 0,
\]
since one can take \(\bar{u} = 0\) for any \(\sigma = (\sigma_1, \dots, \sigma_n)\).

context.name: Removing the absolute value in Rademacher complexity
context.statement:
Let \(\sigma = (\sigma_1, \dots, \sigma_n)\) and \(f_{\theta}(x) = \left(f_{\theta}\left(x^{(1)}\right), \dots, f_{\theta}\left(x^{(n)}\right)\right)\). Suppose that for any \(\sigma \in \{\pm 1\}^n\), \(\sup_{\theta} \langle \sigma, f_{\theta}(x) \rangle \geq 0\). Then,
\[
\mathbb{E}_{\sigma}\left[ \sup_{\theta} \left| \langle \sigma, f_{\theta}(x) \rangle \right| \right] \leq 2\, \mathbb{E}_{\sigma}\left[ \sup_{\theta} \langle \sigma, f_{\theta}(x) \rangle \right].
\]

context.name: Talagrand's lemma
context.statement:
Let \(\phi:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}\) be a \(\kappa\)-Lipschitz function. Then
\[
R_S(\phi\circ \mathcal{H})\leq \kappa R_S(\mathcal{H}),
\]
where \(\phi\circ\mathcal{H} = \{z\mapsto \phi(h(z))\mid h\in\mathcal{H}\}\).

context.name: Rademacher complexity of l2-bounded linear functions
context.statement:
Let \(\mathcal{H} = \{x \mapsto \langle w,x \rangle \mid w \in \mathbb{R}^d,\, \|w\|_2 \le B\}\) for some constant \(B > 0\). Moreover, assume \(\mathbb{E}_{x \sim P}[\|x\|_2^2] \leq C^2\), where \(P\) is some distribution and \(C > 0\) is a constant. Then
\[
R_S(\mathcal{H}) \le \frac{B}{n} \sqrt{\sum_{i=1}^n \|x^{(i)}\|_2^2},
\]
and
\[
R_n(\mathcal{H}) \le \frac{BC}{\sqrt{n}}.
\]

context.name: Empirical Rademacher complexity
context.statement:
Given a dataset \(S = \{z_1, \dots, z_n\}\), the empirical Rademacher complexity is defined as
\[
R_S(\mathcal{F}) \stackrel{\Delta}{=} \mathbb{E}_{\sigma_1,\dots, \sigma_n} \left[ \sup_{f\in \mathcal{F}} \frac{1}{n} \sum^n_{i=1} \sigma_i f(z_i) \right].
\]
\(R_S(\mathcal{F})\) is a function of both the function class \(\mathcal{F}\) and the dataset \(S\).

context.name: Two-layer ReLU network
context.statement:
Given a width \(m\), let \(w_1,\dots,w_m \in \mathbb{R}\), \(u_1,\dots,u_m \in \mathbb{R}^d\), and let \(\phi\) denote the ReLU activation. For \(\theta=(w_1,\dots,w_m,u_1,\dots,u_m)\), define the two-layer ReLU network
\[
f_{\theta}(x)=\sum_{j=1}^m w_j \phi\left(u_j^\top x\right).
\]

import Mathlib

open scoped BigOperators

namespace GraduateLevel

def RadSigns (n : ℕ) : Type := Fin n → ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ)

instance {n} : Fintype (RadSigns n) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Fintype (Fin n → { x // x ∈ {-1, 1} }))

noncomputable def empRadSigned {ι : Type*} {𝒳 : Type*}
    (n : ℕ) (f : ι → 𝒳 → ℝ) (S : Fin n → 𝒳) : ℝ :=
  (Fintype.card (RadSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
    ∑ σ : RadSigns n, ⨆ i, (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * f i (S k)

def relu (x : ℝ) : ℝ := max 0 x

noncomputable def pathNorm {m d : ℕ} (w : Fin m → ℝ) (u : Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j : Fin m, |w j| * ‖u j‖

noncomputable def predict {m d : ℕ} (w : Fin m → ℝ) (u : Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j : Fin m, w j * relu (inner ℝ (u j) x)

section Aux

variable {n d : ℕ}

noncomputable def sgn (σ : RadSigns n) (k : Fin n) : ℝ := ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ)

lemma sgn_cases (σ : RadSigns n) (k : Fin n) : sgn σ k = -1 ∨ sgn σ k = 1 := by
  have h := (σ k).2
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at h
  rcases h with h | h
  · left; simp [sgn, h]
  · right; simp [sgn, h]

lemma abs_sgn (σ : RadSigns n) (k : Fin n) : |sgn σ k| = 1 := by
  rcases sgn_cases σ k with h | h <;> simp [h]

lemma sgn_mul_self (σ : RadSigns n) (k : Fin n) : sgn σ k * sgn σ k = 1 := by
  rcases sgn_cases σ k with h | h <;> simp [h]

def negIdx (s : ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ)) : ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ) :=
  ⟨-(s : ℤ), by
    have h := s.2
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at h ⊢
    rcases h with h | h <;> simp [h]⟩

lemma negIdx_involutive : Function.Involutive (negIdx) := by
  intro s
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [negIdx]

def flipAt (j : Fin n) (σ : RadSigns n) : RadSigns n :=
  fun k => if k = j then negIdx (σ k) else σ k

def negAll (σ : RadSigns n) : RadSigns n := fun k => negIdx (σ k)

lemma flipAt_involutive (j : Fin n) : Function.Involutive (flipAt j : RadSigns n → RadSigns n) := by
  intro σ
  funext k
  by_cases h : k = j
  · subst h
    simp only [flipAt, if_pos rfl]
    exact negIdx_involutive (σ k)
  · simp [flipAt, h]

lemma negAll_involutive : Function.Involutive (negAll : RadSigns n → RadSigns n) := by
  intro σ
  funext k
  simp [negAll, negIdx_involutive (σ k)]

lemma sgn_flipAt_self (j : Fin n) (σ : RadSigns n) : sgn (flipAt j σ) j = - sgn σ j := by
  simp [sgn, flipAt, negIdx]

lemma sgn_flipAt_ne (j : Fin n) (σ : RadSigns n) {k : Fin n} (h : k ≠ j) :
    sgn (flipAt j σ) k = sgn σ k := by
  simp [sgn, flipAt, h]

lemma sgn_negAll (σ : RadSigns n) (k : Fin n) : sgn (negAll σ) k = - sgn σ k := by
  simp [sgn, negAll, negIdx]

lemma sum_flipAt (j : Fin n) (f : RadSigns n → ℝ) : ∑ σ : RadSigns n, f (flipAt j σ) = ∑ σ, f σ :=
  Equiv.sum_comp (Function.Involutive.toPerm _ (flipAt_involutive j)) f

lemma sum_negAll (f : RadSigns n → ℝ) : ∑ σ : RadSigns n, f (negAll σ) = ∑ σ, f σ :=
  Equiv.sum_comp (Function.Involutive.toPerm _ negAll_involutive) f

lemma relu_nonneg (t : ℝ) : 0 ≤ relu t := le_max_left _ _

lemma relu_zero : relu 0 = 0 := by simp [relu]

lemma abs_relu_le (t : ℝ) : |relu t| ≤ |t| := by
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (relu_nonneg t)]
  rcases le_total 0 t with h | h
  · simp [relu, max_eq_right h, abs_of_nonneg h]
  · simp [relu, max_eq_left h]

lemma relu_lipschitz (a b : ℝ) : |relu a - relu b| ≤ |a - b| := by
  simp only [relu, max_comm (0:ℝ)]
  exact abs_max_sub_max_le_abs a b 0

lemma relu_smul {c t : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) : relu (c * t) = c * relu t := by
  simp only [relu]
  rcases le_total 0 t with h | h
  · rw [max_eq_right h, max_eq_right (by positivity)]
  · rw [max_eq_left h, max_eq_left (by nlinarith), mul_zero]

instance instNeRad (n : ℕ) : Nonempty (RadSigns n) := ⟨fun _ => ⟨1, by decide⟩⟩

abbrev Ball (d : ℕ) := {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) // ‖v‖ ≤ 1}

instance : Nonempty (Ball d) := ⟨⟨0, by simp⟩⟩

variable (x : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))

noncomputable def gg (S : Finset (Fin n)) (v : Ball d) (k : Fin n) : ℝ :=
  if k ∈ S then relu (inner ℝ (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (x k))
  else (inner ℝ (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (x k) : ℝ)

noncomputable def Psi (S : Finset (Fin n)) (σ : RadSigns n) : ℝ :=
  ⨆ v : Ball d, ∑ k, sgn σ k * gg x S v k

lemma abs_gg_le (S : Finset (Fin n)) (v : Ball d) (k : Fin n) : |gg x S v k| ≤ ‖x k‖ := by
  have hi : |(inner ℝ (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (x k) : ℝ)| ≤ ‖x k‖ := by
    have := abs_real_inner_le_norm (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (x k)
    have h2 : ‖(v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))‖ * ‖x k‖ ≤ 1 * ‖x k‖ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right v.2 (norm_nonneg _)
    linarith
  unfold gg
  split
  · exact le_trans (abs_relu_le _) hi
  · exact hi

lemma bdd_Psi (S : Finset (Fin n)) (σ : RadSigns n) :
    BddAbove (Set.range fun v : Ball d => ∑ k, sgn σ k * gg x S v k) := by
  refine ⟨∑ k, ‖x k‖, ?_⟩
  rintro y ⟨v, rfl⟩
  refine le_trans (le_abs_self _) ?_
  refine le_trans (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _) ?_
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k _ => ?_)
  rw [abs_mul, abs_sgn, one_mul]
  exact abs_gg_le x S v k

lemma Psi_nonneg (S : Finset (Fin n)) (σ : RadSigns n) : 0 ≤ Psi x S σ := by
  have h : (0:ℝ) = ∑ k, sgn σ k * gg x S (⟨0, by simp⟩ : Ball d) k := by
    symm
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun k _ => ?_)
    have : gg x S (⟨0, by simp⟩ : Ball d) k = 0 := by
      unfold gg
      split <;> simp [relu_zero]
    rw [this, mul_zero]
  rw [h]
  exact le_ciSup (bdd_Psi x S σ) _

lemma sup_le_two_terms {W : Type*} [Nonempty W] (A a R : W → ℝ) (p : ℝ) (hp : p = 1 ∨ p = -1)
    (hlip : ∀ v v' : W, |A v - A v'| ≤ |a v - a v'|)
    (hb1 : BddAbove (Set.range fun v => p * a v + R v))
    (hb2 : BddAbove (Set.range fun v => -(p * a v) + R v)) :
    (⨆ v, p * A v + R v) + (⨆ v, -(p * A v) + R v)
      ≤ (⨆ v, p * a v + R v) + (⨆ v, -(p * a v) + R v) := by
  have key : ∀ v v' : W, (p * A v + R v) + (-(p * A v') + R v')
      ≤ (⨆ v, p * a v + R v) + (⨆ v, -(p * a v) + R v) := by
    intro v v'
    have h1 := le_ciSup hb1 v
    have h2 := le_ciSup hb2 v'
    have h3 := le_ciSup hb1 v'
    have h4 := le_ciSup hb2 v
    have hL1 : A v - A v' ≤ |a v - a v'| := le_trans (le_abs_self _) (hlip v v')
    have hL2 : A v' - A v ≤ |a v - a v'| := by
      have h := le_trans (le_abs_self _) (hlip v' v)
      rwa [abs_sub_comm (a v')] at h
    simp only at h1 h2 h3 h4
    rcases hp with rfl | rfl <;>
      rcases abs_cases (a v - a v') with ⟨he, _⟩ | ⟨he, _⟩ <;> rw [he] at hL1 hL2 <;> linarith
  have hA : (⨆ v, p * A v + R v)
      ≤ (⨆ v, p * a v + R v) + (⨆ v, -(p * a v) + R v) - (⨆ v', -(p * A v') + R v') := by
    apply ciSup_le
    intro v
    have h : (⨆ v', -(p * A v') + R v')
        ≤ (⨆ v, p * a v + R v) + (⨆ v, -(p * a v) + R v) - (p * A v + R v) := by
      apply ciSup_le
      intro v'
      linarith [key v v']
    linarith
  linarith

lemma contraction_step (S : Finset (Fin n)) (j : Fin n) (hj : j ∉ S) :
    ∑ σ : RadSigns n, Psi x (insert j S) σ ≤ ∑ σ : RadSigns n, Psi x S σ := by
  have pt : ∀ σ : RadSigns n, Psi x (insert j S) σ + Psi x (insert j S) (flipAt j σ)
      ≤ Psi x S σ + Psi x S (flipAt j σ) := by
    intro σ
    set A : Ball d → ℝ := fun v => relu (inner ℝ (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (x j)) with hA
    set a : Ball d → ℝ := fun v => (inner ℝ (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (x j) : ℝ) with ha
    set R : Ball d → ℝ := fun v => ∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, sgn σ k * gg x S v k with hR
    have e1 : (fun v : Ball d => ∑ k, sgn σ k * gg x (insert j S) v k)
        = fun v => sgn σ j * A v + R v := by
      funext v
      rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ j)]
      congr 1
      · simp [gg, hA]
      · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k hk => ?_)
        have hkj : k ≠ j := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hk).1
        simp [gg, hkj]
    have e2 : (fun v : Ball d => ∑ k, sgn (flipAt j σ) k * gg x (insert j S) v k)
        = fun v => -(sgn σ j * A v) + R v := by
      funext v
      rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ j)]
      congr 1
      · rw [sgn_flipAt_self]
        simp [gg, hA]
      · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k hk => ?_)
        have hkj : k ≠ j := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hk).1
        rw [sgn_flipAt_ne j σ hkj]
        simp [gg, hkj]
    have e3 : (fun v : Ball d => ∑ k, sgn σ k * gg x S v k)
        = fun v => sgn σ j * a v + R v := by
      funext v
      rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ j)]
      congr 1
      simp [gg, ha, hj]
    have e4 : (fun v : Ball d => ∑ k, sgn (flipAt j σ) k * gg x S v k)
        = fun v => -(sgn σ j * a v) + R v := by
      funext v
      rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ j)]
      congr 1
      · rw [sgn_flipAt_self]
        simp [gg, ha, hj]
      · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k hk => ?_)
        have hkj : k ≠ j := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hk).1
        rw [sgn_flipAt_ne j σ hkj]
    have hb1 : BddAbove (Set.range fun v : Ball d => sgn σ j * a v + R v) := by
      have := bdd_Psi x S σ
      rwa [e3] at this
    have hb2 : BddAbove (Set.range fun v : Ball d => -(sgn σ j * a v) + R v) := by
      have := bdd_Psi x S (flipAt j σ)
      rwa [e4] at this
    have hmain := sup_le_two_terms A a R (sgn σ j)
      (by rcases sgn_cases σ j with h | h; exacts [Or.inr h, Or.inl h])
      (fun v v' => relu_lipschitz _ _) hb1 hb2
    unfold Psi
    rw [e1, e2, e3, e4]
    exact hmain
  have s1 : ∑ σ : RadSigns n, Psi x (insert j S) (flipAt j σ)
      = ∑ σ : RadSigns n, Psi x (insert j S) σ := sum_flipAt j _
  have s2 : ∑ σ : RadSigns n, Psi x S (flipAt j σ) = ∑ σ : RadSigns n, Psi x S σ :=
    sum_flipAt j _
  have hsum : ∑ σ : RadSigns n, (Psi x (insert j S) σ + Psi x (insert j S) (flipAt j σ))
      ≤ ∑ σ : RadSigns n, (Psi x S σ + Psi x S (flipAt j σ)) :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum (fun σ _ => pt σ)
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, s1, s2] at hsum
  linarith

lemma contraction (S : Finset (Fin n)) :
    ∑ σ : RadSigns n, Psi x S σ ≤ ∑ σ : RadSigns n, Psi x ∅ σ := by
  induction S using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact le_rfl
  | insert j S hj ih => exact le_trans (contraction_step x S j hj) ih

lemma Psi_empty_le (σ : RadSigns n) : Psi x ∅ σ ≤ ‖∑ k, sgn σ k • x k‖ := by
  apply ciSup_le
  intro v
  have hEq : ∑ k, sgn σ k * gg x ∅ v k
      = (inner ℝ (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (∑ k, sgn σ k • x k) : ℝ) := by
    rw [inner_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
    rw [real_inner_smul_right]
    simp [gg]
  rw [hEq]
  have h1 := abs_real_inner_le_norm (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (∑ k, sgn σ k • x k)
  have h2 : ‖(v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))‖ * ‖∑ k, sgn σ k • x k‖
      ≤ 1 * ‖∑ k, sgn σ k • x k‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right v.2 (norm_nonneg _)
  have := le_abs_self (inner ℝ (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (∑ k, sgn σ k • x k) : ℝ)
  linarith

lemma neuron_bound (σ : RadSigns n) (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    ∑ k, sgn σ k * relu (inner ℝ u (x k)) ≤ ‖u‖ * Psi x Finset.univ σ := by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (norm_nonneg u) with h | h
  · have hu : u = 0 := by
      have : ‖u‖ = 0 := h.symm
      simpa using this
    subst hu
    simp [relu_zero, ← h]
  · set c := ‖u‖ with hc
    have hcpos : 0 < c := h
    have hv : ‖(c⁻¹ • u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [norm_smul]
      simp [abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hcpos), hc]
      rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hcpos)]
    set v : Ball d := ⟨c⁻¹ • u, hv⟩ with hvdef
    have hterm : ∀ k, sgn σ k * gg x Finset.univ v k
        = c⁻¹ * (sgn σ k * relu (inner ℝ u (x k))) := by
      intro k
      have : (inner ℝ (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (x k) : ℝ)
          = c⁻¹ * (inner ℝ u (x k) : ℝ) := by
        simp [hvdef, real_inner_smul_left]
      simp only [gg, Finset.mem_univ, if_true, this,
        relu_smul (le_of_lt (inv_pos.mpr hcpos))]
      ring
    have hle : ∑ k, sgn σ k * gg x Finset.univ v k ≤ Psi x Finset.univ σ :=
      le_ciSup (bdd_Psi x Finset.univ σ) v
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => hterm k), ← Finset.mul_sum] at hle
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle (le_of_lt hcpos)
    rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hcpos), one_mul] at this
    exact this

lemma neuron_bound_abs (σ : RadSigns n) (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    |∑ k, sgn σ k * relu (inner ℝ u (x k))|
      ≤ ‖u‖ * (Psi x Finset.univ σ + Psi x Finset.univ (negAll σ)) := by
  have h1 := neuron_bound x σ u
  have h2 := neuron_bound x (negAll σ) u
  have h2' : -∑ k, sgn σ k * relu (inner ℝ u (x k)) ≤ ‖u‖ * Psi x Finset.univ (negAll σ) := by
    have : ∑ k, sgn (negAll σ) k * relu (inner ℝ u (x k))
        = -∑ k, sgn σ k * relu (inner ℝ u (x k)) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
      rw [sgn_negAll]
      ring
    rw [this] at h2
    exact h2
  have hn1 : 0 ≤ ‖u‖ * Psi x Finset.univ σ :=
    mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (Psi_nonneg x _ _)
  have hn2 : 0 ≤ ‖u‖ * Psi x Finset.univ (negAll σ) :=
    mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (Psi_nonneg x _ _)
  rw [mul_add]
  rcases abs_cases (∑ k, sgn σ k * relu (inner ℝ u (x k))) with ⟨he, _⟩ | ⟨he, _⟩ <;>
    rw [he] <;> linarith

lemma orth (k l : Fin n) (hkl : k ≠ l) : ∑ σ : RadSigns n, sgn σ k * sgn σ l = 0 := by
  have h : ∑ σ : RadSigns n, sgn (flipAt k σ) k * sgn (flipAt k σ) l
      = ∑ σ : RadSigns n, sgn σ k * sgn σ l :=
    sum_flipAt k (fun σ => sgn σ k * sgn σ l)
  have h2 : ∀ σ : RadSigns n, sgn (flipAt k σ) k * sgn (flipAt k σ) l
      = -(sgn σ k * sgn σ l) := by
    intro σ
    rw [sgn_flipAt_self, sgn_flipAt_ne k σ (Ne.symm hkl)]
    ring
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun σ _ => h2 σ)] at h
  have h3 : ∑ σ : RadSigns n, -(sgn σ k * sgn σ l) = -∑ σ : RadSigns n, sgn σ k * sgn σ l := by
    simp
  rw [h3] at h
  linarith

lemma sum_norm_sq :
    ∑ σ : RadSigns n, ‖∑ k, sgn σ k • x k‖ ^ 2
      = (Fintype.card (RadSigns n) : ℝ) * ∑ k, ‖x k‖ ^ 2 := by
  have expand : ∀ σ : RadSigns n, ‖∑ k, sgn σ k • x k‖ ^ 2
      = ∑ k, ∑ l, (sgn σ k * sgn σ l) * (inner ℝ (x k) (x l) : ℝ) := by
    intro σ
    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    rw [sum_inner]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
    rw [real_inner_smul_left, inner_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => ?_)
    rw [real_inner_smul_right]
    ring
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun σ _ => expand σ)]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  have : ∀ k : Fin n, ∑ σ : RadSigns n, ∑ l, (sgn σ k * sgn σ l) * (inner ℝ (x k) (x l) : ℝ)
      = (Fintype.card (RadSigns n) : ℝ) * ‖x k‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro k
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have hz : ∀ l : Fin n, l ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)) → l ≠ k →
        ∑ σ : RadSigns n, (sgn σ k * sgn σ l) * (inner ℝ (x k) (x l) : ℝ) = 0 := by
      intro l _ hlk
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul, orth k l (Ne.symm hlk), zero_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k hz (by simp)]
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
    have : ∑ σ : RadSigns n, sgn σ k * sgn σ k = (Fintype.card (RadSigns n) : ℝ) := by
      simp [sgn_mul_self]
    rw [this, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => this k), ← Finset.mul_sum]

end Aux

theorem ch5_theorem_5_10
    {m d n : ℕ} (B : ℝ) (Cdata : ℝ)
    (hn : 0 < n) (hB : 0 < B) (hCdata : 0 ≤ Cdata)
    (x : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (hx : ∀ i, ‖x i‖ ≤ Cdata)
    (F : {θ : (Fin m → ℝ) × (Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) // pathNorm θ.1 θ.2 ≤ B}
          → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ θ, F θ = predict (θ : (Fin m → ℝ) × (Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))).1
                          (θ : (Fin m → ℝ) × (Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))).2) :
    empRadSigned n F x ≤ 2 * B * Cdata / Real.sqrt n := by
  classical
  haveI : Nonempty {θ : (Fin m → ℝ) × (Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) //
      pathNorm θ.1 θ.2 ≤ B} := ⟨⟨(0, 0), by simpa [pathNorm] using hB.le⟩⟩
  set N : ℝ := (Fintype.card (RadSigns n) : ℝ) with hN
  have hNpos : 0 < N := by
    rw [hN]
    exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos (α := RadSigns n)
  have hnR : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt n := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hnR
  have stepA : ∀ σ : RadSigns n,
      (⨆ i, (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * F i (x k))
        ≤ (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * (B * (Psi x Finset.univ σ + Psi x Finset.univ (negAll σ))) := by
    intro σ
    apply ciSup_le
    rintro ⟨⟨w, u⟩, hθ⟩
    have hexp : ∑ k : Fin n, ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * F ⟨(w, u), hθ⟩ (x k)
        = ∑ j : Fin m, w j * ∑ k : Fin n, sgn σ k * relu (inner ℝ (u j) (x k)) := by
      simp only [hF, predict, Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
      simp only [sgn]
      ring
    set P : ℝ := Psi x Finset.univ σ + Psi x Finset.univ (negAll σ) with hP
    have hPnn : 0 ≤ P := by
      rw [hP]; exact add_nonneg (Psi_nonneg x _ _) (Psi_nonneg x _ _)
    have hbnd : ∑ k : Fin n, ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * F ⟨(w, u), hθ⟩ (x k) ≤ B * P := by
      rw [hexp]
      have h1 : ∀ j : Fin m, w j * ∑ k : Fin n, sgn σ k * relu (inner ℝ (u j) (x k))
          ≤ (|w j| * ‖u j‖) * P := by
        intro j
        have h2 := neuron_bound_abs x σ (u j)
        have h3 : w j * ∑ k : Fin n, sgn σ k * relu (inner ℝ (u j) (x k))
            ≤ |w j| * |∑ k : Fin n, sgn σ k * relu (inner ℝ (u j) (x k))| := by
          rw [← abs_mul]
          exact le_abs_self _
        have h4 : |w j| * |∑ k : Fin n, sgn σ k * relu (inner ℝ (u j) (x k))|
            ≤ |w j| * (‖u j‖ * P) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (abs_nonneg _)
        calc w j * ∑ k : Fin n, sgn σ k * relu (inner ℝ (u j) (x k))
            ≤ |w j| * (‖u j‖ * P) := le_trans h3 h4
          _ = (|w j| * ‖u j‖) * P := by ring
      refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => h1 j)) ?_
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
      have : pathNorm w u ≤ B := hθ
      have hpn : ∑ j : Fin m, |w j| * ‖u j‖ ≤ B := this
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpn hPnn
    have hinv : (0:ℝ) ≤ (n:ℝ)⁻¹ := by positivity
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbnd hinv
  have hneg : ∑ σ : RadSigns n, Psi x Finset.univ (negAll σ)
      = ∑ σ : RadSigns n, Psi x Finset.univ σ := sum_negAll (fun σ => Psi x Finset.univ σ)
  have hcontr : ∑ σ : RadSigns n, Psi x Finset.univ σ
      ≤ ∑ σ : RadSigns n, ‖∑ k, sgn σ k • x k‖ :=
    le_trans (contraction x Finset.univ) (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun σ _ => Psi_empty_le x σ))
  have hD : ∑ σ : RadSigns n, ‖∑ k, sgn σ k • x k‖ ≤ N * (Cdata * Real.sqrt n) := by
    have hcs : (∑ σ : RadSigns n, ‖∑ k, sgn σ k • x k‖)^2
        ≤ ((Finset.univ : Finset (RadSigns n)).card : ℝ)
            * ∑ σ : RadSigns n, ‖∑ k, sgn σ k • x k‖^2 := sq_sum_le_card_mul_sum_sq
    rw [sum_norm_sq x, Finset.card_univ, ← hN] at hcs
    have hxb : ∑ k, ‖x k‖^2 ≤ (n:ℝ) * Cdata^2 := by
      have hpt : ∀ k : Fin n, ‖x k‖^2 ≤ Cdata^2 := by
        intro k
        have := hx k
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg (x k)]
      calc ∑ k, ‖x k‖^2 ≤ ∑ _k : Fin n, Cdata^2 := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k _ => hpt k)
        _ = (n:ℝ) * Cdata^2 := by simp [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ]
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ σ : RadSigns n, ‖∑ k, sgn σ k • x k‖ :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _)
    have hRn : 0 ≤ N * (Cdata * Real.sqrt n) := by positivity
    have hmul : N * (N * ∑ k, ‖x k‖^2) ≤ N * (N * ((n:ℝ) * Cdata^2)) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hNpos.le
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxb hNpos.le
    have hexp2 : (N * (Cdata * Real.sqrt n))^2 = N * (N * ((n:ℝ) * Cdata^2)) := by
      rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hnR.le]; ring
    have hsq : (∑ σ : RadSigns n, ‖∑ k, sgn σ k • x k‖)^2 ≤ (N * (Cdata * Real.sqrt n))^2 := by
      rw [hexp2]; linarith
    nlinarith [hsq, hnonneg, hRn]
  have hstep : ∑ σ : RadSigns n, (⨆ i, (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * F i (x k))
      ≤ (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * B * (2 * (N * (Cdata * Real.sqrt n))) := by
    refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun σ _ => stepA σ)) ?_
    have e : ∀ σ : RadSigns n,
        (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * (B * (Psi x Finset.univ σ + Psi x Finset.univ (negAll σ)))
          = (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * B * Psi x Finset.univ σ + (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * B * Psi x Finset.univ (negAll σ) := by
      intro σ; ring
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun σ _ => e σ), Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum,
      ← Finset.mul_sum, hneg]
    have hcoef : 0 ≤ (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * B := by positivity
    nlinarith [le_trans hcontr hD, hcoef]
  have hfin : N⁻¹ * ∑ σ : RadSigns n, (⨆ i, (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * F i (x k))
      ≤ N⁻¹ * ((n:ℝ)⁻¹ * B * (2 * (N * (Cdata * Real.sqrt n)))) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hstep (by positivity)
  have heq : N⁻¹ * ((n:ℝ)⁻¹ * B * (2 * (N * (Cdata * Real.sqrt n))))
      = 2 * B * Cdata / Real.sqrt n := by
    have hs : Real.sqrt n * Real.sqrt n = (n:ℝ) := Real.mul_self_sqrt hnR.le
    field_simp
    nlinarith [hs]
  rw [empRadSigned, ← hN]
  rw [← heq]
  exact hfin

end GraduateLevel

targets.label: ch5_theorem_5_5
targets.statement:
Let \(\mathcal{H} = \{x \mapsto \langle w,x \rangle \mid w \in \mathbb{R}^d,\, \|w\|_2 \le B\}\) for some constant \(B > 0\). Moreover, assume \(\mathbb{E}_{x \sim P}[\|x\|_2^2] \leq C^2\), where \(P\) is some distribution and \(C > 0\) is a constant. Then
\[
R_S(\mathcal{H}) \le \frac{B}{n} \sqrt{\sum_{i=1}^n \|x^{(i)}\|_2^2},
\]
and
\[
R_n(\mathcal{H}) \le \frac{BC}{\sqrt{n}}.
\]

nl_proof:
By definition,
\[
R_S(\mathcal{H}) = \mathbb{E}_\sigma\left[ \sup_{\|w\|_2 \le B} \frac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}^n \sigma_i \langle w, x^{(i)} \rangle \right] = \frac{1}{n} \mathbb{E}_\sigma\left[ \sup_{\|w\|_2 \le B} \left\langle w, \sum_{i=1}^n \sigma_i x^{(i)} \right\rangle \right] = \frac{B}{n} \mathbb{E}_\sigma\left[ \left\|\sum_{i=1}^n \sigma_i x^{(i)}\right\|_2 \right],
\]
using \(\sup_{\|w\|_2 \le B} \langle w,v\rangle = B\|v\|_2\). By Jensen's inequality applied to \(\alpha \mapsto \alpha^2\),
\[
\frac{B}{n} \mathbb{E}_\sigma\left[ \left\|\sum_{i=1}^n \sigma_i x^{(i)}\right\|_2 \right] \leq \frac{B}{n} \sqrt{ \mathbb{E}_\sigma\left[\left\|\sum_{i=1}^n \sigma_i x^{(i)}\right\|_2^2\right] } = \frac{B}{n} \sqrt{\sum_{i=1}^n \|x^{(i)}\|_2^2},
\]
where the last equality uses independence of the \(\sigma_i\) and \(\mathbb{E}[\sigma_i] = 0\). This proves the bound on \(R_S(\mathcal{H})\). For the average Rademacher complexity,
\[
R_n(\mathcal{H}) = \mathbb{E}[R_S(\mathcal{H})] \le \frac{B}{n} \mathbb{E}\left[\sqrt{\sum_{i=1}^n \|x^{(i)}\|_2^2}\right] \le \frac{B}{n} \sqrt{\sum_{i=1}^n \mathbb{E}\left[\|x^{(i)}\|_2^2\right]} \le \frac{BC}{\sqrt{n}},
\]
where the first inequality is Jensen's inequality and the second uses \(\mathbb{E}_{x \sim P}[\|x\|_2^2] \leq C^2\).

context.name: Empirical Rademacher complexity
context.statement:
Given a dataset \(S = \{z_1, \dots, z_n\}\), the empirical Rademacher complexity is defined as
\[
R_S(\mathcal{F}) \stackrel{\Delta}{=} \mathbb{E}_{\sigma_1,\dots, \sigma_n} \left[ \sup_{f\in \mathcal{F}} \frac{1}{n} \sum^n_{i=1} \sigma_i f(z_i) \right].
\]
\(R_S(\mathcal{F})\) is a function of both the function class \(\mathcal{F}\) and the dataset \(S\).

context.name: Rademacher complexity
context.statement:
Let \(\mathcal{F}\) be a family of functions mapping \(Z \mapsto \mathbb{R}\), and let \(P\) be a distribution over \(Z\). The (average) Rademacher complexity of \(\mathcal{F}\) is defined as
\[
R_n(F) \triangleq \mathbb{E}_{z_1, \dots, z_n \overset{\text{iid}}{\sim} P} \left[ \mathbb{E}_{\sigma_1, \dots, \sigma_n \overset{\text{iid}}{\sim}\{ \pm 1 \}} \left[ \sup_{f\in F} \frac{1}{n} \sum^n_{i=1} \sigma_i f(z_i) \right] \right],
\]
where \(\sigma_1, \dots, \sigma_n\) are independent Rademacher random variables, i.e. each taking on the value of \(1\) or \(-1\) with probability \(1/2\).

solution:
import Mathlib

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Real

namespace GraduateLevel

def RadSigns (n : ℕ) : Type := Fin n → ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ)

instance {n} : Fintype (RadSigns n) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Fintype (Fin n → { x // x ∈ {-1, 1} }))

noncomputable def empRadSigned {ι : Type*} {𝒳 : Type*}
    (n : ℕ) (f : ι → 𝒳 → ℝ) (S : Fin n → 𝒳) : ℝ :=
  (Fintype.card (RadSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
    ∑ σ : RadSigns n, ⨆ i, (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * f i (S k)

noncomputable def popRadSigned {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {ι : Type*} {𝒳 : Type*}
    (n : ℕ) (f : ι → 𝒳 → ℝ) (μ : Measure Ω) (X : Ω → 𝒳) : ℝ :=
  ∫ ω : Fin n → Ω, empRadSigned n f (X ∘ ω) ∂(Measure.pi fun _ => μ)

noncomputable def l2LinearClass (d : ℕ) (B : ℝ) :
    {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) // ‖w‖ ≤ B} → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ :=
  fun w x => @inner ℝ _ _ (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) x

instance instNonemptyRadSigns {n : ℕ} : Nonempty (RadSigns n) :=
  ⟨fun _ => ⟨1, by decide⟩⟩

private def negElt (x : ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ)) : ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ) :=
  ⟨-(x : ℤ), by
    have h := x.2
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at h ⊢
    rcases h with h | h <;> simp [h]⟩

private def flipAt {n : ℕ} (k : Fin n) (σ : RadSigns n) : RadSigns n :=
  Function.update (σ : Fin n → ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ)) k (negElt (σ k))

private lemma flipAt_involutive {n : ℕ} (k : Fin n) : Function.Involutive (flipAt k) := by
  intro σ
  funext j
  by_cases h : j = k
  · subst h
    simp only [flipAt, Function.update_self]
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [negElt]
  · simp [flipAt, Function.update_of_ne h]

private lemma sq_coe {n : ℕ} (σ : RadSigns n) (k : Fin n) :
    ((σ k : ℝ)) * ((σ k : ℝ)) = 1 := by
  have h := (σ k).2
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at h
  rcases h with h | h <;> · rw [h]; norm_num

private lemma sum_sign_mul {n : ℕ} {k l : Fin n} (hkl : k ≠ l) :
    ∑ σ : RadSigns n, ((σ k : ℝ)) * ((σ l : ℝ)) = 0 := by
  classical
  have h1 : ∑ σ : RadSigns n, ((flipAt k σ) k : ℝ) * ((flipAt k σ) l : ℝ)
      = ∑ σ : RadSigns n, ((σ k : ℝ)) * ((σ l : ℝ)) :=
    Equiv.sum_comp (flipAt_involutive k).toPerm (fun σ => ((σ k : ℝ)) * ((σ l : ℝ)))
  have h2 : ∀ σ : RadSigns n, ((flipAt k σ) k : ℝ) * ((flipAt k σ) l : ℝ)
      = -(((σ k : ℝ)) * ((σ l : ℝ))) := by
    intro σ
    have hkl' : l ≠ k := Ne.symm hkl
    simp only [flipAt, Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne hkl', negElt]
    push_cast
    ring
  simp only [h2] at h1
  rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib] at h1
  linarith

private lemma sup_inner_eq {d : ℕ} {B c : ℝ} (hB : 0 < B) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    (⨆ w : {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) // ‖w‖ ≤ B},
        c * (inner ℝ (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) v)) = c * (B * ‖v‖) := by
  haveI : Nonempty {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) // ‖w‖ ≤ B} := ⟨⟨0, by simp [hB.le]⟩⟩
  have hb : ∀ w : {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) // ‖w‖ ≤ B},
      c * (inner ℝ (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) v) ≤ c * (B * ‖v‖) := by
    intro w
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hc
    calc (inner ℝ (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) v : ℝ)
        ≤ ‖(w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))‖ * ‖v‖ := real_inner_le_norm _ _
      _ ≤ B * ‖v‖ := by
          have := w.2
          have : ‖(w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))‖ ≤ B := w.2
          nlinarith [norm_nonneg v, norm_nonneg (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))]
  refine le_antisymm (ciSup_le hb) ?_
  have hbdd : BddAbove (Set.range fun w : {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) // ‖w‖ ≤ B} =>
      c * (inner ℝ (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) v)) := by
    refine ⟨c * (B * ‖v‖), ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
    exact hb w
  rcases eq_or_ne v 0 with rfl | hv
  · simp
  · have hvn : 0 < ‖v‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hv
    have hw : ‖(B / ‖v‖) • v‖ ≤ B := by
      rw [norm_smul]
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hvn)]
    have hle := le_ciSup hbdd (⟨(B / ‖v‖) • v, hw⟩ :
      {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) // ‖w‖ ≤ B})
    refine le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) hle
    simp only [real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    field_simp <;> ring

private lemma emp_eq {d n : ℕ} {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 < B)
    (S : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    empRadSigned n (l2LinearClass d B) S
      = (Fintype.card (RadSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ * (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * B *
          ∑ σ : RadSigns n, ‖∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) • S k‖ := by
  have hstep : ∀ σ : RadSigns n,
      (⨆ i, (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * l2LinearClass d B i (S k))
        = (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * (B * ‖∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) • S k‖) := by
    intro σ
    have h1 : ∀ i : {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) // ‖w‖ ≤ B},
        (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * l2LinearClass d B i (S k)
          = (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * (inner ℝ (i : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
              (∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) • S k)) := by
      intro i
      congr 1
      rw [inner_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => by
        simp [l2LinearClass, real_inner_smul_right]
    simp only [h1]
    exact sup_inner_eq hB (by positivity) _
  unfold empRadSigned
  simp only [hstep]
  have : ∑ σ : RadSigns n, ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ * (B * ‖∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) • S k‖))
      = ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ * B) * ∑ σ : RadSigns n, ‖∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) • S k‖ := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => by ring
  rw [this]
  ring

private lemma emp_nonneg {d n : ℕ} {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 < B)
    (S : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    0 ≤ empRadSigned n (l2LinearClass d B) S := by
  rw [emp_eq hB]
  have h1 : (0:ℝ) ≤ ∑ σ : RadSigns n, ‖∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) • S k‖ :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _
  have h2 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card (RadSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ * (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * B := by positivity
  exact mul_nonneg h2 h1

private lemma emp_bound {d n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 < B)
    (S : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    empRadSigned n (l2LinearClass d B) S ≤ (B / n) * Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin n, ‖S i‖ ^ 2) := by
  classical
  rw [emp_eq hB]
  set N : ℝ := (Fintype.card (RadSigns n) : ℝ) with hNdef
  have hN : 0 < N := by
    rw [hNdef]
    exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  set v : RadSigns n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := fun σ => ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) • S k with hvdef
  set Q : ℝ := ∑ i : Fin n, ‖S i‖ ^ 2 with hQdef
  have hQ : 0 ≤ Q := by
    rw [hQdef]; positivity
  have hexp : ∀ σ : RadSigns n, ‖v σ‖ ^ 2
      = ∑ k : Fin n, ∑ l : Fin n, ((σ k : ℝ) * (σ l : ℝ)) * (inner ℝ (S k) (S l) : ℝ) := by
    intro σ
    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    simp only [hvdef, sum_inner, inner_sum, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right,
      Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => by
      rw [real_inner_comm (S l) (S k)]; ring
  have hsum : ∑ σ : RadSigns n, ‖v σ‖ ^ 2 = N * Q := by
    simp only [hexp]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm, hQdef, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have hkey : ∀ l : Fin n, ∑ σ : RadSigns n,
        ((σ k : ℝ) * (σ l : ℝ)) * (inner ℝ (S k) (S l) : ℝ)
          = if l = k then N * ‖S k‖ ^ 2 else 0 := by
      intro l
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
      by_cases h : l = k
      · subst h
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun σ _ => sq_coe σ l)]
        simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, Finset.card_univ]
        rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
        simp [hNdef]
      · rw [sum_sign_mul (Ne.symm h)]
        simp [h]
    simp only [hkey]
    simp
  have hjensen : (∑ σ : RadSigns n, ‖v σ‖) ^ 2 ≤ N * (N * Q) := by
    have := sq_sum_le_card_mul_sum_sq (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (RadSigns n)))
      (f := fun σ => ‖v σ‖)
    rw [hsum] at this
    simpa [hNdef, Finset.card_univ] using this
  have hsl : ∑ σ : RadSigns n, ‖v σ‖ ≤ N * Real.sqrt Q := by
    have ha : (0:ℝ) ≤ ∑ σ : RadSigns n, ‖v σ‖ := Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _
    have hb : (0:ℝ) ≤ N * Real.sqrt Q := by positivity
    have hsq : (∑ σ : RadSigns n, ‖v σ‖) ^ 2 ≤ (N * Real.sqrt Q) ^ 2 := by
      rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hQ]
      nlinarith [hjensen]
    nlinarith [hsq, ha, hb]
  have hc : (0:ℝ) ≤ N⁻¹ * (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * B := by positivity
  calc N⁻¹ * (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * B * ∑ σ : RadSigns n, ‖v σ‖
      ≤ N⁻¹ * (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * B * (N * Real.sqrt Q) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsl hc
    _ = (B / n) * Real.sqrt Q := by
        field_simp <;> ring

theorem ch5_theorem_5_5
    {d n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {B C : ℝ} (hB : 0 < B) (hC : 0 < C)
    (S : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    empRadSigned n (l2LinearClass d B) S
      ≤ (B / n) * Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin n, ‖S i‖ ^ 2)
    ∧ ∀ {Ω : Type} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
        (X : Ω → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
        Measurable X →
        Integrable (fun ω => ‖X ω‖ ^ 2) P →
        (∫ ω, ‖X ω‖ ^ 2 ∂P) ≤ C ^ 2 →
        popRadSigned n (l2LinearClass d B) P X
          ≤ B * C / Real.sqrt n := by
  refine ⟨emp_bound hn hB S, ?_⟩
  intro Ω _ P _ X hXm hXint hCbd
  classical
  have hnR : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  set s : ℝ := Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) with hsdef
  have hs0 : 0 < s := by
    rw [hsdef]; exact Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hnR
  have hss : s * s = (n : ℝ) := by
    rw [hsdef]; exact Real.mul_self_sqrt hnR.le
  set a : ℝ := C * s with hadef
  have ha : 0 < a := by rw [hadef]; positivity
  set g : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun ω => ∑ k : Fin n, ‖X (ω k)‖ ^ 2 with hgdef
  have hgint : Integrable g (Measure.pi fun _ => P) := by
    rw [hgdef]
    exact integrable_finset_sum _ fun k _ =>
      integrable_comp_eval (μ := fun _ : Fin n => P) (i := k) (f := fun ω => ‖X ω‖ ^ 2) hXint
  have hbound : ∀ ω : Fin n → Ω,
      empRadSigned n (l2LinearClass d B) (X ∘ ω) ≤ (B / n) * (g ω / (2 * a) + a / 2) := by
    intro ω
    have h1 := emp_bound hn hB (X ∘ ω)
    have hg0 : 0 ≤ g ω := by rw [hgdef]; positivity
    have h2 : Real.sqrt (g ω) ≤ g ω / (2 * a) + a / 2 := by
      have ht : (Real.sqrt (g ω)) ^ 2 = g ω := Real.sq_sqrt hg0
      set t := Real.sqrt (g ω) with htdef
      rw [← ht, ← sub_nonneg]
      have hkey : t ^ 2 / (2 * a) + a / 2 - t
          = (t - a) ^ 2 / (2 * a) := by
        field_simp
        ring
      rw [hkey]
      positivity
    have h3 : (∑ i : Fin n, ‖(X ∘ ω) i‖ ^ 2) = g ω := by
      rw [hgdef]; rfl
    rw [h3] at h1
    refine h1.trans ?_
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (by positivity)
  have hint2 : Integrable (fun ω => (B / n) * (g ω / (2 * a) + a / 2))
      (Measure.pi fun _ => P) := by
    have : (fun ω => (B / n) * (g ω / (2 * a) + a / 2))
        = fun ω => ((B / n) / (2 * a)) * g ω + (B / n) * (a / 2) := by
      funext ω; ring
    rw [this]
    exact (hgint.const_mul _).add (integrable_const _)
  have hmono : popRadSigned n (l2LinearClass d B) P X
      ≤ ∫ ω : Fin n → Ω, (B / n) * (g ω / (2 * a) + a / 2) ∂(Measure.pi fun _ => P) := by
    unfold popRadSigned
    refine integral_mono_of_nonneg (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => emp_nonneg hB _)
      hint2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hbound)
  have hEq : ∫ ω : Fin n → Ω, (B / n) * (g ω / (2 * a) + a / 2) ∂(Measure.pi fun _ => P)
      = (B / n) * ((∫ ω : Fin n → Ω, g ω ∂(Measure.pi fun _ => P)) / (2 * a) + a / 2) := by
    have hfun : (fun ω : Fin n → Ω => (B / n) * (g ω / (2 * a) + a / 2))
        = fun ω => ((B / n) / (2 * a)) * g ω + (B / n) * (a / 2) := by
      funext ω; ring
    rw [hfun, integral_add (hgint.const_mul _) (integrable_const _), integral_const_mul,
      integral_const]
    rw [probReal_univ, one_smul]
    ring
  have hgval : (∫ ω : Fin n → Ω, g ω ∂(Measure.pi fun _ => P)) = n * ∫ ω, ‖X ω‖ ^ 2 ∂P := by
    have hgg : (fun ω : Fin n → Ω => g ω) = fun ω => ∑ k : Fin n, ‖X (ω k)‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [hgdef]
    rw [hgg, integral_finset_sum _ fun k _ =>
      integrable_comp_eval (μ := fun _ : Fin n => P) (i := k) (f := fun ω => ‖X ω‖ ^ 2) hXint]
    have hone : ∀ k : Fin n, (∫ ω : Fin n → Ω, ‖X (ω k)‖ ^ 2 ∂(Measure.pi fun _ => P))
        = ∫ ω, ‖X ω‖ ^ 2 ∂P := fun k =>
      integral_comp_eval (μ := fun _ : Fin n => P) (i := k) (f := fun ω => ‖X ω‖ ^ 2)
        hXint.aestronglyMeasurable
    simp [hone, Finset.card_univ]
  have hG0 : 0 ≤ ∫ ω : Fin n → Ω, g ω ∂(Measure.pi fun _ => P) := by
    refine integral_nonneg fun ω => ?_
    rw [hgdef]; positivity
  have hGle : (∫ ω : Fin n → Ω, g ω ∂(Measure.pi fun _ => P)) ≤ (n : ℝ) * C ^ 2 := by
    rw [hgval]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hCbd hnR.le
  refine hmono.trans ?_
  rw [hEq]
  set G : ℝ := ∫ ω : Fin n → Ω, g ω ∂(Measure.pi fun _ => P) with hGdef
  have hfin : (B / n) * (G / (2 * a) + a / 2) ≤ (B / n) * (((n:ℝ) * C ^ 2) / (2 * a) + a / 2) := by
    have hBn : 0 ≤ B / (n:ℝ) := by positivity
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hBn
    have hd : G / (2 * a) ≤ ((n:ℝ) * C ^ 2) / (2 * a) := by
      gcongr
    linarith
  refine hfin.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  rw [hadef, ← hss]
  field_simp <;> ring

end GraduateLevel

targets.label: ch8_theorem_8_3
targets.statement: Suppose gradient descent on \(\widehat{L}(\beta)\) with initialization \(\beta^0 = 0\) converges to a solution \(\hat{\beta}\) such that \(\widehat{L}(\hat{\beta}) = 0\). Then \(\hat{\beta} = \beta^\star\).

nl_proof:
We first show via induction that \(\beta^t \in \operatorname{span}\{x^{(1)}, \dots, x^{(n)}\}\) for all \(t\). For the base case, note that \(\beta^0 = 0 \in \operatorname{span}\{x^{(1)}, \dots, x^{(n)}\}\). Now suppose \(\beta^{t-1} \in \operatorname{span}\{x^{(1)}, \dots, x^{(n)}\}\). Recall that \(\beta^t = \beta^{t-1} - \eta \nabla \widehat{L}(\beta^{t-1})\). Since left-multiplying any vector by \(X^\top\) amounts to taking a linear combination of the rows of \(X\), it follows that \(\eta \nabla \widehat{L}(\beta^{t-1}) = \eta X^\top(X\beta^{t-1} - \vec{y}) \in \operatorname{span}\{x^{(1)}, \dots, x^{(n)}\}\), and so \(\beta^t \in \operatorname{span}\{x^{(1)}, \dots, x^{(n)}\}\). This proves the induction step.

Next, we show that \(\hat{\beta} \in \operatorname{span}\{x^{(1)}, \dots, x^{(n)}\}\) and \(\widehat{L}(\hat{\beta}) = 0\) implies \(\hat{\beta} = \beta^\star\). By definition, \(\hat{\beta} \in \operatorname{span}\{x^{(1)}, \dots, x^{(n)}\}\) implies \(\hat{\beta} = X^\top v\) for some \(v \in \mathbb{R}^n\). Since \(\widehat{L}(\hat{\beta}) = 0\), we have \(0 = X\hat{\beta} - \vec{y} = XX^\top v - \vec{y}\). This implies \(v = (XX^\top)^{-1}y\), and so \(\hat{\beta} = X^\top v = X^\top(XX^\top)^{-1}\vec{y} = X^+\vec{y} = \beta^\star\).

context.name: Minimum-norm least-squares solution
context.statement: From the referenced lemma, we can derive an explicit formula for the minimum norm interpolant \(\beta^\star \triangleq \operatorname{argmin}_{\beta:\widehat{L}(\beta)=0}\|\beta\|_2\). \(\beta^\star = X^+\vec{y}\).

context.name: Characterization of global minimizers of underdetermined least squares
context.statement: Let \(X^+\) denote the pseudoinverse of \(X\) (since \(X\) is full rank, \(XX^\top\) is invertible and \(X^+ = X^\top(XX^\top)^{-1}\); note that \(XX^+X = X\)). Then \(\beta\) is a global minimizer if and only if \(\beta = X^+\vec{y} + \zeta\) for some \(\zeta\) such that \(\zeta \perp x_1, \dots, x_n\).

context.name: Empirical least-squares loss
context.statement: In the underdetermined least-squares setting of Chapter 8, let \(X \in \mathbb{R}^{n \times d}\) have rows \(x^{(1)}, \dots, x^{(n)}\) and let \(\vec{y} \in \mathbb{R}^n\) be the response vector, where \(n < d\). Assume \(X\) is full rank. Define the empirical least-squares loss by \(\widehat{L}(\beta) = \tfrac12\|X\beta - \vec{y}\|_2^2\). Its gradient is \(\nabla \widehat{L}(\beta) = X^\top(X\beta - \vec{y})\), and \(\widehat{L}(\beta) = 0\) if and only if \(X\beta = \vec{y}\).

open MeasureTheory Real
open scoped InnerProductSpace

namespace GraduateLevel

  map_add' θ₁ θ₂ := by
    ext i; simp only [designMatrixMul, inner_add_left]; rfl

noncomputable def gdSeq {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]

theorem ch8_theorem_8_3
    {n d : ℕ} (hnd : n < d)
    (x : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (η : ℝ)

    (Lhat : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
    (hLhat : Lhat = fun β =>
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖designMatrixMul x β - y‖ ^ 2)

    (XXTinv : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hinvL : XXTinv ∘ₗ
        (designMatrixLinearMap x ∘ₗ
          LinearMap.adjoint (designMatrixLinearMap x))
        = LinearMap.id)
    (hinvR :
        (designMatrixLinearMap x ∘ₗ
          LinearMap.adjoint (designMatrixLinearMap x)) ∘ₗ XXTinv
        = LinearMap.id)

    (βhat : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (hconv : Filter.Tendsto
        (gdSeq Lhat (fun _ => η) 0) Filter.atTop (nhds βhat))

    (hfit : Lhat βhat = 0) :
    βhat = LinearMap.adjoint (designMatrixLinearMap x) (XXTinv y) := by
  classical
  set A : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) →ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) :=
    designMatrixLinearMap x with hA
  set Ac : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) :=
    LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap A with hAc
  have hAcA : ∀ b, Ac b = A b := fun b => rfl
  have hmul : ∀ b, designMatrixMul x b = A b := fun b => rfl
  -- gradient formula
  have hgrad : ∀ β, gradient Lhat β = LinearMap.adjoint A (A β - y) := by
    intro β
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun b => Ac b - y) Ac β := (Ac.hasFDerivAt).sub_const y
    have h2 := h1.norm_sq
    have h3 : HasFDerivAt Lhat
        ((1/2 : ℝ) • (2 • ((innerSL ℝ (Ac β - y)).comp Ac))) β := by
      rw [hLhat]
      exact h2.const_mul _
    have h4 : HasGradientAt Lhat (LinearMap.adjoint A (A β - y)) β := by
      rw [hasGradientAt_iff_hasFDerivAt]
      convert h3 using 1
      ext w
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp',
        Function.comp_apply, innerSL_apply, InnerProductSpace.toDual_apply,
        smul_eq_mul, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply]
      rw [LinearMap.adjoint_inner_left]
      simp [hAcA, real_inner_comm]
    exact h4.gradient
  -- the sequence stays in the range of the adjoint
  set S : Submodule ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) := LinearMap.range (LinearMap.adjoint A) with hS
  have hseq : ∀ k, gdSeq Lhat (fun _ => η) 0 k ∈ S := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => simpa [gdSeq] using S.zero_mem
    | succ k ih =>
        have : gdSeq Lhat (fun _ => η) 0 (k+1)
            = gdSeq Lhat (fun _ => η) 0 k - η • gradient Lhat (gdSeq Lhat (fun _ => η) 0 k) := rfl
        rw [this, hgrad]
        exact S.sub_mem ih (S.smul_mem _ (LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _))
  have hclosed : IsClosed (S : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))) :=
    S.closed_of_finiteDimensional
  have hmem : βhat ∈ S := hclosed.mem_of_tendsto hconv (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hseq)
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hmem
  -- zero loss gives A βhat = y
  have hzero : A βhat - y = 0 := by
    have : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖designMatrixMul x βhat - y‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
      rw [hLhat] at hfit; exact hfit
    have h2 : ‖A βhat - y‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
      rw [hmul] at this; linarith
    have := pow_eq_zero_iff (n := 2) (by norm_num) |>.mp h2
    exact norm_eq_zero.mp this
  have hAy : A (LinearMap.adjoint A v) = y := by
    rw [hv]; linear_combination (norm := module) hzero
  have hv2 : v = XXTinv y := by
    have := congrArg XXTinv hAy
    calc v = (XXTinv ∘ₗ (A ∘ₗ LinearMap.adjoint A)) v := by rw [hinvL]; rfl
    _ = XXTinv (A (LinearMap.adjoint A v)) := rfl
    _ = XXTinv y := this
  rw [← hv, hv2]

end GraduateLevel

targets.label: ch9_lemma_9_1
targets.statement:
Suppose \(z \sim \mathcal{N}(v, I)\). Then,
\[
\mathbb{E}[z \otimes z \otimes z] = v \otimes v \otimes v + \sum_{l=1}^d \mathbb{E}[z] \otimes e_l \otimes e_l + \sum_{l=1}^d e_l \otimes \mathbb{E}[z] \otimes e_l + \sum_{l=1}^d e_l \otimes e_l \otimes \mathbb{E}[z],
\]
where \(e_1,\dots,e_d\) denote the canonical basis vectors.

nl_proof:
We compute the third moment element-wise. That is,
\[
(\mathbb{E}[z \otimes z \otimes z])_{ijk} = \mathbb{E}[z_i z_j z_k] = \mathbb{E}[(v_i + \xi_i)(v_j + \xi_j)(v_k + \xi_k)] \quad (z = v + \xi,\ \xi \sim \mathcal{N}(0, I))
\]
\[
= v_i v_j v_k + \underbrace{\mathbb{E}[v_i v_j \xi_k] + \mathbb{E}[v_i \xi_j v_k] + \mathbb{E}[\xi_i v_j v_k]}_{=0} + \mathbb{E}[v_i \xi_j \xi_k] + \mathbb{E}[v_j \xi_i \xi_k] + \mathbb{E}[v_k \xi_i \xi_j] + \mathbb{E}[\xi_i \xi_j \xi_k].
\]
To explicitly compute the last four terms, we note that:
\[
\mathbb{E}[\xi_i \xi_k] = \begin{cases} 0 & \text{if } i \neq k \\ \mathbb{E}[\xi_i^2] = 1 & \text{if } i = k, \end{cases}
\]
and that for any choice of \(i, j, k\),
\[
\mathbb{E}[\xi_i \xi_j \xi_k] = 0.
\]
Therefore,
\[
(\mathbb{E}[z \otimes z \otimes z])_{ijk} = v_i v_j v_k + v_i \mathbf{1}[j=k] + v_j \mathbf{1}[i=k] + v_k \mathbf{1}[i=j].
\]
Since \(\left(\sum_{l=1}^d v \otimes e_l \otimes e_l\right)_{ijk} = \sum_{l=1}^d v_i e_{lj} e_{lk} = v_i \mathbb{I}(j=k)\), we have proven that:
\[
\mathbb{E}[z \otimes z \otimes z] = v \otimes v \otimes v + \sum_{l=1}^d v \otimes e_l \otimes e_l + \sum_{l=1}^d e_l \otimes v \otimes e_l + \sum_{l=1}^d e_l \otimes e_l \otimes v.
\]

import Mathlib

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped ENNReal NNReal

namespace GraduateLevel

noncomputable def stdGaussianPi (n : ℕ) : Measure (Fin n → ℝ) :=
  Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => gaussianReal 0 1

lemma int_pow_gauss (n : ℕ) : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x ^ n) (gaussianReal 0 1) := by
  rcases n with _ | m
  · simpa using (integrable_const (1 : ℝ) (μ := gaussianReal 0 1))
  · have h : MemLp (id : ℝ → ℝ) ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) (gaussianReal 0 1) := by
      have := memLp_id_gaussianReal (μ := 0) (v := 1) ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0)
      simpa using this
    have h2 := h.integrable_norm_pow (p := m + 1) (by omega)
    refine h2.mono ?_ ?_
    · exact (measurable_id.pow_const _).aestronglyMeasurable
    · filter_upwards with x
      simp [abs_pow]

lemma m1 : ∫ x : ℝ, x ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) = 0 := by
  simpa using integral_id_gaussianReal (μ := 0) (v := 1)

lemma m2 : ∫ x : ℝ, x ^ 2 ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) = 1 := by
  have hv := variance_fun_id_gaussianReal (μ := 0) (v := 1)
  have hL : MemLp (fun x : ℝ => x) 2 (gaussianReal 0 1) := by
    have := memLp_id_gaussianReal (μ := 0) (v := 1) (2 : ℝ≥0)
    simpa using this
  rw [variance_def' hL, m1] at hv
  simpa using hv

lemma m3 : ∫ x : ℝ, x ^ 3 ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) = 0 := by
  have hmap : (gaussianReal 0 1).map (fun x : ℝ => -x) = gaussianReal 0 1 := by
    simpa using gaussianReal_map_neg (μ := 0) (v := 1)
  have h1 : ∫ x : ℝ, x ^ 3 ∂((gaussianReal 0 1).map (fun x : ℝ => -x))
      = ∫ x : ℝ, (-x) ^ 3 ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) :=
    integral_map (μ := gaussianReal 0 1) (φ := fun x : ℝ => -x) (f := fun x : ℝ => x ^ 3)
      measurable_neg.aemeasurable (measurable_id.pow_const 3).aestronglyMeasurable
  rw [hmap] at h1
  have h2 : ∫ x : ℝ, (-x) ^ 3 ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) = - ∫ x : ℝ, x ^ 3 ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) := by
    rw [← integral_neg]
    congr 1
    funext x
    ring
  rw [h2] at h1
  linarith

lemma poly_int (a b c e : ℝ) :
    ∫ x : ℝ, (a + b * x + c * x ^ 2 + e * x ^ 3) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) = a + c := by
  have hI1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x) (gaussianReal 0 1) := by
    simpa using int_pow_gauss 1
  have hI2 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) (gaussianReal 0 1) := int_pow_gauss 2
  have hI3 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 3) (gaussianReal 0 1) := int_pow_gauss 3
  have hc : Integrable (fun _ : ℝ => a) (gaussianReal 0 1) := integrable_const a
  have hb : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => b * x) (gaussianReal 0 1) := hI1.const_mul b
  have hcc : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => c * x ^ 2) (gaussianReal 0 1) := hI2.const_mul c
  have he : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => e * x ^ 3) (gaussianReal 0 1) := hI3.const_mul e
  have e1 : ∫ x : ℝ, (a + b * x + c * x ^ 2 + e * x ^ 3) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1)
      = (∫ x : ℝ, (a + b * x + c * x ^ 2) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1))
        + ∫ x : ℝ, e * x ^ 3 ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) :=
    integral_add ((hc.add hb).add hcc) he
  have e2 : ∫ x : ℝ, (a + b * x + c * x ^ 2) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1)
      = (∫ x : ℝ, (a + b * x) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1))
        + ∫ x : ℝ, c * x ^ 2 ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) :=
    integral_add (hc.add hb) hcc
  have e3 : ∫ x : ℝ, (a + b * x) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1)
      = (∫ _ : ℝ, a ∂(gaussianReal 0 1)) + ∫ x : ℝ, b * x ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) :=
    integral_add hc hb
  rw [e1, e2, e3, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, m1, m2, m3,
    integral_const]
  simp

lemma pi_prod (d : ℕ) (s : Finset (Fin d)) (g : Fin d → ℝ → ℝ) :
    ∫ ξ, ∏ l ∈ s, g l (ξ l) ∂(stdGaussianPi d)
      = ∏ l ∈ s, ∫ x, g l x ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) := by
  have key := integral_fintype_prod_eq_prod (𝕜 := ℝ) (ι := Fin d) (E := fun _ => ℝ)
      (fun l x => if l ∈ s then g l x else 1) (μ := fun _ => gaussianReal 0 1)
  have step : ∀ l : Fin d, (∫ x, (if l ∈ s then g l x else 1) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1))
      = if l ∈ s then (∫ x, g l x ∂(gaussianReal 0 1)) else 1 := by
    intro l
    split <;> simp
  simp only [Finset.prod_ite_mem, Finset.univ_inter, step] at key
  rw [stdGaussianPi]
  rw [key]

lemma pi1 (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (g : ℝ → ℝ) :
    ∫ ξ, g (ξ i) ∂(stdGaussianPi d) = ∫ x, g x ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) := by
  have := pi_prod d {i} (fun _ => g)
  simpa using this

lemma pi2 (d : ℕ) (i j : Fin d) (hij : i ≠ j) (g h : ℝ → ℝ) :
    ∫ ξ, g (ξ i) * h (ξ j) ∂(stdGaussianPi d)
      = (∫ x, g x ∂(gaussianReal 0 1)) * (∫ x, h x ∂(gaussianReal 0 1)) := by
  have := pi_prod d {i, j} (fun l => if l = i then g else h)
  simpa [Finset.prod_insert, hij, Ne.symm hij] using this

lemma pi3 (d : ℕ) (i j k : Fin d) (hij : i ≠ j) (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k)
    (g h f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    ∫ ξ, g (ξ i) * h (ξ j) * f (ξ k) ∂(stdGaussianPi d)
      = (∫ x, g x ∂(gaussianReal 0 1)) * (∫ x, h x ∂(gaussianReal 0 1))
        * (∫ x, f x ∂(gaussianReal 0 1)) := by
  have := pi_prod d {i, j, k} (fun l => if l = i then g else if l = j then h else f)
  simpa [Finset.prod_insert, hij, hik, hjk, Ne.symm hij, Ne.symm hik, Ne.symm hjk,
    mul_assoc] using this

lemma lin1 (a : ℝ) : ∫ x : ℝ, (a + x) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) = a := by
  have h : (fun x : ℝ => a + x) = fun x : ℝ => a + 1 * x + 0 * x ^ 2 + 0 * x ^ 3 := by
    funext x; ring
  rw [h, poly_int]
  ring

lemma lin2 (a : ℝ) : ∫ x : ℝ, (a + x) * (a + x) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) = a * a + 1 := by
  have h : ∀ x : ℝ, (a + x) * (a + x) = a * a + (2 * a) * x + 1 * x ^ 2 + 0 * x ^ 3 := by
    intro x; ring
  simp_rw [h]
  rw [poly_int]

lemma lin3 (a : ℝ) :
    ∫ x : ℝ, (a + x) * (a + x) * (a + x) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) = a * a * a + 3 * a := by
  have h : ∀ x : ℝ, (a + x) * (a + x) * (a + x)
      = a * a * a + (3 * a ^ 2) * x + (3 * a) * x ^ 2 + 1 * x ^ 3 := by
    intro x; ring
  simp_rw [h]
  rw [poly_int]

theorem ch9_lemma_9_1 (d : ℕ) (v : Fin d → ℝ) (i j k : Fin d) :
    ∫ ξ, (v i + ξ i) * (v j + ξ j) * (v k + ξ k) ∂(stdGaussianPi d)
      = v i * v j * v k
        + v i * (if j = k then 1 else 0)
        + v j * (if i = k then 1 else 0)
        + v k * (if i = j then 1 else 0) := by
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst hij
    by_cases hik : i = k
    · subst hik
      rw [pi1 d i (fun x => (v i + x) * (v i + x) * (v i + x)), lin3,
        if_pos (rfl : i = i)]
      ring
    · rw [pi2 d i k hik (fun x => (v i + x) * (v i + x)) (fun x => v k + x), lin2, lin1]
      simp [hik]
      ring
  · by_cases hik : i = k
    · subst hik
      have hji : j ≠ i := fun h => hij h.symm
      have hre : ∀ ξ : Fin d → ℝ, (v i + ξ i) * (v j + ξ j) * (v i + ξ i)
          = ((v i + ξ i) * (v i + ξ i)) * (v j + ξ j) := by intro ξ; ring
      simp_rw [hre]
      rw [pi2 d i j hij (fun x => (v i + x) * (v i + x)) (fun x => v j + x), lin2, lin1]
      simp [hij, hji]
      ring
    · by_cases hjk : j = k
      · subst hjk
        have hre : ∀ ξ : Fin d → ℝ, (v i + ξ i) * (v j + ξ j) * (v j + ξ j)
            = (v i + ξ i) * ((v j + ξ j) * (v j + ξ j)) := by intro ξ; ring
        simp_rw [hre]
        rw [pi2 d i j hij (fun x => v i + x) (fun x => (v j + x) * (v j + x)), lin1, lin2]
        simp [hij]
        ring
      · rw [pi3 d i j k hij hik hjk (fun x => v i + x) (fun x => v j + x) (fun x => v k + x),
          lin1, lin1, lin1]
        simp [hij, hik, hjk]

end GraduateLevel
