theorem ch2_corollary_2_18
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (X : Fin n → Ω → ℝ)
    (hmeas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) P)
    (hindep : iIndepFun X P)
    (hbdd : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, X i ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hident : ∀ i, Measure.map (X i) P = Measure.map (X 0) P)
    (h_int : ∀ t, Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X 0 ω)) P)
    (μ : ℝ) (hmu : μ = ∫ ω, X 0 ω ∂P) :
    (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
        (P {ω | (1 + ε) * μ ≤ (∑ i, X i ω) / n}).toReal
          ≤ Real.exp (-(n : ℝ) * μ * ε ^ 2 / (2 + ε))) ∧
    (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
        (P {ω | (∑ i, X i ω) / n ≤ (1 - ε) * μ}).toReal
          ≤ Real.exp (-(n : ℝ) * μ * ε ^ 2 / 2)) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t →
        (P {ω | μ + Real.sqrt (2 * μ * t / n) + t / (3 * n) ≤ (∑ i, X i ω) / n}).toReal
          ≤ Real.exp (-t)) := by
  classical
  let Y : Fin n → Ω → ℝ := fun i => (hmeas i).mk (X i)
  have hXY (i : Fin n) : X i =ᵐ[P] Y i := (hmeas i).ae_eq_mk
  have hYmeas (i : Fin n) : Measurable (Y i) := (hmeas i).measurable_mk
  have hYb (i : Fin n) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, Y i ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    filter_upwards [hbdd i, hXY i] with ω hb heq
    rwa [← heq]
  have hYindep : iIndepFun Y P := hindep.congr hXY
  have hid (i : Fin n) : IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) P P :=
    ⟨hmeas i, hmeas 0, hident i⟩
  have hmeanX (i : Fin n) : ∫ ω, X i ω ∂P = μ := by
    calc
      ∫ ω, X i ω ∂P = ∫ ω, X 0 ω ∂P := (hid i).integral_eq
      _ = μ := hmu.symm
  have hmeanY (i : Fin n) : ∫ ω, Y i ω ∂P = μ := by
    rw [integral_congr_ae (hXY i).symm]
    exact hmeanX i
  have hYexp (i : Fin n) (s : ℝ) :
      Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (s * Y i ω)) P := by
    have hi : Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (s * X i ω)) P := by
      have hd := (hid i).comp (measurable_const_mul s |>.exp)
      exact hd.integrable_iff.mpr (h_int s)
    exact hi.congr ((hXY i).fun_comp fun x => Real.exp (s * x))
  have hmgfY (i : Fin n) (s : ℝ) :
      mgf (Y i) P s ≤ Real.exp (μ * (Real.exp s - 1)) := by
    simpa [hmeanY i] using
      mgf_le_exp_mean_of_mem_Icc P (Y i) (hYmeas i).aemeasurable
        (hYb i) (hYexp i) s
  let S : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => ∑ i, Y i ω
  have hSint (s : ℝ) : Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (s * S ω)) P := by
    simpa [S] using hYindep.integrable_exp_mul_sum hYmeas
      (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => hYexp i s)
  have hmgfS (s : ℝ) :
      mgf S P s ≤ Real.exp ((n : ℝ) * μ * (Real.exp s - 1)) := by
    calc
      mgf S P s = ∏ i : Fin n, mgf (Y i) P s := by
        rw [show S = ∑ i : Fin n, Y i by
          funext ω
          simp [S]]
        exact hYindep.mgf_sum hYmeas (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))
      _ ≤ ∏ _i : Fin n, Real.exp (μ * (Real.exp s - 1)) := by
        exact Finset.prod_le_prod (fun _ _ => mgf_nonneg) (fun i _ => hmgfY i s)
      _ = Real.exp (μ * (Real.exp s - 1)) ^ n := by simp
      _ = Real.exp ((n : ℝ) * μ * (Real.exp s - 1)) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
        congr 1
        ring
  have hsum_ae : (fun ω => ∑ i, X i ω) =ᵐ[P] S := by
    have hsums (s : Finset (Fin n)) :
        (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) =ᵐ[P] fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, Y i ω := by
      induction s using Finset.induction_on with
      | empty => simp
      | @insert i s hi ih =>
          filter_upwards [hXY i, ih] with ω h_i h_s
          simp only [Finset.sum_insert hi]
          rw [h_i, h_s]
    simpa [S] using hsums Finset.univ
  have hn_nat : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne n)
  have hn : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn_nat
  have hμ : 0 ≤ μ := by
    rw [hmu]
    exact integral_nonneg_of_ae ((hbdd 0).mono fun _ h => h.1)
  have hmeasure_ge (a : ℝ) :
      (P {ω | a ≤ (∑ i, X i ω) / n}).toReal =
        (P {ω | (n : ℝ) * a ≤ S ω}).toReal := by
    congr 1
    apply measure_congr
    filter_upwards [hsum_ae] with ω hω
    apply propext
    change (a ≤ (∑ i, X i ω) / (n : ℝ)) ↔ ((n : ℝ) * a ≤ S ω)
    rw [hω]
    simpa [mul_comm] using (le_div_iff₀ hn)
  have hmeasure_le (a : ℝ) :
      (P {ω | (∑ i, X i ω) / n ≤ a}).toReal =
        (P {ω | S ω ≤ (n : ℝ) * a}).toReal := by
    congr 1
    apply measure_congr
    filter_upwards [hsum_ae] with ω hω
    apply propext
    change ((∑ i, X i ω) / (n : ℝ) ≤ a) ↔ (S ω ≤ (n : ℝ) * a)
    rw [hω]
    simpa [mul_comm] using (div_le_iff₀ hn)
  have hchernoff_ge (a s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
      (P {ω | a ≤ S ω}).toReal ≤
        Real.exp (-s * a + (n : ℝ) * μ * (Real.exp s - 1)) := by
    calc
      (P {ω | a ≤ S ω}).toReal ≤ Real.exp (-s * a) * mgf S P s :=
        measure_ge_le_exp_mul_mgf a hs (hSint s)
      _ ≤ Real.exp (-s * a) *
          Real.exp ((n : ℝ) * μ * (Real.exp s - 1)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hmgfS s) (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = Real.exp (-s * a + (n : ℝ) * μ * (Real.exp s - 1)) := by
        rw [Real.exp_add]
  have hchernoff_le (a s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 0) :
      (P {ω | S ω ≤ a}).toReal ≤
        Real.exp (-s * a + (n : ℝ) * μ * (Real.exp s - 1)) := by
    calc
      (P {ω | S ω ≤ a}).toReal ≤ Real.exp (-s * a) * mgf S P s :=
        measure_le_le_exp_mul_mgf a hs (hSint s)
      _ ≤ Real.exp (-s * a) *
          Real.exp ((n : ℝ) * μ * (Real.exp s - 1)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hmgfS s) (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = Real.exp (-s * a + (n : ℝ) * μ * (Real.exp s - 1)) := by
        rw [Real.exp_add]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro ε hε
    have hden : 0 < ε + 2 := by linarith
    have hlog : 2 * ε / (ε + 2) ≤ Real.log (1 + ε) :=
      Real.le_log_one_add_of_nonneg hε.le
    have hcore : 0 ≤ (ε + 2) * Real.log (1 + ε) - 2 * ε := by
      have := (div_le_iff₀ hden).mp hlog
      linarith
    have hrate :
        ε ^ 2 / (2 + ε) ≤ (1 + ε) * Real.log (1 + ε) - ε := by
      apply (div_le_iff₀ (by linarith : 0 < 2 + ε)).2
      have hp := mul_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ 1 + ε) hcore
      nlinarith
    rw [hmeasure_ge ((1 + ε) * μ)]
    calc
      (P {ω | (n : ℝ) * ((1 + ε) * μ) ≤ S ω}).toReal
          ≤ Real.exp (-Real.log (1 + ε) * ((n : ℝ) * ((1 + ε) * μ)) +
              (n : ℝ) * μ * (Real.exp (Real.log (1 + ε)) - 1)) :=
        hchernoff_ge _ _ (Real.log_nonneg (by linarith))
      _ = Real.exp ((n : ℝ) * μ *
            (ε - (1 + ε) * Real.log (1 + ε))) := by
        rw [Real.exp_log (by linarith : 0 < 1 + ε)]
        congr 1
        ring
      _ ≤ Real.exp (-(n : ℝ) * μ * ε ^ 2 / (2 + ε)) := by
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        have hnm : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) * μ := mul_nonneg hn.le hμ
        calc
          (n : ℝ) * μ * (ε - (1 + ε) * Real.log (1 + ε)) =
              -((n : ℝ) * μ * ((1 + ε) * Real.log (1 + ε) - ε)) := by ring
          _ ≤ -((n : ℝ) * μ * (ε ^ 2 / (2 + ε))) :=
            neg_le_neg (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrate hnm)
          _ = -(n : ℝ) * μ * ε ^ 2 / (2 + ε) := by ring
  · intro ε hε
    have hp : 0 ≤ 1 - ε + ε ^ 2 / 2 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (ε - 1)]
    have hquad : 1 + ε + ε ^ 2 / 2 ≤ Real.exp ε :=
      Real.quadratic_le_exp_of_nonneg hε.le
    have hexpneg : Real.exp (-ε) ≤ 1 - ε + ε ^ 2 / 2 := by
      rw [Real.exp_neg]
      rw [inv_eq_one_div]
      apply (div_le_iff₀ (Real.exp_pos ε)).2
      calc
        1 ≤ (1 - ε + ε ^ 2 / 2) * (1 + ε + ε ^ 2 / 2) := by
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (ε ^ 2)]
        _ ≤ (1 - ε + ε ^ 2 / 2) * Real.exp ε :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hquad hp
    rw [hmeasure_le ((1 - ε) * μ)]
    calc
      (P {ω | S ω ≤ (n : ℝ) * ((1 - ε) * μ)}).toReal
          ≤ Real.exp (-(-ε) * ((n : ℝ) * ((1 - ε) * μ)) +
              (n : ℝ) * μ * (Real.exp (-ε) - 1)) :=
        hchernoff_le _ _ (by linarith)
      _ ≤ Real.exp ((n : ℝ) * μ * (-ε ^ 2 / 2)) := by
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        have hnm : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) * μ := mul_nonneg hn.le hμ
        have hinside :
            Real.exp (-ε) - 1 + ε * (1 - ε) ≤ -ε ^ 2 / 2 := by
          linarith
        calc
          -(-ε) * ((n : ℝ) * ((1 - ε) * μ)) +
                (n : ℝ) * μ * (Real.exp (-ε) - 1) =
              (n : ℝ) * μ * (Real.exp (-ε) - 1 + ε * (1 - ε)) := by ring
          _ ≤ (n : ℝ) * μ * (-ε ^ 2 / 2) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinside hnm
      _ = Real.exp (-(n : ℝ) * μ * ε ^ 2 / 2) := by
        congr 1
        ring
  · intro t ht
    by_cases hμ0 : μ = 0
    · rw [hmeasure_ge
          (μ + Real.sqrt (2 * μ * t / n) + t / (3 * n))]
      have hthreshold :
          (n : ℝ) * (μ + Real.sqrt (2 * μ * t / n) + t / (3 * n)) = t / 3 := by
        rw [hμ0]
        simp [hn.ne']
        field_simp [hn.ne']
      rw [hthreshold]
      calc
        (P {ω | t / 3 ≤ S ω}).toReal ≤
            Real.exp (-(3 : ℝ) * (t / 3) +
              (n : ℝ) * μ * (Real.exp 3 - 1)) :=
          hchernoff_ge _ 3 (by norm_num)
        _ = Real.exp (-t) := by rw [hμ0]; congr 1; ring
    · have hμpos : 0 < μ := lt_of_le_of_ne hμ (Ne.symm hμ0)
      let v : ℝ := (n : ℝ) * μ
      have hv : 0 < v := mul_pos hn hμpos
      let q : ℝ := Real.sqrt (2 * t / v)
      have harg : 0 < 2 * t / v := div_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) ht) hv
      have hq : 0 < q := Real.sqrt_pos.2 harg
      have hq_sq : q ^ 2 = 2 * t / v := by
        dsimp [q]
        exact Real.sq_sqrt harg.le
      let l : ℝ := q / (1 + q / 3)
      have hlden : 0 < 1 + q / 3 := by positivity
      have hl0 : 0 ≤ l := (div_pos hq hlden).le
      have hl3 : l < 3 := by
        dsimp [l]
        apply (div_lt_iff₀ hlden).2
        linarith
      have hone : 0 < 1 - l / 3 := by linarith
      have hexprem :
          Real.exp l - 1 - l ≤ l ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - l / 3)) :=
        exp_sub_one_sub_le hl0 hl3
      let d : ℝ := v * q + t / 3
      have hsqrt_mean :
          (n : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (2 * μ * t / n) = v * q := by
        have ha : 0 ≤ 2 * μ * t / (n : ℝ) := by positivity
        have hs_sq := Real.sq_sqrt ha
        have hs_nonneg := Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * μ * t / (n : ℝ))
        have hl_nonneg : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (2 * μ * t / n) :=
          mul_nonneg hn.le hs_nonneg
        have hr_nonneg : 0 ≤ v * q := mul_nonneg hv.le hq.le
        have hv_ne : v ≠ 0 := hv.ne'
        have hn_ne : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := hn.ne'
        apply sq_eq_sq₀ hl_nonneg hr_nonneg |>.mp
        rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, hs_sq, hq_sq]
        dsimp [v]
        field_simp
      have hthreshold :
          (n : ℝ) *
              (μ + Real.sqrt (2 * μ * t / n) + t / (3 * n)) = v + d := by
        dsimp [d, v] at hsqrt_mean ⊢
        field_simp [hn.ne'] at hsqrt_mean ⊢
        nlinarith
      rw [hmeasure_ge
        (μ + Real.sqrt (2 * μ * t / n) + t / (3 * n)), hthreshold]
      calc
        (P {ω | v + d ≤ S ω}).toReal ≤
            Real.exp (-l * (v + d) +
              (n : ℝ) * μ * (Real.exp l - 1)) :=
          hchernoff_ge _ _ hl0
        _ ≤ Real.exp (-l * d + v * l ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - l / 3))) := by
          apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
          have hvrem := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexprem hv.le
          change -l * (v + d) + v * (Real.exp l - 1) ≤
            -l * d + v * l ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - l / 3))
          calc
            -l * (v + d) + v * (Real.exp l - 1) =
                -l * d + v * (Real.exp l - 1 - l) := by ring
            _ ≤ -l * d + v * (l ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - l / 3))) :=
              by simpa [add_comm] using add_le_add_left hvrem (-l * d)
            _ = -l * d + v * l ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - l / 3)) := by ring
        _ = Real.exp (-t) := by
          congr 1
          have hqt : v * q ^ 2 = 2 * t := by
            rw [hq_sq]
            field_simp [hv.ne']
          dsimp [l, d]
          field_simp [hlden.ne', hv.ne']
          nlinarith [hqt]

end GraduateLevel

targets.label: ch2_corollary_2_19
targets.statement:
Assume that \(X_{1}\in \{0,1\}\). Then for all \(\epsilon >0\) that satisfies
\[
\epsilon^{\prime}=\epsilon+2\sqrt{(\mu+\epsilon)(1-(\mu+\epsilon))/n}<1-\mu,
\]
and \(n\geq (1 - \mu -\epsilon) / (\mu +\epsilon)\), we have
\[
\Pr(\bar{X}_{n}\geq\mu+\epsilon)\geq 0.25\exp\left[-n\mathrm{KL}(\mu+\epsilon^{\prime}| |\mu)-\sqrt{n}\Delta I\right],
\]
where
\[
\Delta I=2\sqrt{(\mu+\epsilon)(1-\mu-\epsilon)}\ln\frac{(\mu+\epsilon^{\prime})(1-\mu)}{(1-(\mu+\epsilon^{\prime}))\mu}.
\]

nl_proof:
In (2.8), we let \(\epsilon'' = 2\epsilon' - \epsilon\). Since \(X_i' \in \{0,1\}\) and \(\mathbb{E}X_i' = \mu + \epsilon'\), we have
\(\operatorname{Var}(X_1') = (\mu + \epsilon') (1 - \mu - \epsilon')\). Using Chebyshev's inequality, we obtain
\[
\begin{array}{l}\Pr\left(|\bar{X}_{n}^{\prime}-(\mu+\epsilon^{\prime})|\geq\epsilon^{\prime}-\epsilon\right)\leq\frac{(\mu+\epsilon^{\prime})(1-\mu-\epsilon^{\prime})}{n(\epsilon^{\prime}-\epsilon)^{2}}\\ =\frac{(\mu+\epsilon^{\prime})(1-\mu-\epsilon^{\prime})}{4(\mu+\epsilon)(1-(\mu+\epsilon))}\leq\frac{(\mu+\epsilon^{\prime})}{4(\mu+\epsilon)}=0. 25+\frac{\epsilon^{\prime}-\epsilon}{4(\mu+\epsilon)}.\\ \end{array}
\]
Therefore
\[
\begin{array}{l}\Pr\left(\bar{X}_{n}^{\prime}\in(\mu+\epsilon,\mu+\epsilon^{\prime\prime})\right)=1-\Pr\left(|\bar{X}_{n}^{\prime}-(\mu+\epsilon^{\prime})|\geq\epsilon^{\prime}-\epsilon\right)\\ \geq 0. 75-\frac{\epsilon^{\prime}-\epsilon}{4(\mu+\epsilon)}=0. 75-0. 5\sqrt{\frac{1-\mu-\epsilon}{n(\mu+\epsilon)}}\geq 0. 25.\\ \end{array}
\]
The choice of \(\lambda\) in (2.4) is given by
\[
\lambda=\ln{\frac{(\mu+\epsilon^{\prime})(1-\mu)}{(1-(\mu+\epsilon^{\prime}))\mu}}.
\]
By using the above estimates, we can obtain the desired bound from (2.8).

context.name: Chebyshev's Inequality
context.statement:
We have
\[
\Pr\left(\left|\bar{X}_{n}-\mu\right|\geq\epsilon\right)\leq\frac{\operatorname{Var}\left(X_{1}\right)}{n\epsilon^{2}}.\tag{2.2}
\]

context.name: theorem 2.17
context.statement:
Assume that \(X_{1}\in [0,1]\) . Then for all \(\epsilon >0\) , we have
\[
\begin{array}{l}\Pr(\bar{X}_{n}\geq\mu+\epsilon)\leq e^{-n\mathrm{KL}(\mu+\epsilon| |\mu)},\\ \Pr(\bar{X}_{n}\leq\mu-\epsilon)\leq e^{-n\mathrm{KL}(\mu-\epsilon| |\mu)},\\ \end{array}
\]
where \(\mathrm{KL}(z||\mu)\) is the Kullback-Leibler divergence (KL divergence) defined as
\[
\mathrm{KL}(z| |\mu)=z\ln{\frac{z}{\mu}}+(1-z)\ln{\frac{1-z}{1-\mu}}.
\]

context.name: Theorem 2.7 (proof)
context.statement:
Theorem 2.7. For all \(\epsilon' > \epsilon > 0\):
\[
\underline{\lim}_{n\rightarrow\infty}\frac{1}{n}\ln\Pr(\bar{X}_{n}\geq\mu+\epsilon)\geq-I_{X_{1}}(\mu+\epsilon^{\prime}).
\]
Similarly,
\[
\underline{\lim}_{n\rightarrow\infty}\frac{1}{n}\ln\Pr(\bar{X}_{n}\leq\mu-\epsilon)\geq-I_{X_{1}}(\mu-\epsilon^{\prime}).
\]
Proof. We only need to prove the first inequality. Consider \(\Pr(X_i \leq x)\) as a function of \(x\), and define a random variable \(X_i'\) with density at \(x\) as
\[
d\Pr(X_{i}^{\prime}\leq x)=e^{\lambda x-\Lambda_{X_{1}}(\lambda)}d\Pr(X_{i}\leq x).
\]
This choice implies that
\[
\frac{d}{d\lambda}\Lambda_{X_{1}}(\lambda)=\frac{\int x e^{\lambda x}d\Pr(X_{1}\leq x)}{\int e^{\lambda x}d\Pr(X_{1}\leq x)}=\mathbb{E}_{X_{1}^{\prime}}X_{1}^{\prime}.
\]
We now take \(\lambda\) such that
\[
\lambda=\arg\max_{\lambda^{\prime}>0}\left[\lambda^{\prime}(\mu+\epsilon^{\prime})-\Lambda_{X_{1}}(\lambda^{\prime})\right].
\]
By setting the derivative to zero, we obtain
\[
\mathbb{E}_{X_{1}^{\prime}}X_{1}^{\prime}=\frac{d}{d\lambda}\Lambda_{X_{1}}(\lambda)=\mu+\epsilon^{\prime},\tag{2.3}
\]
\[
-\lambda(\mu+\epsilon^{\prime})+\Lambda(\lambda)= -I(\mu+\epsilon^{\prime}).\tag{2.4}
\]
Let \(\bar{X}_n' = n^{-1} \sum_{i=1}^{n} X_i'\). Then by the law of large numbers, we know that for \(\epsilon'' > \epsilon'\), we obtain from (2.3)
\[
\lim_{n\rightarrow\infty}\Pr(\bar{X}_{n}^{\prime}-\mu\in [\epsilon,\epsilon^{\prime\prime}])=1.\tag{2.5}
\]
Since the joint density of \((X_1', \ldots, X_n')\) satisfies
\[
e^{-\lambda\sum_{i=1}^{n}x_{i}+n\Lambda_{X_{1}}(\lambda)}\prod_{i}d\Pr(X_{i}^{\prime}\leq x_{i})=\prod_{i}d\Pr(X_{i}\leq x_{i}),\tag{2.6}
\]
by using \(\mathbb{1}(\cdot)\) to denote the set indicator function, we obtain
\[
\begin{array}{l}\Pr(\bar{X}_{n}\geq\mu+\epsilon)\geq\Pr(\bar{X}_{n}-\mu\in [\epsilon,\epsilon^{\prime\prime}])\\ =\mathbb{E}_{X_{1},\ldots,X_{n}}\mathbb{1}(\bar{X}_{n}-\mu\in [\epsilon,\epsilon^{\prime\prime}])\\ =\mathbb{E}_{X_{1}^{\prime},\ldots,X_{n}^{\prime}}e^{-\lambda n\bar{X}_{n}^{\prime}+n\Lambda(\lambda)}\mathbb{1}(\bar{X}_{n}^{\prime}-\mu\in [\epsilon,\epsilon^{\prime\prime}])\\ \geq e^{-\lambda n(\mu+\epsilon^{\prime\prime})+n\Lambda(\lambda)}\Pr(\bar{X}_{n}^{\prime}-\mu\in [\epsilon,\epsilon^{\prime\prime}]).\\ \end{array}
\]
The first equality used the definition of \(\Pr(\cdot)\). The second equality used (2.6). The last inequality used Markov's inequality. Now by taking logarithm, and divide by \(n\), we obtain
\[
\begin{array}{l}\frac{1}{n}\ln\Pr(\bar{X}_{n}\geq\mu+\epsilon)\qquad(2.7)\\ \geq-\lambda(\mu+\epsilon^{\prime\prime})+\Lambda(\lambda)+\frac{1}{n}\ln\Pr(\bar{X}_{n}^{\prime}-\mu\in [\epsilon,\epsilon^{\prime\prime}])\\ = -I(\mu+\epsilon^{\prime})-\lambda(\epsilon^{\prime\prime}-\epsilon^{\prime})+\frac{1}{n}\ln\Pr(\bar{X}_{n}^{\prime}-\mu\in [\epsilon,\epsilon^{\prime\prime}]),\qquad(2.8)\\ \end{array}
\]
The equality used (2.4). Now we obtain the desired bound by letting \(n \to \infty\), applying (2.5), and letting \(\epsilon'' \to \epsilon'\) so that \(\lambda(\epsilon'' - \epsilon') \to 0\) (this is true because \(\lambda\) depends only on \(\epsilon'\)).

context.name: Definition 2.4
context.statement:
Definition 2.4. Given a random variable \(X\), we may define its logarithmic moment generating function as
\[
\Lambda_{X}(\lambda)=\ln\mathbb{E}e^{\lambda X}.
\]
Moreover, given \(z \in \mathbb{R}\), the rate function \(I_X(z)\) is defined as
\[
I_{X}(z)=\left\{\begin{array}{l l}\sup_{\lambda>0}\left[\lambda z-\Lambda_{X}(\lambda)\right]&z>\mu\\ 0&z=\mu\\ \sup_{\lambda<0}\left[\lambda z-\Lambda_{X}(\lambda)\right]&z<\mu,\end{array}\right.
\]
where \(\mu = \mathbb{E}[X]\).

noncomputable def bernoulliKL (z m : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  z * Real.log (z / m) + (1 - z) * Real.log ((1 - z) / (1 - m))

targets.label: ch2_lemma_2_15
targets.statement:
Consider a random variable \(X \in [0,1]\) and \(\mathbb{E}X = \mu\). We have the following inequality:
\[
\ln\mathbb{E}e^{\lambda X}\leq\ln [(1-\mu)e^{0}+\mu e^{\lambda}]\leq\lambda\mu+\lambda^{2}/8.
\]

nl_proof:
Let \( h_L(\lambda) = \mathbb{E}e^{\lambda X} \) and \( h_R(\lambda) = (1 - \mu)e^0 + \mu e^\lambda \). We know that \( h_L(0) = h_R(0) \). Moreover, when \( \lambda \geq 0 \):
\[
h_{L}^{\prime}(\lambda)=\mathbb{E}X e^{\lambda X}\leq\mathbb{E}X e^{\lambda}=\mu e^{\lambda}=h_{R}^{\prime}(\lambda),
\]
and similarly \(h_L'(\lambda) \geq h_R'(\lambda)\) when \(\lambda \leq 0\). This proves the first inequality.
Now we let
\[
h(\lambda)=\ln [(1-\mu)e^{0}+\mu e^{\lambda}].
\]
It implies that
\[
h^{\prime}(\lambda)=\frac{\mu e^{\lambda}}{(1-\mu)e^{0}+\mu e^{\lambda}},
\]
and
\[
\begin{array}{l}h^{\prime\prime}(\lambda)=\frac{\mu e^{\lambda}}{(1-\mu)e^{0}+\mu e^{\lambda}}-\frac{(\mu e^{\lambda})^{2}}{[(1-\mu)e^{0}+\mu e^{\lambda}]^{2}}\\ =\left|h^{\prime}(\lambda)\right|\left(1-\left|h^{\prime}(\lambda)\right|\right)\leq 1/4.\\ \end{array}
\]
Using Taylor expansion, we obtain the inequality \( h(\lambda) \leq h(0) + \lambda h'(0) + \lambda^2 / 8 \), which proves the second inequality.

import Mathlib

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Real

namespace GraduateLevel

noncomputable def phi (z : ℝ) : ℝ := if z = 0 then 1/2 else (Real.exp z - z - 1) / z ^ 2

private lemma phi_id (z : ℝ) : Real.exp z - z - 1 = z ^ 2 * phi z := by
  rcases eq_or_ne z 0 with rfl | hz
  · simp
  · rw [phi, if_neg hz]
    field_simp

private lemma cont_aux (z : ℝ) :
    Continuous (fun t : ℝ => (1 - t) * Real.exp (t * z)) := by
  fun_prop

private lemma phi_eq_int (z : ℝ) :
    phi z = ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, (1 - t) * Real.exp (t * z) := by
  rcases eq_or_ne z 0 with rfl | hz
  · have : (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, (1 - t) * Real.exp (t * 0)) = ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, (1 - t) := by
      congr 1; funext t; simp
    rw [this]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub intervalIntegrable_const
      (intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_id)]
    simp [phi]
    norm_num
  · have hF : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt
        (fun t : ℝ => ((1/z + 1/z^2) + (-1/z) * t) * Real.exp (t * z))
        ((1 - t) * Real.exp (t * z)) t := by
      intro t
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (1/z + 1/z^2) + (-1/z) * t) (-1/z) t := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul (-1/z)).const_add (1/z + 1/z^2)
      have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (t * z)) (Real.exp (t * z) * z) t := by
        simpa using (Real.hasDerivAt_exp (t * z)).comp t ((hasDerivAt_id t).mul_const z)
      have h3 := h1.mul h2
      convert h3 using 1
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (fun t _ => hF t)
      ((cont_aux z).intervalIntegrable _ _)]
    rw [phi, if_neg hz]
    simp only [Real.exp_zero, mul_one, zero_mul, one_mul]
    field_simp
    ring

private lemma phi_mono : Monotone phi := by
  intro u v huv
  rw [phi_eq_int, phi_eq_int]
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (by norm_num)
    ((cont_aux u).intervalIntegrable _ _) ((cont_aux v).intervalIntegrable _ _)
  intro t ht
  have h0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - t := by linarith [ht.2]
  have h1 : t * u ≤ t * v := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left huv ht.1
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.2 h1) h0

private lemma phi_pointwise (lam b x : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) (hx : x ≤ b) :
    Real.exp (lam * x) - lam * x - 1 ≤ lam ^ 2 * phi (lam * b) * x ^ 2 := by
  have h1 : Real.exp (lam * x) - lam * x - 1 = (lam * x) ^ 2 * phi (lam * x) := phi_id _
  have h2 : phi (lam * x) ≤ phi (lam * b) :=
    phi_mono (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx hlam)
  have h3 : (lam * x) ^ 2 * phi (lam * x) ≤ (lam * x) ^ 2 * phi (lam * b) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (sq_nonneg _)
  rw [h1]
  calc (lam * x) ^ 2 * phi (lam * x) ≤ (lam * x) ^ 2 * phi (lam * b) := h3
    _ = lam ^ 2 * phi (lam * b) * x ^ 2 := by ring

theorem ch2_lemma_2_20 {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (b : ℝ)
    (hX_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable X μ)
    (hexpX_int : ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 ≤ lam →
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (lam * X ω)) μ)
    (hX_L2 : MeasureTheory.MemLp X 2 μ)
    (hb : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X ω - (∫ x, X x ∂μ) ≤ b) :
    ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 ≤ lam →
      Real.log (∫ ω, Real.exp (lam * X ω) ∂μ)
        ≤ lam * (∫ ω, X ω ∂μ)
          + lam ^ 2 * phi (lam * b) * ProbabilityTheory.variance X μ := by
  intro lam hlam
  set m : ℝ := ∫ x, X x ∂μ with hm
  -- integrability of the centered exponential
  have hint1 : Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (lam * (X ω - m))) μ := by
    have := (hexpX_int lam hlam).const_mul (Real.exp (-(lam * m)))
    refine this.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => ?_)
    simp only [← Real.exp_add]
    ring_nf
  have hint2 : Integrable (fun ω => lam * (X ω - m)) μ :=
    ((hX_int.sub (integrable_const m)).const_mul lam)
  have hint3 : Integrable (fun _ : Ω => (1:ℝ)) μ := integrable_const 1
  have hsqint : Integrable (fun ω => (X ω - m) ^ 2) μ := by
    have h := (hX_L2.sub (memLp_const (p := 2) (μ := μ) m))
    simpa using h.integrable_sq
  set A : ℝ := ∫ ω, Real.exp (lam * (X ω - m)) ∂μ with hA
  have hsplit : (∫ ω, Real.exp (lam * X ω) ∂μ) = Real.exp (lam * m) * A := by
    rw [hA, ← integral_const_mul]
    congr 1
    funext ω
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    ring_nf
  have hApos : 0 < A := by
    rw [hA, integral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg
      (fun ω => (Real.exp_pos _).le) hint1]
    have : (Function.support fun ω => Real.exp (lam * (X ω - m))) = Set.univ := by
      ext ω; simp [Function.support, Real.exp_ne_zero]
    rw [this]
    simp
  have hXm : (∫ ω, (X ω - m) ∂μ) = 0 := by
    rw [integral_sub hX_int (integrable_const m), integral_const]
    simp [hm]
  have hint12 : Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (lam * (X ω - m)) - lam * (X ω - m)) μ :=
    hint1.sub hint2
  have hAeq : A - 1 = ∫ ω, (Real.exp (lam * (X ω - m)) - lam * (X ω - m) - 1) ∂μ := by
    rw [integral_sub hint12 hint3, integral_sub hint1 hint2,
      integral_const_mul, hXm]
    simp
    exact hA
  have hmono : (∫ ω, (Real.exp (lam * (X ω - m)) - lam * (X ω - m) - 1) ∂μ)
      ≤ ∫ ω, lam ^ 2 * phi (lam * b) * (X ω - m) ^ 2 ∂μ := by
    refine integral_mono_ae ((hint1.sub hint2).sub hint3) (hsqint.const_mul _) ?_
    filter_upwards [hb] with ω hω
    exact phi_pointwise lam b (X ω - m) hlam hω
  have hvar : (∫ ω, lam ^ 2 * phi (lam * b) * (X ω - m) ^ 2 ∂μ)
      = lam ^ 2 * phi (lam * b) * ProbabilityTheory.variance X μ := by
    rw [integral_const_mul, ProbabilityTheory.variance_eq_integral hX_int.aemeasurable]
  rw [hsplit, Real.log_mul (Real.exp_ne_zero _) (ne_of_gt hApos), Real.log_exp]
  have hlog : Real.log A ≤ A - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hApos
  have : Real.log A ≤ lam ^ 2 * phi (lam * b) * ProbabilityTheory.variance X μ := by
    calc Real.log A ≤ A - 1 := hlog
      _ = _ := hAeq
      _ ≤ _ := hmono
      _ = _ := hvar
  linarith

end GraduateLevel

    have hz0 : 0 < z := by rw [hz]; positivity

    have hden : (0:ℝ) < 2*v + 2*ε*b/3 := by positivity

      have h1 : ((n:ℝ) * v / b^2) * (3*z^2/(6+2*z)) = (n:ℝ) * ε^2 / (2*v + 2*ε*b/3) := by

targets.label: ch4_lemma_4_16
targets.statement:
If \(\operatorname{vc}(\mathcal{G}) = d\), then we have for all \(n > 0\) and empirical samples \(\mathcal{S}_n = \{Z_1, \ldots, Z_n\} \in \mathcal{Z}^n\):
\[
|\mathcal{G}(\mathcal{S}_{n})|\leq\sum_{\ell=0}^{d}\binom{n}{\ell}\leq\max(2,e n/d)^{d}.
\]

nl_proof:
First, we prove the statement under the assumption that \(|\mathcal{G}(\mathcal{S}_n)|\) is upper bounded by the number of subsets of \(\mathcal{S}_n\) (including the empty set) that are shattered by \(\mathcal{G}\). Under this assumption, since any subset shattered by \(\mathcal{G}\) cannot be larger than \(d\) by the definition of VC-dimension, and the number of subsets of size \(\ell\) is \(\binom{n}{\ell}\), we know that the number of subsets shattered by \(\mathcal{G}\) cannot be more than \(\sum_{\ell=1}^{d} \binom{n}{\ell}\). When \(n \geq d\), we have (see Exercise 4.1)
\[
\sum_{\ell=0}^{d}\binom{n}{\ell}\leq(e n/d)^{d}.\tag{4.2}
\]
When \(n \leq d\), we have \(\sum_{\ell=0}^{d} \binom{n}{\ell} \leq 2^d\). This implies the desired result.
In the following, we only need to prove the statement that \(|\mathcal{G}(\mathcal{S}_n)|\) is upper bounded by the number of subsets of \(\mathcal{S}_n\) that are shattered by \(\mathcal{G}\). This can be proved by induction on \(n\). When \(n = 1\), one can check that the claim holds trivially.
Now assume that the claim holds for all empirical samples of size no more than \( n - 1 \). Consider \( n \) samples \( \{Z_1, \ldots, Z_n\} \). We define
\[
\phi(w,\mathcal{S}_{k})=[\phi(w,Z_{1}),\dots,\phi(w,Z_{k})],
\]
\[
\mathcal{G}_{n-1}(\mathcal{S}_{n})=\left\{\left[\phi(w,\mathcal{S}_{n-1}),1\right]:\left[\phi(w,\mathcal{S}_{n-1}),0\right],\left[\phi(w,\mathcal{S}_{n-1}),1\right]\in\mathcal{G}(\mathcal{S}_{n})\right\}.
\]
Using the induction hypothesis, we know that \(|\mathcal{G}_{n - 1}(\mathcal{S}_n)|\) is bounded by the number of shattered subset \(\mathcal{S}\subset \mathcal{S}_{n - 1}\); for each shattered \(\mathcal{S}\subset \mathcal{S}_{n - 1}\), \(\mathcal{S}\cup \{Z_n\}\) is shattered by \(\mathcal{G}\) because both \([\phi (w,\mathcal{S}_{n - 1}),1]\) and \([\phi (w,S_{n - 1}),0]\) belong to \(\mathcal{G}(\mathcal{S}_n)\). Therefore \(|\mathcal{G}_{n - 1}(\mathcal{S}_n)|\) is no more than the number of shattered subsets of \(\mathcal{S}_n\) that contains \(Z_{n}\).
Moreover, since for \(\phi(w,\cdot) \in \mathcal{G}(\mathcal{S}_n) - \mathcal{G}_{n-1}(\mathcal{S}_n)\), \(\phi(w,Z_n)\) is uniquely determined by its values at \(\mathcal{S}_{n-1}\) (if not, then both \([\phi(w,\mathcal{S}_{n-1}),0]\) and \([\phi(w,\mathcal{S}_{n-1}),1]\) can be achieved in \(\mathcal{G}(\mathcal{S}_n) - \mathcal{G}_{n-1}(\mathcal{S}_n)\), which is impossible because by definition, we should have put \([\phi(w,\mathcal{S}_{n-1}),1]\) in \(\mathcal{G}_{n-1}(\mathcal{S}_n)\)), it follows that \(|\mathcal{G}(\mathcal{S}_n) - \mathcal{G}_{n-1}(\mathcal{S}_n)|\) is no more than \(|\mathcal{G}(\mathcal{S}_{n-1})|\). By induction hypothesis, \(|\mathcal{G}(\mathcal{S}_{n-1})|\) is no more than the number of shattered subsets of \(\mathcal{S}_n\) that does not contain \(Z_n\). By combining the above two facts, \(|\mathcal{G}(\mathcal{S}_n)|\) is no more than the number of shattered subsets of \(\mathcal{S}_n\).

context.name: VC-dimension
context.statement:
Let \(\mathcal{G} = \{\phi(w,z) : w \in \Omega\}\) be a \(\{0,1\}\) valued binary function class of \(z \in \mathcal{Z}\) indexed by \(w \in \Omega\). Given an arbitrary set of \(n\) samples \(\mathcal{S}_n = \{Z_1, \ldots, Z_n\} \in \mathcal{Z}^n\), we are interested in the number of functions (uniform \(L_\infty\) cover of the function class at \(\epsilon = 0\)) that \(\mathcal{G}(\mathcal{S}_n) = \{[\phi(w,Z_1), \ldots, \phi(w,Z_n)] : w \in \Omega\}\) can achieve.
We say that \(\mathcal{G}\) shatters \(S_{n}\) if the number of elements \(|\mathcal{G}(S_n)|\) is \(2^{n}\). That is, we can always find \(w\in \Omega\) so that \(\phi (w,z)\) matches any arbitrary possible choice of \(\{0,1\} ^n\) values at the \(n\) points. The maximum \(n\) such that \(\mathcal{G}\) shatters at least one instance of \(S_{n}\in \mathcal{Z}^{n}\), denoted by \(\mathrm{vc}(\mathcal{G})\), is called the VC-dimension of \(\mathcal{G}\).
Note that the maximum number of functions in \(\mathcal{G}(\mathcal{S}_n)\) is \(2^n\). If \(n > d\), then for any \(n\) samples \(\mathcal{S}_n\), \(\mathcal{G}(\mathcal{S}_n)\) contains fewer than \(2^n\) elements. Surprisingly, if a binary-valued function class \(\mathcal{G}\) has VC dimension \(d\), then when \(n > d\), the size of set \(\mathcal{G}(\mathcal{S}_n)\) can grow only polynomially in \(n\). This gives an \(O(d\ln n)\) upper bound on the uniform entropy of the function class \(\mathcal{G}\) with a finite VC-dimension (see Vapnik and Chervonenkis, 1968, 1971; Sauer, 1972).

context.name: corollary 4.13
context.statement:
If \(\phi(w, z) \in [0,1]\). Let \(\mathcal{G} = \{\phi(w, z) : w \in \Omega\}\). With probability at least \(1 - \delta\), the approximate ERM method (3.3) satisfies the (additive) oracle inequality:
\[
\begin{array}{l}\mathbb{E}_{Z\sim\mathcal{D}}\phi(\hat{w},Z)\leq\inf_{w\in\Omega}\mathbb{E}_{Z\sim\mathcal{D}}\phi(w,Z)+\epsilon^{\prime}\\ +\inf_{\epsilon>0}\left[2\epsilon+\sqrt{\frac{8\ln(4 N_{1}(\epsilon,\mathcal{G},n)/\delta)}{n}}\right].\\ \end{array}
\]
Moreover, we have the following (multiplicative) oracle inequality for all \(\gamma \in (0,1)\): with probability at least \(1 - \delta\),
\[
\begin{array}{l}(1-\gamma)^{2}\mathbb{E}_{(X,Y)\sim\mathcal{D}}\phi(\hat{w},Z)\leq\inf_{w\in\Omega}(1+\gamma)\mathbb{E}_{(X,Y)\sim\mathcal{D}}\phi(w,Z)+\epsilon^{\prime}\\ +\inf_{\epsilon>0}\left[2\epsilon+\frac{(6-3\gamma)\ln(4 N_{1}(\epsilon,\mathcal{G},n)/\delta)}{2\gamma n}\right].\\ \end{array}
\]

import Mathlib

open scoped ENNReal

namespace GraduateLevel

structure Predictor (𝒳 : Type*) (𝒴' : Type*) [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] [MeasurableSpace 𝒴'] where
  f : 𝒳 → 𝒴'
  hf : Measurable f

abbrev HypothesisClass (𝒳 : Type*) (𝒴' : Type*) [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] [MeasurableSpace 𝒴'] : Type _ :=
  Set (Predictor 𝒳 𝒴')

def Shatters {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool) (S : Finset 𝒳) : Prop :=
  ∀ (b : ↥S → Bool), ∃ h ∈ H, ∀ (x : ↥S), h.f ↑x = b x

noncomputable def VCDim {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool) : ℕ∞ :=
  ⨆ S, ⨆ (_ : Shatters H S), ↑S.card

def Restrictions {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool) (S : Finset 𝒳) : Set (↥S → Bool) :=
  (fun h x => h.f ↑x) '' H

noncomputable def GrowthFunction {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool) (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  sSup ((fun S => (Restrictions H S).ncard) '' {S | S.card = n})

private lemma sum_choose_bound (d n : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ((∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), n.choose ℓ : ℕ) : ℝ)
      ≤ max 2 (Real.exp 1 * n / d) ^ d := by
  have hcast : ((∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), n.choose ℓ : ℕ) : ℝ)
      = ∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), ((n.choose ℓ : ℕ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
  rw [hcast]
  rcases le_or_lt d n with hdn | hnd
  · -- main case  d ≤ n
    have hn0 : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
    have hd0 : (0:ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd
    set r : ℝ := (d : ℝ) / n with hr
    have hr0 : 0 < r := div_pos hd0 hn0
    have hr1 : r ≤ 1 := by
      rw [hr, div_le_one hn0]; exact_mod_cast hdn
    set A : ℝ := ∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), ((n.choose ℓ : ℕ) : ℝ) with hA
    have h1 : A * r ^ d ≤ ∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), ((n.choose ℓ : ℕ) : ℝ) * r ^ ℓ := by
      rw [hA, Finset.sum_mul]
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
      intro ℓ hℓ
      have hℓd : ℓ ≤ d := by
        have := Finset.mem_range.1 hℓ; omega
      have : r ^ d ≤ r ^ ℓ := pow_le_pow_of_le_one hr0.le hr1 hℓd
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this (by positivity)
    have h2 : ∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), ((n.choose ℓ : ℕ) : ℝ) * r ^ ℓ
        ≤ ∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((n.choose ℓ : ℕ) : ℝ) * r ^ ℓ := by
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ ?_
      · intro x hx
        simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hx ⊢; omega
      · intro i _ _; positivity
    have h3 : ∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((n.choose ℓ : ℕ) : ℝ) * r ^ ℓ = (1 + r) ^ n := by
      have := add_pow (r : ℝ) 1 n
      simp only [one_pow, mul_one] at this
      rw [add_comm (1:ℝ) r, this]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
      intro i _
      ring
    have h4 : (1 + r) ^ n ≤ Real.exp 1 ^ d := by
      have hstep : (1 + r) ^ n ≤ (Real.exp r) ^ n := by
        refine pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) ?_ n
        have := Real.add_one_le_exp r
        linarith
      have : (Real.exp r) ^ n = Real.exp 1 ^ d := by
        rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul, ← Real.exp_nat_mul]
        congr 1
        rw [hr]
        field_simp
      linarith [hstep, this.le, this.ge]
    have h5 : A * r ^ d ≤ Real.exp 1 ^ d := by linarith
    have hrd : (0:ℝ) < r ^ d := by positivity
    have h6 : A ≤ (Real.exp 1 / r) ^ d := by
      rw [div_pow, le_div_iff₀ hrd]
      exact h5
    have hmax : max 2 (Real.exp 1 * n / d) = Real.exp 1 * n / d := by
      refine max_eq_right ?_
      have he : (2:ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 1 := by
        nlinarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (1:ℝ)]
      have hnd' : (1:ℝ) ≤ (n:ℝ) / d := by
        rw [le_div_iff₀ hd0]; simpa using (by exact_mod_cast hdn : (d:ℝ) ≤ n)
      have : Real.exp 1 * 1 ≤ Real.exp 1 * ((n:ℝ)/d) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnd' (Real.exp_pos 1).le
      calc (2:ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 1 := he
        _ = Real.exp 1 * 1 := by ring
        _ ≤ Real.exp 1 * ((n:ℝ)/d) := this
        _ = Real.exp 1 * n / d := by ring
    rw [hmax]
    have : Real.exp 1 / r = Real.exp 1 * n / d := by
      rw [hr]; field_simp
    rw [← this]
    exact h6
  · -- case n < d
    have hsum : ∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), ((n.choose ℓ : ℕ) : ℝ)
        = ∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((n.choose ℓ : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      refine (Finset.sum_subset ?_ ?_).symm
      · intro x hx; simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hx ⊢; omega
      · intro x hx hx2
        simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hx hx2
        have : n < x := by omega
        rw [Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt this]
        simp
    rw [hsum]
    have : ∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((n.choose ℓ : ℕ) : ℝ) = ((2:ℝ)) ^ n := by
      have := Nat.sum_range_choose n
      have h' : ((∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.range (n+1), n.choose ℓ : ℕ) : ℝ) = ((2^n : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast congrArg (fun m : ℕ => (m : ℝ)) this
      push_cast at h'
      exact h'
    rw [this]
    have h2m : (2:ℝ) ≤ max 2 (Real.exp 1 * n / d) := le_max_left _ _
    calc (2:ℝ) ^ n ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ d := by
          apply pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num); omega
      _ ≤ max 2 (Real.exp 1 * n / d) ^ d := by
          apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) h2m

private lemma growth_le {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool)
    (d : ℕ) (hVC : ∀ T : Finset 𝒳, Shatters H T → T.card ≤ d)
    (n : ℕ) : GrowthFunction H n ≤ ∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), n.choose ℓ := by
  classical
  apply csSup_le'
  rintro m ⟨S, hS, rfl⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hS
  set α := {x // x ∈ S}
  have hfin : (Restrictions H S).Finite := Set.toFinite _
  set e : (α → Bool) → Finset α := fun f => Finset.univ.filter (fun x => f x = true) with he
  have he_inj : Function.Injective e := by
    intro f g hfg
    funext x
    have : x ∈ e f ↔ x ∈ e g := by rw [hfg]
    simpa [he] using this
  set 𝒜 : Finset (Finset α) := hfin.toFinset.image e with h𝒜
  have hcard : (Restrictions H S).ncard = 𝒜.card := by
    rw [h𝒜, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ he_inj,
      Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card _ hfin]
  -- key : shattering transfer
  have key : ∀ T : Finset α, 𝒜.Shatters T → Shatters H (T.image (Subtype.val)) := by
    intro T hT b
    set g : α → Bool := fun x => if h : (x : 𝒳) ∈ T.image (Subtype.val) then b ⟨(x : 𝒳), h⟩
      else false with hg
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hTu⟩ := hT (Finset.filter_subset (fun x => g x = true) T)
    rw [h𝒜, Finset.mem_image] at hu
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hfe⟩ := hu
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hf
    obtain ⟨h, hh, hfeq⟩ := hf
    refine ⟨h, hh, ?_⟩
    intro y
    obtain ⟨x, hxT, hxy⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 y.2
    have hxu : (x ∈ u) ↔ (f x = true) := by
      rw [← hfe]; simp [he]
    have hmem : x ∈ T ∩ u ↔ x ∈ T.filter (fun z => g z = true) := by rw [hTu]
    simp only [Finset.mem_inter, Finset.mem_filter, hxT, true_and] at hmem
    have hfg : f x = true ↔ g x = true := by rw [← hxu]; exact hmem
    have hyx : y = ⟨(x : 𝒳), Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hxT⟩ := by
      apply Subtype.ext; exact hxy.symm
    have hgx : g x = b y := by
      rw [hg]
      simp only
      rw [dif_pos (Finset.mem_image_of_mem (Subtype.val) hxT)]
      rw [hyx]
    have hhf : h.f (x : 𝒳) = f x := by
      rw [← hfeq]
    rw [← hxy, hhf]
    rcases hb : (f x) with _ | _
    · have : g x ≠ true := by
        intro hc; rw [hfg.2 hc] at hb; exact Bool.noConfusion hb
      have : g x = false := by
        cases hgv : g x
        · rfl
        · exact absurd hgv this
      rw [← hgx, this]
    · rw [← hgx, hfg.1 hb]
  have hvc : 𝒜.vcDim ≤ d := by
    apply Finset.sup_le
    intro T hT
    rw [Finset.mem_shatterer] at hT
    have := hVC _ (key T hT)
    rwa [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (Subtype.val_injective)] at this
  have hcardα : Fintype.card α = n := by
    rw [← hS]
    exact Fintype.card_coe S
  calc (Restrictions H S).ncard = 𝒜.card := hcard
    _ ≤ 𝒜.shatterer.card := Finset.card_le_card_shatterer 𝒜
    _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic 𝒜.vcDim, (Fintype.card α).choose k :=
        Finset.card_shatterer_le_sum_vcDim
    _ = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic 𝒜.vcDim, n.choose k := by rw [hcardα]
    _ ≤ ∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), n.choose ℓ := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset
        intro x hx
        simp only [Finset.mem_Iic] at hx
        simp only [Finset.mem_range]
        omega

theorem ch4_lemma_4_16
    {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] (H : HypothesisClass 𝒳 Bool)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hVC : VCDim H = (d : ℕ∞))
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    GrowthFunction H n ≤ ∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), n.choose ℓ ∧
    ((∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), n.choose ℓ : ℕ) : ℝ)
      ≤ max 2 (Real.exp 1 * n / d) ^ d := by
  refine ⟨?_, sum_choose_bound d n hd hn⟩
  refine growth_le H d ?_ n
  intro T hT
  have h1 : ((T.card : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ VCDim H := by
    rw [VCDim]
    exact le_iSup₂ (f := fun (S : Finset 𝒳) (_ : Shatters H S) => ((S.card : ℕ) : ℕ∞)) T hT
  rw [hVC] at h1
  exact_mod_cast h1

end GraduateLevel

targets.label: symmetrization_4_8
targets.statement:
(Symmetrization) Consider a real valued function family \(F = \{f : Z \rightarrow \mathbb{R}\}\). Assume there exists a function \(\psi : F \times Z^{n} \rightarrow \mathbb{R}\) and \(\epsilon_{n} : (0,1) \rightarrow \mathbb{R}\) so that with probability at least \(1-\delta\):
\[
\forall f \in F, \qquad f(\sigma, S_{n}) \leq \psi(f, S_{n}) + \epsilon_{n}(\delta),
\]
where the randomness is over both \(S_{n} \sim D^{n}\) and \(\sigma\). If there exists \(\tilde{\psi}(f, S_{n} \cup S_{n}^{\prime})\) so that the following superadditive inequality holds for all \((S_{n}, S_{n}^{\prime})\)
\[
\psi(f, S_{n}) + \psi(f, S_{n}^{\prime}) \leq \tilde{\psi}(f, S_{n} \cup S_{n}^{\prime}),
\]
then with probability at least \(1-\delta\) over independent random data \((S_{n}, S_{n}^{\prime}) \sim D^{2n}\):
\[
\forall f \in F, \qquad f(S_{n}^{\prime}) \leq f(S_{n}) + \tilde{\psi}(f, S_{n} \cup S_{n}^{\prime}) + 2\epsilon_{n}(\delta/2).
\]

nl_proof:
Consider independent random samples \((S_{n}, S_{n}^{\prime}) \sim D^{2n}\). The distribution of \(f(S_{n}) - f(S_{n}^{\prime})\) is the same as that of \(f(\sigma, S_{n}) - f(\sigma, S_{n}^{\prime})\), and the latter contains additional randomness from Bernoulli random variables \(\sigma\), drawn independently of \((S_{n}, S_{n}^{\prime})\), as in Definition 4.7. It follows that
\[
\begin{array}{l}
\Pr\Bigl(\exists f \in F,\ f(S_{n}^{\prime}) > f(S_{n}) + \tilde{\psi}(f, S_{n} \cup S_{n}^{\prime}) + 2\epsilon_{n}(\delta/2)\Bigr) \\
= \Pr\Bigl(\exists f \in F,\ f(\sigma, S_{n}^{\prime}) > f(\sigma, S_{n}) + \tilde{\psi}(f, S_{n} \cup S_{n}^{\prime}) + 2\epsilon_{n}(\delta/2)\Bigr) \\
\overset{(a)}{\leq} \Pr\Bigl(\underbrace{\exists f \in F,\ f(\sigma, S_{n}^{\prime}) > f(\sigma, S_{n}) + (\psi(f, S_{n}) + \psi(f, S_{n}^{\prime})) + 2\epsilon_{n}(\delta/2)}_{E_{0}}\Bigr)
\end{array}
\]
\[
\begin{array}{l}
\overset{(b)}{\leq} \Pr\Bigl(\underbrace{\exists f \in F,\ f(\sigma, S_{n}^{\prime}) > \psi(f, S_{n}^{\prime}) + \epsilon_{n}(\delta/2)}_{E_{1}}\Bigr) \\
\quad + \Pr\Bigl(\underbrace{\exists f \in F,\ -f(\sigma, S_{n}) > \psi(f, S_{n}) + \epsilon_{n}(\delta/2)}_{E_{2}}\Bigr)
\end{array}
\]
\[
= 2\Pr\Bigl(\exists f \in F,\ f(\sigma, S_{n}) > \psi(f, S_{n}) + \epsilon_{n}(\delta/2)\Bigr) \leq 2(\delta/2).
\]
In the above derivation, the first equation used the fact that \(f(S_{n}) - f(S_{n}^{\prime})\) and \(f(\sigma, S_{n}) - f(\sigma, S_{n}^{\prime})\) have the same distributions. (a) used the assumption \(\psi(S_{n}) + \psi(S_{n}^{\prime}) \leq \widetilde{\psi}(S_{n} \cup S_{n}^{\prime})\). (b) used the union bound, and the fact that if event \(E_{0}\) holds, then either event \(E_{1}\) holds or event \(E_{2}\) holds. The next equation used the symmetry of \(-f(\sigma, S_{n})\) and \(f(\sigma, S_{n})\), and the last inequality used the assumption of the lemma. The result implies the desired bound.

context.name: corollary 2.27
context.statement:
Let \(\sigma_{i} = \{\pm 1\}\) be independent Bernoulli random variables ( each takes value \(\pm 1\) with equal probability). Let \(a_{i}\) be fixed numbers \((i=1,\dots,n)\) Then for all \(\epsilon >0\) ..
\[
\Pr\left(n^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\sigma_{i}a_{i}\geq\epsilon\right)\leq\exp\left[-\frac{n\epsilon^{2}}{2 n^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^{n}a_{i}^{2}}\right].

context.name: definition 4.7
context.statement:
Consider a real-valued function family \(\mathcal{F}:\mathcal{Z}\to \mathbb{R}\). Consider \(n\) iid Bernoulli random variables \(\sigma_{i}\in \{\pm 1\}\), where \(\operatorname*{Pr}(\sigma_i=1)=\operatorname*{Pr}(\sigma_i= -1)=0.5\). The symmetrized empirical process is
\[
f(\sigma,\mathcal{S}_{n})=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\sigma_{i}f(Z_{i})\qquad f\in\mathcal{F},
\]
where the randomness is with respect to both \(S_{n} = \{Z_{i}\}\) and \(\sigma = \{\sigma_{i}\}\).
Note that in order to bound the symmetrized empirical process, we only need a covering number result on \( S_{n} \). Therefore the symmetrization analysis allows us to work with empirical covering numbers. Next we will show that a bound on the symmetrized empirical process can be used to obtain uniform convergence of the empirical process \( \{f(S_{n}): f \in \mathcal{F}\} \) to the corresponding result on the validation data. Since one can relate the validation loss of a learning algorithm to its generalization error on the test data, we can use this result to obtain generalization bounds.
The following lemma shows that if we can obtain an upper bound on the symmetrized empirical process \(\{f(\sigma, S_n) : f \in \mathcal{F}\}\), and the upper bound satisfies a superadditive property, then we can obtain the uniform convergence of the empirical process \(\{f(S_n) : f \in \mathcal{F}\}\) on the training data \(S_n\) to the corresponding result on the validation data \(S_n'\).

context.name: Union Bound
context.statement:
(Union Bound) Consider \(m\) events \(E_1, \ldots, E_m\). The following probability inequality holds:
\[
\Pr (E_1 \cup \cdots \cup E_m) \leq \sum_{j=1}^{m} \Pr(E_j).
\]

The union bound has an alternative expression, which is often used in the learning theory analysis. If each \(E_j\) occurs with probability at least \(1-\delta_j\) for \(j=1, \ldots, m\), then with probability at least \(1-\sum_{j=1}^{m} \delta_j\), all of events \(\{E_j\}\) occur simultaneously for \(j=1, \ldots, m\).

solution:
import Mathlib

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Real
open scoped ENNReal

namespace GraduateLevel

def Signs (n : ℕ) : Type := Fin n → ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ)

instance instFintypeSigns {n} : Fintype (Signs n) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Fintype (Fin n → { x // x ∈ {-1, 1} }))

instance instMSSigns (n : ℕ) : MeasurableSpace (Signs n) := ⊤

instance instNESigns (n : ℕ) : Nonempty (Signs n) :=
  ⟨fun _ => ⟨1, by decide⟩⟩

noncomputable def empMean {Z : Type*} {ι : Type*} {n : ℕ}
    (f : ι → Z → ℝ) (i : ι) (S : Fin n → Z) : ℝ :=
  (∑ k : Fin n, f i (S k)) / n

noncomputable def empSym {Z : Type*} {ι : Type*} {n : ℕ}
    (f : ι → Z → ℝ) (i : ι) (σ : Signs n) (S : Fin n → Z) : ℝ :=
  (∑ k : Fin n, ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * f i (S k)) / n

noncomputable def μσ (n : ℕ) : Measure (Signs n) :=
  (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Signs n)).toMeasure

instance (n : ℕ) : IsProbabilityMeasure (μσ n) := by
  unfold μσ; infer_instance

def swapL {Z : Type*} {n : ℕ} (σ : Signs n) (S S' : Fin n → Z) : Fin n → Z :=
  fun k => if (σ k : ℤ) = 1 then S k else S' k

def negS {n : ℕ} (σ : Signs n) : Signs n :=
  fun k => ⟨-((σ k : ℤ)), by
    have h := (σ k).2
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at h ⊢
    rcases h with h | h <;> simp [h]⟩

lemma coe_negS {n : ℕ} (σ : Signs n) (k : Fin n) :
    ((negS σ k : ℤ)) = -((σ k : ℤ)) := rfl

lemma sign_eq {n : ℕ} (σ : Signs n) (k : Fin n) :
    (σ k : ℤ) = 1 ∨ (σ k : ℤ) = -1 := by
  have h := (σ k).2
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at h
  tauto

lemma ms_swap {Z : Type*} {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → Prop) [DecidablePred c]
    (S S' : Fin n → Z) (L : Multiset (Fin n)) :
    (L.map fun k => if c k then S k else S' k) + (L.map fun k => if c k then S' k else S k)
      = L.map S + L.map S' := by
  induction L using Multiset.induction with
  | empty => simp
  | cons a L ih =>
    simp only [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.cons_add, Multiset.add_cons]
    by_cases h : c a
    · simp only [h, if_true, ih]
    · simp only [h, if_false, ih]
      exact Multiset.cons_swap _ _ _

lemma ofFn_ms {Z : Type*} {n : ℕ} (g : Fin n → Z) :
    ((List.ofFn g : List Z) : Multiset Z)
      = Multiset.map g ((List.finRange n : List (Fin n)) : Multiset (Fin n)) := by
  rw [List.ofFn_eq_map]
  simp

lemma swap_mp {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] (D : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure D]
    {n : ℕ} (σ : Signs n) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun p : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z) => (swapL σ p.1 p.2, swapL σ p.2 p.1))
      ((Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => D).prod (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => D))
      ((Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => D).prod (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => D)) := by
  classical
  have h1 : MeasurePreserving (MeasurableEquiv.arrowProdEquivProdArrow Z Z (Fin n))
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => D.prod D)
      ((Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => D).prod (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => D)) :=
    measurePreserving_arrowProdEquivProdArrow Z Z (Fin n) (fun _ => D) (fun _ => D)
  have h2 : MeasurePreserving
      (fun (x : Fin n → Z × Z) (k : Fin n) =>
        (fun (k : Fin n) (z : Z × Z) => if (σ k : ℤ) = 1 then z else z.swap) k (x k))
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => D.prod D) (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => D.prod D) := by
    refine measurePreserving_pi (fun _ : Fin n => D.prod D) (fun _ : Fin n => D.prod D)
      (f := fun (k : Fin n) (z : Z × Z) => if (σ k : ℤ) = 1 then z else z.swap) (fun k => ?_)
    by_cases h : (σ k : ℤ) = 1
    · simp only [h, if_true]
      exact MeasurePreserving.id _
    · simp only [h, if_false]
      exact Measure.measurePreserving_swap
  have h3 := h1.comp (h2.comp (MeasurePreserving.symm
    (MeasurableEquiv.arrowProdEquivProdArrow Z Z (Fin n)) h1))
  have heq : (fun p : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z) => (swapL σ p.1 p.2, swapL σ p.2 p.1))
      = (⇑(MeasurableEquiv.arrowProdEquivProdArrow Z Z (Fin n))) ∘
        ((fun (x : Fin n → Z × Z) (k : Fin n) =>
          (fun (k : Fin n) (z : Z × Z) => if (σ k : ℤ) = 1 then z else z.swap) k (x k)) ∘
          ⇑(MeasurableEquiv.arrowProdEquivProdArrow Z Z (Fin n)).symm) := by
    funext p
    have h1' : ∀ q : Fin n → Z × Z,
        (MeasurableEquiv.arrowProdEquivProdArrow Z Z (Fin n)) q
          = (fun c => (q c).1, fun c => (q c).2) := fun q => rfl
    have h2' : ∀ q : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z),
        (MeasurableEquiv.arrowProdEquivProdArrow Z Z (Fin n)).symm q
          = fun c => (q.1 c, q.2 c) := fun q => rfl
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, h1', h2']
    ext k
    · simp only [swapL]
      by_cases h : (σ k : ℤ) = 1 <;> simp [h]
    · simp only [swapL]
      by_cases h : (σ k : ℤ) = 1 <;> simp [h]
  rw [heq]
  exact h3

lemma negS_mp (n : ℕ) : MeasurePreserving (negS (n := n)) (μσ n) (μσ n) := by
  classical
  haveI : MeasurableSingletonClass (Signs n) := ⟨fun _ => trivial⟩
  have hall : ∀ t : Set (Signs n), MeasurableSet t := fun _ => trivial
  have hmeasneg : Measurable (negS (n := n)) := fun s _ => trivial
  refine ⟨hmeasneg, ?_⟩
  ext s _
  have hinv : Function.Involutive (negS (n := n)) := by
    intro σ
    funext k
    apply Subtype.ext
    show -(-((σ k : ℤ))) = _
    ring
  rw [Measure.map_apply hmeasneg (hall s)]
  unfold μσ
  rw [PMF.toMeasure_apply_fintype, PMF.toMeasure_apply_fintype]
  refine Fintype.sum_equiv hinv.toPerm _ _ (fun x => ?_)
  simp only [Set.indicator, PMF.uniformOfFintype_apply, Set.mem_preimage]
  rfl

lemma mean_swap {Z : Type*} {ι : Type*} {n : ℕ} (f : ι → Z → ℝ) (i : ι) (σ : Signs n)
    (S S' : Fin n → Z) :
    empMean f i (swapL σ S' S) - empMean f i (swapL σ S S')
      = empSym f i σ S' - empSym f i σ S := by
  have h : ∀ k : Fin n, f i (swapL σ S' S k) - f i (swapL σ S S' k)
      = ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * f i (S' k) - ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * f i (S k) := by
    intro k
    rcases sign_eq σ k with h1 | h1 <;> simp [swapL, h1] <;> ring
  simp only [empMean, empSym]
  rw [div_sub_div_same, div_sub_div_same, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  exact congrArg (fun t : ℝ => t / (n : ℝ)) (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => h k))

lemma empSym_negS {Z : Type*} {ι : Type*} {n : ℕ} (f : ι → Z → ℝ) (i : ι) (σ : Signs n)
    (S : Fin n → Z) :
    empSym f i (negS σ) S = - empSym f i σ S := by
  simp only [empSym, coe_negS, Int.cast_neg, neg_mul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, neg_div]

lemma ms_swap_ofFn {Z : Type*} {n : ℕ} (σ : Signs n) (S S' : Fin n → Z) :
    ((List.ofFn (swapL σ S S') : List Z) : Multiset Z)
        + ((List.ofFn (swapL σ S' S) : List Z) : Multiset Z)
      = ((List.ofFn S : List Z) : Multiset Z) + ((List.ofFn S' : List Z) : Multiset Z) := by
  simp only [ofFn_ms, swapL]
  exact ms_swap (fun k => (σ k : ℤ) = 1) S S' _

lemma main_helper {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] {ι : Type*} {n : ℕ}
    (PP : Measure (Fin n → Z)) [IsProbabilityMeasure PP]
    (f : ι → Z → ℝ) (ψ : ι → (Fin n → Z) → ℝ) (ψtilde : ι → Multiset Z → ℝ)
    (c : ℝ) (δ : ℝ) (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
    (hswap : ∀ σ : Signs n, MeasurePreserving
      (fun p : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z) => (swapL σ p.1 p.2, swapL σ p.2 p.1))
      (PP.prod PP) (PP.prod PP))
    (A : Set ((Fin n → Z) × Signs n)) (B : Set ((Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z)))
    (hAdef : A = {p | ∀ i, empSym f i p.2 p.1 ≤ ψ i p.1 + c})
    (hBdef : B = {p | ∀ i, empMean f i p.2 ≤ empMean f i p.1
        + ψtilde i (((List.ofFn p.1 : List Z) : Multiset Z)
          + ((List.ofFn p.2 : List Z) : Multiset Z)) + 2 * c})
    (hA_meas : MeasurableSet A) (hB_meas : MeasurableSet B)
    (hA_prob : ENNReal.ofReal (1 - δ / 2) ≤ (PP.prod (μσ n)) A)
    (h_super : ∀ i (S S' : Fin n → Z),
      ψ i S + ψ i S' ≤ ψtilde i (((List.ofFn S : List Z) : Multiset Z)
        + ((List.ofFn S' : List Z) : Multiset Z))) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (1 - δ) ≤ (PP.prod PP) B := by
  classical
  have hnegmeas : Measurable (negS (n := n)) := fun s _ => trivial
  -- pointwise inclusion
  have hsub : ∀ (σ : Signs n) (p : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z)),
      ((p.2, σ) ∈ A) → ((p.1, negS σ) ∈ A) →
      (swapL σ p.1 p.2, swapL σ p.2 p.1) ∈ B := by
    intro σ p h1 h2
    rw [hAdef, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at h1 h2
    rw [hBdef, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    intro i
    have hm := ms_swap_ofFn σ p.1 p.2
    have ha := mean_swap f i σ p.1 p.2
    have e1 := h1 i
    have e2 := h2 i
    rw [empSym_negS] at e2
    have hs := h_super i p.1 p.2
    rw [hm]
    linarith
  -- for each σ, the good set has measure at most that of B
  have hkey : ∀ σ : Signs n,
      (PP.prod PP) {p : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z) | (p.2, σ) ∈ A ∧ (p.1, negS σ) ∈ A}
        ≤ (PP.prod PP) B := by
    intro σ
    have hincl : {p : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z) | (p.2, σ) ∈ A ∧ (p.1, negS σ) ∈ A}
        ⊆ (fun p : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z) => (swapL σ p.1 p.2, swapL σ p.2 p.1)) ⁻¹' B := by
      rintro p ⟨ha, hb⟩
      exact hsub σ p ha hb
    calc (PP.prod PP) {p : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z) | (p.2, σ) ∈ A ∧ (p.1, negS σ) ∈ A}
        ≤ (PP.prod PP)
            ((fun p : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z) => (swapL σ p.1 p.2, swapL σ p.2 p.1)) ⁻¹' B) :=
          measure_mono hincl
      _ = (PP.prod PP) B := (hswap σ).measure_preimage hB_meas.nullMeasurableSet
  -- the joint space
  have hm1meas : Measurable
      (fun q : ((Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z)) × Signs n => (q.1.2, q.2)) :=
    (measurable_snd.comp measurable_fst).prodMk measurable_snd
  have hm2meas : Measurable
      (fun q : ((Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z)) × Signs n => (q.1.1, negS q.2)) :=
    (measurable_fst.comp measurable_fst).prodMk (hnegmeas.comp measurable_snd)
  have hGmeas : MeasurableSet
      {q : ((Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z)) × Signs n | (q.1.2, q.2) ∈ A ∧ (q.1.1, negS q.2) ∈ A} :=
    (hm1meas hA_meas).inter (hm2meas hA_meas)
  have hE1meas : MeasurableSet
      {q : ((Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z)) × Signs n | (q.1.2, q.2) ∉ A} := hm1meas hA_meas.compl
  have hE2meas : MeasurableSet
      {q : ((Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z)) × Signs n | (q.1.1, negS q.2) ∉ A} := hm2meas hA_meas.compl
  have hcompl : ∀ (μ : Measure ((Fin n → Z) × Signs n)) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ],
      ENNReal.ofReal (1 - δ / 2) ≤ μ A → μ Aᶜ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (δ / 2) := by
    intro μ _ h
    rw [prob_compl_eq_one_sub hA_meas]
    refine tsub_le_iff_right.mpr ?_
    calc (1 : ℝ≥0∞) = ENNReal.ofReal (δ / 2) + ENNReal.ofReal (1 - δ / 2) := by
          rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_add (by linarith) (by linarith)]
          norm_num
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (δ / 2) + μ A := by gcongr
  have hE1 : ((PP.prod PP).prod (μσ n))
      {q : ((Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z)) × Signs n | (q.1.2, q.2) ∉ A} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (δ / 2) := by
    have hmp : MeasurePreserving
        (fun q : ((Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z)) × Signs n => (q.1.2, q.2))
        ((PP.prod PP).prod (μσ n)) (PP.prod (μσ n)) :=
      MeasurePreserving.prod (MeasureTheory.measurePreserving_snd) (MeasurePreserving.id _)
    have := hmp.measure_preimage (hA_meas.compl.nullMeasurableSet)
    calc ((PP.prod PP).prod (μσ n))
          {q : ((Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z)) × Signs n | (q.1.2, q.2) ∉ A} = (PP.prod (μσ n)) Aᶜ :=
          this
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (δ / 2) := hcompl _ hA_prob
  have hE2 : ((PP.prod PP).prod (μσ n))
      {q : ((Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z)) × Signs n | (q.1.1, negS q.2) ∉ A}
        ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (δ / 2) := by
    have hmp : MeasurePreserving
        (fun q : ((Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z)) × Signs n => (q.1.1, negS q.2))
        ((PP.prod PP).prod (μσ n)) (PP.prod (μσ n)) :=
      MeasurePreserving.prod (MeasureTheory.measurePreserving_fst) (negS_mp n)
    have := hmp.measure_preimage (hA_meas.compl.nullMeasurableSet)

targets.statement:
Consider offset function of (6.3). We have
\[
\epsilon_{n}^{h}(\mathcal{G},\mathcal{D})\leq 2 R_{n}^{h}(\mathcal{G},\mathcal{D}).
\]
Consequently, the approximate regularized ERM method of (6.1) satisfies
\[
\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{S}_{n}}\phi(\hat{w},\mathcal{D})\leq\inf_{w\in\Omega}[\phi(w,\mathcal{D})+\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{S}_{n}}h(w,\mathcal{S}_{n})]+\epsilon^{\prime}+2 R_{n}^{h}(\mathcal{G},\mathcal{D}).

nl_proof:
Let \(\mathcal{S}_n' = \{Z_1', \ldots, Z_n'\} \sim \mathcal{D}^n\) be \(n\) iid samples from \(\mathcal{D}\) that are independent of \(\mathcal{S}_n\). We have
\[
\epsilon_{n}(\mathcal{G},\mathcal{D})=\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{S}_{n}\sim\mathcal{D}^{n}}\sup_{w\in\Omega}[\phi(w,\mathcal{D})-\phi(w,\mathcal{S}_{n})-h(w,\mathcal{S}_{n})]
\]
\[
=\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{S}_{n}\sim\mathcal{D}^{n}}\sup_{w\in\Omega}\left[\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{S}_{n}^{\prime}\sim\mathcal{D}^{n}}\phi(w,\mathcal{S}_{n}^{\prime})-\phi(w,\mathcal{S}_{n})-h(w,\mathcal{S}_{n})\right]
\]
\[
\leq\mathbb{E}_{\left(\mathcal{S}_{n},\mathcal{S}_{n}^{\prime}\right)\sim\mathcal{D}^{2 n}}\sup_{w\in\Omega}\left[\phi(w,\mathcal{S}_{n}^{\prime})-\phi(w,\mathcal{S}_{n})-h(w,\mathcal{S}_{n})\right]
\]
\[
\begin{array}{l}=\mathbb{E}_{\left(\mathcal{S}_{n},\mathcal{S}_{n}^{\prime}\right)\sim\mathcal{D}^{2n}}\sup_{w\in\Omega}\left[\left[\phi(w,\mathcal{S}_{n}^{\prime})+0. 5h_{1}(w,\mathcal{S}_{n}^{\prime})\right]-0. 5h(w,\mathcal{S}_{n}^{\prime})\right.\\ -\left[\phi(w,\mathcal{S}_{n})+0. 5h_{1}(w,\mathcal{S}_{n})\right]-0. 5h(w,\mathcal{S}_{n})]\\ \end{array}
\]
\[
\begin{array}{l}\stackrel{(a)}{=}\mathbb{E}_{\left(\mathcal{S}_{n},\mathcal{S}_{n}^{\prime}\right)\sim\mathcal{D}^{2n}}\mathbb{E}_{\sigma}\sup_{w\in\Omega}\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\left[\sigma_{i}\left(\phi\left(w,Z_{i}^{\prime}\right)+0. 5h_{1}\left(w,Z_{i}^{\prime}\right)\right)-0. 5h(w,\mathcal{S}_{n}^{\prime})\right.\\ \left.-\sigma_{i}\left(\phi\left(w,Z_{i}\right)+0. 5h_{1}\left(w,Z_{i}\right)\right)-0. 5h\left(w,\mathcal{S}_{n}\right)\right]\\ \end{array}
\]
\[
\begin{array}{l}\leq\mathbb{E}_{\left(\mathcal{S}_{n},\mathcal{S}_{n}^{\prime}\right)\sim\mathcal{D}^{2n}}\mathbb{E}_{\sigma}\sup_{w\in\Omega}\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\left[\sigma_{i}\left(\phi\left(w,Z_{i}^{\prime}\right)+0. 5h_{1}\left(w,Z_{i}^{\prime}\right)\right)-0. 5h\left(w,\mathcal{S}_{n}^{\prime}\right)\right]\\ +\mathbb{E}_{(\mathcal{S}_{n},\mathcal{S}_{n}^{\prime})\sim\mathcal{D}^{2n}}\mathbb{E}_{\sigma}\sup_{w\in\Omega}\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}[-\sigma_{i}(\phi(w,Z_{i})+0. 5h_{1}(w,Z_{i})-0. 5h(w,\mathcal{S}_{n})]\\ \end{array}
\]
\[
=\mathbb{E}_{(\mathcal{S}_{n},\mathcal{S}_{n}^{\prime})\sim\mathcal{D}^{2 n}}[R^{h}(\mathcal{G},\mathcal{S}_{n})+R^{h}(\mathcal{G},\mathcal{S}_{n}^{\prime})]=2 R_{n}^{h}(\mathcal{G},\mathcal{D}).
\]
In the above derivation, \((a)\) used the fact that \(\sigma_{i}(\phi (w,Z_{i}^{\prime}) + 0.5h_{1}(w,Z_{i}^{\prime})) - \sigma_{i}(\phi (w,Z_{i}) + 0.5h_{1}(w,Z_{i}))\) and \((\phi (w,Z_i^{\prime}) + 0.5h_1(w,Z_i^{\prime})) - (\phi (w,Z_i) + 0.5h_1(w,Z_i))\) have the same distributions.

context.name: definition 6.6
context.statement:
Consider any known data-dependent offset function \( h(w, S_n) \). Define the uniform convergence complexity of a function class \( \mathcal{G} \) with offset \( h \) as
\[
\epsilon_{n}^{h}(\mathcal{G},\mathcal{D})=\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{S}_{n}\sim\mathcal{D}^{n}}\sup_{w\in\Omega}[\phi(w,\mathcal{D})-\phi(w,\mathcal{S}_{n})-h(w,\mathcal{S}_{n})].\tag{6.2}
\]
This quantity measures the one-sided expected uniform convergence of function class \(\mathcal{G}\) with offset function \(h(w, S_n)\).
We note that
\[
\epsilon_{n}(\mathcal{G},\mathcal{D})=\epsilon_{n}^{h}(\mathcal{G},\mathcal{D}),\qquad \text{w i t h} h=0.
\]

context.name: definition 6.11
context.statement:
Consider a function class \(\mathcal{G} = \{\phi(w, Z) : w \in \Omega\}\), and let \(h\) be an offset function of the following form
\[
h(w,\mathcal{S}_{n})=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}h(w,Z_{i}),\quad h(w,z)=h_{0}(w)+h_{1}(w,z).\tag{6.3}
\]
Given \( S_{n}=\{Z_{1},\ldots,Z_{n}\} \), the (one-sided) empirical Rademacher complexity of \( \mathcal{G} \) with offset \( h \) decomposition (6.3) is defined as
\[
R^{h}(\mathcal{G},\mathcal{S}_{n})=\mathbb{E}_{\sigma}\sup_{w\in\Omega}\left[\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\sigma_{i}[\phi(w,Z_{i})+0. 5h_{1}(w,Z_{i})]-0. 5h(w,\mathcal{S}_{n})\right],
\]
where \(\sigma_1, \ldots, \sigma_n\) are independent uniform \(\{\pm 1\}\)-valued Bernoulli random variables. Moreover, the expected Rademacher complexity is
\[
R_{n}^{h}(\mathcal{G},\mathcal{D})=\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{S}_{n}\sim\mathcal{D}^{n}}R^{h}(\mathcal{G},\mathcal{S}_{n}).
\]
We note that the standard Rademacher complexity can be regarded as a special case of the offset Rademacher complexity with \( h(\cdot) = h_0(\cdot) = h_1(\cdot) = 0 \):
\[
R(\mathcal{G},\mathcal{S}_{n})=R^{0}(\mathcal{G},\mathcal{S}_{n}),\quad R_{n}(\mathcal{G},\mathcal{D})=R_{n}^{0}(\mathcal{G},\mathcal{D}).
\]
It should be pointed out that the decomposition of \( h \) in (6.3) may not be unique, and the offset Rademacher complexity relies on the specific decomposition used.
As shown in Example 6.10, we allow distribution dependent offset in the definition of uniform convergence complexity. We also allow distribution dependent offset in the definition of offset Rademacher complexity.

context.name: equation (6.1)
context.statement:
The approximate regularized ERM method is to find \( \hat{w} \in \Omega \) such that, for some \( \epsilon' \geq 0 \),
\[
\phi(\hat{w},\mathcal{S}_{n})+h(\hat{w},\mathcal{S}_{n})\leq\inf_{w\in\Omega}[\phi(w,\mathcal{S}_{n})+h(w,\mathcal{S}_{n})]+\epsilon'.\tag{6.1}
\]
When \(h = 0\), this reduces to the plain approximate ERM method.

context.name: theorem 6.7
context.statement:
Let \( S_{n} \) be \( n \) iid samples from \( \mathcal{D} \). Then the approximate ERM method of (6.1) satisfies
\[
\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{S}_{n}}\phi(\hat{w},\mathcal{D})\leq\inf_{w\in\Omega}\left[\phi(w,\mathcal{D})+\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{S}_{n}}h(w,\mathcal{S}_{n})\right]+\epsilon^{\prime}+\epsilon_{n}^{h}(\mathcal{G},\mathcal{D}).
\]

context.name: definition 3.8
context.statement:
We define
\[
\phi(w,z)=L\left(f(w,x),y\right)-L_{*}(x,y),\tag{3.4}
\]
for \( w \in \Omega \) and \( z = (x, y) \in \mathcal{Z} = \mathcal{X} \times \mathcal{Y} \), and a pre-chosen \( L_{*}(x, y) \) of \( z = (x, y) \) that does not depend on \( w \).
For training data \( S_{n}=\{Z_{i}=(X_{i},Y_{i}):i=1,\ldots,n\} \), we define the training loss for \( w\in \Omega \) as
\[
\phi(w,\mathcal{S}_{n})=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\phi(w,Z_{i}).\tag{3.5}
\]
Moreover, for a distribution \(\mathcal{D}\) on \(\mathcal{Z}\), we define the test loss for \(w \in \Omega\) as:
\[
\phi(w,\mathcal{D})=\mathbb{E}_{Z\sim\mathcal{D}}\phi(w,Z).\tag{3.6}
\]
Since \( L_{*}(x,y) \) does not depend on \( w \), the ERM solution with respect to the loss \( L(\cdot) \) is equivalent to the ERM solution with respect to \( \phi (w,\cdot) \). Therefore with the simplified notations, the approximate ERM method (3.3) is a special case of the following method:
\[
\phi(\hat{w},\mathcal{S}_{n})\leq\inf_{w\in\Omega}\phi(w,\mathcal{S}_{n})+\epsilon^{\prime}.\tag{3.7}
\]
In general, we may simply take \( L_{*}(x,y) = 0 \) in (3.4). However, for some applications, we may choose a non-zero \( L_{*}(x,y) \) so that
\[
L(f(w,x),y)-L_{*}(x,y)
\]
has a small variance. For least squares loss, this can be achieved with \( L_{*}(x,y) = L(f_{*}(x),y) \) where \( f_{*}(x) \) is the optimal prediction function that minimizes the test loss as shown in Example 3.9. The smaller variance, combined with Bernstein's inequality, implies better generalization bound (see Section 3.6 for more details).

namespace GraduateLevel

  (Fintype.card (RadSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
    ∑ σ : RadSigns n,
      ⨆ w : Ω,
        ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin n,
            (σ i : ℝ) * (φ w (S i) + (1/2) * h₁ w (S i)))
          - (1/2) * ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin n, (h₀ w + h₁ w (S i)))

noncomputable def offsetRademacher {Ω Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] (n : ℕ)
    (φ : Ω → Z → ℝ) (h₀ : Ω → ℝ) (h₁ : Ω → Z → ℝ) (D : Measure Z) : ℝ :=
  (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D))[fun S => empOffsetRademacher n φ h₀ h₁ S]

noncomputable def offsetUniformConv {Ω Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] (n : ℕ)
    (φ : Ω → Z → ℝ) (h₀ : Ω → ℝ) (h₁ : Ω → Z → ℝ) (D : Measure Z) : ℝ :=
  (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D))[fun S =>
    ⨆ w : Ω,
      (D[fun z => φ w z]
        - (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin n, φ w (S i)
        - (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin n, (h₀ w + h₁ w (S i)))]

private lemma mean_integrable {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z]
    (n : ℕ) (D : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure D] (f : Z → ℝ)
    (hf : Integrable f D) :
    Integrable (fun S : Fin n → Z => (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, f (S i))
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)) := by
  exact (integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => integrable_comp_eval hf)).const_mul _

private lemma mean_integral {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (D : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure D] (f : Z → ℝ)
    (hf : Integrable f D) :
    ∫ S : Fin n → Z, (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, f (S i) ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)
      = ∫ z, f z ∂D := by
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => integrable_comp_eval hf)]
  simp_rw [integral_comp_eval (μ := fun _ : Fin n => D) hf.aestronglyMeasurable]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hn0 : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : n ≠ 0)

private lemma rad_neg_equiv (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ e : RadSigns n ≃ RadSigns n, ∀ σ i, (e σ i : ℝ) = -(σ i : ℝ) := by
  let e₀ : ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ) ≃ ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ) :=
    { toFun := fun x => ⟨-x.val, by
        have hx := x.property
        simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hx ⊢
        rcases hx with hx | hx <;> simp [hx]⟩
      invFun := fun x => ⟨-x.val, by
        have hx := x.property
        simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hx ⊢
        rcases hx with hx | hx <;> simp [hx]⟩
      left_inv := by intro x; apply Subtype.ext; simp
      right_inv := by intro x; apply Subtype.ext; simp }
  refine ⟨Equiv.piCongrRight (fun _ : Fin n => e₀), ?_⟩
  intro σ i
  change ((-(σ i).val : ℤ) : ℝ) = _
  simp

private lemma swap_samples {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z]
    (n : ℕ) (D : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure D] (σ : RadSigns n)
    (F : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z) → ℝ)
    (hF : Integrable F ((Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)).prod
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)))) :
    let t := fun P : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z) =>
      ((fun i => if (σ i : ℤ) = 1 then P.1 i else P.2 i),
       (fun i => if (σ i : ℤ) = 1 then P.2 i else P.1 i))
    Integrable (fun P => F (t P)) ((Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)).prod
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D))) ∧
    ∫ P, F (t P) ∂((Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)).prod
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D))) =
      ∫ P, F P ∂((Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)).prod
        (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D))) := by
  classical
  let e := MeasurableEquiv.arrowProdEquivProdArrow Z Z (Fin n)
  let k (i : Fin n) : Z × Z ≃ᵐ Z × Z :=
    if (σ i : ℤ) = 1 then MeasurableEquiv.refl _ else MeasurableEquiv.prodComm
  have he := measurePreserving_arrowProdEquivProdArrow Z Z (Fin n)
    (fun _ => D) (fun _ => D)
  have hk (i : Fin n) : MeasurePreserving (k i) (D.prod D) (D.prod D) := by
    dsimp [k]
    split_ifs
    · exact MeasurePreserving.id _
    · exact Measure.measurePreserving_swap
  have hp : MeasurePreserving (MeasurableEquiv.piCongrRight k)
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D.prod D))
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D.prod D)) :=
    measurePreserving_pi _ _ hk
  let q := e.symm.trans ((MeasurableEquiv.piCongrRight k).trans e)
  have hq : MeasurePreserving q ((Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)).prod
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)))
      ((Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)).prod
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D))) := he.comp (hp.comp (he.symm e))
  have hq_apply (P : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z)) :
      q P = ((fun i => if (σ i : ℤ) = 1 then P.1 i else P.2 i),
        (fun i => if (σ i : ℤ) = 1 then P.2 i else P.1 i)) := by
    ext i <;> simp [q, e, k, MeasurableEquiv.arrowProdEquivProdArrow,
      MeasurableEquiv.piCongrRight] <;> split_ifs <;> rfl
  dsimp only
  constructor
  · simpa only [hq_apply, Function.comp_def] using hq.integrable_comp_of_integrable hF
  · simpa only [hq_apply] using hq.integral_comp' F
private lemma symmetrize_sums {Ω Z : Type*} [Nonempty Ω] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    (n : ℕ) (D : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure D]
    (f g : Ω → Z → ℝ)
    (hBdd : ∀ (σ : RadSigns n) (S : Fin n → Z),
      BddAbove (Set.range (fun w => ∑ i, ((σ i : ℝ) * f w (S i) - g w (S i)))))
    (hAvg : Integrable (fun S : Fin n → Z =>
      (Fintype.card (RadSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ∑ σ : RadSigns n, ⨆ w, ∑ i, ((σ i : ℝ) * f w (S i) - g w (S i)))
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)))
    (hPair : Integrable (fun P : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z) =>
      ⨆ w, ∑ i, (f w (P.2 i) - g w (P.2 i) - f w (P.1 i) - g w (P.1 i)))
      ((Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)).prod (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)))) :
    (∫ P : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z),
      ⨆ w, ∑ i, (f w (P.2 i) - g w (P.2 i) - f w (P.1 i) - g w (P.1 i))
      ∂((Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)).prod (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)))) ≤
    2 * ∫ S : Fin n → Z, (Fintype.card (RadSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
      ∑ σ : RadSigns n, ⨆ w, ∑ i, ((σ i : ℝ) * f w (S i) - g w (S i))
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D) := by
  classical
  let μ := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)
  let R (σ : RadSigns n) (S : Fin n → Z) :=
    ⨆ w, ∑ i, ((σ i : ℝ) * f w (S i) - g w (S i))
  let A (S : Fin n → Z) := (Fintype.card (RadSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ σ, R σ S
  let H (P : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z)) :=
    ⨆ w, ∑ i, (f w (P.2 i) - g w (P.2 i) - f w (P.1 i) - g w (P.1 i))
  let t (σ : RadSigns n) (P : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z)) :=
    ((fun i => if (σ i : ℤ) = 1 then P.1 i else P.2 i),
      (fun i => if (σ i : ℤ) = 1 then P.2 i else P.1 i))
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := rad_neg_equiv n
  have ht (σ : RadSigns n) : Integrable (fun P => H (t σ P)) (μ.prod μ) ∧
      (∫ P, H (t σ P) ∂μ.prod μ) = ∫ P, H P ∂μ.prod μ :=
    swap_samples n D σ H hPair
  have hpoint (σ : RadSigns n) (P : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z)) :
      H (t σ P) ≤ R σ P.2 + R (e σ) P.1 := by
    apply ciSup_le
    intro w
    calc
      _ = (∑ i, ((σ i : ℝ) * f w (P.2 i) - g w (P.2 i))) +
          ∑ i, ((e σ i : ℝ) * f w (P.1 i) - g w (P.1 i)) := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        dsimp [t]
        rw [he]
        have hs := (σ i).property
        simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hs
        rcases hs with hs | hs <;> simp [hs] <;> ring
      _ ≤ _ := add_le_add (le_ciSup (hBdd σ P.2) w) (le_ciSup (hBdd (e σ) P.1) w)
  have hsum (P : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z)) :
      (Fintype.card (RadSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ σ, H (t σ P) ≤ A P.1 + A P.2 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (Fintype.card (RadSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ σ, (R σ P.2 + R (e σ) P.1) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun σ _ => hpoint σ P))
          (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
      _ = _ := by rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, e.sum_comp (fun σ => R σ P.1)]; dsimp [A]; ring
  have hi := integral_mono
    ((integrable_finset_sum _ (fun σ _ => (ht σ).1)).const_mul
      (Fintype.card (RadSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹)
    ((hAvg.comp_fst μ).add (hAvg.comp_snd μ)) hsum
  simp only [Pi.add_apply] at hi
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_finset_sum _ (fun σ _ => (ht σ).1)] at hi
  simp_rw [(ht _).2] at hi
  haveI : Nonempty (RadSigns n) := ⟨fun _ => ⟨1, by simp⟩⟩
  have hc : (Fintype.card (RadSigns n) : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
    Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul,
    ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc, one_mul] at hi
  rw [integral_add (hAvg.comp_fst μ) (hAvg.comp_snd μ), integral_fun_fst A,
    integral_fun_snd A] at hi
  simpa [μ, A, R, H, two_mul] using hi

private lemma ghost_sup_bound {Ω X : Type*} [Nonempty Ω] [MeasurableSpace X]
    (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (a b : Ω → X → ℝ) (c : Ω → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ w, Integrable (a w) μ) (hmean : ∀ w, ∫ S, a w S ∂μ = c w)
    (hSup : Integrable (fun S => ⨆ w, c w - a w S - b w S) μ)
    (hBdd : ∀ P : X × X, BddAbove
      (Set.range (fun w => a w P.2 - a w P.1 - b w P.1)))
    (hPair : Integrable (fun P : X × X => ⨆ w, a w P.2 - a w P.1 - b w P.1)
      (μ.prod μ)) :
    (∫ S, ⨆ w, c w - a w S - b w S ∂μ) ≤
      ∫ P : X × X, ⨆ w, a w P.2 - a w P.1 - b w P.1 ∂μ.prod μ := by
  rw [integral_prod _ hPair]
  apply integral_mono_ae hSup hPair.integral_prod_left
  filter_upwards [hPair.prod_right_ae] with S hS
  apply ciSup_le
  intro w
  have hw : Integrable (fun T => a w T - a w S - b w S) μ :=
    ((ha w).sub (integrable_const _)).sub (integrable_const _)
  calc
    _ = ∫ T, a w T - a w S - b w S ∂μ := by
      rw [integral_sub (f := fun T => a w T - a w S)
        ((ha w).sub (integrable_const (a w S))) (integrable_const (b w S)),
        integral_sub (ha w) (integrable_const (a w S)), hmean]
      simp
    _ ≤ _ := integral_mono hw hS (fun T => le_ciSup (hBdd (S, T)) w)


private theorem offset_symmetrization_bound
    {Ω Z : Type*} [Nonempty Ω] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (φ : Ω → Z → ℝ) (h₀ : Ω → ℝ) (h₁ : Ω → Z → ℝ)
    (D : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure D]
    (hIntφ : ∀ w, Integrable (fun z => φ w z) D)
    (hIntSup : Integrable (fun S : Fin n → Z =>
        ⨆ w : Ω,
          (D[fun z => φ w z]
            - (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin n, φ w (S i)
            - (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin n, (h₀ w + h₁ w (S i))))
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)))
    (hBddRad : ∀ (S : Fin n → Z) (σ : RadSigns n),
      BddAbove (Set.range (fun w : Ω =>
        ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin n,
            (σ i : ℝ) * (φ w (S i) + (1/2) * h₁ w (S i)))
          - (1/2) * ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin n, (h₀ w + h₁ w (S i))))))
    (hIntRad : Integrable (fun S : Fin n → Z => empOffsetRademacher n φ h₀ h₁ S)
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)))
    (hBddSup2 : ∀ P : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z),
      BddAbove (Set.range (fun w : Ω =>
        ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin n, (φ w (P.2 i) + (1/2) * h₁ w (P.2 i)))
          - (1/2) * ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin n, (h₀ w + h₁ w (P.2 i)))
          - ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin n, (φ w (P.1 i) + (1/2) * h₁ w (P.1 i)))
          - (1/2) * ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin n, (h₀ w + h₁ w (P.1 i))))))
    (hIntSup2 : Integrable (fun P : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z) =>
        ⨆ w : Ω,
          ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin n, (φ w (P.2 i) + (1/2) * h₁ w (P.2 i)))
            - (1/2) * ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin n, (h₀ w + h₁ w (P.2 i)))
            - ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin n, (φ w (P.1 i) + (1/2) * h₁ w (P.1 i)))
            - (1/2) * ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin n, (h₀ w + h₁ w (P.1 i))))
      ((Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)).prod (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)))) :
    offsetUniformConv n φ h₀ h₁ D ≤ 2 * offsetRademacher n φ h₀ h₁ D
 := by
  classical
  let f (w : Ω) (z : Z) := (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * (φ w z + (1/2) * h₁ w z)
  let g (w : Ω) (z : Z) := (1/2) * (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * (h₀ w + h₁ w z)
  have hrad (σ : RadSigns n) (S : Fin n → Z) (w : Ω) :
      (∑ i, ((σ i : ℝ) * f w (S i) - g w (S i))) =
        ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, (σ i : ℝ) * (φ w (S i) + (1/2) * h₁ w (S i)))
          - (1/2) * ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, (h₀ w + h₁ w (S i))) := by
    dsimp [f, g]
    simp only [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring
  have hpair (P : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z)) (w : Ω) :
      (∑ i, (f w (P.2 i) - g w (P.2 i) - f w (P.1 i) - g w (P.1 i))) =
        ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, (φ w (P.2 i) + (1/2) * h₁ w (P.2 i)))
          - (1/2) * ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, (h₀ w + h₁ w (P.2 i)))
          - ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, (φ w (P.1 i) + (1/2) * h₁ w (P.1 i)))
          - (1/2) * ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, (h₀ w + h₁ w (P.1 i))) := by
    dsimp [f, g]
    simp only [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring
  have hghost (P : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z)) (w : Ω) :
      ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, (φ w (P.2 i) + (1/2) * h₁ w (P.2 i)))
          - (1/2) * ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, (h₀ w + h₁ w (P.2 i)))
          - ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, (φ w (P.1 i) + (1/2) * h₁ w (P.1 i)))
          - (1/2) * ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, (h₀ w + h₁ w (P.1 i))) =
        (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, φ w (P.2 i) - (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, φ w (P.1 i)
          - (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, (h₀ w + h₁ w (P.1 i)) := by
    simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
    ring
  have hs := symmetrize_sums n D f g
    (fun σ S => by simpa only [hrad] using hBddRad S σ)
    (by simpa only [hrad, empOffsetRademacher] using hIntRad)
    (by simpa only [hpair] using hIntSup2)
  have hg := ghost_sup_bound (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D))
    (fun w S => (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, φ w (S i))
    (fun w S => (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, (h₀ w + h₁ w (S i)))
    (fun w => D[fun z => φ w z])
    (fun w => mean_integrable n D (φ w) (hIntφ w))
    (fun w => mean_integral n hn D (φ w) (hIntφ w)) hIntSup
    (fun P => by simpa only [hghost] using hBddSup2 P)
    (by simpa only [hghost] using hIntSup2)
  simp only [hpair, hghost, hrad] at hs
  exact hg.trans (by simpa only [offsetRademacher, empOffsetRademacher] using hs)
