open InformationTheory

private lemma fenchel {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (y : ℝ) :
    x * y - Real.exp (y - 1) ≤ x * Real.log x := by
  rcases hx.eq_or_lt with h | h
  · rw [← h]
    simp only [zero_mul, zero_sub, neg_nonpos]
    positivity
  · have h1 : (y - 1 - Real.log x) + 1 ≤ Real.exp (y - 1 - Real.log x) :=
      Real.add_one_le_exp _
    have h2 : x * ((y - 1 - Real.log x) + 1) ≤ x * Real.exp (y - 1 - Real.log x) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hx
    have h3 : x * Real.exp (y - 1 - Real.log x) = Real.exp (y - 1) := by
      rw [Real.exp_sub, Real.exp_log h]
      field_simp
    have h4 : x * ((y - 1 - Real.log x) + 1) = x * y - x * Real.log x := by ring
    rw [h3, h4] at h2
    linarith

private lemma dv_bound {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] {P Qm : Measure X}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure P] [IsProbabilityMeasure Qm]
    (hfin : klDiv P Qm ≠ ⊤) {f : X → ℝ} (hf : Measurable f) {C : ℝ}
    (hbdd : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ C) :
    ∫ x, f x ∂P ≤ (klDiv P Qm).toReal + ∫ x, Real.exp (f x - 1) ∂Qm := by
  obtain ⟨hac, hint⟩ := klDiv_ne_top_iff.mp hfin
  have hri : Integrable (fun x => (P.rnDeriv Qm x).toReal) Qm :=
    Measure.integrable_toReal_rnDeriv
  have hklint : Integrable (fun x => klFun (P.rnDeriv Qm x).toReal) Qm :=
    (integrable_klFun_rnDeriv_iff hac).mpr hint
  have hem : Measurable fun x => Real.exp (f x - 1) :=
    Real.measurable_exp.comp (hf.sub measurable_const)
  have hexpi : Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (f x - 1)) Qm := by
    refine Integrable.mono' (integrable_const (Real.exp (C - 1)))
      hem.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.exp_nonneg _)]
    refine Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_
    have := hbdd x
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    have := (abs_le.mp this).2
    linarith
  have hrfi : Integrable (fun x => (P.rnDeriv Qm x).toReal * f x) Qm :=
    (hri.bdd_mul' hf.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hbdd)).congr
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => mul_comm _ _)
  have i1 : Integrable (fun x => (P.rnDeriv Qm x).toReal * f x - Real.exp (f x - 1)) Qm :=
    hrfi.sub hexpi
  have i2 : Integrable
      (fun x => (P.rnDeriv Qm x).toReal * f x - Real.exp (f x - 1) + 1) Qm :=
    i1.add (integrable_const 1)
  have i3 : Integrable
      (fun x => (P.rnDeriv Qm x).toReal * f x - Real.exp (f x - 1) + 1
        - (P.rnDeriv Qm x).toReal) Qm := i2.sub hri
  have key : ∫ x, ((P.rnDeriv Qm x).toReal * f x - Real.exp (f x - 1) + 1
        - (P.rnDeriv Qm x).toReal) ∂Qm ≤ ∫ x, klFun (P.rnDeriv Qm x).toReal ∂Qm := by
    refine integral_mono i3 hklint ?_
    intro x
    have h := fenchel (x := (P.rnDeriv Qm x).toReal) ENNReal.toReal_nonneg (f x)
    simp only [klFun]
    linarith
  rw [integral_sub i2 hri, integral_add i1 (integrable_const 1),
      integral_sub hrfi hexpi] at key
  have e1 : ∫ x, (P.rnDeriv Qm x).toReal * f x ∂Qm = ∫ x, f x ∂P := by
    simpa [smul_eq_mul] using integral_rnDeriv_smul (f := f) hac
  have e2 : ∫ x, (P.rnDeriv Qm x).toReal ∂Qm = 1 := by
    have h := integral_rnDeriv_smul (f := fun _ : X => (1:ℝ)) hac
    simpa using h
  rw [e1, e2, ← toReal_klDiv_eq_integral_klFun hac] at key
  simp only [integral_const, measureReal_univ_eq_one, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at key
  linarith

theorem ch12_theorem_12_11
    {N : ℕ} [NeZero N]
    {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z]
    {Θ : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Θ]
    (D : Fin N → Measure Z) (hD : ∀ j, IsProbabilityMeasure (D j))
    (Q : Θ → Fin N → ℝ)
    (ε : ℝ)
    (m : ℕ)
    (hm_def : m = ⨆ θ : Θ, lowLossCount Q ε θ)
    (A : Z → Measure Θ) (hA : ∀ z, IsProbabilityMeasure (A z))
    (hAmeas : Measurable A)
    (hQmeas : ∀ j : Fin N, MeasurableSet {θ : Θ | Q θ j < ε})
    (I : ℝ)
    (hI : I = (InformationTheory.klDiv (jointLaw D) (prodMarginals D)).toReal)
    (hI_fin : InformationTheory.klDiv (jointLaw D) (prodMarginals D) ≠ ⊤) :
    (1 / (N : ℝ)) * ∑ j : Fin N, ((D j).bind A {θ : Θ | Q θ j < ε}).toReal
      ≤ max ((m : ℝ) / (N : ℝ)) ((I + Real.log 2) / Real.log ((N : ℝ) / (m : ℝ))) := by
  classical
  haveI : ∀ j, IsProbabilityMeasure (D j) := hD
  haveI : ∀ z, IsProbabilityMeasure (A z) := hA
  have hN0 : 0 < N := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne N)
  have hNR : (0:ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN0
  set S : Fin N → Set Θ := fun j => {θ : Θ | Q θ j < ε} with hS
  set G : Fin N × Z → ℝ≥0∞ := fun x => (A x.2) (S x.1) with hG
  have hGm : Measurable G := by
    refine measurable_from_prod_countable_right (fun j => ?_)
    exact (Measure.measurable_coe (hQmeas j)).comp hAmeas
  have hGle : ∀ x, G x ≤ 1 := fun x => by
    simpa using prob_le_one (μ := A x.2) (s := S x.1)
  -- lintegral against the joint law
  have hlj : ∀ (F : Fin N × Z → ℝ≥0∞), Measurable F →
      ∫⁻ x, F x ∂(jointLaw D) = ∑ j : Fin N, (N : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * ∫⁻ z, F (j, z) ∂(D j) := by
    intro F hF
    rw [jointLaw, Measure.lintegral_bind (Measurable.of_discrete).aemeasurable hF.aemeasurable,
      lintegral_fintype]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [PMF.toMeasure_apply_singleton _ _ (measurableSet_singleton j),
      PMF.uniformOfFintype_apply, lintegral_map hF (measurable_prodMk_left)]
    simp [mul_comm]
  haveI hPprob : IsProbabilityMeasure (jointLaw D) := by
    constructor
    have h := hlj (fun _ => 1) measurable_const
    simp only [lintegral_one, measure_univ, mul_one, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
      Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul] at h
    rw [h]
    exact ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel (by exact_mod_cast hN0.ne') (by simp)
  haveI : IsProbabilityMeasure ((jointLaw D).map Prod.fst) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map measurable_fst.aemeasurable
  haveI : IsProbabilityMeasure ((jointLaw D).map Prod.snd) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map measurable_snd.aemeasurable
  haveI hQprob : IsProbabilityMeasure (prodMarginals D) := by
    rw [prodMarginals]; infer_instance
  -- q
  set q : ℝ := (∫⁻ x, G x ∂(jointLaw D)).toReal with hq
  have hle1 : ∫⁻ x, G x ∂(jointLaw D) ≤ 1 := by
    calc ∫⁻ x, G x ∂(jointLaw D) ≤ ∫⁻ _, (1:ℝ≥0∞) ∂(jointLaw D) := lintegral_mono hGle
      _ = 1 := by simp
  have hGint_ne : ∫⁻ x, G x ∂(jointLaw D) ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top ENNReal.one_ne_top hle1
  have hq_le_one : q ≤ 1 := by
    have h2 := (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal hGint_ne ENNReal.one_ne_top).mpr hle1
    simpa [hq] using h2
  have hq_nonneg : 0 ≤ q := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  -- LHS equals q
  have hLHS : (1 / (N : ℝ)) * ∑ j : Fin N, ((D j).bind A {θ : Θ | Q θ j < ε}).toReal = q := by
    have hbind : ∀ j : Fin N, ((D j).bind A) (S j) = ∫⁻ z, G (j, z) ∂(D j) := by
      intro j
      rw [Measure.bind_apply (hQmeas j) hAmeas.aemeasurable]
    have h1 : ∫⁻ x, G x ∂(jointLaw D) = ∑ j : Fin N, (N : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * ((D j).bind A) (S j) := by
      rw [hlj G hGm]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by rw [hbind j]
    have hbind_le : ∀ j : Fin N, ((D j).bind A) (S j) ≤ 1 := by
      intro j
      rw [hbind j]
      calc ∫⁻ z, G (j, z) ∂(D j) ≤ ∫⁻ _ : Z, (1:ℝ≥0∞) ∂(D j) :=
            lintegral_mono (fun z => hGle (j, z))
        _ = 1 := by simp
    rw [hq, h1, ENNReal.toReal_sum (fun j _ =>
      ENNReal.mul_ne_top (ENNReal.inv_ne_top.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hN0.ne'))
        (ne_top_of_le_ne_top ENNReal.one_ne_top (hbind_le j)))]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_inv, ENNReal.toReal_natCast]
    ring
  rw [hLHS]
  -- q'
  set q' : ℝ := (∫⁻ x, G x ∂(prodMarginals D)).toReal with hq'
  have hle1' : ∫⁻ x, G x ∂(prodMarginals D) ≤ 1 := by
    calc ∫⁻ x, G x ∂(prodMarginals D) ≤ ∫⁻ _, (1:ℝ≥0∞) ∂(prodMarginals D) :=
          lintegral_mono hGle
      _ = 1 := by simp
  have hGint'_ne : ∫⁻ x, G x ∂(prodMarginals D) ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top ENNReal.one_ne_top hle1'
  -- bound on m
  have hbdd_sup : BddAbove (Set.range (fun θ : Θ => lowLossCount Q ε θ)) := by
    refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨θ, rfl⟩
    simp only [lowLossCount]
    calc (Finset.univ.filter (fun k : Fin N => Q θ k < ε)).card
        ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N)).card := Finset.card_filter_le _ _
      _ = N := by simp
  have hm_le : ∀ θ : Θ, lowLossCount Q ε θ ≤ m := by
    intro θ; rw [hm_def]; exact le_ciSup hbdd_sup θ
  have hsum : ∀ z : Z, ∑ j : Fin N, (A z) (S j) ≤ (m : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    intro z
    have hrw : ∀ j : Fin N, (A z) (S j) = ∫⁻ θ, (S j).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ≥0∞)) θ ∂(A z) := by
      intro j
      rw [lintegral_indicator (s := S j) (hQmeas j)]
      simp
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => hrw j),
      ← lintegral_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => measurable_const.indicator (hQmeas j))]
    calc ∫⁻ θ, ∑ j : Fin N, (S j).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ≥0∞)) θ ∂(A z)
        ≤ ∫⁻ _, (m : ℝ≥0∞) ∂(A z) := by
          refine lintegral_mono fun θ => ?_
          have hi : ∀ j : Fin N, (S j).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ≥0∞)) θ
              = if Q θ j < ε then 1 else 0 := by
            intro j; simp [Set.indicator_apply, hS]
          rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hi j, Finset.sum_ite, Finset.sum_const,
            Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
          have := hm_le θ
          rw [lowLossCount] at this
          exact_mod_cast Nat.cast_le.mpr this
      _ = (m : ℝ≥0∞) := by simp
  have hq'_le : q' ≤ (m : ℝ) / (N : ℝ) := by
    have hlp : ∫⁻ x, G x ∂(prodMarginals D)
        = ∫⁻ z, (∫⁻ j, G (j, z) ∂((jointLaw D).map Prod.fst)) ∂((jointLaw D).map Prod.snd) := by
      rw [prodMarginals]
      exact lintegral_prod_symm G hGm.aemeasurable
    have hinner : ∀ z : Z, ∫⁻ j, G (j, z) ∂((jointLaw D).map Prod.fst)
        ≤ (N : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * (m : ℝ≥0∞) := by
      intro z
      rw [lintegral_map (Measurable.of_discrete) measurable_fst,
        hlj (fun x => G (x.1, z)) (hGm.comp (measurable_fst.prodMk measurable_const))]
      have : ∀ j : Fin N, ∫⁻ _ : Z, G (j, z) ∂(D j) = G (j, z) := by
        intro j; simp
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by rw [this j], ← Finset.mul_sum]
      exact mul_le_mul_left' (hsum z) _
    have hle : ∫⁻ x, G x ∂(prodMarginals D) ≤ (N : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * (m : ℝ≥0∞) := by
      rw [hlp]
      calc ∫⁻ z, (∫⁻ j, G (j, z) ∂((jointLaw D).map Prod.fst)) ∂((jointLaw D).map Prod.snd)
          ≤ ∫⁻ _, (N : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * (m : ℝ≥0∞) ∂((jointLaw D).map Prod.snd) :=
            lintegral_mono hinner
        _ = (N : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * (m : ℝ≥0∞) := by simp
    have := (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal hGint'_ne
      (ENNReal.mul_ne_top (ENNReal.inv_ne_top.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hN0.ne'))
        (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top m))).mpr hle
    rw [hq']
    refine this.trans_eq ?_
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_inv, ENNReal.toReal_natCast, ENNReal.toReal_natCast]
    ring
  have hq'_nonneg : 0 ≤ q' := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  -- easy cases
  rcases le_or_lt q ((m : ℝ) / (N : ℝ)) with hcase | hcase
  · exact le_max_of_le_left hcase
  have hmpos : 0 < m := by
    by_contra h
    have hm0 : m = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos h
    have hGz : ∀ x, G x = 0 := by
      intro x
      have hz : ∑ j : Fin N, (A x.2) (S j) = 0 :=
        le_antisymm (by simpa [hm0] using hsum x.2) (zero_le _)
      exact (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff).mp hz x.1 (Finset.mem_univ _)
    have : q = 0 := by
      rw [hq]
      simp [hGz]
    rw [this, hm0] at hcase
    simp at hcase
  have hmN : m < N := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have : (1:ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) / (N : ℝ) := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hNR, one_mul]
      exact_mod_cast h
    linarith [hq_le_one]
  have hmR : (0:ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hmpos
  have hNm : (1:ℝ) < (N : ℝ) / (m : ℝ) := by
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ hmR, one_mul]
    exact_mod_cast hmN
  set s : ℝ := Real.log ((N : ℝ) / (m : ℝ)) with hs_def
  have hs_pos : 0 < s := Real.log_pos hNm
  have hexps : Real.exp s = (N : ℝ) / (m : ℝ) := Real.exp_log (by positivity)
  -- the real-valued function
  set g : Fin N × Z → ℝ := fun x => (G x).toReal with hg_def
  have hgm : Measurable g := hGm.ennreal_toReal
  have hg0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x := fun _ => ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  have hg1 : ∀ x, g x ≤ 1 := by
    intro x
    rw [hg_def]
    exact ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal zero_le_one (by simpa using hGle x)
  have hgiP : Integrable g (jointLaw D) := by
    refine Integrable.mono' (integrable_const (1:ℝ)) hgm.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hg0 x)]
    exact hg1 x
  have hgiQ : Integrable g (prodMarginals D) := by
    refine Integrable.mono' (integrable_const (1:ℝ)) hgm.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hg0 x)]
    exact hg1 x
  have hgP : ∫ x, g x ∂(jointLaw D) = q := by
    rw [hg_def, hq]
    exact integral_toReal hGm.aemeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => lt_of_le_of_lt (hGle x) (by simp))
  have hgQ : ∫ x, g x ∂(prodMarginals D) = q' := by
    rw [hg_def, hq']
    exact integral_toReal hGm.aemeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => lt_of_le_of_lt (hGle x) (by simp))
  set B : ℝ := ∫ x, Real.exp (s * g x) ∂(prodMarginals D) with hB_def
  have hexpm : Measurable fun x => Real.exp (s * g x) :=
    Real.measurable_exp.comp (measurable_const.mul hgm)
  have hexpi : Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (s * g x)) (prodMarginals D) := by
    refine Integrable.mono' (integrable_const (Real.exp s)) hexpm.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.exp_nonneg _)]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith [hg0 x, hg1 x])
  have hB1 : 1 ≤ B := by
    rw [hB_def]
    have : ∫ _ : Fin N × Z, (1:ℝ) ∂(prodMarginals D) ≤ ∫ x, Real.exp (s * g x) ∂(prodMarginals D) :=
      integral_mono (integrable_const 1) hexpi (fun x => by
        have : (0:ℝ) ≤ s * g x := by positivity
        simpa using Real.one_le_exp this)
    simpa using this
  have hBpos : 0 < B := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hB1
  have hB2 : B ≤ 1 + (Real.exp s - 1) * q' := by
    have hcv := convexOn_exp.2
    have hpt : ∀ x, Real.exp (s * g x) ≤ 1 + (Real.exp s - 1) * g x := by
      intro x
      have hc := hcv (Set.mem_univ (0:ℝ)) (Set.mem_univ s) (a := 1 - g x) (b := g x)
        (by linarith [hg1 x]) (hg0 x) (by ring)
      simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_zero, zero_add, Real.exp_zero, mul_one] at hc
      calc Real.exp (s * g x) = Real.exp (g x * s) := by rw [mul_comm]
        _ ≤ (1 - g x) + g x * Real.exp s := hc
        _ = 1 + (Real.exp s - 1) * g x := by ring
    have ic1 : Integrable (fun _ : Fin N × Z => (1:ℝ)) (prodMarginals D) := integrable_const 1
    have ic2 : Integrable (fun x => (Real.exp s - 1) * g x) (prodMarginals D) :=
      hgiQ.const_mul (Real.exp s - 1)
    have ic3 : Integrable (fun x => 1 + (Real.exp s - 1) * g x) (prodMarginals D) := ic1.add ic2
    have hmono := integral_mono hexpi ic3 hpt
    rw [integral_add ic1 ic2, integral_const_mul, hgQ] at hmono
    simpa using hmono
  have hBle2 : B ≤ 2 := by
    have h1 : (Real.exp s - 1) * q' ≤ (Real.exp s - 1) * ((m : ℝ) / (N : ℝ)) := by
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq'_le ?_
      rw [hexps]; linarith
    have h2 : (Real.exp s - 1) * ((m : ℝ) / (N : ℝ)) = 1 - (m : ℝ) / (N : ℝ) := by
      rw [hexps]; field_simp
    have h3 : 0 ≤ (m : ℝ) / (N : ℝ) := by positivity
    linarith
  -- apply the variational bound
  set c : ℝ := 1 - Real.log B with hc_def
  set f : Fin N × Z → ℝ := fun x => s * g x + c with hf_def
  have hfm : Measurable f := (measurable_const.mul hgm).add measurable_const
  have hfbdd : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ s + |c| := by
    intro x
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hf_def]
    refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans ?_
    have : |s * g x| ≤ s := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hs_pos, abs_of_nonneg (hg0 x)]
      nlinarith [hg1 x, hs_pos.le, hg0 x]
    linarith
  have hdv := dv_bound (P := jointLaw D) (Qm := prodMarginals D) hI_fin hfm hfbdd
  have hfP : ∫ x, f x ∂(jointLaw D) = s * q + c := by
    have ja1 : Integrable (fun x => s * g x) (jointLaw D) := hgiP.const_mul s
    have ja2 : Integrable (fun _ : Fin N × Z => c) (jointLaw D) := integrable_const c
    rw [hf_def, integral_add ja1 ja2, integral_const_mul, hgP]
    simp
  have hexpc : ∀ x, Real.exp (f x - 1) = B⁻¹ * Real.exp (s * g x) := by
    intro x
    rw [hf_def, hc_def]
    have : s * g x + (1 - Real.log B) - 1 = s * g x - Real.log B := by ring
    rw [this, Real.exp_sub, Real.exp_log hBpos]
    ring
  have hfQ : ∫ x, Real.exp (f x - 1) ∂(prodMarginals D) = 1 := by
    rw [integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hexpc), integral_const_mul, ← hB_def]
    field_simp
  rw [hfP, hfQ, ← hI] at hdv
  have hkey : s * q ≤ I + Real.log B := by
    rw [hc_def] at hdv
    linarith
  have hlogB : Real.log B ≤ Real.log 2 := Real.log_le_log hBpos hBle2
  have hfinal : q ≤ (I + Real.log 2) / s := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hs_pos]
    nlinarith [hkey, hlogB]
  exact le_max_of_le_right hfinal

targets.label: ch13_theorem_13_5
targets.statement:
Consider a sequence of random functions \(\xi_1(S_1),\ldots,\xi_t(S_t),\ldots\) such that \(\xi_{i}\in [0,1]\) for all \(i\). We have for \(\lambda >0\), with probability at least \(1 - \delta\):
\[
\forall n>0:\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\mathbb{E}_{Z_{i}^{(y)}}\xi_{i}<\frac{\lambda}{1-e^{-\lambda}}\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\xi_{i}+\frac{\ln(1/\delta)}{\left(1-e^{-\lambda}\right)n}.
\]
Similarly, for \(\lambda > 0\), with probability at least \(1 - \delta\):
\[
\forall n>0:\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\mathbb{E}_{Z_{i}^{(y)}}\xi_{i}>\frac{\lambda}{e^{\lambda}-1}\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\xi_{i}-\frac{\ln(1/\delta)}{(e^{\lambda}-1)n}.
\]

nl_proof:
We obtain from Lemma 2.15 and Theorem 13.2 that with probability at least \(1 - \delta\)
\[
\begin{array}{l}-\sum_{i=1}^{n}\xi_{i}<\frac{\ln(1/\delta)}{\lambda}+\frac{1}{\lambda}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\ln(1+(e^{-\lambda}-1)\mathbb{E}_{Z_{i}^{(y)}}\xi_{i})\\ \leq\frac{\ln(1/\delta)}{\lambda}+\frac{1}{\lambda}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\left(e^{-\lambda}-1\right)\mathbb{E}_{Z_{i}^{(y)}}\xi_{i}.\\ \end{array}
\]
This implies the first bound. Moreover, with probability at least \(1 - \delta\):
\[
-\sum_{i=1}^{n}[1-\xi_{i}]<\frac{\ln(1/\delta)}{\lambda}+\frac{1}{\lambda}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\ln(1+(e^{-\lambda}-1)\mathbb{E}_{Z_{i}^{(y)}}[1-\xi_{i}])
\]
implies that
\[
\begin{array}{l}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\xi_{i}<\frac{\ln(1/\delta)}{\lambda}+\frac{1}{\lambda}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\ln(1+(e^{\lambda}-1)\mathbb{E}_{Z_{i}^{(y)}}\xi_{i})\\ \leq\frac{\ln(1/\delta)}{\lambda}+\frac{1}{\lambda}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\left(e^{\lambda}-1\right)\mathbb{E}_{Z_{i}^{(y)}}\xi_{i}.\\ \end{array}
\]
This implies the second bound.

context.name: lemma 2.15
context.statement:
Consider a random variable \(X \in [0,1]\) and \(\mathbb{E}X = \mu\). We have the following inequality:
\[
\ln\mathbb{E}e^{\lambda X}\leq\ln [(1-\mu)e^{0}+\mu e^{\lambda}]\leq\lambda\mu+\lambda^{2}/8.
\]

context.name: theorem 13.2
context.statement:
Consider a sequence of random functions \(\xi_1(S_1),\ldots,\xi_t(S_t),\ldots\) with filtration \(\{\mathcal{F}_t\}\). We have for any \(\delta \in (0,1)\) and \(\lambda >0\):
\[
\operatorname*{Pr}\left[\exists n>0: -\sum_{i=1}^{n}\xi_{i}\geq\frac{\ln(1/\delta)}{\lambda}+\frac{1}{\lambda}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\ln\mathbb{E}_{Z_{i}^{(y)}}e^{-\lambda\xi_{i}}\right]\leq\delta .
\]
Moreover, consider a sequence of \(\{z_t\in \mathbb{R}\}\) adapted to \(\{\mathcal{F}_t\}\), and events \(A_{t}\) on \(\mathcal{F}_t\):
\[
\ln\Pr\left[\exists n>0:\sum_{i=1}^{n}\xi_{i}\leq z_{n}\&\mathcal{S}_{n}\in A_{n}\right]\leq\inf_{\lambda>0}\sup_{n>0}\sup_{\mathcal{S}_{n}\in A_{n}}\left[\lambda z_{n}+\sum_{i=1}^{n}\ln\mathbb{E}_{Z_{i}^{(y)}}e^{-\lambda\xi_{i}}\right].
\]

At each time \(t\), after the history \(S_{t-1}\) has been observed, the next observation \(Z_t\) is drawn according to a distribution that may depend on that history. The observation is decomposed as \(Z_t=(Z_t^{(x)},Z_t^{(y)})\), where \(Z_t^{(x)}\) is the component determined by the past history or the chosen action at time \(t\), and \(Z_t^{(y)}\) is the random response component. private lemma exp_le_lin (θ : ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1) :
    Real.exp (θ * x) ≤ 1 + (Real.exp θ - 1) * x := by
  have h := convexOn_exp.2 (Set.mem_univ (0 : ℝ)) (Set.mem_univ θ)
      (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - x) hx0 (by ring)
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_zero, zero_add, Real.exp_zero, mul_one] at h

private lemma ville {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {ℱ : Filtration ℕ m}
    {N : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} (hsup : Supermartingale N ℱ μ) (hnn : ∀ n ω, 0 ≤ N n ω)

    μ {ω | ∃ n, ε ≤ N n ω} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε⁻¹ := by
  classical
  have hNmeas : ∀ k, Measurable (N k) := fun k =>
    ((hsup.stronglyMeasurable k).mono (ℱ.le k)).measurable
  have hAmeas : ∀ n : ℕ, MeasurableSet {ω | ∃ k ≤ n, ε ≤ N k ω} := by
    intro n

      ext ω; simp [Nat.lt_succ_iff]

    intro n

    have hτ : IsStoppingTime ℱ τ :=

    have hc : (0:ℝ) < 1 - Real.exp (-lam) := by
      have : Real.exp (-lam) < 1 := Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr (by linarith)

        + Real.log (1/δ) / ((1 - Real.exp (-lam)) * n) - (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * u
        = (lam * v + Real.log (1/δ) - (1 - Real.exp (-lam)) * u) / ((1 - Real.exp (-lam)) * n) := by

\Lambda_{t}=\Lambda_{0}+\sum_{s=1}^{t}\psi(X_{s})\psi(X_{s})^{\top},

context.name: equation (15.3)
context.statement:
The ridge regression method defines, for each \(n\),
\[
\hat{w}(\mathcal{S}_{n})=\arg\min_{w}\left[\sum_{i=1}^{n}(Y_{i}-w^{\top}\psi(X_{i}))^{2}+\|w\|_{\Lambda_{0}}^{2}\right].
\]

\[
\hat{w}(\mathcal{S}_{n})=\Lambda_{n}^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\psi(X_{i})Y_{i},\quad\Lambda_{n}=\Lambda_{0}+\sum_{s=1}^{n}\psi(X_{s})\psi(X_{s})^{\top}.

context.name: equation (15.3)
context.statement:
Let \(\Lambda_0\) be a symmetric positive definite regularizer and let \(\psi\) be a feature map. Given \(\mathcal{S}_n = \{(X_1,Y_1),\ldots,(X_n,Y_n)\}\), define
\[
\hat{\Lambda}(\mathcal{S}_{n})=\Lambda_{0}+\sum_{i=1}^{n}\psi(X_{i})\psi(X_{i})^{\top}
\]
and the ridge regression estimator
\[
\hat{w}(\mathcal{S}_{n})=\hat{\Lambda}(\mathcal{S}_{n})^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\psi(X_{i})Y_{i}.\tag{15.3}
\]
Equivalently, \(\hat{w}(\mathcal{S}_{n})\) minimizes
\[
\sum_{i=1}^{n}(w^{\top}\psi(X_{i})-Y_{i})^{2}+\|w\|_{\Lambda_{0}}^{2}.
\]

import Mathlib

open Matrix

namespace GraduateLevel

private lemma symm_dot {d : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ} (hA : Aᵀ = A) (u v : Fin d → ℝ) :
    (A *ᵥ u) ⬝ᵥ v = u ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v) := by
  rw [Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose, hA]

private lemma quad_min {d : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) (b w : Fin d → ℝ) :
    - (b ⬝ᵥ (A⁻¹ *ᵥ b)) ≤ (A *ᵥ w) ⬝ᵥ w - 2 * (w ⬝ᵥ b) := by
  classical
  have hAU : IsUnit A.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hA.det_pos.ne'
  have hsym' : Aᵀ = A := by
    have := hA.isHermitian
    simpa [Matrix.IsHermitian, Matrix.conjTranspose, Matrix.transpose] using this.eq
  set q : Fin d → ℝ := A⁻¹ *ᵥ b with hq
  have hAq : A *ᵥ q = b := by
    rw [hq, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
    simp [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hAU]
  have hnn : 0 ≤ (w - q) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (w - q)) := by
    simpa using hA.posSemidef.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (w - q)
  have hexp : (w - q) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (w - q))
      = (A *ᵥ w) ⬝ᵥ w - 2 * (w ⬝ᵥ b) + b ⬝ᵥ (A⁻¹ *ᵥ b) := by
    have h1 : A *ᵥ (w - q) = A *ᵥ w - A *ᵥ q := by
      simp [Matrix.mulVec_sub]
    rw [h1, hAq]
    have h2 : (w - q) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ w - b) = w ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ w) - w ⬝ᵥ b - q ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ w) + q ⬝ᵥ b := by
      simp [sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_sub]
      ring
    rw [h2]
    have h3 : q ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ w) = (A *ᵥ q) ⬝ᵥ w := (symm_dot hsym' q w).symm
    have h4 : w ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ w) = (A *ᵥ w) ⬝ᵥ w := (symm_dot hsym' w w).symm
    rw [h3, h4, hAq]
    have h5 : b ⬝ᵥ w = w ⬝ᵥ b := dotProduct_comm _ _
    rw [h5, hq, dotProduct_comm (A⁻¹ *ᵥ b) b]
    ring
  linarith [hexp ▸ hnn]

private lemma det_rank_one_sub {d : ℕ} {B : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ} (hB : IsUnit B.det)
    (p : Fin d → ℝ) :
    (B - Matrix.vecMulVec p p).det = B.det * (1 - p ⬝ᵥ (B⁻¹ *ᵥ p)) := by
  classical
  set q : Fin d → ℝ := B⁻¹ *ᵥ p with hq
  have hBq : B *ᵥ q = p := by
    rw [hq, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
    simp [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hB]
  have hmul : B * Matrix.vecMulVec q p = Matrix.vecMulVec p p := by
    have : B * Matrix.vecMulVec q p = Matrix.vecMulVec (B *ᵥ q) p := by
      ext i j
      simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
        Finset.sum_mul, mul_assoc]
    rw [this, hBq]
  have hfac : B - Matrix.vecMulVec p p = B * (1 - Matrix.vecMulVec q p) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one, hmul]
  rw [hfac, Matrix.det_mul]
  congr 1
  have hrep : (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) - Matrix.vecMulVec q p
      = 1 + Matrix.replicateCol Unit (-q) * Matrix.replicateRow Unit p := by
    rw [← Matrix.vecMulVec_eq Unit]
    ext i j
    simp [Matrix.vecMulVec_apply]
    ring
  rw [hrep, Matrix.det_one_add_replicateCol_mul_replicateRow]
  rw [dotProduct_neg]
  ring

private lemma clip_sq {y z M : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) (h0 : 0 ≤ y) (h1 : y ≤ M) :
    (y - max 0 (min M z)) ^ 2 ≤ (y - z) ^ 2 ∧ (y - max 0 (min M z)) ^ 2 ≤ M ^ 2 := by
  rcases le_total z 0 with h | h
  · have hmin : min M z = z := min_eq_right (le_trans h hM)
    have hmax : max 0 z = 0 := max_eq_left h
    rw [hmin, hmax]
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  · rcases le_total z M with h2 | h2
    · have hmin : min M z = z := min_eq_right h2
      have hmax : max 0 z = z := max_eq_right h
      rw [hmin, hmax]
      constructor <;> nlinarith
    · have hmin : min M z = M := min_eq_left h2
      have hmax : max 0 M = M := max_eq_right hM
      rw [hmin, hmax]
      constructor <;> nlinarith

theorem ch15_corollary_15_7
    {𝒳 : Type*} {d T : ℕ}
    (Λ₀ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) (hΛ0 : Λ₀.PosDef)
    (ψ : 𝒳 → (Fin d → ℝ)) (X : ℕ → 𝒳) (Y : ℕ → ℝ)
    (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hYrange : ∀ t, 1 ≤ t → Y t ∈ Set.Icc 0 M)
    (Λ : ℕ → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)
    (hΛ : ∀ n, Λ n = Λ₀ + ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, Matrix.vecMulVec (ψ (X s)) (ψ (X s)))
    (ŵ : ℕ → (Fin d → ℝ))
    (hŵ : ∀ n, ŵ n = (Λ n)⁻¹.mulVec (∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, Y i • ψ (X i)))
    (Ŷ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hŶ : ∀ t, Ŷ t = max 0 (min M ((ŵ (t - 1)) ⬝ᵥ (ψ (X t))))) :
    (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, (Y t - Ŷ t) ^ 2)
      ≤ (⨅ w : Fin d → ℝ,
            ((∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, (Y t - (w ⬝ᵥ (ψ (X t)))) ^ 2)
              + (Λ₀.mulVec w) ⬝ᵥ w))
          + M ^ 2 * Real.log |(Λ₀⁻¹ * Λ T).det| := by
  classical
  set bb : ℕ → (Fin d → ℝ) := fun n => ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, Y i • ψ (X i) with hbb
  set cc : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (Y i) ^ 2 with hcc
  set V : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => cc n - (bb n) ⬝ᵥ ((Λ n)⁻¹ *ᵥ (bb n)) with hV
  -- basic structure
  have hΛ0eq : Λ 0 = Λ₀ := by rw [hΛ]; simp
  have hsucc : ∀ n, Λ (n + 1) = Λ n + Matrix.vecMulVec (ψ (X (n+1))) (ψ (X (n+1))) := by
    intro n
    rw [hΛ, hΛ, Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega)]
    abel
  have hpd : ∀ n, (Λ n).PosDef := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => rw [hΛ0eq]; exact hΛ0
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [hsucc k]
      refine ih.add_posSemidef ?_
      simpa using Matrix.posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star (ψ (X (k+1)))
  have hsym : ∀ n, (Λ n)ᵀ = Λ n := by
    intro n
    have := (hpd n).isHermitian
    simpa [Matrix.IsHermitian, Matrix.conjTranspose, Matrix.transpose] using this.eq
  have hdetpos : ∀ n, 0 < (Λ n).det := fun n => (hpd n).det_pos
  have hIU : ∀ n, IsUnit (Λ n).det := fun n => isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (hdetpos n).ne'
  have hbbsucc : ∀ n, bb (n+1) = bb n + Y (n+1) • ψ (X (n+1)) := by
    intro n
    simp only [hbb]
    rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega)]
  have hccsucc : ∀ n, cc (n+1) = cc n + (Y (n+1)) ^ 2 := by
    intro n
    simp only [hcc]
    rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega)]
  -- gamma
  set γ : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => (ψ (X (n+1))) ⬝ᵥ ((Λ (n+1))⁻¹ *ᵥ (ψ (X (n+1)))) with hγ
  have hγnn : ∀ n, 0 ≤ γ n := by
    intro n
    simpa [hγ] using (hpd (n+1)).inv.posSemidef.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (ψ (X (n+1)))
  have hdetstep : ∀ n, (Λ n).det = (Λ (n+1)).det * (1 - γ n) := by
    intro n
    have h := det_rank_one_sub (hIU (n+1)) (ψ (X (n+1)))
    have h2 : Λ (n+1) - Matrix.vecMulVec (ψ (X (n+1))) (ψ (X (n+1))) = Λ n := by
      rw [hsucc n]; abel
    rw [h2] at h
    exact h
  have hβpos : ∀ n, 0 < 1 - γ n := by
    intro n
    have h := hdetstep n
    nlinarith [hdetpos n, hdetpos (n+1)]
  -- the key algebraic step
  have hstep : ∀ n, V (n+1) - V n
      = (Y (n+1) - (ŵ n) ⬝ᵥ (ψ (X (n+1)))) ^ 2 * (1 - γ n) := by
    intro n
    set p := ψ (X (n+1)) with hp
    set A := Λ n with hA
    set Bm := Λ (n+1) with hBm
    set w := ŵ n with hw
    have hwdef : w = A⁻¹ *ᵥ bb n := by rw [hw, hŵ]
    have hAw : A *ᵥ w = bb n := by
      rw [hwdef, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ (hIU n), Matrix.one_mulVec]
    have hBmw : Bm *ᵥ w = bb n + (p ⬝ᵥ w) • p := by
      rw [hBm, hsucc n, Matrix.add_mulVec, ← hA, hAw]
      congr 1
      ext i
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, dotProduct, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
        Finset.sum_mul]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by ring)
    set r := Y (n+1) - w ⬝ᵥ p with hr
    have hpw : p ⬝ᵥ w = w ⬝ᵥ p := dotProduct_comm _ _
    have hbb1 : bb (n+1) = Bm *ᵥ w + r • p := by
      rw [hbbsucc n, hBmw, hr, hpw]
      ext i
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    have hinv : Bm⁻¹ *ᵥ (Bm *ᵥ w) = w := by
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ (hIU (n+1)), Matrix.one_mulVec]
    have hexp : (bb (n+1)) ⬝ᵥ (Bm⁻¹ *ᵥ (bb (n+1)))
        = (A *ᵥ w) ⬝ᵥ w + (w ⬝ᵥ p) ^ 2 + 2 * r * (w ⬝ᵥ p) + r ^ 2 * γ n := by
      rw [hbb1]
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_smul, hinv]
      rw [add_dotProduct, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_add,
        smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, dotProduct_smul,
        smul_dotProduct]
      have e1 : (Bm *ᵥ w) ⬝ᵥ w = (A *ᵥ w) ⬝ᵥ w + (p ⬝ᵥ w) * (p ⬝ᵥ w) := by
        rw [hBmw, add_dotProduct, smul_dotProduct, hAw, smul_eq_mul]
      have e2 : (Bm *ᵥ w) ⬝ᵥ (Bm⁻¹ *ᵥ p) = w ⬝ᵥ p := by
        rw [symm_dot (hsym (n+1)) w (Bm⁻¹ *ᵥ p), Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
          Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ (hIU (n+1)), Matrix.one_mulVec]
      have e3 : p ⬝ᵥ w = w ⬝ᵥ p := hpw
      have e4 : p ⬝ᵥ (Bm⁻¹ *ᵥ p) = γ n := rfl
      rw [e1, e2, e3, e4]
      simp only [smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    have hV0 : (bb n) ⬝ᵥ ((Λ n)⁻¹ *ᵥ (bb n)) = (A *ᵥ w) ⬝ᵥ w := by
      rw [← hwdef]
      conv_lhs => rw [← hAw]
    simp only [hV]
    rw [hccsucc n, hexp, hV0]
    rw [hr]
    have : w ⬝ᵥ p = w ⬝ᵥ p := rfl
    ring
  -- per-step inequality
  have hper : ∀ n, (Y (n+1) - Ŷ (n+1)) ^ 2
      ≤ (V (n+1) - V n) + M ^ 2 * (Real.log ((Λ (n+1)).det) - Real.log ((Λ n).det)) := by
    intro n
    have hY := hYrange (n+1) (by omega)
    obtain ⟨hY0, hY1⟩ := hY
    have hŶeq : Ŷ (n+1) = max 0 (min M ((ŵ n) ⬝ᵥ (ψ (X (n+1))))) := by
      rw [hŶ]; norm_num
    obtain ⟨hc1, hc2⟩ := clip_sq (z := (ŵ n) ⬝ᵥ (ψ (X (n+1)))) hM hY0 hY1
    rw [hŶeq]
    set e := (Y (n+1) - max 0 (min M ((ŵ n) ⬝ᵥ (ψ (X (n+1)))))) ^ 2 with he
    set r := (Y (n+1) - (ŵ n) ⬝ᵥ (ψ (X (n+1)))) ^ 2 with hrr
    set β := 1 - γ n with hβ
    have hβp : 0 < β := hβpos n
    have hβ1 : β ≤ 1 := by have hg := hγnn n; simp only [hβ]; linarith
    have hlog : Real.log ((Λ (n+1)).det) - Real.log ((Λ n).det) = - Real.log β := by
      rw [hdetstep n, Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt (hdetpos (n+1))) (ne_of_gt hβp)]
      ring
    rw [hstep n, hlog]
    have hlb : Real.log β ≤ β - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hβp
    have hMsq : 0 ≤ M ^ 2 := by positivity
    have h1 : e * β ≤ r * β := by nlinarith
    nlinarith [hc2, hMsq, hlb, hβp]
  -- telescoping
  have hmain : ∀ n, (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (Y t - Ŷ t) ^ 2)
      ≤ V n + M ^ 2 * (Real.log ((Λ n).det) - Real.log ((Λ 0).det)) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      simp only [hV, hcc, hbb]
      simp
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega)]
      have := hper k
      linarith
  -- V T ≤ inf
  have hVinf : V T ≤ (⨅ w : Fin d → ℝ,
      ((∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, (Y t - (w ⬝ᵥ (ψ (X t)))) ^ 2) + (Λ₀.mulVec w) ⬝ᵥ w)) := by
    refine le_ciInf ?_
    intro w
    have hquad : (∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, (Y t - (w ⬝ᵥ (ψ (X t)))) ^ 2) + (Λ₀.mulVec w) ⬝ᵥ w
        = ((Λ T) *ᵥ w) ⬝ᵥ w - 2 * (w ⬝ᵥ (bb T)) + cc T := by
      have hexpand : ∀ t, (Y t - (w ⬝ᵥ (ψ (X t)))) ^ 2
          = (Y t) ^ 2 - 2 * (Y t * (w ⬝ᵥ ψ (X t)))
            + ((Matrix.vecMulVec (ψ (X t)) (ψ (X t))) *ᵥ w) ⬝ᵥ w := by
        intro t
        rw [Matrix.vecMulVec_mulVec, smul_dotProduct]
        have : (ψ (X t)) ⬝ᵥ w = w ⬝ᵥ (ψ (X t)) := dotProduct_comm _ _
        rw [this]
        simp [smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun t _ => hexpand t)]
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      have hs1 : ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T,
          ((Matrix.vecMulVec (ψ (X t)) (ψ (X t))) *ᵥ w) ⬝ᵥ w
          = ((∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, Matrix.vecMulVec (ψ (X t)) (ψ (X t))) *ᵥ w) ⬝ᵥ w := by
        rw [Matrix.sum_mulVec, sum_dotProduct]
      have hs2 : ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, 2 * (Y t * (w ⬝ᵥ ψ (X t))) = 2 * (w ⬝ᵥ (bb T)) := by
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
        congr 1
        rw [hbb]
        rw [dotProduct_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun t _ => ?_)
        rw [dotProduct_smul]
        simp [smul_eq_mul]
      rw [hs1, hs2]
      rw [hΛ T, Matrix.add_mulVec, add_dotProduct]
      simp only [hcc]
      ring
    rw [hquad]
    have := quad_min (hpd T) (bb T) w
    simp only [hV]
    linarith
  -- final log identity
  have hlogfin : Real.log |(Λ₀⁻¹ * Λ T).det| = Real.log ((Λ T).det) - Real.log ((Λ 0).det) := by
    rw [Matrix.det_mul]
    rw [Matrix.det_nonsing_inv]
    have h0 : (0:ℝ) < Λ₀.det := hΛ0eq ▸ hdetpos 0
    have hT : (0:ℝ) < (Λ T).det := hdetpos T
    rw [Ring.inverse_eq_inv]
    have : |Λ₀.det⁻¹ * (Λ T).det| = Λ₀.det⁻¹ * (Λ T).det := by
      rw [abs_of_pos]; positivity
    rw [this, Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity), Real.log_inv, hΛ0eq]
    ring
  have := hmain T
  rw [hlogfin]
  linarith [hVinf]

end GraduateLevel

targets.statement:
Consider Algorithm 16.5. Let \( G_{*} = \max_{a}\sum_{t = 1}^{T}r_{t}(a) \). We have the following bound for the adversarial regret (16.1):
\[
\mathrm{REG}_{T}\leq(e-1)\gamma G_{*}+\frac{K\ln K}{\gamma}.
\]

nl_proof:
We have
\[
\sum_{a=1}^{K}\hat{\pi}_{t}(a)\hat{r}_{t}(a,a_{t})=r_{t}(a_{t}),\tag{16.9}
\]
\[
\sum_{a=1}^{K}\hat{\pi}_{t}(a)\hat{r}_{t}\left(a,a_{t}\right)^{2}=\hat{r}_{t}\left(a_{t},a_{t}\right)r_{t}\left(a_{t}\right)\leq\hat{r}_{t}\left(a_{t},a_{t}\right).\tag{16.10}
\]
It follows that for all \(t \geq 1\):
\[
\begin{array}{l}\frac{w_{t}}{w_{t-1}}=\sum_{a=1}^{K}\frac{w_{t}(a)}{w_{t-1}}=\sum_{a=1}^{K}\frac{w_{t-1}(a)}{w_{t-1}}\exp(\gamma\hat{r}_{t}(a,a_{t})/K)\\ =\sum_{a=1}^{K}\frac{\hat{\pi}_{t}(a)-\gamma/K}{1-\gamma}\exp\left(\gamma\hat{r}_{t}\left(a,a_{t}\right)/K\right)\quad \text{(d e f i n i t i o n o f}\hat{\pi}_{t}(a))\\ \stackrel{(a)}{\leq}\sum_{a=1}^{K}\frac{\hat{\pi}_{t}(a)-\gamma/K}{1-\gamma}\left[1+\gamma\hat{r}_{t}(a,a_{t})/K+(e-2)(\gamma\hat{r}_{t}(a,a_{t})/K)^{2}\right]\\ \leq 1+\frac{1}{1-\gamma}\left[\sum_{a=1}^{K}\hat{\pi}_{t}(a)\gamma\hat{r}_{t}(a,a_{t})/K+\sum_{a=1}^{K}\hat{\pi}_{t}(a)(e-2)(\gamma\hat{r}_{t}(a,a_{t})/K)^{2}\right]\\ \stackrel{(b)}{\leq}1+\frac{\gamma/K}{1-\gamma}r_{t}(a_{t})+\frac{(e-2)(\gamma/K)^{2}}{1-\gamma}\hat{r}_{t}(a_{t},a_{t}).\\ \end{array}
\]
In \((a)\), we used \(\exp(z) \leq 1 + z + (e - 2)z^2\) when \(z \leq 1\), and \(\gamma \hat{r}_t(a, a_t) / K \leq 1\). In \((b)\), we used (16.9) and (16.10).
Therefore
\[
\begin{array}{l}\ln\frac{w_{t}}{w_{t-1}}\leq\ln\left(1+\frac{\gamma/K}{1-\gamma}r_{t}(a_{t})+\frac{(e-2)(\gamma/K)^{2}}{1-\gamma}\hat{r}_{t}(a_{t},a_{t})\right)\\ \leq\frac{\gamma/K}{1-\gamma}r_{t}(a_{t})+\frac{(e-2)(\gamma/K)^{2}}{1-\gamma}\hat{r}_{t}(a_{t},a_{t}).\\ \end{array}
\]
The second inequality follows from \(\ln (1 + z) \leq z\).
Now, by summing over \(t\), and let
\[
G_{T}=\sum_{t=1}^{T}r_{t}(a_{t}),
\]
we obtain
\[
'\ln\frac{w_{T}}{w_{0}}\leq\frac{\gamma/K}{1-\gamma}G_{T}+\frac{(e-2)(\gamma/K)^{2}}{1-\gamma}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{a=1}^{K}\hat{r}_{t}(a,a_{t}),
\]
where we used \(\hat{r}_t(a_t, a_t) = \sum_{a=1}^{K} \hat{r}_t(a, a_t)\). Note that for all \(a'\):
\[
\ln\frac{w_{T}}{w_{0}}\geq\ln\frac{w_{T}(a^{\prime})}{w_{0}}=\frac{\gamma}{K}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\hat{r}_{t}(a^{\prime},a_{t})-\ln K.
\]
It follows that
\[
\frac{\gamma}{K}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\hat{r}_{t}(a^{\prime},a_{t})\leq\frac{\gamma/K}{1-\gamma}G_{T}+\frac{(e-2)(\gamma/K)^{2}}{1-\gamma}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{a=1}^{K}\hat{r}_{t}(a,a_{t})+\ln K.
\]
Observe that conditioned on the history,
\[
\mathbb{E}_{a_{t}\sim\hat{\pi}_{t}}\hat{r}_{t}(a,a_{t})=r_{t}(a).
\]
We obtain the following bound by taking expectation:
\[
\begin{array}{l}\mathbb{E}\frac{\gamma}{K}\sum_{t=1}^{T}r_{t}(a^{\prime})\leq\frac{\gamma/K}{1-\gamma}\mathbb{E}G_{T}+\frac{(e-2)(\gamma/K)^{2}}{1-\gamma}\mathbb{E}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{a=1}^{K}r_{t}(a)+\ln K\\ \leq\frac{\gamma/K}{1-\gamma}\mathbb{E}G_{T}+\frac{(e-2)(\gamma/K)^{2}}{1-\gamma}K G_{*}+\ln K.\\ \end{array}
\]
Let \(a^\prime\) be the optimal arm, and rearrange, we obtain
\[
G_{*}\leq\frac{1}{1-\gamma}\mathbb{E}G_{T}+\frac{(e-2)\gamma}{(1-\gamma)}G_{*}+\frac{K}{\gamma}\ln K.
\]
This implies the desired result.

context.name: definition 16.1
context.statement:
In the multi-armed bandit (or MAB) problem, we consider \(K\) arms. The environment generates a sequence of reward vectors for time steps \(t \geq 1\) as \(r_t = [r_t(1), \ldots, r_t(K)]\). Each \(r_t(a)\) is associated with an arm \(a \in \{1, \ldots, K\}\). In the literature, an arm \(a\) is also referred to as an action. At each time step \(t = 1, 2, \ldots, T\),
- The player pulls one of the arms \( a_{t} \in \{1, \dots, K\} \).
- The environment returns the reward \( r_t(a_t) \), but does not reveal information on any other arm \( a \neq a_t \).
At each time \( t \), a (randomized) bandit algorithm takes the historic observations observed so far, and maps it to a distribution \( \hat{\pi}_{t-1} \) over actions \( a \in \{1, \ldots, K\} \). We then draw a random action \( a_t \) (arm) from \( \hat{\pi}_{t-1} \). Here \( \hat{\pi}_{t-1} \) is referred to as policy.
In the adversarial bandit problem, we are given an arbitrary reward sequence \(\{[r_1(1),\ldots,r_t(K)]:t\geq 1\}\) before hand. The adversary in this setting is called oblivious, who decides the rewards of all the rounds before the game starts (but may take advantage of the bandit algorithm's weakness). For this reward se
quence, the expected cumulative reward of a randomized bandit algorithm is
\[
\mathbb{E}\sum_{t=1}^{T}r_{t}(a_{t}),
\]
where the randomization is over the internal randomization of the bandit algorithm. The expected regret is defined as
\[
\operatorname{REG}_{T}=\max_{a}\sum_{t=1}^{T}r_{t}(a)-\mathbb{E}\sum_{t=1}^{T}r_{t}\left(a_{t}\right).\tag{16.1}
\]
If the bandit algorithm is deterministic: i.e. pulling a single arm \(a_{t}\) only at any time step, then the regret is
\[
\mathrm{REG}_{T}=\max_{a}\sum_{t=1}^{T}r_{t}(a)-\sum_{t=1}^{T}r_{t}(a_{t}).
\]
In the adversarial bandit problem, our goal is to minimize the expected regret \(\mathrm{REG}_T\) (and the expectation is with respect to the internal randomization of the algorithm instead of the data).
Another form of bandit problem, called stochastic bandit, assumes that the reward \( r_t(a) \) is drawn independently from a distribution \( \mathcal{D}_a \), with mean \( \mu(a) = \mathbb{E}_{r_t(a) \sim \mathcal{D}_a} [r_t(a)] \). In this setting, the goal of bandit is to find \( a \) that maximizes the expected reward \( \mu(a) \). We are interested in the expected regret defined as:
\[
\operatorname{REG}_{T}=T\max_{a}\mu(a)-\mathbb{E}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mu\left(a_{t}\right).\tag{16.2}
\]
Again, this regret is defined for each realization of the stochastic rewards, and the expectation is with respect to the randomness of the algorithm. If algorithm is deterministic and outputs \( a_{t} \) at each time \( t \), then
\[
\mathrm{REG}_{T}=T\max_{a}\mu(a)-\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mu(a_{t}).
\]
We can further include randomization over data into the regret of stochastic bandit, by considering expected regret as follows:
\[
\mathbb{E}\operatorname{REG}_{T}=T\max_{a}\mu(a)-\mathbb{E}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mu(a_{t}),
\]
where the expectation is with respect to both the data and the internal randomization of the learning algorithm.

import Mathlib

open MeasureTheory
open scoped MeasureTheory

namespace GraduateLevel

def bestArmReward {K T : ℕ} (hK : 1 ≤ K) (r : Fin T → Fin K → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin K) := ⟨⟨0, by omega⟩⟩
  (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin K)).sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun a => ∑ t : Fin T, r t a)

private theorem expser (x : ℝ) : Real.exp x = ∑' n : ℕ, x ^ n / (Nat.factorial n) := by
  rw [Real.exp_eq_exp_ℝ, NormedSpace.exp_eq_tsum_div]

private theorem exp_quad (z : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ z) (h1 : z ≤ 1) :
    Real.exp z ≤ 1 + z + (Real.exp 1 - 2) * z ^ 2 := by
  have hs : ∀ y : ℝ, Summable (fun n : ℕ => y ^ n / (Nat.factorial n)) :=
    Real.summable_pow_div_factorial
  have hs2 : ∀ y : ℝ, Summable (fun n : ℕ => y ^ (n + 2) / (Nat.factorial (n + 2))) := by
    intro y
    exact (summable_nat_add_iff 2).2 (hs y)
  have hsplit : ∀ y : ℝ, Real.exp y = 1 + y + ∑' n : ℕ, y ^ (n + 2) / (Nat.factorial (n + 2)) := by
    intro y
    rw [expser y, (hs y).tsum_eq_zero_add, ((summable_nat_add_iff 1).2 (hs y)).tsum_eq_zero_add]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [hsplit z, hsplit 1]
  have hle : ∑' n : ℕ, z ^ (n + 2) / (Nat.factorial (n + 2))
      ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, z ^ 2 * ((1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 2) / (Nat.factorial (n + 2))) := by
    apply Summable.tsum_le_tsum _ (hs2 z) ((hs2 1).mul_left _)
    intro n
    have hzz : z ^ (n + 2) ≤ z ^ 2 := by
      calc z ^ (n + 2) = z ^ 2 * z ^ n := by ring
      _ ≤ z ^ 2 * 1 := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_one₀ h0 h1) (by positivity)
      _ = z ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [one_pow]
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    rw [mul_comm (z ^ 2)]
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, mul_comm, mul_div_assoc]
    field_simp
    linarith [hzz]
  rw [tsum_mul_left] at hle
  have hh : (1 : ℝ) + 1 + ∑' n : ℕ, (1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 2) / (Nat.factorial (n + 2)) = Real.exp 1 :=
    (hsplit 1).symm
  nlinarith [hle, hh]

private theorem tele : ∀ {T : ℕ} (L : Fin (T + 1) → ℝ),
    ∑ t : Fin T, (L t.succ - L t.castSucc) = L (Fin.last T) - L 0 := by
  intro T
  induction T with
  | zero => intro L; simp
  | succ n ih =>
    intro L
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    have h := ih (fun i => L i.castSucc)
    rw [show (∑ i : Fin n, (L (Fin.castSucc i).succ - L (Fin.castSucc i).castSucc))
        = ∑ i : Fin n, ((fun j : Fin (n+1) => L j.castSucc) i.succ
            - (fun j : Fin (n+1) => L j.castSucc) i.castSucc) from by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _; rw [Fin.succ_castSucc]]
    rw [h]
    simp [Fin.succ_last]

private theorem one_step {K : ℕ} (hK : 1 ≤ K) (γ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hγ1 : γ < 1)
    (v v' p rh : Fin K → ℝ) (b : Fin K) (rv : ℝ)
    (hvnonneg : ∀ a, 0 ≤ v a) (hVpos : 0 < ∑ a, v a)
    (hp : ∀ a, p a = (1 - γ) * (v a / ∑ c, v c) + γ / K)
    (hrh : ∀ a, rh a = if a = b then rv / p b else 0)
    (hrv0 : 0 ≤ rv) (hrv1 : rv ≤ 1)
    (hv' : ∀ a, v' a = v a * Real.exp (γ * rh a / K)) :
    Real.log (∑ a, v' a) - Real.log (∑ a, v a)
      ≤ (γ / K) / (1 - γ) * rv + (Real.exp 1 - 2) * (γ / K) ^ 2 / (1 - γ) * (∑ a, rh a) := by
  have hK0 : (0 : ℝ) < K := by exact_mod_cast hK
  have hD : 0 < 1 - γ := by linarith
  have hpge : ∀ a, γ / K ≤ p a := by
    intro a
    rw [hp a]
    have h1 : 0 ≤ (1 - γ) * (v a / ∑ c, v c) :=
      mul_nonneg (by linarith) (div_nonneg (hvnonneg a) hVpos.le)
    linarith
  have hppos : ∀ a, 0 < p a := fun a => lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) (hpge a)
  have hrhnn : ∀ a, 0 ≤ rh a := by
    intro a
    rw [hrh a]
    split
    · exact div_nonneg hrv0 (hppos b).le
    · exact le_refl 0
  have hrhle : ∀ a, γ * rh a / K ≤ 1 := by
    intro a
    have h1 : rh a ≤ K / γ := by
      rw [hrh a]
      split
      · rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (hppos b) hγ]
        have hb1 : (K:ℝ) * (γ / K) ≤ (K:ℝ) * p b := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hpge b) hK0.le
        have hb2 : (K:ℝ) * (γ / K) = γ := by field_simp
        nlinarith [hb1, hb2, hγ, hrv1]
      · positivity
    rw [div_le_one hK0]
    have h3 : γ * ((K:ℝ)/γ) = (K:ℝ) := by field_simp
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hγ.le, h3]
  have hpb : p b ≠ 0 := (hppos b).ne'
  have hsum1 : ∑ a, p a * rh a = rv := by
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single b]
    · rw [hrh b, if_pos rfl]
      field_simp
    · intro c _ hc
      rw [hrh c, if_neg hc]
      ring
    · intro h
      exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ b) h
  have hsumrh : ∑ a, rh a = rv / p b := by
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single b]
    · rw [hrh b, if_pos rfl]
    · intro c _ hc
      rw [hrh c, if_neg hc]
    · intro h
      exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ b) h
  have hsum2 : ∑ a, p a * (rh a) ^ 2 = rv * (rv / p b) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single b]
    · rw [hrh b, if_pos rfl]
      field_simp
    · intro c _ hc
      rw [hrh c, if_neg hc]
      ring
    · intro h
      exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ b) h
  have hvle : ∀ a, v a ≤ ((∑ c, v c) / (1 - γ)) * p a := by
    intro a
    rw [hp a]
    have h1 : ((∑ c, v c) / (1 - γ)) * ((1 - γ) * (v a / ∑ c, v c) + γ / K)
        = v a + ((∑ c, v c) / (1 - γ)) * (γ / K) := by
      field_simp
    rw [h1]
    have h2 : 0 ≤ ((∑ c, v c) / (1 - γ)) * (γ / K) :=
      mul_nonneg (div_nonneg hVpos.le hD.le) (by positivity)
    linarith
  have he2 : (0 : ℝ) < Real.exp 1 - 2 := by nlinarith [Real.exp_one_gt_d9]
  have b1 : ∑ a, v a * (γ * rh a / K) ≤ ((∑ c, v c) / (1 - γ)) * ((γ / K) * rv) := by
    calc ∑ a, v a * (γ * rh a / K)
        ≤ ∑ a, (((∑ c, v c) / (1 - γ)) * p a) * (γ * rh a / K) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro a _
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hvle a)
          have := hrhnn a
          positivity
      _ = ((∑ c, v c) / (1 - γ)) * ((γ / K) * (∑ a, p a * rh a)) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro a _
          field_simp
      _ = ((∑ c, v c) / (1 - γ)) * ((γ / K) * rv) := by rw [hsum1]
  have b2 : ∑ a, v a * (γ * rh a / K) ^ 2
      ≤ ((∑ c, v c) / (1 - γ)) * ((γ / K) ^ 2 * (∑ a, rh a)) := by
    calc ∑ a, v a * (γ * rh a / K) ^ 2
        ≤ ∑ a, (((∑ c, v c) / (1 - γ)) * p a) * (γ * rh a / K) ^ 2 := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro a _
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hvle a)
          positivity
      _ = ((∑ c, v c) / (1 - γ)) * ((γ / K) ^ 2 * (∑ a, p a * (rh a) ^ 2)) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro a _
          field_simp
      _ ≤ ((∑ c, v c) / (1 - γ)) * ((γ / K) ^ 2 * (∑ a, rh a)) := by
          rw [hsum2, hsumrh]
          have hq : 0 ≤ rv / p b := div_nonneg hrv0 (hppos b).le
          have h3 : rv * (rv / p b) ≤ rv / p b := by nlinarith
          have h4 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (∑ c, v c) / (1 - γ) := div_nonneg hVpos.le hD.le
          have h5 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (γ / K) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 h5) h4
  have hSnn : (0:ℝ) ≤ ∑ a, rh a := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun a _ => hrhnn a)
  set A : ℝ := (γ / K) / (1 - γ) * rv + (Real.exp 1 - 2) * (γ / K) ^ 2 / (1 - γ) * (∑ a, rh a)
    with hA
  have hAnn : 0 ≤ A := by
    rw [hA]
    have : (0:ℝ) ≤ (γ / K) / (1 - γ) * rv := by positivity
    have h2 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (Real.exp 1 - 2) * (γ / K) ^ 2 / (1 - γ) * (∑ a, rh a) := by
      apply mul_nonneg _ hSnn
      apply div_nonneg _ hD.le
      positivity
    linarith
  have hV'le : ∑ a, v' a ≤ (∑ a, v a) * (1 + A) := by
    calc ∑ a, v' a = ∑ a, v a * Real.exp (γ * rh a / K) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro a _; rw [hv' a]
      _ ≤ ∑ a, v a * (1 + (γ * rh a / K) + (Real.exp 1 - 2) * (γ * rh a / K) ^ 2) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro a _
          refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (exp_quad _ ?_ (hrhle a)) (hvnonneg a)
          have := hrhnn a
          positivity
      _ = ∑ a, (v a + v a * (γ * rh a / K)
            + (Real.exp 1 - 2) * (v a * (γ * rh a / K) ^ 2)) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro a _; ring
      _ = (∑ a, v a) + (∑ a, v a * (γ * rh a / K))
            + (Real.exp 1 - 2) * (∑ a, v a * (γ * rh a / K) ^ 2) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
      _ ≤ (∑ a, v a) + ((∑ c, v c) / (1 - γ)) * ((γ / K) * rv)
            + (Real.exp 1 - 2) * (((∑ c, v c) / (1 - γ)) * ((γ / K) ^ 2 * (∑ a, rh a))) := by
          nlinarith [b1, b2, he2]
      _ = (∑ a, v a) * (1 + A) := by
          rw [hA]; field_simp; ring
  have hV'pos : 0 < ∑ a, v' a := by
    obtain ⟨a1, -, ha1⟩ := Finset.exists_lt_of_sum_lt
      (show ∑ _a : Fin K, (0:ℝ) < ∑ a, v a by simpa using hVpos)
    refine Finset.sum_pos' (fun a _ => ?_) ⟨a1, Finset.mem_univ a1, ?_⟩
    · rw [hv' a]; exact mul_nonneg (hvnonneg a) (Real.exp_pos _).le
    · rw [hv' a1]; exact mul_pos ha1 (Real.exp_pos _)
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log hV'pos hV'le
  rw [Real.log_mul hVpos.ne' (by positivity)] at hlog
  have hlog1 : Real.log (1 + A) ≤ A := by
    have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (show (0:ℝ) < 1 + A by linarith)
    linarith
  linarith

theorem ch16_theorem_16_17
    {K T : ℕ} (hK : 1 ≤ K) (γ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1)
    (r : Fin T → Fin K → ℝ) (hr : ∀ t a, r t a ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    {Ω : Type*} {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} (μ : @Measure Ω m0) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (w : Fin (T + 1) → Ω → Fin K → ℝ) (pol : Fin T → Ω → Fin K → ℝ)
    (a' : Fin T → Ω → Fin K) (rhat : Fin T → Ω → Fin K → ℝ)
    (ha'meas : ∀ t, Measurable (a' t)) (hw0 : ∀ ω a, w 0 ω a = 1)
    (hwnonneg : ∀ (t : Fin (T + 1)) ω a, 0 ≤ w t ω a)
    (hwpos : ∀ (t : Fin T) ω, 0 < ∑ b : Fin K, w t.castSucc ω b)
    (hpol : ∀ (t : Fin T) ω a, pol t ω a = (1 - γ) * (w t.castSucc ω a / ∑ b : Fin K, w t.castSucc ω b) + γ / K)
    (hpolpos : ∀ (t : Fin T) ω a, 0 < pol t ω a)
    (hrhat : ∀ (t : Fin T) ω a, rhat t ω a = if a = a' t ω then r t (a' t ω) / pol t ω (a' t ω) else 0)
    (hwupd : ∀ (t : Fin T) ω a, w t.succ ω a = w t.castSucc ω a * Real.exp (γ * rhat t ω a / K))
    (ℱ : Fin T → MeasurableSpace Ω)
    (hℱ : ∀ t, ℱ t ≤ m0)
    (ha'adapted : ∀ (s t : Fin T), s < t → Measurable[ℱ t] (a' s))
    (hpol_meas : ∀ (t : Fin T) (a : Fin K), Measurable[ℱ t] (fun ω => pol t ω a))
    (hsample : ∀ (t : Fin T) (a : Fin K),
        μ[(fun ω => if a' t ω = a then (1 : ℝ) else 0) | ℱ t]
          =ᵐ[μ] fun ω => pol t ω a)
    (hint_rhat : ∀ (t : Fin T) (a : Fin K), Integrable (fun ω => rhat t ω a) μ)
    (hint_rew : Integrable (fun ω => ∑ t : Fin T, r t (a' t ω)) μ)
    (REG : ℝ) (hREG : REG = bestArmReward hK r - ∫ ω, ∑ t : Fin T, r t (a' t ω) ∂μ) :
    REG ≤ (Real.exp 1 - 1) * γ * bestArmReward hK r + (K * Real.log K) / γ := by
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin K) := ⟨⟨0, hK⟩⟩
  have hK0 : (0:ℝ) < K := by exact_mod_cast hK
  have hlogK : (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.log K := Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hK)
  have he2 : (0:ℝ) < Real.exp 1 - 2 := by nlinarith [Real.exp_one_gt_d9]
  have hGle : ∀ a, ∑ t : Fin T, r t a ≤ bestArmReward hK r := by
    intro a
    unfold bestArmReward
    exact Finset.le_sup' (fun a => ∑ t : Fin T, r t a) (Finset.mem_univ a)
  have hGnonneg : (0:ℝ) ≤ bestArmReward hK r := by
    refine le_trans ?_ (hGle ⟨0, hK⟩)
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun t _ => (hr t _).1)
  have hEnonneg : (0:ℝ) ≤ ∫ ω, ∑ t : Fin T, r t (a' t ω) ∂μ :=
    integral_nonneg (fun ω => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun t _ => (hr t _).1))
  by_cases hlt : γ < 1
  swap
  · have hγ1' : γ = 1 := le_antisymm hγ1 (not_lt.mp hlt)
    subst hγ1'
    rw [hREG]
    have h1 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (K : ℝ) * Real.log K / 1 := by positivity
    nlinarith [hGnonneg, hEnonneg, he2, h1]
  -- main case
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ : ∃ a₀ : Fin K, bestArmReward hK r = ∑ t : Fin T, r t a₀ := by
    unfold bestArmReward
    obtain ⟨a₀, -, h⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup' (Finset.univ_nonempty)
      (fun a => ∑ t : Fin T, r t a)
    exact ⟨a₀, h⟩
  have hD : (0:ℝ) < 1 - γ := by linarith
  set C : ℝ := (Real.exp 1 - 2) * (γ / K) ^ 2 / (1 - γ) with hC
  have hCnn : 0 ≤ C := by rw [hC]; positivity
  -- master pointwise inequality
  have master : ∀ ω, (γ / K) * (∑ t : Fin T, rhat t ω a₀) - Real.log K
      ≤ (γ / K) / (1 - γ) * (∑ t : Fin T, r t (a' t ω))
        + C * (∑ t : Fin T, ∑ a : Fin K, rhat t ω a) := by
    intro ω
    have hup : Real.log (∑ b, w (Fin.last T) ω b) - Real.log (∑ b, w 0 ω b)
        ≤ (γ / K) / (1 - γ) * (∑ t : Fin T, r t (a' t ω))
          + C * (∑ t : Fin T, ∑ a : Fin K, rhat t ω a) := by
      rw [← tele (fun i => Real.log (∑ b, w i ω b))]
      calc ∑ t : Fin T, (Real.log (∑ b, w t.succ ω b) - Real.log (∑ b, w t.castSucc ω b))
          ≤ ∑ t : Fin T, ((γ / K) / (1 - γ) * r t (a' t ω)
              + C * (∑ a : Fin K, rhat t ω a)) := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum
            intro t _
            exact one_step hK γ hγ hlt (w t.castSucc ω) (w t.succ ω) (pol t ω) (rhat t ω)
              (a' t ω) (r t (a' t ω)) (fun a => hwnonneg _ _ _) (hwpos t ω)
              (fun a => hpol t ω a) (fun a => hrhat t ω a) (hr t _).1 (hr t _).2
              (fun a => hwupd t ω a)
        _ = (γ / K) / (1 - γ) * (∑ t : Fin T, r t (a' t ω))
              + C * (∑ t : Fin T, ∑ a : Fin K, rhat t ω a) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum]
    have hwa0pos : ∀ i : Fin (T + 1), 0 < w i ω a₀ := by
      intro i
      induction i using Fin.induction with
      | zero => rw [hw0]; norm_num
      | succ j ih => rw [hwupd]; exact mul_pos ih (Real.exp_pos _)
    have hlogw : ∑ t : Fin T, (γ * rhat t ω a₀ / K) = Real.log (w (Fin.last T) ω a₀) := by
      have h2 := tele (fun i => Real.log (w i ω a₀))
      simp only [hw0, Real.log_one, sub_zero] at h2
      rw [← h2]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro t _
      rw [hwupd t ω a₀, Real.log_mul (hwa0pos _).ne' (Real.exp_pos _).ne', Real.log_exp]
      ring
    have hle : w (Fin.last T) ω a₀ ≤ ∑ b, w (Fin.last T) ω b :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun b => w (Fin.last T) ω b)
        (fun b _ => hwnonneg _ _ _) (Finset.mem_univ a₀)
    have hlog2 : Real.log (w (Fin.last T) ω a₀) ≤ Real.log (∑ b, w (Fin.last T) ω b) :=
      Real.log_le_log (hwa0pos _) hle
    have hW0 : (∑ b, w (0 : Fin (T + 1)) ω b) = (K : ℝ) := by
      simp [hw0]
    have hmul : (γ / K) * (∑ t : Fin T, rhat t ω a₀) = ∑ t : Fin T, (γ * rhat t ω a₀ / K) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro t _
      ring
    rw [hW0] at hup
    linarith [hup, hlog2, hlogw, hmul]
  -- expectation of rhat
  have hIntRhat : ∀ (t : Fin T) (a : Fin K), ∫ ω, rhat t ω a ∂μ = r t a := by
    intro t a
    set f : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => r t a / pol t ω a with hf
    set g : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => if a' t ω = a then (1:ℝ) else 0 with hg
    have hfg : ∀ ω, rhat t ω a = f ω * g ω := by
      intro ω
      simp only [hf, hg]
      rw [hrhat t ω a]
      by_cases h : a = a' t ω
      · subst h
        simp
      · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun hh => h hh.symm)]
        ring
    have hfmeas : Measurable[ℱ t] f := by
      rw [hf]
      exact measurable_const.div (hpol_meas t a)
    have hgmeas : Measurable g := by
      rw [hg]
      exact Measurable.ite (measurableSet_eq_fun (ha'meas t) measurable_const)
        measurable_const measurable_const
    have hgint : Integrable g μ := by
      refine Integrable.mono' (integrable_const 1) hgmeas.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      filter_upwards with ω
      rw [hg]
      by_cases h : a' t ω = a <;> simp [h]
    have hfgint : Integrable (fun ω => f ω * g ω) μ := by
      simpa [hfg] using hint_rhat t a
    have h1 : μ[(fun ω => f ω * g ω)|ℱ t] =ᵐ[μ] f * μ[g|ℱ t] :=
      condExp_mul_of_stronglyMeasurable_left hfmeas.stronglyMeasurable hfgint hgint
    have h2 := integral_condExp (μ := μ) (f := fun ω => f ω * g ω) (hℱ t)
    calc ∫ ω, rhat t ω a ∂μ = ∫ ω, f ω * g ω ∂μ := by
          apply integral_congr_ae; filter_upwards with ω; rw [hfg ω]
      _ = ∫ ω, (μ[(fun ω => f ω * g ω)|ℱ t]) ω ∂μ := h2.symm
      _ = ∫ ω, r t a ∂μ := by
          apply integral_congr_ae
          filter_upwards [h1, hsample t a] with ω hw hw2
          rw [hw]
          simp only [Pi.mul_apply]
          rw [hw2]
          simp only [hf]
          have hp0 : pol t ω a ≠ 0 := (hpolpos t ω a).ne'
          field_simp
      _ = r t a := by simp
  -- integrate the master inequality
  have hI1 : Integrable (fun ω => ∑ t : Fin T, rhat t ω a₀) μ :=
    integrable_finset_sum _ (fun t _ => hint_rhat t a₀)
  have hI2 : Integrable (fun ω => ∑ t : Fin T, ∑ a : Fin K, rhat t ω a) μ :=
    integrable_finset_sum _ (fun t _ => integrable_finset_sum _ (fun a _ => hint_rhat t a))
  have hIL : Integrable (fun ω => (γ / K) * (∑ t : Fin T, rhat t ω a₀) - Real.log K) μ :=
    (hI1.const_mul _).sub (integrable_const _)
  have hIR : Integrable (fun ω => (γ / K) / (1 - γ) * (∑ t : Fin T, r t (a' t ω))
      + C * (∑ t : Fin T, ∑ a : Fin K, rhat t ω a)) μ :=
    (hint_rew.const_mul _).add (hI2.const_mul _)
  have hmono := integral_mono hIL hIR master
  have hL : ∫ ω, ((γ / K) * (∑ t : Fin T, rhat t ω a₀) - Real.log K) ∂μ
      = (γ / K) * (∑ t : Fin T, r t a₀) - Real.log K := by
    rw [integral_sub (hI1.const_mul _) (integrable_const _), integral_const_mul,
      integral_finset_sum _ (fun t _ => hint_rhat t a₀)]
    simp [hIntRhat]
  have hR : ∫ ω, ((γ / K) / (1 - γ) * (∑ t : Fin T, r t (a' t ω))
        + C * (∑ t : Fin T, ∑ a : Fin K, rhat t ω a)) ∂μ
      = (γ / K) / (1 - γ) * (∫ ω, ∑ t : Fin T, r t (a' t ω) ∂μ)
        + C * (∑ t : Fin T, ∑ a : Fin K, r t a) := by
    rw [integral_add (hint_rew.const_mul _) (hI2.const_mul _), integral_const_mul,
      integral_const_mul,
      integral_finset_sum _ (fun t _ => integrable_finset_sum _ (fun a _ => hint_rhat t a))]
    congr 2
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro t _
    rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun a _ => hint_rhat t a)]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => hIntRhat t a)
  rw [hL, hR] at hmono
  -- final algebra
  set G : ℝ := bestArmReward hK r with hG
  set E : ℝ := ∫ ω, ∑ t : Fin T, r t (a' t ω) ∂μ with hE
  set S : ℝ := ∑ t : Fin T, ∑ a : Fin K, r t a with hS

    rw [hS, Finset.sum_comm]
    calc ∑ a : Fin K, ∑ t : Fin T, r t a ≤ ∑ _a : Fin K, G :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun a _ => hGle a)
      _ = (K : ℝ) * G := by simp [mul_comm]
  have hSnn : (0:ℝ) ≤ S := by
    rw [hS]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun t _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun a _ => (hr t a).1))
  rw [← ha₀] at hmono
  -- hmono : (γ/K)*G - log K ≤ (γ/K)/(1-γ)*E + C*S
  have hposm : (0:ℝ) < (K : ℝ) * (1 - γ) / γ := by positivity
  have key2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmono hposm.le
  have ee1 : ((K : ℝ) * (1 - γ) / γ) * ((γ / K) * G - Real.log K)
      = (1 - γ) * G - (K : ℝ) * (1 - γ) * Real.log K / γ := by
    field_simp
  have ee2 : ((K : ℝ) * (1 - γ) / γ) * ((γ / K) / (1 - γ) * E + C * S)
      = E + (Real.exp 1 - 2) * (γ / K) * S := by
    rw [hC]
    field_simp
  rw [ee1, ee2] at key2
  have hSb : (Real.exp 1 - 2) * (γ / K) * S ≤ (Real.exp 1 - 2) * γ * G := by
    have h1 : (γ / K) * S ≤ (γ / K) * ((K : ℝ) * G) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hSle (by positivity)
    have h2 : (γ / K) * ((K : ℝ) * G) = γ * G := by field_simp
    rw [h2] at h1
    calc (Real.exp 1 - 2) * (γ / K) * S = (Real.exp 1 - 2) * ((γ / K) * S) := by ring
      _ ≤ (Real.exp 1 - 2) * (γ * G) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 he2.le
      _ = (Real.exp 1 - 2) * γ * G := by ring
  have hlogb : (K : ℝ) * (1 - γ) * Real.log K / γ ≤ (K : ℝ) * Real.log K / γ := by
    have hnum : (K : ℝ) * (1 - γ) * Real.log K ≤ (K : ℝ) * Real.log K := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hγ.le hK0.le) hlogK]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum hγ.le
  rw [hREG]
  linarith [key2, hSb, hlogb]

end GraduateLevel

targets.label: ch7_theorem_7_7
targets.statement: All local minima of \(g\) are global minima (even though \(g\) is non-convex).

nl_proof:
Step 1: Show that all stationary points must be eigenvectors. We have \(\nabla g(x) = -(M - xx^\top)x\), hence
\[
\nabla g(x) = 0 \implies Mx = \|x\|_2^2 \cdot x,
\]
which implies that \(x\) is an eigenvector of \(M\) with eigenvalue \(\|x\|_2^2\). From the Eckart–Young–Mirsky theorem the global minimum (i.e. the best rank-1 approximation) is the eigenvector with the largest eigenvalue.

Step 2: Show that all local minima must be eigenvectors of the largest eigenvalue. We use the second-order condition. For \(x\) to be a local minimum we need \(\nabla^2 g(x) \succeq 0\), i.e. for any \(v \in \mathbb{R}^d\),
\[
\langle v, \nabla^2 g(x)\, v \rangle \geq 0.
\]
Expanding \(g(x+v)\) into \(g(x) + \text{linear term in }v + \text{quadratic term in }v\) (the quadratic term equals \(\frac{1}{2}\langle v, \nabla^2 g(x)\,v\rangle\)),
\[
g(x+v) = \tfrac{1}{2}\|M - (x+v)(x+v)^\top\|_F^2 = \tfrac{1}{2}\|M - xx^\top\|_F^2 - \langle M - xx^\top, xv^\top + vx^\top\rangle + \tfrac{1}{2}\langle xv^\top + vx^\top, xv^\top + vx^\top\rangle - \langle M - xx^\top, vv^\top\rangle + \text{higher order terms in }v.
\]
Hence,
\[
\tfrac{1}{2}\langle v, \nabla^2 g(x)\,v\rangle = \tfrac{1}{2}\langle xv^\top + vx^\top, xv^\top + vx^\top\rangle - \langle M - xx^\top, vv^\top\rangle = 2\langle x, v\rangle^2 + \|x\|_2^2\|v\|_2^2 - v^\top M v.
\]
Picking \(v = v_1\), the unit eigenvector with the largest eigenvalue \(\lambda_1\), the local minimum condition requires
\[
\langle v_1, \nabla^2 g(x)\,v_1\rangle = 2\langle x, v_1\rangle^2 - v_1^\top M v_1 + \|x\|_2^2 \geq 0.
\]
Since all candidates for local minima are eigenvectors of \(M\), there are two cases:
- Case 1: \(x\) has eigenvalue \(\lambda_1\). Then \(x\) is the global minimum (by the Eckart–Young–Mirsky theorem).
- Case 2: \(x\) has eigenvalue \(\lambda < \lambda_1\). Then \(x\) and \(v_1\) are orthogonal, so
\[
2\langle x, v_1\rangle^2 - v_1^\top M v_1 + \|x\|_2^2 = 0 - \lambda_1 + \lambda \geq 0,
\]
which implies \(\lambda \geq \lambda_1\), a contradiction.

In summary, if \(x\) is a stationary point and not a global minimum, then moving in the direction of \(v_1\) yields a second-order improvement and \(x\) cannot be a local minimum.

import Mathlib

open scoped Matrix

namespace GraduateLevel

noncomputable def pcaObjective {d : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) (x : Fin d → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 2) * ∑ i : Fin d, ∑ j : Fin d, (M i j - Matrix.vecMulVec x x i j) ^ 2

open Filter Topology

section aux

variable {d : ℕ}

noncomputable def ipp (u w : Fin d → ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ i, u i * w i
noncomputable def nnn (u : Fin d → ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ i, u i ^ 2
noncomputable def qbb (M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) (u w : Fin d → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * u i * w j

lemma nnn_nonneg (u : Fin d → ℝ) : 0 ≤ nnn u := by
  unfold nnn
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _

lemma ipp_comm (u w : Fin d → ℝ) : ipp u w = ipp w u := by
  unfold ipp
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => mul_comm _ _

lemma ipp_self (u : Fin d → ℝ) : ipp u u = nnn u := by
  unfold ipp nnn
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => (sq (u i)).symm

lemma qbb_expand (M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) (u w : Fin d → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    qbb M (u + c • w) (u + c • w)
      = qbb M u u + c * (qbb M u w + qbb M w u) + c ^ 2 * qbb M w w := by
  simp only [qbb, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum,
    ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  ring

lemma nnn_expand (u w : Fin d → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    nnn (u + c • w) = nnn u + 2 * c * ipp u w + c ^ 2 * nnn w := by
  simp only [nnn, ipp, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum,
    ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  ring

lemma ipp_expand (u w z : Fin d → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    ipp u (w + c • z) = ipp u w + c * ipp u z := by
  simp only [ipp, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum,
    ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  ring

lemma pca_expand (M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) (y : Fin d → ℝ) :
    pcaObjective M y
      = (1 / 2) * (∑ i : Fin d, ∑ j : Fin d, (M i j) ^ 2) - qbb M y y + (nnn y) ^ 2 / 2 := by
  have hsq : (nnn y) ^ 2 = ∑ i : Fin d, ∑ j : Fin d, (y i ^ 2 * y j ^ 2) := by
    simp only [nnn, sq]
    rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum]
  have hmain : (∑ i : Fin d, ∑ j : Fin d, (M i j - Matrix.vecMulVec y y i j) ^ 2)
      = (∑ i : Fin d, ∑ j : Fin d, (M i j) ^ 2)
        - 2 * (∑ i : Fin d, ∑ j : Fin d, M i j * y i * y j)
        + (∑ i : Fin d, ∑ j : Fin d, (y i ^ 2 * y j ^ 2)) := by
    simp only [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    simp only [Matrix.vecMulVec_apply]
    ring
  simp only [pcaObjective, qbb]
  rw [hmain, hsq]
  ring

end aux

theorem ch7_theorem_7_7
    {d : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)
    (hSymm : M.IsSymm) (hPSD : M.PosSemidef)
    (x : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hLocal : IsLocalMin (pcaObjective M) x) :
    ∀ y : Fin d → ℝ, pcaObjective M x ≤ pcaObjective M y := by
  have hL : ∀ᶠ y in nhds x, pcaObjective M x ≤ pcaObjective M y := hLocal
  have key : ∀ v : Fin d → ℝ,
      (-(qbb M x v + qbb M v x) + 2 * ipp x v * nnn x = 0) ∧
      (0 ≤ -(qbb M v v) + nnn x * nnn v + 2 * (ipp x v) ^ 2) := by
    intro v
    set a1 : ℝ := -(qbb M x v + qbb M v x) + 2 * ipp x v * nnn x with ha1
    set a2 : ℝ := -(qbb M v v) + nnn x * nnn v + 2 * (ipp x v) ^ 2 with ha2
    set a3 : ℝ := 2 * ipp x v * nnn v with ha3
    set a4 : ℝ := (nnn v) ^ 2 / 2 with ha4
    have hpoly : ∀ t : ℝ, pcaObjective M (x + t • v)
        = pcaObjective M x + a1 * t + a2 * t ^ 2 + a3 * t ^ 3 + a4 * t ^ 4 := by
      intro t
      rw [pca_expand M (x + t • v), pca_expand M x, qbb_expand, nnn_expand, ha1, ha2, ha3, ha4]
      ring
    have hev : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in nhds 0,
        0 ≤ a1 * t + a2 * t ^ 2 + a3 * t ^ 3 + a4 * t ^ 4 := by
      have hc : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => x + t • v) (nhds 0) (nhds x) := by
        have h : ContinuousAt (fun t : ℝ => x + t • v) 0 := by fun_prop
        simpa using h.tendsto
      have h3 := hc.eventually hL
      filter_upwards [h3] with t ht
      rw [hpoly t] at ht
      linarith
    have hloc0 : IsLocalMin (fun t : ℝ =>
        pcaObjective M x + a1 * t + a2 * t ^ 2 + a3 * t ^ 3 + a4 * t ^ 4) 0 := by
      filter_upwards [hev] with t ht
      have h0 : pcaObjective M x + a1 * 0 + a2 * 0 ^ 2 + a3 * 0 ^ 3 + a4 * 0 ^ 4
          ≤ pcaObjective M x + a1 * t + a2 * t ^ 2 + a3 * t ^ 3 + a4 * t ^ 4 := by
        nlinarith [ht]
      exact h0
    have hderiv : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ =>
        pcaObjective M x + a1 * t + a2 * t ^ 2 + a3 * t ^ 3 + a4 * t ^ 4) a1 0 := by
      have d0 : HasDerivAt (fun _ : ℝ => pcaObjective M x) 0 0 := hasDerivAt_const _ _
      have d1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => a1 * t) a1 0 := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).const_mul a1
      have d2 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => a2 * t ^ 2) 0 0 := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_pow 2 (0 : ℝ)).const_mul a2
      have d3 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => a3 * t ^ 3) 0 0 := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_pow 3 (0 : ℝ)).const_mul a3
      have d4 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => a4 * t ^ 4) 0 0 := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_pow 4 (0 : ℝ)).const_mul a4
      simpa using (((d0.add d1).add d2).add d3).add d4
    have ha1zero : a1 = 0 := hloc0.hasDerivAt_eq_zero hderiv
    refine ⟨ha1zero, ?_⟩
    have hev2 : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝[≠] (0 : ℝ), 0 ≤ a2 + a3 * t + a4 * t ^ 2 := by
      have h : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝[≠] (0 : ℝ),
          0 ≤ a1 * t + a2 * t ^ 2 + a3 * t ^ 3 + a4 * t ^ 4 :=
        hev.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
      filter_upwards [h, self_mem_nhdsWithin] with t ht htne
      have htne' : t ≠ 0 := htne
      have hpos : 0 < t ^ 2 := by positivity
      rw [ha1zero] at ht
      nlinarith [ht, hpos]
    have hc2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => a2 + a3 * t + a4 * t ^ 2)
        (𝓝[≠] (0 : ℝ)) (nhds a2) := by
      have hcont : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => a2 + a3 * t + a4 * t ^ 2) := by continuity
      have h5 : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => a2 + a3 * t + a4 * t ^ 2)
          (𝓝[≠] (0 : ℝ)) (nhds (a2 + a3 * 0 + a4 * 0 ^ 2)) :=
        (hcont.tendsto 0).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
      simpa using h5
    exact ge_of_tendsto hc2 hev2
  have hxx : qbb M x x = (nnn x) ^ 2 := by
    have h := (key x).1
    rw [ipp_self] at h
    nlinarith [h]
  have hbound : ∀ v : Fin d → ℝ, qbb M v v ≤ nnn x * nnn v := by
    intro v
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (nnn_nonneg x) with h0 | hpos
    · have hs : ∑ i : Fin d, x i ^ 2 = 0 := by
        have : nnn x = 0 := h0.symm
        unfold nnn at this
        exact this
      have hx0 : ∀ i, x i = 0 := by
        intro i
        have h2 := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
          (fun i _ => sq_nonneg (x i))).mp hs i (Finset.mem_univ i)
        exact pow_eq_zero_iff (n := 2) (by norm_num) |>.mp h2
      have hipz : ipp x v = 0 := by
        unfold ipp
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
        rw [hx0 i]; ring
      have h2 := (key v).2
      rw [hipz, ← h0] at h2
      rw [← h0]
      linarith
    · have hnx : nnn x ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hpos
      obtain ⟨c, hcx⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c * nnn x = ipp x v :=
        ⟨ipp x v / nnn x, by field_simp⟩
      have hfo : qbb M x v + qbb M v x = 2 * ipp x v * nnn x := by
        have := (key v).1; linarith
      have hqw : qbb M (v + (-c) • x) (v + (-c) • x)
          = qbb M v v - c ^ 2 * (nnn x) ^ 2 := by
        rw [qbb_expand, hxx]
        linear_combination (-c) * hfo + (2 * c * nnn x) * hcx
      have hnw : nnn (v + (-c) • x) = nnn v - c ^ 2 * nnn x := by
        rw [nnn_expand, ipp_comm v x]
        linear_combination (2 * c) * hcx
      have hipw : ipp x (v + (-c) • x) = 0 := by
        rw [ipp_expand, ipp_self]
        linear_combination -hcx
      set w : Fin d → ℝ := v + (-c) • x with hw
      have h2 := (key w).2
      rw [hqw, hnw, hipw] at h2
      nlinarith [h2]
  intro y
  have h1 : qbb M y y ≤ nnn x * nnn y := hbound y
  rw [pca_expand M x, pca_expand M y, hxx]
  nlinarith [h1, sq_nonneg (nnn x - nnn y)]

end GraduateLevel

targets.label: ch4_theorem_4_18
targets.statement:
Suppose for all \(f \in \mathcal{F}\), \(0 \leq f(z) \leq 1\). Then, with probability at least \(1-\delta\),
\[
\sup_{f\in \mathcal{F}} \left[ \frac{1}{n} \sum^n_{i=1} f(z_i) - \mathbb{E}[f(z)] \right] \leq 2 R_S(\mathcal{F}) + 3\sqrt{\frac{\log{(2/\delta)}}{2n}}.
\]

nl_proof:
Define
\[
g(z_1, \dots, z_n) \triangleq \sup_{f\in F} \left[ \frac{1}{n} \sum^{n}_{i=1} f(z_i) - \mathbb{E}[f(z)]\right].
\]

We prove the theorem in 4 steps.

Step 1: We bound \(g\) using McDiarmid's Inequality. To use McDiarmid's Inequality, we check that the bounded difference condition holds:
\[
g(z_1,\dots,z_n)-g(z_1,\dots,z_i',\dots,z_n)
\leq\sup_{f\in\mathcal{F}}\left[\frac{1}{n}\sum^{n}_{j=1}f(z_j)\right]-\sup_{f\in\mathcal{F}}\left[\left(\frac{1}{n}\sum^{n}_{j=1,j\neq i}f(z_j)\right)+\frac{f(z_i')}{n}\right]
\leq\sup_{f\in\mathcal{F}}\left[\frac{1}{n}\sum^{n}_{j=1}f(z_j)-\left(\frac{1}{n}\sum^{n}_{j=1,j\neq i}f(z_j)\right)-\frac{f(z_i')}{n}\right]
=\sup_{f\in\mathcal{F}}\left[\frac{1}{n}\left(f(z_i)-f(z_i')\right)\right]
\leq\frac{1}{n}.
\]
The first inequality holds because in general \(\sup_f A(f) - \sup_f B(f) \leq \sup_f [A(f) - B(f)]\), and the last inequality holds since \(f\) is bounded by \([0,1]\). We can thus apply McDiarmid's Inequality with parameters \(c_1 = \dots = c_n = 1/n\):
\[
\mathbb{P}\left[g(z_1,\dots,z_n)\geq\mathbb{E}_{z_1,\dots,z_n\overset{\text{iid}}{\sim}P}[g]+\epsilon\right]\leq\exp\!\left(\frac{-2\epsilon^2}{\sum^n_{i=1}c_i^2}\right)=\exp(-2n\epsilon^2).
\]

Step 2: We apply the referenced theorem to get
\[
\mathbb{E}_{z_1,\dots, z_n \overset{\text{iid}}{\sim} P}[g] \leq 2R_n(\mathcal{F}).
\]

Step 3: Define
\[
\tilde{g}(z_1, \dots, z_n) = R_S(\mathcal{F}) \triangleq \mathbb{E}_{\sigma_i}\left[\sup_{f\in \mathcal{F}} \frac{1}{n} \sum^n_{i=1} \sigma_i f(z_i)\right].
\]

Using a similar argument to that of Step 1, \(\tilde{g}\) satisfies the bounded difference condition:
\[
\tilde{g}(z_1, \dots, z_n) - \tilde{g}(z_1, \dots, z_i', \dots, z_n)
\leq \mathbb{E}_{\sigma_i} \left[\sup_{f\in F} \left[ \frac{1}{n} \sum^{n}_{j=1} \sigma_j f(z_j) \right] - \sup_{f\in F} \left[ \left(\frac{1}{n} \sum^{n}_{j=1, j \neq i} \sigma_j f(z_j)\right) + \frac{1}{n} \sigma_if(z_i')\right]\right]
\leq \mathbb{E}_{\sigma_i}\left[\sup_{f\in F} \left(\frac{1}{n} \sigma_i(f(z_i) - f(z_i'))\right)\right]
\leq \frac{1}{n},
\]
since the term inside the \(\sup\) is always upper bounded by 1. We can thus apply McDiarmid's Inequality with parameters \(c_1 = \dots = c_n = 1/n\):
\[
\mathbb{P}\left[ \tilde{g} - \mathbb{E}[\tilde{g}] \geq \epsilon \right] \leq \exp(-2n \epsilon^2), \quad\text{and}\quad \mathbb{P}\left[ \tilde{g} - \mathbb{E}[\tilde{g}] \leq -\epsilon \right] \leq \exp(-2n \epsilon^2).
\]

Step 4: We set \(\delta\) such that \(\exp(-2n \epsilon^2) = \delta/2\), implying \(\epsilon = \sqrt{\frac{\log(2/\delta)}{2n}}\). Then, with probability \(\geq 1 - \delta\),
\[
\sup_{f\in \mathcal{F}} \left[ \frac{1}{n} \sum^n_{i=1} f(z_i) - \mathbb{E}[f]\right] = g \leq \mathbb{E}[g] + \epsilon \leq 2R_n(\mathcal{F}) + \epsilon \leq 2(R_S(\mathcal{F}) + \epsilon) + \epsilon = 2R_S(\mathcal{F}) + 3\epsilon,
\]
as required.

context.name: Empirical Rademacher complexity
context.statement:
Given a dataset \(S = \{z_1, \dots, z_n\}\), the empirical Rademacher complexity is defined as
\[
R_S(\mathcal{F}) \stackrel{\Delta}{=} \mathbb{E}_{\sigma_1,\dots, \sigma_n} \left[ \sup_{f\in \mathcal{F}} \frac{1}{n} \sum^n_{i=1} \sigma_i f(z_i) \right].
\]
\(R_S(\mathcal{F})\) is a function of both the function class \(\mathcal{F}\) and the dataset \(S\).
As the name suggests, the expectation of the empirical Rademacher complexity is the Rademacher complexity:
\[
R_n(\mathcal{F}) = \mathbb{E}_{\substack{z_1, \dots, z_n \overset{\text{iid}}{\sim} P \\ S = \{z_1, \dots, z_n\}}}\left[ R_S(\mathcal{F}) \right].
\]

context.name: Symmetrization bound by Rademacher complexity
context.statement:
\[
\mathbb{E}_{z_1, \dots, z_n \overset{\text{iid}}{\sim} P} \left[ \sup_{f\in F} \left[ \frac{1}{n} \sum^n_{i=1} f(z_i) - \mathbb{E}_{z\sim P} [f(z)] \right]\right] \leq 2 R_n(\mathcal{F}).
\]

context.name: McDiarmid's inequality
context.statement:
Suppose \(f : \mathbb{R}^n \to \mathbb{R}\) satisfies the bounded difference condition: there exist constants \(c_1, \ldots, c_n \in \mathbb{R}\) such that for all real numbers \(x_1, \ldots, x_n\) and \(x_i'\),
\[
|f(x_1, \ldots, x_n) - f(x_1, \ldots, x_{i-1}, x_i', x_{i+1}, \ldots, x_n)| \leq c_i.
\]
Then, for any independent random variables \(X_1, \ldots, X_n\),
\[
\mathbb{P}\left[f(X_1, \ldots, X_n) - \mathbb{E}[f(X_1, \ldots, X_n)] \geq t\right] \leq \exp\left(-\frac{2t^2}{\sum_{i=1}^n c_i^2}\right).
\]
Moreover, \(f(X_1, \ldots, X_n)\) is \(O\!\left(\sqrt{\sum_{i=1}^n c_i^2}\right)\)-sub-Gaussian.

import Mathlib

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Real
open scoped NNReal

namespace GraduateLevel

def RadSigns (n : ℕ) : Type := Fin n → ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ)

instance {n} : Fintype (RadSigns n) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Fintype (Fin n → { x // x ∈ {-1, 1} }))

noncomputable def empRadSigned {ι : Type*} {𝒳 : Type*}
    (n : ℕ) (f : ι → 𝒳 → ℝ) (S : Fin n → 𝒳) : ℝ :=
  (Fintype.card (RadSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
    ∑ σ : RadSigns n, ⨆ i, (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * f i (S k)


private lemma abs_iSup_sub_iSup_le
    {I : Type*} [Nonempty I] (a b : I → ℝ) (M c : ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ i, |a i| ≤ M) (hb : ∀ i, |b i| ≤ M)
    (hab : ∀ i, |a i - b i| ≤ c) :
    |(⨆ i, a i) - (⨆ i, b i)| ≤ c := by
  have haB : BddAbove (Set.range a) := by
    refine ⟨M, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans (ha i)
  have hbB : BddAbove (Set.range b) := by
    refine ⟨M, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans (hb i)
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · have hle : (⨆ i, b i) ≤ (⨆ i, a i) + c := by
      apply ciSup_le
      intro i
      calc
        b i ≤ a i + c := by
          have := (abs_le.mp (hab i)).1
          linarith
        _ ≤ (⨆ i, a i) + c := by gcongr; exact le_ciSup haB i
    exact (neg_le_sub_iff_le_add).2 hle
  · have hle : (⨆ i, a i) ≤ (⨆ i, b i) + c := by
      apply ciSup_le
      intro i
      calc
        a i ≤ b i + c := by
          have := (abs_le.mp (hab i)).2
          linarith
        _ ≤ (⨆ i, b i) + c := by gcongr; exact le_ciSup hbB i
    exact (sub_le_iff_le_add).2 (by simpa [add_comm] using hle)

private lemma abs_iSup_le
    {I : Type*} [Nonempty I] (a : I → ℝ) (M : ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ i, |a i| ≤ M) : |⨆ i, a i| ≤ M := by
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := (abs_nonneg (a (Classical.choice inferInstance))).trans (ha _)
  have hB : BddAbove (Set.range a) := by
    refine ⟨M, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans (ha i)
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · have h := le_ciSup hB (Classical.choice inferInstance)
    have := (neg_le_of_abs_le (ha (Classical.choice inferInstance)))
    linarith
  · exact ciSup_le (fun i ↦ (le_abs_self _).trans (ha i))

private lemma hasSubgaussianMGF_prod_step
    {A B : Type*} [MeasurableSpace A] [MeasurableSpace B] [Nonempty A]
    (mu : Measure A) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (nu : Measure B) [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (F : A × B → ℝ) (hF : Measurable F)
    (M : ℝ) (hM : ∀ z, |F z| ≤ M)
    (c C : ℝ≥0)
    (hosc : ∀ y x x', |F (x, y) - F (x', y)| ≤ (c : ℝ))
    (havg : HasSubgaussianMGF
      (fun y ↦ (∫ x, F (x, y) ∂mu) - ∫ y, ∫ x, F (x, y) ∂mu ∂nu) C nu) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF
      (fun z ↦ F z - ∫ z, F z ∂(mu.prod nu)) (C + c ^ 2 / 4) (mu.prod nu) := by
  have hFint : Integrable F (mu.prod nu) :=
    Integrable.of_bound hF.aestronglyMeasurable M (ae_of_all _ (fun z ↦ by simpa using hM z))
  let Aavg : B → ℝ := fun y ↦ ∫ x, F (x, y) ∂mu
  have hAmeas : Measurable Aavg := by
    exact (StronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_left' (μ := mu) hF.stronglyMeasurable).measurable
  have hAint : Integrable Aavg nu := hFint.integral_prod_right
  have hmean : (∫ z, F z ∂(mu.prod nu)) = ∫ y, Aavg y ∂nu := by
    exact integral_prod_symm F hFint
  have hD (y : B) : HasSubgaussianMGF
      (fun x ↦ F (x, y) - Aavg y) (c ^ 2 / 4) mu := by
    let S : Set ℝ := Set.range (fun x ↦ F (x, y))
    have hSne : S.Nonempty := Set.range_nonempty _
    have hSbdAbove : BddAbove S := by
      refine ⟨M, ?_⟩
      rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
      exact (le_abs_self _).trans (hM _)
    have hSbdBelow : BddBelow S := by
      refine ⟨-M, ?_⟩
      rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
      exact (neg_le_of_abs_le (hM _))
    let a : ℝ := sInf S

private lemma hasSubgaussianMGF_pi_boundedDifferences
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega] [Nonempty Omega]
    (mu : Measure Omega) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]

    (M : ℝ) (hM : ∀ x, |F x| ≤ M)

    (hosc : ∀ x x' (i : Fin m), (∀ j, j ≠ i → x j = x' j) →
      |F x - F x'| ≤ (c : ℝ)) :

      (fun x ↦ F x - ∫ x, F x ∂(Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin m ↦ mu)))
      ((m : ℝ≥0) * c ^ 2 / 4) (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin m ↦ mu)) := by

      let x0 : Fin 0 → Omega := fun i ↦ Fin.elim0 i

        funext x
        congr 1
        funext i
        exact Fin.elim0 i
