        rw [hconst]
        simp
      have hz : (fun x ↦ F x - ∫ x, F x ∂(Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin 0 ↦ mu))) =
          fun _ ↦ 0 := by
        funext x
        rw [hmean0, congrFun hconst x]
        simp
      simpa [hz] using
        (HasSubgaussianMGF.fun_zero (mu := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin 0 ↦ mu)))
  | succ m ih =>
      let Pm : Measure (Fin m → Omega) := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin m ↦ mu)
      let e : (Fin (m + 1) → Omega) ≃ᵐ (Omega × (Fin m → Omega)) :=
        MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) ↦ Omega) 0
      let G : Omega × (Fin m → Omega) → ℝ := fun z ↦ F (e.symm z)
      have hG : Measurable G := hF.comp e.symm.measurable
      have hGM : ∀ z, |G z| ≤ M := fun z ↦ hM _
      let Aavg : (Fin m → Omega) → ℝ := fun y ↦ ∫ x, G (x, y) ∂mu
      have hGint : Integrable G (mu.prod Pm) :=
        Integrable.of_bound hG.aestronglyMeasurable M (ae_of_all _ (fun z ↦ by simpa using hGM z))
      have hAmeas : Measurable Aavg := by
        exact (StronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_left' (μ := mu) hG.stronglyMeasurable).measurable
      have hAM : ∀ y, |Aavg y| ≤ M := by
        intro y
        calc
          |Aavg y| ≤ ∫ x, |G (x, y)| ∂mu := abs_integral_le_integral_abs
          _ ≤ ∫ _x, M ∂mu := by
            apply integral_mono_ae
            · exact Integrable.of_bound
                (hG.comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)).abs.aestronglyMeasurable M
                (ae_of_all _ (fun x ↦ by simpa using hGM (x, y)))
            · exact integrable_const _
            · exact ae_of_all _ (fun x ↦ hGM (x, y))
          _ = M := by simp
      have hAosc : ∀ y y' (i : Fin m), (∀ j, j ≠ i → y j = y' j) →
          |Aavg y - Aavg y'| ≤ (c : ℝ) := by
        intro y y' i hy
        have hsec (y : Fin m → Omega) : Integrable (fun x ↦ G (x, y)) mu :=
          Integrable.of_bound (hG.comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)).aestronglyMeasurable
            M (ae_of_all _ (fun x ↦ by simpa using hGM (x, y)))
        rw [show Aavg y - Aavg y' = ∫ x, (G (x, y) - G (x, y')) ∂mu by
          rw [integral_sub (hsec y) (hsec y')]]
        calc
          |∫ x, (G (x, y) - G (x, y')) ∂mu| ≤
              ∫ x, |G (x, y) - G (x, y')| ∂mu := abs_integral_le_integral_abs
          _ ≤ ∫ _x, (c : ℝ) ∂mu := by
            apply integral_mono_ae
            · exact (hsec y).sub (hsec y') |>.abs
            · exact integrable_const _
            · filter_upwards [] with x
              apply hosc (e.symm (x, y)) (e.symm (x, y')) (Fin.succ i)
              intro j hj
              revert hj
              refine Fin.cases (fun _ ↦ ?_) (fun k hk ↦ ?_) j
              · simp [G, e, MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_symm_apply]
              · simp only [G, e, MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_symm_apply,
                  Fin.insertNthEquiv_apply, Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove]
                exact hy k (by
                  intro hki
                  subst k
                  exact hk rfl)
          _ = (c : ℝ) := by simp
      have hA := ih Aavg hAmeas hAM hAosc
      have hfirst : ∀ y x x', |G (x, y) - G (x', y)| ≤ (c : ℝ) := by
        intro y x x'
        apply hosc (e.symm (x, y)) (e.symm (x', y)) 0
        intro j hj
        revert hj
        refine Fin.cases (fun hj ↦ False.elim (hj rfl)) (fun k _ ↦ ?_) j
        simp [e, MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_symm_apply]
      have hpair := hasSubgaussianMGF_prod_step mu Pm G hG M hGM c
        (((m : ℝ≥0) * c ^ 2 / 4)) hfirst (by simpa [Aavg, Pm] using hA)
      have he_mp := measurePreserving_piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) ↦ mu) 0
      have hmap : (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) ↦ mu)).map e = mu.prod Pm := by
        simpa [e, Pm] using he_mp.map_eq
      have htrans := HasSubgaussianMGF.of_map e.measurable.aemeasurable (by
        rw [hmap]
        exact hpair)
      have hGe (x : Fin (m + 1) → Omega) : G (e x) = F x := by
        change F (e.symm (e x)) = F x
        rw [e.symm_apply_apply]
      have hmean : (∫ z, G z ∂(mu.prod Pm)) =
          ∫ x, F x ∂(Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) ↦ mu)) := by
        symm
        calc
          (∫ x, F x ∂(Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) ↦ mu))) =
              ∫ x, G (e x) ∂(Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) ↦ mu)) := by
                apply integral_congr_ae
                exact ae_of_all _ (fun x ↦ (hGe x).symm)
          _ = ∫ z, G z ∂(mu.prod Pm) := by
                simpa [e, Pm] using he_mp.integral_comp' G
      have hfun : (fun z ↦ G z - ∫ z, G z ∂(mu.prod Pm)) ∘ e =
          (fun x ↦ F x - ∫ x, F x ∂(Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) ↦ mu))) := by
        funext x
        change G (e x) - ∫ z, G z ∂(mu.prod Pm) =
          F x - ∫ x, F x ∂(Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) ↦ mu))
        rw [hGe x, hmean]
      rw [hfun] at htrans
      convert htrans using 1 <;> push_cast <;> ring

targets.label: ch4_theorem_4_16
targets.statement:
Let \(\mathcal{F}\) be a family of functions \(Z \mapsto [-1,1]\). Then
\[
R_S(\mathcal{F})\le\inf_{\epsilon>0}\left(\epsilon+\sqrt{\frac{2\log N(\epsilon,\mathcal{F},L_2(P_n))}{n}}\right).
\]

nl_proof:
Fix any \(\epsilon > 0\). Let \(\mathcal{C}\) be the minimal \(\epsilon\)-cover of \(\mathcal{Q}\) with respect to the metric \(\rho(v,v') = \frac{1}{\sqrt{n}} \|v-v'\|_2\). Note that \(|\mathcal{C}| = N(\epsilon, \mathcal{Q}, \frac{1}{\sqrt{n}} \|\cdot\|_2) = N(\epsilon, \mathcal{F}, L_2(P_n))\).

We aim to bound \(R_S(\mathcal{F}) = \mathbb{E}_\sigma[\sup_{v \in \mathcal{Q}} \frac{1}{n} \langle v, \sigma \rangle]\) by approximating \(v\) with \(v' \in \mathcal{C}\). In particular, for every point \(v \in \mathcal{Q}\), choose \(v' \in \mathcal{C}\) such that \(\rho(v, v') \leq \epsilon\) and \(z\) is small (specifically, \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{n}} \|z\|_2 \le \epsilon\)). This gives
\[
\frac{1}{n} \langle v, \sigma \rangle = \frac{1}{n} \langle v', \sigma \rangle + \frac{1}{n} \langle v - v', \sigma \rangle \le \frac{1}{n} \langle v', \sigma \rangle + \frac{1}{n} \|z\|_2 \|\sigma\|_2 \le \frac{1}{n} \langle v', \sigma \rangle + \epsilon,
\]
where \(z \stackrel{\Delta}{=} v - v'\), using Cauchy-Schwarz and the fact that \(\|z\|_2 \le \sqrt{n}\epsilon\) and \(\|\sigma\|_2 \le \sqrt{n}\).

Taking the expectation of the supremum on both sides gives
\[
R_S(\mathcal{F}) = \mathbb{E}_\sigma \left[\sup_{v\in \mathcal{Q}} \frac{1}{n} \langle v,\sigma \rangle \right] \le \mathbb{E}_\sigma \left[\sup_{v'\in \mathcal{C}} \left(\frac{1}{n} \langle v',\sigma \rangle + \epsilon\right)\right] = \epsilon + \mathbb{E}_\sigma \left[\sup_{v'\in \mathcal{C}} \frac{1}{n} \langle v',\sigma \rangle\right] \le \epsilon + \sqrt{ \frac{2\log |\mathcal{C}|}{n} },
\]
by Massart's lemma (the referenced result). Since the argument holds for any \(\epsilon > 0\), taking the infimum over all \(\epsilon\) yields \(R_S(\mathcal{F})\le\inf_{\epsilon>0}\left(\epsilon+\sqrt{\frac{2\log N(\epsilon,\mathcal{F},L_2(P_n))}{n}}\right)\).

context.name: Empirical Rademacher complexity
context.statement:
Given a dataset \(S = \{z_1, \dots, z_n\}\), the empirical Rademacher complexity is defined as
\[
R_S(\mathcal{F}) \stackrel{\Delta}{=} \mathbb{E}_{\sigma_1,\dots, \sigma_n} \left[ \sup_{f\in \mathcal{F}} \frac{1}{n} \sum^n_{i=1} \sigma_i f(z_i) \right].
\]
\(R_S(\mathcal{F})\) is a function of both the function class \(\mathcal{F}\) and the dataset \(S\).

context.name: definition 4.14
context.statement: \(\mathcal{C}\) is an \(\epsilon\)-cover of \(\mathcal{Q}\) with respect to metric \(\rho\) if for all \(v' \in \mathcal{Q}\), there exists \(v \in \mathcal{C}\) such that \(\rho(v,v')\le \epsilon\).

context.name: definition 4.15
context.statement:
The covering number is defined as the minimum size of an \(\epsilon\)-cover, or explicitly:
\[
N(\epsilon, \mathcal{Q}, \rho) \stackrel{\Delta}{=} (\text{min size of } \epsilon\text{-cover of } \mathcal{Q} \text{ w.r.t. metric } \rho).
\]

context.name: proposition 4.12
context.statement:
Let \(\mathcal{F}\) be a collection of functions mapping \(Z \mapsto \mathbb{R}\) and let \(\mathcal{Q}\) be defined as in the referenced equation. Assume that \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{n}} \|v\|_2 \le M < \infty\) for all \(v \in \mathcal{Q}\). Then,
\[
R_S(\mathcal{F}) \leq \sqrt{\frac{2 M^2 \log |\mathcal{Q}|}{n}}.
\]

context.name: Output space \(\mathcal{Q}\) and the \(L_2(P_n)\) metric
context.statement:
Given a dataset \(S = \{z_1, \dots, z_n\}\), define the output space
\[
\mathcal{Q} \triangleq \left\{ \left(f(z_1), \dots, f(z_n)\right)^\top : f \in \mathcal{F} \right\} \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n.
\]
Correspondingly, the empirical Rademacher complexity can be rewritten as a maximization over the output space \(\mathcal{Q}\) instead of the function space \(\mathcal{F}\):
\[
R_S(\mathcal{F}) = \mathbb{E}_{\sigma}\left[ \sup_{v \in \mathcal{Q}} \frac{1}{n} \langle \sigma, v \rangle \right].
\]
We use the metric \(\rho(v, v') = \frac{1}{\sqrt{n}} \|v - v'\|_2\). In the literature, an \(\epsilon\)-cover of \(\mathcal{Q}\) with respect to \(\rho\) is also referred to as an \(\epsilon\)-cover of the function class \(\mathcal{F}\) under the \(L_2(P_n)\) metric, where \(P_n\) denotes the empirical distribution, i.e. the uniform distribution over the observations \(z_1, \dots, z_n\). In particular,
\[
L_2(P_n)(f, f') = \sqrt{\frac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}^n (f(z_i) - f'(z_i))^2}.
\]
We can write a trivial correspondence between both the output and function class points of view as follows:
\[
N(\epsilon, \mathcal{F}, L_2(P_n)) = N\left(\epsilon, \mathcal{Q}, \frac{1}{\sqrt{n}} \|\cdot\|_2\right).
\]

  simp only [← h_a', ← h_b', ← h_c']
  rw [h_norm a' c', h_norm a' b', h_norm b' c']
  have h_eq : a' - c' = (a' - b') + (b' - c') := (sub_add_sub_cancel a' b' c').symm
  rw [h_eq]
  exact norm_add_le (a' - b') (b' - c')

lemma edist_dist (n : ℕ) (a b : EmpiricalSpace n) :
    edist a b = ENNReal.ofReal (dist a b) := rfl

noncomputable instance instPseudoMetricSpace (n : ℕ) : PseudoMetricSpace (EmpiricalSpace n) where
  dist_self := dist_self n
  dist_comm := dist_comm n
  dist_triangle := dist_triangle n
  edist_dist := edist_dist n

end EmpiricalSpace

def empiricalMetricImage {X : Type*} (n : ℕ) (x : Fin n → X) (g : X → ℝ) : EmpiricalSpace n :=
  fun i => g (x i)

def IsENet {A : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace A] (t : Finset A) (eps : ℝ) (s : Set A) : Prop :=
  s ⊆ ⋃ x ∈ t, Metric.closedBall x eps

noncomputable def coveringNumber {A : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace A] (eps : ℝ) (s : Set A) : WithTop Nat :=
  sInf {n : WithTop Nat | ∃ t : Finset A, IsENet t eps s ∧ (t.card : WithTop Nat) = n}

def RadSigns (n : ℕ) : Type := Fin n → ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ)

instance {n} : Fintype (RadSigns n) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Fintype (Fin n → { x // x ∈ {-1, 1} }))

noncomputable def empRadSigned {ι : Type*} {𝒳 : Type*}
    (n : ℕ) (f : ι → 𝒳 → ℝ) (S : Fin n → 𝒳) : ℝ :=
  (Fintype.card (RadSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
    ∑ σ : RadSigns n, ⨆ i, (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * f i (S k)


lemma trunc_sq_le (a b : ℝ) (ha : -1 ≤ a) (ha' : a ≤ 1) :
    (a - max (-1) (min 1 b))^2 ≤ (a - b)^2 := by
  rcases le_total b (-1) with h | h
  · have hb : max (-1:ℝ) (min 1 b) = -1 := by
      rw [min_eq_right (by linarith : b ≤ 1)]; exact max_eq_left h
    rw [hb]; nlinarith
  · rcases le_total 1 b with h2 | h2
    · have hb : max (-1:ℝ) (min 1 b) = 1 := by
        rw [min_eq_left h2]; norm_num
      rw [hb]; nlinarith
    · have hb : max (-1:ℝ) (min 1 b) = b := by
        rw [min_eq_right h2]; exact max_eq_right h
      rw [hb]

lemma radsigns_card (n : ℕ) : Fintype.card (RadSigns n) = 2^n := by
  show Fintype.card (Fin n → ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ)) = 2^n
  simp

lemma sum_prod_rad (n : ℕ) (F : Fin n → ℤ → ℝ) :
    ∑ σ : RadSigns n, ∏ k, F k (σ k) = ∏ k : Fin n, ∑ b ∈ ({-1,1} : Finset ℤ), F k b := by
  rw [Finset.prod_univ_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_nbij' (i := fun (σ : RadSigns n) => (fun k => ((σ k : ℤ)) : Fin n → ℤ))
    (j := fun (x : Fin n → ℤ) => (fun k => if h : x k ∈ ({-1,1} : Finset ℤ) then (⟨x k, h⟩ : ({-1,1} : Finset ℤ)) else ⟨1, by simp⟩ : RadSigns n))
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro a _; simp [Fintype.mem_piFinset]
  · intro b _; simp
  · intro a _; funext k; simp
  · intro b hb; funext k; rw [Fintype.mem_piFinset] at hb; simp [hb k]
  · intro a _; rfl

lemma mgf_bound (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (lam : ℝ) (v : Fin n → ℝ) (hv : ∀ k, v k ^ 2 ≤ 1) :
    ∑ σ : RadSigns n, Real.exp (lam * ((n:ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k, (σ k : ℝ) * v k))
      ≤ (2^n : ℝ) * Real.exp (lam^2/(2*n)) := by
  have hnR : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have key : ∀ σ : RadSigns n, Real.exp (lam * ((n:ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k, (σ k : ℝ) * v k))
      = ∏ k, Real.exp (((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * (lam * (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * v k)) := by
    intro σ
    rw [← Real.exp_sum]
    congr 1
    simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => by ring)
  simp_rw [key]
  rw [sum_prod_rad n (fun k b => Real.exp ((b : ℝ) * (lam * (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * v k)))]
  have step1 : ∀ k : Fin n, ∑ b ∈ ({-1,1} : Finset ℤ), Real.exp ((b : ℝ) * (lam * (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * v k))
      = 2 * Real.cosh (lam * (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * v k) := by
    intro k
    rw [show ({-1,1} : Finset ℤ) = {(-1 : ℤ), (1:ℤ)} from rfl,
      Finset.sum_pair (by norm_num : (-1:ℤ) ≠ 1)]
    rw [Real.cosh_eq]
    push_cast
    ring_nf
  simp_rw [step1]
  have step2 : ∏ k : Fin n, (2 * Real.cosh (lam * (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * v k))
      ≤ ∏ k : Fin n, (2 * Real.exp ((lam * (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * v k)^2/2)) := by
    apply Finset.prod_le_prod
    · intro k _; positivity
    · intro k _
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.cosh_le_exp_half_sq _) (by norm_num)
  refine step2.trans ?_
  rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib, ← Real.exp_sum]
  simp only [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  have : ∀ k : Fin n, (lam * (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * v k)^2/2 ≤ lam^2 * ((n:ℝ)⁻¹)^2/2 := by
    intro k
    have h1 : (lam * (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * v k)^2 = lam^2 * ((n:ℝ)⁻¹)^2 * (v k)^2 := by ring
    rw [h1]
    have := hv k
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (lam * (n:ℝ)⁻¹), sq_nonneg (v k)]
  refine (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k _ => this k)).trans ?_
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hne : (n:ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hnR
  refine le_of_eq ?_
  field_simp


lemma massart (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) {α : Type*} (t : Finset α) (ht : t.Nonempty)
    (w : α → Fin n → ℝ) (hw : ∀ a ∈ t, ∀ k, (w a k)^2 ≤ 1) :
    (Fintype.card (RadSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ∑ σ : RadSigns n, t.sup' ht (fun a => (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k, ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * w a k)
      ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * Real.log (t.card : ℝ) / n) := by
  have hnR : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  set C : ℝ := (Fintype.card (RadSigns n) : ℝ) with hC
  have hCval : C = 2^n := by rw [hC, radsigns_card]; push_cast; ring
  have hCpos : 0 < C := by rw [hCval]; positivity
  set M : RadSigns n → ℝ := fun σ => t.sup' ht (fun a => (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k, ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * w a k) with hM
  set A : ℝ := C⁻¹ * ∑ σ : RadSigns n, M σ with hA
  set L : ℝ := Real.log (t.card : ℝ) with hL
  have htc : 1 ≤ (t.card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr ht
  have hLnn : 0 ≤ L := Real.log_nonneg htc
  -- main inequality
  have main : ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → lam * A ≤ L + lam^2/(2*n) := by
    intro lam hlam
    have jensen : Real.exp (C⁻¹ * ∑ σ : RadSigns n, (lam * M σ))
        ≤ C⁻¹ * ∑ σ : RadSigns n, Real.exp (lam * M σ) := by
      have h := ConvexOn.map_sum_le (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := Real.exp) convexOn_exp
        (t := (Finset.univ : Finset (RadSigns n))) (w := fun _ => C⁻¹)
        (p := fun σ => lam * M σ) (fun i _ => le_of_lt (inv_pos.mpr hCpos))
        (by rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, ← hC]
            exact mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hCpos)) (fun i _ => trivial)
      simpa [smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum] using h
    have hpt : ∀ σ : RadSigns n, Real.exp (lam * M σ)
        ≤ ∑ a ∈ t, Real.exp (lam * ((n:ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k, ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * w a k)) := by
      intro σ
      obtain ⟨a0, ha0, heq⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup' ht
        (fun a => (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k, ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * w a k)
      rw [hM]
      simp only
      rw [heq]
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun a => Real.exp (lam * ((n:ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k, ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * w a k)))
        (fun i _ => le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _)) ha0
    have hsum : C⁻¹ * ∑ σ : RadSigns n, Real.exp (lam * M σ) ≤ (t.card : ℝ) * Real.exp (lam^2/(2*n)) := by
      have h1 : ∑ σ : RadSigns n, Real.exp (lam * M σ)
          ≤ ∑ σ : RadSigns n, ∑ a ∈ t, Real.exp (lam * ((n:ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k, ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * w a k)) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun σ _ => hpt σ)
      have h2 : ∑ σ : RadSigns n, ∑ a ∈ t, Real.exp (lam * ((n:ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k, ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * w a k))
          = ∑ a ∈ t, ∑ σ : RadSigns n, Real.exp (lam * ((n:ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k, ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * w a k)) :=
        Finset.sum_comm
      have h3 : ∀ a ∈ t, ∑ σ : RadSigns n, Real.exp (lam * ((n:ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k, ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * w a k))
          ≤ (2^n : ℝ) * Real.exp (lam^2/(2*n)) := fun a ha => mgf_bound n hn lam (w a) (hw a ha)
      have h4 : ∑ a ∈ t, ∑ σ : RadSigns n, Real.exp (lam * ((n:ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k, ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * w a k))
          ≤ (t.card : ℝ) * ((2^n : ℝ) * Real.exp (lam^2/(2*n))) := by
        calc _ ≤ ∑ _a ∈ t, ((2^n : ℝ) * Real.exp (lam^2/(2*n))) := Finset.sum_le_sum h3
          _ = (t.card : ℝ) * ((2^n : ℝ) * Real.exp (lam^2/(2*n))) := by
              rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      have : ∑ σ : RadSigns n, Real.exp (lam * M σ) ≤ (t.card : ℝ) * ((2^n : ℝ) * Real.exp (lam^2/(2*n))) := by
        rw [h2] at h1; exact h1.trans h4
      calc C⁻¹ * ∑ σ : RadSigns n, Real.exp (lam * M σ)
          ≤ C⁻¹ * ((t.card : ℝ) * ((2^n : ℝ) * Real.exp (lam^2/(2*n)))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this (le_of_lt (inv_pos.mpr hCpos))
        _ = (t.card : ℝ) * Real.exp (lam^2/(2*n)) := by
            rw [hCval]; field_simp
    have hexp : Real.exp (lam * A) ≤ Real.exp (L + lam^2/(2*n)) := by
      have e1 : lam * A = C⁻¹ * ∑ σ : RadSigns n, (lam * M σ) := by
        rw [hA, ← Finset.mul_sum]; ring
      rw [e1]
      refine jensen.trans (hsum.trans ?_)
      rw [Real.exp_add]
      have : Real.exp L = (t.card : ℝ) := Real.exp_log (by linarith)
      rw [this]
    have := Real.exp_le_exp.mp hexp
    exact this
  -- conclude
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hLnn with hL0 | hLpos
  · have hA0 : A ≤ 0 := by
      refine le_of_forall_pos_le_add ?_
      intro e he
      have := main (2*n*e) (by positivity)
      rw [← hL0] at this
      have hd : (2*(n:ℝ)*e)^2/(2*n) = (2*(n:ℝ)*e)*e := by field_simp
      rw [hd] at this
      have hpos : (0:ℝ) < 2*(n:ℝ)*e := by positivity
      have h6 : (2*(n:ℝ)*e) * A ≤ (2*(n:ℝ)*e) * e := by linarith
      have := le_of_mul_le_mul_left h6 hpos
      linarith
    have : Real.sqrt (2 * L / n) = 0 := by rw [← hL0]; simp
    rw [← hL] at *
    calc A ≤ 0 := hA0
      _ = Real.sqrt (2 * L / n) := this.symm
  · set u : ℝ := Real.sqrt (2 * L / n) with hu
    have hupos : 0 < u := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)
    have hu2 : u^2 = 2 * L / n := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
    have hnu : (n:ℝ) * u^2 = 2 * L := by rw [hu2]; field_simp
    have hmain := main ((n:ℝ) * u) (by positivity)
    have hd : ((n:ℝ)*u)^2/(2*(n:ℝ)) = ((n:ℝ)*u^2)/2 := by field_simp
    rw [hd, hnu] at hmain
    have hnu' : (0:ℝ) < (n:ℝ)*u := by positivity
    have h5 : (n:ℝ)*u*A ≤ (n:ℝ)*u*u := by
      have hq : (n:ℝ)*u*u = 2*L := by nlinarith [hnu]
      rw [hq]; linarith
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h5 hnu'

theorem ch4_theorem_4_16
    {ι : Type*} [Nonempty ι] {𝒳 : Type*}
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (f : ι → 𝒳 → ℝ) (S : Fin n → 𝒳)
    (hf : ∀ i, ∀ z, f i z ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (s : Set (EmpiricalSpace n))
    (hs : s = Set.range (fun i => empiricalMetricImage n S (f i)))
    (hcov : ∀ ε ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), coveringNumber ε s ≠ ⊤) :
    empRadSigned n f S ≤
      ⨅ ε : Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
        ((ε : ℝ) +
          Real.sqrt
            (2 * Real.log (((coveringNumber (ε : ℝ) s).untopD 0 : ℕ) : ℝ)
              / (n : ℝ))) := by
  classical
  have hnR : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  haveI : Nonempty (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) := ⟨⟨1, by norm_num⟩⟩
  refine le_ciInf ?_
  rintro ⟨ε, hε⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_Ioi] at hε
  simp only
  -- covering number is attained
  have hsetne : {x : WithTop ℕ | ∃ t : Finset (EmpiricalSpace n),
      IsENet t ε s ∧ (t.card : WithTop ℕ) = x}.Nonempty := by
    by_contra hcon
    rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hcon
    apply hcov ε hε
    unfold coveringNumber
    rw [hcon]
    exact sInf_empty
  obtain ⟨x0, tx, htx, hx0⟩ := hsetne
  set Mset : Set ℕ := {m : ℕ | ∃ t : Finset (EmpiricalSpace n), IsENet t ε s ∧ t.card = m} with hMset
  have hMne : Mset.Nonempty := ⟨tx.card, tx, htx, rfl⟩
  set N : ℕ := sInf Mset with hNdef
  obtain ⟨t, htnet, htcard⟩ : N ∈ Mset := Nat.sInf_mem hMne
  have hcovval : coveringNumber ε s = (N : WithTop ℕ) := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact sInf_le ⟨t, htnet, by rw [htcard]⟩
    · refine le_sInf ?_
      rintro y ⟨t', ht', rfl⟩
      have : N ≤ t'.card := Nat.sInf_le ⟨t', ht', rfl⟩
      exact_mod_cast this
  have huntop : ((coveringNumber ε s).untopD 0) = N := by rw [hcovval]; rfl
  rw [huntop]
  -- truncation map
  set w : EmpiricalSpace n → Fin n → ℝ := fun v k => max (-1) (min 1 (v k)) with hw
  have hwb : ∀ (v : EmpiricalSpace n) (k : Fin n), -1 ≤ w v k ∧ w v k ≤ 1 := by
    intro v k
    constructor
    · exact le_max_left _ _
    · exact max_le (by norm_num) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hwsq : ∀ a ∈ t, ∀ k, (w a k)^2 ≤ 1 := by
    intro a _ k
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hwb a k
    nlinarith
  -- t is nonempty
  obtain ⟨i0⟩ := ‹Nonempty ι›
  have hmem0 : (empiricalMetricImage n S (f i0)) ∈ s := by rw [hs]; exact ⟨i0, rfl⟩
  have ht : t.Nonempty := by
    have h2 := htnet hmem0
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at h2
    obtain ⟨v, hv, _⟩ := h2
    exact ⟨v, hv⟩
  -- key pointwise bound
  have hkey : ∀ σ : RadSigns n, (⨆ i, (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k, ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * f i (S k))
      ≤ ε + t.sup' ht (fun a => (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k, ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * w a k) := by
    intro σ
    refine ciSup_le ?_
    intro i
    have hmem : (empiricalMetricImage n S (f i)) ∈ s := by rw [hs]; exact ⟨i, rfl⟩
    have h2 := htnet hmem
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Metric.mem_closedBall] at h2
    obtain ⟨v, hvt, hdv⟩ := h2
    -- distance bound
    have hdist : Real.sqrt ((n:ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k, (f i (S k) - v k)^2) ≤ ε := by
      refine le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) hdv
      show _ = empiricalNorm n (empiricalMetricImage n S (f i) - v)
      unfold empiricalNorm
      congr 2
    have hsq : (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k, (f i (S k) - v k)^2 ≤ ε^2 := by
      have hnn : (0:ℝ) ≤ (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k, (f i (S k) - v k)^2 := by
        have : (0:ℝ) ≤ ∑ k, (f i (S k) - v k)^2 :=
          Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => sq_nonneg _)
        positivity
      nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hnn, Real.sqrt_nonneg ((n:ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k, (f i (S k) - v k)^2)]
    have hsum1 : ∑ k, (f i (S k) - v k)^2 ≤ (n:ℝ) * ε^2 := by
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq (le_of_lt hnR)
      rw [← mul_assoc] at this
      rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hnR), one_mul] at this
      exact this
    have hsum2 : ∑ k, (f i (S k) - w v k)^2 ≤ (n:ℝ) * ε^2 := by
      refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum ?_) hsum1
      intro k _
      have hb := hf i (S k)
      simp only [Set.mem_Icc] at hb
      exact trunc_sq_le _ _ hb.1 hb.2
    -- Cauchy-Schwarz
    have hσsq : ∑ k : Fin n, (((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ))^2 = (n:ℝ) := by
      have hone : ∀ k : Fin n, (((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ))^2 = 1 := by
        intro k
        have hk := (σ k).2
        simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hk
        rcases hk with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
      simp [hone]
    have hcs : (∑ k, ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * (f i (S k) - w v k))^2
        ≤ (∑ k : Fin n, (((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ))^2) * (∑ k, (f i (S k) - w v k)^2) :=
      Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq Finset.univ _ _
    have hbound : ∑ k, ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * (f i (S k) - w v k) ≤ (n:ℝ) * ε := by
      rw [hσsq] at hcs
      have h3 : (∑ k, ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * (f i (S k) - w v k))^2 ≤ ((n:ℝ)*ε)^2 := by
        have h4 : (n:ℝ) * (∑ k, (f i (S k) - w v k)^2) ≤ (n:ℝ) * ((n:ℝ) * ε^2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum2 (le_of_lt hnR)
        nlinarith
      nlinarith [h3, mul_pos hnR hε]
    -- combine
    have hsplit : (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k, ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * f i (S k)
        ≤ (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k, ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * w v k + ε := by
      have heq : ∑ k, ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * f i (S k)
          = ∑ k, ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * w v k + ∑ k, ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * (f i (S k) - w v k) := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => by ring)
      rw [heq, mul_add]
      have : (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k, ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * (f i (S k) - w v k) ≤ ε := by
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbound (le_of_lt (inv_pos.mpr hnR))
        rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hnR), one_mul] at this
        exact this
      linarith
    have hle : (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k, ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * w v k
        ≤ t.sup' ht (fun a => (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k, ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * w a k) :=
      Finset.le_sup' (fun a => (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k, ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * w a k) hvt
    linarith
  -- assemble
  have hCpos : (0:ℝ) < (Fintype.card (RadSigns n) : ℝ) := by
    rw [radsigns_card]; positivity
  have hstep : empRadSigned n f S
      ≤ (Fintype.card (RadSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ σ : RadSigns n,
          (ε + t.sup' ht (fun a => (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k, ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * w a k)) := by
    unfold empRadSigned
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun σ _ => hkey σ))
      (le_of_lt (inv_pos.mpr hCpos))
  have heq2 : (Fintype.card (RadSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ σ : RadSigns n,
      (ε + t.sup' ht (fun a => (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k, ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * w a k))
      = ε + (Fintype.card (RadSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ σ : RadSigns n,
          t.sup' ht (fun a => (n:ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k, ((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * w a k) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_add,
      ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hCpos), one_mul]
  have hmass := massart n hn t ht w hwsq
  rw [htcard] at hmass
  linarith [hstep, heq2.le, heq2.ge, hmass]


end GraduateLevel

targets.label: ch5_theorem_5_9
targets.statement:
For some constants \(B_w > 0\) and \(B_u > 0\), let
\[
\mathcal{H} = \left\{ f_\theta \mid \left\|w\right\|_2 \leq B_w,\ \left\|u_i\right\|_2 \leq B_u,\ \forall i \in \{1,2,\dots,m\} \right\},
\]
and suppose \(\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|x\right\|_2^2\right] \leq C^2\). Then
\[
R_n(\mathcal{H}) \le 2 B_w B_u C\sqrt{\frac{m}{n}}.
\]

nl_proof:
By definition,
\[
\begin{aligned}
R_S(\mathcal{H})
&= \mathbb{E}_\sigma\left[ \sup_\theta \frac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}^n \sigma_i \left\langle w,\phi(Ux^{(i)})\right\rangle \right] \\
&= \frac{1}{n} \mathbb{E}_\sigma\left[ \sup_{U : \left\|u_j\right\|_2 \leq B_u} \sup_{\left\|w\right\|_2 \leq B_w} \left\langle w,\sum_{i=1}^n \sigma_i \phi(Ux^{(i)})\right\rangle \right] \\
&= \frac{B_w}{n}\mathbb{E}_\sigma\left[ \sup_{U : \left\|u_j\right\|_2 \leq B_u} \left\| \sum_{i=1}^n \sigma_i \phi(Ux^{(i)})\right\|_2 \right]
\quad \text{(}\textstyle\sup_{\left\|w\right\|_2\leq B}\left\langle w,v\right\rangle = B\left\|v\right\|_2\text{)} \\
&\leq \frac{B_w\sqrt{m}}{n}\mathbb{E}_\sigma\left[ \sup_{U : \left\|u_j\right\|_2 \leq B_u} \left\| \sum_{i=1}^n \sigma_i \phi(Ux^{(i)})\right\|_\infty \right]
\quad \text{(}\left\|v\right\|_2 \leq \sqrt{m}\left\|v\right\|_\infty\text{)} \\
&= \frac{B_w\sqrt{m}}{n}\mathbb{E}_\sigma\left[ \sup_{U : \left\|u_j\right\|_2 \leq B_u} \max_{1\leq j\leq m} \left| \sum_{i=1}^n \sigma_i \phi(u_j^\top x^{(i)})\right| \right] \\
&= \frac{B_w\sqrt{m}}{n}\mathbb{E}_\sigma\left[ \sup_{\left\|u\right\|_2 \leq B_u} \left| \sum_{i=1}^n \sigma_i \phi(u^\top x^{(i)})\right| \right] \\
&\leq \frac{2B_w\sqrt{m}}{n}\mathbb{E}_\sigma\left[ \sup_{\left\|u\right\|_2 \leq B_u} \sum_{i=1}^n \sigma_i \phi(u^\top x^{(i)}) \right]
\quad \text{(by the referenced result)} \\
&\leq \frac{2B_w\sqrt{m}}{n}\mathbb{E}_\sigma\left[ \sup_{\left\|u\right\|_2 \leq B_u} \sum_{i=1}^n \sigma_i u^\top x^{(i)} \right],
\end{aligned}
\]
where the last inequality follows by applying the contraction lemma (Talagrand's lemma) and observing that the ReLU function is \(1\)-Lipschitz. (The expectation above is the Rademacher complexity for \(\{ x \mapsto \phi(u^\top x) \mid \left\|u\right\|_2 \leq B_u \}\): this is the family that we are applying the contraction lemma to.)

We now observe that the expectation in the last line is the Rademacher complexity of the family of linear models \(\{x \mapsto \langle u,x\rangle \mid \left\|u\right\|_2\leq B_u\}\). Thus, applying the referenced linear-model Rademacher bound yields
\[
R_S(\mathcal{H}) \leq \frac{2B_w\sqrt{m}}{n}B_u\sqrt{\sum_{i=1}^n \left\|x^{(i)}\right\|_2^2}.
\]

Taking the expectation of both sides and using similar steps to those in the proof of the referenced theorem gives us
\[
\begin{aligned}
R_n(\mathcal{H}) &= \mathbb{E}\left[ R_S(\mathcal{H})\right] \\
&\leq \frac{2B_wB_u\sqrt{m}}{n} \mathbb{E}\left[\sqrt{\sum_{i=1}^n \left\|x^{(i)}\right\|_2^2}\right] \\
&\leq \frac{2B_wB_u\sqrt{m}}{n} C\sqrt{n} \\
&= 2 B_w B_u C\sqrt{\frac{m}{n}},
\end{aligned}
\]
which completes the proof.

context.name: Removing the absolute value in Rademacher complexity
context.statement:
Let \(\sigma = (\sigma_1, \dots, \sigma_n)\) and \(f_{\theta}(x) = \left(f_{\theta}\left(x^{(1)}\right), \dots, f_{\theta}\left(x^{(n)}\right)\right)\). Suppose that for any \(\sigma \in \{\pm 1\}^n\), \(\sup_{\theta} \langle \sigma, f_{\theta}(x) \rangle \geq 0\). Then,
\[
\mathbb{E}_{\sigma}\left[ \sup_{\theta} \left| \langle \sigma, f_{\theta}(x) \rangle \right| \right] \leq 2\, \mathbb{E}_{\sigma}\left[ \sup_{\theta} \langle \sigma, f_{\theta}(x) \rangle \right].
\]

context.name: Talagrand's lemma
context.statement:
Let \(\phi:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}\) be a \(\kappa\)-Lipschitz function. Then
\[
R_S(\phi\circ \mathcal{H})\leq \kappa R_S(\mathcal{H}),
\]
where \(\phi\circ\mathcal{H} = \{z\mapsto \phi(h(z))\mid h\in\mathcal{H}\}\).

context.name: Rademacher complexity of l2-bounded linear functions
context.statement:
Let \(\mathcal{H} = \{x \mapsto \langle w,x \rangle \mid w \in \mathbb{R}^d,\, \|w\|_2 \le B\}\) for some constant \(B > 0\). Moreover, assume \(\mathbb{E}_{x \sim P}[\|x\|_2^2] \leq C^2\), where \(P\) is some distribution and \(C > 0\) is a constant. Then
\[
R_S(\mathcal{H}) \le \frac{B}{n} \sqrt{\sum_{i=1}^n \|x^{(i)}\|_2^2},
\]
and
\[
R_n(\mathcal{H}) \le \frac{BC}{\sqrt{n}}.
\]

context.name: Rademacher complexity
context.statement:
Let \(\mathcal{F}\) be a family of functions mapping \(Z \mapsto \mathbb{R}\), and let \(P\) be a distribution over \(Z\). The (average) Rademacher complexity of \(\mathcal{F}\) is defined as
\[
R_n(F) \triangleq \mathbb{E}_{z_1, \dots, z_n \overset{\text{iid}}{\sim} P} \left[ \mathbb{E}_{\sigma_1, \dots, \sigma_n \overset{\text{iid}}{\sim}\{ \pm 1 \}} \left[ \sup_{f\in F} \frac{1}{n} \sum^n_{i=1} \sigma_i f(z_i) \right] \right],
\]
where \(\sigma_1, \dots, \sigma_n\) are independent Rademacher random variables, i.e. each taking on the value of \(1\) or \(-1\) with probability \(1/2\).

context.name: Two-layer ReLU network
context.statement:
Given a width \(m\), let \(w_1,\dots,w_m \in \mathbb{R}\), \(u_1,\dots,u_m \in \mathbb{R}^d\), and let \(\phi\) denote the ReLU activation. For \(\theta=(w_1,\dots,w_m,u_1,\dots,u_m)\), define the two-layer ReLU network
\[
f_{\theta}(x)=\sum_{j=1}^m w_j \phi\left(u_j^\top x\right).
\]
Throughout this section, we use the following notation: \(\theta = (w, U)\) are the parameters of the model with \(w \in \mathbb{R}^m\) and \(U \in \mathbb{R}^{m\times d}\), where \(m\) denotes the number of hidden units. We use \(u_i \in \mathbb{R}^d\) to denote the \(i\)-th row of \(U\) (written as a column vector). \(\phi(z) = \max(z,0)\) is the ReLU activation function applied element-wise. \(f_\theta(x) = \langle w, \phi(Ux)\rangle = w^\top \phi(Ux)\) is the model. \(\{(x^{(i)}, y^{(i)})\}_{i=1}^n\) is the training set, with \(x^{(i)} \in \mathbb{R}^d\) and \(y^{(i)} \in \mathbb{R}\).

solution:
import Mathlib

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Real

namespace GraduateLevel

def RadSigns (n : ℕ) : Type := Fin n → ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ)

instance {n} : Fintype (RadSigns n) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Fintype (Fin n → { x // x ∈ {-1, 1} }))

private instance : Neg { x // x ∈ ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ) } where
  neg x := ⟨-x.val, by
    cases x with
    | mk val h =>
      simp at h
      cases h
      · simp [*]
      · simp [*]
  ⟩

noncomputable def empRadSigned {ι : Type*} {𝒳 : Type*}
    (n : ℕ) (f : ι → 𝒳 → ℝ) (S : Fin n → 𝒳) : ℝ :=
  (Fintype.card (RadSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
    ∑ σ : RadSigns n, ⨆ i, (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * f i (S k)

noncomputable def popRadSigned {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {ι : Type*} {𝒳 : Type*}
    (n : ℕ) (f : ι → 𝒳 → ℝ) (μ : Measure Ω) (X : Ω → 𝒳) : ℝ :=
  ∫ ω : Fin n → Ω, empRadSigned n f (X ∘ ω) ∂(Measure.pi fun _ => μ)

def reluAct : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => max 0 x

def NetParam (d m : ℕ) (Bw Bu : ℝ) : Type := {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) × (Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) // ‖p.1‖ ≤ Bw ∧ ∀ i, ‖p.2 i‖ ≤ Bu}

noncomputable def netFun {d m : ℕ} {Bw Bu : ℝ} (p : NetParam d m Bw Bu) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) : ℝ := ∑ j : Fin m, (p.1.1 j) * reluAct (inner ℝ (p.1.2 j) x)

open scoped BigOperators ENNReal

/-- ReLU is continuous. -/
private lemma reluAct_continuous : Continuous reluAct :=
  continuous_const.max continuous_id

/-- ReLU is 1-Lipschitz. -/
private lemma reluAct_lipschitzWith : LipschitzWith 1 reluAct := by
  show LipschitzWith 1 (fun x => max 0 x)
  have h₁ : LipschitzWith 0 (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ)) := LipschitzWith.const 0
  have h₂ : LipschitzWith 1 (id : ℝ → ℝ) := LipschitzWith.id
  have h := h₁.max h₂
  simpa using h

private abbrev RSigns (n : ℕ) := RadSigns n

private instance (n : ℕ) : Nonempty (RSigns n) :=
  ⟨fun _ => ⟨1, by simp⟩⟩

private lemma signs_split {n : ℕ} (f : ℤ → RSigns n → ℝ) :
    ∑ s ∈ ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ), ∑ σ : RSigns n, f s σ =
      ∑ σ : RSigns (n + 1), f (σ (Fin.last n)) (Fin.init σ) := by
  calc
    _ = ∑ z : ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ) × RSigns n, f z.1 z.2 := by
      exact (Fintype.sum_prod_type
        (fun z : ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ) × RSigns n => f z.1 z.2)).symm
    _ = ∑ σ : RSigns (n + 1),
        (fun z : ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ) × RSigns n => f z.1 z.2)
          ((Fin.snocEquiv fun _ => ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ)).symm σ) := by
      exact (Fintype.sum_equiv
        (Fin.snocEquiv fun _ => ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ)).symm _ _ (fun _ => rfl)).symm
    _ = _ := by simp

private lemma sign_abs {n : ℕ} (σ : RSigns n) (k : Fin n) :
    |(σ k : ℝ)| = 1 := by
  have h := (σ k).property
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at h
  rcases h with h | h <;> simp [h]

private lemma exists_eq_ciSup_of_compact
    {H : Type*} [TopologicalSpace H] [CompactSpace H] [Nonempty H]
    (f : H → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f) :
    ∃ h, f h = ⨆ h, f h := by
  obtain ⟨h, -, hh⟩ :=
    isCompact_univ.exists_isMaxOn Set.univ_nonempty hf.continuousOn
  have hb : BddAbove (Set.range f) := ⟨f h, by
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact hh (Set.mem_univ x)⟩
  refine ⟨h, le_antisymm (le_ciSup hb h) ?_⟩
  exact ciSup_le fun x => hh (Set.mem_univ x)

private lemma bddAbove_range_of_compact
    {H : Type*} [TopologicalSpace H] [CompactSpace H] [Nonempty H]
    (f : H → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f) : BddAbove (Set.range f) := by
  obtain ⟨h, -, hh⟩ :=
    isCompact_univ.exists_isMaxOn Set.univ_nonempty hf.continuousOn
  exact ⟨f h, by
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact hh (Set.mem_univ x)⟩

private lemma two_iSup_contraction_compact
    {H : Type*} [TopologicalSpace H] [CompactSpace H] [Nonempty H]
    (A x : H → ℝ) (ψ : ℝ → ℝ) {L : ℝ}
    (hA : Continuous A) (hx : Continuous x) (hψc : Continuous ψ)
    (hψ : ∀ u v, |ψ u - ψ v| ≤ L * |u - v|) :
    (⨆ h, A h + ψ (x h)) + (⨆ h, A h - ψ (x h)) ≤
      (⨆ h, A h + L * x h) + (⨆ h, A h - L * x h) := by
  obtain ⟨h₁, hh₁⟩ := exists_eq_ciSup_of_compact
    (fun h => A h + ψ (x h)) (hA.add (hψc.comp hx))
  obtain ⟨h₂, hh₂⟩ := exists_eq_ciSup_of_compact
    (fun h => A h - ψ (x h)) (hA.sub (hψc.comp hx))
  rw [← hh₁, ← hh₂]
  have hp : Continuous (fun h => A h + L * x h) :=
    hA.add (continuous_const.mul hx)
  have hm : Continuous (fun h => A h - L * x h) :=
    hA.sub (continuous_const.mul hx)
  obtain ⟨hp₀, ehp⟩ := exists_eq_ciSup_of_compact _ hp
  obtain ⟨hm₀, ehm⟩ := exists_eq_ciSup_of_compact _ hm
  by_cases hxx : x h₂ ≤ x h₁
  · have hd : ψ (x h₁) - ψ (x h₂) ≤ L * (x h₁ - x h₂) := by
      calc
        _ ≤ |ψ (x h₁) - ψ (x h₂)| := le_abs_self _
        _ ≤ L * |x h₁ - x h₂| := hψ _ _
        _ = _ := by rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hxx)]
    calc
      _ = A h₁ + A h₂ + (ψ (x h₁) - ψ (x h₂)) := by ring
      _ ≤ A h₁ + A h₂ + L * (x h₁ - x h₂) := by linarith
      _ = (A h₁ + L * x h₁) + (A h₂ - L * x h₂) := by ring
      _ ≤ (⨆ h, A h + L * x h) + (⨆ h, A h - L * x h) := by
        rw [← ehp, ← ehm]
        exact add_le_add
          (by rw [ehp]; exact le_ciSup (bddAbove_range_of_compact _ hp) h₁)
          (by rw [ehm]; exact le_ciSup (bddAbove_range_of_compact _ hm) h₂)
  · have hxx' : x h₁ ≤ x h₂ := le_of_not_ge hxx
    have hd : ψ (x h₁) - ψ (x h₂) ≤ L * (x h₂ - x h₁) := by
      calc
        _ ≤ |ψ (x h₁) - ψ (x h₂)| := le_abs_self _
        _ ≤ L * |x h₁ - x h₂| := hψ _ _
        _ = _ := by rw [abs_sub_comm, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hxx')]
    calc
      _ = A h₁ + A h₂ + (ψ (x h₁) - ψ (x h₂)) := by ring
      _ ≤ A h₁ + A h₂ + L * (x h₂ - x h₁) := by linarith
      _ = (A h₂ + L * x h₂) + (A h₁ - L * x h₁) := by ring
      _ ≤ (⨆ h, A h + L * x h) + (⨆ h, A h - L * x h) := by
        rw [← ehp, ← ehm]
        exact add_le_add
          (by rw [ehp]; exact le_ciSup (bddAbove_range_of_compact _ hp) h₂)
          (by rw [ehm]; exact le_ciSup (bddAbove_range_of_compact _ hm) h₁)

private theorem sum_iSup_contraction_compact
    {H : Type*} [TopologicalSpace H] [CompactSpace H] [Nonempty H]
    (n : ℕ) (a : H → Fin n → ℝ) (ψ : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ)
    (c : H → ℝ) {L : ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ k, Continuous fun h => a h k)
    (hψc : ∀ k, Continuous (ψ k)) (hc : Continuous c)
    (hψ : ∀ k u v, |ψ k u - ψ k v| ≤ L * |u - v|) :
    (∑ σ : RSigns n,
        ⨆ h, c h + ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * ψ k (a h k)) ≤
      ∑ σ : RSigns n,
        ⨆ h, c h + L * ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * a h k := by
  induction n generalizing c with
  | zero => simp
  | succ q ih =>
      let a₀ : H → Fin q → ℝ := fun h k => a h k.castSucc
      let ψ₀ : Fin q → ℝ → ℝ := fun k => ψ k.castSucc
      let x : H → ℝ := fun h => a h (Fin.last q)
      have ha₀ : ∀ k, Continuous fun h => a₀ h k := fun k => ha k.castSucc
      have hψc₀ : ∀ k, Continuous (ψ₀ k) := fun k => hψc k.castSucc
      have hx : Continuous x := ha (Fin.last q)
      have hψ₀ : ∀ k u v, |ψ₀ k u - ψ₀ k v| ≤ L * |u - v| :=
        fun k u v => hψ k.castSucc u v
      have hlast :
          ∑ τ : RSigns q,
              ((⨆ h,
                  c h + (∑ k : Fin q, (τ k : ℝ) * ψ₀ k (a₀ h k)) +
                    ψ (Fin.last q) (x h)) +
                (⨆ h,
                  c h + (∑ k : Fin q, (τ k : ℝ) * ψ₀ k (a₀ h k)) -
                    ψ (Fin.last q) (x h))) ≤
            ∑ τ : RSigns q,
              ((⨆ h,
                  c h + (∑ k : Fin q, (τ k : ℝ) * ψ₀ k (a₀ h k)) +
                    L * x h) +
                (⨆ h,
                  c h + (∑ k : Fin q, (τ k : ℝ) * ψ₀ k (a₀ h k)) -
                    L * x h)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro τ _
        let A : H → ℝ :=
          fun h => c h + ∑ k : Fin q, (τ k : ℝ) * ψ₀ k (a₀ h k)
        have hA : Continuous A := hc.add <| continuous_finset_sum _ fun k _ =>
          continuous_const.mul ((hψc₀ k).comp (ha₀ k))
        simpa [A, add_assoc] using
          two_iSup_contraction_compact A x (ψ (Fin.last q))
            hA hx (hψc (Fin.last q)) (hψ (Fin.last q))
      have hminus := ih (a := a₀) (ψ := ψ₀)
        (c := fun h => c h - L * x h) ha₀ hψc₀
        (hc.sub (continuous_const.mul hx)) hψ₀
      have hplus := ih (a := a₀) (ψ := ψ₀)
        (c := fun h => c h + L * x h) ha₀ hψc₀
        (hc.add (continuous_const.mul hx)) hψ₀
      let Q : ℤ → RSigns q → ℝ :=
        fun s τ =>
          ⨆ h, c h +
            ((∑ k : Fin q, (τ k : ℝ) * ψ₀ k (a₀ h k)) +
              (s : ℝ) * ψ (Fin.last q) (x h))
      let QL : ℤ → RSigns q → ℝ :=
        fun s τ =>
          ⨆ h, c h + L *
            ((∑ k : Fin q, (τ k : ℝ) * a₀ h k) + (s : ℝ) * x h)
      calc
        (∑ σ : RSigns (q + 1),
            ⨆ h, c h + ∑ k : Fin (q + 1),
              (σ k : ℝ) * ψ k (a h k)) =
          ∑ σ : RSigns (q + 1), Q (σ (Fin.last q)) (Fin.init σ) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro σ _
            dsimp only [Q]
            apply congrArg
            funext h
            rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
            rfl
        _ = ∑ s ∈ ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ), ∑ τ : RSigns q,
              ⨆ h, c h +
                ((∑ k : Fin q, (τ k : ℝ) * ψ₀ k (a₀ h k)) +
                  (s : ℝ) * ψ (Fin.last q) (x h)) := (signs_split Q).symm
        _ = ∑ τ : RSigns q,
              ((⨆ h, c h + (∑ k : Fin q, (τ k : ℝ) * ψ₀ k (a₀ h k)) -
                    ψ (Fin.last q) (x h)) +
                (⨆ h, c h + (∑ k : Fin q, (τ k : ℝ) * ψ₀ k (a₀ h k)) +
                    ψ (Fin.last q) (x h))) := by
            simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib, add_comm, add_left_comm]
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro τ _
            apply congrArg
            funext h
            ring
        _ ≤ ∑ τ : RSigns q,
              ((⨆ h, c h + (∑ k : Fin q, (τ k : ℝ) * ψ₀ k (a₀ h k)) -
                    L * x h) +
                (⨆ h, c h + (∑ k : Fin q, (τ k : ℝ) * ψ₀ k (a₀ h k)) +
                    L * x h)) := by simpa [add_comm] using hlast
        _ = (∑ τ : RSigns q,
              ⨆ h, (c h - L * x h) +
                ∑ k : Fin q, (τ k : ℝ) * ψ₀ k (a₀ h k)) +
            ∑ τ : RSigns q,
              ⨆ h, (c h + L * x h) +
                ∑ k : Fin q, (τ k : ℝ) * ψ₀ k (a₀ h k) := by
            simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
            congr 1 <;> apply Finset.sum_congr rfl <;> intro τ _ <;>
              apply congrArg <;> funext h <;> ring
        _ ≤ (∑ τ : RSigns q,
              ⨆ h, (c h - L * x h) +
                L * ∑ k : Fin q, (τ k : ℝ) * a₀ h k) +
            ∑ τ : RSigns q,
              ⨆ h, (c h + L * x h) +
                L * ∑ k : Fin q, (τ k : ℝ) * a₀ h k :=
            add_le_add hminus hplus
        _ = ∑ s ∈ ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ), ∑ τ : RSigns q,
              ⨆ h, c h + L *
                ((∑ k : Fin q, (τ k : ℝ) * a₀ h k) + (s : ℝ) * x h) := by
            simp [add_comm, add_assoc]
            congr 1 <;> apply Finset.sum_congr rfl <;> intro τ _ <;>
              apply congrArg <;> funext h <;> ring
        _ = ∑ σ : RSigns (q + 1), QL (σ (Fin.last q)) (Fin.init σ) :=
            signs_split QL
        _ = ∑ σ : RSigns (q + 1),
              ⨆ h, c h + L * ∑ k : Fin (q + 1), (σ k : ℝ) * a h k := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro σ _
            dsimp only [QL]
            apply congrArg
            funext h
            rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
            rfl

private def flipSign {n : ℕ} (k : Fin n) (σ : RSigns n) : RSigns n :=
  fun i => if i = k then -(σ i) else σ i

private lemma flipSign_involutive {n : ℕ} (k : Fin n) :
    Function.Involutive (flipSign k) := by
  intro σ
  funext i
  dsimp [flipSign]
  by_cases h : i = k
  · subst i
    simp
    apply Subtype.ext
    change - -((σ k : ℤ)) = (σ k : ℤ)
    ring_nf
  · simp [h]

private lemma sign_orthogonality {n : ℕ} (k l : Fin n) (hkl : k ≠ l) :
    ∑ σ : RSigns n, (σ k : ℝ) * (σ l : ℝ) = 0 := by
  let e : RSigns n ≃ RSigns n :=
    { toFun := flipSign k
      invFun := flipSign k
      left_inv := flipSign_involutive k
      right_inv := flipSign_involutive k }
  have heq :
      ∑ σ : RSigns n, (σ k : ℝ) * (σ l : ℝ) =
        ∑ σ : RSigns n, ((e σ) k : ℝ) * ((e σ) l : ℝ) := by
    exact Fintype.sum_equiv e _ _ (fun x => by
      rw [show e (e x) = x from flipSign_involutive k x])
  have hneg :
      ∑ σ : RSigns n, ((e σ) k : ℝ) * ((e σ) l : ℝ) =
        -∑ σ : RSigns n, (σ k : ℝ) * (σ l : ℝ) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro σ _
    dsimp [e, flipSign]
    rw [if_pos rfl, if_neg (Ne.symm hkl)]
    change ((-(σ k : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) * ((σ l : ℤ) : ℝ) =
      -(((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) * ((σ l : ℤ) : ℝ))
    push_cast
    ring
  linarith

private lemma rademacher_norm_sq_average
    {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    {n : ℕ} (Y : Fin n → H) :
    (Fintype.card (RSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ∑ σ : RSigns n, ‖∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) • Y k‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ k : Fin n, ‖Y k‖ ^ 2 := by
  let A : RSigns n → Fin n → Fin n → ℝ :=
    fun σ k l => (σ k : ℝ) * (σ l : ℝ) * inner ℝ (Y k) (Y l)
  have hexpand : ∀ σ : RSigns n,
      ‖∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) • Y k‖ ^ 2 =
        ∑ k : Fin n, ∑ l : Fin n, A σ k l := by
    intro σ
    calc
      _ = inner ℝ (∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) • Y k)
          (∑ l : Fin n, (σ l : ℝ) • Y l) := by
            symm
            exact real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq _
      _ = ∑ k : Fin n, inner ℝ ((σ k : ℝ) • Y k)
          (∑ l : Fin n, (σ l : ℝ) • Y l) := by rw [sum_inner]
      _ = ∑ k : Fin n, ∑ l : Fin n,
          inner ℝ ((σ k : ℝ) • Y k) ((σ l : ℝ) • Y l) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro k _
            rw [inner_sum]
      _ = _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro k _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro l _
        simp only [A, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right]
        ring
  have hsign : ∀ k l : Fin n,
      ∑ σ : RSigns n, (σ k : ℝ) * (σ l : ℝ) =
        if k = l then (Fintype.card (RSigns n) : ℝ) else 0 := by
    intro k l
    by_cases hkl : k = l
    · subst l
      simp only [if_pos]
      calc
        ∑ σ : RSigns n, (σ k : ℝ) * (σ k : ℝ) =
            ∑ _σ : RSigns n, (1 : ℝ) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro σ _
          calc
            (σ k : ℝ) * (σ k : ℝ) = (σ k : ℝ) ^ 2 := by ring
            _ = |(σ k : ℝ)| ^ 2 := (sq_abs _).symm
            _ = 1 := by rw [sign_abs]; norm_num
        _ = _ := by simp
    · simpa [hkl] using sign_orthogonality k l hkl
  calc
    _ = (Fintype.card (RSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
          ∑ σ : RSigns n, ∑ k : Fin n, ∑ l : Fin n, A σ k l := by
      apply congrArg
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => hexpand σ
    _ = (Fintype.card (RSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
          ∑ k : Fin n, ∑ l : Fin n, ∑ σ : RSigns n, A σ k l := by
      congr 1
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k _
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    _ = (Fintype.card (RSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
          ∑ k : Fin n, ∑ l : Fin n,
            (if k = l then (Fintype.card (RSigns n) : ℝ) else 0) *
              inner ℝ (Y k) (Y l) := by
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro l _
      simp only [A]
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hsign k l]
    _ = (Fintype.card (RSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
          ((Fintype.card (RSigns n) : ℝ) * ∑ k : Fin n, ‖Y k‖ ^ 2) := by
      apply congrArg
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k _
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k]
      · simp
      · intro l _ hlk
        simp [Ne.symm hlk]
      · simp
    _ = _ := by
      have hc : (Fintype.card (RSigns n) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp [hc]

private lemma rademacher_norm_average_le
    {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    {n : ℕ} (Y : Fin n → H) :
    (Fintype.card (RSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ∑ σ : RSigns n, ‖∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) • Y k‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin n, ‖Y k‖ ^ 2) := by
  have hs :
      ((Fintype.card (RSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
          ∑ σ : RSigns n, ‖∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) • Y k‖) ^ 2 ≤
        (Fintype.card (RSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
          ∑ σ : RSigns n, ‖∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) • Y k‖ ^ 2 := by
    let f : RSigns n → ℝ := fun _ => 1
    let g : RSigns n → ℝ := fun σ =>
      ‖∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) • Y k‖ *
        (Fintype.card (RSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹
    have hcs := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq
      (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (RSigns n))) f g
    dsimp only [f, g] at hcs
    simp only [one_mul, one_pow, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
      nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one] at hcs
    have hc : (Fintype.card (RSigns n) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    calc
      _ = (∑ σ : RSigns n,
          ‖∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) • Y k‖ *
            (Fintype.card (RSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
              congr 1
              rw [mul_comm, Finset.sum_mul]
      _ ≤ (Fintype.card (RSigns n) : ℝ) *
          ∑ σ : RSigns n,
            (‖∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) • Y k‖ *
              (Fintype.card (RSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2 := hcs
      _ = _ := by
        rw [show (∑ σ : RSigns n,
              (‖∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) • Y k‖ *
                (Fintype.card (RSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2) =
            ∑ σ : RSigns n,
              ‖∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) • Y k‖ ^ 2 *
                ((Fintype.card (RSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹)^2 by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro σ _
          ring]
        rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
        field_simp [hc]
  apply (le_sqrt_of_sq_le hs).trans_eq
  rw [rademacher_norm_sq_average Y]

private abbrev UBall (d : ℕ) (B : ℝ) :=
  Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) B

private def negSignsEquiv (n : ℕ) : RSigns n ≃ RSigns n where
  toFun σ := fun k => -(σ k)
  invFun σ := fun k => -(σ k)
  left_inv σ := by
    funext k
    apply Subtype.ext
    change - -((σ k : ℤ)) = (σ k : ℤ)
    ring_nf
  right_inv σ := by
    funext k
    apply Subtype.ext
    change - -((σ k : ℤ)) = (σ k : ℤ)
    ring_nf

private lemma relu_abs_sign_sum_le
    {d n : ℕ} (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (S : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    ∑ σ : RSigns n,
        ⨆ u : UBall d B,
          |∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) *
            reluAct (inner ℝ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (S k))| ≤
      2 * ∑ σ : RSigns n,
        ⨆ u : UBall d B,
          ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) *
            reluAct (inner ℝ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (S k)) := by
  letI : Nonempty (UBall d B) :=
    (Metric.nonempty_closedBall.mpr hB).to_subtype
  let F : RSigns n → UBall d B → ℝ := fun σ u =>
    ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) *
      reluAct (inner ℝ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (S k))
  have hFc : ∀ σ, Continuous (F σ) := by
    intro σ
    exact continuous_finset_sum _ fun k _ =>
      continuous_const.mul
        (reluAct_continuous.comp (by fun_prop))
  have hone : ∀ σ,
      (⨆ u, |F σ u|) ≤ (⨆ u, F σ u) + (⨆ u, -F σ u) := by
    intro σ
    apply ciSup_le
    intro u
    let u0 : UBall d B := ⟨0, by simpa using hB⟩
    have hF0 : F σ u0 = 0 := by
      simp [F, u0, reluAct]
    have hp0 : 0 ≤ ⨆ u, F σ u := by
      rw [← hF0]
      exact le_ciSup (bddAbove_range_of_compact _ (hFc σ)) u0
    have hn0 : 0 ≤ ⨆ u, -F σ u := by
      rw [show (0 : ℝ) = -F σ u0 by rw [hF0]; simp]
      exact le_ciSup (bddAbove_range_of_compact _ (hFc σ).neg) u0
    apply abs_le.mpr
    constructor
    · have hu := le_ciSup (bddAbove_range_of_compact _ (hFc σ).neg) u
      linarith
    · have hu := le_ciSup (bddAbove_range_of_compact _ (hFc σ)) u
      linarith
  have hneg :
      ∑ σ : RSigns n, (⨆ u : UBall d B, -F σ u) =
        ∑ σ : RSigns n, (⨆ u : UBall d B, F σ u) := by
    let e := negSignsEquiv n
    refine Fintype.sum_equiv e _ _ ?_
    intro σ
    apply congrArg
    funext u
    dsimp [e, negSignsEquiv, F]
    rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    change -(((σ k : ℤ) : ℝ) *
      reluAct (inner ℝ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (S k))) =
      (((-(σ k : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) *
      reluAct (inner ℝ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (S k)))
    push_cast
    ring
  change (∑ σ : RSigns n, ⨆ u : UBall d B, |F σ u|) ≤
    2 * ∑ σ : RSigns n, ⨆ u : UBall d B, F σ u
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ σ : RSigns n, ((⨆ u, F σ u) + (⨆ u, -F σ u)) := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun σ _ => hone σ
    _ = (∑ σ : RSigns n, ⨆ u, F σ u) +
        ∑ σ : RSigns n, ⨆ u, -F σ u := Finset.sum_add_distrib
    _ = 2 * ∑ σ : RSigns n, ⨆ u, F σ u := by rw [hneg]; ring

private lemma relu_sign_contraction
    {d n : ℕ} (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (S : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    ∑ σ : RSigns n,
        ⨆ u : UBall d B,
          ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) *
            reluAct (inner ℝ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (S k)) ≤
      ∑ σ : RSigns n,
        ⨆ u : UBall d B,
          ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) *
            inner ℝ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (S k) := by
  letI : Nonempty (UBall d B) :=
    (Metric.nonempty_closedBall.mpr hB).to_subtype
  have h := sum_iSup_contraction_compact n
    (fun (u : UBall d B) k => inner ℝ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (S k))
    (fun _ => reluAct) (fun _ => 0)
    (L := 1) (fun _ => by fun_prop)
    (fun _ => reluAct_continuous)
    continuous_const (fun _ x y => by
      simpa [Real.dist_eq] using
        reluAct_lipschitzWith.dist_le_mul x y)
  simpa using h

private lemma linear_sign_sup_average_le
    {d n : ℕ} (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (S : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    (Fintype.card (RSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
      ∑ σ : RSigns n,
        ⨆ u : UBall d B,
          ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) *
            inner ℝ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (S k) ≤
      B * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin n, ‖S k‖ ^ 2) := by
  letI : Nonempty (UBall d B) :=
    (Metric.nonempty_closedBall.mpr hB).to_subtype
  calc
    _ ≤ (Fintype.card (RSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ∑ σ : RSigns n, B * ‖∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) • S k‖ := by
      gcongr with σ
      apply ciSup_le
      intro u
      have heq :
          ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) *
              inner ℝ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (S k) =
            inner ℝ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
              (∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) • S k) := by
        rw [inner_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro k _
        rw [real_inner_smul_right]
      rw [heq]
      exact (le_abs_self _).trans <| (abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _).trans <| by
        gcongr
        exact mem_closedBall_zero_iff.mp u.property
    _ = B * ((Fintype.card (RSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ∑ σ : RSigns n, ‖∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) • S k‖) := by
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      ring
    _ ≤ _ := by
      gcongr
      exact rademacher_norm_average_le S

private lemma empirical_net_bound
    {d m n : ℕ} (Bw Bu : ℝ) (hBw : 0 ≤ Bw) (hBu : 0 ≤ Bu)
    (S : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    empRadSigned n
        (fun (p : NetParam d m Bw Bu) => netFun p) S ≤
      2 * Bw * Bu * Real.sqrt (m : ℝ) * (n : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin n, ‖S k‖ ^ 2) := by
  letI : Nonempty (NetParam d m Bw Bu) := ⟨⟨(0, fun _ => 0), by
    constructor
    · simpa using hBw
    · intro i
      simpa using hBu⟩⟩
  letI : Nonempty (UBall d Bu) :=
    (Metric.nonempty_closedBall.mpr hBu).to_subtype
  let M : RSigns n → ℝ := fun σ =>
    ⨆ u : UBall d Bu,
      |∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) *
        reluAct
          (inner ℝ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (S k))|
  have hMc : ∀ σ : RSigns n, Continuous fun u : UBall d Bu =>
      |∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) *
        reluAct
          (inner ℝ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (S k))| := by
    intro σ
    exact (continuous_finset_sum _ fun k _ =>
      continuous_const.mul
        (reluAct_continuous.comp (by fun_prop))).abs
  have hM0 : ∀ σ, 0 ≤ M σ := by
    intro σ
    change 0 ≤ ⨆ u : UBall d Bu,
      |∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) *
        reluAct
          (inner ℝ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (S k))|
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_eq_ciSup_of_compact _ (hMc σ)
    rw [← hu]
    positivity
  have hraw : ∀ (σ : RSigns n) (p : NetParam d m Bw Bu),
      ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * netFun p (S k) ≤
        Bw * Real.sqrt (m : ℝ) * M σ := by
    intro σ p
    let v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) := WithLp.toLp 2 fun j =>
      ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) *
        reluAct (inner ℝ (p.1.2 j) (S k))
    have heq :
        ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * netFun p (S k) =
          inner ℝ p.1.1 v := by
      simp only [netFun, v, PiLp.inner_apply, RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
      simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k _
      ring
    have hv : ‖v‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (m : ℝ) * M σ := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
      calc
        Real.sqrt (∑ j : Fin m, ‖v j‖ ^ 2) ≤
            Real.sqrt (∑ _j : Fin m, (M σ) ^ 2) := by
          gcongr with j
          have hj :
              |v j| ≤ M σ := by
            exact le_ciSup (bddAbove_range_of_compact _ (hMc σ))
              (⟨p.1.2 j, by
                simpa [mem_closedBall_zero_iff] using p.2.2 j⟩ : UBall d Bu)
          simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hj
        _ = Real.sqrt ((m : ℝ) * (M σ) ^ 2) := by simp
        _ = Real.sqrt (m : ℝ) * M σ := by
          rw [Real.sqrt_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg m), Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs,
            abs_of_nonneg (hM0 σ)]
    rw [heq]
    calc
      inner ℝ p.1.1 v ≤ |inner ℝ p.1.1 v| := le_abs_self _
      _ ≤ ‖p.1.1‖ * ‖v‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
      _ ≤ Bw * (Real.sqrt (m : ℝ) * M σ) := by
        exact mul_le_mul p.2.1 hv (norm_nonneg _) hBw
      _ = _ := by ring
  unfold empRadSigned
  have hq : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg n)
  calc
    (Fintype.card (RSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ∑ σ : RSigns n, ⨆ p : NetParam d m Bw Bu,
          (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) * netFun p (S k) ≤
      (Fintype.card (RSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ∑ σ : RSigns n, (n : ℝ)⁻¹ *
          (Bw * Real.sqrt (m : ℝ) * M σ) := by
      gcongr with σ
      apply ciSup_le
      intro p
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (hraw σ p) hq
    _ = Bw * Real.sqrt (m : ℝ) * (n : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ((Fintype.card (RSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ σ : RSigns n, M σ) := by
      simp_rw [show ∀ σ, (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * (Bw * Real.sqrt (m : ℝ) * M σ) =
          ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ * Bw * Real.sqrt (m : ℝ)) * M σ by
        intro σ
        ring]
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      ring
    _ ≤ Bw * Real.sqrt (m : ℝ) * (n : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ((Fintype.card (RSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
          (2 * ∑ σ : RSigns n,
            ⨆ u : UBall d Bu,
              ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) *
                reluAct
                  (inner ℝ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (S k)))) := by
      gcongr
      exact relu_abs_sign_sum_le Bu hBu S
    _ ≤ Bw * Real.sqrt (m : ℝ) * (n : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ((Fintype.card (RSigns n) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
          (2 * ∑ σ : RSigns n,
            ⨆ u : UBall d Bu,
              ∑ k : Fin n, (σ k : ℝ) *
                inner ℝ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (S k))) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      · apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left

targets.label: ch9_theorem_9_2
targets.statement: Let \(t \leqslant n\), \(L, R > 0\). There exists a convex \(L\)-Lipschitz function \(f\) such that any black-box procedure started at \(x_0 = 0\) satisfies \[ \min_{1 \leqslant s \leqslant t} f(x_s) - \min_{x \in B_2(R)} f(x) \geqslant \frac{RL}{2(1+\sqrt{t})}. \] Furthermore, there is an \(\alpha\)-strongly convex, \(L\)-Lipschitz function \(f\) such that \[ \min_{1 \leqslant s \leqslant t} f(x_s) - \min_{x \in B_2(\frac{L}{2\alpha})} f(x) \geqslant \frac{L^2}{8\alpha t}. \]

nl_proof: Consider the function \[ f(x) = \gamma \max_{1 \leqslant i \leqslant t} x[i] + \frac{\alpha}{2} \|x\|^2, \] for some \(\gamma, \alpha \in \mathbb{R}\). In the strongly convex case, \(\gamma\) is a free parameter, and in the Lipschitz case both \(\alpha\) and \(\gamma\) are free parameters. By the subdifferential calculus, \[ \partial f(x) = \alpha x + \gamma \conv\{e_i \colon i \in \argmax_{1 \leqslant j \leqslant t} x(j)\}. \] The function \(f\) is evidently \(\alpha\)-strongly convex. Furthermore, if \(\|x\| \leqslant R\) and \(g \in \partial f(x)\), then \(\|g\| \leqslant \alpha R + \gamma\), so \(f\) is \((\alpha R + \gamma)\)-Lipschitz on \(B_2(R)\). Suppose the gradient oracle returns \(g_i = \alpha x + \gamma e_i\), where \(i\) is the first coordinate such that \(x[i] = \max_{1 \leqslant j \leqslant t} x[j]\). An inductive argument then shows \[ x_s \in \Span\{e_1, \dots, e_{s-1}\} \] Consequently, for \(s \leqslant t\), \(f(x_s) \geqslant 0\). However, consider \(y\in \mathbb{R}^n\) such that \[ y[i] = \begin{cases} -\frac{\gamma}{\alpha t} &\text{if } 1 \leqslant i \leqslant t\\ 0 &\text{otherwise}. \end{cases} \] Since \(0 \in \partial f(y)\), \(y\) is a minimizer of \(f\) with objective value \[ f(y) = \frac{-\gamma^2}{\alpha t} + \frac{\alpha}{2}\frac{\gamma^2}{\alpha^2 t} = -\frac{\gamma^2}{2\alpha t}, \] and hence \(f(x_s) - f(y) \geqslant \frac{\gamma^2}{2 \alpha t}\). We conclude the proof by appropriately choosing \(\alpha\) and \(\gamma\). In the convex, Lipschitz case, set \[ \alpha = \frac{L}{R} \frac{1}{1 + \sqrt{t}} \quad \text{and} \quad \gamma = L \frac{\sqrt{t}}{1 + \sqrt{t}}. \] Then, \(f\) is \(L\)-Lipschitz, \[ \|y\| = \sqrt{t \left(\frac{-\gamma}{\alpha t} \right)^2} = \frac{\gamma}{\alpha \sqrt{t}} = R \] and hence \[ f(x_s) - \min_{x \in B_2(R)} f(x) = f(x_s) - f(y) \geqslant \frac{\gamma^2}{2\alpha t} = \frac{RL}{2(1+\sqrt{t})}. \] In the strongly-convex case, set \(\gamma = \frac{L}{2}\) and take \(R = \frac{L}{2\alpha}\). Then, \(f\) is \(L\)-Lipschitz, \[ \|y\| = \frac{\gamma}{\alpha \sqrt{t}} = \frac{L}{2\alpha \sqrt{t}} = \frac{R}{\sqrt{t}} \leqslant R, \] and therefore \[ f(x_s) - \min_{x \in B_2(L/2\alpha)} f(x) = f(x_s) - f(y) \geqslant \frac{LR}{4t} = \frac{L^2}{8\alpha t}. \]

namespace GraduateLevel

def OracleProcedure {n : ℕ} (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ)
    (G : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (x : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) : Prop :=
  x 0 = 0 ∧
  (∀ s, x (s + 1) - x 0 ∈
    Submodule.span ℝ ((fun i => G (x i)) '' Set.Icc 1 s))

section Aux

private lemma abs_coord_le {n : ℕ} (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (a : Fin n) :
    |x a| ≤ ‖x‖ := by
  have h := abs_real_inner_le_norm (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ)) x
  rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left] at h
  simpa using h

private def Wsub (n t : ℕ) (htn : t ≤ n) (m : ℕ) :
    Submodule ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) where
  carrier := {x | ∀ i : Fin t, m ≤ (i:ℕ) → x (Fin.castLE htn i) = 0}
  zero_mem' := by intro i _; simp
  add_mem' := by intro a b ha hb i hi; simp [ha i hi, hb i hi]
  smul_mem' := by intro c a ha i hi; simp [ha i hi]

private lemma mem_Wsub {n t : ℕ} {htn : t ≤ n} {m : ℕ}
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)} :
    x ∈ Wsub n t htn m ↔ ∀ i : Fin t, m ≤ (i:ℕ) → x (Fin.castLE htn i) = 0 := Iff.rfl

private theorem key (n t : ℕ) (ht : 1 ≤ t) (htn : t ≤ n) (α γ R K B c : ℝ)
    (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hR : 0 < R) (hK : γ + α * R ≤ K)
    (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hcR : c * Real.sqrt t ≤ R)
    (hB : B ≤ γ * c - (α/2) * c^2 * t) :
    ∃ f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ,
      ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f ∧ StrongConvexOn Set.univ α f ∧
      LipschitzOnWith K.toNNReal f (Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) R) ∧
      ∃ G : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n),
        (∀ z, G z ∈ SubderivAt f z) ∧
        ∀ x : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), OracleProcedure f G x →
          ∀ h : ((Finset.Icc 1 t).image (fun s => f (x s))).Nonempty,
          ((Finset.Icc 1 t).image (fun s => f (x s))).min' h
            - sInf (f '' Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) R) ≥ B := by
  classical
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin t) := ⟨⟨0, by omega⟩⟩
  have hne : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin t)).Nonempty := Finset.univ_nonempty
  set ι : Fin t → Fin n := Fin.castLE htn with hιdef
  set M : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ :=
    fun x => Finset.univ.sup' hne (fun i : Fin t => x (ι i)) with hMdef
  set f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ := fun x => γ * M x + (α/2) * ‖x‖^2 with hfdef
  have hMle : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (i : Fin t), x (ι i) ≤ M x := by
    intro x i
    exact Finset.le_sup' (fun i : Fin t => x (ι i)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hkspec : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), ∃ i : Fin t, x (ι i) = M x := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨b, -, hb⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup' hne (fun i : Fin t => x (ι i))
    exact ⟨b, hb.symm⟩
  set kf : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → Fin t :=
    fun x => (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin t => x (ι i) = M x)).min'
      ⟨(hkspec x).choose, by simpa using (hkspec x).choose_spec⟩ with hkfdef
  have hk1 : ∀ x, x (ι (kf x)) = M x := by
    intro x
    have := Finset.min'_mem (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin t => x (ι i) = M x))
      ⟨(hkspec x).choose, by simpa using (hkspec x).choose_spec⟩
    simpa [hkfdef] using this
  have hk2 : ∀ (x) (i : Fin t), x (ι i) = M x → (kf x : ℕ) ≤ (i : ℕ) := by
    intro x i hi
    have : kf x ≤ i := Finset.min'_le _ i (by simpa using hi)
    exact this
  set G : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) :=
    fun x => γ • EuclideanSpace.single (ι (kf x)) (1:ℝ) + α • x with hGdef
  -- basic quadratic identity
  have hquad : ∀ (u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), ‖u - v‖^2 = ‖u‖^2 - 2*⟪u,v⟫ + ‖v‖^2 := by
    intro u v
    have := norm_sub_sq_real u v
    linarith [this]
  have hMc : ∀ (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (a b : ℝ), 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b →

    intro x y a b ha hb
    apply Finset.sup'_le
    intro i _
    have hco : (a • x + b • y) (ι i) = a * x (ι i) + b * y (ι i) := by simp
    rw [hco]
    have h1 := hMle x i
    have h2 := hMle y i
    nlinarith
  have hqid : ∀ (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (a b : ℝ), 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → a + b = 1 →

      simp [abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
      ring
    have e2 := hquad x y
    rw [e1, e2]
    linear_combination (a*‖x‖^2 + b*‖y‖^2) * hab
  have hstrong : StrongConvexOn Set.univ α f := by
    refine ⟨convex_univ, ?_⟩
    intro x _ y _ a b ha hb hab
    have h1 := hMc x y a b ha hb
    have h2 := hqid x y a b ha hb hab
    simp only [hfdef, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [h2]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hγ (sub_nonneg.2 h1)]
  refine ⟨f, ?_, hstrong, ?_, G, ?_, ?_⟩
  · -- ConvexOn
    refine ⟨convex_univ, ?_⟩
    intro x _ y _ a b ha hb hab
    have h := hstrong.2 (Set.mem_univ x) (Set.mem_univ y) ha hb hab
    have hnn : 0 ≤ a * b * (α/2 * ‖x - y‖^2) :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha hb) (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (sq_nonneg _))
    simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h ⊢
    linarith
  · -- Lipschitz
    have hK0 : 0 ≤ K := le_trans (by positivity) hK
    apply LipschitzOnWith.of_dist_le_mul
    intro u hu v hv
    have hu' : ‖u‖ ≤ R := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hu
    have hv' : ‖v‖ ≤ R := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hv
    have hMlip : ∀ p q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), M p - M q ≤ ‖p - q‖ := by
      intro p q
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hkspec p
      have hco : |(p - q) (ι i)| ≤ ‖p - q‖ := abs_coord_le _ _
      have hco2 : (p - q) (ι i) = p (ι i) - q (ι i) := by simp
      have h2 := hMle q i
      rw [hco2] at hco
      have := abs_le.1 hco
      linarith [this.1, this.2]
    have h1 := hMlip u v
    have h2 := hMlip v u
    have hsymm : ‖v - u‖ = ‖u - v‖ := by rw [norm_sub_rev]
    rw [hsymm] at h2
    have hnorm : |‖u‖ - ‖v‖| ≤ ‖u - v‖ := abs_norm_sub_norm_le u v
    have hnn : 0 ≤ ‖u - v‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have hpq : |‖u‖ - ‖v‖| * (‖u‖ + ‖v‖) ≤ ‖u - v‖ * (2*R) :=
      mul_le_mul hnorm (by linarith) (by positivity) hnn
    have hquad2 : |(α/2) * ‖u‖^2 - (α/2)*‖v‖^2| ≤ α * R * ‖u - v‖ := by
      rw [show (α/2) * ‖u‖^2 - (α/2)*‖v‖^2 = (α/2) * ((‖u‖ - ‖v‖) * (‖u‖ + ‖v‖)) by ring,
        abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (show (0:ℝ) ≤ α/2 by linarith), abs_mul,
        abs_of_nonneg (show (0:ℝ) ≤ ‖u‖ + ‖v‖ by positivity)]
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpq (show (0:ℝ) ≤ α/2 by linarith)
      linarith
    have hq := abs_le.1 hquad2
    have e1 : γ * (M u - M v) ≤ γ * ‖u - v‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hγ
    have e2 : γ * (M v - M u) ≤ γ * ‖u - v‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hγ
    have e3 : 0 ≤ (K - (γ + α*R)) * ‖u - v‖ := mul_nonneg (by linarith) hnn
    rw [Real.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm, Real.coe_toNNReal K hK0]
    rw [abs_le]
    simp only [hfdef]
    constructor
    · linarith
    · linarith
  · -- subgradient
    intro z y
    show f y ≥ f z + ⟪G z, y - z⟫
    have hinner : ⟪G z, y - z⟫ = γ * ((y - z) (ι (kf z))) + α * ⟪z, y - z⟫ := by
      simp [hGdef, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left]
    have hco : (y - z) (ι (kf z)) = y (ι (kf z)) - z (ι (kf z)) := by simp
    have h3 := hk1 z
    have h4 := hMle y (kf z)
    have h5 : ⟪z, y - z⟫ = ⟪z, y⟫ - ‖z‖^2 := by
      rw [inner_sub_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    have h6 := hquad y z
    have h7 : ⟪y, z⟫ = ⟪z, y⟫ := real_inner_comm z y
    have h8 : 0 ≤ ‖y - z‖^2 := sq_nonneg _
    rw [hinner, hco, h3, h5]
    simp only [hfdef]

private lemma strong_subgrad {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {Ω : Set E} {f : E → ℝ} {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hsc : StrongConvexOn Ω α f)
    {p g : E} (hp : p ∈ Ω)
    (hsub : ∀ y ∈ Ω, f y ≥ f p + inner ℝ g (y - p)) :
    ∀ y ∈ Ω, f y ≥ f p + inner ℝ g (y - p) + (α/2) * ‖y - p‖^2 := by
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨hconv, hs⟩ := hsc
  set c : ℝ := (α/2) * ‖y - p‖^2 with hc
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := by positivity
  set A : ℝ := f y - f p - inner ℝ g (y - p) with hA
  have main : ∀ a : ℝ, 0 < a → a ≤ 1 → (1 - a) * c ≤ A := by
    intro a ha ha1
    have hb0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - a := by linarith
    have hz : ((1-a) • p + a • y) ∈ Ω := hconv hp hy hb0 ha.le (by ring)
    have h1 := hs hp hy hb0 ha.le (by ring)
    have h2 := hsub _ hz
    have hzp : ((1-a) • p + a • y) - p = a • (y - p) := by module
    rw [hzp, real_inner_smul_right] at h2
    rw [norm_sub_rev p y] at h1
    simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h1
    have key : a * ((1-a) * c) ≤ a * A := by rw [hc, hA]; nlinarith
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left key ha
  have hAc : c ≤ A := by
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hc0 with h | h
    · have h1 := main 1 one_pos le_rfl
      simp at h1
      linarith
    · refine le_of_forall_pos_le_add ?_
      intro ε hε
      have hpos : 0 < min 1 (ε / c) := lt_min one_pos (by positivity)
      have hle : min 1 (ε/c) ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
      have h1 := main _ hpos hle
      have h2 : min 1 (ε/c) * c ≤ ε := by
        rcases min_cases 1 (ε/c) with ⟨he, hle2⟩ | ⟨he, hle2⟩
        · rw [he]; rw [le_div_iff₀ h] at hle2; linarith
        · rw [he, div_mul_cancel₀ _ h.ne']
      nlinarith
  rw [hA] at hAc
  linarith

private lemma alg_step (α S P Q I N Lr F η : ℝ)

    (hη : 0 < η) (hηk : η * (α * (S + 1)) = 2)
    (h1 : Q ≤ P - 2 * (η * I) + η ^ 2 * N)

    S * F ≤ Lr / α + ((α/4) * (S * (S - 1)) * P - (α/4) * ((S+1) * ((S+1) - 1)) * Q) := by
  have hS0 : (0:ℝ) < S := by linarith
  have hS1 : (0:ℝ) < S + 1 := by linarith
  have hm0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ S * α * (S+1) / 4 := by positivity
  have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hm0
  have heq : (S * α * (S+1) / 4) * (P - 2*(η*I) + η^2*N) - (S * α * (S+1) / 4) * Q

    have hprod2 : (Lr/α) * (α*(S+1)) = Lr*(S+1) := by field_simp
    rw [hprod, hprod2]

  nlinarith [e1, e2, h4]

    have hgL2 : ‖f' (x s)‖^2 ≤ (L:ℝ)^2 := by
      have := norm_nonneg (f' (x s)); nlinarith
    refine alg_step α (s:ℝ) (‖x s - xopt‖^2) (‖x (s+1) - xopt‖^2)
      (inner ℝ (f' (x s)) (x s - xopt)) (‖f' (x s)‖^2) ((L:ℝ)^2)
      (f (x s) - f xopt) (2 / (α * ((s:ℝ) + 1))) hα hS1 (sq_nonneg _) hgL2 hηpos hηk ?_ ?_
    · linarith [hd, hexp.ge, hexp.le]
    · linarith
  -- telescoping sum
  have sum_key : ∀ n, n ≤ t → ∑ s ∈ Icc 1 n, (s:ℝ)*(f (x s) - f xopt)
      ≤ (n:ℝ) * ((L:ℝ)^2/α)
        - (α/4) * (((n:ℝ)+1) * (((n:ℝ)+1) - 1)) * ‖x (n+1) - xopt‖^2 := by
    intro n hn
    induction n with
    | zero => norm_num
    | succ m ih =>
      have hm := ih (by omega)
      rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega)]
      have hk := key (m+1) (by omega) hn
      push_cast at hk hm ⊢
      linarith
  have hsum_id : ∀ n : ℕ, ∑ s ∈ Icc 1 n, (s:ℝ) = (n:ℝ)*((n:ℝ)+1)/2 := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => norm_num
    | succ m ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega), ih]
      push_cast; ring
  have htpos : (0:ℝ) < (t:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast ht
  have hden : (0:ℝ) < (t:ℝ)*((t:ℝ)+1) := by nlinarith
  have hw : ∑ s ∈ Icc 1 t, (2*(s:ℝ)/((t:ℝ)*((t:ℝ)+1))) = 1 := by
    have : ∑ s ∈ Icc 1 t, (2*(s:ℝ)/((t:ℝ)*((t:ℝ)+1)))
        = (2/((t:ℝ)*((t:ℝ)+1))) * ∑ s ∈ Icc 1 t, (s:ℝ) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intros; ring
    rw [this, hsum_id]
    field_simp
  have hjen := hconv.map_sum_le (t := Icc 1 t)
      (w := fun s => 2*(s:ℝ)/((t:ℝ)*((t:ℝ)+1))) (p := x)
      (by intro i _; positivity) hw (by intro i hi; exact hmem i (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hi).1)
  have hbound : ∑ s ∈ Icc 1 t, (s:ℝ)*(f (x s) - f xopt) ≤ (t:ℝ) * ((L:ℝ)^2/α) := by
    have h8 := sum_key t le_rfl
    have hnn : 0 ≤ α/4 * (((t:ℝ)+1) * (((t:ℝ)+1) - 1)) * ‖x (t+1) - xopt‖^2 := by
      have he : ((t:ℝ)+1) * (((t:ℝ)+1) - 1) = ((t:ℝ)+1) * (t:ℝ) := by ring
      rw [he]
      have : (0:ℝ) ≤ (t:ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg t
      positivity
    linarith
  have hstep : ∑ i ∈ Icc 1 t, (2*(i:ℝ)/((t:ℝ)*((t:ℝ)+1))) • f (x i) - f xopt
      = (2/((t:ℝ)*((t:ℝ)+1))) * ∑ i ∈ Icc 1 t, (i:ℝ)*(f (x i) - f xopt) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    have h5 : ∑ i ∈ Icc 1 t, (2/((t:ℝ)*((t:ℝ)+1))) * ((i:ℝ)*(f (x i) - f xopt))
        = ∑ i ∈ Icc 1 t, ((2*(i:ℝ)/((t:ℝ)*((t:ℝ)+1))) * f (x i)
            - (2*(i:ℝ)/((t:ℝ)*((t:ℝ)+1))) * f xopt) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intros; ring
    rw [h5, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hw, one_mul]
    simp [smul_eq_mul]
  have hfinal : (2/((t:ℝ)*((t:ℝ)+1))) * ∑ i ∈ Icc 1 t, (i:ℝ)*(f (x i) - f xopt)
      ≤ 2 * (L:ℝ)^2 / (α * ((t:ℝ)+1)) := by
    have hc : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2/((t:ℝ)*((t:ℝ)+1)) := by positivity
    have h6 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbound hc
    have h7 : (2/((t:ℝ)*((t:ℝ)+1))) * ((t:ℝ) * ((L:ℝ)^2/α)) = 2 * (L:ℝ)^2 / (α * ((t:ℝ)+1)) := by
      field_simp
    linarith [h6, h7.le, h7.ge]
  linarith [hjen, hstep.le, hstep.ge, hfinal]

end GraduateLevel

targets.statement: Let \(x_1, \cdots, x_n\) be independent random variables (Lecture 41, opening paragraph). [Editorial, not in the source: each \(f_i\) is a function of \(x_i\), so that \(Z = \sup_{f\in\mathcal F}\sum_{i=1}^n f_i(x_i)\).] Let \(\mathcal{F}\) be a finite set of functions \(|{\mathcal{F}}| <\infty .\forall f=(f_{1},\cdots,f_{n})\in{\mathcal{F}},0\leq f_{i}\leq 1,Z=\) \(\textstyle\operatorname*{sup}_{f}\sum_{i=1}^{n}f_{i}\) ， and define h as \(h(u)=(1+u)\log(1+u)-u\) where \(u \geq 0\) Then \(\mathbb{P}(Z\geq\mathbb{E}Z+x)\leq e^{-\mathbb{E}Z\cdot h(x/\mathbb{E}Z)}\)

nl_proof:
Let
\[Z\quad=\quad\operatorname*{sup}_{f\in{\mathcal{F}}}\sum_{i=1}^{n}f_{i}\ {\stackrel{\mathrm{d e f .}}{=}}\ \sum_{i=1}^{n}f_{i}^{\circ}\]
\[Z^{i}\quad=\quad\operatorname*{sup}_{f\in{\mathcal{F}}}\sum_{j\neq i}f_{j}.\]
It follows that \(0\leq Z-Z^{i}\leq f_{i}^{\circ}\leq 1\) . Since \(\phi=e^{x}-x-1\) is a convex function of \(x,\)
\[\phi(-\lambda(Z-Z^{i}))=\phi(-\lambda\cdot(Z-Z^{i})+0\cdot(1-(Z-Z^{i})))\leq(Z-Z^{i})\phi(-\lambda)\]
and
\[\begin{array}{ r c l }{\mathbb{E}\left(\lambda Z e^{\lambda Z}\right)-\mathbb{E}e^{\lambda Z}\log\mathbb{E}e^{\lambda Z}}&{\leq}&{\mathbb{E}\left(e^{\lambda Z}\displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^{n}\phi\left(-\lambda(Z-Z^{i})\right)\right)}\\ &{\leq}&{\mathbb{E}\left(e^{\lambda Z}\phi(-\lambda)\displaystyle\sum_{i}\left(Z-Z^{i}\right)\right)}\\ &{\leq}&{\phi(-\lambda)\mathbb{E}\left(e^{\lambda Z}\cdot\displaystyle\sum_{i}f_{i}^{\circ}\right)}\\ &{=}&{\phi(-\lambda)\mathbb{E}\left(Z\cdot e^{\lambda Z}\right).}\end{array}\]
Set \(\tilde{Z}=Z-\mathbb{E}Z\ (\mathrm{i . e .}\) , center Z),and we get
\[\begin{array}{ r l r }{\mathbb{E}\left(\lambda\tilde{Z}e^{\lambda\tilde{Z}}\right)-\mathbb{E}e^{\lambda\tilde{Z}}\log\mathbb{E}e^{\lambda\tilde{Z}}}&{\leq}&{\phi(-\lambda)\mathbb{E}\left(\tilde{Z}\cdot e^{\lambda\tilde{Z}}\right)\leq\phi(-\lambda)\mathbb{E}\left(\left(\tilde{Z}+\mathbb{E}Z\right)\cdot e^{\lambda\tilde{Z}}\right)}\\ {(\lambda-\phi(-\lambda))\mathbb{E}\left(\tilde{Z}e^{\lambda\tilde{Z}}\right)-\mathbb{E}e^{\lambda\tilde{Z}}\log\mathbb{E}e^{\lambda\tilde{Z}}}&{\leq}&{\phi(-\lambda)\cdot\mathbb{E}Z\cdot\mathbb{E}e^{\lambda\tilde{Z}}.}\end{array}\]
Let \(v=\mathbb{E}Z,F(\lambda)=\mathbb{E}e^{\lambda\tilde{Z}}\) , 亚 = logF,and we get
\[\begin{array}{ r c l }{{(\lambda-\phi(-\lambda)){\displaystyle\frac{F_{\lambda}^{\prime}(\lambda)}{F(\lambda)}}-\log F(\lambda)}}&{{\le}}&{{v\phi(-\lambda)}}\\ {{(\lambda-\phi(-\lambda)){(\log F(\lambda))}_{\lambda}^{\prime}-\log F(\lambda)}}&{{\le}}&{{v\phi(-\lambda).}}\end{array}\tag{41.1}\]
Solving the differential equation
\[(\lambda-\phi(-\lambda))\left(\underbrace{\log F(\lambda)}_{\Psi_{0}}\right)_{\lambda}^{\prime}-\underbrace{\log F(\lambda)}_{\Psi_{0}}=v\phi(-\lambda),\tag{41.2}\]
yields \(\Psi_{0}=v\cdot\phi(\lambda)\) . We will proceed to show that 亚 satisfying 41.1 has the property \(\Psi\leq\Psi_{0}\)
\[\begin{array}{ r l r }{\mathrm{Substract~41.2~from~41.1,~and~let~\Psi\Psi_1=\Psi-\Psi_0~}}&{}&\\ {(1-e^{-\lambda})\Psi_{1}^{\prime}-\Psi_{1}}&{\le}&{0}\end{array}\]
\[\begin{array}{ r c l }{\displaystyle\big(e^{\lambda}-1\big)\big(1-e^{-\lambda}\big)\frac{1}{e^{\lambda}-1}=1-e^{-\lambda}\mathrm{,a n d}\big(e^{\lambda}-1\big)\big(1-e^{-\lambda}\big)\frac{e^{\lambda}}{(e^{\lambda}-1)^{2}}=1}&&\\ {\displaystyle\big(e^{\lambda}-1\big)\big(1-e^{-\lambda}\big)\underbrace{\Bigg(\frac{1}{e^{\lambda}-1}\Psi_{1}^{\prime}-\frac{e^{\lambda}}{\big(e^{\lambda}-1\big)^{2}}\Psi_{1}\Bigg)}_{\big(\frac{\Psi_{1}}{e^{\lambda}-1}\big)_{\lambda}^{\prime}}}&{\le}&{0}\end{array}\]
\[{\frac{\Psi_{1}(\lambda)}{e^{\lambda}-1}}~\leq~\operatorname*{lim}_{\lambda\to 0}{\frac{\Psi_{1}(\lambda)}{e^{\lambda}-1}}=0 .\]
It follows that \(\Psi\leq v\phi(\lambda)\) ,and \(F=\mathbb{E}e^{\lambda Z}\leq e^{v\phi(\lambda)}\) . By Chebychev's inequality, \(\mathbb{P}\left(Z\geq\mathbb{E}Z+t\right)\leq e^{-\lambda t+v\phi\left(\lambda\right)}\) Minimizing over all \(\lambda > 0\) ，we get \(\mathbb{P}\left(Z\geq\mathbb{E}Z+t\right)\leq e^{-v\cdot h\left(t/v\right)}\) where \(h(x)=(1+x)\cdot\log(1+x)-x.\)

Let \(x_1, \cdots, x_n\) be independent random variables, \(x'_1, \cdots, x'_n\) be their independent copies, \(Z = Z(x_1, \cdots, x_n)\), \(Z^i = Z(x_1, \cdots, x_{i-1}, x'_i, x_{i+1}, \cdots, x_n)\), and \(\phi(x) = e^x - x - 1\).
