solution:
import Mathlib

open MeasureTheory Real Filter

namespace GraduateLevel

private noncomputable def kl (a b : ℝ) : ℝ := a * Real.log (a / b) - a + b

private noncomputable def entropy {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (∫ x, f x * Real.log (f x) ∂μ) -
    (∫ x, f x ∂μ) * Real.log (∫ x, f x ∂μ)

private lemma integrable_of_measurable_bounded
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {f : Ω → ℝ} (hf : Measurable f) {C : ℝ} (hC : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ C) :
    Integrable f μ := by
  refine (integrable_const C).mono hf.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
  filter_upwards [] with x
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, norm_eq_abs] using (hC x).trans (le_abs_self C)

private lemma kl_nonneg {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) : 0 ≤ kl a b := by
  have hlog := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos hb ha)
  rw [Real.log_div hb.ne' ha.ne'] at hlog
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog ha.le
  have hright : a * (b / a - 1) = b - a := by
    field_simp
  dsimp [kl]
  rw [Real.log_div ha.ne' hb.ne']
  rw [hright] at hmul
  calc
    0 ≤ -(a * (Real.log b - Real.log a)) + (b - a) := by
      simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using sub_nonneg.mpr hmul
    _ = a * (Real.log a - Real.log b) - a + b := by ring

private lemma kl_fenchel (a b s : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    s * a - (Real.exp s - 1) * b ≤ kl a b := by
  have h := kl_nonneg (a := a) (b := b * Real.exp s)
      ha (mul_pos hb (Real.exp_pos s))
  rw [kl, Real.log_div ha.ne' (mul_ne_zero hb.ne' (Real.exp_ne_zero s)),
    Real.log_mul hb.ne' (Real.exp_ne_zero s), Real.log_exp] at h
  dsimp [kl]
  rw [Real.log_div ha.ne' hb.ne']
  linarith

private lemma integrable_mul_log_of_bounds
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {f : Ω → ℝ} {C : ℝ} (hf : Measurable f)
    (hf1 : ∀ x, 1 ≤ f x) (hfC : ∀ x, f x ≤ C) :
    Integrable (fun x => f x * Real.log (f x)) μ := by
  letI : Nonempty Ω := ProbabilityMeasure.nonempty ⟨μ, inferInstance⟩
  let x0 : Ω := Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty Ω)
  have hC1 : 1 ≤ C := (hf1 x0).trans (hfC x0)
  apply integrable_of_measurable_bounded (hf.mul hf.log)
  intro x
  rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans (hf1 x)),
    abs_of_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg (hf1 x))]
  exact mul_le_mul (hfC x) (Real.log_le_log (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hf1 x)) (hfC x))
    (Real.log_nonneg (hf1 x)) (zero_le_one.trans hC1)

private lemma integrable_kl_of_bounds
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {f g : Ω → ℝ} {C : ℝ} (hf : Measurable f) (hg : Measurable g)
    (hf1 : ∀ x, 1 ≤ f x) (hg1 : ∀ x, 1 ≤ g x)
    (hfC : ∀ x, f x ≤ C) (hgC : ∀ x, g x ≤ C) :
    Integrable (fun x => kl (f x) (g x)) μ := by
  letI : Nonempty Ω := ProbabilityMeasure.nonempty ⟨μ, inferInstance⟩
  let x0 : Ω := Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty Ω)
  have hC1 : 1 ≤ C := (hf1 x0).trans (hfC x0)
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := zero_le_one.trans hC1
  apply integrable_of_measurable_bounded ((hf.mul (hf.div hg).log).sub hf |>.add hg)
  intro x
  have hdivhi : f x / g x ≤ C := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hg1 x))).2
    nlinarith [hfC x, hg1 x]
  have habslog : |Real.log (f x / g x)| ≤ Real.log C := by
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor
    · rw [neg_le, ← Real.log_inv]
      apply Real.log_le_log (inv_pos.mpr (div_pos
        (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hf1 x))
        (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hg1 x))))
      rw [inv_div]
      apply (div_le_iff₀ (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hf1 x))).2
      nlinarith [hgC x, hf1 x]
    · exact Real.log_le_log (div_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hf1 x))
        (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hg1 x))) hdivhi
  have hmul : |f x * Real.log (f x / g x)| ≤ C * Real.log C := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans (hf1 x))]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hfC x) (abs_nonneg _)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left habslog hC0)
  calc
    |kl (f x) (g x)| ≤ |f x * Real.log (f x / g x)| + |f x| + |g x| := by
      dsimp [kl]
      calc
        |f x * Real.log (f x / g x) - f x + g x|
            ≤ |f x * Real.log (f x / g x) - f x| + |g x| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ |f x * Real.log (f x / g x)| + |f x| + |g x| := by
          gcongr
          exact abs_sub _ _
    _ ≤ C * Real.log C + C + C := by
      exact add_le_add
        (add_le_add hmul (by simpa [abs_of_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans (hf1 x))] using hfC x))
        (by simpa [abs_of_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans (hg1 x))] using hgC x)

private lemma integral_kl_contraction
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {f g : Ω → ℝ} {C : ℝ}
    (hf : Measurable f) (hg : Measurable g)
    (hf1 : ∀ x, 1 ≤ f x) (hg1 : ∀ x, 1 ≤ g x)
    (hfC : ∀ x, f x ≤ C) (hgC : ∀ x, g x ≤ C) :
    kl (∫ x, f x ∂μ) (∫ x, g x ∂μ) ≤ ∫ x, kl (f x) (g x) ∂μ := by
  letI : Nonempty Ω := ProbabilityMeasure.nonempty ⟨μ, inferInstance⟩
  let x0 : Ω := Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty Ω)
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := by
    exact zero_le_one.trans ((hf1 x0).trans (hfC x0))
  have hfi : Integrable f μ := integrable_of_measurable_bounded hf fun x => by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans (hf1 x))]
    exact hfC x
  have hgi : Integrable g μ := integrable_of_measurable_bounded hg fun x => by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans (hg1 x))]
    exact hgC x
  have hfpos : 0 < ∫ x, f x ∂μ := by
    have : (0 : ℝ) < ∫ _x, (1 : ℝ) ∂μ := by simp
    exact this.trans_le (integral_mono (integrable_const 1) hfi (fun x => hf1 x))
  have hgpos : 0 < ∫ x, g x ∂μ := by
    have : (0 : ℝ) < ∫ _x, (1 : ℝ) ∂μ := by simp
    exact this.trans_le (integral_mono (integrable_const 1) hgi (fun x => hg1 x))
  let s := Real.log ((∫ x, f x ∂μ) / (∫ x, g x ∂μ))
  have hpoint : ∀ x, s * f x - (Real.exp s - 1) * g x ≤ kl (f x) (g x) :=
    fun x => kl_fenchel _ _ _ (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hf1 x))
      (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hg1 x))
  have hkmeas : Measurable (fun x => kl (f x) (g x)) := by
    exact ((hf.mul (hf.div hg).log).sub hf).add hg
  have hki : Integrable (fun x => kl (f x) (g x)) μ := by
    apply integrable_of_measurable_bounded hkmeas
    intro x
    have hC1 : 1 ≤ C := (hf1 x).trans (hfC x)
    have hdivlo : 1 / C ≤ f x / g x := by
      apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hg1 x))).2
      nlinarith [hf1 x, hgC x]
    have hdivhi : f x / g x ≤ C := by
      apply (div_le_iff₀ (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hg1 x))).2
      nlinarith [hfC x, hg1 x]
    have habslog : |Real.log (f x / g x)| ≤ Real.log C := by
      rw [abs_le]
      constructor
      · rw [neg_le, ← Real.log_inv]
        apply Real.log_le_log (inv_pos.mpr (div_pos
          (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hf1 x))
          (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hg1 x))))
        rw [inv_div]
        apply (div_le_iff₀ (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hf1 x))).2
        nlinarith [hgC x, hf1 x]
      · exact Real.log_le_log (div_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hf1 x))
          (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hg1 x))) hdivhi
    have hlogC : 0 ≤ Real.log C := Real.log_nonneg hC1
    have hf0 : 0 ≤ f x := zero_le_one.trans (hf1 x)
    have hg0 : 0 ≤ g x := zero_le_one.trans (hg1 x)
    have hmul : |f x * Real.log (f x / g x)| ≤ C * Real.log C := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hf0]
      exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hfC x) (abs_nonneg _)).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left habslog hC0)
    calc
      |kl (f x) (g x)|
          ≤ |f x * Real.log (f x / g x)| + |f x| + |g x| := by
              dsimp [kl]
              calc
                |f x * Real.log (f x / g x) - f x + g x|
                    ≤ |f x * Real.log (f x / g x) - f x| + |g x| := abs_add_le _ _
                _ ≤ |f x * Real.log (f x / g x)| + |f x| + |g x| := by
                    gcongr
                    exact abs_sub _ _
      _ ≤ C * Real.log C + C + C := by
              exact add_le_add (add_le_add hmul (by simpa [abs_of_nonneg hf0] using hfC x))
                (by simpa [abs_of_nonneg hg0] using hgC x)
  have hint := integral_mono (hfi.const_mul s |>.sub (hgi.const_mul (Real.exp s - 1))) hki hpoint
  have hs_exp : Real.exp s = (∫ x, f x ∂μ) / (∫ x, g x ∂μ) := by
    dsimp [s]
    rw [Real.exp_log (div_pos hfpos hgpos)]
  have hs_log : s = Real.log (∫ x, f x ∂μ) - Real.log (∫ x, g x ∂μ) := by
    dsimp [s]
    rw [Real.log_div hfpos.ne' hgpos.ne']
  change (∫ x, s * f x - (Real.exp s - 1) * g x ∂μ) ≤ _ at hint
  rw [integral_sub (hfi.const_mul s) (hgi.const_mul (Real.exp s - 1)),
    integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul] at hint
  rw [kl, Real.log_div hfpos.ne' hgpos.ne']
  calc
    (∫ x, f x ∂μ) * (Real.log (∫ x, f x ∂μ) - Real.log (∫ x, g x ∂μ)) -
          (∫ x, f x ∂μ) + ∫ x, g x ∂μ
        = s * (∫ x, f x ∂μ) -
            (((∫ x, f x ∂μ) / (∫ x, g x ∂μ)) - 1) * (∫ x, g x ∂μ) := by
              rw [hs_log]
              field_simp
              <;> ring
    _ ≤ ∫ x, kl (f x) (g x) ∂μ := by
          simpa only [hs_exp] using hint

private lemma entropy_le_integral_kl_const
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {f : Ω → ℝ} {a C : ℝ}
    (hf : Measurable f) (hf1 : ∀ x, 1 ≤ f x) (hfC : ∀ x, f x ≤ C)
    (ha : 0 < a) :
    entropy μ f ≤ ∫ x, kl (f x) a ∂μ := by
  letI : Nonempty Ω := ProbabilityMeasure.nonempty ⟨μ, inferInstance⟩
  let x0 : Ω := Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty Ω)
  have hC1 : 1 ≤ C := (hf1 x0).trans (hfC x0)
  have hfi : Integrable f μ := integrable_of_measurable_bounded hf fun x => by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans (hf1 x))]
    exact hfC x
  have hflog : Integrable (fun x => f x * Real.log (f x)) μ := by
    apply integrable_of_measurable_bounded (hf.mul hf.log)
    intro x
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans (hf1 x)),
      abs_of_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg (hf1 x))]
    exact mul_le_mul (hfC x) (Real.log_le_log (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hf1 x)) (hfC x))
      (Real.log_nonneg (hf1 x)) (zero_le_one.trans hC1)
  have hmeanpos : 0 < ∫ x, f x ∂μ := by
    have h : (0 : ℝ) < ∫ _x, (1 : ℝ) ∂μ := by simp
    exact h.trans_le (integral_mono (integrable_const 1) hfi hf1)
  have hscalar := kl_nonneg hmeanpos ha
  have hrewrite :
      (∫ x, kl (f x) a ∂μ) = entropy μ f + kl (∫ x, f x ∂μ) a := by
    simp_rw [kl, Real.log_div (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hf1 _)).ne' ha.ne',
      mul_sub, mul_comm (f _) (Real.log a)]
    have hlogmul : Integrable (fun x => Real.log a * f x) μ := hfi.const_mul _
    have hfirst : Integrable (fun x => f x * Real.log (f x) - Real.log a * f x) μ :=
      hflog.sub hlogmul
    have hleft : Integrable
        (fun x => f x * Real.log (f x) - Real.log a * f x - f x) μ := hfirst.sub hfi
    rw [integral_add hleft (integrable_const a), integral_sub hfirst hfi,
      integral_sub hflog hlogmul, integral_const_mul, integral_const]
    simp only [measureReal_univ_eq_one, one_smul]
    rw [entropy, Real.log_div hmeanpos.ne' ha.ne']
    ring
  rw [hrewrite]
  linarith

private lemma entropy_prod_eq
    {Ω₁ Ω₂ : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω₁] [MeasurableSpace Ω₂]
    (μ : Measure Ω₁) (ν : Measure Ω₂) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    {f : Ω₁ × Ω₂ → ℝ} {C : ℝ}
    (hf : Measurable f) (hf1 : ∀ x, 1 ≤ f x) (hfC : ∀ x, f x ≤ C) :
    entropy (μ.prod ν) f =
      (∫ y, entropy μ (fun x => f (x, y)) ∂ν) +
        entropy ν (fun y => ∫ x, f (x, y) ∂μ) := by
  letI : Nonempty Ω₁ := ProbabilityMeasure.nonempty ⟨μ, inferInstance⟩
  letI : Nonempty Ω₂ := ProbabilityMeasure.nonempty ⟨ν, inferInstance⟩
  let z0 : Ω₁ × Ω₂ :=
    (Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty Ω₁),
      Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty Ω₂))
  have hC1 : 1 ≤ C := (hf1 z0).trans (hfC z0)
  have hfi : Integrable f (μ.prod ν) := integrable_of_measurable_bounded hf fun z => by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans (hf1 z))]
    exact hfC z
  have hflog : Integrable (fun z => f z * Real.log (f z)) (μ.prod ν) := by
    apply integrable_of_measurable_bounded (hf.mul hf.log)
    intro z
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans (hf1 z)),
      abs_of_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg (hf1 z))]
    exact mul_le_mul (hfC z) (Real.log_le_log (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hf1 z)) (hfC z))
      (Real.log_nonneg (hf1 z)) (zero_le_one.trans hC1)
  let m : Ω₂ → ℝ := fun y => ∫ x, f (x, y) ∂μ
  have hm_meas : Measurable m := by
    exact hf.stronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_left'.measurable
  have hm1 : ∀ y, 1 ≤ m y := by
    intro y
    have hsec : Integrable (fun x => f (x, y)) μ :=
      integrable_of_measurable_bounded (hf.comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)) fun x => by
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans (hf1 (x, y)))]
        exact hfC (x, y)
    simpa [m] using integral_mono (integrable_const 1) hsec (fun x => hf1 (x, y))
  have hmC : ∀ y, m y ≤ C := by
    intro y
    have hsec : Integrable (fun x => f (x, y)) μ :=
      integrable_of_measurable_bounded (hf.comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)) fun x => by
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans (hf1 (x, y)))]
        exact hfC (x, y)
    simpa [m] using integral_mono hsec (integrable_const C) (fun x => hfC (x, y))
  have hmi : Integrable m ν := integrable_of_measurable_bounded hm_meas fun y => by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans (hm1 y))]
    exact hmC y
  have hmlog : Integrable (fun y => m y * Real.log (m y)) ν := by
    apply integrable_of_measurable_bounded (hm_meas.mul hm_meas.log)
    intro y
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans (hm1 y)),
      abs_of_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg (hm1 y))]
    exact mul_le_mul (hmC y) (Real.log_le_log (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hm1 y)) (hmC y))
      (Real.log_nonneg (hm1 y)) (zero_le_one.trans hC1)
  have hinnerlog : Integrable (fun y => ∫ x, f (x, y) * Real.log (f (x, y)) ∂μ) ν :=
    hflog.integral_prod_right
  simp_rw [entropy]
  rw [integral_sub hinnerlog hmlog]
  change (∫ z, f z * Real.log (f z) ∂μ.prod ν) -
      (∫ z, f z ∂μ.prod ν) * Real.log (∫ z, f z ∂μ.prod ν) =
    ((∫ y, ∫ x, f (x, y) * Real.log (f (x, y)) ∂μ ∂ν) -
      ∫ y, m y * Real.log (m y) ∂ν) +
    ((∫ y, m y * Real.log (m y) ∂ν) -
      (∫ y, m y ∂ν) * Real.log (∫ y, m y ∂ν))
  rw [← integral_prod_symm _ hflog, ← integral_prod_symm _ hfi]
  ring

private lemma entropy_comp_equiv
    {Ω Ω' : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Ω']
    {μ : Measure Ω} {ν : Measure Ω'} (e : Ω ≃ᵐ Ω')
    (he : MeasurePreserving e μ ν) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    entropy ν (f ∘ e.symm) = entropy μ f := by
  rw [entropy, entropy]
  change (∫ x, (fun y => f y * Real.log (f y)) (e.symm x) ∂ν) -
      (∫ x, f (e.symm x) ∂ν) * Real.log (∫ x, f (e.symm x) ∂ν) = _
  have hq : (∫ x, (fun y => f y * Real.log (f y)) (e.symm x) ∂ν) =
      ∫ y, f y * Real.log (f y) ∂μ :=
        he.symm.integral_comp' (fun y : Ω => f y * Real.log (f y))
  have hfm : (∫ x, f (e.symm x) ∂ν) = ∫ y, f y ∂μ :=
    he.symm.integral_comp' (fun y : Ω => f y)
  rw [hq, hfm]

private lemma entropy_pi_le_sum_kl
    {n : ℕ} {α : Fin n → Type*} [∀ i, MeasurableSpace (α i)]
    (μ : ∀ i, Measure (α i)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    {g : (∀ i, α i) → ℝ} {a : Fin n → (∀ i, α i) → ℝ} {C : ℝ}
    (hg : Measurable g) (ha : ∀ i, Measurable (a i))
    (hg1 : ∀ ω, 1 ≤ g ω) (hgC : ∀ ω, g ω ≤ C)
    (ha1 : ∀ i ω, 1 ≤ a i ω) (haC : ∀ i ω, a i ω ≤ C)
    (hainv : ∀ i ω x, a i (Function.update ω i x) = a i ω) :
    entropy (Measure.pi μ) g ≤
      ∫ ω, ∑ i, kl (g ω) (a i ω) ∂Measure.pi μ := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      have hgconst : g = fun _ => g default := by
        funext x
        congr 1
        ext i
        exact Fin.elim0 i
      rw [hgconst]
      simp only [Finset.univ_eq_empty, Finset.sum_empty, integral_zero]
      simp only [entropy, integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul, sub_self]
      exact le_rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      let β := fun j : Fin n => α j.succ
      let ν : Measure (∀ j, β j) := Measure.pi (fun j => μ j.succ)
      let e : (∀ i, α i) ≃ᵐ α 0 × (∀ j, β j) := MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove α 0
      let G : α 0 × (∀ j, β j) → ℝ := fun p => g (e.symm p)
      let A0 : α 0 × (∀ j, β j) → ℝ := fun p => a 0 (e.symm p)
      let Ar : Fin n → α 0 × (∀ j, β j) → ℝ :=
        fun j p => a j.succ (e.symm p)
      let m : (∀ j, β j) → ℝ := fun y => ∫ x, G (x, y) ∂μ 0
      let b : Fin n → (∀ j, β j) → ℝ :=
        fun j y => ∫ x, Ar j (x, y) ∂μ 0
      have he : MeasurePreserving e (Measure.pi μ) ((μ 0).prod ν) := by
        simpa [e, ν, β] using measurePreserving_piFinSuccAbove μ 0
      have he_cons (x : α 0) (y : ∀ j, β j) : e.symm (x, y) = Fin.cons x y := by
        change (MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove α 0).symm (x, y) = Fin.cons x y
        rw [MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_symm_apply]
        ext i
        refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> simp
      have hA0_const (x x' : α 0) (y : ∀ j, β j) : A0 (x, y) = A0 (x', y) := by
        dsimp [A0]
        rw [he_cons, he_cons]
        simpa only [Fin.update_cons_zero] using hainv 0 (Fin.cons x' y) x
      have hG : Measurable G := hg.comp e.symm.measurable
      have hA0 : Measurable A0 := (ha 0).comp e.symm.measurable
      have hAr : ∀ j, Measurable (Ar j) := fun j => (ha j.succ).comp e.symm.measurable
      have hG1 : ∀ p, 1 ≤ G p := fun p => hg1 (e.symm p)
      have hGC : ∀ p, G p ≤ C := fun p => hgC (e.symm p)
      have hA01 : ∀ p, 1 ≤ A0 p := fun p => ha1 0 (e.symm p)
      have hA0C : ∀ p, A0 p ≤ C := fun p => haC 0 (e.symm p)
      have hAr1 : ∀ j p, 1 ≤ Ar j p := fun j p => ha1 j.succ (e.symm p)
      have hArC : ∀ j p, Ar j p ≤ C := fun j p => haC j.succ (e.symm p)
      have hm_meas : Measurable m := hG.stronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_left'.measurable
      have hb_meas : ∀ j, Measurable (b j) :=
        fun j => (hAr j).stronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_left'.measurable
      have hm1 : ∀ y, 1 ≤ m y := by
        intro y
        have hi : Integrable (fun x => G (x, y)) (μ 0) :=
          integrable_of_measurable_bounded
            (hG.comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)) fun x => by
              rw [abs_of_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans (hG1 (x, y)))]
              exact hGC (x, y)
        simpa [m] using integral_mono (integrable_const 1) hi (fun x => hG1 (x, y))
      have hmC : ∀ y, m y ≤ C := by
        intro y
        have hi : Integrable (fun x => G (x, y)) (μ 0) :=
          integrable_of_measurable_bounded
            (hG.comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)) fun x => by
              rw [abs_of_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans (hG1 (x, y)))]
              exact hGC (x, y)
        simpa [m] using integral_mono hi (integrable_const C) (fun x => hGC (x, y))
      have hb1 : ∀ j y, 1 ≤ b j y := by
        intro j y
        have hi : Integrable (fun x => Ar j (x, y)) (μ 0) :=
          integrable_of_measurable_bounded
            ((hAr j).comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)) fun x => by
              rw [abs_of_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans (hAr1 j (x, y)))]
              exact hArC j (x, y)
        simpa [b] using integral_mono (integrable_const 1) hi (fun x => hAr1 j (x, y))
      have hbC : ∀ j y, b j y ≤ C := by
        intro j y
        have hi : Integrable (fun x => Ar j (x, y)) (μ 0) :=
          integrable_of_measurable_bounded
            ((hAr j).comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)) fun x => by
              rw [abs_of_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans (hAr1 j (x, y)))]
              exact hArC j (x, y)
        simpa [b] using integral_mono hi (integrable_const C) (fun x => hArC j (x, y))
      have hb_inv : ∀ j y x, b j (Function.update y j x) = b j y := by
        intro j y x
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [] with x0
        dsimp [b, Ar]
        rw [he_cons, he_cons, Fin.cons_update]
        exact hainv j.succ (Fin.cons x0 y) x
      have hrest := ih (μ := fun j => μ j.succ) (g := m) (a := b)
        hm_meas hb_meas hm1 hmC hb1 hbC hb_inv
      have hfirst :
          ∫ y, entropy (μ 0) (fun x => G (x, y)) ∂ν ≤
            ∫ p, kl (G p) (A0 p) ∂((μ 0).prod ν) := by
        let xref : α 0 := (ProbabilityMeasure.nonempty ⟨μ 0, inferInstance⟩).some
        have hpoint (y : ∀ j, β j) :
            entropy (μ 0) (fun x => G (x, y)) ≤
              ∫ x, kl (G (x, y)) (A0 (x, y)) ∂μ 0 := by
          calc
            entropy (μ 0) (fun x => G (x, y)) ≤
                ∫ x, kl (G (x, y)) (A0 (xref, y)) ∂μ 0 :=
              entropy_le_integral_kl_const (μ 0)
                (hG.comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const))
                (fun x => hG1 (x, y)) (fun x => hGC (x, y))
                (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hA01 (xref, y)))
            _ = ∫ x, kl (G (x, y)) (A0 (x, y)) ∂μ 0 := by
              apply integral_congr_ae
              filter_upwards [] with x
              rw [hA0_const xref x y]
        have hGlog : Integrable (fun p => G p * Real.log (G p)) ((μ 0).prod ν) :=
          integrable_mul_log_of_bounds ((μ 0).prod ν) hG hG1 hGC
        have hmlog : Integrable (fun y => m y * Real.log (m y)) ν :=
          integrable_mul_log_of_bounds ν hm_meas hm1 hmC
        have hent : Integrable (fun y => entropy (μ 0) (fun x => G (x, y))) ν := by
          simpa only [entropy, m] using hGlog.integral_prod_right.sub hmlog
        have hK : Integrable (fun p => kl (G p) (A0 p)) ((μ 0).prod ν) :=
          integrable_kl_of_bounds ((μ 0).prod ν) hG hA0 hG1 hA01 hGC hA0C
        have hmono := integral_mono hent hK.integral_prod_right hpoint
        rw [← integral_prod_symm _ hK] at hmono
        exact hmono
      have hcontract :
          (∫ y, ∑ j, kl (m y) (b j y) ∂ν) ≤
            ∫ p, ∑ j, kl (G p) (Ar j p) ∂((μ 0).prod ν) := by
        have hsecG (y : ∀ j, β j) : Measurable (fun x => G (x, y)) :=
          hG.comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)
        have hsecAr (j : Fin n) (y : ∀ j, β j) : Measurable (fun x => Ar j (x, y)) :=
          (hAr j).comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)
        have hKsec (j : Fin n) (y : ∀ j, β j) :
            Integrable (fun x => kl (G (x, y)) (Ar j (x, y))) (μ 0) :=
          integrable_kl_of_bounds (μ 0) (hsecG y) (hsecAr j y)
            (fun x => hG1 (x, y)) (fun x => hAr1 j (x, y))
            (fun x => hGC (x, y)) (fun x => hArC j (x, y))
        have hpoint (y : ∀ j, β j) :
            (∑ j, kl (m y) (b j y)) ≤
              ∫ x, ∑ j, kl (G (x, y)) (Ar j (x, y)) ∂μ 0 := by
          calc
            (∑ j, kl (m y) (b j y)) ≤
                ∑ j, ∫ x, kl (G (x, y)) (Ar j (x, y)) ∂μ 0 := by
              apply Finset.sum_le_sum
              intro j _
              simpa only [m, b] using integral_kl_contraction (μ 0)
                (hsecG y) (hsecAr j y) (fun x => hG1 (x, y))
                (fun x => hAr1 j (x, y)) (fun x => hGC (x, y))
                (fun x => hArC j (x, y))
            _ = ∫ x, ∑ j, kl (G (x, y)) (Ar j (x, y)) ∂μ 0 := by
              symm
              exact integral_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun j _ => hKsec j y)
        have hL : Integrable (fun y => ∑ j, kl (m y) (b j y)) ν :=
          integrable_finset_sum Finset.univ fun j _ =>
            integrable_kl_of_bounds ν hm_meas (hb_meas j) hm1 (hb1 j) hmC (hbC j)
        have hPj (j : Fin n) :
            Integrable (fun p => kl (G p) (Ar j p)) ((μ 0).prod ν) :=
          integrable_kl_of_bounds ((μ 0).prod ν) hG (hAr j) hG1 (hAr1 j) hGC (hArC j)
        have hP : Integrable (fun p => ∑ j, kl (G p) (Ar j p)) ((μ 0).prod ν) :=
          integrable_finset_sum Finset.univ fun j _ => hPj j
        have hmono := integral_mono hL hP.integral_prod_right hpoint
        rw [← integral_prod_symm _ hP] at hmono
        exact hmono
      rw [← entropy_comp_equiv e he g]
      calc
        entropy ((μ 0).prod ν) G
            = (∫ y, entropy (μ 0) (fun x => G (x, y)) ∂ν) + entropy ν m :=
                entropy_prod_eq (μ 0) ν hG hG1 hGC
        _ ≤ (∫ p, kl (G p) (A0 p) ∂((μ 0).prod ν)) +
              (∫ y, ∑ j, kl (m y) (b j y) ∂ν) := add_le_add hfirst hrest
        _ ≤ (∫ p, kl (G p) (A0 p) ∂((μ 0).prod ν)) +
              (∫ p, ∑ j, kl (G p) (Ar j p) ∂((μ 0).prod ν)) :=
                add_le_add le_rfl hcontract
        _ = ∫ p, ∑ i, kl (G p) (a i (e.symm p)) ∂((μ 0).prod ν) := by
              have hK0 : Integrable (fun p => kl (G p) (A0 p)) ((μ 0).prod ν) :=
                integrable_kl_of_bounds ((μ 0).prod ν) hG hA0 hG1 hA01 hGC hA0C
              have hKr : Integrable (fun p => ∑ j, kl (G p) (Ar j p)) ((μ 0).prod ν) :=
                integrable_finset_sum Finset.univ fun j _ =>
                  integrable_kl_of_bounds ((μ 0).prod ν) hG (hAr j) hG1 (hAr1 j)
                    hGC (hArC j)
              rw [← integral_add hK0 hKr]
              apply integral_congr_ae
              filter_upwards [] with p
              rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
        _ = ∫ ω, ∑ i, kl (g ω) (a i ω) ∂Measure.pi μ := by
              rw [← he.integral_comp']
              simp only [G, MeasurableEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

private lemma exp_chord (t d : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hd0 : 0 ≤ d) (hd1 : d ≤ 1) :
    Real.exp (-t * d) + t * d - 1 ≤ d * (Real.exp (-t) + t - 1) := by
  have he : Real.exp (-t * d) ≤ (1 - d) * Real.exp 0 + d * Real.exp (-t) := by
    convert convexOn_exp.2 (Set.mem_univ (0 : ℝ)) (Set.mem_univ (-t))
      (sub_nonneg.mpr hd1) hd0 (by ring) using 1 <;> simp only [smul_eq_mul] <;> ring
  calc
    Real.exp (-t * d) + t * d - 1 ≤
        ((1 - d) * Real.exp 0 + d * Real.exp (-t)) + t * d - 1 := by linarith
    _ = d * (Real.exp (-t) + t - 1) := by rw [Real.exp_zero]; ring

private lemma kl_exp_eq (A B : ℝ) :
    kl (Real.exp A) (Real.exp B) =
      Real.exp A * (Real.exp (B - A) + (A - B) - 1) := by
  rw [kl, ← Real.exp_sub, Real.log_exp]
  have he : Real.exp B = Real.exp A * Real.exp (B - A) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [he]
  ring

private lemma entropy_exp_selfBounded
    {n : ℕ} {α : Fin n → Type*} [∀ i, MeasurableSpace (α i)]
    (μ : ∀ i, Measure (α i)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    {Z : (∀ i, α i) → ℝ} {Zi : Fin n → (∀ i, α i) → ℝ} {B t : ℝ}
    (hZmeas : Measurable Z) (hZimeas : ∀ i, Measurable (Zi i))
    (hZ0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ Z ω) (hZB : ∀ ω, Z ω ≤ B)
    (hZi0 : ∀ i ω, 0 ≤ Zi i ω) (hZiB : ∀ i ω, Zi i ω ≤ B)
    (hZiinv : ∀ i ω x, Zi i (Function.update ω i x) = Zi i ω)
    (hd0 : ∀ i ω, 0 ≤ Z ω - Zi i ω)
    (hd1 : ∀ i ω, Z ω - Zi i ω ≤ 1)
    (hsum : ∀ ω, (∑ i, (Z ω - Zi i ω)) ≤ Z ω)
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    entropy (Measure.pi μ) (fun ω => Real.exp (t * Z ω)) ≤
      (Real.exp (-t) + t - 1) *
        ∫ ω, Z ω * Real.exp (t * Z ω) ∂Measure.pi μ := by
  let g : (∀ i, α i) → ℝ := fun ω => Real.exp (t * Z ω)
  let a : Fin n → (∀ i, α i) → ℝ := fun i ω => Real.exp (t * Zi i ω)
  let C : ℝ := Real.exp (t * B)
  have hg : Measurable g := (hZmeas.const_mul t).exp
  have ha : ∀ i, Measurable (a i) := fun i => ((hZimeas i).const_mul t).exp
  have hg1 : ∀ ω, 1 ≤ g ω := fun ω => by
    rw [← Real.exp_zero]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_nonneg ht (hZ0 ω))
  have hgC : ∀ ω, g ω ≤ C := fun ω => Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hZB ω) ht)
  have ha1 : ∀ i ω, 1 ≤ a i ω := fun i ω => by
    rw [← Real.exp_zero]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_nonneg ht (hZi0 i ω))
  have haC : ∀ i ω, a i ω ≤ C := fun i ω => Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hZiB i ω) ht)
  have hainv : ∀ i ω x, a i (Function.update ω i x) = a i ω := by
    intro i ω x
    dsimp [a]
    rw [hZiinv]
  have hent := entropy_pi_le_sum_kl μ hg ha hg1 hgC ha1 haC hainv
  let c : ℝ := Real.exp (-t) + t - 1
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := by

  have hK : Integrable (fun ω => ∑ i, kl (g ω) (a i ω)) (Measure.pi μ) :=

private lemma cgf_selfBounded_le
    {n : ℕ} {α : Fin n → Type*} [∀ i, MeasurableSpace (α i)]
    (μ : ∀ i, Measure (α i)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    {Z : (∀ i, α i) → ℝ} {Zi : Fin n → (∀ i, α i) → ℝ} {B : ℝ}
    (hZmeas : Measurable Z) (hZimeas : ∀ i, Measurable (Zi i))
    (hZ0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ Z ω) (hZB : ∀ ω, Z ω ≤ B)
    (hZi0 : ∀ i ω, 0 ≤ Zi i ω) (hZiB : ∀ i ω, Zi i ω ≤ B)
    (hZiinv : ∀ i ω x, Zi i (Function.update ω i x) = Zi i ω)
    (hd0 : ∀ i ω, 0 ≤ Z ω - Zi i ω)
    (hd1 : ∀ i ω, Z ω - Zi i ω ≤ 1)
    (hsum : ∀ ω, (∑ i, (Z ω - Zi i ω)) ≤ Z ω)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ProbabilityTheory.cgf Z (Measure.pi μ) t ≤
      (∫ ω, Z ω ∂Measure.pi μ) * (Real.exp t - 1) := by
  let P : Measure (∀ i, α i) := Measure.pi μ
  let ψ : ℝ → ℝ := ProbabilityTheory.cgf Z P
  let v : ℝ := ∫ ω, Z ω ∂P
  have hP : IsProbabilityMeasure P := by dsimp [P]; infer_instance
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure P := hP
  letI : Nonempty (∀ i, α i) := ProbabilityMeasure.nonempty ⟨P, inferInstance⟩
  let ω0 : ∀ i, α i := Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty (∀ i, α i))
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := (hZ0 ω0).trans (hZB ω0)
  have hexp (s : ℝ) : Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (s * Z ω)) P := by
    apply integrable_of_measurable_bounded (hZmeas.const_mul s |>.exp)
    intro ω
    rw [abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    calc
      s * Z ω ≤ |s| * Z ω := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self s) (hZ0 ω)
      _ ≤ |s| * B := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hZB ω) (abs_nonneg s)
  have hExpSet : ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet Z P = Set.univ := by
    ext s
    simp only [ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
    exact hexp s
  have hinter (s : ℝ) : s ∈ interior (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet Z P) := by
    simp [hExpSet]
  have hmgfpos (s : ℝ) : 0 < ProbabilityTheory.mgf Z P s :=
    ProbabilityTheory.mgf_pos (hexp s)
  have hψ0 : ψ 0 = 0 := by simp [ψ]
  have hderivψ (s : ℝ) :
      deriv ψ s = (∫ ω, Z ω * Real.exp (s * Z ω) ∂P) /
        ProbabilityTheory.mgf Z P s := by
    simpa [ψ] using ProbabilityTheory.deriv_cgf (hinter s)
  have hdiff (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
      (1 - Real.exp (-s)) * deriv ψ s ≤ ψ s := by
    have hent := entropy_exp_selfBounded μ hZmeas hZimeas hZ0 hZB hZi0 hZiB
      hZiinv hd0 hd1 hsum hs
    let I : ℝ := ∫ ω, Z ω * Real.exp (s * Z ω) ∂P
    let F : ℝ := ProbabilityTheory.mgf Z P s
    have hent_eq :
        entropy P (fun ω => Real.exp (s * Z ω)) = s * I - F * ψ s := by
      rw [entropy]
      have hfun : (fun ω => Real.exp (s * Z ω) * Real.log (Real.exp (s * Z ω))) =
          fun ω => s * (Z ω * Real.exp (s * Z ω)) := by
        funext ω
        rw [Real.log_exp]
        ring
      rw [hfun, integral_const_mul]
      rfl
    have hraw : (1 - Real.exp (-s)) * I ≤ F * ψ s := by
      rw [hent_eq] at hent
      dsimp [I, F] at hent ⊢
      linarith
    rw [hderivψ]
    change (1 - Real.exp (-s)) * (I / F) ≤ ψ s
    rw [← mul_div_assoc]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (hmgfpos s)).2
    simpa [mul_comm] using hraw
  let q : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => ψ s / (Real.exp s - 1)
  have hq_deriv (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) : deriv q s ≤ 0 := by
    have hψder : HasDerivAt ψ (deriv ψ s) s :=
      (ProbabilityTheory.analyticAt_cgf (hinter s)).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
    have hden : Real.exp s - 1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt (Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr hs))
    have hqder := hψder.div ((Real.hasDerivAt_exp s).sub_const 1) hden
    have hnum : deriv ψ s * (Real.exp s - 1) - ψ s * Real.exp s ≤ 0 := by
      have hd := hdiff s hs.le
      have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd (Real.exp_pos s).le
      have he : Real.exp s * (1 - Real.exp (-s)) = Real.exp s - 1 := by
        rw [mul_sub, mul_one, ← Real.exp_add]
        simp
      apply sub_nonpos.mpr
      calc
        deriv ψ s * (Real.exp s - 1) =
            Real.exp s * ((1 - Real.exp (-s)) * deriv ψ s) := by
              rw [← he]
              ring
        _ ≤ Real.exp s * ψ s := hm
        _ = ψ s * Real.exp s := by ring
    change deriv (ψ / fun x => Real.exp x - 1) s ≤ 0
    rw [hqder.deriv]
    exact div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hnum (sq_nonneg _)
  have hq_diff : DifferentiableOn ℝ q (Set.Ioi 0) := by
    intro s hs
    have hψd : HasDerivAt ψ (deriv ψ s) s :=
      (ProbabilityTheory.analyticAt_cgf (hinter s)).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
    have hdend : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => Real.exp r - 1) (Real.exp s) s :=
      (Real.hasDerivAt_exp s).sub_const 1
    have hquot := hψd.div hdend
      (sub_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt (Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr hs)))
    exact hquot.hasDerivWithinAt.differentiableWithinAt
  have hq_anti : AntitoneOn q (Set.Ioi 0) := by
    apply antitoneOn_of_deriv_nonpos (convex_Ioi 0) hq_diff.continuousOn
    · simpa using hq_diff
    intro s hs
    exact hq_deriv s (interior_subset hs)
  have hψder0 : HasDerivAt ψ v 0 := by
    have h := (ProbabilityTheory.analyticAt_cgf (hinter 0)).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
    rw [ProbabilityTheory.deriv_cgf_zero (hinter 0)] at h
    simpa [v] using h
  have hden0 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp s - 1) 1 0 := by
    simpa using (Real.hasDerivAt_exp 0).sub_const 1
  have hnum_lim : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => s⁻¹ * ψ s)
      (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds v) := by
    simpa [hψ0, smul_eq_mul] using hψder0.tendsto_slope_zero_right
  have hden_lim : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => s⁻¹ * (Real.exp s - 1))
      (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 1) := by
    simpa [smul_eq_mul] using hden0.tendsto_slope_zero_right
  have hq_lim : Tendsto q (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds v) := by
    have hratio := hnum_lim.div hden_lim (by norm_num)
    have hratio' : Tendsto
        ((fun s : ℝ => s⁻¹ * ψ s) / fun s => s⁻¹ * (Real.exp s - 1))
        (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds v) := by
      simpa using hratio
    apply hratio'.congr'
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs
    dsimp [q]
    have hs' : 0 < s := hs
    have hsne : s ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hs'
    have hene : Real.exp s - 1 ≠ 0 :=
      sub_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt (Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr hs'))
    field_simp [hsne, hene]
  rcases ht.eq_or_lt with rfl | htpos
  · simp [ψ]
  have hqt : q t ≤ v := by
    apply ge_of_tendsto hq_lim
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin,
      (eventually_lt_nhds htpos).filter_mono inf_le_left] with s hs0 hst
    exact hq_anti hs0 htpos hst.le
  have hdenpos : 0 < Real.exp t - 1 := sub_pos.mpr (Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr htpos)
  change ψ t ≤ v * (Real.exp t - 1)
  exact (div_le_iff₀ hdenpos).1 hqt

noncomputable def bennettH (u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 + u) * Real.log (1 + u) - u

private lemma bennett_tail_of_cgf
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    {Z : Ω → ℝ}
    (hexp : ∀ t : ℝ, Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * Z ω)) P)
    {v : ℝ}
    (hcgf : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
      ProbabilityTheory.cgf Z P t ≤ v * (Real.exp t - 1))
    (hv : 0 < v) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    P.real {ω | v + x ≤ Z ω} ≤
      Real.exp (-v * bennettH (x / v)) := by
  let u : ℝ := x / v
  let t : ℝ := Real.log (1 + u)
  have hvne : v ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hv
  have hu : 0 ≤ u := by
    dsimp [u]
    exact div_nonneg hx hv.le
  have h1u : 0 < 1 + u := by linarith
  have ht : 0 ≤ t := by
    dsimp [t]
    exact Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hchernoff := ProbabilityTheory.measure_ge_le_exp_cgf
    (X := Z) (μ := P) (t := t) (v + x) ht (hexp t)
  calc
    P.real {ω | v + x ≤ Z ω} ≤
        Real.exp (-t * (v + x) + ProbabilityTheory.cgf Z P t) := hchernoff
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-t * (v + x) + v * (Real.exp t - 1)) := by
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith [hcgf t ht])
    _ = Real.exp (-v * bennettH (x / v)) := by
      congr 1
      have hvx : x = v * u := by
        dsimp [u]
        field_simp [hvne]
      rw [show Real.exp t = 1 + u by
        dsimp [t]
        exact Real.exp_log h1u]
      change -t * (v + x) + v * ((1 + u) - 1) = -v * bennettH u
      rw [hvx]
      simp only [bennettH]
      dsimp [t]
      ring

private lemma bennett_tail_selfBounded
    {n : ℕ} {α : Fin n → Type*} [∀ i, MeasurableSpace (α i)]
    (μ : ∀ i, Measure (α i)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]

    (hZiinv : ∀ i ω x, Zi i (Function.update ω i x) = Zi i ω)
    (hd0 : ∀ i ω, 0 ≤ Z ω - Zi i ω)
    (hd1 : ∀ i ω, Z ω - Zi i ω ≤ 1)
    (hsum : ∀ ω, (∑ i, (Z ω - Zi i ω)) ≤ Z ω)
    (hv : 0 < ∫ ω, Z ω ∂Measure.pi μ)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    (Measure.pi μ).real
        {ω | (∫ ω, Z ω ∂Measure.pi μ) + x ≤ Z ω} ≤
      Real.exp (-(∫ ω, Z ω ∂Measure.pi μ) *
        bennettH (x / (∫ ω, Z ω ∂Measure.pi μ))) := by
  let P : Measure (∀ i, α i) := Measure.pi μ
  have hP : IsProbabilityMeasure P := by dsimp [P]; infer_instance
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure P := hP
  letI : Nonempty (∀ i, α i) := ProbabilityMeasure.nonempty ⟨P, inferInstance⟩
  let ω0 : ∀ i, α i := Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty (∀ i, α i))
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := (hZ0 ω0).trans (hZB ω0)
  have hexp (t : ℝ) : Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * Z ω)) P := by
    apply integrable_of_measurable_bounded (hZmeas.const_mul t |>.exp)
    intro ω
    rw [abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    calc
      t * Z ω ≤ |t| * Z ω :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self t) (hZ0 ω)

        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hZB ω) (abs_nonneg t)
  apply bennett_tail_of_cgf P hexp (v := ∫ ω, Z ω ∂Measure.pi μ) ?_ hv hx
  intro t ht
  exact cgf_selfBounded_le μ hZmeas hZimeas hZ0 hZB hZi0 hZiB hZiinv
    hd0 hd1 hsum ht

theorem ch41_theorem_41_2

(i.e. if the inequality holds, then it holds with averaging over one of the copies)

nl_proof:
First, note that \(\begin{array}{ r }{\sqrt{a b}=\operatorname*{inf}_{\delta>0}(\delta a+\frac{b}{4\delta})}\end{array}\) with \(\begin{array}{ r }{\delta_{*}=\sqrt{\frac{b}{4 a}}}\end{array}\) achieving the infima. Hence,
\[\begin{array}{ c }{{\{\varphi_{1}\geq\varphi_{2}+\sqrt{\varphi_{3}t}\}=\{\exists\delta>0,\varphi_{1}\geq\varphi_{2}+\delta\varphi_{3}+\displaystyle\frac{t}{4\delta}\}}}\\ {{=\{\exists\delta>0,(\varphi_{1}-\varphi_{2}-\delta\varphi_{3})4\delta\geq t\}}}\\ {{=\{\underbrace{\operatorname*{sup}_{\delta>0}(\varphi_{1}-\varphi_{2}-\delta\varphi_{3})4\delta}_{\nu}\geq t\}}}\end{array}\]
and similarly
\[\big\{\mathbb{E}_{x^{\prime}}\varphi_{1}\geq\mathbb{E}_{x^{\prime}}\varphi_{2}+\sqrt{\mathbb{E}_{x^{\prime}}\varphi_{3}t}\big\}=\underbrace{\{\operatorname*{sup}_{\delta>0}(\mathbb{E}_{x^{\prime}}\varphi_{1}-\mathbb{E}_{x^{\prime}}\varphi_{2}-\delta\mathbb{E}_{x^{\prime}}\varphi_{3})4\delta\geq t\}}_{\xi}.\]
By assumption, \(\mathbb{P}\left(\nu\geq t\right)\leq\Gamma e^{-\gamma t}\) . We want to prove \(\mathbb{P}\left(\xi\geq t\right)\leq\Gamma\cdot e\cdot e^{-\gamma t}\) . By the previous lemma, we only need to check whether \(\mathbb{E}\phi(\xi)\le\mathbb{E}\phi(\nu)\)
\[\begin{array}{ l }{\displaystyle\xi=\operatorname*{sup}_{\delta>0}\mathbb{E}_{x^{\prime}}(\varphi_{1}-\varphi_{2}-\delta\varphi_{3})4\delta}\\ {\displaystyle\quad\leq\mathbb{E}_{x^{\prime}}\operatorname*{sup}_{\delta>0}(\varphi_{1}-\varphi_{2}-\delta\varphi_{3})4\delta}\\ {\displaystyle=\mathbb{E}_{x^{\prime}}\nu}\end{array}\]
Thus,
\[\phi(\xi)\leq\phi(\mathbb{E}_{x^{\prime}}\nu)\leq\mathbb{E}_{x^{\prime}}\phi(\nu)\]
by Jensen's inequality (\(\phi\) is convex). Hence,
\[\mathbb{E}\phi(\xi)\le\mathbb{E}\mathbb{E}_{x^{\prime}}\phi(\nu)=\mathbb{E}\phi(\nu).\]

import Mathlib

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Real ENNReal NNReal

namespace GraduateLevel

private lemma ofReal_max_zero (a : ℝ) : ENNReal.ofReal (max a 0) = ENNReal.ofReal a := by
  rcases le_or_lt a 0 with h | h
  · rw [max_eq_right h, ENNReal.ofReal_zero, (ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero).2 h]
  · rw [max_eq_left h.le]

private lemma sqrt_amgm {a s δ : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    Real.sqrt (a * s) ≤ δ * a + s / (4 * δ) := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA0, rfl⟩ : ∃ A, 0 ≤ A ∧ a = A ^ 2 :=
    ⟨Real.sqrt a, Real.sqrt_nonneg a, (Real.sq_sqrt ha).symm⟩
  obtain ⟨S, hS0, rfl⟩ : ∃ S, 0 ≤ S ∧ s = S ^ 2 :=
    ⟨Real.sqrt s, Real.sqrt_nonneg s, (Real.sq_sqrt hs).symm⟩
  have he : Real.sqrt (A ^ 2 * S ^ 2) = A * S := by
    rw [show A ^ 2 * S ^ 2 = (A * S) ^ 2 by ring, Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)]
  rw [he, ← sub_nonneg]
  have h : δ * A ^ 2 + S ^ 2 / (4 * δ) - A * S = (2 * δ * A - S) ^ 2 / (4 * δ) := by
    field_simp; ring
  rw [h]; positivity

theorem ch15_lemma_15_2
    {Ω Ω' : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Ω']
    (μ : Measure Ω) (μ' : Measure Ω')
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure μ']
    (phi1 phi2 phi3 : Ω → Ω' → ℝ)
    (hmeas1 : Measurable (Function.uncurry phi1))
    (hmeas2 : Measurable (Function.uncurry phi2))
    (hmeas3 : Measurable (Function.uncurry phi3))
    (hphi3_nonneg : ∀ x x', 0 ≤ phi3 x x')
    (hint1 : ∀ x, Integrable (fun x' => phi1 x x') μ')
    (hint2 : ∀ x, Integrable (fun x' => phi2 x x') μ')
    (hint3 : ∀ x, Integrable (fun x' => phi3 x x') μ')
    (hmavg1 : Measurable (fun x => ∫ x', phi1 x x' ∂μ'))
    (hmavg2 : Measurable (fun x => ∫ x', phi2 x x' ∂μ'))
    (hmavg3 : Measurable (fun x => ∫ x', phi3 x x' ∂μ'))
    (Γ γ t : ℝ) (hΓ : 1 ≤ Γ) (hγ : 0 < γ) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hyp : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s →
      (μ.prod μ') {p : Ω × Ω' | phi1 p.1 p.2 ≥ phi2 p.1 p.2 + Real.sqrt (phi3 p.1 p.2 * s)}
        ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Γ * Real.exp (-γ * s))) :
    μ {x : Ω | (∫ x', phi1 x x' ∂μ') ≥ (∫ x', phi2 x x' ∂μ')
        + Real.sqrt ((∫ x', phi3 x x' ∂μ') * t)}
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Γ * Real.exp 1 * Real.exp (-γ * t)) := by
  have hE1 : (2:ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 1 := by have := Real.add_one_le_exp (1:ℝ); linarith
  have m1 : Measurable (fun p : Ω × Ω' => phi1 p.1 p.2) := hmeas1
  have m2 : Measurable (fun p : Ω × Ω' => phi2 p.1 p.2) := hmeas2
  have m3 : Measurable (fun p : Ω × Ω' => phi3 p.1 p.2) := hmeas3
  set S : Set Ω := {x : Ω | (∫ x', phi1 x x' ∂μ') ≥ (∫ x', phi2 x x' ∂μ')
      + Real.sqrt ((∫ x', phi3 x x' ∂μ') * t)} with hSdef
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht with ht0 | ht0
  · -- t = 0
    refine le_trans prob_le_one ?_
    rw [ENNReal.one_le_ofReal]
    have h2 : Real.exp (-γ * t) = 1 := by rw [← ht0]; simp
    rw [h2, mul_one]
    nlinarith
  -- 0 < t
  set u : Ω → ℝ := fun x => (∫ x', phi1 x x' ∂μ') - (∫ x', phi2 x x' ∂μ') with hudef
  set Av : Ω → ℝ := fun x => (∫ x', phi3 x x' ∂μ') with hAvdef
  have hAvmeas : Measurable Av := hmavg3
  have humeas : Measurable u := hmavg1.sub hmavg2
  have hAvnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ Av x := fun x => integral_nonneg (fun x' => hphi3_nonneg x x')
  set d : Ω → ℝ := fun x =>
    if 0 < Av x then Real.sqrt (t / Av x) / 2 else (if 0 < u x then t / (4 * u x) else 1) with hddef
  have hdmeas : Measurable d := by
    refine Measurable.ite (measurableSet_lt measurable_const hAvmeas) ?_ ?_
    · exact (Real.continuous_sqrt.measurable.comp (measurable_const.div hAvmeas)).div_const 2
    · exact Measurable.ite (measurableSet_lt measurable_const humeas)
        (measurable_const.div (measurable_const.mul humeas)) measurable_const
  have hdpos : ∀ x, 0 < d x := by
    intro x
    simp only [hddef]
    split_ifs with h1 h2
    · exact half_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (div_pos ht0 h1))
    · exact div_pos ht0 (by linarith)
    · exact one_pos
  set g : Ω → Ω' → ℝ := fun x x' =>
    1 + γ * (4 * d x * (phi1 x x' - phi2 x x' - d x * phi3 x x') - t) with hgdef
  have hdm : Measurable (fun p : Ω × Ω' => d p.1) := hdmeas.comp measurable_fst
  have hgm : Measurable (fun p : Ω × Ω' => g p.1 p.2) := by
    simp only [hgdef]
    exact measurable_const.add
      ((((measurable_const.mul hdm).mul ((m1.sub m2).sub (hdm.mul m3))).sub_const t).const_mul γ)
  have hgint : ∀ x, Integrable (fun x' => g x x') μ' := by
    intro x
    have h0 : Integrable (fun x' => phi1 x x' - phi2 x x' - d x * phi3 x x') μ' :=
      ((hint1 x).sub (hint2 x)).sub ((hint3 x).const_mul (d x))
    have h1 : Integrable
        (fun x' => 4 * d x * (phi1 x x' - phi2 x x' - d x * phi3 x x') - t) μ' :=
      (h0.const_mul (4 * d x)).sub (integrable_const t)
    exact (integrable_const 1).add (h1.const_mul γ)
  have hgintegral : ∀ x, (∫ x', g x x' ∂μ') = 1 + γ * (4 * d x * (u x - d x * Av x) - t) := by
    intro x
    have h0 : Integrable (fun x' => phi1 x x' - phi2 x x' - d x * phi3 x x') μ' :=
      ((hint1 x).sub (hint2 x)).sub ((hint3 x).const_mul (d x))
    have hi12 : Integrable (fun x' => phi1 x x' - phi2 x x') μ' := (hint1 x).sub (hint2 x)
    have hi3 : Integrable (fun x' => d x * phi3 x x') μ' := (hint3 x).const_mul (d x)
    have e0 : (∫ x', (phi1 x x' - phi2 x x' - d x * phi3 x x') ∂μ') = u x - d x * Av x := by
      rw [integral_sub hi12 hi3, integral_sub (hint1 x) (hint2 x), integral_const_mul]
    have h1 : Integrable
        (fun x' => 4 * d x * (phi1 x x' - phi2 x x' - d x * phi3 x x') - t) μ' :=
      (h0.const_mul (4 * d x)).sub (integrable_const t)
    simp only [hgdef]
    rw [integral_add (integrable_const 1) (h1.const_mul γ), integral_const, integral_const_mul,
      integral_sub (h0.const_mul _) (integrable_const t), integral_const_mul, e0, integral_const]
    simp
  -- the exceptional null set
  set A0 : Set Ω := {x | Av x = 0 ∧ u x = 0} with hA0def
  have hA0meas : MeasurableSet A0 :=
    (hAvmeas (measurableSet_singleton 0)).inter (humeas (measurableSet_singleton 0))
  have hnull : μ A0 = 0 := by
    set N : Set (Ω × Ω') :=
      {p : Ω × Ω' | phi3 p.1 p.2 = 0 ∧ phi2 p.1 p.2 ≤ phi1 p.1 p.2} with hNdef
    have hNmeas : MeasurableSet N :=
      (m3 (measurableSet_singleton 0)).inter (measurableSet_le m2 m1)
    have hNsub : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s →
        N ⊆ {p : Ω × Ω' | phi1 p.1 p.2 ≥ phi2 p.1 p.2 + Real.sqrt (phi3 p.1 p.2 * s)} := by
      intro s _ p hp
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hp ⊢
      rw [hp.1, zero_mul, Real.sqrt_zero, add_zero]
      exact hp.2
    have hNzero : (μ.prod μ') N = 0 := by
      refine le_antisymm ?_ (zero_le _)
      refine ENNReal.le_of_forall_pos_le_add ?_
      intro ε hε _
      have hεpos : (0:ℝ) < (ε : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hε
      set s : ℝ := max 0 ((Real.log Γ - Real.log (ε:ℝ)) / γ) with hsdef
      have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := le_max_left _ _
      have hle : Γ * Real.exp (-γ * s) ≤ (ε:ℝ) := by
        have h1 : (Real.log Γ - Real.log (ε:ℝ)) / γ ≤ s := le_max_right _ _
        have h2 : Real.log Γ - Real.log (ε:ℝ) ≤ γ * s := by
          rw [div_le_iff₀ hγ] at h1; linarith [h1]
        have h3 : -γ * s ≤ Real.log (ε:ℝ) - Real.log Γ := by linarith
        have hΓ0 : (0:ℝ) < Γ := by linarith
        calc Γ * Real.exp (-γ * s) ≤ Γ * Real.exp (Real.log (ε:ℝ) - Real.log Γ) := by
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.2 h3) (by linarith)
          _ = Γ * ((ε:ℝ) / Γ) := by
              rw [Real.exp_sub, Real.exp_log hεpos, Real.exp_log hΓ0]
          _ = (ε:ℝ) := by field_simp
      calc (μ.prod μ') N ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Γ * Real.exp (-γ * s)) :=
            le_trans (measure_mono (hNsub s hs0)) (hyp s hs0)
        _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε:ℝ) := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hle
        _ = 0 + (ε : ℝ≥0∞) := by
            rw [zero_add, ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal]
    have hslice : ∫⁻ x, μ' (Prod.mk x ⁻¹' N) ∂μ = 0 := by
      rw [← Measure.prod_apply hNmeas]; exact hNzero
    have hFae : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, μ' (Prod.mk x ⁻¹' N) = 0 := by
      have hmeasF : Measurable fun x => μ' (Prod.mk x ⁻¹' N) :=
        measurable_measure_prodMk_left hNmeas
      rw [lintegral_eq_zero_iff hmeasF] at hslice
      filter_upwards [hslice] with x hx using hx
    have hsub : A0 ⊆ {x | μ' (Prod.mk x ⁻¹' N) ≠ 0} := by
      intro x hx
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
      intro hzero
      obtain ⟨hAv0, hu0⟩ := hx
      have h3 : (fun x' => phi3 x x') =ᵐ[μ'] 0 :=
        (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun x' => hphi3_nonneg x x') (hint3 x)).1 hAv0
      have hslice0 : ∀ᵐ x' ∂μ', ¬ (phi3 x x' = 0 ∧ phi2 x x' ≤ phi1 x x') := by
        rw [ae_iff]
        have hEq : {a | ¬¬(phi3 x a = 0 ∧ phi2 x a ≤ phi1 x a)} = Prod.mk x ⁻¹' N := by
          ext a; simp [hNdef]
        rw [hEq]; exact hzero
      have hlt : ∀ᵐ x' ∂μ', phi1 x x' < phi2 x x' := by
        filter_upwards [h3, hslice0] with x' e1 e2
        by_contra hcon
        exact e2 ⟨e1, le_of_not_lt hcon⟩
      have hfnn : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ'] (fun x' => phi2 x x' - phi1 x x') := by
        filter_upwards [hlt] with x' e; simp only [Pi.zero_apply]; linarith
      have hfi : Integrable (fun x' => phi2 x x' - phi1 x x') μ' := (hint2 x).sub (hint1 x)
      have hint0 : (∫ x', (phi2 x x' - phi1 x x') ∂μ') = 0 := by
        rw [integral_sub (hint2 x) (hint1 x)]
        have : (∫ x', phi1 x x' ∂μ') = (∫ x', phi2 x x' ∂μ') := by
          have := hu0; simp only [hudef] at this; linarith
        rw [this]; ring
      have hf0 := (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg_ae hfnn hfi).1 hint0
      have hfalse : ∀ᵐ _x' ∂μ', False := by
        filter_upwards [hf0, hlt] with x' e1 e2
        simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at e1
        linarith
      rw [Filter.eventually_false_iff_eq_bot] at hfalse
      exact (ae_neBot.2 (IsProbabilityMeasure.ne_zero μ')).ne hfalse
    refine measure_mono_null hsub ?_
    rw [← ae_iff] at *
    exact hFae
  -- key lower bound on the inner integral
  have hkey : ∀ x ∈ S \ A0, (1:ℝ≥0∞) ≤ ∫⁻ x', ENNReal.ofReal (g x x') ∂μ' := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hxS, hxA0⟩ := hx
    have hxS' : (∫ x', phi2 x x' ∂μ') + Real.sqrt (Av x * t) ≤ (∫ x', phi1 x x' ∂μ') := hxS
    have hu' : Real.sqrt (Av x * t) ≤ u x := by simp only [hudef]; linarith
    have hbig : t ≤ 4 * d x * (u x - d x * Av x) := by
      simp only [hddef]
      split_ifs with h1 h2
      · set q := Real.sqrt (t / Av x) with hq
        have hq0 : 0 ≤ q := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
        have hq2 : q ^ 2 = t / Av x := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
        have hqq : q * Real.sqrt (Av x * t) = t := by
          rw [hq, ← Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity)]
          rw [show t / Av x * (Av x * t) = t ^ 2 by field_simp]
          exact Real.sqrt_sq ht
        have hq2' : q ^ 2 * Av x = t := by rw [hq2]; field_simp
        have hst : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (Av x * t) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu' hq0]
      · have hAv0 : Av x = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.1 h1) (hAvnn x)
        have hune : u x ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h2
        have hcalc : 4 * (t / (4 * u x)) * (u x - t / (4 * u x) * Av x) = t := by
          rw [hAv0]; field_simp; ring
        rw [hcalc]
      · exfalso
        have hAv0 : Av x = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.1 h1) (hAvnn x)
        have hu0 : u x = 0 := by
          have := not_lt.1 h2
          have hnn : 0 ≤ u x := by
            have : Real.sqrt (Av x * t) = 0 := by rw [hAv0, zero_mul, Real.sqrt_zero]
            linarith [hu', this.symm ▸ hu']
          linarith
        exact hxA0 ⟨hAv0, hu0⟩
    have hone : (1:ℝ) ≤ ∫ x', g x x' ∂μ' := by
      rw [hgintegral x]
      nlinarith [hγ.le, hbig]
    have hmax : Integrable (fun x' => max (g x x') 0) μ' := (hgint x).pos_part
    calc (1:ℝ≥0∞) = ENNReal.ofReal 1 := by simp
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x', g x x' ∂μ') := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hone
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x', max (g x x') 0 ∂μ') :=
          ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (integral_mono (hgint x) hmax (fun x' => le_max_left _ _))
      _ = ∫⁻ x', ENNReal.ofReal (max (g x x') 0) ∂μ' :=
          ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hmax
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x' => le_max_right _ _)
      _ = ∫⁻ x', ENNReal.ofReal (g x x') ∂μ' := by simp only [ofReal_max_zero]
  -- tail bound
  have htail : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r →
      (μ.prod μ') {p : Ω × Ω' | r < g p.1 p.2}
        ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Γ * Real.exp (-γ * t) * Real.exp (1 - r)) := by
    intro r hr
    set s : ℝ := t + (r - 1) / γ with hsdef
    have hgs : γ * s = γ * t + (r - 1) := by
      rw [hsdef]; field_simp
    have hexp : Γ * Real.exp (-γ * t) * Real.exp (1 - r) = Γ * Real.exp (-γ * s) := by
      rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
      congr 2
      linarith
    rcases lt_or_le s 0 with hs | hs
    · refine le_trans prob_le_one ?_
      rw [ENNReal.one_le_ofReal, hexp]
      have h1 : 0 < -γ * s := by nlinarith
      have := Real.add_one_le_exp (-γ * s)
      nlinarith
    · rw [hexp]
      refine le_trans (measure_mono ?_) (hyp s hs)
      intro p hp
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, hgdef] at hp
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, ge_iff_le]
      have hD := hdpos p.1
      have hgt : s < 4 * d p.1 * (phi1 p.1 p.2 - phi2 p.1 p.2 - d p.1 * phi3 p.1 p.2) := by
        have h2 : (r - 1) / γ
            < 4 * d p.1 * (phi1 p.1 p.2 - phi2 p.1 p.2 - d p.1 * phi3 p.1 p.2) - t :=
          (div_lt_iff₀ hγ).2 (by nlinarith [hp])
        rw [hsdef]; linarith
      have hstep : s / (4 * d p.1)
          < phi1 p.1 p.2 - phi2 p.1 p.2 - d p.1 * phi3 p.1 p.2 :=
        (div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)).2 (by nlinarith [hgt])
      have := sqrt_amgm (hphi3_nonneg p.1 p.2) hs hD
      linarith
  -- integral bound over the product
  have hprodbound : ∫⁻ p, ENNReal.ofReal (g p.1 p.2) ∂(μ.prod μ')
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Γ * Real.exp 1 * Real.exp (-γ * t)) := by
    have hnn : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ.prod μ'] (fun p : Ω × Ω' => max (g p.1 p.2) 0) :=
      Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun p => le_max_right _ _
    have hmb : AEMeasurable (fun p : Ω × Ω' => max (g p.1 p.2) 0) (μ.prod μ') :=
      (hgm.max measurable_const).aemeasurable
    have hlc := lintegral_eq_lintegral_meas_lt (μ.prod μ') hnn hmb
    have hrw : ∫⁻ p, ENNReal.ofReal (g p.1 p.2) ∂(μ.prod μ')
        = ∫⁻ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), (μ.prod μ') {p : Ω × Ω' | r < max (g p.1 p.2) 0} := by
      rw [← hlc]
      simp only [ofReal_max_zero]
    rw [hrw]
    have hbound : ∫⁻ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), (μ.prod μ') {p : Ω × Ω' | r < max (g p.1 p.2) 0}
        ≤ ∫⁻ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ),
            ENNReal.ofReal (Γ * Real.exp (-γ * t) * Real.exp 1 * Real.exp (-r)) := by
      refine lintegral_mono_ae ?_
      filter_upwards [self_mem_ae_restrict measurableSet_Ioi] with r hr
      have hr0 : (0:ℝ) < r := hr
      have hset : {p : Ω × Ω' | r < max (g p.1 p.2) 0} = {p : Ω × Ω' | r < g p.1 p.2} := by
        ext p
        simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, lt_max_iff]
        constructor
        · rintro (h | h); · exact h
          · exact absurd h (not_lt.2 hr0.le)
        · exact fun h => Or.inl h

      refine le_trans (htail r hr0) (le_of_eq ?_)
      have he : Real.exp (1 - r) = Real.exp 1 * Real.exp (-r) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
      congr 1
      rw [he]; ring
    refine le_trans hbound ?_
    set C : ℝ := Γ * Real.exp (-γ * t) * Real.exp 1 with hC
    have hCnn : 0 ≤ C := by positivity
    have hInt : IntegrableOn (fun r : ℝ => C * Real.exp (-r)) (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) := by
      have := (exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi (0:ℝ) (b := 1) one_pos)
      simpa using this.const_mul C
    have heq : ∫⁻ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (C * Real.exp (-r))
        = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), C * Real.exp (-r)) := by
      rw [ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hInt
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun r => by positivity)]
    rw [heq]
    have hval : (∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), C * Real.exp (-r)) = C := by
      rw [integral_const_mul, integral_exp_neg_Ioi_zero, mul_one]
    rw [hval]
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    rw [hC]
    apply le_of_eq
    ring
  -- put everything together
  have hFmeas : Measurable fun x => ∫⁻ x', ENNReal.ofReal (g x x') ∂μ' := by
    have : Measurable (Function.uncurry fun x x' => ENNReal.ofReal (g x x')) := by
      exact ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp hgm
    exact this.lintegral_prod_right
  have hfinal : μ (S \ A0) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Γ * Real.exp 1 * Real.exp (-γ * t)) := by
    have hSmeas : MeasurableSet S := by
      apply measurableSet_le
      · exact hmavg2.add (Real.continuous_sqrt.measurable.comp (hmavg3.mul_const t))
      · exact hmavg1
    have hdiff : MeasurableSet (S \ A0) := hSmeas.diff hA0meas
    calc μ (S \ A0) = ∫⁻ _x in (S \ A0), 1 ∂μ := by
          rw [setLIntegral_one]
      _ ≤ ∫⁻ x in (S \ A0), (∫⁻ x', ENNReal.ofReal (g x x') ∂μ') ∂μ := by
          refine setLIntegral_mono hFmeas ?_
          intro x hx
          exact hkey x hx
      _ ≤ ∫⁻ x, (∫⁻ x', ENNReal.ofReal (g x x') ∂μ') ∂μ := setLIntegral_le_lintegral _ _
      _ = ∫⁻ p, ENNReal.ofReal (g p.1 p.2) ∂(μ.prod μ') :=
          (lintegral_prod _ (ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp hgm).aemeasurable).symm
      _ ≤ _ := hprodbound
  calc μ S ≤ μ ((S \ A0) ∪ A0) := by
        refine measure_mono ?_
        intro x hx
        by_cases h : x ∈ A0
        · exact Or.inr h
        · exact Or.inl ⟨hx, h⟩
    _ ≤ μ (S \ A0) + μ A0 := measure_union_le _ _
    _ = μ (S \ A0) := by rw [hnull, add_zero]
    _ ≤ _ := hfinal

end GraduateLevel

targets.label: ch7_theorem_7_3
targets.statement:
Let \(a_{1},\cdots,a_{n}\in\mathbb{R},\epsilon_{i},\cdots,\epsilon_{n}\) be i.i.d. Rademacher random variables: \(\mathbb{P}(\epsilon_{i}=1)=\mathbb{P}(\epsilon_{i}= -1)=0.5\) and \(0 < p < \infty\) . Then
\[A_{p}\cdot\left(\sum_{i=1}^{n}\left|a_{i}\right|^{2}\right)^{1/2}\leq\left(\mathbb{E}\left|\sum_{i=1}^{n}a_{i}\epsilon_{i}\right|^{p}\right)^{1/p}\leq B_{p}\cdot\left(\sum_{i=1}^{n}\left|a_{i}\right|^{2}\right)^{1/2}\]
for some constants \(A_{p}\) and \(B_{p}\) depending on p.

nl_proof:
Let \(\sum\left|a_{i}\right|^{2}=1\) without lossing generality. Then
\[\begin{array}{ r c l }{\displaystyle\mathbb E\left|\sum a_{i}\boldsymbol{\epsilon}_{i}\right|^{p}}&{=}&{\displaystyle\int_{0}^{\infty}\mathbb P\left(\left|\sum a_{i}\boldsymbol{\epsilon}_{i}\right|^{p}\geq s^{p}\right)~d s^{p}}\\ &{=}&{\displaystyle\int_{0}^{\infty}\mathbb P\left(\left|\sum a_{i}\boldsymbol{\epsilon}_{i}\right|\geq s\right)\cdot p s^{p-1}~d s^{p}}\\ &{=}&{\displaystyle\int_{0}^{\infty}\mathbb P\left(\left|\sum a_{i}\boldsymbol{\epsilon}_{i}\right|\geq s\right)\cdot p s^{p-1}~d s^{p}}\\ &{\leq}&{\displaystyle\int_{0}^{\infty}2\exp(-\frac{s^{2}}{2})\cdot p s^{p-1}~d s^{p}~,~\mathrm{Hoe}\mathrm{f l d i n g's~i n e q u a l i t y}}\\ &{=}&{(B_{p})^{p}~,\mathrm{when}~p\geq 2 .}\end{array}\]
When \(0 < p < 2\)
\[\begin{array}{ r c l }{\mathbb{E}\left|\sum a_{i}\epsilon_{i}\right|^{p}}&{\leq}&{\mathbb{E}\left|\sum a_{i}\epsilon_{i}\right|^{2}}\\ &{=}&{\mathbb{E}\left|\sum a_{i}\epsilon_{i}\right|^{\frac{2}{3}p+(2-\frac{2}{3}p)}}\\ &{\leq}&{\left(\mathbb{E}\left|\sum a_{i}\epsilon_{i}\right|^{p}\right)^{\frac{2}{3}}\left(\mathbb{E}\left|\sum a_{i}\epsilon_{i}\right|^{6-2 p}\right)^{\frac{1}{3}},\mathrm{~H o l d e r's~i n e q u a l i t y}}\\ &{\leq}&{\left(B_{6-2 p}\right)^{2-\frac{2}{3}p}\cdot\left(\mathbb{E}\left|\sum a_{i}\epsilon_{i}\right|^{p}\right)^{\frac{2}{3}}.}\end{array}\]
Thus \(\begin{array}{ r }{\mathbb{E}\left|\sum a_{i}\epsilon_{i}\right|^{p}\le\left(B_{6-2 p}\right)^{6-2 p}}\end{array}\) , completing the proof.

import Mathlib

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Real
open scoped NNReal ENNReal

namespace GraduateLevel

private lemma rpow_le_const_mul_exp {p t : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    t ^ p ≤ (p / Real.exp 1) ^ p * Real.exp t := by
  have hpe : (0:ℝ) < p / Real.exp 1 := by positivity
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht with h | h
  · rw [← h, Real.zero_rpow hp.ne']
    positivity
  · rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos h, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hpe, ← Real.exp_add]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
    have hkey : Real.log (t / p) ≤ t / p - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by positivity)
    rw [Real.log_div h.ne' hp.ne'] at hkey
    have hlp : Real.log (p / Real.exp 1) = Real.log p - 1 := by
      rw [Real.log_div hp.ne' (Real.exp_ne_zero 1), Real.log_exp]
    rw [hlp]
    have h4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hkey hp.le
    have h6 : (t / p - 1) * p = t - p := by field_simp
    rw [h6] at h4
    nlinarith [h4]

private lemma abs_rpow_integrable {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (S : Ω → ℝ) (c : NNReal) (hs : HasSubgaussianMGF S c μ)
    (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) : Integrable (fun ω => |S ω| ^ q) μ := by
  have hqn : ((q.toNNReal : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0 := by
    simp only [ne_eq, ENNReal.coe_eq_zero, Real.toNNReal_eq_zero, not_le]
    exact hq
  have h := (hs.memLp q.toNNReal).integrable_norm_rpow hqn (by simp)
  simpa [Real.coe_toNNReal _ hq.le, Real.norm_eq_abs] using h

private lemma moment_ub {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : Ω → ℝ) (c : NNReal) (hs : HasSubgaussianMGF S c μ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    ∫ ω, |S ω| ^ q ∂μ ≤ 2 * Real.exp (q / 2) * (Real.sqrt q * Real.sqrt c / Real.exp 1) ^ q := by
  have hqLHSint : Integrable (fun ω => |S ω| ^ q) μ := by
    have hqn : ((q.toNNReal : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0 := by
      simp only [ne_eq, ENNReal.coe_eq_zero, Real.toNNReal_eq_zero, not_le]
      exact hq
    have h := (hs.memLp q.toNNReal).integrable_norm_rpow hqn (by simp)
    simpa [Real.coe_toNNReal _ hq.le, Real.norm_eq_abs] using h
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (zero_le c) with hc | hc
  · have hc0 : c = 0 := hc.symm
    subst hc0
    have h0 : S =ᵐ[μ] 0 := hs.ae_eq_zero_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_zero
    have : ∫ ω, |S ω| ^ q ∂μ = 0 := by
      rw [integral_congr_ae (g := fun _ => (0:ℝ)) ?_]
      · simp
      · filter_upwards [h0] with ω hω
        simp [hω, Real.zero_rpow hq.ne']
    rw [this]
    positivity
  · have hcR : (0:ℝ) < (c:ℝ) := hc
    set lam : ℝ := Real.sqrt q / Real.sqrt c with hlamdef
    have hsq : (0:ℝ) < Real.sqrt q := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hq
    have hsc : (0:ℝ) < Real.sqrt c := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hcR
    have hlam : 0 < lam := by positivity
    set K : ℝ := (q / (Real.exp 1 * lam)) ^ q with hK
    have hKpos : 0 < K := by
      have : (0:ℝ) < q / (Real.exp 1 * lam) := by positivity
      exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos this q
    have hb : ∀ ω, |S ω| ^ q ≤ K * (Real.exp (lam * S ω) + Real.exp ((-lam) * S ω)) := by
      intro ω
      have h1 := rpow_le_const_mul_exp (p := q) (t := lam * |S ω|) hq (by positivity)
      have h2 : (lam * |S ω|) ^ q = lam ^ q * |S ω| ^ q := by
        rw [Real.mul_rpow hlam.le (abs_nonneg _)]
      have hexp : Real.exp (lam * |S ω|) ≤ Real.exp (lam * S ω) + Real.exp ((-lam) * S ω) := by
        rcases abs_cases (S ω) with ⟨he, _⟩ | ⟨he, _⟩
        · rw [he]
          have : (0:ℝ) < Real.exp ((-lam) * S ω) := Real.exp_pos _
          linarith
        · rw [he]
          have : (0:ℝ) < Real.exp (lam * S ω) := Real.exp_pos _
          have : lam * -S ω = (-lam) * S ω := by ring
          rw [this]
          have := Real.exp_pos (lam * S ω)
          linarith
      have hKeq : K * lam ^ q = (q / Real.exp 1) ^ q := by
        rw [hK, ← Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) hlam.le]
        congr 1
        field_simp
      have hlamq : (0:ℝ) < lam ^ q := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hlam q
      rw [h2] at h1
      have h3 : lam ^ q * |S ω| ^ q ≤ (q / Real.exp 1) ^ q *
          (Real.exp (lam * S ω) + Real.exp ((-lam) * S ω)) := by
        refine h1.trans ?_
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp (by positivity)
      rw [← hKeq] at h3
      nlinarith [h3, hlamq]
    have hRint : Integrable
        (fun ω => K * (Real.exp (lam * S ω) + Real.exp ((-lam) * S ω))) μ :=
      ((hs.integrable_exp_mul lam).add (hs.integrable_exp_mul (-lam))).const_mul K
    have hmono := integral_mono hqLHSint hRint hb
    have hval : ∫ ω, K * (Real.exp (lam * S ω) + Real.exp ((-lam) * S ω)) ∂μ
        ≤ K * (2 * Real.exp (q / 2)) := by
      rw [integral_const_mul,
        integral_add (hs.integrable_exp_mul lam) (hs.integrable_exp_mul (-lam))]
      have h1 : mgf S μ lam ≤ Real.exp (c * lam ^ 2 / 2) := hs.mgf_le lam
      have h2 : mgf S μ (-lam) ≤ Real.exp (c * (-lam) ^ 2 / 2) := hs.mgf_le (-lam)
      have hclam : (c:ℝ) * lam ^ 2 / 2 = q / 2 := by
        rw [hlamdef]
        rw [div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hq.le, Real.sq_sqrt hcR.le]
        field_simp
      have : ∫ ω, Real.exp (lam * S ω) ∂μ + ∫ ω, Real.exp ((-lam) * S ω) ∂μ
          ≤ 2 * Real.exp (q / 2) := by
        have e1 : ∫ ω, Real.exp (lam * S ω) ∂μ = mgf S μ lam := rfl
        have e2 : ∫ ω, Real.exp ((-lam) * S ω) ∂μ = mgf S μ (-lam) := rfl
        rw [e1, e2]
        have : (c:ℝ) * (-lam) ^ 2 / 2 = q / 2 := by rw [neg_pow]; simpa using hclam
        rw [hclam] at h1
        rw [this] at h2
        linarith
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this hKpos.le
    have hfin : K * (2 * Real.exp (q / 2))
        = 2 * Real.exp (q / 2) * (Real.sqrt q * Real.sqrt c / Real.exp 1) ^ q := by
      rw [hK]
      have : q / (Real.exp 1 * lam) = Real.sqrt q * Real.sqrt c / Real.exp 1 := by
        rw [hlamdef]
        have hq' : q = Real.sqrt q * Real.sqrt q := (Real.mul_self_sqrt hq.le).symm
        field_simp
        nlinarith [hq', hsq, hsc]
      rw [this]; ring
    linarith [hmono, hval, hfin.le, hfin.ge]

theorem ch7_theorem_7_3 :
    ∀ p : ℝ, 0 < p →
      ∃ Ap Bp : ℝ, 0 < Ap ∧ 0 < Bp ∧
        ∀ (n : ℕ) {Ω : Type} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
          (ε : Fin n → Ω → ℝ)
          (_hindep : iIndepFun ε μ)
          (_hmeas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (ε i) μ)
          (_hrad : ∀ i, μ {ω | ε i ω = 1} = 1/2 ∧ μ {ω | ε i ω = -1} = 1/2)
          (a : Fin n → ℝ),
          Ap * (∑ i, (a i)^2) ^ ((1:ℝ)/2)
              ≤ (∫ ω, |∑ i, a i * ε i ω| ^ p ∂μ) ^ (1/p)
            ∧ (∫ ω, |∑ i, a i * ε i ω| ^ p ∂μ) ^ (1/p)
              ≤ Bp * (∑ i, (a i)^2) ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) := by
  intro p hp
  set C : ℝ := 32 / Real.exp 2 with hCdef
  have hCpos : (0:ℝ) < C := by rw [hCdef]; positivity
  refine ⟨(1/(8*C)) ^ (1/p) / 2, 2 ^ (1/p) * Real.exp (1/2) * Real.sqrt p / Real.exp 1,
    by positivity, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro n Ω _ μ _ ε hindep hmeas hrad a
  set σ2 : ℝ := ∑ i, (a i)^2 with hσ2
  have hσ2nn : (0:ℝ) ≤ σ2 := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _
  have hrad' : ∀ i, (∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ε i ω = 1 ∨ ε i ω = -1) ∧ ∫ ω, ε i ω ∂μ = 0 := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hrad i
    have hA0 : NullMeasurableSet {ω | ε i ω = 1} μ :=
      (hmeas i).nullMeasurable (measurableSet_singleton (1:ℝ))
    have hB0 : NullMeasurableSet {ω | ε i ω = -1} μ :=
      (hmeas i).nullMeasurable (measurableSet_singleton (-1:ℝ))
    have hinter : ({ω | ε i ω = 1} ∩ {ω | ε i ω = -1}) = (∅ : Set Ω) := by
      ext ω
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
      rintro ⟨ha, hb⟩
      rw [ha] at hb; norm_num at hb
    have hdisj : AEDisjoint μ {ω | ε i ω = 1} {ω | ε i ω = -1} := by
      show μ ({ω | ε i ω = 1} ∩ {ω | ε i ω = -1}) = 0
      rw [hinter, measure_empty]
    have hun : μ ({ω | ε i ω = 1} ∪ {ω | ε i ω = -1}) = 1 := by
      rw [measure_union₀ hB0 hdisj, h1, h2]
      rw [ENNReal.div_add_div_same,
        show (1:ℝ≥0∞) + 1 = 2 by norm_num, ENNReal.div_self (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
    have hcompl : μ ({ω | ε i ω = 1} ∪ {ω | ε i ω = -1})ᶜ = 0 := by
      rw [measure_compl₀ (hA0.union hB0) (measure_ne_top _ _), hun, measure_univ]
      simp
    have hae : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ε i ω = 1 ∨ ε i ω = -1 := by
      rw [ae_iff]
      refine measure_mono_null ?_ hcompl
      intro ω hω
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_or] at hω
      simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_or]
      exact ⟨hω.1, hω.2⟩
    refine ⟨hae, ?_⟩
    set A := toMeasurable μ {ω | ε i ω = 1} with hAdef
    have hAm : MeasurableSet A := measurableSet_toMeasurable _ _
    have hAmeas : μ A = 1/2 := by rw [hAdef, measure_toMeasurable, h1]
    have hAeq : A =ᵐ[μ] {ω | ε i ω = 1} := (hA0.toMeasurable_ae_eq)
    have hAeq' : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (ω ∈ A ↔ ω ∈ {ω | ε i ω = 1}) := Filter.eventuallyEq_set.1 hAeq
    have hfeq : ε i =ᵐ[μ] fun ω => 2 * A.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) ω - 1 := by
      filter_upwards [hae, hAeq'] with ω hω hiff
      rcases hω with h | h
      · have hmem : ω ∈ A := hiff.2 h
        rw [h, Set.indicator_of_mem hmem]
        norm_num
      · have hnA : ω ∉ A := by
          intro hmem
          have h5 := hiff.1 hmem
          simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at h5
          rw [h] at h5; norm_num at h5
        rw [h, Set.indicator_of_notMem hnA]
        norm_num
    have hAreal : μ.real A = 1/2 := by
      rw [measureReal_def, hAmeas]
      simp
    rw [integral_congr_ae hfeq,
      integral_sub (((integrable_const (1:ℝ)).indicator hAm).const_mul 2) (integrable_const _),
      integral_const_mul, integral_indicator_const (1:ℝ) hAm]
    simp [hAreal]
  set X : Fin n → Ω → ℝ := fun i ω => a i * ε i ω with hXdef
  have hindX : iIndepFun X μ :=
    hindep.comp (fun (i : Fin n) (x : ℝ) => a i * x) (fun i => measurable_const_mul (a i))
  have hsubX : ∀ i, HasSubgaussianMGF (X i) (((a i)^2).toNNReal) μ := by
    intro i
    have hbdd : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X i ω ∈ Set.Icc (-|a i|) (|a i|) := by
      filter_upwards [(hrad' i).1] with ω hω
      have h1 : -|a i| ≤ a i := neg_abs_le (a i)
      have h2 : a i ≤ |a i| := le_abs_self (a i)
      rcases hω with h | h
      · simp only [hXdef, h, mul_one, Set.mem_Icc]
        exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
      · simp only [hXdef, h, mul_neg_one, Set.mem_Icc]
        constructor <;> linarith
    have hint : ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = 0 := by
      simp only [hXdef]
      rw [integral_const_mul, (hrad' i).2, mul_zero]
    have hmain := hasSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc_of_integral_eq_zero
      (X := X i) (μ := μ) ((hmeas i).const_mul (a i)) hbdd hint
    have hceq : ((‖|a i| - -|a i|‖₊ / 2) ^ 2 : ℝ≥0) = ((a i)^2).toNNReal := by
      apply NNReal.coe_injective
      push_cast
      rw [Real.coe_toNNReal _ (sq_nonneg _), sub_neg_eq_add, ← two_mul,
        Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * |a i|),
        show (2 * |a i|)/2 = |a i| by ring, sq_abs]
    rwa [hceq] at hmain
  have hsumc : ∑ i, ((a i)^2).toNNReal = σ2.toNNReal := by
    rw [hσ2, Real.toNNReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)]

        nlinarith [hbP, hCpos, hpos]

        * Real.sqrt σ2 := by
      have h1 : M ^ (1/p)

namespace GraduateLevel
