solution:
import Mathlib

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Real

namespace GraduateLevel

namespace GtLib

/-! ### Rademacher machinery -/

noncomputable def bern : Measure Bool := (PMF.bernoulli (1/2) (by norm_num)).toMeasure

instance : IsProbabilityMeasure bern := by unfold bern; infer_instance

lemma bern_integral (h : Bool → ℝ) : ∫ x, h x ∂bern = (1/2) * h true + (1/2) * h false := by
  rw [bern, PMF.integral_eq_sum]
  simp [PMF.bernoulli]

noncomputable def Rm (n : ℕ) : Measure (Fin n → Bool) := Measure.pi (fun _ => bern)

instance (n : ℕ) : IsProbabilityMeasure (Rm n) := by unfold Rm; infer_instance

def sgnb {n : ℕ} (A : Fin n → Bool) (i : Fin n) : ℝ := if A i then -1 else 1

lemma measurable_sgnb {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) : Measurable (fun A : Fin n → Bool => sgnb A i) := by
  have : (fun A : Fin n → Bool => sgnb A i) = (fun x : Bool => if x then (-1:ℝ) else 1) ∘ (fun A : Fin n → Bool => A i) := rfl
  rw [this]
  exact Measurable.of_discrete.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)

lemma Rm_integral_eval {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (h : Bool → ℝ) :
    ∫ A, h (A i) ∂(Rm n) = ∫ x, h x ∂bern := by
  have hmp := measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin n => bern) i
  rw [← hmp.map_eq, integral_map ((measurable_pi_apply i).aemeasurable) (by fun_prop)]
  rfl

lemma rad_tail (n : ℕ) (b : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    (Rm n).real {A | t ≤ ∑ i, sgnb A i * b i} ≤ Real.exp (-t^2 / (2 * ∑ i, (b i)^2)) := by
  classical
  set X : Fin n → (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ := fun i A => sgnb A i * b i with hX
  set c : Fin n → NNReal := fun i => ⟨(b i)^2, sq_nonneg _⟩ with hc
  have hmeasX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i) := fun i => (measurable_sgnb i).mul_const _
  have hindep0 : iIndepFun (fun (i : Fin n) (A : Fin n → Bool) => A i) (Rm n) := by
    have := iIndepFun_pi (μ := fun _ : Fin n => bern) (X := fun _ => (id : Bool → Bool))
      (fun i => aemeasurable_id)
    simpa [Rm] using this
  have hindep : iIndepFun X (Rm n) := by
    have := hindep0.comp (fun i => fun (x : Bool) => (if x then (-1:ℝ) else 1) * b i)
      (fun i => by fun_prop)
    exact this
  have hsub : ∀ i : Fin n, HasSubgaussianMGF (X i) (c i) (Rm n) := by
    intro i
    have hmean : ∫ A, X i A ∂(Rm n) = 0 := by
      have h1 : ∫ A, X i A ∂(Rm n) = ∫ x, (if x then -(b i) else b i) ∂bern := by
        rw [← Rm_integral_eval i (fun x => if x then -(b i) else b i)]
        congr 1; funext A; simp only [hX, sgnb]; split <;> ring
      rw [h1, bern_integral]; norm_num
    have hbdd : ∀ᵐ A ∂(Rm n), X i A ∈ Set.Icc (-|b i|) (|b i|) := by
      filter_upwards with A
      simp only [hX, sgnb]
      split <;> constructor <;>
        nlinarith [abs_nonneg (b i), le_abs_self (b i), neg_abs_le (b i)]
    have h2 := hasSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc_of_integral_eq_zero (μ := Rm n) (X := X i)
      (hmeasX i).aemeasurable hbdd hmean
    have heq : (‖|b i| - -|b i|‖₊ / 2) ^ 2 = c i := by
      apply NNReal.coe_injective
      push_cast
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith [abs_nonneg (b i)] : (0:ℝ) ≤ |b i| - -|b i|)]
      have : |b i| - -|b i| = 2 * |b i| := by ring
      rw [this]
      have : (2 * |b i| / 2) = |b i| := by ring
      rw [this, sq_abs]
      simp [hc]
    rwa [heq] at h2
  have := ProbabilityTheory.HasSubgaussianMGF.measure_sum_ge_le_of_iIndepFun hindep
    (c := c) (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => hsub i) ht
  simpa [hX, hc, NNReal.coe_sum] using this


lemma abs_sgnb {n : ℕ} (A : Fin n → Bool) (i : Fin n) : |sgnb A i| = 1 := by
  unfold sgnb; split <;> norm_num

lemma rad_tail_le {n : ℕ} (b : Fin n → ℝ) (t V L : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hb : ∑ i, (b i)^2 ≤ V) (hVL : 2*V*L ≤ t^2) :
    (Rm n) {A | t ≤ ∑ i, sgnb A i * b i} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-L)) := by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) => sq_nonneg (b i)))
    with hW | hW
  · -- ∑ b² = 0 : all b i = 0
    have hb0 : ∀ i, b i = 0 := by
      intro i
      have := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
        (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) => sq_nonneg (b i))).1 hW.symm i (Finset.mem_univ i)
      exact pow_eq_zero_iff (n := 2) (by norm_num) |>.1 this
    have hempty : {A : Fin n → Bool | t ≤ ∑ i, sgnb A i * b i} = ∅ := by
      ext A
      simp only [hb0, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false,
        iff_false, not_le]
      exact ht
    rw [hempty]; simp
  · have hVpos : 0 < V := lt_of_lt_of_le hW hb
    have h1 := rad_tail n b t ht.le
    have h2 : Real.exp (-t^2 / (2 * ∑ i, (b i)^2)) ≤ Real.exp (-L) := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
      rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      have hL : L ≤ t^2/(2*V) := by
        rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]; linarith
      nlinarith [hW, hb, hVpos]
    have h3 : (Rm n).real {A | t ≤ ∑ i, sgnb A i * b i} ≤ Real.exp (-L) := h1.trans h2
    exact (ENNReal.le_ofReal_iff_toReal_le (measure_ne_top _ _) (Real.exp_pos _).le).2 h3


lemma pointwise1 {𝒵 : Type*} {ι : Type*} {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (f : ι → 𝒵 → ℝ) (hf01 : ∀ w z, f w z ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (y : Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵) (ε s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s)
    (C : Finset (𝒵 → ℝ)) (hC01 : ∀ g ∈ C, ∀ z, g z ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hCcov : ∀ w : ι, ∃ g ∈ C, (1/(2*(n:ℝ))) *
        ∑ i, (|f w (y i).1 - g (y i).1| + |f w (y i).2 - g (y i).2|) ≤ ε)
    (L : ℝ) (hL : 2 * (n:ℝ) * L ≤ ((n:ℝ)*s)^2) :
    (Rm n) {A | ∃ w : ι, 2*ε + s < (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, sgnb A i * (f w (y i).2 - f w (y i).1)}
      ≤ (C.card : ENNReal) * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-L)) := by
  classical
  have hn' : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hsubset : {A : Fin n → Bool |
      ∃ w : ι, 2*ε + s < (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, sgnb A i * (f w (y i).2 - f w (y i).1)}
      ⊆ ⋃ g ∈ C, {A : Fin n → Bool |
        (n:ℝ)*s ≤ ∑ i, sgnb A i * (g (y i).2 - g (y i).1)} := by
    rintro A ⟨w, hw⟩
    obtain ⟨g, hgC, hg⟩ := hCcov w
    refine Set.mem_biUnion hgC ?_
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    have hdiff : ∑ i, sgnb A i * (f w (y i).2 - f w (y i).1)
        - ∑ i, sgnb A i * (g (y i).2 - g (y i).1)
        ≤ ∑ i, (|f w (y i).1 - g (y i).1| + |f w (y i).2 - g (y i).2|) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      have heq : sgnb A i * (f w (y i).2 - f w (y i).1) - sgnb A i * (g (y i).2 - g (y i).1)
           = sgnb A i * ((f w (y i).2 - g (y i).2) - (f w (y i).1 - g (y i).1)) := by ring
      rw [heq]
      calc sgnb A i * ((f w (y i).2 - g (y i).2) - (f w (y i).1 - g (y i).1))
          ≤ |sgnb A i * ((f w (y i).2 - g (y i).2) - (f w (y i).1 - g (y i).1))| := le_abs_self _
        _ = |(f w (y i).2 - g (y i).2) - (f w (y i).1 - g (y i).1)| := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_sgnb, one_mul]
        _ ≤ |f w (y i).2 - g (y i).2| + |f w (y i).1 - g (y i).1| := by
            exact (abs_sub _ _).trans (le_of_eq rfl)
        _ = |f w (y i).1 - g (y i).1| + |f w (y i).2 - g (y i).2| := by ring
    have hsum : ∑ i, (|f w (y i).1 - g (y i).1| + |f w (y i).2 - g (y i).2|) ≤ 2*(n:ℝ)*ε := by
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, one_mul, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)] at hg
      linarith
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, one_mul, lt_div_iff₀ hn'] at hw
    linarith
  calc (Rm n) {A : Fin n → Bool |
        ∃ w : ι, 2*ε + s < (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, sgnb A i * (f w (y i).2 - f w (y i).1)}
      ≤ (Rm n) (⋃ g ∈ C, {A : Fin n → Bool |
          (n:ℝ)*s ≤ ∑ i, sgnb A i * (g (y i).2 - g (y i).1)}) := measure_mono hsubset
    _ ≤ ∑ g ∈ C, (Rm n) {A : Fin n → Bool |
          (n:ℝ)*s ≤ ∑ i, sgnb A i * (g (y i).2 - g (y i).1)} := measure_biUnion_finset_le C _
    _ ≤ ∑ _g ∈ C, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-L)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro g hgC
        refine rad_tail_le _ ((n:ℝ)*s) (n:ℝ) L (by positivity) ?_ ?_
        · calc ∑ i, (g (y i).2 - g (y i).1)^2 ≤ ∑ _i : Fin n, (1:ℝ) := by
                apply Finset.sum_le_sum
                intro i _
                have h1 := hC01 g hgC (y i).1
                have h2 := hC01 g hgC (y i).2
                simp only [Set.mem_Icc] at h1 h2
                nlinarith [h1.1, h1.2, h2.1, h2.2]
            _ = (n:ℝ) := by simp
        · linarith
    _ = (C.card : ENNReal) * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-L)) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]


lemma pointwise2 {𝒵 : Type*} {ι : Type*} {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (f : ι → 𝒵 → ℝ) (hf01 : ∀ w z, f w z ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (y : Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵) (ε : ℝ) (γ' : ℝ) (hγ' : 0 < γ')
    (C₁ C₂ : Finset (𝒵 → ℝ))
    (hC₁01 : ∀ g ∈ C₁, ∀ z, g z ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hC₂01 : ∀ g ∈ C₂, ∀ z, g z ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hcov₁ : ∀ w : ι, ∃ g ∈ C₁, (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, |f w (y i).1 - g (y i).1| ≤ ε)
    (hcov₂ : ∀ w : ι, ∃ g ∈ C₂, (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, |f w (y i).2 - g (y i).2| ≤ ε)
    (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) :
    (Rm n) {A | ∃ w : ι,
        γ' * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, (f w (y i).1 + f w (y i).2)) + (2*(1+γ')*ε + L/(2*γ'*(n:ℝ)))
          < (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, sgnb A i * (f w (y i).2 - f w (y i).1)}
      ≤ ((C₁.card * C₂.card : ℕ) : ENNReal) * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-L)) := by
  classical
  have hn' : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hsubset : {A : Fin n → Bool | ∃ w : ι,
      γ' * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, (f w (y i).1 + f w (y i).2)) + (2*(1+γ')*ε + L/(2*γ'*(n:ℝ)))
        < (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, sgnb A i * (f w (y i).2 - f w (y i).1)}
      ⊆ ⋃ p ∈ C₁ ×ˢ C₂, {A : Fin n → Bool |
        (n:ℝ) * (γ' * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, (p.1 (y i).1 + p.2 (y i).2)) + L/(2*γ'*(n:ℝ)))
          ≤ ∑ i, sgnb A i * (p.2 (y i).2 - p.1 (y i).1)} := by
    rintro A ⟨w, hw⟩
    obtain ⟨g, hgC, hg⟩ := hcov₁ w
    obtain ⟨h, hhC, hh⟩ := hcov₂ w
    refine Set.mem_biUnion (show (g,h) ∈ C₁ ×ˢ C₂ from Finset.mem_product.2 ⟨hgC, hhC⟩) ?_
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    -- notation
    set Sw : ℝ := ∑ i, sgnb A i * (f w (y i).2 - f w (y i).1) with hSw
    set Sgh : ℝ := ∑ i, sgnb A i * (h (y i).2 - g (y i).1) with hSgh
    set Tw : ℝ := ∑ i, (f w (y i).1 + f w (y i).2) with hTw
    set Tgh : ℝ := ∑ i, (g (y i).1 + h (y i).2) with hTgh
    have hd1 : Sw - Sgh ≤ ∑ i, (|f w (y i).1 - g (y i).1| + |f w (y i).2 - h (y i).2|) := by
      rw [hSw, hSgh, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      have heq : sgnb A i * (f w (y i).2 - f w (y i).1) - sgnb A i * (h (y i).2 - g (y i).1)
           = sgnb A i * ((f w (y i).2 - h (y i).2) - (f w (y i).1 - g (y i).1)) := by ring
      rw [heq]
      calc sgnb A i * ((f w (y i).2 - h (y i).2) - (f w (y i).1 - g (y i).1))
          ≤ |sgnb A i * ((f w (y i).2 - h (y i).2) - (f w (y i).1 - g (y i).1))| := le_abs_self _
        _ = |(f w (y i).2 - h (y i).2) - (f w (y i).1 - g (y i).1)| := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_sgnb, one_mul]
        _ ≤ |f w (y i).2 - h (y i).2| + |f w (y i).1 - g (y i).1| := abs_sub _ _
        _ = |f w (y i).1 - g (y i).1| + |f w (y i).2 - h (y i).2| := by ring
    have hd2 : Tgh - Tw ≤ ∑ i, (|f w (y i).1 - g (y i).1| + |f w (y i).2 - h (y i).2|) := by
      rw [hTgh, hTw, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      have heq : (g (y i).1 + h (y i).2) - (f w (y i).1 + f w (y i).2)
           = -(f w (y i).1 - g (y i).1) + -(f w (y i).2 - h (y i).2) := by ring
      rw [heq]
      have b1 : -(f w (y i).1 - g (y i).1) ≤ |f w (y i).1 - g (y i).1| := neg_le_abs _
      have b2 : -(f w (y i).2 - h (y i).2) ≤ |f w (y i).2 - h (y i).2| := neg_le_abs _
      linarith
    have hcovsum : ∑ i, (|f w (y i).1 - g (y i).1| + |f w (y i).2 - h (y i).2|) ≤ 2*(n:ℝ)*ε := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, one_mul, div_le_iff₀ hn'] at hg hh
      linarith
    have hne : (n:ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hn'
    have hγne : γ' ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hγ'
    have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hw hn'
    have e1 : (n:ℝ) * (γ' * (1/(n:ℝ) * Tw) + (2*(1+γ')*ε + L/(2*γ'*(n:ℝ))))
        = γ' * Tw + (n:ℝ)*(2*(1+γ')*ε) + L/(2*γ') := by field_simp; ring
    have e2 : (n:ℝ) * (1/(n:ℝ) * Sw) = Sw := by field_simp
    rw [e1, e2] at hmul
    have e3 : (n:ℝ) * (γ' * (1/(n:ℝ) * Tgh) + L/(2*γ'*(n:ℝ))) = γ' * Tgh + L/(2*γ') := by
      field_simp
    show (n:ℝ) * (γ' * (1/(n:ℝ) * Tgh) + L/(2*γ'*(n:ℝ))) ≤ Sgh
    rw [e3]
    have h5 : γ' * Tgh ≤ γ' * (Tw + 2*(n:ℝ)*ε) := by nlinarith [hd2, hcovsum, hγ'.le]
    linarith [hd1, hcovsum, hmul, h5]
  calc (Rm n) {A : Fin n → Bool | ∃ w : ι,
        γ' * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, (f w (y i).1 + f w (y i).2)) + (2*(1+γ')*ε + L/(2*γ'*(n:ℝ)))
          < (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, sgnb A i * (f w (y i).2 - f w (y i).1)}
      ≤ (Rm n) (⋃ p ∈ C₁ ×ˢ C₂, {A : Fin n → Bool |
        (n:ℝ) * (γ' * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, (p.1 (y i).1 + p.2 (y i).2)) + L/(2*γ'*(n:ℝ)))
          ≤ ∑ i, sgnb A i * (p.2 (y i).2 - p.1 (y i).1)}) := measure_mono hsubset
    _ ≤ ∑ p ∈ C₁ ×ˢ C₂, (Rm n) {A : Fin n → Bool |
        (n:ℝ) * (γ' * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, (p.1 (y i).1 + p.2 (y i).2)) + L/(2*γ'*(n:ℝ)))
          ≤ ∑ i, sgnb A i * (p.2 (y i).2 - p.1 (y i).1)} := measure_biUnion_finset_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _p ∈ C₁ ×ˢ C₂, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-L)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        rintro ⟨g, h⟩ hp
        rw [Finset.mem_product] at hp
        obtain ⟨hgC, hhC⟩ := hp
        set T : ℝ := (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, (g (y i).1 + h (y i).2) with hT
        have hT0 : 0 ≤ T := by
          rw [hT]
          apply mul_nonneg (by positivity)
          apply Finset.sum_nonneg
          intro i _
          have a1 := (hC₁01 g hgC (y i).1).1
          have a2 := (hC₂01 h hhC (y i).2).1
          linarith
        refine rad_tail_le _ ((n:ℝ) * (γ' * T + L/(2*γ'*(n:ℝ)))) ((n:ℝ)*T) L ?_ ?_ ?_
        · have : 0 < L/(2*γ'*(n:ℝ)) := by positivity
          have : 0 ≤ γ' * T := mul_nonneg hγ'.le hT0
          nlinarith
        · calc ∑ i, (h (y i).2 - g (y i).1)^2 ≤ ∑ i, (g (y i).1 + h (y i).2) := by
                apply Finset.sum_le_sum
                intro i _
                have a1 := hC₁01 g hgC (y i).1
                have a2 := hC₂01 h hhC (y i).2
                simp only [Set.mem_Icc] at a1 a2
                nlinarith [a1.1, a1.2, a2.1, a2.2]
            _ = (n:ℝ)*T := by rw [hT]; field_simp
        · have e1 : (n:ℝ) * (γ' * T + L/(2*γ'*(n:ℝ))) = (n:ℝ)*γ'*T + L/(2*γ') := by
            field_simp
          rw [e1]
          have h4 : 4 * ((n:ℝ)*γ'*T) * (L/(2*γ')) ≤ ((n:ℝ)*γ'*T + L/(2*γ'))^2 := by
            nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((n:ℝ)*γ'*T - L/(2*γ'))]
          have e2 : 4 * ((n:ℝ)*γ'*T) * (L/(2*γ')) = 2*((n:ℝ)*T)*L := by
            field_simp; ring
          linarith
    _ = ((C₁.card * C₂.card : ℕ) : ENNReal) * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-L)) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, Finset.card_product]


/-! ### Chernoff bounds -/

lemma exp_neg_quad (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) : Real.exp (-x) ≤ 1 - x + x^2/2 := by
  have hderiv : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => 1 - t + t^2/2 - Real.exp (-t))
      (-1 + t + Real.exp (-t)) t := by
    intro t
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => 1 - t + t^2/2) (-1 + t) t := by
      have : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t^2/2) t t := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 t).div_const 2)
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_const t (1:ℝ)).sub (hasDerivAt_id t)).add this
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-t)) (-Real.exp (-t)) t := by
      simpa using (Real.hasDerivAt_exp (-t)).comp t ((hasDerivAt_id t).neg)
    simpa using h1.sub h2
  have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ (fun t : ℝ => 1 - t + t^2/2 - Real.exp (-t)) :=
    fun t => (hderiv t).differentiableAt
  have hmono : Monotone (fun t : ℝ => 1 - t + t^2/2 - Real.exp (-t)) := by
    apply monotone_of_deriv_nonneg hdiff
    intro t
    rw [(hderiv t).deriv]
    have := Real.add_one_le_exp (-t)
    linarith
  have := hmono hx
  simp only at this
  norm_num at this
  linarith


variable {𝒵 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒵]

noncomputable def Pm (D : Measure 𝒵) (n : ℕ) : Measure (Fin n → 𝒵) := Measure.pi (fun _ => D)

instance (D : Measure 𝒵) [IsProbabilityMeasure D] (n : ℕ) : IsProbabilityMeasure (Pm D n) := by
  unfold Pm; infer_instance

lemma pi_integral_eval (D : Measure 𝒵) [IsProbabilityMeasure D]
    {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (h : 𝒵 → ℝ) (hh : AEStronglyMeasurable h D) :
    ∫ S, h (S i) ∂(Pm D n) = ∫ z, h z ∂D := by
  have hmp := measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin n => D) i
  have hmap : Measure.map (Function.eval i) (Pm D n) = D := by rw [Pm]; exact hmp.map_eq
  have hh' : AEStronglyMeasurable h (Measure.map (Function.eval i) (Pm D n)) := by
    rw [hmap]; exact hh
  calc ∫ S, h (S i) ∂(Pm D n)
      = ∫ z, h z ∂(Measure.map (Function.eval i) (Pm D n)) := by
        rw [integral_map ((measurable_pi_apply i).aemeasurable) hh']
    _ = ∫ z, h z ∂D := by rw [hmap]

lemma iIndep_coords (D : Measure 𝒵) [IsProbabilityMeasure D] (n : ℕ) :
    iIndepFun (fun (i : Fin n) (S : Fin n → 𝒵) => S i) (Pm D n) := by
  have := iIndepFun_pi (μ := fun _ : Fin n => D) (X := fun _ => (id : 𝒵 → 𝒵))
    (fun i => aemeasurable_id)
  simpa [Pm] using this

lemma mult_chernoff (D : Measure 𝒵) [IsProbabilityMeasure D]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (g : 𝒵 → ℝ) (hg : Measurable g) (hg01 : ∀ z, g z ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (γ : ℝ) (hγ0 : 0 < γ) (hγ1 : γ < 1) (c : ℝ) :
    (Pm D n).real {S | (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, g (S i) ≤ (1-γ) * (∫ z, g z ∂D) - c}
      ≤ Real.exp (-(2*γ*(n:ℝ)*c)) := by
  classical
  set p : ℝ := ∫ z, g z ∂D with hp
  have hgint : Integrable g D := Integrable.of_mem_Icc 0 1 hg.aemeasurable (ae_of_all _ hg01)
  have hp0 : 0 ≤ p := integral_nonneg (fun z => (hg01 z).1)
  set Y : Fin n → (Fin n → 𝒵) → ℝ := fun i S => g (S i) with hY
  have hYmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i) := fun i => hg.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)
  have hindep : iIndepFun Y (Pm D n) := (iIndep_coords D n).comp (fun _ => g) (fun _ => hg)
  set X : (Fin n → 𝒵) → ℝ := fun S => ∑ i, Y i S with hX
  have hXeq : (∑ i ∈ Finset.univ, Y i) = X := by funext S; simp [hX]
  -- the mgf bound
  set lam : ℝ := 2*γ with hlam
  have hmgfY : ∀ i, mgf (Y i) (Pm D n) (-lam) = ∫ z, Real.exp (-lam * g z) ∂D := by
    intro i
    rw [mgf]
    exact pi_integral_eval D i (fun z => Real.exp (-lam * g z))
      ((hg.const_mul _).exp.aestronglyMeasurable)
  have hm_le : (∫ z, Real.exp (-lam * g z) ∂D) ≤ 1 - p * (1 - Real.exp (-lam)) := by
    have hpt : ∀ z, Real.exp (-lam * g z) ≤ 1 - g z * (1 - Real.exp (-lam)) := by
      intro z
      obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := hg01 z
      have hconv := (convexOn_exp).2 (Set.mem_univ (0:ℝ)) (Set.mem_univ (-lam))
        (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - g z) h0 (by ring)
      simp only [smul_eq_mul, Real.exp_zero, mul_one] at hconv
      have : (1 - g z) * (0:ℝ) + g z * (-lam) = -lam * g z := by ring
      rw [this] at hconv
      nlinarith [hconv]
    have hint1 : Integrable (fun z => Real.exp (-lam * g z)) D :=
      Integrable.of_mem_Icc 0 (Real.exp 0) ((hg.const_mul _).exp.aemeasurable)
        (ae_of_all _ (fun z => ⟨(Real.exp_pos _).le, by
          apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
          have h0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ g z := (hg01 z).1
          have : (0:ℝ) < lam := by rw [hlam]; linarith
          nlinarith⟩))
    have hint2 : Integrable (fun z => 1 - g z * (1 - Real.exp (-lam))) D := by
      apply Integrable.sub (integrable_const 1)
      exact hgint.mul_const _
    have := integral_mono hint1 hint2 hpt
    rw [integral_sub (integrable_const 1) (hgint.mul_const _)] at this
    simpa [integral_mul_const, hp] using this
  -- pointwise bounds on X
  have hXnn : ∀ S, 0 ≤ X S := by
    intro S; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => (hg01 (S i)).1)
  have hXmeas : Measurable X := by
    apply Finset.measurable_sum; intro i _; exact hYmeas i
  have hlam0 : 0 < lam := by rw [hlam]; linarith
  have hint : Integrable (fun S => Real.exp (-lam * X S)) (Pm D n) := by
    apply Integrable.of_mem_Icc 0 1 ((hXmeas.const_mul _).exp.aemeasurable)
    filter_upwards with S
    refine ⟨(Real.exp_pos _).le, ?_⟩
    rw [show (1:ℝ) = Real.exp 0 by simp]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
    nlinarith [hXnn S]
  have hevent : {S : Fin n → 𝒵 | (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, g (S i) ≤ (1-γ) * p - c}
      = {S | X S ≤ (n:ℝ) * ((1-γ)*p - c)} := by
    have hn' : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
    ext S
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, hX, hY]
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, one_mul, div_le_iff₀ hn']
    constructor <;> intro h <;> nlinarith [h]
  have hcher := measure_le_le_exp_mul_mgf (μ := Pm D n) (X := X)
    ((n:ℝ)*((1-γ)*p - c)) (t := -lam) (by linarith) hint
  have hmgfX : mgf X (Pm D n) (-lam) = ∏ _i : Fin n, (∫ z, Real.exp (-lam * g z) ∂D) := by
    rw [← hXeq, hindep.mgf_sum hYmeas Finset.univ]
    exact Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun i _ => hmgfY i)
  have hmnn : 0 ≤ ∫ z, Real.exp (-lam * g z) ∂D :=
    integral_nonneg (fun z => (Real.exp_pos _).le)
  have hmgf_le : mgf X (Pm D n) (-lam) ≤ Real.exp (-((n:ℝ) * p * (1 - Real.exp (-lam)))) := by
    rw [hmgfX, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    calc (∫ z, Real.exp (-lam * g z) ∂D)^n
        ≤ (Real.exp (-(p * (1 - Real.exp (-lam)))))^n := by
          apply pow_le_pow_left₀ hmnn
          refine hm_le.trans ?_
          have := Real.add_one_le_exp (-(p * (1 - Real.exp (-lam))))
          linarith
      _ = Real.exp (-((n:ℝ) * p * (1 - Real.exp (-lam)))) := by
          rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]; congr 1; ring
  rw [hevent]
  refine hcher.trans ?_
  calc Real.exp (-(-lam) * ((n:ℝ)*((1-γ)*p - c))) * mgf X (Pm D n) (-lam)
      ≤ Real.exp (-(-lam) * ((n:ℝ)*((1-γ)*p - c))) * Real.exp (-((n:ℝ) * p * (1 - Real.exp (-lam)))) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmgf_le (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ = Real.exp (lam * ((n:ℝ)*((1-γ)*p - c)) - (n:ℝ) * p * (1 - Real.exp (-lam))) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-(2*γ*(n:ℝ)*c)) := by
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
        have hq : Real.exp (-(2*γ)) ≤ 1 - 2*γ + (2*γ)^2/2 := exp_neg_quad (2*γ) (by linarith)
        have hn0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ n := Nat.cast_nonneg n
        rw [hlam]
        have hbr : 2*γ*(1-γ) - 1 + Real.exp (-(2*γ)) ≤ 0 := by nlinarith [hq]
        have key : ((n:ℝ)*p) * (2*γ*(1-γ) - 1 + Real.exp (-(2*γ))) ≤ 0 :=
          mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (mul_nonneg hn0 hp0) hbr
        nlinarith [key]


lemma add_hoeffding (D : Measure 𝒵) [IsProbabilityMeasure D]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (g : 𝒵 → ℝ) (hg : Measurable g) (hg01 : ∀ z, g z ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    (Pm D n).real {S | (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, g (S i) ≤ (∫ z, g z ∂D) - u}
      ≤ Real.exp (-(2*(n:ℝ)*u^2)) := by
  classical
  set p : ℝ := ∫ z, g z ∂D with hp
  have hgint : Integrable g D := Integrable.of_mem_Icc 0 1 hg.aemeasurable (ae_of_all _ hg01)
  set W : Fin n → (Fin n → 𝒵) → ℝ := fun i S => p - g (S i) with hW
  have hWmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (W i) := fun i => measurable_const.sub (hg.comp (measurable_pi_apply i))
  have hindep : iIndepFun W (Pm D n) :=
    (iIndep_coords D n).comp (fun _ => fun z => p - g z) (fun _ => measurable_const.sub hg)
  have hsub : ∀ i : Fin n, HasSubgaussianMGF (W i) (1/4 : NNReal) (Pm D n) := by
    intro i
    have hmean : ∫ S, W i S ∂(Pm D n) = 0 := by
      have : ∫ S, W i S ∂(Pm D n) = ∫ z, (p - g z) ∂D :=
        pi_integral_eval D i (fun z => p - g z) (by fun_prop)
      rw [this, integral_sub (integrable_const p) hgint]
      simp [hp]
    have hbdd : ∀ᵐ S ∂(Pm D n), W i S ∈ Set.Icc (p - 1) (p - 0) := by
      filter_upwards with S
      obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := hg01 (S i)
      constructor <;> simp [hW] <;> linarith
    have h2 := hasSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc_of_integral_eq_zero (μ := Pm D n) (X := W i)
      (hWmeas i).aemeasurable hbdd hmean
    have heq : (‖(p - 0) - (p - 1)‖₊ / 2) ^ 2 = (1/4 : NNReal) := by
      apply NNReal.coe_injective
      push_cast
      norm_num
    rwa [heq] at h2
  have hmain := ProbabilityTheory.HasSubgaussianMGF.measure_sum_ge_le_of_iIndepFun hindep
    (c := fun _ => (1/4 : NNReal)) (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => hsub i)
    (ε := (n:ℝ)*u) (by positivity)
  have hn' : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hevent : {S : Fin n → 𝒵 | (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, g (S i) ≤ p - u}
      = {S | (n:ℝ)*u ≤ ∑ i, W i S} := by
    ext S
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, hW, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, one_mul, div_le_iff₀ hn']
    constructor <;> intro h <;> nlinarith [h]
  rw [hevent]
  refine hmain.trans ?_
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
  rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
  push_cast
  rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
  ring_nf
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg u, hn'.le]


/-! ### Symmetrization -/

noncomputable def Qm (D : Measure 𝒵) (n : ℕ) : Measure (Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵) :=
  Measure.pi (fun _ => D.prod D)

instance (D : Measure 𝒵) [IsProbabilityMeasure D] (n : ℕ) : IsProbabilityMeasure (Qm D n) := by
  unfold Qm; infer_instance

def swapY {n : ℕ} (A : Fin n → Bool) (y : Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵) : Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵 :=
  fun i => if A i then (y i).swap else y i

lemma measurable_swapY {n : ℕ} (A : Fin n → Bool) :
    Measurable (swapY A : (Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵) → (Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵)) := by
  apply measurable_pi_lambda
  intro i
  by_cases h : A i <;> simp only [swapY, h, if_true, if_false, reduceIte]
  · exact measurable_swap.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)
  · exact measurable_pi_apply i

lemma measurable_swapY_prod {n : ℕ} :
    Measurable (fun q : (Fin n → Bool) × (Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵) => swapY q.1 q.2) := by
  apply measurable_pi_lambda
  intro i
  have hset : MeasurableSet {q : (Fin n → Bool) × (Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵) | q.1 i = true} := by
    have he : {q : (Fin n → Bool) × (Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵) | q.1 i = true}
        = (fun q : (Fin n → Bool) × (Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵) => q.1 i) ⁻¹' {true} := rfl
    rw [he]
    exact ((measurable_pi_apply i).comp measurable_fst) (measurableSet_singleton true)
  show Measurable (fun q : (Fin n → Bool) × (Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵) =>
    if q.1 i then (q.2 i).swap else q.2 i)
  exact Measurable.ite hset (measurable_swap.comp ((measurable_pi_apply i).comp measurable_snd))
    ((measurable_pi_apply i).comp measurable_snd)

lemma swapY_map (D : Measure 𝒵) [IsProbabilityMeasure D] (n : ℕ) (A : Fin n → Bool) :
    Measure.map (swapY A) (Qm D n) = Qm D n := by
  classical
  rw [Qm]
  refine (Measure.pi_eq (μ := fun _ : Fin n => D.prod D) ?_).symm
  intro s hs
  rw [Measure.map_apply (measurable_swapY A) (MeasurableSet.univ_pi hs)]
  have hpre : (swapY A) ⁻¹' (Set.univ.pi s)
      = Set.univ.pi (fun i => if A i then Prod.swap ⁻¹' (s i) else s i) := by
    ext y
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_univ_pi, swapY]
    constructor
    · intro h i
      have := h i
      by_cases hA : A i <;> simp [hA] at this ⊢ <;> exact this
    · intro h i
      have := h i
      by_cases hA : A i <;> simp [hA] at this ⊢ <;> exact this
  rw [hpre, Measure.pi_pi]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro i _
  by_cases hA : A i
  · simp only [hA, if_true]
    rw [← Measure.map_apply measurable_swap (hs i), Measure.prod_swap]
  · simp [hA]

lemma symmetrization (D : Measure 𝒵) [IsProbabilityMeasure D] (n : ℕ)
    {G : Set (Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵)} (hG : MeasurableSet G) :
    Qm D n G = ∫⁻ y, (Rm n) {A | swapY A y ∈ G} ∂(Qm D n) := by
  set T : (Fin n → Bool) × (Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵) → (Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵) := fun q => swapY q.1 q.2 with hT
  have hTm : Measurable T := measurable_swapY_prod
  have h2 : ((Rm n).prod (Qm D n)) (T ⁻¹' G) = ∫⁻ y, (Rm n) {A | swapY A y ∈ G} ∂(Qm D n) := by
    rw [Measure.prod_apply_symm (hTm hG)]
    rfl
  have h1 : ((Rm n).prod (Qm D n)) (T ⁻¹' G) = Qm D n G := by
    rw [Measure.prod_apply (hTm hG)]
    have : ∀ A : Fin n → Bool, (Qm D n) (Prod.mk A ⁻¹' (T ⁻¹' G)) = Qm D n G := by
      intro A
      have : Prod.mk A ⁻¹' (T ⁻¹' G) = (swapY A) ⁻¹' G := rfl
      rw [this, ← Measure.map_apply (measurable_swapY A) hG, swapY_map]
    simp_rw [this]
    simp
  rw [← h1, h2]


/-! ### Union of events / selection -/

lemma combine {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] (P : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    {ι : Type*} [Countable ι] [Nonempty ι] (a : ι → ℝ) (V Tr : X → ι → ℝ)
    (hV : ∀ w, Measurable (fun S => V S w)) (hTr : ∀ w, Measurable (fun S => Tr S w))
    (c₁ c₂ δ δ₁ δ₂ : ℝ) (hδ₂0 : 0 ≤ δ₂) (hδ₂1 : δ₂ < 1) (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ)
    (h1 : (P.prod P) {q | ∃ w, Tr q.1 w + c₁ < V q.2 w} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ₁)
    (h2 : ∀ w, P {S | V S w + c₂ < a w} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ₂)
    (hcond : δ₁ ≤ δ * (1 - δ₂)) :
    P {S | ∃ w, Tr S w + (c₁ + c₂) < a w} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e : ℕ → ι, Function.Surjective e := exists_surjective_nat ι
  set Bad : ℕ → Set X := fun k => {S | Tr S (e k) + (c₁+c₂) < a (e k)} with hBad
  have hBadm : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (Bad k) := by
    intro k
    exact measurableSet_lt ((hTr (e k)).add_const _) measurable_const
  set U : ℕ → Set X := disjointed Bad with hU
  have hUm : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (U k) := fun k => MeasurableSet.disjointed hBadm k
  have hUdisj : Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint U) := disjoint_disjointed Bad
  have hUunion : (⋃ k, U k) = {S | ∃ w, Tr S w + (c₁ + c₂) < a w} := by
    rw [hU, iUnion_disjointed]
    ext S
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_setOf_eq, hBad]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩; exact ⟨e k, hk⟩
    · rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
      obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := he w
      exact ⟨k, hw⟩
  set Good : ℕ → Set X := fun k => {S | a (e k) ≤ V S (e k) + c₂} with hGood
  have hGoodm : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (Good k) := by
    intro k
    exact measurableSet_le measurable_const ((hV (e k)).add_const _)
  have hGoodP : ∀ k, ENNReal.ofReal (1-δ₂) ≤ P (Good k) := by
    intro k
    have hc : (Good k)ᶜ = {S | V S (e k) + c₂ < a (e k)} := by
      ext S; simp [hGood, not_le]
    have h3 : P ((Good k)ᶜ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ₂ := by rw [hc]; exact h2 (e k)
    have h4 : P (Good k) = 1 - P ((Good k)ᶜ) := by
      rw [measure_compl (hGoodm k) (measure_ne_top _ _)]
      rw [measure_univ]
      rw [ENNReal.sub_sub_cancel ENNReal.one_ne_top prob_le_one]
    rw [h4]
    have : (1:ENNReal) - ENNReal.ofReal δ₂ ≤ 1 - P ((Good k)ᶜ) := tsub_le_tsub_left h3 1
    refine le_trans ?_ this
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_sub _ hδ₂0]
    simp
  have hsub : (⋃ k, (U k) ×ˢ (Good k)) ⊆ {q : X × X | ∃ w, Tr q.1 w + c₁ < V q.2 w} := by
    rintro ⟨S, S'⟩ hq
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_prod] at hq
    obtain ⟨k, hS, hS'⟩ := hq
    refine ⟨e k, ?_⟩
    have h5 : Tr S (e k) + (c₁+c₂) < a (e k) := (disjointed_le Bad k hS)
    have h6 : a (e k) ≤ V S' (e k) + c₂ := hS'
    linarith
  have hdisj2 : Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint (fun k => (U k) ×ˢ (Good k))) := by
    intro i j hij
    have := hUdisj hij
    simp only [Function.onFun, Set.disjoint_left] at this ⊢
    rintro ⟨S, S'⟩ h1 h2
    exact this h1.1 h2.1
  have key : ENNReal.ofReal (1-δ₂) * P {S | ∃ w, Tr S w + (c₁ + c₂) < a w} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ₁ := by
    rw [← hUunion, measure_iUnion hUdisj hUm, ENNReal.tsum_mul_left.symm]
    calc ∑' k, ENNReal.ofReal (1-δ₂) * P (U k)
        ≤ ∑' k, P (Good k) * P (U k) :=
          ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum (fun k => mul_le_mul_right' (hGoodP k) _)
      _ = ∑' k, (P.prod P) ((U k) ×ˢ (Good k)) := by
          refine tsum_congr (fun k => ?_)
          rw [Measure.prod_prod, mul_comm]
      _ = (P.prod P) (⋃ k, (U k) ×ˢ (Good k)) :=
          (measure_iUnion hdisj2 (fun k => (hUm k).prod (hGoodm k))).symm
      _ ≤ (P.prod P) {q : X × X | ∃ w, Tr q.1 w + c₁ < V q.2 w} := measure_mono hsub
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ₁ := h1
  have hpos : ENNReal.ofReal (1-δ₂) ≠ 0 := by
    simp [ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero]; linarith
  have hfin : ENNReal.ofReal (1-δ₂) ≠ ⊤ := ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  rw [mul_comm] at key
  have := (ENNReal.le_div_iff_mul_le (Or.inl hpos) (Or.inl hfin)).2 key
  refine this.trans ?_
  rw [ENNReal.div_le_iff hpos hfin, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hδ0]
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hcond


/-! ### swap identities -/

lemma swap_diff {𝒵 ι : Type*} (f : ι → 𝒵 → ℝ) {n : ℕ} (A : Fin n → Bool)
    (y : Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵) (w : ι) :
    (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w ((swapY A y) i).2 - (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w ((swapY A y) i).1
      = (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, sgnb A i * (f w (y i).2 - f w (y i).1) := by
  rw [← mul_sub, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  by_cases h : A i <;> simp [swapY, sgnb, h] <;> ring

lemma swap_sum {𝒵 ι : Type*} (f : ι → 𝒵 → ℝ) {n : ℕ} (A : Fin n → Bool)
    (y : Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵) (w : ι) :
    ∑ i, (f w ((swapY A y) i).1 + f w ((swapY A y) i).2)
      = ∑ i, (f w (y i).1 + f w (y i).2) := by
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  by_cases h : A i <;> simp [swapY, h] <;> ring

/-! ### transport between the double sample space and the product space -/

lemma Qm_to_prod {𝒵 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒵] (D : Measure 𝒵) [IsProbabilityMeasure D]
    (n : ℕ) {B : Set ((Fin n → 𝒵) × (Fin n → 𝒵))} (hB : MeasurableSet B) :
    ((Pm D n).prod (Pm D n)) B
      = (Qm D n) {y : Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵 | ((fun i => (y i).1), (fun i => (y i).2)) ∈ B} := by
  have he := measurePreserving_arrowProdEquivProdArrow 𝒵 𝒵 (Fin n) (fun _ => D) (fun _ => D)
  have h1 : (Qm D n) ((MeasurableEquiv.arrowProdEquivProdArrow 𝒵 𝒵 (Fin n)) ⁻¹' B)
      = ((Pm D n).prod (Pm D n)) B := by
    have := he.measure_preimage hB.nullMeasurableSet
    simpa [Qm, Pm] using this
  rw [← h1]
  rfl

/-! ### Core theorem, additive version -/

theorem core1 {𝒵 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒵] (D : Measure 𝒵) [IsProbabilityMeasure D]
    {ι : Type*} [Countable ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (f : ι → 𝒵 → ℝ) (hfm : ∀ w, Measurable (f w)) (hf01 : ∀ w z, f w z ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (hcov : ∀ᵐ y ∂(Qm D n), ∃ C : Finset (𝒵 → ℝ), C.card ≤ N ∧
        (∀ g ∈ C, ∀ z, g z ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) ∧
        ∀ w : ι, ∃ g ∈ C, (1/(2*(n:ℝ))) *
          ∑ i, (|f w (y i).1 - g (y i).1| + |f w (y i).2 - g (y i).2|) ≤ ε)
    (δ : ℝ) (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) :
    (Pm D n) {S | ∃ w : ι, (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (S i)
        + (2*ε + 3 * Real.sqrt (Real.log (3*(N:ℝ)/δ)/(2*(n:ℝ)))) < ∫ z, f w z ∂D}
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ := by
  classical
  have hn' : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hN' : (1:ℝ) ≤ (N:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hN
  set δ₁ : ℝ := 2*δ/3 with hδ₁def
  set δ₂ : ℝ := δ/3 with hδ₂def
  have hδ₁0 : 0 < δ₁ := by rw [hδ₁def]; linarith
  have hδ₁1 : δ₁ < 1 := by rw [hδ₁def]; linarith
  have hδ₂0 : 0 < δ₂ := by rw [hδ₂def]; linarith
  have hδ₂1 : δ₂ < 1 := by rw [hδ₂def]; linarith
  set Λ : ℝ := Real.log (3*(N:ℝ)/δ) with hΛdef
  set L : ℝ := Real.log ((N:ℝ)/δ₁) with hLdef
  set L₂ : ℝ := Real.log (1/δ₂) with hL₂def
  have hLΛ : L ≤ Λ := by
    rw [hLdef, hΛdef]
    apply Real.log_le_log (by positivity)
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    rw [hδ₁def]; nlinarith
  have hL₂Λ : L₂ ≤ Λ := by
    rw [hL₂def, hΛdef]
    apply Real.log_le_log (by positivity)
    rw [hδ₂def, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    nlinarith
  have hL0 : 0 < L := by
    rw [hLdef]
    apply Real.log_pos
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ hδ₁0]; linarith
  have hL₂0 : 0 < L₂ := by
    rw [hL₂def]
    apply Real.log_pos
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ hδ₂0]; linarith
  set s : ℝ := Real.sqrt (2*L/(n:ℝ)) with hsdef
  set u : ℝ := Real.sqrt (L₂/(2*(n:ℝ))) with hudef
  have hs0 : 0 < s := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by positivity)
  have hu0 : 0 < u := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by positivity)
  have hs2 : s^2 = 2*L/(n:ℝ) := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hu2 : u^2 = L₂/(2*(n:ℝ)) := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  -- measurability facts
  have hmeas1 : ∀ w : ι, Measurable (fun y : Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵 => (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (y i).1) := by
    intro w
    apply Measurable.const_mul
    apply Finset.measurable_sum
    intro i _
    exact (hfm w).comp (measurable_fst.comp (measurable_pi_apply i))
  have hmeas2 : ∀ w : ι, Measurable (fun y : Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵 => (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (y i).2) := by
    intro w
    apply Measurable.const_mul
    apply Finset.measurable_sum
    intro i _
    exact (hfm w).comp (measurable_snd.comp (measurable_pi_apply i))
  have hmeasP : ∀ w : ι, Measurable (fun S : Fin n → 𝒵 => (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (S i)) := by
    intro w
    apply Measurable.const_mul
    apply Finset.measurable_sum
    intro i _
    exact (hfm w).comp (measurable_pi_apply i)
  -- Step 1 : the double sample bound on Qm
  have hQ : (Qm D n) {y : Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵 | ∃ w : ι,
      (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (y i).1 + (2*ε + s) < (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (y i).2}
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ₁ := by
    have hGmeas : MeasurableSet {y : Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵 | ∃ w : ι,
        (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (y i).1 + (2*ε + s) < (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (y i).2} := by
      have he : {y : Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵 | ∃ w : ι,
          (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (y i).1 + (2*ε + s) < (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (y i).2}
          = ⋃ w : ι, {y : Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵 |
              (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (y i).1 + (2*ε + s) < (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (y i).2} := by
        ext y; simp
      rw [he]
      exact MeasurableSet.iUnion (fun w =>
        measurableSet_lt ((hmeas1 w).add_const _) (hmeas2 w))
    rw [symmetrization D n hGmeas]
    calc ∫⁻ y, (Rm n) {A | swapY A y ∈ {y : Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵 | ∃ w : ι,
            (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (y i).1 + (2*ε + s) < (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (y i).2}}
            ∂(Qm D n)
        ≤ ∫⁻ _y, ENNReal.ofReal δ₁ ∂(Qm D n) := by
          apply lintegral_mono_ae
          filter_upwards [hcov] with y hy
          obtain ⟨C, hcard, hC01, hCcov⟩ := hy
          have hset : {A : Fin n → Bool | ∃ w : ι,
              (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w ((swapY A y) i).1 + (2*ε + s)
                < (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w ((swapY A y) i).2}
              = {A : Fin n → Bool | ∃ w : ι,
                  2*ε + s < (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, sgnb A i * (f w (y i).2 - f w (y i).1)} := by
            ext A
            simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
            constructor
            · rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
              refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
              rw [← swap_diff f A y w]
              linarith
            · rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
              refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
              rw [← swap_diff f A y w] at hw
              linarith
          rw [hset]
          refine le_trans (pointwise1 hn f hf01 y ε s hs0 C hC01 hCcov L ?_) ?_
          · rw [mul_pow, hs2]
            field_simp
            ring_nf
            nlinarith [hL0.le, hn'.le, sq_nonneg ((n:ℝ))]
          · have hcexp : (C.card : ENNReal) * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-L))
                ≤ (N : ENNReal) * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-L)) := by
              apply mul_le_mul_right'
              exact_mod_cast hcard
            refine hcexp.trans ?_
            rw [show ((N:ENNReal)) = ENNReal.ofReal (N:ℝ) by
              simp [ENNReal.ofReal_natCast]]
            rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity)]
            apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
            rw [hLdef, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log (by positivity)]
            rw [inv_div]
            field_simp
            norm_num
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal δ₁ := by
          rw [lintegral_const, measure_univ, mul_one]
  -- Step 2 : transport to the product measure
  have hPP : ((Pm D n).prod (Pm D n)) {q : (Fin n → 𝒵) × (Fin n → 𝒵) | ∃ w : ι,
      (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (q.1 i) + (2*ε + s) < (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (q.2 i)}
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ₁ := by
    have hBmeas : MeasurableSet {q : (Fin n → 𝒵) × (Fin n → 𝒵) | ∃ w : ι,
        (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (q.1 i) + (2*ε + s) < (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (q.2 i)} := by
      have he : {q : (Fin n → 𝒵) × (Fin n → 𝒵) | ∃ w : ι,
          (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (q.1 i) + (2*ε + s) < (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (q.2 i)}
          = ⋃ w : ι, {q : (Fin n → 𝒵) × (Fin n → 𝒵) |
              (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (q.1 i) + (2*ε + s) < (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (q.2 i)} := by
        ext q; simp
      rw [he]
      exact MeasurableSet.iUnion (fun w =>
        measurableSet_lt (((hmeasP w).comp measurable_fst).add_const _)
          ((hmeasP w).comp measurable_snd))
    rw [Qm_to_prod D n hBmeas]
    exact hQ
  -- Step 3 : Chernoff bound for a fixed w
  have hCher : ∀ w : ι, (Pm D n) {S : Fin n → 𝒵 |
      (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (S i) + u < ∫ z, f w z ∂D} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ₂ := by
    intro w
    have h1 := add_hoeffding D n hn (f w) (hfm w) (hf01 w) u hu0.le
    have h2 : {S : Fin n → 𝒵 | (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (S i) + u < ∫ z, f w z ∂D}
        ⊆ {S : Fin n → 𝒵 | (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (S i) ≤ (∫ z, f w z ∂D) - u} := by
      intro S hS
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hS ⊢
      linarith
    refine le_trans (measure_mono h2) ?_
    have h3 : (Pm D n) {S : Fin n → 𝒵 | (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (S i) ≤ (∫ z, f w z ∂D) - u}
        ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(2*(n:ℝ)*u^2))) :=
      (ENNReal.le_ofReal_iff_toReal_le (measure_ne_top _ _) (Real.exp_pos _).le).2 h1
    refine h3.trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_)
    rw [hu2]
    have : 2*(n:ℝ)*(L₂/(2*(n:ℝ))) = L₂ := by field_simp
    rw [this, hL₂def, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log (by positivity)]
    rw [inv_div]
    simp
  -- Step 4 : combination
  have hcomb := combine (Pm D n) (fun w : ι => ∫ z, f w z ∂D)
    (fun S w => (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (S i)) (fun S w => (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (S i))
    hmeasP hmeasP (2*ε + s) u δ δ₁ δ₂ hδ₂0.le hδ₂1 hδ0.le hPP hCher
    (by rw [hδ₁def, hδ₂def]; nlinarith)
  refine le_trans (measure_mono ?_) hcomb
  intro S hS
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hS ⊢
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hS
  refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
  have hsu : s + u ≤ 3 * Real.sqrt (Λ/(2*(n:ℝ))) := by
    have h1 : s ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (Λ/(2*(n:ℝ))) := by
      rw [hsdef]
      have he : 2 * Real.sqrt (Λ/(2*(n:ℝ))) = Real.sqrt (4*(Λ/(2*(n:ℝ)))) := by
        rw [show (4:ℝ) = 2^2 by norm_num, Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity),
          Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)]
      rw [he]
      apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hn']
      have : 4*(Λ/(2*(n:ℝ)))*(n:ℝ) = 2*Λ := by field_simp; ring
      rw [this]
      linarith
    have h2 : u ≤ Real.sqrt (Λ/(2*(n:ℝ))) := by
      rw [hudef]
      apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hL₂Λ (by positivity)
    linarith
  linarith

/-! ### Core theorem, multiplicative version -/

lemma Qm_fst_measurePreserving {𝒵 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒵] (D : Measure 𝒵)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure D] (n : ℕ) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun y : Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵 => fun i => (y i).1) (Qm D n) (Pm D n) := by
  have he := measurePreserving_arrowProdEquivProdArrow 𝒵 𝒵 (Fin n) (fun _ => D) (fun _ => D)
  have he' : MeasurePreserving (MeasurableEquiv.arrowProdEquivProdArrow 𝒵 𝒵 (Fin n))
      (Qm D n) ((Pm D n).prod (Pm D n)) := by simpa [Qm, Pm] using he
  exact (measurePreserving_fst).comp he'

lemma Qm_snd_measurePreserving {𝒵 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒵] (D : Measure 𝒵)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure D] (n : ℕ) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun y : Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵 => fun i => (y i).2) (Qm D n) (Pm D n) := by
  have he := measurePreserving_arrowProdEquivProdArrow 𝒵 𝒵 (Fin n) (fun _ => D) (fun _ => D)
  have he' : MeasurePreserving (MeasurableEquiv.arrowProdEquivProdArrow 𝒵 𝒵 (Fin n))
      (Qm D n) ((Pm D n).prod (Pm D n)) := by simpa [Qm, Pm] using he
  exact (measurePreserving_snd).comp he'

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
theorem core2 {𝒵 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒵] (D : Measure 𝒵) [IsProbabilityMeasure D]
    {ι : Type*} [Countable ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (f : ι → 𝒵 → ℝ) (hfm : ∀ w, Measurable (f w)) (hf01 : ∀ w z, f w z ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (γ : ℝ) (hγ0 : 0 < γ) (hγ1 : γ < 1)
    (hcov : ∀ᵐ S ∂(Pm D n), ∃ C : Finset (𝒵 → ℝ), C.card ≤ N ∧
        (∀ g ∈ C, ∀ z, g z ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) ∧
        ∀ w : ι, ∃ g ∈ C, (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, |f w (S i) - g (S i)| ≤ ε)
    (δ : ℝ) (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) :
    (Pm D n) {S | ∃ w : ι, (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (S i)
        + (2*ε + (5-4*γ) * Real.log (3*(N:ℝ)/δ) / (2*γ*(n:ℝ))) < (1-γ)^2 * ∫ z, f w z ∂D}
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ := by
  classical
  have hn' : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hN' : (1:ℝ) ≤ (N:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have h2γ : (0:ℝ) < 2 - γ := by linarith
  set γ' : ℝ := γ/(2-γ) with hγ'def
  have hγ'0 : 0 < γ' := by rw [hγ'def]; positivity
  have h1pγ' : 1 + γ' = 2/(2-γ) := by rw [hγ'def]; field_simp; ring
  have hprod : (1+γ')*(1-γ) = 1-γ' := by rw [hγ'def]; field_simp; ring
  have h1pγ'0 : 0 < 1 + γ' := by linarith
  set δ₁ : ℝ := 2*δ/3 with hδ₁def
  set δ₂ : ℝ := δ/3 with hδ₂def
  have hδ₁0 : 0 < δ₁ := by rw [hδ₁def]; linarith
  have hδ₁1 : δ₁ < 1 := by rw [hδ₁def]; linarith
  have hδ₂0 : 0 < δ₂ := by rw [hδ₂def]; linarith
  have hδ₂1 : δ₂ < 1 := by rw [hδ₂def]; linarith
  set Λ : ℝ := Real.log (3*(N:ℝ)/δ) with hΛdef
  set L₁ : ℝ := Real.log ((N:ℝ)^2/δ₁) with hL₁def
  set L₂ : ℝ := Real.log (1/δ₂) with hL₂def
  have hΛ0 : 0 ≤ Λ := by
    rw [hΛdef]
    apply Real.log_nonneg
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hδ0]; nlinarith
  have hL₁0 : 0 < L₁ := by
    rw [hL₁def]
    apply Real.log_pos
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ hδ₁0]; nlinarith
  have hL₂0 : 0 < L₂ := by
    rw [hL₂def]
    apply Real.log_pos
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ hδ₂0]; linarith
  have hL₁Λ : L₁ ≤ 2*Λ := by
    have : (N:ℝ)^2/δ₁ ≤ (3*(N:ℝ)/δ)^2 := by
      rw [div_pow, div_le_div_iff₀ hδ₁0 (by positivity), hδ₁def]
      have hsq : (0:ℝ) ≤ (N:ℝ)^2 := sq_nonneg _
      have hd2 : δ^2 ≤ δ := by nlinarith
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd2 hsq]
    calc L₁ ≤ Real.log ((3*(N:ℝ)/δ)^2) := by
            rw [hL₁def]; exact Real.log_le_log (by positivity) this
      _ = 2*Λ := by rw [hΛdef, Real.log_pow]; push_cast; ring
  have hL₂Λ : L₂ ≤ Λ := by
    rw [hL₂def, hΛdef]
    apply Real.log_le_log (by positivity)
    rw [hδ₂def, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    nlinarith
  set c₁ : ℝ := 2*(1+γ')*ε + L₁/(2*γ'*(n:ℝ)) with hc₁def
  set c₂ : ℝ := (1+γ')*(1-γ)*(L₂/(2*γ*(n:ℝ))) with hc₂def
  -- measurability
  have hmeas1 : ∀ w : ι, Measurable (fun y : Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵 => (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (y i).1) := by
    intro w
    exact Measurable.const_mul (Finset.measurable_sum _
      (fun i _ => (hfm w).comp (measurable_fst.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)))) _
  have hmeas2 : ∀ w : ι, Measurable (fun y : Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵 => (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (y i).2) := by
    intro w
    exact Measurable.const_mul (Finset.measurable_sum _
      (fun i _ => (hfm w).comp (measurable_snd.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)))) _
  have hmeasP : ∀ w : ι, Measurable (fun S : Fin n → 𝒵 => (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (S i)) := by
    intro w
    exact Measurable.const_mul (Finset.measurable_sum _
      (fun i _ => (hfm w).comp (measurable_pi_apply i))) _
  -- the two covers, almost surely on the double sample space
  have hcov2 : ∀ᵐ y ∂(Qm D n),
      (∃ C : Finset (𝒵 → ℝ), C.card ≤ N ∧ (∀ g ∈ C, ∀ z, g z ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) ∧
        ∀ w : ι, ∃ g ∈ C, (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, |f w (y i).1 - g (y i).1| ≤ ε) ∧
      (∃ C : Finset (𝒵 → ℝ), C.card ≤ N ∧ (∀ g ∈ C, ∀ z, g z ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) ∧
        ∀ w : ι, ∃ g ∈ C, (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, |f w (y i).2 - g (y i).2| ≤ ε) := by
    have h1 := (Qm_fst_measurePreserving D n).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hcov
    have h2 := (Qm_snd_measurePreserving D n).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hcov
    filter_upwards [h1, h2] with y hy1 hy2
    exact ⟨hy1, hy2⟩
  -- Step 1 : the double sample bound
  have hQ : (Qm D n) {y : Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵 | ∃ w : ι,
      (1+γ') * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (y i).1) + c₁ < (1-γ') * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (y i).2)}
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ₁ := by
    have hGmeas : MeasurableSet {y : Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵 | ∃ w : ι,
        (1+γ') * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (y i).1) + c₁
          < (1-γ') * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (y i).2)} := by
      have he : {y : Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵 | ∃ w : ι,
          (1+γ') * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (y i).1) + c₁
            < (1-γ') * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (y i).2)}
          = ⋃ w : ι, {y : Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵 |
              (1+γ') * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (y i).1) + c₁
                < (1-γ') * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (y i).2)} := by
        ext y; simp
      rw [he]
      exact MeasurableSet.iUnion (fun w =>
        measurableSet_lt (((hmeas1 w).const_mul _).add_const _) ((hmeas2 w).const_mul _))
    rw [symmetrization D n hGmeas]
    calc ∫⁻ y, (Rm n) {A | swapY A y ∈ {y : Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵 | ∃ w : ι,
            (1+γ') * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (y i).1) + c₁
              < (1-γ') * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (y i).2)}} ∂(Qm D n)
        ≤ ∫⁻ _y, ENNReal.ofReal δ₁ ∂(Qm D n) := by
          apply lintegral_mono_ae
          filter_upwards [hcov2] with y hy
          obtain ⟨⟨C₁, hcard₁, hC₁01, hcov₁⟩, ⟨C₂, hcard₂, hC₂01, hcov₂⟩⟩ := hy
          have hset : {A : Fin n → Bool | ∃ w : ι,
              (1+γ') * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w ((swapY A y) i).1) + c₁
                < (1-γ') * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w ((swapY A y) i).2)}
              = {A : Fin n → Bool | ∃ w : ι,
                  γ' * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, (f w (y i).1 + f w (y i).2))
                    + (2*(1+γ')*ε + L₁/(2*γ'*(n:ℝ)))
                    < (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, sgnb A i * (f w (y i).2 - f w (y i).1)} := by
            ext A
            simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
            have hkey : ∀ w : ι,
                ((1-γ') * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w ((swapY A y) i).2)
                  - (1+γ') * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w ((swapY A y) i).1))
                = (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, sgnb A i * (f w (y i).2 - f w (y i).1)
                  - γ' * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, (f w (y i).1 + f w (y i).2)) := by
              intro w
              set E1 : ℝ := (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w ((swapY A y) i).1 with hE1
              set E2 : ℝ := (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w ((swapY A y) i).2 with hE2
              set Sg : ℝ := (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, sgnb A i * (f w (y i).2 - f w (y i).1) with hSg
              set TT : ℝ := (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, (f w (y i).1 + f w (y i).2) with hTT
              have e1 : E2 - E1 = Sg := swap_diff f A y w
              have e2 : E1 + E2 = TT := by
                rw [hE1, hE2, hTT, ← mul_add, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
                congr 1
                exact swap_sum f A y w
              calc (1-γ')*E2 - (1+γ')*E1 = (E2 - E1) - γ'*(E1+E2) := by ring
                _ = Sg - γ'*TT := by rw [e1, e2]
            constructor
            · rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
              refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
              have := hkey w
              rw [hc₁def] at hw
              linarith
            · rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
              refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
              have := hkey w
              rw [hc₁def]
              linarith
          rw [hset]
          refine le_trans (pointwise2 hn f hf01 y ε γ' hγ'0 C₁ C₂ hC₁01 hC₂01 hcov₁ hcov₂
            L₁ hL₁0) ?_
          have hcexp : ((C₁.card * C₂.card : ℕ) : ENNReal) * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-L₁))
              ≤ ((N*N : ℕ) : ENNReal) * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-L₁)) := by
            apply mul_le_mul_right'
            exact_mod_cast Nat.mul_le_mul hcard₁ hcard₂
          refine hcexp.trans ?_
          rw [show (((N*N : ℕ)) : ENNReal) = ENNReal.ofReal ((N:ℝ)*(N:ℝ)) by
            push_cast; rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity)]; simp [ENNReal.ofReal_natCast]]
          rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity)]
          apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
          rw [hL₁def, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log (by positivity), inv_div]
          rw [show ((N:ℝ)*(N:ℝ)) = (N:ℝ)^2 by ring]
          have hcalc : (N:ℝ)^2 * (δ₁/(N:ℝ)^2) = δ₁ := by field_simp
          exact le_of_eq hcalc
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal δ₁ := by rw [lintegral_const, measure_univ, mul_one]
  -- Step 2 : transport
  have hPP : ((Pm D n).prod (Pm D n)) {q : (Fin n → 𝒵) × (Fin n → 𝒵) | ∃ w : ι,
      (1+γ') * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (q.1 i)) + c₁
        < (1-γ') * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (q.2 i))} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ₁ := by
    have hBmeas : MeasurableSet {q : (Fin n → 𝒵) × (Fin n → 𝒵) | ∃ w : ι,
        (1+γ') * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (q.1 i)) + c₁
          < (1-γ') * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (q.2 i))} := by
      have he : {q : (Fin n → 𝒵) × (Fin n → 𝒵) | ∃ w : ι,
          (1+γ') * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (q.1 i)) + c₁
            < (1-γ') * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (q.2 i))}
          = ⋃ w : ι, {q : (Fin n → 𝒵) × (Fin n → 𝒵) |
              (1+γ') * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (q.1 i)) + c₁
                < (1-γ') * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (q.2 i))} := by
        ext q; simp
      rw [he]
      exact MeasurableSet.iUnion (fun w =>
        measurableSet_lt ((((hmeasP w).comp measurable_fst).const_mul _).add_const _)
          (((hmeasP w).comp measurable_snd).const_mul _))
    rw [Qm_to_prod D n hBmeas]
    exact hQ
  -- Step 3 : multiplicative Chernoff for a fixed w
  have hCher : ∀ w : ι, (Pm D n) {S : Fin n → 𝒵 |
      (1-γ') * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (S i)) + c₂ < (1+γ')*(1-γ)^2 * ∫ z, f w z ∂D}
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ₂ := by
    intro w
    have h1 := mult_chernoff D n hn (f w) (hfm w) (hf01 w) γ hγ0 hγ1 (L₂/(2*γ*(n:ℝ)))
    have h2 : {S : Fin n → 𝒵 |
        (1-γ') * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (S i)) + c₂ < (1+γ')*(1-γ)^2 * ∫ z, f w z ∂D}
        ⊆ {S : Fin n → 𝒵 | (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (S i)
            ≤ (1-γ) * (∫ z, f w z ∂D) - L₂/(2*γ*(n:ℝ))} := by
      intro S hS
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hS ⊢
      have hpos : 0 < (1+γ')*(1-γ) := by nlinarith
      have hexp : (1+γ')*(1-γ) * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (S i) + L₂/(2*γ*(n:ℝ)))
          < (1+γ')*(1-γ) * ((1-γ) * (∫ z, f w z ∂D)) := by
        rw [hc₂def] at hS
        calc (1+γ')*(1-γ) * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (S i) + L₂/(2*γ*(n:ℝ)))
            = (1-γ')*((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (S i))
              + (1+γ')*(1-γ)*(L₂/(2*γ*(n:ℝ))) := by rw [← hprod]; ring
          _ < (1+γ')*(1-γ)^2 * ∫ z, f w z ∂D := hS
          _ = (1+γ')*(1-γ) * ((1-γ) * (∫ z, f w z ∂D)) := by ring
      have := lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left hexp (le_of_lt hpos)
      linarith
    refine le_trans (measure_mono h2) ?_
    have h3 : (Pm D n) {S : Fin n → 𝒵 | (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (S i)
        ≤ (1-γ) * (∫ z, f w z ∂D) - L₂/(2*γ*(n:ℝ))}
        ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(2*γ*(n:ℝ)*(L₂/(2*γ*(n:ℝ)))))) :=
      (ENNReal.le_ofReal_iff_toReal_le (measure_ne_top _ _) (Real.exp_pos _).le).2 h1
    refine h3.trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_)
    have he : 2*γ*(n:ℝ)*(L₂/(2*γ*(n:ℝ))) = L₂ := by field_simp
    rw [he, hL₂def, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log (by positivity), inv_div]
    simp
  -- Step 4 : combination
  have hcomb := combine (Pm D n) (fun w : ι => (1+γ')*(1-γ)^2 * ∫ z, f w z ∂D)
    (fun S w => (1-γ') * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (S i)))
    (fun S w => (1+γ') * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (S i)))
    (fun w => (hmeasP w).const_mul _) (fun w => (hmeasP w).const_mul _)
    c₁ c₂ δ δ₁ δ₂ hδ₂0.le hδ₂1 hδ0.le hPP hCher
    (by rw [hδ₁def, hδ₂def]; nlinarith)
  refine le_trans (measure_mono ?_) hcomb
  -- Step 5 : the constants
  have hcc : c₁ + c₂ ≤ (1+γ')*(2*ε + (5-4*γ)*Λ/(2*γ*(n:ℝ))) := by
    have expand : (1+γ')*(2*ε + (5-4*γ)*Λ/(2*γ*(n:ℝ))) - (c₁ + c₂)
        = (2*(5-4*γ)*Λ - L₁*(2-γ)^2 - 2*(1-γ)*L₂) / ((2-γ)*(2*γ*(n:ℝ))) := by
      rw [hc₁def, hc₂def, hγ'def]
      field_simp
      ring
    have hnum : 0 ≤ 2*(5-4*γ)*Λ - L₁*(2-γ)^2 - 2*(1-γ)*L₂ := by
      have hq1 : L₁*(2-γ)^2 ≤ 2*Λ*(2-γ)^2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2-γ), hL₁Λ]
      have hq2 : 2*(1-γ)*L₂ ≤ 2*(1-γ)*Λ := by nlinarith [hL₂Λ]
      have hq3 : 0 ≤ Λ * (γ - γ^2) := mul_nonneg hΛ0 (by nlinarith)
      nlinarith [hq1, hq2, hq3]
    have hden : 0 < (2-γ)*(2*γ*(n:ℝ)) := by positivity
    have := div_nonneg hnum hden.le
    linarith [expand]
  intro S hS
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hS ⊢
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hS
  refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
  have hmul : (1+γ') * ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, f w (S i))
      + (1+γ')*(2*ε + (5-4*γ)*Λ/(2*γ*(n:ℝ))) < (1+γ')*((1-γ)^2 * ∫ z, f w z ∂D) := by
    have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hw h1pγ'0
    nlinarith [this]
  nlinarith [hmul, hcc]

/-! ### Passing to the infimum over ε -/

theorem master {𝒵 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒵] (D : Measure 𝒵) [IsProbabilityMeasure D]
    {ι : Type*} [Countable ι]
    (ψ : ι → 𝒵 → ℝ) (hψm : ∀ w, Measurable (ψ w)) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (κ : ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℝ) (δ : ℝ) (hδ0 : 0 < δ)
    (hFnn : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → 0 ≤ F ε)
    (hF : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → (Pm D n) {S : Fin n → 𝒵 | ∃ w : ι,
      (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, ψ w (S i) + F ε < κ * ∫ z, ψ w z ∂D} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (1-δ) ≤ (Pm D n) {S : Fin n → 𝒵 | ∀ w : ι,
      κ * (∫ z, ψ w z ∂D) ≤ (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, ψ w (S i)
        + ⨅ e : {e : ℝ // 0 < e}, F (e : ℝ)} := by
  classical
  set I : ℝ := ⨅ e : {e : ℝ // 0 < e}, F (e : ℝ) with hIdef
  set Bad : ℝ → Set (Fin n → 𝒵) := fun c => {S : Fin n → 𝒵 | ∃ w : ι,
    (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, ψ w (S i) + c < κ * ∫ z, ψ w z ∂D} with hBaddef
  have hBadmeas : ∀ c, MeasurableSet (Bad c) := by
    intro c
    have he : Bad c = ⋃ w : ι, {S : Fin n → 𝒵 |
        (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, ψ w (S i) + c < κ * ∫ z, ψ w z ∂D} := by
      rw [hBaddef]; ext S; simp
    rw [he]
    refine MeasurableSet.iUnion (fun w => measurableSet_lt ?_ measurable_const)
    exact (Measurable.const_mul (Finset.measurable_sum _
      (fun i _ => (hψm w).comp (measurable_pi_apply i))) _).add_const _
  have hmono : Monotone (fun k : ℕ => Bad (I + 1/((k:ℝ)+1))) := by
    intro k l hkl
    intro S hS
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hS
    refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
    have : (1:ℝ)/((l:ℝ)+1) ≤ 1/((k:ℝ)+1) := by
      apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity)
      have : (k:ℝ) ≤ (l:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hkl
      linarith
    linarith
  have hunion : Bad I = ⋃ k : ℕ, Bad (I + 1/((k:ℝ)+1)) := by
    ext S
    simp only [hBaddef, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_nat_one_div_lt (show (0:ℝ) <
        κ * (∫ z, ψ w z ∂D) - ((1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, ψ w (S i) + I) by linarith)
      exact ⟨k, w, by linarith⟩
    · rintro ⟨k, w, hw⟩
      refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
      have : (0:ℝ) < 1/((k:ℝ)+1) := by positivity
      linarith
  have hIle : ∀ e : {e : ℝ // 0 < e}, I ≤ F (e : ℝ) := by
    intro e
    apply ciInf_le
    exact ⟨0, by rintro x ⟨e', rfl⟩; exact hFnn _ e'.2⟩
  have hBadI : (Pm D n) (Bad I) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ := by
    rw [hunion, hmono.measure_iUnion]
    apply iSup_le
    intro k
    have hlt : I < I + 1/((k:ℝ)+1) := by
      have : (0:ℝ) < 1/((k:ℝ)+1) := by positivity
      linarith
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_lt_of_ciInf_lt (f := fun e : {e : ℝ // 0 < e} => F (e : ℝ)) hlt
    refine le_trans (measure_mono ?_) (hF (e : ℝ) e.2)
    intro S hS
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hS
    exact ⟨w, by linarith⟩
  have hcompl : {S : Fin n → 𝒵 | ∀ w : ι,
      κ * (∫ z, ψ w z ∂D) ≤ (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, ψ w (S i) + I} = (Bad I)ᶜ := by
    rw [hBaddef]
    ext S
    simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_exists, not_lt]
  rw [hcompl, measure_compl (hBadmeas I) (measure_ne_top _ _), measure_univ]
  have h1 : ENNReal.ofReal (1-δ) = 1 - ENNReal.ofReal δ := by
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_sub _ hδ0.le]; simp
  rw [h1]
  exact tsub_le_tsub_left hBadI 1

/-! ### Flattening pairs -/

def flatEq (n : ℕ) : Fin n ⊕ Fin n ≃ Fin (2*n) :=
  finSumFinEquiv.trans (finCongr (by ring))

def pairFlat {𝒵 : Type*} {n : ℕ} (y : Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵) : Fin (2*n) → 𝒵 :=
  fun j => Sum.elim (fun i => (y i).1) (fun i => (y i).2) ((flatEq n).symm j)

lemma sum_pairFlat {𝒵 : Type*} {n : ℕ} (y : Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵) (F : 𝒵 → ℝ) :
    ∑ j : Fin (2*n), F (pairFlat y j)
      = ∑ i : Fin n, (F (y i).1 + F (y i).2) := by
  rw [← Equiv.sum_comp (flatEq n) (fun j => F (pairFlat y j))]
  simp only [pairFlat, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib]

lemma Qm_fst_eval {𝒵 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒵] (D : Measure 𝒵) [IsProbabilityMeasure D]
    (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun y : Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵 => (y i).1) (Qm D n) D := by
  have h1 := Qm_fst_measurePreserving D n
  have h2 : MeasurePreserving (fun S : Fin n → 𝒵 => S i) (Pm D n) D := by
    have := measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin n => D) i
    simpa [Pm] using this
  exact h2.comp h1

lemma Qm_snd_eval {𝒵 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒵] (D : Measure 𝒵) [IsProbabilityMeasure D]
    (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun y : Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵 => (y i).2) (Qm D n) D := by
  have h1 := Qm_snd_measurePreserving D n
  have h2 : MeasurePreserving (fun S : Fin n → 𝒵 => S i) (Pm D n) D := by
    have := measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin n => D) i
    simpa [Pm] using this
  exact h2.comp h1

lemma Pm_eval {𝒵 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒵] (D : Measure 𝒵) [IsProbabilityMeasure D]
    (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun S : Fin n → 𝒵 => S i) (Pm D n) D := by
  have := measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin n => D) i
  simpa [Pm] using this
