open GtLib

noncomputable def empLoss {𝒵 : Type*} {Ωp : Type*} {n : ℕ}
    (φ : Ωp → 𝒵 → ℝ) (Z : Fin n → 𝒵) (w : Ωp) : ℝ :=
  (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i : Fin n, φ w (Z i)

noncomputable def testLoss {𝒵 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒵] {Ωp : Type*}
    (φ : Ωp → 𝒵 → ℝ) (D : Measure 𝒵) (w : Ωp) : ℝ :=
  ∫ z, φ w z ∂D

def IsUnifL1Cover {𝒵 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒵] {Ωp : Type*}
    (D : Measure 𝒵)
    (C : Finset (𝒵 → ℝ)) (φ : Ωp → 𝒵 → ℝ) (𝒲 : Set Ωp) (ε : ℝ) {m : ℕ}
    (S : Fin m → 𝒵) : Prop :=
  (∀ g ∈ C, (∀ z, g z ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧ AEMeasurable g D) ∧
  (∀ w ∈ 𝒲, ∃ g ∈ C,
    (1 / (m : ℝ)) * ∑ j : Fin m, |φ w (S j) - g (S j)| ≤ ε)

def IsUnifL1CoveringNumber {𝒵 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒵] {Ωp : Type*}
    (D : Measure 𝒵)
    (N : ℕ) (φ : Ωp → 𝒵 → ℝ) (𝒲 : Set Ωp) (ε : ℝ) (m : ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ S : Fin m → 𝒵, ∃ C : Finset (𝒵 → ℝ),
      C.card ≤ N ∧ IsUnifL1Cover D C φ 𝒲 ε S) ∧
  (∀ M : ℕ,
    (∀ S : Fin m → 𝒵, ∃ C : Finset (𝒵 → ℝ),
        C.card ≤ M ∧ IsUnifL1Cover D C φ 𝒲 ε S) →
      N ≤ M)

theorem ch4_theorem_4_12
    {𝒵 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒵]
    {Ωp : Type*}
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (D : Measure 𝒵) [IsProbabilityMeasure D]
    (𝒲 : Set Ωp) (hW : 𝒲.Nonempty) (hW_ctble : 𝒲.Countable)
    (φ : Ωp → 𝒵 → ℝ)
    (hφ_bdd : ∀ w ∈ 𝒲, ∀ z, φ w z ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hφ_meas : ∀ w ∈ 𝒲, AEMeasurable (fun z => φ w z) D)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (Z : Ω → Fin n → 𝒵)
    (hZ_meas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (fun ω => Z ω i) μ)
    (hZ_iid : (iIndepFun (fun i ω => Z ω i) μ) ∧
      (∀ i, Measure.map (fun ω => Z ω i) μ = D))
    (N₁ : ℝ → ℕ → ℕ)
    (hN₁ : ∀ ε > (0 : ℝ),
      IsUnifL1CoveringNumber D (N₁ ε n) φ 𝒲 ε n ∧
      IsUnifL1CoveringNumber D (N₁ ε (2 * n)) φ 𝒲 ε (2 * n))
    (δ : ℝ) (hδ : δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (1 - δ ≤ μ.real {ω |
        ∀ w ∈ 𝒲,
          testLoss φ D w ≤ empLoss φ (Z ω) w
            + ⨅ ε : {e : ℝ // 0 < e},
                (2 * (ε : ℝ)
                  + 3 * Real.sqrt
                      (Real.log (3 * (N₁ (ε : ℝ) (2 * n) : ℝ) / δ) / (2 * n)))})
    ∧
    (∀ γ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
      1 - δ ≤ μ.real {ω |
        ∀ w ∈ 𝒲,
          (1 - γ) ^ 2 * testLoss φ D w ≤ empLoss φ (Z ω) w
            + ⨅ ε : {e : ℝ // 0 < e},
                (2 * (ε : ℝ)
                  + (5 - 4 * γ) * Real.log (3 * (N₁ (ε : ℝ) n : ℝ) / δ)
                      / (2 * γ * n))}) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hδ0, hδ1⟩ := hδ
  have hn' : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  -- 𝒵 is nonempty
  haveI hZne : Nonempty 𝒵 := by
    rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty 𝒵 with h | h
    · exfalso
      have h1 : (Set.univ : Set 𝒵) = ∅ := Set.univ_eq_empty_iff.2 h
      have h2 := measure_univ (μ := D)
      rw [h1, measure_empty] at h2
      exact zero_ne_one h2
    · exact h
  haveI hιc : Countable ↥𝒲 := hW_ctble.to_subtype
  haveI hιne : Nonempty ↥𝒲 := hW.to_subtype
  -- measurable modification of φ
  have hmk : ∀ w : ↥𝒲, AEMeasurable (fun z => φ (w : Ωp) z) D := fun w => hφ_meas w.1 w.2
  set ψ : ↥𝒲 → 𝒵 → ℝ :=
    fun w z => max 0 (min 1 (((hmk w).mk (fun z => φ (w : Ωp) z)) z)) with hψdef
  have hψm : ∀ w, Measurable (ψ w) := by
    intro w
    exact measurable_const.max (measurable_const.min (hmk w).measurable_mk)
  have hψ01 : ∀ w z, ψ w z ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 := by
    intro w z
    constructor
    · exact le_max_left _ _
    · rw [hψdef]
      simp only
      exact max_le (by norm_num) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hψeq : ∀ w : ↥𝒲, ψ w =ᵐ[D] (fun z => φ (w : Ωp) z) := by
    intro w
    filter_upwards [(hmk w).ae_eq_mk] with z hz
    have hb := hφ_bdd w.1 w.2 z
    rw [hψdef]
    simp only
    rw [← hz]
    rw [min_eq_right hb.2, max_eq_right hb.1]
  have hint : ∀ w : ↥𝒲, ∫ z, ψ w z ∂D = testLoss φ D (w : Ωp) := by
    intro w
    exact integral_congr_ae (hψeq w)
  -- the bad set
  obtain ⟨B, hBsub, hBmeas, hB0⟩ :=
    exists_measurable_superset_of_null (μ := D)
      (s := ⋃ w : ↥𝒲, {z | ψ w z ≠ φ (w : Ωp) z})
      (measure_iUnion_null (fun w => ae_iff.1 (hψeq w)))
  have hgood : ∀ z ∉ B, ∀ w : ↥𝒲, ψ w z = φ (w : Ωp) z := by
    intro z hz w
    by_contra hc
    exact hz (hBsub (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨w, hc⟩))
  -- N ≥ 1
  have hNpos : ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∀ (m : ℕ),
      (∀ S : Fin m → 𝒵, ∃ C : Finset (𝒵 → ℝ), C.card ≤ N₁ ε m ∧ IsUnifL1Cover D C φ 𝒲 ε S) →
      1 ≤ N₁ ε m := by
    intro ε hε m hcov
    obtain ⟨C, hCcard, _, hC2⟩ := hcov (fun _ => Classical.arbitrary 𝒵)
    obtain ⟨w0, hw0⟩ := hW
    obtain ⟨g, hg, _⟩ := hC2 w0 hw0
    exact le_trans (Finset.card_pos.2 ⟨g, hg⟩) hCcard
  have hN1n : ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → 1 ≤ N₁ ε n := fun ε hε =>
    hNpos ε hε n (hN₁ ε hε).1.1
  have hN12n : ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → 1 ≤ N₁ ε (2*n) := fun ε hε =>
    hNpos ε hε (2*n) (hN₁ ε hε).2.1
  -- Z pushes forward to the product measure
  have hZam : AEMeasurable (fun ω => Z ω) μ := aemeasurable_pi_iff.2 hZ_meas
  set Z' : Ω → Fin n → 𝒵 := hZam.mk (fun ω => Z ω) with hZ'def
  have hZ'm : Measurable Z' := hZam.measurable_mk
  have hZ'ae : (fun ω => Z ω) =ᵐ[μ] Z' := hZam.ae_eq_mk
  have hZmap : Measure.map Z' μ = Pm D n := by
    rw [← Measure.map_congr hZ'ae]
    have h1 := (iIndepFun_iff_map_fun_eq_pi_map hZ_meas).1 hZ_iid.1
    simp only [hZ_iid.2] at h1
    rw [Pm]
    exact h1
  -- coordinate bad events are null
  have hbadZ : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ i, Z ω i ∉ B := by
    rw [ae_all_iff]
    intro i
    rw [ae_iff]
    simp only [not_not]
    have he : {ω | Z ω i ∈ B} = (fun ω => Z ω i) ⁻¹' B := rfl
    rw [he, ← Measure.map_apply_of_aemeasurable (hZ_meas i) hBmeas, hZ_iid.2 i]
    exact hB0
  -- generic transfer from the product measure to μ
  have transfer : ∀ (κ : ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → 0 ≤ F ε) →
      (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → (Pm D n) {S : Fin n → 𝒵 | ∃ w : ↥𝒲,
        (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, ψ w (S i) + F ε < κ * ∫ z, ψ w z ∂D} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ) →
      1 - δ ≤ μ.real {ω | ∀ w ∈ 𝒲, κ * testLoss φ D w ≤ empLoss φ (Z ω) w
          + ⨅ e : {e : ℝ // 0 < e}, F (e : ℝ)} := by
    intro κ F hFnn hF
    set I : ℝ := ⨅ e : {e : ℝ // 0 < e}, F (e : ℝ) with hIdef
    have hmaster := master D ψ hψm n hn κ F δ hδ0 hFnn hF
    set A : Set (Fin n → 𝒵) := {S : Fin n → 𝒵 | ∀ w : ↥𝒲,
        κ * (∫ z, ψ w z ∂D) ≤ (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, ψ w (S i) + I} with hAdef
    have hAmeas : MeasurableSet A := by
      have he : A = ⋂ w : ↥𝒲, {S : Fin n → 𝒵 |
          κ * (∫ z, ψ w z ∂D) ≤ (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, ψ w (S i) + I} := by
        rw [hAdef]; ext S; simp
      rw [he]
      refine MeasurableSet.iInter (fun w => measurableSet_le measurable_const ?_)
      exact (Measurable.const_mul (Finset.measurable_sum _
        (fun i _ => (hψm w).comp (measurable_pi_apply i))) _).add_const _
    set G : Set Ω := {ω | (fun ω => Z ω) ω = Z' ω ∧ ∀ i, Z ω i ∉ B} with hGdef
    have hG0 : μ Gᶜ = 0 := ae_iff.1 (hZ'ae.and hbadZ)
    set T : Set Ω := {ω | ∀ w ∈ 𝒲, κ * testLoss φ D w ≤ empLoss φ (Z ω) w + I} with hTdef
    have hpre : Z' ⁻¹' A ∩ G ⊆ T := by
      rintro ω ⟨hA, h1, h2⟩
      intro w hw
      have hthis := hA ⟨w, hw⟩
      rw [hint ⟨w, hw⟩] at hthis
      have hs : ∑ i, ψ ⟨w, hw⟩ (Z' ω i) = ∑ i : Fin n, φ w (Z ω i) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
        rw [← h1]
        exact hgood (Z ω i) (h2 i) ⟨w, hw⟩
      rw [hs] at hthis
      exact hthis
    have hkey : ENNReal.ofReal (1 - δ) ≤ μ T := by
      have h1 : μ (Z' ⁻¹' A) = Pm D n A := by
        rw [← hZmap, Measure.map_apply hZ'm hAmeas]
      calc ENNReal.ofReal (1 - δ) ≤ Pm D n A := hmaster
        _ = μ (Z' ⁻¹' A) := h1.symm
        _ ≤ μ (Z' ⁻¹' A ∩ G) + μ (Z' ⁻¹' A \ G) := measure_le_inter_add_diff _ _ _
        _ ≤ μ T + 0 := by
            refine add_le_add (measure_mono hpre) ?_
            refine le_trans (measure_mono (fun x hx => hx.2)) ?_
            exact le_of_eq hG0
        _ = μ T := add_zero _
    have h2 := ENNReal.toReal_mono (measure_ne_top μ T) hkey
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by linarith)] at h2
    exact h2
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · -- Part 1
    have hFnn : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
        0 ≤ 2 * ε + 3 * Real.sqrt (Real.log (3 * (N₁ ε (2*n) : ℝ) / δ) / (2 * (n:ℝ))) := by
      intro ε hε
      have := Real.sqrt_nonneg (Real.log (3 * (N₁ ε (2*n) : ℝ) / δ) / (2 * (n:ℝ)))
      linarith
    have hF : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → (Pm D n) {S : Fin n → 𝒵 | ∃ w : ↥𝒲,
        (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, ψ w (S i)
          + (2 * ε + 3 * Real.sqrt (Real.log (3 * (N₁ ε (2*n) : ℝ) / δ) / (2 * (n:ℝ))))
          < 1 * ∫ z, ψ w z ∂D} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ := by
      intro ε hε
      simp only [one_mul]
      -- covering hypothesis on Qm
      have hae : ∀ᵐ y ∂(Qm D n), ∀ i : Fin n, (y i).1 ∉ B ∧ (y i).2 ∉ B := by
        rw [ae_all_iff]
        intro i
        have h1 : ∀ᵐ y ∂(Qm D n), (y i).1 ∉ B := by
          rw [ae_iff]
          simp only [not_not]
          have hmp := Qm_fst_eval D n i
          have he : {y : Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵 | (y i).1 ∈ B}
              = (fun y : Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵 => (y i).1) ⁻¹' B := rfl
          rw [he, ← Measure.map_apply hmp.measurable hBmeas, hmp.map_eq]
          exact hB0
        have h2 : ∀ᵐ y ∂(Qm D n), (y i).2 ∉ B := by
          rw [ae_iff]
          simp only [not_not]
          have hmp := Qm_snd_eval D n i
          have he : {y : Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵 | (y i).2 ∈ B}
              = (fun y : Fin n → 𝒵 × 𝒵 => (y i).2) ⁻¹' B := rfl
          rw [he, ← Measure.map_apply hmp.measurable hBmeas, hmp.map_eq]
          exact hB0
        exact h1.and h2
      have hcov : ∀ᵐ y ∂(Qm D n), ∃ C : Finset (𝒵 → ℝ), C.card ≤ N₁ ε (2*n) ∧
          (∀ g ∈ C, ∀ z, g z ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) ∧
          ∀ w : ↥𝒲, ∃ g ∈ C, (1/(2*(n:ℝ))) *
            ∑ i, (|ψ w (y i).1 - g (y i).1| + |ψ w (y i).2 - g (y i).2|) ≤ ε := by
        filter_upwards [hae] with y hy
        obtain ⟨C, hCcard, hC1, hC2⟩ := (hN₁ ε hε).2.1 (pairFlat y)
        refine ⟨C, hCcard, fun g hg => (hC1 g hg).1, ?_⟩
        intro w
        obtain ⟨g, hg, hgle⟩ := hC2 w.1 w.2
        refine ⟨g, hg, ?_⟩
        have hsum := sum_pairFlat y (fun z => |φ (w : Ωp) z - g z|)
        have heq : ∑ i : Fin n, (|ψ w (y i).1 - g (y i).1| + |ψ w (y i).2 - g (y i).2|)
            = ∑ i : Fin n, (|φ (w : Ωp) (y i).1 - g (y i).1|
                + |φ (w : Ωp) (y i).2 - g (y i).2|) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
          rw [hgood _ (hy i).1 w, hgood _ (hy i).2 w]
        rw [heq, ← hsum]
        have hcast : ((2*n : ℕ) : ℝ) = 2*(n:ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
        rw [← hcast]
        exact hgle
      exact core1 D ψ hψm hψ01 n hn ε hε (N₁ ε (2*n)) (hN12n ε hε) hcov δ hδ0 hδ1
    have h := transfer 1
      (fun e => 2 * e + 3 * Real.sqrt (Real.log (3 * (N₁ e (2*n) : ℝ) / δ) / (2 * (n:ℝ))))
      hFnn hF
    simp only [one_mul] at h
    exact h
  · -- Part 2
    rintro γ ⟨hγ0, hγ1⟩
    have hlognn : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → 0 ≤ Real.log (3 * (N₁ ε n : ℝ) / δ) := by
      intro ε hε
      apply Real.log_nonneg
      have hN : (1:ℝ) ≤ (N₁ ε n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hN1n ε hε
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hδ0]
      linarith
    have hFnn : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
        0 ≤ 2 * ε + (5 - 4*γ) * Real.log (3 * (N₁ ε n : ℝ) / δ) / (2 * γ * (n:ℝ)) := by
      intro ε hε
      have h1 := hlognn ε hε
      have h2 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (5 - 4*γ) * Real.log (3 * (N₁ ε n : ℝ) / δ) / (2 * γ * (n:ℝ)) := by
        apply div_nonneg
        · nlinarith
        · positivity
      linarith
    have hF : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → (Pm D n) {S : Fin n → 𝒵 | ∃ w : ↥𝒲,
        (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, ψ w (S i)
          + (2 * ε + (5 - 4*γ) * Real.log (3 * (N₁ ε n : ℝ) / δ) / (2 * γ * (n:ℝ)))
          < (1-γ)^2 * ∫ z, ψ w z ∂D} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ := by
      intro ε hε
      have hae : ∀ᵐ S ∂(Pm D n), ∀ i : Fin n, S i ∉ B := by
        rw [ae_all_iff]
        intro i
        rw [ae_iff]
        simp only [not_not]
        have hmp := Pm_eval D n i
        have he : {S : Fin n → 𝒵 | S i ∈ B} = (fun S : Fin n → 𝒵 => S i) ⁻¹' B := rfl
        rw [he, ← Measure.map_apply hmp.measurable hBmeas, hmp.map_eq]
        exact hB0
      have hcov : ∀ᵐ S ∂(Pm D n), ∃ C : Finset (𝒵 → ℝ), C.card ≤ N₁ ε n ∧
          (∀ g ∈ C, ∀ z, g z ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) ∧
          ∀ w : ↥𝒲, ∃ g ∈ C, (1/(n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, |ψ w (S i) - g (S i)| ≤ ε := by
        filter_upwards [hae] with S hS
        obtain ⟨C, hCcard, hC1, hC2⟩ := (hN₁ ε hε).1.1 S
        refine ⟨C, hCcard, fun g hg => (hC1 g hg).1, ?_⟩
        intro w
        obtain ⟨g, hg, hgle⟩ := hC2 w.1 w.2
        refine ⟨g, hg, ?_⟩
        have heq : ∑ i : Fin n, |ψ w (S i) - g (S i)|
            = ∑ i : Fin n, |φ (w : Ωp) (S i) - g (S i)| := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
          rw [hgood _ (hS i) w]
        rw [heq]
        exact hgle
      exact core2 D ψ hψm hψ01 n hn ε hε (N₁ ε n) (hN1n ε hε) γ hγ0 hγ1 hcov δ hδ0 hδ1
    exact transfer ((1-γ)^2)
      (fun e => 2 * e + (5 - 4*γ) * Real.log (3 * (N₁ e n : ℝ) / δ) / (2 * γ * (n:ℝ)))
      hFnn hF

end GraduateLevel

targets.label: ch16_theorem_16_3
targets.statement:
Assume that rewards \(r_t(a) \in [0,1]\). Let \(a_* \in \arg \max_a \mu(a)\). With a choice of
\[
\hat{c}_{t}(a)=\sqrt{\frac{\ln(2(\hat{n}_{t}(a)+1)^{2}/\delta)}{2\hat{n}_{t}(a)}},
\]
we have with probability at least \(1 - \delta\):
\[
\mathrm{REG}_{T}\leq(K-1)+\sqrt{8\ln(2 K T^{2}/\delta)(T-K)K}.
\]

nl_proof:
Given any integer \( m \geq 1 \) and \( a \in \{1, \ldots, K\} \). We know that the sequence \( r(a_{t})\mathbb{1}(a_{t} = a) \) satisfies the sub-Gaussian bound in Theorem 13.3 with \( \sigma_{i} = 0.5\mathbb{1}(a_{i} = a) \). This means that \( \sum_{i=1}^{t}\sigma_{i}^{2} = 0.25\hat{n}_{t}(a) \). By letting \( \sigma = 0.5\sqrt{m} \) for a constant \( m \), and considering the event \( \hat{n}_{t}(a) = m \), we obtain with probability at most \( 0.5\delta / (m + 1)^{2} \):
\[
\exists t\geq 1:\mu(a)>\hat{\mu}_{t}(a)+\hat{c}_{t}(a)\&\hat{n}_{t}(a)=m.
\]
Similarly, with probability at most \((0.5 / K)\delta /(m + 1)^2\)
\[
\exists t\geq 1:\mu(a)<\hat{\mu}_{t}(a)-\hat{c}_{t}^{\prime}(a)\&\hat{n}_{t}(a)=m,
\]
where the lower confidence interval size is defined as
\[
\hat{c}_{t}^{\prime}(a)=\sqrt{\frac{\ln(2 K(\hat{n}_{t}(a)+1)^{2}/\delta)}{2\hat{n}_{t}(a)}}.
\]
It follows that the failure probability of upper confidence bound is given by
\[
\begin{array}{l}\Pr\left[\exists t>K:\mu\left(a_{*}\right)>\hat{\mu}_{t}\left(a_{*}\right)+\hat{c}_{t}\left(a_{*}\right)\right]\\ \leq\sum_{m=1}^{\infty}\Pr\left[\exists t>K:\hat{n}_{t}\left(a_{*}\right)=m\&\mu\left(a_{*}\right)>\hat{\mu}_{t}\left(a_{*}\right)+\hat{c}_{t}\left(a_{*}\right)\right]\\ \leq\sum_{m=1}^{\infty}0. 5\delta/(m+1)^{2}\leq 0. 5\delta .\\ \end{array}
\]
Moreover, the failure probability of lower confidence bound is given by
\[
\begin{array}{l}\Pr\left[\exists t>K\&a\in\{1,\dots,K\}:\mu(a)<\hat{\mu}_{t}(a)-\hat{c}_{t}^{\prime}(a)\right]\\ \leq\sum_{a=1}^{K}\Pr\left[\exists t>K:\mu(a)<\hat{\mu}_{t}(a)-\hat{c}_{t}^{\prime}(a)\right]\\ \leq\sum_{a=1}^{K}\sum_{m=1}^{\infty}\Pr\left[\exists t>K:\hat{n}_{t}(a)=m\&\mu(a)<\hat{\mu}_{t}(a)-\hat{c}_{t}^{\prime}(a)\right]\\ \leq\sum_{a=1}^{K}\sum_{m=1}^{\infty}\frac{\delta}{2 K(m+1)^{2}}\leq\delta/2.\\ \end{array}
\]
The following bound follows from Lemma 16.2. With probability at least \(1 - \delta\):
\[
\begin{array}{l}\sum_{t=1}^{T}[\mu(a_{*})-\mu(a_{t})]-\sum_{a=1}^{K}[\mu(a_{*})-\mu(a)]\leq\sum_{t=K+1}^{T}[\hat{c}_{t-1}(a_{t})+\hat{c}_{t-1}^{\prime}(a_{t})]\\ \leq 2\sum_{t=K+1}^{T}\sqrt{\frac{\ln(2 K(\hat{n}_{t-1}(a_{t})+1)^{2}/\delta)}{2\hat{n}_{t-1}(a_{t})}}\\ =2\sum_{a=1}^{K}\sum_{t=K+1}^{T}\sqrt{\frac{\ln\left(2 K\left(\hat{n}_{t-1}\left(a_{t}\right)+1\right)^{2}/\delta\right)}{2\hat{n}_{t-1}\left(a_{t}\right)}}\mathbb{1}\left(a_{t}=a\right)\\ \stackrel{(a)}{=}2\sum_{a=1}^{K}\sum_{m=1}^{\hat{n}_{T}(a)-1}\sqrt{\frac{\ln(2 K(m+1)^{2}/\delta)}{2 m}}\\ \leq 2\sum_{a=1}^{K}\int_{0}^{\hat{n}_{T}(a)-1}\sqrt{\frac{\ln\left(2 K\hat{n}_{T}(a)^{2}/\delta\right)}{2 t}}d t\\ =4\sum_{a=1}^{K}\sqrt{\frac{\ln(2 K\hat{n}_{T}(a)^{2}/\delta)(\hat{n}_{T}(a)-1)}{2}}\\ \leq 4\sqrt{\frac{\ln(2 K T^{2}/\delta)(T-K)K}{2}}.\\ \end{array}
\]
Equation (a) used the fact that for each arm \( a \), with \( a_{t} = a \), \( \hat{n}_{t-1}(a_{t}) \) takes values from \( m = 1 \) to \( m = \hat{n}_T(a) - 1 \), once for each value. In the derivation of the last inequality, we used Jensen's inequality and the concavity of \( \sqrt{z} \), which implies that
\[
\sum_{a=1}^{K}\sqrt{\hat{n}_{T}(a)-1}\leq\sqrt{K\sum_{a=1}^{K}(\hat{n}_{T}(a)-1)}=\sqrt{K(T-K)}.
\]
This implies the desired bound.

context.name: Martingale Sub-Gaussian Inequality
context.statement:
Consider a sequence of random functions \(\xi_1(S_1),\ldots,\xi_t(S_t),\ldots\) Assume each \(\xi_{i}\) is sub-Gaussian with respect to \(Z_{i}^{(y)}\):
\[
\ln\mathbb{E}_{Z_{i}^{(y)}}e^{\lambda\xi_{i}}\leq\lambda\mathbb{E}_{Z_{i}^{(y)}}\xi_{i}+\frac{\lambda^{2}\sigma_{i}^{2}}{2}
\]
for some \(\sigma_{i}\) that may depend on \(S_{i - 1}\) and \(Z_{i}^{(x)}\). Then for all \(\sigma >0\), with probability at least \(1 - \delta\)
\[
\forall n>0:\sum_{i=1}^{n}\mathbb{E}_{Z_{i}^{(y)}}\xi_{i}<\sum_{i=1}^{n}\xi_{i}+\left(\sigma+\frac{\sum_{i=1}^{n}\sigma_{i}^{2}}{\sigma}\right)\sqrt{\frac{\ln(1/\delta)}{2}}.
\]

context.name: lemma 16.2
context.statement:
Let \(a_* \in \arg \max_a \mu(a)\). Let
\[
\delta_{1}=\Pr [\exists t>K:\mu(a_{*})>\hat{\mu}_{t-1}(a_{*})+\hat{c}_{t-1}(a_{*})]
\]
be the probability that the upper confident bound fails on \( a_* \). Let
\[
\delta_{2}=\Pr\left[\exists t>K\&a\in\{1,\dots,K\}\backslash\left\{a_{*}\right\}:\mu(a)<\hat{\mu}_{t-1}(a)-\hat{c}_{t-1}^{\prime}(a)\right]
\]
be the probability that the lower confident bound fails on \( a \neq a_* \). Then for Algorithm 16.1, we have with probability at least \( 1 - \delta_1 - \delta_2 \):
\[
\operatorname{REG}_{T}\leq\sum_{a=1}^{K}[\mu(a_{*})-\mu(a)]+\sum_{t=K+1}^{T}[\hat{c}_{t-1}(a_{t})+\hat{c}_{t-1}^{\prime}(a_{t})]\mathbb{1}(a_{t}\neq a_{*}).
\]

context.name: definition 16.1
context.statement:
In the multi-armed bandit (or MAB) problem, we consider \(K\) arms. The environment generates a sequence of reward vectors for time steps \(t \geq 1\) as \(r_t = [r_t(1), \ldots, r_t(K)]\). Each \(r_t(a)\) is associated with an arm \(a \in \{1, \ldots, K\}\). In the literature, an arm \(a\) is also referred to as an action. At each time step \(t = 1, 2, \ldots, T\),
- The player pulls one of the arms \( a_{t} \in \{1, \dots, K\} \).
- The environment returns the reward \( r_t(a_t) \), but does not reveal information on any other arm \( a \neq a_t \).
At each time \( t \), a (randomized) bandit algorithm takes the historic observations observed so far, and maps it to a distribution \( \hat{\pi}_{t-1} \) over actions \( a \in \{1, \ldots, K\} \). We then draw a random action \( a_t \) (arm) from \( \hat{\pi}_{t-1} \). Here \( \hat{\pi}_{t-1} \) is referred to as policy.
In the adversarial bandit problem, we are given an arbitrary reward sequence \(\{[r_1(1),\ldots,r_t(K)]:t\geq 1\}\) before hand. The adversary in this setting is called oblivious, who decides the rewards of all the rounds before the game starts (but may take advantage of the bandit algorithm's weakness). For this reward se
quence, the expected cumulative reward of a randomized bandit algorithm is
\[
\mathbb{E}\sum_{t=1}^{T}r_{t}(a_{t}),
\]
where the randomization is over the internal randomization of the bandit algorithm. The expected regret is defined as
\[
\operatorname{REG}_{T}=\max_{a}\sum_{t=1}^{T}r_{t}(a)-\mathbb{E}\sum_{t=1}^{T}r_{t}\left(a_{t}\right).\tag{16.1}
\]
If the bandit algorithm is deterministic: i.e. pulling a single arm \(a_{t}\) only at any time step, then the regret is
\[
\mathrm{REG}_{T}=\max_{a}\sum_{t=1}^{T}r_{t}(a)-\sum_{t=1}^{T}r_{t}(a_{t}).
\]
In the adversarial bandit problem, our goal is to minimize the expected regret \(\mathrm{REG}_T\) (and the expectation is with respect to the internal randomization of the algorithm instead of the data).
Another form of bandit problem, called stochastic bandit, assumes that the reward \( r_t(a) \) is drawn independently from a distribution \( \mathcal{D}_a \), with mean \( \mu(a) = \mathbb{E}_{r_t(a) \sim \mathcal{D}_a} [r_t(a)] \). In this setting, the goal of bandit is to find \( a \) that maximizes the expected reward \( \mu(a) \). We are interested in the expected regret defined as:
\[
\operatorname{REG}_{T}=T\max_{a}\mu(a)-\mathbb{E}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mu\left(a_{t}\right).\tag{16.2}
\]
Again, this regret is defined for each realization of the stochastic rewards, and the expectation is with respect to the randomness of the algorithm. If algorithm is deterministic and outputs \( a_{t} \) at each time \( t \), then
\[
\mathrm{REG}_{T}=T\max_{a}\mu(a)-\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mu(a_{t}).
\]
We can further include randomization over data into the regret of stochastic bandit, by considering expected regret as follows:
\[
\mathbb{E}\operatorname{REG}_{T}=T\max_{a}\mu(a)-\mathbb{E}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mu(a_{t}),
\]
where the expectation is with respect to both the data and the internal randomization of the learning algorithm.

context.name: UCB Algorithm
context.statement:
Algorithm 16.1: UCB Algorithm
Input: \(K\) and \(T\geq K\)   
1 for \(a=1,\dots,K\) do   
2 Let \(\hat{n}_0(a) = 0\)   
3 Let \(\hat{\mu}_0(a) = 0\)   
4 for \(t=1,2,\ldots,T\) do   
5 if \(t\leq K\) then   
6 Let \(a_{t} = t\)   
7 else   
8 Let \(a_{t}\in \arg \max_{a}[\hat{\mu}_{t - 1}(a) + \hat{c}_{t - 1}(a)]\) according to (16.3)   
9 Pull arm \(a_{t}\) and observe reward \(r_t(a_t)\)

context.name: equation 16.3
context.statement:
For each arm \(a\), define the number of pulls up to time \(t\) and the corresponding empirical mean by
\[
\hat n_t(a)=\sum_{s=1}^{t}\mathbb{1}(a_s=a), \qquad
\hat\mu_t(a)=\frac{1}{\hat n_t(a)}\sum_{s=1}^{t} r_s(a_s)\mathbb{1}(a_s=a),
\]
with the initialization \(\hat n_0(a)=0\) and \(\hat\mu_0(a)=0\). In the UCB algorithm, after the initialization rounds, the arm is selected according to
\[
a_t\in\arg\max_a\left[\hat\mu_{t-1}(a)+\hat c_{t-1}(a)\right]. \tag{16.3}
\]
Here \(\hat c_t(a)\) denotes the confidence width used by the algorithm.

import Mathlib

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Real Finset
open scoped ENNReal NNReal

namespace GraduateLevel

lemma measurable_encode {α : Type*} {_ : MeasurableSpace α} [Encodable α]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass α] :
    Measurable (Encodable.encode (α := α)) := by
  refine measurable_to_nat fun a ↦ ?_
  have : Encodable.encode ⁻¹' {Encodable.encode a} = {a} := by ext; simp
  rw [this]
  exact measurableSet_singleton _

lemma measurableEmbedding_encode (α : Type*) {_ : MeasurableSpace α} [Encodable α]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass α] :
    MeasurableEmbedding (Encodable.encode (α := α)) where
  injective := Encodable.encode_injective
  measurable := measurable_encode
  measurableSet_image' _ _ := .of_discrete

section Finite

variable {𝓧 𝓨 α : Type*} {m𝓧 : MeasurableSpace 𝓧} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨}
  {mα : MeasurableSpace α} [TopologicalSpace α] [LinearOrder α]
  [OpensMeasurableSpace α] [OrderClosedTopology α] [SecondCountableTopology α]

lemma measurableSet_isMax [Countable 𝓨]
    {f : 𝓧 → 𝓨 → α} (hf : ∀ y, Measurable (fun x ↦ f x y)) (y : 𝓨) :
    MeasurableSet {x | ∀ z, f x z ≤ f x y} := by
  rw [show {x | ∀ y', f x y' ≤ f x y} = ⋂ y', {x | f x y' ≤ f x y} by ext; simp]
  exact MeasurableSet.iInter fun z ↦ measurableSet_le (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)

lemma exists_isMaxOn' {α : Type*} [LinearOrder α]
    [Nonempty 𝓨] [Finite 𝓨] [Encodable 𝓨] (f : 𝓧 → 𝓨 → α) (x : 𝓧) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ y, n = Encodable.encode y ∧ ∀ z, f x z ≤ f x y := by
  obtain ⟨y, h⟩ := Finite.exists_max (f x)
  exact ⟨Encodable.encode y, y, rfl, h⟩

noncomputable
def measurableArgmax [Nonempty 𝓨] [Finite 𝓨] [Encodable 𝓨] [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓨]
    (f : 𝓧 → 𝓨 → α)
    [∀ x, DecidablePred fun n ↦ ∃ y, n = Encodable.encode y ∧ ∀ (z : 𝓨), f x z ≤ f x y]
    (x : 𝓧) :
    𝓨 :=
  (measurableEmbedding_encode 𝓨).invFun (Nat.find (exists_isMaxOn' f x))

lemma measurable_measurableArgmax [Nonempty 𝓨] [Finite 𝓨] [Encodable 𝓨]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓨]
    {f : 𝓧 → 𝓨 → α}
    [∀ x, DecidablePred fun n ↦ ∃ y, n = Encodable.encode y ∧ ∀ (z : 𝓨), f x z ≤ f x y]
    (hf : ∀ y, Measurable (fun x ↦ f x y)) :
    Measurable (measurableArgmax f) := by
  refine (MeasurableEmbedding.measurable_invFun (measurableEmbedding_encode 𝓨)).comp ?_
  refine measurable_find _ fun n ↦ ?_
  have : {x | ∃ y, n = Encodable.encode y ∧ ∀ (z : 𝓨), f x z ≤ f x y}
      = ⋃ y, ({x | n = Encodable.encode y} ∩ {x | ∀ z, f x z ≤ f x y}) := by ext; simp
  rw [this]
  refine MeasurableSet.iUnion fun y ↦ (MeasurableSet.inter (by simp) ?_)
  exact measurableSet_isMax (by fun_prop) y

end Finite

structure Algorithm (𝓐 𝓨 : Type*) [MeasurableSpace 𝓐] [MeasurableSpace 𝓨] where

  policy : (n : ℕ) → Kernel (Iic n → 𝓐 × 𝓨) 𝓐
  [h_policy : ∀ n, IsMarkovKernel (policy n)]

  p0 : Measure 𝓐
  [hp0 : IsProbabilityMeasure p0]

attribute [instance] Algorithm.h_policy Algorithm.hp0

structure Environment (𝓐 𝓨 : Type*) [MeasurableSpace 𝓐] [MeasurableSpace 𝓨] where

  feedback : (n : ℕ) → Kernel ((Iic n → 𝓐 × 𝓨) × 𝓐) 𝓨
  [h_feedback : ∀ n, IsMarkovKernel (feedback n)]

  ν0 : Kernel 𝓐 𝓨
  [hp0 : IsMarkovKernel ν0]

attribute [instance] Environment.h_feedback Environment.hp0

section Traj

variable {𝓐 𝓨 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝓐] [MeasurableSpace 𝓨]

noncomputable
def stepKernel (alg : Algorithm 𝓐 𝓨) (env : Environment 𝓐 𝓨) (n : ℕ) :
    Kernel (Iic n → 𝓐 × 𝓨) (𝓐 × 𝓨) :=
  alg.policy n ⊗ₖ env.feedback n

instance (alg : Algorithm 𝓐 𝓨) (env : Environment 𝓐 𝓨) (n : ℕ) :
    IsMarkovKernel (stepKernel alg env n) := by
  rw [stepKernel]; infer_instance

noncomputable
def trajMeasure (alg : Algorithm 𝓐 𝓨) (env : Environment 𝓐 𝓨) :
    Measure (ℕ → 𝓐 × 𝓨) :=
  Kernel.trajMeasure (alg.p0 ⊗ₘ env.ν0) (stepKernel alg env)

def action (n : ℕ) (h : ℕ → 𝓐 × 𝓨) : 𝓐 := (h n).1

end Traj

noncomputable

variable {K : ℕ}

/-- Number of pulls of arm `a` in rounds `0, ..., n-1`. -/
def bcnt (a : Fin K) (n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) : ℕ :=
  ∑ s ∈ range n, if (ω s).1 = a then 1 else 0

/-- Sum of rewards obtained from arm `a` in rounds `0, ..., n-1`. -/
noncomputable def bsumR (a : Fin K) (n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ s ∈ range n, if (ω s).1 = a then (ω s).2 else 0

/-- Sum of the centred rewards over the first `m` pulls of arm `a`, among rounds `0,...,n-1`. -/
noncomputable def bW (mu : Fin K → ℝ) (a : Fin K) (m n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ s ∈ range n, if (ω s).1 = a ∧ bcnt a s ω < m then (ω s).2 - mu a else 0

/-- Number of terms in `bW`. -/
def bD (a : Fin K) (m n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) : ℕ :=
  ∑ s ∈ range n, if (ω s).1 = a ∧ bcnt a s ω < m then 1 else 0

variable {a : Fin K} {m n : ℕ} {ω ω' : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ} {mu : Fin K → ℝ}

@[simp] lemma bcnt_zero : bcnt a 0 ω = 0 := by simp [bcnt]
@[simp] lemma bW_zero : bW mu a m 0 ω = 0 := by simp [bW]
@[simp] lemma bD_zero : bD a m 0 ω = 0 := by simp [bD]
@[simp] lemma bsumR_zero : bsumR a 0 ω = 0 := by simp [bsumR]

lemma bcnt_succ : bcnt a (n+1) ω = bcnt a n ω + (if (ω n).1 = a then 1 else 0) := by
  rw [bcnt, bcnt, Finset.sum_range_succ]

lemma bW_succ : bW mu a m (n+1) ω
    = bW mu a m n ω + (if (ω n).1 = a ∧ bcnt a n ω < m then (ω n).2 - mu a else 0) := by
  rw [bW, bW, Finset.sum_range_succ]

lemma bD_succ : bD a m (n+1) ω
    = bD a m n ω + (if (ω n).1 = a ∧ bcnt a n ω < m then 1 else 0) := by
  rw [bD, bD, Finset.sum_range_succ]

lemma bcnt_mono (h : n ≤ n') : bcnt a n ω ≤ bcnt a n' ω := by
  have hsub : range n ⊆ range n' := Finset.range_subset_range.2 h
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset hsub

lemma bcnt_le_self : bcnt a n ω ≤ n := by
  calc bcnt a n ω ≤ ∑ _s ∈ range n, 1 := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ ↦ ?_
        split <;> simp
    _ = n := by simp

lemma bcnt_congr (h : ∀ i < n, ω i = ω' i) : bcnt a n ω = bcnt a n ω' := by
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi ↦ ?_
  rw [h i (Finset.mem_range.1 hi)]

lemma bW_congr (h : ∀ i < n, ω i = ω' i) : bW mu a m n ω = bW mu a m n ω' := by
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi ↦ ?_
  have hi' := Finset.mem_range.1 hi
  rw [h i hi', bcnt_congr (fun j hj ↦ h j (hj.trans hi'))]

lemma bD_congr (h : ∀ i < n, ω i = ω' i) : bD a m n ω = bD a m n ω' := by
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi ↦ ?_
  have hi' := Finset.mem_range.1 hi
  rw [h i hi', bcnt_congr (fun j hj ↦ h j (hj.trans hi'))]

/-- If `s < n` and arm `a` is pulled at time `s`, then `s` is among the first `bcnt a n ω`
pulls of `a`. -/
lemma bcnt_lt_of_pull (hs : s < n) (ha : (ω s).1 = a) : bcnt a s ω < bcnt a n ω := by
  have h1 : bcnt a (s+1) ω = bcnt a s ω + 1 := by rw [bcnt_succ, if_pos ha]
  have h2 : bcnt a (s+1) ω ≤ bcnt a n ω := bcnt_mono hs
  lia

lemma bW_eq_of_cnt (h : bcnt a n ω = m) :
    bW mu a m n ω = bsumR a n ω - (m : ℝ) * mu a := by
  have key : ∀ s ∈ range n, (if (ω s).1 = a ∧ bcnt a s ω < m then (ω s).2 - mu a else 0)

    intro s hs
    by_cases ha : (ω s).1 = a
    · have : bcnt a s ω < m := h ▸ bcnt_lt_of_pull (Finset.mem_range.1 hs) ha
      simp [ha, this]
    · simp [ha]
  have key2 : ∑ s ∈ range n, (if (ω s).1 = a then mu a else 0) = (m : ℝ) * mu a := by
    have h3 : ∀ s ∈ range n, (if (ω s).1 = a then mu a else 0)
        = ((if (ω s).1 = a then (1:ℝ) else 0)) * mu a := by
      intro s _; split <;> simp
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h3, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← h]
    congr 1
    rw [bcnt, Nat.cast_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ ↦ ?_
    split <;> simp
  rw [bW, Finset.sum_congr rfl key, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, key2]
  rfl

lemma bW_stable (h : bcnt a n ω = m) (hn : n ≤ n') :
    bW mu a m n' ω = bW mu a m n ω := by
  rw [bW, bW, ← Finset.sum_range_add_sum_Ico _ hn]

    rw [if_neg]
    rintro ⟨-, hlt⟩
    have : m ≤ bcnt a s ω := h ▸ bcnt_mono (Finset.mem_Ico.1 hs).1
    lia
  rw [this, add_zero]

lemma bD_stable (h : bcnt a n ω = m) (hn : n ≤ n') :
    bD a m n' ω = bD a m n ω := by
  rw [bD, bD, ← Finset.sum_range_add_sum_Ico _ hn]
  have : ∑ s ∈ Finset.Ico n n', (if (ω s).1 = a ∧ bcnt a s ω < m then 1 else 0) = 0 := by
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun s hs ↦ ?_
    rw [if_neg]
    rintro ⟨-, hlt⟩
    have : m ≤ bcnt a s ω := h ▸ bcnt_mono (Finset.mem_Ico.1 hs).1

  rw [this, add_zero]

lemma bD_le : bD a m n ω ≤ m := by
  classical
  have hcard : bD a m n ω

    rw [bD, Finset.card_filter]
  rw [hcard]
  have : #((range n).filter (fun s ↦ (ω s).1 = a ∧ bcnt a s ω < m)) ≤ #(range m) := by
    refine Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn (fun s ↦ bcnt a s ω) ?_ ?_
    · intro s hs
      simp only [Finset.coe_filter, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hs
      exact Finset.mem_range.2 hs.2.2
    · intro s hs t ht hst
      simp only [Finset.coe_filter, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hs ht
      by_contra hne
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hlt
      · have := bcnt_lt_of_pull hlt hs.2.1
        lia
      · have := bcnt_lt_of_pull hlt ht.2.1
        lia
  rwa [Finset.card_range] at this

end Process

section Meas

variable {K : ℕ}

lemma measurableSet_action (s : ℕ) (a : Fin K) :
    MeasurableSet {ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ | (ω s).1 = a} :=
  (measurableSet_singleton a).preimage (by fun_prop)

lemma measurable_bcnt (a : Fin K) (n : ℕ) :
    Measurable (fun ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ ↦ bcnt a n ω) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [bcnt_zero]; exact measurable_const
  | succ n ih =>
      simp only [bcnt_succ]
      exact ih.add (Measurable.ite (measurableSet_action n a) measurable_const measurable_const)

lemma measurableSet_pullIdx (a : Fin K) (m s : ℕ) :
    MeasurableSet {ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ | (ω s).1 = a ∧ bcnt a s ω < m} :=
  (measurableSet_action s a).inter
    ((measurable_bcnt a s) (measurableSet_Iio (a := m)))

lemma measurable_bW (mu : Fin K → ℝ) (a : Fin K) (m n : ℕ) :
    Measurable (fun ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ ↦ bW mu a m n ω) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [bW_zero]; exact measurable_const
  | succ n ih =>
      simp only [bW_succ]
      exact ih.add (Measurable.ite (measurableSet_pullIdx a m n) (by fun_prop) measurable_const)

lemma measurable_bD (a : Fin K) (m n : ℕ) :
    Measurable (fun ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ ↦ bD a m n ω) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [bD_zero]; exact measurable_const
  | succ n ih =>
      simp only [bD_succ]
      exact ih.add (Measurable.ite (measurableSet_pullIdx a m n) measurable_const measurable_const)

lemma measurable_bsumR (a : Fin K) (n : ℕ) :
    Measurable (fun ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ ↦ bsumR a n ω) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [bsumR_zero]; exact measurable_const
  | succ n ih =>
      have : ∀ ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ, bsumR a (n+1) ω
          = bsumR a n ω + (if (ω n).1 = a then (ω n).2 else 0) := by
        intro ω; rw [bsumR, bsumR, Finset.sum_range_succ]
      simp only [this]
      exact ih.add (Measurable.ite (measurableSet_action n a) (by fun_prop) measurable_const)

end Meas

section MGF

variable {K : ℕ}

/-- Extension of a finite history to an infinite trajectory (junk after time `n`). -/
def extd (z0 : Fin K × ℝ) (n : ℕ) (h : Iic n → Fin K × ℝ) : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ :=
  fun i ↦ if hi : i ≤ n then h ⟨i, Finset.mem_Iic.mpr hi⟩ else z0

lemma extd_frestrictLe (z0 : Fin K × ℝ) (n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ n) :
    extd z0 n (Preorder.frestrictLe n ω) i = ω i := by
  simp [extd, hi, Preorder.frestrictLe]

lemma measurable_extd (z0 : Fin K × ℝ) (n : ℕ) : Measurable (extd z0 n) := by
  refine measurable_pi_lambda _ fun i ↦ ?_
  by_cases hi : i ≤ n
  · simp only [extd, dif_pos hi]
    exact measurable_pi_apply _
  · simp only [extd, dif_neg hi]
    exact measurable_const

noncomputable def bPhi (mu : Fin K → ℝ) (lam : ℝ) (a : Fin K) (m n : ℕ)
    (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (lam * bW mu a m n ω - lam ^ 2 / 8 * (bD a m n ω : ℝ)))

lemma measurable_bPhi (mu : Fin K → ℝ) (lam : ℝ) (a : Fin K) (m n : ℕ) :
    Measurable (bPhi mu lam a m n) := by
  unfold bPhi
  refine ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp (Real.measurable_exp.comp ?_)
  exact ((measurable_bW mu a m n).const_mul lam).sub
    (((measurable_of_countable (Nat.cast : ℕ → ℝ)).comp (measurable_bD a m n)).const_mul _)

@[simp] lemma bPhi_zero (mu : Fin K → ℝ) (lam : ℝ) (a : Fin K) (m : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) :
    bPhi mu lam a m 0 ω = 1 := by simp [bPhi]

lemma bPhi_succ (mu : Fin K → ℝ) (lam : ℝ) (a : Fin K) (m n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) :
    bPhi mu lam a m (n + 1) ω = bPhi mu lam a m n ω *
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp
        (lam * (if (ω n).1 = a ∧ bcnt a n ω < m then (ω n).2 - mu a else 0)
          - lam ^ 2 / 8 * (if (ω n).1 = a ∧ bcnt a n ω < m then (1:ℝ) else 0))) := by
  rw [bPhi, bPhi, bW_succ, bD_succ, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Real.exp_nonneg _), ← Real.exp_add]
  congr 1
  by_cases hP : (ω n).1 = a ∧ bcnt a n ω < m
  · simp only [if_pos hP]; push_cast; ring_nf
  · simp only [if_neg hP]; push_cast; ring_nf

lemma bPhi_congr (mu : Fin K → ℝ) (lam : ℝ) (a : Fin K) (m n : ℕ) {ω ω' : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ}
    (h : ∀ i < n, ω i = ω' i) : bPhi mu lam a m n ω = bPhi mu lam a m n ω' := by
  rw [bPhi, bPhi, bW_congr h, bD_congr h]

end MGF

section Bandit

variable {K : ℕ} {hK : 0 < K} {ν : Kernel (Fin K) ℝ} [IsMarkovKernel ν]
  {nextA : (n : ℕ) → (Iic n → Fin K × ℝ) → Fin K} {hmeasA : ∀ n, Measurable (nextA n)}

noncomputable def banditP {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K) (ν : Kernel (Fin K) ℝ) [IsMarkovKernel ν]
    (nextA : (n : ℕ) → (Iic n → Fin K × ℝ) → Fin K) (hmeasA : ∀ n, Measurable (nextA n)) :
    Measure (ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) :=
  trajMeasure (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA ⟨0, hK⟩) (stationaryEnv ν)

instance : IsProbabilityMeasure (banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA) := by
  unfold banditP trajMeasure; infer_instance

lemma stepKernel_lintegral (n : ℕ) (h : Iic n → Fin K × ℝ) (f : (Fin K × ℝ) → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hf : Measurable f) :
    ∫⁻ z, f z ∂(stepKernel (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA ⟨0, hK⟩) (stationaryEnv ν) n h)
      = ∫⁻ y, f (nextA n h, y) ∂(ν (nextA n h)) := by
  rw [stepKernel, Kernel.lintegral_compProd _ _ _ hf]
  simp [detAlgorithm, stationaryEnv, Kernel.lintegral_deterministic]

lemma keyStep (n : ℕ) {g : ((Iic n → Fin K × ℝ) × (Fin K × ℝ)) → ℝ≥0∞} (hg : Measurable g) :
    ∫⁻ ω, g (Preorder.frestrictLe n ω, ω (n+1)) ∂(banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA)
      = ∫⁻ ω, (∫⁻ y, g (Preorder.frestrictLe n ω,
            (nextA n (Preorder.frestrictLe n ω), y)) ∂(ν (nextA n (Preorder.frestrictLe n ω))))
          ∂(banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA) := by
  unfold banditP GraduateLevel.trajMeasure
  rw [← lintegral_map (g := fun x : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ ↦ (Preorder.frestrictLe n x, x (n+1)))
      hg (by fun_prop),
    ← Kernel.map_frestrictLe_trajMeasure_compProd_eq_map_trajMeasure,
    Measure.lintegral_compProd hg,
    lintegral_map (hg.lintegral_kernel_prod_right'
      (κ := stepKernel (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA ⟨0, hK⟩) (stationaryEnv ν) n)) (by fun_prop)]
  refine lintegral_congr fun ω ↦ ?_
  exact stepKernel_lintegral n _ _ (hg.comp (by fun_prop))

lemma trajMeasure_map_zero {X : ℕ → Type*} [∀ n, MeasurableSpace (X n)]
    (κ : (n : ℕ) → Kernel ((i : Iic n) → X i) (X (n + 1))) [∀ n, IsMarkovKernel (κ n)]
    (μ₀ : Measure (X 0)) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ₀] :
    (Kernel.trajMeasure μ₀ κ).map (fun x ↦ x 0) = μ₀ := by
  have h1 : (fun x : (∀ n, X n) ↦ x 0)
      = (fun h : ((i : Iic (0:ℕ)) → X i) ↦ h default) ∘ (Preorder.frestrictLe 0) := rfl
  rw [h1, ← Measure.map_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  rw [Kernel.trajMeasure, Measure.map_comp _ _ (by fun_prop), Kernel.traj_map_frestrictLe,
    Kernel.partialTraj_self]
  rw [Measure.id_comp, Measure.map_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  have : ((fun h : ((i : Iic (0:ℕ)) → X i) ↦ h default) ∘
      ⇑(MeasurableEquiv.piUnique (fun i : Iic (0:ℕ) ↦ X i)).symm) = id := by
    ext x; simp
  rw [this, Measure.map_id]

lemma keyStep0 {g : (Fin K × ℝ) → ℝ≥0∞} (hg : Measurable g) :
    ∫⁻ ω, g (ω 0) ∂(banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA)
      = ∫⁻ y, g (⟨0, hK⟩, y) ∂(ν ⟨0, hK⟩) := by
  unfold banditP GraduateLevel.trajMeasure
  rw [← lintegral_map (g := fun x : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ ↦ x 0) hg (by fun_prop),
    trajMeasure_map_zero]
  show ∫⁻ z, g z ∂((Measure.dirac (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)) ⊗ₘ ν) = _
  rw [Measure.lintegral_compProd hg, lintegral_dirac]

/-- Mean reward of arm `a`. -/
noncomputable def bmu {K : ℕ} (ν : Kernel (Fin K) ℝ) (a : Fin K) : ℝ := ∫ y, y ∂(ν a)

lemma ae_mem_Icc (hrew : ∀ a, (ν a) (Set.Icc 0 1) = 1) (a : Fin K) :
    ∀ᵐ y ∂(ν a), y ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 := by
  rw [ae_iff]
  have h1 : {y : ℝ | ¬ y ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1} = (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)ᶜ := rfl
  rw [h1, prob_compl_eq_one_sub measurableSet_Icc, hrew a, tsub_self]

lemma hoeffding_subG (hrew : ∀ a, (ν a) (Set.Icc 0 1) = 1) (a : Fin K) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF (fun y : ℝ ↦ y - bmu ν a) ((‖(1:ℝ) - 0‖₊ / 2) ^ 2) (ν a) := by
  have := ProbabilityTheory.hasSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc (μ := ν a) (X := (id : ℝ → ℝ))
      (a := 0) (b := 1) aemeasurable_id (ae_mem_Icc hrew a)
  simpa [bmu, id] using this

lemma hoeffding_mgf (hrew : ∀ a, (ν a) (Set.Icc 0 1) = 1) (a : Fin K) (lam : ℝ) :
    ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (lam * (y - bmu ν a))) ∂(ν a)
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (lam ^ 2 / 8)) := by
  have hsub := hoeffding_subG hrew a
  have hint : Integrable (fun y : ℝ ↦ Real.exp (lam * (y - bmu ν a))) (ν a) :=
    hsub.integrable_exp_mul lam
  rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hint (ae_of_all _ fun y ↦ Real.exp_nonneg _)]
  refine ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_
  have hm := hsub.mgf_le lam
  have hc : (((‖(1:ℝ) - 0‖₊ / 2) ^ 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) = 1 / 4 := by
    norm_num
  rw [hc] at hm
  calc ∫ y, Real.exp (lam * (y - bmu ν a)) ∂(ν a) = mgf (fun y : ℝ ↦ y - bmu ν a) (ν a) lam := rfl
    _ ≤ Real.exp (1 / 4 * lam ^ 2 / 2) := hm
    _ = Real.exp (lam ^ 2 / 8) := by ring_nf

lemma measurable_ite_const {α β : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β] (c : Prop)
    [Decidable c] {f g : α → β} (hf : Measurable f) (hg : Measurable g) :
    Measurable (fun x ↦ if c then f x else g x) := by
  by_cases h : c
  · simpa only [if_pos h] using hf
  · simpa only [if_neg h] using hg

lemma onestep_le_eq (hrew : ∀ a, (ν a) (Set.Icc 0 1) = 1) (a : Fin K) (lam : ℝ)
    (Q : Prop) [Decidable Q] :
    ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp
        (lam * (if Q then y - bmu ν a else 0)
          - lam ^ 2 / 8 * (if Q then (1:ℝ) else 0))) ∂(ν a) ≤ 1 := by
  by_cases hq : Q
  · have key := hoeffding_mgf hrew a lam
    simp only [if_pos hq]
    calc ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (lam * (y - bmu ν a) - lam ^ 2 / 8 * 1)) ∂(ν a)
        = ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(lam ^ 2 / 8)))
            * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (lam * (y - bmu ν a))) ∂(ν a) := by
          refine lintegral_congr fun y ↦ ?_
          rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Real.exp_nonneg _), ← Real.exp_add]
          ring_nf
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(lam ^ 2 / 8)))
            * ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (lam * (y - bmu ν a))) ∂(ν a) := by
          rw [lintegral_const_mul _ (by fun_prop)]
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(lam ^ 2 / 8))) * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (lam ^ 2 / 8)) :=
          mul_le_mul_left' key _
      _ = 1 := by
          rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Real.exp_nonneg _), ← Real.exp_add]
          norm_num
  · simp only [if_neg hq]
    simp

lemma onestep_le (hrew : ∀ a, (ν a) (Set.Icc 0 1) = 1) (a b : Fin K) (lam : ℝ)
    (Q : Prop) [Decidable Q] (hQ : Q → b = a) :
    ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp
        (lam * (if Q then y - bmu ν a else 0)
          - lam ^ 2 / 8 * (if Q then (1:ℝ) else 0))) ∂(ν b) ≤ 1 := by
  by_cases hq : Q
  · rw [hQ hq]
    exact onestep_le_eq hrew a lam Q
  · simp only [if_neg hq]
    simp

/-- A junk element of the observation space. -/
def bz0 {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K) : Fin K × ℝ := (⟨0, hK⟩, 0)

lemma bPhi_lintegral_le (hrew : ∀ a, (ν a) (Set.Icc 0 1) = 1) (lam : ℝ) (a : Fin K) (m n : ℕ) :
    ∫⁻ ω, bPhi (bmu ν) lam a m n ω ∂(banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA) ≤ 1 := by
  classical
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [bPhi_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      set g0 : Fin K × ℝ → ℝ≥0∞ := fun z ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp
          (lam * (if z.1 = a ∧ (0:ℕ) < m then z.2 - bmu ν a else 0)
            - lam ^ 2 / 8 * (if z.1 = a ∧ (0:ℕ) < m then (1:ℝ) else 0))) with hg0
      have hg0meas : Measurable g0 := by
        rw [hg0]
        refine ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp (Real.measurable_exp.comp ?_)
        have hset : MeasurableSet {z : Fin K × ℝ | z.1 = a ∧ (0:ℕ) < m} :=
          MeasurableSet.inter ((measurableSet_singleton a).preimage (by fun_prop))
            (MeasurableSet.const _)
        exact ((Measurable.ite hset (by fun_prop) measurable_const).const_mul lam).sub
          ((Measurable.ite hset measurable_const measurable_const).const_mul _)
      have h1 : ∀ ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ, bPhi (bmu ν) lam a m 1 ω = g0 (ω 0) := by
        intro ω
        rw [show (1:ℕ) = 0 + 1 from rfl, bPhi_succ, bPhi_zero, one_mul, bcnt_zero, hg0]
      calc ∫⁻ ω, bPhi (bmu ν) lam a m 1 ω ∂(banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA)
          = ∫⁻ ω, g0 (ω 0) ∂(banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA) := lintegral_congr h1
        _ = ∫⁻ y, g0 (⟨0, hK⟩, y) ∂(ν ⟨0, hK⟩) := keyStep0 hg0meas
        _ ≤ 1 := by
            simp only [hg0]
            exact onestep_le hrew a ⟨0, hK⟩ lam
              (((⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K) = a ∧ (0:ℕ) < m)) (fun h ↦ h.1)
    | succ n =>
      set g : ((Iic n → Fin K × ℝ) × (Fin K × ℝ)) → ℝ≥0∞ := fun p ↦
        bPhi (bmu ν) lam a m (n+1) (extd (bz0 hK) n p.1) * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp
          (lam * (if p.2.1 = a ∧ bcnt a (n+1) (extd (bz0 hK) n p.1) < m
              then p.2.2 - bmu ν a else 0)
            - lam ^ 2 / 8 *
              (if p.2.1 = a ∧ bcnt a (n+1) (extd (bz0 hK) n p.1) < m then (1:ℝ) else 0))) with hg
      have hgmeas : Measurable g := by
        have h1 : Measurable (fun p : ((Iic n → Fin K × ℝ) × (Fin K × ℝ)) ↦
            extd (bz0 hK) n p.1) := (measurable_extd (bz0 hK) n).comp measurable_fst
        have h2 : MeasurableSet {p : ((Iic n → Fin K × ℝ) × (Fin K × ℝ)) |
            p.2.1 = a ∧ bcnt a (n+1) (extd (bz0 hK) n p.1) < m} :=
          MeasurableSet.inter ((measurableSet_singleton a).preimage (by fun_prop))
            (((measurable_bcnt a (n+1)).comp h1) (measurableSet_Iio (a := m)))
        rw [hg]
        refine Measurable.mul ((measurable_bPhi (bmu ν) lam a m (n+1)).comp h1) ?_
        refine ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp (Real.measurable_exp.comp ?_)
        exact ((Measurable.ite h2 (by fun_prop) measurable_const).const_mul lam).sub
          ((Measurable.ite h2 measurable_const measurable_const).const_mul _)
      have hkey : ∀ ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ, bPhi (bmu ν) lam a m (n+1+1) ω
          = g (Preorder.frestrictLe n ω, ω (n+1)) := by
        intro ω
        have hext : ∀ i < n + 1, ω i = extd (bz0 hK) n (Preorder.frestrictLe n ω) i := fun i hi ↦
          (extd_frestrictLe (bz0 hK) n ω (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hi)).symm
        rw [bPhi_succ, hg]
        simp only
        rw [bPhi_congr (bmu ν) lam a m (n+1) hext, bcnt_congr hext]
      calc ∫⁻ ω, bPhi (bmu ν) lam a m (n+1+1) ω ∂(banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA)
          = ∫⁻ ω, g (Preorder.frestrictLe n ω, ω (n+1)) ∂(banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA) :=
            lintegral_congr hkey
        _ = ∫⁻ ω, (∫⁻ y, g (Preorder.frestrictLe n ω,
              (nextA n (Preorder.frestrictLe n ω), y)) ∂(ν (nextA n (Preorder.frestrictLe n ω))))
              ∂(banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA) := keyStep n hgmeas
        _ ≤ ∫⁻ ω, bPhi (bmu ν) lam a m (n+1) ω ∂(banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA) := by
            refine lintegral_mono fun ω ↦ ?_
            set h := Preorder.frestrictLe n ω with hh
            have hcm : Measurable (fun y : ℝ ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp
                (lam * (if nextA n h = a ∧ bcnt a (n+1) (extd (bz0 hK) n h) < m
                    then y - bmu ν a else 0)
                  - lam ^ 2 / 8 *
                    (if nextA n h = a ∧ bcnt a (n+1) (extd (bz0 hK) n h) < m
                      then (1:ℝ) else 0)))) := by
              by_cases hC : nextA n h = a ∧ bcnt a (n+1) (extd (bz0 hK) n h) < m
              · simp only [if_pos hC]; fun_prop
              · simp only [if_neg hC]; fun_prop
            calc ∫⁻ y, g (h, (nextA n h, y)) ∂(ν (nextA n h))
                = ∫⁻ y, bPhi (bmu ν) lam a m (n+1) (extd (bz0 hK) n h)
                    * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp
                      (lam * (if nextA n h = a ∧ bcnt a (n+1) (extd (bz0 hK) n h) < m
                          then y - bmu ν a else 0)
                        - lam ^ 2 / 8 *
                          (if nextA n h = a ∧ bcnt a (n+1) (extd (bz0 hK) n h) < m
                            then (1:ℝ) else 0))) ∂(ν (nextA n h)) := by
                  simp only [hg]
              _ = bPhi (bmu ν) lam a m (n+1) (extd (bz0 hK) n h) * ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp
                    (lam * (if nextA n h = a ∧ bcnt a (n+1) (extd (bz0 hK) n h) < m
                        then y - bmu ν a else 0)
                      - lam ^ 2 / 8 *
                        (if nextA n h = a ∧ bcnt a (n+1) (extd (bz0 hK) n h) < m
                          then (1:ℝ) else 0))) ∂(ν (nextA n h)) :=
                  lintegral_const_mul _ hcm
              _ ≤ bPhi (bmu ν) lam a m (n+1) (extd (bz0 hK) n h) * 1 :=
                  mul_le_mul_left' (onestep_le hrew a _ lam _ (fun hh ↦ hh.1)) _
              _ = bPhi (bmu ν) lam a m (n+1) ω := by
                  rw [mul_one]
                  refine bPhi_congr (bmu ν) lam a m (n+1) fun i hi ↦ ?_
                  exact extd_frestrictLe (bz0 hK) n ω (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hi)
        _ ≤ 1 := ih

lemma tail_gen (hrew : ∀ a, (ν a) (Set.Icc 0 1) = 1) (lam : ℝ) (a : Fin K) (m N : ℕ) (r : ℝ) :
    (banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA) {ω | r ≤ lam * bW (bmu ν) a m N ω}
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (lam ^ 2 * m / 8 - r)) := by
  classical
  set c : ℝ≥0∞ := ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (r - lam ^ 2 * m / 8)) with hc
  have hcne : c ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hc]
    simp [Real.exp_pos]
  have hctop : c ≠ ⊤ := by rw [hc]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  have hsub : {ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ | r ≤ lam * bW (bmu ν) a m N ω}
      ⊆ {ω | c ≤ bPhi (bmu ν) lam a m N ω} := by
    intro ω hω
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hω ⊢
    rw [hc, bPhi]
    refine ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (Real.exp_le_exp.2 ?_)
    have h1 : lam ^ 2 / 8 * (bD a m N ω : ℝ) ≤ lam ^ 2 / 8 * (m : ℝ) := by
      have : (bD a m N ω : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.2 bD_le
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg lam]
    linarith
  calc (banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA) {ω | r ≤ lam * bW (bmu ν) a m N ω}
      ≤ (banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA) {ω | c ≤ bPhi (bmu ν) lam a m N ω} := measure_mono hsub
    _ ≤ (∫⁻ ω, bPhi (bmu ν) lam a m N ω ∂(banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA)) / c :=
        meas_ge_le_lintegral_div (measurable_bPhi _ _ _ _ _).aemeasurable hcne hctop
    _ ≤ 1 / c := by
        exact ENNReal.div_le_div_right (bPhi_lintegral_le hrew lam a m N) c
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (lam ^ 2 * m / 8 - r)) := by
        rw [hc, ENNReal.div_eq_inv_mul, mul_one, ← ENNReal.ofReal_inv_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _),
          ← Real.exp_neg]
        ring_nf

lemma tail_low (hrew : ∀ a, (ν a) (Set.Icc 0 1) = 1) (a : Fin K) (m N : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    (banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA) {ω | bW (bmu ν) a m N ω ≤ -ε}
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(2 * ε ^ 2 / m))) := by
  have hmR : (0:ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hsub : {ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ | bW (bmu ν) a m N ω ≤ -ε}
      ⊆ {ω | 4 * ε ^ 2 / m ≤ (-(4 * ε / m)) * bW (bmu ν) a m N ω} := by
    intro ω hω
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hω ⊢
    have hlam : (0:ℝ) ≤ 4 * ε / m := by positivity
    have hLe : 4 * ε ^ 2 / (m:ℝ) = (4 * ε / m) * ε := by field_simp
    rw [hLe, neg_mul, ← mul_neg]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hlam
  refine le_trans (measure_mono hsub) ?_
  refine le_trans (tail_gen hrew (-(4 * ε / m)) a m N (4 * ε ^ 2 / m)) ?_
  refine le_of_eq ?_
  congr 1
  field_simp
  ring_nf

lemma tail_high (hrew : ∀ a, (ν a) (Set.Icc 0 1) = 1) (a : Fin K) (m N : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    (banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA) {ω | ε ≤ bW (bmu ν) a m N ω}
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(2 * ε ^ 2 / m))) := by
  have hmR : (0:ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hsub : {ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ | ε ≤ bW (bmu ν) a m N ω}
      ⊆ {ω | 4 * ε ^ 2 / m ≤ (4 * ε / m) * bW (bmu ν) a m N ω} := by
    intro ω hω
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hω ⊢
    have hlam : (0:ℝ) ≤ 4 * ε / m := by positivity
    have hLe : 4 * ε ^ 2 / (m:ℝ) = (4 * ε / m) * ε := by field_simp
    rw [hLe]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hω hlam
  refine le_trans (measure_mono hsub) ?_
  refine le_trans (tail_gen hrew (4 * ε / m) a m N (4 * ε ^ 2 / m)) ?_
  refine le_of_eq ?_
  congr 1
  field_simp
  ring_nf

lemma ae_action_succ (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂(banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA),
      (ω (n+1)).1 = nextA n (Preorder.frestrictLe n ω) := by
  classical
  set g : ((Iic n → Fin K × ℝ) × (Fin K × ℝ)) → ℝ≥0∞ := fun p ↦
    if p.2.1 = nextA n p.1 then 0 else 1 with hg
  have hgmeas : Measurable g := by
    rw [hg]
    refine Measurable.ite ?_ measurable_const measurable_const
    exact measurableSet_eq_fun (by fun_prop) ((hmeasA n).comp measurable_fst)
  have h0 : ∫⁻ ω, g (Preorder.frestrictLe n ω, ω (n+1)) ∂(banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA) = 0 := by
    rw [keyStep n hgmeas]
    have hz : ∀ ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ, (∫⁻ y, g (Preorder.frestrictLe n ω,
        (nextA n (Preorder.frestrictLe n ω), y)) ∂(ν (nextA n (Preorder.frestrictLe n ω)))) = 0 := by
      intro ω; simp [hg]
    simp_rw [hz]
    simp
  rw [ae_iff]
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (zero_le _)
  calc (banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA)
        {ω | ¬ ((ω (n+1)).1 = nextA n (Preorder.frestrictLe n ω))}
      ≤ (banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA)
        {ω | (1:ℝ≥0∞) ≤ g (Preorder.frestrictLe n ω, ω (n+1))} := by
        refine measure_mono fun ω hω ↦ ?_
        simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hω ⊢
        rw [hg]
        simp only [if_neg hω]
        exact le_rfl
    _ ≤ (∫⁻ ω, g (Preorder.frestrictLe n ω, ω (n+1)) ∂(banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA)) / 1 :=
        meas_ge_le_lintegral_div (hgmeas.comp (by fun_prop)).aemeasurable one_ne_zero ENNReal.one_ne_top
    _ = 0 := by rw [h0]; simp

lemma ae_action_zero :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂(banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA), (ω 0).1 = (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K) := by
  classical
  set g : (Fin K × ℝ) → ℝ≥0∞ := fun z ↦ if z.1 = (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K) then 0 else 1 with hg
  have hgmeas : Measurable g := by
    rw [hg]
    refine Measurable.ite ?_ measurable_const measurable_const
    exact (measurableSet_singleton _).preimage (by fun_prop)
  have h0 : ∫⁻ ω, g (ω 0) ∂(banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA) = 0 := by
    rw [keyStep0 hgmeas]
    simp [hg]
  rw [ae_iff]
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (zero_le _)
  calc (banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA) {ω | ¬ ((ω 0).1 = (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K))}
      ≤ (banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA) {ω | (1:ℝ≥0∞) ≤ g (ω 0)} := by
        refine measure_mono fun ω hω ↦ ?_
        simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hω ⊢
        rw [hg]
        simp only [if_neg hω]
        exact le_rfl
    _ ≤ (∫⁻ ω, g (ω 0) ∂(banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA)) / 1 :=
        meas_ge_le_lintegral_div (hgmeas.comp (by fun_prop)).aemeasurable one_ne_zero ENNReal.one_ne_top
    _ = 0 := by rw [h0]; simp

/-- The trajectory follows the (deterministic) algorithm. -/
def followsAlg {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K) (nextA : (n : ℕ) → (Iic n → Fin K × ℝ) → Fin K)
    (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) : Prop :=
  (ω 0).1 = (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K) ∧ ∀ n, (ω (n+1)).1 = nextA n (Preorder.frestrictLe n ω)

lemma ae_followsAlg :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂(banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA), followsAlg hK nextA ω := by
  have h1 := ae_action_zero (hK := hK) (ν := ν) (nextA := nextA) (hmeasA := hmeasA)
  have h2 : ∀ᵐ ω ∂(banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA), ∀ n,
      (ω (n+1)).1 = nextA n (Preorder.frestrictLe n ω) :=
    (ae_all_iff).2 (fun n ↦ ae_action_succ n)
  filter_upwards [h1, h2] with ω ha hb using ⟨ha, hb⟩

end Bandit

section Widths

variable {δ : ℝ} {K m : ℕ}

/-- Upper confidence width used by the algorithm. -/
noncomputable def cUp (δ : ℝ) (m : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (Real.log (2 * ((m:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / δ) / (2 * m))

/-- Lower confidence width. -/
noncomputable def cLow (δ : ℝ) (K : ℕ) (m : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (Real.log (2 * K * ((m:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / δ) / (2 * m))

lemma one_le_argUp (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) (m : ℕ) :
    (1:ℝ) ≤ 2 * ((m:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / δ := by
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hδ0]
  have : (0:ℝ) ≤ (m:ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg m
  nlinarith

lemma one_le_argLow (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) (hK : 0 < K) (m : ℕ) :
    (1:ℝ) ≤ 2 * K * ((m:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / δ := by
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hδ0]
  have h1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (K:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hK
  have : (0:ℝ) ≤ (m:ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg m
  nlinarith

lemma logUp_nonneg (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) (m : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ Real.log (2 * ((m:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / δ) :=
  Real.log_nonneg (one_le_argUp hδ0 hδ1 m)

lemma logLow_nonneg (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) (hK : 0 < K) (m : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ Real.log (2 * K * ((m:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / δ) :=
  Real.log_nonneg (one_le_argLow hδ0 hδ1 hK m)

lemma cUp_nonneg : 0 ≤ cUp δ m := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
lemma cLow_nonneg : 0 ≤ cLow δ K m := Real.sqrt_nonneg _

lemma cUp_sq (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    (cUp δ m) ^ 2 = Real.log (2 * ((m:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / δ) / (2 * m) := by
  rw [cUp, Real.sq_sqrt]
  have hm' : (0:ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have := logUp_nonneg hδ0 hδ1 m
  positivity

lemma cLow_sq (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) (hK : 0 < K) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    (cLow δ K m) ^ 2 = Real.log (2 * K * ((m:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / δ) / (2 * m) := by
  rw [cLow, Real.sq_sqrt]
  have hm' : (0:ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have := logLow_nonneg hδ0 hδ1 hK m
  positivity

lemma cUp_le_cLow (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) (hK : 0 < K) (m : ℕ) :
    cUp δ m ≤ cLow δ K m := by
  refine Real.sqrt_le_sqrt ?_
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with hm | hm
  · subst hm; simp
  have hm' : (0:ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have h1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (K:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hK
  have harg : 2 * ((m:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / δ ≤ 2 * K * ((m:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / δ := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hδ0]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((m:ℝ) + 1)]
  have hlog : Real.log (2 * ((m:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / δ) ≤ Real.log (2 * K * ((m:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / δ) := by
    refine Real.log_le_log ?_ harg
    have : (0:ℝ) ≤ (m:ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg m
    positivity
  gcongr

end Widths

section Failure

lemma sum_inv_sq_le' (T : ℕ) :
    ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, (1:ℝ) / ((m:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 1 - 1 / ((T:ℝ) + 1) := by
  induction T with
  | zero => simp
  | succ T ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by lia)]
      push_cast
      have hT : (0:ℝ) < (T:ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
      have hstep : (1:ℝ) / ((T:ℝ) + 1 + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 1 / ((T:ℝ) + 1) - 1 / ((T:ℝ) + 1 + 1) := by
        have h1 : (1:ℝ) / ((T:ℝ) + 1) - 1 / ((T:ℝ) + 1 + 1)
            = 1 / (((T:ℝ) + 1) * ((T:ℝ) + 1 + 1)) := by
          field_simp
          ring
        rw [h1]
        refine one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) ?_
        nlinarith
      linarith [ih, hstep]

lemma sum_inv_sq_le (T : ℕ) : ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, (1:ℝ) / ((m:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
  refine le_trans (sum_inv_sq_le' T) ?_
  have : (0:ℝ) < (T:ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
  have : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 / ((T:ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
  linarith

end Failure

section FailureProb

variable {K : ℕ} {hK : 0 < K} {ν : Kernel (Fin K) ℝ} [IsMarkovKernel ν]
  {nextA : (n : ℕ) → (Iic n → Fin K × ℝ) → Fin K} {hmeasA : ∀ n, Measurable (nextA n)}
  {δ : ℝ}

lemma prob_fail_up (hrew : ∀ a, (ν a) (Set.Icc 0 1) = 1) (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
    (a : Fin K) (m N : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    (banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA) {ω | bW (bmu ν) a m N ω < -((m:ℝ) * cUp δ m)}
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (δ / (2 * ((m:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2)) := by
  have hm' : (0:ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hsub : {ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ | bW (bmu ν) a m N ω < -((m:ℝ) * cUp δ m)}
      ⊆ {ω | bW (bmu ν) a m N ω ≤ -((m:ℝ) * cUp δ m)} := by
    intro ω hω
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hω ⊢
    exact le_of_lt hω
  refine le_trans (measure_mono hsub) ?_
  refine le_trans (tail_low hrew a m N hm ((m:ℝ) * cUp δ m)
    (mul_nonneg hm'.le cUp_nonneg)) ?_
  refine le_of_eq ?_
  congr 1
  have hkey : 2 * ((m:ℝ) * cUp δ m) ^ 2 / (m:ℝ) = Real.log (2 * ((m:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / δ) := by
    have h1 : ((m:ℝ) * cUp δ m) ^ 2 = (m:ℝ) ^ 2 * (cUp δ m) ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [h1, cUp_sq hδ0 hδ1 hm]
    field_simp
  rw [hkey, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log (by positivity), inv_div]

lemma prob_fail_low (hrew : ∀ a, (ν a) (Set.Icc 0 1) = 1) (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
    (hK' : 0 < K) (a : Fin K) (m N : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    (banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA) {ω | (m:ℝ) * cLow δ K m < bW (bmu ν) a m N ω}
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (δ / (2 * K * ((m:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2)) := by
  have hm' : (0:ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hKR : (0:ℝ) < K := by exact_mod_cast hK'
  have hsub : {ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ | (m:ℝ) * cLow δ K m < bW (bmu ν) a m N ω}
      ⊆ {ω | (m:ℝ) * cLow δ K m ≤ bW (bmu ν) a m N ω} := by
    intro ω hω
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hω ⊢
    exact le_of_lt hω
  refine le_trans (measure_mono hsub) ?_
  refine le_trans (tail_high hrew a m N hm ((m:ℝ) * cLow δ K m)
    (mul_nonneg hm'.le cLow_nonneg)) ?_
  refine le_of_eq ?_
  congr 1
  have hkey : 2 * ((m:ℝ) * cLow δ K m) ^ 2 / (m:ℝ)
      = Real.log (2 * K * ((m:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / δ) := by
    have h1 : ((m:ℝ) * cLow δ K m) ^ 2 = (m:ℝ) ^ 2 * (cLow δ K m) ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [h1, cLow_sq hδ0 hδ1 hK' hm]
    field_simp
  rw [hkey, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log (by positivity), inv_div]

lemma prob_failUp_union (hrew : ∀ a, (ν a) (Set.Icc 0 1) = 1) (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
    (a : Fin K) (T : ℕ) :
    (banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA)
        (⋃ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, {ω | bW (bmu ν) a m T ω < -((m:ℝ) * cUp δ m)})
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (δ / 2) := by
  refine le_trans (measure_biUnion_finset_le _ _) ?_
  refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun m hm ↦
    prob_fail_up hrew hδ0 hδ1 a m T (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hm).1)) ?_
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun m _ ↦ by positivity)]
  refine ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_
  have hcg : ∀ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T,
      δ / (2 * ((m:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2) = (δ / 2) * (1 / ((m:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2) := by
    intro m _
    have : ((m:ℝ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hcg, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  have h2 := sum_inv_sq_le T
  have h3 : (0:ℝ) ≤ δ / 2 := by linarith
  nlinarith

lemma prob_failLow_union_arm (hrew : ∀ a, (ν a) (Set.Icc 0 1) = 1) (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
    (hK' : 0 < K) (a : Fin K) (T : ℕ) :
    (banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA)
        (⋃ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, {ω | (m:ℝ) * cLow δ K m < bW (bmu ν) a m T ω})
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (δ / (2 * K)) := by
  have hKR : (0:ℝ) < K := by exact_mod_cast hK'
  refine le_trans (measure_biUnion_finset_le _ _) ?_
  refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun m hm ↦
    prob_fail_low hrew hδ0 hδ1 hK' a m T (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hm).1)) ?_
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun m _ ↦ by positivity)]
  refine ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_
  have hcg : ∀ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T,
      δ / (2 * K * ((m:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2) = (δ / (2 * K)) * (1 / ((m:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2) := by
    intro m _
    have h0 : ((m:ℝ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have h1 : (K:ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hKR
    field_simp
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hcg, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  have h2 := sum_inv_sq_le T
  have h3 : (0:ℝ) ≤ δ / (2 * K) := by positivity
  nlinarith

lemma prob_failLow_union (hrew : ∀ a, (ν a) (Set.Icc 0 1) = 1) (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
    (hK' : 0 < K) (T : ℕ) :
    (banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA)
        (⋃ a : Fin K, ⋃ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, {ω | (m:ℝ) * cLow δ K m < bW (bmu ν) a m T ω})
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (δ / 2) := by
  have hKR : (0:ℝ) < K := by exact_mod_cast hK'
  set S : Fin K → Set (ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) := fun a ↦
    ⋃ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, {ω | (m:ℝ) * cLow δ K m < bW (bmu ν) a m T ω} with hS
  have hun : (⋃ a : Fin K, S a) = ⋃ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin K)), S a := by
    ext ω; simp
  show (banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA) (⋃ a : Fin K, S a) ≤ _
  rw [hun]
  refine le_trans (measure_biUnion_finset_le _ _) ?_
  refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun a _ ↦
    prob_failLow_union_arm hrew hδ0 hδ1 hK' a T)) ?_
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun a _ ↦ by positivity)]
  refine ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have h1 : (K:ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hKR
  have hEq : (K:ℝ) * (δ / (2 * K)) = δ / 2 := by field_simp
  exact le_of_eq hEq

end FailureProb

section Translate

variable {K : ℕ}

lemma Iic_eq_range (n : ℕ) : Finset.Iic n = Finset.range (n + 1) := by
  ext x; simp [Nat.lt_succ_iff]

lemma pullCount'_eq (n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) (a : Fin K) :
    pullCount' n (Preorder.frestrictLe n ω) a = bcnt a (n + 1) ω := by
  rw [pullCount'_eq_sum, bcnt, ← Iic_eq_range,
    ← Finset.sum_coe_sort (Finset.Iic n) (fun s ↦ if (ω s).1 = a then 1 else 0)]
  rfl

lemma sumRewards'_eq (n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) (a : Fin K) :
    sumRewards' n (Preorder.frestrictLe n ω) a = bsumR a (n + 1) ω := by
  rw [sumRewards', bsumR, ← Iic_eq_range,
    ← Finset.sum_coe_sort (Finset.Iic n) (fun s ↦ if (ω s).1 = a then (ω s).2 else 0)]
  rfl

lemma empMean'_eq (n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) (a : Fin K) :
    empMean' n (Preorder.frestrictLe n ω) a
      = bsumR a (n + 1) ω / (bcnt a (n + 1) ω : ℝ) := by
  rw [empMean', sumRewards'_eq, pullCount'_eq]

lemma ucbWidthNL_eq (δ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) (a : Fin K) :
    ucbWidthNL δ n (Preorder.frestrictLe n ω) a = cUp δ (bcnt a (n + 1) ω) := by
  rw [ucbWidthNL, cUp, pullCount'_eq]

end Translate

section Argmax

variable {K : ℕ}

lemma exists_argmax (hK : 0 < K) (mu : Fin K → ℝ) : ∃ astar : Fin K, ∀ a, mu a ≤ mu astar := by
  have : Nonempty (Fin K) := Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp hK
  obtain ⟨astar, h⟩ := Finite.exists_max mu
  exact ⟨astar, h⟩

lemma iSup_eq_max (hK : 0 < K) {mu : Fin K → ℝ} {astar : Fin K} (h : ∀ a, mu a ≤ mu astar) :
    (⨆ a, mu a) = mu astar := by
  have : Nonempty (Fin K) := Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp hK
  exact le_antisymm (ciSup_le h) (le_ciSup (Finite.bddAbove_range mu) astar)

end Argmax

section MeanBounds

variable {K : ℕ} {ν : Kernel (Fin K) ℝ} [IsMarkovKernel ν]

lemma integrable_id_nu (hrew : ∀ a, (ν a) (Set.Icc 0 1) = 1) (a : Fin K) :
    Integrable (fun y : ℝ ↦ y) (ν a) :=
  Integrable.of_mem_Icc 0 1 aemeasurable_id (ae_mem_Icc hrew a)

lemma bmu_nonneg (hrew : ∀ a, (ν a) (Set.Icc 0 1) = 1) (a : Fin K) : 0 ≤ bmu ν a :=
  integral_nonneg_of_ae ((ae_mem_Icc hrew a).mono (fun y hy ↦ hy.1))

lemma bmu_le_one (hrew : ∀ a, (ν a) (Set.Icc 0 1) = 1) (a : Fin K) : bmu ν a ≤ 1 := by
  have h := integral_mono_ae (integrable_id_nu hrew a) (integrable_const (1:ℝ))
    ((ae_mem_Icc hrew a).mono (fun y hy ↦ hy.2))
  simpa [bmu] using h

end MeanBounds

section Warmup

variable {K : ℕ}

lemma warm_action (hK : 0 < K) {nextA : (n : ℕ) → (Iic n → Fin K × ℝ) → Fin K}
    (hwarm : ∀ n h, n < K - 1 → nextA n h = RoundRobin.nextAction hK n)
    {ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ} (hf : followsAlg hK nextA ω) :
    ∀ s, s < K → ((ω s).1 : ℕ) = s := by
  intro s
  induction s with
  | zero => intro _; rw [hf.1]
  | succ n _ =>
      intro hs
      have hn : n < K - 1 := by lia
      rw [hf.2 n, hwarm n _ hn, RoundRobin.nextAction]
      exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hs

lemma bcnt_warm {ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ} (h : ∀ s, s < K → ((ω s).1 : ℕ) = s) (a : Fin K) :
    bcnt a K ω = 1 := by
  classical
  rw [bcnt]
  have hc : ∀ s ∈ range K, (if (ω s).1 = a then 1 else 0) = (if s = (a:ℕ) then 1 else 0) := by
    intro s hs
    have hs' := Finset.mem_range.mp hs
    by_cases h1 : (ω s).1 = a
    · have h2 : s = (a:ℕ) := by rw [← h s hs', h1]
      rw [if_pos h1, if_pos h2]
    · have h2 : ¬ (s = (a:ℕ)) := by
        intro h2
        exact h1 (Fin.val_injective (by rw [h s hs', h2]))
      rw [if_neg h1, if_neg h2]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hc, Finset.sum_ite_eq' (range K) (a:ℕ) (fun _ ↦ 1)]
  simp [a.isLt]

lemma sum_range_K_eq {ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ} (h : ∀ s, s < K → ((ω s).1 : ℕ) = s) (f : Fin K → ℝ) :
    ∑ s ∈ range K, f ((ω s).1) = ∑ a : Fin K, f a := by
  classical
  set g : ℕ → ℝ := fun s ↦ if hs : s < K then f ⟨s, hs⟩ else 0 with hg
  have h1 : ∑ i : Fin K, g (i : ℕ) = ∑ a : Fin K, f a := by
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
    rw [hg]
    simp
  have h2 : ∑ s ∈ range K, g s = ∑ s ∈ range K, f ((ω s).1) := by
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s hs ↦ ?_
    have hs' := Finset.mem_range.mp hs
    rw [hg]
    simp only [dif_pos hs']
    congr 1
    exact Fin.val_injective (h s hs').symm
  rw [← h2, ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range g K, h1]

lemma sum_gap_le (hK : 0 < K) {mu : Fin K → ℝ} {astar : Fin K}
    (hmax : ∀ a, mu a ≤ mu astar) (hb : ∀ a, 0 ≤ mu a ∧ mu a ≤ 1) :
    ∑ a : Fin K, (mu astar - mu a) ≤ (K:ℝ) - 1 := by
  classical
  have hsplit : ∑ a : Fin K, (mu astar - mu a)
      = ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.erase astar, (mu astar - mu a) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_erase]
    simp
  rw [hsplit]
  calc ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.erase astar, (mu astar - mu a)
      ≤ ∑ _a ∈ Finset.univ.erase astar, (1:ℝ) := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ ↦ ?_
        have h1 := (hb astar).2
        have h2 := (hb a).1
        linarith
    _ = (((Finset.univ.erase astar).card : ℕ) : ℝ) := by simp
    _ = (K:ℝ) - 1 := by
        rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ _), Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
          Nat.cast_sub hK]
        norm_num

end Warmup

section RoundBound

variable {K T : ℕ} {δ : ℝ}

/-- Upper confidence bounds hold for the optimal arm. -/
def goodUp (δ : ℝ) (T : ℕ) {K : ℕ} (mu : Fin K → ℝ) (astar : Fin K) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ T → -((m:ℝ) * cUp δ m) ≤ bW mu astar m T ω

/-- Lower confidence bounds hold for every arm. -/
def goodLow (δ : ℝ) (K T : ℕ) (mu : Fin K → ℝ) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : Fin K) (m : ℕ), 1 ≤ m → m ≤ T → bW mu a m T ω ≤ (m:ℝ) * cLow δ K m

lemma round_bound (hK : 0 < K) (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
    {nextA : (n : ℕ) → (Iic n → Fin K × ℝ) → Fin K}
    {mu : Fin K → ℝ} {astar : Fin K} {ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ}
    (hargmax : ∀ n h a, K - 1 ≤ n →
      empMean' n h a + ucbWidthNL δ n h a ≤
        empMean' n h (nextA n h) + ucbWidthNL δ n h (nextA n h))
    (hf : followsAlg hK nextA ω)
    (hwarmact : ∀ s, s < K → ((ω s).1 : ℕ) = s)
    (hgu : goodUp δ T mu astar ω) (hgl : goodLow δ K T mu ω)
    (s : ℕ) (hs1 : K ≤ s) (hs2 : s < T) :
    mu astar - mu ((ω s).1) ≤ 2 * cLow δ K (bcnt ((ω s).1) s ω) := by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, s = n + 1 := ⟨s - 1, by lia⟩
  set b := (ω (n+1)).1 with hbdef
  set p := bcnt astar (n+1) ω with hpdef
  set q := bcnt b (n+1) ω with hqdef
  -- counts are in `[1, T]`
  have hcntK : ∀ a : Fin K, 1 ≤ bcnt a (n+1) ω := by
    intro a
    have h1 : bcnt a K ω = 1 := bcnt_warm hwarmact a
    have := bcnt_mono (a := a) (ω := ω) hs1
    lia
  have hp1 : 1 ≤ p := hcntK astar
  have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := hcntK b
  have hpT : p ≤ T := le_trans bcnt_le_self (by lia)
  have hqT : q ≤ T := le_trans bcnt_le_self (by lia)
  have hpR : (0:ℝ) < (p:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp1
  have hqR : (0:ℝ) < (q:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hq1
  -- the empirical means
  set A := bsumR astar (n+1) ω / (p:ℝ) with hAdef
  set B := bsumR b (n+1) ω / (q:ℝ) with hBdef
  have hAp : bsumR astar (n+1) ω = A * (p:ℝ) := by
    rw [hAdef]; field_simp
  have hBq : bsumR b (n+1) ω = B * (q:ℝ) := by
    rw [hBdef]; field_simp
  -- upper confidence bound for `astar`
  have hupper : -((p:ℝ) * cUp δ p) ≤ bsumR astar (n+1) ω - (p:ℝ) * mu astar := by
    have h1 := hgu p hp1 hpT
    rwa [bW_stable (a := astar) (mu := mu) (m := p) (n := n+1) rfl (by lia),
      bW_eq_of_cnt (a := astar) (mu := mu) (m := p) (n := n+1) rfl] at h1
  have hA : mu astar ≤ A + cUp δ p := by nlinarith [hupper, hAp]
  -- lower confidence bound for the chosen arm
  have hlower : bsumR b (n+1) ω - (q:ℝ) * mu b ≤ (q:ℝ) * cLow δ K q := by
    have h1 := hgl b q hq1 hqT
    rwa [bW_stable (a := b) (mu := mu) (m := q) (n := n+1) rfl (by lia),
      bW_eq_of_cnt (a := b) (mu := mu) (m := q) (n := n+1) rfl] at h1
  have hB : B ≤ mu b + cLow δ K q := by nlinarith [hlower, hBq]
  -- the algorithm maximises the index
  have hbeq : b = nextA n (Preorder.frestrictLe n ω) := hf.2 n
  have hidx : A + cUp δ p ≤ B + cUp δ q := by
    have h1 := hargmax n (Preorder.frestrictLe n ω) astar (by lia)
    rw [empMean'_eq, ucbWidthNL_eq, empMean'_eq, ucbWidthNL_eq, ← hbeq] at h1
    exact h1
  have hcup : cUp δ q ≤ cLow δ K q := cUp_le_cLow hδ0 hδ1 hK q
  linarith

end RoundBound

section Summation

variable {K T : ℕ} {δ : ℝ}

lemma sum_inv_sqrt_le (M : ℕ) :
    ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, 1 / Real.sqrt m ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt M := by
  induction M with
  | zero => simp
  | succ M ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by lia)]
      have hu0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt M := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
      have hv0 : (0:ℝ) < Real.sqrt ((M:ℝ) + 1) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)
      have hu2 : (Real.sqrt M) ^ 2 = (M:ℝ) := Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg M)
      have hv2 : (Real.sqrt ((M:ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2 = (M:ℝ) + 1 := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
      have hcast : (((M + 1 : ℕ)) : ℝ) = (M:ℝ) + 1 := by push_cast; ring
      rw [hcast]
      have hstep : 1 / Real.sqrt ((M:ℝ) + 1)
          ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt ((M:ℝ) + 1) - 2 * Real.sqrt M := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hv0]
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt ((M:ℝ) + 1) - Real.sqrt M)]
      linarith [ih, hstep]

lemma sum_bcnt (n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) : ∑ a : Fin K, bcnt a n ω = n := by
  classical
  have h1 : (∑ a : Fin K, bcnt a n ω)
      = ∑ a : Fin K, ∑ s ∈ range n, (if (ω s).1 = a then 1 else 0) := rfl
  rw [h1, Finset.sum_comm]
  have h2 : ∀ s ∈ range n, ∑ a : Fin K, (if (ω s).1 = a then 1 else 0) = 1 := by
    intro s _
    rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq Finset.univ ((ω s).1) (fun _ ↦ 1)]
    simp
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h2]
  simp

lemma cLow_le_bound (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) (hK : 0 < K) {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hmT : m + 1 ≤ T) :
    cLow δ K m ≤ Real.sqrt (Real.log (2 * K * (T:ℝ) ^ 2 / δ) / 2) * (1 / Real.sqrt m) := by
  have hmR : (0:ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hKR : (0:ℝ) < K := by exact_mod_cast hK
  have hmono : Real.log (2 * K * ((m:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / δ) ≤ Real.log (2 * K * (T:ℝ) ^ 2 / δ) := by
    refine Real.log_le_log (by positivity) ?_
    have h1 : (m:ℝ) + 1 ≤ (T:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hmT
    have h2 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (m:ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
    have h3 : ((m:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 ≤ (T:ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    rw [div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hδ0]
    nlinarith
  have hLnn : 0 ≤ Real.log (2 * K * (T:ℝ) ^ 2 / δ) :=
    le_trans (logLow_nonneg hδ0 hδ1 hK m) hmono
  have hrw : Real.sqrt (Real.log (2 * K * (T:ℝ) ^ 2 / δ) / (2 * m))
      = Real.sqrt (Real.log (2 * K * (T:ℝ) ^ 2 / δ) / 2) * (1 / Real.sqrt m) := by
    rw [show Real.log (2 * K * (T:ℝ) ^ 2 / δ) / (2 * (m:ℝ))
        = (Real.log (2 * K * (T:ℝ) ^ 2 / δ) / 2) * (1 / (m:ℝ)) by field_simp]
    rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity), one_div, Real.sqrt_inv, one_div]
  rw [cLow, ← hrw]
  refine Real.sqrt_le_sqrt ?_
  gcongr

lemma sum_fiber_le (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) (hK : 0 < K) {ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ}
    (hwarmact : ∀ s, s < K → ((ω s).1 : ℕ) = s) (a : Fin K) :
    ∑ s ∈ (Finset.Ico K T).filter (fun s ↦ (ω s).1 = a), cLow δ K (bcnt a s ω)
      ≤ ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (bcnt a T ω - 1), cLow δ K m := by
  classical
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun s ↦ bcnt a s ω)
      ↑((Finset.Ico K T).filter (fun s ↦ (ω s).1 = a)) := by
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    simp only [Finset.coe_filter, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hx hy
    simp only at hxy
    simp only [Finset.mem_Ico] at hx hy
    by_contra hne
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hlt
    · have := bcnt_lt_of_pull hlt hx.2; lia
    · have := bcnt_lt_of_pull hlt hy.2; lia
  have hmaps : ((Finset.Ico K T).filter (fun s ↦ (ω s).1 = a)).image (fun s ↦ bcnt a s ω)
      ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 (bcnt a T ω - 1) := by
    intro m hm
    simp only [Finset.mem_image] at hm
    obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := hm
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Ico] at hs
    refine Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have h1 : bcnt a K ω = 1 := bcnt_warm hwarmact a
      have h2 := bcnt_mono (a := a) (ω := ω) hs.1.1
      lia
    · have h2 : bcnt a (s+1) ω = bcnt a s ω + 1 := by rw [bcnt_succ, if_pos hs.2]
      have h3 : bcnt a (s+1) ω ≤ bcnt a T ω := bcnt_mono (by lia)
      lia
  calc ∑ s ∈ (Finset.Ico K T).filter (fun s ↦ (ω s).1 = a), cLow δ K (bcnt a s ω)
      = ∑ m ∈ ((Finset.Ico K T).filter (fun s ↦ (ω s).1 = a)).image (fun s ↦ bcnt a s ω),
          cLow δ K m := (Finset.sum_image hinj).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (bcnt a T ω - 1), cLow δ K m :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hmaps (fun _ _ _ ↦ cLow_nonneg)

lemma sum_sqrt_counts_le (hK : 0 < K) (hKT : K ≤ T) {ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ}
    (hwarmact : ∀ s, s < K → ((ω s).1 : ℕ) = s) :
    ∑ a : Fin K, Real.sqrt (((bcnt a T ω - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ Real.sqrt ((K:ℝ) * ((T:ℝ) - K)) := by
  classical
  have hNa : ∀ a : Fin K, 1 ≤ bcnt a T ω := by
    intro a
    have h1 : bcnt a K ω = 1 := bcnt_warm hwarmact a
    have h2 := bcnt_mono (a := a) (ω := ω) hKT
    lia
  have hsum' : ∑ a : Fin K, (((bcnt a T ω - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) = (T:ℝ) - K := by
    have h1 : ∀ a : Fin K, (((bcnt a T ω - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) = ((bcnt a T ω : ℝ)) - 1 := by
      intro a
      have := hNa a
      push_cast [Nat.cast_sub this]
      ring
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ ↦ h1 a), Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    have h2 : ∑ a : Fin K, ((bcnt a T ω : ℝ)) = (T:ℝ) := by
      rw [← Nat.cast_sum, sum_bcnt]
    rw [h2]
    simp
  have hnn : (0:ℝ) ≤ ∑ a : Fin K, Real.sqrt (((bcnt a T ω - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ ↦ Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hsq : (∑ a : Fin K, Real.sqrt (((bcnt a T ω - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) ^ 2
      ≤ (K:ℝ) * ((T:ℝ) - K) := by
    have h1 := sq_sum_le_card_mul_sum_sq (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin K)))
      (f := fun a ↦ Real.sqrt (((bcnt a T ω - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)))
    have h2 : ∀ a : Fin K, (Real.sqrt (((bcnt a T ω - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) ^ 2
        = (((bcnt a T ω - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := fun a ↦ Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ ↦ h2 a), hsum', Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at h1
    exact h1
  calc ∑ a : Fin K, Real.sqrt (((bcnt a T ω - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
      = Real.sqrt ((∑ a : Fin K, Real.sqrt (((bcnt a T ω - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) ^ 2) :=
        (Real.sqrt_sq hnn).symm
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt ((K:ℝ) * ((T:ℝ) - K)) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hsq

lemma sum_widths_bound (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) (hK : 0 < K) (hKT : K ≤ T)
    {ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ} (hwarmact : ∀ s, s < K → ((ω s).1 : ℕ) = s) :
    ∑ s ∈ Finset.Ico K T, cLow δ K (bcnt ((ω s).1) s ω)
      ≤ Real.sqrt (Real.log (2 * K * (T:ℝ) ^ 2 / δ) / 2)
          * (2 * Real.sqrt ((K:ℝ) * ((T:ℝ) - K))) := by
  classical
  set L := Real.log (2 * K * (T:ℝ) ^ 2 / δ) with hL
  have hKR : (0:ℝ) < K := by exact_mod_cast hK
  have hLnn : 0 ≤ L := by
    rw [hL]
    refine Real.log_nonneg ?_
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hδ0]
    have h1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (K:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hK
    have h2 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (T:ℝ) := by
      have : 1 ≤ T := by lia
      exact_mod_cast this
    nlinarith
  set C := Real.sqrt (L / 2) with hC
  have hCnn : 0 ≤ C := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hNa : ∀ a : Fin K, 1 ≤ bcnt a T ω := by
    intro a
    have h1 : bcnt a K ω = 1 := bcnt_warm hwarmact a
    have h2 := bcnt_mono (a := a) (ω := ω) hKT
    lia
  have hNaT : ∀ a : Fin K, bcnt a T ω ≤ T := fun a ↦ bcnt_le_self
  calc ∑ s ∈ Finset.Ico K T, cLow δ K (bcnt ((ω s).1) s ω)
      = ∑ a : Fin K, ∑ s ∈ (Finset.Ico K T).filter (fun s ↦ (ω s).1 = a),
          cLow δ K (bcnt ((ω s).1) s ω) :=
        (Finset.sum_fiberwise (Finset.Ico K T) (fun s ↦ (ω s).1) _).symm
    _ = ∑ a : Fin K, ∑ s ∈ (Finset.Ico K T).filter (fun s ↦ (ω s).1 = a),
          cLow δ K (bcnt a s ω) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ ↦ Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s hs ↦ ?_
        rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hs).2]
    _ ≤ ∑ a : Fin K, ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (bcnt a T ω - 1), cLow δ K m :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ ↦ sum_fiber_le hδ0 hδ1 hK hwarmact a
    _ ≤ ∑ a : Fin K, ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (bcnt a T ω - 1), C * (1 / Real.sqrt m) := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ ↦ Finset.sum_le_sum fun m hm ↦ ?_
        obtain ⟨hm1, hm2⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hm
        have hmT : m + 1 ≤ T := by have := hNa a; have := hNaT a; lia
        exact cLow_le_bound hδ0 hδ1 hK hm1 hmT
    _ = ∑ a : Fin K, C * (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (bcnt a T ω - 1), (1 / Real.sqrt m)) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ ↦ ?_
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ ∑ a : Fin K, C * (2 * Real.sqrt (((bcnt a T ω - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ ↦ ?_
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sum_inv_sqrt_le _) hCnn
    _ = C * (2 * ∑ a : Fin K, Real.sqrt (((bcnt a T ω - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ C * (2 * Real.sqrt ((K:ℝ) * ((T:ℝ) - K))) := by
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hCnn
        have := sum_sqrt_counts_le hK hKT hwarmact
        linarith

end Summation

section FinalDet

variable {K T : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} {ν : Kernel (Fin K) ℝ} [IsMarkovKernel ν]

lemma sqrt_identity (hK : 0 < K) (hKT : K ≤ T) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) :
    Real.sqrt (8 * L * ((T:ℝ) - K) * K)
      = 4 * Real.sqrt (L / 2) * Real.sqrt ((K:ℝ) * ((T:ℝ) - K)) := by
  have hTK : (0:ℝ) ≤ (T:ℝ) - K := by
    have : (K:ℝ) ≤ (T:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hKT
    linarith
  have h16 : Real.sqrt 16 = 4 := by
    rw [show (16:ℝ) = 4 ^ 2 by norm_num, Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)]
  rw [show 8 * L * ((T:ℝ) - K) * K = 16 * ((L / 2) * ((K:ℝ) * ((T:ℝ) - K))) by ring,
    Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num), h16, Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity)]
  ring

lemma regret_bound_det (hK : 0 < K) (hKT : K ≤ T) (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
    (hrew : ∀ a, (ν a) (Set.Icc 0 1) = 1)
    {nextA : (n : ℕ) → (Iic n → Fin K × ℝ) → Fin K}
    (hwarm : ∀ n h, n < K - 1 → nextA n h = RoundRobin.nextAction hK n)
    (hargmax : ∀ n h a, K - 1 ≤ n →
      empMean' n h a + ucbWidthNL δ n h a ≤
        empMean' n h (nextA n h) + ucbWidthNL δ n h (nextA n h))
    {astar : Fin K} (hmax : ∀ a, bmu ν a ≤ bmu ν astar)
    {ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ} (hf : followsAlg hK nextA ω)
    (hgu : goodUp δ T (bmu ν) astar ω) (hgl : goodLow δ K T (bmu ν) ω) :

  classical
  obtain ⟨astar, hmax⟩ := exists_argmax hK (bmu ν)
  set Tgt : Set (ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) :=
    {ω | (T:ℝ) * (⨆ a, bmu ν a) - ∑ s ∈ range T, bmu ν ((ω s).1)

      {ω | bW (bmu ν) astar m T ω < -((m:ℝ) * cUp δ m)} with hB1
  set B2 : Set (ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) := ⋃ a : Fin K, ⋃ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T,

  set B3 : Set (ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) := {ω | ¬ followsAlg hK nextA ω} with hB3

    intro ω h1 h2 h3

      by_contra hc
