    have hgl : goodLow δ K T (bmu ν) ω := by
      intro a m hm1 hm2
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      exact h2 (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
        ⟨a, Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨m, Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hm1, hm2⟩, hc⟩⟩)
    exact regret_bound_det hK hKT hδ0 hδ1 hrew hwarm hargmax hmax hf hgu hgl
  have hcompl : Tgtᶜ ⊆ B1 ∪ B2 ∪ B3 := by
    intro ω hω

    prob_failUp_union hrew hδ0 hδ1 astar T
  have hPB2 : (banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA) B2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (δ / 2) :=
    prob_failLow_union hrew hδ0 hδ1 hK T
  have hPB3 : (banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA) B3 = 0 := by
    have h := ae_followsAlg (hK := hK) (ν := ν) (nextA := nextA) (hmeasA := hmeasA)

  have hbad : (banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA) Tgtᶜ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ := by
    calc (banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA) Tgtᶜ
        ≤ (banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA) (B1 ∪ B2 ∪ B3) := measure_mono hcompl
      _ ≤ (banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA) (B1 ∪ B2) + (banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA) B3 :=
          measure_union_le _ _

            + (banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA) B3 := by
          have h := measure_union_le (μ := banditP hK ν nextA hmeasA) B1 B2

Consider function class \(\mathcal{G} = \{\phi(w, z) : w \in \Omega\}\) with \(h(w) = \phi(w, \mathcal{D})\) and \(\inf_{w \in \Omega} h(w) = 0\). Assume that \(|\phi(\cdot)| \leq M\) and the variance condition (3.14) holds with \(c_0 = 0\). Assume that for any \(b > 0\), we have
\[
\sup_{\mathcal{S}_{n}}R\left(\left\{\phi(w,\cdot):\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\phi(w,Z_{i})^{2}\leq b\right\},\mathcal{S}_{n}\right)\leq r_{n}(b),
\]
where \(r_n(b)\) is a continuous concave function of \(b\). Let \(\alpha \leq 0.5c_1 / M\) and
\[
b_{0}=\sup\{b>0:b\leq(4 c_{1}/\alpha)r_{n}(b)\},
\]
then \(\bar{r}_n^h(\alpha,\mathcal{G},\mathcal{D})\leq 0.5\alpha b_0/c_1\)

\[

\[
\hat{b}(\mathcal{S}_{n})=\sup_{g\in\mathcal{G}_{0}}\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}g(Z_{i})^{2}.
\]

\[
R\left(\mathcal{G}_{0},\mathcal{S}_{n}\right)\leq r_{n}(\hat{b}\left(\mathcal{S}_{n}\right)),\quad R\left(-\mathcal{G}_{0}^{2},\mathcal{S}_{n}\right)\leq 2 M r_{n}(\hat{b}\left(\mathcal{S}_{n}\right)).\tag{6.8}
\]
The first inequality used the definition of \( r_n \) and the definition of \( \hat{b} \). The second inequality used Theorem 6.28 and \( |\phi(w_1, z)^2 - \phi(w_2, z)^2| \leq 2M|\phi(w_1, z) - \phi(w_2, z)| \).

\[

The first inequality used \(\sup_{g\in \mathcal{G}_0}\mathbb{E}_{Z\sim \mathcal{D}}g(Z)^2\leq 0.5b_0'\), which follows from the
variance condition. The second inequality used Theorem 6.4. The third inequality used (6.8). The last inequality used the concavity of \(r_n(\cdot)\) and \(4M \leq 2c_1 / \alpha\).
From the above inequality, we have either \(\tilde{b} < b_0'\), or \(\tilde{b} \leq (2c_1 / \alpha)r_n(\tilde{b}) + 0.5\tilde{b}\). The latter also implies that \(\tilde{b} \leq b_0 < b_0'\) by using the definition of \(b_0\). We thus obtain
\[
\epsilon_{n}(\mathcal{G}_{0})\leq 2\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{S}_{n}}R(\mathcal{G}_{0},\mathcal{S}_{n})\leq 2\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{S}_{n}}r_{n}(\hat{b}(\mathcal{S}_{n}))\leq 2r_{n}(\tilde{b})<(0. 5\alpha/c_{1})b_{0}^{\prime}.

The first inequality used Theorem 6.4. The second inequality (6.8). The third inequality used the concavity of \( r_n(\cdot) \). The last inequality used \( \tilde{b} < b_0' \), \( b_0' > b_0 \), and the definition of \( b_0 \).

context.name: theorem 6.28
context.statement:
Let \(\{\phi_i\}_{i=1}^n\) be functions with Lipschitz constants \(\{\gamma_i\}_{i=1}^n\) respectively. That is, \(\forall i \in [n]\):
\[
\left|\phi_{i}(\theta)-\phi_{i}\left(\theta^{\prime}\right)\right|\leq\gamma_{i}\left|\theta-\theta^{\prime}\right|.
\]
Then for any real valued function \( h: \mathcal{F} \times \mathcal{Z}^n \to \mathbb{R} \), and \( S_n = \{Z_1, \ldots, Z_n\} \subset \mathcal{Z}^n \), we have
\[
\mathbb{E}_{\sigma}\sup_{f\in\mathcal{F}}\left[\sum_{i=1}^{n}\sigma_{i}\phi_{i}(f(Z_{i}))-h(f,\mathcal{S}_{n})\right]\leq\mathbb{E}_{\sigma}\sup_{f\in\mathcal{F}}\left[\sum_{i=1}^{n}\sigma_{i}\gamma_{i}f(Z_{i})-h(f,\mathcal{S}_{n})\right].
\]

context.name: theorem 6.4
context.statement:
We have
\[
\epsilon_{n}(\mathcal{G},\mathcal{D})\leq 2 R_{n}(\mathcal{G},\mathcal{D}).
\]
Consequently, the approximate ERM method of (3.7) satisfies
\[
\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{S}_{n}}\phi(\hat{w},\mathcal{D})\leq\inf_{w\in\Omega}\phi(w,\mathcal{D})+\epsilon^{\prime}+2 R_{n}(\mathcal{G},\mathcal{D}).
\]

context.name: definition 6.35
context.statement:
Given \(\mathcal{D}\) and \(\mathcal{F}\), and consider a localization function \(h: \mathcal{F} \to \mathbb{R}\) such that \(b_0 = \inf_{f \in \mathcal{F}} h(f) > -\infty\). Define localized function class \(\mathcal{F}^h(b) = \{f \in \mathcal{F}: h(f) \leq b\}\) for all \(b > b_0\). For any \(\alpha > 0\), the rate function with respect to localization \(h\) is defined as
\[
\bar{r}_{n}^{h}(\alpha,\mathcal{F},\mathcal{D})=\sup\left\{r:r\leq\inf_{r^{\prime}>\max(r,\alpha b_{0})}\epsilon_{n}\left(\mathcal{F}^{h}\big(r^{\prime}/\alpha\big),\mathcal{D}\right)\right\}.
\]
We note that the requirement of \( r' > \alpha b_0 \) in Definition 6.35 is only to make sure that \( \mathcal{F}^h(r'/\alpha) \) is always non-empty, and thus \( \epsilon_n(\mathcal{F}^h(r'/\alpha), \mathcal{D}) \) is well-defined.

context.name: definition 6.1
context.statement:
Given an empirical process \(\{\phi(w, S_n) : w \in \Omega\}\), with \(S_n \sim \mathcal{D}^n\). Define the expected supremum of this empirical process as
\[
\epsilon_{n}(\mathcal{G},\mathcal{D})=\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{S}_{n}}\sup_{w\in\Omega}\left[\phi(w,\mathcal{D})-\phi(w,\mathcal{S}_{n})\right],
\]
which will be referred to as the uniform convergence complexity of the function class \(\mathcal{G}\).
The smaller this quantity is, the closer the gap between the training error and the test error is, which implies that we have less overfitting. In Chapter 3, we
obtained large probability uniform convergence results for empirical processes, and then derived oracle inequalities in large probabilities. In the following, we show that if average convergence can be obtained, then we can derive oracle inequalities in expectation directly.

context.name: definition 6.3
context.statement:
Given \(S_{n}=\{Z_{1},\ldots,Z_{n}\}\), the (one-sided) empirical Rademacher complexity of \(\mathcal{G}\) is defined as
\[
R(\mathcal{G},\mathcal{S}_{n}) = \mathbb{E}_{\sigma}\sup_{w\in \Omega}\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i = 1}^{n}\sigma_{i}\phi (w,Z_{i}),
\]
where \(\sigma_1, \ldots, \sigma_n\) are independent uniform \(\{\pm 1\}\)-valued Bernoulli random variables. Moreover, the expected Rademacher complexity is
\[
R_{n}(\mathcal{G},\mathcal{D})=\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{S}_{n}\sim\mathcal{D}^{n}}R(\mathcal{G},\mathcal{S}_{n}).
\]

context.name: Variance Condition
context.statement:
Given a function class \(\mathcal{G}\). We say it satisfies the variance condition if there exists \(c_0, c_1 > 0\) such that for all \(\phi(z) \in \mathcal{G}\):
\[
\operatorname{Var}_{Z\sim\mathcal{D}}(\phi(Z))\leq c_{0}^{2}+c_{1}\mathbb{E}_{Z\sim\mathcal{D}}\phi(Z),\tag{3.13}
\]
where we require that \(\mathbb{E}_{Z\sim \mathcal{D}}\phi (Z)\geq -c_0^2 /c_1\) for all \(\phi \in \mathcal{G}\)
In applications, the following modification of the variance condition is often more convenient to employ
\[
\mathbb{E}_{Z\sim\mathcal{D}}[\phi(Z)^{2}]\leq c_{0}^{2}+c_{1}\mathbb{E}_{Z\sim\mathcal{D}}\phi(Z).\tag{3.14}
\]
It is easy to see that (3.14) implies (3.13). If \(\phi(Z)\) is bounded, then the two conditions are equivalent.
In general, if the variance condition (3.13) only holds for \( c_{1} = 0 \), then we can only obtain a convergence rate that is \( O(1 / \sqrt{n}) \) at the best. When the variance condition holds for \( c_{1} > 0 \) and \( c_{0} = 0 \), then we may be able to obtain a convergence rate faster than \( O(1 / \sqrt{n}) \) by using Bernstein's inequality. The ability to achieve faster convergence is the main reason to study this condition.

  rw [add_ciSup hg]

private lemma ciSup_pair_le {W : Type*} [Nonempty W]
    {f g F G : W → ℝ} {cf cg cF cG : ℝ}
    (hf' : ∀ w, f w ≤ cf) (hg' : ∀ w, g w ≤ cg)
    (hF' : ∀ w, F w ≤ cF) (hG' : ∀ w, G w ≤ cG)
    (h : ∀ a b, f a + g b ≤ max (F a + G b) (G a + F b)) :
    (⨆ w, f w) + ⨆ w, g w ≤ (⨆ w, F w) + ⨆ w, G w := by
  have hf : BddAbove (Set.range f) := ⟨cf, by rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩; exact hf' w⟩
  have hg : BddAbove (Set.range g) := ⟨cg, by rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩; exact hg' w⟩
  have hF : BddAbove (Set.range F) := ⟨cF, by rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩; exact hF' w⟩
  have hG : BddAbove (Set.range G) := ⟨cG, by rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩; exact hG' w⟩
  rw [ciSup_add_ciSup hf hg, ciSup_add_ciSup hF hG]
  have hFG (a : W) : BddAbove (Set.range fun b => F a + G b) :=
    ⟨F a + cG, by rintro _ ⟨b, rfl⟩; exact add_le_add (le_refl _) (hG' b)⟩
  have hFG' : BddAbove (Set.range fun a => ⨆ b, F a + G b) :=
    ⟨cF + cG, by
      rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
      exact ciSup_le fun b => add_le_add (hF' a) (hG' b)⟩
  refine ciSup_le fun a => ciSup_le fun b => ?_
  refine (h a b).trans ?_
  apply max_le
  · exact le_ciSup_of_le hFG' a (le_ciSup_of_le (hFG a) b (le_rfl))
  · exact le_ciSup_of_le hFG' b (le_ciSup_of_le (hFG b) a (by simpa [add_comm]))

private lemma contraction_one {W : Type*} [Nonempty W]
    (u x ψ : W → ℝ) (L U X P : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hu : ∀ w, |u w| ≤ U) (hx : ∀ w, |x w| ≤ X) (hψ : ∀ w, |ψ w| ≤ P)
    (hlip : ∀ a b, |ψ a - ψ b| ≤ L * |x a - x b|) :
    (⨆ w, u w + ψ w) + (⨆ w, u w - ψ w) ≤
      (⨆ w, u w + L * x w) + (⨆ w, u w - L * x w) := by
  have hb (s t : W → ℝ) (S T : ℝ) (hs : ∀ w, |s w| ≤ S) (ht : ∀ w, |t w| ≤ T) :
      BddAbove (Set.range fun w => s w + t w) := by
    apply bddAbove_range_of_abs_le
    intro w
    exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (hs w) (ht w))
  have hLx : ∀ w, |L * x w| ≤ L * X := by
    intro w
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hL]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hx w) hL
  apply ciSup_pair_le
      (fun w => (le_abs_self _).trans ((abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (hu w) (hψ w))))
      (fun w => (le_abs_self _).trans ((abs_add_le _ _).trans
        (add_le_add (hu w) (by simpa using hψ w))))
      (fun w => (le_abs_self _).trans ((abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (hu w) (hLx w))))
      (fun w => (le_abs_self _).trans ((abs_add_le _ _).trans
        (add_le_add (hu w) (by simpa using hLx w))))
  intro a b
  dsimp only
  have hab : ψ a - ψ b ≤ L * |x a - x b| :=
    (le_abs_self _).trans (hlip a b)
  rcases le_total (x b) (x a) with hxba | hxab
  · rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hxba)] at hab
    exact (show u a + ψ a + (u b + -ψ b) ≤
        u a + L * x a + (u b + -(L * x b)) by linarith).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  · rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hxab)] at hab
    exact (show u a + ψ a + (u b + -ψ b) ≤
        u a + -(L * x a) + (u b + L * x b) by linarith).trans (le_max_right _ _)

private lemma sum_sign_succ (n : ℕ) (F : (Fin (n + 1) → Bool) → ℝ) :
    (∑ σ, F σ) = ∑ τ : Fin n → Bool, (F (Fin.cons true τ) + F (Fin.cons false τ)) := by
  calc
    (∑ σ, F σ) = ∑ p : Bool × (Fin n → Bool), F (Fin.cons p.1 p.2) := by
      simpa only [Fin.consEquiv_apply] using
        ((Fin.consEquiv (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => Bool)).sum_comp F).symm
    _ = ∑ b : Bool, ∑ τ : Fin n → Bool, F (Fin.cons b τ) := by
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    _ = ∑ τ : Fin n → Bool, ∑ b : Bool, F (Fin.cons b τ) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    _ = _ := by simp only [Fintype.sum_bool]

private lemma rademacher_contraction_sum_aux {W : Type*} [Nonempty W]
    (n : ℕ) (u : W → ℝ) (x ψ : W → Fin n → ℝ) (L U X P : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hu : ∀ w, |u w| ≤ U)
    (hx : ∀ w i, |x w i| ≤ X) (hψ : ∀ w i, |ψ w i| ≤ P)
    (hlip : ∀ i a b, |ψ a i - ψ b i| ≤ L * |x a i - x b i|) :
    (∑ σ : Fin n → Bool, ⨆ w : W,
      u w + ∑ i, (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * ψ w i) ≤
    ∑ σ : Fin n → Bool, ⨆ w : W,
      u w + ∑ i, (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * (L * x w i) := by
  induction n generalizing u U with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [sum_sign_succ, sum_sign_succ]
      have htail (τ : Fin n → Bool) : ∀ w,
          |u w + ∑ i : Fin n, (if τ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * ψ w i.succ| ≤
            U + n * P := by
        intro w
        calc
          |u w + ∑ i : Fin n, (if τ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * ψ w i.succ| ≤
              |u w| + |∑ i : Fin n, (if τ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * ψ w i.succ| :=
                abs_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ U + ∑ i : Fin n,
              |(if τ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * ψ w i.succ| := by
                exact add_le_add (hu w) (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _)
          _ ≤ U + ∑ _i : Fin n, P := by
                gcongr with i hi
                simpa only [abs_mul, abs_ite, abs_one, abs_neg, ite_self, one_mul] using
                  hψ w i.succ
          _ = U + n * P := by simp [mul_comm]
      have hpoint (τ : Fin n → Bool) :
          (⨆ w : W, u w + ∑ i,
              (if (Fin.cons true τ : Fin (n + 1) → Bool) i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * ψ w i) +
            (⨆ w : W, u w + ∑ i,
              (if (Fin.cons false τ : Fin (n + 1) → Bool) i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * ψ w i) ≤
          (⨆ w : W, (u w + L * x w 0) + ∑ i : Fin n,
              (if τ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * ψ w i.succ) +
            (⨆ w : W, (u w - L * x w 0) + ∑ i : Fin n,
              (if τ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * ψ w i.succ) := by
        simp [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
        let v : W → ℝ := fun w =>
          u w + ∑ i : Fin n, (if τ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * ψ w i.succ
        have hc := contraction_one v (fun w => x w 0) (fun w => ψ w 0) L
          (U + n * P) X P hL (htail τ) (fun w => hx w 0) (fun w => hψ w 0) (hlip 0)
        simpa [v, sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm] using hc
      calc
        (∑ τ : Fin n → Bool,
            ((⨆ w : W, u w + ∑ i,
                (if (Fin.cons true τ : Fin (n + 1) → Bool) i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * ψ w i) +
              (⨆ w : W, u w + ∑ i,
                (if (Fin.cons false τ : Fin (n + 1) → Bool) i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * ψ w i)))
            ≤ ∑ τ : Fin n → Bool,
              ((⨆ w : W, (u w + L * x w 0) + ∑ i,
                  (if τ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * ψ w i.succ) +
                (⨆ w : W, (u w - L * x w 0) + ∑ i,
                  (if τ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * ψ w i.succ)) := by
              exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun τ _ => hpoint τ
        _ = (∑ τ : Fin n → Bool, ⨆ w : W,
                (u w + L * x w 0) + ∑ i,
                  (if τ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * ψ w i.succ) +
              (∑ τ : Fin n → Bool, ⨆ w : W,
                (u w - L * x w 0) + ∑ i,
                  (if τ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * ψ w i.succ) := by
              rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        _ ≤ (∑ τ : Fin n → Bool, ⨆ w : W,
                (u w + L * x w 0) + ∑ i,
                  (if τ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * (L * x w i.succ)) +
              (∑ τ : Fin n → Bool, ⨆ w : W,
                (u w - L * x w 0) + ∑ i,
                  (if τ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * (L * x w i.succ)) := by
              apply add_le_add
              · exact ih (fun w => u w + L * x w 0)
                  (fun w i => x w i.succ) (fun w i => ψ w i.succ)
                  (U + L * X)
                  (fun w => (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (hu w) (by
                    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hL]
                    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hx w 0) hL)))
                  (fun w i => hx w i.succ) (fun w i => hψ w i.succ)
                  (fun i a b => hlip i.succ a b)
              · exact ih (fun w => u w - L * x w 0)
                  (fun w i => x w i.succ) (fun w i => ψ w i.succ)
                  (U + L * X)
                  (fun w => (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (hu w) (by
                    simpa only [abs_neg, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hL] using
                      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hx w 0) hL)))
                  (fun w i => hx w i.succ) (fun w i => hψ w i.succ)
                  (fun i a b => hlip i.succ a b)
        _ = ∑ τ : Fin n → Bool,
              ((⨆ w : W, u w + ∑ i,
                  (if (Fin.cons true τ : Fin (n + 1) → Bool) i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * (L * x w i)) +
                (⨆ w : W, u w + ∑ i,
                  (if (Fin.cons false τ : Fin (n + 1) → Bool) i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * (L * x w i))) := by
              rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
              simp [Fin.sum_univ_succ, sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc]

private lemma rademacher_contraction_sum {W : Type*} [Nonempty W]
    (n : ℕ) (x ψ : W → Fin n → ℝ) (L X P : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hx : ∀ w i, |x w i| ≤ X) (hψ : ∀ w i, |ψ w i| ≤ P)
    (hlip : ∀ i a b, |ψ a i - ψ b i| ≤ L * |x a i - x b i|) :
    (∑ σ : Fin n → Bool, ⨆ w : W,
      ∑ i, (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * ψ w i) ≤
    ∑ σ : Fin n → Bool, ⨆ w : W,
      ∑ i, (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * (L * x w i) := by
  simpa only [zero_add] using
    rademacher_contraction_sum_aux n (fun _ : W => 0) x ψ L 0 X P hL
      (fun _ => abs_zero.le) hx hψ hlip

theorem rademacher_square_contraction {W : Type*} [Nonempty W]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (x : W → Fin n → ℝ) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hx : ∀ w i, |x w i| ≤ M) :
    (1 / (2 ^ n : ℝ)) * ∑ σ : Fin n → Bool, (⨆ w : W,
      (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i,
        (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * (-(x w i) ^ 2)) ≤
    (2 * M) * ((1 / (2 ^ n : ℝ)) * ∑ σ : Fin n → Bool, (⨆ w : W,
      (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * x w i)) := by
  let q : ℝ := 1 / (n : ℝ)
  have hq : 0 ≤ q := by positivity
  have hc := rademacher_contraction_sum n
    (fun w i => q * x w i) (fun w i => q * (-(x w i) ^ 2))
    (2 * M) (q * M) (q * M ^ 2) (by positivity)
    (fun w i => by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hq]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hx w i) hq)
    (fun w i => by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hq, abs_neg, abs_pow]
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hq
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (hx w i) 2)
    (fun i a b => by
      rw [← mul_sub, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hq, mul_assoc]
      have hs : |-x a i ^ 2 - -x b i ^ 2| ≤ (2 * M) * |x a i - x b i| := by
        rw [neg_sub_neg, abs_sub_comm, sq_sub_sq, abs_mul]
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        · exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (by linarith [hx a i, hx b i])
        · exact abs_nonneg _
      calc
        q * |-x a i ^ 2 - -x b i ^ 2| ≤ q * ((2 * M) * |x a i - x b i|) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs hq
        _ = 2 * (M * |q * x a i - q * x b i|) := by
          rw [← mul_sub, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hq]
          ring)
  have hb (σ : Fin n → Bool) : BddAbove (Set.range fun w : W =>
      q * ∑ i, (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * x w i) := by
    refine ⟨M, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans (by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hq]
      calc
        q * |∑ i, (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * x w i| ≤
            q * ∑ i, |(if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * x w i| := by
          gcongr
          exact Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
        _ ≤ q * ∑ _i : Fin n, M := by
          gcongr with i hi
          simpa only [abs_mul, abs_ite, abs_one, abs_neg, ite_self, one_mul] using hx w i
        _ = M := by
          dsimp [q]
          rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
          field_simp)
  calc
    (1 / (2 ^ n : ℝ)) * ∑ σ : Fin n → Bool, (⨆ w : W,
        (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i,
          (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * (-(x w i) ^ 2)) =
      (1 / (2 ^ n : ℝ)) * ∑ σ : Fin n → Bool, (⨆ w : W,
        ∑ i, (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * (q * (-(x w i) ^ 2))) := by
      congr 2
      funext σ
      congr 1
      funext w
      dsimp [q]
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      congr 1
      funext i
      ring
    _ ≤ (1 / (2 ^ n : ℝ)) * ∑ σ : Fin n → Bool, (⨆ w : W,
        ∑ i, (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * ((2 * M) * (q * x w i))) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc (by positivity)
    _ ≤ (1 / (2 ^ n : ℝ)) * ∑ σ : Fin n → Bool,
        (2 * M) * (⨆ w : W, q * ∑ i,
          (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * x w i) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      · apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro σ _
        apply ciSup_le
        intro w
        calc
          (∑ i, (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * ((2 * M) * (q * x w i))) =
              (2 * M) * (q * ∑ i, (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * x w i) := by
            rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro i _
            ring
          _ ≤ (2 * M) * (⨆ w : W, q * ∑ i,
              (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * x w i) := by
            gcongr
            exact le_ciSup (hb σ) w
      · positivity
    _ = (2 * M) * ((1 / (2 ^ n : ℝ)) * ∑ σ : Fin n → Bool, (⨆ w : W,
        (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * x w i)) := by
      dsimp [q]
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      ring



private lemma integral_empirical_eq {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z]
    (D : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure D] (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (g : Z → ℝ) (hg : Integrable g D) :
    ∫ S : Fin n → Z, (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, g (S i)
      ∂(Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)) = ∫ z, g z ∂D := by
  rw [integral_const_mul]
  rw [integral_finset_sum]
  · simp_rw [integral_comp_eval (μ := fun _ : Fin n => D) hg.aestronglyMeasurable]
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
  · intro i _
    exact integrable_comp_eval (μ := fun _ : Fin n => D) hg

theorem integrable_ciSup_of_abs_le {A W : Type*} [MeasurableSpace A]
    [Countable W] [Nonempty W] (μ : Measure A) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (f : W → A → ℝ) (C : ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ w, AEMeasurable (f w) μ) (hC : ∀ w a, |f w a| ≤ C) :
    Integrable (fun a => ⨆ w, f w a) μ := by
  have hmeas : AEMeasurable (fun a => ⨆ w, f w a) μ :=
    AEMeasurable.iSup hf
  apply Integrable.of_bound hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable C
  filter_upwards [] with a
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]
  constructor
  · let w : W := Classical.choice inferInstance
    have hb : BddAbove (Set.range fun w => f w a) :=
      ⟨C, by rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩; exact (le_abs_self _).trans (hC w a)⟩
    exact (neg_le_of_abs_le (hC w a)).trans (le_ciSup hb w)
  · exact ciSup_le fun w => (le_abs_self _).trans (hC w a)

theorem aemeasurable_empirical {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z]
    (D : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure D] (n : ℕ) (g : Z → ℝ)
    (hg : AEStronglyMeasurable g D) :
    AEMeasurable (fun S : Fin n → Z =>
      (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, g (S i)) (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)) := by
  apply AEMeasurable.const_mul
  have h := Finset.aemeasurable_sum (μ := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)) Finset.univ
    (fun i _ => hg.aemeasurable.comp_quasiMeasurePreserving
      (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin n => D) i).quasiMeasurePreserving)
  convert h using 1
  funext S
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Function.comp_apply]

private lemma aemeasurable_signed_empirical {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z]
    (D : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure D] (n : ℕ) (g : Z → ℝ)
    (hg : AEStronglyMeasurable g D) (σ : Fin n → Bool) :
    AEMeasurable (fun S : Fin n → Z =>
      (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * g (S i))
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)) := by
  apply AEMeasurable.const_mul
  have h := Finset.aemeasurable_sum (μ := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)) Finset.univ
    (fun i _ => AEMeasurable.const_mul
      (hg.aemeasurable.comp_quasiMeasurePreserving
        (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin n => D) i).quasiMeasurePreserving)
      (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1))
  convert h using 1
  funext S
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Function.comp_apply]

theorem abs_empirical_le {Z : Type*} (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (g : Z → ℝ) (C : ℝ) (hg : ∀ z, |g z| ≤ C) (S : Fin n → Z) :
    |(1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, g (S i)| ≤ C := by
  rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ (1 / (n : ℝ)))]
  calc
    (1 / (n : ℝ)) * |∑ i, g (S i)| ≤
        (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, |g (S i)| := by
      gcongr
      exact Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ _i : Fin n, C := by
      gcongr with i hi
      exact hg (S i)
    _ = C := by
      rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
      field_simp

private lemma symmetrization_ghost {Z W : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z]
    [Countable W] [Nonempty W]
    (D : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure D] (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (g : W → Z → ℝ) (C : ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ w, Integrable (g w) D) (hC : ∀ w z, |g w z| ≤ C) :
    (∫ S : Fin n → Z, (⨆ w : W,
        ((∫ z, g w z ∂D) - (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, g w (S i)))
      ∂(Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D))) ≤
    ∫ ST : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z), (⨆ w : W,
        ((1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, g w (ST.2 i) -
          (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, g w (ST.1 i)))
      ∂((Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)).prod
        (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D))) := by
  let μn : Measure (Fin n → Z) := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)
  let E : W → (Fin n → Z) → ℝ := fun w S =>
    (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, g w (S i)
  let m : W → ℝ := fun w => ∫ z, g w z ∂D
  let dev : (Fin n → Z) → ℝ := fun S => ⨆ w : W, m w - E w S
  let pairDev : ((Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z)) → ℝ := fun ST =>
    ⨆ w : W, E w ST.2 - E w ST.1
  have hm (w : W) : |m w| ≤ C := by
    simpa only [m, Real.norm_eq_abs, probReal_univ, mul_one] using
      (norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (μ := D)
        (f := g w) (C := C)
        (ae_of_all D fun z => by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hC w z))
  have hEmeas (w : W) : AEMeasurable (E w) μn := by
    exact aemeasurable_empirical D n (g w) (hg w).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hE (w : W) (S : Fin n → Z) : |E w S| ≤ C :=
    abs_empirical_le n hn (g w) C (hC w) S
  have hdevInt : Integrable dev μn := by
    apply integrable_ciSup_of_abs_le μn (fun w S => m w - E w S) (2 * C)
    · intro w
      exact AEMeasurable.const_sub (hEmeas w) (m w)
    · intro w S
      exact (abs_sub _ _).trans (by linarith [hm w, hE w S])
  have hpairMeas (w : W) :
      AEMeasurable (fun ST : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z) => E w ST.2 - E w ST.1)
        (μn.prod μn) := by
    exact (hEmeas w).comp_quasiMeasurePreserving
      (measurePreserving_snd (μ := μn) (ν := μn)).quasiMeasurePreserving |>.sub <|
      (hEmeas w).comp_quasiMeasurePreserving
        (measurePreserving_fst (μ := μn) (ν := μn)).quasiMeasurePreserving
  have hpairInt : Integrable pairDev (μn.prod μn) := by
    apply integrable_ciSup_of_abs_le (μn.prod μn)
      (fun w ST => E w ST.2 - E w ST.1) (2 * C) hpairMeas
    intro w ST
    exact (abs_sub _ _).trans (by linarith [hE w ST.2, hE w ST.1])
  have hinnerInt (S : Fin n → Z) :
      Integrable (fun T => pairDev (S, T)) μn := by
    apply integrable_ciSup_of_abs_le μn (fun w T => E w T - E w S) (2 * C)
    · intro w
      exact (hEmeas w).sub aemeasurable_const
    · intro w T
      exact (abs_sub _ _).trans (by linarith [hE w T, hE w S])
  have hpoint (S : Fin n → Z) : dev S ≤ ∫ T, pairDev (S, T) ∂μn := by
    apply ciSup_le
    intro w
    calc
      m w - E w S = ∫ T, E w T - E w S ∂μn := by
        rw [integral_sub]
        · rw [show (∫ T, E w T ∂μn) = m w by
                exact integral_empirical_eq D n hn (g w) (hg w)]
          simp [μn]
        · exact Integrable.of_bound
            (aemeasurable_empirical D n (g w) (hg w).aestronglyMeasurable).aestronglyMeasurable C
            (ae_of_all μn fun T => by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hE w T)
        · exact integrable_const _
      _ ≤ ∫ T, pairDev (S, T) ∂μn := by
        apply integral_mono
        · exact Integrable.of_bound ((hEmeas w).sub aemeasurable_const).aestronglyMeasurable
            (2 * C) (ae_of_all μn fun T => by
              rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
              exact (abs_sub _ _).trans (by linarith [hE w T, hE w S]))
        · exact hinnerInt S
        · intro T
          apply le_ciSup (c := w)
          exact ⟨2 * C, by
            rintro _ ⟨v, rfl⟩
            exact (le_abs_self _).trans
              ((abs_sub _ _).trans (by linarith [hE v T, hE v S]))⟩
  change (∫ S, dev S ∂μn) ≤ ∫ ST, pairDev ST ∂(μn.prod μn)
  rw [integral_prod pairDev hpairInt]
  exact integral_mono hdevInt hpairInt.integral_prod_left hpoint

theorem signed_empirical_abs_le {Z : Type*} (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (g : Z → ℝ) (C : ℝ) (hg : ∀ z, |g z| ≤ C)
    (σ : Fin n → Bool) (S : Fin n → Z) :
    |(1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i,
      (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * g (S i)| ≤ C := by
  rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ (1 / (n : ℝ)))]
  calc
    (1 / (n : ℝ)) * |∑ i, (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * g (S i)| ≤
        (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, |(if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * g (S i)| := by
      gcongr
      exact Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ _i : Fin n, C := by
      gcongr with i hi
      simpa only [abs_mul, abs_ite, abs_one, abs_neg, ite_self, one_mul] using hg (S i)
    _ = C := by
      rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
      field_simp

theorem integrable_rademacher {Z W : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z]
    [Countable W] [Nonempty W]
    (D : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure D] (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (g : W → Z → ℝ) (C : ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ w, AEStronglyMeasurable (g w) D) (hC : ∀ w z, |g w z| ≤ C) :
    Integrable (fun S : Fin n → Z =>
      (1 / (2 ^ n : ℝ)) * ∑ σ : Fin n → Bool, (⨆ w : W,
        (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * g w (S i)))
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)) := by
  have hi (σ : Fin n → Bool) : Integrable (fun S : Fin n → Z => ⨆ w : W,
      (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * g w (S i))
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)) := by
    apply integrable_ciSup_of_abs_le (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D))
      (fun w S => (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i,
        (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * g w (S i)) C
    · intro w
      exact aemeasurable_signed_empirical D n (g w) (hg w) σ
    · intro w S
      exact signed_empirical_abs_le n hn (g w) C (hC w) σ S
  apply Integrable.const_mul
  exact integrable_finset_sum Finset.univ fun σ _ => hi σ

private lemma randomized_diff_le {Z W : Type*} [Countable W] [Nonempty W]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (g : W → Z → ℝ) (C : ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ w z, |g w z| ≤ C) (S T : Fin n → Z) :
    (1 / (2 ^ n : ℝ)) * ∑ σ : Fin n → Bool, (⨆ w : W,
      (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i,
        (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * (g w (T i) - g w (S i))) ≤
    (1 / (2 ^ n : ℝ)) * ∑ σ : Fin n → Bool, (⨆ w : W,
      (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * g w (T i)) +
    (1 / (2 ^ n : ℝ)) * ∑ σ : Fin n → Bool, (⨆ w : W,
      (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * g w (S i)) := by
  let e : (Fin n → Bool) ≃ (Fin n → Bool) :=
    Equiv.piCongrRight (fun _ : Fin n => Equiv.boolNot)
  have hsign (σ : Fin n → Bool) (i : Fin n) :
      (if σ i then -(1 : ℝ) else 1) =
        (if e σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) := by
    cases h : σ i <;> simp [e, Equiv.piCongrRight_apply, h]
  have hterm (σ : Fin n → Bool) :
      (⨆ w : W, (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i,
          (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * (g w (T i) - g w (S i))) ≤
      (⨆ w : W, (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i,
          (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * g w (T i)) +
      (⨆ w : W, (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i,
          (if e σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * g w (S i)) := by
    apply ciSup_le
    intro w
    have hbT : BddAbove (Set.range fun v : W =>
        (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * g v (T i)) := by
      refine ⟨C, ?_⟩
      rintro _ ⟨v, rfl⟩
      exact (le_abs_self _).trans (signed_empirical_abs_le n hn (g v) C (hC v) σ T)
    have hbS : BddAbove (Set.range fun v : W =>
        (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, (if e σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * g v (S i)) := by
      refine ⟨C, ?_⟩
      rintro _ ⟨v, rfl⟩
      exact (le_abs_self _).trans (signed_empirical_abs_le n hn (g v) C (hC v) (e σ) S)
    calc
      (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i,
          (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * (g w (T i) - g w (S i)) =
        (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i,
          (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * g w (T i) +
        (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i,
          (if e σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * g w (S i) := by
            rw [← mul_add, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
            congr 2
            funext i
            rw [← hsign σ i]
            by_cases h : σ i <;> simp [h] <;> ring
      _ ≤ _ := add_le_add (le_ciSup hbT w) (le_ciSup hbS w)
  calc
    (1 / (2 ^ n : ℝ)) * ∑ σ : Fin n → Bool, (⨆ w : W,
        (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i,
          (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * (g w (T i) - g w (S i))) ≤
      (1 / (2 ^ n : ℝ)) * ∑ σ : Fin n → Bool,
        ((⨆ w : W, (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i,
            (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * g w (T i)) +
          (⨆ w : W, (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i,
            (if e σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * g w (S i))) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        · exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun σ _ => hterm σ
        · positivity
    _ = (1 / (2 ^ n : ℝ)) * ∑ σ : Fin n → Bool, (⨆ w : W,
          (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * g w (T i)) +
        (1 / (2 ^ n : ℝ)) * ∑ σ : Fin n → Bool, (⨆ w : W,
          (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * g w (S i)) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_add]
      have heq :
          (∑ σ : Fin n → Bool, (⨆ w : W,
            (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, (if e σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * g w (S i))) =
          ∑ σ : Fin n → Bool, (⨆ w : W,
            (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * g w (S i)) := by
        let F : (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ := fun σ => ⨆ w : W,
          (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * g w (S i)
        simpa only [F] using e.sum_comp F
      rw [heq]

private def coordinateSwap {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] {n : ℕ}
    (σ : Fin n → Bool) : (Fin n → Z × Z) ≃ᵐ (Fin n → Z × Z) :=
  MeasurableEquiv.piCongrRight (fun i =>
    if σ i then MeasurableEquiv.refl (Z × Z) else MeasurableEquiv.prodComm)

private lemma coordinateSwap_apply {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] {n : ℕ}
    (σ : Fin n → Bool) (p : Fin n → Z × Z) (i : Fin n) :
    coordinateSwap σ p i = if σ i then p i else (p i).swap := by
  change (Equiv.piCongrRight (fun i =>
    (if σ i then MeasurableEquiv.refl (Z × Z) else MeasurableEquiv.prodComm).toEquiv) p) i = _
  rw [Equiv.piCongrRight_apply]
  by_cases h : σ i = true
  · simp [Pi.map_apply, h]
  · simp only [Pi.map_apply, h, if_false]
    change Prod.swap (p i) = (p i).swap
    rfl

private lemma coordinateSwap_measurePreserving {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z]
    (D : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure D] {n : ℕ} (σ : Fin n → Bool) :
    MeasurePreserving (coordinateSwap σ)
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D.prod D))
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D.prod D)) := by
  have h : MeasurePreserving (fun p : Fin n → Z × Z => fun i =>
      if σ i then p i else (p i).swap)
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D.prod D))
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D.prod D)) :=
    measurePreserving_pi (fun _ : Fin n => D.prod D)
      (fun _ : Fin n => D.prod D)
      (f := fun i p => if σ i then p else p.swap) (fun i => by
        by_cases hi : σ i = true
        · simpa [hi] using (MeasurePreserving.id (D.prod D))
        · simpa [hi] using (Measure.measurePreserving_swap (μ := D) (ν := D)))
  convert h using 1
  funext p i
  exact coordinateSwap_apply σ p i

private lemma randomization_integral {Z W : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z]
    [Countable W] [Nonempty W]
    (D : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure D] (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (g : W → Z → ℝ) (C : ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ w, Integrable (g w) D) (hC : ∀ w z, |g w z| ≤ C) :
    (∫ p : Fin n → Z × Z, (⨆ w : W,
        (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, (g w (p i).2 - g w (p i).1))
      ∂(Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D.prod D))) =
    ∫ p : Fin n → Z × Z,
      (1 / (2 ^ n : ℝ)) * ∑ σ : Fin n → Bool, (⨆ w : W,
        (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i,
          (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * (g w (p i).2 - g w (p i).1))
      ∂(Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D.prod D)) := by
  let ν : Measure (Fin n → Z × Z) := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D.prod D)
  let base : (Fin n → Z × Z) → ℝ := fun p => ⨆ w : W,
    (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, (g w (p i).2 - g w (p i).1)
  let signed : (Fin n → Bool) → (Fin n → Z × Z) → ℝ := fun σ p => ⨆ w : W,
    (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i,
      (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * (g w (p i).2 - g w (p i).1)
  have hpairAES (w : W) : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun z : Z × Z => g w z.2 - g w z.1) (D.prod D) :=
    (hg w).aestronglyMeasurable.comp_quasiMeasurePreserving
      (measurePreserving_snd (μ := D) (ν := D)).quasiMeasurePreserving |>.sub <|
    (hg w).aestronglyMeasurable.comp_quasiMeasurePreserving
      (measurePreserving_fst (μ := D) (ν := D)).quasiMeasurePreserving
  have hpairBound (w : W) (z : Z × Z) : |g w z.2 - g w z.1| ≤ 2 * C :=
    (abs_sub _ _).trans (by linarith [hC w z.2, hC w z.1])
  have hbaseInt : Integrable base ν := by
    apply integrable_ciSup_of_abs_le ν (fun w p =>
      (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, (g w (p i).2 - g w (p i).1)) (2 * C)
    · intro w
      exact aemeasurable_empirical (D.prod D) n
        (fun z : Z × Z => g w z.2 - g w z.1) (hpairAES w)
    · intro w p
      exact abs_empirical_le n hn (fun z : Z × Z => g w z.2 - g w z.1)
        (2 * C) (hpairBound w) p
  have hswap (σ : Fin n → Bool) (p : Fin n → Z × Z) :
      base (coordinateSwap σ p) = signed σ p := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply ciSup_mono
      · refine ⟨2 * C, ?_⟩
        rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
        exact (le_abs_self _).trans
          (signed_empirical_abs_le n hn
            (fun z : Z × Z => g w z.2 - g w z.1) (2 * C) (hpairBound w) σ p)
      · intro w
        apply le_of_eq
        congr 2
        funext i
        rw [coordinateSwap_apply]
        by_cases hi : σ i = true <;> simp [hi] <;> ring
    · apply ciSup_mono
      · refine ⟨2 * C, ?_⟩
        rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
        exact (le_abs_self _).trans
          (abs_empirical_le n hn
            (fun z : Z × Z => g w z.2 - g w z.1) (2 * C) (hpairBound w)
            (coordinateSwap σ p))
      · intro w
        apply ge_of_eq
        congr 2
        funext i
        rw [coordinateSwap_apply]
        by_cases hi : σ i = true <;> simp [hi] <;> ring
  have hsignedInt (σ : Fin n → Bool) : Integrable (signed σ) ν := by
    have hc : Integrable (base ∘ coordinateSwap σ) ν :=
      ((coordinateSwap_measurePreserving D σ).integrable_comp_emb
        (coordinateSwap σ).measurableEmbedding).2 hbaseInt
    exact hc.congr (ae_of_all ν fun p => hswap σ p)
  have hint (σ : Fin n → Bool) : (∫ p, base p ∂ν) = ∫ p, signed σ p ∂ν := by
    calc
      (∫ p, base p ∂ν) = ∫ p, base (coordinateSwap σ p) ∂ν :=
        ((coordinateSwap_measurePreserving D σ).integral_comp' base).symm
      _ = ∫ p, signed σ p ∂ν := integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all ν fun p => hswap σ p)
  change (∫ p, base p ∂ν) = ∫ p, (1 / (2 ^ n : ℝ)) * ∑ σ, signed σ p ∂ν
  calc
    (∫ p, base p ∂ν) =
        (1 / (2 ^ n : ℝ)) * ∑ _σ : Fin n → Bool, (∫ p, base p ∂ν) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_bool,
        Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
      norm_num [Nat.cast_pow]
    _ = (1 / (2 ^ n : ℝ)) * ∑ σ : Fin n → Bool, (∫ p, signed σ p ∂ν) := by
      congr 1
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => hint σ
    _ = ∫ p, (1 / (2 ^ n : ℝ)) * ∑ σ : Fin n → Bool, signed σ p ∂ν := by
      rw [integral_const_mul, integral_finset_sum]
      intro σ _
      exact hsignedInt σ

theorem symmetrization {Z W : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z]
    [Countable W] [Nonempty W]
    (D : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure D] (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (g : W → Z → ℝ) (C : ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ w, Integrable (g w) D) (hC : ∀ w z, |g w z| ≤ C) :
    (∫ S : Fin n → Z, (⨆ w : W,
        ((∫ z, g w z ∂D) - (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, g w (S i)))
      ∂(Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D))) ≤
    2 * ∫ S : Fin n → Z,
      (1 / (2 ^ n : ℝ)) * ∑ σ : Fin n → Bool, (⨆ w : W,
        (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * g w (S i))
      ∂(Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)) := by
  let μn : Measure (Fin n → Z) := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)
  let ν : Measure (Fin n → Z × Z) := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D.prod D)
  let rad : (Fin n → Z) → ℝ := fun S =>
    (1 / (2 ^ n : ℝ)) * ∑ σ : Fin n → Bool, (⨆ w : W,
      (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * g w (S i))
  let pairBase : (Fin n → Z × Z) → ℝ := fun p => ⨆ w : W,
    (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, (g w (p i).2 - g w (p i).1)
  let pairRand : (Fin n → Z × Z) → ℝ := fun p =>
    (1 / (2 ^ n : ℝ)) * ∑ σ : Fin n → Bool, (⨆ w : W,
      (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i,
        (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * (g w (p i).2 - g w (p i).1))
  have hghost := symmetrization_ghost D n hn g C hg hC
  have hpairAES (w : W) : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun z : Z × Z => g w z.2 - g w z.1) (D.prod D) :=
    (hg w).aestronglyMeasurable.comp_quasiMeasurePreserving
      (measurePreserving_snd (μ := D) (ν := D)).quasiMeasurePreserving |>.sub <|
    (hg w).aestronglyMeasurable.comp_quasiMeasurePreserving
      (measurePreserving_fst (μ := D) (ν := D)).quasiMeasurePreserving
  have hpairBound (w : W) (z : Z × Z) : |g w z.2 - g w z.1| ≤ 2 * C :=
    (abs_sub _ _).trans (by linarith [hC w z.2, hC w z.1])
  have hpairRandInt : Integrable pairRand ν := by
    exact integrable_rademacher (D.prod D) n hn
      (fun (w : W) (z : Z × Z) => g w z.2 - g w z.1) (2 * C) hpairAES hpairBound
  have hradInt : Integrable rad μn := by
    exact integrable_rademacher D n hn g C (fun w => (hg w).aestronglyMeasurable) hC
  have hfstMP : MeasurePreserving (fun p : Fin n → Z × Z => fun i => (p i).1) ν μn := by
    exact measurePreserving_pi (fun _ : Fin n => D.prod D) (fun _ : Fin n => D)
      (fun _ => measurePreserving_fst)
  have hsndMP : MeasurePreserving (fun p : Fin n → Z × Z => fun i => (p i).2) ν μn := by
    exact measurePreserving_pi (fun _ : Fin n => D.prod D) (fun _ : Fin n => D)
      (fun _ => measurePreserving_snd)
  have hradPairInt : Integrable
      (fun p : Fin n → Z × Z => rad (fun i => (p i).2) + rad (fun i => (p i).1)) ν :=
    ((hsndMP.integrable_comp hradInt.aestronglyMeasurable).2 hradInt).add
      ((hfstMP.integrable_comp hradInt.aestronglyMeasurable).2 hradInt)
  have hpairLe : (∫ p, pairRand p ∂ν) ≤
      ∫ p, rad (fun i => (p i).2) + rad (fun i => (p i).1) ∂ν := by
    apply integral_mono hpairRandInt hradPairInt
    intro p
    exact randomized_diff_le n hn g C hC (fun i => (p i).1) (fun i => (p i).2)
  have hprodPair :
      (∫ ST : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z), (⨆ w : W,
          ((1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, g w (ST.2 i) -
            (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, g w (ST.1 i))) ∂(μn.prod μn)) =
      ∫ p, pairBase p ∂ν := by
    let e := MeasurableEquiv.arrowProdEquivProdArrow Z Z (Fin n)
    have he := measurePreserving_arrowProdEquivProdArrow Z Z (Fin n)
      (fun _ : Fin n => D) (fun _ : Fin n => D)
    have hi := he.integral_comp' (fun ST : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z) =>
      ⨆ w : W, (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, g w (ST.2 i) -
        (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, g w (ST.1 i))
    symm
    convert hi using 1
    · congr 1
      funext p
      dsimp [pairBase]
      congr 1
      funext w
      change (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, (g w (p i).2 - g w (p i).1) =
        (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, g w (p i).2 -
          (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, g w (p i).1
      rw [← mul_sub]
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  have hpairRandom : (∫ p, pairBase p ∂ν) = ∫ p, pairRand p ∂ν :=
    randomization_integral D n hn g C hg hC
  have hradPairIntegral :
      (∫ p, rad (fun i => (p i).2) + rad (fun i => (p i).1) ∂ν) =
        2 * ∫ S, rad S ∂μn := by
    let e := MeasurableEquiv.arrowProdEquivProdArrow Z Z (Fin n)
    have he := measurePreserving_arrowProdEquivProdArrow Z Z (Fin n)
      (fun _ : Fin n => D) (fun _ : Fin n => D)
    calc
      (∫ p, rad (fun i => (p i).2) + rad (fun i => (p i).1) ∂ν) =
          ∫ ST : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z), rad ST.2 + rad ST.1 ∂(μn.prod μn) := by
        have hi := he.integral_comp' (fun ST : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z) =>
          rad ST.2 + rad ST.1)
        convert hi using 1
      _ = ∫ S : Fin n → Z, ∫ T : Fin n → Z, rad T + rad S ∂μn ∂μn := by
        rw [integral_prod]
        exact ((measurePreserving_snd.integrable_comp hradInt.aestronglyMeasurable).2 hradInt).add
          ((measurePreserving_fst.integrable_comp hradInt.aestronglyMeasurable).2 hradInt)
      _ = 2 * ∫ S, rad S ∂μn := by
        simp_rw [integral_add hradInt (integrable_const _), integral_const, probReal_univ,
          one_smul]
        rw [integral_add (integrable_const _) hradInt, integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul]
        ring
  change (∫ S, (⨆ w : W,
      ((∫ z, g w z ∂D) - (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, g w (S i))) ∂μn) ≤
    2 * ∫ S, rad S ∂μn
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ ST : (Fin n → Z) × (Fin n → Z), (⨆ w : W,
        ((1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, g w (ST.2 i) -
          (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, g w (ST.1 i))) ∂(μn.prod μn) := hghost
    _ = ∫ p, pairBase p ∂ν := hprodPair
    _ = ∫ p, pairRand p ∂ν := hpairRandom
    _ ≤ ∫ p, rad (fun i => (p i).2) + rad (fun i => (p i).1) ∂ν := hpairLe
    _ = 2 * ∫ S, rad S ∂μn := hradPairIntegral

namespace Local


noncomputable def empRad {Z W : Type*} (n : ℕ) (phi : W → Z → ℝ)
    (P : Set W) (S : Fin n → Z) : ℝ :=
  (1 / (2 ^ n : ℝ)) * ∑ sigma : Fin n → Bool,
    ⨆ w : P, (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i,
      (if sigma i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * phi w.1 (S i)

private lemma sum_sign_succ (n : ℕ) (F : (Fin (n + 1) → Bool) → ℝ) :
    (∑ sigma, F sigma) = ∑ tau : Fin n → Bool,
      (F (Fin.cons true tau) + F (Fin.cons false tau)) := by
  calc
    (∑ sigma, F sigma) = ∑ p : Bool × (Fin n → Bool), F (Fin.cons p.1 p.2) := by
      simpa only [Fin.consEquiv_apply] using
        ((Fin.consEquiv (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => Bool)).sum_comp F).symm
    _ = ∑ b : Bool, ∑ tau : Fin n → Bool, F (Fin.cons b tau) := by
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    _ = ∑ tau : Fin n → Bool, ∑ b : Bool, F (Fin.cons b tau) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    _ = _ := by simp only [Fintype.sum_bool]

private lemma sum_rademacher_linear_zero (n : ℕ) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    ∑ sigma : Fin n → Bool,
      ∑ i, (if sigma i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * x i = 0 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [sum_sign_succ]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.cons_zero, if_true, one_mul,
        Fin.cons_succ, if_false, neg_one_mul]
      simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, neg_one_mul]
      simp_rw [show ∀ (a t : ℝ), a + t + (-a + t) = 2 * t by intros; ring]
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [ih (fun i => x i.succ)]
      simp

theorem empRad_nonneg {Z W : Type*} (n : ℕ) (phi : W → Z → ℝ)
    (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hbound : ∀ w z, |phi w z| ≤ M)
    (P : Set W) (S : Fin n → Z) : 0 ≤ empRad n phi P S := by
  classical
  by_cases hP : P.Nonempty
  · let w0 : P := ⟨hP.choose, hP.choose_spec⟩
    have hb (sigma : Fin n → Bool) : BddAbove (Set.range fun w : P =>
        (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i,
          (if sigma i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * phi w.1 (S i)) := by
      refine ⟨M, ?_⟩
      rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
      by_cases hn : n = 0
      · subst n
        simpa using hM
      · have hnpos : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn
        calc
          (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i,
              (if sigma i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * phi w.1 (S i) ≤
              |(1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i,
                (if sigma i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * phi w.1 (S i)| := le_abs_self _
          _ ≤ (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i,
                |(if sigma i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * phi w.1 (S i)| := by
              rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ (1 / (n : ℝ)))]
              gcongr
              exact Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
          _ ≤ (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ _i : Fin n, M := by
              gcongr with i hi
              simpa only [abs_mul, abs_ite, abs_one, abs_neg, ite_self, one_mul] using
                hbound w.1 (S i)
          _ = M := by
              rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
              field_simp
    have hterm (sigma : Fin n → Bool) :
        (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i,
            (if sigma i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * phi w0.1 (S i) ≤
          ⨆ w : P, (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i,
            (if sigma i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * phi w.1 (S i) :=
      le_ciSup (hb sigma) w0
    have hsum :
        ∑ sigma : Fin n → Bool,
          (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i,
            (if sigma i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * phi w0.1 (S i) ≤
        ∑ sigma : Fin n → Bool,
          ⨆ w : P, (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i,
            (if sigma i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * phi w.1 (S i) := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun sigma _ => hterm sigma
    rw [empRad]
    apply mul_nonneg (by positivity)
    calc
      0 = ∑ sigma : Fin n → Bool,
          (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i,
            (if sigma i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * phi w0.1 (S i) := by
          calc
            0 = (1 / (n : ℝ)) * 0 := (mul_zero _).symm
            _ = (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ sigma : Fin n → Bool,
                ∑ i, (if sigma i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * phi w0.1 (S i) := by
              rw [sum_rademacher_linear_zero]
            _ = _ := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ ≤ _ := hsum
  · haveI : IsEmpty P := ⟨fun w => hP ⟨w.1, w.2⟩⟩
    simp [empRad, iSup_of_empty', csSup_empty]

theorem empRad_le_bound {Z W : Type*} (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (phi : W → Z → ℝ) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hbound : ∀ w z, |phi w z| ≤ M) (P : Set W) (S : Fin n → Z) :
    empRad n phi P S ≤ M := by
  classical
  by_cases hP : P.Nonempty
  · letI : Nonempty P := hP.to_subtype
    have hsingle (sigma : Fin n → Bool) (w : P) :
        (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i,
            (if sigma i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * phi w.1 (S i) ≤ M := by
      apply (le_abs_self _).trans
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ (1 / (n : ℝ)))]
      calc
        (1 / (n : ℝ)) * |∑ i,
            (if sigma i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * phi w.1 (S i)| ≤
            (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i,
              |(if sigma i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * phi w.1 (S i)| := by
          gcongr
          exact Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
        _ ≤ (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ _i : Fin n, M := by
          gcongr with i hi
          simpa only [abs_mul, abs_ite, abs_one, abs_neg, ite_self, one_mul] using
            hbound w.1 (S i)
        _ = M := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
          field_simp
    rw [empRad]
    calc
      (1 / (2 ^ n : ℝ)) * ∑ sigma : Fin n → Bool,
          (⨆ w : P, (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i,
            (if sigma i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * phi w.1 (S i)) ≤
          (1 / (2 ^ n : ℝ)) * ∑ _sigma : Fin n → Bool, M := by
        gcongr with sigma hsigma
        exact ciSup_le (hsingle sigma)
      _ = M := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fun,
          Fintype.card_bool, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
        norm_num
  · haveI : IsEmpty P := ⟨fun w => hP ⟨w.1, w.2⟩⟩
    simp [empRad, iSup_of_empty', csSup_empty, hM]

theorem r_nonneg_of_rademacher {Z W : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z]
    (D : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure D] (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (phi : W → Z → ℝ) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hbound : ∀ w z, |phi w z| ≤ M) (r : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hrCont : ContinuousOn r (Ici 0))
    (hRad : ∀ b > (0 : ℝ),
      (⨆ S : Fin n → Z,
        empRad n phi {w | (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, (phi w (S i)) ^ 2 ≤ b} S) ≤ r b) :
    ∀ b, 0 ≤ b → 0 ≤ r b := by
  have hpos (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) : 0 ≤ r b := by
    let P : (Fin n → Z) → Set W := fun S =>
      {w | (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, (phi w (S i)) ^ 2 ≤ b}
    have houter : BddAbove (Set.range fun S : Fin n → Z => empRad n phi (P S) S) := by
      refine ⟨M, ?_⟩
      rintro _ ⟨S, rfl⟩
      exact empRad_le_bound n hn phi M hM hbound (P S) S
    have hZ : Nonempty Z := by
      by_contra hZ
      letI : IsEmpty Z := not_nonempty_iff.mp hZ
      have hu : (Set.univ : Set Z) = ∅ := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      have hp : D Set.univ = 1 := measure_univ
      rw [hu, measure_empty] at hp
      exact zero_ne_one hp
    letI : Nonempty Z := hZ
    let S0 : Fin n → Z := Classical.choice inferInstance
    calc
      0 ≤ empRad n phi (P S0) S0 := empRad_nonneg n phi M hM hbound (P S0) S0
      _ ≤ ⨆ S : Fin n → Z, empRad n phi (P S) S := le_ciSup houter S0
      _ ≤ r b := by simpa [P] using hRad b hb
  intro b hb
  rcases hb.eq_or_lt with rfl | hb
  · apply ContinuousWithinAt.closure_le (s := Ioi (0 : ℝ))
        (by rw [closure_Ioi]; exact left_mem_Ici)
        continuousWithinAt_const
        ((hrCont 0 left_mem_Ici).mono Ioi_subset_Ici_self)
    exact fun y hy => hpos y hy
  · exact hpos b hb

theorem concave_nonneg_monotone
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ConcaveOn ℝ (Ici 0) f)
    (hnonneg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ x → 0 ≤ f x) : MonotoneOn f (Ici 0) := by
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  by_contra hnot
  have hyx : f y < f x := lt_of_not_ge hnot
  have hxy' : x < y := lt_of_le_of_ne hxy (fun h => by subst y; exact hyx.false)
  let z : ℝ := y + (f y + 1) * (y - x) / (f x - f y)
  have hden : 0 < f x - f y := sub_pos.mpr hyx
  have hfy : 0 ≤ f y := hnonneg y hy
  have hyz : y < z := by
    dsimp [z]
    have hfyp : 0 < f y + 1 := by linarith
    have hyxp : 0 < y - x := sub_pos.mpr hxy'
    have : 0 < (f y + 1) * (y - x) / (f x - f y) :=
      div_pos (mul_pos hfyp hyxp) hden
    linarith
  have hz : z ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ) := le_trans hy hyz.le
  have hs := hf.slope_anti_adjacent hx hz hxy' hyz
  have hzy : 0 < z - y := sub_pos.mpr hyz
  have hyxd : 0 < y - x := sub_pos.mpr hxy'
  have hs' : (f z - f y) * (y - x) ≤ (f y - f x) * (z - y) := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hzy hyxd] at hs
    exact hs
  have hzform : (f x - f y) * (z - y) = (f y + 1) * (y - x) := by
    dsimp [z]
    field_simp
    <;> ring
  have : f z ≤ -1 := by
    nlinarith
  linarith [hnonneg z hz]

noncomputable def popVal {𝒵 Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒵]
    (D : Measure 𝒵) (φ : Ω → 𝒵 → ℝ) (w : Ω) : ℝ :=
  ∫ z, φ w z ∂D

noncomputable def empMean {𝒵 : Type*} (n : ℕ) (g : 𝒵 → ℝ) (S : Fin n → 𝒵) : ℝ :=
  (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, g (S i)

noncomputable def empRad {𝒵 Ω : Type*} (n : ℕ) (φ : Ω → 𝒵 → ℝ)
    (P : Set Ω) (S : Fin n → 𝒵) : ℝ :=
  (1 / (2 ^ n : ℝ)) * ∑ σ : Fin n → Bool,
    ⨆ w : P, (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * φ w.1 (S i)

noncomputable def unifComplexity {𝒵 Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒵]
    (n : ℕ) (D : Measure 𝒵) (φ : Ω → 𝒵 → ℝ) (P : Set Ω) : ℝ :=
  ∫ S, (⨆ w : P, (popVal D φ w.1 - empMean n (φ w.1) S))
    ∂(Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D))

noncomputable def bZero (c₁ α : ℝ) (r : ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sSup {b : ℝ | 0 < b ∧ b ≤ (4 * c₁ / α) * r b}

theorem localized_bound
    {Z W : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] [Nonempty W] [Countable W]
    (D : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure D]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (phi : W → Z → ℝ) (M c1 alpha : ℝ)
    (hM : 0 < M) (hc1 : 0 < c1) (halpha : 0 < alpha)
    (hInf : ⨅ w, popVal D phi w = 0)
    (hInt : ∀ w, Integrable (phi w) D)
    (hInt2 : ∀ w, Integrable (fun z => (phi w z) ^ 2) D)
    (hBound : ∀ w z, |phi w z| ≤ M)
    (hVar : ∀ w, (∫ z, (phi w z) ^ 2 ∂D) ≤ c1 * ∫ z, phi w z ∂D)
    (r : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hrCont : ContinuousOn r (Ici 0))
    (hrConcave : ConcaveOn ℝ (Ici 0) r)
    (hRad : ∀ b > (0 : ℝ),
      (⨆ S : Fin n → Z,
        empRad n phi {w | empMean n (fun z => (phi w z) ^ 2) S ≤ b} S) ≤ r b)
    (hαM : alpha ≤ (1 / 2) * c1 / M)
    (hbNE : {t : ℝ | 0 < t ∧ t ≤ (4 * c1 / alpha) * r t}.Nonempty)
    (hbBdd : BddAbove {t : ℝ | 0 < t ∧ t ≤ (4 * c1 / alpha) * r t})
    (hUnifInt2 : ∀ r' : ℝ,
      Integrable (fun S : Fin n → Z =>
        ⨆ w ∈ {w | popVal D phi w ≤ r' / alpha},
          empMean n (fun z => (phi w z) ^ 2) S)
        (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)))
    (b : ℝ) (hb : bZero c1 alpha r < b) :
    unifComplexity n D phi {w | popVal D phi w ≤ b / (2 * c1)} ≤ 2 * r b := by
  classical
  let μn : Measure (Fin n → Z) := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => D)
  let P : Set W := {w | popVal D phi w ≤ b / (2 * c1)}
  have hb0_mem_le (t : ℝ)
      (ht : t ∈ {t : ℝ | 0 < t ∧ t ≤ (4 * c1 / alpha) * r t}) :
      t ≤ bZero c1 alpha r := by
    exact le_csSup hbBdd ht
  obtain ⟨t0, ht0pos, ht0⟩ := hbNE
  have hbZeroPos : 0 < bZero c1 alpha r := lt_of_lt_of_le ht0pos (hb0_mem_le t0 ⟨ht0pos, ht0⟩)
  have hbpos : 0 < b := lt_trans hbZeroPos hb
  have hrnonneg : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → 0 ≤ r t := by
    exact Local.r_nonneg_of_rademacher D n hn phi M hM.le hBound r hrCont (by
      intro t ht
      simpa only [Local.empRad, empRad, empMean] using hRad t ht)
  have hrmono : MonotoneOn r (Ici 0) :=
    Local.concave_nonneg_monotone r hrConcave hrnonneg
  have hbr_lt : (4 * c1 / alpha) * r b < b := by
    have hnot : ¬ b ≤ (4 * c1 / alpha) * r b := by
      intro hle
      exact (not_lt_of_ge (hb0_mem_le b ⟨hbpos, hle⟩)) hb
    exact lt_of_not_ge hnot
  have hcoef : 4 * M ≤ 2 * c1 / alpha := by
    have haM : alpha * M ≤ (1 / 2) * c1 := (le_div_iff₀ hM).mp hαM
    apply (le_div_iff₀ halpha).2
    nlinarith
  have hsmall : 4 * M * r b < b / 2 := by
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoef (hrnonneg b hbpos.le)
    have hhalf : (2 * c1 / alpha) * r b < b / 2 := by
      calc
        (2 * c1 / alpha) * r b = ((4 * c1 / alpha) * r b) / 2 := by ring
        _ < b / 2 := div_lt_div_of_pos_right hbr_lt (by norm_num)
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt hmul hhalf
  have hpopAbs (w : W) : |popVal D phi w| ≤ M := by
    simpa only [popVal, Real.norm_eq_abs, probReal_univ, mul_one] using
      (norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (f := phi w) (C := M)
        (ae_of_all D fun z => by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hBound w z))
  have hpopBdd : BddBelow (Set.range fun w : W => popVal D phi w) := by
    refine ⟨-M, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
    exact neg_le_of_abs_le (hpopAbs w)
  have hPne : P.Nonempty := by
    have hthreshold : (⨅ w : W, popVal D phi w) < b / (2 * c1) := by
      rw [hInf]
      positivity
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (ciInf_lt_iff hpopBdd).mp hthreshold
    exact ⟨w, hw.le⟩
  letI : Nonempty P := hPne.to_subtype
  let B : (Fin n → Z) → ℝ := fun S =>
    ⨆ w : W, ⨆ _h : w ∈ P, empMean n (fun z => (phi w z) ^ 2) S
  let R : (Fin n → Z) → ℝ := fun S => empRad n phi P S
  let R2 : (Fin n → Z) → ℝ := fun S =>
    (1 / (2 ^ n : ℝ)) * ∑ σ : Fin n → Bool, (⨆ w : P,
      (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i,
        (if σ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * (-(phi w.1 (S i)) ^ 2))
  have hemp2_nonneg (w : W) (S : Fin n → Z) :
      0 ≤ empMean n (fun z => (phi w z) ^ 2) S := by
    unfold empMean
    positivity
  have hemp2_upper (w : W) (S : Fin n → Z) :
      empMean n (fun z => (phi w z) ^ 2) S ≤ M ^ 2 := by
    unfold empMean
    calc
      (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ i, phi w (S i) ^ 2 ≤
          (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ _i : Fin n, M ^ 2 := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i hi
        simpa only [sq_abs] using
          (pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg (phi w (S i))) (hBound w (S i)) 2)
      _ = M ^ 2 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
        field_simp

    (hrbarBdd : BddAbove {ρ : ℝ | ρ ≤

targets.label: ch13_theorem_13_2
targets.statement:
Consider a sequence of random functions \(\xi_1(S_1),\ldots,\xi_t(S_t),\ldots\) with filtration \(\{\mathcal{F}_t\}\). We have for any \(\delta \in (0,1)\) and \(\lambda >0\):
\[
\operatorname*{Pr}\left[\exists n>0: -\sum_{i=1}^{n}\xi_{i}\geq\frac{\ln(1/\delta)}{\lambda}+\frac{1}{\lambda}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\ln\mathbb{E}_{Z_{i}^{(y)}}e^{-\lambda\xi_{i}}\right]\leq\delta .
\]
Moreover, consider a sequence of \(\{z_t\in \mathbb{R}\}\) adapted to \(\{\mathcal{F}_t\}\), and events \(A_{t}\) on \(\mathcal{F}_t\):
\[
\ln\Pr\left[\exists n>0:\sum_{i=1}^{n}\xi_{i}\leq z_{n}\&\mathcal{S}_{n}\in A_{n}\right]\leq\inf_{\lambda>0}\sup_{n>0}\sup_{\mathcal{S}_{n}\in A_{n}}\left[\lambda z_{n}+\sum_{i=1}^{n}\ln\mathbb{E}_{Z_{i}^{(y)}}e^{-\lambda\xi_{i}}\right].
\]

nl_proof:
We will prove the result for a finite time sequence \(\xi_1(S_1),\ldots,\xi_T(S_T)\). It implies the desired result by letting \(T\to \infty\). Let
\[
\xi_{\tau}(\lambda)= -\sum_{i=1}^{\tau}\ln\mathbb{E}_{Z_{i}^{(y)}}e^{-\lambda\xi_{i}}-\lambda\sum_{i=1}^{\tau}\xi_{i},
\]
where \(\tau\) is a stopping time, then we have from Lemma 13.1: \(\mathbb{E}e^{\xi_{\tau}(\lambda)} = 1\). Now for any given sequence of \(\tilde{z}_n(S_n)\) and \(A_{n}\), define the stopping time \(\tau\) as either \(T\), or the first time step \(n\) so that
\[
\xi_{n}(\lambda)\geq-\tilde{z}_{n}\left(\mathcal{S}_{n}\right)\&\mathcal{S}_{n}\in A_{n}
\]
for each sequence \(S_T\). It follows that
\[
\begin{array}{l}\Pr\left(\exists n:\xi_{n}(\lambda)\geq-\tilde{z}_{n}\left(\mathcal{S}_{n}\right)\&\mathcal{S}_{n}\in A_{n}\right)\inf_{n>0,\mathcal{S}_{n}\in A_{n}}e^{-\tilde{z}_{n}\left(\mathcal{S}_{n}\right)}\\ \leq\mathbb{E}\left[e^{\xi_{\tau}(\lambda)+\tilde{z}_{\tau}\left(\mathcal{S}_{\tau}\right)}\mathbb{1}\left(\mathcal{S}_{\tau}\in A_{\tau}\right)\right]\inf_{n>0,\mathcal{S}_{n}\in A_{n}}e^{-\tilde{z}_{n}\left(\mathcal{S}_{n}\right)}\\ \leq\mathbb{E}\left[e^{\xi_{\tau}(\lambda)+\tilde{z}_{\tau}\left(\mathcal{S}_{\tau}\right)}\mathbb{1}\left(\mathcal{S}_{\tau}\in A_{\tau}\right)e^{-\tilde{z}_{\tau}\left(\mathcal{S}_{\tau}\right)}\right]\\ \leq\mathbb{E}e^{\xi_{\tau}(\lambda)}=1.\\ \end{array}
\]
Therefore we obtain
\[
\begin{array}{l}\ln\operatorname*{Pr}\left[\exists n>0: -\lambda\sum_{i=1}^{n}\xi_{i}\geq-\tilde{z}_{n}(\mathcal{S}_{n})+\sum_{i=1}^{n}\ln\mathbb{E}_{Z_{i}^{(y)}}e^{-\lambda\xi_{i}}\&\mathcal{S}_{n}\in A_{n}\right]\\ \leq\sup_{n>0:\mathcal{S}_{n}\in A_{n}}\tilde{z}_{n}(\mathcal{S}_{n}).\\ \end{array}
\]
Let \(\tilde{z}(\mathcal{S}_n) = \ln \delta\), we obtain the first inequality. Let
\[
\tilde{z}_{n}(\mathcal{S}_{n})=\lambda z_{n}+\sum_{i=1}^{n}\ln\mathbb{E}_{Z_{i}^{(y)}}e^{-\lambda\xi_{i}},
\]
we obtain the second inequality.

context.statement:
Consider a sequence of real-valued random (measurable) functions \(\xi_1(S_1),\ldots,\xi_T(S_T)\). Let \(\tau \leq T\) be a stopping time so that \(\mathbb{1}(t\leq \tau)\) is measurable in \(S_{t}\). We have

\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{S}_{T}}\exp\left(\sum_{i=1}^{\tau}\xi_{i}-\sum_{i=1}^{\tau}\ln\mathbb{E}_{Z_{i}^{(y)}}e^{\xi_{i}}\right)=1.

context.name: section 13.1 sequential observation setup
context.statement: In Section 13.1, data are observed sequentially. At each time \(t\), after the history \(S_{t-1}\) has been observed, the next observation \(Z_t\) is drawn according to a distribution that may depend on that history. The observation is decomposed as \(Z_t=(Z_t^{(x)},Z_t^{(y)})\), where \(Z_t^{(x)}\) is the component determined by the past history or the chosen action at time \(t\), and \(Z_t^{(y)}\) is the random response component. The history after time \(t\) is \(S_t=(Z_1,\ldots,Z_t)\), and \(\mathcal{S}_T\) denotes the full sequential experiment/history through time \(T\). For a function depending on \(S_t\), the notation \(\mathbb{E}_{Z_t^{(y)}}[\cdot]\) means conditional expectation over the response component \(Z_t^{(y)}\), conditional on \(S_{t-1}\) and on \(Z_t^{(x)}\). Stopping times are adapted to the filtration generated by the histories \(S_t\).
