import Mathlib

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped NNReal ENNReal

namespace GraduateLevel

def partialSum {Ω : Type*} (ξ : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, ξ i ω

private lemma lintegral_mul_eq_of_setLIntegral_eq
    {Ω : Type*} [m₀ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} (hm : m ≤ m₀)
    {f c : Ω → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable[m₀] f) (hc : Measurable[m₀] c)
    (heq : ∀ s, MeasurableSet[m] s → ∫⁻ ω in s, f ω ∂μ = ∫⁻ ω in s, c ω ∂μ)
    {g : Ω → ℝ≥0∞} (hg : Measurable[m] g) :
    ∫⁻ ω, g ω * f ω ∂μ = ∫⁻ ω, g ω * c ω ∂μ := by
  have htrim : (μ.withDensity f).trim hm = (μ.withDensity c).trim hm := by
    refine @Measure.ext _ m _ _ (fun s hs => ?_)
    rw [trim_measurableSet_eq hm hs, trim_measurableSet_eq hm hs,
      withDensity_apply _ (hm s hs), withDensity_apply _ (hm s hs)]
    exact heq s hs
  have h1 : ∀ d : Ω → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable[m₀] d →
      ∫⁻ ω, g ω * d ω ∂μ = ∫⁻ ω, g ω ∂((μ.withDensity d).trim hm) := by
    intro d hd
    rw [lintegral_trim hm hg, lintegral_withDensity_eq_lintegral_mul _ hd (hg.mono hm le_rfl)]
    congr 1
    funext ω
    simp [mul_comm]
  rw [h1 f hf, h1 c hc, htrim]

private noncomputable def likelihood {Ω : Type*} (ξ : ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (c : ℝ → ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (lam : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : ℝ :=
  ∏ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, Real.exp (-lam * ξ i ω) / c lam i ω

private lemma likelihood_eq_exp {Ω : Type*} (ξ : ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (c : ℝ → ℕ → Ω → ℝ) {lam : ℝ}
    (hc : ∀ i ω, 0 < c lam i ω) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    likelihood ξ c lam n ω =
      Real.exp (-lam * partialSum ξ n ω -
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, Real.log (c lam i ω)) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [likelihood, partialSum]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [likelihood, Finset.prod_Icc_succ_top (Nat.succ_pos n)]
      rw [partialSum, Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (Nat.succ_pos n)]
      rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (Nat.succ_pos n)]
      change likelihood ξ c lam n ω *
          (Real.exp (-lam * ξ (n + 1) ω) / c lam (n + 1) ω) = _
      rw [ih, ← Real.exp_log (hc (n + 1) ω), ← Real.exp_sub]
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      congr 1
      simp only [Real.log_exp, partialSum]
      ring

private lemma likelihood_martingale
    {Ω : Type*} [m₀ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (ℱ : Filtration ℕ m₀) (ξ : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (hξ : Adapted ℱ ξ)
    (c : ℝ → ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (hc_meas : ∀ lam i, StronglyMeasurable[ℱ (i - 1)] (c lam i))
    (hc_mgf : ∀ lam i, 0 < lam → ∀ s, MeasurableSet[ℱ (i - 1)] s →
        ∫⁻ ω in s, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-lam * ξ i ω)) ∂μ
          = ∫⁻ ω in s, ENNReal.ofReal (c lam i ω) ∂μ)
    (hc_pos : ∀ lam i ω, 0 < lam → 0 < c lam i ω)
    {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) :
    Martingale (likelihood ξ c lam) ℱ μ := by
  have hstep (n : ℕ) :
      likelihood ξ c lam (n + 1) =
        fun ω => likelihood ξ c lam n ω / c lam (n + 1) ω *
          Real.exp (-lam * ξ (n + 1) ω) := by
    funext ω
    rw [likelihood, Finset.prod_Icc_succ_top (Nat.succ_pos n)]
    simp only [likelihood]
    ring
  have hadp : Adapted ℱ (likelihood ξ c lam) := by
    intro n
    unfold likelihood
    have H := (Finset.Icc 1 n).stronglyMeasurable_prod (f :=
        fun i ω => Real.exp (-lam * ξ i ω) / c lam i ω) (fun i hi => by
          rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hi
          have hxi := (hξ i).mono (ℱ.mono hi.2)
          have hci := (hc_meas lam i).mono (ℱ.mono ((Nat.sub_le i 1).trans hi.2))
          exact
            ((hxi.measurable.const_mul (-lam)).exp.div hci.measurable).stronglyMeasurable)
    convert H using 1
    funext ω
    simp only [Finset.prod_apply]
  -- one-step identity for set-lintegrals on ℱ n-measurable sets
  have hkey : ∀ n s, MeasurableSet[ℱ n] s →
      ∫⁻ ω in s, ENNReal.ofReal (likelihood ξ c lam (n + 1) ω) ∂μ =
        ∫⁻ ω in s, ENNReal.ofReal (likelihood ξ c lam n ω) ∂μ := by
    intro n s hs
    have hsm : MeasurableSet s := ℱ.le n s hs
    let a : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => likelihood ξ c lam n ω / c lam (n + 1) ω
    have ham : Measurable[ℱ n] a :=
      (hadp n).measurable.div
        ((hc_meas lam (n + 1)).mono (by simp)).measurable
    let g : Ω → ℝ≥0∞ := s.indicator (fun ω => ENNReal.ofReal (a ω))
    have hgm : Measurable[ℱ n] g := (ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp ham).indicator hs
    have hf : Measurable (fun ω => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-lam * ξ (n + 1) ω))) :=
      ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp
        ((((hξ (n + 1)).mono (ℱ.le (n + 1))).measurable.const_mul (-lam)).exp)
    have hcm : Measurable (fun ω => ENNReal.ofReal (c lam (n + 1) ω)) :=
      ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp
        (((hc_meas lam (n + 1)).mono (ℱ.le _)).measurable)
    have hmgf : ∀ t, MeasurableSet[ℱ n] t →
        ∫⁻ ω in t, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-lam * ξ (n + 1) ω)) ∂μ =
          ∫⁻ ω in t, ENNReal.ofReal (c lam (n + 1) ω) ∂μ := by
      intro t ht
      exact hc_mgf lam (n + 1) hlam t (by simpa using ht)
    have hpull := lintegral_mul_eq_of_setLIntegral_eq (ℱ.le n) hf hcm hmgf hgm
    rw [← lintegral_indicator hsm, ← lintegral_indicator hsm]
    have hl : s.indicator (fun ω => ENNReal.ofReal (likelihood ξ c lam (n + 1) ω)) =
        fun ω => g ω * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-lam * ξ (n + 1) ω)) := by
      funext ω
      by_cases hω : ω ∈ s
      · have ha0 : 0 ≤ a ω := div_nonneg
          (Finset.prod_nonneg fun i hi =>
            div_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (hc_pos lam i ω hlam).le)
          (hc_pos lam (n + 1) ω hlam).le
        simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hω, g]
        rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul ha0, hstep n]
      · simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem hω, g]
    have hr : s.indicator (fun ω => ENNReal.ofReal (likelihood ξ c lam n ω)) =
        fun ω => g ω * ENNReal.ofReal (c lam (n + 1) ω) := by
      funext ω
      by_cases hω : ω ∈ s
      · have ha0 : 0 ≤ a ω := div_nonneg
          (Finset.prod_nonneg fun i hi =>
            div_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (hc_pos lam i ω hlam).le)
          (hc_pos lam (n + 1) ω hlam).le
        simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hω, g]
        rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul ha0]
        congr 1
        simp only [a]
        field_simp [ne_of_gt (hc_pos lam (n + 1) ω hlam)]
      · simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem hω, g]
    rw [hl, hr]
    exact hpull
  have hnn : ∀ n ω, 0 ≤ likelihood ξ c lam n ω := fun n ω =>
    Finset.prod_nonneg fun i hi =>
      div_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (hc_pos lam i ω hlam).le
  have hone : ∀ n, ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (likelihood ξ c lam n ω) ∂μ = 1 := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp [likelihood]
    | succ n ih =>
        have := hkey n Set.univ MeasurableSet.univ
        simpa [Measure.restrict_univ, ih] using this
  have hint : ∀ n, Integrable (likelihood ξ c lam n) μ := by
    intro n
    refine ⟨((hadp n).mono (ℱ.le n)).aestronglyMeasurable, ?_⟩
    rw [hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal (ae_of_all _ (hnn n)), hone n]
    exact ENNReal.one_lt_top
  apply martingale_nat hadp hint
  intro n
  refine ae_eq_condExp_of_forall_setIntegral_eq (ℱ.le n) (hint (n + 1))
    (fun s _ _ => (hint n).integrableOn) (fun s hs _ => ?_)
    ((hadp n).aestronglyMeasurable)
  rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae (ae_of_all _ (hnn n))
      ((hint n).aestronglyMeasurable.restrict),
    integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae (ae_of_all _ (hnn (n + 1)))
      ((hint (n + 1)).aestronglyMeasurable.restrict),
    hkey n s hs]

private lemma likelihood_ville
    {Ω : Type*} [m₀ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (ℱ : Filtration ℕ m₀) (ξ : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (hξ : Adapted ℱ ξ)
    (c : ℝ → ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (hc_meas : ∀ lam i, StronglyMeasurable[ℱ (i - 1)] (c lam i))
    (hc_mgf : ∀ lam i, 0 < lam → ∀ s, MeasurableSet[ℱ (i - 1)] s →
        ∫⁻ ω in s, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-lam * ξ i ω)) ∂μ
          = ∫⁻ ω in s, ENNReal.ofReal (c lam i ω) ∂μ)
    (hc_pos : ∀ lam i ω, 0 < lam → 0 < c lam i ω)
    {lam r : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) (hr : 0 < r) :
    μ {ω | ∃ n, r ≤ likelihood ξ c lam n ω} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r⁻¹ := by
  let ε : ℝ≥0 := ⟨r, hr.le⟩
  let E : ℕ → Set Ω := fun N => {ω | ∃ n ≤ N, r ≤ likelihood ξ c lam n ω}
  have hm := likelihood_martingale ℱ ξ hξ c hc_meas hc_mgf hc_pos hlam
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ likelihood ξ c lam := fun n ω =>
    Finset.prod_nonneg fun i hi =>
      div_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (hc_pos lam i ω hlam).le
  have hint (N : ℕ) : ∫ ω, likelihood ξ c lam N ω ∂μ = 1 := by
    calc
      _ = ∫ ω, μ[likelihood ξ c lam N | ℱ 0] ω ∂μ :=
        (integral_condExp (ℱ.le 0)).symm
      _ = ∫ ω, likelihood ξ c lam 0 ω ∂μ :=
        integral_congr_ae (hm.2 0 N (Nat.zero_le N))
      _ = 1 := by simp [likelihood]
  have hEN : ∀ N, μ (E N) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r⁻¹ := by
    intro N
    let S : Set Ω := {ω | (ε : ℝ) ≤
      (Finset.range (N + 1)).sup' Finset.nonempty_range_add_one
        (fun k => likelihood ξ c lam k ω)}
    have hsub : E N ⊆ S := by
      rintro ω ⟨n, hn, hnr⟩
      change (ε : ℝ) ≤ _ 
      exact hnr.trans (Finset.le_sup'
        (fun k => likelihood ξ c lam k ω)
        (Finset.mem_range.2 (Nat.lt_succ_iff.2 hn)))
    refine (measure_mono hsub).trans ?_
    have hmax := maximal_ineq hm.submartingale hnonneg (ε := ε) N
    have hset : ∫ ω in S, likelihood ξ c lam N ω ∂μ ≤ 1 :=
      (setIntegral_le_integral (hm.integrable N) (ae_of_all _ fun ω => hnonneg N ω)).trans_eq
        (hint N)
    have hmul : (ε : ℝ≥0∞) * μ S ≤ 1 := by
      calc
        (ε : ℝ≥0∞) * μ S = ε • μ S := by simp [ENNReal.smul_def]
        _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ ω in S, likelihood ξ c lam N ω ∂μ) := hmax
        _ ≤ 1 := by simpa using ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hset
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_inv_of_pos hr, ENNReal.le_inv_iff_mul_le]
    simpa only [mul_comm, ε, ENNReal.coe_nnreal_eq, NNReal.coe_mk] using hmul
  have hmono : Monotone E := by
    intro a b hab ω
    rintro ⟨n, hn, hnr⟩
    exact ⟨n, hn.trans hab, hnr⟩
  have hunion : (⋃ N, E N) = {ω | ∃ n, r ≤ likelihood ξ c lam n ω} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_setOf_eq, E]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨N, n, hn, hnr⟩
      exact ⟨n, hnr⟩
    · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
      exact ⟨n, n, le_rfl, hn⟩
  rw [← hunion, hmono.measure_iUnion]
  exact iSup_le hEN

theorem ch13_theorem_13_2
    {Ω : Type*} [m₀ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (ℱ : Filtration ℕ m₀) (ξ : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (hξ_adapted : Adapted ℱ ξ)
    (z : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (hz_adapted : Adapted ℱ z)
    (A : ℕ → Set Ω) (hA : ∀ n, MeasurableSet[ℱ n] (A n))
    (c : ℝ → ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (hc_meas : ∀ lam i, StronglyMeasurable[ℱ (i - 1)] (c lam i))
    (hc_mgf : ∀ lam i, 0 < lam → ∀ s, MeasurableSet[ℱ (i - 1)] s →
        ∫⁻ ω in s, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-lam * ξ i ω)) ∂μ
          = ∫⁻ ω in s, ENNReal.ofReal (c lam i ω) ∂μ)
    (hc_pos : ∀ lam i ω, 0 < lam → 0 < c lam i ω) :
    (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < 1 → ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam →
        (μ {ω | ∃ n, 0 < n ∧
            Real.log (1 / δ) / lam + (1 / lam) * (∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, Real.log (c lam i ω))
              ≤ - partialSum ξ n ω}).toReal ≤ δ)
    ∧ (ENNReal.log (μ {ω | ∃ n, 0 < n ∧ partialSum ξ n ω ≤ z n ω ∧ ω ∈ A n})
          ≤ ⨅ lam : {l : ℝ // 0 < l}, ⨆ n : {k : ℕ // 0 < k}, ⨆ ω ∈ A (n : ℕ),
              (((lam : ℝ) * z (n : ℕ) ω
                  + ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n : ℕ), Real.log (c (lam : ℝ) i ω) : ℝ) : EReal)) := by
  constructor
  · intro δ hδ hδ1 lam hlam
    let B : Set Ω := {ω | ∃ n, 0 < n ∧
      Real.log (1 / δ) / lam +
          (1 / lam) * (∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, Real.log (c lam i ω))
        ≤ -partialSum ξ n ω}
    have hr : 0 < 1 / δ := one_div_pos.mpr hδ
    have hv := likelihood_ville ℱ ξ hξ_adapted c hc_meas hc_mgf hc_pos
      hlam hr
    have hsub : B ⊆ {ω | ∃ n, 1 / δ ≤ likelihood ξ c lam n ω} := by
      rintro ω ⟨n, hn, hbound⟩
      refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
      rw [likelihood_eq_exp ξ c (fun i ω => hc_pos lam i ω hlam)]
      rw [← Real.exp_log hr]
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hlam] at hbound
      have hlog : Real.log (1 / δ) =
          Real.log (1 / δ) := rfl
      linarith
    have hmeasure : μ B ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 / δ)⁻¹ :=
      (measure_mono hsub).trans hv
    have hto : (μ B).toReal ≤ (ENNReal.ofReal (1 / δ)⁻¹).toReal :=
      ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hmeasure
    change (μ B).toReal ≤ δ
    calc
      (μ B).toReal ≤ (ENNReal.ofReal (1 / δ)⁻¹).toReal := hto
      _ = δ := by
        rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (inv_nonneg.mpr hr.le)]
        field_simp [ne_of_gt hδ]
  · let D : Set Ω :=
      {ω | ∃ n, 0 < n ∧ partialSum ξ n ω ≤ z n ω ∧ ω ∈ A n}
    apply le_iInf
    intro lam
    let S : EReal := ⨆ n : {k : ℕ // 0 < k}, ⨆ ω ∈ A (n : ℕ),
      ((((lam : ℝ) * z (n : ℕ) ω +
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n : ℕ), Real.log (c (lam : ℝ) i ω)) : ℝ) : EReal)
    change ENNReal.log (μ D) ≤ S
    by_cases htop : S = ⊤
    · rw [htop]
      exact le_top
    by_cases hbot : S = ⊥
    · have hD : D = ∅ := by
        ext ω
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨n, hn, hsum, hωA⟩
          let ns : {k : ℕ // 0 < k} := ⟨n, hn⟩
          have hle : ((((lam : ℝ) * z n ω +
              ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, Real.log (c (lam : ℝ) i ω)) : ℝ) : EReal) ≤ S :=
            le_iSup_of_le ns (le_iSup_of_le ω (le_iSup_of_le hωA le_rfl))
          rw [hbot] at hle
          exact (EReal.coe_ne_bot _ (le_bot_iff.mp hle)).elim
        · simp
      rw [hD, measure_empty, ENNReal.log_zero]
      exact bot_le
    · let s : ℝ := S.toReal
      have hSco : (s : EReal) = S := by
        exact EReal.coe_toReal htop hbot
      have hr : 0 < Real.exp (-s) := Real.exp_pos _
      have hv := likelihood_ville ℱ ξ hξ_adapted c hc_meas hc_mgf hc_pos
        lam.property hr
      have hsub : D ⊆ {ω | ∃ n, Real.exp (-s) ≤
          likelihood ξ c (lam : ℝ) n ω} := by
        rintro ω ⟨n, hn, hsum, hωA⟩
        refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
        rw [likelihood_eq_exp ξ c (fun i ω => hc_pos (lam : ℝ) i ω lam.property)]
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        have hB : (((((lam : ℝ) * z n ω +
            ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, Real.log (c (lam : ℝ) i ω)) : ℝ) : EReal) ≤ S) := by
          exact le_iSup_of_le (⟨n, hn⟩ : {k : ℕ // 0 < k})
            (le_iSup_of_le ω (le_iSup_of_le hωA le_rfl))
        rw [← hSco] at hB
        have hBr : (lam : ℝ) * z n ω +
            ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, Real.log (c (lam : ℝ) i ω) ≤ s := by
          exact_mod_cast hB
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum lam.property.le]
      have hp : μ D ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-s))⁻¹ :=
        (measure_mono hsub).trans hv
      calc
        ENNReal.log (μ D) ≤ ENNReal.log (ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-s))⁻¹) :=
          ENNReal.log_le_log hp
        _ = (s : EReal) := by
          rw [ENNReal.log_ofReal]
          simp [not_le.mpr (inv_pos.mpr hr), Real.log_inv, Real.log_exp]
        _ = S := hSco

end GraduateLevel

targets.label: ch8_theorem_8_2
targets.statement:
Assume \(\sup_{Z,Z'}[\phi(f,Z) - \phi(f,Z')] \leq M\) for all \(f\), and the validation data \(\bar{S}_m\) contains \(m\) iid samples from \(\mathcal{D}\). Given training data \(S_n\), consider (8.2) with
\[
r_{m}(q)=M\sqrt{\frac{\ln(1/q)}{2 m}}.
\]
Then with probability at least \(1 - \delta\) over the random selection of \(S_{m}\):
\[
\phi(\mathcal{A}(\hat{\theta},\mathcal{S}_{n}),\mathcal{D})\leq\inf_{\theta}Q(\theta,\mathcal{A}(\theta,\mathcal{S}_{n}),\bar{\mathcal{S}}_{m})+\tilde{\epsilon}+M\sqrt{\frac{\ln(1/\delta)}{2 m}}.
\]
This implies the following oracle inequality. With probability at least \(1 - \delta\) over the random sampling of \(\bar{S}_m\):
\[
\phi(\mathcal{A}(\hat{\theta},\mathcal{S}_{n}),\mathcal{D})\leq\inf_{\theta}[\phi(\mathcal{A}(\theta,\mathcal{S}_{n}),\mathcal{D})+r_{m}(q(\theta))]+\tilde{\epsilon}+M\sqrt{\frac{2\ln(2/\delta)}{m}},
\]
where \(q(\theta)\) satisfies (8.1).

nl_proof:
For each model \(\theta\), let \(\hat{f}_{\theta} = \mathcal{A}(\theta, S_{n})\). We obtain from the additive Chernoff bound that with probability at least \(1 - q(\theta)\delta\):
\[
\begin{array}{l}\mathbb{E}_{Z\sim\mathcal{D}}\phi(\hat{f}_{\theta},Z)\leq\frac{1}{m}\sum_{Z\in\bar{\mathcal{S}}_{m}}\phi(\hat{f}_{\theta},Z)+M\sqrt{\frac{\ln(1/(q(\theta)\delta))}{2 m}}\\ \leq\frac{1}{m}\sum_{Z\in\mathcal{S}_{m}}\phi(\hat{f}_{\theta},Z)+M\sqrt{\frac{\ln(1/q(\theta))}{2 m}}+M\sqrt{\frac{\ln(1/\delta)}{2 m}}.\\ \end{array}
\]
Taking the union bound over \(\theta\), we know that the above claim holds for all \(\theta \geq 1\) with probability at least \(1 - \delta\). This result, combined with the definition of \(\bar{\theta}\) in (8.2), leads to the first desired bound.
Now by applying the Chernoff bound for an arbitrary \(\theta\) that does not depend on \(\bar{S}_m\), we obtain with probability at least \(1 - \delta / 2\):
\[
Q(\theta,\hat{f}_{\theta},\bar{\mathcal{S}}_{m})\leq\mathbb{E}_{Z\sim\mathcal{D}}\phi(\hat{f}_{\theta},Z)+r_{m}(q(\theta))+M\sqrt{\frac{\ln(2/\delta)}{2 m}}.
\]
By combining this inequality with the first bound of the theorem, we obtain the second desired inequality.

context.name: Union Bound
context.statement:
(Union Bound) Consider \(m\) events \(E_1, \ldots, E_m\). The following probability inequality holds:
\[
\Pr (E_1 \cup \cdots \cup E_m) \leq \sum_{j=1}^{m} \Pr(E_j).
\]

The union bound has an alternative expression, which is often used in the learning theory analysis. If each \(E_j\) occurs with probability at least \(1-\delta_j\) for \(j=1, \ldots, m\), then with probability at least \(1-\sum_{j=1}^{m} \delta_j\), all of events \(\{E_j\}\) occur simultaneously for \(j=1, \ldots, m\).

context.name: definition 8.1
context.statement:
Consider a loss function \(\phi(f, z): \mathcal{F} \times \mathcal{Z} \to \mathbb{R}\), and a model family \(\{\mathcal{A}(\theta, S_n): \Theta \times \mathcal{Z}^n \to \mathcal{F}, n \geq 0\}\). Consider \(N \geq n \geq 0\), and iid dataset \(S_n \subset S_N \sim \mathcal{D}^N\). A model selection algorithm \(\bar{\mathcal{A}}\) maps \(S_N\) to \(\hat{\theta} = \hat{\theta}(S_N) \in \Theta\),
and then train a model \(\hat{f} = \mathcal{A}(\hat{\theta}(\mathcal{S}_N), \mathcal{S}_n) = \bar{\mathcal{A}}(\mathcal{S}_N)\). It satisfies an \(\epsilon_{n,N}(\cdot, \cdot)\) oracle inequality if there exists \(\epsilon_{n,N}(\theta, \delta)\), such that for all \(\delta \in (0,1)\), with probability at least \(1 - \delta\) over \(\mathcal{S}_N\):
\[
\phi(\mathcal{A}(\hat{\theta}(\mathcal{S}_{N}),\mathcal{S}_{n}),\mathcal{D})\leq\inf_{\theta\in\Theta}[\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{S}_{n}}\phi(\mathcal{A}(\theta,\mathcal{S}_{n}),\mathcal{D})+\epsilon_{n,N}(\theta,\delta)].
\]
More generally, a learning algorithm \(\bar{\mathcal{A}}: S_N \to \mathcal{F}\) is \(\epsilon_{n,N}(\cdot, \cdot)\) adaptive to the model family \(\{\mathcal{A}(\theta, \cdot): \theta \in \Theta\}\) if there exists \(\epsilon_{n,N}(\theta, \delta)\), such that for all \(\delta \in (0,1)\), with probability at least \(1 - \delta\) over \(S_N\):
\[
\phi(\bar{\mathcal{A}}(\mathcal{S}_{N}),\mathcal{D})\leq\inf_{\theta\in\Theta}\left[\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{S}_{n}}\phi(\mathcal{A}(\theta,\mathcal{S}_{n}),\mathcal{D})+\epsilon_{n,N}(\theta,\delta)\right].
\]
Note that we have used a slightly different notation \(\phi(f, Z)\), instead of \(\phi(w, Z)\) as in earlier chapters, to emphasize that in model selection, the prediction function \(f(w, \cdot)\) from different models can be compared, but the parameter \(w\) of the functions may not be comparable when different models have different functional forms such as decision trees versus neural networks. Without causing confusion, one may consider \(f\) to be the function represented by \(w\), so that \(\phi(f, Z) = L(f(X), Y)\) and \(\phi(w, Z) = L(f(w, X), Y)\). Similar to Definition 3.8, we use the simplified notation
\[
\phi(f,\mathcal{D})=\mathbb{E}_{Z\sim\mathcal{D}}\phi(f,Z),\quad\phi(f,\mathcal{S}_{n})=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{Z\in\mathcal{S}_{n}}\phi(f,Z).
\]
The concept adaptivity is more general than model selection, as the algorithm does not need to choose a specific model \(\mathcal{A}(\theta,\cdot)\) indexed by \(\theta\). For example, a commonly used method to achieve adaptivity is model averaging, where we take the average of several different model outputs \(\hat{f}_{\theta_j} = \mathcal{A}(\theta_j,\mathcal{S}_n)\) as
\[
\hat{f}_{\mathrm{avg}}(x)=\frac{1}{k}\sum_{j=1}^{k}\hat{f}_{\theta_{j}}(x).
\]
If different models have the same functional form, with a vector model parameter \( w \in \mathbb{R}^d \): \( \hat{f}_{\theta_j}(x) = f(\hat{w}_j, x) \). Then one may also average the model parameters as follows:
\[
\hat{w}_{\mathrm{avg}}=\frac{1}{k}\sum_{j=1}^{k}\hat{w}_{j}.
\]
In general, the training data \( S_{n} \) is a subset of \( S_{N} \), and we allow \( n < N \) in order to analyze validation methods which are commonly used in practice. In addition to the large probability bounds in Definition 8.1, one may also derive bounds that hold for expectation over \( S_{N} \).

context.name: equation (8.2)
context.statement:
Given training data \(S_n\) and validation data \(\bar{S}_m\), define the validation objective
\[
Q(\theta, f, \bar{\mathcal{S}}_m) = \phi(f, \bar{\mathcal{S}}_m) + r_m(q(\theta)).
\]
We select \(\hat{\theta}\) by approximate minimization:
\[
Q(\hat{\theta}, \mathcal{A}(\hat{\theta}, \mathcal{S}_n), \bar{\mathcal{S}}_m) \leq \inf_{\theta} Q(\theta, \mathcal{A}(\theta, \mathcal{S}_n), \bar{\mathcal{S}}_m) + \tilde{\epsilon}. \tag{8.2}
\]
Here \(\tilde{\epsilon}\) is the additive slack in the validation-based model-selection rule.

context.name: equation (8.1)
context.statement:
Let \(q(\theta)\geq 0\) for \(\theta = 1,2,\ldots\) satisfy
\[
\sum_{\theta=1}^{\infty} q(\theta) \leq 1. \tag{8.1}
\]

import Mathlib

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Real NNReal

namespace GraduateLevel

noncomputable def rPenalty (M : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (q : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  M * Real.sqrt (Real.log (1 / q) / (2 * m))

noncomputable def popLoss {F Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] (φ : F → Z → ℝ) (D : MeasureTheory.Measure Z) (f : F) : ℝ :=
  ∫ z, φ f z ∂D

noncomputable def empLoss {F Z : Type*} (φ : F → Z → ℝ) {m : ℕ} (S : Fin m → Z) (f : F) : ℝ :=
  (1 / (m : ℝ)) * ∑ i, φ f (S i)

noncomputable def Qobj {F Z Θ : Type*} (φ : F → Z → ℝ) {m : ℕ} (S : Fin m → Z)
    (M : ℝ) (q : Θ → ℝ) (θ : Θ) (f : F) : ℝ :=
  empLoss φ S f + rPenalty M m (q θ)


private lemma chernoff_core {Z Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {D : Measure Z} [IsProbabilityMeasure D] {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) {S : Fin m → Ω → Z} (hSmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (S i))
    (hSindep : iIndepFun S P) (hSlaw : ∀ i, Measure.map (S i) P = D)
    {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) {g : Z → ℝ} (hgm : AEMeasurable g D)
    {a : ℝ} (hgbdd : ∀ᵐ z ∂D, g z ∈ Set.Icc a (a + M))
    {t : ℝ} (ht0 : 0 < t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    P.real {ω | M * Real.sqrt (Real.log (1/t) / (2*m)) <
        (1/(m:ℝ)) * ∑ i, g (S i ω) - ∫ z, g z ∂D} ≤ t := by
  classical
  set g' : Z → ℝ := hgm.mk g with hg'def
  have hg'meas : Measurable g' := hgm.measurable_mk
  have hgg' : g =ᵐ[D] g' := hgm.ae_eq_mk
  obtain ⟨N, hsubN, hNmeas, hNnull⟩ := exists_measurable_superset_of_null (ae_iff.mp hgg')
  have hpre : ∀ i, P ((S i) ⁻¹' N) = 0 := by
    intro i
    rw [← Measure.map_apply (hSmeas i) hNmeas, hSlaw i]
    exact hNnull
  have hae : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ∀ i, g (S i ω) = g' (S i ω) := by
    rw [ae_all_iff]
    intro i
    filter_upwards [measure_zero_iff_ae_nmem.mp (hpre i)] with ω hω
    by_contra h
    exact hω (hsubN h)
  have hg'bdd : ∀ᵐ z ∂D, g' z ∈ Set.Icc a (a + M) := by
    filter_upwards [hgbdd, hgg'] with z h1 h2
    rwa [← h2]
  have hYbdd : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, g' (S i ω) ∈ Set.Icc a (a + M) := by
    intro i
    have h := hg'bdd
    rw [← hSlaw i] at h
    exact (ae_map_iff (hSmeas i).aemeasurable (hg'meas measurableSet_Icc)).mp h
  have hint : ∀ i, ∫ ω, g' (S i ω) ∂P = ∫ z, g' z ∂D := by
    intro i
    rw [← hSlaw i, integral_map (hSmeas i).aemeasurable hg'meas.aestronglyMeasurable]
  have hintg : ∫ z, g z ∂D = ∫ z, g' z ∂D := integral_congr_ae hgg'
  have hmR : (0:ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  set L : ℝ := Real.log (1/t) with hLdef
  have hL0 : 0 ≤ L := by
    rw [hLdef, Real.log_nonneg_iff (by positivity)]
    rw [le_div_iff₀ ht0]; linarith
  set ε : ℝ := M * Real.sqrt (L / (2*m)) with hεdef
  have hε0 : 0 ≤ ε := by
    have : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (L / (2*m)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    positivity
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hM with hM0 | hMpos
  · -- M = 0 case
    have hMz : M = 0 := hM0.symm
    have hEa : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ∀ i, g' (S i ω) = a := by
      rw [ae_all_iff]
      intro i
      filter_upwards [hYbdd i] with ω hω
      have := hω.1; have h2 := hω.2
      rw [hMz] at h2; simp at h2; linarith
    have hIa : ∫ z, g' z ∂D = a := by
      rw [← hint ⟨0, hm⟩]
      have : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, g' (S ⟨0, hm⟩ ω) = a := by
        filter_upwards [hEa] with ω hω using hω _
      rw [integral_congr_ae this]
      simp
    have hnull : P {ω | ε < (1/(m:ℝ)) * ∑ i, g (S i ω) - ∫ z, g z ∂D} = 0 := by
      have : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ω ∉ {ω | ε < (1/(m:ℝ)) * ∑ i, g (S i ω) - ∫ z, g z ∂D} := by
        filter_upwards [hae, hEa] with ω h1 h2
        simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_lt]
        have hsum : ∑ i, g (S i ω) = (m:ℝ) * a := by
          rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by rw [h1 i, h2 i])]
          simp [mul_comm]
        rw [hsum, hintg, hIa, hεdef, hMz]
        field_simp
        simp
      exact measure_zero_iff_ae_nmem.mpr this
    rw [Measure.real, hnull]
    simpa using ht0.le
  · -- M > 0
    set Y : Fin m → Ω → ℝ := fun i ω => g' (S i ω) with hYdef
    have hYmeas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (Y i) P := fun i =>
      (hg'meas.comp (hSmeas i)).aemeasurable
    have hYindep : iIndepFun Y P := hSindep.comp (fun _ => g') (fun _ => hg'meas)
    have hsubG : ∀ i, HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω => Y i ω - P[Y i]) ((‖(a+M) - a‖₊ / 2)^2) P :=
      fun i => hasSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc (hYmeas i) (hYbdd i)
    have hYindep' : iIndepFun (fun i ω => Y i ω - P[Y i]) P := by
      show iIndepFun (fun i => (fun x : ℝ => x - P[Y i]) ∘ Y i) P
      exact hYindep.comp _ (fun i => measurable_id.sub measurable_const)
    have hkey := HasSubgaussianMGF.measure_sum_ge_le_of_iIndepFun (μ := P)
      (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m))) hYindep' (fun i _ => hsubG i)
      (ε := (m:ℝ) * ε) (by positivity)
    have hEY : ∀ i, P[Y i] = ∫ z, g' z ∂D := fun i => hint i
    have hsubset : {ω | ε < (1/(m:ℝ)) * ∑ i, g (S i ω) - ∫ z, g z ∂D} ≤ᵐ[P]
        {ω | (m:ℝ) * ε ≤ ∑ i : Fin m, (Y i ω - P[Y i])} := by
      filter_upwards [hae] with ω h1 hmem
      show (m:ℝ) * ε ≤ ∑ i : Fin m, (Y i ω - P[Y i])
      have hsum : ∑ i, g (S i ω) = ∑ i, Y i ω := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => h1 i)
      have : ∑ i : Fin m, (Y i ω - P[Y i]) = (∑ i, Y i ω) - (m:ℝ) * ∫ z, g' z ∂D := by
        simp [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hEY, mul_comm]
      rw [this, ← hsum]
      rw [hintg] at hmem
      have hEq : (m:ℝ) * ((1/(m:ℝ)) * ∑ i, g (S i ω) - ∫ z, g' z ∂D)
          = ∑ i, g (S i ω) - (m:ℝ) * ∫ z, g' z ∂D := by
        field_simp
      have h2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hmem hmR
      rw [hEq] at h2
      linarith
    have hmono : P.real {ω | ε < (1/(m:ℝ)) * ∑ i, g (S i ω) - ∫ z, g z ∂D} ≤
        P.real {ω | (m:ℝ) * ε ≤ ∑ i : Fin m, (Y i ω - P[Y i])} := by
      apply ENNReal.toReal_mono (measure_ne_top _ _) (measure_mono_ae hsubset)
    refine hmono.trans (hkey.trans ?_)
    have hnn : (‖(a+M) - a‖₊ : ℝ) = M := by
      simp [abs_of_nonneg hM]

targets.label: ch14_theorem_14_15
targets.statement:
Assume that for all \(t\):
\[
\sup_{w\in\Omega}\ell_{t}(w)-\inf_{w\in\Omega}\ell_{t}(w)\leq M,
\]
then Algorithm 14.4 has regret
\[
\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}_{w_{t-1}\sim p_{t-1}(\cdot)}\ell_{t}(w_{t-1})\leq\inf_{p\in\Delta(\Omega)}\left[\mathbb{E}_{w\sim p}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\ell_{t}(w)+\frac{1}{\eta}\mathrm{KL}(p| |p_{0})\right]+\frac{\eta TM^{2}}{8},
\]
where \(\Delta (\Omega)\) denotes the set of probability distributions on \(\Omega\)

nl_proof:
Let
\[
Z_{t}= -\ln\mathbb{E}_{w\sim p_{0}}\exp\left(-\eta\sum_{s=1}^{t}\ell_{s}(w)\right)
\]
be the log-partition function for observations up to time \( t \). We have
\[
\begin{array}{l}Z_{t-1}-Z_{t}=\ln\mathbb{E}_{w\sim p_{t-1}}\exp(-\eta\ell_{t}(w))\\ \leq-\eta\mathbb{E}_{w\sim p_{t-1}}\ell_{t}(w)+\frac{\eta^{2}M^{2}}{8},\\ \end{array}
\]
where the first equation is simple algebra, and the inequality follows from the estimate of logarithmic moment generation function in Lemma 2.15. By summing
over \(t = 1\) to \(T\), and noticing that \(Z_{0} = 0\), we obtain
\[
\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}_{w_{t-1}\sim p_{t-1}(\cdot)}\ell_{t}(w_{t-1})\leq\frac{1}{\eta}Z_{T}+\frac{\eta T M^{2}}{8}.
\]
The desired bound follows by applying Proposition 7.16 to reformulate the log-partition function \( Z_{T} \).

context.name: Hedge Algorithm
context.statement:
Hedge Algorithm
Input: \(T\), prior \(p_{0}(w)\) on \(\Omega\), learning rate \(\eta > 0\)
1 Randomly draw \(w_{0} \sim p_{0}(w)\)
2 for \(t = 1, 2, \ldots, T\) do
3 \quad Observe loss \(\ell_{t}(w_{t-1})\)
4 \quad Randomly draw \(w_{t} \sim p_{t}(w)\) according to \((14.9)\)

context.name: lemma 2.15
context.statement:
Consider a random variable \(X \in [0,1]\) and \(\mathbb{E}X = \mu\). We have the following inequality:
\[
\ln\mathbb{E}e^{\lambda X}\leq\ln [(1-\mu)e^{0}+\mu e^{\lambda}]\leq\lambda\mu+\lambda^{2}/8.
\]

context.name: proposition 7.16
context.statement:
Given any function \(U(w)\), we have
\[
\min_{p\in\Delta(\Omega)}\left[\mathbb{E}_{w\sim p}U(w)+\mathrm{KL}(p| |p_{0})\right]= -\ln\mathbb{E}_{w\sim p_{0}}\exp(-U(w)),
\]
and the solution is achieved by the Gibbs distribution \( q(w) \propto p_0(w) \exp(-U(w)) \). Here \( \Delta(\Omega) \) denotes the set of probability distributions on \( \Omega \).

context.name: proposition 14.14
context.statement:
Consider \(\Omega = \{w_0, w_1, \ldots, w_T\}\) that contains \(T\) members. Given any deterministic online learning algorithm \(\mathcal{A}\) that returns a model parameter \(w_{t-1}\) based on \(\{\ell_s : s = 1, \ldots, t-1\}\), there exists a loss sequence \(\ell_t(w) \in \{0, 1\}\) so that
\[
\inf_{w}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\ell_{t}(w)=0,\qquad\sum_{t=1}^{T}\ell_{t}(w_{t-1})=T.
\]

  set A : ℕ → ℝ := fun t => ∫ w, Real.exp (-η * S t w) ∂p₀ with hAdef

    intro t w; simp [hSdef, Finset.sum_range_succ]
  have hmeasS : ∀ t, t ≤ T → Measurable (S t) := by
    intro t ht
    refine Finset.measurable_sum _ ?_
    intro s hs
    exact hℓmeas s (lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_range.mp hs) ht)
  have hboundS : ∀ t, t ≤ T → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w, |S t w| ≤ C := by
    intro t
    induction t with
    | zero => intro _; exact ⟨0, by intro w; simp [hSdef]⟩
    | succ n ih =>
      intro ht
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := ih (Nat.le_of_succ_le ht)
      obtain ⟨hu, hl⟩ := hbdd n (Nat.lt_of_succ_le ht)
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hu
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hl
      refine ⟨C + (|a| + |b|), fun w => ?_⟩
      have h1 : ℓ (n + 1) w ≤ b := hb ⟨w, rfl⟩
      have h2 : a ≤ ℓ (n + 1) w := ha ⟨w, rfl⟩
      have h3 := hC w
      have h4 : |ℓ (n + 1) w| ≤ |a| + |b| := by
        rw [abs_le]
        constructor
        · have := neg_abs_le a
          have := abs_nonneg b
          linarith
        · have := le_abs_self b
          have := abs_nonneg a
          linarith
      have h5 : |S (n + 1) w| ≤ |S n w| + |ℓ (n + 1) w| := by
        rw [hSsucc]; exact abs_add_le _ _
      linarith
  have hintexp : ∀ t, t ≤ T → ∀ (μ : Measure Ω), IsFiniteMeasure μ →
      Integrable (fun w => Real.exp (-η * S t w)) μ := by
    intro t ht μ hμ
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hboundS t ht
    have hm : Measurable (fun w => Real.exp (-η * S t w)) :=
      Real.measurable_exp.comp ((hmeasS t ht).const_mul _)
    refine Integrable.mono' (integrable_const (Real.exp (η * C))) hm.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    filter_upwards with w
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
    have h6 := (abs_le.1 (hC w)).1
    nlinarith [hη.le]
  have hApos : ∀ t, t ≤ T → 0 < A t := by
    intro t ht
    simp only [hAdef]
    exact integral_exp_pos (hintexp t ht p₀ inferInstance)
  have hA0 : A 0 = 1 := by
    simp [hAdef, hSdef]
  -- Step 1 : the Gibbs measure is a tilted measure
  have hkey1 : ∀ t, t < T → p t = p₀.tilted (fun w => -η * S t w) := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨Z, hZ, hZeq⟩ := hgibbs t ht
    have hpt : IsProbabilityMeasure (p t) := hp t ht
    have hac : p t ≪ p₀ := hpt_ac t ht
    have hint : Integrable (fun w => Real.exp (-η * S t w)) p₀ := hintexp t ht.le p₀ inferInstance
    have hZeq' : (p t).rnDeriv p₀ =ᵐ[p₀]
        fun w => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-η * S t w) / Z) := hZeq
    have hZA : Z = A t := by
      have h1 : ∫⁻ w, (p t).rnDeriv p₀ w ∂p₀ = 1 := by
        rw [Measure.lintegral_rnDeriv hac]; simp
      have h2 : ∫⁻ w, (p t).rnDeriv p₀ w ∂p₀
          = ∫⁻ w, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-η * S t w) / Z) ∂p₀ := lintegral_congr_ae hZeq'
      have h3 : ∫⁻ w, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-η * S t w) / Z) ∂p₀
          = ENNReal.ofReal (A t / Z) := by
        rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (hint.div_const Z)
          (by filter_upwards with w; positivity)]
        congr 1
        rw [integral_div]
      rw [h2, h3] at h1
      have h4 : A t / Z = 1 := by
        have := (ENNReal.ofReal_eq_one).1 h1
        exact this
      field_simp at h4
      linarith
    have hmeas : AEMeasurable (fun w => -η * S t w) p₀ :=
      ((hmeasS t ht.le).const_mul _).aemeasurable
    have hrn := MeasureTheory.rnDeriv_tilted_left_self (μ := p₀) (f := fun w => -η * S t w) hmeas
    have hrn2 : (p t).rnDeriv p₀ =ᵐ[p₀] (p₀.tilted (fun w => -η * S t w)).rnDeriv p₀ := by
      refine hZeq'.trans (Filter.EventuallyEq.symm (hrn.trans ?_))
      filter_upwards with w
      simp only [hZA, hAdef]
    calc p t = p₀.withDensity ((p t).rnDeriv p₀) :=
          (Measure.withDensity_rnDeriv_eq _ _ hac).symm
      _ = p₀.withDensity ((p₀.tilted (fun w => -η * S t w)).rnDeriv p₀) :=
          withDensity_congr_ae hrn2
      _ = p₀.tilted (fun w => -η * S t w) :=
          Measure.withDensity_rnDeriv_eq _ _ (tilted_absolutelyContinuous _ _)
  -- Step 2 : the recursion for the partition function
  have hkey2 : ∀ t, t < T → A (t + 1) = A t * ∫ w, Real.exp (-η * ℓ (t + 1) w) ∂(p t) := by
    intro t ht
    have hApos' := hApos t ht.le
    rw [hkey1 t ht, integral_exp_tilted]
    have hEq : (∫ x, Real.exp (((fun w => -η * S t w) + fun w => -η * ℓ (t + 1) w) x) ∂p₀)
        = A (t + 1) := by
      simp only [hAdef, Pi.add_apply]
      refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun w => ?_)
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, hSsucc]
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [show (∫ x, Real.exp ((fun w => -η * S t w) x) ∂p₀) = A t from rfl]
    rw [hEq]
    field_simp
  -- Step 3 : Hoeffding's lemma
  have hkey3 : ∀ t, t < T → (∫ w, Real.exp (-η * ℓ (t + 1) w) ∂(p t))
      ≤ Real.exp (-η * (∫ w, ℓ (t + 1) w ∂(p t)) + η ^ 2 * M ^ 2 / 8) := by
    intro t ht
    have hpt : IsProbabilityMeasure (p t) := hp t ht
    obtain ⟨hu, hl⟩ := hbdd t ht
    set a := ⨅ w, ℓ (t + 1) w with hadef
    set b := ⨆ w, ℓ (t + 1) w with hbdef
    have hab : ∀ w, ℓ (t + 1) w ∈ Set.Icc a b := by
      intro w
      exact ⟨ciInf_le hl w, le_ciSup hu w⟩
    have hMle : b - a ≤ M := hosc t ht
    have hba : 0 ≤ b - a := by
      obtain ⟨w⟩ := ‹Nonempty Ω›
      have h := hab w
      have h1 := h.1
      have h2 := h.2
      linarith
    have hsg := ProbabilityTheory.hasSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc (μ := p t) (X := ℓ (t + 1))
      (hℓmeas t ht).aemeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hab)
    have hmgf := hsg.mgf_le (-η)
    set E := ∫ w, ℓ (t + 1) w ∂(p t) with hEdef
    have hmgf_eq : mgf (fun w => ℓ (t + 1) w - E) (p t) (-η)
        = Real.exp (η * E) * ∫ w, Real.exp (-η * ℓ (t + 1) w) ∂(p t) := by
      rw [mgf, ← integral_const_mul]
      refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun w => ?_)
      simp only [← Real.exp_add]
      congr 1
      ring
    have hc : (((‖b - a‖₊ / 2 : ℝ≥0) ^ 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) ≤ M ^ 2 / 4 := by
      push_cast
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hba]
      nlinarith
    have hcpos : (0:ℝ) ≤ (((‖b - a‖₊ / 2 : ℝ≥0) ^ 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hbound : Real.exp (η * E) * (∫ w, Real.exp (-η * ℓ (t + 1) w) ∂(p t))
        ≤ Real.exp (η ^ 2 * M ^ 2 / 8) := by
      rw [← hmgf_eq]
      refine hmgf.trans ?_
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
      have hsq : (-η) ^ 2 = η ^ 2 := by ring
      rw [hsq]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (sq_nonneg η), sq_nonneg η]
    have hEpos : (0:ℝ) < Real.exp (η * E) := Real.exp_pos _
    have : (∫ w, Real.exp (-η * ℓ (t + 1) w) ∂(p t))
        ≤ Real.exp (η ^ 2 * M ^ 2 / 8) / Real.exp (η * E) := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hEpos]
      linarith [hbound]
    refine this.trans_eq ?_
    rw [← Real.exp_sub]
    congr 1
    ring
  -- Step 4 : telescoping
  have hkey4 : ∀ t, t ≤ T → A t ≤ Real.exp (-η * (∑ s ∈ Finset.range t, ∫ w, ℓ (s + 1) w ∂(p s))
      + (t : ℝ) * (η ^ 2 * M ^ 2 / 8)) := by
    intro t
    induction t with
    | zero => intro _; simp [hA0]
    | succ n ih =>
      intro ht
      have hn : n < T := Nat.lt_of_succ_le ht
      have h1 := ih hn.le
      have h2 := hkey3 n hn
      have h3 : (0:ℝ) ≤ ∫ w, Real.exp (-η * ℓ (n + 1) w) ∂(p n) :=
        integral_nonneg fun w => (Real.exp_pos _).le
      rw [hkey2 n hn]
      calc A n * ∫ w, Real.exp (-η * ℓ (n + 1) w) ∂(p n)
          ≤ Real.exp (-η * (∑ s ∈ Finset.range n, ∫ w, ℓ (s + 1) w ∂(p s))
              + (n : ℝ) * (η ^ 2 * M ^ 2 / 8))
            * Real.exp (-η * (∫ w, ℓ (n + 1) w ∂(p n)) + η ^ 2 * M ^ 2 / 8) := by
            exact mul_le_mul h1 h2 h3 (Real.exp_pos _).le
        _ = Real.exp (-η * (∑ s ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ∫ w, ℓ (s + 1) w ∂(p s))
              + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (η ^ 2 * M ^ 2 / 8)) := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add]
            congr 1
            rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
            push_cast
            ring
  -- Step 5 : the Donsker-Varadhan / Gibbs variational principle
  have hSTq : Integrable (S T) q := by
    refine integrable_finset_sum _ ?_
    intro s hs
    exact hℓintq s (Finset.mem_range.mp hs) q hq hqac
  have hFq : Integrable (fun w => -η * S T w) q := hSTq.const_mul _
  have hFp0 : Integrable (fun w => Real.exp (-η * S T w)) p₀ :=
    hintexp T le_rfl p₀ inferInstance
  have hllr : Integrable (llr q p₀) q := ((InformationTheory.klDiv_ne_top_iff).1 hkl).2
  have hνprob : IsProbabilityMeasure (p₀.tilted (fun w => -η * S T w)) :=
    isProbabilityMeasure_tilted hFp0
  have hqν : q ≪ p₀.tilted (fun w => -η * S T w) :=
    hqac.trans (absolutelyContinuous_tilted hFp0)
  have hint2 : Integrable (llr q (p₀.tilted (fun w => -η * S T w))) q :=
    integrable_llr_tilted_right hqac hFq hllr hFp0
  have hnn := InformationTheory.integral_llr_add_sub_measure_univ_nonneg hqν hint2
  rw [integral_llr_tilted_right hqac hFq hFp0 hllr] at hnn
  have hklR : (GraduateLevel.klDiv q p₀).toReal = ∫ w, llr q p₀ w ∂q := by
    simpa using InformationTheory.toReal_klDiv_of_measure_eq (μ := q) (ν := p₀) hqac (by simp)
  have hFint : (∫ w, -η * S T w ∂q) = -η * ∫ w, S T w ∂q := integral_const_mul _ _
  have hlogA : Real.log (A T) ≤ -η * (∑ s ∈ Finset.range T, ∫ w, ℓ (s + 1) w ∂(p s))
      + (T : ℝ) * (η ^ 2 * M ^ 2 / 8) := by
    have := hkey4 T le_rfl
    have h := Real.log_le_log (hApos T le_rfl) this
    rwa [Real.log_exp] at h
  have hAeq : (∫ x, Real.exp (-η * S T x) ∂p₀) = A T := rfl
  rw [hAeq, hFint] at hnn
  simp only [measureReal_univ_eq_one] at hnn
  -- assemble
  have hfinal : (∑ s ∈ Finset.range T, ∫ w, ℓ (s + 1) w ∂(p s))
      ≤ (∫ w, S T w ∂q) + (1 / η) * (GraduateLevel.klDiv q p₀).toReal + η * (T : ℝ) * M ^ 2 / 8 := by
    rw [hklR]
    refine le_of_mul_le_mul_left ?_ hη
    have expand : η * ((∫ w, S T w ∂q) + (1 / η) * (∫ w, llr q p₀ w ∂q)
          + η * (T : ℝ) * M ^ 2 / 8)
        = η * (∫ w, S T w ∂q) + (∫ w, llr q p₀ w ∂q) + η ^ 2 * (T : ℝ) * M ^ 2 / 8 := by
      field_simp
    rw [expand]
    nlinarith [hnn, hlogA]
  simpa [hSdef] using hfinal

end GraduateLevel

targets.label: ch9_ridge_excess_risk_bound
targets.statement:
Assume that \( \mathcal{S}_n = \{(X_i, Y_i)\}_{1}^{n} \sim \mathcal{D}^n \), and \( \operatorname{Var}[\epsilon_i | X_i] \leq \sigma^2 \) for all \( X_i \). If we choose \( \lambda \) such that \( \lambda n > B^2 \geq \sup_x \psi(x)^\top \psi(x) \), then (9.18) satisfies
\[
\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{S}_{n}\sim\mathcal{D}^{n}}\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\mathcal{D}}(\hat{w}^{\top}\psi(X)-w_{*}^{\top}\psi(X))^{2}\leq\frac{d_{1,\lambda^{\prime}}}{n}(\sigma^{2}+\lambda n\|w_{*}\|_{2}^{2}),
\]
where
\[
d_{1,\lambda^{\prime}}=\mathrm{trace}\left((\Sigma_{\mathcal{D}}+\lambda^{\prime}I)^{-1}\Sigma_{\mathcal{D}}\right),\quad\Sigma_{\mathcal{D}}=\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{D}}\psi(X)\psi(X)^{\top},
\]
and \(\lambda' = (\lambda n - B^2) / (n + 1)\).

nl_proof:
Consider \( \mathcal{S}_{n+1} = \{(X_1, Y_1), \ldots, (X_{n+1}, Y_{n+1})\} \). Let \( \hat{w} \) be the solution with training data \( \mathcal{S}_n \). Let
\[
\begin{array}{l}\hat{\Sigma}_{n+1}=\sum_{i=1}^{n+1}\psi(X_{i})\psi(X_{i})^{\top},\\ \hat{\Sigma}_{n}=\sum_{i=1}^{n}\psi(X_{i})\psi(X_{i})^{\top}+\lambda n I,\\ \end{array}
\]
then \(\hat{\Sigma}_n\geq \hat{\Sigma}_{n + 1} + (\lambda n - B^2)I\) . It follows that
\[
\begin{array}{l}\mathbb{E}\left[\left(\hat{w}-w_{*}\right)^{\top}\psi\left(X_{n+1}\right)\right]^{2}\\ \leq\left(\sigma^{2}+\lambda n\|w_{*}\|_{2}^{2}\right)\mathbb{E}\left\|\psi\left(X_{n+1}\right)\right\|_{\left(\hat{\Sigma}_{n+1}+(\lambda n-B^{2})I\right)^{-1}}^{2}\\ =\frac{\sigma^{2}+\lambda n\|w_{*}\|_{2}^{2}}{n+1}\mathbb{E}\operatorname{trace}\left((\hat{\Sigma}_{n+1}+(\lambda n-B^{2})I)^{-1}\hat{\Sigma}_{n+1}\right)\\ \leq\frac{\sigma^{2}+\lambda n\|w_{*}\|_{2}^{2}}{n+1}\mathrm{trace}\left((\mathbb{E}[\hat{\Sigma}_{n+1}]+(\lambda n-B^{2})I)^{-1}[\mathbb{E}\hat{\Sigma}_{n+1}]\right)\\ =\frac{\sigma^{2}+\lambda n\|w_{*}\|_{2}^{2}}{n+1}d_{1,\lambda^{\prime}}.\\ \end{array}
\]
In the above derivation, the first inequality used Lemma 9.34 and \(\hat{\Sigma}_n^{-1} \leq (\hat{\Sigma}_{n+1} + (\lambda n - B^2)I)^{-1}\). The first equality used the symmetry of \(X_1, \ldots, X_{n+1}\) conditioned on \(\mathcal{S}_{n+1}\). The second inequality used Jensen's inequality and the concavity of the matrix function trace \(((A + \mu I)^{-1}A)\) for \(\mu > 0\), where \(A\) is a symmetric positive semi-definite matrix (see Theorem A.18).

context.name: lemma 9.34
context.statement:
Let \(\{Y_i\}_1^n\) be independent samples conditioned on \(\{X_i\}_1^n\) according to (9.19). Given any vector \(X\) that is independent of \(\{Y_i\}_1^n\). If \(\mathbb{E}[\epsilon_i|X_i] \leq \sigma^2\) for all \(i\), then we have
\[
\mathbb{E}_{\left\{Y_{i}\right\}_{1}^{n}\mid\left\{X_{i}\right\}_{1}^{n}}\left[\left(\hat{w}^{\top}\psi(X)-w_{*}^{\top}\psi(X)\right)^{2}\right]\leq\left(\left(\sigma^{2}/n\right)+\lambda\|w_{*}\|_{2}^{2}\right)\|\psi(X)\|_{\hat{\Sigma}_{\lambda}^{-1}}^{2},
\]
where
\[
\hat{\Sigma}_{\lambda}=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\psi(X_{i})\psi(X_{i})^{\top}+\lambda I.
\]
Moreover if \(\epsilon\) is sub-Gaussian:
\[
\forall i:\ln\mathbb{E}\exp [\mu\epsilon_{i}|X_{i}]\leq\frac{\mu^{2}\sigma^{2}}{2},
\]
then the following inequalities hold for conditional probability of \(\{Y_i\}_1^n|\{X_i\}_1^n\):
\[
\Pr\left[\hat{w}^{\top}\psi(X)-w_{*}^{\top}\psi(X)\leq\left(\sqrt{\lambda}\|w_{*}\|_{2}+\sigma\sqrt{\frac{2\ln(1/\delta)}{n}}\right)\|\psi(X)\|_{\hat{\Sigma}_{\lambda}^{-1}}\right]\leq\delta,
\]
\[
\Pr\left[w_{*}^{\top}\psi(X)-\hat{w}^{\top}\psi(X)\leq\left(\sqrt{\lambda}\|w_{*}\|_{2}+\sigma\sqrt{\frac{2\ln(1/\delta)}{n}}\right)\|\psi(X)\|_{\hat{\Sigma}_{\lambda}^{-1}}\right]\leq\delta .
\]

context.name: equation 9.18
context.statement:
The ridge-regression estimator \(\hat w\) on training data \(\mathcal S_n = \{(X_i,Y_i)\}_{i=1}^n\) is the regularized least-squares solution
\[
\hat{w}=\hat{\Sigma}_{\lambda}^{-1}\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\psi(X_{i})Y_{i},\qquad\hat{\Sigma}_{\lambda}=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\psi(X_{i})\psi(X_{i})^{\top}+\lambda I.
\]

context.name: equation 9.19
context.statement:
The response model is
\[
Y_i=w_{*}^{\top}\psi(X_i)+\epsilon_i,
\]
where \(w_*\) is the target parameter and the noise variables satisfy \(\mathbb E[\epsilon_i \mid X_i] = 0\) and \(\operatorname{Var}[\epsilon_i \mid X_i] \leq \sigma^2\).
