import Mathlib

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000

open MeasureTheory
open scoped MatrixOrder

namespace GraduateLevel

noncomputable def featureCovariance {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {d : ℕ}
    (D : Measure Ω) (ψ : Ω → (Fin d → ℝ)) : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ :=
  Matrix.of fun j k => ∫ x, ψ x j * ψ x k ∂D

noncomputable def linPred {Ω : Type*} {d : ℕ}
    (w : Fin d → ℝ) (ψ : Ω → (Fin d → ℝ)) (x : Ω) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j, w j * ψ x j

lemma integral_mul_of_condExp_zero
    {Ω : Type*} {m mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {D : Measure Ω}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure D] {g e : Ω → ℝ}
    (hm : m ≤ mΩ)
    (hg : StronglyMeasurable[m] g)
    (heint : Integrable e D)
    (hgeint : Integrable (g * e) D)
    (hemean : D[e | m] =ᵐ[D] 0) :
    ∫ x, g x * e x ∂D = 0 := by
  have hpull : D[g * e | m] =ᵐ[D] g * D[e | m] :=
    condExp_mul_of_stronglyMeasurable_left hg hgeint heint
  calc
    ∫ x, g x * e x ∂D = ∫ x, D[g * e | m] x ∂D := (integral_condExp hm).symm
    _ = ∫ x, g x * D[e | m] x ∂D := integral_congr_ae hpull
    _ = 0 := by
      have hz : (fun x => g x * D[e | m] x) =ᵐ[D] fun _ => 0 :=
        hemean.mono fun x hx => by
          change g x * D[e | m] x = 0
          change D[e | m] x = 0 at hx
          rw [hx, mul_zero]
      rw [integral_congr_ae hz]
      simp only [integral_zero]

lemma integral_mul_sq_of_condExp_le
    {Ω : Type*} {m mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {D : Measure Ω}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure D] {g e : Ω → ℝ} {s : ℝ}
    (hm : m ≤ mΩ)
    (hg : StronglyMeasurable[m] g)
    (hg0 : 0 ≤ g)
    (hgint : Integrable g D)
    (hesqint : Integrable (fun x => (e x)^2) D)
    (hgesqint : Integrable (fun x => g x * (e x)^2) D)
    (hevar : D[fun x => (e x)^2 | m] ≤ᵐ[D] fun _ => s) :
    ∫ x, g x * (e x)^2 ∂D ≤ s * ∫ x, g x ∂D := by
  have hpull : D[g * fun x => (e x)^2 | m] =ᵐ[D]
      g * D[fun x => (e x)^2 | m] :=
    condExp_mul_of_stronglyMeasurable_left hg hgesqint hesqint
  have hright : Integrable (fun x => g x * s) D := hgint.mul_const s
  calc
    ∫ x, g x * (e x)^2 ∂D = ∫ x, D[g * fun x => (e x)^2 | m] x ∂D :=
      (integral_condExp hm).symm
    _ = ∫ x, g x * D[fun x => (e x)^2 | m] x ∂D := integral_congr_ae hpull
    _ ≤ ∫ x, g x * s ∂D := by
      apply integral_mono_ae
      · exact integrable_condExp.congr hpull
      · exact hright
      · filter_upwards [hevar] with x hx
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx (hg0 x)
    _ = s * ∫ x, g x ∂D := by
      rw [← integral_const_mul]
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with x
      ring

lemma integral_pi_eq_zero_of_slices
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {D : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure D]
    {n : ℕ} (i : Fin (n + 1)) {f : (Fin (n + 1) → Ω) → ℝ}
    (hf : Integrable f (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => D))
    (hz : ∀ r : Fin n → Ω, ∫ x, f (i.insertNth x r) ∂D = 0) :
    ∫ S, f S ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => D) = 0 := by
  let e : (Fin (n + 1) → Ω) ≃ᵐ Ω × (Fin n → Ω) :=
    MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => Ω) i
  let ν : Measure (Fin n → Ω) := Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => D
  have he : MeasurePreserving e (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => D) (D.prod ν) :=
    measurePreserving_piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => D) i
  let F : Ω × (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun z => f (i.insertNth z.1 z.2)
  have hFeq : (fun S => F (e S)) = f := by
    funext S
    simp [F, e, MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_apply]
  have hFint : Integrable F (D.prod ν) := by
    have hi := he.symm.integrable_comp_emb (MeasurableEquiv.measurableEmbedding e.symm) (g := f)
    apply hi.mpr
    simpa [F, e, MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_symm_apply]
  calc
    ∫ S, f S ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => D) =
        ∫ S, F (e S) ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => D) := by rw [hFeq]
    _ = ∫ z, F z ∂(D.prod ν) := he.integral_comp' F
    _ = ∫ r, ∫ x, F (x, r) ∂D ∂ν := integral_prod_symm F hFint
    _ = 0 := by
      apply integral_eq_zero_of_ae
      filter_upwards with r
      exact hz r

lemma integral_pi_le_of_slices
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {D : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure D]
    {n : ℕ} (i : Fin (n + 1)) {f g : (Fin (n + 1) → Ω) → ℝ}
    (hf : Integrable f (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => D))
    (hg : Integrable g (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => D))
    (hle : ∀ r : Fin n → Ω,
      (∫ x, f (i.insertNth x r) ∂D) ≤ ∫ x, g (i.insertNth x r) ∂D) :
    (∫ S, f S ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => D)) ≤
      ∫ S, g S ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => D) := by
  let e : (Fin (n + 1) → Ω) ≃ᵐ Ω × (Fin n → Ω) :=
    MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => Ω) i
  let ν : Measure (Fin n → Ω) := Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => D
  have he : MeasurePreserving e (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => D) (D.prod ν) :=
    measurePreserving_piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => D) i
  let F : Ω × (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun z => f (i.insertNth z.1 z.2)
  let G : Ω × (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun z => g (i.insertNth z.1 z.2)
  have hFeq : (fun S => F (e S)) = f := by
    funext S
    simp [F, e, MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_apply]
  have hGeq : (fun S => G (e S)) = g := by
    funext S
    simp [G, e, MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_apply]
  have hFint : Integrable F (D.prod ν) := by
    have hi := he.symm.integrable_comp_emb (MeasurableEquiv.measurableEmbedding e.symm) (g := f)
    apply hi.mpr
    simpa [F, e, MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_symm_apply]
  have hGint : Integrable G (D.prod ν) := by
    have hi := he.symm.integrable_comp_emb (MeasurableEquiv.measurableEmbedding e.symm) (g := g)
    apply hi.mpr
    simpa [G, e, MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_symm_apply]
  calc
    ∫ S, f S ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => D) =
        ∫ r, ∫ x, F (x, r) ∂D ∂ν := by
      rw [← hFeq, he.integral_comp' F, integral_prod_symm F hFint]
    _ ≤ ∫ r, ∫ x, G (x, r) ∂D ∂ν := by
      apply integral_mono_ae hFint.integral_prod_right hGint.integral_prod_right
      filter_upwards with r
      exact hle r
    _ = ∫ S, g S ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => D) := by
      rw [← integral_prod_symm G hGint, ← he.integral_comp' G, hGeq]

lemma measurable_design_insert
    {Ω Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    {n : ℕ} (i : Fin (n + 1)) (X : Ω → Z) (r : Fin n → Ω) :
    Measurable[MeasurableSpace.comap X inferInstance]
      (fun (x : Ω) (k : Fin (n + 1)) =>
        X ((@Fin.insertNth n (fun _ => Ω) i x r) k)) := by
  have hXm : Measurable[MeasurableSpace.comap X inferInstance] X :=
    measurable_iff_comap_le.mpr le_rfl
  have hins : Measurable (fun z : Z =>
      @Fin.insertNth n (fun _ => Z) i z (fun k => X (r k))) := by
    apply measurable_pi_lambda
    intro j
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst j
      simpa using (measurable_id : Measurable (fun z : Z => z))
    · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Fin.exists_succAbove_eq hji
      subst j
      simpa using (measurable_const : Measurable (fun _ : Z => X (r k)))
  have hc := hins.comp hXm
  convert hc using 1
  funext x j
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · subst j
    simp
  · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Fin.exists_succAbove_eq hji
    subst j
    simp

lemma integrable_mul_of_sq_integrable
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {D : Measure Ω} {f g : Ω → ℝ}
    (hf : AEMeasurable f D) (hg : AEMeasurable g D)
    (hf2 : Integrable (fun x => (f x)^2) D)
    (hg2 : Integrable (fun x => (g x)^2) D) :
    Integrable (fun x => f x * g x) D := by
  have hsum : Integrable (fun x => (f x)^2 + (g x)^2) D := by
    simpa only [Pi.add_apply] using hf2.add hg2
  apply hsum.mono' (hf.mul hg).aestronglyMeasurable
  filter_upwards with x
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
  have hsq := sq_nonneg (|f x| - |g x|)
  nlinarith [sq_abs (f x), sq_abs (g x)]

lemma sq_le_sq_of_abs_le {x C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (h : |x| ≤ C) :
    x ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 := by
  rw [← sq_abs]
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h) (add_nonneg hC (abs_nonneg x))]

lemma sample_linear_noise_bound
    {Ω Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    {D : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure D] {n : ℕ}
    (X : Ω → Z) (hX : Measurable X)
    (e : Fin (n + 1) → Ω → ℝ)
    (heint : ∀ i, Integrable (e i) D)
    (hesqint : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x => (e i x)^2) D)
    (hemean : ∀ i, D[e i | MeasurableSpace.comap X inferInstance] =ᵐ[D] 0)
    (hevar : ∀ i, D[fun x => (e i x)^2 | MeasurableSpace.comap X inferInstance]
      ≤ᵐ[D] fun _ => s)
    (a : (Fin (n + 1) → Z) → (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ))
    (b : (Fin (n + 1) → Z) → ℝ)
    (ha : Measurable a) (hb : Measurable b)
    (Ca Cb : ℝ) (hCa : 0 ≤ Ca) (hCb : 0 ≤ Cb)
    (ha_bound : ∀ (S : Fin (n + 1) → Ω) i, |a (fun k => X (S k)) i| ≤ Ca)
    (hb_bound : ∀ (S : Fin (n + 1) → Ω), |b (fun k => X (S k))| ≤ Cb) :
    (∫ S, ((∑ i, a (fun k => X (S k)) i * e i (S i)) +
          b (fun k => X (S k)))^2
        ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => D))
      ≤ ∫ S, (s * ∑ i, (a (fun k => X (S k)) i)^2 +
          (b (fun k => X (S k)))^2)
        ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => D) := by
  let μ : Measure (Fin (n + 1) → Ω) := Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => D
  let z : (Fin (n + 1) → Ω) → (Fin (n + 1) → Z) := fun S k => X (S k)
  let A : (Fin (n + 1) → Ω) → Fin (n + 1) → ℝ := fun S i => a (z S) i
  let E : (Fin (n + 1) → Ω) → Fin (n + 1) → ℝ := fun S i => e i (S i)
  let T : (Fin (n + 1) → Ω) → Fin (n + 1) → ℝ := fun S i => A S i * E S i
  let B : (Fin (n + 1) → Ω) → ℝ := fun S => b (z S)
  have hz : Measurable z := by
    apply measurable_pi_lambda
    intro i
    exact hX.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)
  have hAmeas (i : Fin (n + 1)) : Measurable (fun S => A S i) := by
    exact (measurable_pi_apply i).comp (ha.comp hz)
  have hBmeas : Measurable B := hb.comp hz
  have hEint (i : Fin (n + 1)) : Integrable (fun S => E S i) μ := by
    simpa [E, μ] using
      (integrable_comp_eval (μ := fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => D) (heint i))
  have hE2int (i : Fin (n + 1)) : Integrable (fun S => (E S i)^2) μ := by
    simpa [E, μ] using
      (integrable_comp_eval (μ := fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => D) (hesqint i))
  have hTint (i : Fin (n + 1)) : Integrable (fun S => T S i) μ := by
    have hi := (hEint i).bdd_mul (hAmeas i).aestronglyMeasurable
      (ae_of_all _ fun S => by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, A, z] using ha_bound S i)
    simpa [T] using hi
  have hT2int (i : Fin (n + 1)) : Integrable (fun S => (T S i)^2) μ := by
    have hcoef : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun S => (A S i)^2) μ := by
      fun_prop
    have hbnd : ∀ᵐ S ∂μ, ‖(A S i)^2‖ ≤ Ca^2 := by
      filter_upwards with S
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_sq]
      simpa [A, z] using sq_le_sq_of_abs_le hCa (ha_bound S i)
    have hi := (hE2int i).bdd_mul hcoef hbnd
    apply hi.congr
    filter_upwards with S
    simp [T, E, pow_two]
    ring
  have hA2int (i : Fin (n + 1)) : Integrable (fun S => (A S i)^2) μ := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound (by fun_prop) (Ca^2)
    filter_upwards with S
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_sq]
    simpa [A, z] using sq_le_sq_of_abs_le hCa (ha_bound S i)
  have hBint : Integrable B μ := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound hBmeas.aestronglyMeasurable Cb
    filter_upwards with S
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, B, z] using hb_bound S
  have hB2int : Integrable (fun S => (B S)^2) μ := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound (by fun_prop) (Cb^2)
    filter_upwards with S
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_sq]
    simpa [B, z] using sq_le_sq_of_abs_le hCb (hb_bound S)
  have hTTint (i j : Fin (n + 1)) : Integrable (fun S => T S i * T S j) μ := by
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simpa [pow_two] using hT2int i
    · exact integrable_mul_of_sq_integrable
        (hTint i).aemeasurable (hTint j).aemeasurable (hT2int i) (hT2int j)
  have hBTint (i : Fin (n + 1)) : Integrable (fun S => B S * T S i) μ := by
    have hi := (hTint i).mul_bdd hBmeas.aestronglyMeasurable
      (ae_of_all _ fun S => by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, B, z] using hb_bound S)
    apply hi.congr
    filter_upwards with S
    ring
  have hdiag (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
      (∫ S, (T S i)^2 ∂μ) ≤ s * ∫ S, (A S i)^2 ∂μ := by
    have hright : Integrable (fun S => s * (A S i)^2) μ := (hA2int i).const_mul s
    have hpi :
        (∫ S, (T S i)^2 ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => D)) ≤
          ∫ S, s * (A S i)^2 ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => D) := by
      apply (integral_pi_le_of_slices i (by simpa [μ] using hT2int i)
        (by simpa [μ] using hright))
      intro r
      let As : Ω → ℝ := fun x => A (i.insertNth x r) i
      have hAsmeas : Measurable[MeasurableSpace.comap X inferInstance] As := by
        have hd := measurable_design_insert i X r
        have hc := (measurable_pi_apply i).comp (ha.comp hd)
        simpa [As, A, z] using hc
      have hAs2int : Integrable (fun x => (As x)^2) D := by
        apply Integrable.of_bound
          ((hAsmeas.pow_const 2).mono hX.comap_le le_rfl).aestronglyMeasurable (Ca^2)
        filter_upwards with x
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_sq]
        simpa [As, A] using
          sq_le_sq_of_abs_le hCa (ha_bound (i.insertNth x r) i)
      have hprod : Integrable (fun x => (As x)^2 * (e i x)^2) D := by
        apply (hesqint i).bdd_mul
          ((hAsmeas.pow_const 2).mono hX.comap_le le_rfl).aestronglyMeasurable
        filter_upwards with x
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_sq]
        simpa [As, A] using
          sq_le_sq_of_abs_le hCa (ha_bound (i.insertNth x r) i)
      have hv := integral_mul_sq_of_condExp_le hX.comap_le
        (hAsmeas.pow_const 2).stronglyMeasurable
        (fun x => sq_nonneg (As x)) hAs2int (hesqint i) hprod (hevar i)
      calc
        ∫ x, (T (i.insertNth x r) i)^2 ∂D =
            ∫ x, (As x)^2 * (e i x)^2 ∂D := by
          apply integral_congr_ae
          filter_upwards with x
          simp [T, E, As, pow_two]
          ring
        _ ≤ s * ∫ x, (As x)^2 ∂D := hv
        _ = ∫ x, s * (A (i.insertNth x r) i)^2 ∂D := by
          rw [integral_const_mul]
    calc
      ∫ S, (T S i)^2 ∂μ ≤ ∫ S, s * (A S i)^2 ∂μ := by simpa [μ] using hpi
      _ = s * ∫ S, (A S i)^2 ∂μ := integral_const_mul s _
  have hmeanB (i : Fin (n + 1)) : ∫ S, B S * T S i ∂μ = 0 := by
    apply integral_pi_eq_zero_of_slices i (by simpa [μ] using hBTint i)
    intro r
    let C : Ω → ℝ := fun x => B (i.insertNth x r) * A (i.insertNth x r) i
    have hCmeas : Measurable[MeasurableSpace.comap X inferInstance] C := by
      have hd := measurable_design_insert i X r
      have ha' := (measurable_pi_apply i).comp (ha.comp hd)
      have hb' := hb.comp hd
      exact hb'.mul ha'
    have hCeint : Integrable (C * e i) D := by
      apply (heint i).bdd_mul
        ((hCmeas.mono hX.comap_le le_rfl).aestronglyMeasurable) (c := Cb * Ca)
      filter_upwards with x
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul (hb_bound _) (ha_bound _ _) (abs_nonneg _) hCb
    have hz0 := integral_mul_of_condExp_zero hX.comap_le hCmeas.stronglyMeasurable
      (heint i) hCeint (hemean i)
    simpa [C, T, E, pow_two, mul_assoc] using hz0
  have hmeanOff (i j : Fin (n + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j) :
      ∫ S, T S i * T S j ∂μ = 0 := by
    apply integral_pi_eq_zero_of_slices i (by simpa [μ] using hTTint i j)
    intro r
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Fin.exists_succAbove_eq hij.symm
    subst j
    let C : Ω → ℝ := fun x =>
      A (i.insertNth x r) i * A (i.insertNth x r) (i.succAbove k) * e (i.succAbove k) (r k)
    have hCmeas : Measurable[MeasurableSpace.comap X inferInstance] C := by
      have hd := measurable_design_insert i X r
      have hai := (measurable_pi_apply i).comp (ha.comp hd)
      have haj := (measurable_pi_apply (i.succAbove k)).comp (ha.comp hd)
      exact (hai.mul haj).mul measurable_const
    have hCeint : Integrable (C * e i) D := by
      apply (heint i).bdd_mul
        ((hCmeas.mono hX.comap_le le_rfl).aestronglyMeasurable)
        (c := Ca^2 * |e (i.succAbove k) (r k)|)
      filter_upwards with x
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      dsimp [C]
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
      have h1 := ha_bound (i.insertNth x r) i
      have h2 := ha_bound (i.insertNth x r) (i.succAbove k)
      calc
        |A (i.insertNth x r) i| * |A (i.insertNth x r) (i.succAbove k)| *
            |e (i.succAbove k) (r k)|
            ≤ Ca * Ca * |e (i.succAbove k) (r k)| := by gcongr
        _ = Ca^2 * |e (i.succAbove k) (r k)| := by ring
    have hz0 := integral_mul_of_condExp_zero hX.comap_le hCmeas.stronglyMeasurable
      (heint i) hCeint (hemean i)
    convert hz0 using 1
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards with x
    simp [C, T, E]
    ring
  have hsumA2 : Integrable (fun S => ∑ i, (A S i)^2) μ :=
    integrable_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hA2int i)
  have hright : Integrable (fun S => s * ∑ i, (A S i)^2 + (B S)^2) μ :=
    (hsumA2.const_mul s).add hB2int
  have hdouble : Integrable (fun S => ∑ i, ∑ j, T S i * T S j) μ :=
    integrable_finset_sum Finset.univ fun i _ =>
      integrable_finset_sum Finset.univ fun j _ => hTTint i j
  have hcross : Integrable (fun S => 2 * ∑ i, B S * T S i) μ :=
    (integrable_finset_sum Finset.univ fun i _ => hBTint i).const_mul 2
  calc
    ∫ S, ((∑ i, a (fun k => X (S k)) i * e i (S i)) + b (fun k => X (S k)))^2
        ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => D) =
      ∫ S, (∑ i, ∑ j, T S i * T S j) + 2 * (∑ i, B S * T S i) + (B S)^2 ∂μ := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards with S
        change ((∑ i, T S i) + B S)^2 =
          (∑ i, ∑ j, T S i * T S j) + 2 * (∑ i, B S * T S i) + (B S)^2
        calc
          ((∑ i, T S i) + B S)^2 =
              (∑ i, T S i) * (∑ j, T S j) + 2 * B S * (∑ i, T S i) + (B S)^2 := by ring
          _ = (∑ i, ∑ j, T S i * T S j) +
                2 * (∑ i, B S * T S i) + (B S)^2 := by
            rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
            simp_rw [mul_assoc]
            rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = (∑ i, ∑ j, ∫ S, T S i * T S j ∂μ) +
        2 * (∑ i, ∫ S, B S * T S i ∂μ) + ∫ S, (B S)^2 ∂μ := by
      calc
        ∫ S, (∑ i, ∑ j, T S i * T S j) + 2 * (∑ i, B S * T S i) + (B S)^2 ∂μ =
            (∫ S, (∑ i, ∑ j, T S i * T S j) + 2 * (∑ i, B S * T S i) ∂μ) +
              ∫ S, (B S)^2 ∂μ := integral_add (hdouble.add hcross) hB2int
        _ = ((∫ S, ∑ i, ∑ j, T S i * T S j ∂μ) +
              ∫ S, 2 * (∑ i, B S * T S i) ∂μ) + ∫ S, (B S)^2 ∂μ := by
          rw [integral_add hdouble hcross]
        _ = (∑ i, ∑ j, ∫ S, T S i * T S j ∂μ) +
              2 * (∑ i, ∫ S, B S * T S i ∂μ) + ∫ S, (B S)^2 ∂μ := by
          rw [integral_finset_sum Finset.univ
              (fun i _ => integrable_finset_sum Finset.univ fun j _ => hTTint i j),
            integral_const_mul,
            integral_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hBTint i)]
          apply congrArg (fun q => q + 2 * (∑ i, ∫ S, B S * T S i ∂μ) +
            ∫ S, (B S)^2 ∂μ)
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          rw [integral_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun j _ => hTTint i j)]
    _ ≤ (∑ i, s * ∫ S, (A S i)^2 ∂μ) + ∫ S, (B S)^2 ∂μ := by
      rw [show (∑ i, ∫ S, B S * T S i ∂μ) = 0 by simp [hmeanB]]
      simp only [mul_zero, add_zero]
      gcongr with i hi
      calc
        ∑ j, ∫ S, T S i * T S j ∂μ = ∫ S, (T S i)^2 ∂μ := by
          rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
          · simp [pow_two]
          · intro j _ hji
            exact hmeanOff i j hji.symm
          · exact fun hi => (hi (Finset.mem_univ i)).elim
        _ ≤ s * ∫ S, (A S i)^2 ∂μ := hdiag i
    _ = ∫ S, s * ∑ i, (A S i)^2 + (B S)^2 ∂μ := by
      rw [integral_add (hsumA2.const_mul s) hB2int, integral_const_mul,
        integral_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hA2int i), Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = ∫ S, (s * ∑ i, (a (fun k => X (S k)) i)^2 +
          (b (fun k => X (S k)))^2) ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => D) := by
      rfl

noncomputable def outer {d : ℕ} (u : Fin d → ℝ) : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ :=
  Matrix.of fun j k => u j * u k

lemma outer_eq_vecMulVec {d : ℕ} (u : Fin d → ℝ) :
    outer u = Matrix.vecMulVec u u := by
  rfl

lemma outer_posSemidef {d : ℕ} (u : Fin d → ℝ) : (outer u).PosSemidef := by
  rw [outer_eq_vecMulVec]
  simpa using Matrix.posSemidef_vecMulVec_star_self (R := ℝ) u

lemma empirical_posSemidef {d n : ℕ} (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, outer (u i)).PosSemidef := by
  exact Matrix.posSemidef_sum Finset.univ (fun i _ => outer_posSemidef (u i))

lemma dot_outer_mulVec {d : ℕ} (u v : Fin d → ℝ) :
    u ⬝ᵥ (outer v).mulVec u = (v ⬝ᵥ u) ^ 2 := by
  have hmv : (outer v).mulVec u = (v ⬝ᵥ u) • v := by
    ext j
    simp only [outer, Matrix.mulVec, Matrix.of_apply, dotProduct, Pi.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul]
    calc
      (∑ x, v j * v x * u x) = ∑ x, v j * (v x * u x) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro x _
        ring
      _ = v j * ∑ x, v x * u x := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = (∑ i, v i * u i) * v j := by ring
  rw [hmv]
  simp only [dotProduct, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  calc
    (∑ x, u x * ((∑ i, v i * u i) * v x)) =
        (∑ i, v i * u i) * ∑ x, v x * u x := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro x _
      ring
    _ = (∑ x, v x * u x) ^ 2 := by ring

lemma psd_cauchy {d : ℕ} {P : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ}
    (hP : P.PosSemidef) (u v : Fin d → ℝ) :
    (u ⬝ᵥ P.mulVec v) ^ 2 ≤
      (u ⬝ᵥ P.mulVec u) * (v ⬝ᵥ P.mulVec v) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := CStarAlgebra.nonneg_iff_eq_star_mul_self.mp hP.nonneg
  rw [hQ]
  have hbilin (a b : Fin d → ℝ) :
      a ⬝ᵥ (star Q * Q).mulVec b = (Q.mulVec a) ⬝ᵥ (Q.mulVec b) := by
    rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec]
    change Matrix.vecMul a (Matrix.conjTranspose Q) ⬝ᵥ Q.mulVec b = _
    rw [Matrix.vecMul_conjTranspose]
    simp
  rw [hbilin u v, hbilin u u, hbilin v v]
  simpa [dotProduct, pow_two] using
    (Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq Finset.univ (Q.mulVec u) (Q.mulVec v))

lemma scalar_one_posDef {d : ℕ} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    (c • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)).PosDef := by
  exact Matrix.PosDef.one.smul hc

lemma ridge_posDef {d n : ℕ} (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ((∑ i, outer (u i)) + c • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)).PosDef := by
  simpa [add_comm] using
    (scalar_one_posDef (d := d) hc).add_posSemidef (empirical_posSemidef u)

lemma scalar_mulVec {d : ℕ} (c : ℝ) (u : Fin d → ℝ) :
    (c • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)).mulVec u = c • u := by
  rw [Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec]

lemma ridge_inverse_quadratic_le {d n : ℕ} (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (v : Fin d → ℝ) :
    c * (v ⬝ᵥ (((∑ i, outer (u i)) +
      c • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹).mulVec v) ≤ v ⬝ᵥ v := by
  let A := ∑ i, outer (u i)
  let H := A + c • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)
  let x := H⁻¹.mulVec v
  have hA : A.PosSemidef := empirical_posSemidef u
  have hH : H.PosDef := by
    simpa [H, A, add_comm] using
      (scalar_one_posDef (d := d) hc).add_posSemidef hA
  have hdet : IsUnit H.det := H.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mp hH.isUnit
  have hHx : H.mulVec x = v := by
    dsimp [x]
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv H hdet, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have hAx : 0 ≤ x ⬝ᵥ A.mulVec x := hA.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg x
  have hAA : 0 ≤ A.mulVec x ⬝ᵥ A.mulVec x := by
    simp only [dotProduct]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_self_nonneg _
  have hcomm : A.mulVec x ⬝ᵥ x = x ⬝ᵥ A.mulVec x := dotProduct_comm _ _
  change c * (v ⬝ᵥ H⁻¹.mulVec v) ≤ v ⬝ᵥ v
  change c * (v ⬝ᵥ x) ≤ v ⬝ᵥ v
  rw [← hHx]
  have hexpand : H.mulVec x = A.mulVec x + c • x := by
    dsimp [H]
    rw [Matrix.add_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  rw [hexpand]
  simp only [add_dotProduct, dotProduct_add, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul,
    smul_eq_mul]
  nlinarith

lemma dot_mulVec_comm_of_posSemidef {d : ℕ}
    {M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ} (hM : M.PosSemidef) (u v : Fin d → ℝ) :
    u ⬝ᵥ M.mulVec v = v ⬝ᵥ M.mulVec u := by
  have ht : M.transpose = M := by
    simpa [Matrix.conjTranspose] using hM.isHermitian.eq
  have hs (i j : Fin d) : M i j = M j i := by
    have h := congrFun (congrFun ht j) i
    simpa using h
  simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec]
  calc
    (∑ i, u i * ∑ j, M i j * v j) =
        ∑ i, ∑ j, u i * (M i j * v j) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = ∑ j, ∑ i, u i * (M i j * v j) := Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ j, v j * ∑ i, M j i * u i := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [hs i j]
      ring

lemma empirical_quadratic_eq_sum_sq {d n : ℕ} (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ)
    (v : Fin d → ℝ) :
    v ⬝ᵥ (∑ i, outer (u i)).mulVec v = ∑ i, (u i ⬝ᵥ v)^2 := by
  have hmv : (∑ i, outer (u i)).mulVec v = ∑ i, (outer (u i)).mulVec v := by
    ext j
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, Finset.sum_apply, dotProduct]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [Matrix.sum_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [hmv]
  have hdot := dotProduct_sum v Finset.univ (fun i => (outer (u i)).mulVec v)
  simp only [Finset.sum_filter, Finset.mem_univ, ↓reduceIte] at hdot
  rw [hdot]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  exact dot_outer_mulVec v (u i)

lemma ridge_sum_coeff_sq_le_leverage {d n : ℕ} (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (v : Fin d → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, (v ⬝ᵥ (((∑ i, outer (u i)) + c •
      (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹).mulVec (u i))^2) ≤
      v ⬝ᵥ (((∑ i, outer (u i)) + c •
        (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹).mulVec v := by
  let A := ∑ i, outer (u i)
  let H := A + c • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)
  let x := H⁻¹.mulVec v
  have hH : H.PosDef := ridge_posDef u hc
  have hInv : H⁻¹.PosSemidef := hH.inv.posSemidef
  have hsymm (i : Fin n) : v ⬝ᵥ H⁻¹.mulVec (u i) = u i ⬝ᵥ x := by
    exact dot_mulVec_comm_of_posSemidef hInv v (u i)
  have hAx : x ⬝ᵥ A.mulVec x = ∑ i, (u i ⬝ᵥ x)^2 :=
    empirical_quadratic_eq_sum_sq u x
  have hEq : H.mulVec x = v := by
    dsimp [x]
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv H
      (H.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mp hH.isUnit)]
    simp
  have hnon : 0 ≤ x ⬝ᵥ x := by
    simp [dotProduct]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_self_nonneg (x i)
  have hlev : v ⬝ᵥ H⁻¹.mulVec v = x ⬝ᵥ A.mulVec x + c * (x ⬝ᵥ x) := by
    calc
      v ⬝ᵥ H⁻¹.mulVec v = x ⬝ᵥ v := dotProduct_comm _ _
      _ = x ⬝ᵥ H.mulVec x := by rw [hEq]
      _ = _ := by
        dsimp [H]
        rw [Matrix.add_mulVec, scalar_mulVec, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_smul]
        rfl
  change (∑ i, (v ⬝ᵥ H⁻¹.mulVec (u i))^2) ≤ v ⬝ᵥ H⁻¹.mulVec v
  simp_rw [hsymm]
  rw [← hAx, hlev]
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg hc.le hnon)

lemma ridge_deterministic_prediction_bound {d n : ℕ}
    (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (test w : Fin d → ℝ) (s : ℝ) :
    s^2 * (∑ i, (test ⬝ᵥ (((∑ i, outer (u i)) + c •
        (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹).mulVec (u i))^2) +
      c^2 * (test ⬝ᵥ (((∑ i, outer (u i)) + c •
        (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹).mulVec w)^2 ≤
      (s^2 + c * (w ⬝ᵥ w)) *
        (test ⬝ᵥ (((∑ i, outer (u i)) + c •
          (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹).mulVec test) := by
  let H := (∑ i, outer (u i)) + c • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)
  let lev := test ⬝ᵥ H⁻¹.mulVec test
  let winv := w ⬝ᵥ H⁻¹.mulVec w
  have hH : H.PosDef := ridge_posDef u hc
  have hInv : H⁻¹.PosSemidef := hH.inv.posSemidef
  have hlev0 : 0 ≤ lev := hInv.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg test
  have hwinv0 : 0 ≤ winv := hInv.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg w
  have hsum : (∑ i, (test ⬝ᵥ H⁻¹.mulVec (u i))^2) ≤ lev :=
    ridge_sum_coeff_sq_le_leverage u hc test
  have hcs := psd_cauchy hInv test w
  have hw := ridge_inverse_quadratic_le u hc w
  have hs2 : 0 ≤ s^2 := sq_nonneg s
  have hww : 0 ≤ w ⬝ᵥ w := by
    simp [dotProduct]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_self_nonneg (w i)
  have hbias : c^2 * (test ⬝ᵥ H⁻¹.mulVec w)^2 ≤
      c * (w ⬝ᵥ w) * lev := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcs (sq_nonneg c)
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw (mul_nonneg hc.le hlev0)
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hlev0 hwinv0]
  dsimp [H] at hsum hcs hw ⊢
  dsimp [lev, winv, H] at hlev0 hbias
  calc
    _ ≤ s^2 * (test ⬝ᵥ (((∑ i, outer (u i)) + c •
        (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹).mulVec test) +
      c * (w ⬝ᵥ w) * (test ⬝ᵥ (((∑ i, outer (u i)) + c •
        (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹).mulVec test) := by gcongr
    _ = _ := by ring

lemma ridge_abs_bilinear_le {d n : ℕ} (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (v w : Fin d → ℝ) :
    |v ⬝ᵥ (((∑ i, outer (u i)) + c •
      (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹).mulVec w| ≤
      ((v ⬝ᵥ v) + (w ⬝ᵥ w)) / (2 * c) := by
  let H := (∑ i, outer (u i)) + c • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)
  let xv := v ⬝ᵥ H⁻¹.mulVec v
  let xw := w ⬝ᵥ H⁻¹.mulVec w
  let z := v ⬝ᵥ H⁻¹.mulVec w
  have hH : H.PosDef := ridge_posDef u hc
  have hInv : H⁻¹.PosSemidef := hH.inv.posSemidef
  have hv0 : 0 ≤ xv := hInv.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg v
  have hw0 : 0 ≤ xw := hInv.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg w
  have hz := psd_cauchy hInv v w
  have hv := ridge_inverse_quadratic_le u hc v
  have hw := ridge_inverse_quadratic_le u hc w
  have ham : 2 * |z| ≤ xv + xw := by
    have hsq : |z|^2 ≤ xv * xw := by simpa [sq_abs] using hz
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (xv - xw), sq_nonneg (|z|), mul_nonneg hv0 hw0]
  have hscale : 2 * c * |z| ≤ (v ⬝ᵥ v) + (w ⬝ᵥ w) := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hc.le (sub_nonneg.mpr ham)]
  change |z| ≤ ((v ⬝ᵥ v) + (w ⬝ᵥ w)) / (2 * c)
  rw [le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos (by norm_num) hc)]
  nlinarith

lemma empirical_mulVec_apply {d n : ℕ} (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ)
    (w : Fin d → ℝ) (j : Fin d) :
    (∑ i, outer (u i)).mulVec w j = ∑ i, u i j * (u i ⬝ᵥ w) := by
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  calc
    (∑ k, (∑ i, outer (u i)) j k * w k) =
        ∑ k, ∑ i, outer (u i) j k * w k := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k _
      rw [Matrix.sum_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
    _ = ∑ i, ∑ k, outer (u i) j k * w k := Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ i, u i j * ∑ k, u i k * w k := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k _
      dsimp [outer]
      ring

lemma ridge_scaled_solution {d n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) (r : Fin d → ℝ) :
    (((n : ℝ)⁻¹ • (∑ i, outer (u i)) + lam •
      (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹).mulVec ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ • r) =
      (((∑ i, outer (u i)) + (lam * n) •
        (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹).mulVec r := by
  let q : ℝ := n
  let A := ∑ i, outer (u i)
  let M := q⁻¹ • A + lam • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)
  let H := A + (lam * q) • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)
  have hq : 0 < q := by
    dsimp [q]
    exact_mod_cast hn
  have hc : 0 < lam * q := mul_pos hlam hq
  have hA : A.PosSemidef := empirical_posSemidef u
  have hM : M.PosDef := by
    have hs : (q⁻¹ • A).PosSemidef := hA.smul (inv_nonneg.mpr hq.le)
    simpa [M, add_comm] using
      (Matrix.PosDef.one.smul hlam).add_posSemidef hs
  have hH : H.PosDef := by simpa [H, q] using ridge_posDef u hc
  have hHM : H = q • M := by
    dsimp [H, M]
    rw [smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul]
    rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hq.ne', one_smul, mul_comm q lam]
  change M⁻¹.mulVec (q⁻¹ • r) = H⁻¹.mulVec r
  apply (Matrix.mulVec_injective_of_isUnit hH.isUnit)
  nth_rw 1 [hHM]
  rw [Matrix.smul_mulVec]
  have hMinv : M * M⁻¹ = 1 :=
    Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv M (M.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mp hM.isUnit)
  have hHinv : H * H⁻¹ = 1 :=
    Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv H (H.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mp hH.isUnit)
  ext j
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
  rw [hMinv, hHinv]
  simp [q, hq.ne']

lemma ridge_prediction_error_identity {d n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (eps : Fin n → ℝ) (w test : Fin d → ℝ)
    {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) :
    test ⬝ᵥ (((n : ℝ)⁻¹ • (∑ i, outer (u i)) + lam •
      (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹).mulVec
        (fun j => (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, u i j * ((w ⬝ᵥ u i) + eps i)) -
      test ⬝ᵥ w =
      (∑ i, (test ⬝ᵥ (((∑ i, outer (u i)) + (lam * n) •
        (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹).mulVec (u i)) * eps i) -
      (lam * n) * (test ⬝ᵥ (((∑ i, outer (u i)) + (lam * n) •
        (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹).mulVec w) := by
  let A := ∑ i, outer (u i)
  let c : ℝ := lam * n
  let H := A + c • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)
  let noise : Fin d → ℝ := fun j => ∑ i, u i j * eps i
  let resp : Fin d → ℝ := fun j => ∑ i, u i j * ((w ⬝ᵥ u i) + eps i)
  have hnR : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hc : 0 < c := mul_pos hlam hnR
  have hH : H.PosDef := by simpa [H, A, c] using ridge_posDef u hc
  have hresp : resp = H.mulVec w + noise - c • w := by
    ext j
    simp only [resp, H, A, noise, Matrix.add_mulVec, scalar_mulVec, Pi.add_apply,
      Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [empirical_mulVec_apply]
    have hsum : (∑ i, u i j * ((w ⬝ᵥ u i) + eps i)) =
        (∑ i, u i j * (w ⬝ᵥ u i)) + ∑ i, u i j * eps i := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      ring
    rw [hsum]
    have hcomm : (∑ i, u i j * (w ⬝ᵥ u i)) =
        ∑ i, u i j * (u i ⬝ᵥ w) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [dotProduct_comm w (u i)]
    rw [hcomm]
    ring
  have hscaled := ridge_scaled_solution hn u hlam resp
  have hinput : (fun j => (n : ℝ)⁻¹ *
      ∑ i, u i j * ((w ⬝ᵥ u i) + eps i)) = (n : ℝ)⁻¹ • resp := by
    ext j
    rfl
  rw [hinput, hscaled]
  have hHinv : H⁻¹ * H = 1 :=
    Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul H (H.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mp hH.isUnit)
  have herr : H⁻¹.mulVec resp = w + H⁻¹.mulVec noise - c • H⁻¹.mulVec w := by
    rw [hresp]
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_smul]
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hHinv]
    simp
  rw [herr, dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_smul]
  have hnoise : test ⬝ᵥ H⁻¹.mulVec noise =
      ∑ i, (test ⬝ᵥ H⁻¹.mulVec (u i)) * eps i := by
    have hnoisevec : noise = ∑ i, eps i • u i := by
      ext j
      dsimp [noise]
      simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      ring
    rw [hnoisevec]
    change test ⬝ᵥ (H⁻¹).mulVecLin (∑ i, eps i • u i) = _
    rw [map_sum]
    simp_rw [map_smul]
    simp only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply]
    have hdot := dotProduct_sum test Finset.univ
      (fun i => eps i • H⁻¹.mulVec (u i))
    simp only [Finset.sum_filter, Finset.mem_univ, ↓reduceIte] at hdot
    rw [hdot]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [dotProduct_smul]
    simp [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  rw [hnoise]
  dsimp [H, A, c]
  ring

lemma scalar_one_sub_outer_posSemidef {d : ℕ} (v : Fin d → ℝ) (B : ℝ)
    (hv : v ⬝ᵥ v ≤ B^2) :
    (B^2 • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) - outer v).PosSemidef := by
  have hs : (B^2 • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)).PosSemidef :=
    Matrix.PosSemidef.one.smul (sq_nonneg B)
  have ho : (outer v).PosSemidef := outer_posSemidef v
  apply Matrix.PosSemidef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (hs.1.sub ho.1)
  intro x
  change 0 ≤ x ⬝ᵥ (B^2 • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) - outer v).mulVec x
  rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, scalar_mulVec, dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_smul,
    dot_outer_mulVec]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  have hx : 0 ≤ x ⬝ᵥ x := by
    simp only [dotProduct]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_self_nonneg (x i)
  have hcs : (v ⬝ᵥ x)^2 ≤ (v ⬝ᵥ v) * (x ⬝ᵥ x) := by
    simpa [dotProduct, pow_two] using
      (Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq Finset.univ v x)
  nlinarith

lemma inverse_quadratic_antitone_add_psd {d : ℕ}
    {G R : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ}
    (hG : G.PosDef) (hR : R.PosDef) (hRG : (R - G).PosSemidef)
    (v : Fin d → ℝ) :
    v ⬝ᵥ R⁻¹.mulVec v ≤ v ⬝ᵥ G⁻¹.mulVec v := by
  let x := R⁻¹.mulVec v
  let y := G⁻¹.mulVec v
  have hRx : R.mulVec x = v := by
    dsimp [x]
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv R
      (R.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mp hR.isUnit), Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have hGy : G.mulVec y = v := by
    dsimp [y]
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv G
      (G.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mp hG.isUnit), Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have hsymG (a b : Fin d → ℝ) : a ⬝ᵥ G.mulVec b = b ⬝ᵥ G.mulVec a :=
    dot_mulVec_comm_of_posSemidef hG.posSemidef a b
  have hsymR (a b : Fin d → ℝ) : a ⬝ᵥ R.mulVec b = b ⬝ᵥ R.mulVec a :=
    dot_mulVec_comm_of_posSemidef hR.posSemidef a b
  have horder : x ⬝ᵥ G.mulVec x ≤ x ⬝ᵥ R.mulVec x := by
    have hp := hRG.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg x
    rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, dotProduct_sub] at hp
    exact sub_nonneg.mp hp
  have hsquare := hG.posSemidef.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (x - y)
  have hsquare' : 0 ≤ x ⬝ᵥ G.mulVec x - 2 * (x ⬝ᵥ v) + y ⬝ᵥ v := by
    change 0 ≤ (x - y) ⬝ᵥ G.mulVec (x - y) at hsquare
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, dotProduct_sub, sub_dotProduct, sub_dotProduct] at hsquare
    rw [hGy] at hsquare
    have hxy : y ⬝ᵥ G.mulVec x = x ⬝ᵥ v := by rw [hsymG, hGy]
    rw [hxy] at hsquare
    linarith
  have hleft : v ⬝ᵥ R⁻¹.mulVec v = 2 * (x ⬝ᵥ v) - x ⬝ᵥ R.mulVec x := by
    dsimp [x]
    rw [dotProduct_comm v (R⁻¹.mulVec v), hRx]
    ring
  have hright : v ⬝ᵥ G⁻¹.mulVec v = y ⬝ᵥ v := by
    dsimp [y]
    exact dotProduct_comm _ _
  rw [hleft, hright]
  linarith

lemma ridge_le_common_leverage {d n : ℕ} (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ)
    (test : Fin d → ℝ) {c B : ℝ} (hcB : B^2 < c)
    (htest : test ⬝ᵥ test ≤ B^2) :
    test ⬝ᵥ (((∑ i, outer (u i)) + c •
        (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹).mulVec test ≤
      test ⬝ᵥ (((∑ i, outer (u i)) + outer test +
        (c - B^2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹).mulVec test := by
  let R := (∑ i, outer (u i)) + c • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)
  let G := (∑ i, outer (u i)) + outer test +
    (c - B^2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)
  have hR : R.PosDef := by
    simpa [R] using ridge_posDef u (lt_of_le_of_lt (sq_nonneg B) hcB)
  have hAG : ((∑ i, outer (u i)) + outer test).PosSemidef :=
    (empirical_posSemidef u).add (outer_posSemidef test)
  have hG : G.PosDef := by
    simpa [G, add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm] using
      (scalar_one_posDef (d := d) (sub_pos.mpr hcB)).add_posSemidef hAG
  have hdiff : R - G = B^2 • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) - outer test := by
    dsimp [R, G]
    module
  exact inverse_quadratic_antitone_add_psd hG hR
    (hdiff ▸ scalar_one_sub_outer_posSemidef test B htest) test

lemma trace_mul_outer {d : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)
    (u : Fin d → ℝ) :
    Matrix.trace (M * outer u) = u ⬝ᵥ M.mulVec u := by
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.mul_apply, outer, Matrix.of_apply,
    dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring

lemma effective_dimension_tangent {d : ℕ}
    {A K : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hK : K.PosSemidef) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    Matrix.trace ((A + c • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹ * A) ≤
      Matrix.trace ((K + c • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹ * K) +
        c * Matrix.trace ((K + c • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹ *
          (A - K) * (K + c • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹) := by
  let Q := A + c • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)
  let P := K + c • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)
  let H := A - K
  have hQ : Q.PosDef := by
    simpa [Q, add_comm] using (scalar_one_posDef (d := d) hc).add_posSemidef hA
  have hP : P.PosDef := by
    simpa [P, add_comm] using (scalar_one_posDef (d := d) hc).add_posSemidef hK
  have hQmul : Q * Q⁻¹ = 1 :=
    Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv Q (Q.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mp hQ.isUnit)
  have hQinvMul : Q⁻¹ * Q = 1 :=
    Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul Q (Q.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mp hQ.isUnit)
  have hPmul : P * P⁻¹ = 1 :=
    Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv P (P.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mp hP.isUnit)
  have hPinvMul : P⁻¹ * P = 1 :=
    Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul P (P.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mp hP.isUnit)
  have hQP : Q - P = H := by dsimp [Q, P, H]; module
  have hresL : P⁻¹ - Q⁻¹ = P⁻¹ * H * Q⁻¹ := by
    calc
      P⁻¹ - Q⁻¹ = P⁻¹ * (Q * Q⁻¹) - (P⁻¹ * P) * Q⁻¹ := by
        rw [hQmul, hPinvMul]; simp
      _ = P⁻¹ * (Q - P) * Q⁻¹ := by noncomm_ring
      _ = P⁻¹ * H * Q⁻¹ := by rw [hQP]
  have hresR : P⁻¹ - Q⁻¹ = Q⁻¹ * H * P⁻¹ := by
    calc
      P⁻¹ - Q⁻¹ = (Q⁻¹ * Q) * P⁻¹ - Q⁻¹ * (P * P⁻¹) := by
        rw [hQinvMul, hPmul]; simp
      _ = Q⁻¹ * (Q - P) * P⁻¹ := by noncomm_ring
      _ = Q⁻¹ * H * P⁻¹ := by rw [hQP]
  let Rem := P⁻¹ * H * Q⁻¹ * H * P⁻¹
  have hRemEq : Rem = P⁻¹ * H * P⁻¹ - (P⁻¹ - Q⁻¹) := by
    calc
      Rem = P⁻¹ * H * (Q⁻¹ * H * P⁻¹) := by dsimp [Rem]; noncomm_ring
      _ = P⁻¹ * H * (P⁻¹ - Q⁻¹) := by rw [← hresR]
      _ = P⁻¹ * H * P⁻¹ - P⁻¹ * H * Q⁻¹ := by noncomm_ring
      _ = P⁻¹ * H * P⁻¹ - (P⁻¹ - Q⁻¹) := by rw [hresL]
  have hHherm : H.IsHermitian := hA.1.sub hK.1
  have hRemPSD : Rem.PosSemidef := by
    have hz := hQ.inv.posSemidef.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same (H * P⁻¹)
    have hPinvHerm : P⁻¹.IsHermitian := hP.inv.1
    have heq : Matrix.conjTranspose (H * P⁻¹) = P⁻¹ * H := by
      rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hPinvHerm.eq, hHherm.eq]
    rw [heq] at hz
    simpa [Rem, mul_assoc] using hz
  have hRemTrace : 0 ≤ Matrix.trace Rem := hRemPSD.trace_nonneg
  have htraceInv : Matrix.trace Q⁻¹ = Matrix.trace P⁻¹ -
      Matrix.trace (P⁻¹ * H * P⁻¹) + Matrix.trace Rem := by
    have hm : Q⁻¹ = P⁻¹ - P⁻¹ * H * P⁻¹ + Rem := by rw [hRemEq]; module
    rw [hm, Matrix.trace_add, Matrix.trace_sub]
  have hQA : Q⁻¹ * A = 1 - c • Q⁻¹ := by
    have hAQ : A = Q - c • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) := by dsimp [Q]; module
    rw [hAQ, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_one, hQinvMul]
  have hPK : P⁻¹ * K = 1 - c • P⁻¹ := by
    have hKP : K = P - c • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) := by dsimp [P]; module
    rw [hKP, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_one, hPinvMul]
  change Matrix.trace (Q⁻¹ * A) ≤ Matrix.trace (P⁻¹ * K) +
    c * Matrix.trace (P⁻¹ * H * P⁻¹)
  rw [hQA, hPK, Matrix.trace_sub, Matrix.trace_sub, Matrix.trace_smul,
    Matrix.trace_smul]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hc.le hRemTrace]

lemma trace_mul_empirical {d n : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)
    (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) :
    Matrix.trace (M * (∑ i, outer (u i))) =
      ∑ i, u i ⬝ᵥ M.mulVec (u i) := by
  rw [Matrix.mul_sum, Matrix.trace_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  exact trace_mul_outer M (u i)

lemma measurable_matrix_det {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] {d : ℕ}
    (A : Z → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ i j, Measurable (fun z => A z i j)) :
    Measurable (fun z => (A z).det) := by
  simp only [Matrix.det_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  apply Finset.measurable_sum Finset.univ
  intro p hp
  apply Measurable.const_smul
  apply Finset.measurable_prod Finset.univ
  intro i hi
  exact hA _ _

lemma measurable_matrix_inv_entry {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] {d : ℕ}
    (A : Z → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ i j, Measurable (fun z => A z i j)) (i j : Fin d) :
    Measurable (fun z => (A z)⁻¹ i j) := by
  simp only [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, Ring.inverse_eq_inv,
    Matrix.adjugate_apply]
  apply Measurable.mul
  · exact (measurable_matrix_det A hA).inv
  · apply measurable_matrix_det
    intro k l
    by_cases h : k = j
    · subst k
      simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self]
      exact measurable_const
    · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_ne h]
      exact hA _ _

lemma measurable_bilinear_inverse {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] {d : ℕ}
    (A : Z → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ i j, Measurable (fun z => A z i j))
    (u v : Z → Fin d → ℝ) (hu : Measurable u) (hv : Measurable v) :
    Measurable (fun z => u z ⬝ᵥ (A z)⁻¹.mulVec (v z)) := by
  simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec]
  apply Finset.measurable_sum Finset.univ
  intro i hi
  apply ((measurable_pi_apply i).comp hu).mul
  apply Finset.measurable_sum Finset.univ
  intro j hj
  exact (measurable_matrix_inv_entry A hA i j).mul
    ((measurable_pi_apply j).comp hv)

lemma featureCovariance_posSemidef {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {d : ℕ}
    (D : Measure Ω) (ψ : Ω → Fin d → ℝ)
    (hψ : ∀ j, AEMeasurable (fun x => ψ x j) D)
    (hψint : ∀ j k, Integrable (fun x => ψ x j * ψ x k) D) :
    (featureCovariance D ψ).PosSemidef := by
  have hherm : (featureCovariance D ψ).IsHermitian := by
    change Matrix.conjTranspose (featureCovariance D ψ) = featureCovariance D ψ
    ext i j
    simp only [featureCovariance, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.of_apply, star_trivial]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards with x
    ring
  apply Matrix.PosSemidef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg hherm
  intro v
  change 0 ≤ v ⬝ᵥ (featureCovariance D ψ).mulVec v
  let g : Ω → ℝ := fun x => v ⬝ᵥ ψ x
  have hgmeas : AEMeasurable g D := by
    dsimp [g, dotProduct]
    fun_prop
  have hg2int : Integrable (fun x => (g x)^2) D := by
    have hdouble : Integrable (fun x => ∑ i, ∑ j,
        (v i * v j) * (ψ x i * ψ x j)) D :=
      integrable_finset_sum Finset.univ fun i _ =>
        integrable_finset_sum Finset.univ fun j _ =>
          (hψint i j).const_mul (v i * v j)
    apply hdouble.congr
    filter_upwards with x
    dsimp [g, dotProduct]
    rw [pow_two, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    ring
  have heq : v ⬝ᵥ (featureCovariance D ψ).mulVec v = ∫ x, (g x)^2 ∂D := by
    calc
      v ⬝ᵥ (featureCovariance D ψ).mulVec v =
          ∑ i, ∑ j, (v i * v j) * ∫ x, ψ x i * ψ x j ∂D := by
        simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, featureCovariance, Matrix.of_apply]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        ring
      _ = ∑ i, ∑ j, ∫ x, (v i * v j) * (ψ x i * ψ x j) ∂D := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        rw [integral_const_mul]
      _ = ∫ x, ∑ i, ∑ j, (v i * v j) * (ψ x i * ψ x j) ∂D := by
        rw [integral_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun i _ =>
          integrable_finset_sum Finset.univ fun j _ =>
            (hψint i j).const_mul (v i * v j))]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        rw [integral_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun j _ =>
          (hψint i j).const_mul (v i * v j))]
      _ = ∫ x, (g x)^2 ∂D := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards with x
        dsimp [g, dotProduct]
        rw [pow_two, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        ring
  rw [heq]
  exact integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg (g x))

lemma integrable_trace_mul_outer {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {d : ℕ}
    {D : Measure Ω} (ψ : Ω → Fin d → ℝ)
    (hψint : ∀ j k, Integrable (fun x => ψ x j * ψ x k) D)
    (M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun x => Matrix.trace (M * outer (ψ x))) D := by
  have hsum : Integrable (fun x => ∑ i, ∑ j,
      M i j * (ψ x j * ψ x i)) D :=
    integrable_finset_sum Finset.univ fun i _ =>
      integrable_finset_sum Finset.univ fun j _ =>
        (hψint j i).const_mul (M i j)
  apply hsum.congr
  filter_upwards with x
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.mul_apply, outer, Matrix.of_apply]

lemma integral_trace_mul_outer {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {d : ℕ}
    {D : Measure Ω} (ψ : Ω → Fin d → ℝ)
    (hψint : ∀ j k, Integrable (fun x => ψ x j * ψ x k) D)
    (M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) :
    (∫ x, Matrix.trace (M * outer (ψ x)) ∂D) =
      Matrix.trace (M * featureCovariance D ψ) := by
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.mul_apply, outer, featureCovariance,
    Matrix.of_apply]
  rw [integral_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun i _ =>
    integrable_finset_sum Finset.univ fun j _ =>
      (hψint j i).const_mul (M i j))]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [integral_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun j _ =>
    (hψint j i).const_mul (M i j))]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  rw [integral_const_mul]

lemma integrable_trace_centered_empirical
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {d N : ℕ}
    (D : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure D]
    (ψ : Ω → Fin d → ℝ)
    (hψint : ∀ j k, Integrable (fun x => ψ x j * ψ x k) D)
    (M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun S => Matrix.trace (M * ((∑ i : Fin N, outer (ψ (S i))) -
        (N : ℝ) • featureCovariance D ψ)))
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin N => D) := by
  let μ : Measure (Fin N → Ω) := Measure.pi fun _ : Fin N => D
  let q : ℝ := N
  let K := featureCovariance D ψ
  let f : Ω → ℝ := fun x => Matrix.trace (M * outer (ψ x))
  have hfint : Integrable f D := integrable_trace_mul_outer ψ hψint M
  have hcomp (i : Fin N) : Integrable (fun S => f (S i)) μ := by
    simpa [μ] using (integrable_comp_eval (μ := fun _ : Fin N => D) hfint)
  have hsum : Integrable (fun S => (∑ i : Fin N, f (S i)) -
      q * Matrix.trace (M * K)) μ :=
    (integrable_finset_sum Finset.univ fun i _ => hcomp i).sub
      (integrable_const (c := q * Matrix.trace (M * K)))
  apply hsum.congr
  filter_upwards with S
  dsimp [f]
  rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_sum, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.trace_sub,
    Matrix.trace_sum, Matrix.trace_smul]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  simp [q, K]

lemma integral_trace_centered_empirical
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {d N : ℕ}
    (D : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure D]
    (ψ : Ω → Fin d → ℝ)
    (hψint : ∀ j k, Integrable (fun x => ψ x j * ψ x k) D)
    (M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) :
    (∫ S, Matrix.trace (M * ((∑ i : Fin N, outer (ψ (S i))) -
        (N : ℝ) • featureCovariance D ψ))
      ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin N => D)) = 0 := by
  let μ : Measure (Fin N → Ω) := Measure.pi fun _ : Fin N => D
  let q : ℝ := N
  let K := featureCovariance D ψ
  let f : Ω → ℝ := fun x => Matrix.trace (M * outer (ψ x))
  have hfint : Integrable f D := integrable_trace_mul_outer ψ hψint M
  have hcomp (i : Fin N) : Integrable (fun S => f (S i)) μ := by
    simpa [μ] using (integrable_comp_eval (μ := fun _ : Fin N => D) hfint)
  have hcint : Integrable (fun _ : Fin N → Ω => q * Matrix.trace (M * K)) μ :=
    integrable_const (c := q * Matrix.trace (M * K))
  have hpoint (S : Fin N → Ω) :
      Matrix.trace (M * ((∑ i : Fin N, outer (ψ (S i))) - q • K)) =
        (∑ i : Fin N, f (S i)) - q * Matrix.trace (M * K) := by
    dsimp [f]
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_sum, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.trace_sub,
      Matrix.trace_sum, Matrix.trace_smul]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  calc
    (∫ S, Matrix.trace (M * ((∑ i : Fin N, outer (ψ (S i))) -
        (N : ℝ) • featureCovariance D ψ)) ∂μ) =
        ∫ S, (∑ i : Fin N, f (S i)) - q * Matrix.trace (M * K) ∂μ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with S
      exact hpoint S
    _ = (∑ i : Fin N, ∫ S, f (S i) ∂μ) - q * Matrix.trace (M * K) := by
      rw [integral_sub (integrable_finset_sum Finset.univ fun i _ => hcomp i) hcint,
        integral_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hcomp i)]
      simp [μ]
    _ = (∑ i : Fin N, ∫ x, f x ∂D) - q * Matrix.trace (M * K) := by
      apply congrArg (fun z => z - q * Matrix.trace (M * K))
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      simpa [μ] using integral_comp_eval (μ := fun _ : Fin N => D)
        hfint.aestronglyMeasurable
    _ = 0 := by
      rw [integral_trace_mul_outer ψ hψint M]
      simp [q, K]

lemma empirical_effective_dimension_integral_le
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {d N : ℕ}
    (D : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure D]
    (ψ : Ω → Fin d → ℝ) (hψmeas : Measurable ψ)
    (hψ : ∀ j, AEMeasurable (fun x => ψ x j) D)
    (hψint : ∀ j k, Integrable (fun x => ψ x j * ψ x k) D)
    (B : ℝ) (hB : ∀ x, (∑ j, ψ x j ^ 2) ≤ B^2)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    (∫ S, ∑ i : Fin N, ψ (S i) ⬝ᵥ
        (((∑ k : Fin N, outer (ψ (S k))) + c •
          (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹).mulVec (ψ (S i))
      ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin N => D)) ≤
      Matrix.trace ((((N : ℝ) • featureCovariance D ψ +
        c • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹) *
          ((N : ℝ) • featureCovariance D ψ)) := by
  let μ : Measure (Fin N → Ω) := Measure.pi fun _ : Fin N => D
  let A : (Fin N → Ω) → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ := fun S =>
    ∑ k : Fin N, outer (ψ (S k))
  let Q : (Fin N → Ω) → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ := fun S => A S + c • 1
  let K : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ := (N : ℝ) • featureCovariance D ψ
  let P : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ := K + c • 1
  let lev : Fin N → (Fin N → Ω) → ℝ := fun i S =>
    ψ (S i) ⬝ᵥ (Q S)⁻¹.mulVec (ψ (S i))
  have hcoord (i : Fin N) (j : Fin d) :
      Measurable (fun S : Fin N → Ω => ψ (S i) j) := by
    exact (measurable_pi_apply j).comp
      (hψmeas.comp (measurable_pi_apply i : Measurable (fun S : Fin N → Ω => S i)))
  have hAentry : ∀ j k, Measurable (fun S => Q S j k) := by
    intro j k
    simp only [Q, A, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, outer, Matrix.of_apply,
      Matrix.smul_apply]
    apply Measurable.add
    · apply Finset.measurable_sum Finset.univ
      intro i hi
      exact (hcoord i j).mul (hcoord i k)
    · exact measurable_const
  have hlevmeas (i : Fin N) : Measurable (lev i) := by
    apply measurable_bilinear_inverse Q hAentry
    · exact hψmeas.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)
    · exact hψmeas.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)
  have hlev0 (i : Fin N) (S : Fin N → Ω) : 0 ≤ lev i S := by
    have hq : (Q S).PosDef := by
      simpa [Q, A] using ridge_posDef (fun k => ψ (S k)) hc
    exact hq.inv.posSemidef.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (ψ (S i))
  have hlevle (i : Fin N) (S : Fin N → Ω) : lev i S ≤ B^2 / c := by
    have hi := ridge_inverse_quadratic_le (fun k => ψ (S k)) hc (ψ (S i))
    have hb : ψ (S i) ⬝ᵥ ψ (S i) ≤ B^2 := by
      simpa [dotProduct, pow_two] using hB (S i)
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hc]
    simpa [lev, Q, mul_comm] using hi.trans hb
  have hlevint (i : Fin N) : Integrable (lev i) μ := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound (hlevmeas i).aestronglyMeasurable (B^2 / c)
    filter_upwards with S
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hlev0 i S)]
    exact hlevle i S
  have hsumint : Integrable (fun S => ∑ i : Fin N, lev i S) μ :=
    integrable_finset_sum Finset.univ fun i _ => hlevint i
  have hKpsd : K.PosSemidef :=
    (featureCovariance_posSemidef D ψ hψ hψint).smul (Nat.cast_nonneg N)
  have hP : P.PosDef := by
    simpa [P, add_comm] using (scalar_one_posDef (d := d) hc).add_posSemidef hKpsd
  let M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ := P⁻¹ * P⁻¹
  let center : (Fin N → Ω) → ℝ := fun S => Matrix.trace (M * (A S - K))
  have hcenterint : Integrable center μ := by
    simpa [center, M, A, K, μ] using
      (integrable_trace_centered_empirical D ψ hψint M :
        Integrable (fun S => Matrix.trace (M * ((∑ i : Fin N, outer (ψ (S i))) -
          (N : ℝ) • featureCovariance D ψ)))
          (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin N => D))
  have hcenterzero : ∫ S, center S ∂μ = 0 := by
    simpa [center, M, A, K, μ] using
      (integral_trace_centered_empirical D ψ hψint M :
        (∫ S, Matrix.trace (M * ((∑ i : Fin N, outer (ψ (S i))) -
          (N : ℝ) • featureCovariance D ψ))
          ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin N => D)) = 0)
  have hconstint : Integrable (fun _ : Fin N → Ω => Matrix.trace (P⁻¹ * K)) μ :=
    integrable_const (c := Matrix.trace (P⁻¹ * K))
  have hrhsint : Integrable (fun S => Matrix.trace (P⁻¹ * K) + c * center S) μ :=
    hconstint.add (hcenterint.const_mul c)
  have hpoint (S : Fin N → Ω) :
      (∑ i : Fin N, lev i S) ≤ Matrix.trace (P⁻¹ * K) + c * center S := by
    have ht := effective_dimension_tangent
      (empirical_posSemidef (fun k => ψ (S k))) hKpsd hc
    have hleft : Matrix.trace ((A S + c • 1)⁻¹ * A S) =
        ∑ i : Fin N, lev i S := by
      simpa [lev, Q] using
        trace_mul_empirical ((A S + c • 1)⁻¹) (fun i => ψ (S i))
    have hcycle : Matrix.trace (P⁻¹ * (A S - K) * P⁻¹) = center S := by
      dsimp [center, M]
      exact Matrix.trace_mul_cycle P⁻¹ (A S - K) P⁻¹
    change Matrix.trace ((A S + c • 1)⁻¹ * A S) ≤
      Matrix.trace (P⁻¹ * K) + c * Matrix.trace (P⁻¹ * (A S - K) * P⁻¹) at ht
    rw [hleft, hcycle] at ht
    exact ht
  calc
    (∫ S, ∑ i : Fin N, ψ (S i) ⬝ᵥ (((∑ k : Fin N, outer (ψ (S k))) +
        c • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹).mulVec (ψ (S i)) ∂μ) =
        ∫ S, ∑ i : Fin N, lev i S ∂μ := by rfl
    _ ≤ ∫ S, Matrix.trace (P⁻¹ * K) + c * center S ∂μ := by
      apply integral_mono_ae hsumint hrhsint
      filter_upwards with S
      exact hpoint S
    _ = Matrix.trace (P⁻¹ * K) := by
      rw [integral_add hconstint (hcenterint.const_mul c), integral_const_mul,
        hcenterzero]
      simp [μ]
    _ = Matrix.trace ((((N : ℝ) • featureCovariance D ψ +
        c • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹) *
          ((N : ℝ) • featureCovariance D ψ)) := by rfl

lemma effective_dimension_scale {d : ℕ}
    (K : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) (hK : K.PosSemidef)
    {q c : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hc : 0 < c) :
    Matrix.trace ((q • K + c • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹ * (q • K)) =
      Matrix.trace ((K + (c / q) • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹ * K) := by
  let P := K + (c / q) • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)
  let Q := q • K + c • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)
  have hcq : 0 < c / q := div_pos hc hq
  have hP : P.PosDef := by
    simpa [P, add_comm] using (scalar_one_posDef (d := d) hcq).add_posSemidef hK
  have hQ : Q.PosDef := by
    have hqK : (q • K).PosSemidef := hK.smul hq.le
    simpa [Q, add_comm] using (scalar_one_posDef (d := d) hc).add_posSemidef hqK
  have hQP : Q = q • P := by
    dsimp [Q, P]
    rw [smul_add, smul_smul]
    have hcancel : q * (c / q) = c := by field_simp
    rw [hcancel]
  have hQmul : Q * Q⁻¹ = 1 :=
    Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv Q (Q.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mp hQ.isUnit)
  have hPmul : P * P⁻¹ = 1 :=
    Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv P (P.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mp hP.isUnit)
  apply congrArg Matrix.trace
  apply hQ.isUnit.mul_left_cancel
  calc
    Q * (Q⁻¹ * (q • K)) = q • K := by
      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hQmul, Matrix.one_mul]
    _ = Q * (P⁻¹ * K) := by
      rw [hQP, Matrix.smul_mul, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hPmul, Matrix.one_mul]

theorem ch9_ridge_excess_risk_bound
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {𝒳 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝒳] {d n : ℕ}
    (D : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure D]
    (X : Ω → 𝒳) (feat : 𝒳 → (Fin d → ℝ))
    (ψ : Ω → (Fin d → ℝ)) (wstar : Fin d → ℝ)
    (ε : Fin n → Ω → ℝ) (Y : Fin n → Ω → ℝ)
    (what : (Fin n → Ω) → (Fin d → ℝ))
    (lam B σ : ℝ)
    (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hXmeas : Measurable X)
    (hfeatmeas : Measurable feat)
    (hψfac : ψ = fun ω => feat (X ω))
    (hψmeas : Measurable ψ)
    (hψ : ∀ j, AEMeasurable (fun x => ψ x j) D)
    (hψint : ∀ j k, Integrable (fun x => ψ x j * ψ x k) D)
    (hY : ∀ i x, Y i x = linPred wstar ψ x + ε i x)
    (hεint : ∀ i, Integrable (ε i) D)
    (hεsqint : ∀ i, Integrable (fun ω => (ε i ω)^2) D)
    (hεmean : ∀ i, MeasureTheory.condExp (MeasurableSpace.comap X inferInstance) D (ε i) =ᵐ[D] 0)
    (hεvar : ∀ i, MeasureTheory.condExp (MeasurableSpace.comap X inferInstance) D (fun ω => (ε i ω)^2) ≤ᵐ[D] fun _ => σ^2)
    (hiid : ∀ i j, D.map (fun ω => (X ω, Y i ω)) = D.map (fun ω => (X ω, Y j ω)))
    (hB : ∀ x, (∑ j, ψ x j ^ 2) ≤ B^2)
    (hlamB : B^2 < lam * n)
    (hExcInt : ∀ S, Integrable (fun x => (linPred (what S) ψ x - linPred wstar ψ x)^2) D)
    (hOuterInt : Integrable (fun S => ∫ x, (linPred (what S) ψ x - linPred wstar ψ x)^2 ∂D) (Measure.pi fun _ => D))
    (hwhat : ∀ S : Fin n → Ω, what S = ((((n : ℝ)⁻¹) • Matrix.of (fun j k => ∑ i, ψ (S i) j * ψ (S i) k) + lam • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹).mulVec (fun j => ((n : ℝ)⁻¹) * ∑ i, ψ (S i) j * Y i (S i))) :
    ∫ S, (∫ x, (linPred (what S) ψ x - linPred wstar ψ x)^2 ∂D) ∂(Measure.pi fun _ => D)
      ≤ ((Matrix.trace ((featureCovariance D ψ + ((lam * n - B^2) / (n + 1)) • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹ * featureCovariance D ψ)) / n) * (σ^2 + lam * n * (∑ j, wstar j ^ 2)) := by
  classical
  have hn0 : 0 < n := lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hn
  have hnR : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn0
  let t : ℝ := lam * n
  let c : ℝ := t - B^2
  have ht : 0 < t := by
    dsimp [t]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (sq_nonneg B) hlamB
  have hc : 0 < c := by simpa [c, t] using sub_pos.mpr hlamB
  have hlam : 0 < lam := by nlinarith
  let iε : Fin n := ⟨0, hn0⟩
  let U : (Fin (n + 1) → 𝒳) → Fin n → Fin d → ℝ :=
    fun z k => feat (z k.castSucc)
  let V : (Fin (n + 1) → 𝒳) → Fin d → ℝ :=
    fun z => feat (z (Fin.last n))
  let H : (Fin (n + 1) → 𝒳) → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ :=
    fun z => (∑ k, outer (U z k)) + t • 1
  let coeff : (Fin (n + 1) → 𝒳) → Fin n → ℝ :=
    fun z k => V z ⬝ᵥ (H z)⁻¹.mulVec (U z k)
  let bias : (Fin (n + 1) → 𝒳) → ℝ :=
    fun z => -t * (V z ⬝ᵥ (H z)⁻¹.mulVec wstar)
  let a : (Fin (n + 1) → 𝒳) → Fin (n + 1) → ℝ :=
    fun z j => Fin.lastCases 0 (coeff z) j
  let enoise : Fin (n + 1) → Ω → ℝ :=
    fun j => Fin.lastCases (ε iε) (fun k => ε k) j
  have hUmeas (k : Fin n) : Measurable (fun z => U z k) := by
    exact hfeatmeas.comp (measurable_pi_apply k.castSucc)
  have hVmeas : Measurable V := by
    exact hfeatmeas.comp (measurable_pi_apply (Fin.last n))
  have hHentry : ∀ j k, Measurable (fun z => H z j k) := by
    intro j k
    simp only [H, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, outer, Matrix.of_apply,
      Matrix.smul_apply]
    apply Measurable.add
    · apply Finset.measurable_sum Finset.univ
      intro r hr
      exact ((measurable_pi_apply j).comp (hUmeas r)).mul
        ((measurable_pi_apply k).comp (hUmeas r))
    · exact measurable_const
  have hcoeffmeas (k : Fin n) : Measurable (fun z => coeff z k) := by
    exact measurable_bilinear_inverse H hHentry V (fun z => U z k)
      hVmeas (hUmeas k)
  have hbiasmeas : Measurable bias := by
    have hz := measurable_bilinear_inverse H hHentry V (fun _ => wstar)
      hVmeas measurable_const
    exact measurable_const.mul hz
  have hameas : Measurable a := by
    apply measurable_pi_lambda
    intro j
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun k => ?_) j
    · simpa [a] using
        (measurable_const : Measurable (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) → 𝒳 => (0 : ℝ)))
    · simpa [a] using hcoeffmeas k
  have henoiseint : ∀ j, Integrable (enoise j) D := by
    intro j
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun k => ?_) j
    · simpa [enoise] using hεint iε
    · simpa [enoise] using hεint k
  have henoisesqint : ∀ j, Integrable (fun x => (enoise j x)^2) D := by
    intro j
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun k => ?_) j
    · simpa [enoise] using hεsqint iε
    · simpa [enoise] using hεsqint k
  have henoisemean : ∀ j,
      D[enoise j | MeasurableSpace.comap X inferInstance] =ᵐ[D] 0 := by
    intro j
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun k => ?_) j
    · simpa [enoise] using hεmean iε
    · simpa [enoise] using hεmean k
  have henoisevar : ∀ j,
      D[fun x => (enoise j x)^2 | MeasurableSpace.comap X inferInstance]
        ≤ᵐ[D] fun _ => σ^2 := by
    intro j
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun k => ?_) j
    · simpa [enoise] using hεvar iε
    · simpa [enoise] using hεvar k
  have hnorm (x : Ω) : ψ x ⬝ᵥ ψ x ≤ B^2 := by
    simpa [dotProduct, pow_two] using hB x
  let wnorm : ℝ := wstar ⬝ᵥ wstar
  have hwnorm : 0 ≤ wnorm := by
    dsimp [wnorm, dotProduct]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => mul_self_nonneg (wstar j)
  let Ca : ℝ := B^2 / t
  let Cb : ℝ := (B^2 + wnorm) / 2
  have hCa : 0 ≤ Ca := div_nonneg (sq_nonneg B) ht.le
  have hCb : 0 ≤ Cb := by dsimp [Cb]; positivity
  have hacoeff (S : Fin (n + 1) → Ω) (k : Fin n) :
      |coeff (fun j => X (S j)) k| ≤ Ca := by
    let u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ := fun r => ψ (S r.castSucc)
    let test : Fin d → ℝ := ψ (S (Fin.last n))
    have hr := ridge_abs_bilinear_le u ht test (u k)
    have hnum : (test ⬝ᵥ test) + (u k ⬝ᵥ u k) ≤ B^2 + B^2 :=
      add_le_add (hnorm _) (hnorm _)
    have hden : 0 < 2 * t := mul_pos (by norm_num) ht
    have hfrac : ((test ⬝ᵥ test) + (u k ⬝ᵥ u k)) / (2 * t) ≤ B^2 / t := by
      calc
        _ ≤ (B^2 + B^2) / (2 * t) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum hden.le
        _ = B^2 / t := by field_simp; ring
    simpa [coeff, H, U, V, Ca, t, u, test, hψfac] using hr.trans hfrac
  have habound (S : Fin (n + 1) → Ω) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
      |a (fun k => X (S k)) j| ≤ Ca := by
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun k => ?_) j
    · simpa [a] using hCa
    · simpa [a] using hacoeff S k
  have hbbound (S : Fin (n + 1) → Ω) :
      |bias (fun k => X (S k))| ≤ Cb := by
    let u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ := fun r => ψ (S r.castSucc)
    let test : Fin d → ℝ := ψ (S (Fin.last n))
    have hr := ridge_abs_bilinear_le u ht test wstar
    have hnum : (test ⬝ᵥ test) + (wstar ⬝ᵥ wstar) ≤ B^2 + wnorm := by
      exact add_le_add (hnorm _) (by rfl)
    have hden : 0 < 2 * t := mul_pos (by norm_num) ht
    have hfrac : ((test ⬝ᵥ test) + (wstar ⬝ᵥ wstar)) / (2 * t) ≤
        (B^2 + wnorm) / (2 * t) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum hden.le
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hr.trans hfrac) ht.le
    have heq : t * ((B^2 + wnorm) / (2 * t)) = Cb := by
      dsimp [Cb]
      field_simp
    rw [heq] at hmul
    simpa [bias, coeff, H, U, V, t, u, test, hψfac, abs_mul,
      abs_of_pos ht] using hmul
  have hsample := sample_linear_noise_bound X hXmeas enoise henoiseint
    henoisesqint henoisemean henoisevar a bias hameas hbiasmeas Ca Cb hCa hCb
    habound hbbound
  let train : (Fin (n + 1) → Ω) → Fin n → Ω :=
    fun S k => S k.castSucc
  let noiseTerm : (Fin (n + 1) → Ω) → ℝ := fun S =>
    (∑ j, a (fun k => X (S k)) j * enoise j (S j)) +
      bias (fun k => X (S k))
  let loss : (Fin (n + 1) → Ω) → ℝ := fun S =>
    (linPred (what (train S)) ψ (S (Fin.last n)) -
      linPred wstar ψ (S (Fin.last n)))^2
  have hpredict (S : Fin (n + 1) → Ω) :
      linPred (what (train S)) ψ (S (Fin.last n)) -
          linPred wstar ψ (S (Fin.last n)) = noiseTerm S := by
    let u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ := fun k => ψ (S k.castSucc)
    let epsv : Fin n → ℝ := fun k => ε k (S k.castSucc)
    let test : Fin d → ℝ := ψ (S (Fin.last n))
    have hr := ridge_prediction_error_identity hn0 u epsv wstar test hlam
    have hmat : Matrix.of (fun j k =>
        ∑ i, ψ ((train S) i) j * ψ ((train S) i) k) =
        ∑ i, outer (u i) := by
      ext j k
      simp [Matrix.sum_apply, outer, train, u]
    rw [hwhat (train S), hmat]
    simp_rw [hY]
    simp only [linPred]
    change
      (((((n : ℝ)⁻¹ • (∑ i, outer (u i)) + lam •
          (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹).mulVec
            (fun j => (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, u i j *
              ((wstar ⬝ᵥ u i) + epsv i))) ⬝ᵥ test) -
        (wstar ⬝ᵥ test) = noiseTerm S
    rw [dotProduct_comm _ test, dotProduct_comm wstar test]
    rw [hr]
    dsimp [noiseTerm]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    simp [noiseTerm, a, enoise, coeff, bias, H, U, V, train, u, epsv,
      test, t, hY, hψfac]
    ring
  have hloss (S : Fin (n + 1) → Ω) : loss S = (noiseTerm S)^2 := by
    simp only [loss]
    rw [hpredict S]
  let μp : Measure (Fin (n + 1) → Ω) :=
    Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => D
  let zdesign : (Fin (n + 1) → Ω) → Fin (n + 1) → 𝒳 :=
    fun S k => X (S k)
  let varTerm : (Fin (n + 1) → Ω) → ℝ := fun S =>
    σ^2 * ∑ j, (a (zdesign S) j)^2 + (bias (zdesign S))^2
  have hzdesign : Measurable zdesign := by
    apply measurable_pi_lambda
    intro j
    exact hXmeas.comp (measurable_pi_apply j)
  have haeval (j : Fin (n + 1)) : Measurable (fun S => a (zdesign S) j) :=
    (measurable_pi_apply j).comp (hameas.comp hzdesign)
  have hbiaseval : Measurable (fun S => bias (zdesign S)) :=
    hbiasmeas.comp hzdesign
  have ha2int (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
      Integrable (fun S => (a (zdesign S) j)^2) μp := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound ((haeval j).pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable (Ca^2)
    filter_upwards with S
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_sq]
    exact sq_le_sq_of_abs_le hCa (by simpa [zdesign] using habound S j)
  have hb2int : Integrable (fun S => (bias (zdesign S))^2) μp := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound (hbiaseval.pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable (Cb^2)
    filter_upwards with S
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_sq]
    exact sq_le_sq_of_abs_le hCb (by simpa [zdesign] using hbbound S)
  have hvarint : Integrable varTerm μp := by
    exact ((integrable_finset_sum Finset.univ fun j _ => ha2int j).const_mul
      (σ^2)).add hb2int
  let common : (Fin (n + 1) → Ω) → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ :=
    fun S => (∑ j, outer (ψ (S j))) + c • 1
  let lev : Fin (n + 1) → (Fin (n + 1) → Ω) → ℝ :=
    fun i S => ψ (S i) ⬝ᵥ (common S)⁻¹.mulVec (ψ (S i))
  have hcommonentry : ∀ j k, Measurable (fun S => common S j k) := by
    intro j k
    simp only [common, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, outer, Matrix.of_apply,
      Matrix.smul_apply]
    apply Measurable.add
    · apply Finset.measurable_sum Finset.univ
      intro i hi
      exact ((measurable_pi_apply j).comp (hψmeas.comp (measurable_pi_apply i))).mul
        ((measurable_pi_apply k).comp (hψmeas.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)))
    · exact measurable_const
  have hlevmeas (i : Fin (n + 1)) : Measurable (lev i) := by
    exact measurable_bilinear_inverse common hcommonentry
      (fun S => ψ (S i)) (fun S => ψ (S i))
      (hψmeas.comp (measurable_pi_apply i))
      (hψmeas.comp (measurable_pi_apply i))
  have hlev0 (i : Fin (n + 1)) (S : Fin (n + 1) → Ω) : 0 ≤ lev i S := by
    have hq : (common S).PosDef := by
      simpa [common] using ridge_posDef (fun k => ψ (S k)) hc
    exact hq.inv.posSemidef.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (ψ (S i))
  have hlevle (i : Fin (n + 1)) (S : Fin (n + 1) → Ω) :
      lev i S ≤ B^2 / c := by
    have hi := ridge_inverse_quadratic_le (fun k => ψ (S k)) hc (ψ (S i))
    have hb : ψ (S i) ⬝ᵥ ψ (S i) ≤ B^2 := hnorm (S i)
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hc]
    simpa [lev, common, mul_comm] using hi.trans hb
  have hlevint (i : Fin (n + 1)) : Integrable (lev i) μp := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound (hlevmeas i).aestronglyMeasurable (B^2 / c)
    filter_upwards with S
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hlev0 i S)]
    exact hlevle i S
  let C : ℝ := σ^2 + t * wnorm
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := by
    dsimp [C]
    exact add_nonneg (sq_nonneg σ) (mul_nonneg ht.le hwnorm)
  have hvardet (S : Fin (n + 1) → Ω) :
      varTerm S ≤ C * lev (Fin.last n) S := by
    let u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ := fun k => ψ (S k.castSucc)

    have hform : varTerm S =
        σ^2 * (∑ k, (test ⬝ᵥ (((∑ r, outer (u r)) + t •
          (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹).mulVec (u k))^2) +
        t^2 * (test ⬝ᵥ (((∑ r, outer (u r)) + t •
          (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹).mulVec wstar)^2 := by
      dsimp [varTerm, zdesign]
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
      simp [a, bias, coeff, H, U, V, u, test, t, hψfac]
      ring
    have hbase : varTerm S ≤
        C * (test ⬝ᵥ (((∑ r, outer (u r)) + t •
          (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹).mulVec test) := by
      rw [hform]
      simpa [C, wnorm] using hd
    have hcommonEq : common S =
        (∑ k, outer (u k)) + outer test +
          (t - B^2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) := by
      dsimp [common]
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    have hr := ridge_le_common_leverage u test (c := t) (B := B)
      hlamB (hnorm (S (Fin.last n)))
    have hr' :
        test ⬝ᵥ (((∑ r, outer (u r)) + t •
          (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹).mulVec test ≤
          lev (Fin.last n) S := by
      rw [show lev (Fin.last n) S =
          test ⬝ᵥ (common S)⁻¹.mulVec test by rfl, hcommonEq]
      exact hr

  have hsampleLoss : (∫ S, loss S ∂μp) ≤ ∫ S, varTerm S ∂μp := by
    calc

    exact hvardet S

  have hnoiseAE : AEStronglyMeasurable noiseTerm μp := by
    have heval (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
        AEStronglyMeasurable (fun S => enoise j (S j)) μp := by

        simpa [μp] using
          (integrable_comp_eval (μ := fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => D)
            (henoiseint j))
      exact hi.aestronglyMeasurable
    have hsumAE : AEStronglyMeasurable
        (fun S => ∑ j, a (zdesign S) j * enoise j (S j)) μp := by
      have hs : AEStronglyMeasurable
          (∑ j, fun S => a (zdesign S) j * enoise j (S j)) μp := by

    exact (hsumAE.add hbiaseval.aestronglyMeasurable).congr
      (ae_of_all _ fun S => by rfl)

    exact (hnoiseAE.pow 2).congr (ae_of_all _ fun S => (hloss S).symm)
  let ν : Measure (Fin n → Ω) := Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => D
  let e : (Fin (n + 1) → Ω) ≃ᵐ Ω × (Fin n → Ω) :=
    MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => Ω) (Fin.last n)
  have he : MeasurePreserving e μp (D.prod ν) := by
    simpa [e, μp, ν] using
      (measurePreserving_piFinSuccAbove
        (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => D) (Fin.last n))
  let F : Ω × (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun z =>
    (linPred (what z.2) ψ z.1 - linPred wstar ψ z.1)^2

    funext S
    have hinit : Fin.init S = (fun k => S k.castSucc) := by
      funext k
      rfl
    simp [F, e, loss, train, MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_apply, hinit]
  have hFsymm : (fun z => loss (e.symm z)) = F := by
    funext z
    simp [F, e, loss, train, MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_symm_apply]
  have hFae : AEStronglyMeasurable F (D.prod ν) := by
    rw [← hFsymm]
    exact hlossAE.comp_quasiMeasurePreserving he.symm.quasiMeasurePreserving

    apply (integrable_prod_iff' hFae).2
    constructor
    · filter_upwards with r
      simpa [F] using hExcInt r
    · have ho : Integrable

        simpa [ν] using hOuterInt
      apply ho.congr
      filter_upwards with r
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with x
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
  have hriskEq :
      (∫ S, (∫ x, (linPred (what S) ψ x - linPred wstar ψ x)^2 ∂D) ∂ν) =

      (∫ S, lev i S ∂μp) = ∫ S, lev (Fin.last n) S ∂μp := by

            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro j hj
            rw [MeasurableEquiv.piCongrLeft_apply_apply
              (e := p) (x := S) (i := j) (β := fun _ => Ω)]
      have hcommon : common (ep S) = common S := by
        dsimp [common]
        rw [hsum]
      simp only [lev, hlast, hcommon]
    calc
      (∫ S, lev i S ∂μp) = ∫ S, lev (Fin.last n) (ep S) ∂μp := by
        rw [hcomp]
      _ = ∫ S, lev (Fin.last n) S ∂μp := hep.integral_comp' _
  have hsumlevint : Integrable (fun S => ∑ i, lev i S) μp :=
    integrable_finset_sum Finset.univ fun i _ => hlevint i
  have hsumEq : (∫ S, ∑ i, lev i S ∂μp) =
      ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ∫ S, lev (Fin.last n) S ∂μp := by
    rw [integral_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hlevint i)]
    simp_rw [hlevsymm]
    simp
  let K : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ := featureCovariance D ψ
  have hK : K.PosSemidef := by
    exact featureCovariance_posSemidef D ψ hψ hψint
  let dbar : ℝ := Matrix.trace (((((n : ℝ) + 1) • K +
      c • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹) * (((n : ℝ) + 1) • K))
  let deff : ℝ := Matrix.trace (((K + (c / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) •
      (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹) * K)
  have hjensen : (∫ S, ∑ i, lev i S ∂μp) ≤ dbar := by
    have hj := empirical_effective_dimension_integral_le
      (N := n + 1) D ψ hψmeas hψ hψint B hB hc
    simpa [lev, common, μp, dbar, K, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hj
  have hq : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
  have hscale : dbar = deff := by
    simpa [dbar, deff] using
      (effective_dimension_scale K hK (q := (n : ℝ) + 1) (c := c) hq hc)
  have hfixed : (∫ S, lev (Fin.last n) S ∂μp) ≤
      deff / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hq]
    calc
      (∫ S, lev (Fin.last n) S ∂μp) * ((n : ℝ) + 1) =
          ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ∫ S, lev (Fin.last n) S ∂μp := mul_comm _ _
      _ = ∫ S, ∑ i, lev i S ∂μp := hsumEq.symm
      _ ≤ dbar := hjensen
      _ = deff := hscale
  have hsum0 : 0 ≤ ∫ S, ∑ i, lev i S ∂μp := by
    apply integral_nonneg_of_ae
    filter_upwards with S
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => hlev0 i S
  have hdeff : 0 ≤ deff := by
    rw [← hscale]
    exact hsum0.trans hjensen
  have hdenom : deff / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ deff / (n : ℝ) := by
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hdeff hnR (by linarith)
  have hriskLoss :
      (∫ S, (∫ x, (linPred (what S) ψ x - linPred wstar ψ x)^2 ∂D)
        ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => D)) = ∫ S, loss S ∂μp := by
    simpa [ν] using hriskEq
  calc
    (∫ S, (∫ x, (linPred (what S) ψ x - linPred wstar ψ x)^2 ∂D)
        ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => D)) = ∫ S, loss S ∂μp := hriskLoss
    _ ≤ C * ∫ S, lev (Fin.last n) S ∂μp := haug
    _ ≤ C * (deff / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfixed hC
    _ ≤ C * (deff / (n : ℝ)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdenom hC
    _ = (deff / (n : ℝ)) * C := mul_comm _ _
    _ = ((Matrix.trace ((featureCovariance D ψ +
          ((lam * n - B^2) / (n + 1)) •
            (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))⁻¹ * featureCovariance D ψ)) / n) *
          (σ^2 + lam * n * (∑ j, wstar j ^ 2)) := by
      simp [deff, K, c, t, C, wnorm, dotProduct, pow_two]

end GraduateLevel

targets.label: ch5_theorem_5_14
targets.statement:
Consider any class \(\mathcal{F} = \{f_1, \ldots, f_d\}\), and assume that for a distribution \(\mathcal{D}\), \(\sup_{f \in \mathcal{F}} \|f\|_{L_2(\mathcal{D})} \leq A\). Then
\[
\ln N(\epsilon,\operatorname{CONV}(\mathcal{F}),L_{2}(\mathcal{D}))\leq\lceil A^{2}/\epsilon^{2}\rceil\ln [e+e d\epsilon^{2}/A^{2}].
\]

nl_proof:
For simplicity, we assume that \(A = 1\). Given any \(f = \sum_{j} \alpha_{j} f_{j} \in \mathrm{CONV}(\mathcal{F})\) with \(\sum_{j} \alpha_{j} = 1\) and \(\alpha_{j} \geq 0\), we can regard \(p_{\alpha}\) as a probability measure on \(\{1, \ldots, d\}\) with \(p_{\alpha}(j) = \alpha_{j}\) (\(j = 1, \ldots, d\)). Now, let \(j_{1}, \ldots, j_{k}\) be \(k\) iid samples from \(p_{\alpha}\), then \(f = \sum_{j} \alpha_{j} f_{j} = \mathbb{E}_{j_{s}} f_{j_{s}}\).
\[
\begin{array}{l}\mathbb{E}_{j_{1},\dots,j_{k}}\left\|\frac{1}{k}\sum_{s=1}^{k}f_{j_{s}}-f\right\|_{L_{2}(\mathcal{D})}^{2}=\operatorname{Var}_{j_{1},\dots,j_{k}}\left(\left\|\frac{1}{k}\sum_{s=1}^{k}f_{j_{s}}\right\|_{L_{2}(\mathcal{D})}\right)\\ =k^{-2}\sum_{s=1}^{k}\operatorname{Var}_{j_{s}}\left(\left\|f_{j_{s}}\right\|_{L_{2}(\mathcal{D})}\right)\\ \leq k^{-2}\sum_{s=1}^{k}\mathbb{E}_{j_{s}}\left(\|f_{j_{s}}\|_{L_{2}(\mathcal{D})}^{2}\right)\leq 1/k.\\ \end{array}
\]
It means that there exists \(j_1, \ldots, j_s\) such that
\[
\left\|\frac{1}{k}\sum_{s=1}^{k}f_{j_{s}}-f\right\|_{L_{2}(\mathcal{D})}\leq 1/\sqrt{k}.
\]
Now, consider
\[
Q_{k}=\left\{\frac{1}{k}\sum_{j=1}^{d}n_{j}f_{j}:\sum_{j=1}^{d}n_{j}=k;n_{j}\geq 0\right\}.
\]
Since \( k^{-1} \sum_{s=1}^{k} f_{j_s} \in Q_k \), we know that \( Q_k \) is an \( 1/\sqrt{k} \) cover of \( \mathrm{CONV}(\mathcal{F}) \). Take \( k = \lceil 1/\epsilon^2 \rceil \), we know that \( Q_k \) is an \( \epsilon \) cover. Moreover, since
\[
|Q_{k}|\leq\left(\begin{array}{c}d+k-1\\ k\end{array}\right)\leq e^{k}(1+d/k)^{k},
\]
we obtain the bound in the theorem.

context.name: definition 5.12
context.statement:
The convex hull of a function class \(\mathcal{F} = \{f(\theta, x) : \theta \in \Theta\}\) is defined as
\[
\operatorname{CONV}(\mathcal{F})=\left\{\sum_{j=1}^{m}w_{j}f\left(\theta_{j},x\right):m>0,\|w\|_{1}=1,w_{j}\geq 0,\theta_{j}\in\Theta\right\}.
\]
We also include the closure of the finite sum functions above with respect to an appropriate topology in the convex hull.

context.name: definition 4.1
context.statement:
Let \((\mathcal{V},d)\) be a pseudometric space with metric \(d(\cdot,\cdot)\). A finite
set \(\mathcal{G}(\epsilon) \subset \mathcal{V}\) is an \(\epsilon\)-cover (or \(\epsilon\)-net) of \(\mathcal{G} \subset \mathcal{V}\) if, for all \(\phi \in \mathcal{G}\), there exists \(\phi' \in \mathcal{G}(\epsilon)\) so that \(d(\phi', \phi) \leq \epsilon\). The \(\epsilon\)-covering number of \(\mathcal{G}\) with metric \(d\) is the smallest cardinality \(N(\epsilon, \mathcal{G}, d)\) of such \(\mathcal{G}(\epsilon)\). The number \(\ln N(\epsilon, \mathcal{G}, d)\) is called the \(\epsilon\)-entropy.
For a function class \(\mathcal{G}\) with seminorm \(L_{p}(\mathcal{D})\) in (3.19), we denote the corresponding \(L_{p}(\mathcal{D})\)-covering number as \(N(\epsilon, \mathcal{G}, L_{p}(\mathcal{D}))\). When \(1 \leq p \leq q\), we have
\[
N(\epsilon,\mathcal{G},L_{p}(\mathcal{D}))\leq N(\epsilon,\mathcal{G},L_{q}(\mathcal{D})).
\]
