  rw [stepKernel, Kernel.lintegral_compProd _ _ _ hF]
  exact Kernel.lintegral_deterministic' (hmeasA n)
    (hF.lintegral_kernel_prod_right'' (η := (stationaryEnv (𝓨 := 𝓨) ν).feedback n))

lemma lintegral_dirac_compProd (a0 : 𝓐) (ν : Kernel 𝓐 𝓨) [IsMarkovKernel ν]
    {F : 𝓐 × 𝓨 → ℝ≥0∞} (hF : Measurable F) :
    ∫⁻ p, F p ∂((Measure.dirac a0) ⊗ₘ ν) = ∫⁻ y, F (a0, y) ∂(ν a0) := by
  rw [Measure.lintegral_compProd hF,
    lintegral_dirac' _ (hF.lintegral_kernel_prod_right' (κ := ν))]

end BanditStep

/-! ### A general one-step supermartingale estimate -/

section OneStep

open Preorder
open scoped ENNReal

/-- Extend a history to an infinite sequence, using `d` after time `n`. -/
def extSeq (n : ℕ) (d : 𝓐 × 𝓨) (h : Iic n → 𝓐 × 𝓨) : ℕ → 𝓐 × 𝓨 :=
  fun i ↦ if hi : i ≤ n then h ⟨i, Finset.mem_Iic.2 hi⟩ else d

lemma extSeq_frestrictLe (n : ℕ) (d : 𝓐 × 𝓨) (ω : ℕ → 𝓐 × 𝓨) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ n) :
    extSeq n d (frestrictLe n ω) i = ω i := by
  simp [extSeq, hi, frestrictLe]

@[fun_prop]
lemma measurable_extSeq (n : ℕ) (d : 𝓐 × 𝓨) : Measurable (extSeq n d) := by
  refine measurable_pi_lambda _ fun i ↦ ?_
  by_cases hi : i ≤ n
  · simp only [extSeq, dif_pos hi]
    exact measurable_pi_apply _
  · simp only [extSeq, dif_neg hi]
    exact measurable_const

theorem lintegral_onestep {nextA : (n : ℕ) → (Iic n → 𝓐 × 𝓨) → 𝓐}
    (hmeasA : ∀ n, Measurable (nextA n)) (a0 : 𝓐) (ν : Kernel 𝓐 𝓨) [IsMarkovKernel ν]
    (d : 𝓐 × 𝓨) (n : ℕ)
    (Φ : (ℕ → 𝓐 × 𝓨) → (𝓐 × 𝓨) → ℝ≥0∞) (W : (ℕ → 𝓐 × 𝓨) → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hΦmeas : Measurable (fun q : (ℕ → 𝓐 × 𝓨) × (𝓐 × 𝓨) ↦ Φ q.1 q.2))
    (hWmeas : Measurable W)
    (hΦdep : ∀ ω ω' : ℕ → 𝓐 × 𝓨, (∀ i, i < n → ω i = ω' i) → Φ ω = Φ ω')
    (hWdep : ∀ ω ω' : ℕ → 𝓐 × 𝓨, (∀ i, i < n → ω i = ω' i) → W ω = W ω')
    (hbound : ∀ ω b, (∫⁻ y, Φ ω (b, y) ∂(ν b)) ≤ W ω) :
    ∫⁻ ω, Φ ω (ω n) ∂(trajMeasure (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA a0) (stationaryEnv ν))
      ≤ ∫⁻ ω, W ω ∂(trajMeasure (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA a0) (stationaryEnv ν)) := by
  set P := trajMeasure (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA a0) (stationaryEnv ν) with hP
  have hPdef : P = Kernel.trajMeasure ((detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA a0).p0 ⊗ₘ
      (stationaryEnv ν).ν0) (stepKernel (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA a0) (stationaryEnv ν)) := rfl
  have hPprob : IsProbabilityMeasure P := by rw [hPdef]; infer_instance
  have hΦfix : ∀ ω0 : ℕ → 𝓐 × 𝓨, Measurable (fun p : 𝓐 × 𝓨 ↦ Φ ω0 p) := fun ω0 ↦
    hΦmeas.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id')
  match n with
  | 0 =>
      have hΦ0 : ∀ ω, Φ ω = Φ (fun _ ↦ d) := fun ω ↦ hΦdep _ _ (by omega)
      have hW0 : ∀ ω, W ω = W (fun _ ↦ d) := fun ω ↦ hWdep _ _ (by omega)
      have e1 : ∫⁻ ω, Φ ω (ω 0) ∂P = ∫⁻ ω, (Φ (fun _ ↦ d)) (ω 0) ∂P := by
        refine lintegral_congr fun ω ↦ ?_
        rw [hΦ0 ω]
      have e2 : ∫⁻ ω, W ω ∂P = W (fun _ ↦ d) := by
        rw [show (fun ω ↦ W ω) = (fun _ ↦ W (fun _ : ℕ ↦ d)) from funext hW0]
        simp
      have hz := lintegral_trajMeasure_zero (X := fun _ ↦ 𝓐 × 𝓨)
        (μ₀ := (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA a0).p0 ⊗ₘ (stationaryEnv ν).ν0)
        (κ := stepKernel (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA a0) (stationaryEnv ν))
        (fun p ↦ Φ (fun _ ↦ d) p) (hΦfix _)
      rw [e1, e2, hPdef, hz]
      calc ∫⁻ p, Φ (fun _ ↦ d) p ∂((detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA a0).p0 ⊗ₘ (stationaryEnv ν).ν0)
          = ∫⁻ y, Φ (fun _ ↦ d) (a0, y) ∂(ν a0) :=
            lintegral_dirac_compProd a0 ν (hΦfix _)
        _ ≤ W (fun _ ↦ d) := hbound _ a0
  | (m + 1) =>
      have key : ∀ ω : ℕ → 𝓐 × 𝓨, Φ (extSeq m d (frestrictLe m ω)) = Φ ω := by
        intro ω
        exact hΦdep _ _ fun i hi ↦ extSeq_frestrictLe m d ω (by omega)
      have hstep := lintegral_trajMeasure_step (X := fun _ ↦ 𝓐 × 𝓨) (μ₀ := (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA a0).p0 ⊗ₘ
          (stationaryEnv ν).ν0) (κ := stepKernel (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA a0) (stationaryEnv ν))
        m (fun q ↦ Φ (extSeq m d q.1) q.2)
        (hΦmeas.comp (((measurable_extSeq m d).comp measurable_fst).prodMk measurable_snd))
      have e1 : ∫⁻ ω, Φ ω (ω (m + 1)) ∂P
          = ∫⁻ ω, Φ (extSeq m d (frestrictLe m ω)) (ω (m + 1)) ∂P := by
        refine lintegral_congr fun ω ↦ ?_
        rw [key ω]
      rw [e1, hPdef, hstep]
      refine lintegral_mono fun ω ↦ ?_
      calc ∫⁻ p, Φ (extSeq m d (frestrictLe m ω)) p
              ∂(stepKernel (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA a0) (stationaryEnv ν) m (frestrictLe m ω))
          = ∫⁻ y, Φ (extSeq m d (frestrictLe m ω))
              (nextA m (frestrictLe m ω), y) ∂(ν (nextA m (frestrictLe m ω))) :=
            lintegral_stepKernel_det hmeasA a0 ν m _ (hΦfix _)
        _ ≤ W (extSeq m d (frestrictLe m ω)) := hbound _ _
        _ = W ω := hWdep _ _ fun i hi ↦ extSeq_frestrictLe m d ω (by omega)

end OneStep

/-! ### Counting functions along a trajectory -/

section Counting

open scoped ENNReal NNReal

variable {K : ℕ}

/-- The number of pulls of arm `a` at times strictly before `n`. -/
def cntω (a : Fin K) (n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) : ℕ :=
  ∑ s ∈ range n, if (ω s).1 = a then 1 else 0

/-- The number of times `s < n` that are among the first `m` pulls of arm `a`. -/
def cntSω (a : Fin K) (m n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) : ℕ :=
  ∑ s ∈ range n, if (ω s).1 = a ∧ cntω a s ω < m then 1 else 0

/-- The sum of the rewards collected at the first `m` pulls of arm `a`, among times `s < n`. -/
noncomputable def smSω (a : Fin K) (m n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ s ∈ range n, if (ω s).1 = a ∧ cntω a s ω < m then (ω s).2 else 0

/-- The sum of the rewards collected from arm `a` at times `s < n`. -/
noncomputable def smω (a : Fin K) (n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ s ∈ range n, if (ω s).1 = a then (ω s).2 else 0

@[simp] lemma cntω_zero (a : Fin K) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) : cntω a 0 ω = 0 := by simp [cntω]
@[simp] lemma cntSω_zero (a : Fin K) (m : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) : cntSω a m 0 ω = 0 := by
  simp [cntSω]
@[simp] lemma smSω_zero (a : Fin K) (m : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) : smSω a m 0 ω = 0 := by
  simp [smSω]
@[simp] lemma smω_zero (a : Fin K) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) : smω a 0 ω = 0 := by simp [smω]

lemma cntω_succ (a : Fin K) (n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) :
    cntω a (n + 1) ω = cntω a n ω + (if (ω n).1 = a then 1 else 0) := by
  rw [cntω, cntω, Finset.sum_range_succ]

lemma cntSω_succ (a : Fin K) (m n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) :
    cntSω a m (n + 1) ω
      = cntSω a m n ω + (if (ω n).1 = a ∧ cntω a n ω < m then 1 else 0) := by
  rw [cntSω, cntSω, Finset.sum_range_succ]

lemma smSω_succ (a : Fin K) (m n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) :
    smSω a m (n + 1) ω
      = smSω a m n ω + (if (ω n).1 = a ∧ cntω a n ω < m then (ω n).2 else 0) := by
  rw [smSω, smSω, Finset.sum_range_succ]

lemma smω_succ (a : Fin K) (n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) :
    smω a (n + 1) ω = smω a n ω + (if (ω n).1 = a then (ω n).2 else 0) := by
  rw [smω, smω, Finset.sum_range_succ]

lemma cntω_congr (a : Fin K) (n : ℕ) {ω ω' : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ} (h : ∀ i, i < n → ω i = ω' i) :
    cntω a n ω = cntω a n ω' :=
  Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s hs ↦ by rw [h s (mem_range.1 hs)]

lemma cntSω_congr (a : Fin K) (m n : ℕ) {ω ω' : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ} (h : ∀ i, i < n → ω i = ω' i) :
    cntSω a m n ω = cntSω a m n ω' :=
  Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s hs ↦ by
    have hs' := mem_range.1 hs
    rw [h s hs', cntω_congr a s (fun i hi ↦ h i (hi.trans hs'))]

lemma smSω_congr (a : Fin K) (m n : ℕ) {ω ω' : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ} (h : ∀ i, i < n → ω i = ω' i) :
    smSω a m n ω = smSω a m n ω' :=
  Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s hs ↦ by
    have hs' := mem_range.1 hs
    rw [h s hs', cntω_congr a s (fun i hi ↦ h i (hi.trans hs'))]

lemma measurableSet_arm (s : ℕ) (a : Fin K) :
    MeasurableSet {ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ | (ω s).1 = a} :=
  (measurableSet_singleton a).preimage (by fun_prop)

@[fun_prop]
lemma measurable_cntω (a : Fin K) (n : ℕ) : Measurable (cntω a n) := by
  unfold cntω
  refine Finset.measurable_sum _ fun s _ ↦ ?_
  exact Measurable.ite (measurableSet_arm s a) measurable_const measurable_const

@[fun_prop]
lemma measurable_cntSω (a : Fin K) (m n : ℕ) : Measurable (cntSω a m n) := by
  unfold cntSω
  refine Finset.measurable_sum _ fun s _ ↦ ?_
  refine Measurable.ite ?_ measurable_const measurable_const
  exact (measurableSet_arm s a).inter (measurable_cntω a s (measurableSet_Iio (a := m)))

@[fun_prop]
lemma measurable_smSω (a : Fin K) (m n : ℕ) : Measurable (smSω a m n) := by
  unfold smSω
  refine Finset.measurable_sum _ fun s _ ↦ ?_
  refine Measurable.ite ?_ (by fun_prop) measurable_const
  exact (measurableSet_arm s a).inter (measurable_cntω a s (measurableSet_Iio (a := m)))

end Counting

/-! ### The exponential supermartingale -/

section Supermartingale

open scoped ENNReal NNReal

variable {K : ℕ}

lemma lintegral_exp_hoeffding (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hrew : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (lam : ℝ) :
    ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (lam * (y - μ[id]) - lam ^ 2 / 8)) ∂μ ≤ 1 := by
  have hsg : HasSubgaussianMGF (fun y : ℝ ↦ id y - μ[id]) ((‖(1 : ℝ) - 0‖₊ / 2) ^ 2) μ :=
    hasSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc aemeasurable_id hrew
  have hmgf := hsg.mgf_le lam
  have hint := hsg.integrable_exp_mul lam
  have hc : (((‖(1 : ℝ) - 0‖₊ / 2) ^ 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) = 1 / 4 := by norm_num
  rw [mgf] at hmgf
  simp only [id] at hmgf hint
  have key : ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (lam * (y - μ[id]) - lam ^ 2 / 8)) ∂μ
      = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y, Real.exp (lam * (y - μ[id]) - lam ^ 2 / 8) ∂μ) := by
    rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal]
    · simp_rw [sub_eq_add_neg (lam * _), Real.exp_add]
      exact hint.mul_const _
    · filter_upwards with y using (Real.exp_pos _).le
  rw [key]
  have h2 : ∫ y, Real.exp (lam * (y - μ[id]) - lam ^ 2 / 8) ∂μ
      = Real.exp (-(lam ^ 2 / 8)) * ∫ y, Real.exp (lam * (y - μ[id])) ∂μ := by
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    congr 1 with y
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    ring_nf
  rw [h2]
  have hfin : Real.exp (-(lam ^ 2 / 8)) * ∫ y, Real.exp (lam * (y - μ[id])) ∂μ ≤ 1 := by
    have h3 : ∫ y, Real.exp (lam * (y - μ[id])) ∂μ ≤ Real.exp (lam ^ 2 / 8) := by
      refine hmgf.trans_eq ?_
      rw [hc]; ring_nf
    calc Real.exp (-(lam ^ 2 / 8)) * ∫ y, Real.exp (lam * (y - μ[id])) ∂μ
        ≤ Real.exp (-(lam ^ 2 / 8)) * Real.exp (lam ^ 2 / 8) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = 1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
  calc ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(lam ^ 2 / 8)) * ∫ y, Real.exp (lam * (y - μ[id])) ∂μ)
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal 1 := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hfin
    _ = 1 := by simp

/-- The exponential weight defining the supermartingale. -/
noncomputable def wgtF (ν : Kernel (Fin K) ℝ) (a : Fin K) (lam : ℝ) (m n : ℕ)
    (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (lam * (smSω a m n ω - (ν a)[id] * (cntSω a m n ω : ℝ))
    - lam ^ 2 / 8 * (cntSω a m n ω : ℝ)))

@[simp] lemma wgtF_zero (ν : Kernel (Fin K) ℝ) (a : Fin K) (lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) : wgtF ν a lam m 0 ω = 1 := by
  simp [wgtF]

lemma wgtF_succ (ν : Kernel (Fin K) ℝ) (a : Fin K) (lam : ℝ) (m n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) :
    wgtF ν a lam m (n + 1) ω = wgtF ν a lam m n ω *
      (if (ω n).1 = a ∧ cntω a n ω < m then
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (lam * ((ω n).2 - (ν a)[id]) - lam ^ 2 / 8)) else 1) := by
  rw [wgtF, wgtF, cntSω_succ, smSω_succ]
  by_cases hc : (ω n).1 = a ∧ cntω a n ω < m
  · simp only [if_pos hc, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Real.exp_nonneg _), ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  · simp only [if_neg hc, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_zero, add_zero, mul_one]

lemma wgtF_ne_top (ν : Kernel (Fin K) ℝ) (a : Fin K) (lam : ℝ) (m n : ℕ)
    (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) : wgtF ν a lam m n ω ≠ ∞ := by
  rw [wgtF]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top

@[fun_prop]
lemma measurable_wgtF (ν : Kernel (Fin K) ℝ) (a : Fin K) (lam : ℝ) (m n : ℕ) :
    Measurable (wgtF ν a lam m n) := by
  unfold wgtF
  fun_prop

lemma wgtF_congr (ν : Kernel (Fin K) ℝ) (a : Fin K) (lam : ℝ) (m n : ℕ)
    {ω ω' : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ} (h : ∀ i, i < n → ω i = ω' i) :
    wgtF ν a lam m n ω = wgtF ν a lam m n ω' := by
  rw [wgtF, wgtF, smSω_congr a m n h, cntSω_congr a m n h]

theorem lintegral_wgtF_le_one (hK : 0 < K) (ν : Kernel (Fin K) ℝ) [IsMarkovKernel ν]
    (hrewards : ∀ a, ∀ᵐ x ∂(ν a), x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (nextA : (n : ℕ) → (Iic n → Fin K × ℝ) → Fin K) (hmeasA : ∀ n, Measurable (nextA n))
    (a : Fin K) (lam : ℝ) (m n : ℕ) :
    ∫⁻ ω, wgtF ν a lam m n ω
        ∂(trajMeasure (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)) (stationaryEnv ν)) ≤ 1 := by
  have hPprob : IsProbabilityMeasure
      (trajMeasure (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)) (stationaryEnv ν)) := by
    rw [trajMeasure]; infer_instance
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    refine le_trans ?_ ih
    set Φ : (ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) → (Fin K × ℝ) → ℝ≥0∞ := fun ω p ↦
      wgtF ν a lam m n ω * (if p.1 = a ∧ cntω a n ω < m then
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (lam * (p.2 - (ν a)[id]) - lam ^ 2 / 8)) else 1) with hΦ
    have hset : MeasurableSet {q : (ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) × (Fin K × ℝ) |
        q.2.1 = a ∧ cntω a n q.1 < m} := by
      have h1 : MeasurableSet {q : (ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) × (Fin K × ℝ) | q.2.1 = a} :=
        (measurableSet_singleton a).preimage (by fun_prop)
      have h2 : MeasurableSet {q : (ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) × (Fin K × ℝ) | cntω a n q.1 < m } :=
        ((measurable_cntω a n).comp measurable_fst) (measurableSet_Iio (a := m))
      exact h1.inter h2
    have hΦmeas : Measurable (fun q : (ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) × (Fin K × ℝ) ↦ Φ q.1 q.2) := by
      refine Measurable.mul ((measurable_wgtF ν a lam m n).comp measurable_fst) ?_
      exact Measurable.ite hset (by fun_prop) measurable_const
    have hcalc : ∀ ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ, wgtF ν a lam m (n + 1) ω = Φ ω (ω n) := fun ω ↦
      wgtF_succ ν a lam m n ω
    calc ∫⁻ ω, wgtF ν a lam m (n + 1) ω
            ∂(trajMeasure (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)) (stationaryEnv ν))
        = ∫⁻ ω, Φ ω (ω n)
            ∂(trajMeasure (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)) (stationaryEnv ν)) :=
          lintegral_congr hcalc
      _ ≤ ∫⁻ ω, wgtF ν a lam m n ω
            ∂(trajMeasure (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)) (stationaryEnv ν)) := by
          refine lintegral_onestep hmeasA ⟨0, hK⟩ ν (⟨0, hK⟩, 0) n Φ (wgtF ν a lam m n)
            hΦmeas (measurable_wgtF ν a lam m n) ?_ ?_ ?_
          · intro ω ω' h
            funext p
            rw [hΦ]
            simp only
            rw [wgtF_congr ν a lam m n h, cntω_congr a n h]
          · intro ω ω' h
            exact wgtF_congr ν a lam m n h
          · intro ω b
            rw [hΦ]
            simp only
            rw [lintegral_const_mul' _ _ (wgtF_ne_top ν a lam m n ω)]
            by_cases hc : b = a ∧ cntω a n ω < m
            · simp only [if_pos hc]
              refine mul_le_of_le_one_right' ?_
              rw [hc.1]
              exact lintegral_exp_hoeffding (ν a) (hrewards a) lam
            · simp only [if_neg hc]
              simp
end Supermartingale

/-! ### Tail bounds and structure of the trajectory -/

section Tail

open Preorder
open scoped ENNReal NNReal

variable {K : ℕ}

theorem measure_tail_bound (hK : 0 < K) (ν : Kernel (Fin K) ℝ) [IsMarkovKernel ν]
    (hrewards : ∀ a, ∀ᵐ x ∂(ν a), x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (nextA : (n : ℕ) → (Iic n → Fin K × ℝ) → Fin K) (hmeasA : ∀ n, Measurable (nextA n))
    (a : Fin K) (lam : ℝ) (m n : ℕ) (L : ℝ) :
    (trajMeasure (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)) (stationaryEnv ν))
        {ω | L ≤ lam * (smSω a m n ω - (ν a)[id] * (cntSω a m n ω : ℝ))
              - lam ^ 2 / 8 * (cntSω a m n ω : ℝ)}
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-L)) := by
  set P := trajMeasure (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)) (stationaryEnv ν) with hPdef
  have hsub : {ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ | L ≤ lam * (smSω a m n ω - (ν a)[id] * (cntSω a m n ω : ℝ))
              - lam ^ 2 / 8 * (cntSω a m n ω : ℝ)}
      ⊆ {ω | ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp L) ≤ wgtF ν a lam m n ω} := by
    intro ω hω
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (Real.exp_le_exp.2 hω)
  have h1 : ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp L) *
      P {ω | ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp L) ≤ wgtF ν a lam m n ω} ≤ 1 :=
    (mul_meas_ge_le_lintegral (measurable_wgtF ν a lam m n) _).trans
      (lintegral_wgtF_le_one hK ν hrewards nextA hmeasA a lam m n)
  have h2 : P {ω | ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp L) ≤ wgtF ν a lam m n ω}
      ≤ (ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp L))⁻¹ := by
    rw [ENNReal.le_inv_iff_mul_le, mul_comm]
    exact h1
  refine (measure_mono hsub).trans (h2.trans_eq ?_)
  rw [Real.exp_neg, ENNReal.ofReal_inv_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]

lemma measurableSet_actionEq (n : ℕ)
    (nextA : (m : ℕ) → (Iic m → Fin K × ℝ) → Fin K) (hmeasA : ∀ m, Measurable (nextA m)) :
    MeasurableSet {q : (Iic n → Fin K × ℝ) × (Fin K × ℝ) | q.2.1 = nextA n q.1} := by
  have : {q : (Iic n → Fin K × ℝ) × (Fin K × ℝ) | q.2.1 = nextA n q.1}
      = ⋃ b : Fin K, ((fun q : (Iic n → Fin K × ℝ) × (Fin K × ℝ) ↦ q.2.1) ⁻¹' {b}) ∩
          ((fun q : (Iic n → Fin K × ℝ) × (Fin K × ℝ) ↦ nextA n q.1) ⁻¹' {b}) := by
    ext q; simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage,
      Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    exact ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨q.2.1, rfl, h.symm⟩, fun ⟨b, h1, h2⟩ ↦ h1.trans h2.symm⟩
  rw [this]
  exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun b ↦
    ((measurableSet_singleton b).preimage (by fun_prop)).inter
      ((measurableSet_singleton b).preimage ((hmeasA n).comp measurable_fst))

theorem ae_action_succ (hK : 0 < K) (ν : Kernel (Fin K) ℝ) [IsMarkovKernel ν]
    (nextA : (n : ℕ) → (Iic n → Fin K × ℝ) → Fin K) (hmeasA : ∀ n, Measurable (nextA n))
    (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂(trajMeasure (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)) (stationaryEnv ν)),
      (ω (n + 1)).1 = nextA n (frestrictLe n ω) := by
  set P := trajMeasure (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)) (stationaryEnv ν) with hPdef
  have hPeq : P = Kernel.trajMeasure
      ((detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)).p0 ⊗ₘ (stationaryEnv ν).ν0)
      (stepKernel (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)) (stationaryEnv ν)) := rfl
  set Φ : ((Iic n → Fin K × ℝ) × (Fin K × ℝ)) → ℝ≥0∞ := fun q ↦
    if q.2.1 = nextA n q.1 then 0 else 1 with hΦ
  have hΦmeas : Measurable Φ :=
    Measurable.ite (measurableSet_actionEq n nextA hmeasA) measurable_const measurable_const
  have hstep := lintegral_trajMeasure_step (X := fun _ ↦ Fin K × ℝ)
    (μ₀ := (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)).p0 ⊗ₘ (stationaryEnv ν).ν0)
    (κ := stepKernel (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)) (stationaryEnv ν)) n Φ hΦmeas
  have hzero : ∫⁻ ω, Φ (frestrictLe n ω, ω (n + 1)) ∂P = 0 := by
    rw [hPeq, hstep]
    refine (lintegral_eq_zero_iff ?_).2 ?_
    · exact (hΦmeas.lintegral_kernel_prod_right'
        (κ := stepKernel (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)) (stationaryEnv ν) n)).comp
        (measurable_frestrictLe n)
    · filter_upwards with ω
      rw [lintegral_stepKernel_det (F := fun p ↦ Φ (frestrictLe n ω, p)) hmeasA
        (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K) ν n (frestrictLe n ω)
        (hΦmeas.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id'))]
      simp [hΦ]
  have := (lintegral_eq_zero_iff
    (hΦmeas.comp ((measurable_frestrictLe n).prodMk (measurable_pi_apply (n + 1))))).1 hzero
  filter_upwards [this] with ω hω
  by_contra hcon
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, hΦ, Pi.zero_apply] at hω
  rw [if_neg hcon] at hω
  exact one_ne_zero hω

theorem ae_action_zero (hK : 0 < K) (ν : Kernel (Fin K) ℝ) [IsMarkovKernel ν]
    (nextA : (n : ℕ) → (Iic n → Fin K × ℝ) → Fin K) (hmeasA : ∀ n, Measurable (nextA n)) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂(trajMeasure (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)) (stationaryEnv ν)),
      (ω 0).1 = (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K) := by
  set P := trajMeasure (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)) (stationaryEnv ν) with hPdef
  have hPeq : P = Kernel.trajMeasure
      ((detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)).p0 ⊗ₘ (stationaryEnv ν).ν0)
      (stepKernel (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)) (stationaryEnv ν)) := rfl
  set Ψ : (Fin K × ℝ) → ℝ≥0∞ := fun p ↦ if p.1 = (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K) then 0 else 1 with hΨ
  have hΨmeas : Measurable Ψ :=
    Measurable.ite ((measurableSet_singleton _).preimage (by fun_prop))
      measurable_const measurable_const
  have hzero : ∫⁻ ω, Ψ (ω 0) ∂P = 0 := by
    rw [hPeq, lintegral_trajMeasure_zero (X := fun _ ↦ Fin K × ℝ)
      (μ₀ := (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)).p0 ⊗ₘ (stationaryEnv ν).ν0)
      (κ := stepKernel (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)) (stationaryEnv ν)) Ψ hΨmeas,
      show (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)).p0 = Measure.dirac (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K) from
        rfl,
      show (stationaryEnv (𝓨 := ℝ) ν).ν0 = ν from rfl,
      lintegral_dirac_compProd (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K) ν hΨmeas]
    simp [hΨ]
  have := (lintegral_eq_zero_iff (hΨmeas.comp (measurable_pi_apply 0))).1 hzero
  filter_upwards [this] with ω hω
  by_contra hcon
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, hΨ, Pi.zero_apply] at hω
  rw [if_neg hcon] at hω
  exact one_ne_zero hω

end Tail

/-! ### Elementary combinatorial facts about the counting functions -/

section CountFacts

open Preorder

variable {K : ℕ}

lemma cntω_mono (a : Fin K) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) {s t : ℕ} (h : s ≤ t) :
    cntω a s ω ≤ cntω a t ω := by
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.range_subset_range.2 h) ?_
  intro i _ _
  positivity

lemma cntω_le (a : Fin K) (n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) : cntω a n ω ≤ n := by
  calc cntω a n ω ≤ ∑ _s ∈ range n, 1 := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ ↦ ?_
        split <;> simp
    _ = n := by simp

lemma cntω_lt_of_pull (a : Fin K) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) {s : ℕ} (hs : (ω s).1 = a) :
    cntω a s ω < cntω a (s + 1) ω := by
  rw [cntω_succ, if_pos hs]
  omega

lemma stopped_cond (a : Fin K) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) (t s : ℕ) :
    ((ω s).1 = a ∧ cntω a s ω < cntω a t ω) ↔ ((ω s).1 = a ∧ s < t) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
    by_contra hcon
    exact absurd (cntω_mono a ω (Nat.le_of_not_lt hcon)) (by omega)
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    exact ⟨h1, lt_of_lt_of_le (cntω_lt_of_pull a ω h1) (cntω_mono a ω h2)⟩

lemma cntSω_stop (a : Fin K) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) {t N : ℕ} (htN : t ≤ N) :
    cntSω a (cntω a t ω) N ω = cntω a t ω := by
  rw [cntSω]
  have h1 : ∀ s ∈ range N, (if (ω s).1 = a ∧ cntω a s ω < cntω a t ω then 1 else 0)
      = (if (ω s).1 = a ∧ s < t then 1 else 0) := by
    intro s _
    exact if_congr (stopped_cond a ω t s) rfl rfl
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h1, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_subset_range.2 htN)]
  · rw [cntω]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s hs ↦ ?_
    rw [if_congr (and_iff_left (mem_range.1 hs)) rfl rfl]
  · intro s _ hs
    rw [if_neg]
    rintro ⟨-, h⟩
    exact hs (mem_range.2 h)

lemma smSω_stop (a : Fin K) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) {t N : ℕ} (htN : t ≤ N) :
    smSω a (cntω a t ω) N ω = smω a t ω := by
  rw [smSω]
  have h1 : ∀ s ∈ range N, (if (ω s).1 = a ∧ cntω a s ω < cntω a t ω then (ω s).2 else 0)
      = (if (ω s).1 = a ∧ s < t then (ω s).2 else 0) := by
    intro s _
    exact if_congr (stopped_cond a ω t s) rfl rfl
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h1, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_subset_range.2 htN)]
  · rw [smω]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s hs ↦ ?_
    rw [if_congr (and_iff_left (mem_range.1 hs)) rfl rfl]
  · intro s _ hs
    rw [if_neg]
    rintro ⟨-, h⟩
    exact hs (mem_range.2 h)

lemma Iic_eq_range (n : ℕ) : Finset.Iic n = Finset.range (n + 1) := by
  ext i; simp [Nat.lt_succ_iff]

lemma pullCount'_frestrictLe (n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) (b : Fin K) :
    pullCount' n (frestrictLe n ω) b = cntω b (n + 1) ω := by
  rw [pullCount'_eq_sum, cntω, ← Iic_eq_range]
  exact Finset.sum_coe_sort (Finset.Iic n) (fun s ↦ if (ω s).1 = b then 1 else 0)

lemma sumRewards'_frestrictLe (n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) (b : Fin K) :
    sumRewards' n (frestrictLe n ω) b = smω b (n + 1) ω := by
  rw [sumRewards', smω, ← Iic_eq_range]
  exact Finset.sum_coe_sort (Finset.Iic n) (fun s ↦ if (ω s).1 = b then (ω s).2 else 0)

lemma empMean'_frestrictLe (n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) (b : Fin K) :
    empMean' n (frestrictLe n ω) b = smω b (n + 1) ω / (cntω b (n + 1) ω : ℝ) := by
  rw [empMean', sumRewards'_frestrictLe, pullCount'_frestrictLe]

lemma cHat_frestrictLe (δ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) (b : Fin K) :
    cHat δ n (frestrictLe n ω) b
      = Real.sqrt (Real.log (2 * ((cntω b (n + 1) ω : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / δ)
          / (2 * (cntω b (n + 1) ω : ℝ))) := by
  rw [cHat, pullCount'_frestrictLe]

end CountFacts

/-! ### The deterministic regret analysis -/

section Deterministic

open Preorder

variable {K : ℕ}

lemma warmup_action (hK : 0 < K)
    {nextA : (n : ℕ) → (Iic n → Fin K × ℝ) → Fin K}
    (hwarm : ∀ n h, n < K - 1 → nextA n h = RoundRobin.nextAction hK n)
    (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) (h0 : (ω 0).1 = ⟨0, hK⟩)
    (hact : ∀ n, (ω (n + 1)).1 = nextA n (frestrictLe n ω))
    (s : ℕ) (hs : s < K) : ((ω s).1 : ℕ) = s := by
  induction s with
  | zero => rw [h0]
  | succ s ih =>
    rw [hact s, hwarm s _ (by omega), RoundRobin.nextAction]
    exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hs

lemma warmup_count (hK : 0 < K)
    {nextA : (n : ℕ) → (Iic n → Fin K × ℝ) → Fin K}
    (hwarm : ∀ n h, n < K - 1 → nextA n h = RoundRobin.nextAction hK n)
    (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) (h0 : (ω 0).1 = ⟨0, hK⟩)
    (hact : ∀ n, (ω (n + 1)).1 = nextA n (frestrictLe n ω))
    (a : Fin K) : cntω a K ω = 1 := by
  have hw := warmup_action hK hwarm ω h0 hact
  rw [cntω]
  have h1 : ∀ s ∈ range K, (if (ω s).1 = a then (1 : ℕ) else 0) = (if s = (a : ℕ) then 1 else 0) := by
    intro s hs
    rw [mem_range] at hs
    refine if_congr ?_ rfl rfl
    constructor
    · intro h; rw [← hw s hs, h]
    · intro h; exact Fin.ext (by rw [hw s hs, h])
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h1, Finset.sum_ite_eq' (range K) ((a : ℕ)) (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℕ))]
  simp [a.isLt]

theorem count_bound (hK : 0 < K) (ν : Kernel (Fin K) ℝ) [IsMarkovKernel ν]
    (T : ℕ) (hKT : K ≤ T) (hT : 0 < T) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    {nextA : (n : ℕ) → (Iic n → Fin K × ℝ) → Fin K}
    (hargmax : ∀ n h a, K - 1 ≤ n →
      empMean' n h a + cHat δ n h a ≤ empMean' n h (nextA n h) + cHat δ n h (nextA n h))
    (astar : Fin K) (hastar : ∀ b, (ν b)[id] ≤ (ν astar)[id])
    (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ)
    (hwarmcount : ∀ b : Fin K, cntω b K ω = 1)
    (hact : ∀ n, (ω (n + 1)).1 = nextA n (frestrictLe n ω))
    (hup : ∀ (b : Fin K) (n : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → n < T → cntSω b n T ω = n →
        smSω b n T ω ≤ (n : ℝ) * (ν b)[id]
          + (n : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (Real.log (2 * K * T ^ 2 / δ) / (2 * n)))
    (hlow : ∀ (m : ℕ), 1 ≤ m → m < T → cntSω astar m T ω = m →
        (m : ℝ) * (ν astar)[id] - smSω astar m T ω
          ≤ (m : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (Real.log (2 * ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / δ) / (2 * m)))
    (a : Fin K) :
    ((∑ s ∈ Ico K T, if (ω s).1 = a then (1 : ℕ) else 0 : ℕ) : ℝ)
        * ((ν astar)[id] - (ν a)[id]) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * Real.log (2 * K * T ^ 2 / δ) := by
  set L := Real.log (2 * (K : ℝ) * (T : ℝ) ^ 2 / δ) with hLdef
  have hKR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (K : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hK
  have hTR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (T : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hT
  have harg : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (K : ℝ) * (T : ℝ) ^ 2 / δ := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hδ]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((T : ℝ) - 1)]
  have hLpos : 0 < L := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  set M := (∑ s ∈ Ico K T, if (ω s).1 = a then (1 : ℕ) else 0) with hMdef
  set Δ := (ν astar)[id] - (ν a)[id] with hΔdef
  have hΔ0 : 0 ≤ Δ := by simp only [hΔdef, sub_nonneg]; exact hastar a
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos M with hM0 | hMpos
  · rw [hM0]
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul]
    linarith
  -- there is a last time in `[K, T)` at which arm `a` is pulled
  set S := (Ico K T).filter (fun s ↦ (ω s).1 = a) with hSdef
  have hcard : S.card = M := by
    rw [hSdef, hMdef, Finset.card_filter]
  have hSne : S.Nonempty := by
    rw [← Finset.card_pos, hcard]; exact hMpos
  set t := S.max' hSne with htdef
  have htS : t ∈ S := S.max'_mem hSne
  have htmem : t ∈ Ico K T := (Finset.mem_filter.1 htS).1
  have hta : (ω t).1 = a := (Finset.mem_filter.1 htS).2
  have hKt : K ≤ t := (Finset.mem_Ico.1 htmem).1
  have htT : t < T := (Finset.mem_Ico.1 htmem).2
  have hmaxS : ∀ s ∈ S, s ≤ t := fun s hs ↦ Finset.le_max' S s hs
  -- the pull count of `a` just before `t` equals `M`
  have hsum_tT : (∑ s ∈ Ico t T, if (ω s).1 = a then (1 : ℕ) else 0) = 1 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem t (Finset.mem_Ico.2 ⟨le_refl t, htT⟩) ?_]
    · rw [if_pos hta]
    · intro b hb hbt
      rw [if_neg]
      intro hba
      have : b ∈ S := Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_Ico.2
        ⟨le_trans hKt (Finset.mem_Ico.1 hb).1, (Finset.mem_Ico.1 hb).2⟩, hba⟩
      have := hmaxS b this
      have := (Finset.mem_Ico.1 hb).1
      omega
  have hMsplit : M = (∑ s ∈ Ico K t, if (ω s).1 = a then (1 : ℕ) else 0) + 1 := by
    rw [hMdef, ← Finset.sum_Ico_consecutive (fun s ↦ if (ω s).1 = a then (1 : ℕ) else 0)
      hKt (le_of_lt htT), hsum_tT]
  have hcnt_t : cntω a t ω = M := by
    have e1 : cntω a t ω = (∑ s ∈ Ico 0 K, if (ω s).1 = a then (1 : ℕ) else 0)
        + (∑ s ∈ Ico K t, if (ω s).1 = a then (1 : ℕ) else 0) := by
      rw [cntω, Finset.range_eq_Ico, Finset.sum_Ico_consecutive _ (Nat.zero_le K) hKt]
    have e2 : (∑ s ∈ Ico 0 K, if (ω s).1 = a then (1 : ℕ) else 0) = 1 := by
      rw [← Finset.range_eq_Ico]; exact hwarmcount a
    rw [e1, e2, hMsplit]
    omega
  -- set up the last round
  obtain ⟨t', ht'⟩ : ∃ t', t = t' + 1 := ⟨t - 1, by omega⟩
  have hKt' : K - 1 ≤ t' := by omega
  have hMT : M < T := by
    have := cntω_le a t ω
    omega
  have hMR : (0 : ℝ) < (M : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hMpos
  have hm1 : 1 ≤ cntω astar t ω := by
    have h1 := hwarmcount astar
    have h2 := cntω_mono astar ω hKt
    omega
  have hmT : cntω astar t ω < T := lt_of_le_of_lt (cntω_le astar t ω) htT
  have hmR : (0 : ℝ) < ((cntω astar t ω : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm1
  -- the algorithm's choice at time `t`
  have hnextA : nextA t' (frestrictLe t' ω) = a := by
    rw [← hact t', ← ht']; exact hta
  have hkey := hargmax t' (frestrictLe t' ω) astar hKt'
  rw [hnextA] at hkey
  rw [empMean'_frestrictLe, empMean'_frestrictLe, cHat_frestrictLe, cHat_frestrictLe,
    ← ht'] at hkey
  rw [hcnt_t] at hkey
  -- the confidence widths
  set γ := Real.sqrt (L / (2 * (M : ℝ))) with hγdef
  have hCa : Real.sqrt (Real.log (2 * ((M : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / δ) / (2 * (M : ℝ))) ≤ γ := by
    refine Real.sqrt_le_sqrt ?_
    have hlog : Real.log (2 * ((M : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / δ) ≤ L := by
      refine Real.log_le_log (by positivity) ?_
      have hMle : (M : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (T : ℝ) := by
        have : (M : ℝ) + 1 ≤ ((M + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; linarith
        have h2 : (M + 1 : ℕ) ≤ T := hMT
        calc (M : ℝ) + 1 = ((M + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
          _ ≤ (T : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h2
      have h0M : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (M : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
      have : ((M : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 ≤ (K : ℝ) * (T : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      rw [div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hδ]
      nlinarith
    gcongr
  -- upper deviation for arm `a`
  have hcntS_a : cntSω a M T ω = M := by
    have h := cntSω_stop a ω (le_of_lt htT); rwa [hcnt_t] at h
  have hsmS_a : smSω a M T ω = smω a t ω := by
    have h := smSω_stop a ω (le_of_lt htT); rwa [hcnt_t] at h
  have hupa := hup a M hMpos hMT hcntS_a
  rw [hsmS_a] at hupa
  have hEa : smω a t ω / (M : ℝ) ≤ (ν a)[id] + γ := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hMR]
    calc smω a t ω ≤ (M : ℝ) * (ν a)[id] + (M : ℝ) * γ := hupa
      _ = ((ν a)[id] + γ) * (M : ℝ) := by ring
  -- lower deviation for the optimal arm
  have hcntS_s : cntSω astar (cntω astar t ω) T ω = cntω astar t ω :=
    cntSω_stop astar ω (le_of_lt htT)
  have hsmS_s : smSω astar (cntω astar t ω) T ω = smω astar t ω :=
    smSω_stop astar ω (le_of_lt htT)
  have hlows := hlow (cntω astar t ω) hm1 hmT hcntS_s
  rw [hsmS_s] at hlows
  have hEs : (ν astar)[id] ≤ smω astar t ω / ((cntω astar t ω : ℕ) : ℝ)
      + Real.sqrt (Real.log (2 * (((cntω astar t ω : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / δ)
          / (2 * ((cntω astar t ω : ℕ) : ℝ))) := by
    rw [← sub_le_iff_le_add, le_div_iff₀ hmR]
    nlinarith [hlows]
  -- combine
  have hΔγ : Δ ≤ 2 * γ := by
    simp only [hΔdef]
    linarith [hkey, hCa, hEa, hEs]
  have hγsq : γ ^ 2 = L / (2 * (M : ℝ)) := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hsq : Δ ^ 2 ≤ (2 * γ) ^ 2 := by
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hΔ0 hΔγ 2
  have hfin : (2 * γ) ^ 2 = 4 * (L / (2 * (M : ℝ))) := by
    rw [mul_pow, hγsq]; norm_num
  calc ((M : ℕ) : ℝ) * Δ ^ 2 ≤ (M : ℝ) * (4 * (L / (2 * (M : ℝ)))) := by
        rw [← hfin]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq (le_of_lt hMR)
    _ = 2 * L := by field_simp; ring

theorem det_regret_bound (hK : 0 < K) (ν : Kernel (Fin K) ℝ) [IsMarkovKernel ν]
    (T : ℕ) (hKT : K ≤ T) (hT : 0 < T) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    {nextA : (n : ℕ) → (Iic n → Fin K × ℝ) → Fin K}
    (hwarm : ∀ n h, n < K - 1 → nextA n h = RoundRobin.nextAction hK n)
    (hargmax : ∀ n h a, K - 1 ≤ n →
      empMean' n h a + cHat δ n h a ≤ empMean' n h (nextA n h) + cHat δ n h (nextA n h))
    (astar : Fin K) (hastar : ∀ b, (ν b)[id] ≤ (ν astar)[id])
    (ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ)
    (h0 : (ω 0).1 = ⟨0, hK⟩)
    (hact : ∀ n, (ω (n + 1)).1 = nextA n (frestrictLe n ω))
    (hup : ∀ (b : Fin K) (n : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → n < T → cntSω b n T ω = n →
        smSω b n T ω ≤ (n : ℝ) * (ν b)[id]
          + (n : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (Real.log (2 * K * T ^ 2 / δ) / (2 * n)))
    (hlow : ∀ (m : ℕ), 1 ≤ m → m < T → cntSω astar m T ω = m →
        (m : ℝ) * (ν astar)[id] - smSω astar m T ω
          ≤ (m : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (Real.log (2 * ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / δ) / (2 * m))) :
    regret ν (fun s ω ↦ (ω s).1) T ω ≤
      (⨅ Δ₀ : {x : ℝ // 0 < x},
        ((T : ℝ) - K) * (Δ₀ : ℝ) +
          ∑ a : Fin K,
            Set.indicator {a' : Fin K | (Δ₀ : ℝ) < gap ν a'}
              (fun a' ↦ 2 * Real.log (2 * K * T ^ 2 / δ) / gap ν a') a)
      + ∑ a : Fin K, gap ν a := by
  have hwarmcount := warmup_count hK hwarm ω h0 hact
  have : Nonempty (Fin K) := Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp hK
  have hsup : (⨆ i, (ν i)[id]) = (ν astar)[id] := by
    refine le_antisymm (ciSup_le hastar) ?_
    exact le_ciSup (f := fun i : Fin K ↦ (ν i)[id])
      (Set.Finite.bddAbove (Set.finite_range _)) astar
  have hgap : ∀ b : Fin K, gap ν b = (ν astar)[id] - (ν b)[id] := by
    intro b; rw [gap, hsup]
  have hgap0 : ∀ b : Fin K, 0 ≤ gap ν b := by
    intro b; rw [hgap]; linarith [hastar b]
  set Mn : Fin K → ℕ := fun b ↦ ∑ s ∈ Ico K T, if (ω s).1 = b then 1 else 0 with hMndef
  -- regret as a sum of gaps
  have hreg : regret ν (fun s ω ↦ (ω s).1) T ω = ∑ s ∈ range T, gap ν ((ω s).1) := by
    rw [regret]
    simp only [gap]
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
  -- the warm-up phase
  have hwarmsum : ∑ s ∈ range K, gap ν ((ω s).1) = ∑ a : Fin K, gap ν a := by
    have hw := warmup_action hK hwarm ω h0 hact
    have e1 : ∀ s ∈ range K, gap ν ((ω s).1)
        = (fun s : ℕ ↦ if h : s < K then gap ν ⟨s, h⟩ else 0) s := by
      intro s hs
      rw [mem_range] at hs
      simp only [dif_pos hs]
      congr 1
      exact Fin.ext (hw s hs)
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl e1,
      ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun s : ℕ ↦ if h : s < K then gap ν ⟨s, h⟩ else 0) K]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ ↦ ?_
    simp only [dif_pos b.isLt, Fin.eta]
  -- the exploitation phase, decomposed over arms
  have hexploit : ∑ s ∈ Ico K T, gap ν ((ω s).1)
      = ∑ b : Fin K, ((Mn b : ℕ) : ℝ) * gap ν b := by
    have e1 : ∀ s ∈ Ico K T, gap ν ((ω s).1)
        = ∑ b : Fin K, (if (ω s).1 = b then gap ν b else 0) := by
      intro s _
      rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq univ ((ω s).1) (fun b ↦ gap ν b)]
      simp
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl e1, Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ ↦ ?_
    rw [hMndef]
    push_cast
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ ↦ ?_
    split <;> simp
  have hcount : ∑ b : Fin K, ((Mn b : ℕ) : ℝ) = (T : ℝ) - K := by
    have e1 : ∑ b : Fin K, (Mn b : ℕ) = T - K := by
      rw [hMndef]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      have : ∀ s ∈ Ico K T, (∑ b : Fin K, if (ω s).1 = b then (1 : ℕ) else 0) = 1 := by
        intro s _
        rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq univ ((ω s).1) (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℕ))]
        simp
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl this]
      simp
    calc ∑ b : Fin K, ((Mn b : ℕ) : ℝ) = ((∑ b : Fin K, (Mn b : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
      _ = ((T - K : ℕ) : ℝ) := by rw [e1]
      _ = (T : ℝ) - K := by
          exact Nat.cast_sub hKT
  -- the key bound for each `Δ₀`
  have hbound : ∀ Δ₀ : {x : ℝ // 0 < x},
      ∑ b : Fin K, ((Mn b : ℕ) : ℝ) * gap ν b ≤
        ((T : ℝ) - K) * (Δ₀ : ℝ) +
          ∑ a : Fin K,
            Set.indicator {a' : Fin K | (Δ₀ : ℝ) < gap ν a'}
              (fun a' ↦ 2 * Real.log (2 * K * T ^ 2 / δ) / gap ν a') a := by
    intro Δ₀
    have hstep : ∀ b : Fin K, ((Mn b : ℕ) : ℝ) * gap ν b ≤
        (Δ₀ : ℝ) * ((Mn b : ℕ) : ℝ) +
          Set.indicator {a' : Fin K | (Δ₀ : ℝ) < gap ν a'}
            (fun a' ↦ 2 * Real.log (2 * K * T ^ 2 / δ) / gap ν a') b := by
      intro b
      have hMn0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((Mn b : ℕ) : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
      by_cases hb : (Δ₀ : ℝ) < gap ν b
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (show b ∈ {a' : Fin K | (Δ₀ : ℝ) < gap ν a'} from hb)]
        have hgb : 0 < gap ν b := lt_trans Δ₀.2 hb
        have hcb := count_bound hK ν T hKT hT δ hδ hδ1 hargmax astar hastar ω hwarmcount hact
          hup hlow b
        rw [← hgap b] at hcb
        have h2 : ((Mn b : ℕ) : ℝ) * gap ν b
            ≤ 2 * Real.log (2 * K * T ^ 2 / δ) / gap ν b := by
          rw [le_div_iff₀ hgb]
          calc ((Mn b : ℕ) : ℝ) * gap ν b * gap ν b
              = ((Mn b : ℕ) : ℝ) * gap ν b ^ 2 := by ring
            _ ≤ 2 * Real.log (2 * K * T ^ 2 / δ) := hcb
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (le_of_lt Δ₀.2) hMn0]
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (show b ∉ {a' : Fin K | (Δ₀ : ℝ) < gap ν a'} from hb)]
        push_neg at hb
        nlinarith
    calc ∑ b : Fin K, ((Mn b : ℕ) : ℝ) * gap ν b
        ≤ ∑ b : Fin K, ((Δ₀ : ℝ) * ((Mn b : ℕ) : ℝ) +
            Set.indicator {a' : Fin K | (Δ₀ : ℝ) < gap ν a'}
              (fun a' ↦ 2 * Real.log (2 * K * T ^ 2 / δ) / gap ν a') b) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ ↦ hstep b
      _ = (Δ₀ : ℝ) * ((T : ℝ) - K) +
            ∑ a : Fin K, Set.indicator {a' : Fin K | (Δ₀ : ℝ) < gap ν a'}
              (fun a' ↦ 2 * Real.log (2 * K * T ^ 2 / δ) / gap ν a') a := by
          rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, hcount]
      _ = ((T : ℝ) - K) * (Δ₀ : ℝ) +
            ∑ a : Fin K, Set.indicator {a' : Fin K | (Δ₀ : ℝ) < gap ν a'}
              (fun a' ↦ 2 * Real.log (2 * K * T ^ 2 / δ) / gap ν a') a := by
          rw [mul_comm]
  have hinf : ∑ b : Fin K, ((Mn b : ℕ) : ℝ) * gap ν b ≤
      ⨅ Δ₀ : {x : ℝ // 0 < x},
        ((T : ℝ) - K) * (Δ₀ : ℝ) +
          ∑ a : Fin K,
            Set.indicator {a' : Fin K | (Δ₀ : ℝ) < gap ν a'}
              (fun a' ↦ 2 * Real.log (2 * K * T ^ 2 / δ) / gap ν a') a := le_ciInf hbound
  have hsplit : ∑ s ∈ range T, gap ν ((ω s).1)
      = (∑ s ∈ range K, gap ν ((ω s).1)) + ∑ s ∈ Ico K T, gap ν ((ω s).1) := by
    rw [Finset.range_eq_Ico, Finset.sum_Ico_consecutive _ (Nat.zero_le K) hKT]
  rw [hreg, hsplit, hwarmsum, hexploit]
  linarith

end Deterministic

/-! ### A telescoping estimate -/

lemma sum_inv_sq_le (T : ℕ) : ∑ m ∈ Ico 1 T, (1 : ℝ) / ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge T 1 with h | h
  · have : T = 0 := by omega
    simp [this]
  · have key : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∑ m ∈ Ico 1 n, (1 : ℝ) / ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 1 - 1 / (n : ℝ) := by
      intro n hn
      induction n, hn using Nat.le_induction with
      | base => simp
      | succ n hn ih =>
        rw [Finset.sum_Ico_succ_top hn]
        have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
        have hstep : (1 : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 1 / (n : ℝ) - 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by
          rw [div_sub_div _ _ (ne_of_gt hn0) (by positivity),
            div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
          ring_nf
          nlinarith
        have hcast : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) + 1 := by push_cast; ring
        rw [hcast]
        linarith
    have h1 := key T h
    have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < (T : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h
    have : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / (T : ℝ) := by positivity
    linarith

/-! ### The good event -/

section GoodEvent

open Preorder
open scoped ENNReal NNReal

variable {K : ℕ}

theorem good_event (hK : 0 < K) (ν : Kernel (Fin K) ℝ) [IsMarkovKernel ν]
    (hrewards : ∀ a, ∀ᵐ x ∂(ν a), x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (nextA : (n : ℕ) → (Iic n → Fin K × ℝ) → Fin K) (hmeasA : ∀ n, Measurable (nextA n))
    (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) (astar : Fin K) :
    ∃ Bad : Set (ℕ → Fin K × ℝ),
      trajMeasure (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)) (stationaryEnv ν) Bad
          ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ ∧
      ∀ ω, ω ∉ Bad →
        ((∀ (b : Fin K) (n : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → n < T → cntSω b n T ω = n →
          smSω b n T ω ≤ (n : ℝ) * (ν b)[id]
            + (n : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (Real.log (2 * K * T ^ 2 / δ) / (2 * n))) ∧
        (∀ (m : ℕ), 1 ≤ m → m < T → cntSω astar m T ω = m →
          (m : ℝ) * (ν astar)[id] - smSω astar m T ω
            ≤ (m : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (Real.log (2 * ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / δ) / (2 * m)))) := by
  classical
  have hKR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (K : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hK
  have hTR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (T : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hT
  have hLarg : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (K : ℝ) * (T : ℝ) ^ 2 / δ := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hδ]; nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((T : ℝ) - 1)]
  have hLpos : 0 < Real.log (2 * (K : ℝ) * (T : ℝ) ^ 2 / δ) := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  set L := Real.log (2 * (K : ℝ) * (T : ℝ) ^ 2 / δ) with hLdef
  set Lm : ℕ → ℝ := fun m ↦ Real.log (2 * ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / δ) with hLmdef
  have hLmpos : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → 0 < Lm m := by
    intro m hm
    have hmR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm
    simp only [hLmdef]
    refine Real.log_pos ?_
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ hδ]
    nlinarith
  set g1 : ℕ → ℝ := fun n ↦ Real.sqrt (L / (2 * (n : ℝ))) with hg1def
  set g2 : ℕ → ℝ := fun m ↦ Real.sqrt (Lm m / (2 * (m : ℝ))) with hg2def
  set S1 : Fin K → ℕ → Set (ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) := fun b n ↦
    {ω | L ≤ (4 * g1 n) * (smSω b n T ω - (ν b)[id] * (cntSω b n T ω : ℝ))
      - (4 * g1 n) ^ 2 / 8 * (cntSω b n T ω : ℝ)} with hS1def
  set S2 : ℕ → Set (ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) := fun m ↦
    {ω | Lm m ≤ (-(4 * g2 m)) * (smSω astar m T ω - (ν astar)[id] * (cntSω astar m T ω : ℝ))
      - (-(4 * g2 m)) ^ 2 / 8 * (cntSω astar m T ω : ℝ)} with hS2def
  refine ⟨(⋃ b : Fin K, ⋃ n ∈ Finset.Ico 1 T, S1 b n) ∪ (⋃ m ∈ Finset.Ico 1 T, S2 m), ?_, ?_⟩
  · -- the union bound
    have hexpL : Real.exp (-L) = δ / (2 * (K : ℝ) * (T : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
      rw [hLdef, Real.exp_neg,
        Real.exp_log (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * (K : ℝ) * (T : ℝ) ^ 2 / δ), inv_div]
    have hexpLm : ∀ m : ℕ, Real.exp (-(Lm m)) = δ / (2 * ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2) := by
      intro m
      simp only [hLmdef]
      rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log (by positivity), inv_div]
    have hS1bound : ∀ (b : Fin K) (n : ℕ),
        trajMeasure (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)) (stationaryEnv ν) (S1 b n)
          ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (δ / (2 * (K : ℝ) * (T : ℝ) ^ 2)) := by
      intro b n
      simp only [hS1def]
      refine le_trans (measure_tail_bound hK ν hrewards nextA hmeasA b (4 * g1 n) n T L) ?_
      rw [hexpL]
    have hS2bound : ∀ m : ℕ,
        trajMeasure (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)) (stationaryEnv ν) (S2 m)
          ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (δ / (2 * ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2)) := by
      intro m
      simp only [hS2def]
      refine le_trans
        (measure_tail_bound hK ν hrewards nextA hmeasA astar (-(4 * g2 m)) m T (Lm m)) ?_
      rw [hexpLm m]
    have hA : trajMeasure (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)) (stationaryEnv ν)
        (⋃ b : Fin K, ⋃ n ∈ Finset.Ico 1 T, S1 b n) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (δ / 2) := by
      calc trajMeasure (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)) (stationaryEnv ν)
              (⋃ b : Fin K, ⋃ n ∈ Finset.Ico 1 T, S1 b n)
          ≤ ∑ b : Fin K, trajMeasure (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K))
              (stationaryEnv ν) (⋃ n ∈ Finset.Ico 1 T, S1 b n) :=
            measure_iUnion_fintype_le _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ b : Fin K, ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico 1 T,
              trajMeasure (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K))
                (stationaryEnv ν) (S1 b n) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ ↦ measure_biUnion_finset_le _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ _b : Fin K, ∑ _n ∈ Finset.Ico 1 T,
              ENNReal.ofReal (δ / (2 * (K : ℝ) * (T : ℝ) ^ 2)) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ ↦ Finset.sum_le_sum fun n _ ↦ hS1bound b n
        _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∑ _b : Fin K, ∑ _n ∈ Finset.Ico 1 T,
              δ / (2 * (K : ℝ) * (T : ℝ) ^ 2)) := by
            rw [ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun b _ ↦ by positivity)]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ ↦ ?_
            rw [ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun n _ ↦ by positivity)]
        _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (δ / 2) := by
            refine ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_
            simp only [Finset.sum_const, Nat.card_Ico, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
              nsmul_eq_mul]
            have h1 : ((T - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (T : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_le T 1
            have h2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ δ / (2 * (K : ℝ) * (T : ℝ) ^ 2) := by positivity
            calc (K : ℝ) * (((T - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (δ / (2 * (K : ℝ) * (T : ℝ) ^ 2)))
                ≤ (K : ℝ) * ((T : ℝ) * (δ / (2 * (K : ℝ) * (T : ℝ) ^ 2))) := by
                  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 h2)
                    (by linarith)
              _ = δ / (2 * (T : ℝ)) := by field_simp
              _ ≤ δ / 2 := by
                  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by linarith) (by norm_num)]
                  nlinarith
    have hB : trajMeasure (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)) (stationaryEnv ν)
        (⋃ m ∈ Finset.Ico 1 T, S2 m) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (δ / 2) := by
      calc trajMeasure (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)) (stationaryEnv ν)
              (⋃ m ∈ Finset.Ico 1 T, S2 m)
          ≤ ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico 1 T, trajMeasure (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K))
              (stationaryEnv ν) (S2 m) := measure_biUnion_finset_le _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico 1 T, ENNReal.ofReal (δ / (2 * ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2)) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum fun m _ ↦ hS2bound m
        _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico 1 T, δ / (2 * ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2)) := by
            rw [ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun m _ ↦ by positivity)]
        _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (δ / 2) := by
            refine ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_
            have he : ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico 1 T, δ / (2 * ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2)
                = (δ / 2) * ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico 1 T, (1 : ℝ) / ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := by
              rw [Finset.mul_sum]
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ ↦ ?_
              have : ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
              field_simp
            rw [he]
            have := sum_inv_sq_le T
            nlinarith [Finset.sum_nonneg (fun m (_ : m ∈ Finset.Ico 1 T) ↦
              (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ (1 : ℝ) / ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2))]
    calc trajMeasure (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)) (stationaryEnv ν)
            ((⋃ b : Fin K, ⋃ n ∈ Finset.Ico 1 T, S1 b n) ∪ (⋃ m ∈ Finset.Ico 1 T, S2 m))
        ≤ trajMeasure (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)) (stationaryEnv ν)
            (⋃ b : Fin K, ⋃ n ∈ Finset.Ico 1 T, S1 b n)
          + trajMeasure (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)) (stationaryEnv ν)
            (⋃ m ∈ Finset.Ico 1 T, S2 m) := measure_union_le _ _
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (δ / 2) + ENNReal.ofReal (δ / 2) := add_le_add hA hB
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal δ := by
          rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_add (by positivity) (by positivity)]
          norm_num
  · -- on the complement of the bad event both confidence bounds hold
    intro ω hω
    have hA' : ∀ (b : Fin K) (n : ℕ), n ∈ Finset.Ico 1 T → ω ∉ S1 b n := by
      intro b n hn hmem
      exact hω (Or.inl (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨b, Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨n, hn, hmem⟩⟩))
    have hB' : ∀ m : ℕ, m ∈ Finset.Ico 1 T → ω ∉ S2 m := by
      intro m hm hmem
      exact hω (Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨m, hm, hmem⟩))
    constructor
    · intro b n hn1 hnT hcnt
      have hnot := hA' b n (Finset.mem_Ico.2 ⟨hn1, hnT⟩)
      simp only [hS1def, Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_le] at hnot
      rw [hcnt] at hnot
      have hnR : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn1
      have harg : 0 < L / (2 * (n : ℝ)) := by positivity
      have hg : 0 < g1 n := by simp only [hg1def]; exact Real.sqrt_pos.2 harg
      have hgsq : (g1 n) ^ 2 = L / (2 * (n : ℝ)) := by
        simp only [hg1def]; exact Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt harg)
      have hL2 : L = 2 * (n : ℝ) * (g1 n) ^ 2 := by rw [hgsq]; field_simp
      have key : (g1 n) * (smSω b n T ω - (ν b)[id] * (n : ℝ))
          < (g1 n) * ((n : ℝ) * g1 n) := by nlinarith [hnot, hL2]
      have hlt := lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left key (le_of_lt hg)
      have hfin : smSω b n T ω ≤ (n : ℝ) * (ν b)[id] + (n : ℝ) * (g1 n) := by nlinarith
      simpa only [hg1def] using hfin
    · intro m hm1 hmT hcnt
      have hnot := hB' m (Finset.mem_Ico.2 ⟨hm1, hmT⟩)
      simp only [hS2def, Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_le] at hnot
      rw [hcnt] at hnot
      have hmR : (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm1

      have hgsq : (g2 m) ^ 2 = Lm m / (2 * (m : ℝ)) := by
        simp only [hg2def]; exact Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt harg)

lemma prob_ge_of_compl {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ : Measure α} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {S B : Set α} {r : ℝ≥0∞} (hsub : ∀ ω, ω ∉ B → ω ∈ S) (hB : μ B ≤ r) :

  have h1 : Sᶜ ⊆ B := by
    intro ω hω
    by_contra hcon
    exact hω (hsub ω hcon)
  rw [tsub_le_iff_right]
  calc (1 : ℝ≥0∞) = μ Set.univ := measure_univ.symm
    _ = μ (S ∪ Sᶜ) := by rw [Set.union_compl_self]
    _ ≤ μ S + μ Sᶜ := measure_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ μ S + r := by
        exact add_le_add (le_refl _) (le_trans (measure_mono h1) hB)

theorem ch16_theorem_16_7 {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K) (ν : Kernel (Fin K) ℝ) [IsMarkovKernel ν]
    (T : ℕ) (hKT : K ≤ T) (hT : 0 < T) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (hrewards : ∀ a, ∀ᵐ x ∂(ν a), x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (nextA : (n : ℕ) → (Iic n → Fin K × ℝ) → Fin K)
    (hmeasA : ∀ n, Measurable (nextA n))
    (hwarm : ∀ n h, n < K - 1 → nextA n h = RoundRobin.nextAction hK n)
    (hargmax : ∀ n h a, K - 1 ≤ n →
      empMean' n h a + cHat δ n h a ≤ empMean' n h (nextA n h) + cHat δ n h (nextA n h)) :
    (trajMeasure (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA ⟨0, hK⟩) (stationaryEnv ν))
        {ω : ℕ → Fin K × ℝ |
          regret ν (fun s ω => (ω s).1) T ω ≤
            (⨅ Δ₀ : {x : ℝ // 0 < x},
              ((T : ℝ) - K) * (Δ₀ : ℝ) +
                ∑ a : Fin K,
                  Set.indicator {a' : Fin K | (Δ₀ : ℝ) < gap ν a'}

            ∑ a : Fin K, gap ν a}

  classical
  have hKne : Nonempty (Fin K) := Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp hK
  obtain ⟨astar, hastar⟩ := Finite.exists_max (fun b : Fin K ↦ (ν b)[id])
  obtain ⟨Bad, hBadmeas, hBadgood⟩ :=
    good_event hK ν hrewards nextA hmeasA T hT δ hδ hδ1 astar
  have hPprob : IsProbabilityMeasure
      (trajMeasure (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)) (stationaryEnv ν)) := by
    rw [trajMeasure]; infer_instance
  set NotAct : Set (ℕ → Fin K × ℝ) := {ω | ¬((ω 0).1 = (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K) ∧
    ∀ n, (ω (n + 1)).1 = nextA n (Preorder.frestrictLe n ω))} with hNAdef
  have hae : ∀ᵐ ω ∂(trajMeasure (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)) (stationaryEnv ν)),
      (ω 0).1 = (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K) ∧
        ∀ n, (ω (n + 1)).1 = nextA n (Preorder.frestrictLe n ω) := by
    filter_upwards [ae_action_zero hK ν nextA hmeasA,
      (ae_all_iff.2 (fun n ↦ ae_action_succ hK ν nextA hmeasA n))] with ω h1 h2 using ⟨h1, h2⟩
  have hNA : (trajMeasure (detAlgorithm nextA hmeasA (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K)) (stationaryEnv ν))
      NotAct = 0 := ae_iff.1 hae
  rw [ge_iff_le, ENNReal.ofReal_sub 1 (le_of_lt hδ), ENNReal.ofReal_one]
  refine prob_ge_of_compl (B := NotAct ∪ Bad) ?_ ?_

    simp only [Set.mem_union, not_or] at hω
    obtain ⟨hω1, hω2⟩ := hω
    have hstruct : (ω 0).1 = (⟨0, hK⟩ : Fin K) ∧

targets.label: ch5_theorem_5_13
targets.statement:
Consider a finite function class \(\mathcal{F} = \{f_1, \ldots, f_d\}\), and assume that for a distribution \(\mathcal{D}\) and \(p \in [1, p]\), \(\sup_{f \in F} \|f\|_{L_p(\mathcal{D})} \leq A\). Then for \(\epsilon \leq A\):
\[
\ln M(\epsilon,\operatorname{CONV}(\mathcal{F}),L_{p}(\mathcal{D}))\leq d\ln(3 A/\epsilon).
\]

nl_proof:
Let \(B_{1} \in R^{d}\) be the \(L_{1}\) ball
\[
B_{1}=\left\{q\in R^{d}:\|q\|_{1}\leq 1\right\}.
\]
Let \(Q = \{q^1, \ldots, q^M\}\) be a maximal \(\epsilon\) \(L_1\) packing of \(B_1\). Theorem 5.3 implies that \(M \leq (3/\epsilon)^d\).
Note that for any \(q=[q_{1},\ldots,q_{d}]\in B_{1}\) , let \(q^{k}\in Q\) so that \(\| q - q^k\| _1\leq \epsilon\) , then
\[
\left[\mathbb{E}_{Z\sim\mathcal{D}}\left|\sum_{j=1}^{d}q_{j}^{k}f_{j}(Z)-\sum_{j=1}^{d}q_{j}f_{j}(Z)\right|^{p}\right]^{1/p}\leq\epsilon A.
\]
Therefore \(\left\{\sum_{j=1}^{d} q_{j}^{k} f_{j}: k = 1, \ldots, N\right\}\) is an \(\epsilon A\) \(L_{p}\)-cover of \(\mathrm{CONV}(F)\). The result follows.

context.name: theorem 5.3
context.statement:
Let \(\| \cdot \|\) be a seminorm on \(\mathbb{R}^k\). Let \(B(r) = \{z \in \mathbb{R}^k : \| z \| \leq r\}\) be the \(\| \cdot \|\)-ball with radius \(r\). Then
\[
M(\epsilon,B(r),\|\cdot\|)\leq\left(1+2 r/\epsilon\right)^{k}.
\]
Moreover, if \(\| \cdot \|\) is a norm, then
\[
N(\epsilon,B(r),\|\cdot\|)\geq(r/\epsilon)^{k}.
\]

context.name: definition 5.12
context.statement:
The convex hull of a function class \(\mathcal{F} = \{f(\theta, x) : \theta \in \Theta\}\) is defined as
\[
\operatorname{CONV}(\mathcal{F})=\left\{\sum_{j=1}^{m}w_{j}f\left(\theta_{j},x\right):m>0,\|w\|_{1}=1,w_{j}\geq 0,\theta_{j}\in\Theta\right\}.
\]
We also include the closure of the finite sum functions above with respect to an appropriate topology in the convex hull.

context.name: Packing Number
context.statement:
Let \((\mathcal{V},d)\) be a pseudometric space with metric \(d(\cdot,\cdot)\). A finite subset \(\mathcal{G}(\epsilon)\subset \mathcal{G}\) is an \(\epsilon\)-packing of \(\mathcal{G}\) if \(d(\phi,\phi^{\prime})>\epsilon\) for all \(\phi,\phi^{\prime}\in\mathcal{G}(\epsilon)\). The \(\epsilon\)-packing number of \(\mathcal{G}\), denoted by \(M(\epsilon,\mathcal{G},d)\), is the largest cardinality of \(\epsilon\)-packing of \(\mathcal{G}\).
The following results illustrate the equivalence between covering number and packing number. One advantage of using an \(\epsilon\) packing of \(\mathcal{G}\) instead of an \(\epsilon\) cover of \(\mathcal{G}\) is that all members in the \(\epsilon\) packing also belong to \(\mathcal{G}\). There if members in \(\mathcal{G}\) satisfy certain assumptions such as the variance condition, then members of its \(\epsilon\) packing also satisfy such assumptions. For this reason, we will use packing numbers instead of covering numbers in some of the theoretical analysis in later chapters.

context.name: Bracketing Number
context.statement:
Let \(\mathcal{G} = \{\phi(w, \cdot) : w \in \Omega\}\) be a real-valued function class, equipped with a pseudometric \(d\). We say
\[
\mathcal{G}(\epsilon)=\left\{\left[\phi_{1}^{L}(z),\phi_{1}^{U}(z)\right],\dots,\left[\phi_{N}^{L}(z),\phi_{N}^{U}(z)\right]\right\}
\]
is an \(\epsilon\)-bracket of \(\mathcal{G}\) under metric \(d\) if for all \(w \in \Omega\), there exists \(j = j(w)\) such that \(\forall z\):
\[
\phi_{j}^{L}(z)\leq\phi(w,z)\leq\phi_{j}^{U}(z),\quad d(\phi_{j}^{L},\phi_{j}^{U})\leq\epsilon .
\]
The \(\epsilon\)-bracketing number is the smallest cardinality \(N_{\mathbb{I}}(\epsilon, \mathcal{G}, d)\) of such \(\mathcal{G}(\epsilon)\). The quantity \(\ln N_{\mathbb{I}}(\epsilon, \mathcal{G}, d)\) is called \(\epsilon\) bracketing entropy.
In particular, given a distribution \(\mathcal{D}\) and \(p \geq 1\), we define \(L_{p}\)-seminorm in function space as
\[
\left\|f-f^{\prime}\right\|_{L_{p}(\mathcal{D})}=\left[\mathbb{E}_{Z\sim\mathcal{D}}|f(Z)-f^{\prime}(Z)|^{p}\right]^{1/p}.\tag{3.19}
\]
It induces a pseudometric, denoted as \( d = L_{p}(\mathcal{D}) \), and the corresponding bracketing number is \( N_{\parallel}(\epsilon, \mathcal{G}, L_{p}(\mathcal{D})) \).
For \(p = \infty\), the \(L_{\infty}(\mathcal{D})\)-seminorm is defined as the essential supremum seminorm, which leads to the pseudometric
\[
d(f,f^{\prime})=\inf\left\{\omega:\Pr_{\mathcal{D}}[|f(Z)-f^{\prime}(Z)|\leq\omega]=1\right\}.
\]
However, when \( p = \infty \), instead of using the \( L_{\infty} \) bracketing number, it is more conventional to use the equivalent notion of \( L_{\infty} \) covering number (see Proposition 4.3).

import Mathlib

open MeasureTheory Real ENNReal

namespace GraduateLevel

def IsPacking {A : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace A] (t : Finset A) (eps : ℝ) (s : Set A) : Prop :=
  ↑t ⊆ s ∧ (↑t : Set A).Pairwise fun x y => eps < dist x y

private theorem card_le_volume_bound
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (s : Finset E) (A ε : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεA : ε ≤ A)
    (hs : ∀ x ∈ s, ‖x‖ ≤ A)
    (hsep : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, x ≠ y → ε < ‖x - y‖) :
    (s.card : ℝ) ≤ (3 * A / ε) ^ Module.finrank ℝ E := by
  borelize E
  let μ : Measure E := Measure.addHaar
  let δ : ℝ := ε / 2
  let ρ : ℝ := 3 * A / 2
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by dsimp [δ]; linarith
  have hρ : 0 < ρ := by dsimp [ρ]; linarith
  set U := ⋃ x ∈ s, Metric.ball (x : E) δ with hU
  have hdisj : Set.Pairwise (s : Set E)
      (Function.onFun Disjoint fun x => Metric.ball (x : E) δ) := by
    rintro x hx y hy hxy
    apply Metric.ball_disjoint_ball
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    have h := hsep x hx y hy hxy
    dsimp [δ]
    linarith
  have hsub : U ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E) ρ := by
    rw [hU]
    refine Set.iUnion₂_subset fun x hx => ?_
    apply Metric.ball_subset_ball'
    calc
      δ + dist x 0 ≤ δ + A := by
        rw [dist_zero_right]
        gcongr
        exact hs x hx
      _ ≤ ρ := by
        dsimp [δ, ρ]
        linarith
  have hmeasure :
      (s.card : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (δ ^ Module.finrank ℝ E) *
          μ (Metric.ball 0 1) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ Module.finrank ℝ E) * μ (Metric.ball 0 1) := by
    calc
      (s.card : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (δ ^ Module.finrank ℝ E) *
            μ (Metric.ball 0 1) =
          μ U := by
            rw [hU, measure_biUnion_finset hdisj fun x _ => measurableSet_ball]
            simp only [μ.addHaar_ball_of_pos _ hδ]
            simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]
      _ ≤ μ (Metric.ball (0 : E) ρ) := measure_mono hsub
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ Module.finrank ℝ E) * μ (Metric.ball 0 1) := by
        simp only [μ.addHaar_ball_of_pos _ hρ]
  have hcancel :
      (s.card : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (δ ^ Module.finrank ℝ E) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ Module.finrank ℝ E) :=
    (ENNReal.mul_le_mul_iff_left
      (Metric.measure_ball_pos μ (0 : E) zero_lt_one).ne'
      (measure_ball_lt_top (μ := μ) (x := (0 : E)) (r := 1)).ne).1 hmeasure
  have hreal :
      (s.card : ℝ) * δ ^ Module.finrank ℝ E ≤ ρ ^ Module.finrank ℝ E := by
    have := (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal
      (ENNReal.mul_ne_top (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top s.card)
        (ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top :
          ENNReal.ofReal (δ ^ Module.finrank ℝ E) ≠ ⊤))
      (ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top :
        ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ Module.finrank ℝ E) ≠ ⊤)).2 hcancel
    simpa [ENNReal.toReal_mul, hδ.le, hρ.le] using this
  have hδpow : 0 < δ ^ Module.finrank ℝ E := pow_pos hδ _
  calc
    (s.card : ℝ) ≤ ρ ^ Module.finrank ℝ E / δ ^ Module.finrank ℝ E :=
      (le_div_iff₀ hδpow).2 hreal
    _ = (3 * A / ε) ^ Module.finrank ℝ E := by
      rw [← div_pow]
      dsimp [ρ, δ]
      congr 1
      field_simp

theorem ch5_theorem_5_13
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (D : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure D]
    (d : ℕ)
    (p : ℝ≥0∞) [Fact (1 ≤ p)] (hp_top : p ≠ ⊤)
    (f : Fin d → Lp ℝ p D)
    (A : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A)
    (hbound : ∀ j, ‖f j‖ ≤ A)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεA : ε ≤ A)
    (Q : Finset (Lp ℝ p D))
    (hQpack : IsPacking Q ε (convexHull ℝ (Set.range f))) :
    Real.log (Q.card : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ) * Real.log (3 * A / ε) := by
  classical
  let V : Submodule ℝ (Lp ℝ p D) := Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range f)
  letI : FiniteDimensional ℝ V := by
    dsimp [V]
    exact FiniteDimensional.span_of_finite ℝ (Set.finite_range f)
  have hconv_span : convexHull ℝ (Set.range f) ⊆ (V : Set (Lp ℝ p D)) := by
    apply convexHull_min
    · exact Submodule.subset_span
    · exact V.convex
  have hconv_ball :
      convexHull ℝ (Set.range f) ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : Lp ℝ p D) A := by
    apply convexHull_min
    · rintro x ⟨j, rfl⟩
      exact mem_closedBall_zero_iff.mpr (hbound j)
    · exact convex_closedBall 0 A
  let emb : {x // x ∈ Q} ↪ V :=
    { toFun := fun q => ⟨q.1, hconv_span (hQpack.1 q.2)⟩
      inj' := by
        intro x y h
        cases x with
        | mk x hx =>
          cases y with
          | mk y hy =>
            simp_all }
  let s : Finset V := Q.attach.map emb
  have hscard : s.card = Q.card := by
    simp [s]
  have hs_norm : ∀ x ∈ s, ‖x‖ ≤ A := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Finset.mem_map] at hx
    obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := hx
    change ‖(q.1 : Lp ℝ p D)‖ ≤ A
    exact mem_closedBall_zero_iff.mp (hconv_ball (hQpack.1 q.2))
  have hs_sep : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, x ≠ y → ε < ‖x - y‖ := by
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    rw [Finset.mem_map] at hx hy
    obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ := hy
    have hqr : q.1 ≠ r.1 := by
      intro h
      apply hxy
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact h
    simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hQpack.2 q.2 r.2 hqr
  let F : Finset (Lp ℝ p D) := Finset.univ.image f
  have hFrange : (↑F : Set (Lp ℝ p D)) = Set.range f := by
    ext x
    simp [F]
  have hfinrank : Module.finrank ℝ V ≤ d := by
    change Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range f)) ≤ d
    rw [← hFrange]
    exact (finrank_span_finset_le_card F).trans
      (Finset.card_image_le.trans (by simp))
  have hcard :
      (Q.card : ℝ) ≤ (3 * A / ε) ^ Module.finrank ℝ V := by
    rw [← hscard]
    exact card_le_volume_bound s A ε hA hε hεA hs_norm hs_sep
  have hbase : 1 ≤ 3 * A / ε := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hε).2
    linarith
  have hlogbase : 0 ≤ Real.log (3 * A / ε) := Real.log_nonneg hbase
  by_cases hQ : Q = ∅
  · subst Q
    simp only [Finset.card_empty, Nat.cast_zero, Real.log_zero]
    exact mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg d) hlogbase
  · have hcardpos : 0 < (Q.card : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr (Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hQ)
    calc
      Real.log (Q.card : ℝ) ≤
          Real.log ((3 * A / ε) ^ Module.finrank ℝ V) :=
        Real.log_le_log hcardpos hcard
      _ = (Module.finrank ℝ V : ℝ) * Real.log (3 * A / ε) := by
        rw [Real.log_pow]
      _ ≤ (d : ℝ) * Real.log (3 * A / ε) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hfinrank) hlogbase

end GraduateLevel
